text.body:
manusmṛtiḥ
kullūkabhaṭṭakṛtamanvarthamuktāvalīsaṃvalitā
prathamo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
manum ekāgram āsīnam abhigamya maharṣayaḥ |
pratipūjya yathānyāyam idaṃ vacanam abruvan || 1.1 ||
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya |
gauḍe nandanavāsināmni sujanair vandye varendryāṃ kule
śrīmadbhaṭṭadivākarasya tanayaḥ kullūkabhaṭṭo ‘bhavat |
kāśyām uttaravāhijahnutanayātīre samaṃ paṇḍitais
teneyaṃ kriyate hitāya viduṣāṃ manvarthamuktāvalī ||1||
sarvajñasya manor asarvavid api vyākhyāmi yad vāṅmayaṃ
yuktyā tad bahubhir yato munivarair etad bahu vyāhṛtam |
tāṃ vyākhyām adhunātanair api kṛtāṃ nyāyyāṃ bruvāṇasya me
bhaktyā mānavavākmaye bhavabhide bhūyād aśeṣeśvaraḥ ||2||
mīmāṃse bahu sevitāsi suhṛdas tarkāḥ samāstāḥ stha me
vekāntāḥ paramātmabodhaguravo yūyaṃ mayopāsitāḥ |
jātā vyākaraṇāni bālasakhitā yuṣmābhir abhyarthaye
prāpto ‘yaṃ samayo manūktavivṛtau sāhāyyam ālambyatām ||3||
dveṣādidoṣarahitasya satāṃ hitāya
manvarthatattvakathanāya mamodyatasya |
daivād yadi kvacid iha skhalanaṃ tathāpi
nistārako bhavatu me jagadantarātmā ||4||
mānavavṛttāv asyāṃ jñeyā vyākhyā navā manodbhinnā |
prācīnā api rucirā vyākhyātṝṇām aśeṣāṇām ||5||
manum ekāgram āsīnam ityādi | atra maharṣīṇāṃ dharmaviṣayapraśne manoḥ “śrūyatāṃ” (1.4) ity uttaradānapartantaślokacatuṣṭayenaitasya śāstrasya prekṣāvat pravṛttyupayuktāni viṣayasaṃbandhaprayojanāny | tatra dharma eva viṣayaḥ | tena saha vacanasaṃdarbharūpasya mānavaśāstrasya pratipādyapratipādakalakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | pramāṇāntarāsannikṛṣṭasya svargāpavargādisādhanasya dharmasya śāstraikagamyatvāt | prayojanaṃ tu svargāpavargādi, tasya dharmādhīnatvāt | yady api patnyupagamanādirūpaḥ kāmo ‘py atrābhihitas tathāpi “ṛtukālābhigāmī syāt svadāranirataḥ sadā” (3.45) ity ṛtukālādiniyamena so ‘pi dharma eva | evaṃ cārthārjanam api “ṛtāmṛtābhyāṃ jīveta” (4.4) ityādiniyamena dharma evety avagantavyam | mokṣopāyatvenābhihitasyātmajñānasyāpi dharmatvād dharmaviṣayatvaṃ mokṣopadeśakatvaṃ cāsya śāstropapannam | pauruṣeyatve ‘pi manuvākyānām avigītamahājanaparigrahāc chrutyupagrahāc ca vedamūlakatayā prāmāṇyam | tathā ca chāndogabrāhmaṇe śrūyate – “manur vai yat kiṃcid avadat tad bheṣajaṃ bheṣajatāyāḥ” iti | bṛhaspatir apy āha:
vedārthopanibaddhatvāt prādhānyaṃ manoḥ smṛtam |
manvarthaviparītā tu yā smṛtiḥ sā na śasyate ||
tāvac chāstrāṇi śobhante tarkavyākaraṇāni ca |
dharmārthamokṣopadeṣṭā manur yāvan na dṛśyate ||
mahābhārate ‘py uktam |
purāṇaṃ mānavo dharmaḥ sāṅgo vedaś cikitsitam |
ājñāsiddhāni catvāri na hantavyāni hetubhiḥ ||
virodhibauddhāditarkair na hantavyāni | anukūlas tu mīmāṃsāditarkaḥ pravartanīya eva | ata eva vakṣyati (12.106):
ārṣaṃ dharmopadeśaṃ ca vedaśāstrāvirodhinā |
yas tarkeṇānusaṃdhatte sa dharmaṃ veda netaraḥ || iti |
sakalavedārthādimananān manuṃ maharṣaya idaṃ dvitīyaślokavākyarūpam ucyate ‘neneti vacanam abruvan | ślokasyādau manunirdeśo maṅgalārthaḥ | parātmana eva saṃsārasthitaye sārvajñyaiśvaryādisaṃpannam anurūpeṇa prādurbhūtatvāt tadabhidhānasya maṅgalātiśayatvāt | vakṣyati hi (12.123):
enam eke vadanty agniṃ manum anye prajāpatim | iti |
ekāgraṃ viṣayāntarāvyākṣiptacittam | āsīnaṃ sukhopaviṣṭam | īdṛśasyaiva maharṣipraśnottaradānayogyatvāt | abhigamyābhimukhaṃ gatvā | maharṣayo mahāntaś ca ye ṛṣayaś ceti tathā | pratipūjya pūjayitvā | yad vā manunā pūrvaṃ svāgatāsanadānādinā pūjitās tasya pūjāṃ kṛtveti pratiśabdād unnīyate | yathānyāyaṃ yena nyāyena vidhānena praśnaḥ kartuṃ yujyate praṇatibhaktiśraddhātiśayādinā | vakṣyati ca (2.110):
nāpṛṣṭaḥ kasyacid brūyān na cānyāyena pṛcchataḥ | iti |
“abhigamya, pratipūjya, abruvan” iti kriyātraye ‘pi manum ity eva karma | abruvann ity atrākathitakarmatā | bruvidhātor dvikarmakatvāt || 1 ||
kim abruvann ity apekṣāyām āha –
bhagavan sarvavarṇānāṃ yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ |
antaraprabhavāṇāṃ ca dharman no vaktum arhasi || 1.2 ||
bhagavann ityādi | aiśvaryādīnāṃ bhagaśabdo vācakaḥ | tad uktaṃ viṣṇupurāṇe:
aiśvaryasya samagrasya vīryasya yaśasaḥ śriyaḥ |
jñānavairāgyayoś caiva ṣaṇṇāṃ bhaga itīṅganā || iti |
matubantena saṃbodhanaṃ bhagavann iti | varṇā brāḥmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrāḥ | sarve ca te varṇāś ceti sarvavarṇāḥ, teṣām antaraprabhavāṇāṃ ca saṃkīrṇajātīnāṃ cāpi anulomapratilomajātānāṃ ambaṣṭhakṣattṛkarṇaprabhṛtīnāṃ teṣāṃ vijātīyamaithunasaṃbhavatvena kharaturagīyasaṃparkāj jātāśvataravaj jātyantaratvād varṇaśabdenāgrahaṇāt pṛthak praśnaḥ | etenāsya śāstrasya sarvopakārakatvaṃ darśitam | yathāvat yo dharmo yasya varṇasya yena prakāreṇārhatīty anenāśramadharmādīnām api praśnaḥ | anupūrvaśaḥ krameṇa jātakarma, tadanu nāmadheyam ityādinā | dharmān no ‘smabhyaṃ vaktum arhasi sarvadharmābhidhāne yogyo bhavasi tasmād brūhīty adhyeṣaṇam adhyāhāryam | yat tu brahmahatyādirūpādharmakīrtanam apy atra tat prāyaścittavidhirūpadharmaviṣayatvena na svatantratayā || 2 ||
sakaladharmābhidhānayogyatve hetum āha –
tvam eko hy asya sarvasya vidhānasya svayaṃbhuvaḥ |
acintyasyāprameyasya kāryatattvārthavit prabho || 1.3 ||
tvam eka ityādinā | hiśabdo hetau | yasmāt tvam eko ‘dvitīyaḥ asya sarvasya pratyakṣaśrutasya smṛtyādyanumeyasya ca vidhānasya vidhīyante ‘nena karmāṇy agnihotrādīnīti vidhānaṃ vedas tasya svayaṃbhuvo ‘pauruṣeyasyācintyasya bahuśākhāvibhinnatvād iyattayā paricchetum ayogyasya, aprameyasya mīmāṃsādinyāyanirapekṣatayānavagamyamānaprameyasya, kāryam anuṣṭheyam agniṣṭomādi, tattaṃ brahma “satyaṃ jñānam anantaṃ brahma” (Taitt Up 2.1.1) ityādi vedāntavedyaṃ tad evārthaḥ pratipādyabhāgas taṃ vettīti kāryatattvārthavit | medhātithis tu karmamīmāṃsāvāsanayā vedasya kāryam eva tattvarūpo ‘rthas taṃ vettīti kāryatattvārthavid iti vyācaṣṭe | dharmādharmavyavasthāpanasamarthatvāt prabho iti saṃbodhanam || 3 ||
sa taiḥ pṛṣṭas tathā samyag amitaujā mahātmabhiḥ |
pratyuvācārcya tān sarvān maharṣīñ chrūyatām iti || 1.4 ||
sa taiḥ pṛṣṭas tathā samyag ityādi | sa manus tair maharṣibhis tathā tena prakāreṇa pūrvoktena nyāyena praṇatibhaktiśraddhātiśayādinā pṛṣṭas tān samyag yathātattvaṃ pratyuvāca śrūyatām ity upakramya | amitam aparicchedam ojaḥ sāmārthyaṃ jñānatattvābhidhānādau yasya sa tathā | ata eva sarvajñasarvaśaktitayā maharṣīṇām api praśnaviṣayaḥ | mahātmabhir mahānubhāvaiḥ | ārcya pūjayitvā | āṅpūrvasyārcater lyabantasya rūpam idam | dharmasyābhidhānam api pūjanapuraḥsaram eva kartavyam ity anena phalitam |
nanu manupraṇītatve 'sya śāstrasya “sa pṛṣṭaḥ pratyuvāca” iti na yuktam, “ahaṃ pṛṣṭo bravīmi” iti yujyate | anyapraṇītatve ca kathaṃ mānavīyasaṃhiteti?
ucyate | prāyeṇācāryāṇām śailī yat svābhiprāyam api paropadeśam iva varṇayanti | ata eva “karmāṇy api jaiminiḥ phalārthatvāt” (Jai. Nyā. Sū. 3.1.4) iti jaiminer eva sūtram | ata eva “tadupary api bādarāyaṇaḥ saṃbhavāt” (brah. sū. 1.3.26) iti bādarāyaṇasyaiva śārīrakasūtram | atha vā manūpadiṣṭā dharmās tacchiṣyeṇa bhṛguṇā tadājñayopanibaddhāḥ | ata eva vakṣyati (1.59): “etad vo ‘yaṃ bhṛguḥ śāstraṃ śrāvayiṣyaty aśeṣataḥ” iti | ato yujyata eva sa pṛṣṭaḥ pratyuvceti | manūpadiṣṭadharmopanibaddhatvāc ca mānavīyasaṃhitety vyapadeśaḥ || 4 ||
śrūyatām ity upakṣiptam artham āha –
āsīd idaṃ tamobhūtam aprajñātam alakṣaṇam |
apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ prasuptam iva sarvataḥ || 1.5 ||
āsīd idam iti |
nanu munīnāṃ dharmaviṣayapraśne tatraivottaraṃ dātum ucitam | tat ko ‘yam aprastutaḥ pralayadaśāyāṃ kāraṇalīnasya jagataḥ sṛṣṭiprakaraṇāvatāraḥ | atra medhātithiḥ samādadhe:
śāstrasya mahāprayojatvam anena sarveṇa pratipādyate | brahmādyāḥ sthāvaraparyantāḥ saṃsāragatayo dharmādharmanimittā atra pratipādyante –
tamasā bahurūpeṇa veṣṭitāḥ karmahetunā | iti | (MDh 1.49)
vakṣyati ca:
etā dṛṣṭvā tu jīvasya gatīḥ svenaiva cetasā |
dharmato 'dharmataś caiva dharme dadhyāt sadā manaḥ || iti | (MDh 12.23)
tataś ca niratiśayaiśvaryahetur dharmas tadviparītaś cādharmas tadrūpaparijñānārtham idaṃ śāstraṃ mahāprayojanam adhyetavyam ity adhyāyatātparyam | (Medh. transcription, p. 10)
ityantena | govindarājasyāpīdam eva samādhānam | naitan manoharam | dharmasvarūpapraśne yad dharmasya phalakīrtanaṃ tad apy aprastutam | dharmoktimātrād dhi śāstram arthavat | kiṃ ca
karmaṇāṃ phalanirvṛttiṃ śaṃsety ukte maharṣibhiḥ |
dvādaśe vakṣyamāṇā sā vaktum ādau na yujyate ||
idaṃ tu vadāmaḥ | munīnāṃ dharmaviṣaye praśne jagatkāraṇatayā brahmapratipādanaṃ dharmakathanam eveti nāprastutābhidhānam, ātmajñānasyāpi dharmarūpatvāt | manunaiva (6.92),
dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo ‘steyaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
dhīr vidyā satyam akrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam ||
iti daśavidhadharmābhidhāne vidyāśabdavācyam ātmajñānaṃ dharmatvenoktam | mahābhārate ‘pi,
ātmajñānaṃ titikṣā ca dharmaḥ sādhāraṇo nṛpa |
ity ātmajñānaṃ dharmatvenoktam | yājñavalkyena tu paramadharmatvena yad uktam,
ijyācāradamāhiṃsādānasvādhyāyakarmaṇām |
ayaṃ tu paramo dharmo yad yogenātmadarśanam || (YDh 1.8)
jagatkāraṇatvaṃ ca brahmalakṣaṇam | ata eva brahmamīmāṃsāyām (Br. Sū. 1.1.1): “athāto brahmajijñāsā” itisūtrānantaraṃ brahmalakṣaṇakathanāta “janmādy asya yataḥ” (Br. Sū 1.1.2) iti dvitīyasūtraṃ bhagavān bādarāyaṇaḥ praṇināya | asya jagato yato janmādi sṛṣṭisthitilayam iti sūtrārthaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Taitt. 3.1) “yato vā imāni bhūtāni jāyante | yena jātāni jīvanti | yat prayanty abhisaṃviśanti | tad vijijñāsasva | tad brahmeti” iti prādhānyena jagadutpattisthitilaya-nimittopādānabrahmapratipādanam | ātmajñānasvarūpaparamadharmāvagamāya prathamādhyāyaṃ kṛtvā saṃskārādirūpaṃ dharmaṃ tadaṅgatayā dvitīyādhyādādikrameṇa vakṣyatīti na kaścid virodhaḥ | kiṃ ca praśnottaravākyānām eva svārasyād ayaṃ madukto ‘rtho labhyate | tathā hi –
dharme pṛṣṭe manur brahma jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ bruvan |
ātmajñānaṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ vitteti vaktum uktavān ||
prādhānyāt prathamādhyāye sādhu tasyaiva kīrtitam |
dharmo ‘nyas tu tadaṅgatvād yukto vaktum anantaram ||
idam ity adhyakṣeṇa sarvasya pratibhāsamānatvāj jagan nirdiśyate | idaṃ jagat tamobhūtaṃ tamasi sthitaṃ līnam āsīt | tamaḥśabdena guṇavṛttyā prakṛtir nirdiśyate | tama iva tamaḥ | yathā tamasi līnāḥ padārthā adhyakṣeṇa na prakāśyanta evaṃ prakṛtilīnā api bhāvā nāvagamyanta iti guṇayogaḥ | pralayakāle sūkṣmarūpatayā prakṛtau līnam āsīd ity arthaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ (RV 8.7.17): “tama āsīt tamasā gūḷham agre” iti prakṛtur api brahmātmanāvyākṛtāsīt | ata eva aprajñātam apratyakṣaṃ sakalapramāṇaśreṣṭhatayā pratyakṣagocaraḥ prajñāta ity ucyate, tan na bhavatīty aprajñātam | alakṣaṇam ananumeyaṃ lakṣyate ‘neneti lakṣaṇaṃ liṅgam, tad as astīti alakṣaṇam apratarkyaṃ tarkayitum aśakyaṃ tadānīṃ vācakasthūlaśabdābhāvāc chabdato ‘py avijñeyam | etad eva pramāṇatrayaṃ satarkaṃ dvādaśādhyāye manunābhyupagatam ata evāvijñeyam ity arthāpattyādyagocaram iti dharaṇīdharasyāpi vyākhyātam | na ca nāsīd eveti vācyam | tadānīṃ śrutisiddhatvāt | tathā ca śrūyate (Bṛ 1.4.7) – “tad dheyaṃ tarhy avyākṛtam āsīt” | chāndogyopaniṣac ca (6.2.1) – “sad eva saumyedam agra āsīt” | idaṃ jagat sad evāsīt | brahmātmanā āsīd ity arthaḥ | sacchabdo brahmavācakaḥ | ata eva prasuptam iva sarvataḥ | prathamārthe tasiḥ | svakāryākṣamam ity arthaḥ || 5 ||
atha kim abhūd ity āha –
tataḥ svayaṃbhūr bhagavān avyakto vyañjayann idam |
mahābhūtādi vṛttaujāḥ prādur āsīt tamonudaḥ || 1.6 ||
tataḥ svayaṃbhūr bhagavān ityādi | tataḥ pralayāvasānānantaraṃ svayaṃbhūḥ paramātmā svayaṃ bhavati svecchayā śarīraparigrahaṃ karoti, na tv itarajīvavat karmāyattadehaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Chānd. 7.26.2): “sa ekadhā bhavati dvidhā bhavati” | bhagavān aiśvaryādisaṃpannaḥ | avyakto bāhyakaraṇāgocaraḥ | yogābhyāsāvaseya iti yāvat | idaṃ mahābhūtādi | ākāśādīni mahābhūtāni | ādigrahaṇān mahadādīni ca vyañjayann avyaktāvasthaṃ prathamaṃ sūkṣmarūpeṇa tataḥ sthūlarūpeṇa prakāśayan | vṛttaujāḥ vṛttam apratihatam ucyate | ata eva “vṛttisargatāyaneṣu kramaḥ” (Pāṇ 1.3.38) ity atra vṛttir apratighāta iti vyākhyātaṃ jayādityena | vṛttam apratihatam ojaḥ sṛṣṭisāmarthyaṃ yasya sa tathā | tamonudaḥ prakṛtiprerakaḥ | tad uktaṃ bhagavatgītāyām (9.10):
mayādhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram | iti |
prādur āsīt prakāśaito babhūva | tamonudaḥ pralayāvasthādhvaṃsaka iti medhātithi-govindarājau || 6 ||
yo ‘sāv atīndriyagrāhyaḥ sūkṣmo ‘vyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ |
sarvabhūtamayo ‘cintyaḥ sa eva svayam udbabhau || 1.7 ||
yo ‘sāv iti | yo ‘sāv iti sarvanāmadvayena sakalalokavedapurāṇetihāsādiprasiddhaṃ paramātmānaṃ nirdiśati | atīndriyagrāhyaḥ indiryam atītya vartata ity atīndriyaṃ manas tad grāhya ity arthaḥ | yad āha vyāsaḥ |
naivāsau cakṣuṣā grāhyo na ca śiṣṭair apīndriyaiḥ |
manasā tu prayatnena gṛhyate sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ ||
sūkṣmo bahirindriyāgocaraḥ | avyakto vyaktir avayavas tadrahitaḥ | sanātano nityaḥ | sarvabhūtamayaḥ sarvabhūtātmā | ata evācintyaḥ iyattayā paricchetum aśakyaḥ | sa eva svayam udbabau mahadādikāryarūpatayā prādur babhūva | ut pūrvo bhātiḥ prādurbhāve vartate, dhātūnām anekārthatvāt || 1.7 ||
so ‘bhidhyāya śarīrāt svāt sisṛkṣur vividhāḥ prajāḥ |
apa eva sasarjādau tāsu bījam avāsṛjat || 1.8 ||
so ‘bhidhyāyeti | sa paramātmā nānāvidhāḥ prajāḥ sisṛkṣur abhidhyāya “āpo jāyantām” ity abhidhyānamātreṇāpa eva sasarja | abhidhyānapūrvikāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ vadato manoḥ prakṛtir evācetanāsvatantrā pariṇamata ity ayaṃ pakṣo na saṃmataḥ, kiṃ tu brahmaivāvyākṛtaśaktyātmanā jagatkāraṇam iti tridaṇḍivedāntasiddhānta evābhimataḥ pratibhāti | tathā ca chāndogyopaniṣat (6.2.3): “tad aikṣata bahu syāṃ prajāyeya” iti | ata eva śārīrakasūtrakṛtā vyāsena siddhāntitam: “īkṣater nāśabdam” (Br. Sū. 1.1.5) iti | īkṣater īkṣaṇaśravaṇān na pradhānaṃ jagatkāraṇam | aśabdaṃ na vidyate śabdaḥ śrutir yasya tad aśabdam iti sūtrārthaḥ | svāc charīrād avyākṛtarūpād avyākṛtam eva bhagavadbhāskarīyavedāntadarśane prakṛtiḥ, tad eva tasya ca śarīram, anyākṛtaśabdena pañcabhūtabuddhīndriyakarmendriyaprāṇamanaḥkarmāvidyāvāsanā eva sūkṣmarūpatayā śaktyātmanā sthitā abhidhīyante | avyākṛtasya ca brahmaṇā saha bhedābhedasvīkārād brahmādvaitam, śaktyātmanā ca brahma jagadrūpatayā pariṇamata ity ubhayam apy upapadyate | ādau svakāryabhūtabrahmāṇḍasṛṣṭeḥ prāk | apāṃ sṛṣṭiś ceyaṃ mahadahaṃkāratanmātrakrameṇa boddhavyā | “mahābhūtādi vyañjayan” (1.6) iti pūrvābhidhānād anantaram api mahadādisṛṣṭer vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tāsv apsu bījaṃ śaktirūpaṃ āropitavān || 1.8 ||
tad aṇḍam abhavad dhaimaṃ sahasrāṃśusamaprabham |
tasmiñ jajñe svayaṃ brahmā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ || 1.9 ||
tad aṇḍam abhavad dhaimam iti | tad bījaṃ parameśvarecchayā haimam aṇḍam abhavat | haimam iva haimaṃ śuddhiguṇayogan na tu haimam eva, tadīyaikaśakalena bhūminirmāṇasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | bhūmeś cahaimatvasya pratyakṣatvād upacārāśrayaṇam | sahasrāṃśur ādityas tattulyaprabham | tasminn aṇḍe hiraṇyagarbho jātavān | yena pūrvajanmani hiraṇyagarbho ‘ham asmīti bhedābhedabhāvanayā parameśvaropāsanā kṛtā tadīyaṃ liṅgaśarīrāvacchinnajīvam anupraviśya svayaṃ paramātmaiva hiraṇyagarbharūpatayā prādur bhūtaḥ | sarvalokānāṃ pitāmaho janakaḥ | sarvalokapitāmaha iti vā tasya nāma || 1.9 ||
idānīm āgamaprasiddhanārāyaṇaśabdārthanirvacanenoktam evārthaṃ draḍhayati –
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ |
tā yad asyāyanaṃ pūrvaṃ tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1.10 ||
āpo nārā ityādi | āpo nārāśabdenocyante | apsu nārāśabdasyāprasiddhes tadartham āha – yatas tā narākhyasya paramātmanaḥ sūnavo ‘patyāni | “asyedam” (Pāṇ 4.3.120) ity aṇpratyayaḥ | yady api aṇi kṛte ṅīppratyayaḥ prāptas tathāpi chāndasalakṣaṇair api smṛtiṣu vyavahārāt “sarve vidhayaś chandasi vikalpyante” (Pari. 26) pākṣiko ṅīppratyayas tasyābhāvapakṣe sāmānyalakṣaṇaprāpte ṭāpi kṛte nārā iti rūpasiddhiḥ | āpo ‘sya paramātmano brahmarūpeṇāvasthitasya pūrvam ayanam āśraya ity asau nārāyaṇa ity āgameṣv āmnātaḥ | govindarājena tu “āpo nārāḥ” iti paṭhitaṃ vyākhyātaṃ ca – nārāyaṇa iti prāpte “anyeṣām api dṛśyate” (Pāṇ 6.3.137) iti dīrghatvena nārāyaṇa iti rūpam iti | anye tu “āpo nārāḥ” iti paṭhanti
|| 1.10 ||
yat tat kāraṇam avyaktaṃ nityaṃ sadasadātmakam |
tadvisṛṣṭaḥ sa puruṣo loke brahmeti kīrtyate || 1.11 ||
yat tat kāraṇam avyaktam iti | yat tad iti sarvanāmabhyāṃ lokavedādisarvaprasiddhaṃ paramātmānaṃ nirdiśati | kāraṇaṃ sarvotpattimatām | avyaktaṃ bahirindriyāgocaram | nityam utpattivināśarahitam | vedāntasiddhatvāt satsvabhāvam pratyakṣādyagocaratvād asatsvabhāvam iva | atha vā sadbhāvajātam asadbhāvas tayor ātmabhūtam | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Chand. 6.8.7) – “aitadātmyam idaṃ sarvam” iti | tadvisṛṣṭas tenotpāditaḥ sa puruṣaḥ sarvatra brahmeti kīrtyate || 1.11 ||
tasminn aṇḍe sa bhagavān uṣitvā parivatsaram |
svayam evātmano dhyānāt tad aṇḍam akarod dvidhā || 1.12 ||
tasminn aṇḍe sa bhagavān ityādi | tasmin pūrvokte ‘ṇḍe sa brahmā vakṣyamāṇabrahmamānena saṃvatsaram uṣitvā sthitvā “ātmanaivāṇḍaṃ dvidhā bhavatu” ity ātmagatadhyānamātreṇa tad aṇḍaṃ dvikhaṇḍaṃ kṛtavān || 1.12 ||
tābhyāṃ sa śakalābhyāṃ ca divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nirmame |
madhye vyoma diśaś cāṣṭāv apāṃ sthānaṃ ca śāśvatam || 1.13 ||
tābhyāṃ sa śakalābhyāṃ cetyādi | śakalaṃ khaṇḍaṃ tābhyām aṇḍaśakalābhyām uttareṇa divaṃ svarlokam adhareṇa bhūrlokam ubhayor madhye ākāśaṃ diśaś cāntarāladigbhiḥ sahāṣṭau samudrākhyam apāṃ sthānaṃ sthiraṃ nirmitavān || 1.13 ||
idānīṃ mahadādikrameṇaiva jagannirmāṇam iti darśayituṃ tat tat sṛṣṭim āha –
udbabarhātmanaś caiva manaḥ sadasadātmakam |
manasaś cāpy ahaṃkāram abhimantāram īśvaram || 1.14 ||
udbabarhātmanaś caivetyādi | brahmā ātmanaḥ paramātmanaḥ sakāśāt tena rūpeṇa mana uddhṛtavān | paramātmana eva brahmasvarūpeṇotpannatvāt paramātmana eva ca manaḥsṛṣṭir vedāntadarśane, na pradhānāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Munḍ. 2.1.3) –
etasmāj jāyate prāṇo manaḥ sarvendriyāṇi ca |
khaṃ vāyur jyotir āpaḥ pṛthivī viśvasya dhāriṇī ||
manaś ca śrutisiddhatvād yugapajjñānānutpattiliṅgāc ca sat apratyakṣatvād asad iti manaḥ pūrvam ahaṃkāratattvam aham ity abhimānākhyakāryayuktam īśvaraṃ svakāryakaraṇakṣamam || 1.14 ||
mahāntam eva cātmānaṃ sarvāṇi triguṇāni ca |
viṣayāṇāṃ grahītṝṇi śanaiḥ pañcendriyāṇi ca || 1.15 ||
mahāntam eva cātmānam ityādi | mahāntam iti mahadākhyatattvam ahaṃkārāt pūrvaṃ paramātmana evāvyākṛtaśaktirūpaprakṛtisahitād uddhṛtatavān | ātmana utpannatvāt ātmānam ātmopakārakatvād vā yāny abhihitāni abhidhāsyante ca tāny utpattimanti sarvāṇi sattvarajastamoguṇayuktāni viṣayāṇāṃ śabdasparśarūparasagandhānāṃ grāhakāṇi śanair krameṇa vedāntasiddhena śrotrādīni dvitīyādhyāyavaktavyāni pañca buddhīndriyāṇi, caśabdāt pañca payvādīni karmendriyāṇi, śabdatanmātrādīni ca pañcotpāditatavān |
nanv abhidhyānapūrvakasṛṣṭyabhidhānād vedāntasiddhānta eva manor abhimata iti prāg uktaṃ tan na saṃgacchate | idānīṃ mahadādikrameṇa sṛṣṭyabhidhānād vedāntadarśanena ca paramātmana evākāśādikrameṇa sṛṣṭir uktā | tathā ca taittirīyopaniṣat (2.1.1) – “tasmād vā etasmād ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ | ākāśād vāyuḥ | vāyor agniḥ | agner āpaḥ | adbhyaḥ pṛthivī” iti |
ucyate | prakṛtito mahadādikrameṇa sṛṣṭir iti bhagavadbhāskarīyadarśane ‘bhyupapadyata iti tadvido vyācakṣate | avyākṛtam eva prakṛtir iṣyate, tasya ca sṛṣṭyunmukhatvaṃ sṛṣṭyādyakālayogarūpaṃ tad eva mahattattvam, tato “bahu syām” ity abhimānātmakekṣaṇakālayogitvam avyākṛtasyāhaṃkāratattvam | tata ākāśādipañcabhūtasūkṣmāṇi krameṇotpannāni pañca tanmātrāṇi, tatas tebhya eva sthūlāny utpannāni pañca mahābhūtāni sūkṣmasthūlakrameṇaiva kāryodayadarśanād iti na virodhaḥ | avyākṛtaguṇatve ‘pi sattvarajastamasāṃ sarvāṇi triguṇānīty upapadyate | bhavatu vā sattvarajastamaḥsamatārūpaiva mūlaprakṛtiḥ, bhavantu ca tattvāntarāṇy eva mahadahaṃkāratanmātrāṇ, tathāpi prakṛtir brahmaṇo ‘nanyeti manoḥ svarasaḥ | yato vakṣyati (12.91) –
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani | iti |
tathā (12.125) –
evaṃ yaḥ sarvabhūteṣu paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā |
sa sarvasamatām etya brahmānveti paraṃ padam || iti |
|| 1.15 ||
teṣāṃ tv avayavān sūkṣmān ṣaṇṇām apy amitaujasām |
sanniveśyātmamātrāsu sarvabhūtāni nirmame || 1.16 ||
teṣāṃ tv avayavān sūkṣmān ityādi | teṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pūrvoktāhaṃkārasya tanmātrāṇāṃ ca ye sūkṣmā avayavās tān ātmamātrāsu ṣaṇṇāṃ svavikāreṣu yojayitvā manuṣyatiryaksthāvarādīni sarvabhūtāni paramātmā nirmitavān | tatra tanmātrāṇāṃ vikāraḥ pañcamahābhūtāni ahaṃkārasyendriyāṇi pṛthivyādibhūteṣu śarīrarūpatayā pariṇateṣu tanmātrāhaṃkārayojanāṃ kṛtvā sakalasya kāryajātasya nirmāṇam | ata evāmitaujasām anantakāryanirmāṇenātivīryaśālinām || 1.16 ||
yan mūrtyavayavāḥ sūkṣmās tasyemāny āśrayanti ṣaṭ |
tasmāc charīram ity āhus tasya mūrtiṃ manīṣiṇaḥ || 1.17 ||
yan mūrtyavayavāḥ sūkṣmā ityādi | yasmān mūrtiḥ śarīraṃ tatsaṃpādakā avayavāḥ sūkṣmās tanmātrāhaṃkārarūpāḥ ṣaṭ tasya brahmaṇaḥ saprakṛtikasya imāṇi vakṣyamāṇāni bhūtānīndriyāṇi ca pūrvoktāni kāryatvenāśrayanti, tanmātrebhyo bhūtotpatteḥ ahaṃkārāc ca indriyotpatteḥ | tathā ca paṭhanti (sāṃ kā. 22) –
prakṛter mahāṃs tato ‘haṃkāras tasmād gaṇaś ca ṣoḍaśakah |
tasmād api ṣoḍaśakāt pañcabhyaḥ pañca bhūtāni ||
tasmāt tasya brahmaṇo yā mūrtiḥ svabhāvas tāṃ tathā pariṇatām indriyādiśālinīṃ lokāḥ śarīram iti vadanti | ṣaḍāśrayaṇāc charīram iti śarīranirvacanenānena pūrvoktotpattikrama eva dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ || 1.17 ||
tad āviśanti bhūtāni mahānti saha karmabhiḥ |
manaś cāvayavaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ sarvabhūtakṛd avyayam || 1.18 ||
tad āviśanti bhūtānītyādi | pūrvaśloke tasyeti prakṛtaṃ brahmātra tad iti parāmṛśyate | tad brahma śabdādipañcatanmātrātmanāvasthitaṃ mahābhūtāny ākāśādīni āviśanti tebhya utpadyante | saha karmabhiḥ svakāryaiḥ, tatrākāśasyāvakāśadānaṃ karma, vayor vyūhanaṃ vinyāsarūpam, tejasaḥ pāko ‘pāṃ saṃgrahaṇam, piṇḍīkaraṇarūpaṃ pṛthivyā dhāraṇam | ahaṃkārātmanāvasthitaṃ brahma mana āviśati | ahaṃkārād utpadyata ity arthaḥ | avayavaiḥ svakāryaiḥ śubhāśubhasaṃkalpasukhaduḥkhādirūpaiḥ sūkṣmair bahirindriyāgocaraiḥ sarvabhūtakṛt sarvotpattinimittaṃ manojanyaśubhāśubhakarmaprabhavatvāj jagataḥ | avyayam avināśi || 1.18 ||
teṣām idaṃ saptānāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ mahaujasām |
sūkṣmābhyo mūrtimātrābhyaḥ saṃbhavaty avyayād vyayam || 1.19 ||
teṣām idaṃ saptānāṃ ityādi | teṣāṃ pūrvakṛtānāṃ mahadahaṃkāratanmātrāṇāṃ saptasaṃkhyānāṃ puruṣād ātmana utpannatvāt tadvṛttigrāhyatvāc ca puruṣāṇāṃ mahaujasāṃ svakāryasaṃpādanena vīryavatāṃ sūkṣmā yā mūrtimātrāḥ śarīrasaṃpādakabhāgās tābhya idaṃ jagan naśvaraṃ saṃbhavati, anaśvarād yat kāryaṃ tad vināśi svakāraṇe līyate | kāraṇaṃ tu kāryāpekṣayā sthiram | paramakāraṇaṃ tu brahma nityam upāsanīyam ity etad darśayitum ayam anuvādaḥ || 1.19 ||
ādyādyasya guṇaṃ tv eṣām avāpnoti paraḥ paraḥ |
yo yo yāvatithaś caiṣāṃ sa sa tāvadguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 1.20 ||
ādyādyasya guṇaṃ tv eṣām ityādi | eṣām iti pūrvataraśloke (1.18) “tad āviśanti bhūtāni” ity atra bhūtānāṃ parāmarśaḥ | teṣāṃ cākāśādikrameṇotpattikramaḥ, śabdādiguṇavattā ca vakṣyati | tatrādyasyākāśāder guṇaṃ śabdādikaṃ vāyvādiḥ paraḥ paraḥ prāpnoti | etad eva spaṣṭayati – yo ya iti | eṣāṃ madhe yo yo yāvatāṃ pūraṇo yāvatithiaḥ “vatorithuk” (Pāṇ 5.2.53), sa sa dvitīyādiḥ dvitīyo dviguṇaḥ tṛtīyas triguṇa ityevamādir manvādibhiḥ smṛtaḥ | etenaitad uktaṃ bhavati – ākāśasya śabdo guṇaḥ, vāyoḥ śabdasparśau, tejasaḥ śabdasparśarūpāṇi, apāṃ śabdasparśarūparasāḥ, bhūmeḥ śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ | atra yady api “nityavīpsayoḥ” (Pāṇ 8.1.4) iti dvirvacanenādyasyādyasyeti prāptaṃ tathāpi smṛtīnāṃ chandaḥsamānaviṣayatvāt “supāṃ suluk” (Pāṇ 7.1.39) iti prathamādyasya subluk tenādyādyasyeti rūpasiddhiḥ|| 1.20 ||
sarveṣāṃ tu sa nāmāni karmāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak |
vedaśabdebhya evādau pṛthak saṃsthāś ca nirmame || 1.21 ||
sarveṣāṃ tu sa nāmānītyādi | sa paramātmā hiraṇyagarbharūpeṇāvasthitaḥ sarveṣāṃ nāmāni gojāter gaur iti, aśvajāter aśva iti, karmāṇi brāhmaṇasyādhyayanādīni, kṣatriyasya prajārakṣādīni, pṛthak pṛthak yasya pūrvakalpe yāny abhūvan ādau sṛṣṭyādau vedaśabdebhya evāvagamya nirmitavān | bhagavatā vyāsenāpi vedamīmāṃsāyāṃ vedapūrvikaiva jagatsṛṣṭir vyutpāditā | tathā ca śārīrakasūtram (Br. Sū. 1.3.28): “śabda iti cen nātaḥ prabhavāt pratyakṣānumānābhyām” | asyārthaḥ: devatānāṃ vigrahavattve vaidike vasvādiśabde devatācācini virodhaḥ syād vedasyādimattvaprasaṅgād iti cen, nāsti virodhaḥ | kasmāt | ataḥśabdād eva, jagataḥ prabhavād utpatteḥ pralayakāle ‘pi sūkṣmarūpeṇa paramātmani vedarāśiḥ sthitaḥ, sa iha kalpādau hiraṇyagarbhasya paramātmana eva prathamadehimūrter manasy avasthāntaram anāpannaḥ suptaprabuddhasyeva prādur bhavati | tena pradīpasthānīyena suranaratiryagādipravibhaktaṃ jagadabhidheyabhūtaṃ nirmimīte | katham idaṃ gamyate | pratyakṣānumānābhyām, śrutismṛtibhyām ity arthaḥ | pratyakṣaṃ śrutir anapekṣatvāt | anumānaṃ smṛti anumīyamānaśrutisāpekṣatvāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ:
eta iti vai prajāpatir devān asṛjatāsṛgram iti manuṣyān indava iti pitṝṃs tiraḥpavitram iti grahān āśava iti stotraṃ viśvānīti śastram abhi sausaubhagety anyāḥ prajāḥ |
smṛtis tu: “sarveṣāṃ tu sa nāmāni” ityādikā manvādipraṇītaiva | pṛthak saṃsthāś ceti | laukikīś ca vyavasthāḥ kulālasya ghaṭanirmāṇam, kuvindasya paṭanirmāṇam ityādikavibhāgena nirmitavān || 1.21 ||
karmātmanāṃ ca devānāṃ so ‘sṛjat prāṇināṃ prabhuḥ |
sādhyānāṃ ca gaṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ yajñaṃ caiva sanātanam || 1.22 ||
karmātmanāṃ ca devānāṃ ityādi | sa brahmā devānāṃ gaṇam asṛjat | prāṇinām indrādīnāṃ karmāṇi ātmā svabhāvo yeṣāṃ teṣām aprāṇināṃ ca grāvādīnāṃ devānāṃ sādhyānāṃ ca devaviśeṣāṇāṃ samūhaṃ yajñaṃ ca jyotiṣṭomādikaṃ kalpāntare ‘py anumīyamānatvān nityam | sādhyānāṃ ca gaṇasya pṛthagvacanaṃ sūkṣmatvāt || 1.22 ||
agnivāyuravibhyas tu trayaṃ brahma sanātanam |
dudoha yajñasiddhyartham ṛgyajuḥsāmalakṣaṇam || 1.23 ||
agnivāyuravibhyas tv ityādi | brahma ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃjñaṃ vedatrayam agnivāyuravibhya ākṛṣṭavān | sanātanaṃ nityam | vedāpauruṣeyatvapakṣa eva manor abhimataḥ | pūrvakalpe ye vadās ta eva paramātmamūrter brahmaṇaḥ sarvajñasya smṛtyārūḍhāḥ, tān eva kalpādau agnivāyuravibhya ācakarṣa | śrautaś cāyam artho na śaṅkanīyaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ: “agner ṛgvedo vāyor yajurveda ādityāt sāmavedaḥ” iti | ākarṣaṇārthatvāt duhidhātor nāgnivāyuravīṇām akathitakarmatā kiṃ tv apādānataiva | yajñasiddhyarthaṃ trayīsaṃpādyatvād yajñānām āpīnasthakṣīravad vidyamānānām eva vedānām abhivyaktipradarśanārtham ākarṣaṇavācako gauṇo duhiḥ prayuktaḥ || 1.23 ||
kālaṃ kālavibhaktīś ca nakṣatrāṇi grahāṃs tathā|
saritaḥ sāgarāñ chailān samāni viṣamāṇi ca || 1.24 ||
kālaṃ kālavibhaktīś cetyādi | atra “sasarja” ity uttaraślokavartinī kriyā saṃbadhyate | ādityādikriyāpracayarūpaṃ kālam, kālavibhaktīr māsartvayanādyāḥ, nakṣatrāṇi kṛttikādīni, grahān sūryādīn, sarito nadīḥ, sāgarān samudrān, śailān parvatān, samāni samasthānāni, viṣamāṇi uccanīcarūpāṇi || 1.24 ||
tapo vācaṃ ratiṃ caiva kāmaṃ ca krodham eva ca |
sṛṣṭiṃ sasarge caivemāṃ sraṣṭum icchann imāḥ prajāḥ || 1.25 ||
tapo vācam ityādi | tapaḥ prājāpatyādi vācaṃ vāṇīṃ ratiṃ cetaḥparitoṣaṃ kāmam icchāṃ krodhaṃ cetovikāraṃ imāṃ etacchlokoktāṃ pūrvaślokoktāṃ ca sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra | sṛjyata iti sṛṣṭiḥ | karmaṇi ktin | imāḥ prajā vakṣyamāṇā devādikāḥ kartum icchan || 1.25 ||
karmaṇāṃ ca vivekārthaṃ dharmādharmau vyavecayat |
dvandvair ayojayac cemāḥ sukhaduḥkhādibhiḥ prajāḥ || 1.26 ||
karmaṇāṃ ceti | dharmo yajñādiḥ, sa ca kartavyaḥ | adharmo brahmavadhādiḥ, sa na kartavyaḥ | iti karmaṇāṃ vibhāgāya dharmādharmau vyavecayat pṛthaktvenābhyadhāt | dharmasya phalaṃ sukham, adharmasya phalaṃ duḥkham | dharmādharmaphalabhūtair dvandvaiḥ parasparaviruddhaiḥ sukhaduḥkhādibhir imāḥ prajā yojitavān | ādigrahaṇāt kāmakrodharāgadveṣakṣutpipāsāśokamohādibhiḥ || 1.26 ||
aṇvyo mātrā vināśinyo daśārdhānāṃ tu yāḥ smṛtāḥ |
tābhiḥ sārdham idaṃ sarvaṃ saṃbhavaty anupūrvaśaḥ || 1.27 ||
aṇvyo mātrā iti | daśārdhānāṃ pañcānāṃ mahābhūtānāṃ yāḥ sūkṣmāḥ pañcatanmātrarūpā vināśinyaḥ pañcamahābhūtarūpatayā vipariṇāminyaḥ tābhiḥ saha uktaṃ vakṣyamānaṃ cedaṃ sarvam utpadyate | anupūrvaśaḥ krameṇa | sūkṣmāt sthūlaṃ sthūlāt sthūlataram ity anena sarvaśakter brahmaṇo mānasasṛṣṭiḥ kadācit tattvanirapekṣā syād itīmāṃ śaṅkām apaninīṣaṃs taddvāreṇaiveyaṃ sṛṣṭir iti madhye punaḥ pūrvoktaṃ smāritavān || 1.27 ||
yaṃ tu karmaṇi yasmin sa nyayuṅkta prathamaṃ prabhuḥ |
sa tad eva svayaṃ bheje sṛjyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 1.28 ||
yaṃ tu karmaṇīti | sa prajāpatir yaṃ jātiviśeṣaṃ vyāghrādikaṃ yasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ hariṇamāraṇādikāyāṃ sṛṣṭyādau niyuktavān sa jātiviśeṣaḥ punaḥ punar api sṛjyamānaḥ svakarmavaśena tad evācaritavān | etena prāṇikarmasāpekṣaṃ prajāpater uttamādhamajātinirmāṇaṃ na rāgadveṣādhīnam iti darśitam | ata eva vakṣyati (1.41): “yathākarma tapoyogāt sṛṣṭaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam” iti || 1.28 ||
etad eva prapañcayati –
hiṃsrāhiṃsre mṛdukrūre dharmādharmāv ṛtānṛte |
yad yasya so ‘dadhāt sarge tat tasya svayam āviśat || 1.29 ||
hiṃsrāhiṃsre ityādi | hiṃsraṃ karma siṃhādeḥ karimāraṇādikam | ahiṃsraṃ hariṇādeḥ | mṛdu dayāpradhānaṃ viprādeḥ | krūraṃ kṣatriyādeḥ | dharmo yathā brahmacaryādeḥ guruśuśrūṣādiḥ | adharmo yathā tasyaiva māṃsamaithunasevanādiḥ | ṛtaṃ satyam, tac ca prāyeṇa devānām | anṛtam asatyam, tad api prāyeṇa manuṣyāṇām | tathā ca śrutiḥ: “satyavāco devā anṛtavāco manuṣyāḥ” iti | teṣāṃ madhye yat karma sa prajāpatiḥ sargādau yasyādārayat sṛṣṭyuttarakālam api sa tad eva karma prāktanādṛṣṭavaśāt svayam eva bheje || 1.29 ||
atra dṛṣṭāntam āha –
yathartuliṅgāny ṛtavaḥ svayam evartuparyaye |
svāni svāny abhipadyante tathā karmāṇi dehinaḥ || 1.30 ||
yatharv iti | yathā vasantādiṛtava ṛtucihnāni cūtamañjaryādīni ṛtuparyaye svakāryāvasare svayam evāpnuvanti tathā dehino ‘pi hiṃsrādīni karmāṇi || 1.30 ||
lokānāṃ tu vivṛddhyarthaṃ mukhabāhūrupādataḥ |
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ ca niravartayat || 1.31 ||
lokānāṃ tv iti | bhūrādīnāṃ lokānāṃ bāhulyārthaṃ mukhabāhūrupādebhyo brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrān yathākramaṃ nirmitavān | brāhmaṇādibhiḥ sāyaṃprātar agnāv āhitiḥ prakṣiptā sūryam upatiṣṭhate sūryād vṛṣṭir vṛṣṭer annam annāt prajābāhulyam | vakṣyati ca “agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyag ādityam” (3.76) ityādi | daivyā ca śaktyā mukhādibhyo brāhmaṇādinirmāṇam | brāhmaṇo na viśaṅkanīyaḥ śrutisiddhatvāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ “brāhmaṇo ‘sya mukham āsīt” (RV 8.4.19) ityādiḥ || 1.31 ||
dvidhā kṛtvātmano deham ardhena puruṣo ‘bhavat |
ardhena nārī tasyāṃ sa virājam asṛjat prabhuḥ || 1.32 ||
dvidhā kṛtveti | sa brahmā nijadehaṃ dvikhaṇḍaṃ kṛtvā ardhena strī tasyāṃ maithunadharmeṇa virāṭsaṃjñaṃ puruṣaṃ nirmitavān | śrutiś ca (RV 8.4.17): “tato virāḍ ajāyata” iti || 1.32 ||
tapas taptvāsṛjad yaṃ tu sa svayaṃ puruṣo virāṭ |
taṃ māṃ vittāsya sarvasya sraṣṭāraṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 1.33 ||
tapas taptveti | sa virāṭ tapo nidhāya yaṃ nirmitavān tāṃ māṃ manuṃ jānīta asya sarvasya jagataḥ sraṣṭāram | bho dvijasattamāḥ | etena svajanmotkarṣasāmarthātiśayāv abhihitavān lokānāṃ pratyayitapratyayārtham || 1.33 ||
ahaṃ prajāḥ sisṛkṣus tu tapas taptvā suduścaram |
patīn prajānām asṛjaṃ maharṣīn ādito daśa || 1.34 ||
aham iti | ahaṃ prajāḥ sraṣṭum icchan suduścaraṃ tapas taptvā daśa prajāpatīn prathamaṃ sṛṣṭavān, tair api prajānāṃ sṛjyamānatvāt || 1.34 ||
marīcīm atryaṅgirasau pulastyaṃ pulahaṃ kratum |
pracetasaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca bhṛguṃ nāradam eva ca || 1.35 ||
marīcim ityādi | ta ete daśa prajāpatayo nāmato nirdiṣṭāḥ || 1.35 ||
ete manūṃs tu saptānyān asṛjan bhūritejasaḥ |
devān devanikāyāṃś ca maharṣīṃś cāmitaujasaḥ || 1.36 ||
ete manūṃs tv iti | ete marīcyādayo daśa bhūritajaso bahutejaso ‘nyān saptāparimitatejaskān manūn devān brahmaṇāsṛṣṭān devanivāsasthānāni svargādīn maharṣīṃś ca sṛṣṭavantaḥ | manuśabdo ‘yam adhikāravācī | caturdaśasu manvantareṣu yasya yatra sargādyadhikāraḥ sa tasmin manvantare svāyaṃbhuvasyārociṣādinamabhir manur iti vyapadiśyate || 1.36 ||
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāṃś ca gandharvāpsaraso ‘surān |
nāgān sarpān suparṇāṃś ca pitṝṇāṃ ca pṛthaggaṇān || 1.37 ||
yakṣarakṣa iti | “ete ‘sṛjan” iti pūrvasyaivātrānuṣaṅgaḥ uttaratra ślokadvaye ca | yakṣo vaiśravaṇas tadanucarāś ca | rakṣāṃsi rāvaṇādīni | piśācās tebhyo ‘pakṛṣṭā aśucimarudeśanivāsinaḥ | gandharvāś citrarathādayaḥ | apsarasa ūrvaśyādyāḥ | asurā garuḍādayaḥ | nāgā vāsukyādayaḥ | sarpās tato ‘pakṛṣṭā alagardādayaḥ | suparṇā garuḍādayaḥ | pitṛṇām ājyapādādīnāṃ gaṇaḥ samūhaḥ | eṣāṃ ca bheda itihāsādiprasiddhā nādhyakṣādigocaraḥ || 1.37 ||
vidyuto ‘śanimeghāṃś ca rohitendradhanūṃṣi ca |
ulkānirghātaketūṃś ca jyotīṃṣy uccāvacāni ca || 1.38 ||
vidyuta iti | megheṣu dṛśyaṃ dīrghākāraṃ jyotir vidyut | meghād eva yaj jyotir vṛkṣādivināśakaṃ tad aśaniḥ | meghāḥ prasiddhāḥ | rohitaṃ daṇḍākāram | nānāvarṇaṃ divi dṛśyate yaj jyotis tad eva vakram indradhanuḥ | ulkā rekhākāram antarikṣāt pataj jyotiḥ | nirghāto bhūmyantarikṣagata utpātadhvaniḥ | ketavaḥ śikhāvanti jyotīṃṣi utpātarūpāṇi | anyāni jyotīṃṣi dhruvāgastyādīni nānāprakārāṇi || 1.38 ||
kinnarān vānarān matsyān vividhāṃś ca vihaṅgamān |
paśūn mṛgān manuṣyāṃś ca vyālāṃś cobhayatodataḥ || 1.39 ||
kinnarān iti | kinnarā aśvamukhā devayonayo naravigrahāḥ | vānarāḥ prasiddhāḥ | matsyā rohitādayaḥ | vihaṃgamāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ | paśavo gavādyāḥ | mṛgā hariṇādyāḥ | vyālāḥ siṃhādyāḥ | ubhayatodataḥ dve dantapaṅktī yeṣāṃ uttarādhare bhavataḥ || 1.39 ||
kṛmikīṭapataṅgāṃś ca yūkāmakṣikamatkuṇam |
sarvaṃ ca daṃśamaśakaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca pṛthagvidham || 1.40 ||
kṛmikīṭeti | kīṭāḥ kṛmibhyaḥ kiṃcitsthūlāḥ | pataṅgāḥ śalabhāḥ | yūkādayaḥ prasiddhāḥ | “kṣudrajantavaḥ” (Pāṇ 2.4.8) ity anena ekavadbhāvaḥ | sthāvaraṃ vṛkṣalatādibhedena vividhaprakāram || 1.40 ||
evam etair idaṃ sarvaṃ manniyogān mahātmabhiḥ |
yathākarma tapoyogāt sṛṣṭaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam || 1.41 ||
evam etair iti | evam ity uktaprakāreṇa etair marīcyādibhir idaṃ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ sṛṣṭam | yathākarma yasya jantor yādṛśaṃ karma tadanurūpam | tasya devamanuṣyatiryagādiyoniṣūtpādanaṃ manniyogān madājñayā | tapoyogān mahat tapaḥ kṛtvā | sarvam aiśvaryaṃ tapo’dhīnam iti darśitam || 1.41 ||
yeṣāṃ tu yādṛśaṃ karma bhūtānām iha kīrtitam |
tat tathā vo ‘bhidhāsyāmi kramayogaṃ ca janmani || 1.42 ||
yeṣām ityādi | yeṣāṃ punar yādṛśaṃ karma iha saṃsāre pūrvācāryaiḥ kathitam | yathā –
yoṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntā bahupuṣpaphalopagāḥ | (1.46)
brāhmaṇādīnāṃ cādhyayanadikarma tat tathaiva vo yuṣmākaṃ vakṣyāmi | janmādikramayogaṃ ca || 1.42 ||
paśavaś ca mṛgāś caiva vyālāś cobhatodataḥ |
rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāś ca manuṣyāś ca jarāyujāḥ || 1.43 ||
paśavaś ceti | jarāyur garbhāvaraṇacarma, tatra manuṣyādayaḥ prādurbhavanti paścān muktā jāyante | eṣām eva janmakramaḥ prāg ukto vivṛtaḥ | dantaśabdasamānārtho dacchabdaḥ prakṛtyanantaram asti, tasyedaṃ prathamābahuvacane rūpam ubhayatodata iti || 1.43 ||
aṇḍajāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarpā nakrā matyāś ca kacchapāḥ |
yāni caivaṃprakārāṇi sthalajāny audakāni ca || 1.44 ||
aṇḍajāḥ pakṣiṇa iti | aṇḍa ādau saṃbhavanti tato jāyanta iti eṣāṃ janmakramaḥ | nakrāḥ kumbhīrāḥ | sthalajāni kṛkalāsādīni | audakāni śaṅkhādīni || 1.44 ||
svedajaṃ daṃśamaśakaṃ yūkāmakṣikamatkuṇam |
ūṣmaṇaś copajāyante yac cānyat kiṃcid īdṛśam || 1.45 ||
svedajam iti | svedaḥ pārthivadravyāṇāṃ tāpena kledaḥ, tato daṃśamaśakādi jāyate | ūṣmaṇaś ca svedahetutāpād api anyad daṃśādisadṛśaṃ puttikāpipīlikādi jāyate || 1.45 ||
udbhijjāḥ sthāvarāḥ sarve bījakāṇḍaprarohiṇaḥ |
oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntā bahupuṣpaphalopagāḥ || 1.46 ||
udbhijjā iti | udbhedanam udbhit | bhāve klip | tato jāyante ūrdhvaṃ bījaṃ bhūmiṃ ca bhittvety udbhijjā vṛkṣāḥ | te ca dvidhā – kecid bījād eva jāyante, kecit kāṇḍāt śākhā eva ropitā vṛkṣatāṃ yānti | idānīṃ yeṣāṃ yādṛśaṃ karma tad ucyante – oṣadhya iti | oṣadhyo vrīhiyavādayaḥ phalapākenaiva naśyanti bahupuṣpaphalayuktāś ca bhavanti | oṣadhiśabdād eva “kṛdikārādaktinaḥ” (Kāśikā on Pāṇ 4.1.31) iti ṅīpi dīrghataṃ oṣadhya it rūpam || 1.46 ||
apuṣpāḥ phalavanto ye te vanaspatayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
puṣpiṇaḥ phalinaś caiva vṛkṣās tūbhayataḥ smṛtāḥ || 1.47 ||
apuṣpā iti | nāsya ślokasyābhidhānakośavat saṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhaparatvam, aprakṛtatvāt kiṃ tu “kramayogaṃ ca janmani” (1.42) iti prakṛtaṃ tadartham idam ucyate || ye vanaspatayas teṣāṃ puṣpam antareṇaiva phalajanma, itarebhyas tu puṣpāṇi jāyante tebhyaḥ phalānīti | evaṃ vṛkṣā ubhayarūpāḥ | prathamāntāt tasiḥ || 1.47 ||
gucchagulmaṃ tu vividhaṃ tathaiva tṛṇajātayaḥ |
bījakāṇḍaruhāṇy eva pratānā vallya eva ca || 1.48 ||
gucchagulmaṃ tv iti | mūlata eva yatra latāsamūho bhavati, na ca prakāṇḍāni te gucchā mallikādayaḥ | gulmā ekamūlāḥ saṃghātajātāḥ śarekṣuprabhṛtayaḥ | tṛṇajātaya ulapādyāḥ | pratānās tantuyuktās trapuṣālābūprabhṛtayaḥ | vallyo guḍūcyādayo yā bhūmer vṛkṣam ārohanti | etāny api bījakāṇḍaruhāṇi | “napuṃsakam anapuṃsakenaikavac cāsyānyatarasyām” (Pāṇ 1.2.69) iti napuṃsakatvam || 1.48 ||
tamasā bahurūpeṇa veṣṭitāḥ karmahetunā |
antaḥsaṃjñā bhavanty ete sukhaduḥkhasamanvitāḥ || 1.49 ||
tamaseti | ete vṛkṣādayas tamoguṇena vicitraduḥkhaphalenādharmakarmahetukena vyāptā antaścaitanyā bhavanti | yady api sarve cāntar eva cetayante tathāpi bahirvyāpārādikāryavirahāt tathā vyapadiśyante | ata eva sukhaduḥkhasamanvitāḥ | sattvasyāpi bhāvāt kadācit sukhaleśo ‘pi jaladharajanitajalasaṃparkād eṣāṃ jāyate || 1.49 ||
etadantās tu gatayo brahmādyāḥ samudāhṛtāḥ |
ghore ‘smin bhūtasaṃsāre nityaṃ satatayāyini || 1.50 ||
etadantā iti | sthāvaraparyantā brahmopakramā gataya utpattayaḥ kathitāḥ | bhūtānāṃ kṣetrajñānāṃ janmamaraṇaprabandhe duḥkhabahulatayā bhīṣaṇe sadā vinaśvare || 1.50 ||
itthaṃ sargam abhidhāya pralayadaśām āha –
evaṃ sarvaṃ sa sṛṣṭvedaṃ māṃ cācintyaparākramaḥ |
ātmany antardadhe bhūyaḥ kālaṃ kālena pīḍayan || 1.51 ||
evam sarvam iti | evaṃ uktaprakāreṇa | idaṃ sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ jagat sṛṣṭvā sa prajāpatir acintyaśantir ātmany śarīratyāgarūpam antardhānaṃ kṛtavān | sṛṣṭikālaṃ pralayakālena nāśayan prāṇināṃ karmavaśena punaḥ punaḥ sargapralayān karotīty arthaḥ
|| 1.51 ||
atra hetum āha –
yadā sa devo jāgarti tadedaṃ ceṣṭate jagat |
yadā svapiti śāntātmā tadā sarvaṃ nimīlati || 1.52 ||
yadeti | yadā sa prajāpatir jāgarti sṛṣṭisthitī icchati tadedaṃ jagat śvāsapraśvāsāhārādiceṣṭāṃ labhate | yadā svapiti nivṛtteccho bhavati śāntātmā upasaṃhāramanāḥ tadedaṃ jagat pralīyate
|| 1.52||
pūrvoktam eva spaṣṭayati –
tasmin svapati susthe tu karmātmānaḥ śarīriṇaḥ |
svakarmabhyo nivartante manaś ca glānim ṛcchati || 1.53 ||
tasmin svapatīti | tasmin prajāpatau nivṛttecche susthe upasaṃhṛtadehamanovyāpāre karmalabdhadehāḥ kṣetrajñāḥ svakarmabhyo dehagrahaṇādibhyo nivartante | manaḥ sarvendriyasahitaṃ vṛttirahitaṃ bhavati || 1.53 ||
idānīṃ mahāpralayam āha –
yugapat tu pralīyante yadā tasmin mahātmani |
tadāyaṃ sarvabhūtātmā sukhaṃ svapiti nirvṛtaḥ || 1.54 ||
yugapat tv iti | ekasminn eva kāle yadā tasmin paramātmani sarvabhūtāni pralayaṃ yānti tadāyaṃ sarvabhūtānām ātmā nirvṛtaḥ nivṛttajāgratsvaptavyāpāraḥ sukhaṃ svapiti suṣupta iva bhavati | yady api nityajñānānandasvarūpe paramātmani na suṣvāpas tathāpi jīvadharmo ‘yam upacaryate || 1.54 ||
idānīṃ pralayaprasaṅgena jīvasyotkramaṇam api ślokadvayenāha –
tamo ‘yaṃ tu samāśritya ciraṃ tiṣṭhati sendriyaḥ |
na ca svaṃ kurute karma tadotkrāmati mūrtitaḥ || 1.55 ||
tamo ‘yam iti | ayaṃ jīvas tamo jñānanivṛttiṃ prāpya bahukālam indriyādisahitas tiṣṭhati | na cātmīyaṃ karma śvāsapraśvāsādikaṃ karoti tadā mūrtitaḥ pūrvadehād utkrāmati anyatra gacchati | liṅgaśarīrāvacchinnasya jīvasya udgamāt tadgamanam apy upapadyate | tathā coktaṃ bṛhadāraṇyake (4.4.2): “tam utkrāmantaṃ prāṇo ‘nūtkrāmati, prāṇam anūtkrāmantaṃ sarve prāṇā anūtkrāmanti” iti | prāṇā indriyāṇi || 1.55 ||
kadā dehāntaraṃ gṛhṇātīty ata āha –
yadāṇumātriko bhūtvā bījaṃ sthāsnu cariṣṇu ca |
samāviśati saṃsṛṣṭas tadā mūrtiṃ vimuñcati || 1.56 ||
yadāṇumātrika iti | aṇavo mātrāḥ puryaṣṭakarūpā yasya so ‘ṇumātrikaḥ | puryaṣṭakaśabdena bhūtādīny aṣṭāv ucyante | tad uktaṃ sanandena:
bhūtendriyamanobuddhivāsanākarmavāyavaḥ |
avidyā cāṣṭakaṃ proktaṃ puryaṣṭam ṛṣisattamaiḥ ||
brahmapurāṇe ‘py uktam |
puryaṣṭakena liṅgena prāṇādyena sa yujyate |
tena baddhasya vai bandho mokṣo muktkasya tena tu ||
yadāṇumātriko bhūtvā saṃpadya sthāsnu vṛkṣādihetubhūtam, cariṣṇu mānuṣādikāraṇaṃ bījaṃ praviśaty adhitiṣṭhati tadā saṃsṛṣṭaḥ puryaṣṭakayukto mūrtiṃ sthūladehāntaraṃ karmānurūpaṃ vimuñcati gṛhṇāti || 1.56 ||
prāsaṅgikaṃ jīvasyotkramaṇam abhidhāya prakṛtam upasaṃharati –
evaṃ sa jāgratsvapnābhyām idaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram |
saṃjīvayati cājasraṃ pramāpayati cāvyayaḥ || 1.57 ||
evaṃ sa jāgratsvapnābhyām iti | sa brahmā anena prakāreṇa svīyajāgratsvapnābhyām idaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ saṃjīvayati mārayati ca | ajasraṃ satatam | avyayaḥ avināśī || 1.57 ||
idaṃ śāstraṃ tu kṛtvāsau mām eva svayam āditaḥ |
vidhivad grāhayāmāsa marīcyādīṃs tv ahaṃ munīn || 1.58 ||
idaṃ śāstram iti | asau brahmā idaṃ śāstraṃ kṛtvā sṛṣṭyādau mām eva vidhivac chāstroktāṅgajānuṣṭhānenādhyāpitavān | ahaṃ tu marīcyādīn adhyāpitavān |
nanu brahmakṛtatve ‘sya śāstrasya kathaṃ mānavavyapadeśaḥ |
atra medhātithiḥ “śāstraśabdena śāstrārtho vidhiniṣedhasamūhaḥ ucyate” | taṃ brahmā manuṃ grāhayāmāsa | manus tu tatpratipādakaṃ granthaṃ kṛtavān iti na virodhaḥ |
anye tu brahmakṛtatve ‘py asya manunā prathamaṃ marīcyādibhyaḥ svarūpato ‘rthataś ca prakāśitatvān mānavavyapadeśo vedāpauruṣeyatve ‘pi kāṭhakādivyapadeśavat |
idaṃ tūcyate – brahmaṇā śatasāhasram idaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ kṛtvā manur adhyāpita āsīt, tatas tena ca svavacanena saṃkṣipya śiṣyebhyaḥ pratipāditam ity avirodhaḥ | tathā ca nāradaḥ “śatasāhasro ‘yaṃ grantha” iti smarati sma || 1.58 ||
etad vo ‘yaṃ bhṛguḥ śāstraṃ śrāvayiṣyaty aśeṣataḥ |
etad dhi matto ‘dhijage sarvam eṣo ‘khilaṃ muniḥ || 1.59 ||
etad vo ‘yam ityādi | etac chastram ayaṃ bhṛguḥ yuṣmākam akhilaṃ kathayiṣyati | yasmād eṣo ‘śeṣam etan matto ‘dhītavān || 1.59 ||
tatas tathā sa tenokto maharṣir manunā bhṛguḥ |
tān abravīd ṛṣīn sarvān prītātmā śrūyatām iti || 1.60 ||
tatas tatheti | sa bhṛgur manunā tathokto ‘yaṃ śrāvayiṣyatīti, yasmād eṣo ‘dhijaga ity uktas tato ‘nantaram anekamunisaṃnidhau gurusaṃbhāvanayā prītamanās tān ṛṣīn pratyuvāca śrūyatām iti || 1.60 ||
svāyaṃbhuvasyāsya manoḥ ṣaḍ vaṃśyā manavo ‘pare |
sṛṣṭavantaḥ prajāḥ svāḥ svā mahātmāno mahaujasaḥ || 1.61 ||
svāyaṃbhuvasyeti | brahmaputrasyāsya manoḥ ṣaḍ vaṃśaprabhavā anye manavaḥ | evaṃ kāryakāriṇaḥ svasvakāle sṛṣṭipālanādāv adhikṛtāḥ svāḥ svāḥ prajā utpāditavantaḥ || 1.61 ||
svārociṣaś cottamaś ca tāmaso raivatas tathā |
cākṣuṣaś ca mahātejā vivasvatsuta eva ca || 1.62 ||
svarociṣaś ceti | ete bhedena manavaḥ ṣaṭ nāmato nirdiṣṭāḥ || 1.62 ||
svāyaṃbhuvādyāḥ saptaite manavo bhūritejasaḥ |
sve sve ‘ntare sarvam idam utpādyāpuś carācaram || 1.63 ||
svāyaṃbhuveti | svāyaṃbuvamukhāḥ saptāmī manavaḥ svīyasvīyādhikārakāle idaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam utpādya pālitavantaḥ || 1.63 ||
idānīm uktamanvantarasṛṣṭipralayādikālaparimāṇaparijñānāyāha –
nimeṣā daśa cāṣṭau ca kāṣṭā triṃśat tu tāḥ kalā |
triṃśat kalā muhūrtaḥ syād ahorātraṃ tu tāvataḥ || 1.64 ||
nimeṣā daśa cāṣṭāv iti | akṣipakṣmaṇoḥ svābhāvikasya unmeṣasya sahakārī nimeṣaḥ | te ‘ṣṭādaśa kāṣṭā nāma kālaḥ | triṃśat kāṣṭāḥ kalāsaṃjñakaḥ | triṃśat kalāḥ muhūrtākhyaḥ kālaḥ | tāvat triṃśan muhūrtān ahorātraṃ kālaṃ vidyāt | tavata iti dvitīyānirdeśāt vidyāt ity adhyāhāraḥ || 1.64 ||
ahorātre vibhajate sūryo mānuṣadaivike |
rātriḥ svapnāya bhūtānāṃ ceṣṭāyai karmaṇām ahaḥ || 1.65 ||
ahorātre iti | mānuṣadaivasaṃbandhinau dinarātrikālāv ādityaḥ pṛthak karoti | tayor madhye bhūtānāṃ svapnārthaṃ rātrir bhavati, karmānuṣṭhānārthaṃ ca dinam || 1.65 ||
pitrye rātryahnī māsaḥ pravibhāgas tu pakṣayoḥ |
karmaceṣṭāsv ahaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śuklaḥ svapnāya śarvarī || 1.66 ||
pitrye iti | mānuṣāṇāṃ māsaḥ pitṝṇām ahorātre bhavataḥ | tatra pakṣadvayena vibhāgaḥ – karmānuṣṭhānāya kṛṣṇapakṣo ‘haḥ, svāpārthaṃ śuklapakṣo rātriḥ || 1.66 ||
daive rātryahanī varṣaṃ pravibhāgas tayoḥ punaḥ |
ahas tatrodagayanaṃ rātriḥ syād dakṣiṇāyanam || 1.67 ||
daive rātryahanī varṣaṃ iti | mānuṣāṇāṃ varṣaṃ devānāṃ rātridine bhavataḥ | tayor apy ayaṃ vibhāgaḥ – narāṇām udagayanaṃ devānām ahaḥ, tatra prāyeṇa daivakarmaṇām anuṣṭhānam, dakṣiṇāyanaṃ tu rātriḥ || 1.67 ||
brāhmasya tu kṣapāhasya yat pramāṇaṃ samāsataḥ |
ekaikaśo yugānāṃ tu kramaśas tan nibodhata || 1.68 ||
brāhmasyeti | brahmaṇo ‘horātrasya yat parimāṇaṃ prayekaṃ yugānāṃ ca kṛtādīnāṃ tat krameṇa samāsataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ śṛṇuta | prakṛte ‘pi kālavibhāge yad brahmaṇo ‘horātrasya pṛthak pratijñānaṃ tat tadīyajñānasya puṇyaphalajñānārtham | vakṣyati ca (1.73) “brāhmaṃ puṇyam ahar viduḥ” iti | tadvedanāt puṇyaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ || 1.68 ||
catvāry āhuḥ sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tat kṛtaṃ yugam |
tasya tāvacchatī saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaś ca tathāvidhaḥ || 1.69 ||
catvāry āhur iti | catvāri varṣasahasrāṇi kṛtayugakālaṃ manvādayo vadanti tasya tāvadvarṣaśatāni saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaś ca bhavati | yugasya pūrvā saṃdhyā, uttaraś ca saṃdhyāṃśaḥ | tad uktaṃ viṣṇupurāṇe |
tatpramāṇaiḥ śataiḥ saṃdhyā pūrvā tatrābhidhīyate |
saṃdhyāṃśakaś ca tattulyo yugasyānantaro hi yaḥ ||
saṃdhyāsaṃdhyāṃśayor antar yaḥ kālo munisattama |
yugākhyaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ kṛtatretādisaṃjñakaḥ ||
varṣasaṃkhyā ceyaṃ divyamānena, tasyaivānantaraprakṛtatvāt,
divyair varṣasahasrais tu kṛtatretādisaṃjñitam |
caturyugaṃ dvādaśabhis tadvibhāgaṃ nibodha me ||
iti viṣṇupurāṇavacanāc ca || 1.69 ||
itareṣu sasaṃdhyeṣi sasaṃdhyāṃśeṣu ca triṣu |
ekāpāyena vartante sahasrāṇi śatāni ca || 1.70 ||
itareṣv iti | anyeṣu tretādvāparakaliyugeṣu saṃdhyāsaṃdhyāṃśasahiteṣu ekahānyā sahasrāṇi śatāni ca bhavanti | tenaivaṃ saṃpadyate – trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi tretāyugam, tasya trīṇi varṣaśatāni saṃdhyā saṃdhyāśaś ca | evaṃ dve varṣasahasre dvāparaḥ, tasya dve varṣaśate saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaś ca | evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ kaliḥ, tasyaikavarṣaśataṃ saṃdhyā saṃdhyāṃśaś ca || 1.70 ||
yad etat parisaṃkhyātam ādāv eva caturyugam |
etad dvādaśasāhasraṃ devānāṃ yugam ucyate || 1.71 ||
yad etad iti | etasya ślokasyādau yad etan mānuṣaṃ caturyugaṃ parigaṇitam etad devānām yugam ucyate | caturyugaśabdena saṃdhyāsaṃdhyāṃśayor aprāptiśaṅkāyām āha – etad dvādaśasāhasram iti | svārthe ‘ṇ | “caturyugair eva dvādaśasaṃkhyair divyaṃ yugam” iti tu medhātither bhrame nādartavyaḥ, manunānantaraṃ divyayugasahasreṇa brahmāhasyāpy abhidhānāt | viṣṇupurāṇe ca mānuṣacaturyugasahasreṇa brahmāhaḥkīrtanān mānuṣacaturyugenaiva divyayugānugamanāt | tathā ca viṣṇupurāṇam |
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliś ceti caturyugam |
procyate tatsahasraṃ tu brahmaṇo divaso mune ||
|| 1.71 ||
daivikānāṃ yugānāṃ tu sahasraṃ parisaṃkhyayā |
brāhmam ekaṃ ahar jñeyaṃ tāvatīṃ rātrim eva ca || 1.72 ||
daivikānām iti | devayugānāṃ sahasraṃ brāhmaṃ dinaṃ jñātavyam | sahasram eva rātriḥ | parisaṃkhyayeti ślokapūraṇo ‘rthānuvādaḥ || 1.71 ||
tad vai yugasahasrāntaṃ brāhmaṃ puṇyam ahar viduḥ |
rātriṃ ca tāvatīm eva te ‘horātravido janāḥ || 1.73 ||
tad vai yugeti | yugasahasrāntaḥ samāptir yasya tad brāhmam ahas tatparimāṇāṃ ca rātriṃ ye jānanti te ‘horātrajñā iti stutir iyam | stutyā ca brāhmaṃ ahorātraṃ jñātavyam iti vidhiḥ parikalpyate | ata etat punyahetutvāt puṇyam iti viśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtam || 1.73 ||
tasya so ‘harniśasyānte prasuptaḥ pratibudhyate |
pratibuddhaś ca sṛjati manaḥ sadasadātmakam || 1.74 ||
tasyeti | sa brahmā tasya pūrvoktasya svīyāhorātrasya samāptau pratibuddho bhavati | pratibuddhaś ca svīnaṃ manaḥ sṛjati bhūrlokāditrayasṛṣṭaye niyuṅkte na tu janayati | tasya mahāpralayānantaraṃ jātatvād anaṣṭatvāc ca, avāntarapralaye bhūrlokāditrayamātranāśāt sṛṣṭyarthaṃ manoniyuktir eva manaḥsṛṣṭiḥ | tathā ca purāṇe śrūyate –
manaḥ sisṛkṣayā yuktaṃ sargāya nidadhe punaḥ | iti |
atha vā manaḥśabdo ‘yaṃ mahattattvapara eva | yady api tan mahāpralayānantaram utpannam, “mahāntam eva ca” (1.18) ityādinā sṛṣṭir api tasyoktā, tathāpy anuktaṃ bhūtānām utpattikramaṃ tadguṇāṃś ca kathayituṃ mahāpralayānantaritām eva mahadādisṛṣṭiṃ bhūtasṛṣṭiṃ ca hiraṇyagarbhasyāpi paramārthatvāt tatkartṛtām anuvadati | etenedam uktaṃ bhavati – brahmā mahāpralayānantaritasṛṣṭyādau paramātmarūpeṇa mahadāditattvāni jagatsṛṣṭyarthaṃ sṛjati | ata eva śeṣe vakṣyati (1.78) “ity eṣā sṛṣṭir āditaḥ” iti | avāntarapralayānantaraṃ tu manaḥprabhṛtisṛṣṭāv abhidhānakrameṇaiva prāthamyaprāptiḥ “ity eṣā sṛṣṭir āditaḥ” iti niṣprayojano ‘nuvādaḥ syāt || 1.74 ||
manaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ vikurute codyamānaṃ sisṛkṣayā |
ākāśaṃ jāyate tasmāt tasya śabdaṃ guṇaṃ viduḥ || 1.75 ||
manaḥ sṛṣṭim iti | mano mahān sṛṣṭiṃ karoti | paramātmanaḥ sraṣṭum icchayā preryamāṇaṃ tasmād ākāśam utpadyate | tac ca pūrvoktānusārād ahaṃkāratanmātrakrameṇākāśasya śabdaṃ guṇaṃ vidur manvādayaḥ || 1.75 ||
ākāśāt tu vikurvāṇāt sarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ |
balavāñ jāyate vāyuḥ sa vai sparśaguṇo mataḥ || 1.76 ||
ākāśād iti | ākāśāt tu vikārajanakāt surabhyasurabhigandhavahaḥ pavitro balavāṃś ca vāyur utpadyate | sa ca sparśākhyaguṇavān manvādīnāṃ saṃmataḥ || 1.76 ||
vāyor api vikurvāṇād virociṣṇu tamonudam |
jyotir utpadyate bhāsvat tad rūpaguṇam ucyate || 1.77 ||
vayor apīti | vāyor api teja utpadyate | virociṣṇu paraprakāśakaṃ tamonāśanaṃ bhāsvat prakāśakam | tac ca guṇarūpam abhidhīyate || 1.77 ||
jyotiṣaś ca vikurvāṇād āpo rasaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ |
adbhyo gandhaguṇā bhūmir ity eṣā sṛṣṭir āditaḥ || 1.78 ||
jyotiṣaś ceti | tejasa āpa utpadyante | tāś ca rasaguṇayuktāḥ | adbhyo gandhaguṇayuktā bhūmir ity eṣā mahāpralayānantarasṛṣṭyādau bhūtasṛṣṭiḥ | tair eva bhūtair avāntarapralayānantaram api bhūrādilokatrayanirmāṇam || 1.79 ||
yat prāgdvādaśasāhasram uditaṃ daivikaṃ yugam |
tad ekasaptatiguṇaṃ manvantaram ihocyate || 1.79 ||
yat prāg iti | yat pūrvaṃ dvādaśavarṣasahasraparimāṇaṃ saṃdhyāsaṃdhyāṃśasahitaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ caturyugaṃ devānām ekaṃ yugam uktaṃ tad ekasaptatiguṇitaṃ manvantarākhyaḥ kāla iha śāstre ‘bhidhīyate | tatraikasya manoḥ sargādyadhikāraḥ || 1.79 ||
manvantarāṇy asaṃkhyāni sargaḥ saṃhāra eva ca |
krīḍann ivaitat kurute parameṣṭhī punaḥ punaḥ || 1.80 ||
manvantarāṇīti | yady api caturdaśamanvantarāṇi purāṇeṣu parigaṇyante, tathāpi sargapralayānām ānantyād asaṃkhyāni | āvṛttyā sargaḥ saṃhāraś cāsaṃkhyaḥ | etat sarvaṃ krīḍann iva prajāpatiḥ punaḥ punaḥ kurute | sukhārthā hi pravṛttiḥ krīḍā | tasya cāptakāmatvān na sukhārthiteti ivaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | parame sthāne ‘nāvṛtalakṣaṇe tiṣṭhatīti parameṣṭhī | prayojanaṃ vinā paramātmanaḥ sṛṣṭyādau kathaṃ pravṛttir iti cet – līlayaiva, evaṃsvabhāvād ity arthaḥ | vyākhyātur iva karatāḍanādau; tathā ca śārīrakasūtram (br. sū. 2.1.33) “lokavat tu līlākaivalyam” iti || 1.80 ||
catuṣpāt sakalo dharmaḥ satyaṃ caiva kṛte yuge |
nādharmeṇāgamaḥ kaścin manuṣyān prati vartate || 1.81 ||
catuṣpāt sakaro dharma iti | satyayuge sakalo dharmaś catuṣpāt sarvāṅgapūrṇaṃ āsīt | dharme mukhyapādāsaṃbhavāt “vṛṣo hi bhagavān dharmaḥ” (8.16) ityādyāgame vṛṣatvena kīrtanāt tasya pādacatuṣṭayena saṃpūrṇatvāt satyayuge ‘pi dharmāṇāṃ sarvair aṅgaiḥ samagratvāt saṃpūrṇatvaparo ‘yaṃ catuṣpātśabdaḥ | atha vā “tapaḥ param” (1.86) ity atra manunaiva tapojñānayajñadānānāṃ caturṇāṃ kīrtanāt tasya pādacatuṣṭayena saṃpūrṇatvāt pādatvena nirūpitāḥ satyayuge samagrā ity arthaḥ | tathā satyaṃ ca kṛtayugam āsīt | sakaladharmaśreṣṭhatvāt satyasya pṛthaggrahaṇam | tathā na śāstrātikrameṇa dhanavidyāder āgama utpattir manuṣyān prati saṃpadyate || 1.81 ||
itareṣv āgamād dharmaḥ pādaśas tv avaropitaḥ |
caurikānṛtamāyābhir dharmaś cāpaiti pādaśaḥ || 1.82 ||
itareṣv iti | satyayugād anyeṣu tretādiṣu āgamād adharmeṇa dhanavidyāder arjanāt tasyaiva pūrvaśloke prakṛtatvāt | āgamād vedād iti tu govindarājo medhātithiś ca | dharmo yāgādiḥ yathākramaṃ pratiyugaṃ pādaṃ pādam avaropito hīnaḥ kṛtas tathā dhanavidyārjito ‘pi yo dharmaḥ pracarati, so ‘pi cauryāsatyacchadmabhiḥ pratiyugaṃ pādaśo hrāsād vyapagacchati | tretādiyugaiḥ saha caurikānṛtacchadmanāṃ na yathāsaṃkhyam, sarvatra sarveṣāṃ darśanāt
|| 1.81 ||
arogāḥ sarvasiddhārthāś caturvarṣaśatāyuṣaḥ |
kṛte tretādiṣu hy eṣām āyur hrasati pādaśaḥ || 1.83 ||
arogā iti | roganimittādharmābhāvād arogāḥ sarvasiddhakāmyaphalāḥ pratibandhakādharmābhāvāc caturvarṣaśatāyuṣṭvaṃ ca svābhāvikam | adhikāyuḥprāpakadharmavaśād adhikāyuṣo ‘pi bhavanti | tena
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rāmo rājyam acīkarat |
ityādyavirodhaḥ | “śatāyur vai puruṣaḥ” ityādiśrutau tu śataśabdo bahutvaparaḥ kaliparo vā | evaṃrūpā manuṣyāḥ kṛte bhavanti | tretādiṣu punaḥ pādaṃ pādam āyur alpaṃ bhavatīti || 1.83 ||
vedoktam āyur martyānām āśiṣaś caiva karmaṇām |
phalanty anuyugaṃ loke prabhāvaś ca śarīriṇām || 1.84 ||
vedoktam āyur iti | “śatāyur vai puruṣaḥ” ityādi vedoktam āyuḥ, karmaṇāṃ ca kāmyānāṃ phalaviṣayāḥ prārthanāḥ, brāhmaṇādīnāṃ ca śāpānugrahakṣamatvādiprabhāvā yugānurūpeṇa phalanti || 1.84 ||
anye kṛtayuge dharmās tretāyāṃ dvāpare ‘pare |
anye kaliyuge nṝṇāṃ yugahrāsānurūpataḥ || 1.85 ||
anya iti | kṛtayuge ‘nye dharmā bhavanti | tretādiṣv api yugāpacayānurūpeṇādharmavailakṣaṇyam || 1.85 ||
tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānam ucyate |
dvāpare yajñam evāhur dānam ekaṃ kalau yuge || 1.86 ||
tapaḥ param iti | yady api tapaḥprabhṛtīni sarvāṇi sarvayugeṣv anuṣṭheyāni tathāpi satyayuge tapaḥ pradhānaṃ mahāphalam iti jñāpyate | evam ātmajñānaṃ tretāyuge, dvāpare yajñaḥ, dānaṃ kalau || 1.86 ||
sarvasyāsya tu sargasya guptyarthaṃ sa mahādyutiḥ |
mukhabāhūrupajjānāṃ pṛthak karmāṇy akalpayat || 1.87 ||
sarvasyāsyeti | sa brahmā mahātejā asya sargasya samagrasya “agnau prāstāhutiḥ” (3.76) iti nyāyena rakṣārthaṃ mukhādijātānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ vibhāgena karmāṇi dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthāni nirmitavān || 1.87 ||
adhyāpanam adhyayanaṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathā |
dānaṃ pratigrahaṃ caiva brāhmaṇānām akalpayat || 1.88 ||
adhyāpanam iti | adhyāpanādīnām iha sṛṣṭiprakaraṇe sṛṣṭiviśeṣatayābhidhānavidhis teṣām uttaratra bhaviṣyati | adhyāpanādīni ṣaṭ karmāṇi brāḥmaṇānāṃ kalpitavān || 1.88 ||
prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dānam ijyādhyayanam eva ca |
viṣayeṣv aprasaktiś ca kṣatriyasya samāsataḥ || 1.89 ||
prajānām iti | prajārakṣaṇādīni kṣatriyasya karmāṇi kalpitavān | viṣayeṣu gītanṛtya-vanitopabhogādiṣv aprasaktis teṣāṃ punar anāsevanam | samāsataḥ saṃkṣepeṇa || 1.89 ||
paśūnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ dānam ijyādhyayanam eva ca |
vaṇikpathaṃ kusīdaṃ ca vaiśyasya kṛṣim eva ca || 1.90 ||
paśūnām iti | paśūnāṃ pālanādīni vaiśyasya kalpitavān | vaṇikpathaṃ sthalajalādinā vāṇijyam | kusīdaṃ vṛddhyā dhanaprayogaḥ || 1.90 ||
ekam eva tu śūdrasya prabhuḥ karma samādiśat |
eteṣām eva varṇānāṃ śuśrūṣām anasūyayā || 1.91 ||
ekam eva tv iti | prabhur brahmā śūdrasya brāhmaṇādivarṇatrayaparicaryātmakaṃ karma nirmitavān | ekam eveti prādhānyapradarśanārtham, dānāder api tasya vihitatvāt | anasūyayā guṇānindayā || 1.91 ||
idānīṃ prādhānyena sargarakṣaṇārthatvād brāhmaṇasya tadupakramadharmābhidhānatvāc cāsya śāstrasya, brāhmaṇasya stutim āha –
ūrdhvaṃ nābher medhyataraḥ puruṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
tasmān medhyatamaṃ tv asya mukham uktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā || 1.92 ||
ūrdhvam iti | sarvata eva puruṣo medhyaḥ, nābher ūrdhvam atiśayena medhyaḥ, tato ‘pi mukhasya medhyatamatvaṃ brahmaṇoktam || 1.92 ||
tataḥ kim ata āha –
uttamāṅgodbhavāj jyaiṣṭhyād brahmaṇaś caiva dhāraṇāt |
sarvasyaivāsya sargasya dharmato brāhmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 1.93 ||
uttamāṅgodbhavād iti | uttamāṅgaṃ mukham, tadudbhavatvāt kṣatriyādibhyaḥ pūrvotpannatvād adhyāpanavyākhyānādinā yuktasyātiśayena vedadhāraṇāt sarvasyāsya jagato dharmānuśāsanena brāḥmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ:
saṃskārasya viśeṣāt tu varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
|| 1.93 ||
kasyottamāṅgād ayam udbhūta ity ata āha ¯
taṃ hi svayaṃbhūḥ svād āsyāt tapas taptvādito ‘sṛjat |
havyakavyābhivāhyāya sarvasyāsya ca guptaye || 1.94 ||
taṃ hi svayaṃbhūr iti | taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahmā ātmīyamukhād daivapitrye haviḥkavye vahanāya tapaḥ kṛtvā sarvasya jagato rakṣāyai ca kṣatriyādibhyaḥ prathamaṃ sṛṣṭavān || 1.94 ||
pūrvoktahavyakavyahavanaṃ spaṣṭayati –
yasyāsyena sadāśnanti havyāni tridivaukasaḥ |
kavyāni caiva pitaraḥ kiṃ bhūtam adhikaṃ tataḥ || 1.95 ||
yasyāsyeneti | yasya viprasya mukhena śrāddhādau sarvadā devā havyāni pitaraś ca kavyāni bhuñjate tato ‘nyat prakṛṣṭatamaṃ bhūtaṃ kiṃ bhavet || 1.95 ||
bhūtānāṃ prāṇinaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ prāṇināṃ bhuddhijīvinaḥ |
bhuddhimatsu narāḥ śreṣṭhā nareṣu brāḥmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1.96 ||
bhūtānām iti | bhūtārabdhānāṃ sthāvarajaṅgamānāṃ madhye prāṇinaḥ kīṭādayaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ, kadācit sukhaleśāt; teṣām api buddhijīvinaḥ sārthanirarthadeśopasarpaṇāpasarpaṇakāriṇaḥ paśvādayaḥ | tebhyo 'pi manuṣyāḥ, prakṛṣṭajñānasaṃbandhāt | tebhyo 'pi brāhmaṇāḥ, sarvapūjyatvād apavargādhikārayogyatvāc ca || 1.96 ||
brāhmaṇeṣu ca vidvāṃso vidvatsu kṛtabuddhayaḥ |
kṛtabuddhiṣu kartāraḥ kartṛṣu brahmavedinaḥ || 1.97 ||
brāḥmaṇeṣu ceti | brāḥmaṇeṣu tu madhye vidvāṃso mahāphalajyotiṣṭomādikarmādhikāritvāt; tebhyo ‘pi kṛtabuddhayaḥ anāgate ‘pi kṛtaṃ mayeti buddhir yeṣām | śāstroktānuṣṭhāneṣūtpannakartavyatābuddhaya ity arthaḥ; tebhyo ‘pi anuṣṭhātāraḥ | hitāhitaprāptiparihārabhāgitvāt | tebhyo ‘pi brahmavidaḥ, mokṣalābhāt || 1.97 ||
utpattir eva viprasya mūrtir dharmasya śāśvatī |
sa hi dharmārtham utpanno brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 1.98 ||
utpattir eveti | brāhmaṇadehajanmamātram eva dharmasya śarīram avināśi | yasmād asau dharmārthaṃ jātaḥ dharmānugṛhītātmajñānena mokṣāya saṃpadyate || 1.98 ||
brāhmaṇo jāyamāno hi pṛthivyām adhijāyate |
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmakośasya guptaye || 1.99 ||
brāhmaṇa iti | yasmād brāhmaṇo jāyamānaḥ pṛthivyām adhi upari bhavati | śreṣṭha ity arthaḥ | sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmasamūharakṣāyai prabhuḥ | brāhmaṇopadiṣṭatvāt sarvadharmāṇām
|| 1.99 ||
sarvaṃ svaṃ brāhmaṇasyedaṃ yat kiṃcij jagatīgatam |
śraiṣṭhyenābhijanenedaṃ sarvaṃ vai brāḥmaṇo ‘rhati || 1.100 ||
sarvaṃ svam iti | yat kiṃcij jagadvarti dhanaṃ tad brāḥmaṇasya svam iti stutyocyate | svam iva svam, na tu svam eva | brāhmaṇasyāpi manunā steyasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | tasmād brahmamukhodbhavatvenābhijanena śreṭhatā sarvaṃ brāhmaṇo ’rhati sarvagrahaṇayogyo bhavaty eva | vai avadhāraṇe || 1.100 ||
svam eva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṃ vaste svaṃ dadāti ca |
ānṛśaṃsyād brāhmaṇasya bhuñjate hītare janāḥ || 1.101 ||
svam eveti | yat parasyāpy annaṃ brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte, parasya ca vastraṃ paridhatte, parasya gṛhītvānyasmai dadāti tad api brāḥmaṇasya svam eva | pūrvavat stutiḥ | evaṃ sati brāhmaṇasya kāruṇyād anye bhojanādi kurvanti || 1.101 ||
idānīṃ prakṛṣṭabrāhmaṇakarmābhidhāyakatayā śāstrapraśaṃsā prakramate |
tasya karmavivekārthaṃ śeṣāṇām anupūrvaśaḥ |
svāyaṃbhuvo manur dhīmān idaṃ śāstraṃ akalpayat || 1.102 ||
tasya karmavivekārtham iti | brāhmaṇasya karmajñānārthaṃ śeṣāṇāṃ kṣatriyādīnāṃ ca svāyaṃbhuvo brahmaputro dhīmān sarvaviṣayajñānavān manur idaṃ śāstraṃ viracitavān
|| 1.102 ||
viduṣā brāhmaṇenedam adhyetavyaṃ prayatnataḥ |
śiṣyebhyaś ca pravaktavyaṃ samyaṅ nyāyena kenacit || 1.103 ||
viduśeti | etacchāstrādhyayanaphalajñena brāhmaṇena etasya śāstrasya vyākhyānādhyāpanocitaṃ prayatnato ‘dhyayanaṃ kartavyam, śiṣyebhyaś cedaṃ vyākhyātavyam, nānyena kṣatriyādinā | adhyayanamātraṃ tu vyākhyānādhyāpanarahitaṃ kṣatriyavaiśyayor api “niṣekādiśmaśānāntaiḥ” (2.16) ityādinā vidhāsyate | anuvādamātram etad iti medhātithimatam | tan na manoharam, dvijair adhyayanaṃ brāhmaṇenaivādhyāpanavyākhyāne ity asyālābhāt | yat tu “adhīyīraṃs trayo varṇāḥ” (10.1) ityādi tad vedaviṣayam iti vakṣyati | vipreṇaivādhyāpanam iti vidhānena saṃbhavaty apy anuvādatvam asyeti vṛthā medhātither grahaḥ || 1.103 ||
idaṃ śāstram adhīyāno brāḥmaṇaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ |
manovāgdehajair nityaṃ karmadoṣair na lipyate || 1.104 ||
idaṃ śāstram iti | idaṃ śāstraṃ paṭhen netadīyam arthaṃ jñātvā śaṃsitavrato ‘nuṣṭhitavrataḥ manovākkāyasaṃbhavaiḥ pāpair na saṃbadhyate || 1.104 ||
punāti paṅktiṃ vaṃśyāṃś ca sapta sapta parāvarān |
pṛthivīm api caivemāṃ kṛtsnām eko ‘pi so ‘rhati || 1.105 ||
punātīti | “idaṃ śāstram adhīyāna” ity anuvartate | apāṅktatayopagatāṃ paṅktim ānupūrvyā niviṣṭajanasamūhaṃ pavitrīkaroti | vaṃśabhavāṃś ca sapta parān pitrādīn, avarāṃś ca putrādīn | pṛthivīm api sarvāṃ sakaladharmajñatayā pātratvena grahītuṃ yogyo bhavati || 1.105 ||
idaṃ svastyayanaṃ śreṣṭham idaṃ buddhivivardhanam |
idaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyam idaṃ niḥśreyasaṃ param || 1.106 ||
idam iti | abhipretārthasyāvināśaḥ svasti, tasyāyanaṃ prāpakam; etac chāstrasyādhyayanaṃ svyastyayanaṃ japahomādibodhakatvāc ca śreṣṭhaṃ svastyayanānantarāt prakṛṣṭaṃ buddhivivardhanam, etacchāstrābhyāsenāśeṣavidhiniṣedhaparijñānāt | yaśase hitaṃ yaśasyaṃ vidvattayā khātilābhāt paraṃ prakṛṣṭam | niḥśeyasaṃ niḥśreyasasya mokṣasyopāyopadeśakatvāt || 1.106 ||
asmin dharmo ‘khilenokto guṇadoṣau ca karmaṇām |
caturṇām api varṇānām ācāraś caiva śāśvataḥ || 1.107 ||
asmin dharma iti | asmin kārtsnyena dharmo ‘bhihita iti śāstrapraśaṃsā | karmaṇāṃ ca vihitaniṣiddhānām iṣṭāniṣṭaphale | varṇacatuṣṭayasyaiva puruṣadharmarūpa ācāraḥ śāśvataḥ pāramparyāgataḥ | dharmatve ‘py ācārasya prādhānyakhyāpanāya pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ || 1.107 ||
prādhānyam eva spaṣṭayati –
ācāraḥ paramo dharmaḥ śrutyuktaḥ smārta eva ca |
tasmād asmin sadā yukto nityaṃ syād ātmavān dvijaḥ || 1.108 ||
ācāra iti | yukto yatnavān ātmahitecchuḥ | sarvasyātmāstīti ātmaśabdena ātmahitecchā lakṣyate
|| 1.108 ||
ācārād vicyuto vipro na vedaphalam aśnute |
ācāreṇa tu saṃyuktaḥ saṃpūrṇaphalabhāg bhavet || 1.109 ||
ācārād iti | ācārād vicyuto vipro na vaidikaṃ phalaṃ labhet | ācārayuktaḥ punaḥ samagraphalabhāg bhavati || 1.109 ||
evam ācārato dṛṣṭvā dharmasya munayo gatim |
sarvasya tapaso mūlam ācāraṃ jagṛhuḥ param || 1.110 ||
evam iti | uktaprakāreṇācārād dharmaprāptim ṛṣayo buddhvā tapasaś cāndrāyaṇādeḥ samagrasya kāraṇam ācāram anuṣṭheyatayā gṛhītavantaḥ | uttaratra vakṣyamāṇasyācārasyeha stutiḥ śāstrastutyarthā || 1.110 ||
idānīṃ śiṣyasya sukhapratipattaye vakṣyamāṇārthānukramaṇikām āha –
jagataś ca samutpattiṃ saṃskāravidhim eva ca |
vratacaryopacāraṃ ca snānasya ca paraṃ vidhim || 1.111 ||
jagataś ca samutpattim iti | “pāṣaṇḍagaṇadharmāṃś ca” (1.118) ityantaṃ jagadutpattir yathoktā | brāhmaṇastutiś ca sargarakṣārthatvena | brāhmaṇasya śāstrastutyādikaṃ ca sṛṣṭāv evāntarbhavati | etat prathamādhyāyaprameyam | saṃskārāṇāṃ jātakarmādīnāṃ vidhim anuṣṭhānam | brahmacāriṇo vratācaraṇam | upacāraṃ ca gurvādīnām abhivādanopāsanādi | “sarvo dvando vibhāṣaikavad bhavati” (Patañjali I: 476–77) ity ekavadbhāvaḥ | etad dvitīyādhyāyaprameyam | snānaṃ gurukulān nivartamānasya saṃskāraviśeṣas tasya prakṛte vidhānam || 1.111 ||
dārādhigamanaṃ caiva vivāhānāṃ ca lakṣaṇam |
mahāyajñavidhānaṃ ca śrāddhakalpaṃ ca śāśvatam || 1.112 ||
dārādhigamanam iti | dārādhigamanaṃ vivāhaḥ, tadveśeṣāṇāṃ brāhmādīnāṃ ca lakṣaṇam | mahāyajñāḥ pañca vaiśvadevādayaḥ | śrāddhasya vidhiḥ śāśvataḥ pratisargam anādipravāhapravṛttyā nityaḥ | eṣa tṛtīyādhyāyārthaḥ || 1.112 ||
vṛttīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ caiva snātakasya vratāni ca |
bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ śuddhim eva ca || 1.113 ||
vṛttīnām iti | vṛttīnāṃ jīvanopāyānām ṛtādīnāṃ lakṣaṇam | snātakasya gṛhasthasya vratāni niyamāḥ | etac caturthādhyāyaprameyam | bhakṣyaṃ dadhyādi, abhakṣyaṃ laśunādi | śaucaṃ maraṇādau brāhmaṇāder daśāhādinā | dravyāṇāṃ śuddhim udakādinā || 1.113 ||
strīdharmayogaṃ tāpasyaṃ mokṣaṃ saṃnyāsam eva ca |
rājñaś ca dharmam akhilaṃ kāryāṇāṃ ca vinirṇayam || 1.114 ||
strīdharmayogam iti | strīṇāṃ dharmayogaṃ dharmopāyam etat pāñcamikam | tāpasyaṃ tapase vānaprasthāya hitaṃ tasya dharmam | mokṣahetutvān mokṣaṃ yatidharmam | yatidharmatve ‘pi saṃnyāsasya pṛthag upadeśaḥ prādhānyajñāpanārthaḥ | eṣa ṣaṣṭhādhyāyārthaḥ | rājño ‘bhiṣiktasya sarvo dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārtho dharmaḥ | eṣa saptamādhyāyārthaḥ | kāryāṇām ṛṇādīnām arthipratyarthisamarpitānāṃ vinirṇayo vicārya tattvanirṇayaḥ || 1.114 ||
sākṣipraśnavidhānaṃ ca dharmaṃ strīpuṃsayor api |
vibhāgadharmaṃ dyūtaṃ ca kaṇṭakānāṃ ca śodhanam || 1.115 ||
sākṣīti | sākṣiṇāṃ ca praśne yad vidhānam | vyavahārāṅgatve ‘pi sākṣipraśnasya vidhānanirṇayopāyatvāt pṛthaṅ nirdeśaḥ | etad āṣṭamikam | strīpuṃsayor bhāryāpatyoḥ saṃnidhāv asaṃnidhau ca dharmānuṣṭhānam, ṛkthabhāgasya ca dharmam | yady api ṛkthabhāgo ‘pi “kāryāṇāṃ ca vinirṇayam” (1.114) ity anenaiva prāptas tathāpy adhyāyabhedāt pṛthaṅ nirdeśaḥ | dyūtaviṣayo vidhir dyūtaśabdenocyate | kaṇṭakānāṃ caurādīnāṃ śodhanaṃ nirasanam || 1.115 ||
vaiśyaśūdropacāraṃ ca saṃkīrṇānāṃ ca saṃbhavam |
āpaddharmaṃ ca varṇānāṃ prāyaścitavidhiṃ tathā || 1.116 ||
vaiśyaśūdropacāraṃ ceti | vaiśyaśūdropacāraṃ svadharmānuṣṭhānam | etan navame | evaṃ saṃkīrṇānāṃ anulomapratilomajātānām utpattim, āpadi ca jīvikopadeśaṃ āpaddharmam | etad daśame | prāyaścittavidhim ekādaśe || 1.116 ||
saṃsāragamanaṃ caiva trividhaṃ karmasaṃbhavam |
niḥśreyasaṃ karmaṇāṃ ca guṇadoṣaparīkṣaṇam || 1.117 ||
saṃsāragamanam iti | saṃsāragamanaṃ dehāntaprāptirūpam uttamamadhyamādhamabhedena trividhaṃ śubhāśubhakarmahetukam | niḥśreyasam ātmajñānaṃ sarvotkṛṣṭamokṣalakṣaṇasya śreyohetutvāt | karmaṇāṃ ca vihitaniṣiddhānāṃ guṇadoṣaparīkṣaṇam || 1.117 ||
deśadharmāñ jātidharmān kuladharmāṃś ca śāśvatān |
pāṣaṇḍagaṇadharmāṃś ca śāstre ‘sminn uktavān manuḥ || 1.118 ||
deśadharmān iti | pratiniyatadeśe ‘nuṣṭhīyamānā deśadharmāḥ, brāhmaṇādijātiniyatā jātidharmāḥ, kulaveśeṣāśrayāḥ kuladharmāḥ, vedabāhyāgamasamāśrayā pratiṣiddhavratacaryā pāṣaṇḍam, tadyogāt puruṣo ‘pi pāṣaṇḍaḥ, tannimittā ye dharmāḥ “pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān” (4.30) ityādayaḥ, teṣāṃ pṛthagdharmānabhidhānāt | gaṇaḥ samūho vaṇigādīnām || 1.118 ||
yathedam uktavāñ chāstraṃ purā pṛṣṭo manur mayā |
tathedaṃ yūyam apy adya matsakāśān nibodhata || 1.119 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ
prathamo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
yathedam iti | pūrvaṃ mayā pṛṣṭo manur yathedaṃ śāstram abhihitavāṃs tathaivānyūnān atiriktaṃ matsakāśāc chṛṇuteti ṛṣīṇāṃ śrāddhātiśayārthaṃ punar abhidhānam || 1.119 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ
prathamo ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
dvitīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ
prakṛṣṭaparamātmajñānarūpadharmajñānāya jagatkāraṇaṃ brahma pratipādyādhunā brahmajñānāṅgabhūtaṃ saṃskārādirūpaṃ dharmaṃ pratipipādayiṣur dharmasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ prathamam āha –
vidvadbhiḥ sevitaḥ sadbhir nityam adveṣarāgibhiḥ |
hṛdayenābhyanujñāto yo dharmas taṃ nibodhata || 2.1 ||
vidvadbhir iti | vidvadbhir vedavidbhiḥ sadbhir dhārmikai rāgadveṣaśūnyair anuṣṭhito hṛdayenābhimukhyena jñāta ity anena śreyaḥsādhanam abhihitam | tatra hi svarasān mano ‘bhimukhībhavati | vedavidbhir jñāta iti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyāj jñātasya vedasyaiva śreyaḥsādhanajñāne kāraṇatvaṃ vivakṣitam | “khaḍgadhāriṇa hataḥ” ity ukte dhṛtakhaḍgasyaiva hanane prādhānyam | ato “vedapramāṇakaḥ śreyaḥsādhanaṃ dharmaḥ” ity uktam | evaṃvidho yo dharmas taṃ nibodhata | uktārthasaṃgrahaślokāḥ –
vedavidbhir jñāta iti prayuñjāno viśeṣaṇam |
vedād eva parijñāto dharma ity uktavān manuḥ ||
hṛdayenābhimukhyena jñāta ity api nirdiśan |
śreyaḥsādhanam ity āha tatra hy abhimukhaṃ manaḥ ||
vedapramāṇakaḥ śreyaḥsādhanaṃ dharma ity ataḥ |
manūktam eva munayaḥ praṇinyur dharmalakṣaṇam ||
ata eva hārītaḥ: “athāto dharmaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | śrutipramāṇako dharmaḥ | śrutiś ca dvividhā vaidikī tāntrikī ca” iti | bhaviṣyapurāṇe:
dharmaḥ śreyaḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ śreyo ‘bhyudayalakṣaṇam |
sa tu pañcavidhaḥ prokto vedamūlaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
asya samyag anuṣṭhānāt svargo mokṣaś ca jāyate |
iha loke sukhaiśvaryam atulaṃ ca khagādhipa ||
śreyaḥsādhanam ity arthaḥ | jaiminir apīdaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam asūtrayat: “codanālakṣaṇo ‘rtho dharmaḥ” (Jai. Sū. 1.,1.2) iti | ubhayaṃ codanayā lakṣyate – arthaḥ śreyaḥsādhanaṃ jyoiṣṭomādiḥ, anarthaḥ pratyavāyasādhanaṃ śyenādiḥ | tatra vedapramāṇakaṃ śreyaḥsādhanaṃ jyotiṣṭomādi dharma iti sūtrārthaḥ | smṛtyādayo ‘pi vedamūlatvenaiva dharme pramāṇam iti darśayiṣyāmaḥ | govindarājas tu hṛdayenābhyanujñāta ity antaḥkaraṇavicikitsāśūnya iti vyākhyātavān | tanmate vedavidbhir anuṣṭhitaḥ saṃśayarahitaś ca dharma iti dharmalakṣaṇaṃ syāt | evaṃ ca dṛṣṭārthagrāmagamanādisādhāraṇaṃ dharmalakṣaṇaṃ vicakṣaṇā na śraddadhate | medhātithis tu hṛdayenābhyanujñāt iti yatra cittaṃ pravartayatīti vyākhyāya, atha vā hṛdayaṃ vedaḥ, sa hy adhīto bhāvanārūpeṇa hṛdayasthito hṛdayam ity ucyata ity uktavān || 2.1 ||
kāmātmatā na praśastā na caivehāsty akāmatā |
kāmyo hi vedādhigamaḥ karmayogaś ca vaidikaḥ || 2.2 ||
kāmātmateti | phalābhilāṣaśīlatvaṃ puruṣasya kāmātmatā | sā na praśastā, bandhahetutvāt | svargādiphalābhilāṣeṇa kāmyāni karmāṇy anuṣṭhīyamānāni punarjanmane kāraṇaṃ bhavanti | nityanaimittikāni tv ātmajñānasahakāritayā mokṣāya kalpante | na punar icchāmātram anena niṣidhyate | tad āha – na caivehāsty akāmateti | yato vedasvīkaraṇaṃ vaidikasakaladharmasaṃbandhaś cecchāviṣaya eva || 2.2 ||
atropapattim āha –
saṃkalpamūlaḥ kāmo vai yajñāḥ saṃkalpasaṃbhavāḥ |
vratāni yamadharmāś ca sarve saṃkalpajāḥ smṛtāḥ || 2.3 ||
saṃkalpamūla iti | anena karmaṇedam iṣṭaṃ phalaṃ sādhyata ity evaṃviṣayā buddhiḥ saṃkalpaḥ, tadanantaram iṣṭasādhanatayāvagate tasminn icchā jāyate, tadarthaṃ prayatnaṃ kurute cety evaṃ yajñāḥ saṃkalpaprabhavāḥ, vratāni, yamarūpāś ca dharmāś caturthādhyāye vakṣyamāṇāḥ | sarva ity anena padena anye ‘pi śāstrārthāḥ saṃkalpād eva jāyante | icchām antareṇa tāny api na saṃbhavantīty arthaḥ | govindarājas tu vratāny anuṣtheyarūpāṇi, yamadharmāḥ pratiṣedhārthakā ity āha || 2.3 ||
atraiva laukikaṃ niyamaṃ darśayati –
akāmasya kriyā kācid dṛśyate neha karhicit |
yad yad dhi kurute kiṃcit tat tat kāmasya ceṣṭitam || 2.4 ||
akāmasyeti | loke yā kācid bhojanagamanādikriyā sāpy anicchato na kadācid dṛśyate | tataś ca sarvaṃ karma laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ ca yad yat puruṣaḥ kurute tat tad icchākāryam || 2.4 ||
saṃprati pūrvoktaṃ phalābhilāṣaniṣedhaṃ niyamayati –
teṣu samyag vartamāno gacchaty amaralokatām |
yathāsaṃkalpitāṃś ceha sarvān kāmān samaśnute || 2.5 ||
teṣu samyag vartamāna iti | nātrecchā niṣidhyate kiṃ tu śāstroktakarmasu samyag vṛttir vidhīyate | bandhahetuphalābhilāṣaṃ vinā śāstrīyakarmaṇām anuṣṭhānaṃ teṣu samyag vṛttiḥ samyag vartamāno ‘maralokatām amaralokaṃ brahmabhāvaṃ gacchati | mokṣaṃ prāpnotīy arthaḥ | tathābhūtaś ca sarveśvaratvād ihāpi loke sarvān abhilaṣitān propnoti | tathā ca chāndogye (8.2.1): “sa yadi pitṛlokakāmo bhavati saṃkalpād evāsya pitaraḥ samuttiṣṭhanti” ityādi || 2.5 ||
idānīṃ dharmapramāṇāny āha –
vedo ‘khilo dharmamūlaṃ smṛtiśīle ca tadvidām |
ācāraś caiva sādhūnām ātmanas tuṣtir eva ca || 2.6 ||
vedo ‘khilo dharmamūlam iti | vedaḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvalakṣaṇaḥ, sa sarvo vidhyarthavādamantrātmā dharme mūlaṃ pramāṇam | arthavādānām api vidhyekavākyatayā stāvakatvena dharme prāmāṇyāt | yad āha jaiminiḥ (Jai. Sū. 1.2.7): “vidhinā tv ekavākyatvāt stutyarthena vidhīnāṃ syuḥ” | mantrārthavādānām api vidhivākyaikavākyatayaiva dharme prāmāṇyam, prayogakāle cānuṣṭheyasmārakatvam, vedasya ca dharme prāmāṇyaṃ yathānubhavakaraṇatvarūpaṃ nyāyasiddham | smṛtyādīnām api tanmūlatvenaiva prāmāṇyapratipādanārtham anūdyate | manvādīnāṃ ca vedavidāṃ smṛtidharme pramāṇam | vedavidām iti viśeṣaṇopādānād vedamulatvenaiva smṛtyādīnāṃ prāmāṇyam abhimatam | śīlaṃ brahmaṇyatādirūpam | tad āha hārītaḥ:
brahmaṇyatā devapitṛbhaktatā saumyatā aparopatāpitā anasuyatā mṛdutā apāruṣyaṃ maitratā priyavāditvaṃ kṛtajñatā śaraṇyatā kāruṇyaṃ praśāntiś ceti trayodaśavidhaṃ śīlam |
govindarājas tu śīlaṃ dhārmikāṇāṃ ātmatuṣṭiś ca vaikalpikapadārthaviṣayā dharme pramāṇam | tad āha gargaḥ: “vaikalpike ātmatuṣṭiḥ pramāṇam” || 2.6 ||
vedād anyeṣāṃ vedamūlatvena prāmāṇye ‘bhihite ‘pi manusmṛteḥ sarvotkarṣajñāpanāya viśeṣeṇa vedamūlatām āha –
yaḥ kaścit kasyacid dharmo manunā parikīrtitaḥ |
sa sarvo ‘bhihito vede sarvajñānamayo hi saḥ || 2.7 ||
yaḥ kaścid iti | yaḥ kaścit kasyacid brāhmaṇader manunā dharma uktaḥ sa sarvo vede pratipāditaḥ | yasmāt sarvajño ‘sau manuḥ sarvajñatayā cotsannaviprakīrṇapaṭhyamāna-vedārthaṃ samyagjñātā lokahitāyopanibaddhavān | govindarājas tu “sarvajñānamayaḥ” ity asya “sarvajñānārabdha iva veda” iti vedaviśeṣaṇatām āha || 2.7 ||
sarvaṃ tu samavekṣyedaṃ nikhilaṃ jñānacakṣuṣā |
śrutiprāṇyato vidvān svadharme niviśeta vai || 2.8 ||
sarvaṃ tv iti | sarvaṃ śāstrajātaṃ vedārthāvagamocitaṃ jñānaṃ mīmāṃsāvyākaraṇādikaṃ jñānam eva cakṣuś tena nikhilaṃ tadviśeṣeṇa paryālocya vedaprāmāṇyenānuṣṭheyam avagamya svadharme ‘vatiṣtheta || 2.8 ||
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmam anutiṣṭhan hi mānavaḥ |
iha kīrtim āvāpnoti pretya cānuttamaṃ sukham || 2.9 ||
śrutismṛtyuditam iti | śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dhamam anutiṣṭhan mānavaḥ iha loke dhārmikatvenānuṣaṅgikīṃ kīrtiṃ paraloke ca dharmaphalam utkṛṣṭaṃ svargāpavargādisukharūpaṃ prāpnoti | anena vāstavaguṇakathanena śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmam anutiṣṭhed iti vidhi kalpyate || 2.9 ||
śrutis tu vedo vijñeyo dharmaśāstraṃ tu vai smṛtiḥ |
te sarvārtheṣv amīmāṃsye tābhyāṃ dharmo hi nirbabhau || 2.10 ||
śrutis tv iti | lokaprasiddhasaṃjñāsaṃjñisaṃbandhānuvādo ‘yaṃ śrutismṛtyoḥ pratikūlatarkeṇāmīṃsyatvavidhānārtham, smṛteḥ śrutitulyatvabodhanenācārādibhyo balavattvapratipādanārthaṃ ca | tena smṛtiviruddhācāro heya ity asya phalam | śrutir vedaḥ, manvādiśāstraṃ smṛtiḥ, te ubhe pratikūlatarkair na vicārayitavye, yatas tābhyāṃ niḥśeṣeṇa dharmo babhau prakāśatāṃ gataḥ || 2.10 ||
yo ‘vamanyeta te mūle hetuśāstrāśrayād dvijaḥ |
sa sādhubhir bahiṣkāryo nāstiko vedanindakaḥ || 2.11 ||
yo ‘vamanyeteti | yaḥ punar te dve śrutismṛtī dvijo ‘vamanyeta sa śiṣṭair dvijānuṣṭheyādhyayanādikarmaṇo niḥsāryaḥ | pūrvaśloke sāmānyenāmīmāṃsye iti mīmāṃsāniṣedhād anukūlamīmāṃśāpi na pravartanīyeti bhramo mā bhūd iti viśeṣayati – hetuśāstrāśrayāt | vedavākyam apramāṇaṃ vākyatvāt vipralambhakavākyavad ityādipratikūlatarkāvaṣṭambhena cārvākādināstika iva nāstikaḥ | yato vedanindakaḥ || 1.11 ||
idānīṃ śīlasyācāra evāntarbhāvasaṃbhavād vedamūlataiva tantraṃ na smṛtiśīlādiprakāraniyama iti darśayituṃ caturdhā dharmapramāṇam āha –
vedaḥ smṛtiḥ sadācāraḥ svasya ca priyam ātmanaḥ |
etac caturvidhaṃ prāhuḥ sākṣād dharmasya lakṣaṇam || 2.12 ||
veda iti | vedo dharmapramāṇam, sa kvacit pratyakṣaḥ kvacit smṛtyānumita ity evaṃ tātparyaṃ na tu pramāṇaparigaṇane | ata eva “śrutismṛtyuditaṃ dharmam” (2.9) ity atra dvayam evābhihitavān | sadācāraḥ śiṣṭācāraḥ | svasya cātmanaḥ priyam ātmatuṣṭiḥ || 2.12 ||
arthakāmeṣv asaktānāṃ dharmajñānaṃ vidhīyate |
dharmaṃ jijñāsamānānāṃ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ śrutiḥ || 2.13 ||
arthakāmeṣv iti | arthakāmeṣv asaktānām arthakāmalipsāśūnyānāṃ dharmopadeśo ‘yam | ye tv arthakāmasamīhayā lokapratipattyarthaṃ dharmam anutiṣṭhanti na teṣāṃ karmaphalam ity arthaḥ | dharmaṃ ca jñātum icchatāṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ pramāṇaṃ śrutiḥ | prakarṣabodhanena ca śrutismṛtivirodhe smṛtyartho nādaraṇīya ity bhāvaḥ | ata eva jābālaḥ:
śrutismṛtivirodhe tu śrutir eva garīyasī |
avirodhe sadā kāryaṃ smārtaṃ vaidikavat satā ||
bhaviṣyapurāṇe ‘py uktam:
śrutyā saha virodhe tu bādhyate viṣayaṃ vinā ||
jaiminir apy āha (Jai. Nyā. Sū. 1.3.3): “virodhe tv anapekṣaṃ syād asati hy anumānam” | śrutivirodhe smṛtivākyam anapekṣyam apramāṇam anādaraṇīyam | asati virodhe mūlavedānumānam ity arthaḥ || 2.13 ||
śrutidvaidhaṃ tu yatra syāt tatra dharmāv ubhau smṛtau |
ubhāv api hi tau dharmau samyag uktau manīṣibhiḥ || 2.14 ||
śrutidvaidhaṃ tv iti | yatra punaḥ śrutyor eva dvaidhaṃ parasparaviruddhārthapratipādanaṃ tatra dvāv api dharmau manunā smṛtau | tulyabalatayā vikalpānuṣṭhānavidhānena ca virodhābhāvaḥ | yasmān manvādibhyaḥ pūrvatarair api vidvadbhiḥ samyak samīcīnau dvāv api tau dharmāv uktau | samānanyāyatayā smṛtyor api virodhe vikalpa iti prakṛtopayogaḥ tulyabalatvāviśeṣāt | tad āha gautamaḥ: “tulyabalavirodhe vikalpaḥ” || 2.14 ||
atra dṛṣṭāntam āha –
udite ‘nudite caiva samayādhyuṣite tathā |
sarvathā vartate yajña itīyaṃ vaidikī śrutiḥ || 2.15 ||
udite ‘nudite caiveti | sūryanakṣatravarjitaḥ kālaḥ samyādhyuṣitaśabdenocyate | udayāt pūrvam aruṇakiraṇavān praviralatārako ‘nuditakālaḥ | parasparaviruddhakālaśravaṇe ‘pi sarvathā vikalpenāgnihotrahomaḥ pravartate | devatoddeśena dravyatyāgaguṇayogāt yajñaśabdo ‘tra gauṇaḥ | “udite hotavyam” ityādikā vaidikī śrutiḥ || 2.15 ||
niṣekādiśmaśānānto mantrair yasyodito vidhiḥ |
tasya śāstre ‘dhikāro ‘smiñ jñeyo nānyasya kasyacit || 2.16 ||
niṣakādīti | garbhādhānādir antyeṣṭiparyanto yasya varṇasya mantrair anuṣṭhānakalāpa ukto dvijāter ity arthaḥ | tasyāsmin mānavadharmaśāstre ‘dhyayane śravaṇe ‘dhikāraḥ, na tv anyasya kasyacic chūdrādeḥ | etac chāstrānuṣthānaṃ ca yathādhikāraṃ sarvair eva kartavyam, pravacanaṃ tv asyādhyāpanaṃ vyākhyānarūpaṃ brāhmaṇakartṛkam eveti “viduṣā brāhmaṇena” (1.103) ity atra vyākhyātam || 2.16 ||
dharmasya svarūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ paribhāṣāṃ coktvā idānīṃ dharmānuṣṭhānayogyadeśān āha –
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyor devanadyor yad antaram |
taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmāvartaṃ pracakṣate || 2.17 ||
sarasvatīti | sarasvatīdṛṣadvator nadyor ubhayor madhyaṃ brahmāvartaṃ deśam āhuḥ | devanadīdevanirmitaśabdau nadīdeśaprāśastyārthau || 2.18 ||
tasmin deśe ya ācāraḥ pāraṃparyakramāgataḥ |
varṇānāṃ sāntarālānāṃ sa sadācāra ucyate || 2.18 ||
tasmin deśa iti | tasmin deśe prāyeṇa śiṣṭānāṃ saṃbhavāt teṣāṃ brāhmaṇādivarṇānāṃ saṃkīrṇajātiparyantānāṃ ya ācāraḥ pāraṃparyakramāgato na tv idānīṃtanaḥ sa sadācāro ‘bhidhīyate || 2.18 ||
kurukṣetraṃ ca matsyāś ca pañcālāḥ śūrasenakāḥ |
eṣa brahmarṣideśo vai brahmāvartād anantaraḥ || 2.19 ||
kurukṣetram iti | matyādiśabdāḥ bahuvacanāntā eva deśavideśavācakāḥ | pañcālāḥ kānyakubjadeśāḥ | śūrasenakā mathurādeśāḥ | eṣa brahmarṣideśo brahmāvartāt kiṃcidūnaḥ
|| 2.19 ||
etaddeśaprasūtasya sakāśād agrajanmanaḥ |
svaṃ svaṃ caritraṃ śikṣeran pṛthivyāṃ sarvamānavāḥ || 2.20 ||
etaddeśa iti | kurukṣetrādideśajātasya brāhmaṇasya sakāśāt sarvamanuṣyā ātmīyam atmīyam ācāraṃ śikṣeran || 2.20 ||
himavadvindhyayor madhyaṃ yat prāg vinaśanād api |
pratyag eva prayāgāc ca madhyadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 2.21 ||
himavad iti | uttaradakṣiṇadigavasthitau himavadvindhyau parvatau tayor madhyaṃ vinaśanāt sarasvatyantardhānadeśād yat pūrvaṃ prayāgāc ca yat paścimaṃ sa madhyadeśanāmā deśaḥ kathitaḥ || 2.21 ||
ā samudrāt tu vai pūrvād ā samudrāc ca paścimāt |
tayor evāntaraṃ giryor āryāvartaṃ vidur budhāḥ || 2.22 ||
ā samudrāt tv iti | ā purvasamudrāt ā paścimasamudrād dhimavadvindhyayoś ca yan madhyaṃ tam āryāvartadeśaṃ paṇḍitā jānanti | maryādāyām ayam āṅ nābhividhau | tena samudramadhyadvīpānāṃ nāryāvartatā | āryā atrāvartante punaḥ punar udbhavantīty āryāvartaḥ
|| 2.22 ||
kṛṣṇasāras tu carati mṛgo yatra svabhāvataḥ |
sa jñeyo yajñiyo deśo mlecchadeśas tv ataḥ paraḥ || 2.23 ||
kṛṣṇasāras tv iti | kṛṣṇasāro mṛgo yatra svabhāvato vasati na tu balād ānītaḥ sa yajñārho deśo jñātavyaḥ | anyo mlecchadeśo na yajñārha ity arthaḥ || 2.23 ||
etān dvijātayo deśān saṃśrayeran prayatnataḥ |
śūdras tu yasmin kasmin vā nivased vṛttikarśitaḥ || 2.24 ||
etān iti | anyadeśodbhavā api dvijātayo yajñārthatvād adṛṣṭārthatvāc caitān deśān prayatnād āśrayeran | śūdras tu vṛttipīḍito vṛttyartham anyadeśam apy āśrayet || 2.24 ||
eṣā dharmasya vo yoniḥ samāsena prakīrtitā |
saṃbhavaś cāsya sarvasya varṇadharmān nibodhata || 2.25 ||
eṣā dharmasyeti | eṣā yuṣmākaṃ dharmasya yoniḥ saṃkṣepeṇoktā | yonir jñaptikāraṇaṃ “vedo ‘khilo dharmamūlam” (2.6) ityādinoktam ity arthaḥ | govindarājas tv “iha dharmaśabdo ‘apūrvākhyātmakadharme vartata iti, “vidvadbhiḥ sevitaḥ” (2.1) ity atra tatkāraṇe ‘ṣṭakādau vāpūrvākhyasya dharmasya yonir” iti vyākhyātavān | saṃbhavaś cotpattir jagata ity uktā | idānīṃ varṇadharmāñ chṛṇuta | varṇadharmaśabdaś ca varṇadharmāśramadharma-varṇāśramadharmaguṇadharmanaimittikadharmāṇām upalakṣakaḥ | te ca bhaviṣyapurāṇoktaḥ |
varṇadharmaḥ smṛtas tv eka āśramāṇām ataḥ param |
varṇāśramas tṛtīyas tu gauṇo naimittikas tathā ||
varṇatvam ekam āśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate |
varṇadharmaḥ sa uktas tu yathopanayanaṃ nṛpa ||
yas tv āśramaṃ samāśritya adhikāraḥ pravartate |
sa khalv āśramadharmas tu bhikṣādaṇḍādiko yathā ||
varṇatvam āśramatvaṃ ca yo ‘dhikṛtya pravartate |
sa varṇāśramadharmas tu mauñjīyā mekhalā yathā ||
yo guṇena pravarteta guṇadharmaḥ sa ucyate |
yathā mūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānāṃ paripālanam ||
nimittam ekam āśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate |
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhir yathā ||
|| 2.25 ||
vaidikaiḥ karmabhiḥ puṇyair niṣekādir dvijanmanām |
kāryaḥ śarīrasaṃskāraḥ pāvanaḥ pretya ceha ca || 2.26 ||
vaidikair iti | vedamūlatvād vaidikaiḥ puṇyaiḥ śubhair mantrayogādikarmabhiḥ dvijātīnāṃ garbhādhānādiśarīrasaṃskāraḥ kartavyaḥ | pāvanaḥ pāpakṣayahetuḥ | pretya paraloke saṃskṛtasya yāgādiphalasaṃbandhāt, iha loke ca vedādhyayanādyadhikārāt || 2.26 ||
kutaḥ pāpasaṃbhavo yenaiṣāṃ pāpakṣayahetutvam ity ata āha –
gārbhair homair jātakarmacauḍamauñjīnibandhanaiḥ |
baijikaṃ gārbhikaṃ caino dvijānām apamṛjyate || 2.27 ||
garbhair iti | ye garbhaśuddhaye kriyante te gārbhāḥ | homagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam, garbhādhānāder ahomarūpatvāt | jātasya yat karma mantravat sarpiḥprāśanādirūpaṃ taj jātakarma | cauḍaṃ cūḍākaraṇakarma | mauñjīnibandhanam upanayanam | etair baijikaṃ pratiṣiddhamaithunasaṃkalpādinā paitṛkaretodoṣād yad yat pāpaṃ, gārbhikaṃ cāśucimātṛgarbhavāsajaṃ tad dvijātīnām apamṛjyate || 2.27 ||
svādhyāyena vratair homais traividyenejyayā sutaiḥ |
mahāyajñaiś ca yajñaiś ca brāhmīyaṃ kriyate tanuḥ || 2.28 ||
svādhyāyeneti | vedādhyayanena | vratair madhumāṃsavarjanādiniyamaiḥ, homaiḥ sāvitracaruhomādibhiḥ, sāyaṃprātar homaiś ca, traividyākhena ca, vrateṣv aprādhānyād asya pṛthag upanyāsaḥ | ijyayā brahmacaryāvasthāyāṃ devarṣipitṛtarpaṇarūpayā, gṛhasthāvasthāyāṃ putrotpādanena | mahāyajñaiḥ pañcabhir brahmayajñādibhiḥ | yajñair jyotiṣṭomādibhiḥ | brāhmī brahmaprāptiyogyeyaṃ tanuḥ tanvavacchinna ātmā kriyate, karmasahakṛtabrahmajñānena mokṣāvāpteḥ || 2.28 ||
prāṅ nābhivardhanāt puṃso jātakarma vidhīyate |
mantravat prāśanaṃ cāsya hiraṇyamadhusarpiṣām || 2.29 ||
prāg iti | nābhicchedanāt prāk puruṣasya jātakarmākhyaḥ saṃskāraḥ kriyate | tadā cāsya svagṛhyoktamantraiḥ svarṇamadhughṛtānāṃ prāśanam || 2.29 ||
nāmadheyaṃ daśamyāṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ vāsya kārayet |
puṇye tithau muhūrte vā nakṣatre vā guṇānvite || 2.30 ||
nāmadheyam iti | “jātakarma” iti pūrvaśloke janmanaḥ prastutatvāj janmāpekṣayaiva daśame dvādaśe vāhani asya śiśor nāmadheyaṃ svayam asaṃbhave ‘nyena kārayet | atha vā,
āśauce ca vyatikrānte nāmakarma vidhīyate | (Śaṅkha 2.2)
iti śaṅkhavacanād daśame ‘hany atīte ekādaśāha iti vyākhyeyam | tatrāpy akaraṇe praśaste tithau praśasta eva muhūrte nakṣatre ca guṇavaty eva jyotiṣāvagate kartavyam | vāśabdo ‘vadhāraṇe || 2.30 ||
maṅgalyaṃ brāhmaṇasya syāt kṣatriyasya balānvitam |
