vaiśyasya dhanasaṃyuktaṃ śūdrasya tu jugupsitam || 2.31 ||
maṅgalyam iti | brāhmaṇādīnāṃ yathākramaṃ maṅgalabaladhananindāvācakāni śubhabalavasudīnādīni nāmāni kartavyāni || 2.31 ||
idānīm upapadaniyamārtham āha –
śarmavad brāhmaṇasya syād rājño rakṣāsamanvitam |
vaiśyasya puṣṭisaṃyuktaṃ śūdrasya preṣyasaṃyutam || 2.32 ||
śramavad brāhmaṇasyeti | eṣāṃ yathākramaṃ śarmarakṣāpuṣṭipraiṣyavācikāni kartavyāni śarmavarmabhūtidāsādīni upapadāni kāryāṇi | udāharaṇāni tu śubhaśarmā, balavarmā, vasubhūtiḥ, dīnadāsaḥ iti | tathā ca yamaḥ |
śarma devaś ca viprasya varma trātā ca bhūbhujaḥ |
bhūtidattaś ca vaiśyasya dāsaḥ śūdrasya kārayet ||
viṣṇupurāṇe ‘py uktam |
śarmavad brāhmaṇasyoktaṃ varmeti kṣatrasaṃyutam |
guptadāsātmakaṃ nāma praśastaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ ||
|| 2.32 ||
strīṇāṃ sukhodyam akrūraṃ vispaṣṭārthaṃ manoharam |
maṅgalyaṃ dīrghavarṇāntam āśīrvādābhidhānavat || 2.33 ||
strīṇām iti | sukhoccaryam akrūrārthavāci vyaktābhidheyaṃ manaḥprītijananaṃ maṅgalavāci dīrghasvarāntaṃ āśīrvācakenābhidhānena śabdenopetaṃ strīṇāṃ nāma kartavyam | yathā yaśodādevīti || 2.33 ||
caturthe māsi kartavyaṃ śiśor niṣkramaṇaṃ gṛhāt |
ṣaṣṭhe ‘nnaprāśanaṃ māsi yad veṣṭaṃ maṅgalaṃ kule || 2.34 ||
caturthe māsīti | caturthe māse bālasya janmagṛhān niṣkramaṇam ādityadarśanārthaṃ kāryam | annaprāśanaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhe māse; atha vā kuladharmatvena yan maṅgalam iṣṭaṃ tat kartavyam, tenoktakālād anyakāle ‘pi niṣkramaṇam | tathā ca yamaḥ |
tatas tṛtīye kartavyaṃ māsi sūryasya darśanam |
sakalasaṃskāraśeṣa(viṣaya)ś cāyam | tena nāmnāṃ śarmādikam apy upapadaṃ kulācāreṇa kartavyam || 2.34 ||
cūḍākarma dvijātīnāṃ sarveṣām eva dharmataḥ |
prathame ‘bde tṛtīye vā kartavyaṃ śruticodanāt || 2.35 ||
cūḍākarmeti | cūdākaraṇaṃ prathame varṣe tṛtīye vā dvijātīnāṃ dharmato dharmārthaṃ kāryam, śruticodanāt |
yatra bāṇāḥ saṃpatanti kumārā viśikhā iva |
iti mantraliṅgāt kuladharmānusāreṇāyaṃ vyavasthitavikalpaḥ | ata evāśvalāyanagṛhyam (1.17): “tṛtīye varṣe caulaṃ yathākuladharmaṃ vā” || 2.35 ||
garbhāṣṭame ‘bde kurvīta brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam |
garbhād ekādaśe rājño garbhāt tu dvādaśe viṣaḥ || 2.36 ||
garbhāṣṭama iti | garbhavarṣād aṣṭame varṣe brāhmaṇyasyopanāyanaṃ kartavyam | upanayanam evopanāyanam | “anyeṣām api dṛśyate (Pāṇ 6.3.137) it dīrghaḥ | garbhaikādaśe kṣatriyasya | garbhād dvādaśe vaiśyasya || 2.36 ||
brahmacarcasakāmasya kāryaṃ viprasya pañcame |
rājño balārthinaḥ ṣaṣṭhe vaiśyasyehārthino ‘ṣṭame || 2.37 ||
brahmavarcasakāmasyeti | vedādhyaynatadarthajñānādiprakarṣakṛtaṃ tejo brahmavarcasam, tatkāmasya brāhmaṇsya garbhapañcame varṣe upanayanaṃ kāryam | kṣatriyasya hastyaśvādirājyabalārthino garbhaṣaṣṭhe | vaiśyasya bahukṛṣyādiceṣṭārthino garbhāṣṭame, garbhavarṣāṇām eva prakṛtatvāt | yady api bālasya kāmanā na saṃbhavati tathāpi tatpitur eva tadgataphalakāmanā tasminn upacaryete || 2.37 ||
ā ṣoḍaśād brāhmaṇasya sāvitrī nātivartate |
ā dvāviṃśāt kṣatrabandhor ā caturviṃśater viśaḥ || 2.38 ||
ā ṣoḍaśād iti | abhividhāv āṅ | brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśām uktāṣṭamaikādaśadvādaśavarṣadvaiguṇyasya vivakṣitatvāt ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyantaṃ brāhmaṇasya sāvitryarthe vacanam upanayanaṃ nātikrāntakālaṃ bhavati | kṣatriyasya dvāviṃśativarṣaparyantam | vaiśyasya caturviṃśativarṣaparyantam | atra maryādāyām āṅ | kecid vyākhyāpayanti yamavacanadarśanāt | tathā ca yamaḥ |
patitā yasya sāvitrī daśa varṣāṇi pañca ca |
brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa tathā rājanyavaiśyayoḥ ||
prāyaścittaṃ bhaved eṣāṃ provāca vadatāṃ varaḥ |
vivasvataḥ sutaḥ śrīmān yamo dharmārthatattvavit ||
saśikhaṃ vapanaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ kuryāt samāhitaḥ |
haviṣyaṃ bhojayed annaṃ brāhmaṇān sapta pañca vā ||
|| 2.38 ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ trayo ‘py ete yathākālam asaṃskṛtāḥ |
sāvitrīpatitā vrātyā bhavanty āryavigarhitāḥ || 2.39 ||
ata ūrdhvam iti | ete brāhmaṇādayo yathākālaṃ yo yasyānukalpiko ‘py upanayanakāla uktaḥ ṣaḍaśavarṣādiparyantam, tatrāsaṃskṛtās tadūrdhvaṃ sāvitrīpatitā upanayanahīnā śiṣṭagarhitā vrātyasaṃjñā bhavanti | saṃjñāprayojanaṃ ca “vrātyānāṃ yājanaṃ kṛtvā” (11.197) ityādinā vyavahārasiddhiḥ || 2.39 ||
naitair apūtair vidhivad āpady api karhicit |
brāhmān yaunāṃś ca saṃbandhān ācared brāhmaṇaḥ saha || 2.40 ||
naitair iti | etair apūtair vrātyair yathāvidhi prāyaścittam akṛtavadbhiḥ saha āpatkāle ‘pi kadācid adhyāpanakanyādānādīn saṃbandhān brāhmaṇo nānutiṣthet || 2.40 ||
kārṣṇarairavabāstāni carmāṇi brahmacāriṇaḥ |
vasīrann ānupūrvyeṇa śāṇakṣaumāvikāni ca || 2.41 ||
kārṣṇarauravabāsānīti | kārṣṇa iti viśeṣānabhidhāne ‘pi mṛgaviśeṣo rurusāhacaryāt “hāriṇam aiṇeyaṃ vā kārṣṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇasya” ity āpastambavacanāc ca kṛṣṇamṛgo gṛhyate | kṛṣṇamṛgarurucchāgacarmāṇi brahmacāriṇa uttarīyāṇi vasīran | “carmāṇy uttarīyāṇi” iti gṛhyavacanāt | tathā śaṇakṣumāmeṣalomabhavāny adhovasanāni brāhmaṇādayaḥ krameṇa paridadhīran || 2.41 ||
mauñjī trivṛt samā ślakṣṇā kāryā viprasya mekhalā |
kṣatriyasya tu maurvī jyā vaiśyasya śaṇatāntavī || 2.42 ||
mauñjīti | muñjamayī triguṇā samaguṇatrayanirmitā sukhasparśā brāḥmaṇasya mekhalā kartavyā | kṣatriyasya mūrvāmayī jyā dhanurguṇarūpā mekhalā | ato jyātvavināśāpattes trivṛttvaṃ nāstīti medhātithi-govindarājau | vaiśyasya śaṇasūtramayī | atra traiguṇyam anuvartata eva, “triguṇāḥ pradakṣiṇāḥ mekhalāḥ” iti sāmānyena pracetasā trauṇyābhidhānāt || 2.42 ||
muñjālābhe tu kartavyāḥ kuśāśmantakabalvajaiḥ |
trivṛtā granthinaikena tribhiḥ pañcabhir eva vā || 2.43 ||
muñjālābhe tv iti | kartavyā iti bahuvacananirdeśād brahmacāritrayasya prakṛtatvān mukhyālābhe triṣv apy apekṣāyāḥ samatvāt kauśādīnāṃ ca tisṛṇāṃ vidhānān muñjālābha iti boddhavyam | kartavyā iti bahuvacanam upapannataram | binnajātisaṃbandhitayeti bruvāṇasya medhātither api bahuvacanapāṭhaḥ saṃmataḥ | muñjādyalābhe brāhmaṇādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ yathākramaṃ kuśādibhis tṛṇaviśeṣair mekhalāḥ kāryāḥ | triguṇenaikagranthinā yuktās tribhir vā pañcabhir vā | atra ca vāśabdanirdeśād granthīnāṃ na viprādibhiḥ krameṇa saṃbandhaḥ kiṃ tu sarvatra yathākulācāraṃ vikalpaḥ | granthibhedaś cāyaṃ mukhyāmukhyāpekṣāsaṃbhavād grahītavyaḥ || 2.43 ||
kārpāsam upavītaṃ syād viprasyordhvavṛtaṃ trivṛt |
śaṇasūtramayaṃ rājño vaiśyasyāvikasautrikam || 2.44 ||
kārpāsam iti | yadīyavinyāsaviśeṣasyopavītasaṃjñāṃ vakṣyati taddharmibrāhmaṇasya kārpāsam, kṣatriyasya śaṇasūtramayam, vaiśyasya meṣalomanirmitam | trivṛd iti triguṇaṃ kṛtvā ūrdhvavṛtaṃ dakṣiṇāvartitam | etac ca sarvatra saṃbadhyate | yady api guṇatrayam evordhvavṛtaṃ manunoktaṃ tathāpi tattriguṇīkṛtyādhovṛtaṃ triguṇaṃ kāryam | tad uktaṃ chandogapariśiṣṭe –
ūrdhvaṃ tu trivṛtaṃ kāryaṃ tantutrayam adhovṛtam |
trivṛtaṃ copavītaṃ syāt tasyaiko granthir iṣyate ||
devalo ‘py āha –
yajñopavītaṃ kurvīta sūtrāṇi nava tantavaḥ |
|| 2.44 ||
brāhmaṇo bailvapālāśau kṣatriyo vāṭakhādirau |
pailavaudumbarau vaiśyo daṇḍān arhanti dharmataḥ || 2.45 ||
brāhmaṇa iti | yady api dvandvanirdeśena samuccayāvagamād dhāraṇam api samuccitavyaiva prāptaṃ tathāpi “keśāntiko brāḥmaṇasya daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ” (2.46) iti, tathā “pratigṛhyepsitaṃ daṇḍam” (2.48) iti vidhāv ekatvasya vivakṣitatvāt “bailvaḥ pālāśo vā daṇḍaḥ” iti vāsiṣṭhe vikalpadarśanād ekasyaiva daṇḍasya dāraṇavikapitayor evaikabrāhmaṇasaṃbandhāt samuccayo dvandvenānūdyate | brāhmaṇādayo vikalpena dvau dvau daṇḍau vakṣyamāṇakārye kartum arhanti || 2.45 ||
keśāntiko brāhmaṇasya daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ pramāṇataḥ |
lalāṭasaṃmito rājñaḥ syāt tu nāsāntiko viśaḥ || 2.46 ||
keśāntika iti | keśalalāṭanāsikāparyantaparimāṇakrameṇa brāhmaṇādīnāṃ daṇḍāḥ kartavyāḥ |
|| 2.46 ||
ṛjavas te tu sarve syur avraṇāḥ saumyadarśaṇāḥ |
anudvegakarā nṝṇāṃ satvaco ‘nagnidūṣitāḥ || 2.47 ||
ṛjava iti | te daṇḍā avraṇā akṣatāḥ śobhanadarśanāḥ savalkalā agnidāharahitā bhaveyuḥ || 2.47 ||
na ca taiḥ prāṇijātam udvejanīyam ity āha –
pratigṛhyepsitaṃ daṇḍam upasthāya ca bhāskaram |
pradakṣiṇaṃ parītyāgniṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ yathāvidhi ¦¦ 2.48 ||
pratigṛhyepsitam iti | uktalakṣaṇaṃ prāptum iṣṭaṃ daṇḍaṃ gṛhītvā ādityābhimukhaṃ sthitvāgniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya yathāvidhi bhaikṣaṃ yācet || 2.48 ||
bhavatpūrvaṃ cared bhaikṣam upanīto dvijottamaḥ |
bhavanmadhyaṃ tu rājanyo vaiśyas tu bhavaduttaram || 2.49 ||
bhavad iti | brāhmaṇo “bhavati bhikṣāṃ dehi” iti bhavacchabdapūrvaṃ bhikṣāṃ yācan vākyam uccārayet | kṣatriyo “bhikṣāṃ bhavati dehi” iti bhavanmadhyam | vaiśyo “bhikṣāṃ dehi bhavati” iti bhavaduttaram || 2.49 ||
mātaraṃ vā svasāraṃ vā mātur vā bhaginīṃ nijām |
bhikṣeta bhikṣāṃ prathamaṃ yā cainaṃ nāvamānayet || 2.50 ||
mātaraṃ veti | upanayanāṅgabhūtāṃ bhikṣāṃ prathamaṃ mātaraṃ bhaginīṃ vā mātur vā bhaginīṃ sahodarāṃ yācet | yā cainaṃ brahmacāriṇaṃ pratyākhyānena nāvamanyeta | pūrvāsabhava uttarāparigrahaḥ || 2.50 ||
samāhṛtya tu tad bhaikṣaṃ yāvad annam amāyayā |
nivedya gurave ‘śnīyād ācamya prāṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ || 2.51 ||
samāhṛtyeti | tad bhakṣaṃ bahubhya āhṛtya yāvad annaṃ tṛptimātrocitaṃ gurave nivedya nivedanaṃ kṛtvā amāyayā na kadannena sadannaṃ pracchādyaivam etad gurur grahīṣyatītyādimāyāvyatirekeṇa tadanujñāta ācamanaṃ kṛtvā śuciḥ san prāṅmukho bhuñjīta
|| 2.51 ||
idānīṃ kāmyabhojanam āha –
āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
śriyaṃ pratyaṅmukho bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte hy udaṅmukhaḥ || 2.52 ||
āyuṣyam iti | āyuṣe hitam annaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte | āyuḥkāmaḥ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte ity arthaḥ | yaśase hitaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | śriyam icchan pratyaṅmukhaḥ | ṛtaṃ satyaṃ tatphalam icchann udaṅmukho bhuñjīta || 2.52 ||
upaspṛśya dvijo nityam annam adyāt samāhitaḥ |
bhuktvā copaspṛśet samyag adbhiḥ khāni ca saṃspṛśet || 2.53 ||
upasprśyeti | “nivedya gurave ‘śnīyād ācamya” (2.51) iti yady api bhojanāt prāg ācamanaṃ vihitaṃ tathāpi adbhiḥ khāni ca saṃspṛśet iti guṇavidhānārtho ‘nuvādaḥ | nityaṃ brahmacaryānantaram api dvija ācamyānnaṃ bhuñjīta | samāhito ‘nanyamanāḥ bhuktvā cācāmed iti | samyag yathāśāstram | tena
prakṣālya hastau pādau ca triḥ pibed ambu vīkṣitam |
ityādi dakṣādyuktam api saṃgṛhṇāti | jalena khānīndriyāṇi ṣaṭ chidrāṇi ca spṛśet, tāni ca śiraḥsthāni ghrāṇacakṣuḥśrotrādīni grahītavyāni, “khāni copaspṛśec chīrṣaṇyāni” iti gautamavacanāt | upasparśanaṃ kṛtvā khāni saṃspṛśed iti pṛthagvidhānāt trir abbhakṣaṇamātram ācamanam, khasparśanādikam itikartavyateti darśitam || 2.53 ||
pūjayed aśanaṃ nityam adyāc caitad akutsayan |
dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyet prasīdec ca pratinandec ca sarvaśaḥ || 2.54 ||
pūjayed aśanam iti | sarvadā annaṃ pūjayet prāṇārthatvena dhyāyet | tad uktam ādipurāṇe, “annaṃ viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ prāha” ity anuvṛttau,
prāṇārthaṃ māṃ sadā dhyāyet sa māṃ saṃpūjayet sadā |
anindaṃś caitad adyāt tu dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyet prasīdec ca || iti |
hetvantaram api khedam annadarśane tyajet | pratinandet nityam asmākam etad astv ity abhidhāya vandanaṃ pratinandanam | tad uktam ādipurāṇe –
annaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇamyādau prāñjaliḥ kathayet tataḥ |
asmākaṃ nityam astv etad iti bhaktyā stuvan namet ||
sarvaśaḥ sarvam annam || 2.54 ||
pūjitaṃ hy aśanaṃ nityaṃ balam ūrjaṃ ca yacchati |
apūjitaṃ tu tad bhuktam ubhayaṃ nāśayed idam || 2.55 ||
pūjitam iti | yasmāt pūjitam annaṃ sāmarthyaṃ vīryaṃ ca dadāti, apūjitaṃ punar etad ubhayaṃ nāśayati, tasmāt sarvadānnaṃ pūjayed iti pūrveṇaikavākyatāpannam idaṃ phalaśravaṇam | saṃdhyāvandanādāv upāttaduritakṣayavan nityaṃ kāmanāviṣayatvenāpi nityaśrutir avihatā nityaśrutivirodhāt | phalaśravaṇaṃ stutyartham iti tu medhātithi-govindarājau || 2.55 ||
nocchiṣṭaṃ kasyacid dadyān nādyāc caiva tathāntarā |
na caivātyaśanaṃ kuryān na cocciṣṭaḥ kvacid vrajet || 2.56 ||
nocciṣṭam iti | bhuktāvaśeṣaṃ kasyacin na dadyāt | caturthyāṃ prāptāyāṃ saṃbandhamātravivakṣayā ṣaṣṭhī | anenaiva sāmānyaniṣedhena śūdrasyāpy ucchiṣṭadānaniṣedhe siddhe “nocchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam” (4.80) iti śūdragocaraniṣedhaś cāturthasnātakavratatvārthaḥ | divāsāyaṃbhojanayoś ca madhye na bhuñjīta, vāradvaye ‘py atibhojanaṃ na kuryāt | nātisauhityam ācared iti cāturthasnātakavratārtham | ucchiṣṭaḥ san kvacin na gacchet || 2.56 ||
atibhojane doṣam āha –
anārogyam anāyuṣyam asvargyaṃ cātibhojanam |
apuṇyaṃ lokavidviṣṭaṃ tasmāt tat parivarjayet || 2.57 ||
anārogyam iti | arogo rogābhāvaḥ, tasmai hitam ārogyam, āyuṣe hitam āyuṣyam | yasmād atibhojanam anārogyam anāyuṣyaṃ ca bhavati, ajīrṇajanakatvena rogamaraṇahetutvāt | asvargyaṃ ca svargahetuyāgādivirodhitvāt | apuṇyam itarapuṇyapratipakṣatvāt | lokavidviṣṭaṃ bahubhojitayā lokair nindanāt | tasmāt tan na kuryāt || 2.57 ||
brāhmena vipras tīrthena nityakālam upaspṛśet |
kāyatraidaśikābhyāṃ vā na pitryeṇa kadācana || 2.58 ||
brāhmeṇeti | brāhmādisaṃjñeyaṃ śāstre saṃvyvavahārārthā stutyarthā ca | na tu mukhyaṃ brahmadevatākatvaṃ saṃbhavati, ayāgarūpatvāt | tīrthaśabdo ‘pi pāvanaguṇayogāt brāhmeṇa tīrthena sarvadā viprādir ācāmet | kaḥ prajāpatis tadīyaḥ kāyaḥ, “tasyedam” (Pāṇ 4.3.120) ity aṇ | ikāraś cāntādeśaḥ | traidaśiko devas tābhyāṃ vā | pitryeṇa tīrthena na kadācid ācāmet, aprasiddhatvāt || 2.58 ||
brāhmāditīrthāny āha –
aṅguṣṭhamūlasya tale brāhmaṃ tīrthaṃ pracakṣate |
kāyam aṅgulimūle ‘gre daivaṃ pitryaṃ tayor adhaḥ || 2.59 ||
aṅguṣṭhamūlasyeti | aṅguṣṭhamūlasyādhobhāge brāhmaṃ, kaniṣṭhāṅgulimūle kāyam, aṅgulīnām agre daivaṃ, aṅguṣṭhapradeśinyor madhye pitryaṃ tīrthaṃ manvādaya āhuḥ | yady api kāyam aṅgulimūle, tayor adha ity atra cāṅgulimātraṃ śrutaṃ tathāpi smṛtyantarād viśeṣaparigrahaḥ | tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ (2.19) |
kaniṣṭhādeśinyaṅguṣṭhamūnāny agraṃ karasya ca |
prajāpatipitṛbrahmadevatīrthāny anukramāt ||
|| 2.59 ||
sāmānyenopadiṣṭasyācamanasyānuṣṭhānakramam āha –
trir ācāmed apaḥ pūrvaṃ dviḥ pramṛjyāt tato mukham |
khāni caiva spṛśed adbhir ātmānaṃ śira eva ca || 2.60 ||
trir ācāmed iti | pūrvaṃ brāhmāditīrthena jalagaṇḍūṣatrayaṃ pibet | anantaraṃ saṃvṛtyauṣṭhādharau vāradvayam aṅguṣṭhamūlena saṃmṛjyāt,
saṃvṛtyāṅguṣṭhamūlena dviḥ pramṛjyāt tato mukham |
iti dakṣeṇa viśeṣābhidhānāt | khāni cendriyāṇi jalena spṛśet | mukhyasya saṃnidhānān mukhakhāny eva | gautamo ‘py āha: “khāni copaspṛśec chīrṣaṇyāni” | “hṛdy antarjyotiḥ puruṣaḥ” (BṛĀrUp 4.3.7) ity upaniṣatsu hṛdayadeśatvenātmanaḥ śravaṇād ātmānaṃ hṛdayaṃ śiraś cādbhir eva spṛśet || 2.60 ||
anuṣṇābhir aphenābhir adbhir tīrthena dharmavit |
śaucepsuḥ sarvadācāmed ekānte prāgudaṅmukhaḥ || 2.61 ||
anuṣṇābhir iti | anuṣṇīkṛtābhiḥ phenavarjitābhir brāhmāditīrthena śaucam icchann ekānte janair anākīrṇe śucideśa ity arthaḥ | prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā sarvadācāmet | āpastambena “taptābhiś ca kāraṇāt” ity abhidhānād vyādhyādikāraṇavyatirekeṇa nācāmet | vyādhyādau tu uṣṇīkṛtābhir ācamane doṣābhāvaḥ | tīrthavyatirekeṇācamane śaucābhāva iti darśayitum uktasyāpi tīrthasya punarvacanam || 2.61 ||
ācamanajalaparimāṇam āha –
hṛdgābhiḥ pūyate vipraḥ kaṇṭhagābhis tu bhūmipaḥ |
vaiśyo ‘dbhiḥ prāśitābhis tu śūdraḥ spṛṣṭābhir antataḥ || 2.62 ||
hṛdgābhir iti | brāhmaṇo hṛdayagāminībhiḥ, kṣatriyaḥ kaṇṭhagāminībhiḥ, vaiśyo ‘ntarāsyapraviṣṭābhiḥ, śūdro jihvauṣṭhāntenāpi spṛṣṭābhir adbhiḥ pūto bhavati | antata iti tṛtīyārthe tasiḥ || 2.62 ||
ācamanāṅgatām upavītasya darśayitum upavītalakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ prasaṅgena prācīnāvītīnivītyādilakṣaṇam āha –
uddhṛte dakṣiṇe pāṇāv upavīty ucyate dvijaḥ |
savye prācīnaāvītī nivītī kaṇṭhasajjane || 2.63 ||
uddhṛte iti | dakṣiṇe prāṇāv uddhṛte vāmaskandhasthite dakṣiṇaskandhāvalambe yajñasūtre vastre vopavītī dvijaḥ kathyate | vāmapāṇāv uddhṛte dakṣiṇaskandhasthite vāmaskandhāvalambhe prācīnāvītī bhaṇyate | savye prācīnaāvītī chando’nurodhād uktam | tathā ca gobhilaḥ: “dakṣiṇaṃ bāhum uddhṛtya śiro ‘vadhāya savye ‘ṃse pratiṣṭhāpayati dakṣiṇaskandhm avalambanaṃ bhavaty evaṃ yajñopavītī bhavati" | savyaṃ bāhum uddhṛtya śiro ‘vadhāya dakṣiṇe ‘ṃse pratiṣṭhāpayati savyaṃ kakṣam avalambanaṃ bhavaty evaṃ prācīnāvītī bhavati | nivītī kaṇṭhasajjana iti | śiro ‘vadhāya dakṣiṇapāṇyādāv apy anuddhṛte kaṇṭhād eva sajjane ṛjuprālambe yajñasūtre vastre ca nivītī bhavati || 2.63 ||
mekhalām ajinaṃ daṇḍam upavītaṃ kamaṇḍalum |
apsu prāsya vinaṣṭāni gṛhṇītānyāni mantravat || 2.64 ||
mekhalām iti | mekhalādīni vinaṣṭāni bhinnāni chinnāni ca jale prakṣipyānyāni svasvagṛhyoktamantrair gṛhṇīyāt || 2.64 ||
keśāntaḥ ṣoḍaśe varṣe brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate |
rājanyabandhor dvāviṃśe vaiśyasya dvyadhike tataḥ || 2.65 ||
keśānta iti | keśāntākhyo gṛhyoktasaṃskāro “garbhādisaṃkhyā varṣāṇām” iti baudhāyanavacanād garbhaṣoḍaśe varṣe brāhmaṇasya, kṣatriyasya garbhadvāviṃśe, vaiśyasya tato dvyadhike garbhacaturviṃśe kartavyaḥ || 2.65 ||
amantrikā tu karyeyaṃ strīṇām āvṛd aśeṣataḥ |
saṃskārārthaṃ śarīrasya yathākālaṃ yathākramam || 2.66 ||
amantriketi | iyam āvṛd ayaṃ jātakarmādikriyākalāpaḥ samagra uktakālakrameṇa śarīrasaṃskārārthaṃ strīṇām amantrakaḥ kāryaḥ || 2.66 ||
anenopanayane ‘pi prāpte viśeṣam āha –
vaivāhiko vidhiḥ strīṇāṃ saṃskāro vaidikaḥ smṛtaḥ |
patisevā gurau vāso gṛhārtho ‘gniparikriyā || 2.67 ||
vaivāhika iti | vivāhavidhir eva strīṇāṃ vaidikaḥ saṃskāra upanayanākho manvādibhiḥ smṛtaḥ | patisevaiva gurukule vāso vedādhyayanarūpaḥ | gṛhakṛtyam eva sāyaṃprātaḥ samiddhomarūpo ‘gniparicaryā | tasmād vivāhāder upanayanasthāne vidhānād upanayanāder nivṛttir iti || 2.67 ||
eṣa prokto dvijātīnām aupanāyaniko vidhiḥ |
utpattivyañjakaḥ puṇyaḥ karmayogaṃ nibodhata || 2.68 ||
eṣa iti | aupanāyanika ity anuśatikāditvād ubhayapadavṛddhiḥ | ayaṃ dvijātīnām upanayanasaṃbandhī karmakalāpa uktaḥ utpatter dvitīyajanmano vyañjakaḥ || 2.68 ||
idānīm upanītasya yena karmaṇā yogas taṃ śṛṇutety āha –
upanīya guruḥ śiṣyaṃ śikṣayec chaucam āditaḥ |
ācāram agnikāryaṃ ca saṃdhyopāsanam eva ca || 2.69 ||
upanīya gurur iti | guruḥ śiṣyam upanīya prathamaṃ “ekā liṅge gude tisraḥ” (5.136) ityādivakṣyamāṇaṃ śaucaṃ snānācamanādyācāram agnau sāyaṃprātaḥ samiddhomānuṣṭhānaṃ samantrakasaṃdhyopāsanavidhiṃ ca śikṣayet || 2.39 ||
adhyeṣyamāṇas tv ācānto yathāśāstram udaṅmukhaḥ |
brahmāñjalikṛto ‘dhyāpyo laghuvāsā jitendriyaḥ || 2.70 ||
adhyeṣyamāṇa iti | adhyayanaṃ kariṣyamāṇaḥ śiṣyo yathāśāstraṃ kṛtācamana uttarābhimukhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ pavitravastraḥ kṛtendriyasaṃyamo guruṇādhyāpyaḥ | “paṅmukho dakṣiṇataḥ śiṣya udaṅmukho vā” (GDh 1.54) iti gautamavacanāt prāṅmukhasyāpy adhyayanam | brahmāñjalikṛta iti “vāhitāgnyādiṣu” (Pāṇ 2.2.37) ity anena kṛtaśabdasya paranipātaḥ || 2.70 ||
brahmārambhe ‘vasāne ca pādau grāhyau guroḥ sadā |
saṃhatya hastāv adhyeyaṃ sa hi brahmāñjaliḥ smṛtaḥ || 2.71 ||
brahmārambhe ‘vasāne ceti | vedādhyayanasyārambhe kartavye samāpane ca kṛte guroḥ pādopasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | hastau saṃhatya saṃśliṣṭau kṛtvādhyetavyam | “sa hi brahmāñjaliḥ smṛtaḥ” iti pūrvaślokoktabrahmāñjaliśabdārthavyākāraḥ || 2.71 ||
vyatyastapāṇinā kāryam upasaṃgrahaṇaṃ guroḥ |
savyena savyaḥ spraṣṭavyo dakṣiṇena ca dakṣiṇaḥ || 2.72 ||
vyatyastapāṇineti | pādopasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kāryam ity anantaram uktaṃ tad vyatyastapāṇinā kāryam iti vidhīyate | kīdṛśo vyatyāsaḥ kārya ity ata āha – savyena pāṇinā savyaḥ pādo dakṣiṇena pāṇinā dakṣiṇaḥ pādo guroḥ spraṣṭavyaḥ | uttānahastābhyāṃ cedaṃ pādayoḥ sparśanaṃ kāryam | yad āha paiṭhīnasiḥ:
uttānābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ dakṣiṇena dakṣiṇaṃ savyaṃ savyena pādāv abhivādayet | dakṣiṇoparibhāvena vyatyāso vāyaṃ śiṣṭasamācārāt |
|| 2.72 ||
adhyeṣyamāṇaṃ tu gurur nityakālam atandritaḥ |
adhīṣva bho iti brūyād virāmo ‘stv iti cāramet || 2.73 ||
adhyeṣyamāṇam iti | adhyayanaṃ kariṣyamāṇaṃ śiṣyaṃ sarvadā analaso guruḥ “adhīṣva bhoḥ” iti prathamaṃ vadet | śeṣe “virāmo ‘stu” ity abhidhāya viramen nivarteta || 2.73 ||
brahmaṇaḥ praṇavaṃ kuryād ādāv ante ca sarvadā |
sravaty anoṃkṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ purastāc ca viśīryati || 2.74 ||
brahmaṇaḥ praṇavam iti | brahmaṇo vedasyādhyayanārambhe adhyayanasamāptau coṅkāraṃ kuryāt | yasmāt pūrvaṃ yasyoṅkāro na kṛtas tat sravati śanaiḥ śanair naśyati, yasya purastān na kṛtas tad viśīryati avasthitim eva na labhate || 2.74 ||
prākkūlān paryupāsīnaḥ pavitraiś caiva pāvitaḥ |
prāṇāyāmais tribhiḥ pūtas tata oṅkāram arhati || 2.75 ||
prākkūlān iti | prākkūlān prāgagrān darbhān adhyāsīnaḥ pavitraiḥ kuśaiḥ karadvayasthaiḥ pavitrīkṛtaḥ “prāṇāyāmās trayaḥ pañcadaśamātrāḥ” (1.49) iti gautamasmaraṇāt pañcadaśamātrais tribhiḥ prāṇāyāmaiḥ prayataḥ | akārādilaghvakṣarakālaś ca mātrā | tato ‘dhyayanārtham oṅkāram arhati || 2.75 ||
akāraṃ cāpy ukāraṃ ca makāraṃ ca prajāpatiḥ |
vedatrayān niraduhad bhūr bhuvaḥ svar itīti ca || 2.76 ||
akāraṃ ceti | “etad akṣaram etāṃ ca” (2.44) iti vakṣyati tasyāyaṃ śeṣaḥ | akāram ukāraṃ makāraṃ ca praṇavāyavabhūtaṃ brahmā vedatrayād ṛgyajuḥsāmalakṣaṇād bhūr bhuvaḥ svar iti vyāhṛtitrayaṃ ca krameṇa niraduhad uddhṛtavān || 2.76 ||
tribhya eva tu vedebhyaḥ pādaṃ pādam adūduhat |
tad ity ṛco ‘syāḥ sāvitryāḥ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ || 2.77 ||
tribhya eveti | tathā tribhya eva vedebhya ṛgyajuḥsāmabhyaḥ tad ity ṛca iti pratīkenānūditāyāḥ sāvitryāḥ pādaṃ pādam iti trīn pādān brahmā cakarṣa | parame sthāne tiṣṭhatīti parameṣṭhī
|| 2.77 ||
yata evam ataḥ –
etad akṣaram etāṃ ca japan vyāhṛtipūrvikām |
saṃdhyayor vedavid vipro vedapuṇyena yujyate || 2.78 ||
etad akṣaram iti | etad akṣaram oṅkārarūpam, etāṃ ca tripadāṃ sāvitrīṃ vyāhṛtitrayapūrvikāṃ saṃdhyākāle praṇavavyāhṛtitrayopetāṃ sāvitrīṃ japed iti vidhiḥ kalpyate || 2.78 ||
sahasrakṛtvas tv abhyasya bahir etat trikaṃ dvijaḥ |
mahato ‘py enaso māsāt tvacevāhir vimucyate || 2.79 ||
sahasrakṛtva iti | saṃdhyāyām anyatra kāla etat prakṛtaṃ praṇavavyāhṛtitrayasāvitryātmakaṃ trikaṃ grāmād bahir nadītīrāraṇyādau sahasrāvṛttiḥ japitvā mahato ‘pi pāpāt sarpa iva kañcukān mucyate | tasmāt pāpakṣayārtham idaṃ japanīyam ity aprakaraṇe ‘pi lāghavārtham uktam | anyatraitan trayoccāraṇam api punaḥ kartavyaṃ syāt || 2.79 ||
etayarcā visaṃyuktaḥ kāle ca kriyayā svayā |
brahmakṣatriyaviḍyonir garhaṇāṃ yāti sādhuṣu || 2.80 ||
etayarceti | saṃdhyāyām anyatra samaya ṛcaitayā sāvitryā visaṃyuktas tyaktasāvitrījapaḥ svakīyayā kriyayā sāyaṃprātarhomādirūpayā svakāle tyakto brāḥmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo ‘pi sajjaneṣu nindāṃ gacchati | tasmāt svakāle sāvitrījapaṃ svakriyāṃ ca na tyajet || 2.80 ||
oṅkārapūrvikās tisro mahāvyāhṛtayo ‘vyayāḥ |
tripadā caiva sāvitrī vijñeyaṃ brahmaṇo mukham || 2.81 ||
oṅkārapūrvikā iti | oṅkārapūrvikās tisro vyāhṛtayo bhūr bhuvaḥ svar ity etā akṣarabrahmāvāptiphalatvenāvyayāḥ | tripadā ca sāvitrī brahmaṇo vedasya mukham ādyam, tatpūrvakavedādhyayanārambhāt | atha vā brahmaṇaḥ parmātmanaḥ prāpter dvāram etat, adhyayanajapādinā niṣpāpasya brahmajñānaprakarṣeṇa mokṣāvāpteḥ || 2.81 ||
ata evāha –
yo ‘dhīte ‘hany ahany etāṃ trīṇi varṣāṇy atandritaḥ |
sa brahma param abhyeti vāyubhūtaḥ khamūrtimān || 2.82 ||
yo ‘dhīta iti | yaḥ pratyaham analasaḥ san sāvitrīṃ praṇavavyāhṛtiyuktāṃ varṣatrayam adhīte sa paraṃ brahmābhimukhena gacchati | sa vāyubhūto vāyur iva kāmacārī jāyate | khaṃ brahma tad evāsya mūrtir iti khamūrtimān bhavati śarīrasyāpi nāśād brahmaiva saṃpadyate || 2.82 ||
ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmāḥ paraṃ tapaḥ |
sāvitryās tu paraṃ nāsti maunāt satyaṃ viśiṣyate || 2.83 ||
ekākṣaram iti | ekākṣaram oṅkāraḥ paraṃ brahma, parabrahmāvāptihetutvāt | oṅkārasya japena tadarthasya ca parabrahmaṇo bhāvanayā tadavāpteḥ | prāṇāyāmāḥ sapraṇavasavyāhṛtisaśiraskagāyatrībhis trirāvṛttibhiḥ kṛtāś cāndrāyaṇādibhyo ‘pi paraṃ tapaḥ | prāṇāyāmā iti bahuvacananirdeśāt trayo ‘vaśyaṃ kartavyā ity uktam | sāvitryāḥ prakṛṣṭam anyan mantrajātaṃ nāsti | maunād api satyaṃ vāg viśiṣyate | eṣāṃ caturṇāṃ stutyā catvāry etāny upāsanīyānīti vidhiḥ kalpyate | dharaṇīdhareṇa tu “ekākṣaraparaṃ brahma prāṇāyāmaparaṃ tapaḥ” iti paṭhitam, vyākhyātaṃ ca – ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ yasya tad ekākṣaraparam, evaṃ prāṇāyāmaparm iti |
medhātithiprabhṛtibhir vṛddhair alikhitaṃ yataḥ |
likhan pāṭhāntaraṃ tatra svatantro dharaṇīdharaḥ || 2.83 ||
kṣaranti sarvā vaidikyo juhotiyajatikriyāḥ |
akṣaraṃ tv akṣaraṃ jñeyaṃ brahma caiva prajāpatiḥ || 2.84 ||
kṣarantīti | sarvā vedavihitā homayāgādirūpāḥ kriyāḥ svarūpataḥ phalataś ca vinaśyanti | akṣaraṃ tu praṇavarūpam akṣayaṃ brahmaprāptihetutvāt phaladvāreṇākṣaraṃ brahmībhāvasyāvināśāt | katham asya brahmaprāptihetutvam ata āha – brahma caiveti | caśabdo hetau | yasmāt prajānām adhipatir yad brahma tad evāyam oṅkāraḥ | svarūpato brahmapratipādakatvena cāsya brahmatvam | ubhayatāpi brahmatvapratipādakatvena vāyam upāsito japakāle mokṣahetur ity anena darśitam || 2.84 ||
vidhiyajñāj japayajño viśiṣṭo daśabhir guṇaiḥ |
upāṃśuḥ syāc chataguṇaḥ sāhasro mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ || 2.75 ||
vidhiyajñād iti | vidhiviṣayo yajño vidhiyajño darśapaurṇamāsādis tasmāt prakṛtānāṃ praṇavādīnāṃ japayajño daśaguṇādhikaḥ | so ‘py upāṃśuś ced anuṣṭhitas tadā śataguṇādhikaḥ | yat samīpastho ‘pi paro na śṛṇoti tad upāṃśu | mānasas tu japaḥ sahasraguṇādhikaḥ | yatra jihvauṣṭhaṃ manāg api na calati sa mānasaḥ || 2.75 ||
ye pākayajñāś catvāro vidhiyajñasamanvitāḥ |
sarve te japayajñasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 2.86 ||
ye pākayajñā iti | brahmayajñās anye ye pañcamahāyajñāntargatā vaiśvadevahomabalikarmanityaśrāddhātithibhojanātmakāś catvāraḥ pākayajñāḥ vidhiyajñā darśapaurṇamāsādayas taiḥ sahitā japayajñasya ṣoḍaśīm api kalāṃ na prāpnuvanti | japayajñasya ṣoḍaśāṃśenāpi na samā ity arthaḥ || 2.86 ||
japyenaiva tu saṃsidhyed brāhmaṇo nātra saṃśayaḥ |
kuryād anyan na vā kuryān maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate || 2.87 ||
japyenaiveti | brāhmaṇo japyenaiva niḥsaṃdehāṃ siddhiṃ labhate mokṣaprāptiyogyo bhavati | anyad vaidikaṃ yāgādikaṃ karotu na karotu vā | yasmān maitro brāhmaṇo brahmaṇaḥ saṃbandhī brahmaṇi līyata ity āgameṣūcyate | mitram eva maitraḥ | svārthe ‘ṇ | yāgādiṣu paśubījādivadhān na sarvaprāṇipriyatā saṃbhavati, tasmād yāgādinā vināpi praṇavādijapaniṣṭho nistaratīti japapraśaṃsā, na tu yāgādīnāṃ niṣedhas teṣām api śāstrīyatvāt || 2.87 ||
idānīṃ sarvavarṇānuṣṭheyaṃ sakalapuruṣārthopayuktam indriyasaṃyamam āha –
indriyāṇāṃ vicaratāṃ viṣayeṣv apahāriṣu |
saṃyame yatnam ātiṣṭhed vidvān yanteva vājinām || 2.88 ||
indriyāṇām iti | indriyāṇāṃ viṣayeṣv apaharaṇaśīleṣu vartamānānāṃ kṣayitvādiviṣayadoṣāñ jānan saṃyame yatnaṃ kuryāt sārathir iva rathaniyuktānām aśvānām || 2.88 ||
ekādaśendriyāṇy āhur yāni pūrve manīṣiṇaḥ |
tāni samyak pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || 2.89 ||
ekādaśeti | pūrvapaṇḍitā yāny ekādaśendriyāny āhus tāny arvācāṃ śikṣārthaṃ sarvāṇi karmato nāmataś ca kramād vakṣyāmi || 2.89 ||
śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī |
pāyūpasthaṃ hastapādaṃ vāk caiva daśamī smṛtā || 2.90 ||
śrotram iti | teṣv ekādaśasu śrotrādīni daśaitāni bahirindriyāṇi nāmato nirdiṣṭāni | pāyūpasthaṃ hastapādam iti “dvandvaś ca prāṇitūryasenāṅgānām” (Pāṇ 2.4.2) iti prāṇyaṅgadvandvatvād ekavadbhāvaḥ || 2.90 ||
buddhīndriyāṇi pañcaiṣāṃ śrotrādīny anupūrvaśaḥ |
karmendriyāṇi pañcaiṣāṃ pāyvādīni pracakṣate || 2.91 ||
buddhīndriyānīti | eṣāṃ daśānāṃ madhye śrotrādīni pañca kramoktāni buddheḥ karaṇatvād buddhīndriyāṇi | pāvyādīni cotsargādikarmakaraṇatvāt karmendriyāṇi tadvido vadanti
|| 2.91 ||
ekādaśaṃ mano jñeyaṃ svaguṇenobhayātmakam |
yasmiñ jite jitāv etau bhavataḥ pañcakau gaṇau || 2.92 ||
ekādaśam iti | ekādaśasaṃkhyāpūrakaṃ ca manorūpam antarindriyaṃ jñātavyam | svaguṇena saṃkalparūpeṇobhayarūpendriyagaṇaparvartakasvarūpam | ata eva yasmin manasi jite ubhāv api pañcakau buddhīndriyakarmendriyagaṇau jitau bhavataḥ | pañcakāv iti “tad asya parimāṇam” (Pāṇ 5.1.57) ity anuvṛttau “saṃkhyāyāḥ saṃjñāsaṅghasūtrādhyayaneṣu” (Pāṇ 5.1.58) iti pañcasaṃkhyāparimitasaṅghārthe kaḥ || 2.92 ||
manodharmasaṃkalpamūltvād indriyāṇāṃ prāyeṇa pravṛtteḥ kim artham indriyanigrahaḥ kartavya ity ata āha –
indriyāṇāṃ prasaṅgena doṣaṃ ṛcchaty asaṃśayam |
saṃniyamya tu tāny eva tataḥ siddhiṃ niyacchati || 2.93 ||
indriyāṇām iti | yasmād indriyāṇāṃ viṣayeṣu prasaktyā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaṃ ca doṣaṃ niḥsaṃdehaṃ prāpnoti | tāny eva punar indriyāṇi samyaṅ niyamya siddhiṃ mokṣādipuruṣārthayogyatārūpāṃ labhate | tasmād indriyasaṃyamaṃ kuryād iti śeṣaḥ || 2.93 ||
kim indriyasaṃyamena viṣayopabhogāder alabdhakāmo nivartsyatīty āśaṅkyāha –
na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati |
haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivardhate || 2.94 ||
na jātv iti | na kadācit kāmo ‘bhilāṣaḥ kāmyanta iti kāmā viṣayās teṣām upabhogena nivartate, kiṃ tu ghṛtenāgnir ivādhikādhikatamam eva vardhate | prāptabhogasyāpi pratidinaṃ tadadhikabhogavāñchādarśanāt | ata eva viṣṇupurāṇe yayātivākyam |
yat pṛthivyāṃ vrīhiyavaṃ hiraṇyaṃ paśavaḥ striyaḥ |
ekasyāpi na paryāptaṃ tad ity atitṛṣaṃ tyajet ||
tathā |
pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ me viṣayāsaktacetasaḥ |
tathāpy anuditaṃ tṛṣṇā yat teṣv eva hi jāyate || 2.94 ||
yaś caitān prāpnuyāt sarvān yaś caitān kevalāṃs tyajet |
prāpaṇāt sarvakāmānāṃ parityāgo viśiṣyate || 2.95 ||
yaś caitān iti | ya etān sarvān viṣayān prāpnuyāt, yaś caitān kāmān upekṣate, tayor viṣayopekṣakaḥ śreyān, tasmāt sarvakāmaprāptes tadupekṣā praśastā | tathā hi – viṣayalolupasya tatsādhanādyutpādane kaṣṭasaṃbhavo vipattau ca kleśātiśayo na tu viṣayavirasasya || 2.95 ||
idānīm indriyasaṃyamopāyam āha –
na tathaitāni śakyante saṃniyantum asevayā |
viṣayeṣu prajuṣṭāni yathā jñānena nityaśaḥ || 2.96 ||
na tatheti | etānīndriyāṇi viṣayeṣu prasaktāni tathā nāsevayā viṣayasaṃnidhivarjanarūpayā niyantuṃ na śakyante, durnivāratvāt | yathā sarvadā viṣayāṇāṃ kṣayitvādidoṣajñānena śarīrasya ca “asthisthūṇam” (6.76) ityādivakṣyamāṇadoṣacintanena | tasmād viṣayadoṣajñānādinā bahirindriyāṇi manaś ca niyacchet || 2.96 ||
yasmād aniyamitaṃ mano vikārasya hetuḥ syād ata āha –
vedās tyāgaś ca yajñāś ca niyamāś ca tapāṃsi ca |
na vipraduṣṭabhāvasya siddhiṃ gacchanti karhicit || 2.97 ||
vedā iti | vedādhyayanadānayajñaniyamatapāṃsi bhogādiviṣayasevāsaṃkalpaśīlino na kadācit phalasiddhaye prabhavanti || 2.97 ||
jitendriyasya svarūpam āha –
śrutvā spṛṣṭvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca bhuktvā ghrātvā ca yo naraḥ |
na hṛṣyati glāyati vā sa vijñeyo jitendriyaḥ || 2.98 ||
śrutveti | stutivākyaṃ nindāvākyaṃ ca śrutvā, sukhasparśaṃ dukūlādi, duḥkhasparśaṃ meṣakambalādi spṛṣṭvā, surūpaṃ kurūpaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā, svādu asvādu ca bhuktvā, surabhim asurabhiṃ ca ghrātvā, yasya na harṣaviṣādau sa jitendriyo jñātavyaḥ || 2.98 ||
ekendriyāsaṃyamo ‘pi nivāryata ity āha –
indriyāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ yady ekaṃ kṣaratīndriyam |
tenāsya kṣarati prajñā dṛteḥ pādād ivodakam || 2.99 ||
indriyāṇām tv iti | sarveṣām indriyāṇāṃ madhye yady ekam apīndriyaṃ viṣayapravaṇaṃ bhavati tato ‘sya viṣayaparasya indriyāntarair api tattvajñānaṃ kṣarati na vyavatiṣṭhate | carmanirmitodakapātrād ivaikenāpi chidreṇa sarvasthānastham evodakaṃna vyavatiṣṭhate
|| 2.99 ||
indriyasaṃyamasya sarvapuruṣārthahetutāṃ darśayat –
vaśe kṛtvendriyagrāmaṃ saṃyamya ca manas tathā |
sarvān saṃsādhayed arthān akṣiṇvan yogatas tanum || 2.100 ||
vaśe kṛtveti | bahirindriyagaṇam āyattaṃ kṛtvā manaś ca saṃyamya sarvān puruṣārthān samyak sādhayet | yogata upāyena svadeham apīḍayan yaḥ sahajasukhī saṃskṛtānnādikaṃ bhuṅkte sa krameṇa taṃ tyajet || 2.100 ||
pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ japaṃs tiṣṭhet sāvitrīm ārkadarśanāt |
paścimāṃ tu samāsīnaḥ samyag ṛkṣavibhāvanāt || 2.101 ||
pūrvāṃ saṃdhyām iti | pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ paścimām iti ca | “kālādhvanor atyantasaṃyoge” (Pāṇ 2.3.5) iti dvitīyā | prathamasaṃdhyāṃ sūryadarśanaparyantaṃ sāvitrīṃ japaṃs tiṣthet | āsanād utthāya nivṛttagatir ekatra deśe kuryāt | paścimāṃ tu saṃdhyāṃ sāvitrīṃ japan samyaṅ nakṣatradarśanaparyantam upaviṣṭaḥ syāt | atra ca phalavattvāj japaḥ pradhānam, sthānāsane tv aṅge, “phalavatsaṃnidhāv aphalaṃ tadaṅgam” iti nyāyāt | “saṃdhyayor vedavid vipro vedapuṇyena yujyate” (2.78), “sahasrakṛtvas tv abhyasya” (2.79) iti pūrvaṃ japāt phalam uktam | medhātithis tu sthānāsanayor eva prādhānyam āha | saṃdhyākālaś ca muhūrtamātram | tad āha yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
hrāsavṛddhī tu satataṃ divasānāṃ yathākramam |
saṃdhyā muhūrtamātraṃ tu hrāse vṛddhau ca sā smṛtā || 2.101 ||
pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ japaṃs tiṣṭhan naiśam eno vyapohati |
paścimāṃ tu samāsīno malaṃ hanti divākṛtam || 2.102 ||
pūrvāṃ saṃdhyām iti | pūrvasaṃdhyāyāṃ tiṣṭhan japaṃ kurvāṇo niśāsaṃcitaṃ pāpaṃ nāśayati | paścimasaṃdhyāyāṃ tūpaviṣṭho japaṃ kurvan divākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ nihanti | tatrāpi japāt phalam uktam | etac cājñānādikṛtapāpaviṣayam | ata eva yājñavalkyaḥ |
divā vā yadi vā rātrau yad ajñānakṛtaṃ bhavet |
trikālasaṃdhyākaraṇāt sarvaṃ vipraṇaśyati || 2.102 ||
na tiṣṭhati tu yā pūrvāṃ nopāste yaś ca paścimām |
sa śūdravad bahiṣkāryaḥ sarvasmād dvijakarmaṇaḥ || 2.103 ||
na tiṣṭhatīti | yaḥ punaḥ pūrvasaṃdhyāṃ nānutiṣṭhati paścimāṃ ca nopāste | tattatkālavihitaṃ japādi na karotīty arthaḥ | sa śūdra eva sarvasmād dvijātikarmaṇo ‘tithisatkārāder api bāhyaḥ kāryaḥ | anenaiva pratyavāyena saṃdhyopāsanasya nityatoktā | nityatve ‘pi sarvadāpekṣitapāpakṣayasya phalatvam aviruddham || 2.103 ||
apāṃ samīpe niyato naityakaṃ vidhim āsthitaḥ |
sāvitrīm apy adhīyīta gatvāraṇyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 2.104 ||
apāṃ samīpa iti | brahmayajñarūpam idaṃ bahuvedādhyayanāśaktau sāvitrīmātrādhyayanam api vidhīyate | araṇyādinirjanadeśaṃ gatvā nadyādijalasamīpe niyatendriyaḥ samāhito ‘nanyamanā naityakaṃ vidhiṃ brahmayajñarūpam āsthito ‘nutiṣṭhāsuḥ sāvitrīm api praṇavavyāhṛtitrayayutāṃ yathoktām adhīyīta || 2.104 ||
vedopakaraṇe caiva svādhyāye caiva naityake |
nānurodho ‘sty anadhyāye homanantreṣu caiva hi || 2.105 ||
vedopakaraṇa iti | vedopakaraṇe vedāṅge śikṣādau naityake nityānuṣṭheye ca svādhyāye brahmayajñarūpe homamantreṣu cānadhyāyādaro nāsti || 2.105 ||
naityake nāsty anadhyāyo brahmasatraṃ hi tat smṛtam |
brahmāhutihutaṃ puṇyam anadhyāyavaṣaṭkṛtam || 2.106 ||
naityaka iti | pūrvoktanaityakasvādhyāyasyāyam anuvādaḥ | naityake japayajñe ‘nadhyāyo nāsti | yataḥ satatabhavatvāt | brahmasatraṃ tan manvādibhiḥ smṛtam | brahmaivāhutir brahmāhutir havis tasyāṃ hutam anadhyāyādhyayanam adhyayanarūpam anadhyāyavaṣaṭkṛtam api puṇyam eva bhavati || 2.106 ||
yaḥ svādhyāyam adhīte ‘bdaṃ vidhinā niyataḥ śuciḥ |
tasya nityaṃ kṣaraty eṣa payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu || 2.107 ||
yaḥ svādhyāyam iti | abdam ity atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā | yo varṣam apy ekaṃ svādhyāyam ahar ahar vihitāṅgayuktaṃ niyatendriyaḥ prayato japati tasyaiva svādhyāyo japayajñaḥ kṣīrādīni kṣarati kṣīrādibhir devān pitṝṃś ca prīṇāti | te ca prītāḥ sarvakāmair japayajñakāriṇas tarpayantīty arthaḥ | ata eva yājñavlkyaḥ (1.41) |
madhuna payasā caiva sa devāṃs tarpayed dvijaḥ |
pitṝn madhughṛtābhyāṃ ca ṛco ‘dhīte hi yo ‘nvaham ||
ity upakramya,
caturṇām eva vedānāṃ purāṇānāṃ japasya ca |
devapitṛtṛptiphalam uktvā, śeṣe
te tṛptās tarpayanty enaṃ sarvakāmaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ | (1.47)
ity uktatvāt || 2.107 ||
agnīndhanaṃ bhaikṣacaryām adhaḥśayyāṃ guror hitam |
ā samāvartanāt kuryāt kṛtopanayano dvijaḥ || 2.108 ||
agnīndhanam iti | sāyaṃprātaḥ samiddhomam, bhikṣāsamūhāharaṇam, akhaṭvāśayanarūpām adhaḥśayyāṃ na tu sthaṇḍilaśāyitvam eva, guror udakakumbhādyāharaṇarūpaṃ hitaṃ kṛtopanayano brahmacārī samāvartanaparyantaṃ kuryāt || 2.108 ||
kīdṛśaḥ śiṣyo ‘dhyāpya ity āha –
ācāryaputraḥ śuśrūṣur jñānado dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ |
āptaḥ śakto ‘rthadaḥ sādhuḥ svo ‘dhyāpyā daśa dharmataḥ || 2.109 ||
ācāryaputra iti | ācāryaputraḥ, paricārakaḥ, jñānāntaradātā, dharmavit, mṛdvāryādiṣu śuciḥ, bāndhavaḥ grahaṇadhāraṇasamarthaḥ, dhanadātā, hitecchuḥ, jñātiḥ, daśaite darmeṇādhyāpyāḥ
|| 2.109 ||
nāpṛṣṭaḥ kasyacid brūyān na cānyāyena pṛcchataḥ |
jānann api hi medhāvī jaḍaval loka ācaret || 2.110 ||
nāpṛṣṭa iti | yad anyenālpākṣaraṃ visvaraṃ cādhītaṃ tasya tattvaṃ na vadet | śiṣyasya tv apṛcchato ‘pi vaktavyam | bhaktiśraddhādipraśnadharmollaṅghanam anyāyaḥ, tena pṛcchato na brūyāt | jānann api hi prājño loke mūka iva vyavaharet || 2.110 ||
uktapratiṣedhadvayātikrame doṣam āha –
adharmeṇa ca yaḥ prāha yaś cādharmeṇa pṛcchati |
tayor anyataraḥ praiti vidveṣaṃ vādhigacchati || 2.111 ||
adharmeṇeti | adharmeṇa pṛṣṭo ‘pi yo yasya vadati yaś cānyāyena yaṃ pṛcchati tayor anyataro vyatikramakārī mriyate, vidveṣaṃ vā ena saha gacchati || 2.111 ||
dharmārthau yatra na syātāṃ śuśrūṣā vāpi tadvidhā |
tatra vidyā na vaptavyā śubhaṃ bījam ivoṣare || 2.112 ||
dharmārthāv iti | yasmin śiṣye ‘dhyāpite dharmārthau na bhavataḥ paricaryā vādhyayanānurūpā tatra vidyā nārpaṇīyā | suṣṭu vrīhyādibījam ivoṣare | yatra bījam uptaṃ na prarohati sa ūṣaraḥ | na cārghagrahaṇe bhṛtakādhyāpakatvam āśaṅkanīyam, yady etāvan mahyaṃ dīyate tadaitāvad adhyāpayāmīti niyamābhāvāt || 2.112 ||
vidyayaiva samaṃ kāmaṃ martavyaṃ brahmavādinā |
āpady api hi ghorāyāṃ na tv enām iriṇe vapet || 2.113 ||
vidyayeti | vidyayaiva saha vedādhyāpakena varaṃ martavyaṃ na tu sarvathādhyāpanayogyaśiṣyābhāve cāpātrāyaiva tāṃ pratidāpayet | tathā ca chāndogyabrāhmaṇam “vidyayā sārdhaṃ mriyeta na vidyām ūṣare vapet” || 2.113 ||
asyānuvādam āha –
vidyā brāhmaṇam etyāha śevadhiṣṭe ‘smi rakṣa mām |
asūyakāya māṃ mādās tathā syāṃ vīryavattamā || 2.114 ||
vidyā brāhmaṇam iti | vidyādhiṣṭhātrī devatā kaṃcid adhyāpakaṃ brāhmaṇam āgatyaivam avadat “tavāhaṃ nidhir asmi | māṃ rakṣa | asūyakādidoṣavate na māṃ vadeḥ | tathā saty atiśayena vīryavatī bhūyāsam” | tathā ca chāndogyabrāhmaṇam: “vidyā ha vai brāhmaṇam ājagāma tavāhas asmi tvaṃ māṃ pālaya, anarhate mānine naiva mādāḥ, gopāya māṃ, śrayasī athāham asmi” iti || 2.114 ||
yam eva tu śuciṃ vidyān niyataṃ brahmacāriṇam |
tasmai māṃ brūhi viprāya nidhipāyāpramādine || 2.115 ||
yam eveti | yam eva punaḥ śiṣyaṃ śuciṃ niyatendriyaṃ brahmacāriṇaṃ jānāsi tasmai vidyārūpanidhirakṣakāya pramādarahitāya māṃ vada || 2.115 ||
brahma yas tv ananujñātam adhīyānād avāpnuyāt |
sa brahmasteyasaṃyukto narakaṃ pratipadyate || 2.116 ||
brahmeti | yaḥ punar abhyāsārtham adhīyānād anyaṃ vā kaṃcid adhyāpayatas tadanumatirahitaṃ vedaṃ gṛhṇāti sa vedasteyayukto narakaṃ gacchati tasmād etan na kartavyam || 2.117 ||
laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ vāpi tathādhyātmikam eva ca |
ādadīta yato jñānaṃ taṃ pūrvam abhivādayet || 2.117 ||
laukikam iti | laukikam arthaśāstrādijñānam, vaidikaṃ vedārthajñānaṃ, ādhyātmikaṃ brahmajñānam, yasmāt tu gṛhṇāti taṃ bahumānyamadhye sthitaṃ prathamam abhivādayet | laukikādijñānadātṝṇām eva trayāṇāṃ samavāye yathottaraṃ mānyatvam || 2.117 ||
sāvitrīmātrasāro ‘pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ |
nāyantritas trivedo ‘pi sarvāśī sarvavikrayī || 2.118 ||
sāvitrīti | sāvitrīmātravettāpi varaṃ suyantritaḥ śāstraniyamito viprādir mānyaḥ, nāyantrito vedatrayavettāpi niṣiddhabhojanādiśīlaḥ pratiṣiddhavikretā ca | etac ca pradarśanamātram, suyantritaśabdena vidhiniṣedhaniṣṭhatvasya vivakṣitatvāt || 2.118 ||
śayyāsane ‘dhyācarite śreyasā na samāviśet |
śayyāsanasthaś caivainaṃ pratyutthāyābhivādayet || 2.119 ||
śayyeti | śayyā cāsanaṃ ca śayyāsanaṃ “jātir aprāṇinām” (Pāṇ 2.4.6) iti dvandvaikavadbhāvaḥ | tasmiñ chreyasā vidyādyadhikena guruṇā cādhyācarite sādāraṇyena svīkṛte ca tatkālam api nāsīta | svayaṃ ca śayyāsanastho gurāv āgate utthāyābhivādanaṃ kuryāt || 2.119 ||
asyārthavādam āha –
ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hy utkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati |
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punas tān pratipadyate || 2.120 ||
ūrdhvam iti | yasmād yūno ‘lpavayaso vayovidyādinā sthavire āyati āgacchati sati prāṇā ūrdhvaṃ utkrāmanti dehād bahir nirgantum icchanti tān vṛddhasya pratyutthānābhivādābhyāṃ punaḥ susthān karoti | tasmād vṛddhasya pratyutthāyābhivādanaṃ kuryāt || 2.120 ||
itaś ca phalam āha –
abhivādanaśīlasya nityaṃ vṛddhopasevinaḥ |
catvāri saṃpravardhante āyur vidyā yaśo balam || 2.121 ||
abhivādanaśīlasyeti | utthāya sarvadā vṛddhābhivādanaśīlasya vṛddhasevinaś ca āyuḥprajñāyaśobalāni catvāri samyak prakarṣeṇa vardhante || 2.121 ||
saṃpratyabhivādanavidhim āha –
abhivādāt paraṃ vipro jyāyāṃsam abhivādayan |
asau nāmāham asmīti svaṃ nāma parikīrtayet || 2.122 ||
abhivādāt param iti | vṛddham abhivādayan viprādir abhivādāt paraṃ “abhivādaye” iti śabdoccāraṇānantaram “amukanāmāham asmi” iti svaṃ nāma parikīrtayet | ato nāmaśabdasya viśeṣaparatvāt svanāmaviśeṣoccāraṇānantaram abhivādanavākye nāmaśabdo ‘pi prayojya iti medhātithi-govindarājayor abhidhānam apramāṇam | ata eva gautamaḥ (6.1): “svanāma procyāham abhivādaya ity abhivadet” | sāṅkhyāyano ‘pi “asāv ahaṃ bho ity ātmano nāmādiśet” ity uktavān | yadi ca nāmaśabdaśravaṇāt tasya prayogas tadā “akāraś cāsya nāmno ‘nte” (2.125) ity abhidhānāt pratyabhivādanavākye nāmaśabdoccāraṇaṃ syān na ca tat kasyacit saṃmatam
|| 1.122 ||
nāmadheyasya ye kecid abhivādaṃ na jānate |
tān prājño ‘ham iti brūyāt striyaḥ sarvās tathaiva ca || 2.123 ||
nāmadheyasyeti | nāmadheyasya uccāritasya sato ye kecid abhivādyāḥ saṃskṛtānabhijñatayābhivādam abhivādārthaṃ na jānanti tān pratyabhivādane ‘py asavarthatvāt prājña ity abhivādyaśaktivijño ‘bhivādayitā “abhivādaye ‘ham” ity evaṃ brūyāt | striyaḥ sarvās tathaiva brūyāt || 2.123 ||
bhoḥśabdaṃ kīrtayed ante svasya nāmno ‘bhivādane |
nāmnāṃ svarūpabhāvo hi bhobhāva ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 2.124 ||
bhoḥśabdam iti | abhivādane yan nāma prayuktaṃ tasyānte bhoḥśabdaṃ kīrtayed abhivādyasaṃbodhanārtham | ata eva āha – nāmnām iti | bho ity asya yo bhāvaḥ sattā so ‘bhivādyanāmnāṃ svarūpabhāva ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtaḥ | tasmād evam abhivādanavākyam “abhivādaye śubhaśarmāham asmi bhoḥ” || 2.124 ||
āyuṣmān bhava saumyeti vācyo vipro ‘bhivādane |
akāraś cāsya nāmno ‘nte vācyaḥ pūrvākṣaraḥ plutaḥ || 1.125 ||
āyuṣmān iti | abhivādane kṛte pratyabhivādayitrā abhivādako viprādiḥ “āyuṣmān bhava saumya” iti vācyaḥ | asya cābhivādakasya yan nāma tasyānte yo ‘kārādiḥ svaro nāmnām akārāntatvaniyamābhāvāt sa plutaḥ kāryaḥ | svarāpekṣaṃ ced akārāntatvaṃ vyañjanānte ‘pi nāmni saṃbhavati | pūrvaṃ nāmagatam akṣaraṃ saṃśliṣṭaṃ yasya sa pūrvākṣaras tena nāgantur apakṛṣya cākārādiḥ svaraḥ plutaḥ kāryaḥ | etac ca “vākyasya ṭeḥ pluta udāttaḥ” (8.2.82) ity asyānuvṛttau “pratyabhivāde ‘śūdre” (8.2.83) iti plutaṃ smaran pāṇiniḥ sphuṭam uktavān | vyākhyātaṃ ca vṛttikṛtā vāmanena – “ṭer iti kim, vyañjanāntasyaiva ṭeḥ pluto yathā syāt” iti | tasmād īdṛśaṃ pratyabhivādanavākyaṃ “āyuṣmān bhava saumya śubhaśraman”, evaṃ kṣatriyasya “balavarman”, evaṃ vaiśyasya “vasubhūe” | “pluto rājanyaviśāṃ vā” (vā. 4865) iti kātyāyanavacanāt kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ pakṣe pluto na bhavati | śūdrasya pluto na kāryaḥ, “aśūdre” (8.2.83) iti pāṇinivacanāt | “striyām api niṣedhaḥ” (vā. 4864) iti kātyāyanavacanāt striyām api pratyabhivādanavākye na plutaḥ | govindarājas tu brāhmaṇasya nāmni śarmopapadaṃ nityaṃ prāg abhidhāya pratyabhivādanavākye “āyuṣmān bhava saumya bhadra” iti nirupapadodāharaṇasopapadodāharaṇānabhijñatvam eva nijaṃ jñāpayati | dharaṇīdharo ‘pi “āyuṣmān bhava saumya” iti saṃbuddhivibhaktyantaṃ manuvacanaṃ paśyann apy asaṃbuddhiprathamaikavacanāntam amukaśarmety udāharan vicakṣaṇair apy upekṣaṇīya eva
|| 2.125 ||
yo na vetty abhivādasya vipraḥ pratyabhivādanam |
nābhivādyaḥ sa viduṣā yathā śūdras tathaiva saḥ || 2.126 ||
yo na vettīti | yo vipro ‘bhivādanasyānurūpaṃ pratyabhivādanaṃ na jānāty asāv abhivādanaviduṣāpi svanāmoccāraṇādyuktavidhinā śūdra iva nābhivādyaḥ | “abhivādaye ‘ham” iti śabdoccāraṇamātraṃ tu caraṇagraṇādiśūnyam aniṣiddham, prāguktatvāt || 2.126 ||
brāhmaṇaṃ kuśalaṃ pṛcchet kṣatrabandhum anāmayam |
vaiśyaṃ kṣemaṃ samāgamya śūdram ārogyam eva ca || 2.127 ||
brāhmaṇam iti | samāgamya samāgame kṛte abhivādayam (n?) avaravayaskaṃ samānavayaskam anabhivādakam api brāhmaṇaṃ kuśalam, kṣatriyam anāmayam, vaiśyaṃ kṣemam, śūdram ārogyaṃ pṛcchet | ata evāpastambaḥ – “kuśalam avaravayasaṃ samānavayasaṃ vā vipraṃ pṛcchet, anāmayaṃ kṣatriyaṃ kṣemaṃ vaiśyam ārogyaṃ śūdram | avaravayasam abhivādakaṃ vayasyam anabhivādakam api” iti manvartham evāpastambaḥ sphuṭayati sma | govindarājas tu prakaraṇāt pratyabhivādakasyaiva kuśalādipraśnam āha | tan na, abhivādakena saha samāgamasyānuprāptatvāt | samāgamyeti niṣprayojanānuvādaprasaṅgāt | ataḥ kuśalakṣemaśabdayor anāmayārogyapadayoś ca samānārthatvāc chabdaviśeṣoccāraṇam eva vivakṣitam || 2.127 ||
avācyo dīkṣito nāmnā yavīyān api yo bhavet |
bhobhavatpūrvakaṃ tv enam abhibhāṣeta dharmavit || 2.128 ||
avācya iti | pratyabhivādanakāle anyadā ca dīkṣaṇīyātaḥprabhṛtyāvabhṛthasnānāt kaniṣṭho ‘pi dīkṣito nāmnā na vācyaḥ, kiṃ tu bhobhavacchabdapūrvakaṃ dīkṣitādiśabdair utkarṣābhidhāyibhir eva dhārmiko ‘bhibhāṣeta – “bho dīkṣita, idaṃ kuru, bhavatā yajamānena idaṃ kriyatām” iti || 2.128 ||
parapatnī tu yā strī syād asaṃbandhā ca yonitaḥ |
tāṃ brūyād bhavatīty evaṃ subhage bhaginīti ca || 2.129 ||
parapatnī tv iti | yā strī parapatnī bhavati, asaṃbandhā ca yonita iti svasrādir na bhavati tām anupayuktasaṃbhāṣaṇakāle “bhavati, subhage, bhagini” iti vā vadet | parapatnīgrahaṇāt kanyāyāṃ naiṣa vidhiḥ | svasuḥ kanyādes tu āyuṣmatītyādipadair abhibhāṣaṇam || 2.129 ||
mātulāṃś ca pitṛvyāṃś ca śvaśurān ṛtvijo gurūn |
asāv aham iti brūyāt pratyutthāya yavīyasaḥ || 2.130 ||
mātulāṃś ceti | mātulādīn āgatān kaniṣṭhān āsanād utthāya “asāv aham” iti vadet nābhivādayet | asāv it svanāmanirdeśaḥ, “bhūyiṣṭhāḥ khalu guravaḥ” ity upakramya jñānavṛddhatapovṛddhayor api hārītena gurutvakīrtanāt tayoś ca kaniṣṭhayor api saṃbhavāt tadviṣayo ‘yaṃ guruśabdaḥ || 2.130 ||
mātṛṣvasā mātulānī śvaśrūr atha pitṛṣvasā |
saṃpūjyā gurupatnīvat samās tā gurubhāryayā || 2.131 ||
mātṛṣvaseti | mātṛṣvasrādayo gurupatnīvat pratyutthānābhivādanāsanadānādibhiḥ saṃpūjyāḥ | abhivādanaprakaraṇād abhivādanam eva saṃpūjanaṃ vijñāyata iti samās tā ity avocat | gurubhāryāsamānatvāt pratyutthānādikam api kāryam ity arthaḥ || 2.131 ||
bhrātur bhāryopasaṃgrāhyā savarṇāhany ahany api |
viproṣya tūpasaṃgrāhyā jñātisaṃbandhiyoṣitaḥ || 2.132 ||
bhrātur bhāryeti | bhrātuḥ sajātīyā bhāryā jyeṣṭhā pūjāprakaraṇād upasaṃgrāhyā pādayor abhivādyā | ahany ahani pratyaham eva | apir evārthe | jñātayaḥ pitṛpakṣāḥ pitṛvyādayaḥ, saṃbandhino mātṛpakṣāḥ śvaśurādayaś ca, teṣāṃ patnyaḥ punar viproṣya pravāsāt pratyāgatenaivābhivādyāḥ, na tu pratyahaṃ niyamaḥ || 2.132 ||
pitur bhaginyāṃ mātuś ca jyāyasyāṃ ca svasary api |
mātṛvad vṛttim ātiṣṭhen mātā tābhyo garīyasī || 2.133 ||
pitur bhaginyām iti | pitur mātuś ca bhaginyāṃ jyeṣṭhāyāṃ vātmano bhaginyāṃ mātṛvad vṛttim ātiṣṭhet | mātā punas tābhyo gurutamā |
nanu “mātṛṣvasā mātulānī” (2.131) ity anenaiva gurupatnīvat pūjyatvam uktaṃ kim adhikam anena bodhyate?
ucyate — idam eva “mātā tābhyo garīyasI” iti | tena pitṛṣvasrānujñāyāṃ dattāyāṃ mātrā ca virodhe mātur ājñānuṣṭheyeti; atha vā pūrvaṃ pitṛṣvsrāder mātṛvat pūjyatvam uktam | anena tu snehādivṛttir apy atidiśyata ity apunaruktiḥ || 2.133 ||
daśābdākhyaṃ paurasakhyaṃ pañcābdākhyaṃ kalābhṛtām |
tryabdapūrvaṃ śrotriyāṇāṃ svalpenāpi svayoniṣu || 2.134 ||
daśābdākhyam iti | daśa abdā ākhyā yasya tad daśābdākhyaṃ paurasakhyam | ayam arthaḥ – ekapuravāsināṃ vakṣyamāṇavidyādiguṇahitānām ekasya daśabhir abdair jyeṣṭhatve saty api sakhyam ākhyāyate | puragrahaṇaṃ pradarśanārtham, tenaikagrāmādinivāsinām api syāt | gītādikalālpenaiva kālena saha sakhyam | apir evārthe | sarvatroktakālād ūrdhvaṃ jyeṣṭhavyavahāraḥ || 2.134 ||
brāhmaṇaṃ daśavarṣaṃ tu śatavarṣaṃ tu bhūmipam |
pitāputrau vijānīyād brāhmaṇas tu tayoḥ pitā || 2.135 ||
brāhmaṇam iti | daśavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ, śatavarṣaṃ punaḥ kṣatriyaṃ pitāputrau vijānīyāt | tayor madhye daśavarṣo ‘pi brāhmaṇa eva kṣatriyasya śatavarṣasyāpi pitā | tasmāt pitṛvad asau tasya mānyaḥ || 2.135 ||
vittaṃ bandhur vayaḥkarma vidyā bhavati pañcamī |
etāni mānyasthānāni garīyo yad yad uttaram || 2.136 ||
vittam iti | vittaṃ nyāyārjitaṃ dhanam, bandhuḥ pitṛvyādiḥ, vayo ‘dhikavayaskatā, karma śrautaṃ smārtaṃ ca, vidyā vedārthatattvajñānam, etāni pañca mānyatvakāraṇāni | eṣāṃ madhye yad yad uttaraṃ tat tat pūrvasmāc chreṣṭham iti bahumānyamelake balābalam uktam || 2.136 ||
pañcānāṃ triṣu varṇeṣu bhūyāṃsi guṇavanti ca |
yatra syuḥ so ‘tra mānārhaḥ śūdro ‘pi daśamīṃ gataḥ || 2.137 ||
pañcānām iti | triṣu varṇeṣu brāhmaṇādiṣu pañcānāṃ vittādīnāṃ madhye yatra puruṣe pūrvam apy anekaṃ bhavati sa evottarasmād api mānyaḥ | tena vittabandhuyukto vayo’dhikān mānyaḥ | evaṃ vittāditrayayuktaḥ karmavato mānyaḥ | vittādicatuṣṭayayukto viduṣo mānyaḥ | guṇavanti ceti prakarṣavanti | tena dvayor eva vidyādisattve prakarṣo mānahetuḥ | śūdro ‘pi daśamīm avasthāṃ navatyadhikāṃ gato dvijanmanām api mānārhaḥ | śatavarṣāṇāṃ daśadhā vibhāge daśamy avasthā navatyadhikā bhavati || 2.137 ||
ayam api pūjāprakāraḥ prasaṅgād ucyate –
cakriṇo daśamīsthasya rogiṇo bhāriṇaḥ striyāḥ |
snātakasya ca rājñaś ca panthā deyo varasya ca || 2.138 ||
cakriṇa iti | cakrayuktarathādiyānārūḍhasya, navatyadhikavayasaḥ, rogārtasya, bhārapīḍitasya, striyāḥ, aciranivṛttasamāvartanasya, deśādhipasya, vivāhāya prasthitasya panthās tyaktavyaḥ | tyāgārthatvāc ca dadāter na caturthī || 2.138 ||
teṣāṃ tu samavetānāṃ mānyau snātakapārthivau |
rājasnātakayoś caiva snātako nṛpamānabhāk || 2.139 ||
teṣām iti | teṣām ekatra militānāṃ deśādhipasnātakau mānyau | rājasnātakayor api snātaka eva rājāpekṣayā mānyaḥ | ato rājaśabdo ‘tra pūrvaśloke na kevalajātivacanaḥ | kṣatriyajātyapekṣayā “brāhmaṇaṃ daśavarṣaṃ tu” (2.135) ity anena brāhmaṇamātrasya mānyatvābhidhānāt snātakagrahaṇavaiyarthyāc ca || 2.139 ||
ācāryādiśabdārtham āha –
upanīya tu yaḥ śiṣyaṃ vedam adhyāpayed dvijaḥ |
sakalpaṃ sarahasyaṃ ca tam ācāryaṃ pracakṣate || 2.140 ||
upanīyeti | taiḥ śabdair iha śāstre prāyo vyavahārāt | yo brāhmaṇaḥ śiṣyam upanīya kalparahasyasahitāṃ vedaśākhāṃ sarvām adhyāpayati tam ācāryaṃ pūrve munayo vadanti | kalpo yajñavidyā, rahasyam upaniṣat | vedatve ‘py upaniṣadāṃ prādhānyavivakṣayā pṛthaṅ nirdeśaḥ || 2.140 ||
ekadeśaṃ tu vedasya vedāṅgāny api vā punaḥ |
yo ‘dhyāpayati vṛttyartham upādhyāyaḥ sa ucyate || 2.141 ||
ekadeśam iti | vedasyaikadeśaṃ mantraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca vedarahitāni vyākaraṇādīny aṅgāni yo vṛttyartham adhyāpayati sa upādhyāya ucyate || 2.141 ||
niṣekādīni karmāṇi yaḥ karoti yathāvidhi |
saṃbhāvayati cānnena sa vipro gurur ucyate || 2.142 ||
niṣekādīnīti | niṣeko garbhādhānam, tena pitur ayaṃ gurutvopadeśaḥ | garbhādānādīni saṃskārakarmāṇi pitur upadiṣṭāni yathāśāstraṃ yaḥ karoti, annena ca saṃvardhayati sa vipro gurur ucyate || 2.14 ||
agnyādheyaṃ pākayajñān agniṣṭomādikān makhān |
yaḥ karoti vṛto yasya sa tasyartvig ihocyate || 2.143 ||
agnyādheyam iti | āhavanīyādyagnyutpādakaṃ karmāgnyādheyam, aṣṭakādīn pākayajñān, agniṣṭomādīn yajñān kṛtavaraṇo yasya karoti sa tasyartvig iha śāstre ‘bhidhīyate | brahmacāridharmeṣv anupayuktam apy ṛtviglakṣaṇam ācāryādivad ṛtvigjo ‘pi mānyatvaṃ darśayituṃ prasaṅgād uktam || 2.143 ||
ya āvṛṇoty avitathaṃ brahmaṇā śravaṇāv ubhau |
sa mātā sa pitā jñeyas taṃ na druhyet kadācana || 2.144 ||
ya āvṛṇotīti | ya ubhau karṇau avitatham iti varṇasvaravaiguṇyarahitena satyarūpeṇa vedenāpūrayati sa mātā pitā ca jñeyaḥ | mahopakārakatvaguṇayogād ayam adhyāpako mātāpitṛśabdavācyas taṃ nāpakuryāt | kadācaneti gṛhīte vede || 2.144 ||
upādhyāyān daśācārya ācāryāṇāṃ śataṃ pitā |
sahasraṃ tu pitṝn mātā gauraveṇātiricyate || 2.145 ||
upādhyāyān iti | daśopādhyāyān apekṣya ācāryaḥ, ācāryaśatam apekṣya pitā, sahasraṃ pitṝn apekṣya mātā gauraveṇātiriktā bhavati | atropanayanapūrvakasāvitrīmātrādhyāpayitā ācāryo ‘bhipretaḥ, tam apekṣya pitur utkarṣaḥ | “utpādakabrahmadātroḥ” (2.146) ity anena mukhyācāryasya pitaram apekṣyotkarṣaṃ vakṣyatīty avirodhaḥ || 2.145 ||
utpādakabrahmadātror garīyān brahmadaḥ pitā |
brahmajanma hi viprasya pretya ceha ca śāśvatam || 2.146 ||
utpādaketi | janakācāryau dvāv api pitarau, janmadātṛtvāt | tayor ācāryaḥ pitā gurutaraḥ | yasmād viprasya brahmagrahaṇārthaṃ janmopanayanasaṃskārarūpaṃ janma paraloke ihaloke ca śāśvataṃ nityam, brahmaprāptiphalakatvāt || 2.146 ||
kāmān mātā pitā cainaṃ yad utpādayato mithaḥ |
saṃbhūtiṃ tasya tāṃ vidyād yad yonāv abhijāyate || 2.147 ||
kāmād iti | mātāpitarau yad enaṃ bālakaṃ kāmavaśenānyonyam utpādayataḥ saṃbhavamātraṃ tat tasya paśvādisādhāraṇam | yad yonau mātṛkukṣāv abhijāyate ‘ṅgapratyaṅgāni labhate || 2.147 ||
ācāryas tv asya yāṃ jātiṃ vidhivad vedapāragaḥ |
utpādayati sāvitryā sā satyā sājarāmarā || 2.148 ||
ācārya iti | ācāryaḥ punar vedajño ‘sya māṇavakasya yāṃ jātiṃ yaj janma vidhivat sāvitryeti sāṅgopanayanapūrvakasāviryanuvacanenotpādayati sā jātiḥ satyā ajarāmarā ca, brahmaprāptiphalatvāt | upanayanapūrvakasya vedādhyayanatadarthajñānānuṣṭhānair niṣkāmasya mokṣalābhāt || 2.148 ||
alpaṃ vā bahu vā yasya śrutasyopakaroti yaḥ |
tam apīha guruṃ vidyāc chrutopakriyayā tayā || 2.149 ||
alpaṃ veti | śrutasya śrutenety arthaḥ | upādhyāyo yasya śiṣyasyālpaṃ vā bahu vā kṛtvā śrutenopakaroti tam apīha śāstre tasya guruṃ jānīyāt | śrutam evopakriyā, tayā śrutopakriyayā || 2.149 ||
brāhmasya janmanaḥ kartā svadharmasya ca śāsitā |
bālo ‘pi vipro vṛddhasya pitā bhavati dharmataḥ || 2.150 ||
brāhmasyeti | brahmaśravaṇārthaṃ janma brāhmam upanayanam | svadharmasya śāsitā vedārthavyākhyātā tādṛśo ‘pi bālo vṛddhasya jyeṣṭasya pitā bhavati | dharmata iti pitṛdharmās tasminn anuṣṭhātavyāḥ || 2.150 ||
prakṛtānurūpārthavādam āha –
adhyāpayāmāsa pitṝñ śiśur āṅgirasaḥ kaviḥ |
putrakā iti hovāca jñānena parigṛhya tān || 2.151 ||
adhyāpayāmāseti | aṅgirasaḥ putro bālaḥ kavir vidvān pitṝn gauṇān pitṛvyatatputrādīn adhikavayaso ‘dhyāpitavān | tāñ jñānena parigṛhya śiṣyān kṛtvā ‘putrakāḥ’ iti ājuhāva | iti ha ity avyayaṃ purāvṛttasūcanārtham || 2.151 ||
te tam artham apṛcchanta devān āgatamanyavaḥ |
devāś caitān sametyocur nyāyyaṃ vaḥ śiśur uktavān || 2.152 ||
te tam artham apṛcchanteti | te pitṛtulyāḥ ‘putrakāḥ’ ity uktā anena jātakrodhāḥ putrakaśabdarthaṃ devān pṛṣṭavantaḥ | devāś ca pṛṣṭā militvā etān avocan – yuṣmān yac chiśuḥ putraśabdenoktamāṃs tad yuktam || 2.152 ||
ajño bhavati vai bālaḥ pitā bhavati mantradaḥ |
ajñaṃ hi bālam ity āhuḥ pitety eva tu mantradam || 2.153 ||
ajña iti | vaiśabdo ‘vadhāraṇe | ajña eva bālo bhavati na tv alpavayāḥ | mantradaḥ pitā bhavati | mantragrahaṇaṃ vedopalakṣaṇārtham | yo vedam adhyāpayati vyācaṣṭe sa pitā | atraiva hetum āha – yasmāt pūrve ‘pi munayo ‘jñaṃ bālam ity ūcuḥ, mantradaṃ ca pitety evābruvann ity āha || 2.153 ||
na hāyanair na palitair na vittena na bandhubhiḥ |
ṛṣayaś cakrire dharmaṃ yo ‘nūcānaḥ sa no mahān || 2.154 ||
na hāyanair iti | na bahubhir varṣaiḥ, na keśasmaśrulomabhiḥ śuklaiḥ, na bahunā dhanena, na pitṛvyatvādibhir bandhubhāvaiḥ, samuditair apy etair na mahattvaṃ bhavati kiṃ tu ṛṣaya imaṃ dharmaṃ kṛtavantaḥ | yaḥ sāṅgavedādhyetā so ‘smākaṃ mahān saṃmataḥ || 2.154 ||
viprāṇāṃ jñātayo jyaiṣṭhyaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu vīryataḥ |
vaiśyānāṃ dhānyadhanataḥ śūdrāṇām eva janmataḥ || 2.155 ||
viprāṇām iti | brāhmaṇānāṃ vidyayā, kṣatriyāṇāṃ punar vīryeṇa, vaiśyānāṃ dhānyavastrādidhanena, śūdrāṇām eva punar janmanā śreṣṭhatvam | sarvatra tṛtīyārthe tasiḥ
|| 2.155 ||
na tena vṛddho bhavati yenāsya palitaṃ śiraḥ |
yo vai yuvāpy adhīyānas taṃ devāḥ sthaviraṃ viduḥ || 2.156 ||
na teneti | na tena vṛddho bhavati yenāsya śuklakeśaṃ śiraḥ kiṃ tu yuvāpi san yo vidvāṃs taṃ devāḥ sthaviraṃ jānanti || 2.156 ||
yathā kāṣṭhamayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ |
yaś ca vipro ‘nadhīyānas trayas te nāma bibhrati || 2.157 ||
yathā kāṣṭhamaya iti | yathā kāṣṭhaghaṭito hastī, yathā carmanirmito mṛgaḥ, yaś ca vipro nādhīte, traya ete nāmamātraṃ dadhati, na tu hastyādikāryaṃ śatruvadhādikaṃ kartuṃ kṣamante || 2.157 ||
yathā ṣaṇḍho ‘phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaur gavi cāphalā |
yathā cājñe ‘phalaṃ dānaṃ tathā vipro ‘nṛco ‘phalaḥ || 2.158 ||
yathā ṣaṇḍa iti | yathā napuṃsakaḥ strīṣu niṣphalaḥ, yathā strīgavī gavyām eva niṣphalā, yathā cājñe dānam aphalam, tathā brāhmaṇo ‘py anadhīyāno niṣphalaḥ śrautasmārtakarmānarhatayā tatphalarahitaḥ || 2.158 ||
ahiṃsayaiva bhūtānāṃ kāryaṃ śreyonuśāsanam |
vāk caiva madhurā ślakṣṇā prayojyā dharmam icchatā || 2.159 ||
ahiṃsayaiveti | bhūtānāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ prakaraṇāc chreyortham anuśāsanam anatihiṃsayā kartavyam, “rajjvā veṇudalena vā” (8.99) ity alpahiṃsāyā abhyanujñānāt | vāṇī madhurā prītijananī ślakṣṇā yā noccair ucyate sā śiṣyaśikṣāyai dharmabuddhim icchatā prayoktavyā
|| 2.159 ||
idānīṃ puruṣamātrasya phalaṃ dharmaṃ vāṅmanaḥsaṃyamam āha –
yasya vāṅmanasī śuddhe samyaggupte ca sarvadā |
sa vai sarvam avāpnoti vedāntopagataṃ phalam || 2.160 ||
yasyeti | adhyāpayitur eva yasya vāṅmanaś cobhayaṃ śuddhaṃ bhavati, vāg anṛtādibhir aduṣṭā, manaś ca rāgadveṣādibhir adūṣitaṃ bhavati, ete vāṅmanasī niṣiddhaviṣayaprakaraṇe sarvadā yasya puṃsaḥ surakṣite bhavataḥ, sa vedānte ‘vagataṃ sarvaṃ phalaṃ sarvajñatvaṃ sarveśānādirūpaṃ mokṣalābhād avāpnoti || 2.160 ||
nāruṃtudaḥ syād ārto ‘pi na paradrohakarmadhīḥ |
yayāsyodvijate vācānālokyāṃ tām udīrayet || 2.161 ||
nāruṃtuda iti | ayam api puruṣamātrasyaiva dharmo nādhyāpakasya | ārtaḥ pīḍito ‘pi nāruṃtudaḥ syān na marmapīḍākaraṃ tattvadūṣaṇam udāharet | tathā parasya droho ‘pahāras tadarthaṃ karma buddhiś ca na kartavyā | tathā yayā vācāsya paro vyathate tāṃ marmasparśanālokyāṃ svargādiprāptivirodhinīṃ na vadet || 2.161 ||
saṃmānād brāhmaṇo nityam udvijeta viṣād iva |
amṛtasyeva cākāṅkṣed avamānasya sarvadā || 2.162 ||
saṃmānād iti | brāhmaṇaḥ saṃmānād viṣād iva sarvadodvijeta saṃmāne prītiṃ na kuryāt | amṛtasyeva sarvasmāl lokād avamānasyākāṅkṣet, avamāne pareṇa kṛte ‘pi kṣamāvāṃs tatra khedaṃ na kuryāt | mānāvamānadvandvasahiṣṇutvam anena vidhīyate || 2.162 ||
avamānasahiṣṇutve hetum āha –
sukhaṃ hy avamataḥ śete sukhaṃ ca pratibudhyate |
sukhaṃ carati loke ‘sminn avamantā vinaśyati || 2.163 ||
sukhaṃ hy avamataḥ śeta iti | yasmād avamāne pareṇa kṛte tatra khedam akurvāṇaḥ sukhaṃ nidrāti | anyathāvamānaduḥkhena dahyamānaḥ kathaṃ nidrāṃ labhate | kathaṃ ca sukhaṃ pratibudhyate | pratibuddhaś ca kathaṃ sukhaṃ kāryeṣu carati | avamānakartā tena pāpena vinaśyati || 2.163 ||
anena kramayogena saṃskṛtātmā dvijaḥ śanaiḥ |
gurau vasan saṃcinuyād brahmādhigamikaṃ tapaḥ || 2.164 ||
aneneti | anena kramakathitopāyena jātakarmādinopanayanaparyantena saṃskṛto dvijo gurukule vasan śanair atvarayā vedagrahaṇārthaṃ tapo ‘bhihitābhidhāsyāmānaniyamakalāparūpam anutiṣṭhet | vidhyantarasiddhasyāpy ayam arthavādo ‘dhyayanāṅgatvabodhanāya || 2.164 ||
adhyayanāṅgatvam eva spaṣṭayati –
tapoviśeṣair vividhair vrataiś ca vidhicoditaiḥ |
vedaḥ kṛtsno ‘dhigantavyaḥ sarahasyo dvijanmanā || 2.165 ||
tapoviśeṣair iti | tapoviśeṣair niyamakalāpair vividhair bahuprakāraiś ca “adhyeṣyamāṇas tv ācāntaḥ” (2.70) ityādinoktaiḥ, “sevetemāṃs tu niyamān” (2.175) ityādibhir vakṣyamāṇair api, vrataiś copaniṣanmahānāmnikādibhir vidhicoditaiḥ svagṛhyavihitaiḥ samagravedo mantrabrāhmaṇātmakaḥ sopaniṣatko ‘py adhyetavyaḥ | rahasym upaniṣadaḥ | prādhānyakhyāpanāya pṛthaṅ nirdeśaḥ || 2.165 ||
vedam eva sadābhyasyet tapas tapsyan dvijottamaḥ |
vedābhyāso hi viprasya tapaḥ param ihocyate || 2.166 ||
vedam eveti | yatra niyamānām aṅgatvam uktaṃ tat kṛtsnasvādhyāyādhyayanam anena vidhatte | tapas tapsyaṃś cariṣyan dvijo vedam eva grahaṇārtham āvartayet | tasmād vedābhyāsa eva viprāder iha loke prakṛṣṭaṃ tapo munibhir abhidhīyate || 2.166 ||
ā haiva sa nakhāgrebhyaḥ paramaṃ tapyate tapaḥ |
yaḥ sragvy api dvijo ‘dhīte svādhyāyaṃ śaktito ‘nvaham || 2.167 ||
ā haiveti | svādhyāyādhyayanastutir iyam | haśabdaḥ paramaśabdavihitasyāpi prakarṣasya sūcakaḥ | sa dvija ā nakhāgrebhya eva caraṇanakhaparyantaṃ sarvadehavyāpakam eva prakṛṣṭatamaṃ tapas tapyate | yaḥ sragvy api kusumamālādhāry api pratyahaṃ yathāśakti svādhyāyam adhīte | sragvy apīty anena vedādhyayanāya brahmacāriniyamatyāgam api stutyarthaṃ darśayati | tapyata iti “tapas tpaḥkarmasyaiva” (Pāṇ 3.1.88) iti yagātmanepade bhavataḥ || 2.167 ||
yo ‘nadhītya dvijo vedam anyatra kurute śramam |
sa jīvann eva śūdratvam āśu gacchati sānvayaḥ || 2.168 ||
dvijānāṃ tatra tatrādikāraśruter dvijatvanirūpaṇārtham āha – |
matur agre ‘dhijananaṃ dvitīyaṃ mauñjibandhane |
tṛtīyaṃ yajñadīkṣāyāṃ dvijasya śruticodanāt || 2.169 ||
matur agra iti | mātuḥ sakāśād ādau puruṣasya janma | dvitīyaṃ mauñjibandhane upanayane | “ṅyāpo saṃjñāchandasor bahulam” (Pāṇ 6.3.63) iti hrasvaḥ; tṛtīyaṃ jyotiṣṭomādiyajñadīkṣāyāṃ vedaśravaṇāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ “punar vā yad ṛtvijo yajñiyaṃ kurvanti yad dīkṣayanti” iti | prathamadvitīyatṛtīyajanmakathanaṃ cedaṃ dvitīyajanmastutyartham, dvijasyaiva yajñadīkṣāyām apy adhikārāt || 2.169 ||
tatra yad brahmajanmāsya mauñjībandhanacihnitam |
tatrāsya mātā sāvitrī pitā tv ācārya ucyate || 2.170 ||
tatreti | teṣu triṣu janmasu madhye yad etad brahmagrahaṇārthaṃ janmopanayanasaṃskārarūpaṃ mekhalābandhanopalakṣitaṃ tatrāsya māṇavakasya sāvitrī mātā, ācāryaś ca pitā, mātṛpitṛsaṃpādyatvāj janmanaḥ || 2.170 ||
vedapradānād ācāryaṃ pitaraṃ paricakṣate |
na hy asmin yujyate karma kiṃcid ā mauñjibandhanāt || 2.171 ||
vedapradānād iti | vedādhyāpanād ācāryaṃ pitaraṃ manvādayo vadanti | pitṛvan mahopakāraphalād gauṇaṃ pitṛtvam | mahopakāram eva darśayati – na hy asminn iti | yasmād asmin māṇavake prāg upanayanāt kiṃcit karma śrautaṃ smārtaṃ ca na saṃbadhyate, na tatrādhikriyata ity arthaḥ || 2.171 ||
nābhivyāhārayed brahma svadhāninayanād ṛte |
śūdreṇa hi samas tāvad yāvad vede na jāyate || 2.172 ||
nābhivyāhārayed iti | ā maujñibandhanād ity anuvartate | prāg upanayanād vedaṃ noccārayet | svadhāśabdena śrāddham ucyate | ninīyate niṣpādyate yena mantrajātena tad varjayitvā mṛtapitṛko navaśrāddhādau mantraṃ noccārayet | tadvyatiriktaṃ vedaṃ nodāharat | yasmād yāvad vede na jāyate tāvad asau śūdreṇa tulyaḥ || 2.172 ||
kṛtopanayanasyāsya vratādeśanam iṣyate |
brahmaṇo grahaṇaṃ caiva krameṇa vidhipūrvakam || 2.173 ||
kṛtopanayanasyeti | yasmād asya māṇavakasya “samidham ādhehi” (gṛ. sū. 1.22.6) “divā mā svāpsīḥ” (gṛ. sū. 1.22.2) ityādivratādeśanaṃ vedasyādhyayanaṃ mantrabrāhmaṇakrameṇa “adhyeṣyamāṇas tv ācāntaḥ” (2.70) ityādividhipūrvakam upanītasyopadiśyate, tasmād upanayanāt pūrvaṃ na vedam udāharet || 2.173 ||
yad yasya vihitaṃ carma yat sūtraṃ yā ca mekhalā |
yo daṇḍo yac ca vasanaṃ tat tad asya vrateṣv api || 2.174 ||
yas yasyeti | yasya brahmacāriṇo yāni carmasūtramekhalādaṇḍavastrāṇy upanayanakāle gṛhyeṇa vihitāni, godānādivrateṣv api tāny eva navāni kartavyāni || 2.174 ||
sevetemāṃs tu niyamān brahmacārī gurau vasan |
saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ tapovṛddhyartham ātmanaḥ || 2.175 ||
seveteti | brahmacārī gurusamīpe vasann indriyasaṃyamaṃ kṛtvānugatādṛṣṭavṛddhyartham imān niyamān anutiṣṭhet || 2.175 ||
nityaṃ snātvā śuciḥ kuryād devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam |
devatābhyarcanaṃ caiva samidādhānam eva ca || 2.176 ||
nityam iti | pratyahaṃ snātvā devarṣipitṛbhya udakadānam, pratimādiṣu hariharādidevapūjanam, sāyaṃprātaś ca samiddhomaṃ kuryāt | yas tu gautamīye snānaniṣedho brahmacāriṇaḥ sa sukhasnānaviṣayaḥ | ata eva baudhāyanaḥ (2.38): “nāpsu ślāghamānaḥ snāyāt” | viṣṇunātra “kāladvayam abhiṣekāgnikāryakaraṇam apsu daṇḍavan majjanam” iti bruvāṇena vāradvayaṃ snānam upadiṣṭam || 2.176 ||
varjayen madhu māṃsaṃ ca gandhaṃ mālyaṃ rasān striyaḥ |
śuktāni yāni sarvāṇi prāṇināṃ caiva hiṃsanam || 2.177 ||
varjayed iti | kṣaudraṃ māṃsaṃ ca na khādet | gandhaṃ ca karpūracandanakastūrikādi varjayet | eṣāṃ ca gandhānāṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ bhakṣaṇam anulepanaṃ ca niṣiddham | mālyaṃ ca na dhārayet | udriktarasāṃś ca guḍādīn na khādet | striyaś ca nopeyāt | yāni svabhāvato madhurādirasāni kālavaśenodakavāsādinā cāmlayanti tāni śuktāni na khādet | prāṇināṃ hiṃsāṃ na kuryāt || 2.177 ||
abhyaṅgam añjanaṃ cākṣṇor upānacchatradhāraṇam |
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca nartanaṃ gītavādanam || 2.178 ||
abhyaṅgam iti | tailādinā śiraḥsahitadehamardanalakṣaṇam, kajjalādibhiś ca cakṣuṣor añjanam, pādukāyāś chatrasya ca dhāraṇam, kāmaṃ maithunātiriktaviṣayābhilāṣātiśayam, maithunasya striya ity anenaiva niṣiddhatvāt | krodhalobhanṛtyagītavīṇāpaṇāvādi varjayet || 2.178 ||
dhūtaṃ ca janavādaṃ ca parivādaṃ tathānṛtam |
strīṇāṃ ca prekṣaṇālambham upaghātaṃ parasya ca || 2.179 ||
dyūtaṃ ceti | akṣakrīḍām, janaiḥ saha nirarthakavākkalaham, parasya doṣavādam, mṛṣābhidhānam, strīṇāṃ ca maithunecchayā sānurāgeṇa prekṣaṇāliṅganam, parasya cāpakāraṃ varjayet || 2.179 ||
ekaḥ śayīta sarvatra na retaḥ skandayet kvacit |
kāmād dhi skandhayan reto hinasti vratam ātmanaḥ || 2.180 ||
eka iti | sarvatra nīcaśayyādāv ekākī śayanaṃ kuryāt | icchayā na svaśukraṃ pātayet | yasmād icchayā svamehāc chukraṃ pātayan svakīyavrataṃ nāśayati | vratalope cāvakīrṇiprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt || 2.180 ||
svapne siktvā brahmacārī dvijaḥ śukram akāmataḥ |
snātvārkam arcayitvā triḥ punar mām ity ṛcaṃ japet || 2.181 ||
svapna iti | brahmacārī svapnādāv anicchayā retaḥ siktvā kṛtasnānaś candanādyanulepanapuṣpadhūpādibhiḥ sūryam abhyarcya “punar mām aitv indriyam” (Āś. Gṛ. 3.6) ity etām ṛcaṃ vāratrayaṃ paṭhet | idam atra prāyaścittam || 2.181 ||
udakumbhaṃ sumanaso gośakṛnmṛttikākuśān |
āhared yāvadarthāni bhaikṣaṃ cāhar ahaś caret || 2.182 ||
udakumbham iti | jalakalaśapuṣpagomayamṛttikākuśān yāvadarthāni yāvadbhiḥ prayojanāni ācāryasya tāvanty ācāryārtham āharet | ata evodakumbham ity atraikatvam apy avivakṣitam | pradarśanaṃ caitat | anyad apy ācāryopayuktam upāhared bhaikṣaṃ ca pratyaham arjayet
|| 2.182 ||
vedayajñair ahīnānāṃ praśastānāṃ svakarmasu |
brahmacāry āhared bhaikṣaṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato ‘nvaham || 2.183 ||
vedayajñair iti | vedayajñaiś cātyaktānāṃ svakarmasu dakṣāṇāṃ gṛhebhyaḥ pratyahaṃ brahmacārī siddhānnabhikṣāsamūham āharet || 2.183 ||
guroḥ kule na bhikṣeta na jñātikulabandhuṣu |
alābhe tv anyagehānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vivarjayet || 2.184 ||
guroḥ kula iti | ācāryasya sapiṇḍeṣu bandhuṣu mātulādiṣu ca na bhikṣeta | tadgṛhavyatiriktabhikṣāyogyagṛhābhāve cokebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ varjayet | tataś ca prathamaṃ bandhūn bhikṣeta, tatrālābhe jñātīn, tatrālābhe guror api jñātīn bhikṣeta || 2.184 ||
sarvaṃ vāpi cared grāmaṃ pūrvoktānām asaṃbhave |
niyamya prayato vācam abhiśastāṃs tu varjayet || 2.185 ||
sarve veti | pūrvaṃ “vedayajñair ahīnānām” (2.183) ity anenoktānām asaṃbhave sarvaṃ vā grāmam uktaguṇarahitam api śucir maunī bhikṣeta | mahāpātakādyabhiśastāṃs tyajet
|| 2.185 ||
dūrād āhṛtya samidhaḥ saṃnidadhyād vihāyasi |
sāyaṃprātaś ca juhuyāt tābhir agnim atandritaḥ || 2.186 ||
dūrād iti | dūrād digbhyaḥ parigṛhītavṛkṣebhyaḥ samidha ānīya ākāśe dāraṇāśaktaḥ paṭalādau sthāpayet | tābhiś ca samidbhiḥ sāyaṃprātar anale homaṃ kuryāt || 2.187 ||
akṛtvā bhaikṣacaraṇam asamidhya ca pāvakam |
anāturaḥ saptarātram avakīrṇivrataṃ caret || 2.187 ||
akṛtveti | bhikṣāhāram, sāyaṃprātaḥ samiddhomam, arogo nairantaryeṇa saptarātram akṛtvā luptavrato bhavati | tataś cāvakīrniprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt || 2.187 ||
bhaikṣeṇa vartayen nityaṃ naikānnādī bhaved vratī |
bhaikṣeṇa vratino vṛttir upavāsasamā smṛtā || 2.188 ||
bhaikṣeṇeti | brahmacārī na ekānnam adyāt kiṃ tu bahugṛhāhṛtabhikṣāsamūhena pratyahaṃ jīvet | yasmād bhikṣāsamūhena brahmacāriṇo vṛttir upavāsatulyā munibhiḥ smṛtā || 2.188 ||
vratavad devadaivatye pitrye karmaṇy atharṣivat |
kāmam abhyarthito ‘śnīyād vratam asya na lupyate || 2.189 ||
vratavad iti | pūrvaniṣiddhasyaikānnabhojanasyāyaṃ pratiprasavaḥ | devadaivatye karmaṇi devatoddeśenābhyarthito brahmacārī vratad iti vrataviruddhamadhumāṃsādivarjitam ekasyāpy annaṃ yathepsitaṃ bhuñjīta | atha pitruddeśenābhyarthito bhavati tadā ṛṣir yatiḥ samyagdarśanasaṃpannatvāt sa iva madhumāṃsavarjitam ekasyāpy annaṃ yathepsitaṃ bhuñjīta iti sa evārtho vaidagdhyenoktaḥ, tathāpi bhaikṣavṛttiniyamarūpaṃ vratam asya luptaṃ na bhavati | yājñavalkyo ‘pi śrāddhe ‘bhyarthitasyaikānnabhojanam āha:
brahmacarye sthito naikam annam adyād anāpadi |
brāhmaṇaḥ kāmam aśnīyāc chrāddhe vratam apīḍayan || [YDh 1.32] iti |
viśvarūpeṇa tu “vratam asya na lupyate” iti paśyatā brahmacāriṇo māṃsabhakṣaṇam anena manuvacanena vidhīyata iti vyākhyātam || 2.189 ||
brāhmaṇasyaiva karmaitad upadiṣṭaṃ manīṣibhiḥ |
rājanyavaiśyayos tv evaṃ naitat karma vidhīyate || 2.190 ||
brāhmaṇasyaiveti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ trayāṇām eva brahmacāriṇāṃ bhaikṣācaraṇavidhānāt “vratavat” (2.189) ity anena tadapavādarūpaṃ ekānnabhojanam upadiṣṭaṃ kṣatriyavaiśyayor api punar uktena paryudasyate | etad ekānnabhojanarūpaṃ karma tad brāhmaṇasyaiva vedārthavidbhir vihitam | kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ punar na caitat karmeti brūte || 2.190 ||
codito guruṇā nityam apracodita eva vā |
kuryād adhyayane yatnam ācāryasya hiteṣu ca || 2.191 ||
codita iti | ācāryeṇa prerito na prerito vā svayam eva pratyaham adhyayane guruhiteṣu codyogaṃ kuryāt || 2.191 ||
śarīraṃ caiva vācaṃ ca buddhīndiryamanāṃsi ca |
niyamya prāñjalis tiṣṭhed vīkṣamāṇo guror mukham || 2.192 ||
śarīraṃ ceti | dehavāgbuddhīndriyamanāṃsi niyamya kṛtāñjalir gurumukhaṃ paśyaṃs tiṣthen nopaviśet || 2.192 ||
nityam uddhṛtapāṇiḥ syāt sādhvācāraḥ susaṃyataḥ |
āsyatām iti coktaḥ sann āsītābhimukhaṃ guroḥ || 2.193 ||
nityam iti | satatam uttarīyād bahiṣkṛtadakṣiṇabāhuḥ, śobhanācāraḥ, vastrāvṛtadehaḥ, “āsyatām” iti guruṇoktaḥ san guror abhimukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā āsīta || 2.193 ||
hīnānnavastraveṣaḥ syāt sarvadā gurusaṃnidhau |
uttiṣṭhet prathamaṃ cāsya caramaṃ caiva saṃviśet || 2.194 ||
hīnānnavastreti | sarvadā gurusamīpe gurvapekṣayā tv avakṛṣṭānnavastraprasādhano bhavet | guroś ca prathamaṃ rātriśeṣe śayanād uttiṣṭhet, pradoṣe ca gurau supte paścāc chayīta
|| 2.194 ||
pratiśravaṇasaṃbhāṣe śayāno na samācaret |
nāsīno na ca bhuñjāno na tiṣṭhan na parāṅmukhaḥ || 2.195 ||
pratiśravaṇeti | pratiśravaṇam ājñāṅgīkaraṇam, saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ ca guroḥ śayyāyāṃ suptaḥ, āsanopaviṣṭaḥ, bhuñjānaḥ, tiṣṭhan, vimukhaś ca na kuryāt || 2.196 ||
kathaṃ tarhi kuryāt tad āha –
āsīnasya sthitaḥ kuryād abhigacchaṃs tu tiṣṭhataḥ |
pratyudgamya tv āvrajataḥ paścād dhāvaṃs tu dhāvataḥ || 2.196 ||
āsīnasyeti | āsanopaviṣṭasya guror ājñāṃ dadataḥ svayam āsanād utthitaḥ, tiṣṭhato guror ādiśatas tadabhimukhaṃ katicit padāni gatvā, yathā gurur āgacchati tathāpy abhimukhaṃ gatvā, yadā tu gurur dhāvann ādiśati tadā tasya paścād dhāvan pratiśravaṇasaṃbhāṣe kuryāt || 2.196 ||
parāṅmukhasyābhimukho dūrasthasyaitya cāntikam |
praṇamya tu śayānasya nideśe caiva tiṣṭhataḥ || 2.197 ||
parāṅmukhasyeti | parāṅmukhasya vādiśataḥ saṃmukhasthaḥ, dūrasthasya guroḥ samīpam āgatya, śayānasya guroḥ praṇamya prahvo bhūtvā, nideśe nikaṭe ‘vatiṣṭhato guror ādiśataḥ, prahvībhūyaiva pratiśravaṇasaṃbhāṣe kuryāt || 2.197 ||
nīcaṃ śayyāsanaṃ cāsya sarvadā gurusaṃnidhau |
guros to cakṣurviṣaye na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet || 2.198 ||
nīcam iti | gurusamīpe cāsya guruśayyāsanāpekṣayā nīce eva śayyāsane nityaṃ syātām | yatra ca deśe samāsīnaṃ guruḥ paśyati na tatra yatheṣṭhaceṣṭāṃ caraṇaprasāraṇādikāṃ kuryāt || 2.198 ||
nodāhared asya nāma parokṣam api kevalam |
na caivāsyānukurvīta gatibhāṣitaceṣṭitam || 2.199 ||
nodāhared iti | asya guroḥ parokṣam api upādhyāyācāryādipūjāvacanopapadaśūnyaṃ nāma noccārayet | na tu guror gamanabhāṣitaceṣṭitāny anukurvīta gurugamanādisadṛśāny ātmano gamanādīny upahāsabuddhyā na kurvīta || 2.199 ||
guror yatra parīvādo nindā vāpi pravartate |
karṇau tatra pidhātavyau gantavyaṃ vā tato ‘nyataḥ || 2.200 ||
guror yatreti | vidyamānadoṣasyābhidhānaṃ parīvādaḥ, avidyamānadoṣābhidhānaṃ nindā, yatra deśe guroḥ parīvādo nindā ca vartate tatra sthitena śiṣyeṇa karṇau hastādinā tirodhātavyau | tasdmād vā deśād deśāntaraṃ gantavyam || 2.200 ||
idānīṃ śiṣyakartṛkaparīvādakṛtaphalam āha –
parīvādāt kharo bhavati śvā vai bhavati nindakaḥ |
paribhoktā kṛmir bhavati kīṭo bhavati matsarī || 2.201 ||
parīvādād iti | guroḥ parīvādāc chiṣyo mṛtaḥ kharo bhavati | guror nindakaḥ kukkuro bhavati | paribhoktā anucitena gurudhanenopajīvakaḥ kṛmir bhavati | matsarī guror utkarṣāsahanaḥ kīṭo bhavati, kīṭaḥ kṛmibhyaḥ kiṃcit sthūlo bhavati || 2.202 ||
dūrastho nārcayed enaṃ na kruddho nāntike striyāḥ |
yānāsanasthaś caivainam avaruhyābhivādayet || 2.202 ||
dūrastha iti | dūrasthaḥ śiṣo ‘nyaṃ viyujya mālyavastrādinā guruṃ nārcayet | svayaṃ gamanāśaktau tv adoṣaḥ | kruddhaḥ kāminīsamīpe ca sthitaṃ svayam api nārcayet | yānāsanasthaś ca śiṣyo yānāsanād avatīrya gurum abhivādayet | “yānāsanasthaś caivainaṃ pratyutthāya” (2.19) ity anena yānāsanād utthānaṃ vihitam, anena tu yānāsanatyāga ity apunaruktiḥ || 2.202 ||
prativāte ‘nuvāte ca nāsīta guruṇā saha |
asaṃśrave caiva guror na kiṃcid api kīrtayet || 2.203 ||
prativāta iti | pratigato ‘bhimukhībhūtaḥ śiṣyas tadā gurudeśāc chiṣyadeśam āgacchati sa prativātaḥ, yaḥ śiṣyadeśād gurudeśam āgacchati so ‘nuvātaḥ, tatra guruṇā samaṃ nāsīta | tathāvidyamānaḥ saṃśravo yatra tasminn asaṃśrave | gurur yatra na śṛṇotīty arthaḥ | tatra gurugatam anyagataṃ vā na kiṃcit kathayet || 2.203 ||
go’śvoṣṭrayānaprāsādasrastareṣu kaṭeṣu ca |
āsīta guruṇā sārdhaṃ śilāphalakanauṣu ca || 2.204 ||
go’śveti | yānaśabdaḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate | balīvardayāne, ghoṭakaprayukte yāne, uṣṭrayuktayāne, rathakāṣṭhādau, prāsādopari, srastare, kaṭe ca tṛṇādinirmite, śilāyāṃ, phalake ca dārughaṭitadīrghāsane, naukāyāṃ ca guruṇā saha āsīta || 2.204 ||
guror gurau saṃnihite guruvad vṛttim ācaret |
na cānisṛṣṭo guruṇā svān gurūn abhivādayet || 2.205 ||
guror gurāv iti | ācāryasyācārye saṃnihite ācārya iva tasminn apy abhivādanādikāṃ vṛttim anutiṣṭhet | tathā gurugṛhe vasan śiṣya ācāryeṇāniyukto na svān gurūn mātṛpitṛvyādīn abhivādayet || 2.205 ||
vidyāguraṣv etad eva nityā vṛttiḥ svayoniṣu |
pratiṣedhatsu cādharmād dhitaṃ copadiśatsv api || 2.206 ||
vidyeti | ācāryavyatiriktā upādhyāyā vidyāguravaḥ, teṣv etad eveti sāmānyopakramaḥ | kiṃ tat | ācārya iva nityā sārvakālikī vṛttir vidheyā, tathā svayoniṣv api pitṛvyādiṣu tadvṛttiḥ, adharmān niṣedhatsu dharmatattvaṃ copadiśatsu guruvad vartitavyam || 2.207 ||
śreyaḥsu guruvad vṛttiṃ nityam eva samācaret |
guruputreṣu cāryeṣu guroś caiva svabandhuṣu || 2.207 ||
śreyaḥsv iti | śreyaḥsu vidyātapaḥsamṛddheṣu, āryeṣv iti guruputraviśeṣaṇam | samānajātiguruputreṣu guroś ca jñātiṣv api pitṛvyādiṣu sarvadā guruvad vṛttim anutiṣthet | guruputraś cātra śiṣyādhivayāś ca boddhavyaḥ | śiṣyabālasamānavayasām anantaraṃ śiṣyasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt || 2.207 ||
bālaḥ samānajanmā vā śiṣyo vā yajñakarmaṇi |
adhyāpayan gurusuto guruvan mānam arhati || 2.208 ||
bāla iti | kaniṣṭhaḥ savayā vā jyeṣṭho vā śiṣyo ‘dhyāpayann adhyāpanasamarthaḥ | gṛhītaveda ity arthaḥ | sa yajñakarmaṇi ṛtvig anṛtvig vā yajñadarśanārtham āgato guruvat pūjām arhati
|| 2.208 ||
ācāryavad ity aviśeṣeṇa pūjāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ viśeṣam āha –
utsādanaṃ ca gātrāṇāṃ snāpanocchiṣṭabhojane |
na kuryād guruputrasya pādayoś cāvanejanam || 2.209 ||
utsādanam iti | gātrāṇām utsādanam udvartanam, ucchiṣṭasya bhakṣaṇam, pādayoś ca prakṣālanaṃ guruputrasya na kuryāt || 2.209 ||
guruvat pratipūjyāḥ syuḥ savarṇā guruyoṣitaḥ |
asavarṇās tu saṃpūjyāḥ pratyutthānābhivādanaiḥ || 2.210 ||
guruvad iti | savarṇā gurupatnyaḥ guruvad ājñākaraṇādinā pūjyā bhaveyuḥ | asavarṇāḥ punaḥ kevalapratyutthānābhivādanaiḥ || 2.210 ||
abhyañjanaṃ snāpanaṃ ca gātrotsādanam eva ca |
gurupatnyā na kāryāṇi keśānāṃ ca prasādhanam || 2.211 ||
abhyañjanam iti | tailādinā dehābhyaṅgaḥ, snāpanam, gātrāṇāṃ codvartanam, keśānāṃ ca mālādinā prasādhanam, etāni gurupatnyā na kartavyāni | keśānām iti pradarśanamātrārtham, dehasyāpi candanādinā prasādhanaṃ na kuryāt || 2.211 ||
gurupatnī tu yuvatir nābhivādyeha pādayoḥ |
pūrṇaviṃśativarṣeṇa guṇadoṣau vijānatā || 2.212 ||
gurupatnī tv iti | yuvatir gurupatnī pādayor upasaṃgṛhya abhivādanadoṣaguṇajñena yūnā nābhivādyā | pūrṇaviṃśativarṣatvaṃ yauvanapradarśanārtham | bālasya pādayor abhivādanam aniṣiddham | yūnas tu bhūmāv abhivādanaṃ vakṣyati || 2.212 ||
svabhāva eṣa nārīṇāṃ narāṇām iha dūṣaṇam |
ato ‘rthān na pramādyanti pramadāsu vipaścitaḥ || 2.213 ||
svabhāva iti | strīṇām ayaṃ svabhāvaḥ yad iha śṛṅgāraceṣṭayā vyāmohya puruṣāṇāṃ dūṣaṇam | ato ‘rthād asmād dhetoḥ paṇḍitāḥ strīṣu na pramattā bhavanti || 2.213 ||
avidvāṃsam alaṃ loke vidvāṃsam api vā punaḥ |
pramadā hy utpathaṃ netuṃ kāmakrodhavaśānugam || 2.214 ||
avidvāṃsam iti | “vidvān ahaṃ jitendriya” iti buddhyā na strīsaṃnidhir vidheyaḥ | yasmād avidvāṃsaṃ vidvāṃsam api vā punaḥ puruṣaṃ dehadharmāt kāmakrodhavaśānuyāyinaṃ striya utpathaṃ netuṃ samarthāḥ || 2.214 ||
ata āha –
mātrā svasrā duhitrā vā na viviktāsano bhavet |
balavān indriyagrāmo vidvāṃsam api karṣati || 2.215 ||
mātreti | mātrā bhaginyā duhitrā nirjanagṛhādau nāsīta | yato ‘tibala indriyagaṇaḥ śāstraniyamitātmānam api puruṣaṃ paravaśaṃ karoti || 2.215 ||
kāmaṃ tu gurupatnīnāṃ yuvatīnāṃ yuvā bhuvi |
vidhivad vandanaṃ kuryād asāv aham iti bruvan || 2.216 ||
kāmaṃ tv iti | kāmaṃ tu gurupatnīnāṃ yuvatīnāṃ svayam api yuvā yathoktavidhinā “abhivādaye ‘mukaśarmāhaṃ bhoḥ” iti bruvan pādagrahaṇaṃ vinā yatheṣṭam abhivādanaṃ kuryāt || 2.216 ||
viproṣya pādagrahaṇam anvahaṃ cābhivādanam |
gurudāreṣu kurvīta satāṃ dharmam anusmaran || 2.217 ||
viproṣyeti | pravāsād āgatya “savyena savyaṃ dakṣiṇena ca dakṣiṇam” [cf.MDh 2.72] ity uktavidhinā pādagrahaṇaṃ pratyahaṃ bhūmāv abhivādanaṃ ca gurupatnīṣu yuvā kuryāt | śiṣṭānām ayam ācāra iti jānan || 2.217 ||
uktasya śuśrūṣāvidheḥ phalam āha –
yathā khanan khanitreṇa naro vāry adhigacchati |
tathā gurugatāṃ vidyāṃ śuśrūṣur adhigacchati || 2.218 ||
yatheti | yathā kaścin manuṣyaḥ khanitreṇa bhūmiṃ khanan jalaṃ prāpnoti, evaṃ gurau sthitāṃ vidyāṃ gurusevāparaḥ śiṣyaḥ prāpnoti || 2.218 ||
brahmacāriṇaḥ prakāratrayam āha –
muṇḍo vā jaṭilo vā syād atha vā syāc chikhājaṭaḥ |
nainaṃ grāme ‘bhinimlocet sūryo nābhyudiyāt kvacit || 2.219 ||
muṇḍo veti | muṇḍitmastakaḥ, śiraḥkeśajaṭāvān vā, śikhaiva vā jaṭā jātā yasya vā, pare śiraḥkeśā muṇḍitās tathā vā bhavet | enaṃ brahmacāriṇaṃ kvacid grāme nidrāṇam, uttaratra “śayānam” (2.220) iti darśanāt sūryo nābhinimlocen nāstam iyāt || 2.219 ||
atra prāyaścittam āha –
taṃ ced abhyudiyāt sūryaḥ śayānaṃ kāmacārataḥ |
nimloced vāpy avijñānāj japann upavased dinam || 2.220 ||
taṃ ced iti | taṃ cet kāmato nidrāṇaṃ nidropavaśatvena sūryo ‘bhyudiyād astam iyāt tadā sāvitrī japann ubhayatrāpi dinam upavasan rātrau bhuñjīta | abhinimluktasyottare ‘hani upavāsajapau | “abhirabhāge” (Pāṇ 1.4.91) iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā, tataḥ karmapravacanīyayukte dvitīyā | sāvitrījapaṃ tu gautamavacanāt | tad āha gautamaḥ (24.2): “sūryābhyudite brahmacārī tiṣṭhed ahar abhuñjāno ‘bhyastam ite ca rātriṃ japan sāvitrīm” |
nanu gautamavacanāt sūryābhyuditasyaiva dinābhojanajapāv uktau, abhyastam itasya tu rātryābhojanajapau |
naitat, apekṣāyāṃ vyākhyāsaṃdehe vā munyantaravivṛtam artham anvayaṃ vāśrayāmahe na tu sphuṭaṃ manvarthaṃ smṛtyantaradarśanād anyathā kurmaḥ | ata eva japāpekṣāyāṃ gautamavacanāt sāvitrījapo ‘bhyupeya eva, na tūbhayatra sphuṭaṃ manūktaṃ dinopavāsajapāv apākurmaḥ | tasmād abhyastmitasya mānava-gautamīyaprāyaścittavikalpaḥ || 2.220 ||
asya tu prāyaścittavidher arthavādam āha –
sūryeṇa hy abhinirmuktaḥ śayāno ‘bhyuditaś ca yaḥ |
prāyaścittam akurvāṇo yuktaḥ syān mahatainasā || 2.221 ||
sūryeneti | yasmāt sūryeṇābhinirmukto ‘bhyuditaś ca nidrāṇaḥ prāyaścittam akurvan mahatā pāpena yukto narakaṃ gacchati | tasmād yathoktaprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt || 2.221 ||
yasmād uktaprakāreṇa saṃdhyātikrame mahat pāpam, ataḥ –
ācamya prayato nityam ubhe saṃdhye samāhitaḥ |
śucau deśe japañ japyam upāsīta yathāvidhi || 2.222 ||
ācamyeti | ācamya pavitro nityam ananyamanāḥ śucideśe sāvitrīṃ japann ubhe saṃdhye vidhivad upāsīta || 2.222 ||
yadi strī yady avarajaḥ śreyaḥ kiṃcit samācaret |
tat sarvam ācared yukto yatra cāsya ramen manaḥ || 2.223 ||
yadīti | yadi strī śūdro vā kiṃcic chreyo ‘nutiṣṭhati tat sarvaṃ yukto ‘nutiṣṭhet | yatra ca śāstraniṣiddhe mano ‘sya tuṣyati tad api kuryāt || 2.223 ||
śreya eva hi dharmārthau tad darśayati –
dharmārthāv ucyate śreyaḥ kāmārthau dharma eva ca |
artha eveha vā śreyas trivarga iti tu sthitiḥ || 2.224 ||
dharmārthāv iti | dharmārthau śreyo ‘bhidhīyate, kāmahetutvād iti kecid ācāryā manyante | anye tv arthakāmau sukhahetutvāc chreyo ‘bhidhīyate | dharma evety apare, arthakāmayor abhyupāyatvāt | artha eveha loke śreya ity anye, dharmakāmayor api sādhanatvāt | saṃprati svamatam āha — dharmārthakāmātmakaḥ parasparāviruddhas trivarga eva puruṣārthatayā śreya iti viniścayaḥ | evaṃ ca bubhukṣūn praty upadeśo na mumukṣūn | mumukṣūṇāṃ tu mokṣa eva śreya iti ṣaṣṭhe vakṣyate || 2.224 ||
ācāryaś ca pitā caiva mātā bhrātā ca pūrvajaḥ |
nārtenāpy avamantavyā brāhmaṇena viśeṣataḥ || 2.225 ||
ācāryaś ceti | ācāryo janako jananī ca bhrātā ca sagarbho jyeṣṭhaḥ pīḍitenāpy amī nāvamānanīyāḥ, viśeṣato brāhmaṇena || 2.225 ||
yasmāt –
ācāryo brahmaṇo mūrtiḥ pitā mūrtiḥ prajāpateḥ |
mātā pṛthivyā mūrtis tu bhrātā svo mūrtir ātmanaḥ || 2.226 ||
ācārya iti | ācāryo vedāntoditasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmano mūrtiḥ śarīram, pitā hiraṇyagarbhasya, mātā ca dhāraṇāt pṛthivīmūrtiḥ, bhrātā ca svaḥ sagarbhaḥ kṣetrajñasya | tasmād devatārūpā etā nāvamantavyāḥ || 2.226 ||
yaṃ mātāpitarau kleśaṃ sahete saṃbhave nṛṇām |
na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā kartuṃ varṣaśatair api || 2.227 ||
yam iti | nṛṇām apatyānāṃ saṃbhave garbhādhāne sati anantaraṃ yaṃ kleśaṃ mātāpitarau sahete tasya varṣaśatair apy anekair api janmabhir ānṛṇyaṃ kartum aśakyam | mātus tāvat kukṣau dhāraṇaduḥkham, prasavavedanātiśayaḥ, jātasya rakṣaṇavardhanakaṣṭaṃ ca pitur adhikāny eva | rakṣāsaṃvardhanaduḥkham, upanayanāt prabhṛti vedatadaṅgādhyāpanādikleśātiśaya iti sarvasiddham || 2.227 ||
tasmāt –
tayor nityaṃ priyaṃ kuryād ācāryasya ca sarvadā |
teṣv eva triṣu tuṣṭeṣu tapaḥ sarvaṃ samāpyate || 2.228 ||
tayor nityam iti | tayor mātāpitroḥ pratyaham ācāryasya ca sarvadā prītim utpādayet | yasmāt teṣv eva triṣu prīteṣu sarvaṃ tapaś cāndrāyaṇādikaṃ phaladvāreṇa samyak prāpyate mātrāditrayatuṣṭyaiva sarvasya tapasaḥ phalaṃ prāpyata ityādi || 2.228 ||
teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ śuśrūṣā paramaṃ tapa ucyate |
na tair anabhyanujñāto dharmam anyaṃ samācaret || 2.229 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ mātāpitrācāryāṇāṃ paricaryā sarvaṃ tapomayaṃ śreṣṭham ita eva sarvatapaḥphalaprāpteḥ | yady anyam api dharmaṃ kathaṃcit karoti tad apy etat trayānumativyatirekeṇa na kuryāt || 2.229 ||
ta eva hi trayo lokās ta eva traya āśramāḥ |
ta eva hi trayo vedās ta evoktās trayo ‘gnayaḥ || 2.230 ||
