ta eveti | yasmāt ta eva mātāpitrācāryās trayo lokāḥ, lokatrayaprāptihetutvāt | kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ | ta eva brahmacaryādibhāvatrayarūpā āśramāḥ, gārhasthyādyāśramatrayapradāyakatvāt | ta eva trayo vedāḥ, vedatrayajapaphalopāyatvāt | ta eva hi trayo ‘gnayo ‘bhihitās tretāsaṃpādyayajñādiphaladātṛtvāt || 2.230 ||
pitā vai gārhapatyo ‘gnir mātāgnir dakṣiṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
gurur āhavanīyas tu sāgnitretā garīyasī || 2.231 ||
piteti | vaiśabdo ‘vadhāraṇe | pitaiva gārhapatyo ‘gniḥ, mātā dakṣiṇāgniḥ, ācārya āhavanīyaḥ | seyam agnitretā śreṣṭhatarā | stutyarthatvāc cāsya na vastuvirodho ‘tra bhāvanīyaḥ || 2.231 ||
triṣv apramādyann eteṣu trīṃl lokān vijayed gṛhī |
dīpyamānaḥ svavapuṣā devavad divi modate || 2.232 ||
triṣv iti | eteṣu triṣu pramādam akurvan brahmacārī tāvaj jayaty eva, gṛhastho ‘pi trīṃl lokān vijayati | saṃjñāpūrvakasyātmanepadavidher anityatvān na "viparābhyāṃ jeḥ” (Pāṇ 1.3.19) ity ātmanepadam | trīṃl lokān vijayed iti triṣv ādhipatyaṃ prāpnoti, tathā svavapuṣā prakāśamānaḥ sūryādidevavad divi hṛṣṭo bhavati || 2.232 ||
imaṃ lokaṃ mātṛbhaktyā pitṛbhaktyā tu madhyamam |
guruśuśrūṣayā tv evaṃ brahmalokaṃ samaśnute || 2.233 ||
imam iti | imaṃ bhūrlokaṃ mātṛbhaktyā, pitṛbhaktyā madhyamam antarikṣam, ācāryabhaktyā tu hiraṇyagarbhalokam eva prāpnoti || 2.233 ||
sarve tasyādṛtā dharmā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ |
anādṛtās tu yasyaite sarvās tasyāphalāḥ kriyāḥ || 2.234 ||
sarva iti | yasyaite trayo mātṛpitrācāryā ādṛtāḥ satkṛtās tasya sarve dharmāḥ phaladā bhavanti | yasyaite trayo ‘nādṛtās tasya sarvāṇi śrautasmārtakarmāṇi niṣphalāni bhavanti || 2.234 ||
yāvat trayas te jīveyus tāvan nānyaṃ samācaret |
teṣv eva nityaṃ śuśrūṣāṃ kuryāt priyahite rataḥ || 2.235 ||
yāvad iti | te trayo yāvaj jīvanti tāvad anyaṃ dharmaṃ svātantryeṇa nānutiṣṭhet | tadanujñayā tu dharmānuṣṭhānaṃ prāg vihitam eva | kiṃ tu teṣv eva pratyahaṃ priyahitaparaḥ śuśrūṣāṃ tadarthe prītisādhanaṃ priyam, bheṣajapānādivat | āyatyām iṣṭasādhanaṃ hitam || 2.235 ||
teṣām anuparodhena pāratryaṃ yad yad ācaret |
tat tan nivedayet tebhyo manovacanakarmabhiḥ || 2.236 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ śuśrūṣāyā avirodhena tadanujñāto yad yan manovacanakarmabhiḥ paralokaphalaṃ karmānuṣṭhitaṃ tan mayaitad anuṣṭhitam iti paścāt tebhyo nivedayet || 2.236 ||
triṣv eteṣv itikṛtyaṃ hi puruṣasya samāpyate |
eṣa dharmaḥ paraḥ sākṣād upadharmo ‘nya ucyate || 2.237 ||
triṣv iti | itiśabdaḥ kārtsnye | hiśabdo hetau | yasmād eteṣu triṣu śuśrūṣiteṣu puruṣasya sarvaṃ śrautasmārtaṃ kartavyaṃ saṃpūrṇam anuṣṭhitaṃ bhavati, tatphalāvāpteḥ | tasmād eva śreṣṭho dharmaḥ sākṣāt sarvapuruṣārthasādhanaḥ | anyas tv agnihotrādipratiniyatasvargādi-heturūpadharmo jaghanyadharma iti śuśrūṣāstutiḥ || 2.237 ||
śraddadhānaḥ śubhāṃ vidyām ādadītāvarād api |
antyād api paraṃ dharmaṃ strīratnaṃ duṣkulād api || 2.238 ||
śraddadhāna iti | śraddhāyuktaḥ śubhāṃ dṛṣṭaśaktiṃ gāruḍādividyām avarāc chūdrād api gṛhṇīyāt | antyaś cāṇḍālas tasmād api jātismarāder vihitayogaprakarṣāt duṣkṛtaśeṣopabhogārtham avāptacāṇḍālajanmataḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ mokṣopāyam ātmajñānam ādadīta | tathā ajñānam evopakramya mokṣadharme “prāpya jñānaṃ brāhmaṇāt kṣatriyād vaiśyāc chūdrād api nīcād abhīkṣṇaṃ śraddhātavyaṃ śraddadhānena nityam” | na śrāddhinaṃ prati janmamṛtyuviśeṣatā | medhātithis tu “śrutismṛtyapekṣayā paro dharmo laukikaḥ | dharmaśabdo vyavasthāyām api yujyate | yadi cāṇḍālo ‘pi ‘atra pradeśe mā ciraṃ sthā mā cāsminn ambhasi snāsīḥ’ iti vadati tam api dharmam anutiṣthet” [Medh 2.238] |
prāgalbhyāl laukikaṃ vastu paraṃ dharmam iti bruvan |
citraṃ tathāpi sarvatra ślāghyo medhātithiḥ satām ||
strīratnaṃ ātmāpekṣayā nikṛṣṭakulād api pariṇetuṃ svīkuryāt || 2.238 ||
viṣād apy amṛtaṃ grāhyaṃ bālād api subhāṣitam |
amitrād api sadvṛttam amedhyād api kāñcanam || 2.239 ||
viṣād iti | viṣaṃ yady amṛtasaṃyuktaṃ bhavati tadā viṣam apasārya tasmād amṛtaṃ grāhyam, bālād api hitavacanaṃ grāhyam, śatruto ‘pi sajjanavṛttam, amedhyād api suvarṇādikaṃ grahītavyam || 2.239 ||
striyo ratnāny atho vidyā dharmaḥ śaucaṃ subhāṣitam |
vividhāni ca śilpāni samādeyāni sarvataḥ || 2.240 ||
striya iti | atra stryādīnām uktānām api dṛṣṭāntatvenopādānam, yathā stryādayo nikṛṣṭakulādibhyo gṛhyante tathā anyāny api hitāni citralikhanādīni sarvataḥ pratigrahītavyāni
|| 2.240 ||
abrāhmaṇād adhyayanam āpatkāle vidhīyate |
anuvrajyā ca śuśrūṣā yāvad adhyayanaṃ guroḥ || 2.241 ||
abrāhmaṇād iti | brāhmaṇād anyo yo dvijaḥ kṣatriyas tadabhāve vaiśyo vā tasmād adhyayanam āpatkāle brāhmaṇādhyāpakāsaṃbhave brahmacāriṇo vidhīyate | anuvrajyādirūpā guroḥ śuśrūṣā yāvad adhyayanaṃ tāvat kāryā | gurupādaprakṣālanocchiṣṭaprāśanādirūpā śuśrūṣāpraśastā sā na kāryā | tadartham anuvrajyā ceti viśeṣitam | gurutvam api yāvad adhyayanam eva kṣatriyasyāha vyāsaḥ (1.35) |
mantradaḥ kṣatriyo vipraiḥ śuśrūṣānugamādinā |
prāptavidyo brāhmaṇas tu punas tasya guruḥ smṛtaḥ ||
|| 2.241 ||
brahmacāritve naiṣṭhikasyāpy abrāhmaṇād adhyayanaṃ prasaktaṃ pratiṣedhayati –
nābrāhmaṇe guro śiṣyo vāsam ātyantikaṃ vaset |
brāhmaṇe cānanūcāne kāṅkṣan gatim anuttamām || 2.242 ||
nābrāhmaṇa iti | ātyantikaṃ vāsaṃ yāvajjīvikaṃ brahmacaryaṃ kṣatriyādike gurau brāhmaṇe sāṅgavedānadhyetari | anuttamāṃ gatiṃ mokṣalakṣaṇām icchan śiṣyo nāvatiṣṭheta || 2.242 ||
yadi tv ātyantikaṃ vāsaṃ rocayeta guroḥ kule |
yuktaḥ paricared enam ā śarīravimokṣaṇāt || 2.243 ||
yadīti | yadi tu guroḥ kule naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryātmakam ātyantikaṃ vāsam icchet tadā yāvajjīvanam udyukto guruṃ śuśrūṣayet || 2.243 ||
asya phalam āha –
ā samāpteḥ śarīrasya yas tu śuśrūṣate gurum |
sa gacchaty añjasā vipro brahmaṇaḥ sadma śāśvatam || 2.244 ||
ā samāpter iti | sampāptiḥ śarīrasya jīvanatyāgaḥ, tatparyantaṃ yo guruṃ paricarati sa tattvato brahmaṇaḥ sadmarūpam avināśi padaṃ prāpnoti | brahmaṇi līyata ity arthaḥ || 2.244 ||
na pūrvaṃ gurave kiṃcid upakurvīta dharmavit |
snāsyāṃs tu guruṇājñaptaḥ śaktyā gurvartham āharet || 2.245 ||
na pūrvam iti | upakurvāṇasyāyaṃ vidhiḥ, naiṣṭhikasya snānāsaṃbhavāt | gurudakṣiṇādānaṃ dharmajño brahmacārī snānāt pūrvaṃ kiṃcid govastrādi dhanaṃ gurave nāvaśyaṃ dadyāt | yadi tu yadṛcchāto labhate tadā gurave dadyād eva | ata eva snānāt pūrvaṃ gurave dānam āhāpastambaḥ: “yad anyāni dravyāṇi yathālābham upaharati dakṣiṇā eva tāḥ sa eva brahmacāriṇo yajño nityavratam” iti | snāsyan punar guruṇā dattājño yathāśakti dhaninaṃ yācitvāpi pratigrahādināpi gurave ‘rtham āhṛtyāvaśyaṃ dadyāt || 2.245 ||
kiṃ tat tad āha –
kṣetraṃ hiraṇyaṃ gām aśvaṃ chatropānaham āsanam |
dhānyaṃ śākaṃ ca vāsāṃsi gurave prītim āvahet || 2.246 ||
kṣetram iti | “śaktyā gurvartham āharet” (2.245) ity uktatvāt kṣetrahiraṇyādikaṃ yathāsāmārthyaṃ vikalpitaṃ samuditaṃ vā gurave datvā tatprītim arjayet | vikalpapakṣe cāntato ‘nyāsaṃbhave chatropānaham api dadyāt; dvandvanirdeśāt samuditadānam | pradarśanārthaṃ caitat | saṃbhave ‘nyad api dadyāt | ata eva laghuhārītaḥ |
ekam apy akṣaraṃ yas tu guruḥ śiṣye nivedayet |
pṛthivyāṃ nāsti tad dravyaṃ yad datvā cānṛṇī bhavet ||
asaṃbhave śākam api dadyāt || 2.246 ||
ācārye tu khalu prete guruputre guṇānvite |
gurudāre sapiṇḍe vā guruvad vṛttim ācaret || 2.247 ||
ācārya iti | naiṣṭhikasyāyam upadeśaḥ | ācārye mṛte tatsute vidyādiguṇayukte, tadabhāve gurupatnyām, tadabhāve guroḥ sapiṇḍe pitṛvyādau guruvac chuśrūṣām anutiṣthet || 2.247 ||
eteṣv avidyamāneṣu snānāsanavihāravān |
prayuñjāno ‘gniśuśrūṣāṃ sādhayed deham ātmanaḥ || 2.248 ||
eteṣv iti | eteṣu triṣv avidyamāneṣu satatam ācāryasyaivāgneḥ samīpe snānāsanavihāraiḥ sāyaṃprātarādau samiddhomādinā cāgneḥ śuśrūṣāṃ kurvann ātmano deham ātmadehāvacchinnaṃ jīvaṃ brahmaprāptiyogyaṃ sādhayet || 2.249 ||
evaṃ carati yo vipro brahmacaryam aviplutaḥ |
sa gacchaty uttamasthānaṃ na cehājāyate punaḥ || 2.249 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ dvitīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
evaṃ caratīti | “ā samāpteḥ śarīrasya” (2.244) ity anena yāvajjīvam ācāryaśuśrūṣāyā mokṣalakṣaṇaṃ phalam | idānīm ācārye mṛte ‘pi evam ity anenānantaroktavidhinā ācāryaputrādīnām apy agniparyantānāṃ śuśrūṣako yo naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryam akhaṇḍitavrato ‘nutiṣthati sa uttamaṃ sthānaṃ brahmanyātyantikalakṣaṇam prāpnoti | na ceha saṃsāre karmavaśād utpattiṃ labhate || 2.249 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau dvitīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
tṛtīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
pūrvatra “ā samāpteḥ śarīrasya” (2.244) ity anena naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryam uktaṃ na tatrāvadhyapekṣā | “ā samāvartanāt” (2,108) ity anena copakurvāṇakasya sāvadhibrahmacaryam uktam | atas tasyaiva gārhastyādhikāraḥ | tatra kiyadavadhividhau brahmacarye tasya gārhasthyam ity apekṣāyām āha –
ṣaṭtriṃśadābdikaṃ caryaṃ gurau traivedikaṃ vratam |
tadadhikaṃ pādikaṃ vā grahaṇāntikam eva vā || 3.1 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadābdikam iti | trayo vedā ṛgyajuḥsāmākhyās teṣāṃ samāhāras trivedī, tadviṣayaṃ vrataṃ svagṛhyoktaniyamasamūharūpaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadvarṣaṃ yāvad gurukule caritavyam | ṣaṭtriṃśadābdikam iti ṣaṭtriṃśadabdaśabdāt “kālāṭ thañ” (Pāṇ 4.3.11) asmiṃś ca pakṣe “samaṃ syād śrutatvāt” iti nyāyena prativedaśākhaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi vratācaraṇam | tadardhikam aṣṭādaśa varṣāṇi | tatra prativedaśākhaṃ ṣaṭ | pādikaṃ nava varṣāṇi | tatra prativedaśākhaṃ trīṇi | yāvatā kālenoktāvadher ūrdhvam adho vā vedān gṛhṇāti tāvatkālaṃ vā vratācaraṇam | viṣamaśiṣṭatve ‘pi pakṣāṇām ekā deyās trisro deyāḥ ṣaṭ devyā itivan niyamaphale nyūnāpekṣo vikalpaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ “niyamenādhītaṃ vīryavattaraṃ bhavati” iti | grahaṇāntikapakṣasaṃdarśanāt pūrvoktapakṣatraye grahaṇād ūrdhvam api vratānuṣṭhānam avagamyate | atharvavedasyargvedāṃśatve ‘pi “ṛgvedaṃ yajurvedaṃ sāmavedam atharvāṇaṃ caturtham” iti chāndogyopaniṣadi caturthavedatvena kīrtanāt, “aṅgāni vedāś catvāraḥ” iti viṣṇupurāṇādivākyeṣu ca pṛthaṅnirdeśāc caturthavedatve ‘pi prāyeṇābhicārādyarthatvād yajñavidyāyām anupayogāc cānirdeśaḥ | tathā hi “ṛgvedenaiva hautraṃ kurvan yajurvedenādhvaryavaṃ sāmavedenaudgātraṃ yad eva trayyai vidyāyai sūktaṃ tena brahmatvam” iti śrutes trayīsaṃpādyatvaṃ yajñānāṃ jñāyate | ayaṃ ca mānavas traivedikavratacaryāvidhir nātharvavedavratacaryāṃ niṣedhayati | tatparatve vākyabhedaprasaṅgāc chrutyantare vedamātre vrataśravaṇāc ca | yad āha yogiyājñavalkyaḥ (ācāra 2.36) “prativedaṃ brahmacaryaṃ dvādaśābdāni pañca vā” iti || 3.1 ||
vedān adhītya vedau vā vedaṃ vāpi yathākramam |
aviplutabrahmacaryo gṛhasthāśramam āvaset || 3.2 ||
vedān adhītyeti | vedaśabdo ‘yaṃ bhinnavedaśākhāparaḥ | svaśākhādhyayanapūrvaka-vedaśākhātrayaṃ dvayam ekāṃ vā śākhāṃ mantrabrāhmaṇakrameṇādhītya gṛhasthāśramaṃ gṛhasthavihitakarmakalāparūpam anutiṣṭhet | kṛtadāraparigraho gṛhasthaḥ, gṛhaśabdasya dāravacanatvāt | aviplutabrahmacarya iti pūrvavihitastrīsaṃyogamadhumāṃsabhakṣaṇa-varjanarūpabrahmacaryānuvādo ‘yaṃ prakṛṣṭādhyayanāṅgatvakhyāpanārthaḥ | puruṣaśaktyapekṣaś cāyam ekadvitriśākhādhyayanavikalpaḥ | yady api vratāni vedādhyayanaṃ ca nityavad upadiśatā manunobhayasnātaka eva śreṣṭhatvād abhihitas tathāpi smṛtyantarād anyasnātako ‘pi boddhavyaḥ | tad āha hārītaḥ: “trayaḥ snātakā bhavanti – vidyāsnātako vratasnātako vidyāvratasnātakaś ca” iti | yaḥ samāpya vedam asamāpya vratāni samāvartate sa vidyāsnātakaḥ | yaḥ samāpya vratāny asamāpya vedaṃ samāvartate sa vratasnātakaḥ | ubhayaṃ samāpya samāvartate yaḥ sa vidyāvratasnātakaḥ | yājñavalkyo ‘py āha (1.51): “vedaṃ vratāni vā pāraṃ nītvā hy ubhayam eva vā” iti || 3.2 ||
taṃ pratītaṃ svadharmeṇa brahmadāyaharaṃ pituḥ |
sragviṇaṃ talpa āsīnam arhayet prathamaṃ gavā || 3.3 ||
tam iti | taṃ brahmacāridharmānuṣṭhānena khyātam, dīyata iti dāyaḥ brahmaiva dāyo brahmadāyaḥ taṃ haratīti brahmadāyaharam, pituḥ pitṛto gṛhītavedam ity arthaḥ | pitṛto ‘dhyayanaṃ mukhyam uktam, pitur abhāva ācāryāder apy adhītavedaṃ mālayālaṃkṛtam utkṛṣṭaśayanopaviṣtaṃ gosādhanamadhuparkeṇa pitā ācāryo vā vivāhāt prathamaṃ pūjayet
|| 3.3 ||
guruṇānumataḥ snātvā samāvṛtto yathāvidhi |
udvaheta dvijo bhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām || 3.4 ||
guruṇeti | guruṇā dattānujñaḥ svagṛhyoktavidhinā kṛtasnānasamāvartanaḥ samānavarṇāṃ śubhalakṣaṇāṃ kanyāṃ vivahet || 3.4 ||
asapiṇḍā ca yā mātur asagotrā ca yā pituḥ |
sā praśastā dvijātīnāṃ dārakarmaṇi maithune || 3.5 ||
asapiṇḍā ceti | mātur yā sapiṇḍā na bhavati | saptamapuruṣaparyantaṃ sapiṇḍatāṃ vakṣyati (5.60) “sapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe saptame vinivartate” iti | tena mātāmahādivaṃśajā jāyā na bhavatīty arthaḥ | caśabdān mātṛsagotrāpi mātṛvaṃśaparaṃparājanmanāmnoḥ pratyabhijñāne sati na vivāhyā, taditarā tu mātṛsagotrā vivāhyeti saṃgṛhītam | tathā ca vyāsaḥ |
sagotrāṃ matur apy eke necchanty udvāhakarmaṇi |
janmanāmnor avijñāna udvahed aviśaṅkitaḥ ||
yat tu medhātithinā vasiṣṭhanāmnā mātṛsagotrāniṣedhavacanaṃ likhitam —
pariṇīya sagotrāṃ tu samānapravarāṃ tathā |
tasyāṃ kṛtvā samutsargaṃ dvijaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret |
mātulasya sutāṃ caiva mātṛgotrāṃ tathaiva ca ||
iti, tad api mātṛvaṃśajanmanāmaparijñānaviṣayam eva | asagotrā ca yā pitur iti | pitur yā sagotrā na bhavati, cakārāt pitṛsapiṇḍāpi | pitṛvyādisaṃtatibhavā yā na bhavatīy arthaḥ, sā dvijātīnāṃ dāratvasaṃpādake vivāhe praśastā, maithunasādhye agnyādhānakarmaputrotpādanādau ceti || 3.5 ||
mahāny api samṛddhāni gojāvidhanadhānyataḥ |
strīsaṃbandhe daśaitāni kulāni parivarjayet || 3.6 ||
mahānty apīti | utkṛṣṭāny api gavādibhiḥ samṛddhāny api imāni daśa kulāni vivāhe tyajet
|| 3.6 ||
tāni kānīty āha –
hīnakriyaṃ niṣpuruṣaṃ niśchando romaśārśasam |
kṣayyāmayāvyapasmāriśvitrikuṣṭhikulāni ca || 3.7 ||
hīnakriyam iti | jātakarmādikriyārahitam, strījanakam, vedādhyāpanaśūnyam, bahudīrgharomānvitam, arśonāmavyādhiyuktam | kṣayo rājayakṣmā mandānalāpasmāriśvitra-kuṣṭhayuktānāṃ ca kulāni varjayed iti pūrvakriyāsaṃbandhaḥ | dṛṣṭamūlatā cāsya pratiṣedhasya mātulavad utpannā anuvahante | tena hīnakriyādikulāt pariṇītāyāṃ saṃtatir api tādṛśī syāt | vyādhayaḥ “saṃcāriṇaḥ” iti vaidyakāḥ paṭhanti –
sarve saṃkrāmiṇo rogā varjayitvā pravāhikām | iti |
avedamūlā katham iyaṃ pramāṇam iti cen, na, dṛṣṭārthatayaiva prāmāṇyasaṃbhavāt | tad uktaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
sarvā etā vedamūlā dṛṣṭārthāḥ parihṛtya tu |
mīmāṃsābhāṣyakāreṇāpi smṛtyadhikaraṇe ‘bhihitam “ye dṛṣṭārthās te tatpramāṇam, ye tv adṛṣṭārthās teṣu vaidikaśabdānumānam” iti || 3.7 ||
kulāśrayaṃ pratiṣedham abhidhāya kanyāsvarūpāśrayapratiṣedham āha –
nodvahet kapilāṃ kanyāṃ nādhikāṅgīṃ na rogiṇīm |
nālomikāṃ nātilomāṃ na vācālāṃ na piṅgalām || 3.8 ||
nodvahed iti | kapilakeśāṃ nityavyādhitām avidyamānalomāṃ pracuralomāṃ bahuparuṣabhāṣiṇīṃ piṅgalākṣīṃ kanyāṃ nopayacchet || 3.8 ||
narkṣavṛkṣanadīnāmnīṃ nāntyaparvatanāmikām |
na pakṣyahipreṣyanāmnīṃ na ca bhīṣaṇanāmikām || 3.9 ||
neti | ṛkṣaṃ nakṣatraṃ tannāmikām ārdrārevatītyādikām | evaṃ tarunadīmlecchaparvata-pakṣisarpadāsabhayānakanāmikāṃ kanyāṃ nodvahet || 3.9 ||
avyaṅgāṅgīṃ saumyanāmnīṃ haṃsavāraṇagāminīm |
tanulomakeśadaśanāṃ mṛdvaṅgīm udvahet striyam || 3.10 ||
avyaṅgāṅgīm iti | avikalāṅgīṃ madhurasukhodyanāmnīṃ haṃsagajaruciragamanām anatisthūlalomakeśadaśanāṃ komalāṅgīṃ kanyām udvahet || 3.10 ||
atra vidhiniṣedhayor abhidhānam aniṣiddhavihitakanyāpariṇayanam abhyudayārtham iti darśayitum āha –
yasyās tu na bhaved bhrātā na vijñāyet vā pitā |
nopayaccheta tāṃ prājñaḥ putrikādharmaśaṅkayā || 3.11 ||
yasyā iti | yasyāḥ punar bhrātā nāsti tāṃ putrikāśaṅkayā nodvahet |
yad apatyaṃ bhaved asyās tan mama syāt svadhākaram |
ity abhisaṃdhānamātrād api putrikā bhavati, “abhisaṃdhimātrāt putrikety eke” iti gautamasmaraṇāt | yasyā vā viśeṣeṇa pitā na jñāyate ‘neneyam utpanneti tām api nodvahet | atra ca putrikādharmaśaṅkayeti na yojanīyam iti kecit | govindarājas tv āha – “bhinnapitṛkayor apy ekamātṛkayor bhrātṛtvaprasiddheḥ sabhrātṛkatve ‘pi yasyā viśeṣeṇa pitā na jñāyate tām api putrikāśaṅkayaiva nodvahet” iti | medhātithis tv ekam evemaṃ pakṣam āha | yasyās tu bhrātā nāsti tāṃ putrikāśaṅkayā nopayacchet | pitā cen na jñāyate proṣito mṛto vā | vāśabdaś cedarthe | pitari tu vidyamāne tadīyavākyād eva putrikātvābhāvam avagamyābhrātṛkāpi voḍhavyeti | asmākaṃ tu vikalpasvarasād idaṃ pratibhāti – yasyā viśeṣeṇa pitā na jñāyate tām api jārajatvenādharmaśaṅkayā nodvahet | atra ca pakṣe putrikādharmaśaṅkayeti putrikā ca adharmaś ca tayoḥ śaṅkā putrikādharmaśaṅkā, tayeti yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yojanīyam | atra ca prakaraṇe sagotrapariṇayane “sagotrāṃ ced amatyopayacchen mātṛvad enāṃ bibhṛyāt” iti parityāgaśravaṇāt “pariṇīya sagotrāṃ ca” iti prāyaścittaśravaṇāc ca, tatra tatsamabhivyāhṛte ca mātṛsapiṇḍāpariṇayanādau bhāryāśabdasyāhavanīyādivat saṃskāravacanatvāt | yeṣāṃ punar dṛṣṭaguṇadoṣamūlake vidhiniṣedhābhidhāne yathā hīnakriyam iti, na tadatikrame bhāṛyātvābhāvaḥ | ata eva manunā “mahānty api samṛddhāni” (3.3) ityādipṛthakkaraṇaṃ kṛtam | etanmadhyapatitaś ca “narkṣavṛkṣanadīnāmnīm” (3.9) ityādipratiṣedho ‘pi na bhāryātvābhāvaphalakaḥ kiṃ tv atra śāstrātikramāt prāyaścittamātram || 3.11 ||
savarṇāgre dvijātīnāṃ praśastā dārakarmaṇi |
kāmatas tu pravṛttānām imāḥ syuḥ kramaśo varāḥ || 3.12 ||
savarṇāgra iti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ prathame vivāhe kartavye savarṇā śreṣṭhā bhavati | kāmataḥ punar vivāhe pravṛttānām etā vakṣyamāṇā ānulomyena śreṣṭhā bhaveyuḥ || 3.12 ||
śūdraiva bhāryā śūdrasya sā ca svā ca viśaḥ smṛte |
te ca svā caiva rājñaś ca tāś ca svā cāgrajanmanaḥ || 3.13 ||
śūdraiveti | śūdrasya śūdraiva bhāryā bhavati na tūtkṛṣṭā vaiśyādayas tisraḥ | vaiśyasya ca śūdrā vaiśyā ca bhāryā manvādibhiḥ smṛtā | kṣatriyasya vaiśyāśudre kṣatriyā ca | brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrā brāhmaṇī ca | vasiṣṭho ‘pi “śūdrām ‘py eke mantravarjam” iti dvijātīnāṃ mantravarjitaṃ śūdrāvivāham āha || 3.13 ||
na brāhmaṇakṣatriyayor āpady api hi tiṣṭhatoḥ |
kasmiṃścid api vṛttānte śūdrā bhāryopadiśyate || 3.14 ||
na brāhmaṇeti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyayor gārhasthyam icchatoḥ sarvathā savarṇālābhe kasmiṃścid api vṛttānte itihāsākhyāne ‘pi śūdrā bhāryā nābhidhīyate | pūrvasavarṇānukrameṇānulomyena vivāhādyanujñānād ayaṃ niṣedhaḥ prātilomyena vivāhaviṣayo boddhavyaḥ | brāhmaṇakṣatriyagrahaṇaṃ cedaṃ doṣabhūyastvārtham | anantaraṃ “dvijātayaḥ” iti bahuvacanāt vaiśyagocaraniṣedhasyāpi vakṣyamāṇatvāt || 3.14 ||
hīnajātistriyaṃ mohād udvahanto dvijātayaḥ |
kulāny eva nayanty āśu sasaṃtānāni śūdratām || 3.15 ||
hīnajātistriyam iti | savarṇām api pariṇīya hīnajātiṃ śūdrāṃ śāstrāvivekāt pariṇayanto brahmakṣatriyavaiśyās tatrotpannaputrapautrādikrameṇa kulāny eva sasaṃtatikāni śūdratāṃ gamayanti | atra “dvijātayaḥ” iti bahuvacananirdeśān nindayā vaiśyasyāpi niṣedhaḥ kalpyate | brāhmaṇakṣatriyayos tu pūrvatraiva niṣedhakalpanāt tannindāmātrārthataiva || 3.15 ||
śūdrāvedī pataty atrer utathyatanayasya ca |
śaunakasya sutotpattyā tadapatyatayā bhṛgoḥ || 3.16 ||
śūdrāvedīti | śūdrāṃ vindati pariṇayatīti śūdrāvedī, sa patati patita iva bhavati | idam atrer matam utathyatanayasya gautamasya ca | atryādigrahaṇam ādarārtham | etad brāhmaṇaviṣayam | “śūdrāyāṃ sutotpattyā patati” iti śaunakasya matam etat kṣatriyaviṣayam | “śūdrāsutotpattyā patati” iti bhṛgor matam etad vaiśyaviṣayam | etasya maharṣimatatrayasya vyavasthāsaṃbhave visadṛśapatanavikalpayogāt | medhātithi-govindarājayos tu mataṃ śūdrāvedī patatīti pūrvoktaśūdrāvivāhaniṣedhaviśeṣaḥ sutotpattyā patatīti daivāj jātaśūdrāvivāhe “ṛtau nopeyāt” iti vidhānārtham, ṛtukālagamane sutotpatteḥ | tadapatyatayeti tu tāny eva śūdrotpannāny apatyāni yasya sa tadapatyas tasya bhāvas tadapatyatā tayā patati | etenedam uktaṃ bhavati — ṛtāv upayann itarāsu jātāpatya upeyāt || 3.16 ||
śūdrāṃ śayanam āropya brāhmaṇo yāty adhogatim |
janayitvā sutaṃ tasyāṃ brāhmaṇyād eva hīyate || 3.17 ||
śūdrām iti | savarṇām apariṇīya daivāt snehād vā śūdrāpariṇetur brāhmaṇasya śayananiṣedho ‘yaṃ nindayā niṣedhasmṛtyanumānāc chūdrāṃ gatvā brāhmaṇo narakaṃ gacchati | “janayitvā sutaṃ tasyām” ity ṛtukālagamananiṣedhaparam | brāhmaṇyād eva hīyata iti doṣabhūyastvārtham || 3.17 ||
daivapitryātitheyāni tatpradhānāni yasya tu |
nāśnanti pitṛdevās tan na svargaṃ sa gacchati || 3.18 ||
daiveti | yadi kathaṃcit savarṇānukrameṇākrameṇa vā śūdrāpi pariṇīyate tadā bhāryātvena prasaktāni tatkartṛkāni daivety anena niṣidhyante | daivaṃ homādi, pitryaṃ śrāddhādi, ātitheyam atithibhojanādi, etāni yasya śūdrāsaṃpādyāni tad dhavyaṃ kavyaṃ pitṛdevā nāśnanti | na ca tenātithyena sa gṛhī svargaṃ yāti | “yas tu tat kārayen mohāt sajātyā shitayānyayā” (9.87) iti savarṇānāṃ saṃnihitāyāṃ niṣedhaṃ vakṣyati | ayaṃ tv asaṃnihitāyām apīty apunaruktiḥ || 3.18 ||
vṛṣalīphenapītasya niḥśvāsopahatasya ca |
tasyāṃ caiva prasūtasya niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate || 3.19 ||
vṣalīti | vṛṣalīpheno ‘dhararasaḥ, sa pīto yena sa vṛṣalīphenapītaḥ | “vāhitāgnyādiṣu” (Pāṇ 2.2.37) ity anena samāsaḥ | anena śūdrāyā adhararasapānaṃ niṣidhyate | niḥśvāsopahatasya ca iti tayā sahaikaśayyādau śayananiṣedhaḥ | tasyāṃ jātāpatyasya śuddhir nopadiśyata ity ṛtukālagamananiṣedhānuvādaḥ || 3.19 ||
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ pretya ceha hitāhitān |
aṣṭāv imān samāsena strīvivāhān nibodhata || 3.20 ||
caturṇām iti | caturṇām api varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ paraloke ihaloke ca kāṃścid dhitān kāṃścid ahitān imān abhidhāsyamānān aṣṭau saṃkṣepeṇa bhāryāprāptihetūn vivāhān śṛṇuta
|| 3.20 ||
brāhmo daivas tathaivārṣaḥ prājāpatyas tathāsuraḥ |
gāndharvo rākṣasaś caiva paiśācaś cāṣṭamo ‘dhamaḥ || 3.21 ||
brāhma iti | ta ete nāmato nirdiśyante | brāhmarākṣasādisaṃjñā ceyaṃ śāstrasaṃvyavahārārthā stutinindāpradarśanārthā ca | brahmaṇa ivāyaṃ brāhmaḥ | rakṣasa ivāyaṃ rākṣasaḥ | na tu brahmādidevatātvaṃ vivāhānāṃ saṃbhavati | paiśācasyādhamatvābhidhānaṃ nindātiśayārtham
|| 3.21 ||
yo yasya dharmyo varṇasya guṇadoṣau ca yasya yau |
tad vaḥ sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi prasave ca guṇāguṇān || 3.22 ||
ya iti | dhārmād anapeto dharmyaḥ | yo vivāho dharmyo yasya vivāhasya yau guṇadoṣau iṣṭāniṣṭaphale tat tad vivāhotpannāpatyeṣu ye guṇāguṇās tat sarvaṃ yuṣmākaṃ prakarṣeṇābhidhāsyāmi | vakṣyamāṇānukīrtanam idaṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ sukhagrahaṇārtham || 3.22 ||
ṣaḍ ānupūrvyā viprasya kṣatrasya caturo ‘varān |
viṭśūdrayos tu tān eva vidyād dharmyān arākṣasān || 3.23 ||
ṣaḍ iti | brāhmaṇasya brāhmādikrameṇa ṣaṭ | kṣatriyasyāvarān uparitanān āsurādīṃś caturaḥ | viṭśūdrayos tu tān eva rākṣasavarjitān āsuragāndharvapaiśācān dharmyān dharmād anapetāñ jānīyāt || 3.23 ||
caturo brāhmaṇasyādyān praśastān kavayo viduḥ |
rākṣasaṃ kṣatriyasyaikam āsuraṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ || 3.24 ||
catura iti | brāhmaṇasya prathamaṃ paṭhitān brāhmādīṃś caturaḥ | kṣatriyasya rākṣasam ekam eva | vaiśyaśūdrayor āsuram | etāñ chreṣṭān jñātāro jānanti | ata eva brāhmaṇādiṣv āsurādīnāṃ pūrvavihitānām apy atrāpy upādānaṃ jaghanyatvajñāpanārtham | tena praśastavivāhāsaṃbhave jaghanyasyāpi parigraha iti darśitam | evam uttaratrāpi vigarhitaparityāgo boddhavyaḥ || 3.24 ||
pañcānāṃ tu trayo dharmyā dvāv adharmyau smṛtāv iha |
paiśācaś cāsuraś caiva na kartavyau kadācana || 3.25 ||
pañcānām iti | iha paiśācapratiṣedhād uparitanānāṃ pañcānāṃ prājāpatyādīnāṃ grahaṇam, teṣu madhye prājāpatya-gāndharva-rākṣasās trayo dharmād anapetāḥ, tatra prājāpatyaḥ kṣatriyādīnām aprāpto vidhīyate | brāhmaṇasya vihitatvād anūdyate | gāndharvasya ca caturṇām eva prāptatvād anuvādaḥ | rākṣaso ‘pi vaiśyaśūdrayor vidhīyate | brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyavṛttyavasthitasyāpy āsurapaiśācau na kartavyau | kadācanety aviśeṣāc caturṇām eva niṣidhyate | atra yaṃ varṇaṃ prati yasya vivāhasya vidhiniṣedhau tasya taṃ prati vikalpaḥ, sa ca vihitāsaṃbhave boddhavyaḥ
|| 3.25 ||
pṛthak pṛthag vā miśrau vā vivāhau pūrvacoditau |
gāndarvo rākṣasaś caiva dharmyau kṣatrasya tau smṛtau || 3.26 ||
pṛghag iti | pṛthak pṛthag iti prāptatvād anūdyate | miśrāv iti vidhīyate | pṛthak pṛthag vimiśrau vā pūrvavihitau gāndharvarākṣasau kṣatrasya dharmyau manvādibhiḥ smṛtau | yadā strīpuṃsayor anyonyānurāgapūrvakasaṃvādena pariṇetā yuddhādinā vijitya tām udvahet tadā gāndharvarākṣasau miśrau bhavataḥ || 3.26 ||
ācchādya cārcayitvā ca śrutiśīlavate svayam |
āhūya dānaṃ kanyāyā brāhmo dharmaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 3.27 ||
ācchādeyeti | ācchādanamātrasyaivaucityaprāptatvāt saviśeṣavāsasā kanyāvarāv ācchādyālaṃkārādinā ca pūjayitvā vidyācāravantam aprārthakavaram ānīya tasmai kanyādānaṃ brāhmo vivāho manvādibhir uktaḥ || 3.27 ||
yajñe tu vitate samyag ṛtvije karma kurvate |
alaṃkṛtya sutādānaṃ daivaṃ dharmaṃ pracakṣate || 3.28 ||
yajña iti | jyotiṣṭomādiyajñe prārabdhe yathāvidhi ṛtvije karmakartre alaṃkṛtya kanyādānaṃ daivaṃ vivāhaṃ munayo bruvate || 3.28 ||
ekaṃ gomithunaṃ dve vā varād ādāya dharmataḥ |
kanyāpradānaṃ vidhivad ārṣo dharmaḥ sa ucyate || 3.29 ||
ekam iti | strīgavī puṃgauś ca gomithunam; tad ekaṃ dve vā varād dharmato dharmārthaṃ yāgādisiddhaye kanyāyai vā dātuṃ na tu śuklabuddhyā gṛhītvā yad yathāśāstraṃ kanyādānaṃ sa ārṣo vivāho vidhīyate || 3.29 ||
sahobhau caratāṃ dharmam iti vācānubhāṣya ca |
kanyāpradānam abhyarcya prājāpatyo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 3.30 ||
saheti | saha yuvāṃ dharmaṃ kuru tam iti sutāpradānakāle vacasā pūrvaṃ niyamyārcayitvā yat kanyādānaṃ sa prājāpatyo vivāhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 3.30 ||
jñātibhyo draviṇaṃ datvā kanyāyai caiva śaktitaḥ |
kanyāpradānaṃ svācchandyād āsuro dharma ucyate || 3.31 ||
jñātibhya iti | kanyāyā jñātibhyaḥ pitrādibhyaḥ kanyāyai yad yathāśakti dhanaṃ datvā kanyāyā āpradānam ādānaṃ svīkāraḥ svācchandyāt svecchayā na tv ārṣa iva śāstrīyadhanajātiparimāṇaniyamena sa āsuro vivāha ucyate || 3.31 ||
icchayānyonyasaṃyogaḥ kanyāyāś ca varasya ca |
gāndharvaḥ sa tu vijñeyo maithunyaḥ kāmasaṃbhavaḥ || 3.32 ||
icchayeti | kanyāyā varasya cānyonyānurāgeṇa yaḥ parasparasaṃyoga āliṅganādirūpaḥ sa gāndharvo jñātavyaḥ | saṃbhavaty asmād iti saṃbhavaḥ | yasmāt kanyāvarayor abhilāṣādau saṃbhavati | ata eva maithunyo maithunāya hitaḥ, sarvavivāhānām eva maithunyatvena yad asya maithunyatvābhidhānaṃ tat saty api maithune na virodha iti pradarśanārtham || 3.32 ||
hatvā chittvā ca bhittvā ca krośantīṃ rudatīṃ gṛhāt |
prasahya kanyāharaṇaṃ rākṣaso vidhir ucyate || 3.33 ||
hatveti | prasahya balātkāreṇa kanyāyā haraṇaṃ rākṣaso vivāha ity eva lakṣaṇam | yadā tu hartuḥ śaktyatiśayaṃ jñātvā pitrādibhir upekṣyate tadā nāvaśyakaṃ hananādi | yadi kanyāpakṣaḥ pratipakṣatāṃ yāti tadā hananādikam api kartavyam ity arthaprāptam anūdyate | kanyāpakṣān vināśya teṣām aṅgacchedaṃ kṛtvā prākārādīn bhittvā “hā pitar bhrātar anāthāhaṃ hriye” iti vadantīm aśrūṇi muñcantīṃ yat kanyāṃ gṛhād apaharati | anena kanyāyām anicchoktā gāndharvād vivekārtham || 3.33 ||
suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vā raho yatropagacchati |
sa pāpiṣṭho vivāhānāṃ paiśācaḥ prathito ‘dhamaḥ || 3.34 ||
suptām iti | nidrābhibhūtāṃ madyamadavihvalāṃ śīlasaṃrakṣaṇena rahitāṃ vijanadeśe yatra vivāhe maithunadharmeṇa pravartate sa pāpahetur vivāhānāṃ madhye ‘dhamaḥ paiśācaḥ khyātaḥ || 3.34 ||
adbhir eva dvijāgryāṇāṃ kanyādānaṃ viśiṣyate |
itareṣāṃ tu varṇānām itaretarakāmyayā || 3.35 ||
adbhir iti | udakadānapūrvakam eva brāhmaṇānāṃ kanyādānaṃ praśastam | kṣatriyādīnāṃ punar vināpy udakaṃ parasparecchayā vāṅmātreṇāpi kanyādānaṃ bhavati | udakapūrvakam apīty aniyamaḥ || 3.35 ||
yo yasaiṣāṃ vivāhānāṃ manunā kīrtito guṇaḥ |
sarvaṃ śṛṇuta taṃ viprāḥ samyak kīrtayato mama || 3.36 ||
ya iti | yady api “guṇadoṣau ca yasya yau” (3.22) iti guṇābhidhānam api pratijñātam eva tathāpi bahūnām arthānāṃ tatra vaktavyatayā pratijñātatvād viśeṣajñāpanārthaḥ punar upanyāsaḥ | eṣāṃ vivāhānām iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | eṣāṃ madhye yasya vivāhasya yo guṇo manunā kathitas tat sarvaṃ he viprāḥ mama kathayataḥ śṛṇuta || 3.36 ||
daśa pūrvān parān vaṃśyān ātmānaṃ caikaviṃśakam |
brāhmīputraḥ sukṛtakṛn mocayaty enasaḥ pitṝn || 3.37 ||
daśeti | daśa pūrvān pitrādīn vaṃśyān, parān putrādīn daśa, ātmānaṃ caikaviṃsakaṃ brāhmaṇavivāhoḍhāputro yadi sukṛtakṛd bhavati tadā pāpān mocayati | pitrādīn narakād uddharati, putrādayaś ca tasyakule niṣpāpā jāyanta iti mocanārthaḥ | teṣām anutpatteḥ pāpadhvaṃsasyāśakyatvāt || 3.37 ||
daivoḍhājaḥ sutaś caiva sapta sapta parāvarān |
ārṣoḍhājaḥ sutas trīṃs trīn ṣaṭ ṣaṭ kāyoḍhajaḥ sutaḥ || 3.38 ||
daivoḍheti | daivavivāhoḍhāyāḥ putraḥ sapta parān pitrādīn saptāvarān putrādīṃś ca | ārṣavivāhoḍhāyāḥ putras trīn pitrādīṃs trīṃś ca putrādīn | prājāpatyavivāhoḍhāyāḥ putraḥ ṣaṭ pitrādīn ṣaṭ putrādīn ātmānaṃ cainaso mocayatīti pūrvasyaiva sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ | kāyoḍhaja iti “ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñāchandasor bahulam” (Pāṇ 6.3.63) iti hrasvatvam | brāhmādyaṣṭavivāhoddeśakramānusāreṇa mandaphalasyārṣasyeha bahuphalaprājāpatyāt pūrvābhidhānam | brāhmādivivāhoddeśaśloka eva katham ayaṃ krama iti cet, “pañcānāṃ tu trayo dharmyāḥ” (3.25) ity atra prājāpatyagrahaṇārtham | anyathā tv ārṣasyaiva grahaṇaṃ syāt
|| 3.38 ||
prasave ca guṇāguṇān iti yad uktaṃ tad ucyate –
brāhmādiṣu vivāheṣu caturṣv evānupūrvaśaḥ |
brahmavarcasinaḥ putrā jāyante śiṣṭasaṃmatāḥ || 3.39 ||
brāhmeti | brāhmādiṣu caturṣu vivāheṣu kramāvasthiteṣu śrutādhyayanasaṃpattikatejoyuktāḥ putrāḥ śiṣṭapriyā jāyante | priyārthatvāc ca saṃmataśabdasya “ktena ca pūjāyām” (Pāṇ 2.2.12) iti na ṣaṣṭhīsamāsapratiṣedhaḥ | saṃbandhasāmānyaviṣayā ṣaṣṭhīyaṃ samasyate || 3.39 ||
rūpasattvaguṇopetā dhanavanto yaśasvinaḥ |
paryāptabhogā dharmiṣṭhā jīvanti ca śataṃ samāḥ || 3.40 ||
rūpeti | rūpaṃ manoharākṛtiḥ, sattvaṃ dvādaśādhyāye vakṣyamāṇam, guṇā dayādayaḥ, tair yuktāḥ dhaninaḥ khyātimanto yathepsitavastrasraggandhalepanādibhogaśālino dhārmikāś ca putrā jāyanta iti pūrvam anuvartate | śataṃ ca varṣāṇi jīvanti || 3.40 ||
itareṣu tu śiṣṭeṣu nṛśaṃsānṛtavādinaḥ |
jāyante durvivāheṣu brahmadharmadviṣaḥ sutāḥ || 3.41 ||
itareṣv iti | brāhmādibhyaś caturbhyo ‘nyeṣv āsurādiṣu caturṣu vivāheṣu krūrakarmāṇo mṛṣāvādino vedadveṣiṇo yāgādidharmadveṣiṇaḥ putrā jāyante || 3.41 ||
aninditaiḥ strīvivāhair anindyā bhavati prajā |
ninditair ninditā nṝṇāṃ tasmān nindyān vivarjayet || 3.42 ||
aninditair iti | saṃkṣepeṇa vivāhānāṃ phalakathanam idam | agarhitair bhāryāprāptihetubhir vivāhair agarhitā manuṣyāṇāṃ saṃtatir bhavati | garhitais tu garhitā | tasmād garhitavivāhān na kuryāt || 3.42 ||
pāṇigrahaṇasaṃskāraḥ savarṇāsūpadiśyate |
asavarṇāsv ayaṃ jñeyo vidhir udvāhakarmaṇi || 3.43 ||
pāṇīti | samānajātīyāsu gṛhyamāṇāsu hastagrahaṇalakṣaṇaḥ saṃskāro gṛhyādiśāstreṇa vidhīyate | vijātīyāsu punar ūhyamānāsu vivādakarmaṇi pāṇigrahaṇasthāne yam anantaraśloke vakṣyamāṇo vidhir jñeyaḥ || 3.43 |||
śaraḥ kṣatriyayā grāhyaḥ pratodo vaiśyakanyayā |
vasanasya daś grāhyā śūdrayotkṛṣṭavedane || 3.44 ||
śara iti | kṣatriyayā pāṇigrahaṇasthāne brāhmaṇavivāhe brāhmaṇahastaparigṛhītakāṇḍaikadeśo grāhyaḥ | vaiśyayā brāhmaṇakṣatriyavivāhe brāhmaṇakṣatriyāvadhṛtapratodaikadeśo grāhyaḥ | śūdrayā punar dvijātitrayavivāhe prāvṛtavasanadaśā grāhyā || 3.44 ||
ṛtukālābhigāmī syāt svadāranirataḥ sadā |
parvavarjaṃ vrajec caināṃ tadvrato ratikāmyayā || 3.45 ||
ṛtv iti | ṛtur nāma śoṇitadarśanopalakṣito garbhadāraṇayogyaḥ strīṇām avasthāviśeṣaḥ | tatkālābhigāmī syād ity ayaṃ viyamavidhiḥ na tu parisaṃkhyā, svārthahāniparārtha-kalpanāprāptabādhātmakadoṣatrayaduṣṭatvāt | ṛtukāle ‘pi rāgataḥ pakṣe gamanaprāptau yasmin pakṣe ‘prāptis tatra vidhiḥ “same jayeta” itivat | ata eva ṛtāv agamane doṣam āha parāśaraḥ |
ṛtusnātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ saṃnidhau nopagacchati |
ghorāyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ patate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
anutpannaputrasya cāyaṃ niyamaḥ: “brāhmaṇo ha vai jāyamānas tribhir ṛṇair ṛṇavā jāyate yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ svādhyāyenarṣibhyaḥ” ity etat pratyakṣaśrutimūlatve ‘sya saṃbhavati mūlāntarakalpanasyāyuktatvāt | “tasmād yugmāsu putrārthī saṃviśed ārtave striyam” (3.48) iti ca vakṣyati | tato ‘py etacchrutimūltvam avagamyate | putrotpādanaśāstrasya caikaputrotpādanenaiva caritārthatvāt “kāmajān itarān viduḥ” (9.107) iti darśanād ajātaputrasyaiva niyamaḥ | “daśāsyāṃ putrān ādhehi” iti mantras tu bahuputrapraśaṃsāparaḥ | jātaputrasyāpy ṛtukālagamananiyamo na daśasv evāvatiṣṭhate | svadāranirataḥ sadeti “nityaṃ svadārasaṃtuṣṭaḥ syān nānyabhāryām upagacched” iti vidhānāt parisaṃkhyaiva | vākyānarthakyāt svadāragamanasya praśastatvāt | ṛtāv agamane doṣaśravaṇāc ca niyamavidhiḥ: “parvavarjaṃ vrajec cainām” iti | parvāṇy amāvāsyādīni vakṣyante | tāni varjayitvā bhāryāprītivrataṃ yasya sa tadvrato ‘nṛtāv apy upeyāt | ata eva ratikāmyayā na tu putrotpādanaśāstrabuddhyā | tasmād vidhitrayam idam – ṛtāv upeyād eva, anyabhāryāṃ nopagacchet, anṛtāv api bhāryāprītaye gacched iti | atra ca gautamaḥ: “ṛtāv upeyād anṛtau ca parvavarjam” (GDh 5.1) | yājñavalkyo ‘py āha (1.81):
yathākāmī bhaved vāpi strīṇāṃ varam anusmaran |
parvavarjam iti ṛtāv anṛtau cobhayatra saṃbadhyate || 3.45 ||
ṛtuḥ svābhāvikaḥ strīṇāṃ rātrayaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ |
caturbhir itaraiḥ sārdham ahobhiḥ sadvigarhitaiḥ || 3.46 ||
ṛtur iti | atra rātryahaḥśabdāv ahorātraparau | śoṇitadarśanāt prabhṛti strīsaṃparkagamanādau śiṣṭaninditaiś caturbhir anyair ahorātraiḥ saha ṣoḍaśāhorātrāṇi māsi māsi strīṇām ṛtuḥ | svabhāve bhavaḥ svābhāvikaḥ | vyādhyādinā tu nyūnādhikakālo ‘pi bhavati || 3.46 ||
tāsām ādyāś catasras tu ninditaikādaśī ca yā |
trayodaśī ca śeṣās tu praśastā daśa rātrayaḥ || 3.47 ||
tāsām iti | tāsāṃ punaḥ ṣoḍaśānāṃ rātrīṇāṃ śoṇitadarśanāt prabhṛti ādyāś catasro rātraya ekādaśī trayodaśī ca rātrir gamane ninditā | avaśiṣṭā daśa rātrayaḥ praśastā bhaveyuḥ || 3.47 ||
yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyo ‘yugmāsu rātriṣu |
tasmād yugmāsu putrārthī saṃviśed ārtave striyam || 3.48 ||
yugmāsv iti | pūrvoktāsv api daśasu ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamyādyāsu rātriṣu gamane putrā utpadyante | ayugmāsu pañcamīsaptamyādiṣu duhitaraḥ | ataḥ putrārthī yugmāsu ṛtukāle bhāryāṃ gacchet
|| 3.48 ||
pumān puṃso ‘dhike śukre strī bhavaty adhike striyāḥ |
same ‘pumān puṃstriyau vā kṣīṇe ‘lpe ca viparyayaḥ || 3.49 ||
pumān iti | puṃso bīje ‘dhike ‘yugmāsv api putro jāyate | strībīje ‘dhike yugmāsv api duhitaiva | ato vṛṣyāhārādinā nijabījādhikyaṃ bhāryāyāś cāhāralāghavādinā bījālpatvam avagamya yugmāsv api putrārthinā gantavyam iti darśitam | strīpuṃsayos tu bījasāmye ‘pumān napuṃsakaṃ jāyate | puṃstriyāv iti yamau ca | niḥsāre ‘lpe cobhayor eva bīje garbhasyāsaṃbhavaḥ || 3.49 ||
nindyāsv aṣṭāsu cānyāsu striyo rātriṣu varjayan |
brahmacāry eva bhavati yatra tatrāśrame vasan || 3.50 ||
nindyeti | nindyāsu pūrvoktāsu ṣaṭsu rātriṣu anyāsu ca nindyāsv api yāsu kāsucid aṣṭāsu striyo varjayan dve rātrī avaśiṣṭe parvavarjite vrajann akhaṇḍitabrahmacāry eva bhavati | yatra tatrāśrame vasann iti vānaprasthāpekṣayā | tasya hi bhāryayā saha gamanapakṣe ṛtugamanaṃ prasaktam | na ca vanasthabhāryāyā | ṛtur na bhavatīti vācyam | “vanaṃ pañcāśato vrajet” iti, “varṣair ekaguṇāṃ bhāryām udvahed dviguṇaḥ pumān” ityādiśāstraparyālocanayā tatsaṃbhavāt | medhātithis tu “yatra tatrāśrame vasann ity anuvādamātram | gṛhasthetarāśramatraye jitendriyatvavidhānād rātridvayābhyanujñānāsaṃbhavāt” ity āha | govindarājas tu “utpannavinaṣṭaputrasyāśramāntarasthasyāpīcchayā putrārthaṃ rātridvayagamane doṣābhāvapratipādanārtham etat | yatra tatrāśrame vasann iti vacanāt putrārthī saṃviśed iti ca prastutatvāt putrasya mahopakārakatvāt” ity āha |
hanta govindarājena viśeṣam avivṛṇvatā |
vvyaktam aṅgīkṛtam ṛtau svadārasurataṃ yateḥ ||
|| 3.50 ||
na kanyāyāḥ pitā vidvān gṛhṇīyāc chulkam aṇv api |
gṛhṇañ chulkaṃ hi lobhena syān naro ‘patyavikrayī || 3.51 ||
neti | kanyāyāḥ pitā dhanagrahaṇadoṣajño ‘lpam api dhanaṃ kanyādānanimittakaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt yasmāl lobhena tad gṛhṇann apatyavikrayī bhavati || 3.51 ||
strīdhanāni tu ye mohād upajīvanti bāndhavāḥ |
nārī yānāni vastraṃ vā te pāpā yānty adhogatim || 3.52 ||
strīdhanānīti | kanyādānanimittakaśulkagrahaṇaniṣedhaprasaṅgān navamādhyāyādheya-strīdhanagrahaṇaniṣedho ‘yam | ye bāndhavāḥ patipitrādayaḥ kalatraduhitrādidhanāni gṛhṇanti; nārī strī, yānāny aśvādīni, vastraṃ ceti pradarśanārtham | sarvam eva dhanaṃ na grāhyam | te gṛhṇānāḥ pāpakāriṇo narakaṃ gacchanti || 3.52 ||
ārṣe gomithunaṃ śulkaṃ kecid āhur mṛṣaiva tat |
alpo ‘py evaṃ mahān vāpi vikrayas tāvad eva saḥ || 3.53 ||
ārṣa iti | ārṣe vivāhe gomithunaṃ śulkaṃ varād grāhyam iti kecid ācāryā vadanti, tat punar asatyam | yasmād alpamūlyasādhyatvād alpo vā bhavatu, bahumūlyasādhyatvān mahān vā bhavatu, sa tāvad vikrayo bhavaty eva | yat punaḥ “ekaṃ gomithunam” (3.29) iti pūrvam uktaṃ tat paramatam iti govindarājas, tad ayuktam | manumate lakṣaṇam ārṣasya na syād eva | varād gomithunagrahaṇapūrvakakanyādānasyaivārṣavivāhalakṣaṇatvāt | manvabhimatam anyad evārṣalakṣaṇam anyad evārṣalakṣaṇam, ekaṃ gomithunam iti paramatam iti cet –
ekaṃ gomithunaṃ dve cety etat paramataṃ yadi |
tadā manumatenārṣalakṣaṇaṃ kiṃ tad ucyatām ||
aṣṭau vivāhān kathayann ārṣoḍhāsaṃtater guṇān |
manuḥ kiṃ svamatenārṣalakṣaṇaṃ vaktum akṣamaḥ ||
medhātithis tu pūrvāparavirodhopanyāsanirāsam eva na kṛtavān | tasmād asmābhir itthaṃ vyākhyāyate – ārṣe vivāhe gomithunaṃ śulkam utkocarūpam iti kecid ācāryā vadanti | manos tu mataṃ nedam, śāstraniyamitajātisaṃkhyākaṃ grahaṇaṃ na śulkarūpam | śulkatve mūlyālpatvamahattve anupayoginī vikraya eva tadā syāt | kiṃ tv ārṣavivāhasaṃpattyai avaśyakartavyayāgādisiddhaye kanyāyai vā dātuṃ śāstrīyaṃ dharmārtham eva gṛhyate | ata evārṣalakṣaṇaśloke “varād ādāya dharmataḥ” (3.29) iti dharmato dharmārtham iti tasyārthaḥ | bhogalobhena tu dhanagrahaṇaṃ śulkarūpam aśāstrīyam | ata eva “gṛhṇan śulkaṃ hi lobhena” (3.51) iti nindām uktavān | tasmāt paurvāparyaparyālocanād ārṣe dharmārthaṃ gomithunaṃ grāhyaṃ na tu bhogārtham iti manunā svamatam anuvarṇitam || 3.53 ||
“ārṣe gomithunaṃ śulkam” (3.53) ity uktam, idānīṃ kanyārtham api dhanasya dānaṃ na śulkam ity āha –
yāsāṃ nādadate śulkaṃ jñātayo na sa vikrayaḥ |
arhaṇaṃ tat kumārīṇām ānṛśaṃsyaṃ ca kevalam || 3.54 ||
yāsām iti | yāsāṃ kanyānāṃ prītyā vareṇa dīyamānaṃ dhanaṃ pitrādayo na gṛhṇanti kiṃ tu kanyāyai samarpayanti so ‘pi na vikrayaḥ, yasmāt kumārīṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tad ānṛśaṃsyam ahiṃsakatvaṃ kevalaṃ tad anukampārūpam || 3.54 ||
pitṛbhir bhātṛbhiś caitāḥ patibhir devarais tathā |
pūjyā bhūṣayitavyāś ca bahukalyāṇam īpsubhiḥ || 3.55 ||
pitṛbhir iti | na kevalaṃ vivāhakāle vareṇa dattaṃ dhanaṃ samarpaṇīyam, kiṃ tu taduttarakālam api pitrādibhir apy etā bhojanādinā pūjayitavyāḥ vastrālaṃkārādinā bhūṣayitavyāś ca; bahudhanādisaṃpadaṃ prāptukāmaiḥ || 3.55 ||
yatra nāryas tu pūjyante ramante tatra devatāḥ |
yatraitās tu pūjyante sarvās tatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ || 3.56 ||
yatreti | yatra kule pitrādibhiḥ striyaḥ pūjyante tatra devatāḥ prasīdanti | yatra punar etā na pūjyante tatra devatāprasādābhāvād yāgādikriyāḥ sarvā niṣphalā bhavantīti nindārthavādaḥ
|| 3.56 ||
śocanti jāmayo yatra vinaśyaty āśu tat kulam |
na śocanti tu yatraitā vardhate tad dhi sarvadā || 3.57 ||
śocantīti | “jāmiḥ svasṛkulastriyoḥ” (Amarakośa 3.3.645) ity ābhidhānikāḥ | yasmin kule bhaginīgṛhapatisaṃvardhanīyasaṃnihitasapiṇḍastriyaś ca patnīduhitṛsnuṣādyāḥ paritāpādinā duḥkhinyo bhavanti tat kulaṃ śīghraṃ nirdhanībhavati daivarājādinā ca pīḍyate | yatraitā na śocanti tad dhanādinā nityaṃ vṛddhim eti | medhātithi-govindarājau tu “navoḍhāduhitṛsnuṣādyā jāmayaḥ” ity āhatuḥ || 3.57 ||
jāmayo yāni gehāni śapanty apratipūjitāḥ |
tāni kṛtyāhatānīva vinaśyanti samantataḥ || 3.58 ||
jāmaya iti | yāni gehāni bhaginīpatnīduhitṛsnuṣādyā apūjitāḥ satyo ‘bhiśapanti “idam aniṣṭam eṣāṃ astu” iti tāny abhicārahatāni dhanapaśvādisahitāni naśyanti || 3.58 ||
tasmād etāḥ sadā pūjyā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ |
bhūtikāmair narair nityaṃ satkāreṣūtsaveṣu ca || 3.59 ||
tasmād iti | yasmād evaṃ tasmāt kāraṇād etā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanair nityaṃ satkāreṣu kaumudyādiṣu, utsaveṣūpanayanādiṣu samṛddhikāmair nṛbhiḥ sadā pūjanīyāḥ || 3.59 ||
saṃtuṣṭo bhāryayā bhartā bhartrā bhāryā tathaiva ca |
yasminn eva kule nityaṃ kalyāṇaṃ tatra vai dhruvam || 3.60 ||
saṃtuṣṭa iti | bhāryayā bhartā iti hetau tṛtīyā | yatra kule bhāryayā bhartā prīto bhavati stryantarābhilāṣādikaṃ na karoti, bhāryā ca svāminā prītā bhavati tasmin kule ciraṃ śreyo bhavati | kulagrahaṇān na kevalaṃ bhāryāpatī eva, putrapautrādisaṃtatiḥ śreyobhāginī bhavati
|| 3.60 ||
yadi hi strī na roceta pumāṃsaṃ na pramodayet |
apramodāt punaḥ puṃsaḥ prajanaṃ na pravartate || 3.61 ||
yadīti | dīptyartho ‘tra ruciḥ | yadi strī vastrābharaṇādinā śobhājanakena dīptimatī na syāt tadā svāminaṃ punar na harṣayed eva | hiśabdo ‘vadhāraṇe | apraharṣāt punaḥ svāminaḥ prajanaṃ garbhadhāraṇaṃ na saṃpadyate || 3.61 ||
striyāṃ tu rocamānāyāṃ sarvaṃ tad rocate kulam |
tasyāṃ tv arocamānāyāṃ sarvam eva na rocate || 3.62 ||
striyām iti | striyāṃ maṇḍanādinā kāntimatyāṃ bhartṛsnehaviṣayatayā parapuruṣasaṃparkavirahāt tat kulaṃ dīptaṃ bhavati | tasyāṃ punar arocamānāyāṃ bhartṛvidviṣṭatayā narāntarasaṃparkāt sakalam eva kulaṃ malinaṃ bhavati || 3.62 ||
kuvivāhaiḥ kriyālopair vedānadhyayanena ca |
kulāny akulatāṃ yānti brāhmaṇātikrameṇa ca || 3.63 ||
kuvivāhair iti | āsurādivivāhair yathāvarṇaniṣiddhair jātakarmādikriyālopair vedāpāṭhena brāhmaṇāpūjanena prakhyātakulāny apakarṣaṃ gacchanti || 3.63 ||
śilpena vyavahāreṇa śūdrāpatyaiś ca kevalaiḥ |
gobhir aśvaiś ca yānaiś ca kṛṣyā rājopasevayā || 3.64 ||
śilpeneti | citrakarmādiśilpena kalayā dhanaprayogātmakavyavahāreṇa kevalaśūdrāpatyena gavāśvarathakrayavikrayādinā kṛṣirājasevābhyāṃ kulāni vinaśyantīty uttareṇa saṃbandhaḥ
|| 3.64 ||
ayājyayājanaiś caiva nāstikyena ca karmāṇām |
kulāny āśu vinaśyanti yāni hīnāni mantrataḥ || 3.65 ||
ayājyeti | ayājyavrātyādiyājanaiḥ karmaṇāṃ śrautasmārtādīnāṃ nāstikyena “śāstrīyaphalavatkarmasu phalābhāvabuddhir nāstikyam" | vedādhyayanaśūnyāni kulāni kṣipram apakarṣaṃ gacchanti | atra ca vivāhaprakaraṇe vivāhanindāprasaṅgena kriyālopādayo ninditāḥ | nindayā caitan na kartavyam iti sarvatra niṣedhaḥ kalpyate || 3.65 ||
idānīṃ kriyālopādigataprāsaṅgikakulanindānuprasaktyā kulotkarṣam āha –
mantratas tu samṛddhāni kulāny alpadhanāny api |
kulasaṃkhyāṃ ca gacchanti karṣanti ca mahad yaśaḥ || 3.66 ||
mantreti | yady api “dhanena kulam” iti loke prasiddhaṃ tathāpy alpadhanāny api kulāni vedādhyayanatadarthajñānānuṣṭhānaprasaktāny utkṛṣṭakulagaṇanāyāṃ gaṇyante mahatīṃ ca khyātim arjayanti || 3.66 ||
vivāhaprakaraṇam atikrāntam | idānīṃ vaivāhikāgnau saṃpādyaṃ mahāyajñavidhānaṃ ceti vaktavyatayā pratijñātaṃ mahāyajñādyanuṣṭhānam āha –
vaivāhike ‘gnau kurvīta gṛhyaṃ karma yathāvidhi |
pañcayajñavidhānaṃ ca paktiṃ cānvāhikīṃ gṛhī || 3.67 ||
vaivāhika iti | vivāhe bhavo vaivāhikaḥ | adhyātmāditvāṭ ṭhañ | tasminn agnau gṛhyoktaṃ karma sāyaṃprātarhomāṣṭakādi yathāśāstram agnisaṃpādyaṃ ca pañcamahāyajñāntargata-vaiśvadevādyanuṣṭhānam, pratidinasaṃpādyaṃ ca pākaṃ gṛhasthaḥ kuryāt || 3.67 ||
pañca sūnā gṛhasthasy cullī peṣaṇy upaskaraḥ |
kuṇḍanī codakumbhaś ca badhyate yās tu vāhayan || 3.68 ||
pañceti | paśuvadhasthānaṃ sūnā | sūnā iva sūnā hiṃsāsthānaguṇayogāc cullyādayaḥ pañca gṛhasthasya hiṃsābījāni hiṃsāsthānāni | cullī udvāhanī, peṣaṇī dṛṣadupalātmikā, upaskaro gṛhopakaraṇakuṇḍasaṃmārjanyādiḥ, kaṇḍanī ulūkhalamusale, udakumbho jalādhārakalaśaḥ | yāḥ svakārye yojayan pāpena saṃbadhyate || 3.68 ||
tāsāṃ krameṇa sarvāsāṃ niṣkṛtyarthaṃ maharṣibhiḥ |
pañca kṛptā mahāyajñāḥ pratyahaṃ gṛhamedhinām || 3.69 ||
tāsām iti | tāsāṃ cullyādisthānānāṃ yathākramaṃ niṣkṛtyartham utpannapāpanāśārthaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ pañcamahāyajñāḥ pratidinaṃ manvādibhir anuṣṭheyatayā smṛtāḥ | evaṃ ca niṣkṛtyartham iti abhidhānād dhiṃsāsthānatvena ca kīrtanāt “sūnādoṣair na lipyate” (3.71) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt pañcasūnānāṃ pāpahetukatvam, pañcayajñānāṃ ca tatpāpanāsakatvam avagamyate | pratyaham ity abhidhānāt pratidinaṃ tatpāpakṣayasyāprekṣitatvāt saṃdhyāvandanādivan nityatvam api na virudhyate || 3.69 ||
adhyāpanaṃ brahmayajñaḥ pitṛyajñas tu tarpaṇam |
homo daivo balir bhauto nṛyajño ‘tithipūjanam || 3.70 ||
adhyāpanam iti | adhyāpanaśabdenādhyayanam api gṛhyate, “japo ‘huta” (3.74) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | ato ‘dhyāpanam adhyayanaṃ ca brahmayajñaḥ | “annādyenodakena vā” (3.82) iti tarpaṇaṃ vakṣyati sa pitṛyajñaḥ | agnau homo vakṣyamāṇo devayajñaḥ | bhūtabalir bhūtayajñaḥ | atithipūjanaṃ manuṣyayajñaḥ | adhyāpanādiṣu yajñaśabdo mahacchabdaś ca stutyarthaṃ gauṇaḥ || 3.70 ||
pañcaitān yo mahāyajñān na hāpayati śaktitaḥ |
sa gṛhe ‘pi vasan nityaṃ sūnādoṣair na lipyate || 3.71 ||
pañceti | śaktita ity etadvidhānārtho ‘yam anuvādaḥ | anukalpenāpi yathāsaṃbhavam ete kartavyāḥ | hāpayatīti prakṛtyartha eva chāndasatvāṇ ṇic | jahātīty arthaḥ || 3.71 ||
devātithibhṛtyānāṃ pitṝṇām ātmanaś ca yaḥ |
na nirvapati pañcānām ucchvasan na sa jīvati || 3.72 ||
devateti | devatāśabdena bhūtānām api grahaṇam, teṣām api baliharaṇe devatārūpatvāt | bhṛtyā vṛddhamātāpitrādayo ‘vaśyaṃ saṃvardhanīyāḥ | “sarvata evātmānaṃ gopāyet” ity śrutyā ātmapoṣaṇam apy avaśyaṃ kartavyam | devatādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ yo ‘nnaṃ na dadāti sa ucchvasann api jīvitakāryākaraṇān na jīvatīti nindāvaśyakartavyatā bodhyate || 3.72 ||
ahutaṃ ca hutaṃ caiva tathā prahutam eva ca |
brāhmyaṃ hutaṃ prāśitaṃ ca pañcayajñān pracakṣate || 3.73 ||
ahutam ceti | nāmabhede ‘pi vākyabheda iti darśayituṃ pañcamahāyajñānāṃ munyantarāny ahutādīny saṃjñāntarāṇy abhidheyāni tāni svayaṃ vyācaṣṭe || 3.73 ||
japo ‘huto huto homaḥ prahuto bhautiko baliḥ |
brāhmyaṃ hutaṃ dvijāgryārcā prāśitaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || 3.74 ||
japa iti | ahutaśabdena brahmayajñākhyojapa ucyate | hutaśabdena devayajñākhyo homaḥ | prahutaśabdena bhūtayajñākhyo bhūtabaliḥ | brāhmyahutaśabdena manuṣyayajñākhyo brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhasyārcā | prāśitaśabdena pitṛyajñākhyaṃ nityaśrāddham || 3.74 ||
svādhyāye nityayuktaḥ syād daive caiveha karmaṇi |
daivakarmaṇi yukto hi bibhartīdaṃ carācaram || 3.75 ||
svādhyāya iti | yadi dāridryādidoṣeṇātithibhojanādikaṃ kartuṃ na kṣamate tadā brahmayajñe nityayukto bhavet | daive karmaṇy agnau home ca | homasya stutim āha: “yato daivakarmapara iidaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ dhārayati” || 3.75 ||
kuta etad ity āha –
agnau prāsāhutiḥ samyag ādityam upatiṣṭhate |
ādiyāj jāyate vṛṣṭir annaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ || 3.76 ||
agnāv iti | yajamānenāgnāv āhutiḥ samyak kṣiptā rasāharaṇakāritvād ādityasyādityaṃ prāpnoti | sa cāhutirasa ādityād vṛṣṭirūpeṇa jāyate | tato ‘nnam | tadupabhogena jāyante prajāḥ || 3.76 ||
yathā vāyuṃ samāśritya sarve jīvanti jantavaḥ |
tathā gṛhastham āśritya vartante sarva āśramāḥ || 3.77 ||
yatheti | yathā prāṇākhyavāyvāśrayeṇa sarvaprāṇino jīvanti tathā gṛhasthāśrayeṇa sarvāśramiṇo nirvahanti || 3.77 ||
gṛhasthaḥ prāṇatulyaḥ sarvāśramiṇām ity uktam, tad evopapapādayati –
yasmāt trayo ‘py āśramiṇo jñānenānnena cānvaham |
gṛhasthenaiva dhāryante tasmāj jyeṣṭhāśramo gṛhī || 3.78 ||
yasmād iti | yasmād gṛhasthavyatiriktās trayo ‘py āśramiṇo vedārthavyākhyānānnadānābhyāṃ nityaṃ gṛhasthair evopakriyante tasmāj jyeṣṭhāśramo gṛhasthaḥ | jyeṣṭha āśramo yasya sa tatheti bahuvrīhiḥ || 3.78 ||
sa saṃdhāryaḥ prayatnena svargam akṣayam icchatā |
sukhaṃ cehecchatā nityaṃ yo ‘dhāryo durbalendriyaiḥ || 3.79 ||
sa iti | yata evam ataḥ sa gṛhasthāśramaḥ svargasukham icchatā anantam iva cirasthāyitvāt | iha loke ca strīsaṃbhogasvādvannādibhojanasukhaṃ saṃtatam icchatā prayatnenānuṣṭheyaḥ | yo ‘saṃyatendriyair dhārayituṃ na śakyate || 3.79 ||
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā bhūtāny atithayas tathā |
āśāsate kuṭumbibhyas tebhyaḥ kāryaṃ vijānatā || 3.80 ||
ṛṣaya iti | ete gṛhasthebhyaḥ sakāśāt prārthayante | ataḥ śāstrajñena tebhyaḥ kartavyam || 3.80 ||
kiṃ tat tad āha –
svādhyāyenārcayetarṣīn homair devān yathāvidhi |
pitṝn śrāddhaiś ca nṝn annair bhūtāni balikarmaṇā || 3.81 ||
svādhyāyeneti | nānāprakāratvād arcanasya svādhyāyāder arcanārthatvam ucitam | mahāyajñāntargataiḥ svādhyāyādibhiḥ ṛṣidevapitratithibhūtāni yathāśāstraṃ pūjayet || 3.81 ||
tatra pitṛyajñaṃ tāvad āha –
kuryād ahar ahaḥ śrāddham annādyenodakena vā |
payomūlaphalair vāpi pitṛbhyaḥ prītim āvahan || 3.82 ||
kuryād iti | pratyahaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt | śrāddhaśabdo ‘yaṃ karmavidhivākyavartī kauṇḍapāyinām ayanīyāgnihotraśabdavad vakṣyamāṇapārvaṇaśrāddhadharmātideśārthaḥ | annādyeneti tilair vrīhibhir yavair ityāder upādānam | payaḥ kṣīram || 3.82 ||
ekam apy āśayed vipraṃ pitrarthe pāñcayajñike |
na caivātrāśayet kiṃcid vaiśvadevaṃ prati dvijam || 3.83 ||
ekam iti | pitṛprayojane pañcayajñāntargate ekam api brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayet | apiśabdāt saṃbhave bahūn api | pārvaṇadharmagrahaṇāc ca vaiśvadevabrāhmaṇabhojanaprāptāv āha –
na kaṃcid vaiśvadevārthaṃ brāhmaṇam atra bhojayet ||
|| 3.83 ||
vaiśvadevasya siddhasya gṛhye ‘gnau vidhipūrvakam |
ābhyaḥ kuryād devatābhyo brāhmaṇo homam anvaham || 3.84 ||
vaiśvadevasyeti | viśvadevārthaḥ sarvadevatārtho vaiśvadevas tasya pakvasyānnasyāvasathyāgnau svagṛhyavihitaparyukṣaṇādītikartavyatāpūrvakam ābhyo vakṣyamāṇadevatābhyo brāhmaṇaḥ pratyahaṃ homaṃ kuryāt | brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ dvijātipradarśanartham, trayāṇāṃ prakṛtatvāt || 3.84 ||
agneḥ somasya caivādau tayoś caiva samastayoḥ |
viśvebhyaś caiva devebhyo dhanvantaraya eva ca || 3.85 ||
agner iti | vacanadvayam “svāhākārapradānahomaḥ” iti kātyāyanasmaraṇād ādau “agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā” iti nirapekṣadevatākaṃ homadvayaṃ kṛtvā, “agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā” iti samastadevatākaṃ homaṃ kuryāt | tato viśvebhyo devebhyo dhanvantaraye || 3.85 ||
kuhvai caivānumatyai ca prajāpataya eva ca |
sahadyāvāpṛthivyoś ca tathā sviṣṭakṛte ‘ntataḥ || 3.86 ||
kuhvai ceti | kuhvā anumatyai prajāpataye dvāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ “agnaye sviṣtakṛte” ity evaṃ svāhākārāntān homān kuryāt | śrutyantareṣv agniviśeṣaṇatvena sviṣtakṛto vidhānāt kevalaṃ sviṣṭakṛnnirdeśe ‘py agniviśeṣaṇatvenaiva prayogaḥ | pāṭhād evāntatve siddhe “sviṣṭakṛte ‘ntataḥ” ityabhidhānaṃ smṛtyantarīyahomasamuccaye ‘py antatvajñāpanārtham || 3.86 ||
evaṃ samyag dhavir hutvā sarvadikṣu pradakṣiṇam |
indrāntakāppatīndubhyaḥ sānugebhyo baliṃ haret || 3.87 ||
evam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇa samyag ananyacitto devatādhyānapara eva homān kṛtvā sarvāsu prācyādiṣu dikṣu pradakṣiṇam indrādibhyaḥ sapuruṣebhyo baliṃ haret | tathā prācyām indrāya namaḥ indrapuruṣebhyo namaḥ, dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamāya namaḥ yamapuruṣebhyo namaḥ, paścimāyāṃ varuṇāya namaḥ varuṇapuruṣebhyo namaḥ, uttarasyāṃ somāya namaḥ somapuruṣebhyo namaḥ | yady api śabdāvagamyatvād devatātvasyāntakāppatīnduśabdair evoddeśo yuktas tathāpi bahvṛcānuṣṭhānasaṃvādād bahvṛcagṛhye ca (1.2) “yamāya yamapuruṣebhyo varuṇāya varuṇapuruṣebhyaḥ somāya somapuruṣebhya iti pratidiśam” iti pāṭhād yathokta eva prayogaḥ || 3.87 ||
marudbhya iti tu dvāri kṣiped apsv adbhya ity api |
vanaspatibhya ity evaṃ musalolūkhale haret || 3.88 ||
marudbhya iti | itiśabdaḥ svarūpavivakṣārthaḥ | “marudbhyo namaḥ” iti dvāre baliṃ dadyāt | jale ‘dbhya iti | musalolūkhala iti dvandvanirdeśāt sahayuktayor anyataratra vanaspatibhya iti baliṃ dadyāt, guṇānurodhena pradhānabalikarmāvṛtter anyāyyatvāt || 3.88 ||
ucchīrṣake śriyai kuryād bhadrakālyai ca pādataḥ |
brahmavāstoṣpatibhyāṃ tu vāstumadhye baliṃ haret || 3.89 ||
ucchīrṣake iti | vāstupuruṣasya śiraḥpradeśa uttarapūrvasyāṃ diśi śriyai baliṃ dadyāt | tasyaiva pādadeśe dakṣiṇapaścimāyāṃ diśi bhadrakālyai | anye tu ucchīrṣakaṃ gṛhasthaśayanasya śiraḥsthānamūlabhāgaṃ pādata iti tasyaiva caraṇabhūpradeśam āhuḥ | “brahmaṇe vāstoṣpataye” iti gṛhamadhye | dvandvanirdeśe ‘pi brahmavāstoṣpatyoḥ pṛthag eva devatātvam | yatra dvandve militasya devatātvam apekṣitaṃ tatra sahādiśabdaṃ karoti; yathā “sahadyāvāpṛthivyoś ca” (3.86) iti || 3.89 ||
viśvebhyaś caiva devebhyo balim ākāśa utkṣipet |
divācarebhyo bhūtebhyo naktaṃcāribhya eva ca || 3.90 ||
viśvebhya iti | viśvebhyaś ca devebhyaḥ iti śabdād ekeyam āhutiḥ | “viśvebhyo devebhyo namaḥ” iti gṛhākāśe baliṃ dadyāt | “divācarebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ” iti divā, “naktaṃcaribhyaḥ” iti naktam | “divācāribhyo divā” (bahvṛ. gṛ. 1.2) ityādibahvṛcagṛhyadarśanād iyaṃ vyavasthā
|| 3.90 ||
pṛṣṭavāstuni kurvīta baliṃ sarvātmabhūtaye |
pitṛbhyo baliśeṣaṃ tu sarvaṃ dakṣiṇato haret || 3.91 ||
pṛṣṭheti | gṛhasyopari yad gṛhaṃ tat pṛṣṭhavāstu balidātuḥ pṛṣṭhadeśe bhūbhāge vā tatra “sarvātmabhūtaye namaḥ” ity eva baliṃ dadyāt | uktabalidānāvaśiṣṭaṃ sarvam annaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ “svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ” iti balim haret | prācīnāvītinā cāyaṃ balir deyaḥ | “svadhā pitṛbhya iti prācīnāvītī śeṣaṃ dakṣiṇāmukho ninayet” (1.2) iti bahvṛcagṛhyavacanāt || 3.91 ||
śunāṃ ca patitānāṃ ca śvapacāṃ pāparogiṇām |
vāyasānāṃ kṛmīṇāṃ ca śanakair nirvaped bhuvi || 3.92 ||
śunām ceti | anyad annaṃ pātre samuddhṛtya śvapatitādibhyaḥ śanakair yathā rajasā na saṃgṛhyate tathā bhuvi dadyāt | pāparogī kuṣṭhī kṣayarogī vā || 3.92 ||
evaṃ yaḥ sarvabhūtāni brāhmaṇo nityam arcati |
sa gacchati paraṃ sthānaṃ tejomūrti patharjunā || 3.93 ||
evam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇa yaḥ sarvabhūtāny annadānādinā nityaṃ pūjayati sa paraṃ sthānaṃ brahmātmakaṃ tejomūrtiṃ prakāśam avakreṇa vartmanārcirādimārgeṇa prāpnoti | brahmaṇi līyata ity arthaḥ, jñānakarmabhyāṃ mokṣaprāpteḥ | tejomūrtiḥ iti savisargapāṭhe prakṛṣṭabrahmabodhasvabhāvo bhūtveti vyākhyā || 3.93 ||
kṛtvaitad balikarmaivam atithiṃ pūrvam āśayet |
bhikṣāṃ ca bhikṣave dadyād vidhivad brahmacāriṇe || 3.94 ||
kṛtveti | evam uktaprakāreṇaitad balikarma kṛtvā gṛhabhoktṛbhyaḥ pūrvam atithiṃ bhojayet | bhikṣave parivrāje brahmacāriṇe prathamāśramiṇe ca vidhivat svastivācya “bhikṣdānam apy ūrdhvam” iti gautamādyuktavidhinā bhikṣāṃ dadyāt | grāsapramāṇā ca bhikṣā bhavati, “grāsamātrā bhaved bhikṣā” iti śātātapavacanāt | saṃbhave tv adhikam api deyam || 3.94 ||
yat puṇyaphalam āpnoti gāṃ datvā vidhivad guroḥ |
tat puṇyaphalam āpnoti bhikṣāṃ datvā dvijo gṛhī || 3.95 ||
yad iti | gurave gāṃ datvā vidhivat svarṇaśṛṅgikādividhānena yat phalaṃ prāpnoti tad gṛhastho vidhinā bhikādānāt prāpnoti || 3.95 ||
bhikṣām apy udapātraṃ vā satkṛtya vidhipūrvakam |
vedatattvārthaviduṣe brāhmaṇāyopapādayet || 3.96 ||
bhikṣām iti | pracurānnābhāve grāsapramāṇāṃ bhikṣām api vyañjanādinā satkṛtya tadabhāve jalapūrṇaṃ pātram api phalapuṣpādinā satkṛtya tattvato vedatadarthajñānavate brāhmaṇāya svastivācyetyādividhipūrvakaṃ dadyāt || 3.96 ||
naśyanti havyakavyāni narāṇām avijānatām |
bhasmībhūteṣu vipreṣu mohād dattāni dātṛbhiḥ || 3.97 ||
naśyantīti | mohād yat pātrānabhijñatayā devapitruddeśenānnāni vedādhyayanatadarthajñānānuṣṭhānatejaḥśūnyatayā bhasmarūpeṣv iva pātreṣu dattāni dātṛbhir niṣphalāni bhavanti || 3.97 ||
vidyātapaḥsamṛddheṣu hutaṃ vipramukhāgniṣu |
nistārayati durgāc ca mahataś caiva kilbiṣāt || 3.98 ||
vidyātapaḥsamṛddheṣv iti | vidyātapastejaḥsaṃpannaviprāṇāṃ mukhāni homādhikaraṇatvenāgnitayā nirūpitāni havyakavyādi prakṣiptam iha loke dustarād vyādhiśatrurājapīḍādibhayān mahataś ca pāpād amutra narakāt trāyate || 3.98 ||
saṃprāptāya tv atithaye pradadyād āsanodake |
annaṃ caiva yathāśakti satkṛtya vidhipūrvakam || 3.99 ||
saṃprāptāyeti | svayam āgatāya tv atithaye āsanaṃ pādaprakṣālaṇādyudakaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vyañjanādibhiḥ satkṛtaṃ cānnam “āsanāvasathau” (3.107) ityādivakṣyamāṇavidhipūrvakaṃ dadyāt || 3.99 ||
śilān apy uñchato nityaṃ pañcāgnīn api juhvataḥ |
sarvaṃ sukṛtam ādatte brāhmaṇo ‘narcito vasan || 3.100 ||
śilān iti | lūnakedāraśeṣadhānyāni śilās tān apy uccinvataḥ, vṛttisaṃyamānvitasya, tretā, āvasathyaḥ, sabhyaś ceti pañcāgnayaḥ | sabhyo nāmāgniḥ śītāpanodādyarthaṃ yas tatra praṇīyate | pañcasv agniṣu homaṃ kurvāṇasyāpi sarvaṃ vṛttisaṃkocena pañcāgnihomārjitapuṇyam anarcito ‘tithir vasan gṛhṇāti | anayā ca nindayātithyarcanasya nityatāvagamyate || 3.100 ||
tṛṇāni bhūmir udakaṃ vāk caturthī ca sūnṛtā |
etāny api satāṃ gehe nocchidyante kadācana || 3.101 ||
tṛṇānīti | annāsaṃbhave punas tṛṇaviśrāmabhūmipādaprakṣālanādyarthajalapriyavacanāny api dhārmikagṛheṣv atithyarthaṃ na kadācid ucchidyante avaśyadeyānīti vidhīyate | tṛṇagrahaṇaṃ śayanīyopalakṣaṇārtham || 3.101 ||
aprasiddhatvād atithilakṣaṇam āha –
ekarātraṃ tu nivasann atithir brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
anityaṃ hi sthito yasmāt tasmād atithir ucyate || 3.102 ||
eketi | ekarātram eva paragṛhe nivasan brāhmaṇo ‘tithir bhavati | anityāvasthānān na vidyate dvitīyā tithir asyety atithir ucyate || 3.102 ||
naikagrāmīṇam atithiṃ vipraṃ sāṅgatikaṃ tathā |
upasthitaṃ gṛhe vidyād bhāryā yatrāgnayo ‘pi vā || 3.103 ||
naiketi | ekagrāmanivāsinaṃ lokeṣu vicitraparihāsakathādibhiḥ saṃgatyā vṛttyarthinaṃ bhāryāgniyukto gṛhe vaiśvadevakālopasthitam api nātithiṃ vidyāt | etena bhāryāgnirahitasya pravāsino nātithitvam it bodhitam || 3.103 ||
upāsate ye gṛhasthāḥ parapākam abuddhayaḥ |
tena te pretya paśutāṃ vrajanty annādidāyinām || 3.104 ||
upāsata iti | atithiprakaraṇād ātithyalobhena ye gṛhasthāḥ grāmāntarāṇi gatvā parānnaṃ sevante te niṣiddhaparānnadoṣānabhijñāḥ tena parānnabhojanena janmāntare annādidāyināṃ paśutāṃ vrajanti | tasmād idaṃ na kuryād iti niṣedhaḥ kalpyate || 3.104 ||
apraṇodyo ‘tithiḥ sāyaṃ sūryoḍho gṛhamedhinā |
kāle prāptas tv akāle vā nāsyānaśnan gṛhe vaset || 3.105 ||
apraṇodya iti | sūrye ‘stam ite gṛhasthenātithir na pratyākheyaḥ | sūryeṇoḍhaḥ prāpito rātrau svagṛhagamanāśakteḥ | dvitīyavaiśvadevakāle prāptaḥ | akāle vā sāyaṃbhojane prāyaścittagauravārtho ‘yam ārambhaḥ | ata eva viṣṇupurāṇe:
divātithau tu vimukhe gate yat pātakaṃ nṛpa |
tad evāṣṭaguṇaṃ proktaṃ sūryoḍhe vimukhe gate ||
govindarājas tu pratiṣiddhātithipratiprasavārthatvam asyāha || 3.105 ||
na vai svayaṃ tad aśnīyād atithiṃ yan na bhojayet |
dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ vātithipūjanam || 3.106 ||
na vā iti | tad ghṛtadadhyādyutkṛṣṭam atithir na pratyācaṣṭe tat tasmai adatvā na svayaṃ bhoktavyam | dhanāya hitaṃ, dhanasya nimittaṃ vā dhanyam | evaṃ yaśasyādayo ‘pi śabdāḥ | atithibhojanaphalakathanam idam | na cānāvaśyakatāpattiḥ, “sarvaṃ sukṛtam ādatte” (3.100) ityādidoṣaśravaṇāt || 3.106 ||
āsanāvasathau śayyām anuvrajyām upāsanām |
uttameṣūttamaṃ kuryād dhīne hīnaṃ same samam || 3.107 ||
āseneti | āsanaṃ pīṭhaṃ carma vā, āvasatho viśrāmasthānam, śayyā khaṭvādi, anuvrajyā gacchato ‘nugamanam, upāsanā paricaryā | etat sarvaṃ bahuṣv atithiṣu yugapad upasthiteṣv itaretarāpekṣayotkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭamadhyamaṃ kuryān na punaḥ sarveṣāṃ samam || 3.107 ||
vaiśvadeve tu nirvṛtte yady anyo ‘tithir āvrajet |
tasyāpy annaṃ yathāśakti pradadyān na baliṃ haret || 3.108 ||
vaiśvadeva iti | anyaśabdanirdeśās atithibhojanaparyantaṃ vaiśvadeve kṛte yady aparo ‘tithir āgacchet tadā tadarthaṃ punaḥ pākaṃ kṛtvā tasyānnaṃ dadyāt | bahiharaṇaṃ tato nātra kuryāt | baliniṣedhād annasaṃskārābhāvo vaiśvadevasyāvagamyate | annasaṃskārapakṣe katham asaṃskṛtānnabhojanam anujānīyāt || 3.108 ||
na bhojanārthaṃ sve vipraḥ kulagotre nivedayet |
bhojanārthaṃ hi te śaṃsan vāntāśīty ucyate budhaiḥ || 3.109 ||
neti | bhojanalābhārthaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ svakulagotre na nivedayet | yasmād bhojanārthaṃ te kathayann udgīrṇāśīti paṇḍitaiḥ kathyate || 3.109 ||
na brāhmaṇasya tv atithir gṛha rājanya ucyate |
vaiśyaśūdrau sakhā caiva jñātayo gurur eva ca || 3.110 ||
neti | brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyādayo ‘tithayo na bhavanti, kṣatriyādīnāṃ brāhmaṇasyotkṛṣṭajātitvāt | mitrajñātīnām ātmasaṃbandhāt | guroḥ prabhutvāt | anenaiva nyāyena kṣatriyasya utkṛṣṭo brāhmaṇaḥ sajātīyaś ca kṣatriyo ‘tithiḥ syān nāpakṛṣṭau vaiśyaśūdrau | evaṃ vaiśyasyāpi dvijātayo ‘tithayo na śūdraḥ || 3.110 ||
yadi tv atithidharmeṇa kṣatriyo gṛham āvrajet |
bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu kāmaṃ tam api bhojayet || 3.111 ||
yadīti | yadi grāmāntarād āgatatvād atithikālopasthitatvād atithidharmeṇa kṣatriyo vipragṛham āgacchet tadā vipragṛhopasthitavipreṣu kṛtabhojaneṣu sthiteṣv icchātas tam api bhojayet
|| 3.111 ||
vaiśyaśūdrāv api prāptau kuṭumbe ‘tithidharmiṇau |
bhojayet saha bhṛtyais tāv ānṛśaṃsyaṃ prayojayan || 3.112 ||
vaiśyeti | yadi vaiśyaśūdrāv api brāhmaṇasya kuṭumbe gṛhe prāptau grāmāntarād āgatatvādyatithidharmaśālinau tadā tāv api kṣatriyabhojanakālāt parato dampatībhojanāt pūrvaṃ dāsabhojanakāle anukampām āśrayan bhojayet || 3.112 ||
itarān api sakhyādīn saṃprītyā gṛham āgatān |
prakṛtyānnaṃ yathāśakti bhojayet saha bhāryayā || 3.113 ||
itarān iti | uktabhojanakāle kṣatriyādivyatiriktān sakhisahādhyāyiprabhṛtīn saṃprītyā gṛham āgatān | na tv atithibhāvena, tasya pratiṣedhāt | yathāśakti prakṛṣṭam annaṃ kṛtvā bhāryāyā bhojanakāle bhojayet | gṛhasthasyāpi sa eva bhojanakālaḥ, “avaśiṣṭaṃ tu dampatī” (3.116) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | ātmanā saheti vaktavye vacanavaicitrīyam ācāryasya | guros tu bhojanakālānabhidhānaṃ prabhutvena svādhīnakālatvāt || 3.113 ||
suvāsinīḥ kumārīś ca rogiṇī garbhiṇīḥ striyaḥ |
atithibhyo ‘gra evaitān bhojayed avicārayan || 3.114 ||
suvāsinīr iti | suvāsinyo navoḍhāḥ striyaḥ snuṣā duhitaraś ca tāḥ, kumārīr garbhiṇīś cātithibhyo ‘gre pūrvam evātithibhyo bhojayet | katham atithiṣv abhojiteṣu bhojanam eṣām iti vicāram akurvan | medhātithis tu “anvag eva” iti paṭhitvānugatān evaitān bhojayed atithisamakālam iti vyākhyāya anye tu agra itipaṭhantīty uktavān || 3.114 ||
adatvā tu ya etebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ bhuṅkte ‘vicakṣaṇaḥ |
sa bhuñjāno na jānāti śvagṛdhrair jagdhim ātmanaḥ || 3.115 ||
adatveti | etebhyo ‘tithyādibhṛtyaparyantebhyo ‘nnam adatvā vyatikramabhojanadoṣam ajānan yaḥ pūrvaṃ bhuṅkte sa maraṇānantaraṃ śvagṛdhrair ātmano bhakṣaṇaṃ na jānāti | vyatikramasyedaṃ phalam iti vacanavaidagdhyenoktam || 3.115 ||
bhuktavatsv atha vipreṣu sveṣu bhṛtyeṣu caiva hi |
bhuñjīyātāṃ tataḥ paścād avaśiṣṭaṃ tu dampatī || 3.116 ||
bhuktavatsv iti | vipreṣv atithiṣu, sveṣu jñātiṣu, bhṛtyeṣu dāsādiṣu kṛtabhojaneṣu tato ‘nnād avaśiṣṭaṃ bhāryāpatī paścād aśnīyātām || 3.116 ||
devān ṛṣīn manuṣyāṃś ca pitṝn gṛhyāś ca devatāḥ |
pūjayitvā tataḥ paścād gṛhasthaḥ śeṣabhug bhavet || 3.117 ||
devān iti | gṛhyāś ca devatāḥ ity anena bhūtayajña uktaḥ, pañcayajñānuṣṭhānasya “avaśiṣṭaṃ tu dampatī” (3.116) ity anena śeṣabhojanasya ca vihitatvāt | vakṣyamāṇadoṣakathanārtho ‘yam anuvādaḥ | atha vā devān ity anenaiva bhūtayajñasyāpi saṃgrahaḥ | gṛhe bhavā gṛhyā devatāḥ pūjayitveti vāsudevādipratikṛtipūjāvidhānārthatvam asya || 3.117 ||
aghaṃ sa kevalaṃ bhuṅkte yaḥ pacaty ātmakāraṇāt |
yajñaśiṣṭāśanaṃ hy etat satām annaṃ vidhīyate || 3.118 ||
agham iti | yas tv ātmārtham evānnaṃ paktvā bhuṅkte devādibhyo na dadāti sa pāpahetutvāt pāpam eva kevalaṃ bhuṅkte nānnam | tathā ca śrutiḥ: “kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī” | yasmād yad eva pākayajñāvaśiṣṭam aśanam annam anyat etad eva sādhūnām annam upadiśyata iti
|| 3.118 ||
atithipūjāprasaṅgena rājādīnām api gṛhāgatānāṃ pūjāviśeṣam āha –
rājartviksnātakagurūn priyaśvaśuramātulān |
arhayen madhuparkeṇa parisaṃvatsarāt punaḥ || 3.119 ||
rājeti | rājyābhiṣiktaḥ kṣatriyo rājā, ṛtvik yajñe yena yasyārtvijyaṃ kṛtam, snātako vidyāvratābhyām, priyo jāmātā | rājādīn etān gṛhāgatān sapta gṛhyoktena madhuparkākhyena karmaṇā pūjayet | parisaṃvatsarād iti saṃvatsaraṃ varjayitvā tad ūrdhvaṃ gṛhāgatān punar madhuparkeṇa pūjayet | “pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ” (Pāṇ 2.3.10) sūtreṇa varjanārthapariyogeneyaṃ pañcamī | ata evaitatsūtravyākhyāne jayādityenokaṃ “apena sāhacaryāt parer varjanārthasya grahaṇam” iti | medhātithis tu parisaṃvatsarān iti paṭhitvā parigato niṣkrāntaḥ saṃvatsaro yeṣāṃ tān pūjayed iti vyākhyātavān |
rājsnātakayoḥ pūjāsaṃkocārtham āha –
rājā ca śrotriyaś caiva yajñakarmaṇy upasthitau |
madhuparkeṇa saṃpūjyau na tv ayajña iti sthitiḥ || 3.120 ||
rājeti | rājasnātakau saṃvatsarād ūrdhvam api yajñakarmaṇy eva prāptau madhuparkeṇa pūjanīyau na tu yajñavyatirekeṇa | jāmātrādayas tu saṃvatsarād ūrdhvaṃ yajñaṃ vināpi madhuparkārhāḥ | saṃvatsaramadhye tu sarveṣāṃ yajñavivāhayor eva madhuparkaḥ | tad āha gautamaḥ (5.25–27): “ṛtvigācāryaśvaśurapitṛvyamātulādīnām upasthāne madhuparkaḥ | saṃvatsare punar yajñavivāhayor arvāk rājñaḥ śrotriyasya ca” || 3.120 ||
sāyaṃ tv annasya siddhasya patny amantraṃ baliṃ haret |
vaiśvadevaṃ hi nāmaitat sāyaṃprātar vidhīyate || 3.121 ||
sāyam iti | dinānte siddhasyānnasya patnī amantraṃ baliharaṇaṃ kuryāt “indrāya namaḥ” iti mantrapāṭhavarjam | mānasas tu devatoddeśo na niṣidhyate | yata etad vaiśvadevaṃ nāmānnasādhyaṃ homabalidānātithibhojanātmakaṃ tat sāyaṃprātar gṛhasthasyopadiśyate
|| 3.121 ||
“śrāddhakalpaṃ ca śāśvatam” (1.112) ity anukramaṇikāyāṃ pratijñātaṃ śrāddhakalpam upakramate –
pitṛyajñaṃ tu nirvartya vipraś cendukṣaye ‘gnimān |
piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryān māsānumāsikam || 3.122 ||
pitṛyajñam iti | sāgnir amāvāsyāyāṃ piṇḍapitṛyajñākhyaṃ karma kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ kuryāt | pitṛyajñapiṇḍānām anu paścād āhriyata iti piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ māsānumāsikaṃ māsaś cānumāsaś ca tayor bhavam | pratimāsaṃ kartavyam ity arthaḥ | anenāsya nityatvam uktam | vipragrahaṇaṃ dvijātiparam, trayāṇāṃ prakṛtatvāt || 3.122 ||
idānīṃ nāmanirvacanenoktam eva pitṛyajñānantaryaṃ draḍhayati –
pitṝṇāṃ māsikaṃ śrāddham anvāhāryaṃ vidur budhāḥ |
tac cāmiṣeṇa kartavyaṃ praśastena prayatnataḥ || 3.123 ||
pitṝṇām iti | idaṃ māsikaṃ pratimāsabhavaṃ śrāddhaṃ yasmāt pitṛyajñapiṇḍānām anu pakṣāḍ [Dave: paścād] āhriyate tena piṇḍānvāhāryakam idaṃ paṇḍitā jānanti | tato yuktaṃ pitṛyajñānantaryam asya | tac cāmiṣeṇa vakṣyamāṇamāṃsena praśastena manohareṇa pūtigandhādirahitena prayatnataḥ kartavyam | “piṇḍānāṃ māsikaṃ śrāddham” iti vā pāṭhaḥ | piṇḍānāṃ pitṛyajñapiṇḍānām | śeṣaṃ tulyam || 3.123 ||
tatra ye bhojanīyāḥ syur ye ca varjyā dvijottamāḥ |
yāvantaś caiva yaiś cānnais tān pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ || 3.124 ||
tatreti | tasmin śrāddhe ye bhojanīyā ye ca tyājyā yatsaṃkhyākāḥ yaiś cānnais tat sarvaṃ pravakṣyāmi || 3.124 ||
atra yady apy uddeśakrameṇa ye bhojanīyā iti vaktum ucitaṃ tathāpy alpavaktavyatvād brāhmaṇasaṃkhyām āha –
dvau daive pitṛkārye trīn ekaikam ubhayatra vā |
bhojayet susamṛddho ‘pi na pravarteta vistare || 3.125 ||
dvāv iti | devaśrāddhe dvau brāhmaṇau pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahānāṃ trīn brāhmaṇān atha vā daive ekaṃ pitrāditrike caikaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayet | uktātiriktabhojanasamartho ‘pi nādhikabhojaneṣu pravarteta
medhātithis tv āha – pitṛkṛtye trīn iti pitus trīn brāhmaṇān, pitāmahasya trīn brāhmaṇān, prapitāmahasya trīn brāhmaṇān bhojayet | ekaikam ubhayatra veti | daivaṃ ekam, pitrāditrayasya caikaikam, na tv ekaṃ pitrāditrayasya, “na tv evaikaṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmam anādye piṇḍair vyākhyātam” (Āśv. Gṛ. 16.7) ity āśvalāyanagṛhyavirodhāt | yathaikapiṇḍaḥ pitrāditrayasya na nirūpyate tathaiko brāhmaṇo na bhojayitavya ity arthaḥ | tasmān na pitrāditrayasyaikabrāhmaṇabhojanam |
tad asat | gṛhyakāreṇaiva “na tv evaikaṃ sarveṣāṃ piṇḍair vyākhyātam” (Āśv. Gṛ. 16.7) iti paṭhitvā kāmam anādye ity abhihitam | asyārthaḥ – bahupitrādidevatākaśrāddhānām ādyaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇam abhimataṃ tadvyatiriktaśrāddhe kāmam ekaḥ pitrādīnāṃ brāhmaṇa ity arthaḥ | atha vā anādye adanīyadravyābhāve eko ‘pi bhojayitavyaḥ | ubhayatrāpi vyākhyāne pārvaṇādau pitrāditrayasyaikabrāhmaṇabhojanaṃ gṛhyakṛtaivoktam | vasiṣṭho ‘pi (11.27) |
yady ekaṃ bhojayec chrāddhe daivatantraṃ kathaṃ bhavet |
annaṃ pātre samuddhṛtya sarvasya prakṛtasya ca ||
devatāyatane kṛtvā yathāvidhi pravartayet |
prāsyed annaṃ tad agnau vā dadyād vā brahmacāriṇe ||
iti sarvebhya ekabrāhmaṇabhojanam āha | tasmād yathoktaiva vyavasthā | “prathane vāvaśabde” (Pāṇ 3.3.33) ity anena vistāra iti prāpte chandaḥsamānatvāt smṛtīnāṃ “sarve vidhayaś chandasi vikalpante” (Kau. Pari. 36) iti vistara iti rūpam || 3.125 ||
satkriyāṃ deśakālau ca śaucaṃ brāhmaṇasaṃpadaḥ |
pañcaitān vistaro hanti tasmān neheta vistaram || 3.126 ||
sad iti | satkriyāṃ brāhmaṇasya pūjāṃ deśaṃ dakṣiṇapravaṇatvādivakṣyamāṇaṃ kālam aparāhṇam, śaucaṃ śrāddhakartṛbhoktṛbrāhmaṇapraiṣyagatam, gunavadbrāhmaṇalābhaṃ ca brāhmaṇavistāro nāśayati | tasmād brāhmaṇavistaraṃ na kurād iti | satkriyādivirodhato brāhmaṇavistaraniṣedhāt satkriyādisaṃbhave pitrāder ekaikasyāpi brāhmaṇatrayābhyanujñānam | ata eva gauamaḥ (15.2): “na cāvarān bhojayed ayujo vā yathotsāham” | bahvṛcagṛhyakāro ‘pi (16.7): “athātaḥ pārvaṇe śrāddhe kāmya ābhyudayika ekoddiṣṭe vā brāḥmaṇān” ity upakramya “ekaikam ekaikasya dvai dvau trīṃs trīn vā vṛddhau phalabhūyastvam” ity āha | dvau dvau ity ābhyudayikaśrāddhaviṣayaṃ smṛtyantareṣu tathā vidhānāt, atrāpy ābhyudayika ity upakramāc ca || 3.126 ||
prathitā pretakṛtyaiṣā pitryaṃ nāma vidhukṣaye |
tasmin yuktasyaiti nityaṃ pretakṛtyaiva laukikī || 3.127 ||
prathiteti | yad etat pitryaṃ karma śrāddharūpaṃ prathiteyaṃ prakhyātā pretakṛtyā pitrupakārārthā kriyā | prakarṣeṇa itaḥ pretaḥ pitṛlokastha evocyate | vidhukṣaye ‘māvāsyāyāṃ tasmin pitrye karmaṇi yuktasyaitatparasya laukikī smārtikī pretakṛtyā pitrupakārārthā kriyā guṇavatputrapautradhanādiphalaprabandharūpeṇa kartāram upatiṣṭhate tasmād idaṃ kartavyam | govindarājena tu “vidhiḥ kṣaya” iti paṭhitam, vyākhyātaṃ ca – yo ‘yaṃ nāma vidhiḥ pitryaṃ karmeti | kṣaye candrakṣaye gṛhe vā tad asāṃpradāyikam | medhātithiprabhṛtibhir govindarājād api vṛddhatarair anabhyupatetatvāt kṣaya iti saṃbandhakleśāc ca || 3.127 ||
śrotriyāyaiva deyāni havyakavyāni dātṛbhiḥ |
arhattamāya viprāya tasmai dattaṃ mahāphalam || 3.128 ||
śrotriyāyeti | chandomātrādhyāyī śrotriyas tasmai daivapitryānnāni yatnato deyāni | arhattamāya śrutācārābhijanādibhiḥ pūjyatamāya tasmai dattaṃ mahāphalaṃ bhavati
|| 3.128 ||
ekaikam api vidvāṃsaṃ daive pitrye ca bhojayet |
puṣkalaṃ phalam āpnoti nāmantrajñān bahūn api || 3.129 ||
ekaikam iti | daivapitryayor ekaikam api vedatattvavidaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayet | tadāpi viśiṣṭaṃ śrāddhaphalaṃ prāpnoti na tv aviduṣo bahūn api | evaṃ ca “phalaśravaṇād brāhmaṇabhojanam eva pradhānam, piṇḍadānādikaṃ tv aṅgam” iti govindarājaḥ | vayaṃ tu pitruddeśena dravyatyāgaṃ brāhmaṇasvīkāraparyantaṃ śrāddhaśabdavācyaṃ pradhānaṃ brūmaḥ | tad eva manunā (3.122) “piṇḍānvāhāryakaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt” iti vihitam | āpastambena tu manvarthasyaiva vyākhyātatvāt | tad āhāpastambaḥ: “tathaitan manuḥ śrāddhaśabdaṃ karma provāca prajāniḥśreyasārthaṃ, tatra pitaro devatā brāhmaṇas tv āhavanīyārthe, māsi māsy aparapakṣasyāparāhṇaḥ śreyān” iti | śrāddhaśabdaṃ śrāddham iti śabdo vācako yasya tat tathā | brāhmaṇas tv āhavanīyārthe āhavanīyavat tyaktadravyapratipattisthānatvāt | pitaro devateti niyatapitṛdevatākatvāc ca śrāddhasya | devatāśrāddhādau śrāddhaśabdas tu taddharmaprāptyartho gauṇaḥ | kauṇḍapāyinām ayana ivāgnihotraśabdaḥ | puṣkalaṃ phalaṃ prāpnotīti tu puṣṭataraphalārthino guṇaphalavidhiḥ | sa bhojanasyāṅgatve ‘pi tadāśrayo na viruddhaḥ |
āpastambo ‘bhyadhāc chrāddhaṃ karmaitat pitṛdaivatam |
manvarthaṃ kathayaṃs tasmān nedaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanam ||
|| 3.129 ||
dūrād eva parīkṣeta brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam |
tīrthaṃ tad dhavyakavyānāṃ pradāne so ‘tithiḥ smṛtaḥ || 3.130 ||
dūrād iti | dūrād eva pitṛpitāmahādyabhijanaśuddhinirūpaṇena kṛtsnaśākhādhyāyinaṃ brāḥmaṇaṃ parīkṣeta | yasmāt tathāvidho brāhmaṇo havyādīnāṃ tīrthaṃ pātram | pradāne so ‘tithir eva, mahāphalaprāpter hetutvāt || 3.130 ||
sahasraṃ hi sahasrāṇām anṛcāṃ yatra bhuñjate |
ekas tān mantravit prītaḥ sarvān arhati dharmataḥ || 3.131 ||
sahasram iti | yatra śrāddhe brāhmaṇānām avidevidāṃ daśalakṣāṇi bhuñjate tatraiko vedavid bhojanena parituṣṭo dharmato dharmotpādanena tān sarvān arhati svīkartuṃ yogyo bhavati | tadbhojanajanyaṃ phalaṃ janayatīty arthaḥ | chāndasatvād ekavacanam | atha vā bahuvacanānāṃ sthāne sahasram iti manor abhimatam | govindarājas tv āha: “sahasraṃ gacchantu bhūtāni” iti vede || 3.131 ||
jñānotkṛṣṭāya deyāni kavyāni ca havīṃṣi ca |
na hi hastāv asṛgdigdhau rudhireṇaiva śudhyataḥ || 3.132 ||
jñāneti | vidyayā utkṛṣṭebhyo havyāni kavyāni ca deyāni na mūrkhebhyaḥ | arthāntaranyāso nāmālaṃkāraḥ | na hi raktāktau hastau raktenaiva viśuddhau bhavataḥ kiṃ tu vimalajalena, evaṃ mūrkhabhojanena janitaṃ doṣaṃ na mūrkha eva bhojito ‘pahanti kiṃ tu vidvān || 3.132 ||
avidvannindayā vidvaddānam evoktaṃ vakroktyā stauti –
yāvato grasate grāsān havyakavyeṣv amantravit |
tāvato grasate pretya dīptaśūlarṣṭyayoguḍān || 3.133 ||
yāvata iti | yatsaṃkhyākān grāsān havyakavyeṣv avedavid bhuṅkte tatsaṃkhyākān eva prakṛtaśrāddhakartā jvalitaśūlarṣṭyākhyāyudhalohapiṇḍān grasate | śrāddhakartur evedam avidvaddānaphalakathanam | yathā ca vyāsaḥ:
grasate yāvataḥ piṇḍān yasya vai haviṣo ‘nṛcaḥ |
grasate tāvataḥ śūlān gatvā vaivasvatakṣayam ||
|| 3.133 ||
jñānaniṣṭhā dvijāḥ kecit taponiṣṭhās tathāpare |
tapaḥsvādhyāyaniṣṭhāś ca karmaniṣṭhās tathāpare || 3.134 ||
jñāneti | kecid ātmajñānaparā brāhmaṇā bhavanti, anye prājāpatyāditapaḥpradhānāḥ, apare tapo’dhyayananiratāḥ, itare yāgādiparāḥ || 3.134 ||
tataḥ kim ata āha –
jñānaniṣṭheṣu kavyāni pratiṣṭhāpyāni yatnataḥ |
havyāni tu yathānyāyaṃ sarveṣv eva caturṣv api || 3.135 ||
jñāneti | jñānapradhānebhyaḥ pitrarthānnāni yatnād dātavyāni, devānnāni punar nyāyāvadhṛtārthaśāstrānusāreṇa caturbhyo ‘pi || 3.135 ||
tayoḥ kaḥ śreṣṭha ity upanyasya viśeṣam āha –
aśrotriyaḥ pitā yasya putraḥ syād vedapāragaḥ |
aśrotriyo vā putraḥ syāt pitā syād vedapāragaḥ || 3.136 ||
aśrotriya iti | yo ‘śrotriyapitṛkaḥ svayaṃ ca śrotriyaḥ, yaḥ śrotriyapitṛkaḥ svayaṃ vā aśrotriyaḥ
|| 3.136 ||
jyāyāṃsam anayor vidyād yasya syāc chrotriyaḥ pitā |
mantrasaṃpūjanārthaṃtu satkāram itaro ‘rhati || 3.137 ||
jyāyāṃsam iti | anayoḥ pūrvaślokanirdiṣṭayor madhye śrotriyaputraṃ svayam aśrotriyam api jyeṣṭhaṃ jānīyāt | pitṛvidyādaraparam idam | yaḥ punar aśrotriyasya putraḥ svayaṃ ca śrotriyaḥ sa tadadhītavedapūjanārthaṃ pūjām arhati | veda eva taddvāreṇa pūjyata iti putravidyādaraparam idam | tasmād vacanabhaṅgyā śrotriyaputraḥ svayaṃ ca śrotriyaḥ śrāddhe bhojayitavya ity uktam | na tu śrotriyaputrasya svayam aśrotriyasyaivābhyanujñānam, “śrotriyāyaiva deyāni” (3.128) iti virodhāt | evaṃ ca “dūrād eva parikṣeta” (3.130) iti vidyāvyatiritācārādi parīkṣārthatvenāvatiṣṭhate || 3.137 ||
na śrāddhe bhojayen mitraṃ dhanaiḥ kāryo ‘sya saṃgrahaḥ |
nāriṃ na mitraṃ yaṃ vidyāt taṃ śrāddhe bhojayed dvijam || 3.138 ||
neti | śrāddhe na mitraṃ bhojayet | dhanāntarair asya maitrī saṃpādanīyā | na śatruṃ na ca mitraṃ yaṃ jānīyāt taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śrāddhe bhojayet || 3.138 ||
yasya mitrapradhānāni śrāddhāni ca havīṃṣi ca |
tasya pretya phalaṃ nāsti śrāddheṣu ca haviḥṣu ca || 3.139 ||
yasyeti | mitraśabdo ‘yaṃ bhāvapradhānaḥ | yasya maitrīpradhānāni havyakavyāni tasya pāralaukikaṃ phalaṃ na bhavatīti phalābhāvakathanaparam idam | pretyeti paraloka ity arthe śabdāntaram avyayam idaṃ na tu ktvāntam, tenāsamānakartṛkatve kathaṃ ktvety nāśaṅkanīyam
|| 3.139 ||
svargaphalaṃ śrāddhasya darśayituṃ pūrvoktaphalābhāvam eva viśeṣeṇa kathayati –
yaḥ saṃgatāni kurute mohāc chrāddhena mānavaḥ |
sa svargāc cyavate lokāc chrāddhamitro dvijādhamaḥ || 3.140 ||
ya iti | yo manuṣyaḥ saṃgatāni mitrabhāvaṃ śāstrānabhijñatayā śrāddhena kurute śrāddham eva mitralābhahetutvān mitraṃ yasya sa śrāddhamitro dvijāpasadaḥ sa svargalokāc cyavate | taṃ na prāpnotīty arthaḥ | śrāddhasyāpi svargaphalatvam āha yājñavalkyaḥ (1.270):
āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca |
prayacchanti tathā prītā nṝṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ ||
|| 3.140 ||
saṃbhojanī sābhihitā paiśācī dakṣiṇā dvijaiḥ |
ihaivāste tu sā loke gaur andhevaikaveśmani || 3.141 ||
saṃbhojanīti | sā dakṣiṇā dānakriyā saṃbhojanī saha bhujyate yayā sā saṃbhojanī goṣṭhī bahupuruṣabhojanātmikā piśācadharmatvāt paiśācī manvādibhir uktā | sā ca maitrīprayojanakatvān na paralokaphalā iha loka evāste | yathāndhā gaur ekasminn eva gṛhe tiṣṭhati na gṛhāntaragamanakṣamā || 3.141 ||
yatheriṇe bījam uptvā na vaptā labhate phalam |
tathānṛce havir datvā na dātā labhate phalam || 3.142 ||
yatheti | īriṇam ūṣaradeśo yatra bījam uptaṃ na prarohati tatra yathā bījam uptvā karṣako na phalaṃ prāpnoty evam aviduṣe śrāddhadānaphalaṃ dātā na prāpnotīti || 3.142 ||
dātṝn pratigrahītṝṃś ca kurute phalabhāginaḥ |
viduṣe dakṣiṇāṃ datvā vidhivat pretya ceha ca || 3.143 ||
dātṝn iti | vedatattvavide yathāśāstraṃ dattam aihikāmuṣmikaphalabhāgino dātṝn karoti | aihikaṃ phalaṃ yathāśāstrānuṣṭhānena loke khyātirūpam ānuṣaṅgikam iti medhātithi-govindarājau | vayaṃ tv āyurādikam evaihikaphalaṃ brūmaḥ | “āhuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ vidyām” (YDh 1.270) ityādyaihikāmuṣmikādiphalatvenāpi śrāddhasya yājñavalkyādibhir uktatvāt | pratigrahītṝṃś ca śrāddhalabdhadhanānuṣṭhitayāgādiphalena paraloke saphalān kurute | anyāyārjitadhanānuṣṭhitayāgāder aphalapradatvāt | iha loke nyāyārjitadhanārabdhakṛṣyādiphalātiśayalābhāt saphalān kurute || 3.143 ||
kāmaṃ śrāddhe ‘racayen mitraṃ nābhirūpam api tv arim |
dviṣatā hi havir bhuktaṃ bhavati pretya niṣphalam || 3.144 ||
kāmam iti | varaṃ vidvadbrāhmaṇābhāve guṇavanmitraṃ bhojayen na tu vidvāṃsam api śatrum; yataḥ śatruṇā śrāddhaṃ bhuktaṃ paraloke niṣphalaṃ bhavati | yathoktapātrāsaṃbhave mitrapratiprasavārtham idam || 3.144 ||
“śrotriyāyaiva deyāni” (3.128) ity anena chandomātrādhyāyini śrotriyaśabdaprayogāt tadāśrayaṇam āvaśyakam uktam, idānīṃ tv adhikaphalārthaṃ mantrabrāhmaṇātmakakṛtsnaśākhādhyāyini śrotriye dānam āha –
yatnena bhojayec chrāddhe bahvṛcaṃ vedapāragam |
śākhāntagam athādhvaryuṃ chandogaṃ tu samāptikam || 3.145 ||
yatneneti | ṛgvedinaṃ mantrabrāhmaṇātmakaśākhādhyāyinaṃ yatnato bhojayet | tathāvidham eva yajurvedinam | vedasya pāraṃ gacchatīti vedapāragaḥ | śākhāyā antaṃ gacchatīti śākhāntagaḥ | samāptir asyāstīti samāptikaḥ | sarvair eva śabdair mantrabrāhmaṇātmakakṛtsnaśākhādhyetābhihitaḥ || 3.145 ||
tadbhojane ‘dhikaṃ phalam āha –
eṣām anyatamo yasya bhuñjīta śrāddham arcitaḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ tasya tṛptiḥ syāc chāśvatī sāptapauruṣī || 3.146 ||
eṣām iti | eṣāṃ saṃpūrṇaśākhādhyāyināṃ bahvṛcādīnāṃ madhyād anyatamo yasya samyak pūjitaḥ san śrāddhe bhuṅkte tasya putrādisaptapuruṣāṇāṃ śāśvatī avicchinnā pitṝṇāṃ tṛptiḥ syāt | sāptapauruṣī ity anuśatikāditvād ubhayapadavṛddhiḥ, tasya cākṛtigaṇatvāt || 3.146 ||
eṣa vai prathamaḥ kalpaḥ pradāne havyakavyayoḥ |
anukalpas tv ayaṃ jñeyaḥ sadā sadbhir anuṣṭhitaḥ || 3.147 ||
eṣa iti | havyakavyayor ubhayor eva pradāne yad asaṃbandhiśrotriyādibhyo dīyata ity ayaṃ mukhyaḥ kalpa uktaḥ | ayaṃ tu mukhyābhāve vakṣyamāṇo ‘nukalpo jñātavyaḥ, sarvadā sādhubhir anuṣṭhitaḥ || 3.137 ||
mātāmahaṃ mātulaṃ ca svasrīyaṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum |
dauhitraṃ viṭpatiṃ bandhum ṛtvigyājyau ca bhojayet || 3.148 ||
mātāmaham iti | svasrīyo bhāgineyaḥ, gurur vidyāgurur ācāryādiḥ, viṭ duhitā, tasyāḥ patir viṭpatir jāmātā; bandhur mātṛṣvasṛpitṛsvasṛputrādiḥ, etān mātāmahādīn daśa mukhyaśrotriyādyasaṃbhave bhojayet || 3.148 ||
na brāhmaṇaṃ parīkṣeta daive karmaṇi dharmavit |
pitrye karmaṇi tu prāpte parīkṣeta prayatnataḥ || 3.149 ||
neti | dharmajño daivaśrāddhe bhojanārthaṃ na brāhmaṇaṃ yatnataḥ parīkṣeta | lokaprasiddhimātreṇāsau sādhutayā bhojayitavyaḥ | pitrye punaḥ karmaṇy upasthite pitṛpitāmahādyabhijanaparīkṣā kartavyeti prayatnataḥśabdasyārthaḥ || 3.149 ||
ye stenapatitaklībā ye ca nāstikavṛttayaḥ |
tān havyakavyayor viprān anarhān manur abravīt || 3.150 ||
ya iti | stenaś cauraḥ sa ca suvarṇacorād anyaḥ, tasya patitaśabdenaiva grahaṇāt | patito mahāpātakī, klībo napuṃsakaḥ, nāstikavṛttir nāsti paraloka ity evaṃ vṛttiḥ pravartanaṃ yasya etān daivapitṛkṛtyayor ubhayor evāyogyān manur avravīd iti | manugrahaṇaṃ niṣedhādarārtham, sarvadharmāṇām eva manunoktatvāt || 3.150 ||
jaṭilaṃ cānadhīyānaṃ durbalaṃ kitavaṃ tathā |
yājayanti ca ye pūgāṃs tāṃś ca śrāddhe na bhojayet || 3.151 ||
jaṭilam iti | jaṭilo brahmacārī | “muṇḍo vā jaṭilo vā syāt” (2.219) ity uktabrahmacāryupalakṣaṇatvāj jaṭilatvasya muṇḍo ‘pi niṣidhyate | anadhīyānaṃ vedādhyayanarahitaṃ yasyopanayanamātraṃ kṛtaṃ na vedādeśaḥ | tenāsvīkṛtavedasyāpi brahmacāriṇo vedādhyayanakartur abhyanujñānārtho ‘yaṃ niṣedhaḥ | ataḥ “śrotriyāyaiva deyāni” (3.128) iti brahmacārītaraviṣayam | durbalo duścarmā | medhātithis tu “durvālam” iti paṭhitvā khalatir lohitakeśo vā duścarmā vety arthatrayam uktavān | kitavo dyūtakṛt | pūgayājakā bahuyājakāḥ, “pūgaḥ kratukavṛndayoḥ” ityābhidhānikāḥ | ata eva vasiṣṭhaḥ: “yaś cāpi bahuyājyaḥ syād yaś copanayate bahūn” iti | tān śrāddhe na bhojayed iti na daive niṣedhaḥ | yatrobhayatra niṣedho manor abhimatas tatra havyakavyagrahaṇam ubhayatreti vā karoti
|| 3.151 ||
cikitsakā devalakā māṃsavikrayiṇas tathā |
vipaṇena ca jīvanto varjyāḥ syur havyakavyayoḥ || 3.152 ||
cikitsakān iti | cikitsako bhiṣak, devalakaḥ pratimāparicārakaḥ, vartanārthatvenaitat karma kurvato ‘yaṃ niṣedho na tu dharmārtham | “devakośopabhojī ca nāmnā devalako bhavet” iti devalavacanāt | māṃsavikrayiṇaḥ sakṛd api, “sadyaḥ patati māṃsena” (10.92) iti liṅgāt | vipaṇeneti | vipaṇo vaṇijyā tayā jīvantaḥ | “havyakavyayoḥ” ity abhidhānād daive pitrye caite tyājyāḥ || 3.152 ||
preṣyo grāmasya rājñaś ca kunakhī śyāvadantakaḥ |
pratiroddhā guroś caiva tyaktāgnir vārdhuṣis tathā || 3.153 ||
preṣya iti | bhṛtigrahaṇapūrvakaṃ grāmāṇāṃ rājñaś cājñākārī kutsitanakhakṛṣṇadantaḥ, gurupratikūlācaraṇaśīlas tyaktaśrautasmārtāgniḥ kalopajīvanaś ca havyakavyayor varjyā iti pūrvasyaivātrānuṣaṅga uttaratra eva ca || 3.153 ||
yakṣmī ca paśupālaś ca parivettā nirākṛtiḥ |
brahmadviṭ parivittiś ca gaṇābhyantara eva ca || 3.154 ||
yakṣmīti | yakṣmī kṣayarogī, paśupālo vṛttyarthatayā chāgameṣādipoṣakaḥ, parivettṛparivittī vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇau, nirākṛtiḥ pañcamahāyajñānuṣṭhānarahitaḥ | tathā ca chandogapariśiṣṭam: “nirākartāmarādīnāṃ sa vijñeyo nirākṛtiḥ”, brahmadviṭ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ dveṣṭā, gaṇābhyantaro gaṇārthopasṛṣṭasaṃbandhidhanādyupajīvī || 3.154 ||
kuśīlavo ‘vakīrṇī ca vṛṣalīpatir eva ca |
paunarbhavaś ca kāṇaś ca yasya copapatir gṛhe || 3.155 ||
kuśīlava iti | kuśīlavo nartanavṛttiḥ, avakīrṇī strīsaṃparkād viplutabrahmacaryaḥ prathamāśramī yatiś ca, vṛṣalīpatiḥ savarṇām apariṇīya kṛtaśūdrāvivāhaḥ, paunarbhavaḥ punarbhūputro vakṣyamāṇaḥ, upapatir yasya jāyājāro gṛhe ‘sti || 3.155 ||
bhṛtakādhyāpako yaś ca bhṛtakādhyāpitas tathā |
śūdraśiṣyo guruś caiva vāgduṣṭaḥ kuṇḍagolakau || 3.156 ||
bhṛtaketi | bhṛtir vetanaṃ tadgrāhī, bhṛtakaḥ san yo ‘dhyāpakaḥ, sa tathā; evaṃ bhṛtakādhyāpitaḥ, śūdraśiṣyo vyākaraṇādau guruś ca tasyaiva | vāgduṣṭaḥ paruṣabhāṣī | abhiśasta ity anye | kuṇḍagolakau vakṣyamāṇau || 3.156 ||
akāraṇaparityaktā mātāpitror guros tathā |
brāhmair yaunaiś ca saṃbandhaiḥ saṃyogaṃ patitair gataḥ || 3.157 ||
