akāraṇeti | mātuḥ pitur gurūṇāṃ ca parityāgakāraṇaṃ vinā tyaktā śuśrūṣāder akartā, patitaiś cādhyayanakanyādānādibhiḥ saṃbandhaiḥ saṃparkaṃ gataḥ | patitatvād evāsya niṣedha iti cen na, saṃvatsarāt prāg idaṃ bhaviṣyati “saṃvatsareṇa patati” (11.180) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt
|| 3.157 ||
agāradāhī garadaḥ kuṇḍāśī somavikrayī |
samudrayāyī bandī ca tailikaḥ kūṭakārakaḥ || 3.158 ||
agāreti | gṛhadāhakaḥ, maraṇahetudravyasya dātā, kuṇḍasya vakṣyamāṇasya yo ‘nnam aśnāti; pradarśanārthatvāt kuṇḍasya golakasyāpi grahaṇam | ata eva devalaḥ |
amṛte jārajaḥ kuṇḍo mṛte bhartari golakaḥ |
yas tayor annam aśnāti sa kuṇḍāśīti kathyate ||
somalatāvikretā, samudre yo vahitrādinā dvīpāntaraṃ gacchati, bandī stutipāṭhakaḥ, tailārthaṃ tilādibījānāṃ preṣṭa, sākṣivāde kūṭasya mṛṣāvādasya kartā || 3.158 ||
pitrā vivadamānaś ca kitavo madyapas tathā |
pāparogy abhiśastaś ca dāmbhiko rasavikrayī || 3.159 ||
pitreti | pitrā saha śāstrārthe laukike vā vastuni nirarthaṃ yo vivadate, kitavo yaḥ svayaṃ devitum anabhijñaḥ svārthaṃ parān devayati na svayaṃ devitā tasyoktatvāt | na ca sabhikaḥ tasya dyūtavṛttipadenābhidhāsyamānatvāt | “kekaraḥ” iti pāṭhe tiryagdṛṣṭiḥ, surāvyatiriktamadyapātā, kuṣṭhī, anirṇīte ‘pi tasmin mahāpātakādau jātābhiśāpaḥ, chadmanā dharmakārī, rasavikretā || 3.159 ||
dhanuḥśarāṇāṃ kartā ca yaś cāgredidhiṣūpatiḥ |
mitradhrug dyūtavṛttiś ca putrācāryas tathaiv ca || 3.160 ||
dhanur iti | dhanūṃṣi śarāṃś ca yaḥ karoti, jyeṣṭhāyāṃ sodarabhaginyām anūḍhāyāṃ yā kaniṣṭhā vivāhena dīyate sāgredidhiṣūs tasyāḥ patiḥ | tathā ca laugākṣiḥ |
jyeṣṭhāyāṃ yady anūḍhāyāṃ kanyāyām uhyate ‘nujā |
sā cāgredidhiṣūr jñryā pūrvā tu didhiṣūḥ smṛtā ||
govindarājas tu “bhrātur mṛtasya bhāryāyām” (3.173) ity anenāgredidhiṣūpatir eva vṛttivaśād agrepadalopena didhiṣūpatir iti manunā vakṣyate sa iha gṛhyata ity āha | mitradhruk yo mitrasyāpakāre vartate, dyūtavṛttiḥ sabhikaḥ putreṇādhyāpitaḥ pitā mukhyena putrācāryatvāsaṃbhavāt || 3.160 ||
bhrāmarī gaṇḍamālī ca śvitry atho piśunas tathā |
unmatto ‘ndhaś ca varjyāḥ syur vedanindaka eva ca || 3.161 ||
bhrāmarīti | apasmārī, gaṇḍamālākhyavyādhyupetaḥ, śvetakuṣṭhayuktaḥ, durjanaḥ, unmādavān, acakṣuḥ vedanindākaraḥ || 3.161 ||
hastigo’śvoṣṭradamako nakṣatrair yaś ca jīvati |
pakṣiṇāṃ poṣako yaś ca yuddhācāryas tathaiva ca || 3.162 ||
hastīti | hastigavāśvoṣṭrāṇāṃ vinetā, nakṣatraśabdena jyotiḥśāstram upalakṣyate; tena yo vartate, pakṣiṇāṃ pañjarasthānaṃ krīḍādyarthaṃ vikrayārthaṃ vā poṣakaḥ, yuddhārtham āyudhavidyopadeśakaḥ || 3.162 ||
srotasāṃ bhedako yaś ca teṣāṃ cāvaraṇe rataḥ |
gṛhasaṃveśako dūto vṛkṣāropaka eva ca || 3.163 ||
srotasām iti | pravahajjalānāṃ setubhedādinā deśāntaranetā, teṣām evāvaraṇakartā nijagatipratibandhakaḥ, gṛhasaṃniveśopadeśako vāstuvidyopajīvī, dūto rājagrāmapreṣyavyatirikto ‘pi, vṛkṣaropayitā vetanagrahaṇena na tu dharmārthī, “pañcāmrāropī narakaṃ na yāti” iti vidhānāt || 3.163 ||
śvakrīḍī śyenajīvī ca kanyādūṣaka eva ca |
hiṃsro vṛṣalavṛttiś ca gaṇānāṃ caiva yājakaḥ || 3.164 ||
śvakrīḍīti | krīḍārthaṃ śunaḥ poṣayati, śyenair jīvati krayavikrayādinā, kanyābhigantā, hiṃsārataḥ, śūdropakḷptavṛttiḥ | “vṛṣalaputraś ca” iti pāṭhāntaram | atra vṛṣalā eva kevalāḥ putrā yasyety arthaḥ | vināyakādigaṇayāgakṛt || 3.164 ||
ācārahīnaḥ klībaś ca nityaṃ yācanakas tathā |
kṛṣijīvī ślīpadī ca sadbhir nindita eva ca || 3.165 ||
ācāreti | gurvatithipratyutthānādyācāravarjitaḥ, klībo dharmakṛtyādau nirutsāhaḥ, napuṃsakasyoktatvāt | nityaṃ yācanena parodvejakaḥ, svayaṃkṛtayā kṛṣyā yo jīvati, vṛttyantare ‘pi vā saṃbhavaty asvayaṃkṛtayāpi | ślīpadī vyādhinā sthūlacaraṇaḥ, kenāpi nimittena sādhūnāṃ nindāviṣayaḥ || 3.165 ||
aurabhriko māhiṣikaḥ parapūrvāpatis tathā |
pretaniryāpakaś caiva varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ || 3.166 ||
aurabhrika iti | meṣamahiṣajīvanaḥ, parapūrvā punarbhūs tasyāḥ patiḥ, pretanirhārako dhanagrahaṇena na tu dharmārtham | “etad vai paramaṃ tapo yat pretam araṇyaṃ haranti” ity āvaśyaśrutyā vihitatvā || 3.166 ||
etān vigarhitācārān apāṅkteyān dvijādhamān |
dvijātipravaro vidvān ubhayatra vivarjayet || 3.167 ||
etān iti | etān stenādīn ninditācārān kāṇādīṃś ca pūrvajanmārjitaninditakarmaśeṣalabdhakāṇādi-bhāvān sādhubhiḥ sahaikatra bhojanādyanarhān brāhmaṇāpasadān brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ śāstrajño daive pitrye ca tyajet || 3.167 ||
brāhmaṇas tv anadhīyānas tṛṇāgnir iva śāmyati |
tasmai havyaṃ na dātavyaṃ na hi bhasmani hūyate || 3.168 ||
brāhmaṇa iti | tṛṇāgnir yathā na havir dahanasamartho haviṣi prakṣipte śāmyati niṣphalas tatra homaḥ, evaṃ vedādhyayanaśūnyo brāhmaṇas tṛṇāgnisamas tasmai vedoddeśena tyaktaṃ havir na dātavyam, yato bhasmani na hūyate | “śrotriyāyaiva deyāni” (3.128) ity anenaivānadhīyānasyāpi praiṣedhasiddhau stenādivat paṅktidūṣakatvajñāpanārthaṃ punarvacanam | anye tu daive ‘nadhīyāna eva varjanīyaḥ, adhīyānas tu kāṇādir api śārīradoṣayukto grāhya ity etadarthaṃ punarvacanam | ata eva vasiṣṭhaḥ |
atha cen mantravid yuktaḥ śārīraiḥ paṅktidūṣaṇaiḥ |
adūṣyaṃ taṃ yamaḥ prāha paṅktipāvana eva saḥ ||
śārīraiḥ kāraṇatvādibhir na tu svayam utpādyaiḥ stenatvādibhiḥ || 3.168 ||
apāṅktadāne yo dātur bhavaty ūrdhvaṃ phalodayaḥ |
daive haviṣi pitrye vā tat pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ || 3.169 ||
apāṅktadāna iti | paṅktibhojanānarhabrāhmaṇāya daive haviṣi pitrye vā datte dātur yo dānād ūrdhvaṃ phalodayas tav aśeṣam abhidhāsyāmi || 3.169 ||
avratair yad dvijair bhuktaṃ parivettrādibhis tathā |
apāṅkteyair yad anyaiś ca tad vai rakṣāṃsi bhuñjate || 3.170 ||
avratair iti | vedagrahaṇārthaṃ vratarahitais tathā parivettrādibhir anyaiś cāpāṅkteyaiḥ stenādibhir yad dhavyaṃ bhuktaṃ tad rakṣāṃsi bhuñjate | niṣphalaṃ tac chrāddhaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ || 3.170 ||
aprasiddhatvāt parivettrādilakṣaṇam āha –
dārāgnihotrasaṃyogaṃ kurute yo ‘graje sthite |
parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittis tu pūrvajaḥ || 3.171 ||
dāreti | agnihotraśabdo ‘yam agnihotrādyādhānaparaḥ | yaḥ sahodare jyeṣṭhe bhrātary anūḍhe ‘nagnike ca dāraparigrahaṃ śrautasmārtāgnigrahaṇaṃ ca kurute sa parivettā, jyeṣṭhaś ca parivittir bhavati || 3.171 ||
prasaṅgāt parivedanasaṃbandhināṃ pañcānām apy aniṣṭaṃ phalam āha –
parivittiḥ parīvettā yayā ca parividyate |
sarve te narakaṃ yānti dātṛyājakapañcamāḥ || 3.172 ||
parīti | parivittiḥ parīvettā ca yayā ca kanyayā parivedanaṃ kriyate kanyāpradātā yājakaś ca tadvivāhahomakartā sa pañcamo yeṣāṃ te sarve narakaṃ vrajanti || 3.172 ||
bhrātur mṛtasya bhāryāyāṃ yo ‘nurajyeta kāmataḥ |
dharmeṇāpi niyuktāyāṃ sa jñeyo didhiṣūpatiḥ || 3.173 ||
bhrātur iti | mṛtasya bhrātur vakṣyamāṇaniyogadharmeṇāpi niyuktāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ “sakṛt sakṛd ṛtāv ṛau” ityādividhiṃ hitvā kāmenānurāgaṃ bhāvayed āśleṣacumbanādi kuryād asakṛd vā pravarteta sa didhiṣūpatir jñātavyaḥ | ataḥ śrāddhaniṣiddhapātramadhyapāṭhād asyāpi havyakavyapātrayor niṣedhaḥ kalpanīyaḥ || 3.173 ||
paradāreṣu jāyete dvau sutau kuṇḍagolakau |
patyau jīvati kuṇḍaḥ syān mṛta bhartari golakaḥ || 3.174 ||
pareti | paradāreṣu kuṇḍagolakākhyau dvau sudāv utpadete | tatra jīvatpatikāyām utpannaḥ kuṇḍaḥ, mṛtapatikāyāṃ ca golakaḥ || 3.174 ||
tau tu jātau parakṣetre prāṇinau pretya ceha ca |
dattāni havyakavyāni nāśayete pradāyinām || 3.175 ||
tāv iti | te parabhāryāyāṃ jātāḥ kuṇḍādyā dṛṣṭānupayogāt prāṇina iti vyapadiṣṭāḥ | prāṇinau brāhmaṇatve ‘pi tatkāryābhāvāt pretya phalābhāvāt paraloke cānuṣaṅgikakīrtyādiphalābhāvād dattāni havyakavyāni pretya phalābhāvād iha kīrter abhāvān nāśayete nāśayataḥ, pradāyibhir dattāni havyakavyāni niṣphalāni kurvataḥ || 3.175 ||
apāṅktyo yāvataḥ pāṅktyān bhuñjānān anupaśyati |
tāvatāṃ na phalaṃ tatra dātā prāpnoti bāliśaḥ || 3.176 ||
apāṅktya iti | sadbhiḥ sahaikapaṅktyāṃ bhojanānarhaḥ stenādir yatsaṃkhyān bhojanārhān paśyati tāvatsaṃkhyānāṃ bhojanasya phalaṃ tatra śrāddhe dātā na prāpnoti | bāliśo ‘jñaḥ | ataḥ stenādir yathā na paśyati tathā kartavyam || 3.176 ||
vīkṣyāndo navateḥ kāṇaḥ ṣaṣṭeḥ svitrī śatasya tu |
pāparogī sahasrasya dātur nāśayati phalam || 3.177 ||
vīkṣyeti | andhasya vīkṣanāsaṃbhavād vīkṣaṇayogyadeśasaṃnihito ‘sau pāṅktyāyāṃ navater bhojanaphalaṃ nāśayati, evaṃ kāṇaḥ ṣaṣṭeḥ, śvetakuṣṭhī śatasya, pāparogī rogarājopahataḥ | sahasrasyety andhādisaṃnidhinirāsārthaṃ vacanam | gurulaghusaṃkhyānidhānaṃ ceha saṃkhyopacaye doṣagauravam, tatra ca prāyaścittagauravam iti darśayitum || 3.177 ||
yāvataḥ saṃspṛśed aṅgair brāhmaṇāñ chūdrayājakaḥ |
tāvatāṃ na bhaved dātuḥ phalaṃ dānasya paurtikam || 3.177 ||
yāvata iti | śūdrasya yajñādāv ṛtvig yāvatsaṃkhyān brāhmaṇāṇ spṛśati “āsaneṣūpakḷpteṣu” (3.208) ity āsanabhedasya vakṣyamāṇatvān mukhyasparśāsaṃbhave yāvatāṃ śrāddhabhojināṃ paṅktāv upaviśati tāvatāṃ sambandhi paurtikaṃ phalaṃ śrāddhīyaṃ dātur na bhavati | tāvatāṃ paurtikaṃ phalaṃ bahirvedidānāc ca yat phalaṃ tan na bhavati iti medhātithi-govindarājau | atas tayaiva nindayā niṣiddhagaṇāpaṭhitasyāpi śūdrayājakasya bhojananiṣedhaḥ kalpyate || 3.178 ||
vedavic cāpi vipro ‘sya lobhāt kṛtvā pratigraham |
vināśaṃ vrajati kṣipram āmapātram ivāmbhasi || 3.179 ||
vedeti| vedajño ‘pi brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrayājakasya lobhāt pratigrahaṃ kṛtvā śīghraṃ śarīrādinā vināśaṃ gacchati | sutarām avedavit | apakvamṛnmayaśarāvādikam ivodake || 3.179 ||
somavikrayiṇe viṣṭhā bhiṣaje pūyaśoṇitam |
naṣṭaṃ devalake dattam apratiṣṭhaṃ tu vārduṣau || 3.180 ||
somavikrayiṇa iti | somavikrayiṇe yad dattaṃ tad dātur bhojanārthaṃ viṣṭhā saṃpadyate | janmāntare viṣṭhābhojināṃ jātau jāyata ity arthaḥ | evaṃ pūyaśoṇite ‘pi vyākhyeyam | naṣṭaṃ nāśabhāgitayā niṣphalaṃ vivakṣitam | apratiṣṭham anāśrayatayā niṣphalam eva || 3.180 ||
yat tu vāṇijake dattaṃ neha nāmutra tad bhavet |
bhasmanīva hutaṃ havyaṃ tathā paurnarbhave dvije || 3.181 ||
yat tv iti | vānijakāya yad dattaṃ śrāddhe tan nehānuṣaṅgikakīrtyādiphalāya, nāpi pāralaukikaphalāya bhavati | punarbhūputrāya yad dattaṃ tad bhasmahutahaviḥsamam | niṣphalam ity arthaḥ || 3.181 ||
itareṣu tv apāṅktyeṣu yathoddiṣṭeṣv asādhuṣu |
medo’sṛṅmāṃsamajjāsthi vadanty annaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ || 3.182 ||
itareṣv iti | itarebhyo viśeṣeṇānuktaphalebhyaḥ paṅktibhojanānarhebhyaḥ stenādibhyo yathākīrtitebhyo yad dattam annaṃ tad dātur bhojanārthaṃ medorudhiramāṃsamajjāsthi bhavatīti paṇḍitā vadanti | atrāpi janmāntare medhaḥśoṇitādibhujāṃ jātiṣu jāyanta ity arthaḥ
|| 3.182 ||
apāṅktyopahatā paṅktiḥ pāvyate yair dvijottamaiḥ |
tān nibodhata kārtsnyena dvijāgryān paṅktipavanān || 3.183 ||
apāṅktyeti | ekapaṅktyupaviṣṭas tenādidūṣitā paṅktir yair brāhmaṇaiḥ pavitrīkriyate tān pavitrīkārakān brāhmaṇān aśeṣeṇa śṛṇuta | niṣedhād ekpaṅktibhojanāsaṃbhave ‘pi stenādīnāṃ rahasyakṛtājñātadoṣaviṣayatvena sādhakatāsya vacanasya || 3.183 ||
agryāḥ sarveṣu vedeṣu sarvapravacaneṣu ca |
śrotriyānvayajāś caiva vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ || 3.184 ||
agryā iti | sarveṣu vedeṣu caturṣv apy agryāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ samyaggṛhītavedā brāhmaṇāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ | ata eva yamaḥ paṅktipāvanagaṇayāyām “caturvedavide caiva” iti paṭhitavān | tathā prakarṣeṇaivocyate vedārtha ebhir iti pravacanāny aṅgāni teṣv apy agryāḥ ṣaḍaṅgavidas te ca caturvedino ‘pi paṅktipāvanāḥ | “nyāyavic ca ṣaḍaṅgavid” iti paṅktipāvanamadhye yamena pṛthakpaṭhitatvāt | tathā “chandasāṃ śuddhadaśpuruṣa” ity uśanovacanād daśapuruṣaparyantam avicchinnavedasaṃpradāyavaṃśajāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ || 3.184 ||
triṇāciketaḥ pañcāgnis trisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit |
brahmadeyātmasaṃtāno jyeṣṭhasāmaga eva ca || 3.185 ||
triṇāciketa iti | triṇāciketo ‘dhvaryuvedagāgas tadvrataṃ ca, tadyogāt puruṣo ‘pi triṇāciketaḥ | pañcāgnir agnihotrī | tathā ca hārītaḥ |
pavanaḥ pāvanas tretā yasya pañcāgnayo gṛhe |
sāyaṃprātaḥ pradīpyante sa vipraḥ paṅktipāvanaḥ ||
pavana āvasathyāgniḥ | pāvanaḥ sabhyo ‘gniḥ | śītāpanodanādyarthaṃ bahuṣu deśeṣv api vidhīyate | trisuparṇo bahvṛcāṃ vedabhāgas tadvrataṃ ca, tadyogāt puruṣo 'pi trisuparṇaḥ | ṣaḍaṅgāni śikṣādīni yo vyācaṣṭe sa ṣaḍaṅgavit sarvapravacanena ṣaḍaṅgādhyetoktaḥ | brahmadeyā brāhmavivāhoḍhā, tasyā ātmasaṃtānaḥ putraḥ | jyeṣṭhasāmāny araṇyake gīyante teṣāṃ gātā | ete ṣaṭ “vijñeyāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ” ity uttaraślokena saṃbandhaḥ || 3.185 ||
vedārthavit pravaktā ca brahmacārī sahasradaḥ |
śatāyuś caiva vijñeyā brāhmaṇāḥ paṅktipāvanāḥ || 3.186 ||
vedeti | anadhītyāpi vedāṅgāni gurūpadeśādhigatavedārthaḥ, pravaktā vedārthasyaiv, brahmacārī prathamāśramī, sahasrada iti deyaviśeṣānupādāne ‘pi “gāvo vai yajñasya mātaraḥ” ityādiviśeṣapravṛttaśrutidarśanād gosahasradātā bahuprado vā | śatāyuḥ śatavarṣavayāḥ | “śrotriyāyaiva deyāni” (2.128) iti niyamāt sati śrotriyatve uktaguṇayogāt paṅktipāvanatvam
|| 3.186 ||
pūrvedyur aparedyur vā śrāddhakarmaṇy upasthite |
nimantrayeta tryavarān samyag viprān yathoditān || 3.187 ||
pūrvedyur iti | śrāddhakarmaṇi prāpte śrāddhāhāt pūrvadine tadasaṃbhave śrāddhadina evoktalakṣaṇān brāhmaṇān samyag atisatkṛtya nimantrayet | trayo ‘varā nyūnā yeṣāṃ te tryavarāḥ na tu tāvata eva, “ekaikam” (3.129) ity ukteḥ || 3.187 ||
nimantrito dvijaḥ pitrye niyatātmā bhavet sadā |
na ca chandasāṃsy adhīyīta yasya śrāddhaṃ ca tad bhavet || 3.188 ||
nimantrita iti | śrāddhe nimantrito brāhmaṇo nimantraṇād ārabhya śrāddhāhorātraṃ yāvan maithunanivṛttisaṃyamaniyamavān syāt | avaśyakartavyajapādivarjaṃ vedādhyayanaṃ ca na kuryāt | śrāddhakartāpi tathaiva syāt || 3.188 ||
nimantritān hi pitara upatiṣṭhanti tān dvijān |
vāyuvac cānugacchanti tathāsīnān upāsate || 3.189 ||
nimantritān iti | pūrvaniyamavidher ayam anuvādaḥ | yasmāt tān brāhmaṇān nimantritān adṛśyarūpeṇa pitaro ‘dhitiṣṭhanti prāṇavāyuvad gacchato ‘nugacchanti, tathopaviṣṭeṣu teṣu samīpa upaviśanti, tasmān niyatā bhaveyuḥ || 3.189 ||
ketitas tu yathānyāyaṃ havyakavye dvijottamaḥ |
kathaṃcid apy atikrāman pāpaḥ sūkaratāṃ vrajet || 3.190 ||
ketita iti | havyakavye yathāśāstraṃ nimantrito brāhmaṇaḥ svīkṛtya kenāpi prakāreṇa bhojanam kurvāṇas tena pāpena janmāntare sūkaro bhaveti || 3.190 ||
“niyatātmā bhavet sadā” (3.188) ity anena maithunaniṣedhe kṛte ‘pi vṛṣalīgamanasyādhikadoṣajñāpanāyāha –
āmantritas tu yaḥ śrāddhe vṛṣalyā saha modate |
dātur yad duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ pratipadyate || 3.191 ||
āmantritas tv iti | vṛṣalī śūdrā tatra mūḍhatvāc chrāddhe nimantritaḥ san yo vṛṣalyā sārdhaṃ strīpuṃdharmeṇa suratādinā ramate sa dātur yat pāpaṃ tat prāpnoti | pāpotpattimātraṃ vivikṣitam | anyathā dātary apāpe pāpaṃ na jāyate | na cedaṃ dātuḥ prāyaścittatayā vihitaṃ yenāsau pāpān mucyate | medhātithi-govindarājau tu sāmānyena brahmacaryasya vidhānād vṛṣasyantī capalayati bhartāram iti yogāśrayaṇena śrāddhabhoktur ūḍhā brāhmaṇy api vṛṣaly abhimatātrety āhatuḥ || 3.191 ||
akrodhanāḥ śaucaparāḥ satataṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ |
nyastaśastrā mahābhāgāḥ pitaraḥ pūrvadevatāḥ || 3.192 ||
akrodhanā iti | krodharahitāḥ, bahiḥśaucaṃ mṛdvāribhyām, antaḥśaucaṃ rāgadveṣādityāgas tadyuktāḥ, sarvadā strīsaṃyogādiśūnyāḥ, tyaktayuddhāḥ, dayādyaṣṭaguṇayogo mahābhāgatā tadvantaḥ, anādidevatārūpāḥ pitaraḥ | tasmāt krodhādirahitena bhoktrā kartrā ca bhavitavyam
|| 3.192 ||
yasmād utpattir eteṣāṃ sarveṣām apy aśeṣataḥ |
ye ca yair upacaryāḥ syur niyamais tān nibodhata || 3.193 ||
yasmād iti | eṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ yasmād utpattir ye ca pitaro yair brāhmaṇādibhir yair niyamaiḥ śāstroktakarmabhir upacaraṇīyā bhaveyus tān sākalyena śṛṇuta || 3.193 ||
manor hairaṇyagarbhasya ye marīcyādayaḥ sutāḥ |
teṣām ṛṣīṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ putrāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 3.194 ||
manor iti | hiraṇyagarbhāpatyasya manor ye marīcyādayaḥ putrāḥ pūrvam uktāḥ “marīcir atryaṅgirasau” (1.35) ityādinā teṣām ṛṣīṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ somapādayaḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ putrā manvādibhiḥ smṛtāḥ || 3.194 ||
virāṭsutāḥ somasadaḥ sādhyānāṃ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ |
agniṣvāttāś ca devānāṃ mārīcā lokaviśrutāḥ || 3.195 ||
virāḍ iti | virāṭsutāḥ somasado nāma sādhyānāṃ pitaraḥ, agniṣvāttā marīceḥ putrāḥ, lokavikhyātā devānāṃ pitaraḥ || 3.195 ||
daityadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām |
suparṇakinnarāṇāṃ ca smṛtā barhiṣado ‘trijāḥ || 3.196 ||
daityeti | daityādīnāṃ prathamādhyāyoditabhedānām atriputrāḥ barhiṣado nāma pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ
|| 3.196 ||
somapā nāma viprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ havirbhujaḥ |
vaiśyānām ājyapā nāma śūdrāṇāṃ tu sukālinaḥ || 3.197 ||
somapā iti | brāhmaṇaprabhṛtīnāṃ caturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ somapāprabhṛtayaś catvāraḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ || 3.197 ||
somapās tu kaveḥ putrā haviṣmanto ‘ṅgiraḥsutāḥ |
pulastyasyājyapāḥ putrā vasiṣṭhasya sukālinaḥ || 3.198 ||
somapā iti | kaver bhṛgoḥ somapāḥ putrāḥ | havirbhuja eva haviṣmanto ‘ṅgirasaḥ putrāḥ | ājyapāḥ pulastyasutāḥ | sukālino vasiṣṭhasutāḥ || 3.199 ||
agnidagdhānagnidagdhān kāvyān barhiṣadaś tathā |
agniṣvāttāṃś ca saumyāṃś ca viprāṇām eva nirdiśet || 3.199 ||
agnīti | agnidagdhānagnidagdhakāvyabarhiṣadagniṣvāttasaumyākhyān parān pitṝn viprāṇām eva jānīyāt || 3.199 ||
ya ete tu gaṇā mukhyāḥ pitṝṇāṃ parikīrtitāḥ |
teṣām apīha vijñeyaṃ putrapautram anantakam || 3.200 ||
ya iti | ya ete pradhānabhūtāḥ pitṛgaṇā uktās teṣām apīha jagati pitara eva putrapautrā anantā vijñeyāḥ | putrpautram iti “gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca” (Pāṇ. 2.4.11) ity ekavadbhāvaḥ | etacchlokasūcitā eva "varo vareṇyaḥ" ityādayo 'nye 'pi pitṛgaṇā mārkaṇḍeyādiputrāṇādiṣu śrūyante || 3.200 ||
ṛṣibhyaḥ pitaro jātāḥ pitṛbhyo devamānavāḥ |
devebhyas tu jagat sarvaṃ caraṃ sthāṇv anupūrvaśaḥ || 3.201 ||
ṛṣibhya iti | ṛṣibhyo marīcyādibhya uktakrameṇa pitaro jātāḥ | pitṛbhyo devamānavā jātāḥ, devebhyaś ca jaṅgamasthāvaraṃ jagat krameṇa jātam | tasmāt somapādiprabhavatvāt svapitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahānāṃ śrāddhe ete pūnajīyāḥ | somapādayo ‘pi pūjitāḥ santaḥ śrāddhaphaladānāya kalpanta iti | prakṛtaś ca pitrādiśrāddhastutyartho ‘yaṃ somapādipitṛgaṇopanyāsaḥ | atha vā āvāhanakāle nijapitrādayo brāhmaṇādibhiḥ somapādirūpeṇa dhyeyāḥ | evaṃ vyavasthājñānam anuṣṭhānaparatā ca syāt || 3.201 ||
rājatair bhājanair eṣām atho vā rajatānvitaiḥ |
vāry api śraddhayā dattam akṣayāyopakalpate || 3.202 ||
rājatair iti | eṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ rūpyamayapātraiḥ rūpyayuktair vā tāmrādipātrair jalam api śraddhayā dattam akṣayasukhahetuḥ saṃpadyate kiṃ punaḥ praśastapāyasādīti || 3.202 ||
devakāryād dvijātīnāṃ pitṛkāryaṃ viśiṣyate |
daivaṃ hi pitṛkāryasya pūrvam āpyāyanaṃ smṛtam || 3.203 ||
deveti | devān uddiśya yat kriyate tad devakāryam | tataḥ pitṛkāryaṃ dvijātīnāṃ viśeṣeṇa kartavyam upadiśyate | anena pitṛśrāddhasya prādhānyam, daivaṃ tatrāṅgam ity āha | etad eva spaṣṭayati – yato daivaṃ karma pitṛkṛtyasya pūrvaṃ sadāpyāyanaṃ paripūrakaṃ smṛtam
|| 3.203 ||
teṣām ārakṣabhūtaṃ tu pūrvaṃ daivaṃ niyojayet |
rakṣāṃsi hi vilumpanti śrāddham ārakṣavarjitam || 3.204 ||
teṣām iti | ārakṣo rakṣā teṣāṃ pitṝṇāṃ rakṣābhūtaṃ daivaṃ viśvedevabrāhmaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ nimantrayet | yasmād rakṣāvarjitaṃ śrāddhaṃ rākṣasā ācchindanti || 3.204 ||
daivādyantaṃ tad īheta pitrādyantaṃ na tad bhavet |
pitrādyantaṃ tv īhamānaḥ kṣipraṃ naśyati sānvayaḥ || 3.205 ||
daiveti | yat evam ataḥ tac chrāddhaṃ daivādyantaṃ daive karmaṇi ādyantāv ārambhāvasāne yasya tat tathā | etenedam uktam – nimantraṇādi sarvaṃ daivapūrvam, visarjanaṃ tu devānāṃ śeṣe | ata eva devalaḥ |
yat tatra kriyate karma paitṛke brāhmaṇān prati |
tat sarvaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ vaiśvadevikapūrvakam ||
yat tu tac chrāddhaṃ pitrupakramāvasānaṃ pitrādyantam, tad anutiṣthan sasaṃtānaḥ śīghraṃ vinaśyati || 3.205 ||
śuciṃ deśaṃ viviktaṃ ca gomayenopalepayet |
dakṣiṇāpravaṇaṃ caiva prayatnenopapādayet || 3.206 ||
śucim iti | asthyaṅgārādyanupahataṃ deśaṃ nirjanaṃ ca gomayenopalepayet | dakṣiṇādigavanataṃ ca prayatnataḥ saṃpādayet || 3.206 ||
avakāśeṣu cokṣeṣu nadītīreṣu caiva hi |
vivikteṣu ca tuṣyanti dattena pitaraḥ sadā || 3.207 ||
aveti | cokṣāḥ svabhāvaśucayo ‘raṇyādipradeśās teṣu, nadyāditīreṣu, tathā nirjanapradeśeṣu dattena śrāddhādinā sarvadā pitaras tuṣyanti || 3.207 ||
āsaneṣūpakḷpteṣu barhiṣmatsu pṛthak pṛthak |
upaspṛṣṭodakān samyag viprāṃs tān upaveśayet || 3.208 ||
āsaneṣv iti | tatra ca deśe āsaneṣu pṛthak pṛthag vinyasteṣu sakuśeṣu prāg āmantritabrāhmaṇān samyak kṛtasnānācamanān upaveśayet | atra devabrāhmaṇāsane kuśadvayam, pitrāsaneṣu ca pratyekaṃ dakṣiṇāgra ekaḥ kuśo deyaḥ | tad āha devalaḥ |
ye cātra viśvedevānāṃ viprāḥ pūrvanimantritāḥ |
prāṅmukhāny āsanāny eṣāṃ dvidarbhopahitāni ca ||
dakṣiṇāmukayuktāni pitṝṇām āsanāni ca |
dakṣiṇāgraikadarbhāṇi prokṣitāni tilodakaiḥ ||
dakṣināmukhayuktāni dakṣiṇāgrāni | agraṃ kāṇḍamūlāpekṣayā || 3.208 ||
upaveśya tu tān viprān āsaneṣv ajugupsitān |
gandhamālyaiḥ surabhibhir arcayed devapūrvakam || 3.209 ||
upeti | tān viprān āmantritān āsaneṣūpaveśya kuṅkumādigandhamālyadhūpādibhiḥ spṛhaṇīyagandhair devapūrvakam arcayet || 3.209 ||
teṣām udakam ānīya sapavitrāṃs tilān api |
agnau kuryād anujñāto brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 3.210 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ brāhmaṇanām arghodakapavitratilān saṃmiśrān kṛtvā tair brāhmaṇaiḥ sahānujñāto ‘gnau vakṣyamāṇaṃ homaṃ kuryāt | anujñāsāmarthyāc ca prārthanāpi pūrvaṃ kartavyā | sā ca svagṛhyānusāreṇa karavāṇi kariṣya ityādikā | anujñāpi om ity evaṃrūpā kuruṣveti vā || 3.210 ||
agneḥ somayamābhyāṃ ca kṛtvāpyāyanam āditaḥ |
havirdānena vidhivat paścāt saṃtarpayet pitṝn || 3.211 ||
agner iti | agneḥ somayamayoś ca vidhivat paryukṣaṇādipūrvaṃ havirdānena prīṇanam ādau kṛtvā paścād annādinā pitṝṃs tarpayet | somayamayor dvandvanirdeśe ‘pi pṛtag eva devatātvam, sahādiśabdaprayogābhāvāt | yatra sāhityaṃ vivakṣitaṃ tatra sahādiśabdaṃ karotīty uktaṃ prāk || 3.211 ||
agnyabhāve tu viprasya prāṇāv evopapādayet |
yo hy agniḥ sa dvijo viprair mantradarśibhir ucyate || 3.212 ||
agnyabhāve tv iti | agnyabhāve punar brāhmaṇahasta evoktāhutitrayaṃ dadyāt | yasmād ya evāgniḥ sa eva brāhmaṇa iti vedavidbhir brāhmaṇair uktaḥ | agnyabhāvaś cānupanītasya saṃbhavati | upanītasya samāvṛttasya ca pāṇigrahaṇāt pūrvam, mṛtabhāryasya vā || 3.212 ||
akrodhanān suprasādān vadanty etān purātanān |
lokasyāpyāyane yuktāñ chrāddhadevān dvijottamān || 3.213 ||
akrodhaneti | krodhaśūnyān suprasādān prasannamukhān pravāhanāditayā purātanān “agnau prāstāhutiḥ” (3.76) iti nyāyena lokavṛddhaya udyuktān śrāddhapātrabhūtān manvādayo vadanti | tasmād devatulyatvāc chrāddhaṃ brāhmaṇasya haste dātavyam iti pūrvavidhyanuvādaḥ || 3.213 ||
apasavyam agnau kṛtvā sarvam āvṛtya vikramam |
apasavyena hastena nirvaped udakaṃ bhuvi || 3.214 ||
apeti | agnau paryukṣaṇādyaṅgam uktaṃ agnaukaraṇahomānuṣṭhānakramam apasavyaṃ dakṣiṇasaṃsthaṃ kṛtvā tato ‘pasavyena dakṣiṇahastena piṇḍādhārabhūtāyāṃ bhuvy udakaṃ kṣipet || 3.214 ||
trīṃs tu tasmād dhaviḥśeṣāt piṇḍān kṛtvā samāhitaḥ |
audakenaiva vidhinā nirvaped dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 3.215 ||
trīn iti | tasmād agnyādihomād uddhṛtād annād uddhṛtāvaśiṣṭāṃs trīn piṇḍān kṛtvā audakenaiva vidhinā dakṣiṇahastena samāhito ‘nanyamanā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ “teṣu darbheṣu” (3.216) iti vakṣyamāṇatvād dharbheṣu dadyāt || 3.215 ||
nyupya piṇḍāṃs tatas tāṃs tu prayato vidhipūrvakam |
teṣu darbheṣu taṃ hastaṃ nimṛjyāl lepabhāginām || 3.216 ||
nyupeti | vidhipūrvakaṃ savgṛhyoktavidhinā darbheṣu tān daṇḍān [Dave: piṇḍān] datvā “darbhamūleṣu karāvagharṣaṇam” iti viṣṇuvacanāc ca (ViDh 73.22) teṣu darbheṣu mūladeśe hastaṃ nirlepaṃ kuryāt prapitāmahapitrādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ lepabhujāṃ tṛptaye || 3.216 ||
ācamyodakparāvṛtya trir āyamya śanair asūn |
ṣaḍṛtūṃś ca namaskuryāt pitṝn eva ca manravit || 3.217 ||
ācamyeti | anantaram upaspṛśyodaṅmukho bhūtvā yathāśakti prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā “vasantāya namas tubhyam” ityādinā ṣaḍṛtūn namaskuryāt pitṝṃś ca “namo vaḥ pitara” ityādimantrayuktam “abhiparyāvṛtya” (gṛ. sū. 4.8) iti gṛhyadarśanād dakṣiṇāmukho namaskuryāt || 3.217 ||
udakaṃ ninayec cheṣaṃ śanaiḥ piṇḍāntike punaḥ |
avajighrec ca tān piṇḍān yathānyuptān samāhitaḥ || 3.218 |
udakam iti | piṇḍadānāt pūrvaṃ piṇḍādhāradeśadattodakaśeṣam udakapātrasthaṃ pratipiṇḍasamīpadeśe krameṇa punar utsṛjet | tāṃś ca piṇḍān yathānyuptān yenaiva krameṇa dattāṃs tenaiva krameṇāvajighret | samāhito ‘nanyamanaḥ || 3.218 ||
piṇḍebhyas tv alpikāṃ mātrāṃ samādāyānupūrvaśaḥ |
tenaiva viprān āsīnān vidhivat pūrvam āśayet || 3.219 ||
piṇḍebhya iti | alpikety annālpamātrā avayavabhāgāḥ piṇḍeṣūtpannān alpabhāgān piṇḍakrameṇaiva gṛhītvā tenaiva pitrādibrāhmaṇān bhojanakāle bhojanāt pūrvaṃ bhojayet | vidhivat piṇḍānuṣṭhānavat pitaram uddiśya yaḥ piṇḍo dattas tadavayavaṃ pitṛbrāhmaṇaṃ bhojayet | evaṃ pitāmahaprapitāmahapiṇḍayor api || 3.219 ||
dhriyamāṇe tu pitari pūrveṣām eva nirvapet |
vipravad vāpi taṃ śrāddhe svakaṃ pitaram āśayet || 3.220 ||
dhriyamāne tv iti | dhriyamāṇe jīvati pitari mṛtānāṃ pitāmahāditrayāṇāṃ śrāddhaṃ kartavyam | atha vā pitṛviprasthāne tam eva svapitaraṃ bhojayet | pitāmahaprapitāmahayoś ca brāhmaṇau bhojayet piṇḍadvayaṃ ca dadyāt || 3.220 ||
pitā yasya nivṛttaḥ syāj jīvec cāpi pitāmahaḥ |
pituḥ sa nāma saṃkīrtya kīrtayet prapitāmaham || 3.221 ||
piteti | nāmakīrtanam atra śrāddhopalakṣaṇārtham | pitṛjīvanāpekṣo ‘yaṃ vā śabdaḥ | yasya punaḥ pitā mṛtaḥ syāt pitāmahe jīvati sa pitṛprapitāmahayoḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt | govindarājas tu “‘yasya pitṛprapitāmahau pretau syātāṃ sa pitre piṇḍaṃ nidhāya pitāmahāt paraṃ dvābhyāṃ dadyād’ iti viṣṇuvacanāt prapitāmahatatpitṛbhyāṃ dadyāt” iti vyākhyātavān || 3.221 ||
pitāmaho vā tacchrāddhaṃ bhuñjītety abravīn manuḥ |
kāmaṃ vā samanujñātaḥ svayam eva samācaret || 3.222 ||
pitāmaha iti | yathā jīvatpitā bhojyas tathā pitāmaho ‘pi pitāmahabrāhmaṇasthāne bhojyaḥ | pitṛprapitāmahayoś ca brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ ca kuryāt | atha vā jīvatā pitāmahena “tvam eva yathāruci kuru” iti dattānujñaḥ svarucyā pitāmahaṃ vā bhojayet | pitṛpitāmahayor vā śrāddhadvayaṃ kuryād iti viṣṇuvacanāt pitṛprapitāmahavṛddhaprapitāmahnāṃ śrāddhatrayaṃ kuryāt || 3.222 ||
teṣāṃ datvā tu hasteṣu sapavitraṃ tilodakam |
tatpiṇḍāgraṃ prayaccheta svadhaiṣām astv iti bruvan || 3.223 ||
teṣām iti | “piṇḍebhyas tv alpikāṃ mātrām” (3.219) iti yad uktaṃ tasyāyaṃ kālavidhiḥ | pradeyavidhiś ca teṣāṃ brāḥmaṇānāṃ hasteṣu sadarbhatilodakaṃ datvā tad iti pūrvanirdiṣṭaṃ “pitre svadhāstu” ity evamādi bruvan pitrādibrāhmaṇebhyas tribhyaḥ krameṇa dadyāt || 3.223 ||
pāṇibhyāṃ tūpasaṃgṛhya svayam annasya vardhitam |
viprāntike pitṝn dhyāyañ śanakair upanikṣipet || 3.224 ||
pāṇibhyām iti | annasyeti tṛtīyārthe ṣaṣṭhī | vardhitaṃ pūrṇaṃ piṭharādipātraṃ svayaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ gṛhītvā pitṝṃś ca cintayan rasavanty agārād ānīya brāhmaṇānāṃ samīpe pariveṣaṇārtham atvarayā sthāpayet || 3.224 ||
ubhayor hastayor muktaṃ yad annam upanīyate |
tad vipralumpanty asurāḥ sahasā duṣṭacetasaḥ || 3.225 ||
ubhayor iti | adhikaraṇasaptamīyam | ubhayoḥ karayor muktam asthitaṃ yad annaṃ brāhmaṇāntikam ānīyate tad asurā duṣṭabuddhaya ācchindanti tasmān naikahasenānīya pariveṣṭavyam || 3.225 ||
guṇāṃś ca sūpaśākādyān payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu |
vinyaset prayataḥ pūrvaṃ bhūmāv eva samāhitaḥ || 3.226 ||
gunān iti | guṇān vyañjanāni, annāpekṣayāprādhānyād guṇayuktān vā sūpaśākādyān prayataḥ śuciḥ samāhitaḥ ananyamanāḥ samyak yathā na viśīryanti tathā bhūmāv eva svapātrasthāne sthāpayen na dāruphalakādau || 3.226 ||
bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca vividhaṃ mūlāni ca phalāni ca |
hṛdyāni caiva māṃsāni pānāni surabhīṇi ca || 3.227 ||
bhakṣyam iti | bhakṣyaṃ kharaviśadam abhyavaharaṇīyaṃ modakādi, bhojyaṃ pāyasādi, nānāprakāraphalamūlāni, hṛdayasya priyāṇi māṃsāni, pānāni sugandhīni bhūmāv eva vinyased iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ || 3.227 ||
upanīya tu tat sarvaṃ śanakaiḥ susamāhitaḥ |
pariveṣayet prayato guṇān sarvān pracodayan || 3.228 ||
upeti | etat sarvam annādikaṃ brāhmaṇasamīpam ānīya prayataḥ śucir ananyamanāḥ krameṇa pariveṣayet | idaṃ madhuram idam amlam ity evaṃ mādhuryādiguṇān kathayan || 3.228 ||
nāsram āpātayej jātu na kupyen nānṛtaṃ vadet |
na pādena spṛśed annaṃ na caitad avadhūnayet || 3.229 ||
nāsram iti | rodankrodhamṛṣābhāṣaṇāni na kuryāt | pādena cānnaṃ na spṛśet | na cotkṣipyotkṣipyānnaṃ pātre kṣipet | puruṣārthatayā pratiṣiddhayor api krodhānṛtayoḥ śrāddhāṅgatvajñāpanārtho ‘yaṃ niṣedhaḥ || 3.229 ||
asraṃ gamayati pretān kopo ‘rīn anṛtaṃ śunaḥ |
pādasparśas tu rakṣāṃsi duṣkṛtīn avadhūnanam || 3.230 ||
asram iti | aśru kriyamāṇaṃ pretān bhūtaviśeṣān śrāddhānnāni prāpayati na pitṝṇām upakāraṃ bhavati, krodhaḥ śatrūn, mṛṣāvādaḥ kukkurān, pādasparśo ‘nnasya rākṣasān, avadhūnanaṃ pāpakāriṇaḥ | tasmān na rodanādi kuryāt || 3.230 ||
yad yad roceta viprebhyas tat tad dadyād amatsaraḥ |
brahmodyāś ca kathāḥ kuryāt pitṝṇām etad īpsitam || 3.231 ||
yad yad iti | yad yad viprāṇām īpsitam annavyañjanādi tat tad amatsaro dadyāt | paramātmanirūpaṇaparāḥ kathāś ca kuryāt | yataḥ pitṝṇām etad apekṣitam || 3.231 ||
svādhyāyaṃ śrāvayet pitrye dharmaśāstrāṇi caiva hi |
ākhyānānītihāsāṃś ca purāṇāni khilāni ca || 3.232 ||
svādhyāyam iti | svādhyāyaṃ vedam, mānavādīni dharmaśāstrāṇi, ākhyānāni sauparṇamaitrāvaruṇādīni, itihāsān mahābhāratādīn, purāṇāni brahmapurāṇādīni, khilāni śrīsūktaśivasaṃkalpādīni śrāddhe brāhmaṇān śrāvayet || 3.232 ||
harṣayed brāhmaṇāṃs tuṣto bhojayec ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
annādyenāsakṛc caitān guṇaiś ca paricodayet || 3.233 ||
harṣayed iti | svayaṃ hṛṣṭo bhūtvā priyavacanādibhir brāhmaṇān paritoṣayet | annaṃ cātvarayā bhojayet | miṣṭānnena pāyasādibhiḥ “pāyasam idaṃ svādu, modako ‘yaṃ hṛdyo gṛhyatām” ityādiguṇābhidhānaiḥ punar brāhmaṇān prerayet || 3.233 ||
vratastham api dauhitraṃ śrāddhe yatnena bhojayet |
kutapaṃ cāsane dadyāt tilaiś ca vikiren mahīm || 3.234 ||
vrateti | brahmacāriṇam api dauhitraṃ śrāddhe prayatnato bhojayet | apiśabdād abrahmacāriṇam api | ānukalpikamadhyapaṭhitasyāpi brahmacāriṇo yatnavacanāc chreṣṭhatvaṃ kathayati dauhitram antareṇāpi | nepālakambalaṃ cāsane dadyāt | tilāṃś ca śrāddhabhūmau vikiret || 3.234 ||
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutapas tilāḥ |
trīṇi cātra praśaṃsanti śaucam akrodham atvarām || 3.235 ||
trīṇīti | pūrvoktany eva trīṇi dauhitrādīni śrāddhe pavitrāṇīti jñāpyante | trīṇi ca śaucādīni praśaṃsanti || 3.235 ||
atyuṣṇaṃ sarvam annaṃ syād bhuñjīraṃs te ca vāgyatāḥ |
na ca dvijātayo brūyur dātrā pṛṣṭā havirguṇān || 3.236 ||
atyuṣṇam iti | uṣṇam evātyuṣṇam, yasyoṣṇasyānnāder bhojanam ucitaṃ tad uṣṇaṃ dadyān na tu phalādy api | ata eva śaṅkhaḥ (śaṃ. smṛ. 14.12–13) |
uṣṇam annaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ śrāddhayā vinivedayet |
anyatra phalamūlebhyaḥ pānakebhyaś ca paṇḍitāḥ ||
saṃyatavācaś ca brāhmaṇā aśnīyuḥ | “kim idaṃ svādv asvādu vā” iti dātrānnādiguṇān pṛṣṭā vakrādyabhinayenāpi na brūyuḥ, vāgyatatvasyātraiva vidhānāt || 3.236 ||
yāvad uṣṇaṃ bhavaty annaṃ yāvad aśnanti vāgyatāḥ |
pitaras tāvad aśnanti yāvan noktā havirguṇāḥ || 3.237 ||
yāvad iti | yāvad anne uṣṇatā bhavati, yāvac ca maunino bhuñjate, yāvac ca havirguṇā nocyante tāvat pitaro ‘śnantīti pūrvoktasyaivārthasya praśaṃsā || 3.237 ||
yad veṣṭitaśirā bhuṅkte yad bhuṅkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ |
sopānatkaś ca yad bhuṅkte tad vai rakṣāṃsi bhuñjate || 3.238 ||
yad iti | vastrādiveṣṭitaśirā yad annaṃ bhuṅkte, tathā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ, sapādukaś ca tad rākṣasā bhuñjate, na pitaraḥ | tasmād evaṃrūpaṃ na kartavyam || 3.328 ||
cāṇḍālaś ca varāhaś ca kukkuṭaḥ śvā tathaiva ca |
rajasvalā ca ṣaṇḍhaś ca nekṣerann aśnato dvijān || 3.239 ||
cāṇḍāla iti | cāṇḍālagrāmyasūkarakukkuṭakukkurodakyānapuṃsakā yathā brāhmaṇān bhojanakāle na paśyeyus tathā kāryam || 3.239 ||
home pradāne bhojye ca yad ebhir abhivīkṣyate |
daive haviṣi pitrye vā tad gacchaty ayathātatham || 3.240 ||
homa iti | yasmād dhome ‘gnihotrādau, pradāne gohiraṇyādau, bhojye svābhyudayārthaṃ brāhmaṇabhojane, daive haviṣi darśapaurṇamāsādau, pitrye śrāddhādau, yad ebhir vīkṣyate kriyamāṇaṃ karma tad yadarthaṃ kriyate tan na sādhayati || 3.240 ||
ghrāṇena sūkaro hanti pakṣavātena kukkuṭaḥ |
śvā tu dṛṣṭinipātena sparśenāvaravarṇajaḥ || 3.241 ||
ghrāṇeneti | sūkaras tadannāder gandhaṃ ghrātvā karma niṣphalaṃ karoti, tasmād annaghrāṇayogyadeśān nirasanīyaḥ | kukkuṭaḥ pakṣavātena so ‘pi pakṣapāvanayogyadeśād apagamanīyaḥ | śvā darśanena, śuno ‘nnādidarśanaṃ niṣiddham api doṣabhūyastvajñāpanārthaṃ punar abhihitam | atha vā dṛṣṭinipāteneti śrāddhakartṛbhoktṝṇāṃ dṛṣṭinipātaviṣayatvena | avaravarṇaḥ śūdras tasmāj jāto ‘varavarṇajaḥ śūdra eva | asāv annādisparśena dvijātiśrāddhaṃ niṣphalayati || 3.241 ||
khañjo vā yadi vā kāṇo dātuḥ preṣyo ‘pi vā bhavet |
hīnātiriktagātro vā tam apy apanayet punaḥ || 3.242 ||
khañjo veti | yadi gativikalaḥ kāṇo vā dātur dāsaḥ śūdras tasyaiva preṣyatvavidhānāt | apiśabdād anyo ‘pi śūdro nyūnādhikāṅgulyādir vā syāt tadā tam api tataḥ śrāddhadeśād apasārayet || 3.242 ||
brāḥmaṇaṃ bhikṣukaṃ vāpi bhojanārtham upasthitam |
brāhmaṇair abhyanujñātaḥ śaktitaḥ pratipūjayet || 3.243 ||
brāhmaṇam iti | brāhmaṇam atithirūpaṃ anyaṃ vā bhakṣaṇaśīlaṃ bhojanārthaṃ tatkālopasthitaṃ śrāddhapātrabrahmaṇair anujñāto yathāśakty annabhojanena bhikṣādānena cārhayet || 3.243 ||
sārvavarṇikam annādyaṃ sannīyāplāvya vāriṇā |
samutsṛjed bhuktavatām agrato vikiran bhuvi || 3.244 ||
sārveti | varṇaśabdaḥ prakāravācī | sarvaprakārakam annādikaṃ vyañjanādibhir ekīkṛtyodakenāplāvayitvā kṛtabhojanānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ purato bhūmau “darbheṣu vikiraś ca yaḥ” (3.245) iti vakṣyamāṇatvād darbhopari nikṣipet tyajet || 3.244 ||
asaṃskṛtapramītānāṃ tyāgināṃ kulayoṣitām |
ucchiṣṭaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ syād dharbheṣu vikiraś ca yaḥ || 3.245 ||
asaṃskṛteti | “nāsya kāryo ‘gnisaṃskāraḥ” (5.69) iti niṣedhāt saṃskārānarhabālānāṃ tathā kulastrīṇām adṛṣṭadoṣāṇāṃ ye tyaktāras teṣāṃ pātrastham ucchiṣṭaṃ darbheṣu ca yo vikiraḥ sa bhāgaḥ syāt | anye tu tyāginām iti gurvādityāgināṃ, kulayoṣitām iti svātantryeṇa tu kulayoṣitām anūḍhakanyānām iti vyācakṣate | govindarājas tu “tyāgināṃ kulayoṣitām iti sāmānyopakramād idaṃ viśeṣābhidhānam, “saṃskṛtaṃ bhakṣāḥ” (Pāṇ 4.2.16) itivat; tataḥ svakulaṃ tyaktvā gatānāṃ kulastrīṇām” ity āha || 3.245 ||
uccheṣaṇaṃ bhūmigatam ajihmasyāśaṭhasya ca |
dāsavargasya tat pitrye bhāgadheyaṃ pracakṣate || 3.246 ||
uccheṣaṇam iti | ucchiṣṭaṃ yad bhūmigataṃ tad dāsasamūhasyāvakrasyānalasasyākuṭilasya ca pitrye śrāddhakarmaṇi bhāgadheyaṃ manvādayo vadanti || 3.246 ||
ā sapiṇḍakriyākarma dvijāteḥ saṃsthitasya tu |
adaivaṃ bhojayec chrāddhaṃ piṇḍam ekaṃ ca nirvapet || 3.247 ||
ā sapiṇḍeti | maryādāyām āṅ nābhividhau | sapiṇḍīkaraṇaśrāddhaparyantam aciramṛtasya dvijāteś ca vaisvadevabrāhmaṇabhojanarahitaṃ śrāddhārtham annaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayet, ekaṃ ca piṇḍaṃ dadyāt | asya ca śrāddhānuṣṭhānam,
ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnam ekārghaikapavitrakam |
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇarahitaṃ hy apasavyavat || [YDh 1.251]
iti yājñavalkyādismṛtiṣv avagantavyam || 3.247 ||
sahapiṇḍakriyāyāṃ tu kṛtāyāmasya dharmataḥ |
anayaivāvṛtā kāryaṃ piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ sutaiḥ || 3.248 ||
saheti | asyeti yasyedam ekoddiṣṭaṃ vihitaṃ tasya dharmataḥ svagṛhyādividhinā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaśrāddhe kṛte anayaivāvṛtā uktāmāvāsyāśrāddhetikartavyatayā piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ pārvaṇavidhinā śrāddhaṃ putraiḥ sarvatra mṛtāhādau kartavyam | nanu ‘anayaivāvṛtā’ ity anena prakṛtam ekoddiṣṭam eva hi kim iti na parāmṛśyate | ucyate – tarhi sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt pūrvam ekoddiṣṭaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte punar anayaivāvṛteti bhedanirdeśo na syāt | tato ‘māvāsyetikartavyataiva pratīyate || 3.248 ||
śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā ya ucchiṣṭaṃ vṛṣalāya prayacchati |
sa mūḍho narakaṃ yāti kālasūtram avākśirāḥ || 3.249 ||
śrāddham iti | āśritaśūdrāyocchiṣṭadānaprasaktāv ayaṃ niṣedhaḥ | śrāddhabhojanocchiṣṭaṃ yaḥ śūdrāya dadāti sa mūrkhaḥ kālasūtraṃ nāma narakam adhomukhaṃ gacchati || 3.249 ||
śrāddhabhug vṛṣalītalpaṃ tadahar yo ‘dhigacchati |
tasyāḥ purīṣe taṃ māsaṃ pitaras tasya śerate || 3.250 ||
śrāddheti | vṛṣalīśabdo ‘tra strīpara ity āhuḥ | niruktaṃ ca – “kurvanti vṛṣasyantī capalayati bhartāram iti vṛṣalī | brāhmaṇasya pariṇītā brāhmaṇy api vṛṣalī” iti | śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā tadahorātre yaḥ strīsaṃprayogaṃ karoti tasya pitaras tasyāḥ purīṣe taṃ māsaṃ śerate iti nivṛttyarthā nindā || 3.250 ||
pṛṣṭvā svaditam ity evaṃ tṛptān ācāmayet tataḥ |
ācāntāṃś cānujānīyād abhi bho ramyatām iti || 3.251 ||
pṛṣṭveti | tṛptān brāhmaṇān bhudhvā ‘svaditam’ iti pṛṣṭvā teṣām ācamanaṃ kārayet | kṛtācamanāṃś ca bho iti saṃbodhya ‘abhiramyatām’ iti brūyāt | ‘abhitaḥ’ iti pāṭhe abhita ubhayata iha vā svagṛhe vāsyatām ity arthaḥ || 3.251 ||
svadhāstv ity evaṃ taṃ brūyur brāhmaṇās tadanantaram |
svadhākāraḥ parā hy āśīḥ sraveṣu pitṛkarmasu || 3.252 ||
svadheti | anujñānānantaraṃ brāhmaṇāḥ śrāddhakartāraṃ ‘svadhāstu’ iti brūyuḥ | yasmāt sarveṣu śrāddhatarpaṇādipitṛkarmasu svadhāśabdoccāraṇaṃ prakṛṣṭā āśīḥ || 3.252 ||
tato bhuktavatāṃ teṣām annaśeṣaṃ nivedayet |
yathā brūyus tathā kuryād anujñātas tato dvijaiḥ || 3.253 ||
tata iti | svadhāśabdoccāraṇānantaraṃ kṛtabhojanānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śeṣam annam apy astīty avaśiṣṭam annaṃ nivedayet | tair brāhmaṇaiḥ ‘idam anenānnena kriyatām’ ity anujñāto yathā te brūyus tathānnaśeṣaviniyogaṃ kuryāt || 3.253 ||
idānīṃ prasaṅgāc chrāddhāntareṣu viśeṣavidhim āha –
pitrye svaditam ity eva vācyaṃ goṣṭhe tu suśṛtam |
saṃpannam ity abhyudaye daive rucitamity api || 3.254 ||
pitrye iti | pitrye nirapekṣapitṛmātṛdevatāka ekoddiṣṭaśrāddhe tṛptipraśnārthaṃ ‘svaditam’ iti vācyam | tathā ca gobhila-sāṃkhyāyanau ‘svāditam’ iti tṛptipraśnaḥ | medhātithi-govindarājau tu śrāddhakālāgatenānyenāpi svaditam ity eva kartavyam iti vyācakṣatuḥ |
śrāddhe svaditam ity etad vācyam anyena kenacit |
nānuruddham idaṃ vidvadvṛddhair na śraddadhīmahi ||
goṣṭhe goṣṭhīśrāddhe ‘suśṛtam’ iti vācyam | ‘goṣṭhyāṃ śuddhyartham aṣṭamam’ iti dvādaśavidhaśrāddhagaṇanāyāṃ goṣṭhīśrāddham api viśvāmitreṇa paṭhitam | abhyudaye vṛddhiśrāddhe ‘saṃpannam’ iti vācyam | daive devatoddeśena śrāddhe ‘rucitam’ iti vacanīyam | daivaśrāddhaṃ tu bhaviṣyapurāṇoktam |
devān uddiśya yac chrāddhaṃ tat tu daivikam ucyate |
haviṣyeṇa viśiṣṭena saptamyādiṣu yatnataḥ ||
|| 3.254 ||
aparāhṇas tathā darbhā vāstusaṃpādanaṃ tilāḥ |
sṛṣṭir mṛṣṭir dvijāś cāgryāḥ śrāddhakarmasu saṃpadaḥ || 3.255 ||
aparāhṇa iti | amāvāsyāśrāddhasya prakṛtatvāt tadviṣayo ‘yam aparāhṇakālaḥ | ‘prātar vṛddhinimittakam’ [= devala] ityādinā vṛddhiśrāddhādau smṛtyantare prātaḥkālādividhānāt | viṣṭarādyarthā darbhāḥ, gomayādinā śrāddhadeśasaṃśodhanam, tilāś ca vikiraṇādhyarthāḥ, sṛṣṭir akārpaṇyenānnādivisargaḥ, mṛṣṭir annādeś ca saṃskāraviśeṣaḥ, paṅktipāvanādayaś ca brāhmaṇāḥ, etāḥ śrāddhe saṃpattaya ity abhidhānād aṅgāntarāpekṣaṃ prakṛṣṭatvam eṣāṃ bodhitam || 3.255 ||
darbhāḥ pavitraṃ pūrvāhṇo haviṣyāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ |
pavitraṃ yac ca pūrvoktaṃ vijñeyā havyasaṃpadaḥ || 3.256 ||
darbhā iti | pavitraṃ mantrāḥ, pūrvāḥṇaḥ kālaḥ, haviṣyāṇi munyannādīni sarvāṇi ca, yac ca pavitraṃ pāvanaṃ vāstusaṃpādanādi pūrvam uktam, etāś ca devārthasya karmaṇaḥ samṛddhayaḥ | havyaśabdo daivakarmopalakṣaṇārthaḥ || 3.256 ||
munyannāni payaḥ somo māṃsaṃ yac cānupaskṛtam |
akṣāralavaṇaṃ caiva prakṛtyā havir ucyate || 3.257 ||
munyannānīti | muner vānaprasthasyānnāni nīvārādīni, payaḥ kṣīram, somalatārasaḥ, anupaskṛtam avikṛtaṃ pūtigandhādirahitaṃ māṃsam, akṣāralavaṇam akṛttimalavaṇaṃ saindhavādi, etat svabhāvato havir manvādibhir abhidhīyate || 3.257 ||
visṛjya brāhmaṇāṃs tāṃs tu niyato vāgyataḥ śuciḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ diśam ākāṅkṣan yācetemān varān pitṝn || 3.258 ||
visṛjyeti | tān brāhmaṇān visṛjyānanyamanāḥ maunī pavitro dakṣiṇāṃ diśaṃ vīkṣamāṇa etān vakṣyamāṇān abhilaṣitān arghān pitṝn prārthayet || 3.258 ||
dātāro no ‘bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ saṃtatir eva ca |
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamad bahu deyaṃ ca no ‘stv iti || 3.259 ||
dātāra iti | asmatkule dātāraḥ puruṣā vardhantām | vedāś cādhyayanādhyāpanatadarthabodha-tadarthayāgādyanuṣṭhānair vṛddhim āpnuvantu | putrapautrādikaṃ ca vardhatām | vedārthaśraddhā cāsmatkule na vyapaitu | dātavyaṃ ca dhanādikaṃ bahu bhavatu || 3.259 ||
evaṃ nirvapaṇaṃ kṛtvā piṇḍāṃs tāṃs tadanantaram |
gāṃ vipram ajam agniṃ vā prāśayed apsu vā kṣipet || 3.260 ||
evam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇa piṇḍānāṃ pradānaṃ kṛtvā prakṛtavarayācanānantaraṃ tān piṇḍān gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ chāgaṃ vā bhojayet, agnau jale vā kṣipet || 3.260 ||
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kecit purastād eva kurvate |
vayobhiḥ khādayanty anye prakṣipanty anale ‘psu vā || 3.261 ||
piṇḍeti | piṇḍapradānaṃ kecid ācāryāḥ brāhmaṇabhojanānantaraṃ kurvate | anye pakṣibhiḥ piṇḍān khādayanti | iyaṃ ca pakṣibhojanarūpā pratipattir agnyudakaprakṣepayor vaikalpikīti darśayitum uktayor apy abhidhānam || 3.261 ||
pativratā dharmapatnī pitṛpūjanatatparā |
madhyamaṃ tu tataḥ piṇḍam adyāt samyak sutārthinī || 3.262 ||
pativrateti | dharmārthakāmeṣu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ patir eva mayā paricaraṇīya iti vrataṃ yasyāḥ sā pativratā, dharmapatnī savarṇā prathamoḍhā śrāddhakriyāyāṃ śraddhāśālinī putrārthinī teṣāṃ piṇḍānāṃ madhyamaṃ pitāmahapiṇḍaṃ bhakṣayet, samyak ‘ādhatta pitaro garbham’ ityādigṛhyoktamantreṇa || 2.262 ||
āyuṣmantaṃ sutaṃ sūte yaśomedhāsamanvitam |
dhanavantaṃ prajāvantaṃ sāttvikaṃ dhārmikaṃ tathā || 3.263 ||
āyuṣmantam iti | tena piṇḍabhakṣaṇena dīrghāyuṣaṃ kīrtidhāraṇātmakabuddhiyuktaṃ dhanaputrādisaṃtatidharmānuṣṭhānasattvākhyaguṇānvitaṃ putraṃ janayati || 3.263 ||
prakṣālya hastāv ācamya jñātiprāyaṃ prakalpayet |
jñātibhyaḥ satkṛtaṃ datvā bāndhavān api bhojayet || 3.264 ||
prakṣālyeti | tad anu hastau prakṣālya jñātiprāyam annaṃ kuryāt | jñātīn praiti gacchatīti jñātiprāyam | karmaṇyam | jñātīn bhojayed ity arthaḥ | tebhyaḥ pūjāpūrvakam annaṃ datvā mātṛpakṣān api sārhaṇaṃ bhojayet || 3.264 ||
uccheṣaṇaṃ tu tat tiṣṭhed yāvad viprā visarjitāḥ |
tato gṛhabaliṃ kuryād iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || 3.265 ||
uccheṣaṇam iti | td brāhmaṇocchiṣṭaṃ tāvatkālaṃ tiṣṭhet yāvad brāhmaṇānāṃ visarjanam, brāhmaṇeṣu tu nirgateṣu mārṣṭavyam ity arthaḥ | tataḥ saṃpanne śrāddhakarmaṇi vaiśvadevabalihomakarmanityaśrāddhātithibhojanāni kartavyāni, baliśabdasya pradarśaṇārthatvāt | ata eva matsyapurāṇe –
nivṛtya pratipattyarthaṃ paryukṣyāgniṃ ca mantravit |
vaiśvadevaṃ prakurvīta naityakaṃ vidhim eva ca || iti |
|| 3.265 ||
yaiś cānnair iti pūrvam uktam api vyavadhānād abuddhisthaṃ śiṣyasukhapratipattaye punar vaktavyatayā pratijānīte –
havir yac cirarātrāya yac cānantyāya kalpate |
pitṛbhyo vidhivad dattaṃ tat pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ || 3.266 ||
havir iti | cirarātrāyapadam avyayaṃ cirakālavāci | ata eva ‘cirāya cirarātrāya cirasyādyāś cirārthakāḥ’ ity abhidhānikāḥ | yad yad dhaviḥ pitṛbhyo yathāvidhi dattaṃ cirakālatṛptaye ‘nantatṛptaye ca saṃpadyate tan niḥśeṣeṇābhidhāsyāmi || 3.266 ||
tilair vrīhiyavair māṣair adbhir mūlaphalena vā |
dattena māsaṃ tṛpyanti vidhivat pitaro nṛṇām || 3.267 ||
tilair iti | tiladhānyayavamāṣajalamūlaphalānām anyatamena yathāśāstraṃ śraddhayā dattena manuṣyāṇāṃ māsaṃ pitaras tṛpyanti |
kṛṣṇā māṣās tilāś caiva śreṣṭhāḥ syur yavaśālayaḥ |
iti vāyupurāṇavacanān māṣair iti kṛṣṇamāṣā boddhavyāḥ || 3.268 ||
dvau māsau matsyamāṃsena trīn māsān hāriṇena tu |
aurabhreṇātha caturaḥ śākunenātha pañca vai || 3.268 ||
dvāv iti | pāṭhīnādimatsyānāṃ māṃsena dvau māsau pitaraḥ prīyanta iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ | trīn māsān hāriṇena māṃsena, caturo meṣamāṃsena, pañca dvijātibhakṣyapakṣimāṃsent
|| 3.268 ||
ṣaṇmāsāṃś chāgamāṃsena pārṣatena ca sapta vai |
aṣṭāv eṇasya māṃsena rauraveṇa navaiva tu || 3.269 ||
ṣaṇmāsān iti | ṣaṇmāsāṃś chāgamāṃsena prīyante, pṛṣataś citramṛgas tanmāṃsena sapta, eṇamāṃsenāṣṭau, rurumāṃsena nava, eṇarurū hariṇajātiviseṣau || 3.269 ||
daśamāsāṃs tu tṛpyanti varāhamahiṣāmiṣaiḥ |
śaśakūrmayos tu māṃsena māsān ekādaśaiva tu || 3.270 ||
daśeti | daśamāsān āraṇyasūkaramahiṣamāṃsais tṛpyanti, ekādaś śaśakacchapamāṃsena
|| 3.270 ||
saṃvatsaraṃ tu gavyena payasā pāyasena ca |
vārdhrīṇasasya māṃsena tṛptir dvādaśavārṣikī || 3.271 ||
saṃvatsaram iti | varṣaṃ punar gobhavakṣīreṇa tatsādhitaudanena ca tuṣyanti, tatraiva pāyasaśabdaprasiddheḥ | vārdhrīṇasasya māṃsena dvādaśavarṣaparyantaṃ pitṛtṛptir bhavati | vārdhrīṇasaś ca nigame vyākhyātaḥ –
tripibaṃ tv indriyakṣīṇaṃ śvetaṃ vṛddham ajāpatim |
vārdhrīṇasaṃ tu taṃ prāhur yājñikāḥ pitṛkarmaṇi ||
nadyādau payaḥ pibato yasya trīṇi jalaṃ spṛśanti karṇau jihvā ca, tribhiḥ pibatīti tripibaḥ
|| 3.271 ||
kālaśākaṃ mahāśalkāḥ khaḍgalohāmiṣaṃ madhu |
ānantyāyaiva kalpyante munyannāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 3.272 ||
kāleti | kālaśākākhyaṃ śākam | mahāśalkāḥ saśalkā iti medhātithiḥ | matsyaviśeṣā iti yujyate, “mahāśalkalino matsyāḥ” iti vacanāt | khaḍgo gaṇḍakaḥ | loho lohitavarṇaś chāga eva, “chāgena sarvalohenānantyam” iti paiṭhīnasivacanāt, tayor āmiśam, madhu mākṣikam, munyannāni nīvārādīny āraṇyāni sarvāṇi, etāny anantatṛptaye saṃpadyante || 3.272 ||
yat kiṃcin madhunā miśraṃ pradadyāt tu trayodaśīm |
tad apy akṣayam eva syād varṣāsu ca maghāsu ca || 3.273 ||
yad iti | ṛtunakṣatratithīnām ayaṃ samuccayaḥ | yat kiṃcid ity aprasiddhaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ varṣākāle maghātrayodaśyāṃ dīyate tad apy akṣayam eva bhavati | trayodaśyā adhikaraṇatve ‘pīpsitatvavivakṣayā prāpyety adhyāhārād vā dvitīyā || 3.273 ||
api naḥ sa kule jāyād yo no dadyāt trayodaśīm |
pāyasaṃ madhusarpirbhyāṃ prākchāye kuñjarasya ca || 3.274 ||
apīti | varṣāsu maghāyuktatrayodaśī pūrvoktā vivakṣitā | tatrāpi –
prauṣṭhapadyām atītāyāṃ maghāyuktāṃ trayodaśīm |
prāpya śrāddhaṃ hi kartavyaṃ madhunā pāyasena ca || (Śaṃ Sm. 14.32)
iti śaṅkhavacanād bhādrakṛṣṇatrayodaśī pūrvatreha ca gṛhyate | pitaraḥ kilaivam āśāsate – api nāma tathāvidhaḥ kaścid asmākaṃ kule bhūyāt yo ‘smabhyaṃ prakṛtāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ tathā tithyantare ‘pi hastinaḥ pūrvāṃ diśaṃ gatāyāṃ chāyāyāṃ maghughṛtasaṃyuktaṃ pāyasaṃ dadyāt | na tu trayodaśīhastichāyayoḥ samuccayaḥ | tathāha viṣṇuḥ –
api jāyeta so ‘smākaṃ kule kaścin narottamaḥ |
prāvṛṭkāle ‘site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
madhuplutena yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pāyasena samācaret |
kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ vāpi prākchāye kuñjarasya ca || iti |
|| 3.274 ||
yad yad dadāti vidhivat samyak śraddhāsamanvitaḥ |
tat tat pitṝṇāṃ bhavati paratrānantam akṣayam || 3.275 ||
yad yad iti | yad yad iti vīpsāyām | sarvam annam apratiṣiddhaṃ yathāśāstraṃ samyagrūpaṃ śraddhāyuktaḥ pitṛbhyo dadāti tad anantakaṃ sarvakālam akṣayam anapacitaṃ paraloke pitṛtṛptaye bhavati | atas tatphalārthinā śraddhayā deyam iti vidhīyate || 3.275 ||
kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau varjayitvā caturdaśīm |
śraddhe praśastās tithayo yathaitā na tathetarāḥ || 3.276 ||
kṛṣṇeti | kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamīm ārabhya caturdaśīṃ tyaktvā śrāddhe yathā tithayaḥ śreṣṭhā mahāphalā na tathaitadanyāḥ pratipadādayaḥ || 3.276 ||
yukṣu kurvan dinarkṣeṣu sarvān kāmān samaśnute |
ayukṣu tu pitṝn sarvān prajāṃ prāpnoti puṣkalām || 3.277 ||
yukṣv iti | dinaśabdo ‘tra tithiparaḥ | yukṣu yugmāsu tithiṣu dvitīyācaturthyādiṣy yugmanakṣatreṣu bharaṇīrohiṇyādiṣu śrāddhaṃ kurvan sarvābhilaṣitān prāpnoti | ayugmāsu tithiṣu pratipattṛtīyāprabhṛtiṣu, ayugmeṣu ca nakṣatreṣv aśvinīkṛttikādiṣu śrāddhen pitṝn pūjayan putrādisaṃtatiṃ labhate puṣkalāṃ dhanavidyāparipuṣṭām || 3.277 ||
yathā caivāparaḥ pakṣaḥ pūrvapakṣād viśiṣyate |
tathā śrāddhasya pūrvāhṇād aparāhṇo viśiṣyate || 3.278 ||
yateti | caitrasitādyā māsā it jyotiḥśāstravidhānāc chuklapakṣopakramatvān māsānām aparaḥ pakṣaḥ, sa yathā śuklapakṣāt śrāddhasya saṃbandhī viśiṣṭaphalado bhavati, evaṃ pūrvārdhadivasād uttarārdhadivasaḥ prakṛṣṭaphalo viśiṣyata iti vacanāt pūrvāhṇe ‘pi śrāddhakartavyatāṃ bodhayati | nanu śuklapakṣād anuktotkarṣasyāparapakṣasya kathaṃ dṛṣṭāntatā? prasiddho hi dṛṣṭānto bhavati | ucyate – “kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau” (3.276) ity atreva viśiṣṭavidhāv utkarṣābhidhānāt || 3.278 ||
prācīnāvītinā samyag apasavyam atandriṇā |
pitryam ā nidhanāt kāryaṃ vidhivad darbhapāṇinā || 3.279 ||
prācīti | dakṣiṇasaṃsthitayajñopavītenānalasena darbhahastena apasavyaṃ pitṛtīrthena yathāśāstraṃ sarvaṃ pitṛsaṃbandhi karma ā nidhanād ā samāpteḥ kartavyam | ā nidhanād yāvajjīvam iti medhātithi-govindarājau || 3.279 ||
rātrau śrāddhaṃ na kurvīta rākṣasī kīrtitā his sā |
saṃdhyayor ubhayoś caiva sūrye caivācirodite || 3.280 ||
rātrāv iti | rātrau śrāddhaṃ na kartavyam | yasmāc chrāddhavināśanaguṇayogād rākṣasī manvādibhir asau kathitā | saṃdhyayoś ca na kuryāt | āditye cācirodite acitroditādityakālaś cāpekṣāyāṃ trimuhūrtaḥ prātaḥ kālo grāhyaḥ | yathoktaṃ viṣṇupurāṇe –
rekhāprabhṛty athāditye trimuhūrtaṃ gate ravau |
prātaḥ tataḥ smṛtaḥ kālo bhāgaḥ so ‘hnas tu pañcamaḥ ||
aparāhṇasya śrāddhāṅgatayā vidhānāt katham ayam aprasaktapratiṣedha iti cen, nāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ | sa hi rāgaprāptasya vā syād vidhiprāptasya vā? nādyaḥ | nātra rāgato nityasya darśaśrāddhasya prāptatvād vidhiprāptasya niṣedhe ṣoḍaśigrahaṇāgrahaṇvad vikalpaḥ syāt | tasmāt paryudāso ‘yam | rātryādiparyudastetarakāle śrāddhaṃ kuryāt | anuyājetarayajatiṣu ‘yeyajāmahe’ iti mantravat | aparāhṇavidhiś ca prāśastyārthaḥ | ata evoktam “yathā śrāddhasya pūrvāhṇād aparāhṇo viśiṣyate” (3.278) iti || 3.380 ||
anena vidhinā śrāddhaṃ trirabdasyeha nirvapet |
hemantagrīṣmavarṣāsu pāñcayajñikam anvaham || 3.281 ||
aneneti | “kuryān māsānumāsikam” (3.122) iti pratimāsaṃ śrāddhaṃ vihitaṃ tadasaṃbhave vidhir yaṃ caturbhir māsaiś caturekaḥ ekas tu ṛtuḥ saṃvatsara itīmaṃ pakṣam āśrityocyate | anenoktavidhānena saṃvatsaramadhye trīn vārān hemanta-grīṣma-varṣāsu śrāddhaṃ kartavyam | tac ca samayācārāt kumbhavṛṣakanyāsthe ‘rke pañcamahāyajñāntargataṃ ca “ekam apy āśayed vipram” (3.83) ity anena vihitaṃ pratyahaṃ kuryād iti tu pūrvoktadārḍhyārtham
|| 3.281 ||
na paitṛyajñiyo homo laukike ‘gnau vidhīyate |
na dharśena vinā śrāddham āhitāgner dvijanmanaḥ || 3.282 ||
na paitriti | “agneḥ somayamābhyāṃ ca” (3.211) ity anena vihitapitṛyajñāṅgabhūto homo na laukike śrautasmārtavyatiriktāgnau śāstreṇa vidhīyate, tasmān na laukikāgnāv agnaukaraṇahomaḥ kartavyaḥ | niragninā tu “agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇau” (3.212) ity abhidhānād viprapāṇyādau karaṇīyaḥ | āhitāgner dvijasya nāmāvasyāvyatirekeṇa kṛṣṇapakṣe daśamyādau śrāddhaṃ vidhīyate | mṛtāhaśrāddhaṃ tu niyatatvāt kṛṣṇapakṣe ‘pi tithyantare na niṣidhyate || 3.282 ||
yad eva tarpayaty adbhiḥ pitṝn snātvā dvijottamaḥ |
tenaiva kṛtsnam āpnoti pitṛyajñakriyāphalam || 3.283 ||
yad iti | pāñcayajñikaśrāddhāsaṃbhave vidhir ayam | yatra snānānantaram udakatarpaṇaṃ dvijaḥ karoti tenaiva sarvaṃ nityaśrāddhaphalaṃ prāpnoti | dvijottamapadaṃ dvijaparam || 3.283 ||
vasūn vadanti tu pitṝn rudrāṃś caiva pitāmahān |
prapitāmahāṃs tathādityāñ chrutir eṣā sanātanī || 3.284 ||
vasūn iti | yasmāt pitrādayo vasvādaya ity eṣām anādibhūtā śrutir asti; ataḥ pitṝn vasvākhyadevān pitāmahān rudrān prapitāmahān ādityān manvādayo vadanti | tataś ca siddhabhodhanavaiyarthyāc chrāddhe pitrādayo vasvādirūpeṇa dhyeyā iti vidhiḥ kalpyate | ata eva paiṭhīnasiḥ: “ya evaṃ vidvān pitṝn yajate vasavo rudrā ādityāś cāsya prītā bhavanti” | medhātithi-govindarājau tu “pitṛdveṣān nāstikyād vā yaḥ pitṛkarmaṇi na pravartate taṃ praty etat pravartanārthaṃ devatātvādhyāropeṇa pitṝṇāṃ stutivacanam” ity ūcatuḥ || 3.284 ||
vighasāśī bhaven nityaṃ nityaṃ vāmṛtabhojanaḥ |
vidhaso bhuktaśeṣaṃ tu yajñaśeṣaṃ tathāmṛtam || 3.285 ||
vighasāśīti | sarvadā vighasabhojanaḥ syāt sarvadā cāmṛtabhojano bhavet | vighasāmṛtapadayor aprasiddhatvād arthaṃ vyākurute | viprādibhuktaśeṣaṃ vighasa ucyate | darśapaurṇamāsādiyajñaśiṣṭaṃ puroḍāśādy amṛtam | sāmānyābhidhāne ‘pi prakṛtatvāc chrāddhe viprabhuktaśeṣabhojanārtho ‘yaṃ vidhiḥ | ata eva,
bhuñjītātithisaṃyuktaḥ sarvaṃ pitṛniṣevitam |
iti smṛtyantaram | atithyādiviśeṣabhojanaṃ tu “avaśiṣṭaṃ tu dampatī” (3.116) ity anenaiva vihitam | tasyaiva yajñaśeṣatulyatvāpādanena stutyarthaṃ punarvacanam iti tu govindarājavyākhyānam anuṣṭhānaviśeṣānarham aprākaraṇikaṃ ca || 3.285 ||
etad vo ‘bhihitaṃ sarvaṃ vidhānaṃ pāñcayajñikam |
dvijātimukhyavṛttīnāṃ vidhānaṃ śrūyatām iti || 3.286 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ tṛtīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
etad iti | idaṃ pañcayajñabhavam anuṣṭhānaṃ sarvaṃ yuṣmākam uktaṃ pārvaṇaśrāddhavyavahitair api pañcayajñair upasaṃhāras teṣām abhyarhitatvajñāpanārthaḥ | maṅgalārtha iti tu medhātithi-govindarājau | idānīṃ dvijānāṃ mukhyo brāhmaṇas tasya vṛttīnām ṛtādīnām anuṣṭhānaṃ śrūyatām iti vakṣyamāṇādhyāyaikadeśopanyāsaḥ || 3.286 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau
tṛtīyo ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
caturtho ‘dhyāyaḥ
śrāddhakalpānantaraṃ “vṛttīnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caiva” (1.113) iti vṛttiṣu vyaktatayā pratijñātāsu vṛtty-adhīnatvād gārhasthyasyānantaraṃ vyaktavyāsu brahmacaryapūrvakam eva gārhasthyaṃ tatraiva cātra vakṣyamāṇā vṛttaya iti darśayituṃ brahmacaryakālaṃ gārhasthyakālaṃ cātra vadati –
caturtham āyuṣo bhāgam uṣitvādyaṃ gurau dvijaḥ |
dvitīyam āyuṣo bhāgaṃ kṛtadāro gṛhe vaset || 4.1 ||
caturtham iti | caturtham āyuṣo bhāgam ādyam ity uktaṃ brahmacaryakālopalakṣaṇārtham, aniyataparmāṇatvād āyuṣaś caturthabhāgasya durjñānatvāt | na ca “śatāyur vai puruṣaḥ” iti śruteḥ pañcaviṃśativarṣaparatvam, “ṣaṭtriṃśadābdikaṃ brahmacaryam” ityādivirodhāt | āśramasamuccayapakṣam āśrito brāhmaṇa uktabrahmacaryakālaṃ janmāpekṣādyaṃ yathāśakti gurukule sthitvā dvitīyam āyaṣaś caturthabhāgaṃ gṛhasthāśramam anutiṣṭhet, “gṛhasthas tu yadā paścet” (6.2) ity aniyatatvāt “dvitīyam āyuṣo bhāgam” ity api gārhasthyakālam eva || 4.1 ||
adroheṇaiva bhūtānām alpadroheṇa vā punaḥ |
yā vṛttis tāṃ samāsthāya vipro jīved anāpadi || 4.2 ||
adroheṇeti | parasyāpīḍā śiloñchāyācitādir adrohaḥ īṣatpīḍā yācitādir alpadrohaḥ na tu hiṃsaiva drohaḥ, tasyā niṣiddhatvāt | adroheṇa tadasaṃbhave ‘lpadroheṇa yā vṛttir jīvanopāyaḥ tadāśrayaṇena bhāryādibhṛtyapañcayajñānuṣṭhānayukto brāhmaṇo na tu kṣatriyādir anāpadi jīvet | āpadi daśame vidhir bhaviṣyati | ayaṃ ca sāmānyopadeśo yājanādhyāpanaviśuddha-pratigrahādisaṃgrahārthaḥ | vakṣyamāṇartādiviśeṣamātraniṣṭhatve saṃkucitasvarasatvahānir anadhikārārthatvaṃ yājanāder vṛttiprakaraṇāniveśaś ca syāt tayāpi jīvet || 4.2 ||
yātrāmātraprasiddhyarthaṃ svaiḥ karmabhir agarhitaiḥ |
akleśena śarīrasya kurvīta dhanasaṃcayam || 4.3 ||
yātreti | yātrā prāṇasthitiḥ śāstrīyakuṭumbasaṃvardhananityakarmānuṣṭhānapūrvaka-prāṇasthitimātrārthaṃ na tu bhogārthaṃ svasaṃbandhitayā śāstravihitārjanarūpaiḥ karmabhir ṛtādivakṣyamāṇaiḥ kāyakleśaṃ vinārthasaṃgrahaṃ kuryāt || 4.3 ||
kaiḥ karmabhir ity atrāha –
ṛtāmṛtābhyāṃ jīvet tu mṛtena pramṛtena vā |
satyānṛtābhyām api vā na śvavṛttyā kadācana || 4.4 ||
ṛtāmṛtābhyām iti | anāpadīty anuvartate | ṛtādibhir anāpadi jīvet | sevayā tv anāpadi kadāpi na varteta || 4.4 ||
aprasiddhatvād ṛtādīni vyācaṣṭe –
ṛtam uñchaśilaṃ jñeyam amṛtaṃ syād ayācitam |
mṛtaṃ tu yācitaṃ bhaikṣaṃ pramṛtaṃ karṣaṇaṃ smṛtam || 4.5 ||
ṛtam uñchaśilam iti | “abādhitasthāneṣu pathi vā kṣetreṣu vāpratihatāvakāśeṣu yatra yatrauṣadhayo vidyante tatra tatrāṅgulibhyāṃ ekaikaṃ kaṇaṃ samuccayitvā” (BDh 3.2.15) iti baudhāyanadarśanāt ekaikadhānyādiguṭakoccayanam uñchaḥ | mañjaryātmakānekadhānyoccayanaṃ śilaḥ | uñchaś ca śilaś cety ekavadbhāvaḥ | tat satyasamānaphalavād ṛtam ity ucyate | ayācitopasthitam amṛtam iva sukhahetutvād amṛtam | prārthite punar bhaikṣaṃ bhikṣāsamūharūpaṃ maraṇasamapīḍājananān mṛtam | etac ca sāgner gṛhasthasya bhaikṣam apakvataṇḍulādirūpaṃ na tu siddhānnaṃ parāgnipakvena svāgnau homābhāvāt | karṣaṇaṃ ca bhūmigatapracuraprāṇimaraṇanimittatvād bahuduḥkhaphalakaṃ prakarṣeṇa mṛtam iva pramṛtam || 4.5 ||
satyānṛtaṃ tu vāṇijyaṃ tena caivāpi jīvyate |
sevā śvavṛttir ākhyātā tasmāt tāṃ parivarjayet || 4.6 ||
satyānṛtaṃ tv iti | prāyeṇa satyānṛtavyavahārasādhyatvāt satyānṛtaṃ vāṇijyam | na tu vāṇijye śāstreṇa satyānṛtābhyām anujñātam | “tena caivāpi jīvyate” iti caśabdena vāṇijyasamaśiṣṭatvāt kusīdam api gṛhyate | pūrvaślokoktā kṛṣir etacchloke ca vāṇijyakusīde | anāpadītyanuvṛtter asvayaṃkṛtāny etāni boddhavyāni | yathāha gautamaḥ (10.1): “kṛṣivāṇijye svayaṃ cākṛte kusīdaṃ ca” | sevā tu dīnadṛṣṭisaṃdarśanasvāmitarjananīcakriyādidharmayogāc chuna iva vṛttir ataḥ śvavṛttir uktā, tasmāt tāṃ prakṛto brāhmaṇas tyajet || 4.6 ||
kusūladhānyako vā syāt kumbhīdhānyaka eva vā |
tryahaihiko vāpi bhaved aśvastanika eva vā || 4.7 ||
kusūladhānyaka iti | “kusūlo vrīhyagāraṃ syāt” ity ābhidhānikāḥ | iṣṭakādinirmitāgāre dhānyasaṃcayo bhavet | atra kālaviśeṣāpekṣāyāṃ,
yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye |
adhikaṃ vāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātum arhati || (11.7)
iti manūktam eva kālo grāhyaḥ | tena nityanaimittikadharmakṛtyapoṣyavargasahitasya gṛhiṇo yāvatā dhānyādidhanena varṣatrayaṃ samadhikaṃ vā nirvāho bhavati tāvaddhanaḥ kusūladhānyaka ucyate | varṣanirvāhocitadhānyādidhanaḥ kumbhīdhānyakaḥ,
prāksaumikīḥ kriyā jñeyā [Dave: kuryād] yasyānnaṃ vārṣikaṃ bhavet ||
(YDh 1.124)
iti yājñavalkyena gṛhasthasya vārṣikasaṃcayābhyanujñānāt | manur api vānaprasthasyaiva “samānicaya eva vā” (6.18) ity anena samānicayaṃ vakṣyati | tadapekṣayā bahupoṣyavargasya gṛhiṇaḥ samucitaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ saṃcayaḥ | medhātithis tu yāvatā dhānyādidhanena bahubhṛtyadārādimatas trisaṃvatsarasthitir bhavati tāvat suvarṇādidhanavān api kusūladhānya ity abhidhāya kumbhī uṣṭrikā ṣāṇmāsikadhānyādinicayaḥ kumbhīdhānyaka iti vyākhyātavān | govindarājas tu kusūladhānyaka ity etad vyācakṣya koṣṭhapramāṇadhānyasaṃcayo vā syāt | dvādaśāhamātraparyāptadhanaḥ kumbhīdhānyaka ity etad vyācaṣṭe | uṣṭrikāpramāṇadhānyādisaṃcayo vā ṣaḍahamātraparyāptadhanaḥ |
dvādaśāhaṃ kusūlena vṛttiḥ kumbhyā dināni ṣaṭ |
imām amūlāṃ govindarājoktiṃ nānurundhmahe ||
īhā ceṣṭā tasyāṃ bhavaṃ aihikam | tryahaparyāptam aihikaṃ dhanaṃ yasya sa tryahaikaḥ tahā vā syāt | dinatrayanirvāhocitadhanam ity arthaḥ | śvo bhavaṃ śvastanaṃ bhaktaṃ tad asyāstīti matvarthīyam ikaṃ kṛtvā nañsamāsaḥ, tathā vā bhavet || 4.7 ||
caturṇām api caiteṣāṃ dvijānāṃ gṛhamedhinām |
jyāyān paraḥ paro jñeyo dharmato lokajittamaḥ || 4.8 ||
caturṇām apīti | eṣāṃ caturṇām api kusūladhānyakādīnāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ madhye yo yaḥ śeṣe paṭhitaḥ sa śreṣṭho jñātavyaḥ | yato ‘sau vṛttisaṃkocadharmeṇa svargādilokajittamo bhavati || 4.8 ||
ṣaṭkarmaiko bhavaty eṣāṃ tribhir anyaḥ pravartate |
dvābhyām ekaś caturthas tu brahmasatreṇa jīvati || 4.9 ||
ṣaṭkarmeti | eṣāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ madhye kaścid gṛhastho yo bahupoṣyavargaḥ sa prakṛtair ṛtāyācitabhaikṣakṛṣivāṇijyaiḥ pañcabhiḥ “tena caiva” (4.6) ity anenaiva caśabdasamuccitena kusīdenety evaṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ karmabhiḥ ṣaṭkarmā bhavati ṣaḍbhir etair jīvati | kṛṣivāṇijyakusīdāny etāny asvayaṃkṛtāni gautamoktānīty uktam (GDh 10.1) | anyaḥ punas tato ‘lpaparikaraḥ tribhir yājanādhyāpanapratigrahaiḥ “adroheṇa” (4.2) ity etacchlokasaṃgṛhītaiḥ pravartate | praśabdo ‘narthako varteta ity arthaḥ | aparaḥ punaḥ “pratigrahaḥ pratyavaraḥ” (10.109) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt tatparityāgena dvābhyāṃ yājanādhyāpanābhyāṃ pravartate | uktatrayāpekṣayā caturthaḥ punar brahmasatreṇādhyāpanena jīvati | medhātithis tu eṣāṃ kusūladhānyakādīnāṃ madhyād ekaḥ kusūladhānyakaḥ prakṛtair uñchaśilāyācitāyācitalābhakṛṣivāṇijyaiḥ ṣaṭkarmā bhavati ṣaḍbhir jīvati | anyo dvitīyaḥ kumbhīdhānyakaḥ kṛṣivāṇijyayor ninditatvāt tattyāga uñchaśilayācitāyācitānāṃ madhyād icchātas tribhir varteta | ekas tryahaihiko yācitalābhaṃ vihāyoñchaśilāyācitānāṃ madhyād icchayā dvābhyāṃ varteta | caturthaḥ punar aśvastaniko brahmasatreṇa jīvati | brahmasatraṃ śiloñchayor anyatarā vṛttiḥ, brahmaṇo brāhmaṇasya satatabhavatvāt satram ity āha || 4.9 ||
vartayaṃś ca śiloñchābhyām agnihotraparāyaṇaḥ |
iṣṭīḥ pārvāyaṇāntīyāḥ kevalā nirvapet sadā || 4.10 ||
vartayaṃś ceti | śiloñchābhyāṃ jīvan dhanasādhyakarmāntarānuṣṭhānāsāmarthyād agnihotraniṣṭha eva syāt | pārvāyaṇāntīyāś ca iṣṭīḥ kevalā anuthiṣṭhet | parva ca ayanaṃ ca parvāyaṇe, tayor anyas tatra bhavā darśapaurṇamāsāgrayanātmikāḥ || 4.10 ||
na lokavṛttaṃ varteta vṛttihetoḥ kathaṃcana |
ajihmām aśaṭhāṃ śuddhāṃ jīved brāhmaṇajīvikām || 4.11 ||
na lokavṛttam iti | lokavṛttam asatpriyākhyānaṃ vicintraparihāsakathādikaṃ jīvikārthaṃ na kuryāt | ajihmāṃ mṛṣātmaguṇārthābhidhānādipāparahitām | aśaṭhāṃ dambhādivyājaśūnyām | śuddhāṃ vaiśyādivṛtter asaṃkīrṇāṃ brāḥmaṇajīvikām anutiṣṭhet | anekārthatvād dhātūnām anuṣṭhānārtho ‘yaṃ jivatir iti sakarmakatā || 4.11 ||
saṃtoṣaṃ param āsthāya sukhārthī saṃyato bhavet |
saṃtoṣamūlaṃ hi sukhaṃ duḥkhamūlaṃ viparyayaḥ || 4.12 ||
saṃtoṣam iti | yathāsaṃbhavabhṛtyātmaprāṇadhāraṇāvaśyakapañcayajñādyanuṣṭhānamātrocita-dhanānadhikā spṛhā saṃtoṣaḥ, tam atiśayitam ālambya pracuradhanārjane saṃyamaṃ kuryāt | yataḥ saṃtoṣahetukam iti sukham, paratra cāvyagrasya vihitānuṣṭhānāt svargādisukham | viparyayas tv asaṃtoṣo dukhamūlaṃ bahudhanārjanaprayāsena pracuraduḥkhād asaṃpattau vipattau ca kleśāt || 4.12 ||
ato ‘nyatamayā vṛttyā jīvaṃs tu snātako dvijaḥ |
svargāyuṣyayaśasyāni vratānīmāni dhārayet || 4.13 ||
ato ‘nyatamayeti | abahubhṛtyasyaikavṛttyā nirvāhasaṃbhave saty anyatamayeti vidhīyate, bahubhṛtyasyānnasaṃbhave “ṣaṭkarmaiko bhavaty eṣām” (4.9) iti vihitatvāt | atha vaikavakyatāvagamād vratavidhāyakatvāc cānyatamayā vṛttyety anuvādakatvād ekatvam avivakṣitam | uktavṛttīnām anyatamayā vṛttyā jīvan snātako brāhmaṇa imāni vakṣyamāṇāni yathāsaṃbhavaṃ svargāyuryaśasāṃ hitāni vratāni kuryāt | ‘idaṃ mayā kartavyam, idaṃ na kartavyam’ ityevaṃvidhasaṃkalpaviśeṣād vratam || 4.13 ||
vedoditaṃ svakaṃ karma nityaṃ kuryād atandritaḥ |
tad dhi kurvan yathāśakti prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 4.14 ||
vedoditam iti | vedoktaṃ smārtam api vedamūlatvād vedoktam eva | svakaṃ svāśramoktaṃ yāvajjīvam atandrito ‘nalasaḥ kuryāt | hir hetau | yasmāt tat kurvan yathāsāmarthyaṃ paramāṃ gatiṃ mokṣalakṣaṇāṃ prāpnoti | nityakarmānuṣthānāt pāpakṣaye sati niṣpāpāntaḥkaraṇena brahmasākṣātkārān mokṣāvāpteḥ | tad uktaṃ mokṣadharme |
jñānam utpadyate puṃsāṃ kṣayāt pāpasya karmaṇaḥ |
tatrādarśatalaprakhye paśyaty ātmānam ātmani ||
ātmany antaḥkareṇe || 4.14 ||
nehetārthān prasaṅgena na viruddhena karmaṇā |
na vidyamāneṣv artheṣu nārtyām api yatas tataḥ || 4.15 ||
nehetārthān iti | prasajyate yatra puruṣaḥ sa prasaṅgo gītavāditrādis tenārthān nārjayet | nāpi śāstraniṣiddhena karmaṇāyājyayājanādinā ca | na ca vidyamāneṣu dhaneṣu | na cāpy avidyamāneṣv api prakārāntarasaṃbhave yatas tataḥ patitādibhyo ‘pi || 4.15 ||
indriyārtheṣu sarveṣu na prasajyeta kāmataḥ |
atiprasaktiṃ caiteṣāṃ manasā saṃnivartayet || 4.16 ||
indriyārtheṣv iti | indriyāṇām arthā rūparasagandhasparśādayas teṣv aniṣiddheṣv api svadārasuratādiṣu na prasajyeta nātiprasaktim atyantasevanātmikāṃ kuryāt | kāmata upabhogārtham | atiprasaktinivṛttyupāyam āha ‘athiprasaktim’ iti | viṣayāṇām asthiratva-svargāpavargātmakaśreyovirodhitvādibhāvanayā manasā samyaṅ nivartayet || 4.16 ||
sarvān parityajed arthān svādhyāyasya virodhinaḥ |
yathātathādhyāpayaṃs tu sā hy asya kṛtakṛtyatā || 4.17 ||
sarvān iti | vedārthavirodhino ‘rthān atyanteśvaragṛhopasarpaṇakṛṣilokayātrādayas tān sarvān parityajet | kathaṃ tarhi bhṛtyātmapoṣaṇam ity āśaṅkyāha ‘yathātathā kenāpy upāyena svādhyāyāvirodhinā bhṛtyātmānau jīvayan | yasmāt sāsya snātakasya kṛtakṛtyatā kṛtārthatā yan nityaṃ svādhyāyaparatā || 4.17 ||
vayasaḥ karmaṇo ‘rthasya śrutasyābhijanasya ca |
veṣavāgbuddhisārūpyam ācaran vicared iha || 4.18 ||
vayasa iti | vayasaḥ kriyāyā dhanasya śrutasya kulasyānurūpeṇa veṣavāgbuddhīr ācaraṃl loke pravarteta | yathā yauvane sraggandhalepanādidhāraṇaṃ trivargānusārī vāgbuddhīś ca evam karmādiṣv apy unneyam || 4.18 ||
buddhivṛddhikarāṇy āśu dhanyāni ca hitāni ca |
nityaṃ śāstrāṇy avekṣeta nigamāṃś caiva vaidikān || 4.19 ||
buddhīti | vedāviruddhāni śīghraṃ buddhivṛddhijanakāni vyākaraṇamīmāṃsāsmṛtipurāṇa-nyāyādīni śāstrāṇi, tathā dhanyāni dhanāya hitāny arthaśāstrāṇi bārhaspatyauśanasādīni, tathā hitāni dṛṣṭopakārakāṇi vaidyakajyotiṣādīni, tathā paryāyakathanena vedārthāvabodhakān nigamākhyāṃś ca granthān nityaṃ paryālocayet || 4.19 ||
yathā yathā hi puruṣaḥ śāstraṃ samadhigacchati |
tathā tathā vijānāti vijñānaṃ cāsya rocate || 4.20 ||
yathā yatheti | yasmād yathā yathā puruṣaḥ śāstraṃ samyag abhyasyati tathā tathā viśeṣeṇa jānāti, śāstrāntaraviṣayam api cāsya vijñānaṃ rocata ujjvalaṃ bhavati | dīptyarthatvād rucer abhilāṣārthatvābhāvāt “rucyarthānāṃ prīyamāṇaḥ” (Pāṇ 1.4.33) iti na saṃpradānasaṃjñā
|| 4.20 ||
ṛṣiyajñaṃ devayajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ ca sarvadā |
nṛyajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ ca yathāśakti na hāpayet || 4.21 ||
ṛṣiyajñam iti | svādhyāyādīn pañcayajñān yathāśakti na tyajet | tṛtīyādhyāyābhihitānām api pañcayajñānām iha nirdeśa uttaratra viśeṣavidhānārthaṃ snātakavratatvabodhanārthaś ca
|| 4.21 ||
etān eke mahāyajñān yajñaśāstravido janāḥ |
anīhamānāḥ satatam indriyeṣv eva juhvati || 4.22 ||
etān eka iti | eke gṛhasthā bāhyāntarayajñānuṣṭhānaśāstrajñā etān pañcamahāyajñān brahmajñānaprakarṣād bahir aceṣṭamānāḥ pañcasu buddhīndriyeṣv evaṃ pañcarūpajñānādisaṃyamaṃ kurvantaḥ saṃpādayanti | yajñānāṃ homatvānupapatteḥ saṃpādanārtho juhotiḥ || 4.22 ||
vācy eke juhvati prāṇaṃ prāṇe vācaṃ ca sarvadā |
vāci prāṇe ca paśyanto yajñanirvṛttim akṣayām || 4.23 ||
vācīti | eke gṛhasthā brahmavido vāci prāṇavayau ca yajñanirvṛttim akṣayaphalāṃ jānantaḥ satataṃ vāci prāṇaṃ ca juhvati | vācaṃ ca prāṇe, bhāṣamāṇena ca vāci prāṇaṃ juhotīti | abhāṣamāṇenocchvāsatā prāṇe vācaṃ juhomīti vyākhyātavyam ity anena vidhīyate | yathā kauṣītakirahasyabrāhmaṇam (2.4.1) –]
yāvad vai puruṣo bhāṣate na tāvat prāṇituṃ śaknoti prāṇaṃ tadā vāci juhoti, yāvad dhi puruṣaḥ prāṇiti na tāvad bhāṣituṃ śaknoti vācaṃ tadā prāṇe juhoti, ete ‘nante amṛte āhutī jāgrat svapnaṃś ca satataṃ juhoti | atha vā anyā āhutayo ‘nantaranyastāḥ karmamayyo hi bhavanty evaṃ hi tasyaitat pūrve vidvāṃso ‘gnihotraṃ na juhavāṃcakruḥ |
iti || 4.23 ||
jñānenaivāpare viprā yajanty etair makhaiḥ sadā |
jñānamūlāṃ kriyām eṣāṃ paśyanto jñānacakṣuṣā || 4.24 ||
jñānenaiveti | apare viprā brahmaniṣṭhāḥ sarvathā brahmajñānenaivaitair makhair yajanti | etāṃś ca yajñān anutiṣthanti | katham etad ity āha – jñānaṃ brahma “satyaṃ jñānam anantam” (Tait Up. 2.1.1) ityādiśrutiṣu prasiddham | jñānamūlām eṣāṃ jñānānāṃ kriyām utpattiṃ jānantaḥ jñāyate ‘neneti jñānaṃ cakṣur iva cakṣuḥ jñānacakṣuṣopaniṣadā “sarvaṃ khalv idaṃ brahma tajjalān” (Ch. Up. 6.2.3) ityādikayā pañcayajñān api brahmotpattikāle brahmātmakān dhyāyantaḥ saṃpādayati | pañcayajñaphalam aśnuvata ity arthaḥ | ślokatrayeṇa brahmaniṣṭhānāṃ vedasaṃnyāsināṃ gṛhasthānām amī vidhayaḥ || 4.24 ||
agnihotraṃ ca juhuyād ādyante dyuniśoḥ sadā |
darśena cārdhamāsānte paurṇamāsena caiva hi || 4.25 ||
agnihotram iti | uditahomapakṣe dinasyādau niśāyāś cādau | anuditahomapakṣe dinasyānte niśāyāś cānte | yad vā uditahomapakṣe dinasyādau dinānte ca | anuditahomapakṣe niśādau niśānte ca agnihotraṃ kuryāt | kṛṣṇapakṣārdhamāsānte darśākhyena karmaṇā śuklapakṣārdhe ca paurṇamāsākhyena yajet || 4.25 ||
sasyānte navasasyeṣṭyā tathartvante dvijo ‘dhvaraiḥ |
paśunā tv ayanasyādau samānte saumikair makhaiḥ || 4.26 ||
sasyānta iti | pūrvārjitadhānyādisasye samāpte ‘śaradi navānnam’ iti sūtrakāravacanād asamāpte ‘pi pūrvasasye navasasyotpattāv āgrayaṇena yajet, sasyakṣayasyāniyatatvāt, dhanināṃ bahuhāyanajīvanocitadhānyasaṃbhavāc ca | sasyāntagrahaṇāc ca navasasyotpattir evābhipretā niyatatvāt tasyāḥ pratyabdaṃ nimittatvotpatteḥ | ṛtusaṃvatsara ity etanmatāśrayaṇena catvāraś catvāro māsā ṛtavas tadante ‘dhvaraiś cāturmāsākhyair yāgair yajeta | ayanayor anayor uttaradakṣiṇayor ādau paśunā yajeta paśuvadhākhyaṃ yāgam anutiṣṭhet | jyotiḥśāstre caitraśuklapratipadādivarṣagaṇanāc chiśireṇa samāpte varṣe vasante somarasasādhyair agniṣṭomādiyāgair yajeta || 4.26 ||
nāniṣṭvā navasasyeṣṭyā paśunā cāgnimān dvijaḥ |
navānnam adyān māṃsaṃ vā dīrgham āyur jijīviṣuḥ || 4.27 ||
nāniṣṭveti | āhitāgnir dvijo dīrgham āyur jīvitum icchann āgrayaṇam akṛtvā navānnaṃ na bhakṣayet | na ca paśuyāgam akṛtvā māṃsam aśnīyāt || 4.27 ||
doṣaṃ kathayann anityatām anayor āha –
navenānarcitā hy asya paśuhavyena cāgnayaḥ |
prāṇān evāttum icchanti navānnāmiṣagardhinaḥ || 4.28 ||
naveneti | yasmān navena havyena paśuvad āmenānarcitā akṛtayāgā agnayo navānnamāṃsābhilāṣiṇo ‘syāhitāgner agnihotriṇaḥ prāṇān eva khāditum icchanti | gardho ‘bhilāṣātiśayaḥ |n gṛdher gañantasya rūpam | so ‘syāstīti gardhī | matvartīya iniḥ || 4.28 ||
āsanāśanaśayyābhir adbhir mūlaphalena vā |
nāsya kaścid vased gehe śaktito ‘narcito ‘tithiḥ || 4.29 ||
āsanāśaneti | yathāśakty āsanabhojanādibhir anarcito ‘tithir asya gṛhasthasya gṛhe na vaset | anena śaktito ‘tithiṃ pūjayed ity uktam apy uttarārdham anūdyate || 4.29 ||
pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān baiḍālavratikāñ chaṭhān |
haitukān bakavṛttīṃś ca vāṅmātreṇāpi nārcayet || 4.30 ||
pāṣaṇḍina iti | pāṣaṇḍino vedabāhyavrataliṅgadhāriṇaḥ śākyabhikṣukakṣapaṇakādayaḥ, vikarmasthāḥ pratiṣiddhavṛttijīvinaḥ, baiḍālavratikabakavṛttī vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇau, śaṭhā vedeṣv aśraddadhānāḥ, haitukā vedavirodhitarkavyavahāriṇaḥ, etān atithikālopasthitān vāṅmātreṇāpi na pūjayet | pūjārahite ‘nnadānamātraṃ tu ‘śaktito ‘pacamānebhyaḥ’ (4.32) ity anujñātam eva || 4.30 ||
vedavidyāvratasnātāñ śrotriyān gṛhamedhinaḥ |
pūjayed dhavyakavyena viparītāṃś ca varjayet || 4.31 ||
vedavidyeti | vedavidyāvratasnātān iti vidyāsnātakavratasnātakobhayasnātakās trayo ‘pi gṛhyante | yathāha hārītaḥ:
yaḥ samāpya vedān asamāpya vratāni samāvartate sa vidyāsnātakaḥ | yaḥ samāpya vratāny asamāpya vedān samāvartate sa vratasnātakaḥ | ubhayaṃ samāpya yaḥ samāvartate sa vidyāvratasnātakaḥ |
yady api snātakadharmatvenaiva snātakamātraprāptis tathāpi śrotriyatvaṃ vivakṣitam, tān snātakāñ śrotriyān havyakavyena pūjayet, viparītān punar varjayet || 4.31 ||
śaktito ‘pacamānebhyo dātavyaṃ gṛhamedhinā |
saṃvibhāgaś ca bhūtebhyaḥ kartavyo ‘nuparodhataḥ || 4.32 ||
śaktita iti | apacamānā brahmacāriparivrājakāḥ pāṣaṇḍādayaḥ | brahmacāriparivrājakānām uktam apy annadānaṃ pacamānāpekṣayātiśayārthaṃ snātakavratatvārthaṃ ca punar ucyate | medhātithi-govindarājau tu “bhikṣāṃ ca bhikṣave dadyād vidhivad brahmacāriṇe” (3.94) iti brahmacāriparivrājakayor uktatvāt pāṣaṇḍyādiviṣayatvam evāsya vacanasyety ūcatuḥ | svakuṭumbānurodhena vṛkṣādiparyantaprāṇibhyo ‘pi jalādināpi vibhāgaḥ kartavyaḥ || 4.32 ||
rājato dhanam anvicchet saṃsīdan snātakaḥ kṣudhā |
yājyāntevāsinor vāpi na tv anyata iti sthitiḥ || 4.33 ||
rājata iti | “na rājñaḥ pratigṛhṇīyād arājanyaprasūtitaḥ” (4.84) iti niṣedhād rājaśabdo ‘tra kṣatriyanṛpatiparaḥ | snātakaḥ kṣudhāvasīdan dvijātipratigrahasya saṃbhave ‘pi yathāśāstravartinaḥ kṣatriyād rājño yājyaśiṣyābhyāṃ vā prathamaṃ dhanam abhilaṣet, rājño mahādhanatvena pīḍāvirahāt, yājyaśiṣyayoś ca kṛtopakāratayā pratyupakārapravaṇatvāt | tadasaṃbhave tv anyasmād api dvijād dhanam ādadīta | tadabhāve tu “sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt” (10.102) ity āpaddharmaṃ vakṣyati | evaṃ cānāpadi prathamaṃ kṣatriyanṛpayājyaśiṣyebhyaḥ pratigrahaniyamārthaṃ vacanam | ata evāha “na tv anyataḥ” iti | sthitiḥ śāstramaryādā | na ca saṃsīdan ity abhidhānād āpaddharmaviṣayatvam asya vācyam, avyabhicārād anāpatprakaraṇāt, saṃsīdan ity asya copāttadhanābhāvaparatvāt | anyathā sadyaḥprakṣālako ‘py āpadvṛttiḥ syāt | yadi cāpadviṣayatvam asya bhavet tadā na tv anyataḥ ity anena “sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt” (10.102) iti virudhyeta | yac cāpatprakaraṇe “sīsadbhiḥ kupyam icchadbhir dhanaṃ vā pṛthivīpatiḥ | yācyaḥ syāt” (10.113) ity uktaṃ tac chūdranṛpaviṣayam evaṃ rājādipratigrahāsaṃbhave || 4.33 ||
na sīdet snātako vipraḥ kṣudhā śaktaḥ kathaṃcana |
na jīrṇamalavadvāsā bhavec ca vibhave sati || 4.34 ||
na sīded iti | vidyādiyogāt pratigrahaśakto ‘pi snātako brāhmaṇa uktarājapratigrahādilābhe sati na kṣudhāvasanno bhavet | na ca dhane saṃbhavati jīrṇe maline ca vāsasī bibhṛyāt || 4.34 ||
kḷptakeśanakhaśmaśrur dāntaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ |
svādhyāye caiva yuktaḥ syān nityam ātmahiteṣu ca || 4.35 ||
kḷptakeśeti | kalapanaṃ chedanaṃ lūnakeśanakhaśmaśruḥ tapaḥkleśasaho dāntaḥ śuklavāsā bāhyābhyantaraśaucasaṃpanno vedābhyāsayukta auṣadhopayogādinā cātmahitaparaḥ syāt
|| 4.35 ||
vaiṇavīṃ dhārayed yaṣṭiṃ sodakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum |
yajñopavītaṃ vedaṃ ca śubhe raukme ca kuṇḍale || 4.36 ||
vaiṇavīm iti | veṇudaṇḍam udakasahitaṃ ca kamaṇḍaluṃ yajñopavītaṃ kuśamuṣṭiṃ śobhane ca sauvarṇakuṇḍale dhārayet || 4.36 ||
nekṣetodyantam ādityaṃ nāstaṃ yāntaṃ kadācana |
nopaspṛṣṭaṃ na vāristhaṃ na madhyaṃ nabhaso gatam || 4.37 ||
nekṣeteti | udyantam astaṃ yantaṃ ca sūryabimbaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ nekṣeta | upasṛṣṭaṃ grahoparaktaṃ vakrādyupasargayuktaṃ ca, vāristhaṃ jalapratibimbitam, nabhomadhyagataṃ madhyaṃdinasamaye || 4.37 ||
na laṅghayed vatsatantrīṃ na pradhāvec ca varṣati |
na codake nirīkṣeta svaṃ rūpam iti dhāraṇā || 4.38 ||
na laṅghayed iti | vatsabandhanarajjuṃ na laṅghayet | varṣati meghe ca dhāvet | na ca svadehapratibimbaṃ jale nirīkṣeteti śāstre niścayaḥ || 4.38 ||
mṛdaṃ gāṃ daivataṃ vipraṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu catuṣpatham |
pradakṣiṇāni kurvīta prajñātāṃś ca vanaspatīn || 4.39 ||
mṛdam iti | prasthitaḥ san saṃmukhāvasthitānuddhṛtamṛttikāgopāṣāṇādidevatābrāhmaṇaghṛta-kṣaudracatuṣpathamahāpramāṇajñātavṛkṣān dakṣiṇahastamārgeṇa kuryāt | pradakṣiṇānīti “napuṃsakam anapuṃsakenaikavac cāsyānyatarasyām” (Pāṇ 1.2.69) iti napuṃsakatvam || 4.39 ||
nopagacchet pramatto ‘pi striyam ārtavadarśane |
samānaśayane caiva na śayīta tayā saha || 4.40 ||
nopagacched iti | pramattaḥ kāmārto ‘pi rajodarśane niṣiddhasparśadinatraye striyaṃ nopagacchet | sparśaniṣedhenaiva “tāsām ādyāś catasraḥ” (3.47) iti niṣedhasiddhau prāyaścittagauravārthaṃ snātakavratatvārthaṃ ca punar ārambhaḥ | na cāgacchann api tayā sahaikaśayyāyāṃ supyāt || 4.40 ||
rajasābhiplutāṃ nārīṃ narasya hy upagacchataḥ |
prajñā tejo balaṃ cakṣur āyuś caiva prahīyate || 4.41 ||
rajasābhiplutām iti | yasmād rajasvalāṃ striyaṃ puruṣasyopagacchataḥ prajñāvīryabala-cakṣurāyūṃṣi naśyanti, tasmāt tāṃ nopagacchet || 4.41 ||
tāṃ vivarjayatas tasya rajasā samabhiplutām |
prajñā tejo balaṃ cakṣur āyuś caiva pravardhate || 4.42 ||
tām iti | tāṃ tu rajasvalām agacchatas tasya prajñādayo vardhante, tasmāt tāṃ nopeyāt || 4.42 ||
nāśnīyād bhāryayā sārdhaṃ naināṃ īkṣeta cāśnatīm |
kṣuvatīṃ jṛmbhamāṇāṃ vā na cāsīnāṃ yathāsukham || 4.43 ||
nāśnīyād iti | bhāryayā sahaikapātre nāśṇīyāt | enāṃ ca bhuñjānāṃ kṣutaṃ jṛmbhāṃ ca kurvatīṃ yathāsukhaṃ niryantraṇapradeśāvasthitāṃ ca nekṣeta || 4.43 ||
nāñjayantīṃ svake netre na cābhyaktām anāvṛtām |
na paśyet prasavantīṃ ca tejaskāmo dvijottamaḥ || 4.44 ||
nāñjayantīm iti | tathā svanetrayor añjanaṃ kurvatīṃ tailādyabhyaktām anāvṛtāṃ stanāvaraṇarahitāṃ na tu nagnām, “nagnāṃ nekṣeta ca striyam” (4.53) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | apatyaṃ ca prasavantīṃ brāhmaṇo na nirīkṣeta || 4.44 ||
nānnam adyād ekavāsā na nagnaḥ snānam ācaret |
na mūtraṃ pathi kurvīta na bhasmani na govraje || 4.45 ||
nānnam adyād iti | ekavastro nānnaṃ bhuñjīta | upasthācchādanavāsorahito na snāyāt | mūtragrahaṇam adhaḥkāyamalavisargopalakṣaṇārtham | tena mūtrapurīṣe vartmani, bhasmani, goṣthe ca na kuryāt || 4.45 ||
na phālakṛṣṭe na jale na cityāṃ na ca parvate |
na jīrṇadevāyatane na valmīke kadācana || 4.46 ||
na phālakṛṣṭa iti | tathā phālakṛṣṭe kṣetrādau, udake, agnyarthakṛteṣṭakācaye, parvate, cirantanadevatāgāre, kṛmikṛtamṛttikācaye ca viṇmūtrotsargaṃ na kadācana kuryāt || 4.46 ||
na sasattveṣu garteṣu na gacchan nāpi ca sthitaḥ |
na nadītīram āsādya na ca parvatamastake || 4.47 ||
na sasattveṣv iti | tathā saprāṇiṣu bileṣu na vrajan na cotthito na nadītaṭm āśritya nāpi parvataśṛṅge mūtrapurīṣe kuryāt | parvataniṣedhād eva tacchṛṅganiṣedhe siddhe punaḥ parvataśṛṅganiṣedhas taditaraparvate vikalpārthaḥ | tatrecchāvikalpasyānyathāpi prāptau sāmānyaniṣedhavaiyarthyād vyavasthito ‘tra vikalpaḥ | atyantārtasya parvate na doṣaḥ || 4.47 ||
vāyvagnivipram ādityam apaḥ paśyaṃs tathaiva gāḥ |
na kadācana kurvīta viṇmūtrasya visarjanam || 4.48 ||
vāyvagnivipram iti | vāyam agniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sūryaṃ jalaṃ gāṃ ca paśyan na kadāpi mūtrapurīṣotsargaṃ kuryāt | vāyor arūpatvena darśanāsaṃbhave vātyāpreritatṛṇakāṣṭādiniṣedho ‘yam || 4.48 ||
tiraskṛtyoccaret kāṣṭhaloṣṭapatratṛṇādinā |
niyamya prayato vācaṃ saṃvītāṅgo ‘vaguṇṭhitaḥ || 4.49 ||
tiraskṛtyoccared iti | antardhāya kāṣṭhādinā bhūmim avāganucchiṣṭaḥ pracchāditāṅgo ‘vaguṇṭhitaśirā mūtrapurīṣotsargaṃ kuryāt |
śuṣkair tṛṇair vā kāṣṭhair vā parṇair veṇudalena vā |
mṛnmayair bhājanair vāpi antardhāya vasuṃdharām ||
iti vāyupurāṇavacanāt śuṣkāṇi kāṣṭhapatratṛṇāni jñeyāni || 4.49 ||
mūtroccārasamutsargaṃ divā kuryād udaṅmukhaḥ |
dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau saṃdhyayoś ca tathā divā || 4.50 ||
mūtroccārasamutsargam iti | mūtrapurīṣotsargam ahani saṃdhyayoś cottarābhimukho rātrau ced dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ kuryāt | dharaṇīdharas tu “svastho ‘nāśāya cetasaḥ” iti caturthapādaṃ paṭhitvā cetaso buddher anāśāyeti vyākhyātavān |
paraṃparīyam āmnāyaṃ hitvā vidvadbhir ādṛtam |
pāṭhāntaraṃ vyaracayan mudheha dharaṇīdharaḥ ||
|| 4.50 ||
chāyāyām andhakāre vā rātrāv ahani vā dvijaḥ |
yathāsukhamukhaḥ kuryāt prāṇabādhābhayeṣu ca || 4.51 ||
chāyāyāṃ iti | rātrau chāyāyām andhakāre vā ahani chāyāyāṃ nīhārādyandhakāre vā digviśeṣājñāne sati cauravyāghrādikṛtaprāṇavināśabhayeṣu ca yathepsitamukho mūtrapurīṣe kuryāt || 4.51 ||
pratyagniṃ pratisūryaṃ ca pratisomodakadvijān |
pratigāṃ prativātaṃ ca prajñā naśyati mehataḥ || 4.52 ||
pratyagnim iti | “vāyvagnivipram” (4.48) ity anena mehato ‘gnyādīnāṃ darśanaṃ niṣiddham | anena tv apaśyato ‘pi saṃmukhīnatvaṃ niṣidhyate | agnisūryacandrajalabrāhmaṇa-govātābhimukhaṃ mūtrapirīṣe kurvataḥ prajñā naśyati, tasmād etan na kartavyam | prativātam ity asya sthāne ‘pratisaṃdhyam’ ity anye paṭhanti || 4.52 ||
nāgniṃ mukhenopadhamen nagnāṃ nekṣeta ca striyam |
nāmedhyaṃ prakṣiped agnau na ca pādau pratāpayet || 4.53 ||
nāgnim iti | nāgnir mukhena dhmātavyaḥ, kiṃ tarhi, vyajanādinā | “na nagnāṃ striyam īkṣeta maithunād anyatra” iti sāṃkhyāyanadarśanān maithunavyatirekeṇa nagnāṃ striyam na paśyet | amedhyaṃ mūtrapurīṣādikaṃ nāgnau kṣipet | na ca pādau pratāpayet | praśabdād agnau pādāv utkṣipya sākṣān na pratāpayet | vastrāditāpasvede ‘virodhaḥ || 4.53 ||
adhastān nopadadhyāc ca na cainam abhilaṅghayet |
na cainaṃ pādataḥ kuryān na prāṇābādham ācaret || 4.54 ||
adhastād iti | khaṭvādibhyo ’dhastād aṅgāraśakaṭyādikaṃ na kuryāt | na cāgnim utplutya gacchet | na ca suptaḥ pādadeśe ‘gniṃ sthāpayet | na ca prāṇapīḍākaraṃ karma kuryāt || 4.54 ||
nāśnīyāt saṃdhivelāyāṃ na gacchen nāpi saṃviśet |
na caiva pralikhed bhūmiṃ nātmano ‘paharet srajam || 4.55 ||
nāśnīyād iti | saṃdhyākāle bhojanaṃ grāmāntaragamanaṃ nidrāṃ ca na kuryāt | na ca rekhādinā bhūmim ullikhet | na ca mālāṃ ghṛtāṃ svayam evāpanayet | arthād anyenāpanayed ity uktam || 4.55 ||
nāpsu mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā ṣṭhīvanaṃ vā samutsṛjet |
amedhyaliptam anyad vā lohitaṃ vā viṣāṇi vā || 4.56 ||
nāpsu mūtram iti | mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ śleṣmāṇaṃ mūtrādyamedhyaliptavastraṃ anyad vā bhuktocchitādyamedhyaṃ rudhiraṃ viṣāṇi ca kṛtrimākṛtrimabhedbhinnāni na jale prakṣipet
|| 4.56 ||
naikaḥ supyāc chūnyagehe śreyāṃsaṃ na prabodhayet |
nodakyayābhibhāṣeta yajñaṃ gacchen na cāvṛtaḥ || 4.57 ||
naika iti | utsannajanavāsagehe naikaḥ śayīta | vittavidyādibhir adhikaṃ ca suptaṃ na prabodhayet | rajasvalayā saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ na kuryāt | yajñaṃ cākṛtavaraṇo ‘nṛtvik na gacchet | darśanāyecchayā gacchet, “darśanāya tu kāmam” (GDh 9.55) iti gautamavacanāt || 4.57 ||
agnyagāre gavāṃ goṣṭhe brāhmaṇānāṃ ca saṃnidhau |
svādhyāye bhojane caiva dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇim uddharet || 4.58 ||
agnyagāra iti | agnigṛhe gavāṃ nivāse brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ samīpe svādhyāyabhojanakālayoś ca dakṣiṇapāṇiṃ sabāhuṃ vāsasa uddhared bahiṣkuryāt || 4.58 ||
na vārayed gāṃ dhayantīṃ na cācakṣīta kasyacit |
na divīndrāyudhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kasyacid darśayed budhaḥ || 4.59 ||
na vārayed iti | gāṃ jalaṃ kṣīraṃ vā pibantīṃ na nivārayet | dohanārthavāraṇād anyatra niṣedhaḥ | nāpi parakīyakṣīrādi pibantīṃ tasya kathayet | na cendradhanur ākāśe dṛṣṭvā niṣiddhadarśanadoṣajñaḥ kasyacid darśayet || 4.59 ||
nādhārmike vased grāme na vyādhibahule bhṛśam |
naikaḥ prapadyetādhvānaṃ na ciraṃ parvate vaset || 4.60 ||
nādhārmika iti | adhārmika ity anena yatrādhārmikā vasanti na tatra vāso yuktaḥ | yatra vā ninditaduścikitsitavyādhipīḍitā bahavo janās tatra bhṛśam atyarthaṃ vāso na yuktaḥ | panthānam ekaḥ kadāpi na gacchet | parvate ca dīrghakālaṃ na vaset || 4.60 ||
na śūdrarājye nivasen nādhārmikajanāvṛte |
na pāṣaṇḍigaṇākrānte nopasṛṣṭe ‘ntyajair nṛbhiḥ || 4.61 ||
na śūdrarājya iti | yatra deśe śūdro rājā tatra na vaset | adhārmikajanaiś ca bāhyataḥ parivṛte grāmādau na vased ity apunaruktiḥ | pāṣaṇḍibhiś ca vedabāhyaliṅgadhāribhir vaśīkṛte cāṇḍālādibhiś cāntyajair upadrute na vaset || 4.61 ||
na bhuñjītoddhṛtasnehaṃ nātisauhityam ācaret |
nātiprage natisāyaṃ na sāyaṃ prātarāśitaḥ || 4.62 ||
na bhuñjīteti | uddhṛtasnehaṃ piṇyākādi na bhuñjīta | atitṛptiṃ vāradvaye ‘pi na kuryāt,
jaṭharaṃ pūrayed ardham annair bhāgaṃ jalena ca |
vāyoḥ saṃcaraṇārthaṃ tu caturtham avaśeṣayet ||
ityādiviṣṇupurāṇavacanāt | sūryodayakāle sūryāstamaye bhojanaṃ na kuryāt | prātarāśito ‘titṛptaḥ sāyaṃ na bhuñjīta || 4.62 ||
na kurvīta vṛthaceṣṭāṃ na vāry añjalinā pibet |
notsaṅge bhakṣayed bhakṣyān na jātu syāt kutūhalī || 4.63 ||
na kurvīteti | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthaśūnyaṃ vyāpāraṃ na kuryāt | añjalinā ca jalaṃ na pibet | ūrvor upari vinyasya modakādīn na bhakṣayet | asati prayojane kim etad iti jijñāsā kutūhalaṃ tan na kadācit kuryāt || 4.63 ||
na nṛtyed atha vā gāyen na vāditrāṇi vādayet |
nāsphoṭayen na ca kṣveḍen na ca rakto virāvayet || 4.64 ||
na nṛtyed iti | aśāstrīyāṇi nṛtyagītavādyāni nācaret | pāṇinā bāhau dhvanirūpam āsphoṭanaṃ na kuryāt | avyaktadantaśabdātmakaṃ kṣveḍanaṃ na kuryāt | na ca sānurāgo rāsabhādiravaṃ kuryāt
|| 4.64 ||
na pādau dhāvayet kāṃsye kadācid api bhājane |
na bhinnabhāṇḍe bhuñjīta na bhāvapratidūṣite || 6.65 ||
na pādāv iti | kāṃsyapātre kadācit pādau na prakṣālayet | “tāmrarajatasuvarṇānāṃ bhinnam abhinnaṃ veti na doṣaḥ” iti paiṭhīnasivacanād etadvyatiriktabhinnabhāṇde na bhojanaṃ kuryāt | yatra mano vicikitsati tad bhāvaduṣṭaṃ tatra na bhūñjīta || 6.65 ||
upānahau ca vāsaś ca dhṛtam anyair na dhārayet |
upavītam alaṃkāraṃ srajaṃ karakam eva ca || 6.66 ||
upānahāv iti | upānadvastrayajñopavītālaṃkārapuṣpamālākamaṇdalūn paropabhuktān na dhārayet || 6.66 ||
nāvinītair vrajed dhuryair na ca kṣudvyādhipīḍitaiḥ |
na bhinnaśṛṅgākṣikhurair na vāladhivirūpitaiḥ || 6.67 ||
