nāvinītair iti | aśvagajādibhir vāhanair adamitaiḥ kṣudhā vyādhinā ca pīḍitair bhinnaśṛṅgākṣikhuraiś chinnavāladhibhiś ca na yāyāt || 6.67 ||
vinītais tu vrajen nityam āśugair lakṣaṇānvitaiḥ |
varṇarūpopasaṃpannaiḥ pratodenātudan bhṛśam || 6.68 ||
vinītais tv iti | damitaiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ śubhasūcakalakṣaṇopetaiḥ śobhanavarṇair manojñākṛtibhiḥ pratodenātyartham apīḍayan gacchet || 6.68 ||
bālātapaḥ pretadhūmo varjyaṃ bhinnaṃ tathāsanam |
na chindyān nakhlomāni dantair notpāṭayen nakhān || 4.69 ||
bālātapa iti | prathamoditādityatāpo bālātapaḥ, sa ca muhūrthatrayaṃ yāvad iti medhātithiḥ, kanyārkātapa ity anye, pretadhūmo dahyamānaśavadhūmaḥ, bhagnāsanaṃ ca – etāni varjanīyāni | nakhāni ca romāṇi ca pravṛddhāni na chindyāt | dantaiś ca nakhān notpāṭayet
|| 4.69 ||
na mṛlloṣṭaṃ ca mṛdnīyān na chindyāt karajais tṛṇam |
na karma niṣphalaṃ kuryān nāyatyām asukhodayam || 4.70 ||
na mṛlloṣṭam iti | “nākāraṇaṃ mṛlloṣṭaṃ mṛdnīyat, tṛṇāni ca na chindyāt” [cf. ĀpDh 1.32.28] ity āpastambavacanān niṣprayojanaṃ mṛlloṣṭamardanaṃ nakhaiś ca tṛṇacchedanaṃ na kuryāt |
nanu “na kurvīta vṛthāceṣṭām” (4.63) ity anenaivāsyāpi pratiṣedhasiddhau doṣabhūyastvaṃ prāyaścittagauravaṃ ca darśayituṃ viśeṣeṇa niṣedhaḥ | ata evātrānantaraṃ loṣṭamardīti nindiṣyati | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaśūnyaṃ ca karma na kuryāt | nanu “na kurvīta vṛthāceṣṭām” (4.63) ity anena punaruktiḥ |
ucyate – dehavyāpāraś ceṣṭā, sa vṛthāceṣṭāśabdena niṣiddhaḥ, anena tu niṣphalaṃ manogrāhyādisaṃkalpātmakaṃ karma mānasaṃ niṣidhyate | yac ca āyatyām āgāmikāle karmāsukhāvahaṃ yathājīrṇe bhojanādi tad api na kuryāt || 4.70 ||
loṣṭamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ |
sa vināśaṃ vrajaty āśu sūcako ‘śucir eva ca || 4.71 ||
loṣṭamardīti | loṣṭamardayitā tṛṇacchettā nakhakāditā ca yo manuṣyas tathā sūcakaḥ khalo yaḥ parasya doṣān asataḥ sato vā khyāpayati bāhyābhyantaraśaucarahitaḥ śīghram ete dehadhanādinā vinaśyanti || 4.71 ||
na vigarhya kathāṃ kuryād bahirmālyaṃ na dhārayet |
gavāṃ ca yānaṃ pṛṣṭhena sarvathaiva vigarhitam || 4.72 ||
na vigarhya kathām iti | na cābhiniveśena kathāṃ śāstrīyeṣv artheṣu laukikeṣu vā kuryāt, keśakalāpād bahirmālyaṃ na dhārayet | gavāṃ ca pṛṣṭhena yānam | sarvatheti praveṇyādivyavadhānenāpy adharmāvaham | pṛṣṭhena ity abhidhānād ākṛṣṭaśakaṭādinā na doṣaḥ
|| 4.72 ||
advāreṇa ca nātīyād grāmaṃ vā veśma vāvṛtam |
rātrau ca vṛkṣamūlāni dūrataḥ parivarjayet || 4.73 ||
advāreṇa ceti | prākārādyāvṛtaṃ gṛhaṃ ca dvāravyatiriktapradeśeṇa prākārādilaṅghanaṃ kṛtvā na viśet | rātrau ca vṛkṣamūlāvasthānaṃ dūratas tyajet || 4.73 ||
nākṣaiḥ krīḍet kadācit tu svayaṃ nopānahau haret |
śayanastho na bhuñjīta na pāṇisthaṃ na cāsane || 4.74 ||
nākṣair iti | glahaṃ vinā kadācid api parihāsenāpi nākṣādibhiḥ krīḍet | svayam ity abhidhānād ātmopānahau pādavyatiriktena hastādinā deśāntaraṃ na nayet | śayyādyavasthitaś ca na bhuñjīta | haste ca prabhūtam annaṃ kṛtvā krameṇa na khādet | āsane bhojanapātraṃ nidhāya na bhuñjīta
|| 4.74 ||
sarvaṃ ca tilasaṃbaddhaṃ nādyād astamite ravau |
na ca nagnaḥ śayīteha na cocchiṣṭaḥ kvacid vrajet || 4.75 ||
sarvam iti | yat kiṃcit tilasaṃmiśraṃ kṛsaramodakādi tad astamite ‘rke nādyāt | upasthācchādanavāsorahito neha loke supyāt | ucchiṣṭas tu nānyato gacchet || 4.75 ||
ārdrapādas tu bhuñjīta nārdrapādas tu saṃviśet |
ārdrapādas tu bhuñjāno dīrgham āyur avāpnuyāt || 4.76 ||
ārdrapāda iti | jalārdrapādo bhojanam ācaret | nārdrapādaḥ supyāt | yasmād ārdrapādo bhuñjānaḥ śatāyur bhavati || 4.76 ||
acakṣurviṣayaṃ durgaṃ na prapadyeta karhicit |
na viṇmūtram udīkṣeta na bāhubhyāṃ nadīṃ taret || 4.77 ||
acakṣurviṣayam iti | tarugulmalatāgahanatvenācakṣurgocaram araṇyādideśaṃ durgaṃ nākrāmet, sarpacaurāder antarhitasya saṃbhavāt | purīṣaṃ mūtraṃ ca na nirīkṣeta | bāhubhyāṃ ca nadīṃ na taret || 4.77 ||
adhitiṣṭhen na keśāṃs tu na bhasmāsthikapālikāḥ |
na kārpāsāsthi na tuṣān dīrgham āyur jijīviṣuḥ || 4.78 ||
adhitiṣṭhen neti | dīrgham āyur jīvitum icchuḥ keśādīn nādhirohet | bhagnamṛnmayabhājanaśakalāni kapālikāḥ || 4.78 ||
na saṃvasec ca patitair na cāṇḍālair na pulkasaiḥ |
na mūkhair nāvaliptaiś ca nāntyair nāntyāvasāyibhiḥ || 4.79 ||
na saṃvased iti | patitādibhir grāmāntaravāsibhir api saha na saṃvaset | ekatarucchāyādau na samīpe vaset | ato “nādhārmike vased grāme” (4.60) ity ato bhedaḥ | niṣādāc chūdrāyāṃ jātaḥ pulkasaḥ | vakṣyati ca “jāto niṣādāc chūdrāyāṃ jātyā bhavati pulkasaḥ” (10.18) iti | avaliptā dhanādimadagarvitāḥ | antyā antyajā rajakādayaḥ | antyāvasāyino niṣādastriyāṃ cāṇḍalāj jātāḥ | vakṣyati ca “niṣādastrī tu cāṇḍālāt putram antyāvasāyinam” (10.39) || 4.79 ||
na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyān nocchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam |
na cāsyopadiśed dharmaṃ na cāsya vratam ādiśet || 4.80 ||
na śūdrāyeti | śūdrāya matiṃ dṛṣṭārthopadeśaṃ na dadyāt, dharmopadeśasya pṛthaṅnirdeśāt | adāsaśūdrāyocchiṣṭaṃ na dadyāt | dāsagocaratayā “ucchiṣṭam annaṃ dātavyam” (10.125) iti vakṣyamāṇatvād adoṣaḥ | “dvijocchiṣṭaṃ ca bhojayet” (cf. 5.140) iti bhoktur vidhir dātur ucchiṣṭadānaniṣedhe ‘pi yathāsaṃbhavalabdhaviṣayaḥ | haviṣkṛtam iti yasyaikadeśo hutaḥ sa haviḥśeṣo na dātavyaḥ | dharmopadeśo na śūdrasya kartavyaḥ | vrataṃ cāsya prāyaścittarūpaṃ sākṣān nopadiśet, kiṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ madhye kṛtvā tadupadeśavyavadhānāt | yathāhāṅgirāḥ –
tathā śūdraṃ samāsādya sadā dharmapuraḥsaram |
antarā brāhmaṇaṃ kṛtvā prāyaścittaṃ samādiśet ||
prāyaścittam iti sakaladharmopadeśasyopalakṣaṇārtham || 4.80 ||
yo hy asya dharmam ācaṣṭe yaś caivādiśati vratam |
so ‘saṃvṛtaṃ nāma tamaḥ saha tenaiva majjati || 4.81 ||
yo hy asyeti | yasmād yo ‘sya śūdrasya dharmaṃ brūte yaś ca prāyaścittam upadiśati sa tena śūdreṇaiva sahāsaṃvṛtākhyaṃ tamo gahanaṃ narakaṃ praviśati | pañcasu pūrvokteṣu dvayor doṣakathanaṃ prāyaścittagauravārtham || 4.81 ||
na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyed ātmanaḥ śiraḥ |
na spṛśec caitad ucchiṣṭo na ca snāyād vinā tataḥ || 4.82 ||
na saṃhatābhyām iti | saṃśliṣṭābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ na kaṇḍūyed ātmanaḥ śiraḥ | ucchiṣṭaḥ svaśiro na spṛśet | śirasā vinonmajjanavyatirekeṇa nityanaimittikasnāne na kuryāt | dṛṣṭārthe śirovyatiriktagātraprakṣālane na doṣaḥ | snānaśaktasya cāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ | āśaktasya tu,
aśiraskaṃ bhavet snānaṃ snānāśaktau tu karmiṇām |
iti jābālinā vihitam eva || 4.82 ||
keśagrahān prahārāṃś ca śirasy etān vivarjayet |
śiraḥsnātaś ca tailena nāṅgaṃ kiṃcid api spṛśet || 4.83 ||
keśagrahān iti | kopena keśagrahaprahārau śirasi varjayet | kopanimittatvāc cātmanaḥ parasya ca pratiṣedhaḥ | ata eva suratasamaye kāminīkeśagrahasyāniṣedhaḥ | saśiraskasnātasya tailena ca kiṃcid apy aṅgaṃ spṛśet | atha vā taileneti kākākṣivad ubhayatra saṃbadhyate | tailena śiraḥsnātaḥ tailena punaḥ kiṃcid apy aṅgaṃ na spṛśet | ato rātrau śiṣṭānām atailaśiraḥsnātānāṃ tailena pādābhyaṅgsamācaraṇam aviruddham || 4.83 ||
na rājñaḥ pratigṛhṇīyād arājanyaprasūtitaḥ |
sūnācakradhvajavatāṃ veśenaiva ca jīvatām || 4.84 ||
na rājña iti | rājanyaśabdaḥ kṣatriyavacanaḥ | akṣatriyaprasūtasya rājño dhanaṃ na pratigṛhṇīyāt | “rājato dhanam icchet” (4.33) ity uktam, tasyāyaṃ viśeṣa uktaḥ | sūnācakradhvajavatām iti | sūnāvatāṃ cakravatāṃ dhvajavatāṃ ca | sūnā prāṇivadhasthānam, tad yasyāstīti sūnāvān paśumāraṇapūrvakamāṃsavikrayajīvī; cakravān bījavadhavikrayajīvī tailakaḥ; dhvajavān madyavikrayajīvī śauṇḍikaḥ; veśaḥ paṇyastriyā bhṛtiḥ, tayā yo jīvati strī pumān vā sa veśavān; eteṣāṃ ca na pratigṛhṇīyāt || 4.84 ||
daśasūnāsamaṃ cakraṃ daśacakrasamo dhvajaḥ |
daśadhvajasamo veśo daśaveśasamo nṛpaḥ || 4.85 ||
daśasūneti | govindarājas tu ‘daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ’ iti paṭhati | medhātithiprabhṛtayaḥ prāñco ‘daśaveśasamo nṛpaḥ’ iti paṭhanti | sūnādiśabdais tadvān upalakṣyate | daśasūnāvatsu yāvān doṣas tāvān ekasmin cakravati tailike, yāvān daśasu tailikeṣu doṣas tāvān ekadhvajavati śauṇḍike, yāvān daśasu dhvajavatsu doṣas tāvān ekatra veśavati, yāvān daśasu veśavatsu doṣas tāvān ekatra rājani | uttarottaranindā cayaṃ pūrvadātṛsaṃbhave saty uttaravarjanārtham apekṣayā yojyate || 4.75 ||
daśasūnāsahasrāṇi yo vāhayati saunikaḥ |
tena tulyaḥ smṛto rājā ghoras tasya pratigrahaḥ || 4.86 ||
daśasūnāsahasrāṇīti | sūnayā caratīti saunikaḥ | evaṃ saṃkalanayā yat sauniko daśasahasrāṇi svārthe vyāpādayati tena tulyo rājā manvādibhiḥ smṛtaḥ | tasmāt tasya pratigraho narakahetutvād bhayānakaḥ kṣatriyasyāpi ca || 4.86 ||
yo rājñaḥ pratigṛhṇāti lubdhasyocchāstravartinaḥ |
sa paryāyeṇa yātīmān narakān ekaviṃśatim || 4.87 ||
yo rājña iti | yo rājñaḥ kṛpaṇasya śāstrollaṅghanena pravartamānasya pratigrahaṃ karoti sa krameṇaitān vakṣyamāṇaikaviṃsatiṃ narakān gacchati || 4.87 ||
tāmisram andhatāmisraṃ mahārauravarauravau |
narakaṃ kālasūtraṃ ca mahānarakam eva ca || 4.88 ||
saṃjīvanaṃ mahāvīciṃ tapanaṃ saṃpratāpanam |
saṃhātaṃ ca sakākolaṃ kuḍmalaṃ pratimūrtikam || 4.89 ||
lohaśaṅkum ṛjīṣaṃ ca panthānaṃ śālmalīṃ nadīm |
asipatravanaṃ caiva lohadārakam eva ca || 4.90 ||
eteṣāṃ narakāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇādiṣu vistareṇoktaṃ tatraivāvagantavyam
|| 4.88–90 ||
etad vidanto vidvāṃso brāhmaṇā brahmavādinaḥ |
na rājñaḥ pratigṛhṇanti pretya śreyo’bhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ || 4.91 ||
etad vidanta iti | pratigraho vividhanarakahetur iti jānanto brāhmaṇā dharmaśastrapurāṇādivido vedādhyāyino janmāntare śreyaḥkāmavanto na rājñaḥ pratigṛhṇīyuḥ | viduṣo hi pratigrahe nātīva doṣaḥ | yato vakṣyati “tasmād avidvān bibhīyāt” (4.191) iti | teṣām api niṣiddho rājapratigrahaḥ pracurapratyavāyaphalaka iti darśayituṃ vidvadgrahaṇaṃ brahmavādigrahaṇaṃ ca || 4.91 ||
brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthau cānucintayet |
kāyakleśāṃś ca tanmūlān vedatattvārtham eva ca || 4.92 ||
brāhma iti | brāhmo muhūrto rātreḥ paścimo yāmaḥ | brāhmī bhāratī tatprabodhahetutvāt | muhūrtaśabdo ‘tra kālamātravacanaḥ, tatra budhyeta | dakṣeṇāpi,
pradoṣapaścimau yāmau vedābhyādena tau nayet |
praharadvayaṃ śayāno hi brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||
iti bruvatā tatra prabodho ‘bhyanujñātaḥ | govindarājas tu “rātreḥ paścime muhūrte budhyeta” ity āha | dharmārthau ca parasparāvirodhenānuṣṭhānārtham avadhārayet | yadi mahān kāyakleśo ‘lpau ca dharmārthau vā tadā taṃ pariharet | vedasya tattvārthaṃ brahmakarmātmakaṃ niścinuyāt, tasmin samaye buddhiprakāśāt || 4.92 ||
utthāyāvaśyakaṃ kṛtvā kṛtaśaucaḥ samāhitaḥ |
pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ japaṃs tiṣṭhet svakāle cāparāṃ ciram || 4.93 ||
utthāyeti | tataḥ uṣaḥkāle śayyāyā utthāya sati vege mūtrapurīṣotsargaṃ kṛtvātra kṛtavakṣyamāṇaśauco ‘nanyamanāḥ pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ ciraṃ gāyatrījapaṃ kurvan vartetārkadarśanāt | ayaṃ vidhiḥ prātaḥsaṃdhyāyām uktaḥ | udayād ūrdhvam api japed āyurādikāma iti vidhānārtho ‘yam ārambhaḥ | aparām api saṃdhyāṃ svakāle prārabhya tārakodayād ūrdhvam api japann āsīta || 4.93 ||
āyurādikāmādhikāro ‘yam iti darśayann āha –
ṛṣayo dīrghasaṃdhyatvād dīrgham āyur avāpnuyuḥ |
prajñāṃ yaśaś ca kīrtiṃ ca brahmavarcasam eva ca || 4.94 ||
ṛṣaya iti | saṃdhyāśabdo ‘tra saṃdhyānuṣtheyajapādiparaḥ | yasmād ṛṣayo dīrghasaṃdhyānuṣṭhānād dīrgham āyuḥ jīvantaḥ prajñāṃ yaśo ‘mṛtāṃ ca kīrtim adhyayanādisaṃpannaṃ yaśaś ca prāpnuyuḥ | tasmād āyurādikāmaś ciraṃ saṃdhyām upāsīta
|| 4.94 ||
śrāvaṇyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ vāpy upākṛtya yathāvidhi |
yuktaś chandāṃsy adhīyīta māsān vipro ‘rdhapañcamān || 4.95 ||
śrāvaṇyām iti | śrāvaṇasya paurṇamāsyāṃ bhādrapadasya vā svagṛhyānusāreṇopākarmākhyaṃ karma kṛtvā sārdhāś caturo māsān brāhmaṇa udyukto vedān adhīyīta || 4.95 ||
puṣye tu chandasāṃ kuryād bahir utsarjanaṃ dvijaḥ |
māghaśuklasya vā prāpte pūrvāhṇe prathame ‘hani || 4.96 ||
puṣye tv iti | tataḥ pakṣādhikeṣu caturṣu māseṣu yaḥ puṣyas tatra grāmād bahir gatvā svagṛhyānusāreṇotsargākhyaṃ karma kuryāt | atha vā māghaśuklasya prathame ‘hani pūrvāhṇe kuryāt | māghaśukle ca vidhiḥ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ yenopākarma na kṛtaṃ tadviṣayaḥ
|| 4.96 ||
yathāśāstraṃ tu kṛtvaivam utsargaṃ chandasāṃ bahiḥ |
viramet pakṣiṇīṃ rātriṃ tad evaikam aharniśam || 4.97 ||
yathāśāstraṃ tv iti | evam uktaśāstrānusāreṇa grāmād bahiś chandasām utsargākhyaṃ karma kṛtvā pakṣiṇīṃ rātriṃ viramen nādhīyīta | dve dine pūrvāpare pakṣāv iva yasyā madhyavartinyā rātreḥ sā pakṣiṇī rātriḥ | asmin pakṣe tūtsargāhorātre dvitīyadine cāhni nādhyetavyam, dvitīyarātrau tv adhyetavyam | atha vā tam evaikam utsargāhorātram anadhyāyaṃ kuryāt | vidyānaipuṇyakāmaṃ praty ayam ahorātrānadhyāyavidhiḥ || 4.97 ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ tu chandāṃsi śukleṣu niyataḥ paṭhet |
vedāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu saṃpaṭhet || 4.98 ||
ata ūrdhvam iti | utsargānadhyayanād ūrdhvaṃ mantrabrāhmaṇātmakaṃ vedaṃ śuklapakṣeṣu saṃyataḥ paṭhet | sarvāṇi tu vedāṅgāni śikṣāvyākaraṇādīni kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu paṭhet || 4.98 ||
nāvispaṣṭam adhīyīta na śūdrajanasaṃnidhau |
na niśānte pariśrānto brahmādhītya punaḥ svapet || 4.99 ||
nāvispaṣṭam iti | svaravarṇādyabhivyaktiśūnyaṃ śūdrasaṃnidhau ca nādhīyīta | tathā rātreḥ paścime yāme suptotthito vedam adhītya śrānto na punaḥ supyāt || 4.99 ||
yathoditena vidhinā nityaṃ chandaskṛtaṃ paṭhet |
brahma chandaskṛtaṃ caiva dvijo yukto hy anāpadi || 4.100 ||
yathoditeneti | yathoktavidhinā nityaṃ chandaskṛtaṃ gāyatryādichandoyuktaṃ mantramātraṃ paṭhet, mantrāṇām eva karmāntaraṅgatvāt | anāpadi samyakkaraṇādau sati brahma brāhmaṇaṃ mantrajātaṃ ca yathoktavidhinā yuktaḥ san dvijaḥ paṭhet || 4.100 ||
imān nityam anadhyāyān adhīyāno vivarjayet |
adhyāpanaṃ ca kurvāṇaḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam || 4.101 ||
imān iti | imān vakṣyamāṇān anadhyāyān sarvathā yathoktavidhinādhīyānaḥ śiṣyādhyāpanaṃ ca kurvāṇo gurur varjayet || 4.101 ||
karṇaśrave ‘nile rātrau divā pāṃsusamūhane |
etau varṣāsv anadhyāyāv adhyāyajñāḥ pracakṣate || 4.102 ||
karṇaśrava iti | rātrau karṇaśravaṇayogyaśabdajanake vāyau vāti | govindarājas tu “karṇābhyām eva śravaṇopapatter atiśayavivakṣayā karṇaśrava ity uktam, tenātiśabdavati vāyau vāti” ity abhihitavān | divā ca dhūlipaṭalotsāraṇasamarthe vāyau vahati etau varṣākāle ‘nadhyāyau tātkālikāv adhyāpanavidhijñā munayaḥ kathayanti || 4.102 ||
vidyutstanitavarṣeṣu maholkānāṃ ca saṃplave |
ākālikam anadhyāyam eteṣu manur abravīt || 4.103 ||
vidyud iti | vidyudgarjitavarṣeṣu dvandvanirdeśād yugapadupasthiteṣu mahatīnāṃ colkānāṃ saṃplava itas tataḥ pāte sati | ākālikam iti nimittakālād ārabhyāparedyur yāvat sa kālas tāvatparyantam anadhyāyam eteṣu manur avocat || 4.103 ||
etāṃs tv abhyuditān vidyād yadā prāduṣkṛtāgniṣu |
tadā vidyād anadhyāyam anṛtau cābhradarśane || 4.104 ||
etān iti | etān vidyudādīn yadā homārthaṃ prakaṭīkṛtāgnikāleṣu saṃdhyākṣaṇeṣu yugapadutpannāñ jānīyāt tadānadhyāyaṃ varṣāsu kuryān na sarvadā | tathānṛtau prāduṣkṛtāgnikāleṣu meghadarśanamātre saty anadhyāyo na varṣāsu || 4.105 ||
nirghāte bhūmicalane jyotiṣāṃ copasarjane |
etān ākālikān vidyād anadhyāyān ṛtāv api || 4.105 ||
nirghāta iti | antarikṣabhavotpātadhvanau bhūkampe sūryacandratārāgaṇānāṃ copasarge saty anadhyāyān imān ākālikāñ jānīyāt | ākālikaśabdārtho vyākṛta eva | ṛtāv api varṣāsu kila bhūkampādayo na doṣāvahā ity abhiprāyeṇartāv apīty uktam; apiśabdād anyatrāpi || 4.105 ||
prāduṣkṛteṣv agniṣu tu vidyutstanitaniḥsvane |
sajyotiḥ syād anadhyāyaḥ śeṣe rātrau yathā divā || 4.106 ||
prāduṣkṛteṣv iti | homārthaṃ prakāśiteṣv agniṣu saṃdhyāyāṃ sadā vidyudgarjitaśabdāv eva bhavato na tu varṣaṃ tadā sajyotir anadhyāyaḥ syāt nākālikaḥ | tatra yadi prātaḥsaṃdhyāyāṃ vidyudgarjitaśabdau tadā yāvat sūryajyotis tāvad anadhyāyo dinamātram eva | yadi sāyaṃsamdhyāyāṃ tau syātāṃ tadā yāvan nakṣatrajyotis tāvad anadhyāyo rātrimātram iti rātrau stanitavidyudvarṣeṣv iti trayāṇāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ śeṣe varṣākhye tritaye jāte yathā divānadhyāyas tathā rātrāv api | ahorātra evety arthaḥ || 4.106 ||
nityānadhyāya eva syād grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca |
dharmanaipuṇyakāmānāṃ pūtigandhe ca sarvaśaḥ || 4.107 ||
nityānadhyāya iti | naipuṇyaviṣayo dharmātiśayārthino grāmanagarayoḥ sarvadānadhyāyaḥ syāt | kutsitagandhe ca sarvasminn api gamyamāne dharmanaipuṇyakāmaṃ praty ayaṃ vidyānadhyāyopdeśo vidyānaipuṇyakāmasya kadācid adhyayanam anujānāti | ye śiṣyāḥ kecid gṛhītavedādhyayanajanmādṛṣṭecchavas te dharmanaipuṇyakāmāḥ || kecit prathamādhyetāro vidyātiśayamātrārthinas te vidyānaipuṇyakāmāḥ || 4.107 ||
antargataśave grāme vṛṣalasya ca saṃnidhau |
anadhyāyo rudyamāne samavāye janasya ca || 4.108 ||
antargateti | śūdrajanayasmin grāme jñayate tatra | vṛṣalo ‘dhārmikas tasya saṃnidhau na tu śūdraḥ, tasya “na śūdrajanasaṃnidhau” (4.99) iti niṣedhāt | rudyamāne rodanadhvanau | bhāve lakāraḥ | kāryāntarārthaṃ bahujanamelake saty anadhyāyaḥ || 4.108 ||
udake madhyarātre ca viṇmūtrasya visarjane |
ucchiṣṭaḥ śrāddhabhuk caiva manasāpi na cintayet || 4.109 ||
udaka iti | udakamadhye madhyarātre ca muhūrtacatuṣṭaye ca “niśāyāṃ ca caturmuhūrtam” (GDh 16.44) iti gautamasmaraṇāt | govindarājas tu rātrimadhyapraharadvaya ity uktavān | tathā mūtrapurīṣotsargakāle ‘nnabhojanādinā cocchiṣṭo nimantraṇasamayād ārabhya śrāddhabhojanāhorātraṃ yāvan manasāpi vedaṃ na cintayet || 4.109 ||
pratigṛhya dvijo vidvān ekoddiṣṭasya ketanam |
tryahaṃ na kīrtayed brahma rājño rāhoś ca sūtake || 4.110 ||
pratigṛhyeti | eka evoddiśyate yatra śrāddhe tad ekoddiṣṭaṃ navaśrāddhaṃ tatketanaṃ nimantraṇaṃ gṛhītvā nimantraṇād ārabhya kṣatriyasya janapadeśvarasya putrajanmādisūtake rāhoś ca sūtakaṃ candrasūryoparāgaḥ tatra trirātraṃ vedaṃ nādhīyīta || 4.110 ||
yāvad ekānudiṣṭasya gandho lepaś ca tiṣṭhati |
viprasya viduṣo dehe tāvad brahma na kīrtayet || 4.111 ||
yāvad iti | yāvad ekasyānudiṣṭasyocchiṣṭasya sakuṅkumāder gandho lepaś ca brāhmaṇasya śāstravido dehe tiṣthati tāvanty ahorātrāṇy ūrdhvam api vedaṃ nādhīyīta || 4.111 ||
śayānaḥ prauḍhapādaś ca kṛtvā vaivavasakthikām |
nādhīyītāmiṣaṃ jagdhvā sūtakānnādyam eva ca || 4.112 ||
śayāna iti | śayyāyāṃ patitāṅga āsanārūḍhapādaḥ kṛtāvasakthiko vā māṃsaṃ bhuktvā jananamaraṇāśaucināṃ cānnaṃ bhuktvā nādhīyīta || 4.112 ||
nīhāre vāṇaśabde ca saṃdhyayor eva cobhayoḥ |
amāvāsyācaturdaśyoḥ paurṇamāsyaṣṭakāsu ca || 4.113 ||
nīhāra iti | nīhāre dhūlikāyāṃ vāṇaśabde śaradhvajau | “vāṇo vīṇāviśeṣaḥ” ity anye | prātaḥsāyaṃsaṃdhyayor amāvāsyācaturdaśīpaurṇamāsyaṣṭamīṣu nādhīyīta | aṣṭakāsūttaratra niṣedhāt paurṇamāsyādisāhacaryād aṣṭakāśabdo ‘ṣṭamītithiparaḥ || 4.113 ||
viśeṣadoṣam āha –
amāvāsyā guruṃ hanti śiṣyaṃ hanti caturdaśī |
brahmāṣṭakāpaurṇamāsyau tasmāt tāḥ parivarjayet || 4.114 ||
amāvāsyeti | yasmād amāvāsyā guruṃ hanti, śiṣyaṃ hanti caturdaśī, vedaṃ cāṣṭamīpaurṇamāsyau vismārayataḥ, tasmāt tā adhyayanādhyāpanayoḥ parityajet || 4.114 ||
pāṃsuvarṣe diśāṃ dāhe gomāyuvirute tathā |
śvakharoṣṭre ca ruvati paṅktau ca na paṭhed dvijaḥ || 4.115 ||
pāṃsuvarṣa iti | dhūlīvarṣe diśāṃ dāhe śṛgālakukkuragardabhoṣṭreṣu ca ruvatsu paṅktau copaviśya prakṛtatvāc chṛgālaśvakharādīnām eva brāhmaṇo na paṭhet || 4.115 ||
nādhīyīta śmaśānānte grāmānte govraje ‘pi vā |
vasitvā maithunaṃ vāsaḥ śrāddhikaṃ pratigṛhya ca || 4.116 ||
nādhīyīteti | śmaśānasamīpe, grāmasamīpe, goṣṭhe ca, maithunasamayadhṛtavāsaḥ paridhāya, śrāddhīyaṃ ca siddhānnādi pratigṛhya nādhīyīta || 4.116 ||
prāṇi vā yadi vāprāṇi yat kiṃcic chrāddhikaṃ bhavet |
tad ālabhyāpy anadhyāyaḥ pāṇyāsyo hi dvijaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4.117 ||
prāṇi veti | śrāddhikam annādi bhuktvā tāvad anadhyāyo bhavatīty uktam | prāṇi vā gavāśvādi, aprāṇi vā vastramālyādi, pratigrahakāle hastena gṛhītvānadhyāyo bhavati | yasmāt pāṇir evāsyam asyeti pāṇyāsyo hi brāhmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 4.117 ||
corair updrute grāme saṃbhrame cāgnikārite |
ākālikam anadhyāyaṃ vidyāt sarvādbhuteṣu ca || 4.118 ||
corair iti | corair upadrute grāme gṛhādidāhādikṛte bhaye divyāntarikṣabhaumeṣu cādbhuteṣūtpāteṣv ākālikam anadhyāyaṃ jānīyāt || 4.118 ||
upākarmaṇi cotsarge trirātraṃ kṣepaṇaṃ smṛtam |
aṣṭakāsu tv ahorātram ṛtvantāsu ca rātriṣu || 4.119 ||
upākarmaṇīti | upākarmaṇi cotsarge trirātram adhyayanakṣepaṇam | utsarge pakṣiṇyahorātrāv anadhyāyāv uktau tatrāyaṃ dharmanaipuṇyakāmaṃ prati trirātropadeśaḥ | tathāgrahāyaṇyā ūrdhvaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamīṣu tisṛṣu catasṛṣu cāhorātram anadhyāyaḥ | divākālamātrasadbhāve ‘pi “paurṇamāsyaṣṭakāsu ca” (4.113) ity anena yāvad aṣṭamy evānadhyāya itarāṣtamīṣūka ity apunaruktiḥ | ṛtvantāhorātreṣu cānadhyāyaḥ || 4.119 ||
nādhīyītāśvam ārūḍho na vṛkṣaṃ na ca hastinam |
na nāvaṃ na kharaṃ noṣṭraṃ neriṇastho na yānagaḥ || 4.120 ||
nādhīyīteti | turagatarukarinaukākharoṣṭrārūḍhaḥ tathoṣaradeśasthaḥ śakaṭādiyānena gacchan nādhīyīta || 4.120 ||
na vivāde na kalahe na senāyāṃ na saṃgare |
na bhuktamātre nājīrṇe na vamitvā na śuktake || 4.121 ||
na vivāda iti | vivāde vākkahale, kalahe daṇḍyādaṇḍyādau, senāyām apravṛttavṛddhāyām, saṃgare yuddhe, bhojanānantaraṃ ca yāvad ārdrahastaḥ, “yāvad ārdrapāṇiḥ” (VaDh 13.20) iti vasiṣṭhasmaraṇāt | tathājīrṇe ‘nne, vamanaṃ ca kṛtvāmlodgāre ca na paṭhet || 4.121 ||
atithiṃ cānanujñāpya mārute vāti vā bhṛśam |
rudhire ca srute gātrāc chastreṇa ca parikṣate || 4.122 ||
atithim iti | adhyayanaṃ karomīti yāvad atithir anujñāpito na bhavati, mārute cātyarthaṃ vāti, rudhire ca gātrāt srute, rudhirasrāvaṃ vināpi śastreṇa kṣatamātre ‘pi nādhīyīta || 4.122 ||
sāmadhvanāv ṛgyajuṣī nādhīyīta kadācana |
vedasyādhītya vāpy antam āraṇyakam adhītya ca || 4.123 ||
sāmadhvanāv iti | sāmadhvanau ca śrūyamāṇe ṛgyajuṣoḥ kadācid adhyayanaṃ na kuryāt | vedaṃ ca samāpya āraṇyakākhyaṃ ca vedaikadeśam adhītya tadahorātre vedāntaraṃ nādhīyīta
|| 4.123 ||
ṛgvedo devadaivatyo yajurvedas tu mānuṣaḥ |
sāmavedaḥ smṛtaḥ pitryas tasmāt tasyāśucir dhvaniḥ || 4.124 ||
ṛgveda iti | sāmagānaśrutau ṛgayajuṣor anadhyāya uktas tasyāyam anuvādaḥ | ṛgvedo deva eva devatāsyeti devadaivatyaḥ | yajurvedo mānuṣo mānuṣadevatākatvāt | prāyeṇa mānuṣakarmopadeśād vā mānuṣaḥ | sāmavedaḥ pitṛdevatākatvāt pitryaḥ | pitṛkarma kṛtvā jalopasparśanaṃ smaranti tasmāt tasyāśucir iva dhvaniḥ na tv aśucir eva | atas tasmiñ śrūyamāṇe ṛgyajuṣī nādhīyīta || 4.124 ||
etad vidanto vidvāṃsas trayīniṣkarṣam anvaham |
kramataḥ pūrvam abhyasya paścād vedam adhīyate || 4.125 ||
etad vidanta iti | etad vedatrayasya devamanuṣyapitṛdevatākatvaṃ jānantaḥ śāstrajñās trayīniṣkarṣaṃ sāroddhataṃ praṇavavyāhṛtisāvitryātmakaṃ praṇavavyāhṛtisāvitrīḥ krameṇa pūrvam adhītya paścād vedādhyayanaṃ kuryuḥ | dvitīyādhyāyokto ‘py ayam arthaḥ punar anadhyāyaprakaraṇe ‘bhihitaḥ | yathaite yathoktānadhyāyā evaṃ praṇavavyāhṛtisāvitrīṣv apaṭhitāsv anadhyāya iti darśayituṃ śiṣyasyādhyāpanam evaṃ kartavyam iti snātakavratatvāvagamārthaṃ ca || 4.125 ||
paśumaṇḍūkamārjāraśvasarpanakulākhubhiḥ |
antarāgamane vidyād anadhyāyam aharniśam || 4.126 ||
paśumaṇḍūketi | paśur gavādiḥ, maṇḍūkabiḍālakukkurasarpanakulamūṣakaiḥ śiṣyopādhyāyayor madhāgamane ‘nadhyāyam ahorātraṃ jānīyāt || 4.126 ||
saṃprati vidyānaipuṇyakāmaṃ prati pūrvoktānadhyāyavikalpārtham āha –
dvāv eva varjayen nityam anadhyāyau prayatnataḥ |
svādhyāyabhūmiṃ cāśuddhām ātmānaṃ cāśuciṃ dvijaḥ || 4.127 ||
dvāv eveti | svādhyāyabhūmiṃ cocchiṣṭādyamedhyopahatām ātmānaṃ ca yathoktaśaucarahitam iti dvāv evānadhyāyau nityaṃ prayatnato varjayen na tu pūrvoktān | teṣām api yatra nityagrahaṇam anuvādo vā nityatvakhyāpako vāsti tān api nityaṃ varjayet | anyatra vikalpaḥ || 4.127 ||
amāvāsyām aṣṭamīṃ ca paurṇamāsīṃ caturdaśīm |
brahmacārī bhaven nityam apy ṛtau snātako dvijaḥ || 4.128 ||
amāvāsyām iti | amāvāsyādiṣv ṛtāv api snātako dvijo na striyam upagacchet | “parvavarjaṃ vrajec cainām” (3.45) ity anenaiva niṣedhasiddhau snātakavratalopaprāyaścittārtham iha punarvarjanam || 4.128 ||
na snānam ācared bhuktvā nāturo na mahāniśi |
na vāsobhiḥ sahājasraṃ nāvijñāte jalāśaye || 4.129 ||
na snānam iti | nityasnānasya bhojanānantaram aprasakteś cāṇḍālādisparśanimittakasya “muhūrtam api śaktiviṣaye nāprayataḥ syāt" ity āpastambasmaraṇān (ĀpDh 1.15.8) niṣeddhum ayogyatvād yadṛcchāsnānam idaṃ bhojanānantaraṃ niṣidhyate | tathā rogī naimittikam api snānaṃna kuryāt kiṃ tu yathāsāmarthyaṃ,
aśiraskaṃ bhavet snānaṃ snānāśaktau tu karmiṇām |
ārdreṇa vāsasā vā syāt mārjanaṃ daihikaṃ viduḥ ||
ityādijābālādyuktam anusaṃdheyam | tathā,
mahāniṣātra vijñeyā madhyasthaṃ praharadvayam |
tasmin snānaṃ na kurvīta kāmyanaimitakād ṛte ||
iti devalavacanāt tatra na snāyāt | bahuvāsāś ca nityaṃ na snāyāt | naimittikacāṇḍālādisparśe sati tu snānaṃ bahuvāsaso ‘py aniṣiddham | grāhādyākrāntāgādharūpatayā ca viśeṣeṇājñāte jalāśaye ca || 4.129 ||
devatānāṃ guro rājñaḥ snātakācāryayos tathā |
nākrāmet kāmataś chāyāṃ babhruṇo dīkṣitasya ca || 4.130 ||
devatānām iti | devatānāṃ pāṣāṇādimayīnām, guroḥ pitrādeḥ, nṛpateḥ, snātakasyācāryasya ca | gurutve ‘py ācāryasya prādhānyavivakṣayā pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ | babhruṇaḥ kapilasya | yajñe dīkṣitasyāvabhṛthasnānāt pūrvam icchayā chāyāṃ nākrāmet | caśabdāc cāṇḍālādīnām api | kāmata ity abhidhānād abuddhipūrvake na doṣaḥ || 4.130 ||
madhyaṃdine ‘rdharātre ca śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā ca sāmiṣam |
saṃdhyayor ubhayoś caiva na seveta catuṣpatham || 4.131 ||
madhyaṃdina iti | divārātre ca saṃpūrṇe praharadvaye samāṃsaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā prātaḥsāyaṃsaṃdhyayoś ca ciraṃ catuṣpathaṃ nādhitiṣṭhet || 4.131 ||
udvartanam apasnānaṃ viṇmūtre raktam eva ca |
śleṣmaniṣṭhyūtavāntāni nādhitiṣṭhet tu kāmataḥ || 4.132 ||
udvartanam iti | udvartanam abhyaṅgamalāpakarṣaṇapiṣṭakādi, apasnānaṃ snānodakaṃ mūtrapurīṣe rudhiraṃ ca śleṣmāṇaṃ niṣṭhyūtam aśeṣmarūpam api carvitaparityaktarūpatāmbūlādi vāntaṃ bhuktvodgīrṇabhaktādi etāni kāmato nādhitiṣthet | adhiṣṭhānaṃ tadupary avasthānam || 4.132 ||
vairiṇaṃ nopaseveta sahāyaṃ caiva vairiṇaḥ |
adhārmikaṃ taskaraṃ ca parasyaiva ca yoṣitam || 4.133 ||
vairiṇam iti | śatruṃ tanmantriṇam adharmaśīlaṃ cauraṃ paradārāṃś ca na seveta | caurasyādhārmikatve ‘py atyantagarhitatvāt pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ || 4.133 ||
na hīdṛśam anāyuṣyaṃ loke kiṃcana vidyate |
yādṛśaṃ puruṣasyeha paradāropasevanam || 4.134 ||
na hīdṛśam iti | yasmād īdṛśam anāyuṣyam iha loke puruṣasya na kiṃcid asti yādṛśaṃ paradāragamanaṃ tasmād etan na kartavyam || 4.134 ||
kṣatriyaṃ caiva sarpaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ ca bahuśrutam |
nāvamanyeta vai bhūṣṇuḥ kṛśān api kadācana || 4.135 ||
kṣatriyam iti | vṛddhyarthe bhūdhātuḥ | bhūṣṇur vardhiṣṇuḥ dhanagavādinā vardhanaśīlaḥ kṣatriyaṃ sarpaṃ bahuśrutaṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ nāvajānīyāt | kṛśān api tatkāle pratīkārākṣamān || 4.135 ||
etat trayaṃ hi puruṣaṃ nirdahed avamānitam |
tasmād etat trayaṃ nityaṃ nāvamanyeta buddhimān || 4.136 ||
etat trayam iti | etat trayam avamānitaṃ sad avamantāraṃ vināśayati | kṣatriyasarpau dṛṣṭaśaktyā brāhmaṇaś cābhicārādinādṛṣṭena | tasmāt kalyāṇabuddhir etat trayaṃ sarvadā nāvajānīyāt || 4.136 ||
nātmānam avamanyeta pūrvābhir asamṛddhibhiḥ |
āmṛtyoḥ śriyam anvicchen naināṃ manyeta durlabhām || 4.137 ||
nātmānam iti | prathamaṃ dhanārtham udyame kṛte tatra dhanānām asaṃpattibhiḥ “mandabhāgyo ‘ham” iti nātmānam avajānīyāt, kiṃ tu maraṇaparyantaṃ śrīsiddhyartham udyamaṃ kuryāt | na tv imāṃ durlabhāṃ buddhyet || 4.137 ||
satyaṃ brūyāt priyaṃ brūyān na brūyāt satyam apriyam |
priyaṃ ca nānṛtaṃ brūyād eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 4.138 ||
satyaṃ brūyād iti | yathā dṛṣṭaśrutaṃ tattvaṃ brūyāt, tathā prītisādhanaṃ brūyāt putras te jāta iti | yathā dṛṣñaśrutam apy apriyaṃ putras te mṛta ityādi na vadet | priyam api mithyā na vadet | eṣa vedamūlatayā nityo dharmaḥ || 4.138 ||
bhadraṃ bhadram iti brūyād bhadram ity eva vā vadet |
śuṣkavairaṃ vivādaṃ ca na kuryāt kenacit saha || 4.139 ||
bhadram iti | prathamaṃ bhadrapadam abhadrapadaparam, dvitīyaṃ bhadraśabdaparyāyaparam, abhadraṃ yat tad bhadraśabdaparyāyaparaṃ praśastādiśabdena prabrūyāt | tathā cāpastambaḥ: “nābhadram abhadraṃ brūyāt puṇyaṃ praśastam iti brūyād bhadram ity eva” iti | bhadrapadam eva vā tatra yojyam | śuṣkaṃ niṣprayojanaṃ vairaṃ vivādaṃ na kenacit saha kuryāt || 4.139 ||
nātikalyaṃ nātisāyaṃ nātimadhyaṃdine sthite |
nājñātena samaṃ gacchen naiko na vṛṣalaiḥ saha || 4.140 ||
nātikalyam iti | uṣaḥsamaye pradoṣe ca divā saṃpūrṇapraharadvaye ca ajñātakulaśīlena puruṣeṇa śūdraiś ca saha na gacchet | “naikaḥ prapadyetādhvānam” (4.30) ity ukte pratiṣedhe ‘pi punar naika iti pratiṣedhaḥ snātakavratalopaprāyaścittagauravārthaḥ || 4.141
hīnāṅgān atiriktāṅgān vidyāhīnān vayo’dhikān |
rūpadravyavihīnāṃś ca jātihīnāṃś ca nākṣipet || 4.141 ||
hīnāṅgān iti | hīnāṅgādhikāṅgamūrkhavṛddhakurūpārthahīnahīnajātīn kāṇaśabdāhvānādinā na nindate || 4.141 ||
na spṛśet pāṇinocchiṣṭo vipro gobrāhmaṇānalān |
na cāpi paśyed aśuciḥ sustho jyotirgaṇān divi || 4.142 ||
na spṛśed iti | kṛtabhojanaḥ kṛtamūtrapurīṣādiś cākṛtaśaucācamano brāḥmaṇo hastādinā gobrāhmaṇāgnīn na spṛśet | na cāśuciḥ sann anāturo divisthān sūryacandragrahādijyotirgaṇān paśyet || 4.142 ||
spṛṣṭvaitān aśucir nityam adbhiḥ prāṇān upaspṛśet |
gātrāṇi caiva sarvāṇi nābhiṃ pāṇitalena tu. || 4.143 ||
spṛṣṭvaitān iti | etān gavādīn aśuciḥ san spṛṣṭvā kṛtācamanaḥ pāṇinā gṛhītābhir adbhiḥ prāṇāṃś cakṣurādīnīndriyāṇi śiraḥskandhajānupādān nābhiṃ ca spṛśet | aprakaraṇe cedaṃ prāyaścittābhidhānaṃ lāghavārtham, tatra prakaraṇe gavādigrahaṇam api kartavyam syāt
|| 4.143 ||
anāturaḥ svāni khāni na spṛśed animittataḥ |
romāṇi ca rahasyāni sarvāṇy eva vivarjayet || 4.144 ||
anātura iti | anāturaḥ san svāni khānīndriyachidrāṇi romāṇi ca gopyāny upasthakakṣādigatāni nirnimittaṃ na spṛśet || 4.144 ||
maṅgalācārayuktaḥ syāt prayatātmā jitendriyaḥ |
japec ca juhuyāc caiva nityam agnim atandritaḥ || 4.145 ||
maṅgalācārayuktaḥ syād iti | abhipretārthsiddhir maṅgalaṃ taddhetutvena gorocanādidhāraṇam api maṅgalam | gurusevādikam ācāras tatrodyuktaḥ syāt | bāhyābhyantaraśaucopeto jitendriyaś ca bhavet | gāyatryādijapaṃ vihitahomaṃ ca nityaṃ kuryāt | atandrito ‘nalasaḥ | atrācārādīnām uktānām api vinipātanivṛttyarthatvāt punar abhidhānam || 4.145 ||
ata āha –
maṅgalācārayuktānāṃ nityaṃ ca prayatātmanām |
japatāṃ juhvatāṃ caiva vinipāto na vidyate || 4.146 ||
maṅgalācārayuktānām iti | maṅgalācārābhyāṃ yuktānāṃ nityaṃ śucīnāṃ japahomaratānāṃ daivamānuṣopadravo na jāyate || 4.146 ||
vedam eva japen nityaṃ yathākālam atandritaḥ |
taṃ hy asyāhuḥ paraṃ dharmam upadharmo ‘nya ucyate || 4.147 ||
vedam eveti | nityakṛtyāvasare śreyohetutayā praṇavagāyatryādikaṃ vedam evānalaso japet; yasmāt taṃ brāhmaṇasya śreṣṭhaṃ dharmaṃ manvādayo vadanti | anyaḥ punar tato ‘pakṛṣṭo dharmo munibhir ucyate | uktasyaiva vedābhyāsādeḥ pūrvajātismaraṇadvāreṇa mokṣahetutvaṃ vadituṃ punar abhidhānam || 4.147 ||
vedābhyāsena satataṃ śaucena tapasaiva ca |
adroheṇa ca bhūtānāṃ jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm || 4.148 ||
vedābhyāseneti | satatavedābhyāsaśaucatapo’hiṃsābhiḥ pūrvabhavasya jātiṃ smarati || 4.148 ||
tataḥ kim ata āha –
paurvikīṃ saṃsmarañ jātiṃ brahmaivābhyasyate punaḥ |
brahmābhyāsena cājasram anantaṃ sukham aśnute || 4.149 ||
paurvikīm iti | pūrvajātiṃ smaran | jātim ity ekatvam anākāṅkṣitatvād avivakṣitam | bahūni janmāni smaraṃs teṣu ca garbhajanmajarāmaraṇaduḥkhāny api smaran saṃsāre virajyan brahmaivājasram abhyasyati śravaṇamananadhyānaiḥ sākṣāt karoti, tena cānantam avināśi paramānandāvirbhāvalakṣaṇaṃ mokṣasukhaṃ prāpnoti || 4.149 ||
sāvitrāñ chāntihomāṃś ca kuryāt parvasu nityaśaḥ |
pitṝṃś caivāṣṭakāsv arcen nityam anvaṣṭakāsu ca || 4.150 ||
sāvitrān iti | sāvitrīdevatākān homān aniṣṭanivṛttyarthaṃ ca śāntihomān paurṇamāsyamāvāsyayoḥ sarvadā kuryāt | tathā āgrahāyaṇyā ūrdhvaṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamīṣu tisṛṣu cāṣṭakākhyena karmaṇā śrāddhena ca tadantaritakṛṣṇanavamīṣu cānvakṣṭakākhena paralokagatān pitṝn yajet || 4.150 ||
dūrād āvasathān mūtraṃ dūrāt pādāvasecanam |
ucchiṣṭānnaniṣekaṃ ca dūrād eva samācaret || 4.151 ||
dūrād āvasathād iti |
nairṛtyām iṣuvikṣepam atītyābhyadhikaṃ bhuvaḥ |
iti viṣṇupurāṇavacanād evaṃvidhād agnigṛhasya dūrān mūtrapurīṣapādaprakṣālana-sakalocchiṣṭānnāni niṣicyata iti niṣekaṃ retaś cotsṛjet ||
maitraṃ prasādhanaṃ snānaṃ dantadhāvanam añjanam |
pūrvāhṇa eva kurvīta devatānāṃ ca pūjanam || 4.152 ||
mairam iti | mitradevatākatvān maitraḥ pāyus tadbhavatvān maitraṃ purīṣotsargam | tathā dehaprasādhanaṃ prātaḥsnānadantadhāvanāñjanadevatārcanādi pūrvāhṇa eva kuryāt | pūrvāhṇaśabdena rātriśeṣadinapūrvabhāgāv iha vivakṣitau | padārthamātravidhiparatvāc cāsya pāṭhakramo ‘pi nādaraṇīyaḥ | na hi snānānantaraṃ dantadhāvanam || 4.152 ||
daivatāny abhigacchet tu dhārmikāṃś ca dvijottamān |
īśvaraṃ caiva rakṣārthaṃ gurūn eva ca parvasu || 4.153 ||
daivatānīti | pāṣāṇādimayāni dharmapradhānāṃś ca brāhmaṇān rakṣārthaṃ rājādikaṃ gurūṃś ca pitrādīn amāvāsyādiparvasu draṣtum abhimukho gacchet || 4.153 ||
abhivādayed vṛddhāṃś ca dadyāc caivāsanaṃ svakam |
kṛtāñjalir upāsīta gacchataḥ pṛṣṭhato ‘nviyāt || 4.154 ||
abhivādayed iti | gṛhāgatān guruṇ abhivādayet | teṣāṃ ca svīyam āsanam upaveṣṭuṃ ca dadyāt | baddhāñjaliś ca gurusamīpa āsīta | gacchataś ca pṛṣthadeśe ‘nugacchet | ukto ‘py ayam abhivādanādyācāraḥ phalābhidhānāya punar ucyate || 4.154 ||
śrutismṛtyuditaṃ samyaṅ nibaddhaṃ sveṣu karmasu |
dharmamūlaṃ niṣeveta sadācāram atandritaḥ || 4.155 ||
śrutismṛtyuditam iti | vedasmṛtibhyāṃ samyag uktaṃ sveṣu karmasv adhyayanādiṣv aṅgatvena saṃbaddhaṃ dharmasya hetuṃ sādhūnām ācāram analasaḥ san nitāntaṃ seveteti sāmānyenācārānuṣṭhānopadeśaḥ phalakathanāya || 4.155 ||
ācārāl labhate hy āyur ācārād īpsitāḥ prajāḥ |
ācārād dhanam akṣayyam ācāro hanty alakṣaṇam || 4.156 ||
ācārād iti | ācārād vedoktam āyur labhate, abhimatāś ca prajāḥ putrapautraduhitrātmikāḥ, prabhūtiṃ ca dhanam, aśubhaphalasūcakaṃ ca dehastham alakṣaṇam ācārato niṣphalayati, ācārākhyadharmeṇālakṣaṇasūcitāriṣṭanāśāt || 4.156 ||
durācāro hi puruṣo loke bhavati ninditaḥ |
duḥkhabhāgī ca satataṃ vyādhito ‘lpāyur eva ca || 4.157 ||
durācāro hīti | yasmād durācāraḥ puruṣo loke garhitaḥ syāt sarvadā duḥkhānvito rogavān alpāyuś ca bhavati tasmāt sadācārayuktaḥ syāt || 4.157 ||
sarvalakṣaṇahīno ‘pi yaḥ sadācāravān naraḥ |
śraddadhāno ‘nasūyaś ca śataṃ varṣāṇi jīvati || 4.158 ||
sarvalakṣaṇahīno ‘pīti | yaḥ sadācāravāñ śraddhānvitaḥ paradoṣānabhidhātā sa śubhasūcakalakṣaṇaśūnyo ‘pi śatāyur bhavati || 4.158 ||
yad yat paravaśaṃ karma tat tad yatnena varjayet |
yad yad ātmavaśaṃ tu syāt tat tat seveta yatnataḥ || 4.159 ||
yad yat pareti | yad yat karma parādhīnaṃ paraprārthanādisādhyaṃ tat tad yatnato varjayet | yad yat svādhīnadehavyāpārasādhyaṃ paramātmagrahādi tat tad yatnato ‘nutiṣṭhet || 4.159 ||
atra hetum āha –
sarvaṃ paravaśaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarvam ātmavaśaṃ sukham |
etad vidyāt samāsena lakṣaṇaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || 4.160 ||
sarvaṃ paravaśam iti | sarvaṃ paraprārthanādisādhyaṃ duḥkhahetuḥ | sarvam ātmādhīnaṃ sukhahetuḥ | etat sukhaduḥkhayoḥ kāraṇaṃ jānīyāt || 4.160 ||
yat karma kurvato ‘sya syāt paritoṣo ‘ntarātmanaḥ |
tat prayatnena kurvīta viparītaṃ tu varjayet || 4.161 ||
yat karma kurvata iti | yat karma kurvato ‘syānuṣṭhātuḥ puruṣasyāntarātmanas tuṣṭiḥ syāt tat prayatnato ‘nuṣṭheyam | atuṣṭikaraṃ varjayet | etac cāvihitāniṣiddhagocaraṃ vaikalpikaviṣayaṃ ca || 4.161 ||
ācāryaṃ ca pravaktāraṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum |
na hiṃsyād brāhmaṇān gāś ca sarvāś caiva tapasvinaḥ || 4.162 ||
ācāryaṃ ceti | ācāryam upanayanapūrvakavedādhyāpakam, pravaktāraṃ vedārthavyākhyātāram, guruṃ “alpaṃ vā bahu vā yasya” (2,149) ity uktam | ācāryādīṃs tu na hiṃsyāt | pratikūlācaraṇe ‘tra hiṃsāśabdaḥ | govindarājas tu sāmānyena hiṃsāniṣedhād ātatāyino ‘py etān na hiṃsyād iti vyākhyātavān | tad ayuktam, “guruṃ vā bālavṛddhau vā” (8.350) ity anena virodhāt || 4.162 ||
nāstikyaṃ vedanindāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca kutsanam |
dveśaṃ dambhaṃ ca mānaṃ ca krodhaṃ taikṣṇyaṃ ca varjayet || 4.163 ||
nāstikyam iti | nāsti paraloka iti buddhim, vedānāṃ devatānāṃ ca nindām, mātsaryaṃ dharmānutsāhābhimānakopakrauryāṇi tyajet || 4.163 ||
parasya daṇḍaṃ nodyacchet kruddho naiva nipātayet |
anyatra purāc chiṣṭād vā śiṣṭyarthaṃ tāḍayet tau || 4.164 ||
parasya daṇḍam iti | parasya hananārthaṃ kruddhaḥ san daṇḍādi notkṣipet | na ca paragātre nipātayet putraśiṣyabhāryādāsāder anyatra | kṛtāparādhān etān anuśāsanārthaṃ “rajjvā veṇudalena vā” (8.299) ityādivakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa tāḍayet || 4.164 ||
brāhmaṇāyāvagūryaiva dvijātir vadhakāmyayā |
śataṃ varṣāṇi tāmisre narake parivartate || 4.165 ||
brāhmaṇāyeti | dvijātir api brāhmaṇasya hananārthaṃ daṇḍādikam udyamyaiva na tu nipātya, varṣaśataṃ tāṃisrādinarake paribhramati || 4.165 ||
tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi saṃrambhān matipūrvakam |
ekaviṃśatim ājātīḥ pāpayoniṣu jāyate || 4.166 ||
tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpīti | tṛṇenāpi krodhād buddhipūrvakaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tāḍayitvā ekaviṃśatijanmāni pāpayoniṣu kukkurādiyoniṣu jāyate || 4.166 ||
ayudhyamānasyotpādya brāhmaṇasyāsṛg aṅgataḥ |
duḥkhaṃ sumahad āpnoti pretyāprājñatayā naraḥ || 4.167 ||
ayudhyamānasyeti | ayudhyamānasya brāhmaṇasyāṅge śāstrānabhijñatayā śoṇitam utpādya paraloke mahad duḥkhaṃ āpnoti || 4.167 ||
śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃsūn saṃgṛhṇāti mahītalāt |
tāvato ‘bdān amutrānyaiḥ śoṇitotpādako ‘dyate || 4.168 ||
śoṇitam iti | khaḍgādihatabrāhmaṇāṅganirgataṃ rudhiraṃ bhūmipatitaṃ yāvato dhūlidvyaṇukān piṇḍīkaroti tāvatsaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi paraloke śoṇitotpādakaḥ prahartā anyaiḥ śvasṛgālādibhir bhakṣyate || 4.168 ||
na kadācid dvije tasmād vidvān avagured api |
na tāḍayet tṛṇenāpi na gātrāt srāvayed asṛk || 4.169 ||
na kadācid iti | tasmād avagoraṇādidoṣābhijño brāhmaṇe daṇḍādyudyamananipātarudhira-sravaṇāni nāpady api kuryād iti pūrvoktakriyātrayasyopasaṃhāraḥ || 4.170 ||
adhārmiko naro yo hi yasya cāpy anṛtaṃ dhanam |
hiṃsārataś ca yo nityaṃ nehāsau sukham edhate || 4.170 ||
adhārmika iti | adharmeṇa vyavaharatīty adhārmikaḥ śāstrapratiṣiddhāgamyāgamanādy-anuṣṭhātā yo mānuṣaḥ, yasya ca sākṣye vyavahāranirṇayādau ca mithyābhidhānam eva dhanopāyo ‘satyam abhidhāyotkocadhanaṃ gṛhṇāti, yaś ca parahiṃsābhirato nāsāv iha loke sukhayukto vartate | tasmād etan na kartavyam iti nindayā niṣedhaḥ kalpyate || 4.170 ||
na sīdann api dharmeṇa mano ‘dharme niveśayet |
adhārmikāṇāṃ pāpānām āśu paśyan viparyayam || 4.171 ||
na sīdann apīti | śāstravihitam anutiṣthan dhanādyabhāvenāvasīdann api kadācin nādharme buddhiṃ kuryāt | yasmād adharmavyavahāriṇo yady apy āpātato dhanādisaṃpadbhāgino ‘pi dṛśyante tathāpi teṣām adhārmikāṇām adharmacauryādivyavahāriṇāṃ pāpināṃ tajjanitaduritaśālināṃ śīghraṃ dhanādiviparyayo ‘pi dṛśyate | taṃ paśyan nādharme dhiyaṃ dadyād iti śiṣyahitāya dṛṣṭam arthaṃ darśitavān || 4.171 ||
nādharmaś carito loke sadyaḥ phalati gaur iva |
śanair āvartamānas tu kartur mūlāni kṛntati || 4.172 ||
nādharma iti | śāstreṇāniyamitakālaparipākatvāc chubhāśubhakarmaṇāṃ nādharmo ‘nutiṣṭhataḥ tatkāla eva phalati gaur iva | iha bhūmipakṣe sādharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathā bhūmir uptabījamātrā tadaiva pracurapacelimaphalavrīhistabakasaṃvalitā na bhavati kiṃ tu niyamaphalapākasamayam āsādya | paśupakṣe vaidharmyadṛṣṭāntaḥ | yathā gauḥ paśur vāhadohābhyāṃ sadyaḥ phalati naivam adharmaḥ kiṃ tu krameṇāvartamānaḥ phalonmukhībhavann adharmakartur mūlāni chinatti | mūlacchedena sarvanāśo lakṣyate | dehadhanādyanvito naśyati || 4.172 ||
yadi nātmani putreṣu na cet putreṣu naptṛṣu |
na tv eva tu kṛto dharmaḥ kartur bhavati niṣphalaḥ || 4.173 ||
yadīti | yadi svayaṃ kartur dehadhanādināśaṃ phalaṃ na janayati tadā tatputreṣu, no cet pautreṣu janayati, na tu niṣphala eva bhavati | nanu anyakṛtasya karmaṇaḥ katham anyatra phalajanakatvam? ucyate – putrādināśasya pituḥ kleśahetutvāc chāstrīyatvāc cāsyārthasya nāviśvāsaḥ || 4.173 ||
adharmeṇaidhate tāvat tato bhadrāṇi paśyati |
tataḥ sapatnāñ jayati samūlas tu vinaśyati || 4.174 ||
adharmeṇeti | adharmeṇa paradrohādinā tāvad āpātato grāmadhanādinā vardate | tato bhadrāṇi bahubhṛtyagavāśvādīni labhate | tataḥ śatrūn svasmād apakṛṣṭāñ jayati | paścāt kiyatā kānenādharmaparipākavaśād dehadhanatanayādisahito vinaśyati || 4.174 ||
satyadharmāryavṛtteṣu śauce caivāramet sadā |
śiṣyāṃś ca śiṣyād dharmeṇa vāgbāhūdarasaṃyataḥ || 4.175 ||
satyadharmāryavṛtteṣv iti | satyadharmasadācāraśauceṣu sarvadā ratiṃ kuryāt | śiṣyāṃś cānuśāsanīyān bhāryāputradāsacchātrān “rajjvā veṇudalena vā” (8.299) iti prakāreṇa śāsayet | uktānām apy abhidhānād ādarārthaṃ vāgbāhūdarasaṃyataś ca syāt | vāksaṃyamaḥ satyabhāṣitā | bāhusaṃyamo bāhubalena kasyāpy apīḍanam | udarasaṃyamo yathālabdhālpabhojanam || 4.175 ||
parityajed arthakāmau yau syātāṃ dharmavarjitau |
dharmaṃ cāpy asukhodarkaṃ lokavikruṣṭam eva ca || 4.176 ||
parityajed iti | yāv arthakāmau dharmavirodhinau bhavetāṃ tau pariharet | yathā cauryādinārthopapādanam, dīkṣādine yajamānasya patnyupagamaḥ, udarka uttarakālaḥ, tatrāsukhaṃ yatra dharme taṃ dharmam api parityajet | yathā putrādivargapoṣyayuktasya sarvasvadānam | lokavikruṣṭaṃ yatra lokānāṃ vikrośaḥ, yathā kalau madhyamāṣṭakādiṣu govadhādiḥ || 4.176 ||
na pāṇipādacapalo na netracapalo ‘nṛjuḥ |
na syād vākcapalaś caiva na paradrohakarmadhīḥ || 4.177 ||
na pāṇipādacapala iti | pāṇyādicāpalaṃ tyajet | anupayuktas tūpādānādi pāṇicāpalam | niṣprayojanaṃ bhramaṇādi pādacāpalam | parastrīprekṣaṇādi netracāpalam | bahugarhyavāditā vākcāpalam | anṛjuḥ kuṭilo na syāt | paradroho hiṃsā tadarthaṃ ceṣṭāṃ dhiyaṃ ca na kuryāt
|| 4.177 ||
yenāsya pitaro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ |
tena yāyāt satāṃ mārgaṃ tena gacchan na riṣyate || 4.178 ||
yeneti | bahuvidhaśāstrārthasaṃbhave pitṛpitāmahādyanuṣṭhita eva śāstrārtho ‘nuṣṭhātavyaḥ | tena gacchan na riṣyate nādharmeṇa hiṃsyate || 4.178 ||
ṛtvikpurohitācāryair mātulātithisaṃśritaiḥ |
bālavṛddhāturair vaidyair jñātisaṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ || 4.179 ||
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ jāmībhir bhrātrā putreṇa bhāryayā |
duhitrā dāsavargeṇa vivādaṃ na samācaret || 4.180 ||
ṛtvig iti vacanadvayam | ṛtvigādibhir vākkahalaṃ na kuryāt | śāntyādikartā purohitaḥ | saṃśritā anujīvinaḥ | jñātayaḥ pitṛpakṣāḥ | saṃbandhino jāmātṛśālakādayaḥ | bāndhavāḥ mātṛpakṣāḥ | jāmayo bhaginīsnuṣādyāḥ || 4.179–180 ||
etair vivādān saṃtyajya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate |
ebhir jitaiś ca jayati sarvāṃl lokān imān gṛhī || 4.181 ||
etair iti | etair ṛtvigādibhiḥ saha vivādān parityajājñātapāpaiḥ pramucyate | tathaitair vivādair upekṣitair imān vakṣyamāṇān sarvalokān gṛhastho jayati || 4.181 ||
ācāryo brahmalokeśaḥ prājāpatye pitā prabhuḥ |
atithis tv indralokeśo devalokasya cartvijaḥ || 4.182 ||
ācārya iti | ācāryo brahmalokasya prabhuḥ | tena saha vivādaparityāgena tatsaṃtuṣṭyā tu brahmalokaprāptir gauṇaṃ brahmalokeśatvam | evaṃ prājāpatyalokekśaḥ prājāpatye pitā ca prabhuḥ | atithir indralokeśaḥ | devalokasya ca ṛtvijaḥ | evam uttaratrāpi tattallokeśatvaṃ boddhavyam || 4.182 ||
jāmayo ‘psarasāṃ loke vaiśvadevasya bāndhavāḥ |
saṃbandhino hy apāṃ loke pṛthivyāṃ mātṛmātulau || 4.183 ||
jāmaya iti | apsarasāṃ loke jāmayaḥ prabhavanti | vaiśvadevaloke bāndhavāḥ | varuṇaloke saṃbandhinaḥ | bhūrloke mātṛmātulau || 4.183 ||
ākāśeśās tu vijñeyā bālavṛddhakṛśāturāḥ |
bhrātā jyeṣṭhaḥ samaḥ pitrā bhāryā putraḥ svakā tanuḥ || 4.184 ||
ākāśeṣās tv iti | kṛśaḥ kṛśadhanaḥ, saṃśrito vivakṣītaḥ | bālavṛddhasaṃśritāturā antarikṣe prabhavanti | bhrātā ca jyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛtulyaḥ tasmāt so ‘pi prajāpatilokaprabhuḥ | bhāryāputrau ca svaśarīram eva, ataḥ katham ātmanaiva saha vivādaḥ saṃbhaveti || 4.184 ||
chāyā svo dāsavargaś ca duhitā kṛpaṇaṃ param |
tasmād etair adhikṣiptaḥ sahetāsaṃjvaraḥ sadā || 4.185 ||
chāyeti | svadāsavargaś ca nityānugatatvād ātmachāyeva na vivādārhaḥ | duhitā ca paraṃ kṛpāpātram | tasmād etair adhikṣiptaḥ san asaṃtāpaḥ saheta na tu vivadet || 4.185 ||
pratigrahasamartho ‘pi prasaṅgaṃ tatra varjayet |
pratigraheṇa hy asyāśu brāhmaṃ tejaḥ praśāmyati || 4.186 ||
pratigrahasamartho ‘pīti | vidyātapovṛttasaṃpannatayā pratigrahe ‘dhikāry api tatra punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttiṃ tyajet | yasmāt pratigraheṇāsya vedādhyayanādinimittaprabhāvaḥ śīghram eva vinaśyati | “yātrāmātraprasiddhyartham” (4.3) ity ukte ‘pi sāmānyenārjanasaṃkoce viśeṣeṇa pratigrahasya brāhmaprabhāvapraśamanaphalatvakathanārthaṃ vacanam || 4.186 ||
na dravyāṇām avijñāya vidhiṃ dharmyaṃ pratigrahe |
prājñaḥ pratigrahaṃ kuryād avasīdann api kṣudhā || 4.187 ||
na dravāṇām iti | dravyāṇāṃ pratigrahe dharmāya hitaṃ vidhānaṃ grāhyadevatāpratigraha-mantrādikam ajñātvā kṣudhāvasādaṃ gacchann api prājño na pratigṛhṇīyāt kiṃ punar anāpadi
|| 4.187 ||
hiraṇyaṃ bhūmim aśvaṃ gām annaṃ vāsas tilān ghṛtam |
pratigṛhṇann avidvāṃs tu bhasmībhavati dāruvat || 4.188 ||
hiraṇyam iti | svarṇādīñ śrutasvādhyāhahīnaḥ pratigṛhṇann agnisaṃyogena dāruvad bhasmībhūto bhavati punar utpattiṃ na labhate || 4.188 ||
hiraṇyam āyur annaṃ ca bhūr gāś cāpy oṣatas tanam |
aśvaś cakṣus tvacaṃ vāso ghṛtaṃ tejas tilāḥ prajāḥ || 4.189 ||
hiraṇyam iti | aviduṣaḥ pratigrahītur bhūr gauś ca śarīraṃ oṣato dahataḥ | “uṣa dāhe” bhauvādikas tasyedaṃ rūpam | bhūgavor dvitvavivakṣayā dvivacanam | evaṃ hiraṇyam annaṃ cāyur oṣataḥ | aśvaś cakṣur ityādiṣu vibhaktivipariṇāmāt ‘oṣati’ ity ekavacanāntasyānuṣaṅgaḥ
|| 4.189 ||
atapās tv anadhīyānaḥ pratigraharucir dvijaḥ |
ambhasy aśmaplavenaiva saha tenaiva majjati || 4.190 ||
atapās tv iti | yas tapovidyāśūnyaḥ pratigrahecchuḥ brāhmaṇo bhavati sa pratigrahāvinābhāvād buddhisthena tena iti parāmṛṣṭenaiva [or parāmṛṣṭe tenaiva] dātraivānarhapratigrahādānapāpayuktena saha narake majjati | yathā pāṣāṇamayenoḍupenāmbhas taraṃs tenaiva sahāmbhasi magno bhavati || 4.190 ||
tasmād avidvān bibhiyād yasmāt tasmāt pratigrahāt |
svalpakenāpy avidvān hi paṅke gaur iva sīdati || 4.191 ||
tasmād avidvān iti | yasmād asāv alpadravyapratigraheṇāpi mūrkhaḥ paṅke gaur iva narake nimagno bhavati, tasmād yataḥ kutaścit suvarṇādivyatiriktasīsakādyasārapratigrahād api trasyet || 4.191 ||
pratigrahītur dharmam abhidhāyādhunā dātur āha –
na vāry api prayacchet tu baiḍālavratike dvije |
na bakavratike vipre nāvedavidi dharmavit || 4.192 ||
na vāry apīti | vāyasādibhyo yad dīyate tad api baiḍālavartikebho dharmajño na dadyād ity atiśayoktyā dravyāntaradānaṃ niṣidhyate na tu vāridānam eva | “pāṣaṇḍino vikarmasthān” (4.30) ity anena baiḍālavratikāyātithitvena satkṛtyārthadānādi niṣiddham, iha tu dhanadānaṃ niṣidhyate | ata eva “vidhināpy arjitaṃ dhanaṃ” (4.193) iti vakṣyati | nāvedavidīti vedārthānabhijñe | etac ca vidvatsaṃbhave nāvedavidīti niṣidhyate || 4.192 ||
triṣv apy eteṣu dattaṃ hi vidhināpy arjitaṃ dhanam |
dātur bhavaty anarthāya paratrādātur eva ca || 4.193 ||
triṣv apīti | eteṣu triṣv api baiḍālavratikādiṣu nyāyārijitam api dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātuḥ pratigrahītuś ca paraloke narakahetutvād anarthāya bhavati || 4.193 ||
yathā plavenaupalena nimajjaty udake taran |
tathā nimajjato ‘dhastād ajñau dātṛpratīcchakau || 4.194 ||
yathā plaveneti | yathā pāṣāṇamayenoḍupādinā jale taraṃs tenaiva sahādho gacchati evaṃ dānapratigrahaśāstrānabhijñau dātṛgrāhakau narakaṃ gacchataḥ | “atapās tv anadhīyānaḥ” (4.190) iti pratigrahītṛprādhānyena nindoktā, iha tu dātṛprādhānyenety apunaruktiḥ || 4.194 ||
dharmadhvajī sadā lubdhaś chādmiko lokadambhakaḥ |
baiḍālavratiko jñeyo hiṃsraḥ sarvābhisaṃdhakaḥ || 4.195 ||
dharmadhvajīti | yo bahujanasamakṣaṃ dharmam ācarati svataḥ parataś ca loke khyāpayati tasya dharmo dhvajaṃ cihnam iveti dharmadhvajī | lubdhaḥ paradhanābhilāṣukaḥ | chadmanā vyājena caratīti chādmikaḥ | lokadambhako nikṣepāpahārādinā janavañcakaḥ | hiṃsraḥ parahiṃsāśīlaḥ | sarvābhisaṃdhakaḥ paraguṇāsahanatayā sarvākṣepakaḥ | biḍālavratena caratīti baiḍālavratikaḥ | biḍālo hi prāyeṇa mūṣikādihiṃsārucitayā dhyānaniṣṭha iva vinītaḥ sann avatiṣṭhate ity upacārāt biḍālavrataśabdaḥ || 4.195 ||
adhodṛṣṭir naiṣkṛtikaḥ svārthasādhanatatparaḥ |
śaṭho mithyāvinītaś ca bakavratacaro dvijaḥ || 4.196 ||
adhidṛṣṭir iti | adhodṛṣṭir nijavinayakhyāpanāya satatam eva nirīkṣate | niṣkṛtir niṣṭhuratā, tayā caratīti naiṣkṛtikaḥ | svārthasādhanatatparaḥ parārthakhaṇḍanena, śaṭho vakraḥ | mithyāvinītaḥ kapaṭavinayavān | bakavrataṃ caratīti bakavratacaraḥ | bako hi prāyeṇa mīnahananarucitayā mithyāvinītaḥ sann evaṃśīlo bhavatīti gauṇo bakavrataśabdaḥ || 4.196 ||
ye bakavratino viprā ye ca mārjāraliṅginaḥ |
te patanty andhatāmisre tena pāpena karmaṇā || 4.197 ||
ye bakavratina iti | ye bakavrataṃ biḍālavrataṃ caranti te brāhmaṇās tena pāpahetunā karmaṇāndhatāmisranāmni narake patanti || 4.197 ||
na dharmasyāpadeśena pāpaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caret |
vratena pāpaṃ pracchādya kurvan strīśūdradambhanam || 4.198 ||
na dharmasyeti | pāpaṃ kṛtvā prāyaścittarūpaṃ prājāpatyādivratam, pāpam apanayati iti tan nedaṃ prāyaścittam, kiṃ tu “dharmārtham aham anutiṣṭhāmi” iti strīśūdramūrkhādijanamohanaṃ kurvan nānutiṣṭhet || 4.198 ||
pretyeha cedṛśā viprā garhyante brahmavādibhiḥ |
chadmanā caritaṃ yac ca vrataṃ rakṣāṃsi gacchati || 4.199 ||
aliṅgī liṅgiveṣeṇa yo vṛttim upajīvati |
sa liṅgināṃ haraty enas tiryagyonau ca jāyate || 4.200 ||
pretyeheti ślokadvayam | prathamaṃ subodham | abrahmacārī yo brāhmaṇo brahmacaryādiliṅgaṃ mekhalājinadaṇḍādiveṣopalakṣitas tadvṛttyā bhikṣābhramaṇādinā jīvati sa brahmacāryādīnāṃ yat pāpaṃ tad ātmany āharati | kukkurāditiryagyonau cotpadyate | tasmād etan na kartavyam iti niṣedhaḥ kalpyate || 4.199–200 ||
parakīyanipāneṣu na snāyāc ca kadācana |
nipānakartuḥ snātvā tu kuṣkṛtāṃśena lipyate || 4.201 ||
parakīyeti | nipānaṃ jalādhāraḥ | parakṛtapuṣkariṇyādiṣu na kadācit snāyāt | tatra snātvā puṣkariṇyādikartur yat pāpaṃ tasyāṃśena vakṣyamāṇacaturthabhāgarūpeṇa saṃbadhyate | akṛtrimanadyādyasaṃbhave parakṛte 'pi puṣkariṇyādau prāk pradānāt pañca piṇḍān uddhṛtya snātavyam | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ (1.159) |
pañca piṇḍān anuddhṛtya na snāyāt paravāriṣu |
uddhṛtya caturaḥ piṇḍān pārakye snānam ācaret |
snātvā ca tarpayed devān pitṝṃś caiva viśeṣataḥ ||
|| 4.201 ||
yānaśayyāsanāny asya kūpodyānagṛhāni ca |
adattāny upayuñjānaḥ enasaḥ syāt turīyabhāk || 4.202 ||
yānaśayyeti | asyeti prakṛtaḥ punaḥ parāmṛśyate | parasya yānādīny adattāny upayuñjānas tadīyapāpacaturthabhāgabhāgī bhavati | adattānīti parasyānumatyabhāvaś ca vivakṣitaḥ | tena sarvārthotsṛṣṭamaṭhakūpādāv upayogārthātmasnānādau na virodhaḥ || 4.202 ||
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu taḍāgeṣu saraḥsu ca |
snānaṃ samācaren nityaṃ gartaprasravaṇeṣu ca || 4.203 ||
nadīṣv iti | nadyādiṣu sarvadā snānam ācaret | devakhyāteṣv iti taḍāgaviśeṣaṇam | devasaṃbandhitvena prasiddheṣu saraḥsu garteṣv aṣṭadhanuḥsahasrebhyo nyūnagatiṣu | tad uktaṃ candhogapariśiṣṭe |
dhanuḥsahasrāṇy aṣṭau ca gatir yāsāṃ na vidyate |
na tā nadīśabdavahā gartās tāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||
caturhastapramāṇaṃ dhanuḥ | prasravaṇeṣu nirjhareṣu cānenaiva parakīyanipānavyāvṛttisiddhau yat pṛthagvacanaṃ tad ātmīyotsṛṣṭataḍāgādiṣu snānādyanujñānārtham, tad api nadyādyasaṃbhave draṣṭavyam || 4.203 ||
yamān seveta satataṃ na nityaṃ niyamān budhaḥ |
yamān pataty akurvāṇo niyamān kevalān bhajan || 4.204 ||
yamān iti | niyamāpekṣayā yamānuṣṭhānagauravajñāpanārtham idaṃ na tu niyamaniṣedhārtham, dvayor eva śāstrārthatvāt | yamaniyamavivekaś ca munibhir evaṃ kṛtaḥ | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ (3.312–13) |
brahmacaryaṃ dayā kṣāntir dhyānaṃ satyam akalkatā |
ahiṃsāsteyamādhurye damaś ceti yamāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
snānaṃ maunopavāsejyāsvādhyāyopasthanigrahāḥ |
niyamo guruśuśrūṣā śaucākrodhāpramādatā ||
yamniyamasvarūpajñaḥ samastasnānādiniyamatyāgenāpy ahiṃsādirūpaṃ yamam anutiṣṭhet | niyamān anutiṣṭhann api yamānuṣṭhānarahitaḥ patatīty ayaṃ yamastutyartha ārambha iti | medhātithi-govindarājau tu hiṃsādipratiṣedhārthakā yamāḥ, “vedam eva japen nityam” (4.147) ityādayo ‘nuṣṭheyarūpā niyamā iti vyācakṣāte |
ahiṃsā satyavacanaṃ brahmacaryam akalkatā |
asteyam iti pañcaite yamā vai parikīrtitāḥ ||
akrodho guruśuśrūṣā śaucam āhāralāghavam |
apramādaś ca satataṃ pañcaite niyamāḥ smṛtāḥ ||
|| 4.204 ||
nāśrotriyatate yajñe grāmayājikṛte tathā |
striyā klībena ca hute bhuñjīta brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit || 4.205 ||
nāśrotriyeti | anadhītavedenopakrānte yajñe ‘gnīṣomīyād ūrdhvam api bhojanayogyasamaye brāḥmaṇo na bhuñjīta | tathā bahūnāṃ yājakena ṛtvijā striyā napuṃsakena ca yatra yajñe hūyate tatra kacādin na bhuñjīta || 4.205 ||
aślīkam etat sādhūnaṃ yatra juhvaty amī haviḥ |
pratīpam etad devānāṃ tasmāt tat parivarjayet || 4.206 ||
aślīkam iti | pūrvoktā bahuyājakādayo yatra homaṃ kurvanti tat karma śiṣṭānām aślīkam aśrīkaṃ śrīghnam | rephasya sthāne lakāraḥ | devānāṃ pratikūlaṃ tasmād etad dhomaṃ na kārayet || 4.206 ||
mattakruddhāturāṇāṃ ca na bhuñjīta kadācana |
keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca padā spṛṣṭaṃ ca kāmataḥ || 4.207 ||
mattakruddhāturāṇām iti | kṣībakruddhavyādhitānāṃ annaṃ tathā keśakīṭasaṃsargaduṣṭaṃ pādena cecchātaḥ saṃspṛṣṭam annaṃ na bhuñjīta || 4.207 ||
bhrūṇaghnāvekṣitaṃ caiva saṃspṛṣṭaṃ cāpy udakyayā |
patatriṇāvalīḍhaṃ ca śunā saṃspṛṣṭam eva ca || 4.208 ||
bhrūṇadhneti | bhrūṇaghnety upalakṣaṇād goghnetyādipatitāvekṣitaṃ rajasvalayā ca spṛṣṭaṃ pakṣiṇā ca kākādinā svāditaṃ kukkureṇa ca spṛṣṭam annaṃ na bhuñjīta || 4.208 ||
gavā cānnam upāghrātaṃ ghuṣṭānnaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca viduṣā ca jugupsitam || 4.209 ||
gaveti | yad annaṃ gavāghrātam | ghuṣṭānnaṃ ko bhoktety upodghuṣṭvānnaṃ satrādau yad dīyate | viśeṣata iti bhūridoṣatayā prāyaścittagauravārtham | gaṇānnaṃ śatabrāhmaṇasaṅghānnam | gaṇikā veśyā tasyā annam | śāstravidā ca yad duṣṭam iti ninditaṃ tac ca na bhūñjīta || 4.209 ||
stenagāyanayoś cānnaṃ takṣṇo vārdhuṣikasya ca |
dīkṣitasya kadaryasya baddhasya nigaḍasya ca || 4.210 ||
steneti | cauragāyanajīvinos tathā takṣavṛttijīvanasya vṛddhyupajīvinaś cānnaṃ na bhūñjīta | tathā yajñe dīkṣitasya prāg agnīṣomīyāt | kadaryasya kṛpaṇasya | nigaḍasyeti tṛtīyārthe ṣaṣṭhī | nigaḍena baddhasya | govindarājas tu baddhaśabdasya bandhanair vināpy ayonigaḍair nigaḍitasya dattāyonigaḍasyeti vyākhyātavān || 4.210 ||
abhiśastasya ṣaṇḍhasya puṃścalyā dāmbhikasya ca |
śuktaṃ paryuṣitaṃ caiva śūdrasyocchiṣṭam eva ca || 4.211 ||
abhiśastasyeti | mahāpātakitvena saṃjātalokavikrośasya, napuṃsakasya, puṃścalyā vyabhicāriṇyā agaṇikāyā api, dāmbhikasya chadmanā dharmacāriṇo baiḍālavratikāder annaṃ na bhuñjīta | śuktaṃ yat svabhāvato madhuraṃ dadhyādisaṃparkavaśenodakādinā cāmlādibhāvaṃ gatam, paryuṣitaṃ rātryantaritam, śūdrasyānnaṃ na bhūjñiteti saṃbandhaḥ | ucchiṣṭaṃ ca bhuktāvaśiṣṭānnam aviśeṣāt kasyāpi na bhuñjīta | gurūcchiṣṭaṃ ca vihitatvād bhojyam | govindarājas tu śūdrasyocchiṣṭaṃ tadbhuktāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca sthālīstham api na bhuñjīety āha || 4.211 ||
cikitsakasya mṛgayoḥ krūrasyocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ |
ugrānnaṃ sūtikānnaṃ ca paryācāntam anirdaśam || 4.212 ||
cikitsakasyeti | cikitsājīvinaḥ, mṛgayor māṃsavikrayārthaṃ mṛgādipaśuhantuḥ, krūrasyānṛjuprakṛteḥ, niṣiddhocchiṣṭabhoktur annaṃ na bhuñjīta | ugro dāruṇakarmā tasyānnam |
govindarājo mañjaryām ugraṃ rājānam uktavān |
manuvṛttau ca śūdrāyāṃ kṣatriyotpannam abhyadhāt ||
bhedokter yājñavalkīye nogro rājeti vāvadat |
āścaryam idam etasya svakīyahṛdi bhūṣaṇam ||
sūtikānnaṃ sūtikām uddiśya yat kriyate tad annaṃ tatkulajair api na bhoktavyam | ekapaṅktisthān anyān avamanya yatrānne bhujyamāne kenacid ācamanaṃ kriyate tat paryācāntam | anirdaśaṃ sūtikānnaṃ vakṣyamāṇatvān na bhuñjīta || 4.212 ||
anarcitaṃ vṛthāmāṃsam avīrāyāś ca yoṣitaḥ |
dviṣadannaṃ nagaryānnaṃ patitānnam avakṣutam || 4.213 ||
anarcitam iti | arcārhasya yad avajñayā dīyate, vṛthāmāṃsaṃ devatādikam uddiśya yan na kṛtam, avīrāyāḥ patiputrarahitāyāḥ, śatrunagarapatitānāṃ ca, upari kṛtakṣutaṃ cānnaṃ na bhuñjīta || 4.213 ||
piśunānṛtinoś cānnaṃ kratuvikrayiṇas tathā |
śaulūṣatunnavāyānnaṃ kṛtaghnasyānnam eva ca || 4.214 ||
piśuneti | piśunaḥ parokṣe parāpavādabhāṣaṇaparaḥ, anṛtyatiśayenānṛtavādi kūṭasākṣyādiḥ, kratuvikrayikaḥ “madīyayāgasya phalaṃ tava bhavatu” ity abhidhāya yo dhanaṃ gṛhṇāti, śaulūṣo naṭaḥ, tunnavāyaḥ saucikaḥ, kṛtaghno yaḥ kṛtopakārasyāpakāre pravartate tasyānnaṃ na bhuñjīta || 4.214 ||
karmārasya niṣādasya raṅgāvatarakasya ca |
suvarṇakartur veṇasya śastravikrayiṇas tathā || 4.215 ||
karmārasyeti | karmārasya lohakārasya, niṣādasya daśamādhyāyoktasya, naṭagāyanavyatiriktasya raṅgāvataraṇajīvinaḥ, suvarṇakārasya, veṇor bhedanena yo jīvati, “buruḍa” iti viśvarūpaḥ | śastraṃ lohaṃ tadvikrayiṇaś cānnaṃ na bhuñjīta || 4.215 ||
śvavatāṃ śauṇḍikānāṃ ca cailanirṇejakasya ca |
rañjakasya nṛśaṃsasya yasya copapatir gṛhe || 4.216 ||
śvavatām iti | ākheṭakādyarthaṃ śunaḥ poṣakāṇām, madyavikrayiṇām, vastradhāvakasya, kusumbhādinā vastrarāgakṛtaḥ, nirdayasya, yasya copapatir gṛhe jāraś ca yasyājñānato gṛhe sthitas tasya gehe nādyāt || 4.216 ||
mṛṣyanti ye copapatiṃ strījitānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
anirdaśaṃ ca pretānnam atuṣṭikaram eva ca || 4.217 ||
mṛṣyantīti | gṛha ity anuṣajyate | gehe jñātaṃ bhāryājāraṃ ye sahante teṣām annaṃ na bhuñjīta | tena gṛhān niḥsāritāyā jārasahane naiṣa doṣaḥ | tathā sarvakarmasu strīparatantrāṇām, anirgatāśaucaṃ ca sūtakānnam, atuṣṭikaram eva ca na bhuñjīta || 4.217 ||
rājānnaṃ teja ādatte śūdrānnaṃ brahmavarcasam |
āyuḥ suvarṇakārānnaṃ yaśaś carmāvakartinaḥ || 4.218 ||
rājānnam iti | rājānnaṃ tejo nāśayati | ita eva doṣadarśanāt tadannabhakṣaṇaniṣedhaḥ kalpyate | evam uttaratrāpi | pūrvam aniṣiddhasya doṣadarśanād eva niṣedhakalpanam | “nādyāc chūdrasya pakvānnam” (4.223) iti niṣedhiṣyati | tadatikramaṇaphalakathanam idam | śūdrasya pakvānnam adhyayanādinimittaṃ tejo nāśayati | suvarṇakārasyānnam āyuḥ | carmakārānnaṃ khyātiṃ nāśayati || 4.218 ||
kārukānnaṃ prajāṃ hanti balaṃ nirṇejakasya ca |
gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca lokebhyaḥ parikṛntati || 4.219 ||
kārukānnam iti | kārukasya sūpakārāder annaṃ prajām apatyaṃ nihanti | carmakārādeḥ kārukatve ‘pi gobalīvardanyāyena pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ | nirṇejakasyānnaṃ balaṃ hanti | gaṇagaṇikayor annaṃ ca karmāntarārjitebhyaḥ svargādilokebhya ācchinatti || 4.219 ||
pūyaṃ cikitsakasyānnaṃ puṃścalyās tv annam indriyam |
viṣṭhā vārdhuṣikasyānnaṃ śastravikrayiṇo malam || 4.220 ||
pūyam iti | cikitsakasyānnaṃ pūyaṃ pūyabhakṣaṇasamadoṣam | evaṃ puṃścalyā annam indriyaṃ śukram | vārdhuṣikasyānnaṃ purīṣam | lohavikrayiṇo ‘nnaṃ viṣṭhāvyatiriktaśleṣmādi | govindarājas tu cikitsakānnabhakṣaṇena tathāvidhānāṃ jātau jāyate yatra pūyabhug bhavatīty āha || 4.220 ||
ya ete ‘nye tv abhojyānnāḥ kramaśaḥ parikīrtitaḥ |
teṣāṃ tvagasthiromāṇi vadanty annaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ || 4.221 ||
ya ete ‘nya iti | pratipadanirdiṣṭebhyo ye ‘nye krameṇābhojyānnā asmin prakaraṇe paṭhitās teṣāṃ yad annaṃ tat tvagasthiromāṇi, yās tadīyās tvacaḥ kīkasasya romnāṃ ca bhuktānāṃ yo doṣaḥ sa eva tadannasyāpi bhuktasya boddhavyaḥ || 4.221 ||
bhuktvāto ‘nyatamasyānnam amatyā kṣapaṇaṃ tryaham |
matyā bhuktvācaret kṛcchraṃ retoviṇmūtram eva ca || 4.222 ||
bhuktveti | eṣāṃ madhye ‘nyatamasaṃbandhānnam ajñānato bhuktvā tryaham upavāsaḥ | jñānatas tu kṛcchram | evaṃ retoviṇmūtrabhojane ‘pi | etac cānyatamasyeti ṣaṣṭīnirdeśān mattādisaṃbandhinaḥ parigrahaduṣṭānnasyaiva prāyaścittaṃ na saṃsargaduṣṭasya keśakīṭāvapannādeḥ | nāpi kāladuṣṭasya paryuṣitānnadeḥ | nāpi nimittaduṣṭasya ghuṣṭādeḥ | ekaprakaraṇopadeśaś caiṣāṃ snātakatvajñāpanārtham | prāyaścittaṃ caiteṣv ekādaśe vakṣyati | yadi tu sarveṣv evaṃ prāyaścittaṃ syāt tadā bhuktvāto ‘nyatamasyānnaṃ duṣṭam ity abhyadhāsyat | na tv anyatamasya tu bhuktveti |
tasmād ekaprakaraṇād yan medhātithir abhyadhāt |
prāyaścittam idaṃ yuktaṃ śuktādau tad asundaram ||
aprakaraṇe ca prāyaścittasyābhidhānaṃ lāghavārtham | tatra kriyamāṇe mattādigrahaṇam api kartavyaṃ syāt || 4.222 ||
nādyāc chūdrasya pakvānnaṃ vidvān aśrāddhino dvijaḥ |
ādadītāmam evāsmād avṛttāv ekarātrikam || 4.223 ||
nādyād iti | aviśeṣeṇa śūdrānnaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ tasyedānīṃ viśiṣṭaviṣayatocyate | aśrāddhinaḥ śrāddhādipañcayajñaśūnyasya śūdrasya śāstravid dvijaḥ pakvānnaṃ na bhuñjīta, kiṃ tv annāntarābhāve saty ekarātranirvāhocitam āmam evānnam asmād gṛhṇīyān na tu pakvānnam
|| 4.223 ||
śrotriyasya kadaryasya vadānyasya ca vārdhuṣeḥ |
mīṃāṃsitvobhayaṃ devāḥ samam annam akalpayan || 4.224 ||
śrotriyasyeti | eko ‘dhītavedaḥ kṛpaṇaś ca, paro dātā vṛddhijīvī ca | tayor ubhayor api guṇadoṣavattvaṃ vicārya devās tulyam annam anayor iti nirūpitavantaḥ, ubhayor api guṇadoṣasāmyāt || 4.224 ||
tān prajāpatir āhaitya mā kṛḍhvaṃ viṣamaṃ samam |
śraddhāpūtaṃ vadānyasya hatam aśraddhayetarat || 4.225 ||
tān iti | tān devān āgatya brahmā provāca viṣamam annaṃ mā samaṃ kuruta | viṣamasamīkaraṇam anucitam | kaḥ punar anayor viśeṣa ity apekṣāyāṃ sa evāvocat | dānaśīlavārdhuṣikasyāpi śraddhayānnaṃ pavitraṃ bhavati | kṛpaṇānnaṃ punar aśraddhayā hataṃ dūṣitam adhamam | prāg ubhayapratiṣedhe ‘pi śraddhādattavidvadvārdhuṣikānna-viśuddhibodhanaparam idam || 4.225 ||
ata evāha –
śraddhayeṣṭaṃ ca pūrtaṃ ca nityaṃ kuryād atandritaḥ |
śraddhākṛte hy akṣaye te bhavataḥ svāgatair dhanaiḥ || 4.226 ||
śraddayeti | iṣṭam antarvedi yajñādikarma, pūrtaṃ tato ‘nyat puṣkariṇīkūpaprapārāmādi, tad evam analasaḥ san nityaṃ kāmyasvargādiphalarahitaṃ śraddhayā kuryāt | yasmāt te iṣṭāpūrte nyāyārjitadhanena śraddhayā kṛte ‘kṣaye mokṣaphale bhavataḥ || 4.226 ||
dānadharmaṃ niṣeveta nityam aiṣṭikapaurtikam |
parituṣṭena bhāvena pātram āsādya śaktitaḥ || 4.227 ||
dānadharmam iti | dānākhyaṃ dharmam aiṣṭikaṃ paurtikam antarvedikaṃ bahirvedikaṃ ca sarvadā vidyātapoyuktaṃ brāhmaṇam āsādya parituṣṭāntaḥkaraṇayuktaḥ yathāśakti kuryāt
|| 4.227 ||
yat kiṃcid api dātavyaṃ yācitenānasūyatā |
utpatsyate hi tat pātraṃ yat tārayati sarvataḥ || 4.228 ||
yat kiṃcid iti | prārthitena paraguṇāmatsareṇānnam api yathāśakti dātavyam | yasmāt sarvadā dānaśīlasya kadācit tādṛśaṃ pātram āgamiṣyati tat sarvasmān narakahetor mocayiṣyati || 4.228 ||
vāridas tṛptim āpnoti sukham akṣayyam annadaḥ |
tilapradaḥ prajām iṣṭāṃ dīpadaś cakṣur uttamam || 4.229 ||
vārida iti | jaladaḥ kṣutpipāsāvigamāt tṛptim, annado ‘tytantasukham, tulaprada īpsitāny apatyādīni, dīpado vipraveśmādau nirdoṣaṃ cakṣuḥ prāpnoti || 4.229 ||
bhūmido bhūmim āpnoti dīrgham āyur hiraṇyadaḥ |
gṛhado ‘gryāṇi veśmāni rūpyado rūpam uttamam || 4.230 ||
bhūmida iti | bhūmido bhūmer ādhipatyam, suvarṇadaś cirajīvitvam, gṛhadaḥ śreṣṭhāni veśmāni, rūpyadaḥ sakalajananayanamanoharaṃ rūpaṃ labhate || 4.230 ||
vāsodaś candrasālokyam aśvisālokyam aśvadaḥ |
anaḍuddaḥ śriyaṃ puṣṭāṃ godo bradhnasya viṣṭapam || 4.231 ||
vāsoda iti | vastradaś candrasamānalokān prāpnoti candraloke candrasamavibhūtir vasati, evam evāśvilokaṃ ghoṭakadaḥ, balīvardasya dātā pracurāṃ śriyaṃ, strīgavīpradaḥ sūryalokaṃ prāpnoti || 4.231 ||
yānaśayyāprado bhāryām aiśvaryam abhayapradaḥ |
dhānyadaḥ śāśvataḥ saukhyaṃ brahmado brahmasārṣṭitām || 4.232 ||
yānaśayyeti | rathādiyānasya śayyāyāś ca dātā bhāryām, abhayapradaḥ prāṇinām ahiṃsakaḥ prabhutvam, dhānyado vrīhiyavamāṣamudgādisasyānāṃ dātā cirasthāyi sukhitvam, brahma vedas tatprado vedasyādhyāpako vyākhyātā ca brahmaṇaḥ sārṣṭitāṃ samānagatitāṃ tattulyatāṃ prāpnoti || 4.232 ||
sarveṣām eva dānānāṃ brahmadānaṃ viśiṣyate |
vāryannagomahīvāsastilakāñcanasarpiṣām || 4.233 ||
sarveṣām iti | udakānnadhenubhūmivastratilasuvarṇaghṛtādīnāṃ sarveṣām eva yāni dānāni teṣāṃ madhyād vedadānaṃ viśiṣyate prakṛṣṭaphaladaṃ bhavati || 4.233 ||
yena yena tu bhāvena yad yad dānaṃ prayacchati |
tat tat tenaiva bhāvena prāpnoti pratipūjitaḥ || 4.234 ||
yena yeneti | avadhāraṇe tuśabdaḥ | yena yenaiva bhāvenābhiprāyeṇa phalābhisaṃdhikaḥ svargo me syād iti, mumukṣur mokṣābhiprāyeṇa niṣkāmo yad yad dānaṃ dadāti tenaiva bhāvenopalakṣitas tattaddānaphaladvāreṇa janmāntare pūjitaḥ san prāpnoti || 4.234 ||
yo ‘rcitaṃ pratigṛhṇāti dadāty arcitam eva ca |
tāv ubhau gacchataḥ svargaṃ narakaṃ tu viparyaye || 4.235 ||
yo ‘rcitam iti | yo ‘rcāpūrvakam eva dātā dadāti, yaś ca pragrahītārcāpūrvakam eva dattaṃ pratigṛhṇāti tāv ubhau svargaṃ gacchato ‘narcitadānapratigrahaṇe narakam | puruṣārthe tu pratigrahe ‘narcitam eva mayā grahītavyaṃ nānyatheti niyamāt phalalābho na viruddhaḥ
|| 4.235 ||
na vismayeta tapasā vaded iṣṭvā ca nānṛtam |
nārto ‘py apavaded viprān na datvā parikīrtayet || 4.236 ||
na vismayeteti | cāndrāyaṇāditapasā kṛtena ‘kathaṃ mamedaṃ duṣkaram anuṣṭhitam’ iti vismayaṃ na kuryāt | yāgaṃ ca kṛtvā nāsatyaṃ vadet | kṛte ‘pi puruṣārthatayānṛtavadananiṣedhe kratvartho ‘yaṃ punar niṣedhaḥ | brāhmaṇaiḥ pīḍito ‘pi na tān nindet | gavādikaṃ ca datvā ‘mayedaṃ dattam’ iti parasya na kathayet || 4.236 ||
yajño ‘nṛtena kṣarati tapaḥ kṣarati vismayāt |
āyur viprāpavādena dānaṃ ca parikīrtanāt || 4.237 ||
yajña iti | anṛtena hetunā yajñaḥ kṣarati | satyenaiva sa phalaṃ sādhayati | evaṃ tapasi dāne ca yojyam | vipranindayā cāyuḥ kṣīyate || 4.237 ||
dharmaṃ śanaiḥ saṃcinuyād valmīkam iva puttikāḥ |
paralokasahāyārthaṃ sarvabhūtāny apīḍayan || 4.238 ||
dharmam iti | sarvaprāṇināṃ pīḍāṃ pariharan paralokasahāyārthaṃ yathāśakti śanaiḥ śanair dharmam anutiṣṭhet | yathā puttikāḥ pipīlikāprabhedāḥ śanaiḥ śanair mahāntaṃ mṛttikākūṭaṃ saṃcinvanti || 4.238 ||
nāmutra hi sahāyārthaṃ pitā mātā ca tiṣṭhataḥ |
na putradārā na jñātir dharmas tiṣthati kevalaḥ || 4.239 ||
nāmutreti | yasmāt paraloke sahāyakāryasiddhyarthaṃ na pitṛmātṛpatnījñātayas tiṣṭhanti kiṃ tu dharma evaiko ‘dvitīyabhāvenopakārārtham avatiṣṭhate | tasmāt putrādibhyo ‘pi mahopakārakaṃ dharmam anutiṣthet || 4.239 ||
ekaḥ prajāyate jantur eka eva pralīyate |
eko ‘nubhuṅkte sukṛtam eka eva ca duṣkṛtam || 4.240 ||
eka iti | eka eva prāṇy utpadyate na bāndhavaiḥ sahitaḥ | eka eva ca mriyate | sukṛtaphalam api svargādikaṃ, duritaphalaṃ ca narakādikam eka eva bhuṅkte na mātrādibhiḥ saha | tasmān mātrādyapekṣayāpi dharmaṃ na tyajet || 4.240 ||
mṛtaṃ śarīram utsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ kṣitau |
vimukhā bāndhavā yānti dharmas tam anugacchati || 4.241 ||
mṛtam iti | mṛtaṃ śarīraṃ manaḥprāṇādityaktaṃ loṣtavad acetanaṃ bhūmau tyaktvā parāṅmukhā bāndhavā yānti na mṛtaṃ jīvam anuyanti, dharmas tu tam anugacchati || 4.241 ||
tasmād dharmaṃ sahāyārthaṃ nityaṃ saṃcinuyāc chanaiḥ |
dharmeṇa hi sahāyena tamas tarati dustaram || 4.242 ||
tasmād iti | yasmād dharmeṇa sahāyena dustaraṃ tamo narakādiduḥkhaṃ tarati tasmād dharmaṃ sahāyabhāvena satataṃ śanair anutiṣṭhet || 4.242 ||
dharmapradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ tapasā hatakilbiṣam |
paralokaṃ nayaty āśu bhāsvantaṃ khaśarīriṇam || 4.243 ||
dharmapradhānam iti | dharmaparaṃ puruṣaṃ daivād upajāte pāpe prājāpatyāditaporūpaprāyaścittena hatapāpaṃ dīptimantaṃ prakṛto dharma eva śīghraṃ brahma svargādirūpaṃ paralokaṃ nayati | “khaṃ brahma” (ChUp 4.10.5) ityādyupaniṣatsu khaśabdasya brahmaṇi prayogaḥ | khaśarīriṇaṃ brahmasvarūpam ity arthaḥ | yady api liṅgśarīrāvacchinno jīva eva gacchati tathāpi brahmāṃśatvād brahmasvarūpam upapannam, dharma eva cet paraṃ lokaṃ nayati tato dharmam anutiṣthet |
na hi vedāḥ svadhītās tu śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca |
tatra gacchanti yatrāsya dharma eko ‘nugacchati ||
|| 4.243 ||
uttamair uttamair nityaṃ saṃbandhān ācaret saha |
ninīṣuḥ kulam utkarṣam adhamān adhamāṃs tyajet || 4.244 ||
uttamair iti | kulam utkarṣaṃ netum icchan vidyācārajanmādibhir utkṛṣṭaiḥ saha sarvadā kanyādānādisaṃbandhān ācaret | apakṛṣṭāṃs tu saṃbandhāṃs tyajet | uttamavidhānād evādhamaparityāge siddhe yat punaḥ ‘adhamāṃs tyajet’ ity abhidhānaṃ taduttamāsaṃbhave svatulyādyanujñānārtham || 4.244 ||
uttamān uttamān gacchan hīnān hīnāṃś ca varjayan |
brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhatām eti pratyavāyena śūdratām || 4.245 ||
uttamān iti | uttamān gacchaṃs taiḥ saha saṃbandhaṃ kurvan brāhmaṇaḥ śreṣṭhatāṃ gacchati | pratyavāyena viparītācāreṇa hīnaiḥ saha saṃbandhe jāter apakarṣatayā śūdratulyatām eti || 4.245 ||
dṛḍhakārī mṛdur dāntaḥ krūrācārair asaṃvasan |
ahiṃsro damadānābhyāṃ jayet svargaṃ tathāvrataḥ || 4.246 ||
dṛḍhakārīti | prārabdhasaṃpādayitā dṛḍhakārī mṛdur aniṣthuraḥ | damasya pṛthag upādānāḍ dānta iti śītātapādidvandvasahiṣṇur grahītavyaḥ | krūrācāraiḥ puruṣaiḥ saṃsargaṃ pariharan, parahiṃsānivṛttaḥ, tathāvrata eva niyamadamendriyasaṃyamākhyena ca dānena svargaṃ prāpnoti || 4.246 ||
edhodakaṃ mūlaphalam annam abhyudyataṃ ca yat |
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyān madhv athābhayadakṣiṇām || 4.247 ||
edhodakam iti | kāṣṭhajalaphalamūlamadhūni annaṃ cābhyudyatam ayācitopanītam |
anyatra kulaṭāṣaṇḍhapatitebhyas tathā dviṣaḥ | (YDh 1.215)
iti yājñavalkyavacanāt kulaṭādivarjaṃ sarvataḥ śūdrādibhyo ‘pi pratigṛhṇīyāt | “āmam evādadītāsmāt” (4.223) ity uktatvād āmānnam eva śūdrāt pratigrāhyam | abhayaṃ cātmatrāṇātmakaṃ prītihetutvād dakṣiṇātulyaṃ caṇḍālādibhyo ‘pi svīkuryāt || 4.247 ||
āhṛtābhyudyatāṃ bhikṣāṃ purastād apracoditām |
mene prajāpatir grāhyam api duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ || 4.248 ||
āhṛtābhyudyatām iti | āhṛtāṃ saṃpradānadeśam ānītām | abhyudyatām ābhimukhyena sthāpitām | apracoditāṃ pratigrahītrā svayam anyamukhena vā pūrvam ayācitāṃ dātrā ca ‘tubhyam idaṃ dadāni’ iti pūrvam akathitāṃ hiraṇyādibhikṣāṃ na tu siddhānnarūpām | “annam abhyudyataṃ ca” (4.247) ity uktatvāt pāpakāriṇo ‘pi patitādivarjaṃ grāhyam iti viriñcir amanyata || 4.248 ||
nāśnanti pitaras tasya daśa varṣāṇi pañca ca |
na ca havyaṃ vahaty agnir yas tām abhyavamanyate || 4.249 ||
nāśnantīti | tenopakalpitaṃ śrāddheṣu kavyaṃ pañcadaśa varṣāṇi pitaro na bhuñjate | na ca yajñeṣu tena dattaṃ puroḍāśādi havyam agnir vahati devān prāpayati yas tāṃ bhikṣāṃ na svīkaroti || 4.249 ||
śayyāṃ gṛhān kuśān gandhān apaḥ puṣpaṃ maṇīn dadhi |
dhānā matsyān payo māṃsaṃ śākaṃ caiva na nirṇudet || 4.250 ||
śayyām iti | gandhān gandhavanti karpūrādīni, dhānāḥ bhraṣṭayavataṇḍulān, payaḥ kṣīram, pūrvam āharaṇopāyanibandhena gavādīnām apratyākhyānam uktam, śayyādīni tv ayācitāhṛtāny api dātrā svagṛhasthitāny ayācitopakalpitāni na pratyācakṣīta || 4.250 ||
gurūn bhṛtyāṃś cojjihīrṣann arciṣyan devatātithīn |
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyān na tu tṛpyet svayaṃ tataḥ || 4.251 ||
gurūn iti | mātāpitrādīn gurūn bhṛtyāṃś ca bhāryādīn kṣudhāvasannān uddhartum icchan patitādivarjaṃ sarvataḥ śūdrāder asādhubhyaś ca pratigṛhṇīyāt, na tu tena dhanena svayaṃ varteta || 4.251 ||
guruṣu tv abhyatīteṣu vinā vā tair gṛhe vasan |
ātmano vṛttim anvicchan gṛhṇīyāt sādhutaḥ sadā || 4.252 ||
guruṣv iti | mātāpitrādiṣu mṛteṣu tair vā jīvadbhir api svayogāvasthitair vinā gṛhāntare vasann ātmano vṛttim anvicchan sarvadā sādhubhyo gṛhṇīyād eva || 4.252 ||
ārdhikaḥ kulamitraṃ ca gopālo dāsanāpitau |
ete śūdreṣu bhojyānnā yaś cātmānaṃ nivedayet || 4.253 ||
ārdhika iti | ārdhikaḥ kārṣikaḥ | saṃbandhiśabdāś caite | yo yasya kṛṣiṃ karoti sa tasya bhojyānnaḥ | evaṃ svakulasya mitram, yo yasya gopālaḥ, yo yasya dāsaḥ, yo yasya nāpitaḥ karma karoti, yo yasminn ātmānaṃ nivedayati ‘durgatir ahaṃ tvadīyasevāṃ kurvann iti ca tvatsamīpe vasāmi’ iti yaḥ śūdras tasya bhojyānnaḥ || 4.253 ||
yathātmanivedanaṃ śūdreṇa kartavyaṃ tad āha –
yādṛśo ‘sya bhaved ātmā yādṛśaṃ ca cikīrṣitam |
yathā copacared enaṃ tathātmānaṃ nivedayet || 4.254 ||
yādṛsa iti | asya śūdrasya kulaśīlādibhir yādṛśa ātmā svarūpaṃ yac cāsya karma kartur īpsitaṃ, yathā cānena sevā kartavyā tena prakāreṇātmānaṃ kathayet || 4.254 ||
yo ‘nyathā santam ātmānam anyathā satsu bhāṣate |
sa pāpakṛttamo loke stena ātmāpahārakaḥ || 4.255 ||
yo ‘nyatheti | ya iti sāmānyanirdeśāt prakṛtaśūdrād anyo ‘pi yaḥ kaścit kulādibhir anyathā bhūtam ātmānam anyathā sādhuṣu kathayati sa loke ‘tiśayena pāpakārī cauraḥ yasmād ātmāpahārakaḥ | steno dravyāntaram apaharati, ayaṃ tu sarvapradhānam ātmānam evāpaharet
|| 4.255 ||
vācy arthā niyatāḥ sarve vāṅmūlā vāgviniḥsṛtāḥ |
tāṃ tu yaḥ stenayed vācaṃ sa sarvasteyakṛn naraḥ || 4.256 ||
vācy arthā iti | sarve ‘rthāḥ śabdeṣu niyatā vācyatvena niyatāḥ vāṅmūlāś ca śabdās teṣāṃ pratipattau śabdebhya eva pratīyante pratītidvāreṇa śabdamūlatvaṃ śabdebhyaḥ evāvagamya cānuṣṭhīyanta iti vāgvinirgatā ity ucyante | ata eva “vedaśabdebhya evādau” (1.21) iti brahmaṇo ‘pi sṛṣṭir vedaśabdamūlaivoktā | ato yas tāṃ vācaṃ stenayet svārthavyabhicāriṇīṃ vācayati sa naraḥ sarvārthasteyakṛd bhavati || 4.256 ||
maharṣipitṛdevānāṃ gatvānṛṇyaṃ yathāvidhi |
putre sarvaṃ samāsajya vasen mādyasthyam āśritaḥ || 4.257 ||
maharṣīti | gṛhasthasyaiva saṃnyāsaprakāro ‘yam ucyate | maharṣīṇāṃ svādhyāyena, pitṝṇāṃ putrotpādanena, devatānāṃ yajñair yathāśāstram ānṛṇyaṃ gatvā yogyaputre sarvaṃ kuṭumbacintābhāram āropya mādhyasthyam āśritaḥ putradāradhanādau tyaktamamatvo brahmabuddhyā sarvatra samadarśano gṛha eva vaset || 4.257 ||
ekākī cintayen nityaṃ vivikte hitam ātmanaḥ |
ekākī cintayāno hi paraṃ śreyo ‘dhigacchati || 4.258 ||
ekākīti | kāmyakarmaṇāṃ dhanārjanasya ca kṛtasaṃnyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhādhyāye vakṣyamāṇaḥ putropakalpitavṛttir ekākī nirjanadeśe ātmahitaṃ jīvasya brahmabhāvaṃ vedāntoktaṃ sarvadā dhyāyet | yasmāt tad dhyāyan brahmasākṣātkāreṇa paraṃ śreyo mokṣalakṣaṇaṃ prāpnoti
|| 4.258 ||
eṣoditā gṛhasthasya vṛttir viprasya śāśvatī |
snātakavratakalpaś ca sattvavṛddhikaraḥ śubhaḥ || 4.259 ||
eṣeti | ayam adhyāyārthopasaṃhāraḥ | eṣā ṛtādivṛttir gṛhasthasya brāhmaṇasyoktā | śāśvatī nityā | āpadi tv anityā vakṣyate | snātakavratavidhiś ca sattvaguṇasya vṛddhikaraṇe praśasta uktaḥ || 4.259 ||
anena vipro vṛttena vartayan vedaśāstravit |
vyapetakalmaṣo nityaṃ brahmaloke mahīyate || 4.260 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ
caturtho ‘dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
aneneti | sarvasoktasya phalakathanam idam | anena śāstroktācāreṇa vedavid brāhmaṇo vartamāno nityakarmānuṣṭhānāt kṣīṇapāpaḥ san brahmajñānaprakarṣeṇa brahmaiva lokas tasmiṃl līno mahimānaṃ sarvotkarṣaṃ prāpnoti || 4.260 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau
caturtho ‘dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
pañcamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
śrutvaitān ṛṣayo dharmān snātakasya yathoditān |
idam ūcur mahātmānam analaprabhavaṃ bhṛgum || 5.1 ||
śrutvaitān iti | ṛṣayaḥ snātakasyaitānyathoditadharmāñ chrutvā mahātmānaṃ paramarthaparaṃ bhṛgum idaṃ vacanam abruvan | yady api prathamādhyāye daśaprajāpatimadhye “bhṛguṃ nāradam eva ca” (1.35) iti bhṛgusṛṣṭir api manuta evoktā tathāpi kalpabhedenāgniprabhavatvam ucyate | tathā ca śrutiḥ – “tasya yad retasaḥ prathamaṃ dedīpyate tad asāv ādityo ‘bhavad yad dvitīyam āsīd bhṛguḥ” iti | ata eva bhraṣṭād retasa utpannatvād bhṛguḥ || 5.1 ||
evaṃ yathoktaṃ viprāṇāṃ svadharmam anutiṣṭhatām |
kathaṃ mṛtyuḥ prabhavati vedaśāstravidāṃ prabho || 5.2 ||
evam iti | evaṃ yathoktaṃ svadharmaṃ karvatāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śrutiśāstrajñānāṃ vedoditāyuṣaḥ pūrvaṃ kathaṃ mṛtyuḥ prabhavati āyuralpatvahetor adharmācaraṇasyābhāvāt | sakalasaṃśayocchedanasamarthatvāt prabho iti saṃbodhanam || 5.2 ||
sa tān uvāca dharmātmā maharṣīn mānavo bhṛguḥ |
śrūyatāṃ yena doṣeṇa mṛtyur viprāñ jighāṃsati || 5.3 ||
sa tān iti | sa manoḥ putro bhṛgur dharmasvabhāvo yena doṣeṇālpakāle viprān hantum icchati mṛtyuḥ sa doṣaḥ śrūyatām ity evaṃ tān maharṣīñ jagāda || 5.3 ||
anabhyāsena vedānām ācārasya ca varjanāt |
ālasyād annadoṣāc ca mṛtyur viprāñ jighāṃsati || 5.4 ||
anabhyāseneti | vedānām anabhyāsāt, svīyācāraparityāgāt sāmarthye saty avaśyakartavyakaraṇānutsāhalakṣaṇād ālasyāt adanīyadoṣāc ca mṛtyur viprān hantum icchati, eteṣām adharmotpādanadvāreṇāyuḥkṣayahetutvāt || 5.4 ||
vedānabhyāsāder uktatvād anuktam annadoṣam āha –
laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ caiva palāṇḍuṃ kavakāni ca |
abhakṣyāṇi dvijātīnām amedhyaprabhavāṇi ca || 5.5 ||
laśunam iti | laśunagṛñjanapalāṇḍvākhyāni trīṇi sthūlakandaśākāni, kavakaṃ chatrākam, amedhyaprabhavāṇi viṣṭhādijātāni tandulīyādīni | dvijātīnām iti yājñavalkyavacanād etāni dvijātīnām abhakṣyāṇi | dvijātigrahaṇaṃ śūdraparyudāsārtham || 5.5. ||
lohitān vṛkṣaniryāsān vraścanaprabhavāṃs tathā |
śeluṃ gavyaṃ ca peyūṣaṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || 5.6 ||
lohitān iti | lohitavarṇān vṛkṣaniryāsān vṛkṣān nirgatarsān kaṭhinatāṃ yātān vraścanaṃ chedanaṃ tatprabhavān alohitām api | tathā ca taittirīyaśrutiḥ – “atho khalu ya eva lohito yo vā vraścanān niryeṣati tasyā nāśyaṃ kāmam anyasya” iti | śeluṃ bahuvārakaphalam, gobhavaṃ peyūṣaṃ navaprasūtāyā goḥ kṣīram agnisaṃyogāt kaṭhitaṃ bhavaty etān yatnatas tyajet | “anirdaśāyāḥ goḥ kṣīram” (5.8) ity anenaiva peyūṣasyāpi niṣedhasiddhāv adhikadoṣatvāt prāyaścittagauravajñāpanārthaṃ pṛthaṅnirdeśaḥ | ata eva yatnata ity uktam || 5.6 ||
vṛthākṛsarasaṃyāvaṃ pāyasāpūpam eva ca |
anupākṛtamāṃsāni devānnāni havīṃṣi ca || 5.7 ||
vṛthākṛsareti | devatādyanuddeśenātmārthaṃ yat pacyate tad vṛthā | kṛsaras tilena saha siddha odanaḥ | tathā ca chandogapratiśiṣṭam |
tilataṇḍulasaṃpakvaḥ kṛsaraḥ so ‘bhidhīyate |
saṃyāvo ghṛtakṣīraguḍagodhūmacūrṇasiddhas tatkariketi prasiddhaḥ | kṣīrataṇḍulamiśraḥ pāyasaḥ | apūpaḥ piṣṭakaḥ | etān vṛthāpakvān vivarjayet | paśuyāgādau mantrabahulena pasoḥ sparśanam upākaraṇaṃ tadrahitaḥ paśur upākṛtas tasya māṃsāni | devānnāni naivedyārtham annāni prāṅnivedanāt, havīṃṣi ca puroḍāśādīni homāt prāg varjayet | anupākṛtamāṃsāni ity etad viśeṣaniṣedhadarśanāt “anarcitaṃ vṛthāmāṃsam” (4.213) iti sāmānyaniṣedho gobalīvardanyāyenānupākṛtamāṃsetaraśrāddhādyanuddeśyamāṃsabhakṣaṇe paryavasyati || 5.7 ||
anirdaśāyā goḥ kṣīram auṣṭram aikaśaphaṃ tathā |
āvikaṃ saṃdhinīkṣīraṃ vivatsāyāś ca goḥ payaḥ || 5.8 ||
anirdaśāyā iti | prasūtāyā anidaśāyā gor dugdham | gor iti peyakṣīrapaśūpalakṣaṇārtham | tena ajāmahiṣyor api daśāhamadhye pratiṣedhaḥ | tathā ca yamaḥ |
anirdaśāhaṃ gokṣīram ājaṃ māhiṣam eva ca |
tathoṣṭrabhavam, aśvādyekakhurasaṃbandhi, meṣabhavam, saṃdhinī yā ṛtumatī vṛṣam icchati tasyāḥ kṣīram | tathā ca hārītaḥ: “saṃdhinī vṛṣasyantī tasyāḥ payo na pibed ṛtumat tad bhavati” | vivatsāyā mṛtavatsāyāḥ asaṃnihitavatsāyāś ca kṣīraṃ varjayet | dhenvadhikaraṇanyāyena vatsagrahaṇād eva gavi labdhāyāṃ punar gograhaṇaṃ gor eva na tv ajāmahiṣyor iti jñāpanārtham || 5.8 ||
āraṇyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ māhiṣaṃ vinā |
strīkṣīraṃ caiva varjyāni sarvaśuktāni caiva hi || 5.9 ||
araṇyānām iti | mṛgaśabdo ‘tra mahiṣaparyudāsāt paśumātraparaḥ | māhiṣaṃ kṣīraṃ varjayitvā sarveṣām āraṇyaprabhavapaśūnāṃ hastyādīnāṃ kṣīraṃ strīkṣīraṃ ca sarvāṇi śuktāni varjanīyāni | svabhāvato madhurarasāni yāni kālavaśenodakādinā cāmlībhavanti tāni śuktaśabdavācyāni | “śuktaṃ paryuṣitaṃ caiva” (4.211) iti caturthe kṛte ‘pi śuktapratiṣedhe dhadhyāipratiprasavārthaṃ punar ihocyate || 5.9 ||
dadhi bhakṣyaṃ ca śukteṣu sarvaṃ ca dadhisaṃbhavam |
yāni caivābhiṣūyante puṣpamūlaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 5.10 ||
dadhi bhakṣyaṃ ceti | śukteṣu madhye dadhi bhakṣyaṃ dadhisaṃbhavaṃ ca sarvaṃ takrādi | yāni tu puṣpamūlaphalair udakena saṃdhīyante tāni bhakṣaṇīyāni | śubhair iti viśeṣanopādānān mohādivikārakāribhiḥ kṛtasaṃdhānasya pratiṣedhaḥ | tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
kandamūlaphalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śastaiḥ śuktān na varjayet |
avikāri bhaved bhakṣyam abhakṣyaṃ tad vikārakṛt ||
|| 5.10 ||
kravyādāñ chakunān sarvāṃs tathā grāmanivāsinaḥ |
anirdiṣṭāṃś caikaśaphāṃṣ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ ca vivarjayet || 5.11 ||
kravyādān iti | āmaṃ māṃsaṃ ye bhakṣayanti te kravyādās tān sarvān gṛdhrādīn pakṣiṇo varjayet | tathā grāmanivāsinaś ca pakṣiṇaḥ pārāvatādīn | tathā śrutau kecid ekaśaphā bhakṣyatvena nirdiṣṭāḥ | tathā ca “auṣṭraṃ vāḍavam ālabheta tasya ca māṃsam aśnīyāt” iti | kecic cānirdiṣṭā rāsabhādayas teṣāṃ māṃsaṃ varjayet | ye ‘pi yajñāṅgatvena vihitās teṣām api yajña eva māṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ na sarvadā | ṭiṭṭibhākhyaṃ ca pakṣiṇaṃ varjayet || 5.11 ||
kalaviṅkaṃ plavaṃ haṃsaṃ cakrāhvaṃ grāmakukkuṭam |
sārasaṃ rajjudālaṃ ca dātyūhaṃ śukasārike || 5.12 ||
kalaviṅkam iti | kalaviṅkaṃ caṭakaṃ tasya grāmāranyobhayavāsinatvād eva niṣedhaḥ | ity āraṇyasyāpy abhakṣyatvārthaṃ jātiśabdena (?) niṣedhaḥ | plavākhyaṃ pakṣiṇam | tathā haṃsacakravākagrāmakukkuṭasārasarajjudāladātyūhaśukasārikākhyān pakṣiṇo varjayet | vakṣyamāṇajālapādaniṣedhenaiva haṃsacakravākayor api niṣedhasuddhau pṛthaṅniṣedho ‘nyeṣām āpadi jālapādānāṃ vikalpārthaḥ | sa ca vyavasthito vijñeyaḥ | āpadi bhakṣyā na tv anāpadi, icchāvikalpasya rāgata eva prāpteḥ | grāmakukkuṭe tu grāmagrahaṇam āraṇyakukkuṭādyanujñānārthaṃ na tv etadvyatiriktagrāmavāsivikalpārtham | āpadarthe gataprayojanaṃ bhavati, vākyāntaragataviśeṣāvadhāraṇaparatvasyānyāyyatvāt || 5.12 ||
pratudāñ jālapādāṃś ca koyaṣṭinakhaviṣkirān |
nimajjataś ca matsyādān saunaṃ vallūram eva ca || 5.13 ||
pratudān iti | pratudya cañcvā ye bhakṣayanti tān dārvāghāṭādīn, jālapādān iti jālākārapādāñ śarādiprabhṛtīn, koyaṣṭyākhyaṃ pakṣiṇam, nakhaviṣkirān nakhair vikīrya ye bhakṣayanti tān abhyanujñātāraṇyakukkuṭādivyatiriktāñ śyenādīn | tathā nimajya ye matsyān khādanti tān madguprabhṛtīn, sūnā māraṇasthānaṃ tatra sthitaṃ yan māṃsaṃ bhakṣyam api, vallūraṃ śuṣkamāṃsaṃ etāni varjayet || 5.13 ||
bakaṃ caiva balākāṃ ca kākolaṃ khañjarīṭakam |
matsyādān viḍvarāhāṃś ca matsyān eva sarvaśaḥ || 5.14 ||
bakaṃ caiveti | bakabalākādroṇakākakhañjanān, tathā matsyādān pakṣivyatiriktān api nakrādīn viḍvarāhāṃś ca | viḍ iti viśeṣaṇam āraṇyasūkarābhyanujñānārtham | matsyāṃś ca sarvān varjayet || 5.14 ||
matsyabhakṣaṇanindām āha –
yo yasya māṃsam aśnāti sa tanmāṃsāda ucyate |
matsyādaḥ sarvamāṃsādas tasmān matsyān vivarjayet || 5.15 ||
yo yasyeti | yo yadīyaṃ māṃsaṃ khadati sa tanmāṃsāda eva paraṃ vyapadiśyate | yathā mārjāro mūṣakādaḥ | matsyādaḥ punaḥ sarvamāṃsabhakṣakatvena vyapadeṣṭuṃ yogyas tasmān matsyān na khādet || 5.15 ||
idānīṃ bhakṣyamatsyān āha –
pāṭhīnarohitāv ādyau niyuktau havyakavyayoḥ |
rājīvān siṃhatuṇḍāṃś ca saśalkāṃś caiva sarvaśaḥ || 5.16 ||
pāṭhīnarohitāv iti | pāṭhīnarohitau matsyabhedau bhakṣaṇīyau | ‘havyakavyayor niyuktau’ iti samastavakṣyamāṇabhakṣaṇaniṣiddhopalakṣaṇārtham | tena prāṇātyayādāv adoṣaḥ | tathā rājīvākhyān siṃhatuṇḍāṃś ca saśalkāṃś ca sarvān vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇopetān adyāt | medhātithi-govindarājau tu “pāṭhīnarohitau daivapaitrādikarmaṇi niyuktāv evādanīyau na tv anyadā | rājīvasiṃhatuṇḍasaśalkamatsyās tu havyakavyābhyām anyatrāpi bhakṣaṇīyāḥ” ity ācakṣatuḥ | na tan manoharam | pāṭhīnarohitau śrāddhe niyuktau śrāddhabhoktraiva bhakṣaṇīyau na tu śrāddhakartrāpi, rājīvādayo havyakavyābhyām anyatrāpi bhakṣyā ity asyāpramāṇatvāt, munyantaraiś ca rohitapāṭhīnarājīvādīnāṃ tulyatvenābhidhānāt | tathā ca śaṅkhaḥ (17.25) |
rājīvāḥ siṃhatuṇḍāś ca saśalkāś ca tathaiva ca |
pāṭhīnarohitau cāpy bhakṣyā matsyeṣu kīrtitāḥ ||
yājñavalkyaḥ (1.177) |
bhakṣyāḥ pañcanakhāḥ śvāvidgodhākacchapaśalyakāḥ |
śaśaś ca matsyeṣv api tu siṃhatuṇḍakarohitāḥ |
tathā pāṭhīnarājīvasaśalkāś ca dvijātibhiḥ ||
hārītaḥ: “saśalkān matsyān nyāyopapannān bhakṣayet” | evaṃ ca,
bhoktraivādyau na kartrāpi śrāddhe pāṭhīnarohitau |
rājīvādyās tathā neti vyākhyā na munisaṃmatā ||
|| 5.16 ||
na bhakṣayed ekacarān ajñātāṃś ca mṛgadvijān |
