bhakṣyeṣv api samuddiṣṭān sarvān pañcanakhāṃs tathā || 5.17 ||
na bhakṣayed iti | ye ekākinaḥ prāyeṇa caranti sarpādayas tān ekacarān, tathā ye abhiyuktair api nāmajātibhedenāvadhārya vibhāgataś ca mṛgapakṣiṇo na jñāyante tān | ‘bhakṣyeṣv api samuddiṣṭān’ iti sāmānyaviśeṣaniṣedhābhāvena bhakṣypakṣanikṣiptān bhakṣyatvena samuddiṣṭāṃś ca, tathā sarvān pañcanakhān vānarādīn na bakṣayet || 5.17 ||
atra pratiprasavam āha –
śvāvidhaṃ śalyakaṃ godhāṃ khaḍgakūrmaśaśāṃs tathā |
bhakṣyān pañcanakheṣv āhur anuṣṭrāṃś caikatodataḥ || 5.18 ||
śvāvidham iti | śvāvidhaṃ sedhākhyaṃ prāṇibhedam, śalyakaṃ tatsadṛśaṃ sthūlalomānam, tathā godhāgaṇḍakakacchapaśaśān pañcanakheṣu bhakṣyān manvādayaḥ prāhuḥ | tathoṣṭravarjitān ekadantapaṅktyupetān || 5.18 ||
chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca laśunaṃ grāmakukkuṭam |
palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ caiva matyā jagdhvā pated dvijaḥ || 5.19 ||
chatrākam iti | kavakagrāmasūkaralaśunādīnām anyatamaṃ buddhipūrvakaṃ guruprāyaścittopadeśād abhyāsato bakṣayitvā dvijātiḥ patati | tataś ca patitaprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt | “garhitānādyayor jagdhiḥ surāpānasamāni ṣaṭ” (11.56) iti || 5.19 ||
amatyaitāni ṣaḍ jagdhvā kṛcchaṃ sāntapanaṃ caret |
yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ vāpi śeṣeṣūpavased ahaḥ || 5.20 ||
amatyeti | etāni chatrākādīni ṣaḍ buddhipūrvakam eva bhakṣayitvābhidheyabhakṣaṇasya nimittatvena sāhityasyāvivakṣitatvāt | ekādaśādhyāyavakṣyamāṇasvarūpaṃ saptāhasādhyaṃ sāntapanaṃ yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ vā caret | etadvyatirikteṣu lohitavṛkṣaniryāsādiṣu pratyekaṃ bhakṣaṇād ahorātropavāsaṃ kuryāt | chatrākādīnāṃ ca prāyaścittāpakarṣo varjanādarārthaḥ | ‘śeṣeṣūpavased ahaḥ’ iti lāghavārtham | tatra hi kriyamāṇe lohitaniryāsagrahaṇam api kartavyaṃ syāt || 5.20 ||
saṃvatsarasyaikam api caret kṛcchraṃ dvijottamaḥ |
ajñātabhuktaśuddhyarthaṃ jñātasya tu viśeṣataḥ || 5.21 ||
saṃvatsarasyeti | dvijottamapadaṃ dvijātiparam, trayāṇāṃ prakṛtatvāt, “etad uktaṃ dvijātīnām” (5.26) ity upasaṃhārāc ca | dvijātiḥ saṃvatsaramadhye ekam api kṛcchraṃ prathamāmnānāt prājāpatyākhyam ajñātabhakṣaṇadoṣopaśamanārtham anutiṣthet | jñātasya punar abhakṣyabhakṣaṇadoṣasya viśeṣato yatra yad vihitaṃ tad eva prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt | yat tu,
trīṇi devāḥ pavitrāṇi brāhmaṇānām akalpayan |
adṛṣṭam adbhir nirṇiktaṃ yac ca vācā praśasyate || (MDh 5.127)
tad dravyaśuddhiprakaraṇapaṭhitaprāyaścittavyatiriktadravyaśuddhiviśeṣe ‘vatiṣṭhate || 5.21 ||
idānīṃ bhakṣaṇaprasaṅgena yāgādyarthaṃ hiṃsām apy anujānāti –
yajñārthaṃ brāhmaṇair vadhyāḥ praśastā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ |
bhṛtyānāṃ caiva vṛttyartham agastho hy ācarat purā || 5.22 ||
yajñārtham iti | brāhmaṇādibhir yāgārthaṃ praśastāḥ śāstravihitā. mṛgapakṣiṇo vadhyāḥ | bhṛtyānāṃ cāvaśyabharaṇīyānāṃ vṛddhamātāpitrādīnāṃ saṃvardhanārtham | yasmād agasthyo muniḥ pūrvaṃ tathā kṛtavān | prakṛtirūpo ‘yam anuvādaḥ || 5.22 ||
babhūvur hi puroḍāśā bhakṣyāṇāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām |
purāṇeṣv ṛṣiyajñeṣu brahmakṣatrasaveṣu ca || 5.23 ||
babhūvur iti | yasmāt purātaneṣv apy ṛṣikartṛkayajñeṣu ca bhakṣyāṇāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇāṃ māṃsena puroṣāśā abhavaṃs tasmād yajñārtham adhunātanair api mṛgapakṣiṇo vadhyāḥ
|| 5.23 ||
yat kiṃcit snehasaṃyuktaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyam agarhitam |
tat paryuṣitam apy ādyaṃ haviḥśeṣaṃ ca tad bhavet || 5.24 ||
yat kiṃcid iti | yat kiṃcit kharaviśadam abhyavahāryaṃ modakādi, bhojyaṃ pāyasādi, agarhitam upaghātāntararahitaṃ tat paryuṣitaṃ rātryantaritam api ghṛtatailadadhyādisaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣaṇīyam | na tu prāg eva yat snehasaṃyuktaṃ tat paryuṣitaṃ bhakṣaṇīyam iti vyākhyeyam, tathā ca sati haviḥśeṣasya snehasaṃyogāvaśyaṃbhāvāt ‘yat kiṃcit snehasaṃyuktam’ ity anenaiva bhakṣaṇe siddhe ‘haviḥśeṣaṃ ca yad bhavet’ ity anarthakaṃ syāt | smṛtyantare ‘pi bhakṣaṇakāla evābhighāraṇam upadiśyate | tathā ca yamaḥ |
masūramāṣasaṃyuktaṃ tathā paryuṣitaṃ ca yat |
tat tu prakṣālitaṃ kṛtvā bhuñjīta hy abhighāritam ||
haviḥśeṣaṃ tu carupuroḍāśādi paryuṣitam api bhojanakāle snehasaṃyogaśūnyam eva bhakṣaṇīyam, pṛthagupadeśāt || 5.24 ||
cirasthitam api tv ādyam asnehāktaṃ dvijātibhiḥ |
yavagodhūmajaṃ sarvaṃ payasaś caiva vikriyā || 5.25 ||
cirasthitam iti | anekarātryantaritā api yavagodhūmadugdhavikārāḥ snehasaṃyogarahitā api dvijātibhir bhakṣaṇīyāḥ || 5.25 ||
etad uktaṃ dvijātīnāṃ bhakṣyābhakṣyam aśeṣataḥ |
māṃsasyātaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ bhakṣaṇavarjane || 5.26 ||
etad uktam iti | etad dvijātīnāṃ bhakṣyābhakṣyam uktam, ata ūrdhvaṃ māṃsasya bhakṣaṇe varjane ca vidhānaṃ niḥśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi || 5.26 ||
prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayen māṃsaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmyayā |
yathāvidhi niyuktas tu prāṇānām eva cātyaye || 5.27 ||
prokṣitam iti | ‘prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayet’ iti parisaṃkhyā vā syān niyamavidhir vā | tatra parisaṃkhyātve prokṣitād anyan na bhakṣaṇīyam iti vākyārthaḥ syāt | sa ca “anupākṛtamāṃsāni” (5.7) ity anenaiva niṣedhāt prāptaḥ | tasmān mantrakṛtaprokṣaṇākhyasaṃskārayuktayajñahuta-paśumāṃsabhakṣaṇam idaṃ yajñāṅgaṃ vidhīyate | ata eva “asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantraiḥ” (5.36) ity asyānuvādaṃ vakṣyati | brāhmaṇānāṃ ca yadā kāmanā bhavati tadāvaśyaṃ māṃsaṃ bhoktavyam iti tadāpi niyamata ekavāraṃ bhakṣayet “sakṛd brāhmaṇakāmyayā’”iti yamavacanāt | tathā śrāddhe madhuparke ca “nāmāṃso madhuparkaḥ” (1.24) iti gṛhyavacanān niyuktena niyamān māṃsaṃ bhakṣaṇīyam iti | ata eva “niyuktas tu yathānyāyam” (5.35) ity atikramadoṣaṃ vakṣyati | prāṇātyaye cāhārāntarābhāvanimittake vyādhihetuke vā niyamato māṃsaṃ bhakṣayet
|| 5.27 ||
prāṇātyaye māṃsabhakṣaṇānuvādam āha –
prāṇasyānnam idaṃ sarvaṃ prajāpatir akalpayat |
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam || 5.28 ||
prāṇasyānnam iti | prāṇitīti prāṇo jīvaḥ śarīrāntargato bhoktā tasyādanīyaṃ sarvam idaṃ brahmā kalpitavān | kiṃ tad āha – jaṅgamaṃ paśvādi, sthāvaraṃ vrīhiyavādi sarvaṃ tasya bhojanam | tasmāt prāṇadhāraṇārthaṃ jīvo māṃsaṃ bhakṣayet || 5.28 ||
“prāṇasyānnam idaṃ sarvam” (5.28) ity evaṃ prapañcayati –
carāṇām annam acarā daṃṣṭriṇām apy adaṃṣṭriṇaḥ |
ahastāś ca sahastānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ caiva bhīravaḥ || 5.29 ||
carāṇām iti | jaṅgamānāṃ hariṇādīnām ajaṅgamās tṛṇādayaḥ, daṃṣṭriṇāṃ vyāghrādīnāṃ adaṃṣṭriṇo hariṇādayaḥ, sahastānāṃ manuṣyādīnāṃ ahastā matsyādayaḥ, śūrāṇāṃ siṃhādīnāṃ bhīravo hastyādayo ‘danīyāḥ | etādṛśyāṃ vidhātur eva sṛṣṭau || 5.29 ||
nāttā duṣyaty adannn ādyān prāṇino ‘hany ahany api |
dhātraiva sṛṣṭā hy ādyāś ca prāṇino ‘ttāra eva ca || 5.30 ||
nātteti | bhakṣayitā bhakṣaṇārhān prāṇinaḥ pratyaham api bhakṣayan na doṣaṃ prāpnoti | yasmād vidhātraiva bhakṣaṇārhā bhakṣayitāraś ca nirmitā iti tribhiḥ ślokaiḥ prāṇātyaye māṃsabhakṣaṇastutir iyam || 5.30 ||
atha prokṣitabhakṣaṇaniyamārthavādam āha –
yajñāya jagdhir māṃsasyety eṣa daivo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
ato 'nyathāpravṛttis tu rākṣaso vidhir ucyate || 5.31 ||
yajñāyeti | yajñasaṃpattyarthaṃ tadaṅgabhūtamāṃsasya jagdhir bhakṣaṇam etad daivam anuṣṭhānaṃ uktavyatiriktaprakāreṇa punar ātmārtham eva paśuṃ vyāpādya tanmāṃsabhakṣaṇeṣu pravṛttī rākṣasocitam anuṣṭhānam ity uttarārdhaṃ vṛthāmāṃsabhakṣaṇanivṛttyanuvādaḥ || 5.31 ||
krītvā svayaṃ vāpy utpādya paropakṛtam eva vā |
devān pitṝṃś cārcayitvā khādan māṃsaṃ na duṣyati || 5.32 ||
krītveti | krītvā ātmanā cotpādya anyena vā kenāpy ānīya dattaṃ māṃsaṃ devapitṛbhyo datvā śeṣaṃ bhakṣayan na pāpaṃ prāpnoti | ataḥ prokṣitādicatuṣṭayabhakṣaṇavan nedaṃ nityataṃ bhakṣaṇam “na duṣyati” (5.30) ity abhidhānāt “varṣe varṣe ‘śvamedhena” (5.53) ityādivakṣyamāṇamāṃsavarjanavidhir apy etadviṣaya evāvirodhāt || 5.32 ||
nādyād avidhinā māṃsaṃ vidhijño ‘nāpadi dvijaḥ |
jagdhvā hy avidhinā māṃsaṃ pretas tair adyate ‘vaśaḥ || 5.33 ||
nādyād iti | māṃsabhakṣaṇānuṣṭhānadoṣajño dvijātir anāpadi tattaddevādyarcanavidhānaṃ vinā na māṃsaṃ bhakṣayet | yasmād avidhānena yo māṃsaṃ khādati sa mṛtaḥ san yan māṃsaṃ bhakṣitaṃ taiḥ prāṇibhiḥ paraloke svarakṣaṇākṣamaḥ khādyata iti sarvaślokānuvādaḥ || 5.33 ||
na tādṛśaṃ bhavaty eno mṛgahantur dhanārthinaḥ |
yādṛśaṃ bhavati pretya vṛthāmāṃsāni khādataḥ || 5.34 ||
na tādṛśam iti | mṛgavadhajīvino vyādhāder dhananimittaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ hantur na tathāvidhaṃ pāpaṃ bhavati, yādṛśam adevapitṛśeṣabhūtamāṃsāni khādataḥ paraloke bhavatīti pūrvānuvāda eva || 5.34 ||
niyuktas tu yathānyāyaṃ yo māṃsaṃ nātti mānavaḥ |
sa pretya paśutāṃ yāti saṃbhavān ekaviṃsatim || 5.35 ||
niyuktas tv iti | śrāddhe madhuparke ca yathāśāstraṃ niyuktaḥ san yo manuṣyo māṃsaṃ na khādati sa mṛtaḥ san ekaviṃśatijanmāni paśur bhavati | “yathāvidhi niyuktas tu” (5.27) ity etanniyamātikramaphalavidhānam idam || 5.35 ||
asaṃskṛtān paśūn mantrair nādyād vipraḥ kadācana |
mantrais tu saṃskṛtān adyāc chāśvataṃ vidhim āsthitaḥ || 5.36 ||
asaṃskṛtān iti | vedavihitamantravatprokṣaṇādisaṃskāraśūnyān paśūn viprādiḥ kadācin nāśnīyāt | śāśvataṃ pravāhānāditayā nityaṃ paśuyāgādividhim āsthito mantrasaṃskṛtān evāśnīyād iti | “prokṣitaṃ bhakṣayen māṃsam” (5.27) ity etasyānuvādārtham etat || 5.36 ||
kuryād ghṛtapaśuṃ saṅge kuryāt piṣṭapaśuṃ tathā |
na tv eva tu vṛthā hantuṃ paśum icchet kadācana || 5.37 ||
kuryād iti | saṅga āsaktau paśubhakṣaṇānurāgeṇa ghṛtamayīṃ piṣṭamayīṃ vā paśupratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā khāden na punar devatādyuddeśaṃ vinaiva paśūn kadācid api hantum icchet || 5.37 ||
yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvatkṛtvo ha māraṇam |
vṛthāpaśughnaḥ prāpnoti pretya janmani janmani || 5.38 ||
yāvantīti | devatādyuddeśam antareṇātmārthaṃ yaḥ paśūn hanti sa vṛthāpaśughno mṛtaḥ san yāvatsaṃkhyāni paśuromāṇi tāvatsaṃkhyābhūtaṃ janmani janmani māraṇam prāpnoti | tasmād vṛthā paśuṃ na hanyāt | tāvatkṛtva iti vatvantāt kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasucpratyayaḥ | iha haśabda āgamaprasiddhisūcanārthaḥ || 5.38 ||
yajñārthaṃ paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā |
yajño ‘sya bhūtyai sarvasya tasmād yajñe vadho ‘vadhaḥ || 5.39 ||
yajñārthaṃ paśava iti | yajñasiddhyarthaṃ prajāpatinā ātmanaivādareṇa paśavaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ | yajñaś cāgnau prāstāhutinyāyāt sarvasyāsya jagato vivṛddhyarthaḥ | tasmād yajñe vadho ‘vadha eva, vadhajanyadoṣābhāvāt || 5.39 ||
kiṃ ca –
oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣās tiryañcaḥ pakṣiṇas tathā |
yajñārthaṃ nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ prāpnuvanty ucchritīḥ punaḥ || 5.40 ||
oṣadhya iti | oṣadhyo vrīhiyavādyāḥ, paśavaś chāgādyāḥ, vṛkṣā yūpādyarthāḥ, tiryañcaḥ kūrmādayaḥ, pakṣiṇaḥ kapiñjalādyāḥ, yajñārtham vināśaṃ gatāḥ punarjātyutkarṣaṃ prāpnuvanti || 5.40 ||
madhuparke ca yajñe ca pitṛdaivatakarmaṇi |
atraiva paśavo hiṃsyā nānyatrety abravīn manuḥ || 5.41 ||
madhuparke ceti | “nāmāṃso madhuparkaḥ” (Gṛhyasū. 1.24) iti vidhānān madhuparke ca yajñe ca jyotiṣṭomādau, pitrye daive ca karmaṇi śrāddhādau paśavo hiṃsanīyā nānyatreti manur abhihitavān || 5.41 ||
eṣv artheṣu paśūn hiṃsan vedatattvārthavid dvijaḥ |
ātmānaṃ ca paśuṃ caiva gamayaty uttamāṃ gatim || 5.42 ||
eṣv artheṣv iti | eṣu madhuparkādiṣu padārtheṣu paśūn hiṃsann ātmānaṃ paśuṃ cottamāṃ gatiṃ svargādyupabhogayogyavilakṣaṇadehadaśādisaṃbandhaṃ prāpayati | vedatattvārthavit iti vidvadadhikārabodhanārtham |
nanv anyādhikāritve karmaṇi katham anadhikṛtasya paśvāder uttamagatiprāptiḥ phalam?
ucyate – śāstrapramāṇakatvāt | asyārthasya pitradhikārikāyāṃ jāteṣṭāv anadhikāriṇo ‘pi putrasya phalaprāptivad ihāpi paśvādigataphalasaṃbhavād yajamāna eva kāruṇikatayā paśugataphalaviśiṣṭam eva phalaṃ kāmayiṣyati | ata eva ‘ātmānaṃ ca paśuṃ caiva’ ity abhidhānāt yajamānavyāpārād eva paśugataphalasiddhir uktā || 5.42 ||
gṛhe gurāv araṇye vā nivasann ātmavān dvijaḥ |
nāvedavihitāṃ hiṃsām āpady api samācaret || 5.43 ||
gṛhe gurāv araṇye veti | gṛhāśrame brahmacaryāśrame vānaprasthāśrame ca praśastātmā dvijo nivasann āpady api nāśāstrīyāṃ hiṃsāṃ samācaret || 5.43 ||
kathaṃ tarhi tulye hiṃsātve vaidikī daikṣādipaśuhiṃsā nādharmāyety ata āha –
yā vedavihitā hiṃsā niyatāsmiṃs carācare |
ahiṃsām eva tāṃ vidyād vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau || 5.44 ||
yā vedavihiteti | yā śrutivihitā karmaviśeṣadeśakālādiniyatāsmiñ jagati sthāvarajaṅgamātmani, ahiṃsām eva tāṃ jānīyāt, hiṃsājanyādharmavirahāt | daikṣapaśuhananam adharmaḥ, prāṇihananatvāt brāḥmaṇahananavad ityādyanumānam upajīvya śāstrabādhād eva na pravartate | dṛṣṭāntīkṛtabrāhmaṇahananasyāpy adharmatve śāstram evopajīvyam | vedād dharmo hi nirbabhau yasmād ananyapramāṇako dharmo vedād eva niḥśeṣeṇa prakāśatāṃ gataḥ || 5.44 ||
yo ‘hiṃsakāni bhūtāni hinasty ātmasukhecchayā |
sa jīvaṃś ca mṛtaś caiva na kvacit sukham edhate || 5.45 ||
yo ‘hiṃsakānīti | yo ‘nupaghātakān prāṇinaḥ hariṇādīn ātmasukhecchayā mārayati sa ihaloke paraloke ca na sukhena vardhate || 5.45 ||
yo bandhanavadhakleśān prāṇināṃ na cikīrṣati |
sa sarvasya hitaprepsuḥ sukham atyantam aśnute || 5.46 ||
yo bandhaneti | yo bandhanamāraṇakleśādīn prāṇināṃ kartuṃ necchati sa sarvahitaprāptīcchur anantasukhaṃ prāpnoti || 5.46 ||
anyac ca –
yad dhyāyati yat kurute dhṛtiṃ badhnāti yatra ca |
tad avāpnoty ayatnena yo hinasti na kiṃcana || 5.47 ||
yad dhyāyatīti | yac cintayati dharmādikam idaṃ me ‘stv iti, yac ca śreyaḥsādhanaṃ karma karoti, yatra ca paramārthadhyānādau dhṛtiṃ badhnāti, tat sarvam akleśena labhate | ya upaghātanimittaṃ daṃśamaśakādy api na vyāpādayati || 5.47 ||
māṃsabhakṣaṇaprasaṅgena hiṃsāguṇadoṣāv abhidhāya punaḥ prakṛtamāṃsābhakṣaṇam āha –
nākṛtvā prāṇināṃ hiṃsāṃ māṃsam utpadyate kvacit |
na ca prānivadhaḥ svargyas tasmān māṃsaṃ vivarjayet || 5.48 ||
nākṛtveti | prāṇihiṃsāvyatirekeṇa na kvacin māṃsam utpadyate | prāṇivadhaś ca na svarganimittaṃ narakahetur eva yasmāt tasmād avidhinā māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayed iti || 5.48 ||
samutpattiṃ ca māṃsasya vadhabandhau ca dehinām |
prasamīkṣya nivarteta sarvamāṃsasya bhakṣaṇāt || 5.49 ||
samutpattim ceti | śukraśoṇitapariṇāmātmikāṃ samutpattiṃ ghṛṇākarīṃ vijñāya prāṇināṃ vadhabandhau ca krūrakarmarūpau nirūpya vihitamāṃsabhakṣaṇād api nivarteta kim utāvihitamāṃsabhakṣaṇād ity avidhinā māṃsabhakṣaṇanindānuvādaḥ || 5.49 ||
na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ vidhiṃ hitvā piśācavat |
sa loke priyatāṃ yāti vyādhibhiś ca na pīḍyate || 5.50 ||
na bhakṣayatīti | uktavidhivyatirekeṇa yo na māṃsaṃ bhakṣayati | piśācavad iti, yathā piśāco bhakṣayati tathā neti vyatireke dṛṣṭāntaḥ | sa lokasya priyo bhavati, rogaiś ca na bādhyate | tasmād avaidhamāṃsabhakṣaṇād vyādhayo bhavantīti darśitam || 5.50 ||
anumantā viśasitā nihantā krayavikrayī |
saṃskartā copahartā ca khādakaś ceti ghātakāḥ || 5.51 ||
anumanteti | yad anumativyatirekeṇa hananaṃ kartuṃ na śakyate so ‘numantā, viśasitā aṅgāni yaḥ kartaryādinā pṛthak pṛthak karoti, krayavikrayī māṃsasya kretā vikretā ca, saṃskartā pācakaḥ, upahartā pariveṣakaḥ, khādako bhakṣayitā | govindarājas tu “yaḥ krītvā vikrīṇāti sa krayavikrayī” ity ekam evāha | tad ayuktam,
hananena tathā hantā dhanena krayikas tathā |
vikrayī tu dhanādānāt saṃskartā tatpravartanāt ||
iti yamavacanena pṛthaṅ nirdeśāt | ghātakatvavacanaṃ cedam aśāstrīyapaśuvadhe ‘numatyādayo ‘pi na kartavyā ity evaṃparam, vidhiniṣedhaparatvāc chāstrasya, khādakādīnāṃ pṛthakprāyaścittadarśanāt || 5.51 ||
svamāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena yo vardhayitum icchati |
anabhyarcya pitṝn devāṃs tato ‘nyo nāsty apuṇyakṛt || 5.52 ||
svamāṃsam iti | svaśarīramāṃsaṃ paramāṃsena devapitrādyarcanaṃ vinā yo vṛddhiṃ netum icchati tasmād aparo nāpuṇyakartāstīty avidhimāṃsabhakṣaṇanindānuvādaḥ || 5.52 ||
idānīm aniyamitāpratiṣiddhamāṃsabhakṣaṇasya nivṛttir dharmāyety etad darśayitum āha –
varṣe varṣe ‘śvamedhena yo yajeta śataṃ samāḥ |
māṃsāni ca na khāded yas tayoḥ puṇyaphalaṃ samam || 5.53 ||
varṣe varṣa iti | yo varṣaśataṃ yāvat partivarṣam aśvamedhena yajet yaś ca yāvajjīvaṃ māṃsaṃ na khādati tayoḥ puṇyasya phalaṃ svargādi tulyam || 5.53 ||
phalamūlāśanair medhyair munyannānāṃ ca bhojanaiḥ |
na tat phalam avāpnoti yan māṃsaparivarjanāt || 5.54 ||
phalamūlāśanair iti | pavitraphalamūlabhakṣaṇair vānaprasthabhojyānāṃ ca nīvārādyannānāṃ bhojanair na tat phalam avāpnoti yac chāstrāniyamitāpratiṣiddha-māṃsavarjanāl labhate || 5.54 ||
māṃ sa bhakṣayitāmutra yasya māṃsam ihādmy aham |
etan māṃsasya māṃsatvaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || 5.55 ||
māṃ sa bhakṣayiteti | iha loke ‘yasya māṃsam aham aśnāmi paraloke māṃ sa bhakṣayiṣyati’ ity etat māṃsaśabdasya niruktaṃ paṇḍitāḥ pravadanti iti māṃsaśabdasya nirvacanam avaidhamāṃsabhakṣaṇapāpaphalabādhanārtham || 5.55 ||
na māṃsabhakṣaṇe doṣo na madye na ca maithune |
pravṛttir eṣā bhūtānāṃ nivṛttis tu mahāphalā || 5.56 ||
na māṃsabhakṣaṇa iti | brāhmaṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ yathādhikāram avihitāpratiṣiddha-bhakṣaṇādau na kaścid doṣaḥ | yasmāt prāṇināṃ bhakṣaṇapānamaithunādau pravṛttiḥ svābhāviko ‘yaṃ dharmaḥ | varjanaṃ punar mahāphalam | avihitāpratiṣiddhamadyamaithuna-nivṛtter mahāphalakathanārtho ‘yam uktasyaiva māṃsavarjanamahāphalakathanasyānuvādaḥ
|| 5.56 ||
pretaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi dravyaśuddhiṃ tathaiva ca |
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || 5.57 ||
pretaśuddhim iti | brāhmaṇādīnāṃ caturṇām api varṇānāṃ preteṣv api pitrādīnāṃ śuddhiṃ brāḥmaṇādikrameṇa yā yasyeti, dravyādīnāṃ ca taijasādīnāṃ śuddhim abhidhāsyāmi || 5.57 ||
tatra śuddher aśuddhisāpekṣatvāt tannirūpaṇārtham āha –
dantajāte ‘nujāte ca kṛtacūḍe ca saṃsthite |
aśuddhā bāndhavāḥ sarve sūtake ca tathocyate || 5.58 ||
dantajāta iti | dantajāte, jātadanta ity arthaḥ | “vāhitāgnyādiṣu” (Pāṇ 2.2.37) ity anena jātaśabdasya paranipātaḥ | anujāte jātadantānantare | kṛtacūḍākaraṇe cakārāt kṛtopanayane ca saṃsthite mṛte sati bāndhavāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ samānodakāś cāśuddhā bhavanti | prasave ca tathaivāśuddhā bhavantīty ucyate | vayovibhāgenoddeśamātram idaṃ vakṣyamāṇāśaucakālabhedādisukhāvabodhanārtham || 5.58 ||
daśāhaṃ śāvam āśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate |
arvāk saṃcayanād asthnāṃ tryaham ekāham eva cā || 5.59 ||
daśāham iti | saptapuruṣaparyantaṃ sapiṇḍātām vakṣyati | sapiṇḍeṣu śavanimittam āśaucaṃ daśāhorātraṃ brāhmaṇasyopdiśyate, “śuddhyed vipro daśāhena” (5.83) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | ‘arvāk saṃcayanād asthnām’ iti caturahopalakṣaṇam | “caturthe divase ‘sthisaṃcayanaṃ kuryāt” iti viṣṇuvacanāt tryaham ekāhaṃ vā | ahaḥśabdo ‘horātraparaḥ | ayaṃ cāgnivedādiguṇāpekṣo vyavasthitavikalpaḥ | yad āha dakṣaḥ (6.6) |
ekāhāc chuddhyate vipro yo ‘gnivedasamanvitaḥ |
hīne hīnaṃ bhavec caiva tryahaś caturahas tathā ||
śrautāgnimato mantrabrāhmaṇātmakakṛtsnaśākhādhyāyina ekāhāśaucam | tatra śrautāgnivedādhyayanaguṇayor ekaguṇarahito hīnas tasya tryahaḥ, ubhayaguṇarahitas tu hīnataraḥ, kevalasmārtāgnimāṃs tasya caturahaḥ, sakalaguṇarahitasya daśāhaḥ | tad āha parāśaraḥ (PārSm 3.5) “nirguṇo daśabhir dinaiḥ” iti || 5.59 ||
sapiṇḍalakṣaṇam āha –
sapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe saptame vinivartate |
samānodakabhāvas tu janmanāmnor avedane || 5.60 ||
sapiṇḍatā tv iti | yaṃ puruṣaṃ pratiyoginaṃ kṛtvā nirūpyate tasya pitāmahaprabhṛtīn ṣaṭpuruṣān atikramya saptame puruṣe prāpte sapiṇḍatvaṃ nivartate | evaṃ putrapautrādiṣv apy avagantavyam | piṇḍasaṃbandhinibandhanā ceyaṃ sapiṇḍatā | tathā hi – pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahebhyas tribhyaḥ piṇḍadānam, prapitāmahasya pitrādayas trayaḥ piṇḍalepabhujaś ca, tatpūrvasya tu saptamasya piṇḍasaṃbandho nāstīty asapiṇḍatā | tasya caite ṣaṭ puruṣāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ so ‘pi teṣāṃ sapiṇḍaḥ, piṇḍadātṛtvena tatpiṇḍasaṃbandhāt | ataḥ sāptapuruṣīyaṃ sapiṇḍatā | tad uktaṃ matsyapurāṇe |
lepabhājaś caturthādyāḥ pitrādyāḥ piṇḍabhāginaḥ |
piṇḍadaḥ saptamas teṣāṃ sāpiṇḍyaṃ sāptapauruṣam ||
sagotratve ceyaṃ sapiṇḍatā | ata eva śaṅkha-likhitau |
sapiṇḍatā tu sarveṣāṃ gotrataḥ sāptapauruṣī |
tena mātāmahādīnām ekapiṇḍasaṃbandhe ‘pi na sapiṇḍatā | samānodakatvaṃ punar asmatkule ‘mukanāmābhūd iti janmanāmobhayāparijñāne nivartate || 5.60 ||
yathedaṃ śāvam āśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate |
janane ‘py evam eva syān nipuṇaṃ śuddhim icchatām || 5.61 ||
yathedam iti | yathedaṃ daśāhādikaṃ śavanimittam āśaucaṃ karmānarhatvalakṣaṇaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu “daśāhaṃ śāvam āśaucam” (5.59) ity anena vidhīyate | prasave ‘pi samyak śuddhim icchatāṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ tādṛśam evāśaucaṃ bhavet || 5.61 ||
anirdeśena tulyatāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ viśeṣam āha –
sarveṣāṃ śāvam āśaucaṃ mātāpitros tu sūtakam |
sūtakaṃ mātur eva syād upaspṛśya pitā śuciḥ || 5.62 ||
sarveṣām iti | maraṇanimittam aspṛśyatvalakṣaṇam āśaucaṃ sarveṣām eva sapiṇḍānāṃ samānam | janananimittaṃ tu mātāpitror eva bhavati | tatrāpy evaṃ viśeṣaḥ – janananimittam apṛśyatvaṃ mātur eva daśarātram | pitā tu snānāt spṛśyo bhavati | ayam eva saṃbandhaḥ saṃvartena vyaktīkṛtaḥ |
jāte putre pituḥ snānaṃ sacailaṃ tu vidhīyate |
mātā śuddhyed daśāhena snānāt tu sparśanaṃ pituḥ ||
|| 5.62 ||
nirasya tu pumāñ śukram upaspṛśyaiva śuddhyati |
baijikād abhisaṃbandhād anurundhyād aghaṃ tryaham || 5.63 ||
nirasya tv iti | “snānaṃ maithuninaḥ smṛtam” (5.144) iti maithune snānaṃ vidhāsyati, tena maithunaṃ vināpi kāmato retaḥskhalane snātvā pumān śuddho bhavati | akāmatas tu svapnādau retaḥpāte “mūtravad retasa utsargaḥ” ity āpastambokteḥ snānaṃ vināpi gṛhasthasya śuddhiḥ | brahmacāriṇas tv akāmato ‘pi “svapne siktvā brahmacārī” (2.181) ity anena snānādinā śuddhir uktā | baijike tu saṃbandhe parapūrvabhāryāyām apatyotpattau tryaham āśaucaṃ bhavati | tathā ca viṣṇuḥ: “parapūrvabhāryāsu trirātram” | retaḥpātinām āśaucam aprakṛtam api jananaprakaraṇe prasaṅgāt tadanuguṇatayoktam | yatra retaḥpātamātreṇa snānaṃ tatrāpatyotpattau trirātram ucitam || 5.63 ||
ahnā caikena rātryā ca trirātrair eva ca tribhiḥ |
śavaspṛśo viśudhyanti tryahād udakadāyinaḥ || 5.64 ||
ahnā caikeneti | ekenāhnā ekayā ca rātryety ahorātreṇa trirātrais tribhir iti navāhorātrair militvā daśāheneti vaidagdhyenoktam | nanu daśāheneti vaktavye kimartho ‘yaṃ vāgvistaraḥ | ucyate–
bṛṃhīyasīṃ laghiṣṭhāṃ vā giraṃ nirmānti vāgminaḥ |
na cāvaśyatvam eteṣāṃ laghūktyaiva niyamyate ||
vṛttasvādhyāyaguṇayogena ye sapiṇḍā ekāhādyalpāśaucayogyās te yadi snehādinā śavaspṛśo bhavanti tadā daśāhenaiva śuddhyanti | udakadāyinaḥ punaḥ samānodakās tryaheṇa | govindarājas tu dhanagrahaṇapūrvakaśavanirhārakasaṃbandhibrāhmaṇaviṣayam idaṃ daśāhāśaucam āha || 5.64 ||
guroḥ pretasya śiṣyas tu piṛmedhaṃ samācaran |
pretahāraiḥ samaṃ tatra daśarātreṇa śudhyati || 5.65 ||
guror iti | guror ācāryāder asapiṇḍasya mṛtasya śiṣyo ‘ntyeṣṭiṃ kṛtvā pretanirhārakair gurusapiṇḍais tulyo daśarātreṇa suddho bhavati || 5.65 ||
rātribhir māsatulyābhir garbhasrāve viśudhyati |
rajasy uparate sādhvī snānena strī rajasvalā || 5.66 ||
rātribhir iti | atra rātribhir iti vidheyagāmino bahutvasya vivakṣitatvāt tṛtīyamāsāt prabhṛti garbhasrāve garbhamāsatulyāhorātrair viśeṣābhidhānāc cāturvarṇyastrī viśudhyati | etac ca ṣaṇmāsaparyantam | yathoktam ādipurāṇe |
ṣaṇmāsābhyantaraṃ yāvad garbhasrāvo bhaved yadi |
tadā māsasamais tāsāṃ divasaiḥ śuddhir iṣyate ||
ata ūrdhvaṃ tu jātyuktam āśaucaṃ tāsu vidyate ||
medhātithi-govindarājādayas tv ādipurāṇe vacanādarśanāt saptamāsād arvāg garbhasrāve māsatulyāhorātraiḥ strīṇāṃ viśuddhir ity atidiśanti | prathamadvitīyamāsīyagarbhasrāve strīṇāṃ trirātram | yathāha hārītaḥ: “garbhasrāve strīṇāṃ trirātraṃ sādhīyo rajoviśeṣatvāt | pitrādisapiṇḍānāṃ tv atra sadyaḥśaucam” | yathāha sumantuḥ: “garbhamāsatulyā divasā garbhasaṃsravaṇe sadyaḥśaucaṃ vā bhavati” | garbhamāsatulyā iti strīviṣayaṃ sadyaḥśaucaṃ veti pitrādisapiṇḍāviṣayam iti vyavasthitavikalpaḥ | rajasvalā ca strī rajasi nivṛtte sati pañcame dine snānenādṛṣṭārthakalpanayogyā bhavati | sparśayogyā tu trirātravyapagame caturthe ‘hani kṛtasnānenaiva śuddhā bhavati || 5.66 ||
nṛṇām akṛtacūḍānāṃ viśuddhir naiśikī smṛtā |
nirvṛttacūḍakānāṃ tu trirātrāc chuddhir iṣyate || 5.67 ||
nṛṇām iti | akṛtacūḍānāṃ bālānāṃ maraṇe sapiṇḍānām ahorātreṇa śuddhir bhavati | kṛtacūḍānāṃ tu maraṇe prāg upanayanāt trirātreṇa śuddhiḥ || 5.67 ||
ūnadvivārṣikaṃ pretaṃ nidadhyur bāndhavā bahiḥ |
alaṃkṛtya śucau bhūmāv asthisaṃcayanād ṛte || 5.68 ||
ūnadvivārṣikam iti | asaṃpūrṇadvivarṣaṃ bālaṃ mṛtam akṛtacūḍaṃ mālādibhir alaṃkṛtya grāmād bahiḥ kṛtvā viśuddhāyāṃ bhūmau kālāntare śīrṇadehatayāśakyam asthisaṃcayanavarjaṃ bāndhavāḥ prakṣipeyuḥ | viśvarūpas tu “yasyāṃ bhūmāv anyasyāsthisaṃcayanaṃ na kṛtaṃ tasyāṃ nidadhyuḥ” iti vyācaṣṭe || 5.68 ||
nāsya kāryo ‘gnisaṃskāro na ca kāryodakakriyā |
araṇye kāṣṭhavat tyaktvā kṣapeta tryaham eva ca || 5.69 ||
nāsyeti | asyonadvivārṣiksyāgnisaṃskāro na kartavyaḥ | nāpy udakakriyā kartavyā | udakadānaniṣedho ‘yaṃ śrāddhādisakalapretakṛtyanivṛttyarthaḥ | kiṃ tv araṇye kāṣṭhavat parityajya | kāṣṭhavad iti śokābhāvo ‘bhihitaḥ | yathāraṇye kāṣṭhaṃ parityajya śoko na bhavati, evaṃ tyaktvā tryahaṃ kṣapet tryahāśaucaṃ kuryāt | ayaṃ cākṛtacūḍasya tryahāśaucavidhiḥ pūrvoktaikāhāśaucavikalpaparaḥ | sa ca vyavasthito vṛttasvādhyāyādiyuktasyaikāhaḥ, tadrahitasya tryahaḥ | yady api manunā parityāgamātraṃ vihitaṃ tathāpi “ūnadvivarṣaṃ nikhanet” (YDh 3.1) iti yājñavalkyavacanād viśuddhabhūmau nikhāyaiva tyaktavyaḥ || 5.69 ||
nātrivarṣasya kartavyā bāndhavair udakakriyā |
jātadantasya vā kuryur nāmni vāpi kṛte sati || 5.70 ||
nātrivarṣasyeti | aprāptatṛtīyavarṣasya pitrādisapiṇḍair udakakriyā na kartavyeti pūrvatra niṣiddhāpy uttarārtham anūdyate | jātadantasya vodakadānaṃ kartavyam | nāmakaraṇe vā kṛte udakakriyāsāhacaryād agnisaṃskāro ‘py anujñāmātram, pretapiṇḍaśrāddhādikaṃ ca yady apy akaraṇasaṃbhave karaṇaṃ kleśāvahaṃ tathāpi karaṇākaraṇayor āmnānāj jātadantakṛtanāmnoḥ karaṇe pretopakāro bhavati, akaraṇe pratyavāyābhāva ity avagamyate
|| 5.70 ||
sabrahmacāriṇy ekāham atīte kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam |
janmany ekodakānāṃ tu trirātrāc chuddhir iṣyate || 5.71 ||
sabrahmacāriṇīti | sahādhyāyini mṛte ekarātram āśaucaṃ kartavyam | samānodakānāṃ punaḥ putrajanane sati trirātreṇa śuddhir bhavati | “tryahād udakadāyinaḥ” (5.64) iti maraṇaviṣayam ukatm || 5.71 ||
strīṇām asaṃskṛtānāṃ tu tryahāc chudhyanti bāndhavāḥ |
yathoktenaiva kalpena śudhyanti tu sanābhayaḥ || 5.72 ||
strīṇām iti | strīṇām akṛtavivāhānāṃ vāgdattānāṃ maraṇe bāndhavā bhartrādayas tryaheṇa śūdhyanti | vāgdānaṃ vinā bhartṛpakṣe saṃbandhābhāvād aśrutam api vāgdānāntaparyantaṃ boddhavyam | sanābhayaḥ pitṛpakṣāḥ vāgdattānāṃ vivāhād arvāṅ maraṇe “yathoktenaiva kalpena” ity etacchlokapūrvārdhoktena trirātreṇaiva śudhyantīty arthaḥ | tad uktam ādipurāṇe |
ā janmanas tu cūḍāntaṃ yatra kanyā vipadyate |
sadyaḥśaucaṃ bhavet tatra sarvavarṇeṣu nityaśaḥ ||
tato vāgdānaparyantaṃ yāvad ekāham eva hi |
ataḥ paraṃ pravṛddhānāṃ trirātram iti niścayaḥ ||
vāgdāne tu kṛte tatra jñeyaṃ cobhayatas tryaham |
pitur varasya ca tato dattānāṃ bhartur eva hi ||
svajātyuktam aśaucaṃ syān mṛtake sūteke ‘pi ca |
medhātithi-govindarājau tu yathokenaiva kalpeneti “nṛṇām akṛtacūḍānām” ity etaduktena vidhinā śudhyantīti vyācakṣāte | atra ca vyākhyāne putravat kanyāyām api cūḍākaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ maraṇe tryahāśaucaṃ syāt | tac cādityapurāṇādyanekavacanaviruddham || 5.72 ||
akṣāralavaṇānnāḥ syur nimajjeyuś ca te tryaham |
māṃsāśanaṃ ca nāśnīyuḥ śayīraṃś ca pṛthak kṣitau || 5.73 ||
akṣāreti | kṣāralavaṇaṃ kṛtrimalavaṇaṃ tadrahitam annam aśnīyuḥ | trirātraṃ nadyādau snānam ācareyuḥ | māṃsaṃ ca na bhakṣayeyuḥ | bhūmau caikākinaḥ śayanaṃ kuryuḥ || 5.73 ||
saṃnidhāv eva vai kalpaḥ śāvāśaucasya kīrtitaḥ |
asaṃnidhāv ayaṃ jñeyo vidhiḥ saṃbandhibāndhavaiḥ || 5.74 ||
saṃnidhāv iti | mṛtasya saṃnidhāv ekasthānāvasthānād ahaḥparijñāne śāvāśaucasya vidhir ayam uktaḥ | deśāntarāvasthānād ajñāne saty ayaṃ vakṣyamāṇo vidhiḥ saṃbandhibāndhavair jñātavyaḥ | saṃbandhinaḥ sapiṇḍāḥ | samānodakā bāndhavāḥ || 5.74 ||
vigataṃ tu videśasthaṃ śṛṇuyāḍ yo hy anirdaśam |
yac cheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvad evāśucir bhavet || 5.75 ||
vigataṃ tv iti | vigataṃ mṛtaṃ videśasthaṃ viprakṛṣṭadeśastham anirdaśam anirgatadaśāhādyaśaucakālaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti sa yad avaśiṣṭaṃ daśarātrādyāśaucasya tāvatkālam aviśuddho bhavati | vigatam ity upalakṣaṇam | janane ‘py etad avagantavyam | tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
anyadeśamṛtaṃ jñātiṃ śrutivā vā putrajanma ca |
anirgate daśāhe tu śeṣāhobhir viśudhyati ||
|| 5.75 ||
atikrānte daśāhe ca trirātram aśucir bhavet |
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu spṛṣṭvaivāpo viśudhyati || 5.76 ||
atikrānta iti |
nāśaucaṃ prasavasyāsti vyatīteṣu dineṣv api |
iti devalavacanān maraṇaviṣayaṃ vacanam idam | sapiṇḍamaraṇe daśāhāśauce ‘tikrānte trirātram aśuddho bhavati, saṃvatsare punar atīte snātvaiva viśūdhyati | etac cāviśeṣeṇābhidhānāc cāturvarṇyaviṣayam || 5.76 ||
nirdaśaṃ jñātimaraṇaṃ śrutvā putrasya janma ca |
savāsā jalam āplutya śuddho bhavati mānavaḥ || 5.77 ||
nirdaśam | daśāhāśaucavyapagame karmānarhatvalakṣaṇasya tryahāśaucasyoktatvāt tadaṅgāsparśaviṣayam | nirgatadaśāhasapiṇḍamaraṇam śrutvā putrasya janma ca śrutvā sacailaṃ snātvā spṛśyo bhavati || 5.77 ||
bāle deśāntarasthe ca pṛthakpiṇḍe ca saṃsthite |
savāsā jalam āplutya sadya eva viśudhyati || 5.78 ||
bāla iti | bāle ‘jātadante mṛte | jātadante “nṛṇām akṛtacūḍānām” (5.67) ity ekāhorātrābhidhānād deśāntarasthe ca sapiṇḍe mṛta ity ekāhāśaucaviṣayam | pūrvaśloke daśāhāśaucinas tryahavidhānāt pṛthakpiṇḍe samānodake trirātram uktam | tatra trirātravyapagame sarveṣv eṣu sacailaṃ snātvā sadyoviśuddho bhavati || 5.78 ||
antardaśāhe syātām cet punar maraṇajanmanī |
tāvat syād aśucir vipro yāvatr tat syād anidaśam || 5.79 ||
antardaśāha iti | daśāhādimadhye yadi punar maraṇe maraṇaṃ janane jananaṃ syāt, punaḥśabdāt sajātīyāvagamāt tadā tāvatkālam eva viprādir aśuddhaḥ syāt | yāvat pūrvajātadaśāhādyaśaucaṃ nāpagataṃ syāt tāvat pūrvāśaucavyapagamenaiva dvitīye ‘pi mṛtake sūtake ca śuddhir ity arthaḥ || 5.79 ||
trirātram āhur āśaucam ācārye saṃsthite sati |
tasya putre ca patnyāṃ ca divārātram iti sthitiḥ || 5.80 ||
trirātram iti | ācārye mṛte sati śiṣyasya trirātram āśaucaṃ vadanti | tatputrapatnyoś ca mṛtayor ahorātram ity eṣā śāstramaryādā || 5.80 ||
śrotriye tūpasaṃpanne trirātram aśucir bhavet |
mātule pakṣiṇīṃ rātriṃ śiṣyartvigbāndhaveṣu ca || 5.81 ||
śrotriya iti | vedaśāstrādhyāyiny upasaṃpanne maitrādinā tatsamīpavartini | tadgṛhavāsinīty arthaḥ | tasmin mṛte trirātreṇa śuddho bhavati | mātulartvikśiṣyādiṣu pakṣiṇīrātriṃ vyāpyāśaucam | dve ahanī pūrvottare pakṣāv eva yasyāḥ sā pakṣiṇī || 5.81 ||
prete rājani sajyotir yasya syād viṣaye sthitaḥ |
aśrotriye tv ahaḥ kṛtsnam anūcāne tathā gurau || 5.82 ||
prete rājanīti | yasya deśe brāhmaṇādiḥ sthitas tasmin rājani kṛtābhiṣeke kṣatriye mṛte sajyotir āśaucaṃ syāt | saha jyotiṣā vartata iti sajyotiḥ | yadi divā mṛtas tadā yāvat sūryajyotis tāvad āśaucam, yadi rātrau mṛtas tadā yāvat tārakājyotis tāvad āśaucam | śrotriye trirātram uktam | aśrotriye punas tadgṛhe mṛte kṛtsnaṃ dinamātram āśaucam, na tu rātrāv api | rātrau mṛte rātrāv evety avagantavyam | sāṅgavedādhyāyini “svalpaṃ vā bahu vā yasya” (2.149) ity etannirdiṣṭe gurāv apy aharmātram eva || 5.82 ||
śudhyed vipro daśāhena dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ |
vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śudhyati || 5.83 ||
śudhyed iti | upanītasapiṇḍamaraṇe saṃpūrṇakālīnajanane ca vṛttasyādhyāyādirahitabrāhmaṇo daśāhena śuddho bhavati, kṣatriyo dvādaśāhena, vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena, śūdro māsena | tasya copanayanasthāne vivāhaḥ || 5.83 ||
na vardhayed aghāhāni pratyūhen nāgniṣu kriyāḥ |
na ca tat karma kurvāṇaḥ sanābhyo ‘py aśucir bhavet || 5.84 ||
na vardhayed iti | yasya tu vṛttasvādhyāyādyapekṣayā pūrvam “arvāk saṃcayanād asthnām” (5.59) ityāsyāśaucasaṃkoca uktaḥ sa niṣkarmā sukham āsiṣye iti buddhyā nāśaucadināni daśāhādirūpatayā vardhayet saṃkucitāśaucadineṣv api | agniṣv iti bahuvacanāc chrautāgniṣv agnihotrahomān na vighātayet | svayaṃ kuryād aśaktau vā putrādīn kārayet | atraiva hetum āha – yasmāt tatkarmāgnihotrarūpaṃ kurvāṇaḥ putrādiḥ sapiṇḍo nāśucir bhavati | tad āha pāraskaraḥ: “nityāni vinivartante vaitānavarjam” | vaitānaṃ śrauto homaḥ gārhapatyakuṇḍasthān agnīn āhavanīyādikuṇḍeṣu vitatya kriyate iti | tathā ca śaṅkha-likhitau: “agnihotrārthaṃ snānopasparśanāc chuciḥ” | jābālo ‘py āha|
janmahānau vitānasya karmalopo na vidyate |
śālāgnau kevalo homaḥ kārya evānyagotrajaiḥ ||
chandogapariśiṣṭam api |
mṛtake karmaṇāṃ tyāgaḥ saṃdhyādīnāṃ vidhīyate |
homaḥ śraute tu kartavyaḥ śuṣkānnenāpi vā phalaiḥ ||
tasmād ekāhatryahādyāśaucasaṃkoce saṃdhyādīnām eva parityāgo na tu śrautahomasya | ekāhatryahādyapagame tu saṃdhyāpañcamahāyajñādisarvam evānuṣṭheyam | ato yan medhātithi-govindarājābhyām anyathāpy abhyadhāyi “ekāhatryahādyaśaucasaṃkoco ‘yaṃ homasvādhyāyamātraviṣayaḥ | saṃdhyopāsanādikaṃ tu tenāpi daśāham eva na kartavyam” iti, tan niṣpramāṇakam | yat tu gautamena (GDh 14.9) “rājñāṃ ca karmavirodhād brāhmaṇasya svādhyāyānivṛttyartham,” yājñavalkyena ca (YDh 3.28) “ṛtvijāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ ca” ityādinā sadyaḥśaucam uktaṃ tat sarveṣām eva daśāhādyaśaucinām api tattatkarmaviṣayam | yāni tūbhayatra daśāhāni “kulasyānnaṃ na bhuñjīta” ityādīni daśāhaṃ tattatkarmaniṣedhakāni vacanāni, tāni daśāhāśaucaviṣayāṇīti na kaścid virodhaḥ | tasmād dhomasvādhyāyamātrārthaṃ saguṇe aśaucalāghavaṃ ca saṃdhyopāsanārtham itīdaṃ niṣpramāṇam || 5.84 ||
divākīrtim udakyāṃ ca patitaṃ sūtikāṃ tathā |
śavaṃ tatspṛṣṭinaṃ caiva spṛṣṭvā snānena śudhyati || 5.85 ||
diveti | cāṇḍālaṃ, rajasvalāṃ, brahmahādikaṃ, prasūtāṃ daśāhābhyantare, śavaṃ śavaspṛṣṭinaṃ ca spṛṣṭvā snānena śuddho bhavati | kecit tu tatspṛṣṭinam iti cāṇḍālodakyādibhir sarvaiḥ saṃbandhayanti | govindarājas tu yājñavalkyavacanāc chavaspṛṣṭinam eva tatspṛṣṭinam āha, nodakyādispṛṣṭinam, tatrācamanavidhānāt | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ (YDh 3.30) |
udakyāśucibhiḥ snāyāt saṃspṛṣṭais tair upaspṛśet |
udakyāśucibhiḥ spṛṣṭaḥ snānaṃ kuryāt | udakyāśaucibhiḥ spṛṣṭaiḥ spṛṣṭas tūpaspṛśed ācāmet
|| 5.85 ||
ācamya prayato nityaṃ japed aśucidarśane |
saurān mantrān yathotsāhaṃ pāvamānīś ca śaktitaḥ || 5.86 ||
ācamyeti | śrāddhadevapūjādisaṃcikīrṣuḥ snānācamanādinā prayataḥ san prakṛtacāṇḍālādyaśucidarśane sati “ud u tyaṃ jātavedasam” (RV 1.4.7) ityādisūryadaivatamantrān yathāsāmarthyaṃ pāvamānīś ca śaktyā japet || 5.86 ||
nāraṃ spṛṣṭvāsthi sasnehaṃ snātvā vipro viśudhyati |
ācamyaiva tu niḥsnehaṃ gām ālabhyārkam īkṣya vā || 5.87 ||
nāram iti | mānuṣāsthi snehasaṃyuktaṃ spṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇādiḥ snānena viśudhyati | snehaśūnyaṃ punaḥ spṛṣṭvā ācamya gosparśārkāvekṣaṇayor anyatarat kṛtvā viśuddho bhaveti
|| 5.87 |
ādiṣṭī nodakaṃ kuryād ā vratasya samāpanāt |
samāpte tūdakaṃ kṛtvā trirātreṇaiva śudhyati || 5.88 ||
ādiṣṭīti | vratādeśanam ādiṣṭaṃ tad asyāstīti brahmacārī, sa pretodakam ā vratasamāpanān na kuryāt | udakam iti pūrakapiṇḍaṣoḍaśaśrāddhādisakalapretakṛtyopalakṣaṇam | samāpte punar brahmacarye pretodakaṃ kṛtvā trirātram āśaucaṃ kṛtvā viśuddho bhavati | etac ca mātāpitrācāryavyatiriktaviṣayam | tad āha vasiṣṭhaḥ: “brahmacāriṇaḥ śavakarmaṇā vratān nivṛttir anyatra mātāpitror guror vā” | śavakarmaṇeti śavanimittakena nirharaṇadahanodakadāna-pūrvakapiṇḍaṣoḍaśaśrāddhādikarmaṇā | vakṣyati ca “ācāryaṃ svam upādhyāyam” (5.91) iti
|| 5.88 ||
vṛthāsaṃkarajātānāṃ pravrajyāsu ca tiṣṭhatām |
ātmanas tyāgināṃ caiva nivartetodakakriyā || 5.89 ||
vṛtheti | jātaśabdaḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate | vṛthājātānāṃ bāhulyena tyaktasvadharmāṇāṃ saṃkarajātānāṃ hīnavarṇenotkṛṣṭastrīṣūtpannānāṃ vedabāhyaraktapaṭādipravrajyāsu vartamānānām aśāstrīyaviṣodbandhanādinā kāmataś ca kṛtajīvitatyāginām udakādikriyā na kartavyā || 5.89 ||
pāṣaṇḍam āśritānāṃ ca carantīnāṃ ca kāmataḥ |
garbhabhartṛdruhāṃ caiva surāpīnāṃ ca yoṣitām || 5.90 ||
pāṣaṇḍam iti | vedabāhyaraktapaṭamauñjādivratacaryā pāṣaṇḍaṃ tadanutiṣṭhantīnāṃ svacchandam ekānekapuruṣagāminīnāṃ garbhapātanabhartṛvadhakāriṇīnāṃ dvijātistrīṇāṃ surāpīnām udakakriyaurdhvadaihikaṃ nivarteta iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ || 5.90 ||
ācāryaṃ svam upādhyāyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ gurum |
nirhṛtya tu vratī pretān na vratena viyujyate || 5.91 ||
ācāryam iti | ācārya upanayanapūrvakaṃ saṃpūrṇaśākhādhyāpayitā, upādhyāyo vedaikadeśasyāṅgasya vādhyāpakaḥ, vedasya vedānāṃ caikadeśasyāpi vyākhyātā guruḥ | nirharaṇapūrvakatvāt pretakṛtyasya nirhṛtyeti dāhadaśāhapiṇḍaṣoḍaśaśrāddhādisakala-pretakṛtyasya pradarśanārtham ācāryādīn pañca mṛtān nirhṛtya brahmacārī na luptavrato bhavati | evaṃ cānyān nirhṛtya vratalopo bhavatīti gamyate | ‘ācāryaṃ svam’ ity abhidhānāt “guror gurau saṃnihite guruvad vṛttim ācaret” (2.205) iti nyāyān nācāryācāryam api | svam iti sarvatra saṃbadhyate | tenopādhyāyopādhyāyam api nirhṛtya vratalopa eva || 5.91 ||
dakṣiṇena mṛtaṃ śūdraṃ puradvāreṇa nirharet |
paścimottarapūrvais tu yathāyogaṃ dvijanmanaḥ || 5.92 ||
dakṣiṇeneti | amāṅgalikatvād atyantāpakṛṣṭaśūdrakrameṇābhidhānam | śūdraṃ mṛtaṃ dakṣiṇapuradvāreṇa nirharet dvijātīn punar yathāyogaṃ yathāyuktyāpakṛṣṭavaiśyakṣatriya-viprakrameṇaiva paścimottarapūrvadvāreṇa nirharet || 5.92 ||
na rājñām aghadoṣo ‘sti vratināṃ na ca mantriṇām |
aindraṃ sthānam upāsīnā brahmabhūtā hi te sadā || 5.93 ||
na rājñām iti | rājñām abhiṣiktakṣatriyāṇāṃ sapiṇḍamaraṇādāv aśaucadoṣo nāsti | yato rājāna aindraṃ sthānaṃ rājyābhiṣekākhyam ādhipatyakāraṇaṃ prāptāḥ | vratino brahmacāriṇaś cāndrāyaṇādivratakāriṇaś ca, satriṇāṃ gavāmayanādiyāgapravṛttāḥ | yato brahmabhūtās te brahmeva niṣpāpāḥ | aśaucābhāvaś cāyaṃ karmaviśeṣe | tad āha viṣṇuḥ: “aśaucaṃ na rājñāṃ rājakarmaṇi na vratināṃ vrate na satriṇāṃ satre” | rājakarmaṇi vyavahāradarśanaśāntihomādikarmaṇi || 5.93 ||
rājño māhātmike sthāne sadyaḥśaucaṃ vidhīyate |
prajānāṃ parirakṣārtham āsanaṃ cātra kāraṇam || 5.94 ||
rājña iti | mahātmana idaṃ sthānaṃ māhātmikaṃ rājyapadākhyaṃ sarvādhipatyalakṣaṇaṃ mahātmaiva prācīnapuṇyarājyam āsādayati tasmin vartamānasya sadyaḥśaucam upadiśyate | na tu rājyapracyutasya kṣatriyajāter api | atra jātir avivakṣitety anena ślokena darśitam | yato nyāyanirūpaṇena durbhikṣe ‘nnadānenopasargeṣu śāntihomādinā prajārakṣārthaṃ rājyāsaneṣv avasthānam aśaucābhāve ca kāraṇam | tac cākṣatriyāṇām api tatkāryakāriṇāṃ vipravaiśyaśūdrāṇām aviśiṣṭam | ata eva somakāryakāriṇi phalacamase somadharmāḥ | ata eva vrīhidharmānvitatayā śrutam apy avaghātādi tatkāryakāritvasya vivakṣitatvāt prakṛtau yave vikṛtau ca nīvārādiṣu saṃbadhyata iti karmamīmāṃśāyāṃ tattadadhikaraṇeṣu niraṇāyi || 5.94 ||
ḍiṃbhāhavahatānāṃ ca vidyutā pārthivena ca |
gobrāhmaṇasya caivārthe yasya cecchati pārthivaḥ || 5.95 ||
ḍiṃbhāhaveti | ḍiṃbhāhavo nṛparahitayuddhaṃ tatra hatānāṃ, vidyutā vajreṇa, pārthivena vadhārhe ‘parādhe hate, gobrāḥmaṇarakṣaṇārthaṃ vināpi yuddhaṃ jalāgnivyāghrādibhir hatānāṃ, yasya purohitādeḥ svakāryāvighātārthaṃ nṛpatir aśaucābhāvam icchati tasyāpi sadyaḥśaucam || 5.95 ||
somāgnyarkānilendrāṇāṃ vittāppatyor yamasya ca |
aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ vapur dhārayate nṛpaḥ || 5.96 ||
someti | candrāgnisūryavāyuśakrayamānāṃ vittasyāpāṃ ca patyoḥ kuberavaruṇayor evam aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ saṃbandhi dehaṃ rājā dhārayati || 5.96 ||
lokeśādhiṣṭhito rājā nāsyāśaucaṃ vidhīyate |
śaucāśaucaṃ hi martyānāṃ lokeśaprabhavāpyayam || 5.97 ||
lokeśeti | yato lokeśāṃśākrānto nṛpatir ato nāsyāśaucam upadiśyate | yasmān manuṣyāṇāṃ yac chaucam aśaucaṃ vā tal lokeśebhyaḥ prabhavati vinaśyati ca | apyayo vināśaḥ | etenānyadīyaśaucāśaucotpādanavināśaśaktasya lokeśvararūpasya nṛpateḥ kutaḥ svakīyāśaucam iti pūrvoktāśaucābhāvastutiḥ || 5.97 ||
udyatair āhave śastraiḥ kṣatradharmahatasya ca |
sadyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate yajñas tathāśaucam iti sthitiḥ || 5.98 ||
udyatair iti | udyataiḥ śastraiḥ khaḍgādibhir na tu laguḍapāṣāṇādibhir aparāṅmukhatvādikṣatriyadharmayuktasaṃgrāme hatasya tatkṣaṇād eva jyotiṣṭomādiyajñaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate samāptim eti | tatpuṇyena yujyata ity arthaḥ | tathāśaucam api tatkṣaṇād eva samāptim eti | iyaṃ śāstre maryādā || 5.98 ||
vipraḥ śudhyaty apaḥ spṛṣṭvā kṣatriyo vāhanāyudham |
vaiśyaḥ pratodaṃ raśmīn vā yaṣṭiṃ śūdraḥ kṛtakriyaḥ || 5.99 ||
vipra iti | aśaucānte kṛtaśrāddhādikṛtyo brāhmaṇo ‘paḥ spṛṣṭveti calasparśamātraṃ dakṣiṇahastena kṛtvā śuddho bhavati na tu,
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu spṛṣair adbhir viśudhyati | [cf. MDh 5.75]
itivat | snātvā vāhanādisparśasāhacaryāt spṛṣṭvety asya ca sakṛduccaritasyārthabhedasyānyāyyatvāt kṣatriyo hastyādivāhanaṃ khaḍgādyastraṃ ca, vaiśyo balīvardādipratodaṃ lohaprotāgraṃ yoktraṃ vā, śūdro yaṣṭiṃ vaṃśadaṇḍikām || 5.99 ||
etad vo ‘bhihitaṃ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu dvijottamāḥ |
asapiṇḍeṣu sarveṣu pretaśuddhiṃ nibodhata || 5.100 ||
etad iti | bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ etac chaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu preteṣu yuṣmākam uktam | idānīm asapiṇḍeṣu pretaśuddhiṃ śṛṇuta || 5.100 ||
asapiṇḍaṃ dvijaṃ pretaṃ vipro nirhṛtya bandhuvat |
viśudhyati trirātreṇa mātur āptāṃś ca bāndhavān || 5.101 ||
asapiṇḍam iti | asapiṇḍaṃ brāḥmaṇaṃ mṛtaṃ brāhmaṇo bandhuvat snehānubandhena na tv adṛṣṭabuddhyety arthād uktam | mātuś cāptān saṃnikṛṣṭān sahodarabhrātṛbhaginyādīn bāndhavān nirhṛtya trirātreṇa śuddho bhavati || 5.101 ||
yady annam atti teṣāṃ tu daśāhenaiva śūdhyati |
anadann annam ahnaiva na cet tasmin gṛhe vaset || 5.102 ||
yady annam iti | nirhārako yadi teṣāṃ mṛtasya sapiṇḍānām āśaucinām annam aśnāti tadā tad daśāhenaiva śudhyati na trirātreṇa | atha teṣām annaṃ nāśnāti, gṛhe ca teṣāṃ na vasati, nirharati ca tadāhorātreṇaiva śudhyati | evaṃ ca tadgṛhavāse sati tadannābhojino nirhārakasya pūrvoktaṃ trirātram || 5.102 ||
anugamyecchayā pretaṃ jñātim ajñātim eva ca |
snātvā sacailaḥ spṛṣṭvāgniṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati || 5.103 ||
anugamyeti | jñātim ajñātiṃ vā mṛtam icchāto ‘nugamya sacailasnānaṃ ca kṛtvā tato ‘gniṃ ca spṛṣṭvā paścād ghṛtaprāśanaṃ kṛtvā anugamananimittāśaucād viśudhyati || 5.103 ||
na vipraṃ sveṣu tiṣthatsu mṛtaṃ śūdreṇa nāyayet |
asvargyā hy āhutiḥ sā syāc chūdrasaṃsparśadūṣitā || 5.104 ||
na vipram iti | brāhmaṇādiṃ mṛtaṃ samānajātīyeṣu sthiteṣu na śūdreṇa putrādir nirhārayet | yasmāt sā śarīrāhutiḥ śūdrasparśaduṣṭā satī mṛtasya svargāya hitā na bhavati | mṛtaṃ svargaṃ na prāpayatīty arthaḥ | ‘sveṣu tiṣṭhatsu’ ityabhidhānād brāhmaṇābhāve kṣatriyeṇa tadabhāve vaiśyena tadabhāve śūdreṇāpi nirhārayed ity uktaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ śreṣṭhatvād asvargyadoṣaś ca brāḥmaṇādisadbhāve śūdreṇa nirharaṇe sati boddhavyaḥ | govindarājas tu doṣanirdeśāt sveṣu tiṣṭhatsv ity avivakṣitam ity āha | tad ayuktam | saṃbhavadarthapadadvayoccāraṇavaiyarthya-prasaṅgād upakramāvagateś ca vedoditanyāyenānubodhyatvād guṇabhūtaśuddhyanurodhena pradhānabhūtāyā jāter upekṣāyāṃ guṇalopenāmukhyasyety api nyāyena bādhyeta | tasmāt ‘sveṣu tiṣṭhatsu’ iti padadvitayaṃ na vivakṣitam |
imāṃ govindarājasya rājājñāṃ nādriyāmahe |
|| 5.104 ||
jñānaṃ tapo ‘gnir āhāro mṛn mano vāry upāñjanam |
vāyuḥ karmārkakālau ca śuddheḥ kartṝṇi dehinām || 4.105 ||
jñānam iti | jñānādīni śuddheḥ sādhanāni bhavanti | tatra brahmajñānaṃ buddhirūpāntaḥkaraṇaśuddheḥ sādhanam, yathā vakṣyati (5.109) “buddhir jñānena śūdhyati” | tapo yathā (5.107) “tapasā vedavittamāḥ” | agnir yathā (5.122) “punaḥ pākena mṛṇmayam” | āhāro yathā (11.106) “haviṣyeṇa yavāgvā” iti | mṛdvāriṇī yathā (5.134) “mṛdvāry ādeyam arthavat” iti | mano yathā (3.146) “manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret” iti | saṃkalpavikalpātmakaṃ manaḥ, niścayātmikā buddhir iti manobuddhyor bhedaḥ | upāñjanam upalepanaṃ yathā (5.122) “mārjanopāñjanair veśma” | karma yathā (11.174) “yajeta vāśvamedhena” ityādi | arko yathā (5.87) “gām ālabhyārkam īkṣya vā” | kālo yathā (5.83) “śudhyed vipro daśāhena” | vāyo ‘stu śuddhihetutvaṃ manunānuktam api “panthānaś ca viśudhyanti somasūryāṃśumārutaiḥ” iti viṣṇvādāv uktaṃ grāhyam || 5.105 ||
sarveṣām eva śaucānām arthaśaucaṃ paraṃ smṛtam |
yo ‘rthe śucir hi sa śucir na mṛdvāriśuciḥ śuciḥ || 5.106 ||
sarveṣām eveti | sarveṣāṃ mṛdvārinimittadehaśaucamanaḥśaucādīnāṃ madhyād arthaśaucam anyāyena paradhanaharaṇaparihāreṇa yad dhanehā tat paraṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ manvādibhiḥ smṛtam | yasmād yo ‘rthe śuddhaḥ sa śūddho bhavati | yaḥ punar mṛdvāriśucir arthe cāśuddhaḥ so ‘śuddha eva || 5.106 ||
kṣāntyā śudhyanti vidvāṃso dānenākāryakāriṇaḥ |
pracchannapāpā japyena tapasā vedavittamāḥ || 5.107 ||
kṣāntyeti | pareṇāpakāre kṛte tasmin pratyapakārabuddhyanutpattirūpayā paṇḍitāḥ śudhyanti | yathā ca vakṣyati (11.245) “mahāyajñakriyākṣamā | nāsayanty āśu pāpāni” iti | akāryakāriṇo dānena | yathā vakṣyati (11.76) “sarvasvaṃ vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāya” iti | aprakhyātapāpā japyena | yathā vakṣyati (2.220) “japaṃs tūpavased dinam” iti | vedavittamāḥ vedārthacāndrāyaṇāditapovidaḥ tapasā (11.101) ity ekādaśādhyāye vakṣyamāṇena || 5.107 ||
mṛttoyaiḥ śudhyate śodhyaṃ nadī vegena śudhyati |
rajasā strī manoduṣṭā saṃnyāsena dvijottamāḥ || 5.108 ||
mṛttoyair iti | malādyupahataṃ śodhanīyaṃ mṛjjalaiḥ śodhyate | nadīpravāhaś ca śleṣmādyaśucidūṣito vegena śudhyati | strī ca parapuruṣamaithunasaṃkalpādidūṣitamānasā pratimāsārtavena tasmāt pāpāc chuddhā bhavati | brāhmaṇasya saṃnyāsena ṣaṣṭhādhyāyābhidheyena pāpāc chudhyati || 5.108 ||
adbhir gātrāṇi śudhyanti manaḥ satyena śudhyati |
vidyātapobhyāṃ bhūtātmā buddhir jñānena śūdhyati || 5.109 ||
adbhir iti | svedādyupahatāny aṅgāni jalena kṣālitāni śudhyanti | manaś ca niṣiddhacintādinā dūṣitaṃ satyābhidhānena śudhyati | bhūtātmā sūkṣmādiliṅgaśarīrāvacchinno jīvātmā brahmavidyayā pāpakṣayahetutayā tapasā ca śuddho bhavati | śuddhaḥ paramātmarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhate | buddhis ca viparyayajñānopahatā yathārthaviṣayajñānena śudhyati
|| 5.109 ||
eṣa śaucasya vaḥ proktaḥ śārīrasya vinirṇayaḥ |
nānāvidhānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ śuddheḥ śṛṇuta nirṇayam || 5.110 ||
eṣa iti | ayaṃ śarīrasaṃbandhinaḥ śaucasya yuṣmākaṃ niścaya uktaḥ | idānīṃ nānāprakāradravyāṇāṃ yena yac chudhyati tasya nirṇayaṃ śṛṇuta || 5.110 ||
taijasānāṃ maṇīnāṃ ca sarvasyāśmamayasya ca |
bhasmanādbhir mṛdā caiva śuddhir uktā manīṣibhaḥ || 5.111 ||
taijaseti | taijasānāṃ suvarṇādīnāṃ marakatādimaṇīnāṃ pāṣāṇamayasya ca sarvasya bhasmanā jalena mṛttikayā ca manvādibhiḥ śuddhir uktā | nirlepasya jalenaivāntaraṃ śuddher vakṣyamāṇatvād idam ucchiṣṭaghṛtādiliptaviṣayam | tatra mṛdbhasmanor gandhakṣayaikakāryatvād vikalpaḥ | āpas tūbhayatra samuccīyante || 5.111 ||
nirlepaṃ kāñcanaṃ bhāṇḍam adbhir eva viśudhyati |
abjama āśmamayaṃ caiva rājataṃ cānupaskṛtam || 5.112 ||
nirlepam iti | ucchiṣṭādileparahitaṃ sauvarṇabhāṇḍam, jalabhavaṃ ca śaṅkhamuktādi, pāṣāṇamayaṃ ca rājatam anupaskṛtaṃ rekhādiguṇāntarādhānarahitaṃ tathāvidhamalāsaṃbhavāj jalenaiva bhasmādirahitena śudhyati || 5.112 ||
apām agneś ca saṃyogād dhemaṃ raupyaṃ ca nirbabhau |
tasmāt tayoḥ svayonyaiva nirṇeko guṇavattaraḥ || 5.113 ||
apām agner iti | “agnir vai varuṇānīr akāmayata” ityādi vede śrūyate | tathā “agneḥ suvarṇam indriyam, varuṇānīnāṃ rajatam” ityādiśrutiṣv agnyāpaḥsaṃyogāt suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ codbhūtaṃ yasmād atas tayoḥ svena kāraṇenaiva jalenātyantopaghātenāgninā nirṇekaḥ śuddhihetur guṇavattaraḥ praśastataraḥ || 5.113 ||
tāmrāyaḥkāṃsyaraityānāṃ trapuṇaḥ sīsakasya ca |
śaucaṃ yathārhaṃ kartavyaṃ kṣārāmlodakavāribhiḥ || 5.114 ||
tāmrāya iti | ayo lohaṃ, rītiḥ pittalaṃ tadbhavaṃ pātraṃ raityaṃ, trapu raṅgaṃ, eṣāṃ bhasmāmlodakaiḥ śodhanaṃ kartavyam | yathārhaṃ yasya yad arhati |
ambhasā hemaraupyāyaḥkāṃsyaṃ śudhyati bhasmanā |
amlais tāmraṃ ca raityaṃ ca punaḥpākena mṛnmayam ||
iti bṛhaspatyādivacanād viśeṣo ‘tra boddhavyaḥ || 5.114 ||
dravāṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śuddhir utpavanaṃ smṛtam |
prokṣaṇaṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca dāravāṇāṃ ca takṣaṇam || 5.115 ||
dravāṇāṃ ceti | dravāṇāṃ ghṛtatailānāṃ kākakīṭādyupahatānāṃ baudhāyanādivacanāt prasṛtimātrapramāṇānāṃ prādeśapramāṇakuśapatradvayābhyām utpavanena śuddhiḥ | saṃhatānāṃ ca śayyādīnām ucchiṣṭādyupaghāte prokṣaṇaṃ, dāravāṇāṃ cātyantopaghāte takṣaṇena || 5.115 ||
mārjanaṃ yajñapātrāṇāṃ pāṇinā yajñakarmaṇi |
camasānāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca śuddhiḥ prakṣālanena tu || 5.116 ||
mārjanam iti | camasānāṃ grahāṇāṃ cānyeṣāṃ yajñapātrāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ pāṇinā mārjanaṃ kāryam, paścāt prakṣālanena yajñe kartavye śuddhir bhavati || 5.116 ||
carūṇāṃ sruksruvāṇāṃ ca śuddhir uṣṇena vāriṇā |
sphyaśūrpaśakaṭānāṃ ca musalolūkhalasya ca || 5.117 ||
carūṇām iti | snehāktānāṃ carusrugādīnām uṣṇajalena śuddhiḥ | snehādyayuktānāṃ tu jalamātreṇaiva śuddhir yajñārtham || 5.117 ||
adbhis tu prokṣaṇaṃ śaucaṃ bahūnāṃ dhānyavāsasām |
prakṣālanena tv alpānām adbhiḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate || 5.118 ||
adbhis tv iti | bahūnāṃ dānyānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ ca cāṇḍālādyupaghāte jalena prokṣaṇāc chuddhiḥ | bahutvaṃ ca puruṣabhārahāryādhikatvam iti vyācakṣate | tadalpānāṃ tu prakṣālanāc chuddhir manvādibhir upadiśyate || 5.118 ||
cailavac carmaṇāṃ śuddhir vaidalānāṃ tathaiva ca |
śākamūlaphalānāṃ ca dhānyavac chuddhir iṣyate || 5.119 ||
cailavad iti | spṛśyapaśucarmaṇāṃ vaṃśādidalanirmitānāṃ ca vastravac chuddhir bhavati | śākamūlaphalānāṃ ca dhānyavac chuddhiḥ || 5.119 ||
kauśeyāvikayor ūṣaiḥ kutapānām ariṣtakaiḥ |
śrīphalair aṃśupaṭṭānāṃ kṣaumāṇāṃ gaurasarṣapaiḥ || 5.120 ||
kauśeyeti | kṛmikośodbhavasya vastrasya, meṣādilomaprabhavasya kambalādeḥ, ūṣaiḥ kṣāramṛttikābhiḥ, kutapānāṃ nepālakambalānam ariṣṭakair ariṣṭacūrṇaiḥ, aṃśupaṭṭānāṃ paṭṭaśāṭakānāṃ bilvaphalaiḥ, kṣaumāṇāṃ dukūlānāṃ kṣumāvalkalabhavānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ tu piṣṭaśvetasarṣapaprakṣālanāc chuddhiḥ || 5.120 ||
kṣaumavac chaṅkhaśṛṅgāṇām asthidantamayasya ca |
śuddhir vijānatā kāryā gomūtreṇodakena vā || 5.121 ||
kṣaumavad iti | śaṅkhasya paśuśṛṅgāṇāṃ spṛśyapaśvasthibhavasya gajādidantasya ca kṣaumavat piṣṭaśvetasarṣapakalkena gomūtrajalayor anyatarayuktena śāstravidā śuddhiḥ kartavyā || 5.121 ||
prokṣaṇāt tṛṇakāṣṭhaṃ ca palālaṃ caiva śudhyati |
mārjanopāñjanair veśma punaḥpākena mṛnmayam || 5.122 ||
prokṣaṇāt tṛṇakāṣṭhaṃ ceti | tṛnakāṣṭhapalālaṃ ca cāṇḍālādisparśadūṣitaṃ prokṣaṇena śūdhyati | tṛṇapalālasāhacaryād idam indhanādikāṣṭhaviṣayam | “dāravāṇāṃ ca takṣaṇam” (5.115) iti nirmitadārumayagṛhapātraviṣayam | gṛham udakyānivāsādidūṣitaṃ mārjanagomayādyupalepanena | mṛnmayabhāṇḍam ucchiṣṭādisparśadūṣitaṃ punaḥpākena śudhyati || 5.122 ||
madyair mūtraiḥ purīṣair vā ṣṭhīvanaiḥ pūyaśoṇitaiḥ |
saṃspṛṣṭaṃ naiva śudhyeta punaḥpākena mṛnmayam || 5.123 ||
madyair iti | madyādibhis tu saṃspṛṣṭaṃ mṛnmayapātraṃ punaḥpākenāpi na śudhyati | ṣṭhīvanaṃ śleṣmā, pūyaṃ śoṇitavikāraḥ || 5.123 ||
saṃmārjanopāñjanena sekenollekhanena ca |
gavāṃ ca parivāsena bhūmiḥ śūdhyati pañcabhiḥ || 5.124 ||
saṃmārjaneti | avakaraśodhanena gomayādyupalepanena gomūtrodakādisekena khātvā katipayamṛdapanayanena gavām ahorātranivāsena pañcabhir ekaikaśo bhūmiḥ śudhyati | eṣāṃ cocchiṣṭamūtrapurīṣacaṇḍālanivāsādyupaghātagauravalāghavābhyāṃ samuccayavikalpāv avagantavyau || 5.124 ||
pakṣijagdhaṃ gavāghrātam avadhūtam avakṣutam |
dūṣitaṃ keśakīṭaiś ca mṛtprakṣepeṇa śudhyati || 5.125 ||
pakṣijagdham iti | bhakṣyapakṣibhir na tu kākagṛdhrādibhiḥ kaścid bhāgo yasya bhakṣitaḥ, gavā yasyāghrāṇaṃ kṛtaṃ, padā cāvadhūtam, upari kṛtakṣutaṃ, keśakīṭadūṣitaṃ, jagdhaśabdaliṅgād annam alpaṃ mṛtkṣepeṇa śudhyati || 5.125 ||
yāvan nāpaity amedhyāktād gandho lepaś ca tatkṛtaḥ |
tāvan mṛd vāri cādeyaṃ sarvāsu dravyaśuddhiṣu || 5.126 ||
yāvad iti | viṣṭhādiliptād dravyād yāvat tatsaṃbandhinau gandhalepau tiṣṭhatas tāvad dravyam uddhṛtya mṛdvāri prakṣipya grahītavyam | yatra ca vasāmajjādau mṛdā śuddhis tatra mṛtsahitaṃ jalagrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | yatra karṇamalādau jalenaiva śuddhis tatra jalamātram ity avagantavyam || 5.126 ||
trīṇi devāḥ pavitrāṇi brāhmaṇānām akalpayan |
adṛṣṭam adbhir nirṇiktaṃ yac ca vācā praśasyate || 5.127 ||
trīṇi deva iti | kenāpi prakāreṇādṛṣṭopaghātahetusaṃsargam adṛṣṭam | saṃjātopaghātaśaṅkāyāṃ jalena prakṣālitam | tad āha hārītaḥ: “yad yan mīmāṃsyaṃ syāt tat tad adbhiḥ sparśāc chuddhaṃ bhavati” | upaghātaśaṅkāyām eva “pavitraṃ bhvatu” iti brāhmaṇavācā yat praśasyate tāni trīṇi pavitrāṇi deva brāḥmaṇānāṃ kalpitavantaḥ || 5.127 ||
āpaḥ śuddhā bhūmigatā vaitṛṣṇyaṃ yāsu gor bhavet |
avyāptāś ced amedhyena gandhavarṇarasānvitāḥ || 5.128 ||
āpaḥ śuddhā iti | yatparimāṇāsv apsu goḥ pipāsāvicchedo bhavati tā āpo gandhavarṇarasaśālinyaḥ satyaḥ yady amedhyaliptā na bhavanti tadā viśuddhabhūmigatā viśuddhāḥ syuḥ | bhūmigatā iti viśuddhabhūmisaṃbandhapradarśanāya na tv antarikṣagatānāṃ nivṛttyartham || 5.128 ||
nityaṃ śuddhaḥ kāruhastaḥ paṇye yac ca prasāritam |
brahmacārigataṃ bhaikṣyaṃ medhyam iti sthitiḥ || 5.129 ||
nityaṃ śuddha iti | kāror mālākārāder devabrāhmaṇādyarthe ‘pi mālyādigrathane dravyaprayojanādyapekṣayā śuddhiviśeṣākaraṇe ‘pi svabhāvād eva hastaḥ sarvadā śuddhaḥ | tathā jananamaraṇayor api svavyāpāre śuddhaḥ, “na tv āśaucaṃ kārūṇāṃ kārukarmaṇi” iti vacanāt | tathā yad vikretavyaṃ paṇyavīthikāyāṃ prasāritaṃ “nāpaṇanīyam annam aśnīyāt” iti śaṅkhavacanāt siddhānnavyatriktaṃ tad anekakretṛkarasparśe ‘pi śuddham eva | tathā ca brahmacāryādigatabhaikṣyam anācāntastrīdattam api rathyādikramaṇe ‘pi sarvadā śuddham iti śāstramaryādā || 5.129 ||
nityam āsyaṃ śuci strīṇāṃ śakuniḥ phalapātane |
prasrave ca śucir vatsaḥ śvā mṛgagrahaṇe śuciḥ || 5.130 ||
nityam āsyam iti | sarvadā strīṇāṃ mukhaṃ śuci, tathā kākādipakṣiṇāṃ cañcūpaghātapatitaṃ phalaṃ śuci, vatsamukhaṃ ca dohasamaye kṣīraprakṣaraṇe śuci, śvā ca yadā mṛgādīn hantuṃ gṛhṇāti tadā tatra vyāpāre śuciḥ syāt || 5.130 ||
śvabhir hatasya yan māṃsaṃ śuci tan manur abravīt |
kravyādbhiś ca hatsyānyaiś caṇḍālādyaiś ca dasyubhiḥ || 5.131 ||
śvabhir iti | kukkurair hatasya mṛgāder yan māṃsaṃ tac chuci manur avocat | tac chrāddhādyatithbhojanādāv eva draṣṭavyam | anyaiś cāmamāṃsādibhir vyāghraśyenādibhiś ca vyādhādibhiś ca mṛgavadhajīvibhir hatasya || 5.131 ||
ūrdhvaṃ nābher yāni khāni tāni medhyāni sarvaśaḥ |
yāny adhastāny amedhyāni dehāc caiva malāś cyutāḥ || 5.132 ||
ūrdhvaṃ nābher iti | yāni nābher uparīndriyacchidrāṇi tāni sarvāṇi pavitrāṇi bhavanti | atas teṣāṃ sparśane nāśaucam | yāni nābher adhastāny aśucīni bhavanti adhaśchidreṣu ca | bahuvacanaṃ vyaktibahutvāpekṣayā | vakṣyamāṇāś ca vasādayo dehamalā dehān niḥsṛtā aśuddhā bhavanti || 5.132 ||
makṣikā vipruṣaś chāyā gaur aśvaḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ |
rajo bhūr vāyur agniś ca sparśe medhyāni nirdiśet || 5.133 ||
makṣiketi | makṣikā amedhyasparśinyo ‘pi, vipruṣo mukhaniḥsṛtā alpā jalakaṇāḥ, chāyā patitāder hīnasparśasyāpi, gavādīni cāgniparyantāni caṇḍālādispṛṣṭāni sparśe śucīni jānīyāt
|| 5.133 ||
viṇmūtrotsargaśuddhyarthaṃ mṛdvāry ādeyam arthavat |
daihikānāṃ malānāṃ ca śūddhiṣu dvādaśasv api || 5.134 ||
viṇmūtreti | viṇmūtram utsṛjyate yena sa viṇmūtrotsargaḥ pāyvādis tasya śuddhyarthaṃ mṛdvāri grahītavyam arthavat prayojanavat yāvatā gandhalepakṣayo bhavati | tathā śārīrāṇāṃ vasādimalānāṃ saṃbandhiṣu dvādaśasv api gandhalepakṣayārthaṃ mṛdvāri grāhyam | tatra smṛtyantarāt pūrvaṣaṭke mṛjjalagrahaṇam | uttaraṣaṭke jalamātragrahaṇam | tad āha baudhāyanaḥ:
ādadīta mṛdo ‘paś ca ṣaṭsu pūrveṣu śuddhaye |
uttareṣu ca ṣaṭsv adbhiḥ kevalābhir viśudhyati ||
ataś ca ‘dvādaśasv api’ iti mānavaṃ mṛdvārigrahaṇavacanaṃ vyavasthayā mṛdvāriṇor grahaṇe sati na virudhyate | govindarājas tum manu-baudhāyanavacanasaṃdarśanād uttaraṣaṭke ‘pi vikalpam āha; sa ca vyavasthito daivapitrādyadṛṣṭakarmapravṛtte uttareṣv api mṛdam ādadyān nānyadā || 5.134 ||
vasāśukram asṛṅ majjā mūtraviḍghrāṇakarṇaviṭ |
śleṣmāśru dūṣikā svedo dvādaśaite nṛṇāṃ malāḥ || 5.135 ||
vaseti | vasā kāyasnehaḥ, śukraṃ retaḥ, asṛk raktaṃ, majjā śiromadhye piṇḍitasnehaḥ, dūṣikā akṣimalaḥ, svedaḥ śramādinā dehaniḥsṛtaṃ jalam | vasādayo dvādaśa narāṇāṃ daihikā malā bhavanti || 5.135 ||
ekā liṅge gude tisras tathaikatra kare daśa |
ubhayoḥ sapta dātavyā mṛdaḥ śuddhim īpsatā || 5.136 ||
ekā liṅga iti | mūtrapurīṣotsarge sati śuddhim abhīpsatā “mṛdvāry ādeyam arthavat” (5.134) ity uktatvāj jalasahitā mṛd ekā liṅge dātavyā, gude tisro mṛdaḥ, tathaikasmin kare vāme |
śaucavid dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ nādhaḥśauce niyojayet |
tathaiva vāmahastena nābher ūrdhvaṃ na śodhayet ||
iti devalavacanāt tasyaivādhaśaucasādhanatvāt tatraiva daśa mṛdo dātavyāḥ | ata ubhayoḥ karayoḥ sapta dātavyāḥ | yadā tūktaśaucenāpi gandhalepakṣayo na bhavati tadā “yāvad apaity amedhyāktāt” (5.126) iti vacanād adhikasaṃkhyāpi mṛd dātavyā | etadviṣayāṇy eva munīnām adhikamṛtsaṃkhyāvacanāni | mṛtparimāṇam āha dakṣaḥ (5.8) |
liṅge ‘pi mṛt samākhyātā triparvī pūryate yathā |
dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca tadardhārdhā prakīrtitā || iti |
yadā tūktasaṃkhyāyā alpenāpi gandhalepakṣayo bhavati tadā saṃkhyāvākyārambhasāmarthyāt saṃkhyā pūrayitavyaiva || 5.136 ||
etac chaucaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ dviguṇaṃ brahmacāriṇām |
triguṇaṃ syād vanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ tu caturguṇam || 5.137 ||
etac chaucam iti | “ekā liṅge” (5.136) ityādi yac chaucam uktaṃ tad gṛhasthānām eva; brahmacāriṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ, vānaprasthānāṃ triguṇaṃ, yatīnāṃ punaś caturguṇam
|| 5.137 ||
kṛtvā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā khāny ācānta upaspṛśet |
vedam adhyeṣyamāṇaś ca annam aśnaṃś ca sarvadā || 5.138 ||
kṛtveti | mūtrapurīṣaṃ kṛtvā kṛtayathoktaśaucas trir ācānta indriyacchidrāṇi śīrṣaṇyāni ca spṛśet vedādhyayanaṃ cikīrṣan, annaṃ vāśnan | yat tu dvitīyādhyāye “adhyeṣyamāṇas tv ācānto” (2.70), “nivedya gurave ‘śnīyād ācamya” (2.51) ity ubhayam uktaṃ tad vratāṅgatvārtham, idaṃ tu puruṣārthaśaucāyety apunaruktiḥ || 5.138 ||
trir ācāmed apaḥ pūrvaṃ dviḥ pramṛjyāt tato mukham |
śārīraṃ śaucam icchan hi strī śūdras tu sakṛt sakṛt || 5.139 ||
trir ācāmed iti | dehasya śuddhim icchan prathamaṃ vāratrayam apo bhakṣayet | tato dvir mukhaṃ parimṛjyat | strī śūdraś caikavāram ācamanārtham udakaṃ bhakṣayet || 5.139 ||
śūdrāṇāṃ māsikaṃ kāryaṃ vapanaṃ nyāyavartinām |
vaiśyavac chaucakalpaś ca dvijocchiṣṭaṃ ca bhojanam || 5.140 ||
śūdrāṇām iti | śūdrāṇāṃ kāryam iti “kṛtyānāṃ kartari vā” (Pāṇ 2.3.71) iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī | yathāśāstravyavahāribhir dvijaśuśrūṣakaiḥ śūdrair māsi māśi muṇḍanaṃ kāryam, vaiśyavac ca mṛtasūtakādau śaucakalpo ‘nuṣṭhātavyaḥ; dvijocchiṣṭaṃ ca bhojanam | bhujyata iti bhojanaṃ kāryam iti || 5.140 ||
“niṣṭhīvyoktvānṛtāni ca” (5.145) iti niṣṭhīvatām ācamanavidhānād viduṣām api mukhān niḥsaraṇaṃ niṣṭhīvanam evati prasaktau śuddhyartham apavādam āha –
nocchiṣṭaṃ kurvate mukhyā vipruṣo ‘ṅge patanti yāḥ |
na śmaśrūṇi gatāny āsyaṃ na dantāntaradhiṣṭhitam || 5.141 ||
nocchiṣṭam iti | mukhabhavā vipruṣo yā aṅge nipatanti tā ucchiṣṭaṃ na kurvanti | tathā śmaśrulomāni mukhapraviṣṭāni nocchiṣṭatāṃ janayanti | dantāvakāśasthitaṃ cānnāvayavādi nocchiṣṭaṃ kurute | atra gautamīye (1.5) viśeṣaḥ: “dantāśliṣṭeṣu dantavad anyatra jihvābhimarṣanāt prāk cyuter” iti | eke “cyuteṣv āhāravad vidyān nirgirann eva tacchuciḥ” (GDh 1.40) || 5.141 ||
spṛśanti bindavaḥ pādau ya ācāmayataḥ parān |
bhaumikais te samā jñeyā na tair aprayato bhavet || 5.142 ||
spṛśantīti | anyeṣām ācamanārthaṃ jalaṃ dadatāṃ ye bindavaḥ pādau spṛśanti na jaṅghādi viśuddhabhūmiṣṭhodakais tulyās tena nācamanārho bhavati | tadā tatra cyavanāvasthair akṛtācamanaḥ śudhyati, dravyaṃ ca śudhyati || 5.142 ||
ucchiṣṭena tu saṃspṛṣṭo dravyahastaḥ kathaṃcana |
anidhāyaiva tad dravyam ācāntaḥ śucitām iyāt || 5.143 ||
ucchiṣṭeneti | dravyahastapadena śarīrasaṃbandhamātraṃ dravyasya vivakṣitam | “āmaṇibandhanāt pāṇiṃ prakṣālya” (GDh 1.36) iti dravyahastasyācamanāsaṃbhavāt skandhādisthitadravyo yady ucchiṣṭena saṃspṛṣṭo bhavati tadā dravayam anavasthāpyaiva kṛtācamanaḥ śūdhyati, dravyaṃ ca śuddhaṃ bhavati || 5.143 ||
vānto viriktaḥ snātvā tu ghṛtaprāśanam ācaret |
ācāmed eva bhuktvānnaṃ snānaṃ maithuninaḥ smṛtam || 5.144 ||
vanta iti | kṛtavamanaḥ saṃjātavirekaḥ snātvā ghṛtaprāśanaṃ kuryāt | “daśa virekān viriktaḥ” iti govindarājaḥ | yadi bhuktvā anantaram eva vamati tadā ācamanam eva kuryān na snānaghṛtaprāśane | maithunaṃ ca kṛtvā snāyāt | ekaṃ tv ṛtumatīviṣayam || 5.144 ||
suptvā kṣutvā ca bhuktvā ca niṣṭhīvyoktvānṛtāni ca |
pīrvāpo ‘dhyeṣyamāṇaś ca ācāmet prayato ‘pi san || 5.145 ||
suptveti | nidrākṣudbhojanaśleṣmanirasanamṛṣāvādajalapānādi kṛtvādhyayanaṃ cikīrṣuḥ śucir apy ācāmet | yat tu “bhuktvā copaspṛśet Samyak” (2.53) iti, tathā “adhyeṣyamāṇas tv ācāntaḥ” (2.70) iti dvitīyādhyāyoktaṃ tad vratāṅgatvena | iha tu bhuktvācamanavidhānaṃ puruṣārtham, adhyayanāṅgatayācamanavidhānaṃ gṛhasthādīnām apīti || 5.145 ||
eṣa śaucavidhiḥ kṛtsno dravyaśuddhis tathaiva ca |
ukto vaḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ srīṇāṃ dharmān nibodhata || 5.146 ||
eṣa śaucavidhir iti | eṣa varṇānāṃ jananamaraṇādau daśarātrādir aśaucavidhiḥ samagro dravyāṇāṃ taijasādīnāṃ celādīnāṃ ca jalādinā śuddhividhir yuṣmākam uktaḥ | idānīṃ strīṇām anuṣtheyaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇuta || 5.146 ||
bālayā vā yuvatyā vā vṛddhayā vāpi yoṣitā |
na svātantryeṇa kartavyaṃ kiṃcit kāryaṃ gṛheṣv api || 5.147 ||
bālayā veti | bālye yauvane vārdhike ca vartamānayā kiṃcit sūkṣmam api kāryaṃ bhartrādyananumataṃ na svātantryeṇa kartavyam iti || 5.147 ||
bālye pitur vase tiṣṭhet pāṇigrāhasya yauvane |
putrāṇāṃ bhartari prete na bhajet strī svatantratām || 5.148 ||
bāle pitur iti | kiṃ tu bālye pitur vase tiṣṭhet, yauvane bhartuḥ, bhartari mṛte putrāṇām | tadabhāve,
tatsapiṇḍeṣu cāsatsu pitṛpakṣaḥ prabhuḥ striyaḥ |
pakṣadvayāvasāne tu rājā bhartā striyā mataḥ ||
iti nāradavacanāt, jñātirājādīnām āyattā syāt, kadācin na svatantrā bhavet || 5.148 ||
pitrā bhartrā sutair vāpi necched viraham ātmanaḥ |
eṣāṃ hi viraheṇa strī garhye kuryād ubhe kule || 5.149 ||
pitrā bhartreti | pitrā patyā putrair vā nātmano virahaṃ kuryāt | yasmād eṣāṃ viyogena strī bandhakībhāvaṃ gatā patipitṛkule nindite karoti || 5.149 ||
sadā prahṛṣṭayā bhāvyaṃ gṛhakārye ca dakṣayā |
susaṃskṛtopaskarayā vyaye cāmuktahastayā || 5.150 ||
sadā prahṛṣṭayeti | sarvadā bhartari viruddhe ‘pi prasannavadanayā gṛhakarmaṇi caturayā suśodhitakuṇḍalakaṭāhādigṛhabhāṇḍayā vyaye cābahupradayā striyā bhavitavyam || 5.150 ||
yasmai dadyāt pitā tv enāṃ bhrātā vānumate pituḥ |
taṃ śuśrūṣeta jīvantaṃ saṃsthitaṃ ca na laṅghayet || 5.151 ||
yasmai dadyād iti | yasmai pitā enāṃ dadyāt pitur anumatyā bhrātā vā taṃ jīvantaṃ paricaren mṛtaṃ ca nātikrāmet; vyabhicāreṇa tadīyaśrāddhatarpaṇādivirahitayā pāralaukikakṛtyakhaṇḍanena ca || 5.151 ||
maṅgalārthaṃ svastyayanaṃ yajñaś cāsāṃ prajāpateḥ |
prayujyate vivāheṣu pradānaṃ svāmyakāraṇam || 5.152 ||
maṅgalārtham iti | yad āsāṃ svastyayanaśāntyanumantravacanādirūpaṃ, yaś cāsāṃ prajāpatiyāgaḥ prajāpatyuddeśenājyahomātmako vivāheṣu kriyate tan maṅgalārtham abhīṣṭasaṃpattyarthaṃ karma | yat punaḥ prathamaṃ pradānaṃ vāgdānātmakaṃ tad eva bhartuḥ svāmyajanakam | tataś ca vāgdānād ārabhya strī bhartṛparatantrā | tasmāt taṃ śrayeteti pūrvoktaśeṣaḥ | yat tu aṣṭame vakṣyate “teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu vijñeyā vidvadbhiḥ saptame pade” (8.227) iti tad bhāryātvasaṃskārārtham ity avirodhaḥ || 5.152 ||
anṛtāv ṛtukāle ca mantrasaṃskārakṛt patiḥ |
sukhasya nityaṃ dāteha paraloke ca yoṣitaḥ || 5.153 ||
anṛtāv iti | yataḥ mantrasaṃskāro vivāhas tatkartā bhartā “ṛtāv upeyāt sarvatra vā pratiṣiddhavarjam” (GDh 5.1) iti gautamavacanāt ṛtukāle anyadā ca nityam iha loke ca sukhasya dātā tadārādhanena ca svargādiprāpteḥ paraloke ‘pi sukhasya dāteti || 5.153 ||
tasmāt –
viśīlaḥ kāmavṛtto vā guṇair vā parivarjitaḥ |
upacaryaḥ striyā sādhvyā satataṃ devavat patiḥ || 5.154 ||
viśīla iti | sadācāraśūnyaḥ stryantarānurakto vā vidyādiguṇahīno vā tathāpi sādhvyā striyā devavat patir ārādhanīyaḥ || 5.154 ||
yasmāc ca –
nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthag yajño na vrataṃ nāpy upoṣaṇam |
patiṃ śuśrūṣate yena tena svarge mahīyate || 5.155 ||
nāsti strīṇām iti | yathā bhartuḥ kasyāścit patnyā rajoyogādinā anupasthitāv api patnyantareṇa yajñaniṣpattiḥ, tathā na strīṇāṃ bhartrā vinā yajñasiddhiḥ | nāpi bhartur anumatim antareṇa vratopavāsau kiṃ tu bhartṛparicaryayaiva strī svargaloke pūjyate || 5.155 ||
pāṇigrāhasya sādhvī strī jīvato vā mṛtasya vā |
patilokam abhīpsantī nācaret kiṃcid apriyam || 5.156 ||
pāṇigrāhasyeti | patyā saha dharmācaraṇena yo ‘rjitaḥ svargādilokaḥ tam icchantī sādhvī strī jīvato vā mṛtasya vā bhartur na kiṃcid apriyam arjayet | mṛtasyāpriyaṃ vyabhicāreṇa vihitaśrāddhakhaṇḍanena ca || 5.156 ||
kāmaṃ tu kṣapayed dehaṃ puṣpamūlaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
na tu nāmāpi gṛhṇīyāt patyau prete parasya tu || 5.157 ||
kāmaṃ tv iti | vṛttisaṃbhave ‘pi puṣpamūlaphalaiḥ pavitraiś ca dehaṃ kṣapayed alpāhāreṇa kṣīṇaṃ kuryāt | na ca bhartari mṛte vyabhicāradhiyā parapuruṣasya nāmāpy uccārayet
|| 5.157 ||
evaṃ ca sati –
āsītāmaraṇāt kṣāntā niyatā brahmacāriṇī |
yo dharma ekapatnīnāṃ kāṅkṣantī tam anuttamam || 5.158 ||
āsīteti | kṣamāyuktā niyamavatī ekabhartṛkāṇāṃ yo dharmaḥ prakṛṣṭatamas tam icchantī madhumāṃsamaithunavarjanātmakabrahmacaryaśālinī maraṇaparyantaṃ tiṣṭhet | aputrāpi putrārthaṃ na parapuruṣaṃ seveta || 5.158 ||
yasmāt –
anekāni sahasrāṇi kumārabrahmacāriṇām |
divaṃ gatāni viprāṇām akṛtvā kulasaṃtatim || 5.159 ||
anekānīti | bālyata eva brahmacāriṇām akṛtadārāṇāṃ sanakavālakhilyādīnāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bahūni sahasrāṇi kulavṛddhyarthaṃ saṃtatim anutpādyāpi svargaṃ gatāni || 5.159 ||
mṛte bhartari sādhvī strī brahmacarye vyavasthitā |
svargaṃ gacchati aputrāpi yathā te brahmacāriṇaḥ || 5.160 ||
mṛte bhartarīti | sādhvācārā strī mṛte bhartary akṛtapuruṣāntaramaithunā putrarahitāpi svargaṃ gacchati | yathā te sanakavālakhilyādayaḥ putraśūnyāḥ svargaṃ gatāḥ || 5.160 ||
apatyalobhād yā tu strī bhartāram ativartate |
seha nindām avāpnoti paralokāc ca hīyate || 5.161 ||
apatyalobhād iti | ‘putro me jāyatāṃ tena svargaṃ prāpsyāmi’ iti lobhena yā strī bhartāram atikramya vartate | vyabhicaratīty arthaḥ | seha loke garhāṃ prāpnoti | paralokaṃ ca svargaṃ tena putreṇa na labhate || 5.161 ||
atraiva hetum āha –
nānyotpannā prajāstīha na cāpy anyaparigrahe |
na dvitīyaś ca sādhvīnāṃ kvacid bhartopadiśyate || 5.162 ||
nānyotpanneti | yasmād bhartṛvyatiriktena puruṣeṇotpannā sā prajā tasyāḥ śāstrīyā na bhavati | na cānyapatnyām utpāditotpādakasya prajā bhavati | etac cāniyogotpāditāviṣayam | bahubhartṛkeyam iti lokaprasiddheḥ dvitīyo ‘pi bhartaiva | tasmād anyotpāditatvam asiddham ity āśaṅkyāha – neti | loke garhāprasiddhāv api sādhvācārāṇāṃ na kvacic chāstre dvitīyopabhartopadiśyate | evaṃ ca sati punarbhūtvam api pratiṣiddham || 5.162 ||
patiṃ hitvāpakṛṣṭaṃ svam utkṛṣṭaṃ yā niṣevate |
nindyaiva sā bhavel loke parapūrveti cocyate || 5.163 ||
patim iti | apakṛṣṭaṃ kṣatriyādikaṃ svakīyaṃ patiṃ tyaktvotkṛṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇādikaṃ yā āśrayati sā loke garhaṇīyaiva bhavati | paro ‘nyaḥ pūrvo bhartāsyā abhūd iti lokair ucyate
|| 5.163 ||
vyabhicāraphalam āha –
vyabhicārāt tu bhartuḥ strī loke prāpnoti nindyatām |
sṛgālayoniṃ prāpnoti pāparogaiś ca pīḍyate || 5.164 ||
vyabhicārād iti | parapuruṣopabhogena strī iha loke garhaṇīyatāṃ labhate, mṛtā ca śṛgālī bhavati, kuṣṭhādirogaiś ca pīḍyate || 5.164 ||
patiṃ yā nābhicarati manovāgdehasaṃyatā |
sā bhartṛlokam āpnoti sadbhiḥ sādhvīti cocyate || 5.165 ||
patim iti | manovāgdehasaṃyateti viśeṣaṇopādānād yā manovāgdehair eva bhartāraṃ na vyabhicarati sā bhartṛmātraniṣṭhamanogāgdehavyāpāratvād bhartrā sahārjitāṃl lokān prāpnoti | iha ca śiṣṭaiḥ sādhvīty ucyate | vāṅmanasābhyām api patiṃ na vyabicared iti vidhānārtho daihikavyabhicāranivṛtter uktāyā apy anuvādaḥ || 5.165 ||
anena nārī vṛttena manovāgdehasaṃyatā |
ihāgryāṃ kīrtim āpnoti patilokaṃ paratra ca || 5.166 ||
aneneti | anena śtrīdharmaprakāreṇoktenācāreṇa patiśuśrūṣābhartravyabhicārādinā manovākkāyasaṃyatā strī iha loke ca prakṛṣṭāṃ kīrtiṃ paratra patyā sahārjitaṃ ca svargādilokaṃ prāpnotīti prakaraṇārthopasaṃhāraḥ || 5.166 ||
evaṃvṛttāṃ savarṇāṃ strīṃ dvijātiḥ pūrvamāriṇīm |
dāhayed agnihotreṇa yajñapātraiś ca dharmavit || 5.167 ||
evaṃvṛttam iti | dvijātiḥ samānavarṇāṃ yathoktācārayuktāṃ pūrvamṛtāṃ śrautasmārtāgnibhir yajñapātraiś ca dāhadharmajño dāhayet || 5.167 ||
bhāryāyai pūramāriṇyai datvāgnīn antyakarmaṇi |
punar dārakriyāṃ kuryāt punar ādhānam eva ca || 5.168 ||
bhāryeti | pūrvamṛtāyā antyakarmaṇi dāhanimittam agnīn samarpya gṛhasthśramam icchann utpannaputro vā punar vivāhaṃ kuryāt | smārtāgnīn śrautāgnīn vā ādadhyāt || 5.168 ||
anena vidhinā nityaṃ pañcayajñān na hāpayet |
dvitīyam āyuṣo bhāgaṃ kṛtadāro gṛhe vaset || 5.169 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcamo ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
aneneti | anena tṛtīyādhyāyādyuktavidhinā pratyahaṃ pañcayajñān na tyajet | dvitīyam āyurbhāgaṃ kṛtadāraparigraho ‘nenaiva yathoktavidhinā gṛhasthavihitān dharmān anutiṣṭhet | gṛhasthadharmatve ‘pi pañcayajñānāṃ prakṛṣṭadharmajñāpanārthaṃ pṛthak nirdeśaḥ || 5.169 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau
pañcamo ‘dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
ṣaṣṭho ‘dhyāyaḥ |
evaṃ gṛhāśrame sthitvā vidhivat snātako dvijaḥ |
vane vaset tu niyato yathāvad vijitendriyaḥ || 6.1 ||
evam iti | āśramasamuccayapakṣāśrito dvijātiḥ kṛtasamāvartana uktaprakāreṇa yathāśāstraṃ gṛhāśramam anuṣṭhāya niyataḥ kṛtaniścayo yathāvidhānaṃ vakṣyamāṇadharmeṇa yathārhaṃ viśeṣeṇa jitendriyaḥ | paripakvakaṣāya ity arthaḥ | vānaprathāśramam anutiṣṭhet || 6.1 ||
gṛhasthas tu yadā paśyed valīpalitam ātmanaḥ |
apatyasyaiva cāpatyaṃ tadāraṇyaṃ samāśrayet || 6.2 ||
gṛhasthas tv iti | gṛhastho yadātmadehasya tvakśaithilyaṃ keśadhāvalyaṃ putrasya putraṃ ca paśyati tathāvidhavayovasthayā vigataviṣayarāgatayā vanam āśrayet || 6.2 ||
saṃtyajya grāmyam āhāraṃ sarvaṃ caiva paricchadam |
putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya vanaṃ gacchet sahaiva vā || 6.3 ||
saṃtyajyetyādi | grāmyaṃ vrīhiyavādikaṃ bhakṣyaṃ sarvaṃ ca gavāśvaśayyādiparicchadaṃ parityajya vidyamānabhāryaś ca vanavāsam anicchantīṃ bhāryāṃ putreṣu samarpya icchantyā ca sahaiva vanaṃ gacchet || 6.3 ||
agnihotraṃ samādāya gṛhyaṃ cāgniparicchadam |
grāmād araṇyaṃ niḥsṛtya nivasen niyatendriyaḥ || 6.4 ||
agnihotram iti | śrautāgnim āvasathyāgim agnyupakaraṇaṃ ca sruksruvādi gṛhītvā grāmād araṇyaṃ niḥsṛtya gatvā saṃyatendriyaḥ san nivaset || 6.4 ||
munyannair vividhair medhyaiḥ śākamūlaphalena vā |
etān eva mahāyajñān nirvaped vidhipūrvakam || 6.5 ||
munyannair iti | munyannair nīvārādibhir nānāprakāraiḥ pavitraiḥ śākamūlaphalair vāraṇyodbhavaiḥ | etān eveti gṛhasthasya pūrvoktān mahāyajñān yathāśāsram anutiṣṭhet || 6.5 ||
vasīta carma cīraṃ vā sāyaṃ snāyāt prage tathā |
jaṭāś ca bibhṛyān nityaṃ śmaśrulomanakhāni ca || 6.6 ||
vasīteti | mṛgādicarma vṛkṣavalkalaṃ vā ācchādayet | hārītena tu “valkalaśāṇacarmacīrakuśa-muñjaphalakavāsāḥ” iti vidadhatā valkalādikam apy anujñātam | sāyaṃprātaḥ snāyāt | jaṭāśmaśrulomanakhāni nityaṃ dhārayet || 6.6 ||
yad bhakṣyaṃ syāt tato dadyād baliṃ bhikṣāṃ ca śaktitaḥ |
ammūlaphalabhikṣābhir arcayed āśramāgatān || 6.7 ||
yad bhakṣyam iti | yad bhuñjīta tato yathāśakti baliṃ bhikṣāṃ ca dadyāt | balim iti tu vaiśvadevanityaśrāddhayor upalakṣaṇam | “etān eke mahāyajñān” (4.22) iti vihitatvāt āśramāgatāñ jalaphalamūlabhikṣādānena pūjayet || 6.7 ||
svādhyāye nityayuktaḥ syād dānto maitraḥ samāhitaḥ |
dātā nityam anādātā sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ || 6.8 ||
svādhyāye iti | vedābhyāse nityayuktaḥ syāt | śītātapādidvandvasahiṣṇuḥ sarvopakārakaḥ saṃyatamanāḥ satataṃ dātā pratigrahanivṛttaḥ sarvabhūteṣu kṛpāvān bhavet || 6.8 ||
vaitānikaṃ ca juhuyād agnihotraṃ yathāvidhi |
darśam askandayan parva paurṇamāsaṃ ca yogataḥ || 6.9 ||
vaitānikam iti | gārhapatyakuṇḍasthānām agnīnām āhavanīyadakṣiṇāgnikuṇḍayor vihāro vitānaṃ tatra bhavaṃ vaitānikam agnihotraṃ yathāśāstram anutiṣṭhet | darśapaurṇamāsaṃ ca parveti śrautasmārtadarśapaurṇamāsau yogataḥ svakāle askandayann aprityajan, bharyānikṣepapakṣe ca rajasvalāyām iva bhāryāyām eteṣām anuṣṭhānam ucitam, viśeṣāśravaṇāt
|| 6.9 ||
ṛkṣeṣṭyāgrayaṇaṃ caiva cāturmāsyāni cāharet |
turāyaṇaṃ ca kramaśo dākṣasyāyanam eva ca || 6.10 ||
ṛkṣeti | ṛkṣeṣṭir nakṣatreṣṭiḥ, āgrayaṇaṃ navasasyeṣṭiḥ, ṛkṣeṣṭyāgrayaṇaṃ ceti samāhāradvandvaḥ | tathā cāturmāsyaturāyaṇadākṣāyaṇāni śrautakarmāṇi krameṇa kuryāt | atra kecit – sarvam etac chrautaṃ darśapaurṇamāsādi karma vānaprasthasya stutyartham ucyate, na tv asyānuṣṭheyaṃ grāmyavrīhyādisādhyatvād eṣāṃ ca | na ca smṛtiḥ śrautāṅgbādhane śaktety āhuḥ | tad asat | “vāsantaśāradaiḥ” (6.11) ity uttaraśloke munyannair nīvārādibhir vānaprasthaviṣayatayā spaṣṭasya carupuroḍāśādividher bādhanasyānyāyyatvāt | govindarājas tu vrīhyādibhir eva kathaṃcid araṇyajātair etān nirvartayiṣyata ity āha || 6.10 ||
vāsantaśāradair medhyair munyannaiḥ svayam āhṛtaiḥ |
puroḍāśāṃś carūṃś caiva vidhivan nirvapet pṛthak || 6.11 ||
vāsantetyādi | vasantodbhavaiḥ śaradudbhavair medhyair yāgāṅgabhūtair munyannair nīvārādibhiḥ svayam ānītaiḥ puroḍāśāṃś carūn yathāśāstraṃ tattadyāgādisiddhaye saṃpādayet
|| 6.11 ||
devatābhyas tu tad dhutvā vanyaṃ medhyataraṃ haviḥ |
śeṣam ātmani yuñjīta lavaṇaṃ ca svayaṃ kṛtam || 6.12 ||
devatābhya ityādi | tad vanodbhavanīvārādikasādhitam atiśayena yāgārhaṃ havir devatābhya upakalpya śeṣānnam upabhuñjīta | ātmanā ca kṛtaṃ lavaṇaṃ ūṣaralavaṇādyupabhuñjīta || 6.12 ||
sthalajaudakaśākāni puṣpamūlaphalāni ca |
medhyavṛkṣodbhavāny adyāt snehāṃś ca phalasaṃbhavān || 6.13 ||
sthalajeti | sthalajalodbhavaśākāny araṇyayajñiyavṛkṣodbhavāni puṣpamūlaphalānīṅgudyādi-phalodbhavāṃś ca snehān adyāt || 6.13 ||
varjayen madhu māṃsaṃ ca bhaumāni kavakāni ca |
bhūstṛṇaṃ śigrukaṃ caiva śleṣmātakaphalāni ca || 6.14 ||
varjayed ityādi | mākṣikaṃ, māṃsaṃ, bhaumānīti prasiddhidarśanārtham, bhaumādīni, kavakāni chatrākān, bhūstṛṇaṃ mālavadeśe prasiddhaṃ śākaṃ, śigrukaṃ vāhīkeṣu prasiddhaṃ śākaṃ, śleṣmātakaphalāni varjayet | govindarājas tu bhaumāni kavakānīty anyavyavacchedakaṃ viśeṣaṇam icchan bhaumānāṃ kavakānāṃ niṣedhaḥ, vārkṣāṇāṃ tu bhakṣaṇam āha | tad ayuktam, manunaiva pañcame dvijāter eva kavakamātraniṣedhād vanasthagocaratayā niyamātiśayasyocitatvāt | yamas tu,
bhūmijaṃ vṛkṣajaṃ vāpi chatrākaṃ bhakṣayanti ye |
brahmaghnāṃs tān vijānīyād brahmavādiṣu garhitān ||
iti viśeṣeṇa vṛkṣajasyāpi niṣedham āha | medhātithis tu bhaumānīti svatantraṃ padaṃ vadan gojihvikā nāma kaścit padārtho vanecarāṇāṃ prasiddhas tadviṣayaṃ niṣedham āha | tad api bahuṣv abhidhānakoṣādiṣv aprasiddhaṃ na śraddadhīmahi | kavakānāṃ dvijātiviśeṣe niṣedhe saty api punar niṣedho bhūstṛṇādīnāṃ niṣedhe ‘pi ca samaprāyaścittavidhānārthaḥ || 6.14 ||
tyajed āśvayuje māsi munyannaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam |
jīrṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi śākamūlaphalāni ca || 6.15 ||
tyajed iti | saṃvatsaranicayapakṣe pūrvasaṃcitanīvārādyannaṃ jīrṇāni ca vāsāṃsi śākamūlaphalāni cāśvine māsi tyajet || 6.15 ||
na phālakṛṣṭam aśnīyād utsṛṣṭam api kenacit |
na grāmajātāny ārto ‘pi mūlāni ca phalāni ca || 6.16 ||
na phāleti | araṇye ‘pi phālakṛṣṭapradeśe jātaṃ svāminopekṣitam api vrīhyādi nādyāt | tathā grāmajātāny aphālakṛṣṭabhūbhāge ‘pi latāvṛkṣamūlaphalāni kṣutpīḍito ‘pi na bhakṣayet || 6.16 ||
agnipakvāśano vā syāt kālapakvabhug eva vā |
aśmakuṭṭo bhaved vāpi dantolūkhaliko ‘pi vā || 6.17 ||
asnīti | agnipakvaṃ vanyam annam, kālapakvaṃ vā phalādi | yad vā nolūkhalamusalābhyāṃ kiṃ tu pāṣāṇena cūrṇīkṛtvāpakvam evādyāt | dantā evolūkhalasthānāni yasya tathāvidho vā bhavet
|| 6.17 ||
sadyaḥprakṣālako vā syān māsasaṃcayiko ‘pi vā |
ṣaṇmāsanicayo vā syāt samānicaya eva vā || 6.18 ||
sadya ityādi | ekāhamātrajīvanocitaṃ māsavṛttyupacitaṃ vā ṣaṇmāsasaṃvatsaranirvāhasamarthaṃ vā nīvārādikaṃ saṃcinuyāt | yathāpūrvaṃ niyamātiśayaḥ | māsavṛttiyogyasaṃcayo māsasaṃcayaḥ, so ‘syāstīti “ata iniṭhanau” (Pāṇ 5.2.115) iti ṭhanpratyayena ‘māsasaṃcayika’ iti rūpam || 6.18 ||
naktaṃ cānnaṃ samaśnīyād diva vāhṛtya śaktitaḥ |
caturthakāliko vā syāt syād vāpy aṣṭamakālikaḥ || 6.19 ||
naktam ityādi | yathāsāmarthyam annam āhṛtya pradoṣe bhuñjīta | ahany eva vā caturthakālāśano vā syāt | “sāyaṃ prātar manuṣyāṇām aśanaṃ devanirmitam” (MBh 12.186.10) iti vihitaṃ tatraikasminn ahany upoṣyāparedyuḥ sāyaṃ bhuñjīta | aṣṭamakāliko vā bhavet | trirātram upoṣya caturthasyāhno rātrau bhuñjīta || 6.19 ||
cāndrāyaṇavidhānair vā śuklakṛṣṇe ca vartayet |
pakṣāntayor vāpy aśnīyād yavāgūṃ kvathitāṃ sakṛt || 6.20 ||
cāndrāyaṇeti | śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ “ekaikaṃ hrāsayet piṇḍaṃ śukle kṛṣṇe ca vardhayet” (11.216) ityādinaikādaśādhyāye ca vakṣyamāṇaiś cāndrāyaṇair vā vartayet | pakṣāntau paurṇamāsyamāvāsye tatra śṛtāṃ yavāgūṃ vāpy aśnīyāt | sakṛd it sāyaṃ prātar vā || 6.20 ||
puṣpamūlaphalair vāpi kevalair vartayet sadā |
kālapakvaiḥ svayaṃśīrṇair vaikhānasamate sthitaḥ || 6.21 ||
puṣpamūletyādi | puṣpamūlaphalair vā kālapakvaiḥ nāgnipakvaiḥ svayaṃpatitair jīvet | vaikhānaso vānaprasthaḥ taddharmapratipādakaśāstradarśane sthitaḥ | tenaitad uktam anyad api vaikhānasaśāstroktaṃ dharmam anutiṣṭhet || 6.21 ||
bhūmau viparivarteta tiṣṭhed vā prapadair dinam |
sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharet savaneṣūpayann apaḥ || 6.22 ||
bhūmāv ityādi | kevalāyāṃ bhūmau luṭhan gatāgatāni kuryāt | sthānāsanādāv upaviśet | uttiṣṭhet paryaṭed ity arthaḥ | āvaśyakaṃ snānabhojanādikālaṃ vihāya cāyaṃ niyamaḥ | evam uttaratrāpi | pādāgrābhyāṃ vā dinaṃ tiṣṭhet kaṃcitkālaṃ sthita eva syāt | kaṃcic copaviṣṭa eva na tv antarā paryaṭet | savaneṣu sāyaṃprātarmadhyāhneṣu snāyāt | yat tu “sāyaṃ snāyāt prage tathā” (6.6) ity uktaṃ tena sahāsya niyamātiśayāpekṣo vikalpaḥ || 6.22 ||
grīṣme pañcatapās tu syād varṣāsv abhrāvakāśikaḥ |
ārdravāsās tu hemante kramaśo vardhayaṃs tapaḥ || 6.23 ||
grīṣma ityādi | ātmatapovivṛddhyarthaṃ grīṣme caturdigavasthitair agnibhir ūrdhvaṃ vādityatejasātmānaṃ tāpayet | varṣāsv abhrāvakāśam āśrayet | yatra deśe devo varṣati tatra chatrādyāvaraṇarahitas tiṣṭhed ity arthaḥ | hemante cārdravāsā bhavet | ṛtutrayasaṃvatsarāvalambenāyaṃ sāṃvatsarika eva niyamaḥ || 6.23 ||
upaspṛśaṃs triṣavaṇaṃ pitṝn devāṃś ca tarpayet |
tapaś caraṃś cogrataraṃ śoṣayed deham ātmanaḥ || 6.24 ||
upeti | vihitam api triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ devarṣipitṛtarpaṇavidhānārtham anūdyate | prātar madhyaṃdinaṃ sāyaṃ savaneṣu triṣv api devarṣipitṛtarpaṇaṃ kurvan | anyad api pakṣamāsopavāsādikaṃ tīvravrataṃ tapo ‘nutiṣṭhan | yathoktaṃ yamena:
pakṣopavāsinaḥ kecit kecin māsopavāsinaḥ | iti |
svaśarīraṃ śoṣayet || 6.24 ||
agnīn ātmani vaitānān samāropya yathāvidhi |
anagnir aniketaḥ syān munir mūlaphalāśanaḥ || 6.25 ||
agnīn ityādi | śrautān agnīn vaikhānasaśāstravidhānena bhasmapānādinā ātmani samāropya laukikāgnigṛhaśūnyaḥ | yathā vakṣyati “vṛkṣamūlaniketanaḥ” (6.26) iti | munir maunavratacārī phalamūlāśana eva syāt | nīvārādy api nāśnīyāt | etac cordhvaṃ ṣaṇmāsebhyo ‘py upari “anagnir aniketanaḥ” iti vasiṣṭhavacanāt (9.11) ṣaṇmāsopary anagnitam aniketatvaṃ ca || 6.25 ||
aprayatnaḥ sukhārtheṣu brahmacārī dharāśayaḥ |
śaraṇeṣv amamaś caiva vṛkṣamūlaniketanaḥ || 6.26 ||
aprayatna iti | sukhaprayojaneṣu svāduphalabhakṣaṇaśītātapaparihārādiṣu prayatnaśūnyo ‘strīsaṃbhogī bhūśāyī ca nivāsasthāneṣu mamatvarahito vṛkṣamūlavāsī syāt || 6.26 ||
tāpaseṣv eva vipreṣu yātrikaṃ bhaikṣam āharet |
gṛhamedhiṣu cānyeṣu dvijeṣu vanavāsiṣu || 6.27 ||
tāpaseṣv iti | phalamūlāsaṃbhave ca vānaprasthebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prāṇamātradhāraṇocitaṃ bhaikṣam āharet | tadabhāve cānyebhyo vanavāsibhyo gṛhasthebhyo dvijebhyaḥ || 6.27 ||
grāmād āhṛtya vāśnīyād aṣṭau grāsān vane vasan |
pratigṛhya puṭenaiva pāṇinā śakalena vā || 6.28 ||
grāmeti | tasyāpy asaṃbhave grāmād ānīya grāmasyānnasyāṣṭau grāsān parṇaśarāvādikhaṇḍena pāṇinaiva vā gṛhītvā vānaprastho bhuñjīta || 6.28 ||
etāś cānyāṃś ca seveta dīkṣā vipro vane vasan |
vividhāś caupaniṣadīr ātmasaṃsiddhaye śrutīḥ || 6.29 ||
etāś ceti | vanaprastha etā dīkṣā etān niyamān anyāṃś ca vānaprasthaśāstroktān abhyaset | aupaniṣadīś ca śrutīr upaniṣatpaṭhitabrahmapratipādakavākyāni vividhāny asyātmano brahmasiddhaye granthato ‘rthataś cābhyaset || 6.29 ||
ṛṣibhir brāhmaṇaiś caiva gṛhasthair eva sevitāḥ |
vidyātapovivṛddhyarthaṃ śarīrasya ca śuddhaye || 6.30 ||
ṛṣibhir iti | yasmād etā ṛṣibhir brahmadarśibhiḥ parivrājakair gṛhasthaiś ca vānaprasthair brahmādvaitajñānadharmayor vivṛddhyartham upaniṣacchrutayaḥ sevitās tasmād etāḥ seveteti pūrvasyānuvādaḥ || 6.30
aparājitāṃ vāsthāya vrajed diśam ajihmagaḥ |
ā nipātāc charīrasya yukto vāryanilāśanaḥ || 6.31 ||
apareti | acikitsitavyādhyādyudbhave ‘parājitām aiśānīṃ diśam āśrityākuṭilagatir yukto yoganiṣtho jalānilāśana ā śarīranipātād gacchet | mahāprasthānākhyaṃ śāstre vihitaṃ cedaṃ maraṇaṃ, tena “na purāyuṣaḥ svaḥkāmī preyāt” iti śrutyāpi na virodhaḥ |
āsāṃ maharṣicaryāṇāṃ tyaktvānyatamayā tanum |
vītaśokabhayo vipro brahmaloke mahīyate || 6.32 ||
āsām ityādi | eṣāṃ pūrvoktānuṣthānānām anyatamenānuṣthānena śarīraṃ tyaktvāpagataduḥkhabayo brahmaiva lokas tatra pūjāṃ labhate | mokṣam āpnotīty arthaḥ | kevalakarmaṇo vānaprasthasya kathaṃ mokṣa iti cen na, “vividhāś caupaniṣadhīr ātmasaṃśuddhaye śrutīḥ” (6.29) ity anenāsyāpy ātmajñānasaṃbhavāt || 6.32 ||
yasya tu maraṇābhāvas tasyāha –
vaneṣu ca vihṛtyaivaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhāgam āyuṣaḥ |
caturtham āyuṣo bhāgaṃ tyaktvā saṅgān parivrajet || 6.33 ||
vaneṣv ityādi | aniyataparimāṇatvād āyuṣas tṛtīyabhāgasya durvijñānāt tṛtīyam āyuṣo bhāgam iti rāgakṣayāvadhi vānaprasthakālopalakṣaṇārtham | ata eva śaṅkha-likhitau “vanavāsād ūrdhvaṃ śāntasya parigatavayaḥ pārivrājyam” ity ācakhyatuḥ | evaṃ vaneṣu vihṛtyaivaṃ vidhivad duścaratapo’nuṣṭhānaprakāreṇa vānaprasthāśramaṃ viṣayarāgopaśamanāya kaṃcit kalam anuṣṭhāya “caturtham āyuṣo bhāgam” iti śeṣāyuḥkāle sarvathā viṣayasaṅgāṃs tyaktvā parivrājakāśramam anutiṣthet || 6.33 ||
āśramād āśramaṃ gatvā hutahomo jitendriyaḥ |
bhikṣābalipariśrāntaḥ pravrajan pretya vardhate || 6.34 ||
āśramād iti | pūrvapūrvāśramād uttarottarāśramaṃ gatvā brahmacaryād gṛhasthāśramaṃ tato vānaprasthāśramam anuṣṭhāyety arthaḥ | yathāśakti gatāśramahutahomo jitendriyo bhikṣābalidānacirasevayā śrāntaḥ parivrajyāśramam anutiṣthan paraloke mokṣalābhād brahmabhūtarddhyatiśayaṃ prāpnoti || 6.34 ||
ṛṇāni trīṇy apākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet |
anapākṛtya mokṣaṃ tu sevamāno vrajaty adhaḥ || 6.35 ||
ṛṇānītyādi | āśramasamuccayapakṣam āśrito brāhmaṇa uttaraślokābhidheyāni trīṇy ṛṇāni saṃśodhya mokṣe mokṣāntaraṅge parivrājyāśrame mano niyojayet | tāny ṛṇāni tv asaṃśodhya mokṣaṃ caturthāśramam anutiṣthan narakaṃ vrajati || 6.35 ||
tāny evarṇāni darśayati –
adhītya vidhivad vedān putrāṃś cotpādya dharmataḥ |
iṣṭvā ca śaktito yajñair mano mokṣe niveśayet || 6.36 ||
adhītyeti | “jāyamāno vai brāhmaṇas tribhir ṛṇavā jāyate yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ svādhyāyena ṛṣibhyaḥ” iti śrūyate | ato yathāśākhaṃ vedān adhītya parvagamanavarjanādidharmeṇa ca putrān utpādya yathāsāmarthyaṃ jyotiṣṭomādiyajñāṃś cānuṣṭhāya mokṣāntarṅge caturthāśrame mano niyojayet || 6.36 ||
anadhītya dvijo vedān anutpādya tathā sutān |
aniṣtvā caiva yajñaiś ca mokṣam icchan vrajaty adhaḥ || 6.37 ||
anadhītyeti | vedādhyayanam akṛtvā putram anutpādya yajñāṃś cānanuṣṭhāya mokṣam icchan narakaṃ vrajati || 6.37 ||
prājāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭiṃ sarvavedasadakṣiṇām |
ātmany agnīn samāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajed gṛhāt || 6.38 ||
