prājāpatyām iti | yajurvedīyopākhyānagranthoktāṃ sarvasvadakṣiṇāṃ prajāpatidevatākām iṣṭiṃ kṛtvā taduktavidhinaiva “ātmany agnīn samāropya gṛhāt” ity abhidhānād vānaprathāśramam anuṣṭhāyaiva caturthāśramam anutiṣthet | etena manunā cāturāśramyasya samuccayo ‘pi darśitaḥ | śrutisiddhāś caikadvitricaturāśramāṇāṃ samuccayā vikalpitāḥ | tathā jābālaśrutiḥ (4): “brahmacaryaṃ samāpya gṛhī bhaved gṛhī bhūtvā vanī bhaved vanī bhūtvā pravrajet | itarathā brahmacaryād eva pravrajed gṛhād vā vanād vā” iti || 6.38 ||
yo datvā sarvabhūtebhyaḥ pravrajaty abhayaṃ gṛhāt |
tasya tejomayā lokā bhavanti brahmavādinaḥ || 6.39 ||
ya ityādi | yaḥ sarvebhyo bhūtārabdhebhyaḥ sthāvarajaṅgamebhyo ‘bhayaṃ datvā gṛhāśramāt pravrajati tasya brahmapratipādakopaniṣaṇniṣṭhasya sūryādyālokarahitā hiraṇyagarbhāder lokās tattejasaiva prakāśā bhavanti | tān āpnotīty arthaḥ || 6.39 ||
yasmād aṇv api bhūtānāṃ dvijān notpadyate bhayam |
tasya dehād vimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kutaścana || 6.40 ||
yasmād ityādi | yasmād dvijāt sūkṣmam api bhayaṃ bhūtānāṃ na bhavati tasya dehād vimuktasya vartamānadehanāśe kasmād api bhayaṃ na bhavati || 6.40 ||
agārād abhiniṣkrāntaḥ pavitropacito muniḥ |
samupoḍheṣu kāmeṣu nirapekṣaḥ parivrajet || 6.41 ||
agārād iti | gṛhān nirgataḥ pavitrair daṇḍakamaṇḍalvādibhir yukto munir maunī samupoḍheṣu kāmeṣu kenacit samyak samīpaṃ prāpiteṣu svādvannādiṣu vigataspṛhaḥ parivrajet | medhātithis tu “pavitrair mantrajapair atha vā pāvanaiḥ kṛcchrair yuktaḥ” iti vyācaṣṭe || 6.41 ||
eka eva caren nityaṃ siddhyartham asahāyavān |
siddhim ekasya saṃpaśyan na jahāti na hīyate || 6.42 ||
eka ityādi | ekasya sarvasaṅgavirahiṇo mokṣāvāptir bhavatīti jānann eka eva sarvadāpi mokṣārthaṃ caret | ‘eka eva’ ity anena pūrvaparicitaputrādityāga ucyate | asahāyavān ity uttarasyāpi ekākī yadi carat sa kiṃcin na tyajati, na kasyāpi tyāgena duḥkham anubhavati, nāpi kenāpi tyajyate, na ko ‘py anena tyāgaduḥkham anubhāvyate | tataś ca sarvatra nirmamatvaḥ sukhena muktim āpnoti || 6.42 ||
anagnir aniketaḥ syād grāmam annārtham āśrayet |
upekṣako ‘saṃkusuko munir bhāvasamāhitaḥ || 6.43 ||
anagnir ityādi | anagnir laukikāgnisaṃyogarahitaḥ “śāstrīyāgniṃ samāropya” ity purvam uktatvāt | aniketo gṛhaśūnyaḥ, upekṣakaḥ śarīrasya vyādhyādyutpāde tatpratīkārarahitaḥ, asaṃkusukaḥ sthiramatiḥ, ‘asāṃcayika’ ity anye paṭhanti | munir brahma mananāt, maunasya pūrvoktatvāt | bhāvena brahmaṇi samāhitas tad ekatānamanāḥ araṇye ca divārātrau vasan bhikṣārtham eva grāmaṃ praviśet || 6.43 ||
kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni kucelam asahāyatā |
samatā caiva sarvasminn etan muktasya lakṣaṇam || 6.44 ||
kapālam ityādi | mṛnmayakarparādibhikṣāpātraṃ, vāsārthaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni, sthūlajīrṇavastraṃ, kaupīnakanthā, sarvatra brahmabuddhyā śatrumitrābhāvaḥ, etan muktisādhanatvān muktasya liṅgam || 6.44 ||
nābhinandeta maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvitam |
kalam eva pratīkṣeta nirdeśaṃ bṛtako yathā || 6.45 ||
netyādi | maraṇaṃ jīvanaṃ ca dvayam api na kāmayet kiṃ tu svakarmādhīnaṃ maraṇakālam eva pratīkṣeta | nirdiśyata iti nirdeśo bhṛtis tatpariśodhanakālam iva bhṛtakaḥ || 6.45 ||
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyaset pādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet |
satyapūtāṃ vaded vācaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret || 6.46 ||
dṛṣṭipūtam ityādi | keśāsthyādiparihārārthaṃ dṛṣṭiśodhitabhūmau pādau kṣipet | jaleṣu kṣudrjantvādivāraṇārthaṃ vastraśodhitaṃ jalaṃ pibet | satyapavitrāṃ vācaṃ vadet | tataś ca maunena saha satyasya vikalpaḥ | pratiṣiddhasaṃkalpaśūnyamanāḥ sarvadā pavitrātmā syāt
|| 6.46 ||
ativādāṃs titikṣeta nāvamanyet kaṃcana |
na cemaṃ deham āśritya vairaṃ kurvīta kenacit || 4.47 ||
ativādān ityādi | atikramavādān paroktān saheta | na kaṃcit paribhavet | nemaṃ deham asthiraṃ vyādhyāyatanam āśritya tadarthaṃ kenacit saha vairaṃ kuryāt || 4.47 ||
krudhyantaṃ na pratikrudhyed ākruṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ vadet |
saptadvārāvakīrṇāṃ ca na vācam anṛtāṃ vadet || 4.48 ||
krudhyantam ityādi | saṃjātakrodhāya kasmaicit pratikrodhaṃ na kuryāt | ninditaś cānyena vācaṃ bhadrāṃ vadet na tu nindet | saptadvārāvakīrṇām iti | cakṣurādīni pañca bahir buddhīndriyāṇi mano buddhir ity antaḥkaraṇadvayaṃ vedāntadarśana etair gṛhīteṣu sveṣu vācā pravṛtter etāni sapta dvārāṇīty ucyante, etair avakīrṇāṃ nikṣiptāṃ tadgṛhītārthaviṣayāṃ vācaṃ na vadet kiṃ tu brahmamātraviṣayāṃ vadet |
nanu manasaiva brahmopāsyate, brahmaviṣayavāguccāraṇam api manovyāpāras tat kathaṃ saptadvārāvakīrṇatvaviśeṣe ‘pi brahmaviṣayāṃ vaded ity anyaviṣayāṃ na vaded iti labhyate |
ucyate | ata evānṛtām iti viśeṣayati sma, anṛtam asatyaṃ vināśīti yāvat, tadviṣayā vāg apy anṛtocyate, tena vināśikāryaviṣayāṃ vācaṃ noccārayet | avināśibrahmaviṣayāṃ tu praṇavopaniṣadādirūpāṃ vadet | govindarājas tu dharmo ‘rthaḥ kāmo dharmārthāv arthakāmau dharmārthakāmā ity etāni sapta vāgviṣayatayā vākpravṛtter dvārāṇi, teṣv avakīrṇāṃ vikṣiptāṃ sarvasya bhedasyāsattvāt tadviṣayām asatyarūpāṃ vācaṃ na vadet |
anye tu sapta bhuvanāny eva vāgviṣayatvāt sapta dvārāṇi teṣāṃ bhedād vināśitvāc cāsatyatayā tadviṣayāṃ vācam asatyāṃ na vadet kevalaṃ brahmaviṣayāṃ vadet || 6.48 ||
adhyātmaratir āsīno nirapekṣo nirāmiṣaḥ |
ātmanaiva sahāyena sukhārthī vicared iha || 6.49 ||
adhyātmeti | ātmānaṃ brahmādhikṛtya ratir yasya so ‘dhyātmaratiḥ sarvadā brahmadhyānaparaḥ, āsīna iti svastikādiyogāsananiṣṭhaḥ, nirapekṣo daṇḍakamaṇḍalvādiṣv api viśeṣāpekṣāśūnyaḥ, nirāmiṣaḥ āmiṣaṃ viṣayās tadabhilāṣarahitaḥ, ātmanā dehenaiva sahāyena mokṣasukhārthīha saṃsāre vicaret || 6.49 ||
na cotpātanimittābhyāṃ na nakṣatrāṅgavidyayā |
nānuśāsanavādābhyāṃ bhikṣāṃ lipseta karhicit || 6.50 ||
netyādi | bhūkampādyutpātacakṣuḥspandādinimittaphalakathanena, “adyāśvinī, hastarekhāder īdṛśaṃ phalam” iti nakṣatrāṅgavidyayā, “īdṛśo nītimārgaḥ, itthaṃ vartitavyam” ity anuśāsanena śāstrārthakathanena ca kadācin na bhikṣāṃ labdhum icchet || 6.50 ||
na tāpasair brāhmaṇair vā vayobhir api vā śvabhiḥ |
ākīrṇaṃ bhikṣukair vānyair agāram upasaṃvrajet || 6.51 ||
na tāpasir ityādi | vānaprasthair anyair vā brāhmaṇair bhakṣaṇaśīlaiḥ, pakṣibhiḥ, kukkurair vā vyāptaṃ gṛhaṃ bhikṣārthaṃ na praviśet || 6.51 ||
kḷptakeśanakhaśmaśruḥ pātrī daṇḍī kusumbhavān |
vicaren niyato nityaṃ sarvabhūtāny apīḍayan || 6.52 ||
kḷptetyādi | kḷptakeśanakhaśmaśruḥ bhikṣāpātravān daṇḍī kusumbhaḥ kamaṇḍalus tadyuktaḥ sarvaprāṇino ‘pīḍayan sarvadā paribhramet || 6.52 ||
ataijasāni pātrāṇi tasya syur nirvraṇāni ca |
teṣām adbhiḥ smṛtaṃ śaucaṃ camasānām ivādhvare || 6.53 ||
ataijasānīti | sauvarṇādivarjitāni niśchidrāṇi bhikṣor bhikṣāpātrāṇi bhaveyuḥ | tathā yamaḥ |
suvarṇarūpyapātreṣu tāmrakāṃsyāyaseṣu ca |
gṛhṇan bhikṣāṃ na dharmo ‘sti gṛhītvā narakaṃ vrajet ||
teṣāṃ ca yatipātrāṇāṃ jalenaiva tu śuddhiḥ yajñe camasānām iva || 6.53 ||
tāny eva darśayati –
alābuṃ dārupātraṃ ca mṛnmayaṃ vaidalaṃ tathā |
etāni yatipātrāṇi manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo ‘bravīt || 6.54 ||
alābum ityādi | alābudārumṛttikāvaṃśādikhaṇḍanirmitāni yatīnāṃ bhikṣāpātrāṇi svāyaṃbhuvo manur avadat | vaidalaṃ tarutvaṅnirmitam iti govindarājaḥ || 6.54 ||
ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣaṃ na prasajjeta vistare |
bhaikṣaprasakto hi yatir viṣayeṣv api sajjati || 6.55 ||
ekakālam iti | ekavāraṃ prāṇadhāraṇārthaṃ bhaikṣaṃ caret | tatrāpi pracurabhikṣāprasaṅgaṃ na kuryāt | yato bahutarabhikṣābhakṣaṇaprasakto yatiḥ pradhānadhātuvṛddhyā stryādiviṣayeṣv api prasajjate || 6.55 ||
vidhūme sannamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane |
vṛtte śarāvasaṃpāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiś caret || 6.56 ||
vidhūma ityādi | vigatapākadhūme, nivṛttāvahananamusale, nirvāṇapākāṅgāre, gṛhasthaparyantabhuktavajjane, ucchiṣṭaśarāveṣu tyakteṣu, sarvadā yatir bhikṣāṃ caret | etac ca dinaśeṣamuhūrtatrayarūpasāyāhnopalakṣaṇam | tathāha yājñavalkyaḥ (3.59):
apramattaś cared bhaikṣaṃ sāyāhne nābhisaṃdhitaḥ |
|| 6.56 ||
alābhe na viṣādī syāl lābhe caiva na harṣayet |
prāṇayātrikamātraḥ syān mātrāsaṅgād vinirgataḥ || 6.57 ||
alābha ityādi | bhikṣāder alābhe na viṣīdet | lābhe ca harṣaṃ na kuryāt | prāṇasthitimātropacitānnabhojanaparaḥ syāt | daṇḍakamaṇḍalumātrāsv api ‘idam aśobhanaṃ tyajāmi, idaṃ ruciraṃ gṛhṇāmi’ ityādiprasaṅgaṃ na kuryāt || 6.57 ||
abhipūjitalābhāṃs tu jugupsetaiva sarvaśaḥ |
abhipūjitalābhaiś ca yatir mukto ‘pi badhyate || 6.58 ||
abhītyādi | pūjāpūrvakabhikṣālābhaṃ sarvakālaṃ nindet | na svīkuryād ity arthaḥ | yasmāt pūjāpūrvakalābhasvīkāre dātṛgocarasnehamamatvādibhir āsannamuktir api yatir janmabandhāṃl labhate || 6.58 ||
alpānnābhyavahāreṇa rahaḥsthānāsanena ca |
hriyamāṇāni viṣayair indriyāṇi nivartayet || 6.59 ||
alpetyādi | āhāralāghavena nirjanadeśasthānādinā ca rūpādiviṣayair ākṛṣyamānānīndriyāṇi nivartayet || 6.59 ||
indriyāṇāṃ nirodhena rāgadveṣakṣayeṇa ca |
ahiṃsayā ca bhūtānām amṛtatvāya kalpate || 6.60 ||
indriyāṇām ityādi | yasmāt indriyāṇāṃ nigraheṇa rāgadveṣābhāvena ca prāṇihiṃsāviratena ca mokṣayogyo bhavati || 6.60 ||
idānīm indriyaniyamopāyaviṣayavairāgyāya saṃsāratattvacintanam upadiśati –
avekṣeta gatīr nṝṇāṃ karmadoṣasamudbhavāḥ |
niraye caiva patanaṃ yātanāś ca yamakṣaye || 6.61 ||
avekṣetetyādi | vihitākaraṇaninditācaraṇarūpakarmadoṣajanyāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ paśvādidehaprāptiṃ narakeṣu patanaṃ yamaloke narakasthasya niśitanistriṃśacchedanādibhāvās tīvravedanāḥ śrutipurāṇādiṣūktāś cintayet || 6.61 ||
viprayogaṃ priyaiś caiva saṃyogaṃ ca tathāpriyaiḥ |
jarayā cābhibhavanaṃ vyādhibhiś copapīḍanam || 6.62 ||
viprayogam ityādi | iṣṭaputrādiviyogaṃ, aniṣṭahiṃsakādiyogaṃ, jarābhibhavanaṃ, vyādhyādibhiś ca pīḍanaṃ karmadoṣasamudbhavam anucintayet || 6.62 ||
dehād utkramaṇaṃ cāsmāt punar garbhe ca saṃbhavam |
yonikoṭisahasreṣu sṛtīś cāsyāntarātmanaḥ || 6.63 ||
dehād ityādi | yasmād dehād asya jīvātmana utkramaṇaṃ tathā ca marmabhidbhir mahārogapatitasya śleṣmādidoṣaniruddhakaṇṭhasya mahatīṃ vedanāṃ garbhe cotpattiduḥkhabahulāṃ śvaśṛgālādinikṛṣṭajātiyonikoṭisahasragamanāni svakarmabandhāny anucintayet || 6.63 ||
adharmaprabhavaṃ caiva duḥkhayogaṃ śarīriṇām |
dharmārthaprabhavaṃ caiva sukhasaṃyogam akṣayam || 6.64 ||
adharmetyādi | śarīravatāṃ jīvātmanām adharmahetukaṃ duḥkhasaṃbandhaṃ dharmahetujo ‘rtho brahmasākṣātkāras tatprabhavaṃ mokṣalakṣaṇam akṣayaṃ brahmasukhasaṃyogaṃ cintayet || 6.64 ||
sūkṣmatāṃ cānvekṣeta yogena paramātmanaḥ |
deheṣu ca samutpattim uttameṣv adhameṣu ca || 6.65 ||
sūkṣmatām ityādi | yogena viṣayāntaracittavṛttinirodhena paramātmanaḥ sthūlaśarīrādyapekṣayā sarvāntaryāmitvena sūkṣmatāṃ niravayavatāṃ tattyāgād utkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭeṣu devapaśvādiśarīreṣu jīvānāṃ śubhāśubhaphalabhogārtham utpattim adhiṣṭhānam anucintayet || 6.65 ||
dūṣito ‘pi cared dharmaṃ yatra tatrāśrame rataḥ |
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu na liṅgaṃ dharmakāraṇam || 6.66 ||
dūṣita iti | yasmin kasmiṃścid āśrame sthitas tadāśramiviruddhācāradūṣito ‘py āśramaliṅgarahito ‘pi sarvabhūteṣu brahmabuddhyā samadṛṣṭiḥ san dharmam anutiṣṭhet | na hi daṇḍādiliṅgadhāraṇamātraṃ dharmakāraṇaṃ kiṃ tu vihitānuṣṭhānaṃ, etac ca dharmaprādhānyabodhanāyoktaṃ na tu liṅgaparityāgārtham || 6.66 ||
atra dṛṣṭāntam āha –
phalaṃ katakvṛkṣasya yady apy ambuprasādakam |
na nāmagrahaṇād eva tasya vāri prasīdati || 6.67 ||
phalam iti | yady api katakvṛkṣasya phalaṃ kaluṣajalasvacchatājanakaṃ tathāpi tannāmoccāraṇavaśān na prasīdati kiṃ tu phalaprakṣepeṇa, evaṃ na liṅgadhāraṇamātraṃ dharmakāraṇaṃ kiṃ tu vihitānuṣṭhānam || 6.67 ||
saṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ jantūnāṃ rātrāv ahani vā sadā |
śarīrasyātyaye caiva samīkṣya vasudhāṃ caret || 6.68 ||
saṃrakṣaṇārtham ityādi | śarīrasyāpi pīḍāyāṃ sūkṣmapipīlikādiprāṇarakṣārthaṃ rātrau divase vā sadā bhūmiṃ nirīkṣya paryaṭet | pūrvaṃ keśādiparihārārthaṃ “dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyaset pādam” (6.46) ity uktaṃ, idaṃ tu hiṃsāparihārārtham ity apunaruktiḥ || 6.68 ||
atra prāyaścittam āha –
ahnā rātryā ca yāñ jantūn hinasty ajñānato yatiḥ |
teṣāṃ snātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmān ṣaḍ ācaret || 6.69 ||
ahnā rātryeti | yatir yān ajñānato divase rātrau vā prāṇino hanti taddhananajanitapāpanāśārthaṃ snātvā ṣaṭ prāṇāyāmān kuryāt | prāṇāyāmaś ca –
savyāhṛtiṃ sapraṇavāṃ gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha |
triḥ paṭhed āyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate || (VaDh 25.13)
iti vasiṣṭhoktyātra draṣṭavyaḥ || 6.69 ||
prāṇāyāmā brāhmaṇasya trayo ‘pi vidhivat kṛtāḥ |
vyāhṛtipraṇavair yuktā vijñeyaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 6.70 ||
prāṇāyāmā iti | brāhmaṇasyeti nirdeśād brāhmaṇajāter ayam upadeśo na yater eva | trayo ‘pi prāṇāyāmāḥ saptabhir vyāhṛtibhir daśabhiḥ praṇavair yuktāḥ, vidhivad ity anena sāvitryā śirasā ca yuktāḥ, pūrakakumbhakarecakavidhinā kṛtā brāhmaṇasya śreṣṭhaṃ tapo jñātavyam | pūrakādisvarūpaṃ smṛtyantareṣu jñeyam | tathā yogiyājñavalkyaḥ |
nāsikotkṛṣṭa ucchvāso dhmātaḥ pūraka ucyate |
kumbhako niścalaḥ śvāso mucyamānas tu recakaḥ ||
trayo ‘pīti apiśabdena trayo ‘vaśyaṃ kartavyāḥ, adhikakaraṇe tv adhikapāpakṣayaḥ || 6.70 ||
dahyante dhmāyamānānāṃ dhātūnāṃ hi yathā malāḥ |
tathendriyāṇāṃ dahyante doṣāḥ prāṇasya nigrahāt || 6.71 ||
dahyanta iti | dhātūnāṃ svarṇarajatādīnāṃ yathā mūṣāyām agninā dhmāyamānānāṃ maladravyāṇi dahyante, evaṃ manaso rāgādayaś cakṣurādeś ca viṣayapravaṇatvādayo doṣāḥ prāṇāyāmena viṣayānabhidhyānād dahyante || 6.71 ||
prāṇāyāmair dahed doṣān dhāraṇābhiś ca kilbiṣam |
pratyāhāreṇa saṃsargān dhyānenānīśvarān guṇān || 6.72 ||
prāṇāyāmair ityādi | evaṃ sati anantaroktaprakāreṇa prāṇāyāmai rāgādidoṣān dahet | apekṣitadeśe parabrahmādau yan manaso dhāraṇaṃ sā dhāraṇā, tayā pāpaṃ nāśayet | pratyāhāreṇa viṣayebhya indriyākarṣaṇair viṣayasaṃparkān vārayet | brahmadhyāneneti | so ‘ham asmīti sajātīyapratyayapravāharūpeṇānīśvarān guṇān īśvarasya paramātmano ye guṇā na bhavanti krodhalobhāsūyādayaḥ tān nivārayet || 6.72 ||
uccāvaceṣu bhūteṣu durjñeyām akṛtātmabhiḥ |
dhyānayogena saṃpaśyed gatim asyāntarātmanaḥ || 6.73 ||
uccāvaceṣv ityādi | asya jīvasyotkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭeṣu devapaśvādiṣu janmaprāptim akṛtātmabhiḥ śāstrair asaṃskṛtāntaḥkaraṇair durjñeyāṃ dhyānābhyāsena samyak sakāraṇakaṃ jānīyāt | tataś cāvidyākāmyniṣiddhakarmanirmiteyaṃ gatir iti jñātvā brahmajñānaniṣtho bhaved iti tātparyārthaḥ || 6.73 ||
samyagdarśanasaṃpannaḥ karmabhir na nibadhyate |
darśanena vihīnas tu saṃsāraṃ pratipadyate || 6.74 ||
samyagdarśaneti | tataś ca tattvato brahmasākṣātkāravān karmabhir na nibadhyate karmāṇi tasya punarjanmane na prabhavanti, pūrvārjitapāpapuṇyasya brahmajñānena nāśāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Ch. Up. 5.24.3): “tad yatheṣīkātūlam agnau protaṃ pradūyetaivaṃ hāsya sarve pāpmānaḥ pradūyanta ubhau brahmaivaiṣa bhavati” iti śrutyā, tathā “kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāvare” (Muṇ. Up. 2.2.8) ity aviśeṣaśrutyā puṇyasaṃbandho ‘pi bodhyate, uttarakāle ca daivāt pāpe karmaṇi prakṛte ‘pi na pāpasaṃśleṣaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ “yathā puṣkarapalāśa āpo na śliṣyanta evam evaṃvidi pāpaṃ karma na śliṣyate” iti | dehārambhakapāpapuṇyasaṃbandhaḥ paraṃ naśyati | ayam eva cārtho brahmamīmāṃsāyāṃ (Br. Sū. 4.1.13): “tadadhigama uttarapūrvāghayor aśleṣavināśau tadvyapadeśāt” iti sūtreṇa bādarāyaṇena niraṇāyi | brahmasākṣātkāraśūnyas tu janmamaraṇaprabandhaṃ labhate || 6.74 ||
ahiṃsayendriyāsaṅgair vaidikaiś caiva karmabhiḥ |
tapasaś caraṇaiś cograiḥ sādhayantīha tatpadam || 6.75 ||
ahiṃsayeti | niṣiddhahiṃsāvarjanenendriyāṇāṃ ca viṣayasaṅgaparihāreṇa vaidikair nityaiḥ karmabhiḥ, kāmyakarmaṇāṃ bandhahetutvāt | uktaṃ ca (2.2) “kāmātmatā na praśastā” iti | tapasaś ca yathāsaṃbhavam upavāsakṛcchracāndrāyaṇāder anuṣṭhānair iha loke tatpadaṃ brahmātyantikalayalakṣaṇaṃ prāpnuvanti | pūrvaślokena brahmadarśanasya mokṣahetutvam uktam, anena tatsahakāritayā karmaṇo ‘bhihitam || 6.75 ||
idānīṃ mokṣāntaraṅgopāyasaṃsāravairāgyāya dehasvarūpam āha ślokadvayena –
asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanam |
carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhi pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ || 6.76 ||
jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanam āturam |
rajasvalam anityaṃ ca bhūtāvāsam imaṃ tyajet || 6.77 ||
asthītyādi | jaretyādi | asthīny eva sthūṇā iva yasya taṃ asthisthūṇaṃ, snāyurajjubhir ābaddhaṃ, māṃsarudhirādyupaliptaṃ, carmācchāditaṃ, mūtrapurīṣābhyāṃ pūrṇam ata eva durgandhi | jaropatāpābhyām ākrāntaṃ, vividhavyādhīnām āśrayaṃ, āturaṃ kṣutpipāsāśītoṣṇādikātaraṃ, prāyeṇa rajoguṇayuktaṃ, vinaśvarasvabhāvaṃ ca, āvāso gṛhaṃ pṛthivyādibhūtāni teṣām āvāsaṃ, deham eva jīvasya gṛhatvena nirūpitaṃ tyajet | yathā punar dehasaṃbandho na bhavet tathā kuryāt | gṛhasāmyam evoktam asthītyādinā || 6.76–77 ||
nadīkūlaṃ yathā vṛkṣo vṛkṣaṃ vā śakunir yathā |
tathā tyajann imaṃ dehaṃ kṛcchrād grāhād vimucyate || 6.78 ||
nadīkūlam iti | brahmopāsakasya dehatyāgasamaye mokṣaḥ, ārabdhadehasya karmaṇo bhogenaiva nāśat | tatra dehatyaktur dvaividhyam āha – yaḥ karmādhīnaṃ dehapātam avekṣate sa nadīkūlaṃ yathā vṛkṣas tyajati svapātam ajānann eva nadīrayeṇa pātyate, tathā dehaṃ tyajan yaś ca jñānakarmaprakarṣād bhīṣmādivat svādhīnamṛtyuḥ sa yathā pakṣī vṛkṣaṃ svecchayā tyajati tathā deham imaṃ tyajan saṃsārakaṣṭād grāhād iva jalacaraprāṇibhedād vimucyate || 6.78 ||
priyeṣu sveṣu sukṛtam apriyeṣu ca duṣkṛtam |
visṛjya dhyānayogena brahmābhyeti sanātanam || 6.79 ||
priyeṣv ityādi | brahmavid ātmīyeṣu priyeṣu hitakāriṣu sukṛtaṃ apriyeṣv ahitakāriṣu duṣkṛtaṃ nikṣipya dhyānayogena nityaṃ brahmābhyeti brahmaṇi līyate | tathā ca śrutiḥ: “tasya putrā dāyam upayanti suhṛdaḥ sādhukṛtyāṃ dviṣantaḥ pāpakṛtyām” ityevamādīny eva vākyāny udāhṛtya sukṛtaduṣkṛtayor hānimātraśravaṇe ‘py upāyanaṃ pratipattavyam iti brahmamīmāṃsāyāṃ “hānau tūpāyanaśabdaśeṣatvāt kuśācchandastutyupagāyanavat tad uktam” (Br. Sū. 3.3.26) ityādisūtrair bādarāyaṇena niraṇāyi |
nanu parakīyasukṛtaduṣkṛtayoḥ kathaṃ paratra saṃkrāntiḥ |
ucyate – dharmādharmavyavasthāyāṃ śāstram eva pramāṇaṃ, saṃkrāmo ‘pi tayoḥ śāstrapramāṇaka eva | ataḥ śāstrāt saṃkramaṇayogyāv etau siddhyataḥ | ataḥ śāstreṇa bādhān na pratipakṣānumānodayaḥ, śuci naraśiraḥkapālaṃ prāṇyaṅgatvāc chaṅkhādivad iti vat |
medhātithi-govindarājau tu sveṣu priyeṣu kenacit kṛteṣu dhyānābhyāsenātmīyam eva sukṛtaṃ tatra kāraṇatvenāropya, evam apriyeṣv api kenacit kṛteṣv ātmīyam eva prāgjanmārjitaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kāraṇatvena prakalpyoddhṛtya tatsaṃpādayitārau puruṣau rāgadveṣākhyau tyaktvā nityaṃ brahmābhyeti brahmasvabhāvam upagacchatīti vyācakṣāte |
tan na | visṛjeti kriyāyāṃ sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtam iti karmadvayatyāgena tatsaṃpādayitārāv ity aśrutakarmādhyāhārāt, karmadvaye ca śrutakriyātyāgena kāraṇatvena prakalpyetyādyaśrutākriyādhyāhārāt | kiṃ ca,
vyāsavyākhyātavedārtham evam asyā manusmṛteḥ |
manye na kalpitaṃ garvād arvācīnair vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
|| 6.79 ||
yadā bhāvena bhavati sarvabhāveṣu niḥspṛhaḥ |
tadā sukham avāpnoti pretya ceha ca śāśvatam || 6.80 ||
yadeti | yadā paramārthato viṣayadoṣabhāvanayā sarvaviṣayeṣu nirabhilāṣo bhavati tadeha loke saṃtoṣajanyasukhaṃ paraloke ca mokṣasukham avināśi prāpnoti || 6.80 ||
anena vidhinā sarvāṃs tyaktvā saṅgāñ chanaiḥ śanaiḥ |
sarvadvandvavinirmukto brahmaṇy evāvatiṣthate || 6.81 ||
aneneti | putrakalatrakṣetrādiṣu mamatvarūpān krameṇa saṅgān sarvāṃs tyaktvā dvandvair mānāpamānādibhir nirmukto ‘nena yathoktena jñānakarmānuṣṭhānena brahmaṇy evātyantikaṃ layam āpnoti || 6.81 ||
dhyānikaṃ sarvam evaitad yad etad abhiśabditam |
na hy anadhyātmavit kaścit kriyāphalam upāśnute || 6.82 ||
dhyānikam iti | yad etad ity atyantasaṃnidhānāt pūrvaślokoditaṃ parāmṛśyate | yad etad uktaṃ putrādimamatvatyāgo mānāpamānādihānir brahmaṇy evāvasthānaṃ sarvam evaitaddhyānikam ātmanaḥ paramātmatvena dhyāne sati bhavati | yadātmānaṃ paramātmeti jānāti tadā sarvasattvān na viśiṣyate tasya na kutracin mamatvaṃ mānāpamānādikaṃ vā bhavati, tathāvidhajñānād brahmātmatvaṃ ca jāyate | dhyānikaviśeṣād dhyeyaviśeṣalābhe paramātmadhyānārtham āha – na hy anadhyātmavid iti | yasmād ātmānaṃ jīvam adhikṛtya yad uktaṃ tasya paramātmatvaṃ tad yo na jānāti na dhyāyati sa prakṛtadhyānakriyāphalaṃ mamatvatyāgamānāpamānādihāniṃ mokṣaṃ ca na prāpnoti || 6.82 ||
adhiyajñaṃ brahma japed ādhidaivikam eva ca |
ādhyātmikaṃ ca satataṃ vedāntābhihitaṃ ca yat || 6.83 ||
adhiyajñam iti | pūrvaṃ brahmadhyānasvarūpam upāsanam uktam, idānīṃ tadaṅgatayā vedajapaṃ vidhatte | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Bṛ. Ār. Up. 4.4.22) “tam etaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti” iti vidyāṅgatayā vedajapam upadiśati — adhiyajñam iti | yajñam adhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ brahma vedaṃ tathā devatām adhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ tathā jīvam adhikṛtya, tathā vedānteṣūktam (Tait. Up. 2.1.1): “satyaṃ jñānam anantaṃ brahma” ityādibrahmapratipādakaṃ sarvadā japet || 6.83 ||
idaṃ śaraṇam ajñānām idam eva vijānatām |
idam anvicchatāṃ svargam idaṃ ānantyam icchatām || 6.84 ||
idam iti | idaṃ vedākhyaṃ brahma tadarthānabhijñānām api śaraṇaṃ gatiḥ, pāṭhamātreṇāpi pāpakṣayahetutvāt | sutarāṃ tajjānatāṃ tadarthābhijñānāṃ svargam apavargaṃ cecchatām idam eva śaraṇaṃ, tadupāyopadeśakatvena tatprāptihetutvāt || 6.84 ||
anena kramayogena parivrajati yo dvijaḥ |
sa vidhūyeha pāpmānaṃ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 6.85 ||
aneneti | anena yathākramoktānuṣṭhānena yaḥ pravrajyāśramam āśrayati sa iha loke pāpaṃ visṛjya paraṃ brahma prāpnoti brahmasākṣātkāreṇopādhiśarīranāśād brahmaṇy aikyaṃ gacchati || 6.85 ||
eṣa dharmo ‘nuśiṣṭo vo yatīnāṃ niyatātmanām |
vedasaṃnyāsikānāṃ tu karmayogaṃ nibodhata || 6.86 ||
eṣa dharma iti | eṣa yatīnāṃ yatātmanāṃ caturṇām eva kuṭīcarabahūdakahaṃsa-paramahaṃsānāṃ sādhāraṇo dharmo vo yuṣmākam uktaḥ | idānīṃ yativiśeṣāṇāṃ kuṭīcarākhyānāṃ vedavihitādikarmayoginām asādhāraṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ “putraiśvarye sukhaṃ vaset” (6.95) iti karmasaṃbandhaṃ śṛṇuta | bhārate caturdhā bhikṣava uktāḥ |
caturdhā bhikṣavas tu syuḥ kuṭīcarabahūdakau |
haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsaś ca yo yaḥ paścāt sa uttamaḥ || iti |
kuṭīcarasyāyaṃ putrabhikṣācaraṇarūpāsādhāraṇakarmopadeśaḥ |
govindarājas tu gṛhasthaviśeṣam eva vedoditāgnihotrādikarmatyāginaṃ jñānamātrasaṃpāditavaidikakarmāṇaṃ vedasaṃnyāsikam āha |
tan na | yato gṛhasthasyāhitāgner antyeṣṭau viniyogaḥ caturthāśramāśrayaṇe cātmani samāropaḥ śāstreṇocyate, tadubhayābhāve saty evam evāgnīnāṃ tyāgaḥ syāt | govindarājo gṛhasthaṃ vedasaṃnyāsikaṃ bruvan,
evam evāhitāgnīnāṃ tyāgam arthād upetavān |
vedasaṃnyāsikaṃ medhātithiḥ prāha nirāśrayam |
tanmate cāturāśramyaniyamoktiḥ kathaṃ manoḥ ||
|| 6.86 ||
idānīṃ vedasaṃnyāsikasya pratijñāte karmayoge ‘nantaraṃ vaktum ucitam api vedasaṃnyāsikaḥ pañcamāśramī nirāśramī vā catvāra evāśramā niyatā iti darśayitum uktānāśramān anuvadati –
brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca vānaprastho yatis tathā |
ete gṛhasthaprabhavāś catvāraḥ pṛthag āśramāḥ || 6.87 ||
brahmacārīti | brahmacaryādayo ya ete pṛthag āśramā uktā ete catvāra eva gṛhasthajanyā bhavanti || 6.87 ||
sarve ‘pi kramaśas tv ete yathāśāstraṃ niṣevitāḥ |
yathoktakāriṇaṃ vipraṃ nayanti paramāṃ gatim || 6.88 ||
sarve ‘pītyādi | ete sarve catvāro ‘py āśramāḥ śāstrānatikrameṇānuṣṭhitāḥ | apiśabdāt trayo dvāv eko ‘pi yathoktānuṣṭhātāraṃ vipraṃ mokṣalakṣaṇāṃ gatiṃ prāpayanti || 6.88 ||
prakṛtavedasaṃnyāsikasya gṛhe putraiśvarye sukhe vāsaṃ vakṣyati, tadarthaṃ gṛhasthotkarṣam āha –
sarveṣām api caiteṣāṃ vedasmṛtividhānataḥ |
gṛhastha ucyate śreṣṭhaḥ sa trīn etān bibharti hi || 6.89 ||
sarveṣām iti | sarveṣām eteṣāṃ brahmacāryādīnāṃ madhye gṛhasthasya śrūyamāṇatvena prāyaśo ‘gnihotrādividhānād gṛhastho manvādibhiḥ śreṣṭha ucyate | tathā yasmād brahmacārivānaprasthayatīn asau bhikṣādānena poṣayati tenāpy asau śreṣṭhaḥ | yathoktam (3.78) “yasmāt trayo ‘py āśramiṇo jñānenānnena cānvaham” iti || 6.89 ||
yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃsthitim |
tathaivāśramiṇaḥ sarve gṛhasthe yānti saṃsthitim || 6.90 ||
yathetyādi | yathā sarve nadīnadā gaṅgāśoṇādyāḥ samudre ‘vasthitiṃ labhante evaṃ gṛhasthād apare sarvāśramiṇas tadadhīnajīvanatvād gṛhasthasamīpe ‘vasthitaṃ labhante || 6.90 ||
caturbhir api caivaitair nityam āśramibhir dvijaiḥ |
daślakṣaṇako dharmaḥ sevitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 6.91 ||
caturbhir ityādi | etair brahmacāryādibhir āśramibhiś caturbhir api dvijātibhir vakṣyamāṇo daśavidhasvarūpo dharmaḥ prayatnataḥ satatam anuṣṭheyaḥ || 6.91 ||
tam eva svarūpataḥ saṃkhyādibhiś ca darśayati –
dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo ‘steyaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
dhīr vidyā satyam akrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam || 6.92 ||
dhṛtir ityādi | saṃtoṣo dhṛtiḥ, pareṇāpakāre kṛte tasya pratyapakārānācaraṇaṃ kṣamā, vikārahetuviṣayasaṃnidhāne ‘py avikrīyatvaṃ manaso damaḥ, “manaso damanaṃ damaḥ” ity sanandanavacanāt | śītātapādidvandvasahiṣṇutā dama iti govindarājaḥ | anyāyena paradhanādigrahaṇaṃ steyaṃ tadbhinnam asteyam, yathāśāstraṃ mṛjjalābhyāṃ dehaśodhanaṃ śaucaṃ, viṣayebhyaś cakṣurādivāraṇam indriyanigrahaḥ, śāstrāditattvajñānaṃ dhīḥ, ātmajñānaṃ vidyā, yathārthābhidhānaṃ satyaṃ, krodhahetau saty api krodhānutpattir akrodhaḥ, etad daśavidhaṃ dharmasvarūpam || 6.92 ||
daśa lakṣaṇāni dharmasya ye viprāḥ samadhīyate |
adhītya cānuvartante te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 6.93 ||
daśa lakṣaṇānīti | ye viprā etāni daśavidhadarmasvarūpāṇi paṭhanti paṭhitvā cātmajñānasācivyenānutiṣthanti te brahmajñānasamutkarṣāt paramāṃ gatiṃ mokṣalakṣaṇāṃ prāpnuvanti || 6.93 ||
daśalakṣaṇakaṃ dharmam anutiṣthan samāhitaḥ |
vedāntaṃ vidhivac chrutvā saṃnyased anṛṇo dvijaḥ || 6.94 ||
daśalakṣaṇakam iti | uktaṃ daśalakṣaṇakaṃ dharmaṃ saṃyatamanāḥ sann anutiṣthan upaniṣadādyarthaṃ gṛhasthāvasthāyāṃ yathoktādhyayanadharmān gurumukhād avagamya pariśodhitadevādyṛṇatrayaḥ saṃnyāsam anutiṣṭhet || 6.94 ||
saṃnyasya sarvakarmāṇi karmadoṣān apānudan |
niyato vedam abhyasya putraiśvarye sukhaṃ vaset || 6.95 ||
saṃnyasyeti | sarvāṇi gṛhasthānuṣṭheyāgnihotrādikarmāṇi parityajya ajñātajantuvadhādikarma-janitapāpāni ca prāṇāyāmādinā nāśayan niyatendriya upaniṣado granthato ‘rthataś cābhyasya putraiśvarya iti putragṛhe putropakalpitabhojanācchādanatvena vṛtticintārahitaḥ sukhaṃ vaset | ayam evāsādhāraṇo dharmaḥ kuṭīcarasyoktaḥ | idam eva vaktuṃ “vedasaṃnyāsikānāṃ tu” (6.86) ity pūrvam uktam || 6.95 ||
evaṃ saṃnyasya karmāṇi svakāryaparamo ‘spṛhaḥ |
saṃnyāsenāpahatyainaḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 6.96 ||
evam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇa vartamāno ‘gnihotrādigṛhasthakarmāṇi parityjyātmasākṣātkāra-svarūpasvakāryapradhānaḥ svargādāv api bandhahetutayā niḥspṛhaḥ pravrajyayā pāpāni vināśya brahmasākṣātkāreṇa paramāṃ gatiṃ mokṣalakṣaṇāṃ prāpnoti || 6.96 ||
eṣa vo ‘bhihito dharmo brāhmaṇasya caturvidhaḥ |
puṇyo ‘kṣayaphalaḥ pretya rājñāṃ dharmaṃ nibodhata || 6.97 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ
ṣaṣṭho ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
eṣa iti | ṛṣīn saṃbodhyocyate | eṣa yuṣmākaṃ brāhmaṇasya saṃbandhī kriyākalāpo dharmas tasyaiva brahmacārigṛhasthavānaprasthādibhedena caturvidhaḥ paratrākṣaphala uktaḥ | idānīṃ rājasaṃbandhinaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇuta | atra ca śloke brāhmaṇasya cāturāśramyopadeśād brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajed iti pūrvam abhidhānād brāhmaṇasyaiva pravrajyādhikāraḥ || 6.97 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau
ṣaṣṭho ‘dhyāyaḥ |
saptamo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
rājadharmān pravakṣyāmi yathāvṛtto bhaven nṛpaḥ |
saṃbhavaś ca yathā tasya siddhis ca paramā yathā || 7.1 ||
rājadharmān iti | dharmaśabdo ‘tra dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthānuṣṭheyaparaḥ, ṣāḍguṇyāder api vakṣyamāṇatvāt | rājaśabdo ‘pi nātra kṣatriyajātivacanaḥ, kiṃ tv abhiṣiktajanapadapurapālayitṛ-puruṣavacanaḥ | ata evāha ‘yathāvṛtto bhaven nṛpaḥ’ iti | yathāvadācāro nṛpatir bhavet tathā tasyānuṣṭheyāni kathayiṣyāmi | yathā yena prakāreṇa vā “rājānam asṛjat prabhuḥ” (7.3) ityādinā tasyotpattiḥ, yathā ca dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalasaṃpattiḥ tad api vakṣyāmi || 7.1 ||
brāhmaṃ prāptena saṃskāraṃ kṣatriyeṇa yathāvidhi |
sarvasyāsya yathānyāyaṃ kartavyaṃ parirakṣaṇam || 7.2 ||
brāhmam ityādi | brahma vedas tatprāptyarthatayopanayanasaṃskāras taṃ yathāśāstraṃ prāpnuvatā kṣatriyenāsya sarvasya svaviṣayāvasthitasya śāstrānusāreṇa niyamato rakṣaṇaṃ kartavyam | etena kṣatriya eva nānyo rājyādhikārīti darśitam | ata eva śāstrārthatattvaṃ kṣatriyasya jīvanārthaṃ, tathā kṣatriyasya tu rakṣaṇaṃ svakarmasu śreṣṭhaṃ ca vakṣyati, brāhmaṇasya hy āpadi “jīvet kṣatriyadharmeṇa” (10.81) ity abhidhāsyati, vaiśyasyāpi kṣatriyadharmaṃ, śūdrasya ca kṣatriyavaiśyakarmaṇī jīvanārtham āpadi jagāda nāradaḥ |
na kathacana kurvīta brāhmaṇaḥ karma vārṣalam |
vṛṣalaḥ karma ca brāḥmaṃ patanīye hi te tayoḥ ||
utkṛṣṭaṃ cāpakṛṣṭaṃ ca tayoḥ karma na vidyate |
madhyame karmaṇī hitvā sarvasādhāraṇe hi te ||
rakṣaṇaṃ vedadharmārthaṃ tapaḥ kṣatrasya rakṣaṇam |
iti, “sarvato dharmaṣaḍbhāgo rājño bhavati rakṣataḥ” (8.304) iti ca vakṣyamāṇatvād rakṣītur baliṣaḍbhāgagrahaṇād dṛṣṭārtham api “yo ‘rakṣan balim ādatte” (8.307) it narakapātaṃ vakṣyati
|| 7.2 ||
arājake hi loke ‘smin sarvato vidrute bhayāt |
rakṣārtham asya sarvasya rājānam asṛjat prabhuḥ || 7.3 ||
arājaka iti | yasmād arājake jagati balavadbhayāt sarvataḥ pracalite sarvasyāsya carācarasya rakṣāyai rājānaṃ sṛṣṭavāṃs tasmāt tena rakṣaṇaṃ kāryam || 7.3 ||
kathaṃ sṛṣṭavān ity āha –
indrānilayamārkāṇām agneś ca varuṇasya ca |
candravitteśayoś caiva mātrā nirhṛtya śāśvatīḥ || 7.4 ||
indreti | indravātayamasūryāgnivaruṇacandrakuberāṇāṃ mātrā aṃśān sārabhūtān ākṛṣya rājānam asṛjat || 7.4 ||
yasmād eṣāṃ surendrāṇāṃ mātrābhyo nirmito nṛpaḥ |
tasmād abhibhavaty eṣa sarvabhūtāni tejasā || 7.5 ||
yasmād iti | yasmād indrādīnāṃ devaśreṣṭhānām aṃśebhyo nṛpatiḥ sṛṣṭas tasmād eṣa sarvaprāṇino vīryeṇātiśete || 7.5 ||
tapaty ādityavac caiṣa cakṣūṃṣi ca manāṃsi ca |
na cainaṃ bhuvi śaknoti kaścid apy abhivīkṣitum || 7.6 ||
tapatītyādi | ayaṃ ca rājā svatejasā sūrya iva paśyatāṃ cakṣūṃṣi manāṃsi ca saṃtāpayati, na cainaṃ rājānaṃ pṛthivyāṃ kaścid apy ābhimukhyena draṣṭuṃ kṣamate || 7.6 ||
so ‘gnir bhavati vāyuś ca so ‘rkaḥ somaḥ sa dharmarāṭ |
sa kuberaḥ sa varuṇaḥ sa mahendraḥ prabhāvataḥ || 7.7 ||
sa ityādi | evaṃ cāgnyādīnāṃ pūrvoktāṃśabhavatvāt tatkarmakāritvāc ca pratāpa uktaḥ, “tejasvī” (9.310) ityādinā navamādhyāye vakṣyamāṇatvāt | sa rājā śaktyatiśayenāgnyādirūp bhavati || 7.7 ||
bālo ‘pi nāvamantavyo manuṣya iti bhūmipaḥ |
mahatī devata hy eṣā nararūpeṇa tiṣṭhati || 7.8 ||
bāla ityādi | tataś ca manuṣya iti buddhyā bālo ‘pi rājā nāvamantavyaḥ | yasmān mahatīyaṃ kācid devata mānuṣarūpeṇāvatiṣṭhate | etena devatāvajñāyām adharmādayo ‘dṛṣṭadoṣā uktāḥ
|| 7.8 ||
saṃprati dṛṣṭadoṣam āha –
ekam eva dahaty agnir naraṃ durupasarpiṇam |
kulaṃ dahati rājāgniḥ sapaśudravyasaṃcayam || 7.9 ||
ekam ityādi | yo ‘gner atisamīpam anavahitaḥ sann upasarpati taṃ durupasarpiṇam ekam evāgnir dahati, na tatputrādikam | kruddho rājāgniḥ putradārabhrātrādirūpaṃ kulam eva gavāśvādipaśusuvarṇādidhanasaṃcayasahitaṃ sāparādhaṃ nihanti || 7.9 ||
kāryaṃ so ‘vekṣya śaktiṃ ca deśakālau ca tattvataḥ |
kurute dharmasiddhyarthaṃ viśvarūpaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 7.10 ||
kāryam ityādi | sa rājā prayojanāpekṣayā svaśaktiṃ deśakālau cāvekṣya kāryasiddhyarthaṃ tattvato viśvarūpaṃ bahūni rūpāṇi karoti | jātivivakṣayā bahuṣv ekavacanam | aśaktidaśāyāṃ kṣamate, śaktiṃ prāpyonmūlayati, evam ekasminn api deśe kale ca prayojanānurodhena śatrur vā mitraṃ vā udāsīno vā bhavati, ato ‘rājavallabho ‘ham’ iti buddhyā nāvajñeyaḥ || 7.10 ||
yasya prasāde padmā śrīr vijayaś ca parākrame |
mṛtyuś ca vasati krodhe sarvatejomayo hi saḥ || 7.11 ||
yasyetyādi | padmāśabdaḥ śrīparyāyo ‘pi mahattvavivakṣayātra prayuktaḥ | yasya prasādān mahatī śrīr bhavaty ataḥ śrīkāmena sevyaḥ | yasya śatravaḥ santi tān api saṃtoṣito hanti | tena ca śatruvadhakāmenāpy ārādhanīyaḥ | yasmai krudhyati tasya mṛtyuṃ karoti, tasmāj jīvanārthinā na krodhanīyaḥ | yasmāt sarveṣāṃ sūryāgnisomādīnāṃ tejo bibharti || 7.11 ||
taṃ yas tu dveṣṭi saṃmohāt sa vinaśyaty asaṃśayam |
tasya hy āśu vināśāya rājā prakurute manaḥ || 7.12 ||
tam ityādi | taṃ rājānam ajñatayā yo dveṣṭi tasyāprītim utpādayati sa niścitaṃ rājakrodhān naśyati | yasmāt tasya vināśāya śīghraṃ rājā mano niyuṅkte || 7.12 ||
tasmād dharmaṃ yam iṣṭeṣu sa vyavasyen narādhipaḥ |
aniṣṭaṃ cāpy aniṣṭeṣu taṃ dharmaṃ na vicālayet || 7.13 ||
tasmād ityādi | yataḥ sarvatejomayo nṛpatis tasmād apekṣiteṣu yam iṣṭaṃ śāstrānuṣtheyaṃ śāstrāviruddhaṃ niścitya vyavasthāpayati, anapekṣiteṣu cāniṣṭaṃ niyamaṃ nātikrāmet || 7.13 ||
tasyārthe sarvabhūtānāṃ goptāraṃ dharmam ātmajam |
brahmatejomayaṃ daṇḍam asṛjat pūrvam īśvaraḥ || 7.14 ||
tasyārtha iti | tasya rājñaḥ prayojanasiddhaye sarvaprāṇināṃ rakṣitāraṃ dharmasvarūpaṃ putraṃ brahmaṇo yat kevalaṃ tejas tena nirmitaṃ na pāñcabhautikaṃ dehaṃ brahma pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭavān || 7.14 ||
tasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca |
bhayād bhogāya kalpante svadharmān na calanti ca || 7.15 ||
tasyetyādi | tasya daṇḍasya bhayena carācarāḥ sarve prāṇino bhogaṃ kartuṃ samarthā bhavanti, anyathā balavatā durbalasya dhanadārādigrahaṇe tasyāpi tad apekṣya balineti kasyāpi bhogo na siddhyet, vṛkṣādīnāṃ sthāvarādīnāṃ chedane bhogāsiddhiḥ, tathā satām api nityanaimittkasvadharmānuṣṭhānam akaraṇe yāmyayātanābhayād eva || 7.15 ||
taṃ deśakālau śaktiṃ ca vidyāṃ cāvekṣya tattvataḥ |
yathārhataḥ saṃpraṇayen nareṣv anyāyavartiṣu || 7.16 ||
tam ityādi | taṃ daṇḍaṃ deśakālau daṇḍyasya ca śaktiṃ vidyādikaṃ yasminn aparādhe yo daṇḍo ‘rhatītyādikaṃ śāstrānusāreṇa tattvato nirūpyāparādhiṣu pravartayet || 7.16 ||
sa rājā puruṣo daṇḍo sa netā śāsitā ca saḥ |
caturṇām āśramāṇāṃ ca dharmasya pratibhūḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.17 ||
sa ityādi | sa eva daṇḍo vastuto rājā tasmin sati rājaśaktiyogāt, sa eva puruṣas tato ‘nye striya iva tadvidheyatvāt, sa eva netā tena kāryāṇi nīyante prāpyante, sa eva śāsitā śāsanam ājñā taddātṛtvāt, sa eva caturṇām apy āśramāṇāṃ yo dharmas tasya saṃpādane pratibhūr iva pratibhūr munibhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.17 ||
daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa evābhirakṣati |
daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidur budhāḥ || 7.18 ||
daṇḍaḥ śāstīti | yasmād daṇḍaḥ sarvāḥ prajā ājñāṃ karoti tasmāt sādhūktaṃ śāsiteti jñeyam | yasmāt sa eva prajā rakṣati tato yuktam uktaṃ rājeti | nidrāṇeṣv api rakṣitṛṣu daṇḍa eva jāgarti, tadbhayenaiva caurādīnām apravṛtteḥ | daṇḍam eva dharmahetutvād dharmaṃ jānanti | kāraṇe kāryopacāraḥ | aihikapāratrikadaṇḍabhayād eva dharmānuṣṭhānam || 7.18 ||
samīkṣya sa dhṛtaḥ Samyak sarvā rañjayati prajāḥ |
asamīkṣya praṇītas tu vināśayati sarvataḥ || 7.19 ||
samīkṣyetyādi | sa daṇḍaḥ śāstrataḥ samyaṅ nirūpyāparādhānurūpeṇa dehadhanādiṣu dhṛtaḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sānurāgāḥ karoti | avicārya tu lobhādinā prayuktaḥ sarvāṇi bāhyārthaputrādīni nāśayati | sarvata iti dvitīyārthe tasiḥ || 7.19 ||
yadi na praṇayed rājā daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyeṣv atandritaḥ |
śūle matsyān ivāpakṣyan durbalān balavattarāḥ || 7.20 ||
yadītyādi | yadi rājānalaso bhūtvā daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ na kuryāt tadā śūle kṛtvā matsyān iva balavanto durbalān apakṣyan | ḷṅantasya pacidhāto rūpam idam | balino ‘lpabalānāṃ hiṃsām akariṣyann ity arthaḥ | “śūle matsyān ivāpakṣyan” ity eṣa medhātithi-govindarājalikhitaḥ pāṭhaḥ | “jale matsyān ivāhiṃsyuḥ” iti ca pāṭhāntaram | atra balavanto durbalān hiṃsyur iti matsyanyāya eva syād ity uktam || 7.20 ||
adyāt kākaḥ puroḍāśaṃ śvā ca lihyād dhavis tathā |
svāmyaṃ ca na syāt kasmiṃścit pravartetādharottaram || 7.21 ||
adyād iti | yadi rājā daṇḍaṃ nācariṣyat tadā yajñeṣu sarvathā haviranarhaḥ kākaḥ puroḍāśam akhādiṣtat | tathā kukkuraḥ pāyasādi havir alekṣyat | na kasyacit kutracit svāmyaṃ abhaviṣyat | tato balinā tadgrahaṇād brāhmaṇādivarṇānāṃ ca madhye yad avaraṃ śūdrādi tad evottaraṃ pradhānaṃ prāvartiṣyata || 7.21 ||
sarvo daṇḍajito loko durlabho hi śucir naraḥ |
daṇḍasya hi bhayāt sarvaṃ jagad bhogāya kalpate || 7.22 ||
sarva iti | sarvo ‘yaṃ loko daṇḍenaiva niyamitaḥ san mārge ‘vatiṣṭhate | svabhāvaviśuddho hi mānuṣaḥ kaṣṭena labhyate | tathā sarvaṃ idaṃ jagad daṇḍasyaiva bhayād āvaśyakabhojanādirūpe ‘pi bhoge samarthaṃ bhavati || 7.22 ||
uktam api daṇḍasya bhogasaṃpādakatvaṃ dārdhyārthaṃ punar ucyate –
devadānavagandharvā rakṣāṃsi patagoragāḥ |
te ‘pi bhogāya kalpante daṇḍenaiva nipīḍitāḥ || 7.23 ||
deveti | indrāgnisūryavāyvādayo devās tathā dānavagandharvarākṣasapakṣisarpā api “jagad īśvaraparamārthabhayapīḍitā eva varṣadānādyupakārāya pravartante” | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Kāṭh. Up. 2.6.3):
bhayād asyāgnis tapati bhayāt tapati sūryaḥ |
bhayād indraś ca vāyuś ca mṛtyur dhāvati pañcamaḥ || iti |
|| 7.23 ||
duṣyeyuḥ sarvavarṇāś ca bhidyeran sarvasetavaḥ |
sarvalokaprakopaś ca bhaved daṇḍasya vibhramāt || 7.24 ||
duṣyeyur iti | daṇḍasyānācaraṇād anucitena vā pravartanāt sarve brāhmaṇādivarṇā itaretarastrīgamanena saṃkīryeran, sarvaśāstrīyaniyamāś caturvargaphalā utsīdeyuḥ, cauryasāhasādinā ca parasyāpakārāt sarvalokasaṃkṣobhaś ca jāyeta || 7.24 ||
yatra śyāmo lohitākṣo daṇḍaś carati pāpahā |
prajās tatra na muhyanti netā cet sādhu paśyati || 7.25 ||
yatreti | yatra deśe śāstrapramāṇāvagataḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ lohitanayano ‘diṣṭhātṛdevatāko daṇḍo vicarati tatra prajā vyākulā na bhavanti | daṇḍapreṇetā yadi viṣayānurūpaṃ samyag jānāti
|| 7.25 ||
tasyāhuḥ saṃpraṇetāraṃ rājānaṃ satyavādinam |
samīkṣyakāriṇaṃ prājñaṃ dharmakāmārthakovidam || 7.26 ||
tasyetyādi | tasya daṇḍasya pravartayitāram abhiṣekādiguṇayuktaṃ nṛpatim avitathavādinaṃ samīkṣyakāriṇaṃ tattvātattvavicārocitaṃ prajñāśālinaṃ dharmārthakāmānāṃ jñātāraṃ manvādayo ‘py āhuḥ || 7.26 ||
taṃ rājā praṇayan samyak trivargeṇābhivardhate |
kāmātmā viṣamaḥ kṣudro daṇḍenaiva nihanyate || 7.27 ||
tam iti | taṃ daṇḍaṃ rājā samyak pravartayan dharmārthakāmair vṛddhiṃ gacchati | yaḥ punar viṣayābhilāṣī viṣamaḥ kopanaḥ kṣudraś chalānveṣī nṛpaḥ sa prakṛtenaiva daṇḍenāmātyādinā kopād adharmād vā vināśyate || 7.27 ||
daṇḍo hi sumahat tejo durdharaś cākṛtātmabhiḥ |
dharmād vicalitaṃ hanti nṛpam eva sabāndhavam || 7.28 ||
daṇḍa iti | yato daṇḍaḥ prakṛṣṭatejaḥsvarūpaḥ svaśāstrair asaṃskṛtātmabhir duḥkhena dhriyate ‘to rājadharmarahitaṃ nṛpam eva putrabandhusahitaṃ nāśayati || 7.28 ||
tato durgaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca lokaṃ ca sacarācaram |
antarikṣagatāṃś caiva munīn devāṃś ca pīḍayet || 7.29 ||
tata iti | doṣādyanapekṣayā yo daṇḍaḥ kriyate sa bandhunṛpanāśāntaraṃ dhanvādidurgarāṣṭraṃ deśaṃ pṛthivīlokaṃ jaṅgamasthāvarasahitaṃ “haviḥpradānajīvanā devāḥ” ity śrutyā haviḥpradānābhāve ‘ntarikṣagatān ṛṣīn devāṃś ca pīḍayed iti || 7.29 ||
so ‘sahāyena mūḍhena lubdhenākṛtabuddhinā |
na śakyo nyāyato netuṃ saktena viṣayeṣu ca || 7.30 ||
sa ityādi | sa daṇḍo mantrisenāpatipurohitādisahāyarahitena mūrkhena lobhavatā śāstrāsaṃskṛtabuddhipareṇa nṛpatinā śāstrato na praṇetuṃ śakyate || 7.30 ||
śucinā satyasaṃdhena yathāśāstrānusāriṇā |
praṇetuṃ śakyate daṇḍaḥ susahāyena dhīmatā || 7.31 ||
śucineti | arthādiśaucayuktena satyapratijñena yathāśāstravyavahāriṇā śobhanasahāyena tattvajñena kartuṃ śakyata iti pūrvoktadoṣapratipakṣe guṇā anena ślokenoktāḥ || 7.31 ||
svarāṣṭre nyāyavṛttaḥ syād bhṛśadaṇḍaś ca śatruṣu |
suhṛtsv ajihmaḥ snigdheṣu brāhmaṇeṣu kṣmānvitaḥ || 7.32 ||
svarāṣṭra iti | ātmadeśe yathāśāstravyavahārī syāt | śatruviṣayeṣu tīkṣṇadaṇḍo bhavet | nisargasnehaviṣayeṣu mitreṣv akuṭilaḥ syān na kāryamitreṣu | brāhmaṇeṣu ca kṛtālpāparādheṣu ca kṣamāvān bhavet || 7.32 ||
evaṃvṛttasya nṛpateḥ śiloñchenāpi jīvataḥ |
vistīryate yaśo loke tailabindur ivāmbhasi || 7.33 ||
evam ityādi | śiloñcheneti kṣīṇakośatvaṃ vivakṣitam | kṣīṇakośasyāpi nṛpater uktācāravato jale tailabindur iva kīrtir loke vistāram eti || 7.34 ||
atas tu viparītasya nṛpater ajitātmanaḥ |
saṃkṣipyate yaśo loke ghṛtabindur ivāmbhasi || 7.34 ||
ata iti | uktācārād viparītācāravato nṛpater ajitendriyasya jale ghṛtabindur iva kīrtiḥ loke saṃkocayati || 7.34 ||
sve sve dharme niviṣṭānāṃ sarveṣām anupūrvaśaḥ |
varṇānām āśramāṇāṃ ca rājā sṛṣṭo ‘bhirakṣitā || 7.35 ||
sve sve ityādi | krameṇa svadharmānuṣṭhātṝṇāṃ brāhmaṇādivarṇānāṃ brahmacāryādyāśramāṇāṃ ca viśvasṛjā rājā rakṣitā sṛṣṭaḥ | tasmāt teṣāṃ rakṣaṇam akurvato rājñaḥ pratyavāyaḥ | svadharmavirahiṇāṃ tv arakṣaṇe ‘pi na pratyavāya ity asya tātparyārthaḥ || 7.35 ||
tena yad yat sabhṛtyena kartavyaṃ rakṣatā prajāḥ |
tat tad vo ‘haṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvad anupūrvaśaḥ || 7.36 ||
tenetyādi | vakṣyamāṇāvatārārtho ‘yaṃ ślokaḥ | tena rājñā prajārakṣaṇaṃ kurvatā sāmātyena yad yat kartavyaṃ tat tat samagraṃ yuṣmākam abhidhāsyāmi || 7.36 ||
brāhmaṇān paryupāsīta prātar utthāya pārthivaḥ |
traividyavṛddhān viduṣas tiṣthet teṣāṃ ca śāsane || 7.37 ||
brāhmaṇān iti | pratyahaṃ prātar utthāya brāhmaṇān ṛgyajuḥsāmākhyavidyātraya-granthārthābhijñān viduṣa iti nītiśāstrābhijñān seveta tadājñāṃ kuryāt || 7.37 ||
vṛddhāṃś ca nityaṃ seveta viprān vedavidaḥ śucīn |
vṛddhasevī hi satataṃ rakṣobhir api pūjyate || 7.38 ||
vṛddhān ityādi | tāṃś ca brāhmaṇān vayastapasyādivṛddhān arthato granthataś ca vedajñān bahir antaś cārthadānādinā śucīn nityaṃ seveta | yasmād vṛddhasevī satataṃ hiṃsrai rākṣasair api pūjyate tair api tasya hitaṃ kriyate | sutarāṃ manuṣyaiḥ || 7.38 ||
tebhyo ‘dhigacched vinayaṃ vinītātmāpi nityaśaḥ |
vinītātmā hi nṛpatir na vinaśyati karhicit || 7.39 ||
tebhya ityādi | sahajaprajñayā arthaśāstrādijñānena ca vinīto ‘py atiśayārthaṃ tebhyo vinayam abhyaset | yasmād vinītātmā rājā na kadācin naśyati || 7.39 ||
bahavo ‘vinayān naṣṭā rājānaḥ saparicchadāḥ |
vanasthā api rājyāni vinayāt pratipedire || 7.40 ||
bahava ityādi | karituragakośādiparicchadayuktā api rājāno vinayarahitā naṣṭāḥ | bahavaś ca vanasthā niṣparicchadā api vinayena rājyaṃ prāpnuvan || 7.40 ||
ubhayatraiva ślokadvayena dṛṣṭāntam āha –
veno vinaṣṭo ‘vinayān nahuṣaś caiva pārthivaḥ |
sudāḥ paijavanaś caiva sumukho nimir eva ca || 7.41 ||
vena ityādi | veno nahuṣaś ca rājā pijavanasya ca putraḥ sudānāmā sumukho nimiś cāvinayād anaśyan || 7.41 ||
pṛthus tu vinayād rājyaṃ prāptavān manur eva ca |
kuberaś ca dhanaiśvaryaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ caiva gādhijaḥ || 7.42 ||
pṛthur iti | pṛthur manuś ca vinayād rājyaṃ prāpatuḥ | kuberaś ca vinayād dhanādhipatyaṃ lebhe | gādhiputro viśvāmitraś ca kṣariyaḥ saṃs tenaiva dehena brāḥmaṇyaṃ prāptavān | rājyalābhāvasare brāhmaṇyaprāptir aprastutāpi vinayotkarṣārtham uktā īdṛśo ‘yaṃ śāstrānuṣṭhānaniṣiddhavarjanarūpo vinayo yad anena kṣatriyo ‘pi durlabhaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ lebhe
|| 7.42 ||
traividyebhyas trayīṃ vidyāṃ daṇḍanītiṃ ca śāśvatīm |
ānvīkṣikīṃ cātmavidyāṃ vārtārambhāṃś ca lokataḥ || 7.43 ||
traividyebhya iti | trivedīrūpavidyāvidbhyas trivedīm arthato granthataś cābhyaset, brahmacaryadaśāyām eva vedagrahaṇāt samāvṛttasya ca rājyādhikārāt | abhyāsārtho ‘yam upadeśaḥ | daṇḍanītiṃ cārthaśāstrarūpām arthayogakṣemopadeśinīṃ pāramparyāgatatvena nityāṃ tadvidbhyo ‘dhigacchet | tathā ānvīkṣikīṃ tarkavidyāṃ bhūtapravṛttiprayukty-upayoginīṃ brahmavidyāṃ cābhyudayavyasanayor harṣaviṣādapraśamanahetuṃ śikṣeta | kṛṣivāṇijyapaśupālanādivārtā tadārambhān dhanopāyārthāṃs tadabhijñakarṣakādibhyaḥ śikṣeta
|| 7.43 ||
indriyāṇāṃ jaye yogaṃ samātiṣthed divāniśam |
jitendriyo hi śaknoti vase sthāpayituṃ prajāḥ || 7.44 ||
indriyāṇām ityādi | cakṣurādīnāṃ indriyāṇāṃ viṣayāsaktivāraṇe sarvakālaṃ yatnaṃ kuryāt | yasmāj jitendriyaḥ prajā niyantuṃ śaknoti na tu viṣayopabhogavyagraḥ | brahmacāridharmeṣu sarvapuruṣopādeyatayābhihito ‘pīndriyajayo rājadharmeṣu mukhyatvajñānārtham anantaravakṣyamāṇavyasananivṛttihetutvāc ca punaruktiḥ || 7.44 ||
daśa kāmasamutthāni yathāṣṭau krodhajāni ca |
vyasanāni durantāni prayatnena vivarjayet || 7.45 ||
daśetyādi | daśa kāmasaṃbhavāni aṣṭau krodhajāni vakṣyamāṇavyasanāni yatnatas tyajet | durantāni duḥkhāvasānāny ādau sukhayanti ante duḥkhāni durantāni | na hi vyasaninas tato nivartayituṃ śakyante || 7.45 ||
varjanaprayojanam āha –
kāmajeṣu prasakto hi vyasaneṣu mahīpatiḥ |
viyujyate ‘rthadharmābhyāṃ krodhajeṣv ātmanaiva tu || 7.46 ||
kāmajeṣv iti | yasmāt kāmajaniteṣu vyasaneṣu prasakto rājā dharmārthābhyāṃ hīyate | krodhajeṣu prasaktaḥ prakṛtikopād dehanāśaṃ prāpnoti || 7.46 ||
tāni vyasanāni nāmato darśayati –
mṛgayākṣo divāsvapnaḥ parivādaḥ striyo madaḥ |
tauryatrikaṃ vṛthāṭyā ca kāmajo daśako gaṇaḥ || 7.47 ||
mṛgayetyādi | ākheṭākhyo mṛgavadho mṛgayā, akṣo dyūtakrīḍā, sakalakāryavighātinī divānidrā, paradoṣakathanaṃ, strīsaṃbhogaḥ, madyapānajanito madaḥ, tauryatrikaṃ nṛtyagītavāditrāṇi, vṛthābhramaṇam, eṣa daśaparmāṇo daśakaḥ sukhecchāprabhavo gaṇaḥ || 7.47 ||
paiśunyaṃ sāhasaṃ droha īrṣyāsūyārthadūṣaṇam |
vāgdaṇḍajaṃ ca pāruṣyaṃ krodhajo ‘pi gaṇo ‘ṣṭakaḥ || 7.48 ||
pauśunyam iti | paiśunyam avijñātadoṣāviṣkaraṇaṃ, sāhasaṃ sādhor bandhanādinigrahaḥ, drohaś chadmavadhaḥ, īrṣyānyaguṇāsahiṣṇutā, paraguṇeṣu doṣāviṣkaraṇam asūyā, arthadūṣaṇam arthānām apaharaṇaṃ deyānām adānaṃ ca, vākpāruṣyam ākrośādi, daṇḍapāruṣyaṃ tāḍanādi, eṣo ‘ṣṭaparimāṇo vyasanagaṇaḥ krodhād bhavati || 7.48 ||
dvayor apy etayor mūlaṃ yaṃ sarve kavayo viduḥ |
taṃ yatnena jayel lobhaṃ tajjāv etāv ubhau gaṇau || 7.49 ||
dvayor iti | etayor dvayor api kāmakrodhavyasanasaṅghayoḥ kāraṇaṃ smṛtikārā jānanti, taṃ yatnato lobhaṃ tyajet | yasmād etad gaṇadvayaṃ lobhāj jāyate | kvacid dhanalobhataḥ, kvacit prakārāntaralobhena pravṛtteḥ || 7.49 ||
pānam akṣāḥ striyaś caiva mṛgayā ca yathākramam |
etat kaṣṭatamaṃ vidyāc catuṣkaṃ kāmaje gaṇe || 7.50 ||
pānam iti | madyapānaṃ, akṣaiḥ krīḍā, strīsaṃbhogaḥ, mṛgayā ceti kramapaṭhitam etac catuṣkaṃ kāmajavyasanamadhye bahudoṣatvād atiśayena duḥkhahetuṃ jānīyāt || 7.50 ||
daṇḍasya pātanaṃ caiva vākpāruṣyārthadūṣaṇe |
krodhaje ‘pi gaṇe vidyāt kaṣṭam etat trikaṃ sadā || 7.51 ||
daṇḍasyetyādi | daṇḍapātanaṃ, vākpāruṣyaṃ, arthadūṣaṇaṃ ceti krodhaje ‘pi vyasanagaṇe doṣabahulatvād atiśayitaduḥkhasādhanaṃ manyeta || 7.51 ||
saptakasyāsya vargasya sarvatraivānuṣaṅgiṇaḥ |
pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurutaraṃ vidyād vyasanam ātmavān || 7.52 ||
saptakasyeti | asya pānādeḥ kāmakrodhasaṃbhavasya saptaparimāṇasya vyasanavargasya sarvasminn eva rājamaṇḍale prāyeṇāvasthitasya pūrvapūrvavyasanam uttarottarāt kaṣṭataraṃ praśastātmā rājā jānīyāt | tathā hi – dyūtātmānaṃ kaṣṭataraṃ, madyapānena mattasya saṃjñāpraṇāśad yatheṣṭaceṣṭayā dehadhanādivirodha ityādayo doṣāḥ | dyūte tu pākṣikī dhanāvāptir apy asti, strīvyasanād dyūtaṃ duṣtam, dyūte hi vairodbhavādayo nītiśāstroktā doṣāḥ | mūtrapurīṣavegadhāraṇāc ca vyādhyutpattiḥ | strīvyasane punar apatyotpattyādiguṇayogo ‘py asti | mṛgayāstrīvyasanayoḥ strīvyasanaṃ duṣṭam | tatrādarśanakāryāṇāṃ kālātipātena dharmalopādayo doṣāḥ, mṛgayāyāṃ tu vyāyāmenārogyādiguṇayogo ‘py astīty evaṃ kāmajacatuṣkasya pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurudoṣaṃ, krodhajeṣv api triṣu vākpāruṣyād daṇḍapāruṣyaṃ duṣṭam | aṅgacchedāder aśakyasamādhānatvāt, vākpāruṣye tu kopānalo dānamānapānīyasekaiḥ śakyaḥ śamayitum | arthadūṣaṇād vākpāruṣyaṃ doṣavan marmapīḍākaraṃ, vākprahārasya duścikitsyatvāt | tad uktaṃ – “na saṃrohayati vākkṛtam” | arthadūṣaṇaṃ tu pracuratarārthadānāc chakyasamādhānaṃ, evaṃ krodhajatrikasya pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ duṣṭataraṃ yatnatas tyajet || 7.52 ||
vyasanasya ca mṛtyoś ca vyasanaṃ kaṣṭam ucyate |
vyasany adho ‘dho vrajati svar yāty avyasanī mṛtaḥ || 7.53 ||
vyasanasyeti | yady api mṛtyuvyasane dve apīha loke saṃjñāpraṇāśādiduḥkhahetutayā śāstrānuṣṭhānavirodhitayā ca tulye, tathāpi vyasanaṃ kaṣṭataraṃ paratrāpi narakapātahetutvāt | tad āha – vyasany adho ‘dho vrajatīti | bahūn narakān gacchatīty arthaḥ | avyasanī tu mṛtaḥ śāstrānuṣthānapratipakṣavyasanābhāvāt svargaṃ gacchati | etenātiprasaktir vyasaneṣu niṣidhyate na tu tasya sevanam api || 7.53 ||
maulāñ chāstravidaḥ śūrāṃl labdhalakṣān kulodbhavān |
sacivān sapta cāṣṭau vā prakurvīta parīkṣitān || 7.54 ||
maulān iti | maulān pitṛpitāmahakrameṇa sevakān, teṣām api drohādinā vyabhicārāt dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthaśāstrajñān vikrāntān, labdhalakṣāṃl lakṣād apracyutaśarīraśalyādīn āyudhavida ity arthaḥ | viśuddhakulabhavān devatāsparśādiniyatān amātyān saptāṣṭau vā mantrādau kurvīta
|| 7.54 ||
yasmāt –
api yat sukaraṃ karma tad apy ekena duṣkaram |
viśeṣato ‘sahāyena kiṃ nu rājyaṃ mahodayam || 7.55 ||
apītyādi | sukhenāpi yat kriyate karma tad apy ekena duṣkaraṃ bhavati | viśeṣato yan mahāphalaṃ tat katham asahāyena kriyate || 7.55 ||
taiḥ sārdhaṃ cintayen nityaṃ sāmānyaṃ saṃdhivigraham |
sthānaṃ samudayaṃ guptiṃ labdhapraśamanāni ca || 7.56 ||
tair ityādi | sacivaiḥ saha sāmānyaṃ mantreṣv agopanīyaṃ saṃdhivigrahādi | tan nirūpayet | tathā tiṣthaty aneneti sthānaṃ daṇḍakośapurarāṣṭrātmakaṃ caturvidhaṃ cintayet | daṇḍyate ‘neneti daṇḍo hastyaśvarathapadātayas teṣāṃ poṣaṇaṃ rakṣaṇādi tac cintyam | kośo ‘rthanicayas tasyāyavyayādi, purasya rakṣaṇādi, rāṣṭraṃ deśas tadvāsimanuṣyapaśvādidhāraṇakṣamatvādi cintayet | tathā samudayanty utpadyante ‘smād arthā iti samudayo dhānyahiraṇyādyutpatti-sthānaṃ tan nirūpayet | tathā guptiṃ rakṣām ātmagatāṃ rāṣṭragatāṃ ca svaparīkṣitam annādyam adyāt | “parīkṣitāḥ striyaś caiman” (7.219) ityādinātmarakṣaṇam, “rāṣṭrasya saṃgrahe nityam” (7.113) ityādinā rāṣṭrarakṣāṃ ca vakṣyati | labdhasya ca dhanasya praśamanāni satpātre pratipādanādīni cintayet | tathā ca vakṣyati “jitvā saṃpūjayed devān” (7.201) ityādi || 7.56 ||
teṣāṃ svaṃ svam abhiprāyam upalabhya pṛthak pṛthak |
samastānāṃ ca kāryeṣu vidadhyād dhitam ātmanaḥ || 7.57 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ sacivānāṃ rahasi niṣpratipakṣatayā hṛdayagatabhāvajñānasaṃbhavāt pretyekam abhiprāyaṃ samastānām api yugapad abhiprāyaṃ budhvā kārye yad ātmano hitaṃ tat kuryāt || 7.57 ||
sarveṣāṃ tu viśiṣṭena brāhmaṇena vipaścitā |
mantrayet paramaṃ mantraṃ rājā ṣāḍguṇyasaṃyutam || 7.58 ||
sarveṣām iti | eṣām eva sarveṣāṃ sacivānāṃ madhyād anyatamena dhārmikatvādinā viśiṣṭena viduṣā brāhmaṇena saha saṃdhivigrahādivakṣyamāṇaguṇaṣaṭkopetaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ mantraṃ nimantrayet || 7.58 ||
nityaṃ tasmin samāśvastaḥ sarvakāryāṇi nikṣipet |
tena sārdhaṃ viniścitya tataḥ karma samārabhet || 7.59 ||
nityam iti | sarvadā tasmin brāhmaṇe saṃjātaviśvāso bhūtvā yāni kuryāt tāni sarvakāryāṇi samarpayet | tena saha niścitya sarvaṃ karmārabhet || 7.59 ||
anyān api prakurvīta śucīn prājñān avasthitān |
samyag arthsamāhartṝn amātyān suparīkṣitān || 7.60 ||
anyān ityādi | anyān apy arthadānādinā śucīn, prajñāśālinaḥ, samyag dhanārjanaśīlān dharmādinā parīkṣitān karma sacivān kuryāt || 7.60 ||
nirvartetāsya yāvadbhir itikartavyatā nṛbhiḥ |
tāvato ‘tandritān dakṣān prakurvīta vicakṣaṇān || 7.61 ||
nirvarteteti | asya rājño yatsaṃkhyākair manuṣyaiḥ karmajātaṃ saṃpadyate tatsaṃkhyākān manuṣyān ālasyaśūnyān, kriyāsu sotsāhān, tatkarmajñāṃs tatra kuryāt || 7.61 ||
teṣām arthe niyuñjīta śūrān dakṣān kulodgatān |
śucīn ākarakarmānte bhīrūn antarniveśane || 7.62 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ sacivānāṃ madhye vikrāntāṃś caturān kulāṅkuśaniyamitān śucīn arthaniḥspṛhān dhanotpattisthāne niyuñjīta | asyaivodāharaṇam ākarakarmānta iti | ākareṣu suvarṇādyutpattisthāneṣu, karmānteṣu ca ikṣudhānyādisaṃgrahasthāneṣu, antarniveśane bhojanaśayanagṛhāntaḥpurādau bhīrūn niyuñjīta | śūrā hi tatra rājānaṃ prāyeṇaikākinaṃ strīvṛtaṃ vā kadācic chatrūpajāpadūṣitā hanyur api || 7.62 ||
dūtaṃ caiva prakurvīta sarvaśāstraviśāradam |
iṅgitākāraceṣṭajñaṃ śuciṃ dakṣaṃ kulodgatam || 7.63 ||
dūtam iti | dūtaṃ ca dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthaśāstrajñaṃ, iṅgitajñam abhiprāyasūcakaṃ vacanasvarādi, ākāro dehadharmādimukhaprasādavaivarṇyādirūpaḥ prītyaprītisūcakaḥ, ceṣṭā karāsphālanādikriyā kopādisūcikā tadīyatattvajñaṃ, arthadānastrīvyasanādyabhāvātmakaṃ śaucayuktaṃ caturaṃ kulīnaṃ kuryāt || 7.63 ||
yasmāt –
anuraktaḥ śucir dakṣaḥ smṛtimān deśakālavit |
vapuṣmān vītabhīr vāgmī dūto rājñaḥ praśasyate || 7.64 ||
anurakta iti | janeṣu anurāgavān tena pratirājāder api adveṣaviṣayaḥ, arthastrīśaucayuktas tena dhanastrīdānādinābhedyaḥ, dakṣaś caturas tena kāryakālaṃ nātikrāmati | smṛtimān tena saṃdeśaṃ na vismarati, deśakālajñaḥ tena deśakālau jñātvā anyad api saṃdiṣṭaṃ deśakālocitam anyathā kathayati, surūpaḥ tenādeyavacanaḥ, vigatabhayaḥ tenāpriyasaṃdeśasyāpi vaktā, vāgmī tena saṃskṛtādyuktikṣamaḥ, evaṃvidho dūto rājñaḥ praśasyo bhavati || 7.64 ||
amātye daṇḍa āyatto daṇḍe vainayikī kriyā |
nṛpatau kośarāṣṭre ca dūte saṃdhiviparyayau || 7.65 ||
amātya iti | amātye senāpatau hastyaśvarathapādātādyātmako daṇḍa āyattaḥ, tadicchayā tasya kāryeṣu pravṛtteḥ | vinayayogād vainayikī | yo vinayaḥ sa daṇḍa āyattaḥ | nṛpatāv arthasaṃcayasthānadeśāv āyattau rājñā parādhīnau na kartavyau | svayam eva cintanīyaṃ dhanaṃ grāmaś ca | dūte saṃdhivigrahāv āyattau, tadicchayā tatpravṛtteḥ || 7.65 ||
dūta eva hi saṃdhatte bhinatty eva ca saṃhatān |
dūtas tat kurute karma bhidyante yena mānavāḥ || 7.66 ||
dūta eveti | yasmād dūta eva hi bhinnānāṃ saṃdhisaṃpādane kṣamaḥ, saṃhatānāṃ ca bhedane, tathā paradeśe dūtas tatkarma karoti yena saṃhatā bhidyante, tasmāt “dūte saṃdhiviparyayau” (7.65) saṃdhivigrahāv āyattāv iti yad uktaṃ tasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ || 7.66 ||
dūtasya kāryāntaram āha –
sa vidyād asya kṛtyeṣu nigūḍheṅgitaceṣṭitaiḥ |
ākāram iṅgitaṃ ceṣṭāṃ bhṛtyeṣu ca cikīrṣitam || 7.67 ||
sa vidyād iti | sa dūto ‘sya pratirājasya kartavye ākāreṅgitaceṣṭāṃ jānīyāt | nigūḍhā anucarāḥ pratipakṣanṛpasyaiva parijanās tasmin yuktās tatsaṃnidhāv api teṣām iṅgitaceṣṭitaiḥ | bhṛtyeṣu ca kṣubdhalubdhāpamāniteṣu pratirājasya kartum īpsitaṃ jānīyāt || 7.67 ||
buddhvā ca sarvaṃ tattvena pararājacikīrṣitam |
tathā prayatnam ātiṣṭhed yathātmānaṃ na pīḍayet || 7.68 ||
buddhvā ceti | uktalakṣaṇadūtadvāreṇa pratipakṣarājasya kartum iṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ tattvato jñātvā tathā prayatnaṃ kuryāt yathātmanaḥ pīḍā na bhavati || 7.68 ||
jāṅgalaṃ sasyasaṃpannam āryaprāyam anāvilam |
ramyam ānatasāmantaṃ svājīvyaṃ deśam āvaset || 7.69 ||
jāṅgalam iti |
alpodakatṛṇo yas tu pravātaḥ pracurātapaḥ |
sa jñeyo jāṅgalo deśo bahudānyādisaṃyutaḥ ||
pracuradhārmikajanaṃ rogopasargādyair anākulaṃ phalapuṣpatarulatādimanoharaṃ praṇatasamīpavāstavyāṭavikādijanaṃ sulabhakṛṣivāṇijyādyājīvanam āśrityāvāsaṃ kuryāt
|| 7.69 ||
dhanurdurgaṃ mahīdurgam abdurgaṃ vārkṣam eva vā |
nṛdurgaṃ giridurgaṃ vā samāśritya vaset puram || 7.70 ||
dhanvagurgam (?) iti | dhanurdurgaṃ maruveṣṭitaṃ caturdiśaṃ pañcayojanam anudakaṃ, mahīdurgaṃ pāṣāṇena iṣṭakena vā vistārād vaiguṇyocchrāyeṇa dvādaśahastād ucchritena yuddhārtham uparibhramaṇayogyena sāvaraṇagavākṣādiyuktena prākāreṇa veṣṭitaṃ, jaladurgam agādhodakena sarvataḥ parivṛtaṃ, vārkṣadurgaṃ bahiḥ sarvato yojanamātraṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhan mahāvṛkṣakaṇṭakigulmalatādyācitaṃ, nṛdurgaṃ cuturdigavasthāyi hastyaśvarathayuktabahupadātarakṣitaṃ, giridurgaṃ parvatapṛṣṭham atidurārohaṃ saṃkocaikamārgopetaṃ antarnadīprasravaṇādyudakayuktaṃ, bahusasyotpannakṣetravṛkṣānvitam, eteṣu durgeṣu madhyād anyatamaṃ durgam āśritya puraṃ viracayet || 7.70 ||
sarveṇa tu prayatnena giridurgaṃ samāśrayet |
eṣāṃ hi bāhuguṇyena giridurgaṃ viśiṣyate || 7.71 ||
sarveṇeti | yasmād eṣāṃ durgāṇāṃ madhyāt durgaguṇabahutvena giridurgam atiricyate tasmāt sarvaprayatnena tad āśrayet | giridurge śatrudurārohatvaṃ mahatpradeśād alpaprayatnapreritaśilādinā bahuvipakṣasainyavyāpādanam ityādayo bahavo guṇāḥ || 7.71 ||
trīṇy ādyāny āśritās tv eṣāṃ mṛgagartāśrayāpsarāḥ [-carāḥ?] |
trīṇy uttarāṇi kramaśaḥ plavaṅgamanarāmarāḥ || 7.72 ||
trīṇīti | eṣāṃ durgāṇāṃ madhyāt prathamoktāni trīṇi durgāṇi mṛgadaya āśritāḥ | atra dhanurdurgaṃ mṛgair āśritaṃ, mahīdurgaṃ gartāśritair mūṣikādibhiḥ, abdurgaṃ jalacarair nakrādibhiḥ, itarāṇi trīṇi vṛkṣadurgādīni vānarādaya āśritās tatra vṛkṣadurgaṃ vānarair āśritaṃ, nṛdurgaṃ mānuṣaiḥ, giridurgaṃ devaiḥ || 7.72 ||
yathā durgāśritān etān nopahiṃsanti śatravaḥ |
tathārayo na hiṃsanti nṛpaṃ durgasamāśritam || 7.73 ||
yathetyādi | yathaitān durgavāsino mṛgādīn vyādhādayaḥ śatravo na hiṃsanti evaṃ durgāśritaṃ rājānaṃ na śatravaḥ || 7.73 ||
ekaḥ śataṃ yodhayati prākārastho dhanurdharaḥ |
śataṃ daśasahasrāṇi tadmād durgaṃ vidhīyate || 7.74 ||
eka iti | yasmād eko dhānuṣkaḥ prākārasthaḥ śatrūṇāṃ śataṃ yodhayati, prākārasthaṃ dhānuṣkaśataṃ ca śatrūṇāṃ daśasahasrāṇi, tasmād durgaṃ kartum upadiśyate || 7.74 ||
tat syād āyudhasaṃpannaṃ dhanadhānyena vāhanaiḥ |
brāhmaṇaiḥ śilpibhir yantrair yavasenodakena ca || 7.75 ||
tad ityādi | tad durgaṃ khaḍgādyāyudhasuvarṇādidhanadhānyakarituragādivāhana-brāhmaṇabhakṣyādiśilpiyantraghāsodakasamṛddhaṃ kuryāt || 7.75 ||
tasya madhye suparyāptaṃ kārayed gṛham ātmanaḥ |
gupaṃ sarvartukaṃ śubhraṃ jalavṛkṣasamanvitam || 7.76 ||
tasyetyādi | tasya durgasya madhye paryāptaṃ pṛthak pṛthak strīgṛhadevāgārāyudhāgārāgni-śālādiyuktaṃ parikhāprākārādyair guptaṃ sarvartukaphalapuṣpādiyogena sarvartukaṃ sudhādhāvalitaṃ vāpyādijalayuktaṃ vṛkṣānvitam ātmano gṛhaṃ kārayet || 7.76 ||
tad adhyāsyodvahed bhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām |
kule mahati saṃbhūtāṃ hṛdyāṃ rūpaguṇānvitām || 7.77 ||
tad ityādi | tad gṛham āśritya samānavarṇāṃ śubhasūcakalakṣaṇopetāṃ mahākulaprasūtāṃ manohāriṇīṃ surūpāṃ guṇavatīṃ bhāryām udvahet || 7.77 ||
purohitaṃ ca kurvīta vṛṇuyād eva carvijaḥ |
te ‘sya gṛhyāṇi karmāṇi kuryur vaitānikāni ca || 7.78 ||
purohitam iti | purohitaṃ cāpy ātharvaṇavidhinā kurvīta, ṛtvijaś ca karmāṇi kartuṃ vṛṇuyāt | te cāsya gṛhyoktāṇi tretāsaṃpādyāni karmāṇi kuryuḥ || 7.78 ||
yajeta rājā kratubhir vividhair āptadakṣiṇaiḥ |
dharmārthaṃ caiva viprebhyo dadyād bhogān dhanāni ca || 7.79 ||
yajeteti | rājā nānāprakārān bahudakṣiṇān aśvamedhādiyajñān kuryāt | brāhmaṇebhyaś ca strīgṛhaśayyādīn bhogān suvarṇavastrādīni dhanāni dadyāt || 7.79 ||
sāṃvatsarikam āptaiś ca rāṣṭrād āhārayed balim |
syāc cāmnāyaparo loke varteta pitṛvan nṛṣu || 7.80 ||
sāṃvatsarikam iti | rājāsaktair amātyair varṣagrāhyaṃ dhānyādibhāgam ānāyayet, loke ca karādigrahaṇe śāstraniṣṭhaḥ syāt, svadeśavāsiṣu nareṣu pitṛvat snehādinā varteta || 7.80 ||
adhyakṣān vividhān kuryāt tatra tatra vipaścitaḥ |
te ‘sya sarvāṇy avekṣeran nṛṇāṃ kāryāṇi kurvatām || 7.81 ||
adhyakṣān iti | tatra tatra hastyaśvarathapadātādyarthādisthāneṣv adhyakṣān avekṣitṝn vividhān pṛthak pṛthak vipaścitaḥ karmakuśalān kuryāt | te ‘sya rājñas teṣu hastyaśvādisthāneṣu manuṣtāṇāṃ kurvatāṃ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi samyak kāryārtham avekṣeran || 7.81 ||
āvṛttānāṃ gurukulād viprāṇāṃ pūjako bhavet |
nṛpāṇām akṣayo hy eṣa nidhir brāhmo ‘bhidhīyate || 7.82 ||
āvṛtānām iti | gurukulān nivṛttānām adhītavedānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ gārhasthyārthināṃ niyamato dhanadhānyena pūjāṃ kuryāt | yasmād yo ‘yaṃ brāhmo brāhmaṇeṣu sthāpitadhanadhānyādinidhir iva nidhiḥ akṣayo brahmaphalatvād avināśī rājñāṃ śāstreṇopadiśyate || 7.82 ||
ata eva –
na taṃ stenā na cāmitrā haranti na ca naśyati |
tasmād rājñā nidhātavyo brāhmaṇeṣv akṣayo nidhiḥ || 7.83 ||
na tam iti | taṃ brāhmaṇasthāpitanidhiṃ na caurā nāpi śatravo haranti, anyanidhivad bhūmyādisthāpitaḥ kālavaśān na naśyati | sthānabhrāntyā vā darśanam upaiti | tasmād yo ‘yam akṣayo ‘nantaphalo nidhir iva nidhir dhanaughaḥ sa rājñā brāhmaṇeṣu nidhātavyaḥ | tebhyo deya ity arthaḥ || 7.83 ||
na skandate na vyathate na vinaśyati karhicit |
variṣṭham agnihotrebhyo brāhmaṇasya mukhe hutam || 7.84 ||
netyādi | agnau yad dhavir hūyate tat kadācit skandate sravaty adhaḥ patati, kadācid vyathate śuṣyati, kadācid dāhādinā naśyati, brāhmaṇasya mukhe yad dhutaṃ “pāṇyāsyo hi dvijaḥ smṛtaḥ” (4.117) iti brāhmaṇahastadattam ity arthaḥ | tasya noktā doṣāḥ | tasmād agnihotrādibhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ brāhmaṇāya dānam ity arthaḥ || 7.84 ||
samam abrāhmaṇe dānaṃ dviguṇaṃ brāhmaṇabruve |
prādhīte śatasāhasram anantaṃ vedapārage || 7.85 ||
samam ityādi | brāhmaṇetarakṣatrādiviṣaye yad dānaṃ tat samaphalaṃ | yasya deyadravyasya yat phalaṃ śrutaṃ tato nādhikaṃ na ca nyūnaṃ bhavati | yo brāhmaṇaḥ kriyārahita ātmānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bravīti sa brāhmaṇabruvaḥ | tadviṣayadānaṃ pūrvāpekṣayā dviguṇaphalam | evaṃ prādhīte prakrāntādhyayane brāhmaṇe lakṣaguṇaṃ phalam | samastaśākhādhyāyiny anantaphalam | ‘sahasraguṇam ācārye’ iti vā tṛtīyapādasya pāṭhaḥ || 7.85 ||
pātrasya hi viśeṣeṇa śraddadhānatayaiva ca |
alpaṃ vā bahu vā pretya dānasya phalam aśnute || 7.86 ||
pātrasyeti | vidyātapovṛttiyuktatayā pātrasya tāratamyam apekṣya śāstre tatheti pratyayarūpāyāḥ śraddhāyās tāratamyapātram āsādya dānasyālpaṃ mahad vā phalaṃ paraloke labhyate || 7.86 ||
samottamādhamai rājā tv āhūtaḥ pālayan prajāḥ |
na nivarteta saṃgrāmāt kṣātraṃ dharmam anusmaran || 7.87 ||
samottamādhamair iti | samabalenādhikabalena hīnabalena ca rājñā yuddhārtham āhūto rājā prajārakṣaṇaṃ kurvan yuddhān na nivarteta | kṣatriyeṇa yuddhārtham āhūtenāvaśyaṃ yoddhavyam iti kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ smaran || 7.87 ||
yasmāt –
saṃgrāmeṣv anivartitvaṃ prajānāṃ caiva pālanam |
śuśrūṣā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca rājñāṃ śreyaskaraṃ param || 7.88 ||
saṃgrāmeṣv iti | yuddheṣv aparāṅmukhatvaṃ prajānāṃ ca rakṣaṇaṃ brāhmaṇaparicaryā etad rājñāṃ atiśayitaṃ svargādiśreyaḥsthānam || 7.88 ||
ata eva –
āhaveṣu mitho ‘nyonyaṃ jighāṃsanto mahīkṣitaḥ |
yudhyamānāḥ paraṃ śaktyā svargaṃ yānty aparāṅmukhāḥ || 7.89 ||
āhaveṣv iti | rājāno mithaḥ spardhamānā yuddheṣv anyonyaṃ hantum icchantaḥ prakṛṣṭayā śaktyā saṃmukhībhūya yudhyamānāḥ svargaṃ gacchanti | yady api yuddhasya śatrujanadhanalābhādirūpaṃ dṛṣṭam eva phalaṃ na svargas tathāpi yuddhāśritāparāṅmukhatvaniyamasya svargaḥ phalam iti na doṣaḥ || 7.89 ||
na kūṭair āyudhair hanyād yudhyamāno raṇe ripūn |
na karṇibhir nāpi digdhair nāgnijvalitatejanaiḥ || 7.90 ||
netyādi | kūṭāny āyudhāni bahiḥkāṣṭhādimayāny antarguptaniśitaśastrāṇy etaiḥ samara yudhyamānaḥ śatrūn na hanyāt | nāpi karṇyākāraphalakair bāṇaiḥ | nāpi viṣāktaiḥ | nāpy agnidīptaphalakaiḥ || 7.90 ||
na ca hanyāt sthalārūḍhaṃ na klībaṃ na kṛtāñjalim |
na muktakeśaṃ nāsīnaṃ na tavāsmīti vādinam || 7.91 ||
na ceti | svayaṃ rathastho rathaṃ tyaktvā sthalārūḍhaṇ na hanyāt | tathā napuṃsakaṃ baddhāñjaliṃ, muktakeśaṃ, upaviṣṭaṃ, tvadīyo ‘ham ity evaṃvādinaṃ na hanyāt || 7.91 ||
na suptaṃ na visannāhaṃ na nagnaṃ na nirāyudham |
nāyudhyamānaṃ paśyantaṃ na pareṇa samāgatam || 7.92 ||
na suptam iti | suptaṃ, muktasannāhaṃ vivastram anāyudhaṃ, ayudhyamānaṃ, prekṣakaṃ anyena saha yudhyamānaṃ ca na hanyāt || 7.92 ||
nāyudhavyasanaprāptaṃ nārtaṃ nātiparikṣatam |
na bhītaṃ na parāvṛttaṃ satāṃ dharmam anusmaran || 7.93 ||
netyādi | bhagnakhaḍgādyāyudhaṃ, putraśokādinārtaṃ, bahuprahārākulaṃ, bhītaṃ, yuddhaparāṅmukhaṃ, śiṣṭakṣatriyāṇāṃ dharmaṃ smaran na hanyāt || 7.93 ||
yas tu bhītaḥ parāvṛttaḥ saṃgrāme hanyate paraiḥ |
bhartur yad duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ pratipadyate || 7.94 ||
yas tv iti | yas tu yodho bhītaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ san yuddhe śatrubhir hanyate sa poṣaṇakartuḥ prabhor yad duṣkṛtaṃ tat sarvaṃ prāpnoti | śāstrapramāṇake ca sukṛtaduṣkṛte yathāśāstraṃ saṃkramayogye eva sidhyataḥ | ata evopajīvyaśāstreṇa bādhanān na pratipakṣānumānodayo ‘pi | etac ca ṣaṣṭhe “priyeṣu sveṣu sukṛtam” (6.79) ity atrāviṣkṛtam asmābhiḥ || “parāṅmukhahatasya syāt pāpam etad vivakṣitam, na tv atra prabhupāpaṃ syād” iti govindarājakaḥ | medhātithis tv arthavādamātram etan nirūpayan | manye naitad dvayaṃ yuktaṃ vyaktamanvarthavarjanāt | “anyadīyapuṇyapāpe ‘nyatra saṃkramete” iti śāstraprāmāṇyād vedāntasūtrakṛtā bādarāyaṇena nirṇīto ‘yam artha iti yathoktam eva ramaṇīyam || 7.94 ||
yac cāsya sukṛtaṃ kiṃcid amutrārtham upārjitam |
bhartā tat sarvam ādatte parāvṛttahatasya tu || 7.95 ||
yac cetyādi | parāṅmukhahatasya yat kiṃcit sukṛtaṃ paralokārtham arjitam anenāsit tat sarvaṃ prabhur labhate || 7.95 ||
rājñaḥ svāminaḥ sarvadhanagrahaṇe prāpte tadapavādārtham āha –
rathāśvaṃ hastinaṃ chatraṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ paśūn striyaḥ |
sarvadravyāṇi kupyaṃ ca yo yac jayati tasya tat || 7.96 ||
rathāśvam ityādi | rathāśvahastichatravastrādi, dhanadhānyagavādi, dāsyādi striyaḥ, sarvāṇi dravyāṇi guḍalavaṇādīni, kupyaṃ ca suvarṇarajatavyatiriktaṃ tāmrādi dhanaṃ, yaḥ pṛthag jitvā satataṃ gṛham ānayati tasyaiva tad bhavati | suvarṇarajatabhūmiratnādy-anapakṛṣṭadhanaṃ tu rājña eva samarpaṇīyam, etadartham evātra parigaṇanīyam || 7.96 ||
ata evāha –
rājñaś ca dadyur uddhāram ity eṣā vaidikī śrutiḥ |
rājñā ca sarvayodhebhyo dātavyam apṛthagjitam || 7.97 ||
rājña ityādi | uddhāraṃ yoddhāro rājñe dadyuḥ | uddhriyata ity uddhāraḥ | jitadhanād utkṛṣṭadhanaṃ suvarṇarajatakupyādi rājñe samarpaṇīyam | karituragādivāhanam api rājñe deyam, “vāhanaṃ ca rājña uddhāraṃ ca” iti gautamavacanāt | uddhāradāne ca śrutiḥ: “indro vai vṛtraṃ hatvā” ity upakramya “sa mahān bhūtvā devata abravīd uddhāraṃ samuddharata” iti | rājñā cāpṛthagjitaṃ sahajitaṃ sarvayodhebhyo yathāpauruṣaṃ saṃvibhajanīyam || 7.97 ||
eṣo ‘nupaskṛtaḥ prokto yodhadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ |
asmād dharmān na cyaveta kṣatriyo ghnan raṇe ripūn || 7.98 ||
eṣa ityādi | avigarhita eṣo ‘nādisargapravāhasaṃbhavatayā nityo yodhadharma uktaḥ | yuddhe śatrūn hiṃsan kṣatriya etaṃ dharmaṃ na tyajet | yuddhādhikāritvāt kṣatriyagrahaṇam | anyo ‘pi tatsthānapatito na tyajet || 7.98 ||
alabdhaṃ caiva lipseta labdhaṃ rakṣet prayatnataḥ |
rakṣitaṃ vardhayec caiva vṛddhaṃ pātreṣu nikṣipet || 7.99 ||
alabdham iti | ajitaṃ bhūmihiraṇyādi jetum icchet | jitaṃ prayatnato rakṣet | rakṣitaṃ ca vāṇijyādinā vardhayet | vṛddhaṃ ca pātrebhyo dadyāt || 7.99 ||
etac caturvidhaṃ vidyāt puruṣārthaprayojanam |
asya nityam anuṣṭhānaṃ samyak kuryād atandritaḥ || 7.100 ||
etad iti | etac catuḥprakāraṃ puruṣārtho yaḥ svargādis tatprayojanaṃ yasmād evaṃrūpaṃ jānīyāt | ato ‘nalasaḥ san sarvadānuṣṭhānaṃ kuryāt || 7.100 ||
alabdham icched daṇḍena labdhaṃ rakṣed avekṣayā |
rakṣitaṃ vardhayed vṛddhyā vṛddhaṃ pātreṣu nikṣipet || 7.101 ||
alabdham iti | alabdhaṃ yad dhastyaśvarathapādātyātmakena daṇḍena jetum icchet | jitaṃ ca pratyavekṣaṇena rakṣet | rakṣitaṃ ca vṛddhyupāyena sthalajalapathavāṇijyādinā vardhayet | vṛddhaṃ śāstrīyavibhāgena pātrebhyo dadyāt || 7.101 ||
nityam udyatadaṇḍaḥ syān nityaṃ vivṛtapauruṣaḥ |
nityaṃ saṃvṛtasaṃvāryo nityaṃ chidrānuśāry areḥ || 7.102 ||
nityam iti | nityaṃ hastyaśvādiyuddhādiśikṣābhyāso daṇḍo yasya sa tathā syāt | nityaṃ ca prakāśīkṛtam astravidyādinā pauruṣaṃ yasya sa tathā syāt | nityaṃ ca śastror vyasanādirūpacchidrānusaṃdhānaṃ tatparaḥ syāt || 7.102 ||
nityam udyatadaṇḍasya kṛtsnam udvijate jagat |
tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni daṇḍenaiva prasādhayet || 7.103 ||
nityam iti | yasmān nityodyatadaṇḍasya jagad udvijed iti tasmāt sarvaprāṇino daṇḍenaivātmasāt kuryāt || 7.103 ||
amāyayaiva varteta na kathaṃcana māyayā |
budhyetāriprayuktāṃ ca māyāṃ nityaṃ svasaṃvṛtaḥ || 7.104 ||
amāyayeti | māyayā chadmatayā amātyādiṣu na varteta | tathā sati sarveṣām aviśvasanīyaḥ syāt | dharmarakṣārthaṃ yathātattvenaiva vyavaharet | yatnakṛtātmapakṣarakṣaś ca śatrukṛtāṃ prakṛtibhedarūpāṃ māyāṃ cāradvāreṇa jānīyāt || 7.104 ||
nāsya chidraṃ paro vidyād vidyāc chidraṃ parasya tu |
gūhet kūrma ivāṅgāni rakṣed vivaram ātmanaḥ || 7.105 ||
netyādi | tathā yatnaṃ kuryād yathāsya prakṛtibhedādi chidraṃ śatrur na jānāti | śatros tu prakṛtibhedādikaṃ cārair jānīyat | kūrmo yathā mukhacaraṇādīny aṅgāny ātmadehe gopāyaty evaṃ rājāṅgāny amātyādīni dānasaṃmānādinātmasāt kuryāt | daivāc ca prakṛtibhedādirūpe chidre jāte yatnataḥ pratīkāraṃ kuryāt || 7.105 ||
bakavac cintayed arthān siṃhavac ca parākramet |
vṛkavac cāvalumpeta śaśavac ca viniṣpatet || 7.106 ||
bakavad iti | yathā bako jale mīnam aticañcalasvabhāvam api matsyagrahaṇārtham ekatānāntaḥkaraṇaś cintayaty evaṃ rahasi suvihitarakṣasyāpi vipakṣasya deśagrahaṇādīn arthāṃś cintayet | yathā ca siṃhaḥ prabalam atisthūlam api dantāvalaṃ hantum ākramaty evam alpabalo balavatopakrānaḥ saṃśrayādyupāyāntarāsaṃbhave sarvaśaktyā śatruṃ hantum ākramet | yathā ca vṛkaḥ pālakṛtarakṣaṇam api paśuṃ daivāt pālānavadhānam āsādya vyāpādayaty evaṃ durgādyavasthitam api ripuṃ kathaṃcit pramādam āsādya vyāpādayet | yathā śaśaḥ vadhoddhuravividhavyādhamadhyagato ‘pi kuṭilagatir utplutya palāyate, evaṃ svayam abalo balavadariparivṛto ‘pi kathaṃcid arivyāmoham ādhāya guṇavatpārthivāntaraṃ saṃśrayitum upasarpet || 7.106 ||
evaṃ vijayamānasya ye ‘sya syuḥ paripanthinaḥ |
tān ānayed vaśaṃ sarvān sāmādibhir upakramaiḥ || 7.107 ||
evam ityādi | evam uktaprakāreṇa vijayapravṛttasya nṛpater ye vijayavirodhino bhaveyus tān sarvān sāmadānabhedadaṇḍair upāyair vaśam ānayet || 7.107 ||
yadi te tu na tiṣṭheyur upāyaiḥ prathamais tribhiḥ |
daṇḍenaiva prasahyaitāṃś chanakair vaśam ānayet || 7.108 ||
yadītyādi | te ca vijayavirodhino yady ādyais tribhir upāyair na nivartante tadā balād deśopamardādinā yuddhena śanakair laghugurudaṇḍakrameṇa daṇḍena vaśīkuryāt || 7.108 ||
sāmādīnām upāyānāṃ caturṇām api paṇḍitāḥ |
sāmadaṇḍau praśaṃsanti nityaṃ rāṣṭrābhivṛddhaye || 7.109 ||
sāmādīnām iti | caturṇām api sāmādīnām upāyānāṃ madhyāt sāmadaṇḍāv eva rāṣṭravṛddhyarthaṃ paṇḍitāh praśaṃsanti | sāmni prayāsadhanavyayasainyakṣayādidoṣābhāvād daṇḍe tu tatsadbhāve ‘pi kāryasiddhyatiśayāt || 7.109 ||
yathoddharati nirdātā kakṣaṃ dhānyaṃ ca rakṣati |
tathā rakṣen nṛpo rāṣṭraṃ hanyāc ca paripanthinaḥ || 7.110 ||
yathetyādi | yathā kṣetre dhānyatṛṇādikayoḥ sahotpannayor api dhānyāni lavanakartā rakṣati tṛṇādikaṃ coddharati, evaṃ nṛpatī rāṣṭre duṣṭān hanyān na tv aduṣṭāṃs tadīyasahajān bhrātṝn api, nirdātṛdṛṣṭāntād avasīyate | śiṣṭasahitaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ rakṣet || 7.110 ||
mohād rājā svarāṣṭraṃ yaḥ karṣayaty anavekṣayā |
so ‘cirād bhraśyate rājyāj jīvitāc ca sabāndhavaḥ || 7.111 ||
mohād ityādi | yo rājānavekṣayā duṣṭaśiṣṭājñānena sarvān eva svarāṣṭrīyajanān śāstrīyadhanagrahaṇamāraṇādikaṣṭena pīḍayati sa śīghram eva janapadavairākhyaprakṛtikopādharmai rājā rājyāj jīvitāc ca putrādisahito bhraśyate || 7.111 ||
śarīrakarṣaṇāt prāṇāḥ kṣīyante prāṇināṃ yathā |
tathā rājñām api prāṇāḥ kṣīyante rāṣṭrakarṣaṇāt || 7.112 ||
śarīrakarṣaṇeti | yathā prāṇabhṛtām āhāranirodhādinā śarīraśoṣaṇāt prāṇāḥ kṣīyante, evaṃ rājñām api rāṣṭrapīḍanāt prakṛtikopādinā prāṇā vinaśyanti | tasmāt svaśarīravad rājñā rāṣṭraṃ rakṣaṇīyam ity uktam || 7.112 ||
rāṣṭrasya saṃgrahe nityaṃ vidhānam idam ācaret |
susaṃgṛhītarāṣṭro hi pārthivaḥ sukham edhate || 7.113 ||
rāṣṭrasyetyādi | rāṣṭrasya rakṣaṇe ca vakṣyamāṇam imam upāyam anutiṣṭhet | yasmāt saṃrakṣitarāṣṭro rājānāyāsena vardhate || 7.113 ||
dvayos trayāṇāṃ pañcānāṃ madhye gulmam adhiṣṭhitam |
tathā grāmaśatānāṃ ca kuryād rāṣṭrasya saṃgraham || 7.114 ||
dvayor iti | dvayor grāmayor madhye trayāṇāṃ vā grāmāṇāṃ pañcānāṃ vā grāmaśatānāṃ gulmaṃ rakṣitṛpuruṣasamūhaṃ satyapradhānapuruṣādhiṣṭhitaṃ rāṣṭrasya saṃgrahaṃ rakṣāsthānaṃ kuryāt | asya lāghavagauravāpekṣaś coktavikalpaḥ || 7.114 ||
grāmasyādhipatiṃ kuryād daśagrāmapatiṃ tathā |
viṃśatīśaṃ śateśaṃ ca sahasrapatim eva ca || 7.115 ||
grāmasyeti | ekagrāmadaśagrāmādyadhipatīn kuryāt || 7.115 ||
grāmadoṣān samutpannān grāmikaḥ śanakaiḥ svayam |
śaṃsed grāmadaśeśāya daśeśo viṃśatīśine || 7.116 ||
viṃśatīśas tu tat sarvaṃ śateśāya nivedayet |
śaṃsed grāmaśateśas tu sahasrapataye svayam || 7.117 ||
grāma iti | viṃśatīśa iti | grāmādhipatiś caurādidoṣān [NSP caurādirādidoṣān] grāme saṃjātān ātmanā pratikartum akṣamo ‘nutkṛṣṭatayā svayaṃ daśagrāmādhipataye kathayet | evaṃ daśagrāmādhipatayo viṃśatigrāmasvāmyādibhyaḥ kathayeyuḥ | tathā ca sati samyak caurādikaṇṭakoddhāro bhavati
|| 7.116–117 ||
ekagrāmādhikṛtasya vṛttim āha –
yāni rājapradeyāni pratyahaṃ grāmavāsibhiḥ |
annapānendhanādīni grāmikas tāny avāpnjyāt || 7.118 ||
yānīti | yāny annapānendhanādīni grāmavāsibhiḥ pratyaṃ rājñe deyāni na tv abdakaraṃ “dhānyānām aṣṭamo bhāgaḥ” (7.130) ityādikam, tāni grāmādhipatir vṛttyarthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt
|| 7.118 ||
daśī kulam tu bhuñjīta viṃśi pañca kulāni ca |
grāmaṃ grāmaśatādhyakṣaḥ sahasrādhipatiḥ puram || 7.119 ||
daśī kulam iti |
aṣṭāgavaṃ dharmahalaṃ ṣaḍgavaṃ jīvitārthinām |
caturgavaṃ gṛhasthānāṃ trigavaṃ brahmaghātinām ||
iti hārītasmaraṇāt | ṣaḍgavaṃ madhyamaṃ halam iti tathāvidhahaladvayena yāvatī bhūmir vāhyate tat kulam iti vadati | tad daśagrāmādhipatir vṛttyarthaṃ bhuñjīta | evaṃ viṃśatyadhipatiḥ pañca kulāni, śatādhipatir madhyamaṃ grāmaṃ, sahasrādhipatir madhyamaṃ puram || 7.119 ||
teṣāṃ grāmyāṇi kāryāṇi pṛthakkāryāṇi caiva hi |
rājño ‘nyaḥ sacivaḥ snigdhas tāni paśyed atandritaḥ || 7.120 ||
teṣām ityādi | teṣāṃ grāmanivāsiprabhṛtīnāṃ parasparavipratipattau yāni grāmabhavāni kāryāṇi, kṛtākṛtāni ca pṛthakkāryāṇi, tāny anyo rājño hitakṛt tanniyukto ‘nalasaḥ kurvīta
|| 7.120 ||
nagare nagare caikaṃ kuryāt sarvārthacintakam |
uccaiḥsthānaṃ ghorarūpaṃ nakṣatrāṇām iva graham || 7.121 ||
nagara iti | pratinagaram ekaikam ucchaiḥsthānaṃ kulādinā mahāntaṃ pradhānarūpaṃ ghorarūpaṃ hastyaśvādisāmagryā bhayajanakanakṣatrādimadhye bhārgavādigraham iva tejasvinaṃ kāryadraṣṭāraṃ nagarādhipatiṃ kuryāt || 7.121 ||
sa tān anuparikrāmet sarvān eva sadā svayam |
teṣāṃ vṛttaṃ pariṇayet samyag rāṣṭreṣu taccaraiḥ || 7.122 ||
sa ityādi | sa nagarādhikṛtas tān sarvān grāmādhipatyādīn asati prayojane sarvadā svayaṃ sabalenānugacchet | teṣāṃ ca nagarādhikṛtaparyantānāṃ sarveṣām eva yad rāṣṭre svaceṣṭitaṃ tattadviṣayaniyuktaiś caraiḥ samyak prajāḥ pariṇayed avagacchet || 7.122 ||
rājño hi rakṣādhikṛtāḥ parasvādāyinaḥ śaṭhāḥ |
bhṛtyā bhavanti prāyeṇa tebhyo rakṣed imāḥ prajāḥ || 7.123 ||
rājño hītyādi | yasmād ye rājño rakṣādhikṛtās te bāhulyena parasvagrahaṇaśīlā vañcakāś ca bhavanti, tasmāt tebhya imāḥ svātmīyāḥ prajā rājā rakṣet || 7.123 ||
ye kāryikebhyo ‘rtham eva gṛhṇīyuḥ pāpacetasaḥ |
teṣāṃ sarvasvam ādāya rājā kuryāt pravāsanam || 7.124 ||
ya ityādi | ye rakṣādhikṛtāḥ kāryārthibhya eva vākchalādikam udbhāvya lobhād aśāstrīyadhanagrahaṇaṃ pāpabuddhayaḥ kurvanti teṣāṃ sarvasvaṃ rājā gṛhītvā deśān niḥsāraṇaṃ kuryāt || 7.124 ||
rājā karmasu yuktānāṃ strīṇāṃ preṣyajanasya ca |
pratyahaṃ kalpayed vṛttiṃ sthānakarmānurūpataḥ || 7.125 ||
rājetyādi | rājopayuktakarmaniyuktānāṃ strīṇāṃ dāsyādīnāṃ karmakarajanasya cotkṛṣṭamadhyamāpakṛṣṭasthānayogyānurūpeṇa pratyahaṃ karmānurūpeṇa vṛttiṃ kuryāt
|| 7.125 ||
tām eva darśayati –
paṇo deyo ‘vakṛṣṭasya ṣaḍ utkṛṣṭasya vetanam |
ṣāṇmāsikas tathācchādo dhānyadroṇas tu māsikaḥ || 7.126 ||
paṇa iti | avakṛṣṭasya gṛhādisaṃmārjakodakavāhādeḥ karmakarasya vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaḥ paṇo bhṛtirūpaḥ pratyahaṃ dātavyaḥ | ṣāṇmāsikaś cācchādo vastrayugaṃ dātavyam |
aṣṭamuṣṭir bhavet kuñciḥ kuñcayo ‘ṣṭau tu puṣkalam |
puṣkalāni tu catvāri āḍhakaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
caturāḍhako bhaved droṇaḥ |
iti gaṇanayā dhānyadroṇaś ca pratimāsaṃ deyaḥ | utkṛṣṭasya tu bhṛtirūpāś ca ṣaṭ paṇā deyāḥ | anayaiva kalpanayā ṣāṇmāsikāni ṣaṭ vastrayugāni deyāni | pratimāsaṃ ṣāṇmāsyā droṇā deyāḥ | anayaivātidiśā madhyamasya paṇatrayaṃ bhṛtirūpaṃ dātavyam | ṣāṇmāsikaṃ ca vastrayugatrayaṃ māsikaṃ ca dhānyaṃ droṇatrayaṃ deyam || 7.126 ||
krayavikrayam adhvānaṃ bhaktaṃ ca saparivyayam |
yogakṣemaṃ ca saṃprekṣya vaṇijo dāpayet karān || 7.127 ||
krayavikrayam ityādi | kiyatā mūlyena krītam idaṃ vastraṃ, lavaṇādidravyaṃ vikrīyamāṇaṃ cātra kiyal labhyate, kiyaddūrād ānītaṃ, kim asya vaṇijo bhaktavyayena śākasūpādinā parivyayeṇa lagnaṃ, kim asyāraṇyādau caurādibhyo rakṣārūpeṇa kṣemapratividhānena gataṃ, ko ‘syedānīṃ lābhayoga ity etad avekṣya vaṇijaḥ karān dāpayet || 7.127 ||
yathā phalena yujyeta rājā kartā ca karmaṇām |
tathāvekṣya nṛpo rāṣṭre kalpayet satataṃ karān || 7.128 ||
yatheti | yathā rājāvekṣaṇādikarmaṇaḥ phalena, yathā ca vārṣikavaṇigādayaḥ kṛṣivāṇijyādikarmaṇāṃ phalena saṃbadhyante tathā nirūpya rājā sarvadā rājñe karān gṛhṇīyāt
|| 7.128 ||
atra dṛṣṭāntam āha –
yathālpālpam adanty ādyaṃ varyokovatsaṣaṭpadāḥ |
tathālpālpo grahītavyo rāṣṭrād rājñābdikaḥ karaḥ || 7.129 ||
yathetyādi | yathā jalaukovatsabhramarāḥ stokastokāni raktakṣīramadhūny adanty evaṃ rājñā mūladhanam anucchindatālpo’lpo rāṣṭrād ābdikaḥ karo grāhyaḥ || 7.129 ||
tam āha –
pañcāśadbhāga ādeyo rājñā paśuhiraṇyayoḥ |
dhānyānām aṣṭamo bhāgaḥ ṣaṣṭho dvādaśa eva vā || 7.130 ||
pañcāśadbhāga ityādi | mūlād adhikayoḥ paśuhiraṇyayoḥ pañcāśadbhāgo rājñā grahītavyaḥ | evaṃ dhānyānāṃ ṣaṣṭho ‘ṣṭamo dvādaśo vā bhāgo rājñā grāhyaḥ | bhūmyutkarṣāpakarṣāpekṣayā karṣaṇādikleśalāghavagauravāpekṣaś cāyaṃ bahvalpagrahaṇavikalpaḥ || 7.130 ||
ādadītātha ṣaḍbhāgaṃ drumāṃsamadhusarpiṣām |
gandhauṣadhirasānāṃ ca puṣpamūlaphalasya ca || 7.131 ||
patraśākatṛṇānāṃ ca carmaṇāṃ vaidalasya ca |
mṛnmayānāṃ ca bhāṇḍānāṃ sarvasyāśmamayasya ca || 7.132 ||
ādadītetyādi | patraśāketyādi | druśabdo ‘tra vṛkṣavācakaḥ | vṛkṣādīnāṃ saptadaśānām aśmamayāntānāṃ ṣaṣṭho bhāgo lābhād grahītavyaḥ || 7.131–132 ||
mriyamāṇo ‘py ādadīta na rājā śrotriyāt karam |
na ca kṣudhāsya saṃsīdec chrotriyo viṣaye vasan || 7.133 ||
mriyamāṇa iti | kṣīṇadhano ‘pi rājā śrotriyabrāhmaṇāt karaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt | na ca tadīyadeśe vasan śrotriyo bubhukṣayāvasādaṃ gacchet || 7.133 ||
yasya rājñas tu viṣaye śrotriyaḥ sīdati kṣudhā |
tasyāpi tat kṣudhā rāṣṭram acireṇaiva sīdati || 7.134 ||
yasyetyādi | yasya rājño deśe śrotriyaḥ kṣudhāvasanno bhavati tasya rāṣṭram api durbhikṣādibhiḥ kṣudhā śīghram avasādaṃ gacchati || 7.134 ||
yata evam ataḥ –
śrutavṛtte viditvāsya vṛttiṃ dharmyāṃ prakalpayet |
saṃrakṣet sarvataś cainaṃ pitā putram ivaurasam || 7.135 ||
śruteti | śāstrajñānānuṣṭhāne jñātvā asya tadanurūpāṃ dharmād anapetāṃ jīvikāṃ upakalpayet | caurādibhyaś cainam aurasaṃ putram iva pitā rakṣet || 7.135 ||
yasmāt –
saṃrakṣyamāṇo rājñā yaṃ kurute dharmam anvaham |
tenāyur vardhate rājño draviṇaṃ rāṣṭram eva ca || 7.136 ||
saṃrakṣyamāṇa ityādi | sa ca śrotriyo rājñā samyag rakṣyamāṇo yaṃ dharmaṃ pratyahaṃ karoti tena rājña āyurdhanarāṣṭrāṇi vardhante || 7.136 ||
yat kiṃcid api varṣasya dāpayet karasaṃjñitam |
vyavahāreṇa jīvantaṃ rājā rāṣṭre pṛthagjanam || 7.137 ||
yad iti | rājā svadeśe śākaparṇādisvalpamūlyavastukrayavikrayādinā jīvantaṃ nikṛṣṭajanaṃ svalpam api karākhyaṃ varṣeṇa dāpayet || 7.137 ||
kārukāñ chilpinaś caiva śūdrāṃś cātmopajīvinaḥ |
ekaikaṃ kārayet karma māsi māsi mahīpatiḥ || 7.138 ||
kārukān iti | kārukān sūpakārādīn śilpibhya īṣad utkṛṣṭān, śilpinaś ca lohakārādīn, śūdrāṃś ca dehakleśopajīvino bhārikādīn māsi māsy ekaṃ dinaṃ karma kārayet || 7.138 ||
nocchindyād ātmano mūlaṃ pareṣāṃ cātitṛṣṇayā |
ucchindan hy ātmano mūlam ātmānaṃ tāṃś ca pīḍayet || 7.139 ||
nocchindyād iti | prajāsnehāt karaśulkāder agrahaṇam ātmano mūlacchedaḥ, atilobhena pracurakarādigrahaṇaṃ pareṣāṃ mūllocchedaḥ, etad ubhayaṃ na kuryāt | yasmāt ātmano mūlam ucchidya kośakṣayād ātmānaṃ pīḍayet | pūrvārdhāt pareṣāṃ cety saṃbadhyate | pareṣāṃ mūlam ucchidya tāṃś ca pīḍayet || 7.139 ||
tīkṣṇaś caiva mṛduś ca syāt kāryaṃ vīkṣya mahīpatiḥ |
tīkṣṇaś caiva mṛduś caiva rājā bhavati saṃmataḥ || 7.140 ||
tīkṣṇa iti | kāryaviśeṣam avagamya kvacit kārye tīkṣṇaḥ kvacin mṛduś ca bhaven na tv ekarūpam ālambeta | yasmād uktarūpo rājā sarveṣām abhimato bhavati || 7.140 ||
amātyamukhyaṃ dharmajñaṃ prājñaṃ dāntaṃ kulodgatam |
sthāpayed āsane tasmin khinnaḥ kāryekṣaṇe nṛṇām || 7.141 ||
amātyeti | svayaṃ kāryadarśane khinnaḥ śreṣṭhāmātyaṃ dharmavidaṃ prājñaṃ jitendriyaṃ kulīnaṃ tasmin kāryadarśanasthāne niyuñjīta || 7.141 ||
evaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāyedam itikartavyam ātmanaḥ |
yuktaś caivāpramattaś ca parirakṣed imāḥ prajāḥ || 7.142 ||
evam ityādi | evam uktaprakāreṇa sarvam ātmanaḥ kāryajātaṃ saṃpādya yuktaḥ pramādarahita ātmīyāḥ prajā rakṣet || 7.142 ||
vikrośantyo yasya rāṣṭrād dhriyante dasyubhiḥ prajāḥ |
saṃpaśyataḥ sabhṛtyasya mṛtaḥ sa na tu jīvati || 7.143 ||
vikrośantya iti | yasya rājño ‘mātyādisahitasya paśyata eva rāṣṭrād ākrośantyaḥ prajās taskarādibhir api hriyante sa mṛta eva na tu jīvati | jīvanakāryābhāvāj jīvanam api tasya maraṇam evety arthaḥ || 7.143 ||
tasmāt “apramattaḥ prajā rakṣet” (7.142) iti pūrvoktaśeṣaṃ tad eva draḍhayati –
kṣatriyasya paro dharmaḥ prajānām eva pālanam |
nirdiṣṭaphalabhoktā hi rājā dharmeṇa yujyate || 7.144 ||
kṣatriyasyeti | dharmāntarebhyaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ kṣatriyasya prajārakṣaṇam eva prakṛṣṭo dharmaḥ | yasmād yathoktalakṣaṇaphalakarādibhoktā rājā dharmeṇa saṃbadhyate || 7.144 ||
utthāya paścime yāme kṛtaśaucaḥ samāhitaḥ |
hutāgnir brāhmaṇāṃś cārcya praviśet sa śubhāṃ sabhām || 7.145 ||
utthāyeti | sa bhūpo rātreḥ paścimayāma utthāya kṛtamūtrapurīṣotsargādiśauco ‘nanyamanāḥ kṛtāgnihotrāvasathyahomo brāhmaṇān pūjayitvā vāstulakṣaṇādyupetāṃ sabhām amātyādidarśanagṛhaṃ praviśet || 7.145 ||
tatra sthitaḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ pratinandya visarjayet |
visṛjya ca prajāḥ sarvā mantrayet saha mantribhiḥ || 7.146 ||
tatreti | tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ sthito darśanārtham āgatāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ saṃbhāṣaṇadarśanādibhiḥ pratinandya prasthāpayet | tāś ca prasthāpya mantribhiḥ saha saṃdhivigrahādi cintayet
|| 7.146 ||
giripṛṣṭhaṃ samāruhya prāsādaṃ vā rahogataḥ |
araṇye niḥśalāke vā mantrayed avibhāvitaḥ || 7.147 ||
giripṛṣṭham iti | parvatapṛṣṭham āruhya nirjanavanagṛhasthito ‘raṇyadeśe vā vivikte mantrabhedakāribhir anupalakṣitaḥ | karmaṇām ārambhopāyaḥ, puruṣadravyasaṃpat, deśakālavibhāgaḥ, vinipātapratīkāraḥ, kāryasiddhir ity evam pañcāṅgaṃ mantraṃ cintayet
|| 7.147 ||
yasya mantraṃ na jānanti samāgamya pṛthagjanāḥ |
na kṛtsnāṃ pṛthivīṃ bhuṅkte kośahīno ‘pi pārthivaḥ || 7.148 ||
yasyeti | yasya rājño mantribhyaḥ pṛthag anye janā militvāsya mantraṃ na jānanti sa kṣīṇakośo ‘pi sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ bhunakti || 7.148 ||
jaḍamūkāndhabadhirāṃs tairyagyonān vayo’tigān |
strīmlecchavyādhitavyaṅgān mantrakāle ‘pasārayet || 7.149 ||
jaḍamūkāndhabadhirān iti | buddhivākcakṣuḥśrotravikalān, tiryagyonibhavāṃś ca śukasārikādīn, ativṛddhastrīmleccharogyaṅgahīnāṃś ca mantrasamaye ‘pasārayet || 7.149 ||
yasmāt –
bhindanty avamatā mantraṃ tairyagyonās tathaiva ca |
striyaś caiva viśeṣeṇa tasmāt tatrādṛto bhavet || 7.150 ||
bhindantītyādi | ete jaḍādayo ‘pi prācīnaduṣkṛtavaśena prāptajaḍādibhāvā adhārmikatayaivāvamānitā mantrabhedaṃ kurvanti | tathā śukādayo ‘tivṛddhāś ca striyaś ca viśeṣenāsthirabuddhitayā mantraṃ bhindanti | tasmāt tadapasāraṇe yatnavān syāt || 7.150 ||
madhyaṃdine ‘rdharātre vā viśrānto vigataklamaḥ |
cintayed dharmakāmārthān sārdhaṃ tair eka eva vā || 7.151 ||
madhyaṃdina iti | dinamadhye rātrimadhye vā vigatacittakhedaḥ śarīrakleśarahitaś ca mantribhiḥ saha ekākī vā dharmārthakāmān anuṣṭhātuṃ cintayet || 7.151 ||
parasparaviruddhānāṃ teṣāṃ ca samupārjanam |
kanyānāṃ saṃpradānaṃ ca kumārāṇāṃ ca rakṣaṇam || 7.152 ||
paraspareti | teṣāṃ ca dharmārthakāmānāṃ prāyikavirodhavatāṃ virodhaparihāreṇārjanopāyaṃ cintayet | duhitṝṇāṃ ca dānaṃ svakāryasiddhyarthaṃ nirūpayet | kumārāṇāṃ ca putrāṇāṃ vinayādhānanītiśikṣārthaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ cintayet || 7.152 ||
dūtasaṃpreṣaṇaṃ caiva kāryaśeṣaṃ tathaiva ca |
antaḥpurapracāraṃ ca praṇidhīnāṃ ca ceṣṭitam || 7.153 ||
