dūteti | dūtānāṃ saṃguptārthalekhahāritvādinā pararāṣṭraprasthāpanaṃ cintayet | tathā prārabdhakāryaśeṣaṃ samāpayituṃ cintayet | strīṇāṃ cātiviṣamaceṣṭitatvāt | tathā hi –
śastreṇa veṇīvinigūhitena
vidūrathaṃ vai mahiṣī jaghāna |
viṣapradigdhena ca nūpureṇa
devī viraktā kila kāśirājam ||
ityādy avagamyātmarakṣārthaṃ cāntaḥpurastrīṇāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ sakhīdāsyādinā nirūpayet | cārāṇāṃ ca pratirājādiṣu niyuktānāṃ cārāntaraiś ceṣṭitam avadhārayet || 7.153 ||
kṛtsnaṃ cāṣṭavidhaṃ karma pañcavargaṃ ca tattvataḥ |
anurāgāparāgau ca pracāraṃ maṇḍalasya ca || 7.154 ||
kṛtsnam iti | aṣṭavidhaṃ karma samagraṃ cintayet | tac cośanasoktam |
ādāne ca visarge ca tathā praiṣaniṣadhayoḥ |
pañcame cārthavacane vyavahārasya cekṣaṇe ||
daṇḍaśuddhyoḥ sadā yuktas tenāṣṭagatiko nṛpaḥ |
aṣṭakarmā divaṃ yāti rājā śakrābhipūjitaḥ ||
tatrādānaṃ karādīnāṃ, visargo bhṛtyādibhyo dhanadānaṃ, praiṣo ‘mātyādīnāṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaviruddhakriyāsu, arthavacanaṃ kāryasaṃdehe rājājñayaiva tatra niyamāt, vyavahārasyekṣaṇaṃ prajānām ṛṇādivipratipattau, daṇḍaḥ parājitānāṃ śāstroktadhanagrahaṇam, śuddhiḥ pāpe karmaṇi jāte tatra prāyaścittasaṃpādanam | medhātithis tu
akṛtārambhakṛtānuṣṭhānam anuṣṭhitaviśeṣaṇaṃ karmaphalasaṃgrahas tathā sāmadānadaṇḍabhedā etad aṣṭavidhaṃ karma | atha vā vaṇikpathaḥ, udakasetubandhanaṃ, durgakaraṇaṃ, kṛtasya saṃskāranirṇayaḥ, hastibandhanaṃ, khanikhananaṃ, śūnyaniveśanaṃ, dāruvanacchedanaṃ ca |
ity āha | tathā kāpaṭikodāsthitagṛhapativaidehikatāpasavyañjanātmakaṃ pañcavidhaṃ cāravargaṃ pañcavargaśabdavācyaṃ tattvataś cintayet | tatra paramarmajñaḥ pragalbhacchātraḥ kapaṭavyavahāritvāt kāpaṭikas taṃ vṛttyarthinam arthamānābhyām upagṛhya rahasi rājā brūyāt – “yasya durvṛttaṃ paśyasti tat tadānīm eva mayi vaktavyam” iti pravrajārūḍhapatita udāsthitaḥ taṃ lokeṣu viditadoṣaṃ prajñāśaucayuktaṃ vṛttyarthinaṃ kṛtvā rahasi rājā pūrvavat brūyāt | bahūtpattikamaṭhe sthāpayet pracurasasyotpattikaṃ bhūmyantaraṃ ca tadvṛttyartham upakalpayet | sa cānyeṣām api pravrajitānāṃ rājā cārakarmakāriṇāṃ grāsācchādanādikaṃ dadyāt | karṣakaḥ kṣīṇavṛttiḥ prajñāśaucayukto gṛhapativyañjanas tam api pūrvavad uktvā svabhūmau kṛṣikarma kārayet | vāṇijakaḥ kṣīṇavṛttiḥ vaidehikavyañjanas taṃ pūrvavad uktvā dhanamānābhyām ātmīkṛtya vāṇijyaṃ kārayet | muṇḍo jaṭilo vā vṛttakāmas tāpasavyañjanaḥ so ‘pi kvacid āśrame vasan bahumuṇḍajaṭilāntare kapaṭaśiṣyagaṇavṛto guptarājopakalpitavṛttis tāpasyaṃ kuryāt | māsadvimāsāntaritaṃ prakāśaṃ badarādimuṣṭim aśnīyāt, rahasi ca rājopakalpitam āhāraṃ kalpayet | śiṣyāś cāsyātītānāgatajñānādikaṃ khyāpayeyuḥ | te ca bahulokaveṣṭanam āsādya sarveṣāṃ viśvasanīyatvāt sarvakāryam akāryaṃ ca pṛcchanti, anyasya kukriyādikaṃ kathayanty evaṃrūpaṃ pañcavargaṃ yathāvac cintayet | evaṃ pañcavargaṃ prakalpya tenaiva pañcavargadvāreṇa pratirājasyātmīyānāṃ cāmātyādīnāṃ cānurāgavirāgau jñātvā tadanurūpaṃ cintayet | vakṣyamāṇasya rājamaṇḍalasya pracāraṃ “kaḥ saṃdhyarthī ko vā vigrahārthī” ityādikaṃ cintayet | taṃ ca jñātvā tadanuguṇaṃ cintayet
|| 7.154 ||
madhyamasya pracāraṃ ca vijigīṣoś ca ceṣṭitam |
udāsīnapracāraṃ ca śatroś caiva prayatnataḥ || 7.155 ||
madhyamasyeti | arivijigīṣor yo bhūmyanantaraḥ saṃhatayor anugrahasamartho nigrahe cāsaṃhatayoḥ samarthaḥ sa madhyamas tasya pracāraṃ cintayet | tathā prajñotsāhaguṇaprakṛtisamartho vijigīṣus tasya ceṣṭitaṃ cintayet | tathā vijigīṣumadhyamānāṃ saṃhatānām anugrahe samartho nigrahe cāsaṃhatānāṃ samartha udāsīnas tasya pracāraṃ cintayet | śatroś ca trividhasyāpi sahajasyākṛtrimasya bhūmyanantarasya ca pūrvāpekṣayā prayatnataḥ pracāraṃ cintayet || 7.155 ||
etāḥ prakṛtayo mūlaṃ maṇḍalasya samāsataḥ |
aṣṭau cānyāḥ samākhyātā dvādaśaiva tu tāḥ smṛtāḥ || 7.156 ||
etā ityādi | etā madhyamādyāś catasraḥ prakṛtayaḥ saṃkṣepeṇa maṇḍalasya mūlaṃ aparāsām abhidhāsyamānaprakṛtīnām amātyādīnāṃ mūlam ity ucyate | anyāś cāṣṭau samākhyātāḥ | tad yathā – agrato ‘ribhūmīnāṃ mitraṃ, arimitraṃ, mitramitram arimitramitraṃ cety evaṃ catasraḥ, prakṛtayo bhavanti | paścāc ca pārṣṇigrāhaḥ, ākrandaḥ, pārṣṇigrāhāsāraḥ, ākrandāsāra iti catasraḥ evam aṣṭau prakṛtayo bhavanti | pūrvoktābhiś ca madhyamārivijigīṣūdāsīnaśatrurūpābhiḥ mūlaprakṛtibhiḥ saha dvādaśaitāḥ prakṛtayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 7.156 ||
amātyarāṣṭradurgārthadaṇḍākhyāḥ pañca cāparāḥ |
pratyekaṃ kathitā hy etāḥ saṃkṣepeṇa dvisaptatiḥ || 7.157 ||
amātyeti | āsāṃ mūlaprakṛtīnāṃ catasṝṇām aṣṭānāṃ śākhāprakṛtīnām uktānām ekaikasyāḥ prakṛter amātyadeśadurgakośadurgadaṇḍākhyāḥ pañca dravyaprakṛtayo bhavanti | etāś ca pañca dvādaśānāṃ pratyekaṃ bhavantyo dvādaśaguṇajātāḥ ṣaṣṭir eva dravyaprakṛtayo bhavanti | tathā mūlaprakṛtibhiś catasṛbhiḥ śākhāprakṛtibhiś cāṣṭābhiḥ saha saṃkṣepato dvisaptatiprakṛtayo munibhiḥ kathitāḥ || 7.157 ||
anantaram ariṃ vidyād arisevinam eva ca |
arer anantaraṃ mitram udāsīnaṃ tayoḥ param || 7.158 ||
anantaram iti | vijigīṣor nṛpasyānantaritaṃ caturdiśam apy ariprakṛtiṃ vijānīyāt | tathā tatsevinam apy arim eva vidyāt | arer anantaraṃ vijigīṣor nṛpasyaikāntaraṃ mitraprakṛtiṃ vidyāt | tayoś cārimitrayoḥ paraṃ vijigīṣor udāsīnaprakṛtiṃ vidyāt | āsām eva prakṛtīnām agrapaścādbhāvabhedena vyapadeśabhedaḥ | tatrāgravartino ‘rivyapadeśa eva | paścādvartinas tv aritve ‘pi pārṣṇigrāhavyapadeśaḥ || 7.158 ||
tān sarvān abhisaṃdadhyāt sāmādibhir upakramaiḥ |
vyastaiś caiva samastaiś ca pauruṣeṇa nayena ca || 7.159 ||
tān iti | tān sarvān nṛpatīn sāmadānabhedadaṇḍair upāyair yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vyastaiḥ samastair vaśīkuryāt | atha vā pauruṣeṇa daṇḍenaiva nayena sāmnaiva vā kevalenātmavaśān kuryāt | tathā coktam “sāmadaṇḍau praśaṃsanti nityaṃ rāṣṭrābhivṛddhaye” (7.109) || 7.159 ||
saṃdhiṃ ca vigrahaṃ caiva yānam āsanam eva ca |
dvidhībhāvaṃ saṃśrayaṃ ca ṣaḍguṇāṃś cintayet sadā || 7.160 ||
saṃdhim iti | tatrobhayānugrahārthaṃ hastyaśvarathahiraṇyādinibandhanenāvābhyām anyonyasyopakartavyam iti niyamabandhaḥ saṃdhiḥ, vairaṃ vigrahācaraṇādyādhikyena, yānaṃ śatruṃ prati gamanam, upekṣaṇam āsanaṃ, svārthasiddhaye balasya dvidhākaraṇaṃ dvaidhībhāvaḥ, śatrupīḍitasya prabalatararājāntarāśrayaṇaṃ saṃśrayaḥ, etān guṇān upakārān sarvadā cintayet | yadguṇāśrayaṇe saty ātmana upacayaḥ parasyāpacayas taṃ guṇam āśrayet
|| 7.160||
āsanaṃ caiva yānaṃ ca saṃdhiṃ vigraham eva ca |
kāryaṃ vīkṣya prayuñjīta dvaidhaṃ saṃśrayam eva ca || 7.161 ||
āsanam iti | saṃdhyādiguṇānāṃ nairapekṣyeṇānuṣthānam anantaram uktaṃ taducitānuṣṭhānārtho ‘yam ārambhaḥ | ātmasamṛddhiparahānyādikaṃ kāryaṃ vīkṣya saṃdhāyāsanaṃ vigṛhya vā yānaṃ dvaidhībhāvasaṃśraye ca kenacit saṃdhiṃ kenacid vigraham ityādikam anutiṣṭhet || 7.161 ||
saṃdhiṃ tu dvividhaṃ vidyād rājā vigraham eva ca |
ubhe yānāsane caiva dvividhaḥ saṃśrayaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.162 ||
saṃdhiṃ tv iti | saṃdhyādīn ṣaḍ eva guṇān dviprakārāñ jānīyād ity avivakṣārtham || 7.162 ||
samānayānakarmā ca viparītas tathaiva ca |
tadā tv āyatisaṃyuktaḥ saṃdhir jñeyo dvilakṣaṇaḥ || 7.163 ||
samāneti | tātkālikaphalalābhārtham uttarakālīnaphalalābhārthaṃ vā yatra rājāntareṇa sahānyaṃ prati yānādi karma kriyate sa samānayānakarmā saṃdhiḥ | yaḥ punaḥ ‘tvam atra yāhi, aham atra yāsyāmi’ iti sāṃpratikottarakālīnaphalārthitayaiva kriyate so ‘samānayānakarmety evaṃ dviprakāraḥ saṃdhir jñātavyaḥ || 7.163 ||
svayaṃkṛtaś ca kāryārtham akāle kāla eva vā |
mitrasya caivāpakṛte dvividho vigrahaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.164 ||
svayam ityādi | śatrujayarūpaprayojanārthaṃ śatror vyasanādikam ākalayya vakṣyamāṇamārgaśīrṣādikālād anyadā yathoktakāla eva vā svayaṃkṛta ity eko vigrahaḥ | apakṛtam apakāraḥ, mitrasyāpakāre rājāntareṇa kṛte mitrarakṣaṇārtham aparo vigraha ity evaṃ dvividho vigrahaḥ | govindarājena tu ‘mitreṇa caivāpakṛte’ iti paṭhitaṃ vyākhyātaṃ ca | ‘yaḥ parasya śatruḥ sa vijigīṣor mitraṃ tenāpakāre kriyamāṇe vyasanini śatrāv’ iti |
tasmāl likhitapāṭhārthau vṛddhair govindarājataḥ |
medhātithiprabhṛtibhir likhitau svīkṛtau mayā ||
|| 7.164 ||
ekākinaś cātyayike kārye prāpte yadṛcchayā |
saṃhatasya ca mitreṇa dvividhaṃ yānam ucyate || 7.165 ||
ekākina ityādi | ātyayikaṃ kāryaṃ śatror vyasanādikaṃ tasminn akasmāj jāte śaktasyaikākino yānam, aśaktasya mitrasahitasyety evaṃ yānaṃ dvividham abhidhīyate || 7.165 ||
kṣīṇasya caiva kramaśo daivāt pūrvakṛtena vā |
mitrasya cānurodhena dvividhaṃ smṛtam āsanam || 7.166 ||
kṣīṇasyeti | prāgjanmārjitena duṣkṛtena aihikena vā pūrvakṛtena kramaśaḥ kṣīṇahastyaśvakośādikasya samṛddhasyāpi vā mitrānurodhena tatkāryarakṣārtham ity evaṃ dvividham āsanaṃ munibhiḥ smṛtam || 7.166 ||
balasya svāminaś caiva sthitiḥ kāryārthasiddhaye |
dvividhaṃ kīrtyate dvaidhaṃ ṣāḍguṇyaguṇavedibhiḥ || 7.167 ||
balasyeti | sādhyasvaprayojanasiddhyarthaṃ balasya hastyaśvādeḥ senādhipatyādhiṣṭhitasya ekatra śatrunṛpopadravavāraṇārtham avasthānam anyatra durgadeśe rājñaḥ katicidbalādhiṣṭhitasyāvasthānam evaṃ saṃdhyādiguṇaṣaṭkopakārajñaiḥ dvividhaṃ dvaidhaṃ kīrtyate || 7.167 ||
arthasaṃpādanārthaṃ ca pīḍyamānasya śatrubhiḥ |
sādhuṣu vyapadeśārthaṃ dvividhaḥ saṃśrayaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.168 ||
artheti | śatrubhiḥ pīḍyamānasya śatrupīḍānivṛttyākhyaprayojanasiddhyartham, asatyām api vā tatkāle pīḍāyāṃ bhāviśatrupīḍanaśaṅkayā amukamayaṃ mahābalaṃ nṛpatim āśrita iti sarvatra vyapadeśotpādanārthaṃ balavantam upāśrayaṇam, evaṃ dvividhaḥ saṃśrayaḥ smṛtaḥ
|| 7.168 ||
yadāvagacched āyatyām ādhikyaṃ dhruvam ātmanaḥ |
tadātve cālpikāṃ pīḍāṃ tadā saṃdhiṃ samāśrayet || 7.169 ||
yadetyādi | yadā yuddhottarakāle niścitam ātmana ādhikyaṃ jānīyāt tadātve tatkāle ‘lpadhanādyupakṣayaḥ tadā tv alpam aṅgīkṛtyāpi saṃdhim āśrayet || 7.169 ||
yadā prahṛṣṭā manyeta sarvās tu prakṛtīr bhṛśam |
atyucchritaṃ tathātmānaṃ tadā kurvīta vigraham || 7.170 ||
yadeti | yadāmātyādikāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtīr dānasaṃmānādyair atīva tuṣṭā manyeta ātmānaṃ ca hastyaśvakośādiśaktitrayeṇopacitaṃ tadā vigraham āśrayet || 7.170 ||
yadā manyeta bhāvena hṛṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ balaṃ svakam |
parasya viparītaṃ ca tadā yāyād ripuṃ prati || 7.171 ||
yadetyādi | yadātmīyam amātyādisainyaṃ harṣayuktaṃ dhanādinā puṣṭaṃ tattvato jānīyāt, śatroś cāmātyādibalaṃ viparītaṃ tadā taṃ lakṣīkṛtya yāyāt || 7.171 ||
yadā tu syāt parikṣīṇo vāhanena balena ca |
tadāsīta prayatnena śanakaiḥ sāṃtvayann arīn || 7.172 ||
yadetyādi | yadā punar vāhanena hastyaśvādinā balena cāmātyādivipattyādiparikṣīṇo bhavet tadā sāmopadāpradānādinā śatrūn prasāntvayan prayatnenāsanam āśrayet || 7.172 ||
manyetāriṃ yadā rājā sarvathā balavattaram |
tadā dvidhā balaṃ kṛtvā sādhayet kāryam ātmanaḥ || 7.173 ||
manyeteti | yadā rājā sarvaprakāreṇa balīyāṃsam aśaktyasaṃdhānaṃ ca śatruṃ budhyet tadā katicidbalasahitaḥ svayaṃ durgam āśrayet | balaikadeśena ca śatruvirodham ācaret | evaṃ dvidhā balaṃ kṛtvā mitrasaṃgrahādikaṃ svakāryaṃ sādhayet || 7.173 ||
yadā parabalānāṃ tu gamanīyatamo bhavet |
tadā tu saṃśrayet kṣipraṃ dhārmikaṃ balinaṃ nṛpam || 7.174 ||
yadeti | yadā tu sainyānām amātyādiprakṛtidoṣādinātiśayena grāhyo bhavati balaṃ dvaidhaṃ vidhāya durgāśrayaṇenāpi nātmarakṣākṣamas tadā śīghram eva dhārmikaṃ balavantaṃ ca rājānam āśrayet || 7.174 ||
kīdṛśaṃ taṃ balavantam ity āha –
nigrahaṃ prakṛtīnāṃ ca kuryād yo ‘ribalasya ca |
upaseveta taṃ nityaṃ sarvayatnair guruṃ yathā || 7.175 ||
nigraham iti | yāsāṃ doṣeṇāsau gamanīyatamo jātas tāsāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ, yasmāc ca śatrubalād asya bhayam utpannaṃ tayor dvayor api yaḥ saṃśrito nigrahakṣamas taṃ nṛpaṃ sarvayatnair gurum iva nityaṃ seveta || 7.175 ||
yadi tatrāpi saṃpaśyed doṣaṃ saṃśrayakāritam |
suyuddham eva tatrāpi nirviśaṅkaḥ samācaret || 7.176 ||
yadīti | agatikā hi gatiḥ saṃśrayo nāma | tatrāpi yadi saṃśrayakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ paśyet tadā niḥsaṃśayo bhūtvā śobhanam eva yuddhaṃ tasmin kāle samācaret | durbalenāpi balavato jayadarśanān nihatasya ca svargaprāpteḥ || 7.176 ||
sarvopāyais tathā kuryān nītijñaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
yathāsyābhyadhikā na syur mitrodāsīnaśatravaḥ || 7.177 ||
sarvopāyair iti | sarvaiḥ sāmādibhir upāyair nītijño rājā tathā yateta, yathāsya mitrodāsīnaśatravo ‘bhyadhikā na bhavanti | ādhikye hi teṣām asau grāhyo bhavati, dhanalobhena mitrasyāpi śātravāpatteḥ || 7.177 ||
āyatiṃ sarvakāryāṇāṃ tadātvaṃ ca vicārayet |
atītānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ guṇadoṣau ca tattvataḥ || 7.178 ||
āyatim iti | sarveṣāṃ kāryāṇām alpānāṃ bahūnām apy āyatim uttarakālaṃ guṇaṃ doṣaṃ vicārayet | vartamānakālaṃ ca śīghrasaṃpādanādyarthaṃ vicārayet | atītānāṃ ca sarvakāryāṇāṃ guṇadoṣau kim eṣāṃ kṛtaṃ vighaṭitaṃ kiṃ vāvaśiṣṭam ity evaṃ yathāvad vicārayet || 7.178 ||
yasmāt –
āyatyāṃ guṇadoṣajñas tadātve kṣipraniścayaḥ |
atīte kāryaśeṣajñaḥ śatrubhir nābhibhūyate || 7.179 ||
āyatyām iti | yaḥ kāryāṇām āgāmikaguṇadośajñaḥ sa guṇavat kāryam ārabhate doṣavat parityajati | yaś ca vartamānakāle kṣipram evāvadhārya kāryaṃ karoti atīte kārye yaḥ kāryaśeṣajñaḥ sa tatkāryasamāptau tatphalaṃ labhate | yasmād evaṃvidhakālatrayasāvadhānatvān na kadācic chatrubhir abhibhūyate || 7.179 ||
kiṃ bahunā –
yathainaṃ nābhisaṃdadhyur mitrodāsīnaśatravaḥ |
tathā sarvaṃ saṃvidadhyād eṣa sāmāsiko nayaḥ || 7.180 ||
yathetyādi | yathainaṃ rājānaṃ mitrādaya uktā na bādheraṃs tathā sarvasaṃvidhānaṃ kuryāt | ity eṣa sāṃkṣepiko nayo nītiḥ || 7.180 ||
yadā tu yānam ātiṣṭhed arirāṣṭraṃ prati prabhuḥ |
tadādena vidhānena yāyād aripuraṃ śanaiḥ || 7.181 ||
yadeti | yadā punaḥ śaktaḥ san śatrurāṣṭraṃ prati yātrām ārabhet tadānena vakṣyamānaprakāreṇa śatrudeśam atvaramāṇo gacchet || 7.181 ||
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi yāyād yātrāṃ mahīpatiḥ |
phālguṇaṃ vātha caitraṃ va sāsau praty yathabalam || 7.182 ||
mārgaśīrṣa iti | yaś caturaṅgabalopeto rājā karirathāgamanavilambena vilambitaprayāṇas tathā haimantikasasyabahulaṃ ca pararāṣṭraṃ jigamiṣuḥ samupagamanāya śobhane mārgaśīrṣe māsi yātrāṃ kuryāt | yaḥ punar aśvabalaprāyo nṛpatiḥ śīghragatir vā sarvasasyabahulaṃ pararāṣṭraṃ yiyāsuḥ sa phālgune caitre vā māsi svabalayogyakālānatikrameṇa yāyāt | ata eva manvarthavyāpāraparaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa yājñavalkyavacanam “yadā sasyaguṇopetaṃ pararāṣṭraṃ tadā vrajet” (YDh 1.348) || 7.182 ||
anyeṣv api tu kāleṣu yadā paśyed dhruvaṃ jayam |
tadā yāyād vigṛhyaiva vyasane cotthite ripoḥ || 7.183 ||
anyeṣv iti | uktakālavyatirikteṣu yadātmano niścitaṃ jayam avagacchet tadā svabalayogyakāle grīṣmādāv api hastyaśvādibalaṃ prāyo vigṛhyaiva yātrāṃ kuryāt | śatroś cāmātyādiprakṛtigocaradaṇḍapāruṣyādivyasane jāte ‘ripakṣabhūtāyāṃ tatprakṛtāv apy uktakālād anyatrāpi yāyāt || 7.183 ||
kṛtvā vidhānaṃ mūle tu yātrikaṃ ca yathāvidhi |
upagṛhyāspadaṃ caiva cārān samyag vidhāya ca || 7.184 ||
saṃśodhya trividhaṃ mārgaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ ca balaṃ svakam |
sāṃparāyikakalpena yāyād aripuraṃ śanaiḥ || 7.185 ||
kṛtvetyādi | saṃśodhyeti | mūle svīyadurgarāṣṭrarūpe pārṣṇigrāhasaṃvidhānaṃ pradhānapuruṣādhiṣṭhitarakṣārthaṃ sainyaikadeśasthāpanarūpaṃ pratividhānaṃ kṛtvā yātropayogi ca vāhanāyudhavarmayātrāvidhānaṃ yathāśāstraṃ kṛtvā paramaṇḍalagatasya ca yenāsyāvasthānaṃ bhavati tad upagṛhya tadīyān bhṛtyapakṣān ātmasātkṛtvā cārāṃś ca kāpaṭikādīn śatrudeśavārtājñāpanārthaṃ prasthāpya samyaktayā jāṅgalānūpāṭavikaviṣayabhedena trividhaṃ panthānaṃ mārgaṃ śodhitatarugulmādicchedanimnonnatādisamīkaraṇādinā saṃśodhya tathā hastyaśvarathapadātisenākarmakarātmakaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ balaṃ yathopayogam āhārauṣadhasatkārādinā saṃśodhya sāṃparāyikaṃ saṃparāyaḥ saṃgrāmas tadupacitavidhinā śatrudeśam atvarayā gacchet || 7.184–185 ||
śatrusevini mitre ca gūḍhe yuktataro bhavet |
gatapratyāgate caiva sa hi kaṣṭataro ripuḥ || 7.186 ||
śatruseviṇīti | yan mitraṃ gūḍhaṃ kṛtvā śatruṃ sevate, yaś ca bhṛtyādiḥ pūrvaṃ virāgād gataḥ paścād āgatas tayoḥ sāvadhāno bhavet | yasmāt tāv atiśayena durnigraho ripuḥ || 7.186 ||
daṇḍavyūhena tan mārgaṃ yāyāt tu śakaṭena vā |
varāhamakarābhyāṃ vā sūcyā vā garuḍena vā || 7.187 ||
daṇḍeti | daṇḍākṛtivyūharacanādiḥ daṇḍavyūhaḥ | evaṃ śakaṭādivyūhā api | tatrāgre balādhyakṣo madhye rājā paścāt senāpatiḥ pārśvayor hastinas tatsamīpe ghoṭakās tataḥ padātayaḥ ity evaṃ kṛtaracano dīrghaḥ sarvataḥ samavinyāso daṇḍavyūhas tena tad yātavyaṃ mārgaṃ sarvato bhaye sati yāyāt | sūcyākārāgraḥ paścāt pṛthulaḥ śakaṭavyūhas tena pṛṣṭhato bhaye sati gacchet | sūkṣmamukhapaścādbhāgaḥ pṛthumadhyo varāhavyūhaḥ | eṣa eva pṛthutaramadhyo garuḍavyūhas tābhyāṃ pārśvayor bhaye sati vrajet | varāhaviparyayeṇa makaravyūhas tenāgre paścāc cobhayatra bhaye sati gacchet | pipīlikāpaṅktir ivāgrapaścādbhāvena saṃhatarūpatayā yatra yatra sainikāvasthānaṃ sa śīghrapravīrapuruṣamukhaḥ sūcīvyūhas tenāgrato bhaye sati yāyāt || 7.187 ||
yataś ca bhayam āśaṅket tato vistārayed balam |
padmena caiva vyūhena niviśeta sadā svayam || 7.188 ||
yata ityādi | yasyā diśaḥ śatrubhayam āśaṅketa tasyām eva balaṃ vistārayet, samavistṛtaparimaṇḍalo madhyopaviṣṭajigīṣuḥ padmavyūhena purān nirgatya sarvadā kapaṭaniveśanaṃ kuryāt || 7.188 ||
senāpatibalādhyakṣau sarvadikṣu niveśayet |
yataś ca bhayam āśaṅket prācīṃ tāṃ kalpayed diśam || 7.189 ||
senāpatīti | hastyaśvarathapadātyātmakasyāṅgadaśakasyaikaḥ pati kāryaḥ | sa ca pattika ucyate | pattikadaśakasyaikaḥ patiḥ senāpatir ucyate | taddaśakasyaikaḥ senānāyakaḥ, sa eva ca balādhyakṣaḥ | senāpatibalādhyakṣau samastāsu dikṣu saṃgharṣayuddhārthaṃ niyojayet | yasyāś ca diśo yadā bhayam āśaṅket tadā tām agre diśaṃ kuryāt || 7.189 ||
gulmāṃś ca sthāpayed āptān kṛtasaṃjñān samantataḥ |
sthāne yuddhe ca kuśalān abhīrūn avikāriṇaḥ || 7.190 ||
gulmān ityādi | gulmān sainyaikadeśān āptapuruṣādhiṣṭhitān sthānāpasaraṇayuddhārthaṃ kṛtabherīpaṭahaśaṅkhādisaṃketān avasthānayuddhayoḥ pravīṇān nirbhayān avyabhicāriṇaḥ senāpatibalādhyakṣān dūrataḥ sarvadikṣu pārakyapraveśavāraṇāya śatruceṣṭāparijñānāya ca niyojayet || 7.190 ||
saṃhatān yodhayed alpān kāmaṃ vistārayed bahūn |
sūcyā vajreṇa caivaitān vyūhena vyūhya yodhayet || 7.191 ||
saṃhatān iti | alpān yodhān saṃhatān kṛtvā bahūn punar yatheṣṭaṃ vistārayet | sūcyā pūrvoktayā vajrākhyena vyūhena tridhā vyavasthitabalena racayitvā yodhān yodhayet
|| 7.191 ||
syandanāśvaiḥ same yudhyed anūpe naudvipais tathā |
vṛkṣagulmāvṛte cāpair asicarmāyudhaiḥ sthale || 7.192 ||
syandanāśvair ityādi | samabhūbhāge rathāśvena yudhyeta | tatra tena yuddhasāmarthyāt tadanugatodake naikāhastibhiḥ | tarugulmāvṛte dhanvibhir gartakaṇṭakapāṣāṇādirahitasthale khaḍgaphalakakuntādyair āyudhair yudhyeta || 7.192 ||
kurukṣetrāṃś ca matsyāṃś ca pañcālāñ śūrasenajān |
dīrghāṃl laghūṃś caiva narān agrānīkeṣu yojayet || 7.193 ||
kurukṣetrān iti | kurukṣetrabhavān, matsyān virāṭadeśanivāsinaḥ, pañcālān kānyakubjāhicchatrodbhavān, śūrasenajān māthurān prāyeṇa pṛthuśarīraśauryāhaṃkārayogāt senāgre yojayet | tathānyadeśodbhavān api dīrghalaghudehān manuṣyān yuddhābhimāninaḥ senāgra eva yojayet || 7.193 ||
praharṣayed balaṃ vyūhya tāṃś ca samyak parīkṣayet |
ceṣṭāś caiva vijānīyād arīn yodhayatām api || 7.194 ||
praharṣayed ityādi | balaṃ racayitvā jaye dharmalābhaḥ abhimukhahatasya svargaprāptiḥ palāyane tu prabhuduritagrahaṇaṃ narakagamanaṃ cetyādyarthavādair yuddhārthaṃ protsāhayet | tāṃś ca yodhān kenābhiprāyeṇa hṛṣyanti kupyanti veti parīkṣayet | tathā yodhānām aribhiḥ saha yudhyamānānām api sopadhyanupadhiceṣṭā budhyeta || 7.194 ||
uparudhyārim āsīta rāṣṭraṃ cāsyopapīḍayet |
dūṣayec cāsya satataṃ yavasānnodakendhanam || 7.195 ||
upetyādi | durgāśrayam adurgāśrayaṃ vā ripum ayudhyamānam apy āveṣṭyāsīta asya ca deśam utsādayet | tathā ghāsānnodakendhanāni sarvadāsyāpadravyasaṃmiśraṇādinā dūṣayet || 7.195 ||
bhindyāc caiva taḍāgāni prākāraparikhās tathā |
samavaskandayec cainaṃ rātrau vitrāsayet tathā || 7.196 ||
bhindyād ityādi | śatror upajīvyāni taḍāgādīni nāśayet, tathā durgaprākārādīn bhindyāt, tatparikhāś ca bhedena pūraṇādinā nirudakāḥ kuryāt | evaṃ ca śatrūn aśaṅkitam eva samyag avaskandayet tathā śaktiṃ gṛhṇīyāt | rātrau ca ḍhakkākāhalikādiśabdena vitrāsayet || 7.196 ||
tadānīṃ ca –
upajapyān upajaped budhyetaiva ca tatkṛtam |
yukte ca daive yudhyeta jayaprepsur apetabhīḥ || 7.197 ||
upaetyādi | upajāpārhān ripuvaṃśyān rājyārthinaḥ kṣubdhān amātyādīṃś ca bhedayet | upajapenātmīyakṛtāṃ ca teṣāṃ ceṣṭāṃ jānīyāt | śubhagrahadaśādinā śubhaphalayukte daive ‘vagate nirbhayo jayepsur yudhyeta || 7.197 ||
sāmnā dānena bhedena samastair atha vā pṛthak |
vijetuṃ prayatetārīn na yuddhena kadācana || 7.198 ||
sāmnetyādi | prītyādaradarśanahitakathanādyātmakena sāmnā hastyaśvarathahiraṇyādīnāṃ ca dānena tatprakṛtīnāṃ tadanuyāyināṃ ca rājyārthināṃ bhedena | etaiḥ samastair vyastair vā yathāsāmartham arīñ jetuṃ yatnaṃ kuryān na punaḥ kadācid yuddhena || 7.198 ||
anityo vijayo yasmād dṛśyate yudhyamānayoḥ |
parājayaś ca saṃgrāme tasmād yuddhaṃ vivarjayet || 7.199 ||
anitya iti | yasmād yudhyamānayor bahulabalatvādyalpabalatvādyanapekṣam evāniyamena jayaparājayau dṛśyete, tasmāt saty upāyāntare yuddhaṃ pariharet || 7.199 ||
trayāṇām apy upāyānāṃ pūrvoktānām asaṃbhave |
tathā yudhyeta saṃpanno vijayeta ripūn yathā || 7.200 ||
trayāṇām ityādi | purvoktānāṃ trayāṇām api sāmādīnām upāyānām asādhakatve sati jayaparājayasaṃdehe ‘pi tathā prayatnavān samyag yudhyeta yathā śatrūñ jayet | yato jaye ‘rthalābho ‘bhimukhamaraṇe ca svargaprāptiḥ | “niḥsaṃdigdhe tu parājaye yuddhād apasaraṇaṃ sādhīyaḥ | yathā vakṣyati ‘ātmānaṃ satatam rakṣet’ ” (7.213) iti medhātithi-govindarājau
|| 7.200 ||
jitvā saṃpūjayed devān brāhmaṇāṃś caiva dhārmikān |
pradadyāt parihārāṃś ca khyāpayed abhayāni ca || 7.201 ||
jitveti | pararāṣṭraṃ jitvā tatra ye devās tān dharmapradhānāṃś ca brāhmaṇān bhūmisuvarṇādidānasaṃmānādibhiḥ pūjayet | jitadravyaikadeśadānādinaiva cedaṃ pūjanam | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ (1.323) |
nātaḥ parataro dharmo nṛpāṇāṃ yad raṇārjitam |
viprebhyo dīyate dravyaṃ prajābhyaś cābhayaṃ sadā ||
tathā devabrāhmaṇārthaṃ mayaitad dattam iti taddeśavāsinṃ parihārān dadyāt | tathā svāmibhaktyā yair asmākam apakṛtaṃ teṣāṃ mayā kṣāntam idānīṃ nirbhayāḥ santaḥ sukhaṃ svavyāpāram anutiṣṭhantv ity abhayāni khyāpayet || 7.201 ||
sarveṣāṃ tu viditvaiṣāṃ samāsena cikīrṣitam |
sthāpayet tatra tadvaṃśyaṃ kuryāc ca samayakriyām || 7.202 ||
sarveṣām iti | eṣāṃ śatrunṛpāmātyānāṃ sarveṣām eva saṃkṣepato ‘bhiprāyaṃ jñātvā tasmin rāṣṭre balanihatarājavaṃśyam eva rājye ‘bhiṣecayet | ‘idaṃ kāryaṃ tvayā, idaṃ na’ iti tasya tadamātyānāṃ ca niyamaṃ kuryāt || 7.202 ||
pramāṇāni ca kurvīta teṣāṃ dharmyān yathoditān |
ratnaiś ca pūjayed enaṃ pradhānapuruṣaiḥ saha || 7.203 ||
pramāṇānīti | teṣāṃ ca parakīyānāṃ darmād anapetān ācārān deśadharmatayā śāstreṇābhyupetān pramāṇīkuryāt | enaṃ cābhiṣiktam amātyādibhiḥ saha ratnādidānena pūjayet || 7.203 ||
yasmāt –
ādānam apriyakaraṃ dānaṃ ca priyakārakam |
abhīpsitānām arthānāṃ kāle yuktaṃ praśasyate || 7.204 ||
ādānam iti | yady apy abhilaṣitānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ grahaṇam apriyakaraṃ dānaṃ ca priyakārakam ity utsargas tathāpi samayaviśeṣe dānam ādānaṃ ca praśasyate | tasmāt tasmin kāla evaṃ pūjayet || 7.204 ||
sarvaṃ karmedam āyattaṃ vidhāne daivamānuṣe |
tayor daivam acintyaṃ tu mānuṣe vidyate kriyā || 7.205 ||
sarvam ityādi | yat kiṃcit saṃpādyaṃ tat prāgjanmārjitasukṛtaduṣkṛtarūpe karmaṇi daivaśabdābhidheye, tathehalokārjitamānuṣaśabdavācye vyāpāre āyattaṃ, tayor madhye daivaṃ cintayitum aśakyam | mānuṣe tu paryālocanam asti | ato mānuṣadvāreṇaiva kāryasiddhaye yatitavyam || 7.205 ||
saha vāpi vrajed yuktaḥ saṃdhiṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ |
mitraṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhūmiṃ vā saṃpaśyaṃs trividham phalam || 7.206 ||
sahetyādi | evam upakramaṇīye na śatruṇā yuddhaṃ kāryaṃ | yadi vā sa eva mitraṃ tena ca dattaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bhūmyekadeśo vārpitaṃ etat trayaṃ yātrāphalam | tena saha saṃdhiṃ kṛtvā yatnavān vrajet || 7.206 ||
pārṣṇigrāhaṃ ca saṃprekṣya tathākrandaṃ ca maṇḍale |
mitrād athāpy amitrād vā yātrāphalam avāpnuyāt || 7.207 ||
pārṣṇigrāham ityādi | vijīgīṣor ariṃ prati niryātasya yaḥ pṛṣṭhavartī nṛpatir deśākramaṇādy ācarati sa pārṣṇigrāhas tasya tathā kurvato yo niyāmakas tasyānantaro nṛpatiḥ sa ākrandas tāv apekṣya yātavyam | mitrībhūtād amitrād vā yātrāphalaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tāv anapekṣya gṛhṇan kadācit tatkṛtena doṣeṇa gṛhyate || 7.207 ||
hiraṇyabhūmisaṃprāptyā pārthivo na tathaidhate |
yathā mitraṃ dhruvaṃ labdhvā kṛśam apy āyatikṣamam || 7.208 ||
hiraṇyabhūmīti | suvarṇabhūmilābhena tathā rājā na vṛddhim eti yathedānīṃ kṛśam apy āgāmikāle vṛddhiyutaṃ sthiraṃ mitraṃ labdhvā vardhate || 7.208 ||
dharmajñaṃ ca kṛtajñaṃ ca tuṣṭaprakṛtim eva ca |
anuraktaṃ sthirārambhaṃ laghu mitraṃ praśasyate || 7.209 ||
dharmajñam iti | dharmajñaṃ, kṛtopakārasya smartṛ, sānurāgam anuraktaṃ, sthirakāryārambhaṃ, prītimatprakṛtiṃ yat, tan mitram atiśayena śasyate || 7.209 ||
prājñaṃ kulīnaṃ śūraṃ ca dakṣaṃ dātāram eva ca |
kṛtajñaṃ dhṛtimantaṃ ca kaṣṭam āhur ariṃ budhāḥ || 7.210 ||
prājñam ityādi | vidvāṃsaṃ, mahākulaṃ, vikrāntaṃ, caturaṃ, dātāraṃ, upakārasmartāraṃ, sukhaduḥkhayor ekarūpaṃ śatruṃ durucchedaṃ paṇḍitā vadanti | tenaivaṃvidhaśatruṇā saha saṃdhātavyam || 7.210 ||
āryatā puruṣajñānaṃ śauryaṃ karuṇaveditā |
sthaulalakṣyaṃ ca satatam udāsīnaguṇodayaḥ || 7.211 ||
āryatetyādi | sādhutvaṃ, puruṣaviśeṣajñatā, vikrāntatvaṃ, kṛpālutvaṃ, sarvadā ca sthaulalakṣyaṃ bahupradatvam | ata eva “syur vadānyasthūlalakṣyadānaśauṇḍā bahuprade” ity ābhidhānikāḥ | sthaulalakṣyam arthe ‘sūkṣmadarśitvam iti tu medhātithi-govindarājayoḥ padārthakathanam anāgamam, etad udāsīnaguṇasāmagryaṃ, tasmād evaṃvidham udāsīnam āśrityoktalakṣaṇenāpy ariṇā saha yoddhavyam || 7.211 ||
kṣemyāṃ sasyapradāṃ nityaṃ paśuvṛddhikarīm api |
parityajen nṛpo bhūmim ātmārtham avicārayan || 7.212 ||
kṣemyam iti | anāmayādikalyāṇakṣamām api, nadīmātṛkatayā sarvadā sarvasasyapradām api, pracuratṛṇādiyogāt paśuvṛddhikarīm api bhūmim ātmarakṣārtham avilambamāno rājā nijarakṣāprakārāntarābhāvād parityajet || 7.212 ||
yasmāt sarvaviṣayo ‘yaṃ dharmaḥ smaryate –
āpadarthaṃ dhanaṃ rakṣed dārān rakṣed dhanair api |
ātmānaṃ satataṃ rakṣed dārair api dhanair api || 7.213 ||
āpadartham ityādi | āpannivāraṇārthaṃ dhanaṃ rakṣaṇīyam | dhanaparityāgenāpi dārān rakṣet | ātmānaṃ punaḥ sarvadā dāradhanaparityāgenāpi rakṣet, “sarvata evātmānaṃ gopāyīta” ity śrutiyā śāstrīyamaraṇavyatirekeṇātmarakṣety upadeśāt || 7.213 ||
saha sarvāḥ samutpannāḥ prasamīkṣyāpado bhṛśam |
saṃyuktāṃś ca viyuktāṃś ca sarvopāyān sṛjed budhaḥ || 7.214 ||
sahetyādi | kośakṣayaprakṛtikopamitravyasanādikāḥ sarvā āpado yugapad atiśayenotpannā jñātvā na moham upeyāt | api tu vyastān samastān vā sāmādīn upāyān śāstrajñaḥ saṃprayuñjīta
|| 7.214 ||
upetāram upeyaṃ ca sarvopāyāṃś ca kṛtsnaśaḥ |
etat trayaṃ samāśritya prayatetārthasiddhaye || 7.215 ||
upetāram iti | upetāram ātmānaṃ, upeyaṃ prāptavyaṃ, upāyāḥ sāmādayaḥ sarve, te ca paripūrṇā etat trayam avalambya yathāsāmarthyaṃ prayojanasiddhaye yatnaṃ kuryāt || 7.215 ||
evaṃ sarvam idaṃ rājā saha saṃmantrya mantribhiḥ |
vyāyamyāplutya madhyāhne bhoktum antaḥpuraṃ viśet || 7.216 ||
evam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇa sarvarājavṛttaṃ mantribhiḥ saha vicārya anantaram āyudhābhyāsādinā vyāyāmaṃ kṛtvā madhyāhne snānādikaṃ mādhyāhnikaṃ kṛtyaṃ nirvāhya bhoktum antaḥpuraṃ viśet || 7.216 ||
tatrātmabhūtaiḥ kālajñair ahāryaiḥ paricārakaiḥ |
suparīkṣitam annādyam adyān mantrair viṣāpahaiḥ || 7.217 ||
tatreti | tatrāntaḥpura ātmatulyair bhojanakālavedibhir abhedyaiḥ sūpakārādibhiḥ kṛtaṃ suṣṭhu ca parīkṣitaṃ cakorādidarśanena | saviṣam annaṃ dṛṣṭvā cakorākṣiṇī rakte bhavataḥ | viṣāpahair mantrair japitam annam adyāt || 7.217 ||
viṣaghnair agadaiś cāsya sarvadravyāṇi yojayet |
viṣaghnāni ca ratnāni niyato dhārayet sadā || 7.218 ||
viṣaghnair iti | viṣanāśibhir auṣadhaiḥ sarvāṇi bhojyadravyāṇi yojayet | viṣaharaṇāni ca ratnāni yatnavān sarvadā dhārayet || 7.218 ||
parīkṣitāḥ striyaś cainaṃ vyajanodakadhūpanaiḥ |
veṣābharaṇasaṃśuddhāḥ spṛśeyuḥ susamāhitāḥ || 7.219 ||
parīkṣitā iti | striyaś ca gūḍhacāradvāreṇa kṛtaparīkṣā guptāyudhagrahaṇaviṣaliptābharaṇa-dhāraṇaśaṅkayā virūpitaveṣābharaṇā ananyamanasaḥ cāmarasnānapānādyudakadhūpanair enaṃ rājānaṃ paricareyuḥ || 7.219 ||
evaṃ prayatnaṃ kurvīta yānaśayyāsanāśane |
snāne prasādhane caiva sarvālaṃkārakeṣu ca || 7.220 ||
evam iti | evaṃvidhaparīkṣādiprayatnaṃ vāhanaśayyāsanāśanasnānānulepaneṣu sarveṣu cālaṃkaraṇārtheṣu kuryāt || 7.220 ||
bhuktavān viharec caiva strībhir antaḥpure saha |
vihṛtya tu yathākālaṃ punaḥ kāryāṇi cintayet || 7.221 ||
bhuktavān iti | kṛtabhojanaś ca tatraivāntaḥpure bhāryābhiḥ saha krīḍet | kālānatikrameṇa ca saptame divasasya bhāge tatra vihṛtyāṣṭame bhāge punaḥ kāryāṇi cintayet || 7.221 ||
alaṃkṛtaś ca saṃpaśyed āyudhīyaṃ punar janam |
vāhanāni ca sarvāṇi śastrāṇy ābharaṇāni ca || 7.222 ||
alaṃkṛta iti | kṛtālaṃkāraḥ sann āyudhajīvinaṃ, vāhanāni hastyaśvādīni, sarvāṇi ca śastrāṇi khaḍgādīni, alaṃkāraracanādīni ca paśyet || 7.222 ||
saṃdhyāṃ copāsya śṛṇuyād antarveśmani śastrabhṛt |
rahasyākhyāyināṃ caiva praṇidhīnāṃ ca ceṣṭitam || 7.223 ||
gatvā kakṣāntaraṃ tv anyat samanujñāpya taṃ janam |
praviśed bhojanārthaṃ ca strīvṛto ‘ntaḥpuraṃ punaḥ || 7.224 ||
saṃdhyām iti | gatveti | tataḥ saṃdhyopāsanaṃ kṛtvā tasmāt pradeśāt kakṣāntaraṃ viviktaprakoṣṭhāvakāśam anyad gatvā gṛhābhyantare dhṛtaśastro rahasyābhidhāyināṃ carāṇāṃ svavyāpāraṃ śṛṇuyāt | tatas taṃ caraṃ saṃpreṣya paricārikāstrīvṛtaḥ punar bhoktum antaḥpuraṃ viśet || 7.223–224 ||
tatra bhuktvā punaḥ kiṃcit tūryaghoṣaiḥ praharṣitaḥ |
saṃviśet tu yathākālam uttiṣṭhec ca gataklamaḥ || 7.225 ||
tatretyādi | tatrāntaḥpure vāditraśabdaiḥ śrutisukhaiḥ praharṣitaḥ punaḥ kiṃcid bhuktvā nātitṛptaḥ kālānatikrameṇa gatārthapraharāyāṃ rātrau svapyāt | tato rātreḥ paścimayāme ca viśrāntaḥ sann uttiṣṭhet || 7.225 ||
etad vidhānam ātiṣṭhed arogaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
asvasthaḥ sarvam etat tu bhṛtyeṣu viniyojayet || 7.226 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptamo ‘dyāyaḥ |
etad iti | etad yathoktaprakāraprajārakṣaṇādikaṃ nīrogo rājā svayam anutiṣṭhet | asvasthaḥ punaḥ sarvam eatad yogyaśreṣṭhāmātyeṣu samarpayet || 7.226 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau
saptamo ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
aṣṭamo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
vyavahārān didṛkṣus tu brāhmaṇaiḥ saha pārthivaḥ |
mantrajñair mantribhiś caiva vinītaḥ praviśet sabhām || 8.1 ||
vyavahārān iti | evaṃvidhavipakṣamahīkṣidbhyaḥ prajānāṃ rakṣaṇād avāptavṛttis tāsām evetaretaravivādajapīḍāparihārārthaṃ, ṛṇādānādyaṣṭādaśavivāde viruddhārthārthipratyarthi-vākyajanitasaṃdehahārī vicāra eva vyavahāraḥ | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
vi nānārthe ‘va saṃdehe haraṇaṃ hāra ucyate |
nānāsaṃdehaharaṇād vyavahāra iti smṛtaḥ ||
tān vyavahārān draṣṭum icchan pṛthivīpatir vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇalakṣitair brāhmaṇair amātyaiś ca saptamādhyāyoktapañcāṅgamantraiḥ saha vinīto vākpāṇipādacāpalavirahād anuddhataḥ | avinīte hi nṛpe vādiprativādināṃ pratibhākṣayād asamyagabhidhāne tattvanirṇayo na syāt | tādṛśo vakṣyamāṇāṃ sabhāṃ praviśet | vyavahāradarśanaṃ cedaṃ prajānām itaretarapīḍāyāṃ tattvanirṇayena rakṣaṇārthaṃ vakṣyamāṇadṛṣṭārthakaraṇaphalenaiva phalavat || 8.1 ||
tatrāsīnaḥ sthito vāpi pāṇim udyamya dakṣiṇam |
vinītaveṣābharaṇaḥ paśyet kāryāṇi kāryiṇām || 8.2 ||
tatretyādi | tasyāṃ ca sabhāyāṃ kāryagauravāpekṣāyām upaviṣṭo, laghuni kārye utthito ‘pi vā | pāṇiśabdo bāhuparaḥ | dakṣiṇabāhum udyamyānuddhataveṣālaṃkāraḥ pūrvatraśloka indriyānaudhatyam uktaṃ tādṛśaḥ kāryāṇi vicārayet || 8.2 ||
pratyahaṃ deśadṛṣṭaiś ca śāstradṛṣṭaiś ca hetubhiḥ |
aṣṭādaśasu mārgeṣu nibaddhāni pṛthak pṛthak || 8.3 ||
pratyaham ityādi | tāni ca ṛṇādānādīni kāryāṇy aṣṭādaśasu vyavahāramārgeṣu viṣayeṣu paṭhitāni deśajātikulavyavahārāvagataiḥ śāstrāvagataiḥ sākṣidivyādibhir hetubhiḥ pṛthak pṛthak pratyahaṃ vicārayet || 8.3 ||
tāny evāṣṭādaśa gaṇayati –
teṣām ādyam ṛṇādānaṃ nikṣepo ‘svāmivikrayaḥ |
saṃbhūya ca samutthānaṃ dattasyānapakarma ca || 8.4 ||
vetanasyaiva cādānaṃ saṃvidaś ca vyatikramaḥ |
krayavikrayānuśayo vivādaḥ svāmipālayoḥ || 8.5 ||
sīmāvivādadharmaś ca pāruṣye daṇḍavācike |
steyaṃ ca sāhasaṃ caiva strīsaṃgrahaṇam eva ca || 8.6 ||
strīpuṃdharmo vibhāgaś ca dyūtam āhvaya eva ca |
padāny aṣṭādaśaitāni vyavahārasthitāv iha || 8.7 ||
teṣām iti | vetanasyaiva ceti | sīmeti | strīpum iti | teṣām aṣṭādaśānāṃ madhye ādāv iha ṛṇādānaṃ vicāryate | tasya svarūpam uktaṃ nāradena |
ṛṇaṃ deyam adeyaṃ ca yena yatra yathā ca yat |
dānagrahaṇadharmāś ca tad ṛṇādānam ucyate ||
tataś ca svadhanasyānyasminn arpaṇarūpo nikṣepaḥ | asvāminā ca kṛto vikrayaḥ | saṃbhūya vaṇigādīnāṃ kriyānuṣṭhānam | dattasya dhanasyāpātrabuddhyā krodhādinā vā grahaṇam | karmakarasya bhṛter adānam | kṛtavyavasthātikramaḥ | krayavikraye ca kṛte paścāttāpād vipratipattiḥ | svāmipaśupālayor vivādaḥ | grāmādisīmāvipratipattiḥ | vākpāruṣyam ākrośanādi | daṇḍapāruṣyaṃ tāḍanādi | steyaṃ nihnavena dhanagrahaṇam | sāhasaṃ prasahya dhanaharaṇādi | striyāś ca parapuruṣasaṃparkaḥ | strīsahitasya puṃso dharme vyavasthā | paitṛkādidhanasya ca vibhāgaḥ | akṣādikrīḍā paṇavyavasthāpanapūrvakam | pakṣimeṣādiprāṇiyodhanam | ity evam aṣṭādaśa padāni | etāni vyavahārapravṛtteḥ sthānāni | samāhvayasya prāṇidyūtarūpatvena dyūtāvāntaraviśeṣatvād aṣṭādaśasaṃkhyopapattiḥ || 8.4–7 ||
eṣu sthāneṣu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ vivādaṃ caratāṃ nṛṇām |
dharmaṃ śāśvatam āśritya kuryāt kāryavinirṇayam || 8.8 ||
eṣv ityādi | eṣv ṛṇādānādiṣu vyavahārasthāneṣu bāhulyena vivādaṃ kurvatāṃ manuṣyāṇām anādipāramparyāgatatvena nityaṃ dharmam avalambya kāryanirṇayaṃ kuryāt | bhūyiṣṭhaśabdenānyāny api vivādapadāni santīti sūcayate | ata eva nāradaḥ |
na dṛṣṭaṃ yac ca pūrveṣu sarvam tat syāt prakīrṇakam || iti |
|| 8.8 ||
yadā svayaṃ na kuryāt tu nṛpatiḥ kāryadarśanam |
tadā niyuñjyād vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kāryadarśane || 8.9 ||
yadetyādi | yadā kāryāntarākulatayā rogādinā vā rājā svayaṃ kāryadarśanaṃ na kuryāt tadā taddarśanārthaṃ kāryadarśanābhijñaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ niyuñjīta || 8.9 ||
so ‘sya kāryāṇi saṃpaśyet sabhyair eva tribhir vṛtaḥ |
sabhām eva praviśyāgryām āsīnaḥ sthita eva vā || 8.10 ||
so ‘syeti | sa brāhmaṇo ‘sya rājño draṣṭavyāni kāryāṇi tribhir brāhmaṇaiḥ sabhāyāṃ sādhubhir dhārmikaiḥ kāryadarśanābhijñair vṛtas tām eva sabhāṃ praviśyopaviśya sthito vā na tu caṃkramyamāṇas tasya cittavyākṣepasaṃbhavāt tādṛśaṛṇādānādīni kāryāṇi paśyet || 8.10 ||
yasmin deśe niṣīdanti viprā vedavidas trayaḥ |
rājñaś cādhikṛto vidvān brahmaṇas tāṃ sabhāṃ viduḥ || 8.11 ||
yasminn iti | yasmin sthāne ṛgyajuḥsāmavedinas trayo ‘pi brāhmaṇā avatiṣṭhante, rājñādhikṛtaś ca vidvān brāhmaṇa eva prakṛtatvād avatiṣṭhate, tāṃ sabhāṃ caturmukhasabhām iva manyante || 8.11 ||
dharmo viddhas tv adharmeṇa sabhāṃ yatropatiṣṭhate |
śalyaṃ cāsya na kṛntanti viddhās tatra sabhāsadaḥ || 8.12 ||
dharma iti | bhāḥ prakāśas tayā saha vartata iti vidvatsaṃhatir evātra sabhāśabdenābhimatā | yatra deśe sabhāṃ vidvatsaṃhatirūpāṃ dharmaḥ satyābhidhānajanyo ‘nṛtābhidhānajanyenādharmeṇa pīḍita āgacchati arthipratyarthinor madhye ekasya satyābhidhānād aparasya mṛṣāvādāt te ca sabhāsado ‘sya dhamasya pīḍākaratvāc chalyam ivādharmaṃ noddharanti tadā ta eva tenādharmaśalyena viddhā bhavanti || 8.12 ||
yataḥ evam ataḥ –
sabhāṃ vā na praveṣṭavyaṃ vaktavyaṃ vā samañjasam |
abruvan vibruvan vāpi naro bhavati kilbiṣī || 8.13 ||
sabhām iti | sabhām avagamya vyavahārārthaṃ tatpraveśo na kartavyaḥ | pṛṣṭaś cet tadā satyam eva vaktavyam | anyathā tūṣṇīm avatiṣṭhamāno mṛṣā vā vadann ubhayathāpi sadyaḥ pāpī bhavati | medhātithinā tu “sabhā vā na preveṣṭavyā” iti ṛjv eva paṭhitam || 8.13 ||
yatra dharmo hy adharmeṇa satyaṃ yatrānṛtena ca |
hanyate prekṣamāṇānāṃ hatās tatra sabhāsadaḥ || 8.14 ||
yatretyādi | yasyāṃ sabhāyām arthipratyarthibhyām adharmeṇa dharmo na dṛśyate, yatra ca sākṣibhiḥ satyam anṛtena nāśyate, sabhāsadāṃ prekṣamāṇānāṃ tān anādṛtya te pratīkārakṣamā na bhavantīty arthaḥ | “ṣaṣṭhī cānādare” (Pāṇ 2.3.38) ity anena ṣaṣṭhī | tatra ta eva sabhāsadas tena pāpena hatā bhavanti || 8.14 ||
dharma eva hato hanti dharmo rakṣati rakṣitaḥ |
tasmād dharmo na hantavyo mā no dharmo hato vadhīt || 8.15 ||
dharma ityādi | yasmād dharma evātikrānta iṣṭāniṣṭābhyāṃ saha nāśayati nārthipratyarthyādiḥ | sa eva nātikrāntas tābhyāṃ saha rakṣati | tasmād dharmo nātikramaṇīyaḥ | māsmān tvatsahitān atikrānto dharmo vadhīd iti sabhyānām utpathapravṛttasya prāḍvivākasya saṃbodhanam idam | atha vā no niṣedhe ‘vyayam | no hato dharmo mā vadhīt na hanty evety abhiprāyaḥ || 8.15 ||
vṛṣo hi bhagavān dharmas tasya yaḥ kurute hy alam |
vṛṣalaṃ taṃ vidur devās tasmād dharmaṃ na lopayet || 8.16 ||
vṛṣa ityādi | kāmān varṣatīti vṛṣaḥ, vṛṣaśabdena darhma evādhidhīyata iti | alaṃśabdo vāraṇārthaḥ | yasmād dharmasya yo vāraṇaṃ karoti taṃ devā vṛṣalaṃ jānanti na jātivṛṣalam | tasmād dharmaṃ nocchindyād iti dharmavyatikramakhaṇḍanārthaṃ vṛṣalaśabdārthanirvacanam || 8.16 ||
eka eva suhṛd dharmo nidhane ‘py anuyāti yaḥ |
śarīreṇa samaṃ nāśaṃ sarvam anyad dhi gacchati || 8.17 ||
eka ityādi | dharma evaiko mitraṃ yo maraṇe ‘py abhīṣṭaphaladānārtham anugacchati yasmād anyat sarvaṃ bhāryāputrādi śarīreṇaiva sahādarśanaṃ gacchati | tasmāt putrādisnehāpekṣayāpi dharmo na hātavyaḥ || 8.17 ||
pādo ‘dharmasya kartāraṃ pādaḥ sākṣiṇam ṛcchati |
pādaḥ sabhāsadaḥ sarvān pādo rājānam ṛcchati || 8.18 ||
pāda ityādi | durvyavahāradarśanād adharmasaṃbandhī caturthabhāgo ‘rthinam adharmakartāraṃ pratyarthinaṃ vā gacchati | paraś caturthabhāgaḥ sākṣiṇam asatyavādinam | anyapādaḥ sabhāsadaḥ sarvān adharmapravṛttyanivārakān vyāpnoti | pādaś ca rājānaṃ vrajati | sarveṣāṃ pāpasaṃbandho bhavatīty atra vivakṣitam || 8.18 ||
rājā bhavaty anenās tu mucyante ca sabhāsadaḥ |
eno gacchati kartāraṃ nindārho yatra nidyate || 8.19 ||
rājetyādi | yasyāṃ punaḥ sabhāyām asatyavādī nindārho ‘rthī pratyarthī vā samyak nyāyadarśanena nindyate tatra rājā niṣpāpo bhavati | sabhāsadaś ca pāpena na saṃbadhyante | kartāraṃ pāpam upaiti || 8.19 ||
jātimātropajīvī vā kāmaṃ syād brāhmaṇabruvaḥ |
dharmapravaktā nṛpater na tu śūdraḥ kathaṃcana || 8.20 ||
jātimātreti | brāhmaṇajātimātraṃ yasya vidyate na tu brāhmaṇakarmānuṣṭhānaṃ vaṇigādivat sākṣyādidvāreṇa sphuṭanyāyānyāyanirūpaṇakṣamo brāhmaṇajātir api vā yasya saṃdigdhātmānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bravīti sa varam | uktayogyabrāhmaṇābhāve ca kvacit kāryadarśane nṛpater dharmapravaktā bhaven na tu dhārmiko ‘pi vyavahārajño ‘pi śūdraḥ | brāhmaṇo dharmapravakteti vidhānād eva śūdranivṛttiḥ siddhā punar na tu śūdra iti śūdraniṣedho yogyabrāhmaṇābhāve kṣatriyavaiśyayor abhyanujñārthaḥ | ata eva kātyāyanaḥ |
yatra vipro na vidvān syāt kṣatriyaṃ tatra yojayet |
vaiśyaṃ vā dharmaśāstrajñaṃ śūdraṃ yatnena varjayet ||
|| 8.20 ||
yasmāt –
yasya śūdras tu kurute rājño dharmavivecanam |
tasya sīdati tad rāṣṭraṃ paṅke gaur iva paśyataḥ || 8.21 ||
yasyetyādi | yasya rājño dharmavivecanaṃ śūdraḥ kurute tasya paśyata eva paṅke gaur iva tad rāṣṭram avasannaṃ bhavati || 8.21 ||
yad rāṣṭraṃ śūdrabhūyiṣṭhaṃ nāstikākrāntam advijam |
vinaśyaty āśu tat kṛtsnaṃ durbhikṣavyādhipīḍitam || 8.22 ||
yad ityādi | yad rāṣṭraṃ śūdrabahulaṃ bahulaparalokābhāvavādyākrāntaṃ dvijaśūnyaṃ tat sarvaṃ durbhikṣarogapīḍitaṃ tac chīghraṃ vinaśyati | “agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyak” (3.76) ity asyābhāvena vṛṣṭivirahāt, upajātadurbhikṣarogādyupasargaśāntyarthakarmābhāvāc ca || 8.22 ||
dharmāsanam adhiṣṭhāya saṃvītāṅgaḥ samāhitaḥ |
praṇamya lokapālebhyaḥ kāryadarśanam ārabhet || 8.23 ||
dharmāsanam iti | dharmadarśanārtham āsana upaviśya ācchāditadeho ‘nanyamanā lokapālebhyaḥ praṇāmaṃ kṛtvā kāryadarśanam anutiṣṭhet || 8.23 ||
arthānarthāv ubhau buddhvā dharmādharmau ca kevalau |
varṇakrameṇa sarvāṇi paśyet kāryāṇi kāryiṇām || 8.24 ||
artheti | prajārakṣaṇocchedādyātmakāv aihikāv arthānarthau buddhvā paralokārthaṃ dharmādharmau kevalāv anurudhya yathā virodho na bhavati tathā kāryārthināṃ kāryāṇi paśyet | bahuvarṇamelake tu brāhmaṇādikrameṇa paśyet || 8.24 ||
bāhyair vibhāvayel liṅgair bhāvam antargataṃ nṛṇām |
svaravarṇeṅgitākāraiś cakṣuṣā ceṣṭitena ca || 8.25 ||
bāhyair iti | bāhyaiḥ svarādiliṅgair ity abhidhānād evāvadhāritavyapāraiḥ arthipratyarthinām antargatam abhiprāyaṃ nirūpayet | svaro gadgadādiḥ, varṇaḥ svābhāvikavarṇād anyādṛśo mukhakālimādiḥ, iṅgitam adhonirīkṣaṇādi, ākāro dehabhavasvedaromāñcanādiḥ, ceṣṭā hastāsphālanādiḥ || 8.25 ||
yasmāt –
ākārair iṅgitair gatyā ceṣṭayā bhāṣitena ca |
netravaktravikāraiś ca gṛhyate ‘ntargataṃ manaḥ || 8.26 ||
ākārair iti | ākārādibhiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ gatyā skhalatpādādikayā antargatamanobuddhirūpeṇa pariṇatam avadhāryate || 8.26 ||
bāladāyādikaṃ riktaṃ tāvad rājānupālayet |
yāvat sa syāt samāvṛtto yāvac cātītaśaiśavaḥ || 8.27 ||
bāladāyeti | anāthabālasvāmikaṃ dhanaṃ pitṛvyādibhir anyāyena gṛhyamāṇaṃ tāvad rājā rakṣet, yāvad asau “ṣaṭtriṃśadabdādikaṃ brahmacaryam” (cf. MDh 3.1) ityādyuktena prakāreṇa gurukulāt samāvṛtto na bhavati tādṛśasyāvaśyakabālyavigamāt | yas tv aśaktyādinā bāla eva samāvartate so ‘pi yāvad atītabālyo bhavati tāvat tasya dhanaṃ rakṣet | bālyaṃ ca ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyantam, “bāla ā ṣoṣaśād varṣāt” ity nāradavacanāt || 8.27 ||
vaśāputrāsu caivaṃ syād rakṣaṇaṃ niṣkulāsu ca |
pativratāsu ca strīṣu vidhavāsv āturāsu ca || 8.28 ||
vaśetyādi | vaśāsu vandhyāsu kṛtadārāntaraparigrahaḥ svāmī nirvāhārthopakalpitadhanopāyāsu nirapekṣaḥ | aputrāsu ca strīṣu, proṣitabhartṛkāsu, niṣkulāsu sapiṇḍarahitāsu, sādhvīṣu ca strīṣu, vidhavāsu rogiṇīṣu ca yad dhanaṃ tasyāpi bāladhanasyeva rājñā rakṣaṇaṃ kartavyam | atra cānekaśabdopādāne gobalivardanyāyena punaruktiparihāraḥ || 8.28 ||
jīvantīnāṃ tu tāsāṃ ye tad dhareyuḥ svabāndhavāḥ |
tāñ chiṣyāc cauradaṇḍena dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 8.29 ||
jīvantīnām iti | ‘vayam atrānantarādhikāriṇo rakṣyāma idaṃ dhanam’ ityādivyājena ye bāndhavās tāsāṃ jīvantīnāṃ tad dhanaṃ gṛhṇanti tān vakṣyamāṇacauradaṇḍena dhārmiko rājā daṇḍayet || 8.29 ||
pranaṣṭasvāmikaṃ riktaṃ rājā tryabdaṃ nidhāpayet |
arvāk tryabdād dharet svāmī pareṇa nṛpatir haret || 8.30 ||
pranaṣṭeti | ajñātasvāmikaṃ dhanaṃ rājā kasya kiṃ pranaṣṭaṃ ity evaṃ paṭahādinā udghoṣya rājadvārādau rakṣitaṃ varṣatrayaṃ sthāpayet | varṣatrayamadhye yadi dhanasvāmy āgacchati tadā sa eva gṛhṇīyāt | tadūrdhvaṃ tu nṛpatir viniyuñjīta || 8.30 ||
mamedam iti yo brūyāt so ‘nuyojyo yathāvidhi |
saṃvādya rūpasaṃkhyādīn svāmī tad dravyam arhati || 8.31 ||
mamedam ityādi | ‘madīyaṃ dhanam’ iti yo vadati sa ‘kiṃrūpaṃ kiṃsaṃkhyākaṃ kutra praṇaṣṭaṃ tad dhanam’ ityādividhānena praṣṭavyaḥ | tato yadi rūpasaṃkhyādīn satyān vadati tadā sa tatra dhanasvāmī tad dhanaṃ grahītum arhati || 8.31 ||
avedayāno naṣṭasya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca tattvataḥ |
varṇaṃ rūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca tatsamaṃ daṇḍam arhati || 8.32 ||
avedayāna ityādi | naṣṭadravyasya deśakālāv asmin deśe ‘smin kāle naṣṭam iti, tathā varṇaṃ śuklādi, ākāraṃ kaṭakamukuṭādi, parimāṇaṃ ca yathāvad ajānan naṣṭadravyasamadaṇḍam arhati || 8.32 ||
deśakālādisaṃvāde punaḥ –
ādadītātha ṣaḍbhāgaṃ pranaṣṭādhigatān nṛpaḥ |
daśamaṃ dvādaśaṃ vāpi satāṃ dharmam anusmaran || 8.33 ||
ādadīteti | yad etad rājñā pranaṣṭadravyaṃ prāptaṃ tasmāt ṣaḍbhāgaṃ daśamaṃ dvādaśaṃ vā rakṣānimittaṃ pūrveṣāṃ sādhūnām ayaṃ dharma iti jānan rājā gṛhṇīyāt | dhanasvāmino nirguṇasaguṇatvāpekṣaś cāyaṃ ṣaḍbhāgādigrahaṇavikalpaḥ | avaśiṣṭaṃ svāmine samarpayet
|| 8.33 ||
pranaṣṭādhigataṃ dravyaṃ tiṣthed yuktair adhiṣṭhitam |
yāṃs tatra caurān gṛhṇīyāt tān rājebhena ghātayet || 8.34 ||
pranaṣṭeti | yad dravyaṃ kasyāpi pranaṣṭaṃ sat rājapuruṣaiḥ prāptaṃ rakṣāyuktai rakṣitaṃ kṛtvā sthāpyam | tasmiṃś ca dravye yāṃś caurān gṛhṇīyāt tān hastinā ghātayet | govindarājas tu “śatād abhyadhike vadhaḥ” (8.231) iti darśanād atrāpi śatasuvarṇasya maulyādhikadravyaharaṇe vadham āha | tan na, tatra “saṃdhiṃ chittvā tu yac cauryam” (9.276) iti yat svāmye ‘pi pranaṣṭarājarakṣitadravyaharaṇenaiva viśeṣeṇa vadhavidhānāt, “śatād abhyadhike vadhaḥ” (8.231) ity asya viśeṣopadiṣṭavadhetaraviṣayatvāt || 8.34 ||
mamāyam iti yo brūyān nidhiṃ satyena mānavaḥ |
tasyādadīta ṣaḍbhāgaṃ rājā dvādaśam eva vā || 8.35 ||
mamāyam iti | yo mānuṣaḥ svayaṃ nidhiṃ labdhvā, anyena vā nidhau prāpte mamāyaṃ nidhir iti vadati satyena pramāṇena ca svasaṃbandhaṃ bodhayati tasya puruṣasya nirguṇatvasaguṇatvāpekṣayā tato nidhānāt ṣaḍbhāgaṃ dvādaśabhāgaṃ vā rājā gṛhṇīyāt | avaśiṣṭaṃ tasyārpayet || 8.35 ||
anṛtaṃ tu vadan daṇḍyaḥ svavittasyāṃśam aṣṭamam |
tasyaiva vā nidhānasya saṃkhyayālpīyasīṃ kalām || 8.36 ||
anṛtam iti | asvīyaṃ svīyam iti bruvan svadhanasyāṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ daṇḍyaḥ | yad vā tasyaiva nidher atyantālpabhāgaṃ gaṇayitvā yenāvasādaṃ na gacchati na viṣayaś ca labhate tad daṇḍyaḥ | alpīyasīm itīyasunnantanirdeśāt pūrvasmād anyo ‘yaṃ daṇḍaḥ | vikalpaś ca nirguṇasaguṇāpekṣaḥ
|| 8.36 ||
vidvāṃs tu brāhmaṇo dṛṣṭvā pūrvopanihitaṃ nidhim |
aśeṣato ‘py ādadīta sarvasyādhipatir hi saḥ || 8.37 ||
vidvān ityādi | vidvān punar brāhmaṇaḥ pūrvam upanihitaṃ nidhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | na ṣaḍbhāgaṃ dadyāt | yasmāt sarvasya dhanajātasya sa prabhuḥ | ata evoktam “sarvasvaṃ brāhmaṇasyedam” (1.100) iti | tasmāt paranihitaviṣayam etad vacanam | tathā ca nāradaḥ |
pareṇa nihitaṃ labdhvā rājā hy apaharen nidhim |
rājagāmī nidhiḥ sarvaḥ sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇād ṛte || (7.6)
yājñavalkyo py āha |
rājā labdhvā nidhiṃ dadyād dvijebhyo ‘rdhaṃ dvijaḥ punaḥ |
vidvān aśeṣam ādadyāt sa sarvasya prabhur yataḥ || (2.34)
ato yan medhātithi-govindarājābhyāṃ “mamāyam iti yo brūyāt” (8.35) ity uktaṃ, rājadeyārthanirāsārthaṃ pitrādinihitaviṣayatvam evāsya vacanasya vyākhātaṃ, tad anārṣam | nāradādimunivyākhyāviparītaṃ svakalpitaṃ na medhātithi-govindarājavyākhyānam ādriye
|| 8.37 ||
yaṃ tu paśyen nidhiṃ rājā purāṇaṃ nihitaṃ kṣitau |
tasmād dvijebhyo datvārdham ardhaṃ kośe praveśayet || 8.38 ||
yaṃ tv iti | yaṃ punar asvāmikaṃ purātanaṃ bhūmyantargataṃ nidhiṃ rājā labhate tasmād brāhmaṇebhyo ‘rdhaṃ datvārdham ātmīyadhanāgāre ca praveśayet || 8.38 ||
nidhīnāṃ tu purāṇānāṃ dhātūnām eva ca kṣitau |
ardhabhāg rakṣaṇād rājā bhūmer adhipatir hi saḥ || 8.39 ||
nidhīnām iti | nidhīnāṃ purātanānām asvakīyānāṃ vidvadbrāhmaṇetaralabdhānāṃ suvarṇādyutpattisthānānāṃ cārdhaharo rājā | yasmād asau rakṣati bhūmeś ca prabhuḥ || 8.39 ||
dātavyaṃ sarvavarṇebhyo rājñā caurair hṛtaṃ dhanam |
rājā tad upayuñjānaś caurasyāpnoti kilbiṣam || 8.40 ||
dātavyam iti | yad dhanaṃ caurair lokānām apahṛtaṃ tad rājñā caurebhya āhṛtya dhanasvāmibhyo deyam | tad dhanaṃ rājā svayam upayuñjānaś caurasya pāpaṃ prāpnoti
|| 8.40 ||
jātijānapadān dharmāñ śreṇīdharmāṃś ca dharmavit |
samīkṣya kuladharmāṃś ca svadharmaṃ pratipādayet || 8.41 ||
jātīti | dharmān brāhmaṇādijātiniyatān yājanādīn jānapadāṃś ca niyatadeśavyavasthitān āmnāyāviruddhān, deśajātikuladharmāṃś ca “āmnāyair apratiṣiddhāḥ pramāṇam” (GDh 11.7) iti gautamasmaraṇāt | śreṇīdharmāṃś ca vaṇigādidharmān pratiniyatakulavyavasthitān jñātvā tadviruddhān rājā vyavahāreṣu tattaddharmān vyavasthāpayet || 8.41 ||
yasmāt –
svāni karmāṇi kurvāṇā dūre santo ‘pi mānavāḥ |
priyā bhavanti lokasya sve sve karmaṇy avasthitāḥ || 8.42 ||
svānīti | jātideśakuladharmādīny ātmīyakarmāṇy anutiṣthanaḥ, sve sve ca nityanaimittikādau karmaṇi vartamānāḥ, dūre ‘pi santaḥ sāṃnidhyanibandhanasnehābhāve ‘pi lokasya priyā bhavanti || 8.42 ||
prāsaṅgikam idam abhidhāya punaḥ prakṛtam āha –
notpādayet svayaṃ kāryaṃ rājā nāpy asya pūruṣaḥ |
na ca prāpitam anyena grasetārthaṃ kathaṃcana || 8.43 ||
notpādayed iti | rājā rājaniyukto vā dhanalobhādinā kāryam ṛṇādivivādaṃ notpādayet | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
na rājā tu vaśitvena dhanalobhena vā punaḥ |
svayaṃ karmāṇi kurvīta narāṇām avivādinām ||
na cārthinā pratyarthinā vāveditaṃ vivādaṃ dhanādilobhenāpekṣeta || 8.43 ||
yathā nayaty asṛkpātair mṛgasya mṛgayuḥ padam |
nayet tathānumānena dharmasya nṛpatiḥ padam || 8.44 ||
yatheti | yathā mṛgasya śastrahatasya rudhirapātair vyādhaḥ padaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnoti tathānumānena dṛṣṭapramāṇena vā dharmasya tattvaṃ niścinuyāt || 8.44 ||
satyam arthaṃ ca saṃpaśyed ātmānam atha sākṣiṇaḥ |
deśaṃ rūpaṃ ca kālaṃ ca vyavahāravidhau sthitaḥ || 8.45 ||
satyam ityādi | vyavahāradarśanapravṛtto rājā chalam apahāya satyaṃ paśyet tathārthaṃ ca | arśāditvān matvarthīyo ‘c | arthavantaṃ gohiraṇyādidhanaviṣayasthaṃ vyavahāraṃ paśyet, na tv aham anenākṣinikocanenopahasita ityādisvalpāparādham ātmānaṃ ca tattvanirṇaye svargādiphalabhāginaṃ, sākṣiṇaḥ satyavādinaḥ, deśaṃ kālaṃ ca deśakālocitaṃ svarūpaṃ vyavahārasvarūpaṃ gurulaghutādikaṃ paśyet || 8.45 ||
sadbhir ācaritaṃ yat syād dhārmikaiś ca dvijātibhiḥ |
tad deśakulajātīnām aviruddhaṃ prakalpayet || 8.46 ||
sadbhir | vidvadbhir dharmapradhānair dvijātibhir yad dṛśyamānaśāstram anuṣṭhitaṃ tad deśakulajātyaviruddham ādāya vyavahāranirṇayaṃ prakalpayet || 8.46 ||
etat sakalavyavahārasādhāraṇaṃ paribhāṣātmakam uktam, saṃprati ṛṇādānam adhikṛtyāha –
adhamarṇārthasiddhyartham uttamarṇena coditaḥ |
dāpayed dhanikasyārtham adhamarṇād vibhāvitam || 8.47 ||
adhamarṇartheti | adhamarṇārthasiddhyarhaṃ prayuktadhanasiddhyarthaṃ dhanasvāminā rājā bodhito vakṣyamāṇalekhyādipramāṇapratipāditaṃ dhanam uttamarṇasyādhamarṇaṃ pradāpayet | adhamarṇād uttamarṇāya dāpayed ity arthaḥ || 8.47 ||
kathaṃ dāpayed ity āha –
yair yair upāyair arthaṃ svaṃ prāpnuyād uttamārṇikaḥ |
tair tair upāyair saṃgṛhya dāpayed adhamarṇikam || 8.48 ||
yari yair iti | yair vakṣyamāṇair upāyaiḥ saṃprayuktam artham uttamarṇo labhate tais tair upāyair vaśikṛtya tam arthaṃ dāpayet || 8.48 ||
tān upāyān āha –
dharmeṇa vyavahāreṇa chalenācaritena ca |
prayuktaṃ sādhayed arthaṃ pañcamena balena ca || 8.49 ||
dharmeṇetyādi | dharmādinā prayuktam arthaṃ sādhayet | tatra dharmān āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
suhṛtsaṃbandhisaṃdiṣṭaiḥ sāmnā cānugamena ca |
prāyeṇa vā ṛṇī dāpyo dharma eṣa udāhṛtaḥ ||
deye dhane ‘dhamarṇasyāvipratipattau vyāvahāreṇa | tathā ca vakṣyati “arthe ‘pavyayamānaṃ tu” (8.51) iti | medhātithis tu “niḥsvo yaḥ sa vyavahāreṇa dāpayitavyaḥ | anyat karmopakaraṇaṃ dhanaṃ datvā kṛṣivāṇijyādinā vyavahārayitavyaḥ | tadutpannaṃ dhanaṃ tasmāt tu gṛhṇiyād” ity āha | chalādīni trīṇy āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
chadmanā yācitaṃ cārtham ānīya ṛṇikād balī |
anyāhṛtād ivāhṛtya dāpyate tatra sopadhiḥ ||
dāraputrapaśūn hatvā kṛtvā dāropaveśanam |
yātrārthaṃ dāpyate ‘rthaṃ svaṃ tad ācaritam ucyate ||
badhvā svagṛham ānīya tāḍanādyair upakramaiḥ |
ṛṇiko dāpyate yatra balātkāraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||
|| 8.49 ||
yaḥ svayaṃ sādhayed artham uttamarṇo ‘dhamarṇikāt |
na sa rājñābhiyoktavyaḥ svakaṃ saṃsādhayan dhanam || 8.50 ||
ya ityādi | ya uttamarṇaḥ saṃpratipannam artham adhamarṇāt svayaṃ balādinā sādhayati sa svīyaṃ dhanaṃ samyak sādhayann asmāsv anivedya kim iti balādikaṃ kṛtavān asīti na rājñā niṣeddhavyaḥ || 8.50 ||
arthe ‘pavyayamānaṃ tu karaṇena vibhāvitam |
dāpayed dhanikasyārthaṃ daṇḍaleśaṃ ca śaktitaḥ || 8.51 ||
artha iti | nāham asmai dārayāmīti dhanaviṣaye ‘pahnavānam adharmarṇaṃ karaṇena lekhyasākṣidivyādinā pratipāditam artham uttamarṇasya rājā pradāpayet | daṇḍaleśaṃ ca “apahnave taddviguṇa” (8.139) iti vakṣyamāṇadaśamabhāgadaṇḍān nyūnam api daṇḍaṃ puruṣaśaktyā dāpayet || 8.51 ||
apahnave ‘dhamarṇasya dehīty uktasya saṃsadi |
abhiyoktā diśed deśyaṃ karaṇaṃ vānyad uddiśet || 8.52 ||
apeti | uttamarṇasya dhanaṃ dehīti sabhāyāṃ prāḍvivākenoktasyādhamarṇasya nāsmai dhārayāmīty apalāpe sati abhiyoktārthī ‘rtho deśyaṃ dhanaprayogadeśavartisākṣiṇaṃ nirdiśet | prāyeṇa sākṣibhir eva strīmūrkhādisādhāraṇanirṇayāt prāk sākṣyupanyāsaḥ | anyad vā karaṇaṃ patrādi kathayet || 8.52 ||
adeśyaṃ yaś ca diśati nirdiśyāpahnute ca yaḥ |
yaś cādharottarān arthān vigītān nāvabudhyate || 8.53 ||
apadiśyāpadeśyaṃ ca punar yas tv apadhāvati |
samyak praṇihitaṃ cārthaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ san nābhinandati || 8.54 ||
asaṃbhāṣye sākṣibhiś ca deśe saṃbhāṣate mithaḥ |
nirucyamānaṃ praśnaṃ ca necched yaś cāpi niṣpatet || 8.55 ||
brūhīty uktaś ca na brūyād uktaṃ ca na vibhāvayet |
na ca pūrvāparaṃ vidyāt tasmād arthāt sa hīyate || 8.56 ||
adeśyam iti | apadiśyeti | asaṃbhāṣya iti | brūhītyādi | adeśyaṃ yatra deśe ‘dhamarṇasya ṛṇagrahaṇakāle sarvadāvasthānaṃ na saṃbhavatīti nirdiśya cādeśādikaṃ naitan mayā nirdiṣṭam ity apanayati, yaś ca pūrvoktān arthān svārthān svoktān viruddhān vāvagacchati | yaś ca mama hastāt suvarṇasya palam anena gṛhītam iti nirdiśya matputrahastād gṛhītam ity evamādinā yaḥ punar apasarati | yaś ca samyak pratijñātam arthaṃ kasmāt tvayā rātrāv asākṣikaṃ dattam ity evamādi prāḍvivākena pṛṣṭaḥ san na samādhatte | yaś ca saṃbhāṣaṇānarhanirjanādideśe sākṣibhiḥ sahānyonyaṃ saṃbhāṣate | yaś ca bhāṣārthasthirīkaraṇāya nitarām ucyamānaṃ prāḍvivākena praśnaṃ necchet | yaś ca niṣpatet uktāṃś ca vyavahārān purānākhyāya yathā sthānāt sthānāntaraṃ gacchet | yaś ca brūhīty ukto na kiṃcid bravīti | uktaṃ sādhyaṃ na pramāṇena pratipādayati | pūrvaṃ sādhanaṃ, aparaṃ sādyaṃ, tad yo na jānāti | asādhanam eva sādhanatvena nirdiśati | asādhyam eva mānena “śataśṛṅgakṛtaṃ dhanur jñeyam” ityādi sādhyatvena nirdiśati sa tasmāt sādhyād arthād dhīyate || 8.53–56 ||
sākṣiṇaḥ santi mety uktvā diśety ukto diśen na yaḥ |
dharmasthaḥ kāraṇair etair hīnaṃ tam api nirdiśet || 8.57 ||
sākṣiṇa iti | sākṣiṇo mama vidyanta ity uktvā tān nirdiśety ukto yo na nirdiśati taṃ pūrvoktair ebhiḥ kāraṇair dharmasthaḥ prāḍvivākaḥ parājitaṃ kathayet | “jñātāraḥ santi mety uktvā” iti vā pāṭhaḥ | atra chāndasam ikārasya pūrvarūpatvam || 8.57 ||
abhiyoktā na ced brūyād badhyo daṇḍyaś ca dharmataḥ |
na cet tripakṣāt prabrūyād dharmaṃ prati parājitaḥ || 8.58 ||
abhiyokteti | yo ‘rthī san rājasthāne nivedya bhāṣāyāṃ na brūyāt tadā viṣayagauravāpekṣayā badhyo laghuni viṣaye daṇḍyaś ca dharmataḥ syāt | pratyarthī punar yadi pakṣatrayamadhye na brūyāt tadā dharmata eva parājitaḥ syān na tu chalena || 8.58 ||
yo yāvan nihnuvītārthaṃ mithyā yāvati vā vadet |
tau nṛpeṇa hy adharmajñau dāpyau taddviguṇaṃ damam || 8.59 ||
ya iti | yaḥ pratyarthī yatparimāṇadhanam apanayati, arthī vā yatparimāṇadhane mithyā vadati tāv adhārmikāv apahnutamithyoktadhanād dviguṇaṃ daṇḍarūpaṃ dāpanīyau | adharmajñāv iti vacanāj jñānapūrvāpahnavamithyoktiviṣayam idam | pramādādināpalāpamithyāniyogāpahnave dviguṇam iti śatadaśamabhāgaṃ vakṣyati || 8.59 ||
pṛṣṭo ‘pavyayamānas tu kṛtāvastho dhanaiṣiṇā |
tryavaraiḥ sākṣibhir bhāvyo nṛpabrāhmaṇasaṃnidhau || 8.60 ||
pṛṣṭa iti | dhanārthinottamarṇena rājapuruṣāpakarṣaṃ kṛtāhvānaḥ prāḍvivākena pṛṣṭaḥ san yadā na dhārayāmīty apahnavāno bhavati tadā nṛpatyadhikṛtabrāhmaṇasamakṣaṃ tryavaraiḥ sākṣibhis trayo ‘varā nyūnā yeṣāṃ tair arthinā bhāvanīyaḥ || 8.60 ||
yādṛśā dhanibhiḥ kāryā vyavahāreṣu sākṣiṇaḥ |
tādṛśān saṃpravakṣyāmi yathā vācyam ṛtaṃ ca taiḥ || 8.61 ||
yādṛśā iti | dhanibhir uttamarṇādibhiḥ ṛṇādānādivyavahāreṣu yathāvidhāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ kartavyās tathāvidhān vadiṣyāmi | yathā ca tair api satyaṃ vaktavyaṃ tam api prakāraṃ vakṣyāmi || 8.61 ||
gṛhiṇaḥ putriṇo maulāḥ kṣatraviṭśudrayonayaḥ |
arthyuktāḥ sākṣyam arhanti na ye kecid anāpadi || 8.62 ||
iti | kṛtadāraparigrahāḥ putravantas taddeśajāḥ kṣatriyaśūdravaiśyajātīyā arthinirdiṣṭāḥ santaḥ sākṣitvayogyā bhavanti | te hi kṛtaparikaraputrabhayāt taddeśavāsinā virodhāc ca nānyathā vadanti na tu ye kecid ṛṇādānādivyavahāreṣu sākṣiṇaḥ syuḥ | āpadi tu vāgdaṇḍapāruṣya-strīsaṃgrahaṇādiṣūktavyatiriktāḥ sākṣiṇo bhavanti || 8.62 ||
āptāḥ sarveṣu varṇeṣu kāryāḥ kāryeṣu sākṣiṇaḥ |
sarvadharmavido ‘lubdhā viparītāṃs tu varjayet || 8.63 ||
āptā ityādi | “kṣatraviṭśudrayonayaḥ” (8.62) ity uktatvāt tato brāhmaṇaparigrahārthaṃ sarveṣu varṇeṣv ity abhidhānam | sarvavarṇeṣu madhye ye yathārthāvagatavādinaḥ sarvadharmajñā lobharahitās te sākṣiṇaḥ kartavyāḥ | uktaviparītāṃś ca varjayet || 8.63 ||
nārthasaṃbandhino nāptā na sahāyā na vairiṇaḥ |
na dṛṣṭadoṣāḥ kartavyā na vyādhyārtā na dūṣitāḥ || 8.64 ||
nārthasaṃbandhina ityādi | ṛṇādyarthasaṃbandhino ‘dhamarṇādyāḥ, āptā mitrāṇi, sahāyās tatparicārakāḥ, śatravaḥ, sthānāntarāvagatakauṭasākṣyāḥ, rogapīḍitāḥ, mahāpātakādidūṣitāḥ sākṣiṇo na kartavyāḥ, lobharāgadveṣasmṛtibhraṃśādīnām anyathābhidhānahetūnāṃ saṃbhavāt || 8.64 ||
na sākṣī nṛpatiḥ kāryo na kārukakuśīlavau |
na śrotriyo na liṅgastho na saṅgebhyo vinirgataḥ || 8.65 ||
na sākṣīti | prabhutvāt sākṣidharmeṇa praṣṭum ayogyatvān na rājā sākṣī kāryaḥ | kāruḥ sūpakārādiḥ, kuśīlavo naṭādiḥ, tayoḥ svakarmavyagratvāt prāyeṇa dhanalobhavattvāc cāsākṣitvam | śrotriyo ‘py adhyayanāgnihotrādikarmavyagratayā na sākṣī | liṅgastho brahmacārī, saṅgavinirgataḥ parivrājakas tayor api svakarmavyagratvād brahmaniṣthatvāc cāsākṣitvam | śrotriyagrahaṇād adhyayanāgnihotrādivyagretarabrāhmaṇasyāniṣedhaḥ || 8.65 ||
nādhyadhīno na vaktavyo na dasyur na vikarmakṛt |
na vṛddho na śiśur naiko nāntyo na vikalendriyaḥ || 8.66 ||
nādhyadhīna iti | adhyadhīno ‘tyantaparatantro garbhadāso na vaktavyo vihitakarmatyāgāl lokavigarhitaḥ | dasyuḥ krūrakarmā, “na kruddho nāpi taskaraḥ” (8.67) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | vikarmakṛn niṣiddhakarmakārī, eteṣāṃ rāgadveṣādisaṃbhavāt | na vṛddhaḥ, prāyeṇa smṛtibhraṃśasaṃbhavāt | na bālo ‘prāptavyavahāratvāt | naikaḥ, vināśapravāsaśaṅkayā tasya “tryavarair” (8.60) iti vidhānāt | arthapratiṣedhasiddho kasyāṃcid avasthāyāṃ dvayor abhyanujñānārthaṃ niṣedhavacanam | antyaś cāṇḍālādiḥ, dharmānabhijñātatvāt | vikalendriya upalabdhivaikalyān na sākṣī karyaḥ || 8.66 ||
nārto na matto nonmatto na kṣuttṛṣṇopapīḍitaḥ |
na śramārto na kāmārto na kruddho nāpi taskaraḥ || 8.67 ||
nārta iti | ārto bandhuvināśādinā, matto madyādinā, unmatta utkṣepabhūtāveśādinā, kṣudhāpipāsādinā pīḍitaḥ, śramārto vartmagamanādinā khinnaḥ, kāmārtaḥ, utpannakrodhaḥ, cauraś ca, ‘na sākṣī kārya’ iti sarvatra saṃbadhyate | tatrārtādir buddhivaikalyāt, cauras tv adhārmikatvāt || 8.67 ||
strīṇāṃ sākṣyaṃ striyaḥ kuryur dvijānāṃ sadṛśā dvijāḥ |
śūdrāś ca santaḥ śūdrāṇām antyānām antyayonayaḥ || 8.68 ||
strīṇām ityādi | strīṇām anyonyavyavahāre ṛṇādānādau striyaḥ sākṣiṇyo bhavanti | dvijānāṃ brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ sadṛśāḥ sajātīyāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ syuḥ | evaṃ śūdrāḥ sādhavaḥ śūdrāṇāṃ, cāṇḍālādīnāṃ cāṇḍālādayaḥ sākṣiṇo bhaveyuḥ | etac ca sajātīyasākṣyabhidhānam | uktalakṣaṇasajātīyasākṣyasaṃbhave vijātīyā api sākṣiṇo bhavanti | ata eva yājñavalkyaḥ |
yathājāti yathāvarṇaṃ sarve sarveṣu vā smṛtāḥ || (2.69)
|| 8.68 ||
anubhāvī tu yaḥ kaścit kuryāt sākṣyaṃ vivādinām |
antarveśmany araṇye vā śarīrasyāpi cātyaye || 8.69 ||
anubhāvīti | gṛhābhyantare ‘raṇyādau vā caurādikṛtopadrave dehopaghāte vātatāyyādikṛte yaḥ kaścid upalabhyate sa vādinor eva sākṣī bhavati, na tu ṛṇādānādivad uktalakṣaṇopetaḥ || 8.69 ||
tad evodāharaṇāt spaṣṭayati –
striyāpy asaṃbhave kāryaṃ bālena sthavireṇa vā |
śiṣyeṇa bandhunā vāpi dāsena bhṛtakena vā || 8.70 ||
striyāpīti | antarveśmādāv uktasākṣyabhāve sati strībālavṛddhaśiṣyabandhudāsakarmakarā api sākṣiṇaḥ syuḥ || 8.70 ||
nanv asthirabuddhitvādinā strībālādīnāṃ katham atrāpi sākṣitvam ity atrāha –
bālavṛddhāturāṇāṃ ca sākṣyeṣu vadatāṃ mṛṣā |
jānīyād asthirāṃ vācam utsiktamanasāṃ tathā || 8.71 ||
bālavṛddheti | bālavṛddhavyādhitānām upaplutamanasāṃ ca mattonmattādīnāṃ sākṣye ‘nṛtaṃ vadatām asthirā vāg bhavati | atas tām anumānena jānīyāt | yathoktam “bāhyair vibhāvayal liṅgaiḥ” (8.25) iti || 8.71 ||
sāhaseṣu ca sarveṣu steyasaṃgrahaṇeṣu ca |
vāgdaṇḍayoś ca pāruṣye na parīkṣeta sākṣiṇaḥ || 8.72 ||
sāhaseṣv iti | gṛhadāhādiṣu sāhaseṣv ācāryastrīsaṃgrahaṇe vāgdaṇḍapāruṣye ca “gṛhiṇaḥ” (8.62) ity uktasākṣiparīkṣā na kāryā | “stryāpy asaṃbhae kāryam” (8.70) ity asyaivāyam udāharaṇaprapañcaḥ || 8.72 ||
bahutvaṃ parigṛhṇīyāt sākṣidvaidhe narādhipaḥ |
sameṣu tu guṇotkṛṣṭān guṇidvaidhe dvijottamān || 8.73 ||
bahutvam ityādi | sākṣiṇāṃ parasparaviruddhānāṃ bahubhir yad uktaṃ tad eva nirṇayārthatvena rājā gṛhṇīyāt | sameṣu tu viruddhārthābhidhāyiṣu guṇavataḥ pramāṇīkuryāt | guṇavatām eva vipratipattau dvijottamān dvijeṣu ca uttamāḥ | kriyāvanta ity arthaḥ | ata eva bṛhaspatiḥ:
guṇidvaidhe kriyāyuktaḥ | iti |
govindarājas tu guṇavatāṃ vipratipattau dvijottamān brāhmaṇān pramāṇīkuryād ity āha || 8.73 ||
samakṣadarśanāt sākṣyaṃ śravaṇāc caiva sidhyati |
tatra satyaṃ bruvan sākṣī dharmārthābhyāṃ na hīyate || 8.74 ||
samakṣeti | cakṣurgrāhye sākṣāddarśanāt, śrotragrāhye śravaṇāt śākṣyaṃ sidhyati | tatra sākṣī satyaṃ vadan dharmārthābhyāṃ na mucyate, satyavacanena dharmopapatter daṇḍābhāve ‘rthahānyabhāvāt || 8.74 ||
sākṣī dṛṣṭaśrutād anyad vibruvann āryasaṃsadi |
avāṅ narakam abhyeti pretya svargāc ca hīyate || 8.75 ||
sākṣītyādi | sākṣī dṛṣṭaśrutād anyādṛśaṃ sādhusabhāyāṃ vadann adhomukho narakaṃ gacchati | paraloke ca karmāntarajanyasvargarūpaphalādānena pāpena hīyate || 8.75 ||
yatrānibaddho ‘pīkṣeta śṛṇuyād vāpi kiṃcana |
dṛṣṭas tatrāpi tad brūyād yathādṛṣṭaṃ yathāśrutam || 8.76 ||
yatretyādi | tvam asmin viṣaye sākṣī bhavety evam akṛto ‘pi yat kiṃcid ṛṇādānādi paśyati, vākpāruṣyādikaṃ vā śṛṇoti tatrāpi sākṣī sa pṛṣṭaḥ san yathopalabdhaṃ kathayet | ayaṃ tv akṛtasākṣī sāmānyena manunoktaḥ | asya “grāmaś ca prāḍvivākaś ca rājā ca” (NSm 1.131) ityādinā nāradādibhiḥ ṣāḍvidhyam uktam || 8.76 ||
eko ‘lubdhas tu sākṣī syāḍ bahvyaḥ śucyo ‘pi na striyaḥ |
strībuddher asthiratvāt tu doṣaiś cānye ‘pi ye vṛtāḥ || 8.77 ||
eka ityādi | eko ‘lubdha ity atrākārapraśleṣo draṣṭavyaḥ | eko ‘pi sākṣī lobhādirahitaḥ syāt | ata eva vyāsaḥ |
śucikriyaś ca dharmajñaḥ sākṣī yatrānubhūtavāk |
pramāṇam eko ‘pi bhavet sāhaseṣu viśeṣataḥ ||
medhātithi-govindarājābhyāṃ ‘eko lubdhas tv asākṣī syāt’ iti paṭhitaṃ vyākhyātaṃ ca | lobhātmaka ekaḥ sākṣī na bhavati | evaṃ cālubdho guṇavān kasyāṃcid avasthāyām eko ‘pi bhavatīti | striyaḥ punar ātmaśaucādiyuktā bahvyo ‘py asthirabuddhitvād ṛṇādānādyaiḥ paryālocitavyavahāre sākṣiṇyo na bhavanti | aparyālocite tu steyavāgdaṇḍapāruṣyādau “striyāpy asaṃbhave kāryaṃ” (8.70) iti sākṣitvam uktam | anye ‘pi ye steyādidoṣair vyāptās te ‘pi paryālocitavyavahāre sākṣiṇo na syuḥ || 8.77 ||
svabhāvenaiva yad brūyus tad grāhyaṃ vyāvahārikam |
ato yad anyad vibrūyur dharmārthaṃ tad apārthakam || 8.78 ||
svabhāveneti | yat sākṣiṇo bhayādivyatirekeṇa svabhāvād yad brūyus tad vyavahāranirṇayārthaṃ grāhyam | yat punaḥ svābhāvikād anyat kuto ‘pi kāraṇād vadanti tad dharmaviṣaye niṣprayojanaṃ tan na grāhyam || 8.78 ||
sabhāntaḥ sākṣiṇaḥ prāptān arthipratyarthisaṃnidhau |
prāḍvivāko ‘nuyuñjīta vidhinānena sāntvayan || 8.79 ||
sabhāntar ityādi | sabhāmadhyaṃ sākṣiṇaḥ saṃprāptān arthipratyarthisamakṣaṃ rājādhikṛto brāhmaṇaḥ priyoktiṃ racayan vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa pṛcchet || 8.79 ||
yad dvayor anayor vettha kārye ‘smiṃś ceṣṭitaṃ mithaḥ |
tad brūta sarvaṃ satyena yuṣmākaṃ hy atra sākṣitā || 8.80 ||
yad dvayor iti | yad dvayor arthipratyarthinor anayoḥ parasparam asmin kārye ceṣṭitaṃ jānītha tat sarvaṃ satyena kathayata | yato yuṣmākam atra sākṣitvam || 8.80 ||
satyaṃ sākṣye bruvan sākṣī lokān āpnoti puṣkalān |
iha cānuttamāṃ kīrtiṃ vāg eṣā brahmapūjitā || 8.81 ||
satyam iti | sākṣī sākṣye karmaṇi satyaṃ vadan sann utkṛṣṭān brahmalokādīn prāpnoti puṣkalān, iha lokeṣu cātyutkṛṣṭāṃ khyātiṃ labhate | yasmād eṣā satyātmikā vāk caturmukhena pūjitā || 8.81 ||
sākṣye ‘nṛtaṃ vadan pāśair badhyate vāruṇair bhṛśam |
vivaśaḥ śatam ājātīs tasmāt sākṣyaṃ vaded ṛtam || 8.82 ||
sākṣya ityādi | yasmāt sākṣī mṛṣā vācaṃ kathayan varuṇasaṃbandhibhiḥ pāśaiḥ sarparajjubhir jalodareṇa paratantrīkṛtaḥ śataṃ janmāni yāvad atyarthaṃ pīḍyate | tasmāt sākṣye satyaṃ brūyāt || 8.82 ||
satyena pūyate sākṣī dharmaḥ satyena vardhate |
tasmāt satyaṃ hi vaktavyaṃ sarvavarṇeṣu sākṣibhiḥ || 8.83 ||
satyenetyādi | yasmāt satyena pūrvārjitād api pāpāt sākṣī mucyate dharmaś cāsya satyābhidhānena vṛddhim eti tasmāt sarvavarṇaviṣaye sākṣibhiḥ satyaṃ vaktavyam || 8.83 ||
ātmaiva hy ātmanaḥ śakṣī gatir ātmā tathātmanaḥ |
māvamaṃsthāḥ svam ātmānaṃ nṛṇāṃ sākṣiṇam uttamam || 8.84 ||
ātmaiveti | yasmāc chubhāśubhakarmapratiṣṭhā ātmaivātmanaḥ śaraṇaṃ tasmād evaṃ svam ātmānaṃ narāṇāṃ madhyamād uttamaṃ sākṣiṇaṃ mṛṣābhidhānena nāvajñāsīḥ || 8.84 ||
manyante vai pāpakṛto na kaścit paśyatīti naḥ |
tāṃs tu devāḥ prapaśyanti svasyaivāntarapūruṣaḥ || 8.85 ||
manyanta iti | pāpakāriṇa evaṃ manyante ‘smān adharmapravṛttān na kaścit paśyatīti | tān punar vakṣyamāṇā devāḥ paśyanti | svasyāntarapūruṣaḥ paśyati || 8.85 ||
dyaur bhūmir āpo hṛdayaṃ candrārkāgniyamānilāḥ |
rātriḥ saṃdhye ca dharmaś ca vṛttajñāḥ sarvadehinām || 8.86 ||
dyaur ityādi | dyulokapṛthivījalahṛdayasthajīvacandrādityāgniyamavāyurātrisaṃdhyādvaya-dharmāḥ sarvaśarīriṇāṃ śubhāśubhakarmajñāḥ | divādīnāṃ cādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāsti sā ca śarīriṇy ekatrāvasthāpitā tat sarvaṃ jānātīty āgamaprāmāṇyād vedāntadarśanaṃ tad aṅgīkṛtyedam uktam
|| 8.86 ||
devabrāhmaṇasāṃnidhye sākṣyaṃ pṛcched ṛtaṃ dvijān |
udaṅmukhān prāṅmukhān vā pūrvāhṇe vai śuciḥ śucīn || 8.87 ||
devabrāhmaṇeti | pratimā devatā, brāhmaṇasaṃnidhāne śucīn dvijātiprabhṛtīn prāṅmukhān udaṅmukhān vā svayaṃ prayataḥ prāḍvivākaḥ pūrvāhṇe kāle yathātathyaṃ sākṣyaṃ pṛcchet
|| 8.87 ||
brūhīti brāhmaṇaṃ pṛcchet satyaṃ brūhīti pārthivam |
gobījakāñcanair vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ sarvais tu pātakaiḥ || 8.88 ||
brūhītyādi | ‘brūhi’ ity evaṃ śabdam uccārya brāhmaṇaṃ pṛcchet | ‘satyaṃ brūhi’ iti pārthivaṃ kṣatriyaṃ pṛcchet | ‘gobījasuvarṇāpahāre yat pāpaṃ tad bhavato ‘nṛtābhidhāne syāt’ ity evaṃ vaiśyam | śūdraṃ punaḥ ‘sarvair vakṣyamāṇapāpaiḥ saṃbadhyase yadi mṛṣā vadasi’ iti pṛcchet || 8.88 ||
brahmaghno ye smṛtā lokā ye ca strībālaghātinaḥ |
mitradruhaḥ kṛtaghnasya te te syur bruvato mṛṣā || 8.89 ||
brhmaghna iti | brāhmaṇahantuḥ strīghātino bālaghātinaś ca ye narakādilokā ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtāḥ, ye ca mitradrohādikāriṇaḥ, ye copakatur apakāriṇas te te tava mithyā vadato bhaveyuḥ || 8.89 ||
janmaprabhṛti yat kiṃcit puṇyaṃ bhadra tvayā kṛtam |
tat te sarvaṃ śuno gacched yadi brūyās tvam anyathā || 8.90 ||
janmaprabhṛtītyādi | he śubhācāra yat tvayā janmata ārabhya kiṃcit sukṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tat sarvaṃ tvadīyaṃ kukkurādikaṃ saṃkrāmati yadi tvam asatyaṃ bravīṣi || 8.90 ||
eko ‘ham asmīty ātmānaṃ yat tvaṃ kalyāṇa manyase |
nityaṃ sthitas te hṛdy eṣaḥ puṇyapāpekṣitā muniḥ || 8.91 ||
eko ‘ham ityādi | he bhadra eka evāham asmi jīvātmaka iti yad ātmānaṃ manyase maivaṃ maṃsthāḥ | yasmād evaṃ pāpānāṃ puṇyānāṃ ca draṣṭā mananān muniḥ sarvajñas tava hṛdaye paramātmā nityaṃ avasthitaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ |
dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā
samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pariṣasvajāte |
tayor anyaḥ pippalaṃ svādv atty
anaśnann anyo abhicākaśīti || [RV 2.3.17]
|| 8.91 ||
yamo vaivasvato devo yas tavaiṣa hṛdi sthitaḥ |
tena ced avivādas te mā gaṅgā mā kurūn gamaḥ || 8.92 ||
yama iti | sarvasaṃyamanād yamaḥ paramātmā, vaivasvata iti daṇḍadhāritvāt, devanād devaḥ, yas tavaiṣa hṛdi tiṣṭhati tena saha yathārthakathane yadi tavāvivādaḥ yadā tvanmanogatam asāv anyaj jānāti, tvaṃ cānyathā kathayasi tadantaryāmiṇā saha vipratipattiḥ syāt | evaṃ cātra satyābhidhānenaiva niṣpāpaḥ kṛtakṛtyo ‘si | pāpanirharaṇārthaṃ mā gaṅgāṃ mā ca kurukṣetraṃ yāsīḥ | manūktam evātra gaṅgākurukṣetrayoḥ sāmyaṃ matsyapurāṇe vyāsena sphuṭīkṛtam |
kurukṣetrasamā gaṅgā yatratatrāvagāhitā | iti |
medhātithi-govindarājau tu vivasvataḥ putro yo yamo dakṣiṇadikpatir lokataḥ karṇagocarībhūtatvāt tava hṛdaye parisphurati tena saha yadi tadādharmakāritvād vivādo nāsti tadā mā gaṅgāṃ mā kurukṣetraṃ yāsīr iti vyācakṣāte || 8.92 ||
nagno muṇḍaḥ kapālena bhikṣārthī kṣutpipāsitaḥ |
andhaḥ śatrukulaṃ gacched yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtaṃ vadet || 8.93 ||
nagna iti | yaḥ sākṣyam asatyaṃ vadet sa nagnaḥ kṛtamuṇḍanaparibhāvo ‘ndhaḥ karpareṇopalakṣitaḥ bhikṣarthī śatrukulaṃ gacchet || 8.93 ||
avākśirās tamasy andhe kilbiṣī narakaṃ vrajet |
yaḥ praśnaṃ vitathaṃ brūyāt pṛṣṭaḥ san dharmaniścaye || 8.94 ||
avāg iti | yo dharmaniścayanimittaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ sann asatyaṃ brūyāt sa pāpavān adhomukho mahāndhakāre yo narakas taṃ gacchati || 8.94 ||
andho matsyān ivāśnāti sa naraḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ saha |
yo bhāṣate ‘rthavaikalyam apratyakṣaṃ sabhāṃ gataḥ || 8.95 ||
andha iti | yaḥ sabhāṃ prāpto ‘rthasya tattvārthasya vaikalyam ayathārthābhiprāyam apratyakṣam anupalabdham utkocādisukhaleśena kathayati sa naro ‘ndha iva sakaṇṭakān matsyān bhakṣayati sukhabuddhyā pravṛtto duḥkham eva mahal labhate || 8.96 ||
yasya vidvān hi vadataḥ kṣetrajño nābhiśaṅkate |
tasmān na devāḥ śreyāṃsaṃ loke ‘nyaṃ puruṣaṃ viduḥ || 8.96 ||
yasyeti | yasya vadataḥ sarvajño ‘ntaryāmī kim ayaṃ satyaṃ vadaty utānṛtam iti na śaṅketa kiṃ tu satyam evāyaṃ vadatīti nirviśaṅkaḥ saṃpadyate | tasmād anyaṃ praśastataraṃ puruṣaṃ devā na jānanti || 8.96 ||
yāvato bāndhavān yasmin hanti sākṣye ‘nṛtaṃ vadan |
tāvataḥ saṃkhyayā tasmiñ chṛṇu saumyānupūrvaśaḥ || 8.97 ||
yāvata iti | yasmin paśvādinimitte sākṣye ‘nṛtaṃ vadan yatsaṃkhyākān pitrādibāndhavān narake yojayati tatsaṃkhyākān krameṇa parigaṇanayā mayocyamānān sādho śṛṇu | atha vā yāvato bāndhavān yasmin hanti yāvatāṃ bāndhavānāṃ hananaphalaṃ prāpnoti tāvatsaṃkhyākāñ chṛṇu | pakṣadvaye ‘py anṛtanindārtham idam || 8.97 ||
pañca paśvanṛte hanti daśa hanti gavānṛte |
śatam aśvānṛte hanti sahasraṃ puruṣānṛte || 8.98 ||
pañceti | paśuviṣaye ‘nṛte pañca bāndhavān narake yojayati pañcānāṃ bāndhavānāṃ hananaphalaṃ prāpnoti | evaṃ daśa goviṣaye, śatam aśvaviṣaye, sahasraṃ puruṣaviṣaye | saṃkhyāgauravaṃ cedaṃ prāyaścittagauravārtham || 8.98 ||
hanti jātān ajātāṃś ca hiraṇyārthe ‘nṛtaṃ vadan |
sarvaṃ bhūmyanṛte hanti mā sma bhūmyanṛtaṃ vadīḥ || 8.99 ||
hantīti | hiraṇyārthe ‘nṛtaṃ vadañ jātān ajātāṃś ca putraprabhṛtīn narake yojayati eṣāṃ hananaphalaṃ prāpnoti | bhūmiviṣaye cānṛtaṃ vadan sarvaprāṇināṃ hananaphalaṃ prāpnoti | tasmād bhūmiviṣaye ‘nṛtaṃ mā vadīr iti viśiṣyābhidhānam || 8.99 ||
vaidūryādiṣv anṛtaṃ vadato bhūmivad doṣam āha –
apsu bhūmivad ity āhuḥ strīṇāṃ bhoge ca maithune |
abjeṣu caiva ratneṣu sarveṣv aśmamayeṣu ca || 8.100 ||
apsv iti | taḍāgakūpagrāhyodakaviṣaye ‘nṛte strīṇāṃ ca maithunākhyopabhogaviṣaye abjeṣu ca ratneṣu ca muktādiṣu pāṣāṇamayeṣu vaudūryādiṣv anṛte bhūmivad doṣam āhuḥ || 8.100 ||
etān doṣān avekṣya tvaṃ sarvān anṛtabhāṣaṇe |
yathāśrutaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ sarvam evāñjasā vada || 8.101 ||
etān iti | etān asatyabhāṣaṇadoṣān adhigamya dṛṣṭaśrutānatikrameṇa sarvam evāñjasā tattvato brūhi || 8.101 ||
gorakṣakān vāṇijakāṃs tathā kārukuśīlavān |
preṣyān vārdhuṣikāṃś caiva viprāñ śūdravad ācaret || 8.102 ||
gorakṣakān ityādi | gorakṣaṇajīvinaḥ, vāṇijyajīvinaḥ, sūpakārādikārukarmajīvinaḥ, dāsakarmajīvinaḥ, naṭakarmanṛtyagītādijīvinaḥ, pratiṣiddhajīvino brāhmaṇān prakṛtasākṣyadarśane śūdravat pṛcchet || 8.102 ||
tad vadan dharmato ‘rtheṣu jānann apy anyathā naraḥ |
na svargāc cyavate lokād daivīṃ vācaṃ vadanti tām || 8.103 ||
tadvann iti | tad etat sākṣyam anyathāpi jānan manuṣyo dharmeṇa dayādinā vyavahāreṣv anyathā vadan svargalokān na bhraśyati | yasmād yad etan nimittaviśeṣeṇāsatyābhidhānaṃ tāṃ devasaṃbandhinīṃ vācaṃ manvādayo vadanti || 8.103 ||
kva punas tad asatyaṃ vaktavyam ity ata āha –
śūdraviṭkṣatraviprāṇāṃ yatrartoktau bhaved vadhaḥ |
tatra vaktavyam anṛtaṃ tad dhi satyād viśiṣyate || 8.104 ||
śudreti | yasmin vyavahāre satyābhidhāne sati śūdravaiśyakṣatriyabrāhmaṇānāṃ vadhaḥ saṃpadyate tatrāsatyaṃ vaktavyam | yasmāt yasmin viṣaye ‘nṛtaṃ yat tat prāṇarakṣaṇena satyād viśiṣyate | etac ca pramādaskhalitādharmaviṣayatve na tv atyantādhārmikasaṃdhikārastenādiviṣaye | tathā gautamaḥ: “nānṛtavadane doṣo yaj jīvanaṃ cet tadadhīnaṃ na tu pāpīyaso jīvanam” iti | na ca “na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt sarvapāpeṣv api sthitam” (8.380) iti manunāiva vakṣyamāṇatvān na brāhmaṇavadhaprasaktir iti vācyam | uktadaṇḍatvād rājñaḥ kathaṃcit saṃbhavāt | atra vacane śūdrādikrameṇābhidhānaṃ vadhasyāmaṅgalatvāt || 8.104 ||
vāgdaivatyaiś ca carubhir yajeraṃs te sarasvatīm |
anṛtasyainasas tasya kurvāṇā niṣkṛtiṃ parām || 8.105 ||
vāgdaivatir iti | te sākṣiṇo ‘nṛtābhidhāyino vāgdevatākaiś carubhiḥ sarasvatīṃ yajeran | tasyānṛtābhidhānajanitapāpasya prakṛṣṭāṃ śuddhiṃ kurvāṇāḥ | sākṣibahutvāpekṣaṃ cedam | na tv ekasyaiva sākṣiṇaḥ kapiñjalanyāyena carutrayam | yady api vāgdevatāke carau vākśabdenaiva devatātvaṃ na sarasvatīśabdena “vidhiśabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ syāt” iti nyāyāt tathāpi “vāg vai sarasvatī” iti śruter vāksarasvatyor ekārthatvāt sarasvatīm ity upasaṃhāraḥ | atra prakaraṇe cedaṃ prāyaścittābhidhānaṃ lāghavārtham | atra kriyamāṇe śūdraviṭkṣatriyabrāhmaṇa-vadhaviṣayānṛtavādina ity api vaktavyaṃ syāt || 8.105 ||
kūṣmāṇḍair vāpi juhuyād ghṛtam agnau yathāvidhi |
ud ity ṛcā vā vāruṇyā tṛcenābdaivatena vā || 8.106 ||
kūṣmāṇdair iti | kūṣmāṇḍamantrā yajurvedikā “yad devā devaheḍanam” (20.14) ityevamādayas tair mantradevatāyai ghṛtam agnau juhuyāt | yathāvidhi paristaraṇāditvāt svadharmeṇa svagṛhyoktena | “ud uttamaṃ varuṇa pāśam” (RV 1.2.15) ity etayā varuṇadevatākayā “āpo hi ṣṭhāḥ” (RV 7.6.5) iti tṛceṇa vāgdevatākena juhuyāt ghṛtam agnāv iti sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ || 8.106 ||
tripakṣād abruvan sākṣyam ṛṇādiṣ naro ‘gadaḥ |
tad ṛṇaṃ prāpnuyāt sarvaṃ daśabandhaṃ ca sarvataḥ || 8.107 ||
tripakṣād iti | avyādhitaḥ sākṣī ṛṇādānādivyavahāre tripakṣaparyantaṃ yadi sākṣyaṃ na vadet tadā tadvivādāspadaṃ sarvam ṛṇam uttamārṇasya dadyāt, asya ca sarvasyarṇasya daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ rājño daṇḍaṃ dadyāt || 8.107 ||
yasya dṛśyeta saptāhād uktavākyasya sākṣiṇaḥ |
rogo ‘gnir jñātimaraṇam ṛṇaṃ dāpyo damaṃ ca saḥ || 8.108 ||
yasyeti | yasya sākṣiṇa uktasākṣyasya saptāhamadhye vyādhyagnidāhasaṃnihitaputrādijñāti-maraṇānām anyatamaṃ bhavati daivasūcitamithyābhidoṣatvād ṛṇam uttamarṇasya daṇḍaṃ ca rājñā dāpyaḥ || 8.108 ||
asākṣikeṣu tv artheṣu mitho vivadamānayoḥ |
avindaṃs tattvataḥ satyaṃ śapathenāpi lambhayet || 8.109 ||
asākṣikeṣv iti | avidyamānasākṣikeṣu vyavahāreṣu parasparaṃ vivadamānayos tattvataś chalādivyatirekeṇa satyam alabhamānaḥ prāḍvivāko vakṣyamāṇena śapathena satyam unnayet
|| 8.109 ||
maharṣibhiś ca devaiś ca kāryārthaṃ śapathāḥ kṛtāḥ |
vasiṣṭhaś cāpi śapathaṃ śepe paijavane nṛpe || 8.110 ||
maharṣibhiś ceti | saptarṣibhir devaiś cendrādibhiḥ saṃdigdhakāryanirṇayārthaṃ śapathāḥ kṛtāḥ | vasiṣṭho ‘py anena putraśataṃ bhakṣitam iti viśvāmitreṇākruṣṭaḥ svapariśuddhaye pijavanāpatye sudāsi rājani śapathaṃ cakāra | anekārthatvād dhātūnāṃ śapir api karotyarthaḥ
|| 8.110 ||
na vṛthā śapathaṃ kuryāt svalpe ‘py arthe naro budhaḥ |
vṛthā hi śapathaṃ kurvan pretya ceha ca naśyati || 8.111 ||
na vṛtheti | svalpe ‘pi kārye na vṛtha śapathaṃ paṇḍitaḥ kuryāt | vṛthā śapathaṃ kurvan paraloka ihaloke narakaprāptyākīrtiprāptyā ca nāśaṃ prāpnoti || 8.111 ||
vṛthaśapathapratiprasavārtham āha –
kāminīṣu vivāheṣu gavāṃ bhakṣye tathendhane |
brāhmaṇābhyupapattau ca śapathe nāsti pātakam || 8.112 ||
kāminīṣv iti | bahubhāryasya ‘nānyām ahaṃ kāmaye tvam eva matpreyasī’ ity evaṃviśiṣṭaḥ suratalābhārthaṃ kāminīviṣaye, vivāhaviṣaye ca ‘mayānyā na voḍhavyā’ ityādau, gavārthaṃ ghāsādyupahāre ca, agnau homārtham indhanādyupahāre, brāhmaṇarakṣārtham aṅgīkṛtadhanādau vṛthā śapathe pāpaṃ na bhavati || 8.112 ||
satyena śāpayed vipraṃ kṣatriyaṃ vāhanāyudhaiḥ |
gobījakāñcanair vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ sarvais tu pātakaiḥ || 8.113 ||
satyeneti | brāhmaṇaṃ satyaśabdoccāraṇena śāpayet | kṣatriyaṃ vāhanāyudhaṃ mama niṣphalaṃ syād ity evam | vaiśyaṃ gobījakāñcanāni ca mama niṣphalāni syur ity evam | śūdraṃ ca sarvāṇi me pātakāni syur ity evaṃ śāpayet || 8.113 ||
kāryagauravalāghavāpekṣayā –
agniṃ vāhārayed enam apsu cainaṃ nimajjayet |
putradārasya vāpy enaṃ śirāṃsi sparśayet pṛthak || 8.114 ||
agnim iti | agnisaṃnibhaṃ pañcāśatpalikam aṣṭāṅgulam ayāpiṇḍaṃ hastadvayavinyastasaptāśvatthapatraṃ śūdrādikaṃ sapta padāni pitāmahādyuktavidhānād āhārayet | jalaukādirahitajale cainaṃ nimajjayet | aśeṣetikartavyatā smṛtyantare jñeyā | putrāṇāṃ dārāṇāṃ ca pṛthak śirasy enaṃ sparśayet || 8.114 ||
yam iddho na dahaty agnir āpo nonmajjayanti ca |
na cārtim ṛcchati kṣipraṃ sa jñeyaḥ śapathe śuciḥ || 8.115 ||
yam iti | yaṃ pradīpto ‘gnir na dahati, āpaś ca nordhvaṃ nayanti, na cārtim eva mahatīṃ prāpnoti sa śapathe viśuddho jñeyaḥ || 8.115 ||
atra prakṛtam arthavādam āha –
vatsasya hy abhiśastasya purā bhrātrā yavīyasā |
nāgnir dadāha romāpi satyena jagataḥ spaśaḥ || 8.116 ||
vatsasyeti | yasmāt pūrvakāle vatsanāmna ṛṣer na tvaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrāpatyo ‘sīty evaṃ kanīyasā vaimātreyeṇābhikruṣṭasya naitad evam iti sa yathārtham agniṃ praviṣṭasyāgniḥ sarvasya jagataḥ śubhāśubhakartavye cārabhūtaḥ satyena hetunā romaikam api vahnir na dagdhavān || 8.116 ||
yasmin yasmin vivāde tu kauṭasākṣyaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet |
tat tat karyaṃ nivarteta kṛtaṃ cāpy akṛtaṃ bhavet || 8.117 ||
yasminn iti | yasmin yasmin vyavahāre sākṣibhir anṛtaṃ uktam iti niścitaṃ bhavet tat kāryam asamāptaṃ prāḍvivākaḥ punar api nivartayet | yad api ca daṇḍasamāptiparyantatāṃ nītaṃ tad api punaḥ parīkṣeta || 8.117 ||
vakṣyamāṇaviśeṣārthaṃ lobhādīn pṛthaṅ nirdiśati –
lobhān mohād bhayān maitrāt kāmāt krodhāt tathaiva ca |
ajñānād bālabhāvāc ca sākṣyaṃ vitatham ucyate || 8.118 ||
lobhād iti | lobhena, viparītajñānena, bhayena, snehena, kāmena, krodhena, ajñānena, anavadhānena sākṣyam asatyam ucyate || 8.118 ||
eṣām anyatame sthāne yaḥ sākṣyam anṛtaṃ vadet |
tasya daṇḍaviśeṣāṃs tu pravakṣyāmy anjupūrvaśaḥ || 8.119 ||
eṣām iti | eṣāṃ lobhādīnāṃ madhyād anyatamasmin nimitte sati yo mithyā sākṣyaṃ kathayet tasya daṇḍaviśeṣān kramaśo vadiṣyāmi || 8.119 ||
lobhāt sahasraṃ daṇḍyas tu mohāt pūrvaṃ tu sāhasam |
bhayād dvau madhyamau daṇḍau maitrāt pūrvaṃ caturguṇam || 8.120 ||
lobhād iti | lobhena mithyābhidhāne sati vakṣyamāṇapaṇānāṃ sahasraṃ daṇḍyaḥ, mohena prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ vakṣyamāṇam, bhayena ca vakṣyamāṇau madhyamasāhasau, maitrāt prathamasāhasaṃ caturguṇam || 8.120 ||
kāmād daśaguṇaṃ pūrvaṃ krodhāt tu triguṇaṃ param |
ajñānād dve śate pūrṇe bāliśyāc chatam eva tu || 8.121 ||
kāmād iti | strīsaṃbhogarūpakāmānurodhena mithyā vadan prathamasāhasaṃ daśaguṇaṃ daṇḍyaḥ | krodhena tu paraṃ madhyamasāhasaṃ triguṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ, ajñānatvād dve śate, bāliśyād anavadhānāt paṇaśatam eva daṇḍya iti sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ || 8.121 ||
etān āhuḥ kauṭasākṣye proktān daṇḍān manīṣibhiḥ |
dharmasyāvyabhicārārtham adharmaniyamāya ca || 8.122 ||
etān iti | satyarūpadharmasyāparilopārtham asatyarūpādharmasya ca vāraṇārtham etān kauṭasākṣyaviṣaye pūrvair munibhir uktān daṇḍān manvādaya āhuḥ | etac ca sakṛtkauṭasākṣye
|| 8.122 ||
bhūyobhūyaḥ kauṭasakṣyakaraṇeṣu tu –
kauṭasākṣyaṃ tu karvāṇāṃs trīn varṇān dhārmiko nṛpaḥ |
pravāsayed daṇḍayitvā brāhmaṇaṃ tu vivāsayet || 8.123 ||
kauṭasākṣyam iti | kṣatryādīṃs trīn varṇān kauṭasākṣyāt pūrvoktena daṇḍayitvā dhārmiko rājā svarāṣṭrād vivāsayet | brāhmaṇaṃ tu dhanadaṇḍavyatirekeṇa svarāṣṭrān niḥsārayet,
na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt sarvapāpeṣv avasthitam |
rāṣṭrād enaṃ bahiḥ kuryāt samagradhanam akṣatam || (8.380)
iti dhanasahitanirvāsanasyābhidhāsyamānatvāt | govindarājas tu “brāhmaṇaṃ punaḥ pūrvadaṇḍena daṇḍayitvā nagnaṃ kuryād” iti vyācaṣṭte | medhātithis tu brāḥmaṇasya “vivāsastvaṃ vāso’paharaṇaṃ gṛhabhaṅgo vā” ity ācaṣṭe || 8.123 ||
daśa sthānāni daṇḍasya manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo ‘bravīt |
triṣu varṇeṣu yāni syur akṣato brāhmaṇo vrajet || 8.124 ||
daśeti | hairaṇyagarbho manur daśa daṇḍasthānāny uktavān yāni kṣatriyādivarṇatrayaviṣaye bhavanti | brāhmaṇaḥ punar mahaty aparādhe ‘kṣataśarīro deśān niḥsāryate || 8.124 ||
upastham udaraṃ jihvā hastau pādau ca pañcamam |
cakṣur nāsā ca karṇau ca dhanaṃ dehas tathaiva ca || 8.125 ||
upastham iti | liṅgādīny etāni daśa daṇḍasthānāni, atas tattadaṅgenāparādhe sati aparādhalāghavagauravāpekṣayā tattadaṅgatāḍanavedanādi kartavyam | alpāparādhe yathāśrutaṃ dhanadaṇḍaḥ | dehadaṇḍo māraṇaṃ mahāpātakādau || 8.125 ||
anubandhaṃ parijñāya deśakālau ca tattvataḥ |
sārāparādhau cālokya daṇḍaṃ daṇḍyeṣu pātayet || 8.126 ||
anubandham iti | punaḥ punar icchāto ‘parādhakaraṇam apekṣya grāmāraṇyādicāparādhisthānaṃ rātryādikaṃ vāparādhasyāpekṣya sāraṃ cāparādhakāriṇo dhanaśarīrādisāmarthyam aparādhaṃ ca gurulaghubhāvena cālokya daṇḍanīyeṣu daṇḍaṃ kuryāt | etac cābhihitābhidhāsyamānadaṇḍaśeṣabhūtam || 8.126 ||
adharmadaṇḍanaṃ loke yaśoghnaṃ kīrtināśanam |
asvargyaṃ ca paratrāpi tasmāt tat parivarjayet || 8.127 ||
adharmeti | jīvataḥ khyātir yaśaḥ, mṛtasya khyātiḥ kīrtiḥ, yasmād anubandhādy anapekṣya daṇḍanam iha loke yaśonāśanaṃ mṛtasya ca kīrtināśanaṃ paraloke ca dharmāntarārjitasvargapratibandhakaṃ tasmāt tat parityajet || 8.127 ||
adaṇḍyān daṇḍayan rājā daṇḍyāṃś caivāpy adaṇḍayan |
ayaśo mahad āpnoti narakaṃ caiva gacchati || 8.128 ||
adaṇḍyān iti | rājā daṇḍānarhān dhanalobhādinā daṇḍayan, daṇḍārhāś cānurodhādinotsṛjan mahatīm akhyātiṃ prāpnoti narakaṃ ca vrajati || 8.128 ||
vāgdaṇḍaṃ prathamaṃ kuryād dhigdaṇḍaṃ tadanantaram |
tṛtīyaṃ dhanadaṇḍaṃ tu vadhadaṇḍam ataḥ param || 8.129 ||
vāgdaṇḍam iti | “na sādhu kṛtavān asi maivaṃ bhūyaḥ kārṣīḥ” ity evaṃ vāṅnirbhartsanaṃ prathamāparādhe guṇavataḥ kuryāt | tathāpi yadi nopaśāmyati tadā “dhig jālma mā jīvahānis te pāpasya bhūyāt” ity evamādi tasya kāryam | evam api cen nāvatiṣthate tadātaḥ paraṃ vadhadaṇḍaṃ tāḍanādyaṅgacchedarūpaṃ tasya kuryān na māraṇam || 8.129 ||
yato vakṣyati –
vadhenāpi yadā tv etān nigrahītuṃ na śaknuyāt |
tadaiṣu sarvam apy etat prayuñjīta catuṣṭayam || 8.130 ||
vadhenāpi yadā tv etān iti | vyastenāṅgacchedenāpi daṇḍyān vaśe kartuṃ na śaknuyāt tadā eteṣu sarvaṃ vāgdaṇḍādicatuṣṭayaṃ kuryāt || 8.130 ||
lokasaṃvyavahārārthaṃ yāḥ saṃjñāḥ prathitā bhuvi |
tāmrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ tāḥ pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ || 8.131 ||
loketi | tāmrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ yāḥ paṇādisaṃjñāḥ krayavikrayādilokavyavahārārthaṃ pṛthivyāṃ prasiddhās tā daṇḍādyupayogārthaṃ sākalyena kathayiṣyāmi || 8.131 ||
jālāntaragate bhānau yat sūkṣmaṃ dṛśyate rajaḥ |
prathamaṃ tat pramāṇānāṃ trasareṇuṃ pracakṣate || 8.132 ||
jālāntareti | gavākṣavivarapraviṣṭasūryaraśmiṣu yat sūkṣmaṃ rajo dṛśyate tad dṛśyamānaparimāṇānāṃ prathamaṃ trasareṇuṃ vadanti || 8.132 ||
trasareṇavo ‘ṣṭau vijñeyā likṣaikā parimāṇataḥ |
tā rājasarṣapas tisras te trayo gaurasarṣapaḥ || 8.133 ||
trasareṇava iti | aṣṭau trasareṇavo likṣaikā parimāṇena jñeyā | tās tisro likṣā rājasarṣapo jñeyaḥ, te rājasarṣapās trayo gaurasarṣapo jñeyaḥ || 8.133 ||
sarṣapāḥ ṣaḍ yavo madhyas triyavaṃ tv ekakṛṣṇalam |
pañcakṛṣṇalako māṣas te suvarṇas tu ṣoḍaśa || 8.134 ||
