sarṣapā iti | gaurasarṣapāḥ ṣaṭ madhyo na sthūlo nāpi sūkṣmo yavo bhavati | tribhir yavaiḥ kṛṣṇalaṃ raktiketi prasiddham | pañcabhiḥ kṛṣṇalair māṣaḥ | ṣoḍaśa māṣāḥ suvarṇaḥ syāt | puṃliṅgaś cāyaṃ parimāṇavacanaḥ || 8.134 ||
palaṃ suvarṇāś catvāraḥ palāni dharaṇaṃ daśa |
dve kṛṣṇale samadhṛte vijñeyo rūpyamāṣakaḥ || 8.135 ||
palam iti | catvāraḥ suvarṇāḥ palaṃ syāt | daśa palāni dharaṇam | kṛṣṇaladvayaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā tulayā dhṛtaṃ rūpyamāṣako boddhavyaḥ || 8.135 ||
te ṣoḍaśa syād dharaṇaṃ purāṇaś caiva rājataḥ |
kārṣāpaṇas tu vijñeyas tāmrikaḥ kārṣikaḥ paṇaḥ || 8.136 ||
te ṣoḍaśeti | te ṣoḍaśa rūpyamāṣakā raupyadharaṇaṃ purāṇaś ca rājato rajatasaṃbandhī syāt | kārṣikas tāmramayaḥ kārṣāpaṇaḥ paṇa iti vijñeyaḥ | kārṣikaś ca śāstrīyapalacaturthabhāgo boddhavyaḥ | ata eva “palaṃ karṣacatuṣṭayam” ity ābhidhānikāḥ || 8.136 ||
dharaṇāni daśa jñeyaḥ śatamānas tu rājataḥ |
catuḥsauvarṇiko niṣko vijñeyas tu pramāṇataḥ || 8.137 ||
daraṇānīti | daśa rūpyadharaṇāni raupyaśatamāno jñātavyaḥ | caturbhiḥ suvarṇair niṣkaḥ pramāṇena boddhavyaḥ || 8.137 ||
paṇānāṃ dve śate sārdhe prathamaḥ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ |
madhyamaḥ pañca vijñeyaḥ sahasraṃ tv eva cottamaḥ || 8.138 ||
paṇānām iti | pañcāśadadhike dve paṇaśate prathamasāhaso manvādibhiḥ smṛtaḥ | paṇapañcaśatāni madhyamaḥ sāhasro jñeyaḥ | paṇasahasraṃ tūttamasāhaso jñeyaḥ
|| 8.138 ||
ṛṇe deye pratijñāte pañcakaṃ śatam arhati |
apahnave taddviguṇaṃ tan manor anuśāsanam || 8.139 ||
ṛṇa iti | ‘mayottamarṇasya dhanaṃ deyam’ iti sabhāyām adhamarṇenokte saty adhamarṇaḥ paṇaśatāt pañca paṇā ity evaṃ daṇḍam arhati | yadā tu sabhāyām api na kiṃcid asmai dārayāmīty evam apalapati tadā paṇaśatād daśapaṇā ity evaṃ daṇḍam arhati | ity evaṃ manusmṛtau daṇḍaprakāraḥ || 8.139 ||
vasiṣṭhavihitāṃ vṛddhiṃ sṛjed vittavivardhinīm |
aśītibhāgaṃ gṛhṇīyān māsād vārdhuṣikaḥ śate || 8.140 ||
vasiṣṭheti | vasiṣṭhenoktāṃ vṛddhiṃ dharmyatvād dhanavṛddhikarīṃ vṛddhijīvī gṛhṇīyāt | tām eva darśayati – śate prayukte ‘śītibhāgaṃ pratimāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ gṛhṇīyāt || 8.140 ||
dvikaṃ śataṃ vā gṛhṇīyāt satāṃ dharmam anusmaran |
dvikaṃ śataṃ hi gṛhṇāno na bhavaty arthakilbiṣī || 8.141 ||
dvikam iti | sādhūnām ayaṃ dharma iti manyamānaḥ paṇaśate prayukte paṇadvayaṃ vā pratimāsaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | yasmāt dvikaṃ śataṃ hi gṛhṇāno vṛddhidhanagrahaṇe kilbiṣī na bhavati || 8.141 ||
dvikaṃ trikaṃ catuṣkaṃ ca pañcakaṃ ca śataṃ samam |
māsasya vṛddhiṃ gṛhṇīyād varṇānām anupūrvaśaḥ || 8.142 ||
dvikam iti | brāhmaṇādivarṇānāṃ krameṇa dvikaṃ trikaṃ catuṣkaṃ pañcakaṃ śataṃ samam ito nādhikaṃ māsasya saṃbandhinīṃ vṛddhiṃ gṛhṇīyāt | nanv aśītibhāgo laghu dvikaśatagrahaṇaṃ guru, katham imau brāhmaṇasya laghugurukalpau vikalpetām | atra medhātithi-govindarājau tu pūrvavṛddhyā nirvāhāsaṃbhave dvikaśataparigraha iti vyācakṣāte | idaṃ tu vadāmaḥ – sabandhakeṣv aśītibhāgagrahaṇam | bandhakarahite tu dvikaśatavṛddhiparigrahaḥ | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
aśītibhāgo vṛddhiḥ syān māsi māsi sabandhake |
varṇakramāc chataṃ dvitricatuḥpañcakam anyathā || [YDh 3.37]
vedāntodgītamahaso muner vyākhyānam ādriye |
tadviruddhaṃ svabuddhyā ca nibaddham adhunātanaiḥ ||
|| 8.142 ||
na tv evādhau sopakāre kausīdīṃ vṛddhim āpnuyāt |
na cādheḥ kālasaṃrodhān nisargo ‘sti na vikrayaḥ || 8.143 ||
neti | bhūmigodhanādau bhogārthaṃ bandhake datte dhanaprayogabhavām anantaroktāṃ vṛddhim uttamarṇo na labhate | kālasaṃrodhāc cirakālāvasthānād dviguṇībhūtamūladhana-praveśe ‘pi na nisargo ‘nyasmai dānaṃ, na vānyato vikrayaḥ | medhātithi-govindarājau tu ādheś cirakālāvasthāne ‘pi na nisargo nānyatra bandhake nārpaṇam iti vyācakṣāte | atra tu sarvadeśīyaśiṣṭācāravirodhaḥ bandhakīkṛtabhūmyāder anyatrādhīkaraṇasamācārāt || 8.143 ||
na bhoktavyo balād ādhir bhuñjāno vṛddhim utsṛjet |
mūlyena toṣayec cainam ādhisteno ‘nyathā bhavet || 8.144 ||
na bhoktavya iti | gopyādhiviṣayaṃ vacanam idam | vastrālaṃkārāir gopyādhir balān na bhoktavyaḥ | bhuñjāno vṛddhim utsṛjet pāṅmūlyenātrainaṃ toṣayet | yad vā bhogenāsāratām ādhau nīte sārāvasthādhimūlyadānena svāminaṃ toṣayet, anyathā bandhakacauraḥ syāt || 8.144 ||
ādhiś copanidhiś cobhau na kālātyayam arhataḥ |
avahāryau bhavetāṃ tau dīrghakālam avasthitau || 8.145 ||
āshiś ceti | ādhir bandhakaḥ, upanidhīyata ity upanidhiḥ prītyā bhogārtham arpitaṃ dravyam | nāradasmṛtilakṣitau ca nikṣepopanidhī tāv evātra upanidhiśabdena gṛhyete | etāv ādhyupanidhī cirakālāvasthitāv api na kālātyayam arhataḥ | yadaiva svāminā prārthitau tadaiva tasyāvahāryau samarpaṇīyāv ity arthaḥ || 8.145 ||
saṃprītyā bhujyamānāni na naśyanti kadācana |
dhenur uṣṭro vahann aśvo yaś ca damyaḥ prayujyate || 8.146 ||
saṃprītyeti | “yat kiṃcid daśa varṣāṇi” (8.147) ity anantaraṃ bhogena svatvahāniṃ vakṣyati, tadapavādārtham idam | dṛśyamānā gaur uṣṭro ‘śvaś ca vahan damanārthaṃ ca prayukto balīvardādiḥ ete prītyānyena tu bhujyamānāḥ kadācid api svāmino na naśyanti | pradarśanartham idaṃ prītyopabhujyamānaṃ na naśyatīti vivakṣitam | sāmānyopakramaṃ cedaṃ viśeṣābhidhānam iti napuṃsakaliṅgatā || 8.146 ||
yat kiṃcid daśavarṣāṇi saṃnidhau prekṣate dhanī |
bhujyamānaṃ parais tūṣṇīṃ na sa tal labdhum arhati || 8.147 ||
yat kiṃcid iti | yat kiṃcid dhanajātaṃ samakṣam eva prītyādivyatirekeṇa parair daśavarṣāṇi bhujyamānaṃ svāmī prekṣate, mā bhuṅkṣvetyādipratiṣedhoktiṃ na racayati, nāsau tal labdhuṃ yogyo bhavati | tasya tatra svāmyaṃ nivartata iti bhāvaḥ || 8.147 ||
ajaḍaś ced apogaṇḍo viṣaye cāsya bhujyate |
bhagnaṃ tad vyavahāreṇa bhoktā tad dhanam arhati || 8.148 ||
ajaḍa iti | jaḍo buddhivikalaḥ | nyūnaṣoḍaśavarṣaḥ pogaṇḍaḥ | tathā ca nāradaḥ |
bāla ā ṣoḍaśād varṣāt pogaṇḍaś cāpi śabditaḥ |
sa dhanasvāmī yadi jaḍaḥ pogaṇḍaś ca bhavati tadīyadarśanaviṣaye ca taddhanaṃ bhujyate tadā svāmino vyavahāreṇa naṣṭaṃ tato bhoktur eva tad dhanaṃ bhavati || 8.148 ||
ādhiḥ sīmā bāladhanaṃ nikṣepopanidhiḥ striyaḥ |
rājasvaṃ śrotriyasvaṃ ca na bhogena praṇaśyati || 8.149 ||
ādhir iti | bandhaḥ, grāmādimaryādā, bāladhanaṃ, nikṣepaḥ “vāsanastham anākhyāya samudraṃ yan nidhīyate” ity nāradokta upanidhilakṣaṇaḥ, dāsyādistriyaḥ, rājaśrotriyadhnāni, uktena daśavarṣabhogena na svāmino naśyanti na bhoktuḥ svatvaṃ bhajante || 8.149 ||
yaḥ svāminānanujñātam ādhiṃ bhuṅkte ‘vicakṣaṇaḥ |
tenārdhavṛddhir moktavyā tasya bhogasya niṣkṛtiḥ || 8.150 ||
yaḥ svāmineti | yo vṛddhyā dattaṃ bandhaṃ svāmyanujñāvyatirekeṇa mūrkho nihnavena bhuṅkte tena tasya bhogasya saṃśuddhyartham ardhavṛddhir moktavyā | balabhogena tu bhoktavye balād adhibhuñjāne sati sarvavṛddhityāga evoktaḥ || 8.150 ||
kusīdavṛddhir dvaiguṇyaṃ nātyeti sakṛdāhṛtā |
dhānye sade lave vāhye nātikrāmati pañcatām || 8.151 ||
kusideti | vṛddhyā dhanaprayogaḥ kusīdaṃ, tatra yā vṛddhiḥ sakṛdgṛhītā sā dvaiguṇyaṃ nātikrāmati mūlavṛddhir dviguṇaiva bhavati | pratidinapratimāsādigrāhyeti tātparyam | dhānye punar vṛddhyādiprayukte, sade vṛkṣaphale, lūyata iti lava ūrṇā loma tasmin, vāhanīye ca balīvardādau prayukte cireṇāpi kālena mūladhānyādinā saha pañcaguṇatāṃ nātikrāmed iti
|| 8.151 ||
kṛtānusārād adhikā vyatiriktā na sidhyati |
kusīdapatham āhus taṃ pañcakaṃ śatam arhati || 8.152 ||
kṛtānusārād iti | kṛtā vā vṛddhir dvikaṃ trikam iti śāstreṇa varṇakrameṇoktā tasyāḥ śāstrānusārād adhikā vyatiriktā kṛtā | ato ‘nyā vṛddhir akṛtety arthaḥ | kiṃ tu kṛtāpi vṛddhir varṇakrameṇa dvikatrikaśatādirūpair yā māse grāhyā | tathā ca viṣṇuḥ: “vṛddhiṃ dadyur akṛtā api vatsarātikrame yathābhihitā varṇakrameṇa” dvikatrikādinety arthaḥ | kiṃ tv akṛtavṛddhā api viśeṣāntaram āha – kutsitāt prasaraty ayaṃ panthā iti kusīdapathaḥ | ayam adhamarṇo yac chūdraviṣayoktaṃ pañcakaṃ śataṃ dvijāter api gṛhṇātīty evaṃ kutsitaḥ panthāḥ | pūrvoktād dharmyavṛddhikarād apakṛṣṭa ity evaṃ manvādayaḥ āhuḥ | evaṃ cākṛtā vṛddhir uddhāraviṣaye yācanād ūrdhvaṃ boddhavyā | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
prītidattaṃ ca vardheta yāvan na pratiyācitam |
yācyamānaṃ na dattaṃ ced vardate pañcakaṃ śatam ||
|| 8.152 ||
nātisāṃvatsarīṃ vṛddhiṃ na cādṛṣṭāṃ punar haret |
cakravṛddhiḥ kālavṛddhiḥ kāritā kāyikā ca yā || 8.153 ||
nātīti | mamaikasmin māsi māsadvaye māsatraye vā gate tasya vṛddhiṃ vigaṇayyaikadā dātavyety evaṃvidhaniyamapūrvakavṛddhigrahaṇam uttamarṇaḥ saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ kuryāt | nātikrānte saṃvatsare niyamasya vṛddhiṃ gṛhṇīyāt | na ca śāstrād adṛṣṭām uktādharmyadvikatrikaśatādhyadhikāṃ gṛhṇīyāt | adharmatvabodhanārtho niṣedhaḥ | cakravṛddhyādicatuṣṭayīṃ cāśāstrīyāṃ na gṛhṇīyāt | tāsāṃ svarūpam āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
kāyikā kāyasaṃyuktā māsagrāhyā ca kālikā |
vṛddher vṛddhiś cakravṛddhiḥ kāritā ṛṇinā kṛtā ||
tatra cakravṛddhiḥ svarūpeṇaiva garhitā | kālavṛddhis tu dviguṇādhikagrahaṇena kāyikā cātivāhadohādinā kāritā | ṛṇikena yānāpatkāla evottamarṇapīḍayā kṛtā | catasro ‘pi vṛddhīr aśāstrīyā na gṛhṇīyāt | tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
bhāgo yad dviguṇād ūrdhvaṃ cakravṛddhiś ca gṛhyate |
pūrṇe ca sodaye paścād vārdhuṣyaṃ tad vigarhitam ||
kātyāyanaḥ |
ṛṇikena kṛtā vṛddhir adhikā saṃprakalpitā |
āpatkālakṛtā nityaṃ dātavyā kāritā tathā |
anyathā kāritā vṛddhir na dātavyā kathaṃcana ||
|| 8.153 ||
ṛṇaṃ dātum aśakto yaḥ kartum icchet punaḥ kriyām |
sa datvā nirjitāṃ vṛddhiṃ karaṇaṃ parivartayet || 8.154 ||
ṛṇaṃ dātum iti | yo ‘dhamarṇo dhanadānāsāmarthyāt punar lekhyādikriyāṃ kartum icchet sa nirjitām uttmarṇaḥ svatvatyātmasātkṛtāṃ vṛddhiṃ datvā karaṇaṃ lekhyaṃ punaḥ kuryāt
|| 8.154 ||
adarśayitvā tatraiva hiraṇyaṃ parivartayet |
yāvatī saṃbhaved vṛddhis tāvatīṃ dātum arhati || 8.155 ||
adarśayitveti | yadi daivagatyā vṛddhihiraṇyam api samaye dātuṃ na śaknoti tadā tad gṛhītvaiva tatraiva punaḥ kriyamāṇe lekhyādau vṛddhihiraṇyādiśeṣam āropayet | yatpramāṇaṃ cakravṛddhidhanaṃ tadānīṃ saṃbhavati tad dātum arhati || 8.155 ||
cakravṛddhiṃ samārūḍho deśakālavyavasthitaḥ |
atikrāman deśakālau na tatphalam āpnuyāt || 8.156 ||
cakravṛddhim iti | cakravṛddhiśabdenātra cakravac chakaṭādibhārarūpā vṛddhir abhimatā | cakravṛddhim āśrita uttamarṇo deśakālavyavasthito yadi vārāṇasīparyantaṃ lavaṇādi śakaṭena vahāmi tadā mamedaṃ yad dhanaṃ dātavyam iti vetanarūpadeśavyavasthitiḥ | yadi māsaṃ yāvad vahāmi tadā māsaṃ yad dhanaṃ dātavyam iti kālavyavasthitiḥ | evam abhyupagatadeśakālaniyamasthau deśakālau daivād apūrayan śakaṭādinā vahan lābharūpaphalaṃ sakalaṃ na prāpnoti || 8.156 ||
api tu –
samudrayānakuśalā deśakālārthadarśinaḥ |
sthāpayanti tu yāṃ vṛddhiṃ sā tatrādhigamaṃ prati || 8.157 ||
samudreti | sthalapathajalapathayāne nipuṇā iyaddeśaparyantam iyatkālaparyantam ūhyamāne sati etāvāṃl lābho grahītuṃ yukta ity evaṃ deśalābhadhanajñā vaṇigādayo yāṃ vṛddhiṃ tathāviṣaye cāvasthāpayanti saiva tatra vyavasthā tatrādhigamaṃ dhanaprāptiṃ prati pramāṇam || 8.157 ||
yo yasya pratibhūs tiṣṭhed darśanāyeha mānavaḥ |
adarśayan sa taṃ tasya yateta svadhanād ṛṇam || 8.158 ||
yo yasyeti | yo manuṣyo yasya darśanāya pratibhūs tiṣṭhed dhanadānakāle mamāyam adhamarṇo darśanīya ity sa taṃ tasmin kāla uttamarṇasyādarśayaṃs tad dhanaṃ dātuṃ yateta
|| 8.158 ||
prātibhāvyaṃ vṛthādānam ākṣikaṃ saurikaṃ ca yat |
daṇḍaśulkāvaśeṣaṃ ca na putro dātum arhati || 8.159 ||
prātibhāvyam iti | pratibhūtvena yad deyaṃ dhanaṃ tat prātibhāvyaṃ, vṛthādānaṃ parihāsanimittaṃ daṇḍādibhyo deyatvena pitrāṅgīkṛtaṃ, dyūtanimittaṃ surānimittaṃ ca, daṇḍaṃ yad deyaṃ daṇḍaṃ, śulkaṃ ghaṭṭādideyaṃ tadavaśeṣaṃ ca pitṛsaṃbandhinaṃ pitari mṛte putro dātum nārhati || 8.159 ||
darśanaprātibhāvye tu vidhiḥ syāt pūrvacoditaḥ |
dānapratibhivi prete dāyādān api dāpayet || 8.160 ||
darśaneti | surānimittaṃ ca yad deyaṃ daṇḍaṃ prātibhāvyaṃ na putro dātum arhatīti yo ‘yaṃ pūrvopadeśaḥ sa darśanapratibhuvaḥ pitur deyo jñeyaḥ | dānapratibhuvi tu pitari mṛte putraṃ ṛṇaṃ dāpayet || 8.160 ||
adātari punar dātā vijñātaprakṛtāv ṛṇam |
paścāt pratibhuvi prete parīpset kena hetunā || 8.161 ||
adātarīti | adātari dānapratibhuvo ‘nyasmin darśanapratibhuvi pratyayapratibhuvi vā vijñātaprātibhāvyakāraṇamūlaśodhanocitadhanagrahaṇaṃ yasya tasmin mṛte dātottamarṇaḥ paścāt kena hetunā dhanaṃ prāptum icchati || 8.161 ||
pratibhuvo mṛtatvāt tatputrasya cādānapratibhūtvenādātṛtvāditvāśaṅkyāha –
nirādiṣṭadhanaś cet tu pratibhūḥ syād alaṃdhanaḥ |
svadhanād eva tad dadyān nirādiṣṭa iti sthitiḥ || 8.162 ||
nirdiṣṭeti | asau darśanapratibhūḥ pratyayapratibhūr vā yadi nirādiṣṭadhano ‘dhamarṇena nisṛṣṭadhano yāvatā dhanenāsau pratibhūs tacchodhanaparyāptadhanas tad ātmadhanād eva tad dhanaṃ nirādiṣṭo ‘tra nirādiṣṭadhanaputro lakṣaṇayocyate | ṛṇam uttamarṇāya dadyād iti śāstrasaṃpradāyaḥ || 8.162 ||
mattonmattārtādhyadhīnair bālena sthavireṇa vā |
asaṃbaddhakṛtaś caiva vyavahārato na sidhyati || 8.163 ||
1. mattonmatteti | madyādinā mattaḥ, unmattaḥ, vyādhyādipīḍito ‘pahato ‘svatantrabālavṛddhair asvatantratvena pitṛbhrātniyuktādivyatirekena kṛta ṛṇādānavyavahāro na sidhyati || 8.163 ||
satyā na bhāṣā bhavati yady api syāt pratiṣṭhitā |
bahiś ced bhāṣyate dharmān niyatād vyāvahārikāt || 8.164 ||
satyeti | ‘idaṃ mayānuṣṭheyam’ ity evamādinā bhāṣā lekhyādinā sthirīkṛāpi yadi śāstrīyadharmāt pāraṃparyāt sadvyavahārāc ca bahir bhāṣyate sā satyā na bhavati tadartho anuṣṭheyaḥ || 8.164 ||
yogādhamanavikrītaṃ yogadānapratigraham |
yatra vāpy upadhiṃ paśyet tat sarvaṃ vinivartayet || 8.165 ||
yogādhamaneti | yogaśabdaś chalavācī | chalena ye bandhakavikrayadānapratigrahāḥ kriyante na tattvato ‘nyatrāpi nikṣepādau yatra chadma jānīyāt | vastuto nikṣepādi na kṛtaṃ tat sarvaṃ nivartate || 8.165 ||
grahītā yadi naṣṭaḥ syāt kuṭumbārthe kṛto avyayaḥ |
dātavyaṃ bāndhavais tat syāt pravibhaktair api svataḥ || 8.166 ||
grahīteti | ṛṇagrahītā yadi mṛtaḥ syāt tena pūrvavibhakrāvibhaktasarvabhrātṛkuṭumba-saṃvardhanārthaṃ tadṛṇavyayaḥ kṛtas tadā tad ṛṇaṃ vibhaktair avibhaktaiś ca svadhanād dātavyam || 8.166 ||
kuṭumbārthe ‘dhyadhīno ‘pi vyavahāraṃ yam ācaret |
svadeśe vā videśe vā taṃ jyāyān na vicālayet || 8.167 ||
kuṭumbārtha iti | taddeśasthe deśāntarasthe vā svāmini svāmisāṃbandhikuṭumbavyaya-nimittaṃ dāso ‘pi yad ṛṇādānādi kuryāt svāmī tat tathāpy anumanyeta || 8.167 ||
balād dattaṃ balād bhuktaṃ balād yac cāpi lekhitam |
sarvān balakṛtān arthān akṛtān manur abravīt || 8.168 ||
balād dattam ityādi | balād dattam apratigrāhyādi, balād bhuktaṃ bhūmyādi, balāl lekhitaṃ cakravṛddhipatrādi | pradarśanaṃ caitat | sarvān balakṛtān vyavahārān nivartanīyān manur āha
|| 8.168 ||
trayaḥ parārthe kliśyanti sākṣiṇaḥ pratibhūḥ kulam |
catvāras tūpacīyante vipra āḍhyo vaṇiṅ nṛpaḥ || 8.169 ||
trayaḥ parārtha iti | sākṣiṇaḥ pratibhūḥ kulaṃ ca dharmārthavyavahāradraṣṭāras traya ete parārthaṃ kleśam anubhavanti tasmād balena sākṣyaṃ prātibhāvyaṃ vyavahārekṣaṇaṃ ca nāṅgīkārayitavyāḥ | catvāraḥ punaḥ brāhmaṇottamavarṇavaṇigrājānaḥ parārthaṃ dānaphalopādānaṛṇadravyārpaṇavikrayavyavahārekṣaṇarūpaṃ kurvāṇā dhanopacayaṃ prāpnuvanti | tasmād vipro dātāraṃ, āḍhyo ‘dhamarṇaṃ, vaṇik kretāraṃ, rājā vyavahartāraṃ balena ca pravartayet | pūrvaślokābhihitabalaniṣedhasyaivāyaṃ prapañcaḥ || 8.189 ||
anādeyaṃ nādadīta parikṣīṇo ‘pi pārthivaḥ |
na cādeyaṃ samṛddho ‘pi sūkṣmam apy artham utsṛjet || 8.170 ||
anādeyam iti | kṣīṇadhano ‘pi rājā nāgrāhyam arthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | samṛddho ‘pi svalpam api grāhyaṃ dhanaṃ na tyajet || 8.170 ||
yasmāt –
anādeyasya cādānād ādeyasya ca varjanāt |
daurbalyaṃ khyāpyate rājñaḥ sa pretyeha ca naśyati || 8.171
anādeyasyeti | agrāhyagrahaṇāc chāstrīyagrāhyaparityāgāc ca rājñaḥ paurair asāmarthyaṃ khyāpyate | tataś ca sa pretyādharmeṇa narakādibhogād ihākīrtyā vinaśyati || 8.171 ||
svādānād varṇasaṃsargād abalānāṃ ca rakṣaṇāt |
balaṃ saṃjāyate rājñaḥ sa pretyeha ca vardhate || 8.172 ||
svādānād iti | nyāyyadhanagrahaṇād varṇānāṃṇ sajātīyaiḥ śāstrīyapariṇayanādisaṃbandhāt | yad vā varṇasaṃsargād varṇasaṃkarād ity atrāpi rakṣaṇād iti yojanīyam | prajānāṃ durbalānāṃ balavadbhyo ‘pi rakṣaṇāt sāmarthyam upajāyate nṛpasya | tataś cāsāv ihalokaparalokayoś ca vardhate || 8.172 ||
yata evam –
tasmād yama iva svāmī svayaṃ hitvā priyāpriye |
varteta yāmyayā vṛttyā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ || 8.173 ||
tasmād yama iti | tasmād yama iva rājā vaśīkṛtakrodho jitendriyaḥ svakīye ‘pi priyāpriye prarityajya yamasya ceṣṭayā sarvatra sāmyarūpayā varteta || 8.173 ||
yas tv adharmeṇa kāryāṇi mohāt kuryān narādhipaḥ |
acirāt taṃ durātmānaṃ vaśe kurvanti śatravaḥ || 8.174 ||
yas ev adharmeṇeti | yaḥ punar nṛpatir lobhādivyavahārād adharmeṇa vyavahāradarśanādīni kāryāṇi kurute taṃ duṣṭacittaṃ prakṛtipauravirāgāt kṣipram eva śatrayo nigṛhṇanti || 8.174 ||
kāmakrodhau tu saṃyamya yo ‘rthān dharmeṇa paśyati |
prajās tam anuvartante samudram iva sindhavaḥ || 8.175 ||
kāmakrodhāv iti | yo rājā rāgadveṣau vihāya dharmeṇa kāryāṇi nirūpayati taṃ rājānaṃ prajā bhajante samudram iva nadyaḥ | nado yathā samudrān na nivartante tenaivaikatāṃ yānti prajā api tasmān nṛpād anivartinyas tadekatānā bhavantīti sāmyam || 8.175 ||
yaḥ sādhayantaṃ chandena vedayed dhanikaṃ nṛpe |
sa rājñā taccaturbhāgaṃ dāpyas tasya tad dhanam || 8.176 ||
yaḥ sādhayantam iti | yo ‘dhamarṇo rājavallabho ‘ham iti garvād uttamarṇaṃ svecchayā dhanaṃ sādhayantaṃ nṛpe nivedayet sa rājñā ṛṇacaturthabhāgaṃ daṇḍyaḥ, tasya tad dhanaṃ dāpanīyam || 8.176 ||
karmaṇāpi samaṃ kuryād dhanikāyādhamarṇikaḥ |
samo ‘vakṛṣṭajātis tu dadyāc chreyāṃs tu tac chanaiḥ || 8.177 ||
karmaṇāpīti | samānajātir apakṛṣṭajātiś cādhamarṇo dhanābhāve sati svajātyanurūpakarma-karaṇenāpi samaṃ kuryāt | nivṛttottamarṇādhamarṇavyapadeśatayā dhanikasamam ātmānaṃ kuryāt | samajātir atra brāhmaṇetaraḥ karmaṇā kṣatraviṭśudrān samānajātīyān “hīnāṃs tu dāpayet” iti kātyāyanena viśeṣitatvāt | śreyān punar utkṛṣṭajātir na karma kārayitavyaḥ kiṃ tu śanaiḥ śanair yathāsaṃbhavaṃ tad dhanaṃ dadyāt || 8.177 ||
anena vidhinā rājā mitho vivadatāṃ nṛṇām |
sākṣipratyayasiddhāni kāryāṇi samatāṃ nayet || 8.178 ||
aneneti | anena proktaprakāreṇa parasparaṃ vivadamānānām arthipratyarthināṃ sākṣyādipramāṇena nirṇītārthāni kāryāṇi vipratipattikhaṇḍanena rājā samīkuryāt || 8.178 ||
kulaje vṛttasaṃpanne dharmajñe satyavādini |
mahāpakṣe dhaniny ārye nikṣepaṃ nikṣiped budhaḥ || 8.179 ||
kulaja iti | satkulaprasūte, sadācāravati, dharmavedini, satyābhidhāyini, bahuputrādiparijane, ṛjuprakṛtau manuṣye vyabhicārābhāvān nikṣepaṃ sthāpayet || 8.179 ||
yo yathā nikṣiped dhaste yam arthaṃ yasya mānavaḥ |
sa tathaiva grahītavyo yathā dāyas tathā grahaḥ || 8.180 ||
yo yatheti | yo manuṣyo yena prakāreṇa mudrārahitaṃ samudraṃvā sasākṣikam asākṣikaṃ vā yam arthaṃ suvarṇādi yasya haste nikṣipet so ‘rtha tena nikṣeptrā tathaiva grāhyaḥ | yasmād yena prakāreṇa samarpaṇaṃ tenaiva prakāreṇa grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam | samudrasthāpitasuvarṇāder nikṣeptā svayam eva mudrāṃ bhittvā yadā vadati ‘mamedaṃ tulayitvā samarpara’ ity abhidhānaṃ daṇḍādyartham || 8.180 ||
yo nikṣepaṃ yācyamāno nikṣeptur na prayacchati |
sa yācyaḥ prāḍvivākena tannikṣeptur asaṃnidhau || 8.181 ||
yo nikṣepam iti | yaḥ puruṣo ‘dehi me nikṣiptaṃ hiraṇyādi dravyam’ ity evaṃ nikṣeptrā prārthyamānas tasya yadā na samarpayati tadā nikṣeptrā jñāpite prāḍvivākena tasya nikṣeptur asaṃnidhau yācanīyaḥ || 8.181 ||
kiṃ kṛtvā kiṃ yācanīya ity āha –
sākṣyabhāve praṇidhibhir vayorūpasamanvitaiḥ |
apadeśaiś ca saṃnyasya hiraṇyaṃ tasya tattvataḥ || 8.182 ||
sākṣyeti (?) | prathamanikṣepe sākṣyabhāve svakīyasabhyaiś cārapuruṣair atikrāntabālyaiḥ saumyādibhir nṛpopadravādivyājābhidhāyibhir hiraṇyāni tattvena tatra nikṣepayitvā tair eva cārapuruṣaiḥ sa nikṣepadhārī prāḍvivākena cārapuruṣanikṣiptasuvarṇaṃ yācyaḥ || 8.182 ||
sa yadi pratipadyeta yathānyastaṃ yathakṛtam |
na tatra vidyate kiṃcid yat parair abhiyujyate || 8.183 ||
sa yadīti | sa nikṣepadhārī yathānyastaṃ samudraṃ vā yathākṛtaṃ kaṛakamukuṭādyākāreṇa racitaṃ yadi tathaiva pratipadyeta ‘satyam asti gṛhyatām’ iti yadā pareṇa pūrvanikṣeptrā prāḍvivākavedinā yan nikṣiptam ity abhiyujyate tatra na kiṃcid astīti jñātavyam || 8.183 ||
teṣāṃ na dadyāḍ yadi tu tad dhiraṇyaṃ yathāvidhi |
ubhau nigṛhya dāpyaḥ syād iti dharmasya dhāraṇā || 8.184 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ cārapuruṣāṇāṃ yan nikṣiptaṃ hiraṇyaṃ yathānyastaṃ yadi tan na dadyāt tadā dvāv api nikṣepau jñāpakacārasaṃbandhinau saṃpīḍya dāpanīyaḥ syād ity evaṃrūpā dharmasya dhāraṇā niścayaḥ | “yo nikṣepam” (8.181) ityādiślokacatuṣṭayasya cedṛśa eva pāṭhakramo medhātithi-bhojadevādibhir niścitaḥ | govindarājena tu “sākṣyabhāve praṇidhibhiḥ” (8.182) iti śloko ‘nta eva paṭhitaḥ, tatra ca nārthasaṃgatiḥ na vā vṛddhāmnāyādaraḥ || 8.184 ||
nikṣepopanidhī nityaṃ na deyau pratyanantare |
naśyato vinipāte tāv anipāte tv anāśinau || 8.185 ||
nikṣepeti | nikṣipyata iti nikṣepaḥ, mudrāṅkitam agaṇitaṃ vā yan nidhīyate sa upanidhiḥ | brāhmaṇaparivrājakavad upadeśabhedaḥ | tau nikṣepopanidhī nikṣeptary upanidhātari jīvati pratyanantare tadīyaputrādau tadanantare taddhanādhikāriṇi kadācin na nikṣepadhāriṇā deyau | yatas tasya putrāder api pitur asamarpaṇavināśe tau nikṣepopanidhī naśyataḥ | putrādeḥ pituś ca punar avināśe samarpaṇe ca kadācid avināśinau syātāṃ | tasmād anarthasaṃdehān na deyau
|| 8.185 ||
svayam eva tu yo dadyān mṛtasya pratyanantare |
na sa rājñā niyoktavyo na nikṣeptuś ca bandhubhiḥ || 8.186 ||
svayam iti | nikṣetur mṛtasya nikṣepadhārī taddhanādhikāriṇi putrādau tadanabhyarthitaḥ svayam eva yaḥ samarpayati sa rājñā nikṣeptuḥ putrādibhir vānyad api tvayi nikṣiptam astīti nākṣeptavyaḥ || 8.186 ||
yadi kathaṃcid bhrāntiḥ syād tadā –
acchalenaiva cānvicchet tam arthaṃ prītipūrvakam |
vicārya tasya vā vṛttaṃ sāmnaiva parisādhayet || 8.187 ||
acchalenaiveti | tatrasthe dhanāntarasadbhāvalakṣaṇavākchalādiparihāreṇaiva prītipūrvakaṃ niścinuyān na tu jhaṭ iti divyādidānena | tasya nikṣepadhāriṇaḥ śīlam avekṣya dhārmiko ‘yam iti jñātvā sāmaprayogeṇa niścinuyāt || 8.187 ||
nikṣepeṣv eṣu sarveṣu vidhiḥ syāt parisādhane |
samudre nāpnuyāt kiṃcid yadi tasmān na saṃharet || 8.188 ||
nikṣepeṣv iti | sarveṣu nikṣepeṣv apakriyamāṇeṣv eva “sākṣyabhāve” (8.182) ityādipūrvoktavidhir nirṇayasiddhau syāt | mudritādau punas tasya nikṣepadhārī yadi pratimudrādinā na kim apy apaharet tadā tasminn api tena kiṃ dūṣaṇaṃ prāpnuyāt || 8.188 ||
caurair hṛtaṃ jalenoḍham agninā dagdham eva vā |
na dadyād yadi tasmāt sa na saṃharati kiṃcana || 8.189 ||
caurair iti | caurair muṣitaṃ, udakena deśāntaraṃ prāpitaṃ, agninā vā dagdhaṃ nikṣepaṃ nikṣepadhārī na dadyāt | yadi svayaṃ tasmān na kiṃcid apy apaharati || 8.189 ||
nikṣepasyāpahartāram anikṣeptāram eva ca |
sarvair upāyair anvicchec chapathaiś caiva vaidikaiḥ || 8.190 ||
nikṣepasyeti | nikṣepasyāpahnotāram anikṣipya yācitāraṃ sarvaiḥ sāmādibhir upāyair vaidikaiś ca śapathair agniharaṇādibhir nṛpo nirūpayet || 8.190 ||
yo nikṣepaṃ nārpayati yaś cānikṣipya yācate |
tāv ubhau cauravac chāsyau dāpyau vā tatsamaṃ damam || 8.191 ||
yo nikṣepam iti | nikṣiptadhanaṃ yo na samarpayati, yaś cānikṣiptaṃ prārthayati tau dvau suvarṇamuktādau mahati viṣaye cauravad daṇḍyau | svalpaviṣaye tāmrādau tatsamaṃ daṇḍanīyau || 8.191 ||
nikṣepasyāpahartāraṃ tatsamaṃ dāpayed damam |
tathopanidhihartāram aviśeṣeṇa pārthivaḥ || 8.192 ||
nikṣepasyeti | nikṣepāpahāriṇaṃ nikṣiptasamadhanaṃ daṇḍayet | samaśiṣṭatvād anikṣipya yācitāram api | na ca punaruktiḥ | mahaty aparādhe brāhmaṇetarasya cauravad iti pūrvaślokena śārīradaṇḍasyāpi prāptau tannivṛttyartham idam, dāpayed iti dhanadaṇḍaniyamāt | na cānena pūrvaślokavaiyarthyam | asya prathamāparādhaviṣayatvāt pūrvokte cābhyāse cauroktamahāsāhasādidhanadaṇḍāvarodhakatvāt | upanidhir mudrādicihnitaṃ nihitadhanaṃ tasyāpahartāraṃ kathitaviśeṣaṇaṃ rājā daṇḍayet || 8.192 ||
upadhābhiś ca yaḥ kaścit paradravyaṃ haren naraḥ |
sasahāyaḥ sa hantavyaḥ prakāśaṃ vividhair vadhaiḥ || 8.193 ||
upadhābhir iti | ‘rājā tvayi ruṣṭas tasmāt tvāṃ rakṣāmi, mama dhanaṃdehi’ dhanadhānyādilobhopakaraṇaṃ vānṛtam abhidhāya chadmabhir yaḥ paradravyaṃ gṛhṇāti sa chadmadhanasahakārisahito bahujanasamakṣaṃ karacaraṇaśiraśchedādibhir nānāprakārair vadhopāyair rājñā hantavyaḥ || 8.193 ||
nikṣepo yaḥ kṛto yena yāvāṃś ca kulasaṃnidhau |
tāvān eva sa vijñeyo vibruvan daṇḍam arhati || 8.194 ||
nikṣepa iti | yaḥ suvarṇādir yāvatparimito yena sākṣisamakṣaṃ nikṣepaḥ kṛtas tatra parimāṇādivipratipattau sākṣivacanāt tāvān eva vijñātavyaḥ | vipratipattiṃ kurvann apy etad uktānusāreṇa daṇḍaṃ dāpyaḥ || 8.194 ||
mitho dāyaḥ kṛto yena gṛhīto mitha eva vā |
mitha eva pradātavyo yathā dāyas tathā grahaḥ || 8.195 ||
mitho dāya iti | rahasi yena nikṣepo ‘rpito nikṣepadhāriṇā ca rahasy eva gṛhīta sa nikṣepo rahasy eva pratyarpaṇīyaḥ | na pratyarpaṇe sākṣyapekṣā | yasmāt ‘yenaiva prakāreṇa dānaṃ tenaiva prakāreṇa pratyarpaṇaṃ dātavyam’ iti śravaṇān nikṣepadhāriṇo ‘yaṃ niyamavidhiḥ | “yo yathā nikṣiped dhaste” (8.180) iti tu nikṣeptur niyamārthaṃ, “grahītavya” (8.180) iti śravaṇāt | ato na paunaruktyam || 8.195 ||
nikṣiptasya dhanasyaivaṃ prītyopanihitasya ca |
rājā vinirṇayaṃ kuryād akṣiṇvan nyāsadhāriṇam || 8.196 ||
nikṣiptasyeti | rājñā nikṣiptasya dhanasyāmudrasya mudrādiyutasya vopanidhirūpasya tathā prītyā katicit kālaṃ bhogārtham arpitasyānenoktaprakāreṇa nyastadhanadhāriṇam apīḍayan nirṇayaṃ kuryāt || 8.196 ||
vikrīṇīte parasya svaṃ yo ‘svāmī svāmyasaṃmataḥ |
na taṃ nayeta sākṣyaṃ tu stenam astenamāninam || 8.197 ||
vikrīṇīta iti | asvāmī yaḥ svāminā cānanumataḥ parakīyaṃ dravyaṃ vikrīṇīte vastutaś cauram acauram ātmānaṃ manyamānaṃ taṃ sākṣitvaṃ na kārayet | na kutracid api pramāṇīkuryād ity arthaḥ || 8.197 ||
avahāryo bhavec caiva sānvayaḥ ṣaṭśataṃ damam |
niranvayo ‘napasaraḥ prāptaḥ syāc caurakilbiṣam || 8.198 ||
avahārya iti | eṣa parasvavikrayī yadi svāmino bhrātrādirūpatvena sānvayaḥ saṃbandhī bhavati tadā ṣaṭ paṇaśatāny avahāryo daṇḍanīyaḥ | yadi punaḥ svāminaḥ saṃbandhī na bhavati, anapasaraś ca syāt, apasaraty anenāsmāt sakāśād dhanam ity apasaraḥ pratigrahakrayādiḥ sa yasya svāmisaṃbandhiputrādeḥ sakāśān nāsti tadā caurasaṃbandhi pāpaṃ prāpnoti | tadvad daṇḍanīya ity arthaḥ || 8.198 ||
asvāminā kṛto yas tu dāyo vikraya eva vā |
akṛtaḥ sa tu vijñeyo vyavahāre yathā sthitiḥ || 8.199 ||
asvāmineti | asvāminā yat kṛtaṃ yad dattaṃ vikrītaṃ vā tad akṛtam eva boddhavyam | vyavahāre yathā maryādā kṛtā tathā kṛtaṃ na bhavatīty arthaḥ || 8.199 ||
saṃbhogo dṛśyate yatra na dṛśyetāgamaḥ kvacit |
āgamaḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra na saṃbhoga iti sthitiḥ || 8.200 ||
saṃbhoga iti | yasmin vastuni saṃbhogo vidyate krayādirūpas tv āgamo nāsti tatra prathamapuruṣagocara āgama eva pramāṇaṃ na saṃbhoga iti śāstramaryādā || 8.200 ||
vikrayād yo dhanaṃ kiṃcid gṛhṇīyāt kulasaṃnidhau |
krayeṇa sa viśuddhaṃ hi nyāyato labhate dhanam || 8.201 ||
vikrayād iti | vikrīyate ‘sminn iti vikrayadeśo vikrayaḥ, tato yat kreyadhanaṃ kiṃcid vyavahartṛsamūhasamakṣaṃ krīyate ‘neneti krayo mūlyaṃ tena yasmād gṛhṇīyāt | ato nyāyata evāsvāmivikretṛsakāśāt krayaṇād viśuddhaṃ dhanaṃ labhate || 8.201 ||
atha mūlam anāhāryaṃ prakāśakrayaśodhitaḥ |
adaṇḍyo mucyate rājñā nāṣṭiko labhate dhanam || 8.202 ||
atheti | atha mūlam asvāmī vikretā maraṇād deśāntarādigamanādinā vā hartuṃ śakyate prakāśakrayaṇe cāsau niścitas tadā daṇḍānarhaṃ eva kretā rājñā mucyate | naṣṭadhanasvāmī ca yad asvāminā vikrītaṃ dravyaṃ tat kretur hastāl labhyate | atra ca viṣayo ‘rdhamūlyaṃ kretur datvā svadhanaṃ svāminā grāhyam | tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
vaṇigvīthīparigataṃ vijñātaṃ rājapūruṣaiḥ |
avijñātāśrayāt krītaṃ vikretā yatra vā mṛtaḥ ||
svāmī datvārdhamūlyaṃ tu pragṛhṇīyāt svakaṃ dhanam |
ardhaṃ dvayor apahṛtaṃ tatra syād vyavahārataḥ ||
|| 8.202 ||
nānyad anyena saṃsṛṣṭarūpaṃ vikrayam arhati |
na cāsāraṃ na ca nyūnaṃ na dūreṇa tirohitam || 8.203 ||
nānyad iti | kuṅkumādi dravyaṃ kusumbhādinā miśrīkṛtya na vikretavyam | na cāsāraṃ sāram ity abhidhāya | na ca tulādinā nyūnam | na parokṣāvasthitam | na rāgādinā sthagitarūpam | atrāsvāmivikrayasādṛśyād asvāmivikraye daṇḍa eva syāt || 8.203 ||
anyāṃ ced darśayitvānyā voḍhuḥ kanyā pradīyate |
ubhe ta ekaśulkena vahed ity abravīn manuḥ || 8.204 ||
anyām iti | śulkadeyāṃ śulkavyavasthākāle niravadyāṃ darśayitvā yadi sāvadyā varāya dīyate tadā dve api kanye tenaivaikena śulkenāsau varaḥ pariṇayed iti manur āha | śulkagrahaṇapūrvakakanyāyā dānasya vikrayarūpatvād arthakrayavikrayasādharmyeṇāsyātrābhidhānam || 8.204 ||
nonmattāyā na kuṣṭhinyā na ca yā spṛṣṭamaithunā |
pūrvaṃ doṣān anabhikhyāpya pradātā daṇḍam arhati || 8.205 ||
nonmattāyā iti | unmattāyās tathā kuṣṭhavatyā yā cānubhūtamaithunā tasyā brāhmādivivāhāt pūrvam unmādādīn doṣān varasya kathayitvā daṇḍārho na bhavati | tenākathane daṇḍya iti gamyate | “yas tu doṣavatīṃ kanyāṃ” (8.224) iti vakṣyati || 8.205 ||
atha saṃbhūyasamutthānam āha –
ṛtvig yadi vṛto yajñe svakarma parihāpayet |
tasya karmānurūpeṇa deyo ‘ṃśaḥ sahakartṛbhiḥ || 8.206 ||
ṛtvig iti | yajñe kṛtavaraṇa ṛtvik yadi kiṃcit karma kṛtvā vyādhyādinā karma tyajati tadā tasyetarartvigbhiḥ paryālocya kṛtānusāreṇa dakṣiṇāṃśo deyaḥ || 8.206 ||
dakṣiṇāsu ca dattāsu svakarma parihāpayan |
kṛtsnam eva labhetāṃśam anyenaiva ca kārayet || 8.207 ||
dakṣiṇāsv iti | mādhyandinasavanādau dakṣiṇākāle dakṣiṇāsu dattāsu vyādhyādinā karma parityjan na tu śāṭhyāt sa kṛtsnam eva dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ labheta | karmaśeṣaṃ prakṛtam anyena kārayet || 8.207 ||
yasmin karmaṇi yās tu syur uktāḥ pratyaṅgadakṣiṇāḥ |
sa eva tā ādadīta labheran sarva eva vā || 8.208 ||
yasminn iti | yasmin karmaṇy ādhānādau aṅgam aṅgaṃ prati yā dakṣiṇā yatsaṃbandhena śrutāḥ syuḥ sa eva tā ādadīta na tattadbhāgamātraṃ sarve vibhajya gṛhṇīrann iti saṃśayaḥ
|| 8.208 ||
atra siddhāntam āha –
rathaṃ hareta cādhvaryur brahmādhāne ca vājinam |
hotā vāpi hared aśvam udgātā cāpy anaḥ kraye || 8.209 ||
ratham iti | keṣāṃcic chākhinām ādhāne ‘dhvaryave ratho deyatvenāmnāyate, brahmaṇe vegavān aśvaḥ, hotre cāśvaḥ, udgātre somakrayavahanaśakaṭam, ato vyavasthāmnānasāmarthyād yā dakṣiṇā yatsaṃbandhatvena śrūyate sa eva tām ādadīta || 8.209 ||
saṃpratipattividhāne dakṣiṇāvibhāgam āha –
sarveṣām ardhino mukhyās tadardhenārdhino ‘pare |
tṛtīyinas tṛtīyāṃśāś caturthāṃśāś ca pādinaḥ || 8.210 ||
sarveṣām iti | “taṃ śatena dīkṣayati” iti śrūyate | tatra sarveṣāṃ ṣoḍaśānām ṛtvijāṃ madhye ye mukhyā ṛtvijo hotradhvaryubrahmodgātāraḥ samagradakṣiṇāyās te ‘rdhaharā aṣṭacatvāriṃśad gobhājo bhavanti | ata eva kātyāyanena “yad dvādaśādyebhyaḥ” iti pratyekaṃ dvādaśagodānaṃ vihitam | yady api śatasyārdhaṃ pañcāśad bhavati tathāpīha nyūnārdhagrahaṇenāpi ime ‘rdhina ucyante sāmīpyāt | apare maitrāvaruṇayoḥ pratiprasthātṛbrāhmaṇācchaṃsiprastotāras te mukhyartviggṛhītadakṣiṇārdhagrahaṇenārdhina ucyante | tṛtīyino ‘cchāvāṅneṣṭragnīdhrapratihartāras te mukhyartviggṛhītasya tṛtīyam aṃśaṃ labhante | pādinas tu grāvastudunnetṛsubrahmaṇyā ete mukhartviggṛhītasya caturtham aṃśaṃ labhante | etac ca “ṣaṭ ṣaṭ dvitīyebhyaś catasraḥ catasraś ca tṛtīyebhyas tisras tisraś caturthebhyaḥ” iti sūtrayatā kātyāyanena sphuṭīkṛtam || 8.210 ||
saṃbhūya svāni karmāṇi kurvadbhir iha mānavaiḥ |
anena vidhiyogena kartavyāṃśaprakalpanā || 8.211 ||
saṃbhūyeti | militvā gṛhanirmāṇādīni svakarmāṇi loke sthapatisūtradhāryādibhiś ca manuṣyaiḥ kurvadbhir anena yajñadakṣiṇāvidhyāśrayaṇena vijñānavyāpārādyapekṣayā bhāgakalpanā kāryā || 8.211 ||
idānīṃ dattānapakarmāha –
dharmārthaṃ yena dattaṃ syāt kasmaicid yācate dhanam |
paścāc ca na tathā tat syān na deyaṃ tasya tad bhavet || 8.212 ||
dharmārtham iti | yena yāgādikarmārthaṃ kasmaicid yācamānāya dhanaṃ dattaṃ pratiśrutaṃ vā, paścāc ca tad dhanam asau yāgārthaṃ na viniyuñjīta tadā tad dattam api dhanaṃ grāhyaṃ, pratiśrutaṃ ca na deyam | yad āha gautamaḥ: “pratiśrutyāpy adharmasaṃyuktāya na dadyāt” || 8.212 ||
yadi saṃsādhayet tat tu darpāl lobhena vā punaḥ |
rājñā dāpyaḥ suvarṇaṃ syāt tasya steyasya niṣkṛtiḥ || 8.213 ||
yadīti | yadi tad dattam asau gṛhītvā lobhād ahaṃkārād vā na tyajati, pratiśrutaṃ vā dhanaṃ balena gṛhṇāti tadā tasya cauryapāpasya saṃśuddhyarthaṃ rājñā svarṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpanīyo bhavati || 8.213 ||
dattasyaiṣoditā dharmyā yathāvad anapakriyā |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vetanasyānapakriyām || 8.214 ||
dattasyeti | etad dattasyāpratipādanaṃ dharmād anapetaṃ tad uktam | ato ‘nantaraṃ bhṛter asamarpaṇādikaṃ vakṣyāmi || 8.214 ||
bhṛto nārto na kuryād yo darpāt karma yathoditam |
sa daṇḍyaḥ kṛṣṇalāṇy aṣṭau na deyaṃ cāsya vetanam || 8.215 ||
bhṛta iti | yo bhṛtiparikrīto vyādhyāpīḍito yathānirūpitaṃ karmāhaṃkārān na kuryāt sa karmānurūpeṇa suvarṇādikṛṣṇalāny aṣṭau daṇḍanīyaḥ | vetanaṃ cāsya na deyam || 8.215 ||
ārtas tu kuryāt svasthaḥ san yathābhāṣitam āditaḥ |
sa dīrghasyāpi kālasya tal labhetaiva vetanam || 8.216 ||
ārta ityādi | yadā vyādhyādipīḍayā karma na karoti svasthaḥ san yādṛgbhāṣitaṃ tādṛkkarma kuryād vetanaṃ ca cirakālād api labhetaiva || 8.216 ||
yathoktam ārtaḥ sustho vā yas tat karma na kārayet |
na tasya vetanaṃ deyam alponasyāpi karmaṇaḥ || 8.217 ||
yathoktam iti | yat karma yathābhāṣitaṃ pīḍito ‘nyena na kārayet, sustho vā na kuryān nāpi kārayet tasya kiṃcic cheṣasyāpi kṛtasya karmaṇo vetanaṃ na deyam || 8.217 ||
eṣa dharmo ‘khilenokto vetanādānakarmaṇaḥ |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmaṃ samayabhedinām || 8.218 ||
eṣa dharma iti | eṣā vyavasthā vetanādānākhyakarmaṇo niḥśeṣeṇoktā | ato ‘nantaraṃ saṃvidvyatikramakāriṇāṃ daṇḍādivyavasthāṃ vadiṣyāmi || 8.218 ||
yo grāmadeśasaṅghānāṃ kṛtvā satyena saṃvidam |
visaṃvaden naro lobhāt taṃ rāṣṭrād vipravāsayet || 8.219 ||
ya iti | grāmadeśaśabdābhyāṃ tadvāsino lakṣyante | saṅgho vaṇigādisamūhaḥ | idam asmābhiḥ kartavyaṃ parihāryam ity evaṃrūpaṃ saṃketaṃ satyādiśapathena kṛtvā tanmadhye yo naro lobhādinā niṣkrāmet taṃ rājā rāṣṭrān nirvāsayet || 8.219 ||
nigṛhya dāpayec cainaṃ samayavyabhicāriṇam |
catuḥsuvarṇān ṣaṇniṣkāṃś chatamānaṃ ca rājatam || 8.220 ||
nigṛhyeti | atha cainaṃ saṃvidvyatikramakāriṇaṃ nibodhya caturaḥ suvarṇān ṣaṇniṣkān pratyekaṃ catuḥsuvarnaparimitān rājataṃ ca śatamānaṃ viṃśatyadhikaraktikāśatatraya-parimāṇaṃ trayam etadviṣayalāghavagauravāpekṣayā samanvitaṃ vyastaṃ vā rājā daṇḍaṃ dāpayet || 8.220 ||
etad daṇḍavidhiṃ kuryād dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
grāmajātisamūheṣu samayavyabhicāriṇām || 8.221 ||
etad iti | grāmeṣu brāhmaṇajātisamūheṣu saṃvidvyatikramakāriṇām etad daṇḍavidhiṃ dharmapradhāno rājānutiṣṭhet || 8.221 ||
krītvā vikrīya vā kiṃcid yasyehānuśayo bhavet |
so ‘ntardaśāhāt tad dravyaṃ dadyāc caivādadīta vā || 8.222 ||
krītveti | krītvā vikrīya vā kiṃcid dravyaṃ vinaśvararūpaṃ sthirārdhaṃ bhūmitāmrapaṭṭādi yasya loke paścāttāpo jāyate ‘na sādhu mayā krītam’ iti sa krītaṃ daśāhamadhye pratyarpayet | vikrītaṃ vā gṛhṇīyāt || 8.222 ||
pareṇa tu daśāhasya na dadyān nāpi dāpayet |
ādadāno dadac caiva rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ || 8.223 ||
pareṇeti | daśāhād ūrdhvaṃ krītaṃ na tyajet | nāpi vikrītaṃ vikrayiko balena dāpayet | vikrītaṃ balena gṛhṇan parityajan rājñā ṣaṭśatāni paṇān daṇḍyaḥ || 8.223 ||
yas tu doṣavatīṃ kanyām anākhyāya prayacchati |
tasya kuryān nṛpo daṇḍaṃ svayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ paṇān || 8.224 ||
yas tv iti | “nonmattāyā” (8.205) iti sāmānyenoktaṃ, daṇḍaviśeṣābhidhānārtham idam | unmādādidoṣān akathayitvā doṣavatīṃ kanyāṃ varāya yaḥ prayacchati tasya rājā svayam ādareṇa ṣaṇṇavatiṃ paṇān daṇḍaṃ kuryāt | anuśayaprasaṅgenaitat kanyāgatam ucyate
|| 8.224 ||
akanyeti tu yaḥ kanyāṃ brūyād dveṣeṇa mānavaḥ |
sa śataṃ prāpnuyād daṇḍaṃ tasyā doṣam adarśayan || 8.225 ||
akanyeti | ‘neyaṃ kanyā, kṣatayonir iyam’ iti yo manuṣyo dveṣeṇa brūyāt tasyā uktadoṣam avibhāvayan paṇaśataṃ rājā daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet || 8.225 ||
yuktaś cāsyākanyetivādino daṇḍaḥ, yasmāt –
pāṇigrahaṇikā mantrāḥ kanyāsv eva pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
nākanyāsu kvacin nṛṇāṃ luptadharmakriyā hi tāḥ || 8.226 ||
pāṇīti | “aryamaṇaṃ nu devaṃ kanyā agnim ayakṣata” (ĀśGṛ 1.7) ity evamādayo vaivāhikā manuṣyāṇāṃ mantrāḥ kanyāśabdaśravaṇāt kanyāsv eva vyavasthitāḥ nākanyāviṣaye | kvacic chāstre dharmavivāhasiddhaye vyavasthitāḥ asamavetārthatvāt | ata evāha – tāḥ kṣatayonayo vaivāhikamantraiḥ saṃskriyamāṇā api yasmād apagatadharmavivāhādiśālinyo bhavanti | nāsau dharmyo vivāha ity arthaḥ | na tu kṣatayoner vaivāhikamantrahomādiniṣedhakam idam | “yā garbhiṇī saṃskriyate” (p.173), tathā “voḍhuḥ kanyāsamudbhavam” (9.172) iti kṣatayoner api manunaiva vivāhasaṃskārasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | devalena tu,
gāndharveṣu vivāheṣu punar vaivāhiko vidhiḥ |
kartavyaś ca tribhir varṇaiḥ samayeṇāgnisākṣikaḥ ||
iti gāndharveṣu vivāheṣu homamantrādividhir uktaḥ | gāndharvaś copagamanapūrvako ‘pi bhavati, tasya kṣatriyaviṣaye sudharmatvaṃ manunoktam | ataḥ sāmānyaviśeṣanyāyād itaraviṣayo ‘yaṃ kṣatayonivivāhasyādharmatvopadeśaḥ || 8.226 ||
pāṇigrahaṇikā mantrā niyataṃ dāralakṣaṇam |
teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu vijñeyā vidvadbhiḥ saptame pade || 8.227 ||
pāṇigrahaṇikā iti | vaivāhikā mantrā niyataṃ niścitaṃ bhāryātve nimittam, mantrair yathāśāstraprayuktair bhāryātvena niṣpatteḥ | teṣāṃ tu mantrāṇāṃ “sakhā saptapadī bhava” (ĀśGṛ 1.7) iti mantreṇa kalpanayā saptame pade datte bhāryātvaniṣpatteḥ śāstrajñair niṣpattir vijñeyā, evaṃ ca saptapadīdānāt prāg bhātyātvāniṣpatteḥ saty anuśaye jahyān nordhvam
|| 8.227 ||
yasmin yasmin kṛte kārye yasyehānuśayo bhavet |
tam anena vidhānena dharmye pathi niveśayet || 8.228 ||
yasminn iti | na kevalaṃ kraya eva, anyatrāpi yasmin yasmin saṃbandhitvenādau kārye yasya paścāttāpo jāyate tam anena daśāhavidhinā dharmād anapete mārge nṛpaḥ sthāpayet || 8.228 ||
paśuṣu svāmināṃ caiva pālānāṃ ca vyatikrame |
vivādaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yathāvad dharmatattvataḥ || 8.229 ||
paśuṣv iti | gavādipaśuviṣaye svāmināṃ pālānāṃ vyatikrame jāte vivādaṃ samyag dharmyaṃ yathā tathā vyavasthā vakṣyāmi || 8.229 ||
divā vaktavyatā pāle rātrau svāmini tadgṛhe |
yogakṣeme ‘nyathā cet tu pālo vaktavyatām iyāt || 8.230 ||
diveti | divā paśūnāṃ pālahastanyastānāṃ yogakṣemaviṣaye pālasya garhaṇīyatā | rātrau punaḥ pālapratyarpitānāṃ svāmigṛhasthitānāṃ svāmino doṣaḥ | anyathā tu yadi rātrāv api pālahastagatā bhavanti tatra doṣa utpanne pāla eva garhaṇīyatāṃ prāpnoti || 8.230 ||
gopaḥ kṣīrabhṛto yas tu sa duhyād daśato varām |
gosvāmyanumate bhṛtyaḥ sā syāt pāle ‘bhṛte bhṛtiḥ || 8.231 ||
gopa iti | yo gopālākhyo bhṛtyaḥ kṣīreṇa na bhaktādinā svasvāmyanujñayā dharṣito gobhyaḥ śreṣṭhām ekāṃ gāṃ bhṛtyarthaṃ duhyāt sā bhaktādirahite gopāle bhṛtiḥ syāt | evaṃ caikagavīkṣīradānena daśa gāḥ pālayed ity uktam || 8.231 ||
naṣṭaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ kṛmibhiḥ śvahataṃ viṣame mṛtam |
hīnaṃ puruṣakāreṇa pradadyāt pāla eva tu || 8.232 ||
naṣṭam iti | naṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭipathātītaṃ, kṛmibhir nāśitaṃ, śvabhiḥ khāditaṃ hataṃ vivarādipātamṛtam | pradarśanaṃ caitat | pālasaṃbandhirakṣakākhyapuruṣavyāpārarahitaṃ mṛtaṃ, palāyitaṃ gavādi, paśupāla eva tu svāmine dadyāt || 8.232 ||
vighuṣya tu hṛtaṃ caurair na pālo dātum arhati |
yadi deśe ca kāle ca svāminaḥ svasya śaṃsati || 8.233 ||
vighuṣyeti | cauraiḥ punaḥ paṭahādi vighuṣya hṛtaṃ pālo dātuṃ nārhati | vighuṣyeti caurāṇāṃ bahutvaṃ prabalatvakathanaparam | saṃnihite deśe haraṇakālānantaram evātmīyasvāminaḥ kathayati || 8.233 ||
karṇau carma ca vālāṃś ca bastiṃ snāyuṃ ca rocanām |
paśuṣu svāmināṃ dadyān mṛteṣv aṅkāni darśayet || 8.234 ||
karṇāv iti | svayaṃ mṛteṣu paśuṣu karṇacarmalāṅgūlapravālān nābher adhobhāgasnāyurocanāḥ svāmināṃ dadyāt | anyāni ca cihnāni śṛṅgakhurādīni darśayet
|| 8.234 ||
ajāvike tu saṃruddhe vṛkaiḥ pāle tv anāyati |
yāṃ prasahya vṛko hanyāt pāle tat kilbiṣaṃ bhavet || 8.235 ||
ajāvika iti | ajāś cāvikāś cāvikam, “gavāśvaprabhṛtīni ca” (Pāṇ 2.4.11) iti dvandvaikavadbhāvaḥ | tasminn ajāvike vṛkaiḥ parivṛte sati pāle ‘nāgacchati yām ajām eḍakāṃ ca vane vṛko hanyāt sa pālasya doṣaḥ syāt || 8.235 ||
tāsāṃ ced avaruddhānāṃ carantīnāṃ mitho vane |
yām utplutya vṛko hanyān na pālas tatra kilbiṣī || 8.236 ||
tāsām iti | tāsām ajāvikānāṃ pālena niyamitānāṃ saṃghībhūya vane carantīnāṃ yatnād yadi kaścit kutaścid utplutyālakṣito yāṃ kāṃcid dhanyān na pālas tatra doṣabhāk || 8.236 ||
dhanuḥśataṃ parīhāro grāmasya syāt samantataḥ |
śamyāpātās trayo vāpi triguṇo nagarasya tu || 8.237 ||
dhanuḥśatam iti | caturhasto dhanuḥ | śamyā yaṣṭis tasyāḥ pātaḥ prakṣepo grāmasamīpe sarvāsu dikṣu catvāri hastaśatāni, trīn vā yaṣṭiprakṣepān yāvat paśupracārārthaṃ sasyavapanādisaṃrodhaparihāraḥ kāryaḥ | nagarasamīpe punar ayaṃ triguṇaḥ kartavyaḥ
|| 8.237 ||
tatrāparivṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ vihiṃsyuḥ paśavo yadi |
na tatra praṇayed daṇḍaṃ nṛpatiḥ paśurakṣiṇām || 8.238 ||
tatrāparivṛtam iti | tasmin parihārasthāne yadi kenacid adattāvṛtikaṃ dhānyam upyate tac cet paśavo bhakṣeyus tatra paśupālānāṃ nṛpo daṇḍaṃ na kuryāt || 8.238 ||
vṛtiṃ tatra prakurvīta yām uṣṭro na vilokayet |
chidraṃ ca vārayet sarvaṃ śvasūkaramukhānugam || 8.239 ||
vṛtim iti | tatra parihārasthāne kṣetre vṛtiṃ kaṇṭakādimayīṃ tathāvidhām ucchritāṃ kuryāt | yām aparapārśve uṣṭro na vilokayet, tasyāṃ ca yat kiṃcic chidraṃ śvasūkaramukhapraveśayogyaṃ tat sarvam āvṛṇuyāt || 8.239 ||
pathi kṣetre parivṛte grāmāntīye ‘tha vā punaḥ |
sapālaḥ śatadaṇḍārho vipālān vārayet paśūn || 8.240 ||
pathīti | vartmasamīpagrāmasamīpavartini vā parihārasthe kṣetre dattavṛttau spālaḥ paśuḥ pālānivārito dvārādinā kathaṃcit praviṣṭo yadā bhakṣayati tadā paṇaśataṃ daṇḍyaḥ | paśoś ca daṇḍāsaṃbhavāt pāla eva daṇḍyaḥ | vipālān punar bhakṣaṇapravṛttān kṣetrarakṣako nivārayet
|| 8.240 ||
kṣetreṣv anyeṣu tu paśuḥ sapādaṃ paṇam arhati |
sarvatra tu sado deyaḥ kṣetrikasyeti dhāraṇā || 8.241 ||
kṣetreṣv iti | vartmagrāmāntavyatirikteṣu paśur bhakṣayan sapādaṃ paṇaṃ daṇḍam arhati | atrāpi pāla eva daṇḍyaḥ | sarvatra kṣetre paśubhakṣitaṃ phalaṃ svāmine pālena svāminā vā yathāparādhaṃ dātavyam iti niścayaḥ || 8.241 ||
anirdaśāhāṃ gāṃ sūtāṃ vṛṣān devapaśūṃs tathā |
sapālān vā vipālān vā na daṇḍyān manur abravīt || 8.242 ||
anirdaśāhām iti | prasūtāṃ gām anirgatadaśāhāṃ tathā ca cakraśūlāṅkitotsṛṣṭavṛṣān hariharādipratimāsaṃbandhipaśūn pālasahitān pālarahitān vā sasyabhakṣaṇapravṛttān manur adāṇḍyān āha | utsṛṣṭavṛṣāṇām api garbhārthaṃ gokule pālair dhāraṇāt sapālatvasaṃbhavaḥ
|| 8.242 ||
kṣetrikasyātyaye daṇḍyo bhāgād daśaguṇo bhavet |
tato ‘rdhadaṇḍo bhṛtyānām ajñānāt kṣetrikasya tu || 8.243 ||
kṣetrikasyeti | kṣetrakarṣakasyātmapaśusasyabhakṣaṇe ‘yathākālaṃ vapanādau vāparādhe sati yāvato rājabhāgasya tena hāniḥ kṛtā tato daśaguṇadaṇḍaḥ syāt | kṣetrikāvidite bhṛtyānām uktāparādhe kṣetrikasyaiva daśaguṇārdhadaṇḍaḥ | kṣetrasasyaprasaṅgāc cedam uktam
|| 8.243 ||
etad vidhānam ātiṣṭhed dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
svāmināṃ ca paśūnāṃ ca pālānāṃ ca vyatikrame || 8.244 ||
etad iti | svāmināṃ pālānāṃ cārakṣaṇād aparādhe paśūnāṃ ca sasyabhakṣaṇarūpe vyatikrame dharmapradhāno bhūpatir etat pūrvoktaṃ kartavyam anutiṣthet || 8.244 ||
sīmāṃ prati samutpanne vivāde grāmayor dvayoḥ |
jyeṣṭhe māsi nayet sīmāṃ suprakāśeṣu setuṣu || 8.245 ||
sīmām iti | dvayor grāmayor maryādāṃ prati vipratipattāv utpannāyāṃ jyeṣṭhe māsi grīṣmaravitāpasaṃśuṣkatṛṇatvāt prakaṭībhūteṣu sīmāliṅgeṣu rājā sīmāṃ niścinuyāt || 8.245 ||
sīmāvṛkṣāṃś ca kurvīta nyagrodhāśvattakiṃśukān |
śālmalīn sālatālāṃś ca kṣīriṇaś caiva pādapān || 8.246 ||
sīmāvṛkṣān iti | nyagrodhādīn vṛkṣān kṣīriṇa udumbarādīṃś cirasthāyitvāt sīmāliṅgabhūtān kurvīta || 8.246 ||
gulmān veṇūṃś ca vividhāñ chamīvallīsthalāni ca |
śarān kubjakagulmāṃś ca tathā sīmā na naśyati || 8.247 ||
gulmān iti | gulmān prakāṇḍarahitān veṇūṃś ca pracurakaṇṭakatvālpakaṇṭakatvādibhedena nānāprakārān sīmāvṛkṣān vallīr latāḥ sthānāni kṛtrimonnatabhūbhāgān śarān kubjakagulmāṃś ca pracurālpabhogatvenādarārthaṃ pṛthaṅnirdiṣṭān sīmāliṅgabhūtān kuryāt | evaṃ kṛte sīmā na naśyati || 8.247 ||
taḍāgāny udapānāni vāpyaḥ prasravaṇāni ca |
sīmāsaṃdhiṣu kāryāṇi devatāyatanāni ca || 8.248 ||
tadāgānīti | taḍāgakūpadīrghakājalanirgamamārgadevagṛhāṇi sīmārūpeṣu grāmadvayasaṃdhisthāneṣu kartavyāni | eteṣu sīmānirṇayāya vikhyāpya kṛteṣūdakādyarthijanā api śrutiparaṃparayā cirakāle ‘pi sākṣiṇo bhavanti || 8.248 ||
upacchannāni cānyāni sīmāliṅgāni kārayet |
sīmājñāne nṛṇāṃ vīkṣya nityaṃ loke viparyayam || 8.249 ||
upacchannānītyādi | sīmānirṇaye sarvadāsmiṃl loke manuṣyāṇāṃ vibhramam ajñānaṃ dṛṣṭvābhihitavyatiriktāṇi gūḍhāni vakṣyamāṇāni sīmācihnāni kārayet || 8.249 ||
aśmano ‘sthīni govālāṃs tuṣān bhasma kapālikāḥ |
karīṣam iṣṭakāṅgārāṃś charkarā vālukās tathā || 8.250 ||
yāni caivaṃprakārāṇi kālād bhūmir na bhakṣayet |
tāni saṃdhiṣu sīmāyām aprakāśāni kārayet || 8.251 ||
aśmana iti | yānīti | prastarāsthigovālatuṣabhasmakarpaṭikāśuṣkagomayapakveṣṭakāṅgāra-pāṣāṇakarparasikatā anyāny apy evaṃprakārāṇi kālāñjanakārpāsāsthiprabhṛtīni yāni cirakālenāpi bhūmir ātmasān na karoti tāni grāmayoḥ saṃdhiṣu sīmāyāṃ,
prakṣipya kumbheṣv etāni sīmānteṣu nidhāpayet |
iti bṛhaspativacanāt sthūlapāṣāṇavyatiriktāni kumbheṣu kṛtvā pracchannāni bhūmau nikhāya dhārayet || 8.250–251 ||
etair liṅgair nayet sīmāṃ rājā vivadmānayoḥ |
pūrvabhuktyā ca satatam udakasyāgamena ca || 8.252 ||
etair iti | vivadamānayor grāmayoḥ prāguktair etair uktacihnai rājā sīmām unnayet | vasatoḥ punar avicchinnayā bhuktyā sīmānirṇayo na tu tripuruṣādikatayā | tasya “ādhiḥ sīmā” (8.149) iti paryudastatvāt | grāmadvayasaṃdhisthanadyādipravāheṇa ca pārāvāragrāmayoḥ sīmāṃ niścinuyāt || 8.252 ||
yadi saṃśaya eva syāl liṅgānām api darśane |
sākṣipratyaya eva syāt sīmāvādavinirṇayaḥ || 8.253 ||
yadīti | yadi pracchannaprakāśaliṅgadarśane ‘pi pracchannāṅgāratuṣādikumbhā amī sthānāntaraṃ nītvā nikhātāḥ, nāyaṃ sīmātarur nyagrodhaḥ sa naṣṭa ityādi samasta eva yadi saṃdehaḥ syāt tadā sākṣipramāṇa eva sīmāvivādaniścayo bhavet || 8.253 ||
grāmīyakakulānāṃ ca samakṣaṃ sīmni sākṣiṇaḥ |
praṣṭavyāḥ sīmāliṅgāni tayoś caiva vivādinoḥ || 8.254 ||
grāmīyaketi | grāmikajanasamūhānāṃ grāmadvayasthaniyuktayor vādiprativādinoś ca samakṣaṃ sīmāviṣaye sīmāliṅgsaṃdehe liṅgāni sākṣiṇaḥ praṣṭavyāḥ || 8.254 ||
te pṛṣṭās tu yathā brūyuḥ samastāḥ sīmni niścayam |
nibadhnīyāt tathā sīmāṃ sarvāṃs tāṃś caiva nāmataḥ || 8.255 ||
te iti | te pṛṣṭāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ samastā na dvaidhena sīmāviṣayeṇa yena prakāreṇa niścayaṃ brūyus tena prakāreṇātivismaraṇārthaṃ patre sīmāṃ likhet | tāṃś ca sarvān eva sākṣiṇo nāmavibhāgato likhet || 8.255 ||
śirobhis te gṛhītvorvīṃ sragviṇo raktavāsasaḥ |
sukṛtaiḥ śāpitāḥ svaiḥ svair nayeyus te samañjasam || 8.256 ||
śirobhir iti | te sākṣiṇa iti sāmānyaśravaṇe ‘pi “raktasragvāsasaḥ sīmāṃ nayeyuḥ” (YDh 2.152) iti yājñavalkyavacanād raktapuṣpamālādhāriṇo lohitavāsaso mastake mṛlloṣṭāni gṛhītvā ‘yad asmākaṃ sukṛtaṃ tan niṣphalaṃ syād’ ityevam ātmīyaiḥ sukṛtaiḥ śāpitāḥ santas tāṃ sīmāṃ yathāśakti nirṇayeyuḥ || 8.256 ||
yathoktena nayantas te pūyante satyasākṣiṇaḥ |
viparītaṃ nayantas tu dāpyāḥ syur dviśataṃ damam || 8.257 ||
yathokteneti | te satyapradhānāḥ sākṣiṇaḥ śāstroktena vidhānena nirṇayasthā niṣpāpā bhavanti | atathyena tu niścinvantaḥ pratyekaṃ paṇaśatadvayaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyā bhaveyuḥ || 8.258 ||
sākṣyabhāve tu catvāro grāmāḥ sāmantavāsinaḥ |
sīmāvinirṇayaṃ kuryuḥ prayatā rājasaṃnidhau || 8.258 ||
sākṣyabhāva iti | grāmadvayasaṃbandhisīmāvivādasākṣyabhāve caturdiśaṃ samantabhavāḥ sāmantās tadvāsinaś catvāro grāmavāsinaḥ sākṣidharmeṇa rājasamakṣaṃ sīmānirṇayaṃ kuryuḥ || 8.258 ||
sāmantānām abhāve tu maulānāṃ sīmni sākṣiṇām |
imān apy anuyuñjīta puruṣān vanagocarān || 8.259 ||
sāmantānām iti | sākṣidharmeṇa rājasamakṣam anubhavena nirṇayam akurvatāṃ grāmavāsināṃ grāmanirmāṇakālād ārabhya maulānāṃ puruṣakrameṇa tadgrāmasthānāṃ sīmāsākṣiṇām abhāva imān vakṣyamāṇān saṃnihitavanacāriṇaḥ pṛcchet || 8.259 ||
vyādhāṃś chākunikān gopān kaivartān mūlakhānakān |
vyālagrāhān uñchavṛttīn anyāṃś ca vanacāriṇaḥ || 8.260 ||
vyādhān iti | lubdhakān, pakṣivadhajīvinaḥ, gopālān, matsyajīvinaḥ mūlotpāṭanajīvinaḥ, sarpagrāhiṇaḥ, śiloñchavṛttīn, anyāṃś ca phalapuṣpendhanādyarthaṃ vanavyavahāriṇaḥ pṛcchet | ete hi svaprayojanārthaṃtena grāmeṇa sarvadā vanaṃ gaccheyus tadgrāmasīmābhijñāḥ saṃbhavanti || 8.260 ||
te pṛṣṭās tu yathā brūyuḥ sīmāsaṃdhiṣu lakṣaṇam |
tat tathā sthāpayed rājā dharmeṇa grāmayor dvayoḥ || 8.261 ||
te pṛṣṭā iti | te vyādhādayaḥ pṛṣṭāḥ sīmārūpeṣu grāmasaṃdhiṣu yena prakāreṇa cihnaṃ brūyus tat tenaiva prakāreṇa dvayor grāmayoḥ sīmāṃ vyavasthāpayet
|| 8.261 ||
kṣetrakūpataḍāgānām ārāmasya gṛhasya ca |
sāmantapratyayo jñeyaḥ sīmāsetuvinirṇayaḥ || 8.262 ||
kṣetreti | ekagrāme ‘pi kṣetrakūpataḍāgodyānagṛhāṇāṃ sīmāsetuvivāde samastadeśavāsisākṣipramāṇaka eva maryādācihnaniścayo vijñeyo na vyādhādipramāṇakaḥ || 8.262 ||
sāmantāś cen mṛṣā brūyuḥ setau vivadatāṃ nṛṇām |
sarve pṛthak pṛthag daṇḍyā rājñā madhyamasāhasam || 8.263 ||
sāmantā iti | sīmācihnanimittaṃ vivadamānānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ yadi sāmantā deśavāsino mithyā brūyus tadā te sarve pratyekaṃ rājñā madhyamasāhasaṃ daṇḍanīyāḥ | evaṃ cāsāmantarūpāṇāṃ pūrvoktadviśato damo jñeyaḥ || 8.263 ||
gṛhaṃ taḍāgam ārāmaṃ kṣetraṃ vā bhīṣayā haran |
śatāni pañca daṇḍyaḥ syād ajñānād dviśato damaḥ || 8.264 ||
gṛham iti | gṛhataḍāgodyānakṣetrāṇām anyatamaṃ māraṇabandhanādibhayakathanapūrvam ākramya haraṇe pañca paṇaśatāni daṇḍanīyaḥ syāt | svatvabhrāntyā harato dviśato daṃaḥ
|| 8.264 ||
sīmāyām aviṣahyāyāṃ svayaṃ rājaiva dharmavit |
pradiśed bhūmim eteṣām upakārād iti sthitiḥ || 8.265 ||
sīmāyām iti | liṅgasākṣyādyabhāve sīmāyāṃ paricchettum aśakyāyāṃ rājaiva dharmajñaḥ pakṣapātarahito grāmadvayamadhyavartinīṃ vivādaviṣayāṃ bhūmiṃ yeṣām eva grāmavāsinām upakārātiśayo bhavati yadvyatirekeṇa ca mahān anirvāhas teṣām eva dadyād iti śāstravyavasthā
|| 8.265 ||
eṣo ‘khilenābhihito dharmaḥ sīmavinirṇaye |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vākpāruṣyavinirṇayam || 8.266 ||
eṣa iti | eṣa sīmāniścaye dharmo niḥśeṣeṇoktaḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ vakṣyāmi | daṇḍapāruṣyād vākpāruṣyapravṛtteḥ pūrvam abhidhānam anukramaśrutyāṃ tu “pāruṣye daṇḍavācike” (8.6) iti daṇḍaśabdasyālpasvaratvāt pūrvanirdeśaḥ || 8.266 ||
śataṃ brāhmaṇam ākruśya kṣatriyo daṇḍam arhati |
vaiśyo ‘py ardhaśataṃ dve vā śūdras tu vadham arhati || 8.267 ||
śatam iti | dvijasya cauretyākṣeparūpaṃ paruṣam uktvā kṣatriyaḥ paṇaśataṃ daṇḍam arhati | evaṃ sārdhaśataṃ dve vā śate lāghavagauravāpekṣayā vaiśyaḥ | śūdro ‘py evaṃ brāhmaṇākrośe tāḍanādirūpaṃ vadham arhati || 8.267 ||
pañcāśad brāhmaṇo daṇḍyaḥ kṣatriyasyābhiśaṃsane |
vaiśye syād ardhapañcāśac chūdre dvādaśako damaḥ || 8.268 ||
pañcāśad iti | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyasyoktarūpākṣepe kṛte pañcāśat paṇān daṇḍyaḥ | vaiśye śūdre ca yathoktākrośe kṛte pañcaviṃśatir dvādaśa paṇāḥ krameṇa brāhmaṇasya daṇḍaḥ syāt
|| 8.268 ||
samavarṇe dvijātīnāṃ dvādaśaiva vyatikrame |
vādeṣv avacanīyeṣu tad eva dviguṇaṃ bhavet || 8.269 ||
sameti | dvijātīnāṃ samānajātiviṣaye yathoktākrośe kṛte dvādaśapaṇo daṇḍaḥ | avacanīyeṣu punar ākroṣavādeṣu mātṛbhaginyādyaślīlarūpeṣu tadeveti napuṃsakanirdeśāt “śataṃ brāhmaṇam ākruśya” (8.167) ityādi yad uktaṃ tad eva dviguṇaṃ daṇḍarūpaṃ bhavet || 8.269 ||
ekajātir dvijātīṃs tu vācā dāruṇayā kṣipan |
jihvāyāḥ prāpnuyāc chedaṃ jaghanyaprabhavo hi saḥ || 8.270 ||
eketi | śūdro dvijātīn pātakābhiyoginyā vācākruśya jihvācchedaṃ labhet | yasmād asau pādākhyān nikṛṣṭāṅgāj jātaḥ || 8.270 ||
nāmajātigrahaṃ tv eṣām abhidroheṇa kurvataḥ |
nikṣepyo ‘yomayaḥ śaṅkur jvalann āsye daśāṅgulaḥ || 8.271 ||
nāmeti | abhidroha ākrośaḥ | brāhmaṇādīnāṃ ‘re tvaṃ yajñadatta brāhmaṇāpasada’ ityākrośena nāmajātyādigrahaṇaṃ kurvato lohakīlo ‘gninā pradīpto daśāṅgulo mukhe kṣeptavyaḥ
|| 8.271 ||
dharmopadeśaṃ darpeṇa viprāṇām asya kurvataḥ |
taptam āsecayet tailaṃ vaktre śrotre ca pārthivaḥ || 8.272 ||
dharmeti | kathaṃcid dharmaleśam avagamyāyaṃ te dharmo ‘nuṣṭheya iti brāhmaṇasyāhaṃkārād upadiśato ‘sya śūdrasya mukhe karṇayoś ca javlat tailaṃ rājā prakṣepayet || 8.272 ||
śrutaṃ deśaṃ ca jātiṃ ca karma śārīram eva ca |
vitathena bruvan darpād dāpyaḥ syād dviśataṃ damam || 8.273 ||
śrutam iti | samānajātiviṣayam idaṃ daṇḍalāghavān na tu śūdrasya dvijātyākṣepaviṣayam | na tvayaitac chrutaṃ, na bhavān taddeśajātaḥ, na taveyaṃ jātiḥ, na tava śarīrasaṃskāram upanayanādikarma kṛtam ity ahaṃkāreṇa mithyā bruvan dviśataṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyaḥ syāt | vitatheneti ‘tṛtīyāvidhāne prakṛtyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam’ (Kātyāyna on Pāṇ 2.3.1, 33) iti tṛtīyā || 8.273 ||s
kāṇaṃ vāpy atha vā khañjam anyaṃ vāpi tathāvidham |
tathyenāpi bruvan dāpyo daṇḍaṃ kārṣāpaṇāvaram || 8.274 ||
kāṇam iti | ekākṣivikalaṃ pādavikalam anyam api vā tathāvidhaṃ hastādyaṅgavikalaṃ satyenāpi kāṇādiśabdena bruvann atyantālpaṃ tadā kārṣāpaṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyaḥ || 8.274 ||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ jāyāṃ bhrātaraṃ tanayaṃ gurum |
ākṣārayañ chataṃ dāpyaḥ panthānaṃ cādadad guroḥ || 8.275 ||
mātaram iti | “ākṣāritaḥ kṣārito ‘bhiśaptaḥ” ity ābhidhāyikāḥ | mātrādīn pātakādinābhiśapan, guroś ca panthānam atyajan daṇḍyaḥ | bhāryādīnāṃ gurulaghupātābhiśāpena daṇḍasāmyaṃ samādheyam | medhātithis tu ākṣāraṇaṃ bhedanam ity uktvā mātṛputrapitrādīnāṃ parasparabhedanakartur ayaṃ daṇḍavidhir iti vyākhyātavān || 8.275 ||
brāhmaṇakṣatriyābhyāṃ tu daṇḍaḥ kāryo vijānatā |
brāhmaṇe sāhasaḥ pūrvaḥ kṣatriye tv eva madhyamaḥ || 8.276 ||
brāhmaṇeti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyābhyāṃ parasparaṃ patanīyākrośe kṛte daṇḍaśāstrajñena rājñā daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ | daṇḍam eva viśeṣeṇāha – brāhmaṇa iti | brāhmaṇe kṣatriyākrośini prathamasāhasaḥ kāryaḥ | brāhmaṇākrośini punaḥ kṣatriye madhyamasāhasaḥ || 8.276 ||
viṭśūdrayor evam eva svajātiṃ prati tattvataḥ |
chedavarjaṃ praṇayanaṃ daṇḍasyeti viniścayaḥ || 8.277 ||
viḍ iti | vaiśaśūdrayor anyonyajātiṃ prati patanīyākrośe brāhmaṇakṣatriyavad vaiśye śūdrākrośini prathamasāhasaḥ, śūdre vaiśyākrośini madhyamasāhasa ity evaṃrūpaṃ daṇḍasya praṇayanaṃ jihvācchedarahitaṃ yathāvat kartavyam iti śāstraniścayaḥ | evaṃ ca “ekajātir dvijātīṃś tu” (8.270) iti prāguktajihvācchedo vaiśye nivāritaḥ brāhmaṇakṣatriyākrośaviṣaya evāvatiṣthate || 8.277 ||
eṣa daṇḍavidhiḥ prokto vākpāruṣyasya tattvataḥ |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi daṇḍapāruṣyanirṇayam || 8.278 ||
eṣa iti | eṣo ‘nantarokto vākpāruṣyasya yathāvad daṇḍavidhir uktaḥ, anantaraṃ tāḍanāder daṇḍapāruṣyasya nirṇayaṃ vakṣyāmi || 8.278 ||
yena kenacid aṅgena hiṃsyāc chreṣṭham antyajaḥ |
chettavyaṃ tad tad evāsya tan manor anuśāsanam || 8.279 ||
yeneti | antyajaḥ śūdro yena kenacit karacaraṇādināṅgena sākṣād daṇḍādināvyavahitena dvijātiṃ praharet tad evāṅgam asya chettavyam ity ayaṃ manor updeśaḥ | manugrahaṇam ādarārtham || 8.279 ||
asyaivottaratra prapañcaḥ –
pāṇim udyamya daṇḍaṃ vā pāṇicchedanam arhati |
pādena praharan kopāt pādacchedanam arhati || 8.280 ||
pāṇim iti | prahartuṃ pāṇiṃ daṇḍaṃ vodyamya pāṇiccchedaṃ labhate | pādena kopāt praharaṇe pādacchedaṃ prāpnoti || 8.280 ||
sahāsanam abhiprepsur utkṛṣṭasyāpakṛṣṭajaḥ |
kaṭyāṃ kṛtāṅko nirvāsyaḥ sphicaṃ cāsyāvakartayet || 8.281 ||
saheti | brāhmaṇena sahāsanopviṣṭaḥ śūdraḥ kaṭyāṃ taptalokakṛtacihno nirvāsanīyaḥ, sphicaṃ vāsya yathā na mriyate tathā chedayet || 8.281 ||
avaniṣṭhīvato darpād dvāv oṣṭhau chedayen nṛpaḥ |
avamūtrayato meḍhram avaśardhayato gudam || 8.282 ||
aveti | darpeṇa śleṣmaṇā brāhmanān apamānayataḥ śūdrasya rājā dvāv oṣṭhau chedayet | mūtraprakṣepeṇāpamānayato meḍhram | śardhanaṃ kutsito gudaśabdas tenāvamānayato darpān na pramādād gudaṃ chedayet || 8.282 ||
keśeṣu gṛhṇato hastau chedayed avicārayan |
pādayor dāḍhikāyāṃ ca grīvāyāṃ vṛṣaṇeṣu ca || 8.283 ||
keśeṣv iti | darpād ity anuvartate | ahaṃkāreṇa keśeṣu brāhmaṇaṃ gṛhṇataḥ śūdrasya pīḍāsya jātā na jātā vety avicārayan hastau chedayet | pādayoḥ śmaśruṇi ca grīvāyāṃ vṛṣaṇe ca hiṃsārthaṃ gṛhṇato hastadvayacchedam eva kuryāt || 8.283 ||
tvagbhedakaḥ śataṃ daṇḍyo lohitasya ca darśakaḥ |
māṃsabhettā tu ṣaṇniṣkān pravāsyas tv asthibhedakaḥ || 8.284 ||
tvagbhedaka iti | carmamātrabhedakṛt samānajātir na śūdro brāhmaṇasya daṇḍalāghavaṃ paṇaśataṃ daṇḍanīyaḥ | tathā raktotpādako ‘pi paṇaśatam eva daṇḍyaḥ | māṃsabhedī ṣaṇniṣkān dāpyaḥ | asthibhedakas tu deśān nirvāsyaḥ || 8.284 ||
vanaspatīnāṃ sarveṣām upabhogo yathā yathā |
tathā tathā damaḥ kāryo hiṃsāyām iti dhāraṇā || 8.285 ||
vanaspatīnām iti | vṛkṣādyudbhidāṃ sarveṣāṃ yena yena prakāreṇa upabhogaḥ phalapuṣpapatrādinā uttamamadhyamādhamarūpo bhavati tathā tathā hiṃsāyām apy uttamasāhasādir daṇḍo vidheya iti niścayaḥ | tathā ca viṣṇuḥ:
phalopabhogadrumacchedī tūttamaṃ sāhasaṃ, puṣpopabhogadrumacchedī madhyamaṃ, vallīgulmalatācchedī kārṣāpaṇaśataṃ, tṛṇacchedy ekaṃ | [ViDh 5.55–58]
kāṛṣāpaṇaṃ ca paṇa eva manunāpy ukto veditavyaḥ | || 8.285 ||
manuṣyāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ ca duḥkhāya prahṛte sati |
yathā yathā mahad duḥkhaṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryāt tathā tathā || 8.286 ||
manuṣyāṇām iti | manuṣyāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ pīḍotpādanārthaṃ prahāre kṛte sati yathā yathā pīḍādhikyaṃ tathā tathā daṇḍam apy adhikaṃ kuryāt | evaṃ ca marmasthānādau tvagbhedanādiṣu kṛteṣu “tvagbhedakaḥ śataṃ daṇḍyaḥ” (8.284) ity uktād apy adhiko daṇḍo duḥkhaviśeṣāpakṣayā kartavyaḥ || 8.286 ||
aṅgāvapīḍanāyāṃ ca vraṇaśoṇitayos tathā |
samutthānavyayaṃ dāpyaḥ sarvadaṇḍam athāpi vā || 8.287 ||
aṅgeti | aṅgānāṃ karacaraṇādīnāṃ vraṇaśoṇitayoś ca pīḍanāyāṃ satyāṃ samutthānavyayaṃ yāvatā kālena pūrvāvasthāprāptiḥ samutthānasaṃbandho bhavati tāvatkālena pathyauṣadhādinā yāvān vyayo bhavati tam asau dāpanīyaḥ | atha taṃ vyayaṃ pīḍotpādako na dātum icchati, tadā yaḥ samutthānavyayo yaś ca daṇḍas tam enaṃ daṇḍatvena rājñā dāpyaḥ || 8.287 ||
dravyāṇi hiṃsyād yo yasya jñānato ‘jñānato ‘pi vā |
sa tasyotpādayet tuṣṭiṃ rājñe dadyāc ca tatsamam || 8.288 ||
dravyeti | dravyāṇy anuktaviśeṣadaṇḍāni kaṭakāni tāmraghaṭādīti yo yasya jñānād ajñānād vā nāśayet sa tasya dravyāntarādinā tuṣṭim utpādayet, rājñaś ca vināśitadravyasamaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt || 8.288 ||
carmacārmikabhāṇḍeṣu kāṣṭhaloṣṭamayeṣu ca |
mūlyāt pañcaguṇo daṇḍaḥ puṣpamūlaphaleṣu ca || 8.289 ||
carmeti | carmaṇi carmaghaṭitavaratrādau carmakāṣṭhamṛttikānirmiteṣu ca bhāṇḍeṣu puṣpamūlaphaleṣu parasya nāśiteṣu mūlyāt pañcaguṇo daṇḍo rājño deyaḥ | svāminaś ca tuṣṭir utpādanīyaiva || 8.289 ||
yānasya caiva yātuś ca yānasvāmina eva ca |
daśātivartanāny āhuḥ śeṣe daṇḍo vidhīyate || 8.290 ||
yanasyeti | yānasya rathāder yātuḥ sārathyāder yānasvāminaś ca yasya yad yānaṃ teṣāṃ chinnanāsyādīni daśa nimittāni daṇḍam atikramya vartante | eṣu nimitteṣu satsu prāṇimāraṇe dravyanāśe ca prakṛte yānasvāmināṃ daṇḍo na bhavatīti manvādaya āhuḥ | etadvyatiriktanimitte ca punar daṇḍo ‘nuṣṭhīyate || 8.290 ||
chinnanāsye bhagnayuge tiryakpratimukhāgate |
akṣabhaṅge ca yānasya cakrabhaṅge tathaiva ca || 8.291 ||
chedane caiva yantrāṇāṃ yoktraraśmyos tathaiva ca |
ākrande cāpy apaihīti na daṇḍaṃ manur abravīt || 8.292 ||
chinneti | chedana iti | nāsāyāṃ bhavaṃ nāsyam | śarīrāvayavatvād yat | sā ceha balīvardanāsāsraṃbandhinī rajjuḥ | chinnanāsyarajjau balīvardādike, bhagnayugākhye kāṣṭhe, rathādau bhūmivaiṣamyādinā tiraścīnaṃ vā gate, tathā cakrāntaḥpraviṣṭākṣakāṣṭhabhaṅge, yantrāṇāṃ carmabandhanānāṃ chedane, yoktrasya paśugrīvārajjoḥ, raśmeḥ praharaṇasya ca chedane, apasarāpasarety uccaiḥśabde sārathyādinā kṛte ca yānena prāṇihiṃsādravyavināśayoḥ kṛtayoḥ sārathyāder daṇḍo nāstīti manur āha || 8.291–291 ||
yatrāpavartate yugyaṃ vaigunyāt prājakasya tu |
tatra svāmī bhaved daṇḍyo hiṃsāyāṃ dviśataṃ damam || 8.293 ||
yatreti | yatra sārather akauśalād yānam anyathā vrajati tatra hiṃsāyām aśikṣitasārathyaniyogasvāmī dviśataṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyaḥ syāt || 8.293 ||
prājakaś ced bhaved āptaḥ prājako daṇḍam arhati |
yugyasthāḥ prājake ‘nāpte sarve daṇḍyāḥ śataṃ śatam || 8.294 ||
prājaka iti | yadi sārathiḥ kuśalaḥ syāt tadā sārathir evoktadviśataṃ damaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca “manuṣyamāraṇe” (8.296) ityādikaṃ daṇḍam arhati na svāmī | akuśale tu tasmin sārathisvāmivyatiriktā anye ‘pi yānārūḍhā akuśalasārathikayānārohaṇāt sarve pratyekaṃ śataṃ śataṃ daṇḍyāḥ || 8.294 ||
sa cet tu pathi saṃruddhaḥ paśubhir vā rathena vā |
pramāpayet prāṇabhṛtas tatra daṇḍo ‘vicāritaḥ || 8.295 ||
sa ced iti | sa cet prājakaḥ saṃmukhāgataiḥ pracuragavādibhī rathāntareṇa vā saṃruddhaḥ svarathagamanānavadhānāt pratyaksarpaṇākṣamaḥ saṃkaṭe ‘pi svarathaturagān prerayan, turagai rathena vā rathāvayavair vā prāṇino vyāpādayati tatrāvicārito daṇḍaḥ kartavya eva || 8.295 ||
sakṛdaparādhe kīdṛśa ity āha –
manuṣyamāraṇe kṣipraṃ cauravat kilbiṣaṃ bhavet |
prāṇabhṛtsu mahatsv ardhaṃ gogajoṣṭrahayādiṣu || 8.296 ||
manuṣyeti | tatra manuṣyamāraṇe prājakasyānavadhānād yānena kṛtaṃ śīghram eva cauradaṇḍottamasāhasaṃ bhaven na tu māraṇarūpaḥ, ‘prāṇabhṛtsu mahatsv ardham’ iti śravaṇāt | gogajādiṣu mahatsu prāṇiṣu māriteṣu uttamasāhasasyārdhaṃ pañcaśatapaṇo daṇḍo bhavet || 8.296 ||
kṣudrakāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ tu hiṃsāyāṃ dviśato damaḥ |
pañcāśat tu bhaved daṇḍaḥ śubheṣu mṛgapakṣiṣu || 8.297 ||
kṣudreti | kṣudrakāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ jātito viśeṣāpadiṣṭetareṣāṃ vanacarādīnāṃ vayasā ca kiśorādīnāṃ māraṇe dviśato daṇḍaḥ syāt | śubheṣu mṛgeṣu rurupṛṣatādiṣu pakṣiṣu ca śukahaṃsasārasādiṣu pakṣiṣu hateṣu pañcāśad daṇḍo bhavet || 8.297 ||
gardabhājāvikānāṃ tu daṇḍaḥ syāt pañcamāṣikaḥ |
māṣikas tu bhaved daṇḍaḥ śvasūkaranipātane || 8.298 ||
gardabheti | gardabhacchāgaiḍakādīnāṃ punar māraṇe pañcarūpyamāṣakaparimāṇo daṇḍaḥ syāt | na cātra hairaṇyamāṣagrahaṇaṃ, uttarottaralaghudaṇḍābhidhānāt | śvasūkaramāraṇe tu punā raupyamāṣaparimāṇo daṇḍaḥ syāt || 8.298 ||
bhāryā putraś ca dāsaś ca preṣyo bhrātā ca sodaraḥ |
prāptāparādhās tāḍyāḥ syū rajjvā veṇudalena vā || 8.299 ||
bhāryeti | bhāryāputrādayaḥ kṛtāparādhā rajjvā vātilaghuveṇuśalākayā tāḍyā bhaveyuḥ | śikṣārthaṃ tāḍanavidhānād atra daṇḍāpavādaḥ || 8.299 ||
pṛṣṭhatas tu śarīrasya nottamāṅge kathaṃcana |
ato ‘nyathā tu praharan prāptaḥ syāc caurakilbiṣam || 8.300 ||
pṛṣṭata iti | rajjvādibhir api dehasya pṛṣṭhadeśe tāḍanīyāḥ na tu śirasi | uktavyatirekeṇa praharaṇe vāgdaṇḍadhanadaṇḍarūpaṃ cauradaṇḍaṃ prāpnuyāt || 8.300 ||
eṣo ‘khilenābhihito daṇḍapāruṣyanirṇayaḥ |
stenasyātaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidhiṃ daṇḍavinirṇaye || 8.301 ||
eṣa iti | eṣa daṇḍapāruṣyanirṇayo niḥśeṣeṇoktaḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ cauradaṇḍavinirṇaye vidhānaṃ vakṣyāmi || 8.301 ||
paramaṃ yatnam ātiṣṭhet stenānāṃ nigrahe nṛpaḥ |
stenānāṃ nigrahād asya yaśo rāṣṭraṃ ca vardhate || 8.302 ||
paramam iti | caurāṇāṃ niyamane rājā paramam utkṛṣṭaṃ yatnaṃ kuryāt | yasmāc cauranigrahād rājñaḥ khyātir nirupadravatayā rāṣṭraṃ ca vṛddhim eti || 8.302 ||
abhayasya hi yo dātā sa pūjyaḥ satataṃ nṛpaḥ |
satraṃ hi vardhate tasya sadaivābhayadakṣiṇam || 8.303 ||
abhayasyeti | hir avadhāraṇe | caurāṇāṃ niyamanena yo nṛpatiḥ sādhūnām abhayaṃ dadāti sa eva pūjyaḥ pūrveṣāṃ ślāghyo bhavati | satraṃ gavāmayanādikratuviśeṣaḥ | yad yasmāt satram iva satraṃ tad abhayadānāc cauranigraharūpābhayadakṣiṇaṃ sarvadaiva tasya vṛddhim eti | anyad dhi niyatakālīnaṃ niyatadakṣiṇaṃ ca, etat sarvakālīnam abhayadakṣiṇaṃ ceti vākyam | vyatirekālaṃkāraḥ || 8.303 ||
sarvato dharmaṣaḍbhāgo rājño bhavati rakṣataḥ |
adharmād api ṣaḍbhāgo bhavaty asya hy arakṣataḥ || 8.304 ||
sarvata iti | prajā rakṣato rājñaḥ sarvasya bhṛtidātur vaṇigāder bhṛtyadātuś ca śrotriyādeḥ sakāśād dharmaṣaḍbhāgo bhavati | arakṣataś cādharmād api lokena kṛtāt ṣaḍbhāgaḥ syāt | tasmād yatnataḥ stenanigraheṇa rājā rakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt | na ca bhṛtikrītatvād rājño dharmaṣaḍbhāgo na yukta iti vācyam, bhṛtyā dharmaṣaḍbhāgena ca parikrītasya śāstrīyatvāt
|| 8.304 ||
yad adhīte yad yajate yad dadāti yad arcati |
tasya ṣaḍbhāgabhāg rājā samyag bhavati rakṣaṇāt || 8.305 ||
yad iti | yaḥ kaścij japayāgadānadevatārcādīni karoti tasya rājā pālanena ṣaḍbhāgaṃ prāpnoti
|| 8.305 ||
rakṣaṇ dharmeṇa bhūtāni rājā vadhyāṃś ca ghātayan |
yajate ‘har ahar yajñaiḥ sahasraśatadakṣiṇaiḥ || 8.306 ||
rakṣann iti | bhūtāni sarvāṇi sthāvarajaṅgamādīni yathāśāstraṃ daṇḍapraṇayanarūpeṇa dharmeṇa rakṣan, vadhyāṃś ca stenādīṃs tāḍayan, pratyahaṃ lakṣagodakṣiṇair yajñair yajate | tajjanyaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnotīti bhāvaḥ || 8.306 ||
yo ‘rakṣan balim ādatte karaṃ śulkaṃ ca pārthivaḥ |
pratibhāgaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca sa sadyo narakaṃ vrajet || 8.307 ||
yo ‘rakṣann iti | yo rājā rakṣām akurvan baliṃ dhānyādeḥ ṣaḍbhāgaṃ grāmavāsibhyaḥ pratimāsaṃ vā bhādrapauṣaniyamena grāhyaṃ śulkaṃ sthalajalapathādinā vāṇijyākāritebhyo niyatasthāneṣu dravyānusāreṇa grāhyaṃ dānam iti prasiddhaṃ pratibhāgaṃ phalakusumaśākatṛṇādyupāyanaṃ pratidinagrāhyaṃ daṇḍaṃ vyavahārādau gṛhṇāti sa mṛtaḥ san sadya eva narakaṃ yāti || 8.307 ||
arakṣitāraṃ rājānaṃ baliṣaḍbhāgahāriṇam |
tam āhuḥ sarvalokasya samagramalahārakam || 8.308 ||
arakṣitāram iti | yo rājā na rakṣati, atha ca dhānyādiṣaḍbhāgaṃ balirūpaṃ gṛhṇāti, taṃ sarvalokānāṃ sakalapāpahāriṇaṃ manvādaya āhuḥ || 8.308 ||
anapekṣitamaryādaṃ nāstikaṃ vipralumpakam |
arakṣitāram attāraṃ nṛpaṃ vidyād adhogatim || 8.309 ||
anapekṣiteti | laṅghitaśāstramaryādaṃ paralokābhāvaśālinam anucitadaṇḍādinā dhanagrāhiṇaṃ rakṣaṇarahitaṃ karabalyāder bhakṣitāraṃ rājānaṃ narakagāminaṃ jānīyāt || 8.309 ||
adhārmikaṃ tribhir nyāyair nigṛhṇīyāt prayatnataḥ |
nirodhanena bandhena vividhena vadhena ca || 8.310 ||
adhārmikam iti | adhārmikaṃ caurādikam aparādhāpekṣayā tribhir upāyaiḥ prayatnena niyamayet | tān āha – kārāgārapraveśanena, nigaḍādibandhanena, karacaraṇacchedanādinānāprakārahiṃsanena || 8.310 ||
nigraheṇa hi pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṃgraheṇa ca |
dvijātaya ivejyābhiḥ pūyante satataṃ nṛpāḥ || 8.311 ||
nigraheneti | pāpaśālināṃ nigraheṇa, sādhūnāṃ saṃgraheṇa, dvijātaya iva mahāyajñādibhiḥ sarvakālaṃ nṛpatayaḥ pavitrībhavanti | tasmād adhārmikān nigṛhṇīyāt sādhūṃś cānugṛhṇīyāt
|| 8.311 ||
kṣantavyaṃ prabhuṇā nityaṃ kṣipatāṃ kāryiṇāṃ nṛṇām |
bālavṛddhāturāṇāṃ ca kurvatā hitam ātmanaḥ || 8.312 ||
kṣantavyam iti | kāryavatām arthipratyarthināṃ duḥkhenākṣepoktiṃ racayatāṃ tathā bālavṛddhavyādhitānām ākṣipatāṃ vakṣyamāṇam ātmīyam upakāram icchatā prabhuṇā kṣamaṇīyam || 8.312 ||
yaḥ kṣipto marṣayaty ārtais tena svarge mahīyate |
yas ev aiśvaryān na kṣamate narakaṃ tena gacchati || 8.313 ||
yaḥ kṣipta iti | duḥkhitair ākṣiptaḥ sahate yaḥ sa tena svargaloke pūjāṃ labhate | prabhutvadarpān na sahate yaḥ sa tena narakaṃ gacchati || 8.1313 ||
rājā stenena gantavyo muktakeśena dhāvatā |
ācakṣāṇena tat steyam evaṃkarmāsmi śādhi mām || 8.314 ||
skandhenādāya musalaṃ laguḍaṃ vāpi khādiram |
śaktiṃ cobhayatas tīkṣṇām āyasaṃ daṇḍam eva vā || 8.315 ||
rājeti | skandeneti | yady api “suvarṇasteyakṛd vipraḥ” (11.99) ityādinā prāyaścittaprakaraṇe vakṣyati tathāpi suvarṇasteyaṃ prati rājadaṇḍarūpatām asya daṇḍaprakaraṇe darśayituṃ pāṭhaḥ | brāhmaṇasuvarṇasya caureṇa muktakeśena vegād gacchatā ‘mayā brāhmaṇasuvarṇam apahṛtam’ iti khyāpayatā musalākhyam āyudhaṃ khādiramayaṃ vā daṇḍam ubhayatas tīkṣṇāṃ śaktiṃ lohamayaṃ vā daṇḍaṃ skandhe gṛhītvā rājasamīpaṃ gacchet | tato ‘brāhmaṇasuvarṇahāry aham, ato ‘nena musalādinā māṃ vyāpādaya’ ity evaṃ rājñe vaktavyam
|| 8.314–315 ||
śāsanād vā vimokṣād vā stenaḥ steyād vimucyate |
aśāsitvā tu taṃ rājā stenasyāpnoti kilbiṣam || 8.316 ||
śāsanād iti | sakṛn musalādiprahāreṇa prāṇaparityājanān mṛtakakalpasya jīvato ‘pi parityāgād vā sa cauras tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate | ata eva yājñavalkyaḥ [YDh 3.248]–
mṛtakalpaḥ prahārārto jīvann api viśūdhyati | iti |
tam punaḥ stenaṃ karuṇādibhir ahatvā stenasya yat pāpaṃ tad rājā prāpnoti || 8.316 ||
annāde bhrūṇahā mārṣṭi patyau bhāryāpacāriṇī |
gurau śiṣyaś ca yājyaś ca steno rājani kilbiṣam || 8.317 ||
annāda iti | brahmahā yas tatsaṃbandhi yo ‘nnam atti tasminn asau svapāpaṃ saṃkrāmayati | bhrūṇahānnabhoktuḥ pāpaṃ bhavatīty etad atra vivakṣitaṃ, na tu brahmaghnaḥ pāpaṃ naśyati | tathā bhāryā vyabhicāriṇī jārapatiṃ kṣamamāṇe bhartari pāpaṃ saṃśleṣayati | śiṣyaś ca saṃdhyāgnikāryādyakaraṇajanyaṃ pāpaṃ gurau sahamāne nyasyati | yājyaś ca vidhim atikrāman yājake kṣamamāṇe pāpaṃ nikṣipati | stenaś ca rājany upekṣamāṇe pāpaṃ samarpayati | tasmād rājā steno nigrahītavyaḥ || 8.317 ||
rājabhiḥ kṛtadaṇḍās tu kṛtvā pāpāni mānavāḥ |
nirmalāḥ svargam āyāṇti santaḥ sukṛtino yathā || 8.318 ||
rājeti | suvarṇasteyādīni pāpāni kṛtvā paścād rājabhir vihitadaṇḍā manuṣyāḥ santaḥ pratibandhakaduritābhāvāt pūrvārjitapuṇyavaśena sādhavaḥ sukṛtakāriṇa iva svargaṃ gacchanti | evaṃ prāyaścittavad daṇḍasyāpi pāpakṣayahetutvam uktam || 8.318 ||
yas tu rajjuṃ ghaṭaṃ kūpād dhared bhidyāc ca yaḥ prapām |
sa daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyān māṣaṃ tac ca tasmin samāharet || 8.319 ||
yas tv iti | kūpasamīpe rajjughaṭayor jaloddharaṇāya dhṛtayo rajjuṃ ghaṭaṃ vā haret | yo vā pānīyadānagṛhaṃ vidārayet sa sauvarṇaṃ māṣaṃ daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyāt,
yan nirdiṣṭaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ māṣaṃ tatra prakalpayet |
iti kātyāyanavacanāt | tac ca rajjvādi tasmin kūpe samarpayet || 8.319 ||
dhānyaṃ daśabhyaḥ kumbhebhyo harato ‘bhyadhikaṃ vadhaḥ |
śeṣe ‘py ekādaśaguṇaṃ dāpyas tasya ca tad dhanam || 8.320 ||
dhānyam iti | dvipalaśataṃ droṇaḥ, viṃśatidroṇaś ca kumbhaḥ, daśasaṃkhyebhyaḥ kumbhebhyo ‘dhikaṃ dhānyaṃ harato vadhaḥ | sa ca hartṛsvāmiguṇavattāpekṣayā tāḍanāṅgacchedamāraṇātmako jñeyaḥ | śeṣe punar ekasmād ārabhya daśakumbhaparyantaharaṇe nihnutaikādaśaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyaḥ | svāminaś cāpahṛtaṃ dāpyaḥ || 8.320 ||
tathā dharimameyānāṃ śatād abhyadhike vadhaḥ |
suvarṇarajatādīnām uttamānāṃ ca vāsasām || 8.321 ||
tatheti | yathā dhānyena vadha uktas tathā tulāparicchedyānāṃ suvarṇarajatādīnām utkṛṣṭānāṃ ca vāsasāṃ paṭṭādīnāṃ palaśatādhike ‘pahṛte vadhaḥ kartavya eva | viṣayasamīkaraṇaṃ cātra deśakālāpahartṛdravyasvāmijātiguṇāpekṣayā pariharaṇīyam | evam uttaratrāpi jñeyam || 8.321 ||
pañcāśatas tv abhyadhike hastacchedanam iṣyate |
śeṣe tv ekādaśaguṇaṃ mūlyād daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet || 8.322 ||
pañcāśata iti | pūrvoktānāṃ pañcāśadūrdhvaṃ śataṃ yāvad apahāre kṛte hastacchedanaṃ manvādibhir abhihitam | śeṣeṣv ekapalād ārabhya pañcāśatpalaparyantāpahāre apahṛtadhanād ekādaśaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyaḥ || 8.322 ||
puruṣāṇāṃ kulīnānāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ |
mukhyānāṃ caiva ratnānāṃ haraṇe vadham arhati || 8.323 ||
puruṣāṇām iti | mahākulajātānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa strīṇāṃ mahākulaprasūtānāṃ śreṣṭhānāṃ ca ratnānāṃ vajravaidūryādīnām apahāre vadham arhati || 8.323 ||
mahāpaśūnāṃ haraṇe śastrāṇām auṣadhasya ca |
kālam āsādya kāryaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ rājā prakalpayet || 8.324 ||
mahāpaśūnām iti | mahatāṃ paśūnāṃ hastyaśvādigomahiṣyādīnāṃ tathā khaḍgādīnāṃ śastrāṇāṃ kalyāṇaghṛtādeś cauṣadhasya ca durbhikṣādirūpaṃ kālaṃ kāryaṃ prayojanaṃ ca sadasadviniyogarūpaṃ nirūpya rājā tāḍanāṅgacchedavadharūpaṃ daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet
|| 8.324 ||
goṣu brāhmaṇasaṃsthāsu chūrikāyāś ca bhedane |
paśūnāṃ haraṇe caiva sadyaḥ kāryo ‘rdhapādikaḥ || 8.325 ||
goṣv iti | brāhmaṇasaṃbandhinīnāṃ gavām apahāre vandhyāyāś ca gor vāhanārthaṃ nāsācchedane paśūnāṃ cājaiḍakānāṃ daṇḍabhūyastvād yāgādyarthānāṃ haraṇe ‘nantaram eva chinnārdhapādikaḥ kāryaḥ || 8.325 ||
sūtrakārpāsakiṇvānāṃ gomayasya guḍasya ca |
dadhnaḥ kṣīrasya takrasya pānīyasya tṛṇasya ca || 8.326 ||
veṇuvaidalabhāṇḍānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca |
mṛnmayānāṃ ca haraṇe mṛdo bhasmana eva ca || 8.327 ||
matsyānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva tailasya ca ghṛtasya ca |
māṃsasya madhunaś caiva yac cānyat paśusaṃbhavam || 8.328 ||
anyeṣāṃ caivamādīnām adyānām odanasya ca |
pakvānnānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tanmūlyād dviguṇo damaḥ || 8.329 ||
sūtretyādi | ūrṇādisūtrasya kārpāsikasya ca, kiṇvasya surābījadravyasya ca, sūkṣmaveṇukhaṇḍanirmitajalāharaṇabhāṇḍādīnāṃ, yad apy anyat paśusaṃbhavaṃ ca mṛgacarmakhaḍgaśṛṅgādi, anyeṣām apy evaṃvidhānām asāraprāyāṇāṃ manaḥśilādīnāṃ, madyānāṃ dvādaśānāṃ, pakvānnānām odanavyatiriktānām apy apūpamodakādīnāṃ ca kārpāsādiśabdārthānāṃ prasiddhānāṃ cāpahāre kṛte mūlyād dviguṇo daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ
|| 8.326–329 ||
puṣpeṣu harite dhānye gulmavallīnageṣu ca |
anyeṣv aparipūteṣu daṇḍaḥ syāt pañcakṛṣṇalaḥ || 8.330 ||
puṣpeṣv iti | puṣpeṣu, harite kṣetrasthe dhānye, gulmalatāvṛkṣeṣv aparivṛteṣu anapāvṛtavṛkṣeṣu, vakṣyamāṇaśloke dhānyādiṣu nirdeśāt parivapanasaṃbhavāc ca dhānyeṣu, anyeṣu samarthapuruṣabhārahāryeṣu hṛteṣu deśakālādyapekṣayā suvarṇasya raupyasya vā pañcakṛṣṇalamāṣaparimāṇo daṇḍaḥ syāt || 8.330 ||
paripūteṣu dhānyeṣu śākamūlaphaleṣu ca |
niranvaye śataṃ daṇḍaḥ sānvaye ‘rdhaśataṃ damaḥ || 8.331 ||
parīti | niṣpulākīkṛteṣu, vṛkṣeṣu, dhānyeṣu, śākādiṣu cāpahṛteṣu, anvayo dravyasvāmināṃ saṃbandhaḥ, yena saha kaścid api saṃbandho nāsty ekagrāmavāsādis tatra śataṃ daṇḍyaḥ | sānvaye tu pañcāśatpaṇo deyaḥ | khalastheṣu ca dhānyeṣv ayaṃ daṇḍas tatra hi paripūryate | gṛheṣv ekādaśaguṇo daṇḍaḥ prāg uktaḥ || 8.331 ||
syāt sāhasaṃ tv anvayavat prasabhaṃ karma yat kṛtam |
niranvayaṃ bhavet steyaṃ hṛtvāpavyayate ca yat || 8.332 ||
syād iti | yad dhānyāpahārādikaṃ karma dravyasvāmisamakṣaṃ balād dhṛtaṃ tat sāhasaṃ syāt, saho balaṃ tadbhavaṃ sāhasam | ata iha steyadaṇḍo na kāryaḥ | etadarthaḥ steyaprakaraṇe ‘sya pāṭhaḥ | yat punaḥ svāmiparokṣāpahṛtaṃ tat steyaṃ bhavet | yac ca hṛtvāpahnute tad api steyam eva || 8.332 ||
yas tv etāny upakḷptāni dravyāṇi stenayen naraḥ |
tam ādyaṃ daṇḍayed rājā yaś cāgniṃ corayed gṛhāt || 8.333 ||
yas tv etānīti | yaḥ punar etāni sūtrādidravyāṇy upabhogārthaṃ kṛtasaṃskārāṇi manuṣyaś corayet, yaś ca tretāgniṃ gṛhyāgniṃ vāgnigṛhāc corayet taṃ rājā prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ daṇḍayet | agnisvāminaś cādhānopakṣayo dātavyaḥ | govindarājas tu laukikāgnim api corayato daṇḍa ity āha | tad ayuktam, alpāparādhe gurudaṇḍasyānyāyyatvāt || 8.333 ||
yena yena yathāṅgena steno nṛṣi viceṣṭate |
tad tad eva haret tasya pratyādeśāya pārthivaḥ || 8.334 ||
yeneti | yena yenāṅgena hastapādādinā yena prakāreṇa saṃdhicchedādinā cauro manuṣyeṣu viruddhaṃ dhanāpahārādikaṃ ceṣṭhate tasya tad evāṅgaṃ prasaṅganivāraṇāya rājā chedayet | tatra dhanasvāmyutkarṣāpekṣayāyam aṅgacchedaḥ || 8.334 ||
pitācāryaḥ suhṛn mātā bhāryā putraḥ purohitaḥ |
nādaṇḍyo nāma rājño ‘sti yaḥ svadharme na tiṣṭhati || 8.335 ||
piteti | pitrācāryamitrabhrātṛmātṛpatnīputrapurohitānāṃ madhyāt svadharme yo nāvatiṣṭhate sa rājño ‘daṇḍanīyo nāsti, api tu daṇḍanīya eva || 8.335 ||
kārṣāpaṇaṃ bhaved daṇḍyo yatrānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ |
tatra rājā bhaved daṇḍyaḥ sahasram iti dhāraṇā || 8.336 ||
kārṣāpaṇam iti | yatrāparādhe rājavyatirikto janaḥ kārṣāpaṇaṃ daṇḍanīyo bhavet tasminn aparādhe rājā paṇasahasraṃ daṇḍanīya iti niścayaḥ | svārthadaṇḍaṃ tv apsu praveśayed brāhmaṇebhyo vā dadyāt, “īśo daṇḍasya varuṇaḥ” (9.245) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt || 8.236 ||
aṣṭāpādyaṃ tu śūdrasya steye bhavati kilbiṣam |
ṣoḍaśaiva tu vaiśyasya dvātriṃśat kṣatriyasya ca || 8.337 ||
brāhmaṇasya catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ pūrṇaṃ vāpi śataṃ bhavet |
dviguṇā vā catuḥṣaṣṭis taddoṣaguṇavid dhi saḥ || 8.338 ||
aṣṭāpādyam iti | brāhmaṇasyeti | taddoṣaguṇavid dhi sa iti sarvatra saṃbadhyate | yasmin steye yo daṇḍa uktaḥ sa steyaguṇadoṣajñasya śūdrasyāṣṭabhir āpādyate guṇyat ity aṣṭaguṇaḥ kartavyaḥ, ṣoḍaśaguṇo guṇadoṣajñasya vaiśyasya, dvātriṃśadguṇas tathāvidhakṣatriyasya, catuḥṣaṣṭiguṇo guṇadoṣaviduṣo brāhmaṇasya, śataguṇo vāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikaśataguṇo vā guṇātiśayāpekṣayā brāhmaṇasyaiva || 8.337–338 ||
vānaspatyaṃ mūlaphalaṃ dārvagnyarthaṃ tathaiva ca |
tṛṇaṃ ca gobhyo grāsārtham asteyaṃ manur abravīt || 8.339 ||
vānaspatyam iti | “vīrudvanaspatīnāṃ puṣpāṇi svavad ādadīta, phalāni cāparivṛtānām” iti gautamavacanād aparivṛtavānaspatyādīnāṃ mūlaphalaṃ, homīyāgnyarthaṃ ca dāru, gogrāsārthaṃ ca tṛṇaṃ parakīyam asteyaṃ manur āha | tasmān na daṇḍo nāpy adharmaḥ
|| 8.339 ||
yo ‘dattādāyino hastāl lipseta brāhmaṇo dhanam |
yājanādhyāpanenāpi yathā stenas tathaiva saḥ || 8.340 ||
ya iti | adattādāyinaś caurasya hastād yo brāhmaṇo yājanādhyāpanapratigrahair api parakīyadhanaṃ jñātvā labdhum icchet sa cauravac cauratulyo jñeyaḥ, ataḥ sa iva daṇḍyaḥ
|| 8.340 ||
dvijo ‘dhvagaḥ kṣīṇavṛttir dvāv ikṣū dve ca mūlake |
ādadānaḥ parakṣetrān na daṇḍaṃ dātum arhati || 8.341 ||
dvija iti | dvijātiḥ pathikaḥ kṣīṇapātheyo dvāv ikṣudaṇḍau dve vā mūlake parakīyakṣetrād gṛhṇan daṇḍadānayogyo na bhavati || 8.341 ||
asaṃditānāṃ saṃdātā saṃditānāṃ ca mokṣakaḥ |
dāsāśvarathahartā ca prāptaḥ syāc caurakilbiṣam || 8.342 ||
asaṃditānām iti | abaddhānām aśvādīnāṃ parakīyānāṃ yo darpeṇa bandhayitā, baddhānāṃ mandurādau mocayitā, yo dāsāśvarathāpahārī sa cauradaṇḍaṃ prāpnuyāt | sa ca gurulaghvaparādhānusāreṇa māraṇāṅgacchedanadhanādyapahārarūpo boddhavyaḥ || 8.342 ||
anena vidhinā rājā kurvāṇaḥ stenanigraham |
yaśo ‘smin prāpnuyāl loke pretya cānuttamaṃ sukham || 8.343 ||
aneneti | anenoktavidhānena rājā cauraniyamanaṃ kurvāṇa iha loke khyātiṃ paraloke cotkṛṣṭasukhaṃ prāpnuyāt || 8.343 ||
idānīṃ sāhasam āha –
aindraṃ sthānam abhiprepsur yaśaś cākṣayam avyayam |
nopekṣeta kṣaṇam api rājā sāhasikaṃ naram || 8.344 ||
aindram iti | sarvādhipatyalakṣaṇaṃ padaṃ khyātiṃ cāvināśinīm anupakṣayāṃ cātiśayena prāptum icchan rājā balena gṛhadāhadhanagrahaṇakāriṇaṃ manuṣyaṃ kṣaṇam api nopekṣeta
|| 8.344 ||
vāgduṣṭāt taskarāc caiva daṇḍenaiva ca hiṃsataḥ |
sāhasasya naraḥ kartā vijñeyaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ || 8.345 ||
vāg iti | vākpāruṣyakṛtāc corāc ca daṇḍapāruṣyakāriṇaś ca manuṣyāt sāhasakṛn manuṣyo ‘tiśayena pāpakārī boddhavyaḥ || 8.345 ||
sāhase vartamānaṃ tu yo marṣayati pārthivaḥ |
sa vināśaṃ vrajaty āśu vidveṣaṃ cādhigacchati || 8.346 ||
sāhasa iti | yo rājā sāhase vartamānaṃ kṣamate sa pāpakṛtām upekṣaṇād adharmabuddhyā vinaśyati | apakriyamāṇarāṣṭratayā janavidveṣaṃ ca gacchati || 8.346 ||
na mitrakāraṇād rājā vipulād vā dhanāgamāt |
samutsṛjet sāhasikān sarvabhūtabhayāvahān || 8.347 ||
na metreti | mitravākyena bahudhanaprāptyā vā sarvabhūtabhayajanakān sāhasikān rājā na tyajet || 8.347 ||
śastraṃ dvijātibhir grāhyaṃ dharmo yatroparudhyate |
dvijātīnāṃ ca varṇānāṃ viplave kālakārite || 8.348 ||
ātmanaś ca paritrāṇe dakṣiṇānāṃ ca saṃgare |
strīviprābhyupapattau ca ghnan dharmeṇa na duṣyati || 8.349 ||
śāstram iti | ātmanaś ceti | brāhmaṇādibhis tribhir varṇaiḥ khaḍgādyāyudhaṃ grahītavyam | yasmin kāle varṇānām āśramiṇāṃ ca sāhasakārādibhir dharmaḥ kartuṃ na dīyate | tathā traivarṇikānām arājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu paracakrāgamanādikālajanite strīsaṅgarādau prāpte tathātmarakṣārthaṃ dakṣiṇādhanagavādyaparāhanimitte ca saṃgrāme strībrāhmaṇarakṣārthaṃ ca dharmayuddhenānanyagatikatayā parān hiṃsan na doṣabhāg bhavati | paramāraṇe ‘py atra sāhasadaṇḍo na kāryaḥ || 8.348–349 ||
guruṃ vā bālavṛddhau vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā bahuśrutam |
ātatāyinam āyāntaṃ hanyād evāvicārayan || 8.350 ||
guruṃ veti | gurubālavṛddhabahuśrutabrāhmaṇānām anyatamaṃ vadhodyatam āgacchantaṃ vidyāvṛttādibhir utkṛṣṭaṃ palāyanādibhir api svanistaraṇāśaktau nirvicāraṃ hanyāt | ata evośanāḥ: “gṛhītaśastram ātatāyinaṃ hatvā na doṣaḥ” | kātyānanaś ca bhṛguśabdollekhena manūktaślokam eva vyaktaṃ vyākhyātavān |
ātatāyini cotkṛṣṭe tapaḥsvādhyāyajanmataḥ |
vadhas tatra tu naiva syāt pāpaṃ hīne vadho bhṛguḥ ||
medhatithi-govindarājau tu “strīviprābhyupapattau ca ghnan dharmena na duṣyati” iti pūrvasyāyam anuvādaḥ | gurvādikam api hanyāt kim utānyam apīti vyācakṣāte || 8.350 ||
nātatāyivadhe doṣo hantur bhavati kaścana |
prakāśaṃ vāprakāśaṃ vā manyus taṃ manyum ṛcchati || 8.351 ||
neti | janasamakṣaṃ rahasi vā vadhodyatasya māraṇe hantur na kaścid apy adharmadaṇḍaḥ prāyaścittākhyo doṣo bhavati | yasmād dhantṛgato manyuḥ krodhābhimāninī devatā hanyamānagataṃ krodhaṃ vivardhayati | sāhase cāparādhagauravāpekṣayā māraṇāṅgacchedanadhanagrahaṇādayo daṇḍāḥ kāryāḥ || 8.351 ||
idānīṃ strīsaṃgrahaṇam āh–
paradārābhimarśeṣu pravṛttān nṝn mahīpatiḥ |
udvejanakarair daṇḍaiś cihnayitvā pravāsayet || 8.352 ||
paradāreti | paradārasaṃbhogāya pravṛttān manuṣyagaṇān udvejanakarair daṇḍair nāsauṣṭhakartanādibhir aṅkayitvā deśān niḥsārayet || 8.352 ||
tatsamuttho hi lokasya jāyate varṇasaṃkaraḥ |
yena mūlaharo ‘dharmaḥ sarvanāśāya kalpate || 8.353 ||
tad iti | yasmāt paradārābhigamanāt saṃbhūto varṇasya saṃkaraḥ saṃpadyate | yena varṇasaṃkareṇa viśuddhapatnīkayajamānābhāvāt “agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyag ādityam upatiṣṭhati” (3.76), asyābhāve sati vṛṣṭyākhyajaganmūlavināśo ‘dharmo jagannāśāya saṃpadyate || 8.353 ||
parasya patnyā puruṣaḥ saṃbhāṣāṃ yojayan rahaḥ |
pūrvam ākṣārito doṣaiḥ prāpnuyāt pūrvasāhasam || 8.354 ||
parasyeti | tatstrīprārthanādidoṣaiḥ pūrvam utpannābhir apavādaprārthanābhiśāpādibhiḥ puruṣaḥ ucitakāraṇavyatirekeṇa parabhāryayā saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kurvan prathamasāhasaṃ daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyāt || 8.354 ||
yas tv anākṣāritaḥ pūrvam abhibhāṣeta kāraṇāt |
na doṣaṃ prāpnuyāt kiṃcin na hi tasya vyatikramaḥ || 8.355 ||
yas tv iti | yaḥ punaḥ pūrvaṃ tatstrīprārthanābhiśāparahitaḥ kenacit kāraṇena janasamakṣam abhibhāṣaṇaṃ kuryān na sa punar daṇḍyatvādidoṣaṃ prāpnuyāt | tasmān na kaścit tasyāparādho ‘sti || 8.355 ||
parastriyaṃ yo ‘bhivadet tīrthe ‘raṇye vane ‘pi vā |
nadīnāṃ vāpi saṃbhede sa saṃgrahaṇam āpnuyāt || 8.356 ||
pareti | tīrthādyaraṇyavanādikanirjanadeśopalakṣaṇamātram | yaḥ puruṣaḥ parastriyam udakāvataraṇamārge ‘raṇye grāmād bahir gulmalatākīrṇe nirjane deśe vane bahuvṛkṣasaṃtate nadīnāṃ saṃgame pūrvam anākṣārito ‘pi kāraṇād api saṃbhāṣeta sa saṃgrahaṇaṃ sahasrapaṇadaṇḍaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ prāpnuyāt | samyag gṛhyate jñāyate yena parastrīsaṃbhogābhilāṣa iti saṃgrahaṇam || 8.356 ||
upacārakriyā keliḥ sparśo bhūṣaṇavāsasām |
saha khaṭvāsanaṃ caiva sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ smṛtam || 8.357 ||
upacāreti | sraggandhānulepanapreṣaṇādyupacārakaraṇaṃ keliḥ parihāsāliṅganādiḥ alaṃkāravastrāṇāṃ sparśanam, ekakhaṭvāsanam ity etat sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ manvādibhiḥ smṛtam || 8.357 ||
striyaṃ spṛśed adeśe yaḥ spṛṣṭo vā marṣayet tayā |
parasparasyānumate sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ smṛtam || 8.358 ||
striyam iti | yaḥ spraṣṭum anucite stanajaghanādideśe striyaṃ spṛśet tayā vā vṛṣaṇādike spṛṣṭaḥ kṣamate, tadānyonyāṅgīkaraṇe sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ manvādibhiḥ smṛtam || 8.358 ||
abrāhmaṇaḥ saṃgrahaṇe prāṇāntaṃ daṇḍam arhati |
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ dārā rakṣyatamāḥ sadā || 8.359 ||
abrāhmaṇa iti | abrāhmaṇo ‘tra śūdraḥ,daṇḍabhūyastvāt | brāhmaṇyām anicchantyām uttame saṃgrahaṇe prāṇāntaṃ daṇḍaṃ prāpnoti | caturṇām api brāhmaṇādīnāṃ varṇānāṃ dhanaputrādīnām atiśayena dārā sarvadā rakṣaṇīyā || 8.359 ||
bhikṣukā bandhinaś caiva dīkṣitāḥ kāravas tathā |
saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ saha strībhiḥ kuryur aprativāritāḥ || 8.360 ||
