bhikṣukā iti | bhikṣājīvinaḥ, stutipāṭhakāḥ, yajñārthaṃ kṛtadīkṣakāḥ, sūpakārādayaḥ bhikṣādisvakāryārthaṃ gṛhistrībhiḥ saha saṃbhāṣaṇam anivāritaḥ kuryuḥ | evaṃ caiṣāṃ saṃgrahaṇābhāvaḥ || 8.360 ||
na saṃbhāṣāṃ parastrībhiḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ samācaret |
niṣiddho bhāṣamāṇas tu suvarṇaṃ daṇḍam arhati || 8.361 ||
na saṃbhāṣām iti | svāminā niṣiddhaḥ strībhiḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ na kuryāt | pratiṣiddhaḥ saṃbhāṣaṇam ācaran rājñaḥ ṣoḍaśamāṣātmakasuvarṇadānayogyo bhavati || 8.361 ||
naiṣa cāraṇadāreṣu vidhir nātmopajīviṣu |
sajjayanti hi te nārīr nigūḍhāś cārayanti ca || 8.362 ||
naiṣa iti | “parastriyaṃ yo ‘bhivadet” (8.356) ityādisaṃbhāṣaṇaniṣedhavidhir naṭagāyanādidāreṣu nāśti | tathā “bhāryā putraḥ svakā tanuḥ” (4.18) ity uktatvād bhāryevātmānayopajīvanti dhanalābhāya tasyā jāraṃ kṣamante ye, teṣu naṭādivyatirikteṣv api dārās teṣv apy evaṃ niṣedhavidhir nāsti | yasmāc cāraṇā ātmopajīvinaś ca parapuruṣān ānīya taiḥ svabhāryāṃ saṃśleṣayante | svayam āgatāṃś ca parapuruṣān pracchannā bhūtvā svājñānaṃ vibhāvayanto vyavahārayanti || 8.362 ||
kiṃcid eva tu dāpyaḥ syāt saṃbhāṣāṃ tābhir ācaran |
praiṣyāsu caikabhaktāsu rahaḥpravratijāsu ca || 8.363 ||
kiṃcid iti | nirjanadeśe cāraṇātmopajīvibhiḥ strībhiḥ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kurvan svalpadaṇḍaleśaṃ rājā dāpyaḥ tāsām api paradāratvāt | tathā dāsībhir avaruddhābhir bauddhābhir brahmacāriṇībhiḥ saṃbhāṣāṃ kurvan kiṃcid daṇḍamātraṃ dāpyaḥ syāt || 8.363 ||
yo ‘kāmāṃ dūṣayet kanyāṃ sa sadyo vadham arhati |
sakāmāṃ dūṣayaṃs tulyo na vadhaṃ prāpnuyāt naraḥ || 8.364 ||
yo ‘kāmam iti | yas tulyajātir anicchantīṃ kanyāṃ gacchati sa tatkṣaṇād eva brāhmaṇetaro liṅgacchedanādikaṃ vadham arhati | icchantīṃ punar gacchan vadhārho manuṣyo na bhavati
|| 8.364 ||
kanyāṃ bhajantīm utkṛṣṭaṃ na kiṃcid api dāpayet |
jaghanyaṃ sevamānāṃ tu saṃyatāṃ vāsayed gṛhe || 8.365 ||
kanyām iti | kanyāṃ saṃbhogārtham utkṛṣṭajātipuruṣaṃ sevamānāṃ svalpam api daṇḍaṃ na dāpayet | hīnajātiṃ punaḥ sevamānāṃ yatnāt sthāpayet | yathā vā nivṛttakāmā syāt || 8.365 ||
uttamāṃ sevamānas tu jaghanyo vadham arhati |
śulkaṃ dadyāt sevamānaḥ samām icchet pitā yadi || 8.366 ||
uttamām iti | hīnajātir utkṛṣṭām icchantīm anicchantīṃ vā gacchaty apekṣayāṅgacchedana-māraṇātmakaṃ vadham arhati | samānajātīyāṃ punar icchantīṃ gacchan yadi pitā manyate tadā pituḥ śulkānurūpam arthaṃ vā dadyān na ca daṇḍyaḥ | sā ca kanyā tenaiva voḍhavyā
|| 8.366 ||
abhiṣahya tu yaḥ kanyāṃ kuryād darpeṇa mānavaḥ |
tasyāśu kartye aṅgulyau daṇḍaṃ cārhati ṣaṭśatam || 8.367 ||
abhisahyeti | yo manuṣyaḥ prasahya balātkāreṇa samānajātīyāṃ gamanavarjam ahaṃkāreṇāṅguliprakṣepamātreṇaiva nāśayet tasya śīghram evāṅgulidvayacchedaḥ kartavyaḥ | ṣaṭpaṇaśatāni cāyaṃ daṇḍyaḥ || 8.367 ||
sakāmāṃ dūṣayaṃs tulyo nāṅgulicchedam āpnuyāt |
dviśataṃ tu damaṃ dāpyaḥ prasaṅgavinivṛttaye || 8.368 ||
sakāmām iti | samānajātir icchantīṃ kanyām aṅguliprakṣepamātreṇa nāśayan nāṅgulicchedam āpnoti | kiṃ tv atiprasaktinivāraṇāya dviśataṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyaḥ || 8.368 ||
kanyaiva kanyāṃ yā kuryāt tasyāḥ syād dviśato damaḥ |
śulkaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ dadyāc chiphāś caivāpnuyād daśa || 8.369 ||
kanyaiveti | yā kanyaiva parām aṅguliprakṣepeṇa nāśayet tasyāḥ dviśato daṇḍaḥ syāt | kanyāśulkaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ kanyāpitur dadyāc chiphāprahārāṃś ca daśa prāpnuyāt || 8.369 ||
yā tu kanyāṃ prakuryāt strī sā sadyo mauṇḍyam arhati |
aṅgulyor eva vā chedaṃ khareṇodvahanaṃ tathā || 8.370 ||
yā tv iti | yā punaḥ kanyām aṅguliprakṣepeṇa strī nāśayet sā tatkṣaṇād eva śiromuṇḍanam, anubandhāpekṣayāṅgulyor eva chedanaṃ, gardabhena ca rājamārge vahanam arhati || 8.370 ||
bhartāraṃ laṅghayed yā tu strī jñātiguṇadarpitā |
tāṃ śvabhiḥ khādayed rājā saṃsthāne bahusaṃsthite || 8.371 ||
bhartāram iti | yā strī prabaladhanikapitrādibāndhavadarpeṇa saundaryādiguṇadarpeṇa ca patiṃ puruṣāntaropagamanāl laṅghayet tāṃ rājā bahujanākīrṇe deśe śvabhir bhakṣayet
|| 8.371 ||
pumāṃsaṃ dāhayet pāpaṃ śayane tapta āyase |
abhyādadhyuś ca kāṣṭhāni tatra dahyeta pāpakṛt || 8.372 ||
pumāṃsam iti | anantaroktaṃ jāraṃ pāpakāriṇaṃ puruṣam ayomayaśayane prajvalite rājā dāhayet | tatra śayane vadhyaghātinaḥ kāṣṭhāni nikṣipeyur yāvat pāpakārī dagdhaḥ syāt
|| 8.372 ||
saṃvatsarābhiśastasya duṣṭasya dviguṇo damaḥ |
vrātyayā saha saṃvāse cāṇḍālyā tāvad eva tu || 8.373 ||
saṃvatsareti | parastrīgamanena duṣtasya puṃso ‘daṇḍitasya ca saṃvatsarātikrameṇābhiśastasya pūrvadaṇḍād dviguṇo damaḥ kāryaḥ | tathā vrātyajāyāgamane yo daṇḍaḥ parikalpitaḥ cāṇḍālyā saha nirdeśāc cāṇḍālīgamanarūpaḥ, tathā cāṇḍālīgamane yo daṇḍaḥ “sahasraṃ tv antyajastriyam” (8.385) iti | saṃvatsare tv atīte yadi tām eva vrātyajāyāṃ tām eva cāṇḍālīṃ punar gacchati tadā dviguṇaḥ kartavyaḥ | etat pūrvasyaivodāharaṇadvayaṃ vrātyajāyāgamane ‘pi cāṇḍālīgamanadaṇḍapradarśanārtha, sarvasyaiva tu pūrvābhiśastadaṇḍitasya saṃvatsarātikrame punas tām eva gacchataḥ pūrvād dvuguṇo daṇḍo boddhavyaḥ || 8.373 ||
śūdro guptam aguptaṃ vā dvaijātaṃ varṇam āvasan |
aguptam aṅgasarvasvair guptaṃ sarveṇa hīyate || 8.374 ||
śūdra iti | bhartrādibhī rakṣitām arakṣitāṃ vā dvijātistriyaṃ yadi śūdro gacchet tadārakṣitāṃ rakṣārahitāṃ gacchaṃl liṅgasarvasvābhyāṃ viyojanīyaḥ | atrāṅgaviśeṣāśravaṇe ‘py āryastryabhigamane liṅgoddhāraḥ | “sarvasvaharaṇaṃ gupāṃ ced vadho ‘dhikaḥ” (GDh 12.2–3) iti gautamavacanāl liṅgacchedaḥ | rakṣitāṃ tu gacchañ charīradhanahīnaḥ kartavyaḥ || 8.374 ||
vaiśyaḥ sarvasvadaṇḍaḥ syāt saṃvatsaranirodhataḥ |
sahasraṃ kṣatriyo daṇḍyo mauṇḍyaṃ mūtreṇa cārhati || 8.375 ||
vaiśya iti | vaiśyasya guptabrāhmaṇīgamane saṃvatsarabandhād anantaraṃ sarvasvagrahaṇarūpo daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ | kṣatriyāgamane tu “vaiśyaś cet kṣatriyām” (8.382) iti vakṣyati | kṣatriyo guptabrāhmaṇīgamane sahasraṃ daṇḍanīyaḥ | kharamūtreṇa cāsya muṇḍanaṃ kartavyam
|| 8.375 ||
brāhmaṇīṃ yady aguptāṃ tu gacchetāṃ vaiśyapārthivau |
vaiśyaṃ pañcaśataṃ kuryāt kṣatriyaṃ tu sahasriṇam || 8.376 ||
brāhmaṇīm iti | arakṣiāṃ tu brāhmaṇīṃ yadi vaiśyakṣatriyau gacchatas tadā vaiśyaṃ pañcaśatadaṇḍayuktaṃ kuryāt | kṣatriyaṃ punaḥ sahasradaṇḍopetam | vaiśye cāyaṃ pañcaśatadaṇḍaḥ śūdrābhramādinā nirguṇajātimātropajīvibrāḥmaṇīgamanaviṣayaḥ | taditarabrāhmaṇīgamane vaiśyasyāpi sahasraṃ daṇda eva || 8.376 || ||
ubhāv api tu tāv eva brāhmaṇyā guptayā saha |
viplutau śūdravad daṇḍyau dagdhavyau vā kaṭāgninā || 8.377 ||
ubhāv iti | tāv evobhāv api kṣatriyavaiśyau brāhmaṇyā rakṣitayā saha kṛtamaithunau śūdravat sarveṇa hīyete iti daṇḍyau | yad vā kaṭenāveṣṭya dagdhavyau | tatra “vaiśyaṃ lohitadarbhaiḥ kṣatriyaṃ śarapatrair vāveṣṭya” (VaDh 21.2) iti vasiṣṭhoko viśeṣo grāhyaḥ | pūrvaṃ “sahasraṃ kṣatriyo daṇḍyaḥ” (8.375), “vaiśyaḥ sarvasvam” (8.375) ity uktatvād ayaṃ prāṇāntikadaṇdo guṇavadbrāhmaṇīgamanaviṣayo boddhavyaḥ || 8.377 ||
sahasraṃ brāhmaṇo daṇḍyo guptāṃ viprāṃ balād vrajan |
śatāni pañca daṇḍyaḥ syāḍ icchantyā saha saṃgataḥ || 8.378 ||
sahasram iti | rakṣitāṃ viprāṃ brāhmaṇo balenopagacchan sahasraṃ daṇḍyaḥ syāt | icchantyā punaḥ sakṛn maithune pañca śatāni daṇḍanīyo bhavet || 8.378 ||
mauṇḍyaṃ prāṇāntiko daṇḍo brāḥmaṇasya vidhīyate |
itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ daṇḍaḥ prāṇāntiko bhavet || 8.379 ||
mauṇḍyam iti | brāhmaṇasya vadhadaṇḍasthāne śiromuṇḍanaṃ daṇḍaḥ śāstreṇopadiśyate | kṣatriyādīnāṃ punar uktena ghātena daṇḍo bhavati || 8.379 ||
na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt sarvapāpeṣv api sthitam |
rāṣṭrād enaṃ bahiḥ kuryāt samagradhanam akṣatam || 8.380 ||
na jātv ityādi | brāhmaṇaṃ sarvapāpakāriṇam api kadācin na hanyād api tu sarvasvayuktam akṣataśarīraṃ rāṣṭrān nirvāsayet || 8.380 ||
na brāhmaṇavadhād bhūyān adharmo vidyate bhuvi |
tasmād asya vadhaṃ rājā manasāpi na cintayet || 8.381 ||
neti | brāhmaṇavadhān mahān pṛthivyām adharmo nāsti | tasmād rājā sarvapāpakāriṇo brāhmaṇasya manasāpi vadhaṃ na cintayet || 8.381 ||
vaiśyaś cet kṣatriyāṃ guptāṃ vaiśyāṃ vā kṣatriyo vrajet |
yo brāhmaṇyām aguptāyāṃ tāv ubau daṇḍam arhati || 8.382 ||
vaiśyaś ced iti | rakṣitāṃ kṣatriyāṃ yadi vaiśyo gacchet kṣatriyo vā yadi rakṣitāṃ vaiśyāṃ tadā tayor brāhmaṇyām aguptāyāṃ gamane yau daṇḍāv uktau “vaiśyaṃ pañcaśataṃ kuryāt kṣatriyaṃ tu sahasriṇam” (8.376) iti dvāv eva daṇḍau vaiśyakṣatriyayor bhavataḥ | ayaṃ ca vaiśyasya rakṣitakṣatriyāgamane pañcaśatarūpo daṇḍo laghutvād guṇavadvaiśyasya nirguṇajātimātropajīvikṣatriyāyāḥ śūdrābhrāntyādigamanaviṣayo boddhavyaḥ | kṣatriyasya rakṣitaviśyāyāṃ jñānato yuktaḥ sahasraṃ daṇḍaḥ || 8.382 ||
sahasraṃ brāhmaṇo daṇḍaṃ dāpyo gupte tu te vrajan |
śūdrāyāṃ kṣatriyaviśoḥ sāhasro vai bhaved damaḥ || 8.383 ||
sahasram ityādi | kṣatriyāvaiśye rakṣite brāhmaṇo vrajan sahasraṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpanīyaḥ | śūdrāyāṃ rakṣitāyāṃ kṣatriyavaiśyayor gamane sahasram eva daṇḍaḥ syāt || 8.383 ||
kṣatriyāyām guptāyāṃ vaiśye pañcaśataṃ damaḥ |
mūtreṇa mauṇḍyam ṛcchet tu kṣatriyo daṇḍam eva vā || 8.384 ||
kṣatriyāyām iti | arakṣitakṣatriyāgamane vaiśyasya pañcaśatāni daṇḍaḥ syāt | kṣatriyasya tv arakṣitāgamane gardabhamūtreṇa muṇḍanaṃ pañcaśatarūpaṃ vā daṇḍam āpnuyāt || 8.384 ||
agupte kṣatriyāvaiśye śūdrāṃ vā brāhmaṇo vrajan |
śatāni pañca daṇḍyaḥ syāt sahasraṃ tv antyajastriyam || 8.385 ||
agupte iti | arakṣitāṃ kṣatriyāṃ vaiśyāṃ śūdrāṃ vā brāhmaṇo gacchan pañcaśatāni daṇḍyaḥ syāt | ante bhave ‘ntyajaḥ, yasmād adhamo nāsti cāṇḍālādis tasya striyaṃ gacchan sahasraṃ daṇḍyaḥ || 8.385 ||
yasya stenaḥ pure nāsti nānyastrīgo na duṣtavāk |
na sāhasikadaṇḍaghnau sa rājā śakralokabhāk || 8.386 ||
yasyeti | yasya rājño cauraḥ, paradāragāmī, paruṣavādī, gṛhadāhādisāhasakārī, daṇḍapāruṣyakartā ca nāsti sa rājā śakrapuraṃ yāti || 8.386 ||
eteṣāṃ nigraho rājñaḥ pañcānāṃ viṣaye svake |
sāmrājyakṛt sajātyeṣu loke caiva yaśaskaraḥ || 8.387 ||
eteṣām iti | eteṣāṃ stenādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ svarāṣṭre nigrahaḥ samānajātīyeṣu rājasu madhye rājā sāmrājyakṛd iha loke ca yaśaskaro bhavati || 8.387 ||
ṛtvijaṃ yas tyajed yājyo yājyaṃ cartvik tyajed yadi |
śaktaṃ karmaṇy aduṣṭaṃ ca tayor daṇḍaḥ śataṃ śatam || 8.388 ||
ṛtvijam iti | yo yājyaḥ ṛtvijaṃ karmānuṣṭhānasamartham atipātakādidoṣarahitam ṛtvig vā yājyam aduṣṭaṃ tyajati tayoḥ śataṃ śataṃ daṇḍaḥ kārya iti daṇḍaprasaṅgād idam uktam
|| 8.388 ||
na mātā na pitā na strī na putras tyāgam arhati |
tyajann apatitān etān rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ || 8.389 ||
na māteti | mātṛpitṛbhāryāputrās tyāgam apoṣaṇaśuśrūṣādyakaraṇātmakaṃ nārhanti | tasmād etān pātakādirahitān parityajann ekaikaparityāge rājñā ṣaṭ śatāni daṇḍyaḥ || 8.389 ||
āśrameṣu dvijātīnāṃ kārye vivadatāṃ mithaḥ |
na vibrūyān nṛpo dharmaṃ cikīrṣaṇ hitam ātmanaḥ || 8.390 ||
āśrameṣv iti | dvijātīnāṃ gārhasthyādyāśramaviṣaye kārye ‘yaṃ śāstrārtho nāyaṃ śāstrārtha iti parasparaṃ jātavivādānāṃ rājā svīyahitaṃ cikīrṣur ayaṃ śāstrārtha iti sadṛśān viśeṣeṇa na brūyāt
|| 8.390 ||
yathārham etān abhyarcya brāhmaṇaiḥ saha pārthivaḥ |
sāntvena praśamayyādau svadharmaṃ pratipādayet || 8.391 ||
yathārham iti | yo yādṛśīṃ pūjām arhati taṃ tathā pūjayitvā anyair brāhmaṇaiḥ saha prathamaṃ prītyā apagatakopaṃ kṛtvā tata eṣāṃ yaḥ svadharmas taṃ bodhayet || 8.391 ||
prātiveśyānuveśyau ca kalyāṇe viṃśatidvije |
arhāv abhojayan vipro daṇḍam arhati māṣakam || 8.392 ||
prātiveśyeti | nirantaragṛhavāsī prātiveśyaḥ, tadantaragṛhavāsy anuveśyaḥ, yasminn utsave viṃśatir anye brāhmaṇā bhojyante tatra prātiveśyānuveśyau “prātiveśyabrāhmaṇātikramakārī ca” iti viṣṇuvacanād brāhmaṇau bhojanārhāv abhojayan brāḥmaṇa uttaratra hairaṇyādigrahaṇād iha raupyamāṣaṃ daṇḍam arhati || 8.392 ||
śrotriyaḥ śrotriyaṃ sādhuṃ bhūtikṛtyeṣv abhojayan |
tad annaṃ dviguṇaṃ dāpyo hiraṇyaṃ caiva māṣakam || 8.393 ||
śrotriya iti | vidyācāravāṃs tathāvidham eva guṇavantaṃ vibhavakāryeṣu vivāhādiṣu prakṛtatvāt prātiveśyānuveśyāv abhojayan tad annaṃ bhojitād dviguṇam annaṃ dāpyo hiraṇyamāṣakaṃ ca rājñā || 8.393 ||
andho jaḍaḥ pīṭhasarpī saptatyā sthaviraś ca yaḥ |
śrotriyeṣūpakurvaṃś ca na dāpyāḥ kenacit karam || 8.394 ||
andha iti | andho badhiraḥ | paṅguḥ saṃpūrṇasaptativarṣaḥ | saptatyeti “prakṛtyādibhya upasaṃkhyānam” (Vārt. 24 66) iti tṛtīyā | śrotriyeṣu dhanadhānyaśuśrūṣādinopakārakāḥ kenacid api kṣīṇakośenāpi rājñā tv anugrāhyāḥ karaṃ na dāpanīyāḥ || 8.394 ||
śrotriyaṃ vyādhitārtau ca bālabṛddhāv akiṃcanam |
mahākulīnam āryaṃ ca rājā saṃpūjayet sadā || 8.395 ||
śrotriyam iti | vidyācāravantaṃ brāḥmaṇaṃ rogiṇaṃ putraviyogādiduḥkhitaṃ bālavṛddhadaridramahākulaprasūtodāracaritān rājā dānamānahitakaraṇaiḥ saṃpūjayet sadā
|| 8.395 ||
śālmalīphalake ślakṣṇe nenijyān nejakaḥ śanaiḥ |
na ca vāsāṃsi vāsobhir nirharen na ca vāsayet || 8.396 ||
śālmalīti | śālmalyādivṛkṣasaṃbandhiphalake ‘paruṣe rajakaḥ śanaiḥ śanair vāsāṃsi prakṣālayen na parakīyair vastrair anyavastrāṇi nayen na cānyavāsāṃsy anyaparidhānārthaṃ dadyāt | yady evaṃ kuryāt tadāsau daṇḍyaḥ syāt || 8.396 ||
tantuvāyo daśapalaṃ dadyād ekapalādhikam |
ato ‘nyathā vartamāno dāpyo dvādaśakaṃ damam || 8.397 ||
tantuvāya iti | tantuvāyo vastranirmāṇārthaṃ daśa palāni sūtraṃ gṛhītvā piṣṭabhakṣyādyanupraveśād ekādaśapalaṃ vastraṃ dadyāt | yadi tato nyūnaṃ dadyāt tadā dvādaśa paṇān rājñā dāpyaḥ, svāminaś ca tuṣṭiḥ kartavyaiva || 8.397 ||
śulkasthāneṣu kuśalāḥ sarvapaṇyavicakṣaṇāḥ |
kuryur arghaṃ yathāpalyaṃ viṃśaṃ nṛpo haret || 8.398 ||
śukleti | sthalajalapathavyavahārato rājagrāhyo bhāgaḥ śulkam | tasyāvasthāneṣu ye kuśalās tathā sarvapaṇyānāṃ sārāsārajñās te paṇyeṣu yam arghaṃ mūlyam anurūpaṃ kuryus tato lābhadhanād viṃśatibhāgaṃ rājā gṛhṇīyāt || 8.398 ||
rājñaḥ prakhyātabhāṇḍāni pratiṣiddhāni yāni ca |
tāni nirharato lobhāt sarvahāraṃ haren nṛpaḥ || 8.399 ||
rājña iti | rājñaḥ saṃbandhitayā yāni vikreyadravyāṇi prakhyātāni rājopayogīni hastyaśvādīni ca taddeśodbhavāni ca pratiṣiddhāni ca | yathā ‘durbhikṣe dhānyaṃ deśāntaraṃ na neyam’ iti tāni lobhād deśāntaraṃ nayato vaṇijaḥ sarvaharaṇaṃ rājā kuryāt || 8.399 ||
śulkasthānaṃ pariharann akāle krayavikrayī |
mithyāvādi ca saṃkhyāne dāpyo ‘ṣṭaguṇam atyayam || 8.400 ||
śulkasthānam iti | yaḥ śulkamoṣaṇāyotpathena gacchati | akāle rātryādau vā krayavikrayaṃ karoti | śulkakhaṇḍanārthaṃ vikreyadravyasyālpāṃ saṃkhyāṃ vakti | sa rājadeyam apalapitam aṣṭaguṇaṃ daṇḍarūpatayā dāpyaḥ || 8.400 ||
āgamaṃ nirgamaṃ sthānaṃ tathā vṛddhikṣayāv ubhau |
vicārya sarvapaṇyānāṃ kārayet krayavikrayau || 8.401 ||
āgamam iti | kiyato dūrād āgatam iti deśāntarīyadravyasyāgamanaṃ, kiyaddūraṃ nīyata iti svadeśodbhavasya nirgamaṃ, kiyatkālasthitaṃ kiyanmūlyaṃ labhata it sthitaṃ, tathā kiyatī vṛddhir ity atra karmakārāṇāṃ bhaktācchādanādinā kiyān apakṣaya ity evaṃ vicāryaṃ, tathā vaṇijāṃ kretṝṇāṃ yathā pīḍā na bhavati tathā sarvapaṇyānāṃ krayavikrayau kārayet || 8.401 ||
pañcarātre pañcarātre pakṣe pakṣe ‘tha vā gate |
kurvīta caiṣāṃ pratyakṣam arthasaṃsthāpanaṃ nṛpaḥ || 8.402 ||
pañcarātra iti | āgamanirgamopāyayogādeḥ paṇyānām aniyatatvād asthirārghādīnāṃ pañcarātre pañcarātre gate sthiraprāyārghāṇāṃ pakṣe pakṣe gate vaṇijām arghavidāṃ pratyakṣaṃ nṛpatir āptapuruṣair vyavasthāṃ kuryāt || 8.402 ||
tulāmānaṃ pratīmānaṃ sarvaṃ ca syāt sulakṣitam |
ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu ca māseṣu punar eva parīkṣayet || 8.403 ||
tuleti | tulānāṃ suvarṇādīnāṃ paricchedārthaṃ yat kriyate pratimānaṃ prasthadroṇādi tat sarvaṃ svanirūpitaṃ yathā syāt, ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu māseṣu gateṣu punas tat sarvaṃ sabhyapuruṣair nṛpatiḥ prīkṣayet || 8.403 ||
paṇaṃ yānaṃ tare dāpyaṃ pauruṣe ‘rdhapaṇaṃ tare |
pādaṃ paśuś ca yoṣic ca pādārdhaṃ riktakaḥ pumān || 8.404 ||
paṇam iti | “bhāṇḍapūrṇāni yānāni” (8.405) iti vakṣyati | tena riktaśakaṭādi yānaṃ taraviṣaye paṇaṃ dāpyam | evaṃ puruṣabhāro ‘rdhapaṇaṃ tarapaṇyaṃ dāpyaḥ | paśuś ca gavādiḥ paṇacaturthabhāgaṃ, bhārarahito manuṣyaḥ paṇāṣṭabhāgaṃ dāpanīyaḥ || 8.404 ||
bhāṇḍapūrṇāni yānāni tāryaṃ dāpyāni bhārataḥ |
riktabhāṇḍāni yat kiṃcit pumāṃsaś cāparicchadāḥ || 8.405 ||
bhāṇḍeti | paṇyadravyapūrṇāni śakaṭādīni dravyagatotkarṣāpekṣayā taraṃ dāpyāni | dravyahitāni ca goṇīkambalādīni yat kiṃcit svalpaṃ tāryaṃ dāpyāni | aparicchadā daridrāḥ uktapadārthadānāpekṣayā yat kiṃcid dāpanīyāḥ || 8.405 ||
dīrghādhvani yathādeśaṃ yathākālaṃ taro bhavet |
nadītīreṣu tad vidyāt samudre nāsti lakṣaṇam || 8.406 ||
dīrgheti | pūrvaṃ pārāvāre taraṇārtham uktam | idānīṃ nadīmārge dūrādhvani gantavye prabalavegasthirodakanadyādideśagrīṣmavarṣādikālāpekṣayā taramūlyaṃ kalpanīyam | etac ca nadītīre boddhavyam | samudre tu vātādhīnapotagamanatvāt svāyattatvābhāve tarapaṇyaviśeṣajñāpakaṃ nadīvad dviyojanādikaṃ nāsti | tatas tatrocitam eva tarapaṇyaṃ grāhyam || 8.406 ||
garbhiṇī tu dvimāsādis tathā pravrajito muniḥ |
brāhmaṇā liṅginaś caiva na dāpyās tārikaṃ tare || 8.407 ||
garbhiṇīti | saṃjātagarbhā strī māsadvayād ūrdhvaṃ, tathā pravrajito bhikṣuḥ, munir vānaprasthaḥ, brāhmaṇāś ca, liṅgino brahmacāriṇaḥ taramūlyaṃ tare na dāpyāḥ || 8.407 ||
yan nāvi kiṃcid dāśānāṃ viśīryetāparādhataḥ |
tad dāśair eva dātavyaṃ samāgamya svato ‘ṃśataḥ || 8.408 ||
yan nāvīti | naukārūḍhānāṃ yat kiṃcin nāvikāparādhena naṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ tan nāvikair eva militvā yathābhāgaṃ dātavyam || 8.408 ||
eṣa nauyāyinām ukto vyavahārasya nirṇayaḥ |
dāśāparādhatas toye daivike nāsti vigrahaḥ || 8.409 ||
eṣa iti | nāvikāparādhād yad udake naṣṭaṃ tan nāvikair eva dātavyam | pūrvoktam anūditaṃ ‘daivike nāsti vigrahaḥ’ iti vidhātuṃ nauyāyinām eva vyavahārasya nirṇaya uktaḥ | daivopajātavātādinā naubhaṅgena dhanādivināśe nāvikānāṃ na daṇḍaḥ || 8.409 ||
vāṇijyaṃ kārayed vaiśyaṃ kusīdaṃ kṛṣim eva ca |
paśūnāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caiva dāsyaṃ śūdraṃ dvijanmanām || 8.410 ||
vāṇijyam iti | vāṇijyaṃ kusīdakṛṣipaśurakṣaṇāni vaiśyaṃ kārayet | śūdraṃ ca rājā dvijātīnāṃ dāsyaṃ kārayet | akurvāṇau vaiśyaśūdrau rājño daṇḍyāv ity evamartho ‘yam ihopadeśaḥ
|| 8.410 ||
kṣatriyaṃ caiva vaiśyaṃ ca brāhmaṇo vṛttikarśitau |
bibhṛyād ānṛśaṃsyena svāni karmāṇi kārayan || 8.411 ||
kṣatriyam iti | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyavaiśyau bhṛtyabhāvena pīḍitau karuṇayā svāni karmāṇi rakṅṣaṇakṛṣyādīni kārayan grāsācchādanādinā poṣayet | evaṃ dhanavān brāhmanas tāv upagatāv abibhran rājñā daṇḍanīya iti prakaraṇasāmarthād gamyate || 8.411 ||
dāsyaṃ tu kārayaṃl lobhād brāhmaṇaḥ saṃskṛtān dvijān |
anicchataḥ prābhavatyād rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ || 8.412 ||
dāsyaṃ tv iti | prabhavato bhāvaḥ prābhavatyaṃ | brāhmaṇaḥ kṛtopanayanān dvijātīn anicchataḥ prabhutvena lobhād dāsyakarma pādadhāvanādi kārayan ṣaṭ śatāni daṇḍyaḥ
|| 8.412 ||
śūdraṃ tu kārayed dāsyaṃ krītam akrītam eva vā |
dāsyāyaiva hi sṛṣṭo ‘sau brāhmaṇasya svayaṃbhuvā || 8.413 ||
śūdraṃ tv iti | śūdraṃ punar bhaktādibhṛtam abhṛtaṃ vā dāsyaṃ kārayet | tasmād asau brāhmaṇasya dāsyāyaiva prajāpatinā sṛṣṭaḥ || 8.413 ||
na svāminā nisṛṣṭo ‘pi śūdro dāsyād vimucyate |
nisargajaṃ hi tat tasya kas tasmāt tad apohati || 8.414 ||
na svāmineti | yasmād asau dhvajāhṛtatvādinā dāsatvaṃ gataḥ sa tena tyaktasvadāsyābhāve ‘pi śūdro brāhmaṇasya dāsyān na vimucyate | tasmād dāsyaṃ śūdrasya sahajam | kaḥ śūdratvajātim iva dāsyam apanayati | adṛṣṭārtham apy avaśyaṃ śūdreṇa brāhmaṇādidvijaśuśrūṣā kartavyety evaṃparam etat | anyathā vakṣyamāṇadāsyakaraṇaparigaṇanam anarthakaṃ syāt
|| 8.414 ||
dhvajāhṛto bhaktadāso gṛhajaḥ krītadattrimau |
paitriko daṇḍadāsaś ca saptaite dāsayonayaḥ || 8.415 ||
dhvajeti | saṃgrāme svāmisakāśāj jitaḥ, bhaktalobhābhyupagatadāsyo bhaktadāsaḥ, tathā dāsīputraḥ, mūlyena krītaḥ, anyena dattaḥ, pitrādikramāgataḥ, daṇḍādidhanaśuddhyarthaṃ svīkṛtadāsyabhāvaḥ, ity etāni sapta dhvajāhṛtatvādīni dāsatvakāraṇāni || 8.415 ||
bhāryā putraś ca dāsaś ca traya evādhanāḥ smṛtāḥ |
yat te samadhigacchanti yasya te tasya tad dhanam || 8.416 ||
bhāryeti | putrabhāryādāsās trayo ‘mī nirdhanā eva manvādibhiḥ smṛtāḥ | yasmād yad dhanaṃ te ‘rjayanti yasya te bhāryādayas tasya tad dhanaṃ bhavati | etac ca bhāryādīnāṃ pāratantryapradarśanārthaparam | adhyagnyādeḥ ṣaḍvidhasya strīdhanasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt, dhanasādhyadṛṣṭārthakarmopadeśārthaṃ ca bhāryādīnāṃ patnyadhikaraṇe patnyarthe ‘pi yāgādhikārasyoktatvāt, strīpuṃsayor madhye ekadhane cānumatidvāreṇa striyā api kartṛtvāt
|| 8.416 ||
visrabdhaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śūdrād dravyopādānam ācaret |
na ti tasyāsti kiṃcit svaṃ bhartṛhāryadhano hi saḥ || 8.417 ||
visrabdham iti | nirvicikitsam eva prakṛtād dāsaśūdrād dhanagrahaṇaṃ kuryād brāhmaṇaḥ | yatas tasya kiṃcid api svaṃ nāsti | yasmād bhartṛgrāhyadhano ‘sau | evaṃ cāpadi balād api dāsād brāhmaṇo dhanaṃ gṛhṇan na rājñā daṇḍanīya ity evamartham etad ucyate || 8.417 ||
vaiśyaśūdrau prayatnena svāni karmāṇi kārayet |
tau hi cyutau svakarmabhyaḥ kṣobhayetām idaṃ jagat || 8.418 ||
vaiśyeti | vaiśyaṃ kṛṣyādīni, śūdraṃ ca dvijātiśuśrūṣādīni karmāṇi yatnato rājā kārayet | yasmāt tau svakarmabhyaś cyutāv aśāstrīyopārjitadhanagrahaṇamadādinā jagad ākulīkuryātām
|| 8.418 ||
ahany ahany avekṣeta karmāntān vāhanāni ca |
āyavyayau ca niyatāv ākarān kośam eva ca || 8.419 ||
ahany ahanīti | pratyahaṃ tadadhikṛtadvāreṇa prārabdhadṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthakarmaṇāṃ niṣpattiṃ nṛpatir nirūpayet | tathā hastyaśvādīni kim adya praviṣṭaṃ kim niḥsṛtam iti, suvarṇaratnotpattisthānāni, bhāṇḍāgāraṃ cāvekṣeta | vyavahāradarśanāsakto ‘pi rājā dharmān na parityajed iti darśayitum uktasyāpi punarvacanam || 8.419 ||
evaṃ sarvān imān rājā vyavahārān samāpayan |
vyapohya kilbiṣaṃ sarvaṃ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 8.420 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyām
aṣṭamo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
evam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇaitān sarvān ṛṇādānādīn vyavahārāṃs tattvato nirṇayenāntaṃ nayan pāpaṃ sarvam apahāya svargādiprāptirūpām utkṛṣṭāṃ gatiṃ labhate || 8.420 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamutāvalyāṃ manuvṛttāv
aṣṭamo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
navamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
puruṣasya striyāś caiva dharmye vartmani tiṣṭhatoḥ |
saṃyoge viprayoge ca dharmān vakṣyāmi śāśvatān || 9.1 ||
puruṣasyeti | puruṣasya patnyāś ca dharmāya hi te anyonyāvyabhicārilakṣaṇe vartmani vartamānayoḥ saṃyuktaviyuktayoś ca dharmān pāramparyāgatatvena nityān vakṣyāmi | dampatyoḥ parasparadharmavyatikrame saty anyatarajñāne daṇḍenāpi svadharmavyavasthāpanaṃ rājñā kartavyam iti vyavahāramadhye ‘syopadeśaḥ || 9.1 ||
asvatantrāḥ striyaḥ kāryāḥ puruṣaiḥ svair divāniśam |
viṣayeṣu ca sajjantyaḥ saṃsthāpyā ātmano vaśe || 9.2 ||
asvatantrā iti | svīyair bhartrādibhiḥ sadā striyaḥ svādhīnāḥ kāryāḥ | aniṣiddheṣv api rūparasādiviṣayeṣu prasaktā api ātmavaśāḥ kāryāḥ || 9.2 ||
pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane |
rakṣanti sthavire putrā na strī svātantryam arhati || 9.3 ||
piteti | pitā vivāhāt pūrvaṃ striyaṃ rakṣet | paścād bhartā | tadabhāve putrāḥ | tasmān na strī kasyāṃcid apy avasthāyāṃ svātantryaṃ bhajet | ‘bhartā rakṣati yauvane’ ityādi prāyikam, abhartṛputrāyāḥ saṃnihitāyāḥ pitrādibhir api rakṣaṇāt || 9.3 ||
kāle ‘dātā pitā vācyo vācyaś cānupayan patiḥ |
mṛte bhartari putras tu vācyo mātur arakṣitā || 9.4 ||
kāla iti | pradānakāle pitā tām adadan garhyo bhavati | “pradānaṃ prāg ṛtoḥ” (GDh 18.3) iti gautamavacanād ṛtoḥ prāk pradānakālaḥ | patiś ca ṛtukāle patnīm agacchan garhaṇīyo bhavati | patyau mṛte mātaram arakṣan putro nindyaḥ syāt || 9.4 ||
sūkṣmebhyo ‘pi prasaṅgebhyaḥ striyo rakṣyā viśeṣataḥ |
dvayor hi kulayoḥ śokam āvaheyur arakṣitāḥ || 9.5 ||
sūkṣmebhya iti | svalpebhyo ‘pi duḥsaṅgebhyo dauḥśīlyasaṃpādakebhyo viśeṣeṇa striyo rakṣaṇīyāḥ kiṃ punar mahadbhyaḥ | yasmād upekṣitarakṣaṇād dvayoḥ pitṛbhartṛgaṇayoḥ saṃtāpaṃ dāpayeyuḥ || 9.5 ||
imaṃ hi sarvavarṇānāṃ paśyanto dharmam uttamam |
yatante rakṣituṃ bhāryāṃ bhartāro durbalā api || 9.6 ||
imam iti | sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇādivarṇānāṃ bhāryārakṣaṇalakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ vakṣyamāṇaślokarītyā sarvadharmebhya utkṛṣṭaṃ jānanto ‘ndhapaṅgvādayo ‘pi bhāryāṃ rakṣituṃ yateran || 9.6 ||
svāṃ prasūtiṃ caritraṃ ca kulam ātmānam eva ca |
svaṃ ca dharmaṃ prayatnena jāyāṃ rakṣan hi rakṣati || 9.7 ||
svām iti | yasmād bhāryāṃ rakṣato rakṣaṇam asaṃkīrṇaviśuddhāpatyotpādanena svasaṃtatiṃ tathā śiṣṭasamācāraṃ pitṛpitāmahādyanvayam ātmānaṃ viśuddhasaṃtānanimittaurdhvadehikalābhena svadharmaṃ ca viśuddhabhāryasyādhānādāv apy adhikārād rakṣati | tasmāt striyo rakṣituṃ yateteti pūrvasya viśeṣaḥ || 9.7 ||
patir bhāryāṃ saṃpraviśya garbho bhūtveha jāyate |
jāyāyās tad dhi jāyātvaṃ yad asyāṃ jāyate punaḥ || 9.8 ||
patir iti | patiḥ śukrarūpeṇa bhāryāṃ saṃpraviśya garbham āpādya tasyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ putrarūpeṇa jāyate | tathā ca śrutiḥ – “ātmā vai putranāmāsi” (ĀśGṛ 1.15) iti | jāyāyās tad eva jāyātvaṃ yato ‘syāṃ patiḥ punar jāyate | tathā ca bahvṛcabrāhmaṇam –
patir jāyāṃ praviśati garbho bhūtveha mātaram |
tasyāṃ punar navo bhūtvā daśame māsi jāyate ||
tajjāyā jāyā bhavati yad asyāṃ jāyate punaḥ ||
tataś cāsau rakṣaṇīyety etad arthaṃ nāmanirvacanam || 9.8 ||
yādṛśaṃ bhajate hi strī sutaṃ sūte tathāvidham |
tasmāt prajāviśuddhyarthaṃ striyaṃ rakṣet prayatnataḥ || 9.9 ||
yādṛśam iti | yasmād yādṛśaṃ puruṣaṃ śāstreṇa vihitaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ vā strī bhajate tādṛśaśāstroktapuruṣasevanenotkṛṣṭaṃ niṣiddhapuruṣasevanena ca nikṛṣṭaṃ putraṃ janayati | tasmād apatyaviśuddhyarthaṃ patnīṃ yatnato rakṣet || 9.9 ||
kathaṃ rakṣaṇīyety ata āha –
na kaścid yoṣitaḥ śaktaḥ prasahya parirakṣitum |
etair upāyayogais tu śakyās tāḥ parirakṣitum || 9.10 ||
neti | kaścid balāt saṃrodhādināpi striyo rakṣituṃ na śaktaḥ tatrāpi vyabhicāradarśanāt | kiṃ tv etair vakṣyamāṇai rakṣaṇopāyaprayogais tā rakṣayituṃ śakyāḥ || 9.10 ||
tān upāyān āha –
arthasya saṃgrahe caināṃ vyaye caiva niyojayet |
śauce dharme ‘nnapaktyāṃ ca pāriṇāhyasya vekṣaṇe || 9.11 ||
arthasyeti | dhanasya saṃgrahaṇe viniyoge ca dravyaśarīraśuddhau bhartragniśuśrūṣādike ‘nnasādhane gṛhopakaraṇasya śayyāsanakuṇḍalakaṭāhāder avekṣaṇe enāṃ niyojayet | vekṣaṇe avasya ādilopaḥ || 9.11 ||
arakṣitā gṛhe ruddhāḥ puruṣair āptakāribhiḥ |
ātmānam ātmanā yās tu rakṣeyus tā surakṣitāḥ || 9.12 ||
arakṣitā iti | āptāś ca te ājñākāriṇaś ca taiḥ puruṣair gṛhe ruddhā apy arakṣitā bhavanti yāḥ duḥśīlatayā nātmānaṃ rakṣanti | yās tu dharmajñatayā ātmānam ātmanā rakṣanti tā eva surakṣitā bhavanti | ato dharmādharmaphalasvarganarakaprāptyādyupadeśenāsāṃ saṃyamaḥ kārya iti mukhyarakṣaṇopāyakathanaparam idam || 9.12 ||
pānaṃ durjanasaṃsargaḥ patyā ca viraho ‘ṭanam |
svapno ‘nyagehavāsaś ca nārīsaṃdūṣaṇāni ṣaṭ || 9.13 ||
pānam iti | madyapānaṃ, asatpuruṣasaṃsargaḥ, bhartrā saha virahaḥ, itas tataś ca bhramaṇaṃ, akālasvāpaḥ, paragṛhanivāsaḥ, ity etāni ṣaṭ striyā vyabhicārākhyadoṣajanakāni | tasmād etebhya etā rakṣaṇīyāḥ || 9.13 ||
naitā rūpaṃ parīkṣante nāsāṃ vayasi saṃsthitiḥ |
surūpaṃ vā virūpaṃ vā pumān ity eva bhuñjate || 9.14 ||
naitā iti | naitāḥ kamanīyarūpaṃ vicārayanti | na cāsāṃ yauvanādike vayasyādaro bhavati | kiṃ tu surūpaṃ kurūpaṃ vā pumān ity etāvataiva tam upabhuñjate || 9.14 ||
pauṃścalyāc calacittāc ca naisnehyāc ca svabhāvataḥ |
rakṣitā yatnato ‘pīha bhartṛṣv etā vikurvate || 9.15 ||
pauṃścalyād iti | puṃso darśane saṃbhogādyabhilāṣaśīlatvāt, cittasthairyābhāvāt, svabhāvataḥ sneharahitatvāc ca etā yatnenāpi loke rakṣitāḥ satyo vyabhicārāśrayaṇena bhartṛṣu vikriyāṃ gacchanti || 9.15 ||
evaṃ svabhāvaṃ jñātvāsāṃ prajāpatinisargajam |
paramaṃ yatnam ātiṣṭhet puruṣo rakṣaṇaṃ prati || 9.16 ||
evam iti | evaṃ ślokadvayoktam āsāṃ svabhāvaṃ hiraṇyagarbhasṛṣṭikālajanitaṃ jñātvā rakṣaṇārthaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ yatnaṃ puruṣaḥ kuryāt || 9.16 ||
śayyāsanam alaṃkāraṃ kāmaṃ krodham ārjavam |
drohabhāvaṃ kucaryāṃ ca strībhyo manur akalpayat || 9.17 ||
śayyeti | śayanopaveśanālaṃkaraṇaśīlatvaṃ kāmakrodhānārjavaparahiṃsākutsitācāratvāni sargādau manuḥ strībhyaḥ kalpitavān | tasmād yatnato rakṣaṇīyāḥ || 9.17 ||
nāsti strīṇāṃ kriyā mantrair iti dharme vyavasthitiḥ |
nirindriyā hy amantrāś ca striyo ‘nṛtam iti sthitiḥ || 9.18 ||
nāstīti | jātakarmādikriyā strīṇāṃ mantrair nāstīty eṣā śāstramaryādā vyavasthitā | tataś ca mantravat saṃskāragaṇābhāvān na niṣpāpāntaḥkaraṇāḥ | indriyaṃ pramāṇaṃ, dharmapramāṇaśrutismṛtirahitatvān na dharmajñāḥ | amantrāḥ pāpāpanodanamantrajapahitatvāj jāte ‘pi pāpe tannirṇejanākṣamāḥ | anṛtavad aśubhāḥ striya iti śāstramaryādā | tasmād yatnato rakṣaṇīyā ity atra tātparyam || 9.18 ||
tathā śrutayo bahvyo nigītā nigameṣv api |
svālakṣaṇyaparīkṣārthaṃ tāsāṃ śṛṇuta niṣkṛtīḥ || 9.19 ||
tathā ceti | vyabhicāraśīlatvaṃ strīṇāṃ svabhāva ity uktam | tatra śrutiṃ pramāṇatayopanyasyati | tathā bahvyaḥ śrutayo bahūni śrutivākyāni “na caitad vidmo brāhmaṇāḥ smo abrāhmaṇā vā” ityevamādīni nigameṣu svālakṣaṇyaṃ vyabhicāraśīlatvaṃ tatparijñānārthaṃ paṭhitāni | tāsāṃ śrutīnāṃ madhye yā niṣkṛtirūpā vyabhicāraprāyaścittabhūtās tāḥ śrutīḥ śṛṇuta | ekasyāḥ śruter vakṣyamāṇatvāc chrutiṃ śṛṇutety arthaḥ | “supāṃ supo bhavanti” (Pāṇ 7.1.39) iti dvitīyaikavacane bahuvacanam || 9.19 ||
yan me mātā pralulubhe vicaranty apativratā |
tan me retaḥ pitā vṛṅktām ity asyaitan nidarśanam || 9.20 ||
yad iti | kaścit putro mātur mānasavyabhicāram avagamya brūte | manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ pativyatiriktaṃ puruṣaṃ yā na kāmayate sā pativratā tato ‘nyā apativratā | mama mātā apativratā asatī paragṛhān gacchantī yat pralulubhe parapuruṣaṃ prati saṃjātalobhābhūt tatpuruṣasaṃkalpaduṣṭaṃ mātṛrajorūpaṃ reto mama pitā śodhayatv ity asya striyā vyabhicāraśīlatvasyaitad itikaraṇāntaṃ mantrapādatrayaṃ jñāpakam | ayaṃ ca mantraś cāturmāsyādiṣu viniyuktaḥ || 9.20 ||
saṃprati mānasavyabhicāraprāyaścittarūpatām asya mantrasyāha ¯
dhyāyaty aniṣṭaṃ yat kiṃcit prāṇigrāhasya cetasā |
tasyaiṣa vyabhicārasya nihnavaḥ samyag ucyate || 9.21 ||
dhyāyatīti | bhartur apriyaṃ yat kiṃcit puruṣāntaragamanaṃ strī manasā cintayati tasya mānasasya vyabhicārasyaiṣa prakṛto mantraḥ samyak śodhano manvādibhir ucyate | māteti śravaṇāt putrasyaivāyaṃ prāyaścittarūpo mantro na mātuḥ || 9.21 ||
yādṛgguṇena bhartrā strī saṃyujyeta yathāvidhi |
tādṛgguṇā sā bhavati samudreṇeva nimnagā || 9.22 ||
yādṛgguṇeneti | yathārūpeṇa bhartrā sādhunāsādhunā vā strī vivāhavidhinā saṃyujyate sā bhartṛsadṛśaguṇā bhavati | yathā samudreṇa saṃyujyamānā nadī svādūdakāpi kṣārajalā jāyate | bhartur ātmasaṃmānākhyastrīrakṣaṇopāyāntaropadeśārtham idam || 9.22 ||
atrotkarṣadṛṣṭāntam āha –
akṣamālā vasiṣṭhena saṃyuktādhamayonijā |
śāraṅgī mandapālena jagāmābhyarhaṇīyatām || 9.23 ||
akṣamāleti | akṣamālākhyā nikṛṣṭayonijā vasiṣṭhena pariṇītā, tathā caṭakā mandapālākhyena ṛṣiṇā saṃgatā pūjyatāṃ gatā || 9.23 ||
etāś cānyāś ca loke ‘sminn apakṛṣṭaprasūtayaḥ |
utkarṣaṃ yoṣitaḥ prāptāḥ svaiḥ svair bhartṛguṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 9.24 ||
etā iti | yady api dve prakṛte tathāpi pradarśanārthatvam anayor matvā ‘etāḥ’ iti bahuvacanaṃ kṛtam | etāś cānyāś ca satyavatyādayo nikṛṣṭaprasūtayaḥ svabhartṛguṇaiḥ prakṛṣṭair asmiṃl loke utkṛṣṭatāṃ prāptāḥ || 9.24 ||
eṣoditā lokayātrā nityaṃ strīpuṃsayoḥ śubhā |
pretyeha ca sukhodarkān prajādharmān nibodhata || 9.25 ||
eṣeti | eṣa lokācāro jāyāpativiṣayaḥ sadā śubha uktaḥ | idānīm iha loke paraloke cottarakālaśubhasukhahetūn ‘kiṃ kṣetriṇo ‘patyam uta bījinaḥ’ ityādīn prajādharmān śṛṇuta
|| 9.25 ||
prajārthaṃ mahābhāgāḥ pūjārhā gṛhadīptayaḥ |
striyaḥ śriyaś ca geheṣu na viśeṣo ‘sti kaścana || 9.26 ||
prajārtham iti | yady apy āsāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ doṣā uktās tathāpi śakyapratīkāratvād iha doṣābhāvaḥ | etāḥ striyo mahopakārā garbhotpādanārthaṃ bahukalyāṇabhājanabhūtā vastrālaṃkārādidānena samānārhāḥ svagṛhe śobhākāriṇyaḥ striyaḥ śriyaś ca geheṣu tulyarūpāḥ, nānayor viśeṣo vidyate | yathā niḥśrīkaṃ gṛhaṃ na rājaty evaṃ niḥstrīkam iti || 9.26 ||
api ca –
utpādanam apatyasya jātasya paripālanam |
pratyahaṃ lokayātrāyāḥ pratyakṣaṃ strī nibandhanam || 9.27 ||
utpādanam iti | apatyasya jananaṃ jātasya paripālanaṃ pratidinaṃ cātithimitrabhojanāder lokavyavahārasya pratyakṣaṃ bhāryaiva nidānam || 9.27 ||
apatyaṃ dharmakāryāṇi śuśrūṣā ratir uttamā |
dārādhīnas tathā svargaḥ pitṝṇām ātmanaś ca ha || 9.28 ||
apatyam iti | apatyotpādanam uktam apy etad abhyarhitatvajñāpanārthaṃ punar abhidhānam | dharmakāryāṇy agnihotrādīni, paricaryā, utkṛṣṭā ratiḥ, pitṝṇām ātmanaś cāpatyajananādinā svarga ity etat sarvaṃ bhāryādhīnam || 9.28 ||
patiṃ yā nābhicarati manovāgdehasaṃyatā |
sā bhartṛlokān āpnoti sadbhiḥ sādhvīti cocyate || 9.29 ||
patim iti | yā strī manovāgdehasaṃyatā satīti viśeṣaṇopādānasāmarthyān manovāgdehair eva na vyabhicarati sā bhartrā sahārjitān svargādilokān prāpnoti | iha loke ca viśiṣṭaiḥ sādhvīty ucyate || 9.29 ||
vyabhicārāt tu bhartuḥ strī loke prāpnoti nindyatām |
sṛgālayoniṃ cāpnoti pāparogaiś ca pīḍyate || 9.30 ||
vyabhicārād iti | puruṣāntarasaṃparkāt strī loke nindyatāṃ, janmāntare ca sṛgālajātiṃ prāpnoti | pāparogādibhiś ca pīḍyate | pañcamādhyāye strīdharme uktam apy etac chlokadvayaṃ sadapatyasaṃpattyarthatvena mahāprayojanatayā punaḥ paṭhitam || 9.30 ||
putraṃ praty uditaṃ sadbhiḥ pūrvajaiś ca maharṣibhiḥ |
viśvajanyam imaṃ puṇyam upanyāsaṃ nibodhata || 9.31 ||
putram iti | putram adhikṛtya śiṣṭair manvādibhiḥ pūrvam utpannaiś ca maharṣibhir abhihitam imaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ sarvajanahitaṃ vicāraṃ śṛṇuta || 9.32 ||
bhartuḥ putraṃ vijānanti śrutidvaidhaṃ tu bhartari |
āhur utpādakaṃ kecid apare kṣetriṇaṃ viduḥ || 9.32 ||
bhartur iti | bhartuḥ putro bhavatīti munayo manyante | bhartari dviprakārā śrutir vartate | kecid utpādakam avoḍhāram api bhartāraṃ tena putreṇa putriṇam āhuḥ | anye tu voḍhāraṃ bhartāram anutpādakam apy anyajanitena putreṇa putriṇam āhuḥ || 9.32 ||
kṣetrabhūtā smṛtā nārī bījabhūtaḥ smṛtaḥ pumān |
kṣetrabījasamāyogāt saṃbhavaḥ sarvadehinām || 9.33 ||
kṣetrabhūteti | vrīhyādyutpattisthānaṃ kṣetraṃ tattulyā strī munibhiḥ smṛtā | puruṣaś ca vrīhyādibījatulyaḥ smṛtaḥ | yady api reto bījaṃ tathāpi tadadhikaraṇatvāt puruṣo bījam iti vyapadiśate | kṣetrabījasamāyogāt sarvaprāṇinām utpattiḥ | evaṃ cobhayoḥ kāraṇatvasyāviśiṣṭatvād yuktā vipratipattiḥ – kiṃ yatsaṃbandhi kṣetraṃ tasyāpatyam, uta yadīyaṃ bījaṃ tasya iti || 9.33 ||
viśiṣṭaṃ kutracid bījaṃ strīyonis tv eva kutracit |
ubhayaṃ tu samaṃ yatra sā prasūtiḥ praśasyate || 9.34 ||
viśiṣṭam iti | kvacid bījaṃ ‘jātā ye tv aniyuktāyām’ iti nyāyenotpanno bījino budha iva somasya | tathā vyāsarṣyaśṛṅgādayo bījinām eva matāḥ | kvacit kṣetrasya prādhānyaṃ yathā “yas talpajaḥ pramītasya” (9.167) iti vakṣyati | ata eva vicitravīryakṣetre kṣatriyāyāṃ brāhmaṇotpāditā api. dhṛtarāṣṭrādayaḥ kṣatriyāḥ kṣetriṇa eva putrā babhūvuḥ | yatra punar bījayonyoḥ sāmyaṃ tatra voḍhaiva janayitvā tadapatyaṃ praśastaṃ bhavati tatra bījaprādhānyāpekṣaṃ tāvad āhuḥ
|| 9.34 ||
bījasya caiva yonyāś ca bījam utkṛṣṭam ucyate |
sarvabhūtaprasūtir hi bījalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 9.35 ||
bījasyeti | bījakṣetrayor bījaṃ pradhānam abhidhīyate | yasmāt sarveṣāṃ bhūtārabdhānām utpattir bījagatavarṇasvarūpādicihnair upalakṣiā dṛśyate || 9.36 ||
yādṛśaṃ tūpyate bījaṃ kṣetre kālopapādite |
tādṛg rohati tat tasmin bījaṃ svair vyañjitaṃ guṇaiḥ || 9.36 ||
yādṛśam iti | yajjātīyaṃ bījaṃ vrīhyādi grīṣmādikāle varṣādinā saṃskṛte kṣetre upyate tajjātīyam eva tad bījam ātmīyair varṇādibhir upalakṣitaṃ tasmin kṣetre jāyate || 9.36 ||
evam anvayaprakāreṇa bījaprādhānyaṃ pradarśya vyatirekamukhena darśayitum āha –
iyaṃ bhūmir hi bhūtānāṃ śāśvatī yonir ucyate |
na ca yoniguṇān kāṃścid bījaṃ puṣyati puṣṭiṣu || 9.37 ||
iyam iti | hir avadhāraṇe | iyam eva bhūmir bhūtārabdhānāṃ tarugulmalatādīnāṃ nityā yoniḥ kāraṇaṃ kṣetrātmakaṃ sarvalokair ucyate | na ca bhūmyākhyayonidharmān kāṃścid api mṛtsvarūpatvādīn bījaṃ svavikāreṣv aṅkurakāṇḍādyavasthāsu bhajate | bhajatyarthatvāt puṣyateḥ sakarmatā | tasmād yoniguṇānuvartanābhāvān na kṣetraprādhānyam || 9.37 ||
api ca –
bhūmāv apy ekakedāre kāloptāni kṛṣīvalaiḥ |
nānārūpāṇi jāyante bījānīha svabhāvataḥ || 9.38 ||
bhūmāv iti | bhūmāv ekasminn api kedāre karṣakair vapanakāloptāni vrīhimudgādīni nānārūpāṇy eva bījasvabhāvāj jāyante na tu bhūmer ekatvād ekarūpāṇi bhavanti || 9.38 ||
tathā hi –
vrīhayaḥ śālayo mudgās tilā māṣās tathā yavāḥ |
yathābījaṃ prarohanti laśunānīkṣavas tathā || 9.39 ||
vrīhaya iti | vrīhayaḥ ṣaṣṭikāḥ, śālayaḥ kalamādyāḥ, tathā mudgādayo bījasvabhāvānatikrameṇa nānārūpā jāyante || 9.39 ||
evaṃ ca sati –
anyad uptaṃ jātam anyad ity etan nopapadyate |
upyate yad dhi yad bījaṃ tat tad eva prarohati || 9.40 ||
anyad iti | vrīhir upto mudgādir jāyata ity etan na saṃbhavati | yasmād yad eva bījam upyate tat tad eva jāyate | evaṃ bījaguṇānuvartanāt kṣetradharmānanuvṛtteś ca vrīhyādau manuṣyeṣv api bījaprādhānyam || 9.40 ||
saṃprati kṣetraprādhānyam āha –
tat prājñena vinītena jñānavijñānavedinā |
āyuṣkāmena vaptavyaṃ na jātu parayoṣiti || 9.41 ||
tad iti | tad bījaṃ sahajaprajñāvatā pitrādibhir anuśiṣṭena jñānaṃ vedaḥ, evaṃ vijñānam api tadaṅgādiśāstrāṇi, tadvedināyur icchatā na kadācit parajāyāyāṃ vapanīyam || 9.41 ||
atra gāthā vāyugītāḥ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ |
yathā bījaṃ na vaptavyaṃ puṃsā paraparigrahe || 9.42 ||
atreti | atītakālajñā asminn arthe vāyuproktā gāthāś chandoviśeṣayuktāni vākyāni kathayanti | yathā parapuruṣeṇa parapatnyāṃ bījaṃ na vaptavyam iti || 9.42 ||
naśyatīṣur yathā viddhaḥ khe viddham anuvidhyataḥ |
tathā naśyati vai kṣipraṃ bījaṃ paraparigrahe || 9.43 ||
naśyatīti | yathānyena viddhaṃ mṛgaṃ kṛṣṇasāraṃ tasminn eva chidre paścād anyasya vidhyata āviddhaḥ kṣiptaḥ śaro niṣphalo bhavati pūrvahantraiva hatatvāt tasyaiva tanmṛgalābhāt, evaṃ parapatnyām uptaṃ bījaṃ śīghram eva niṣphalaṃ bhavati, garbhagrahaṇānanaraṃ kṣetriṇaḥ sadyaḥphalalābhāt || 9.43 ||
pṛthor apīmāṃ pṛthivīṃ bhāryāṃ pūrvavido viduḥ |
sthāṇucchedasya kedāram āhuḥ śalyavato mṛgam || 9.44 ||
pṛthor iti | imām api pṛthvīṃ pṛthunā pūrvaṃ parigṛhītatvād anekarājasaṃbandhe ‘pi pṛthor bhāryām ity atītajñā jānanti | tasmāt sthāṇuṃ chindati sthānucchedaḥ | karmaṇy aṇ | yena sthānum utpāṭhya kṣetraṃ kṛtaṃ tasyaiva tat kṣetraṃ vadanti | tathā śarādi śalyaṃ yena pūrvaṃ mṛte kṣiptaṃ tasyaiva taṃ mṛgam āhuḥ | evaṃ ca pūrvaparigrahītuḥ svāmitvād voḍhur evāpatyaṃ bhavati na janayituḥ || 9.44 ||
etāvān eva puruṣo yaj jāyātmā prajeti ha |
viprāḥ prāhus tathā caitad yo bhartā sā smṛtāṅganā || 9.45 ||
etāvān iti | naikaḥ puruṣo bhavati api tu bhāryā svadeham apatyānīty etatparimāṇa eva puruṣaḥ | tathā ca vājasaneyabrāhmaṇam –
ardho ha vā eṣa ātmanas tasmād yaj jāyāṃ na vindate naitāvat prajāyate asarvo hi tāvad bhavati, atha yadaiva jāyāṃ vindate ‘tha prajāyate tarhi sarvo bhavati tathā caitad vedavido viprā vadanti yo bhartā saiva bhāryā smṛta | iti |
evaṃ ca tasyām utpāditaṃ bhartur evāpatyaṃ bhavatīti | yataś ca dampatyor aikyamataḥ || 9.45 ||
na niṣkrayavisargābhyāṃ bhartur bhāryā vimucyate |
evaṃ dharmaṃ vijānīmaḥ prāk prajāpatinirmitam || 9.46 ||
neti | niṣkrayo vikrayaḥ, visargas tyāgaḥ, na tābhyāṃ strī bhartur bhāryātvād apaiti, evaṃ pūrvaṃ prajāpatinā smṛtaṃ nityaṃ karma manyāmahe | evaṃ ca krayādināpi parastriyam ātmasāt kṛtvā tadutpāditāpatyaṃ kṣetriṇa eva bhavati na bījinaḥ || 9.46 ||
sakṛd aṃśo nipatati sakṛt kanyā pradīyate |
sakṛd āha dadānīti trīṇy etāni satāṃ sakṛt || 9.47 ||
sakṛd ityādi | pitrādidhanavibhāgo bhrātṝṇāṃ dharmataḥ kṛtaḥ sakṛd eva bhavati na punar anyathā kriyata iti | tathā kanyā pitrādinā sakṛd ekasmai dattā na punar anyasmai dīyate | evaṃ cānyena pūrvam anyasmai dattāyāṃ paścāt pitrādibhiḥ prāptāyām api janitam apatyaṃ na bījino bhavatīty etadartham asyopanyāsaḥ | tathā kanyāto ‘nyasminn api gavādidravye sakṛd eva dadānīty āha, na punas tad anyasmai dīyata iti trīṇy etāni sādhūnāṃ sakṛd bhavanti | yady api kanyādānasya sakṛtkaraṇaṃ prakṛtopayuktaṃ tathāpi prasaṅgād aṃśadānayor api sakṛttābhidhānam ‘sakṛd āha dadāni’ ity anenaiva kanyādānasyāpi sakṛtkaraṇasiddhau prakṛtopayogitvād eva pṛthag abhidhānam || 9.47 ||
yathā go’śvoṣṭradāsīṣu mahiṣyajāvikāsu ca |
notpādakaḥ prajābhāgī tathaivānyāṅganāsv api || 9.48 ||
yatheti | yathā gavādiṣu parakīyeṣv ātmavṛṣabhādikaṃ viyujya vatsotpādako na tadbhāgī tathā parakīyabhāryāsv api notpādakaḥ prajābhāgī bhavati || 9.48 ||
ye ‘kṣetriṇo bījavantaḥ parakṣetrapravāpiṇaḥ |
te vai sasyasya jātasya na labhante phalaṃ kvacit || 9.49 ||
ya iti | kṣetrasvāmino ye na bhavanti | atha bījasvāminaḥ santaḥ parakṣetre bījaṃ vapanti te tatra kṣetrajātasya dhānyādeḥ phalaṃ kvacid api deśe na labhanta iti prakṛtasya dṛṣṭāntaḥ
|| 9.49 ||
yad anyagoṣu vṛṣabho vatsānāṃ janayec chatam |
gominām eva te vatsā modhaṃ skanditam ārṣabham || 9.50 ||
yad anyeti | yad anyadīyagavīṣu vṛṣabho vatsaśatam api janayet sarve te vatsāḥ strīgavīsvāmino bhavanty eva na vṛṣabhasvāminaḥ | vṛṣabhasya yac chukrasecanaṃ tad vṛṣabhasvāmino niṣphalam eva bhavati | “yathā go’śvoṣṭra-“ (9.48) ity anenotpādakasya prajābhāgitvaṃ na bhavatīty etatparatvena dṛṣṭānta uktaḥ, ayaṃ tu kṣetrasvāminaḥ prajābhāgitvaṃ bhavatīty etatparatvena, ato na punaruktiḥ || 9.50 ||
tathaivākṣetriṇo bījaṃ parakṣetrapravāpinaḥ |
kurvanti kṣetriṇām arthaṃ na bījī labhate phalam || 9.51 ||
tathaiveti | yathā gavādigarbheṣu tathaivāpatyarahitāḥ santaḥ parakīyabhāryāyāṃ ye bījaṃ vapanti te kṣetrasvāminām evāpatyalakṣaṇam arthaṃ kurvanti | bījasektā tv apatyākhyaṃ phalaṃ na labhate || 9.51 ||
phalaṃ tv anabhisaṃdhāya kṣetriṇāṃ bījināṃ tathā |
pratyakṣaṃ kṣetriṇām artho bījād yonir garīyasī || 9.52 ||
phalam iti | ‘yad asyām utpatsyate ‘patyaṃ tad āvayor ubhayor eva’ evaṃ yatra niyamo na kṛtas tatra niḥsaṃdigdham eva kṣetriṇo ‘patyam | uktarītyā bījāt kṣetraṃ balavat || 9.52 ||
kriyābhyupagamāt tv etad bījārthaṃ yat pradīyate |
tasyeha bhāginau dṛṣṭau bījī kṣetrika eva ca || 9.53 ||
kriyeti | ‘yad atrāpatyaṃ bhaviṣyati tad āvayor eva’ iti niyamyaitat kṣetraṃ svāminā bījavapanārthaṃ yad bījino dīyate tasyāpatyasya loke bījikṣetriṇau dvāv eva bhāginau dṛṣṭau
|| 9.53 ||
moghavātāhṛtaṃ bījaṃ yasya kṣetre prarohati |
kṣetrikasyaiva tad bījaṃ na vaptā labhate phalam || 9.54 ||
mogheti | yad bījaṃ jalavegavātābhyām anyadīyakṣetrād ānītaṃ yasya kṣetre jāyate tatkṣetrasvāmina eva tad bījaṃ bhavati, na tu yena bījam uptaṃ sa tat phalaṃ labhate | evaṃ ca svabhāryābhrameṇāparabhāryāgamane ‘mamāyaṃ putro bhavitā’ ity avagame ‘pi kṣetriṇa evāpatyam ity anena darśitam || 9.54 ||
eṣa dharmo gavāśvasya dāsyuṣṭrājāvikasya ca |
vihaṃgamahiṣīṇāṃ ca vijñeyaḥ prasavaṃ prati || 9.55 ||
eṣa iti | eṣaiva vyavasthā gavāśvādīnāṃ santatiṃ prati jñātavyā | yatkṣetrasvāmy eva gavāśvādeḥ santatisvāmī na tu vṛṣabhādisvāmī | niyame tu kṛte saty etayor eva santatisvāmyam || 9.55 ||
etad vaḥ sāraphalgutvaṃ bījayonyoḥ prakīrtitam |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yoṣitāṃ dharmam āpadi || 9.56 ||
etad iti | etad bījayonyoḥ prādhānyāprādhānyaṃ yuṣmākam uktam | ato ‘nantaraṃ strīṇāṃ santānābhāve yat kartavyaṃ tad vakṣyāmi || 9.56 ||
bhrātur jyeṣṭhasya bhāryā yā gurupatny anujasya sā |
yavīyasas tu yā bhāryā snuṣā jyeṣṭhasya sā smṛtā || 9.57 ||
bhrātur iti | jyeṣṭhasya bhrātur yā bhāryā sā kaniṣṭhasya bhrātur gurupatnī bhavati | kaniṣṭhasya ca bhrātur yā bhāryā sā jyeṣṭhabhrātuḥ snuṣā munibhiḥ smṛtā || 9.57 ||
jyeṣṭho yavīyaso bhāryāṃ yavīyān vāgrajastriyam |
patitau bhavato gatvā niyuktāv apy anāpadi || 9.58 ||
jyeṣṭha iti | jyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhabhrātarāv itaretarabhāryāṃ gatvā santānābhāvaṃ vinā niyuktāv api patitau syātām || 9.58 ||
devarād vā sapiṇḍād vā striyā samyaṅ niyuktayā |
prajepsitādhigantavyā santānasya parikṣaye || 9.59 ||
devarād iti | santānābhāve striyā patyādiguruniyuktayā devarād anyasmād vā sapiṇḍād vakṣyamāṇaghṛtāktādiniyamavatpuruṣagamaneneṣṭāḥ prajā utpādayitavyāḥ | ‘īpsitā’ ity abhidhānam arthāt kāryākṣamaputrotpattau punargamanārtham || 9.59 ||
vidhavāyāṃ niyuktas tu ghṛtākto vāgyato niśi |
ekam utpādayet putraṃ na dvitīyaṃ kathaṃcana || 9.60 ||
vidhavāyām iti | vidhavāyām ity apatyotpādanayogyapatyabhāvaparam idam | jīvaty api patyau ayogyapatyādiguruniyukto ghṛtāktasarvagātro maunī trātrāv ekaṃ putraṃ janayen na kathaṃcid dvitīyam || 9.60 ||
dvitīyam eke prajanaṃ manyante strīṣu tadvidaḥ |
anirvṛttaṃ niyogārthaṃ paśyanto dharmatas tayoḥ || 9.61 ||
dvitīyam iti | anye punar ācāryā niyogāt putrotpādanavidhijñā ‘aputra ekaputraḥ’ iti śiṣṭapravādād aniṣpannaṃ niyogaprayojanaṃ manyamānāḥ strīṣu putrotpādanaṃ dvitīyaṃ dharmato manyante || 9.61 ||
vidhavāyāṃ niyogārthe nirvṛtte tu yathāvidhi |
guruvac ca snuṣāvac ca varteyātāṃ parasparam || 9.62 ||
vidhavāyām iti | vidhavādikāyāṃ niyogaprayojane garbhadhāraṇe yathāśāstraṃ saṃpanne sati jyeṣṭho bhrātā kaniṣthabhrātṛbhāryā ca parasparaṃ guruvat snuṣāvac ca vyavaharetām || 9.62 ||
niyuktau yau vidhiṃ hitvā varteyātāṃ tu kāmataḥ |
tāv ubhau patitau syātāṃ snuṣāgagurutalpagau || 9.63 ||
niyuktāv iti | jyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhabrātarau yau parasparabhāryāyāṃ niyuktau ghṛtāktādividhānaṃ tyaktvā svecchāto varteyātāṃ tau snuṣāgagurudāragau patitau bhavetām || 9.63 ||
evaṃ niyogam abhidhāya dūṣayitum āha –
nānyasmin vidhavā nārī niyoktavyā dvijātibhiḥ |
anyasmin hi niyuñjānā dharmaṃ hanyuḥ sanātanam || 9.64 ||
nānyasminn iti | brāhmaṇādibhir vidhavā strī bhartur anyasmin devarādau na niyojanīyā | striyam anyasmin niyuñjānās te strīṇām ekapatitvadharmam anādisiddhaṃ nāśayeyuḥ || 9.64 ||
nodvāhikeṣu mantreṣu niyogaḥ kīrtyate kvacit |
na vivāhavidhāv uktaṃ vidhavāvedanaṃ punaḥ || 9.65 ||
nodvāhikeṣv iti | “aryamaṇaṃ nu devam” (ĀśGṛ 1.7) ity evamādiṣu vivāhaprayojanakeṣu mantreṣu kvacid api śākhāyāṃ na niyogaḥ kathyate | na ca vivāhavidhāyakaśāstre ‘nyena puruṣeṇa saha punarvivāha uktaḥ || 9.65 ||
ayaṃ dvijair hi vidvadbhiḥ paśudharmo vigarhitaḥ |
manuṣyāṇām api prokto vene rājyaṃ praśāsati || 9.66 ||
ayam iti | yasmād ayaṃ paśusaṃbandhī manuṣyāṇām api vyavahāro vidvadbhir ninditaḥ | yo ‘yam adhārmike vene rājñi rājyaṃ kurvāṇe tena kartavyatayā proktaḥ | ato venād ārabhya pravṛtto ‘yam ādimān iti nindyate || 9.66 ||
sa mahīm akhilāṃ bhuñjan rājarṣipravaraḥ purā |
varṇānāṃ saṃkaraṃ cakre kāmopahatacetanaḥ || 9.67 ||
sa mahīm iti | sa veno mahīṃ samagrāṃ pūrvaṃ pālayann ata eva rājarṣiśreṣṭho na tu dhārmikatvāt, kāmopahatabuddhir bhrātṛbhāryāgamanarūpaṃ varṇasaṃkaraṃ prāvartayat
|| 9.67 ||
tataḥ prabhṛti yo mohāt pramītapatikāṃ striyam |
niyojayaty apatyārthaṃ taṃ vigarhanti sādhavaḥ || 9.68 ||
tata iti | venakālāt prabhṛti yo mṛtabhartṛkādistriyaṃ śāstrārthajñānād apatyanimittaṃ devarādau niyojayati taṃ sādhavo niyataṃ garhayante | ayaṃ ca svoktaniyoganiṣedhaḥ kaliyugaviṣayaḥ | tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ –
ukto niyogo muninā niṣiddhaḥ svayam eva tu |
yugakramād aśakyo ‘yaṃ kartum anyair vidhānataḥ ||
tapojñānasamāyuktāḥ kṛtatretāyuge narāḥ |
dvāpare ca kalau nṝṇāṃ śaktihānir hi nirmitā ||
anekadhā kṛtāḥ putrā ṛṣibhiś ca purātanaiḥ |
na śakyante ‘dhunā kartuṃ śaktihīnair idantanaiḥ ||
ato yad govindarājena yugaviśeṣavyavasthām ajñātvā sarvadaiva santānābhāve niyogād aniyogapakṣaḥ śreyān iti svamanīṣayā kalpitaṃ tan munivyākhyāvirodhān nādriyāmahe |
prāyaśo manuvākyeṣu munivyākhyānam eva hi |
nāparādhyo ‘smi viduṣāṃ kvāhaṃ sarvavidaḥ kudhīḥ ||
|| 9.68 ||
niyogaprakaraṇatvāt kanyāgataṃ viśeṣam āha –
yasyā mriyeta kanyāyā vācā satye kṛte patiḥ |
tām anena vidhānena nijo vindeta devaraḥ || 9.69 ||
yasyā iti | yasyāḥ kanyāyā vāgdāne kṛte sati bhartā mriyeta tām anena vakṣyamāṇenānuṣthānena bhartuḥ sodarabhrātā pariṇayet || 9.69 ||
yathāvidy adhigamyaināṃ śuklavastrāṃ śucivratām |
mitho bhajetāprasavāt sakṛt sakṛd ṛtāv ṛtau || 9.70 ||
yathāvidhīti | sa devaro vivāhavidhinā enāṃ svīkṛtya śuklavastrāṃ kāyavāṅmanaḥśaucaśālinīm ā garbhagrahaṇād rahasi ṛtāv ṛtāv ekaikavāraṃ gacchet | evaṃ kanyayā niyogaprakāratvād vivāhasyāgrahāc ca gamanopadeśad yasmai vāgdattā tasyaiva tadapatyaṃ bhavati || 9.70 ||
na datvā kasyacit kanyāṃ punar dadyād vicakṣaṇaḥ |
datvā punaḥ prayacchan hi prāpnoti puruṣānṛtam || 9.71 ||
na datveti | kasmaicid vācā kanyāṃ datvā tasmin mṛte dānaguṇadoṣajñas tām anyasmai na dadyāt | yasmād ekasmai datvānyasmai dadat puruṣānṛtaṃ ‘sahasraṃ puruṣānṛte’ (8.98) ity uktadoṣaṃ prāpnoti | saptapadīkaraṇasyājātatvād bhāryātvāniṣpatteḥ punar dānāśaṅkāyām idaṃ vacanam || 9.71 ||
vidhivat pratigṛhyāpi tyajet kanyāṃ vigarhitām |
vyādhitāṃ vipraduṣṭāṃ vā chadmanā copapāditām || 9.72 ||
vidhivad iti | ‘adhbhir eva dvijāgryāṇām” (3.35) ity evamādividhinā pratigṛhyāpi kanyāṃ vaidhavyalakṣaṇopetāṃ rogiṇīṃ kṣatayonitvādyabhiśāpavatīm adhikāṅgādigopanacchadmopapāditāṃ saptapadīkaraṇāt prāg jñātāṃ tyajet | tataś ca tattyāge doṣābhāva ity etadarthaṃ na tu tyāgārtham || 9.72 ||
yas tu doṣavatīṃ kanyām anākhyāyopapādayet |
tasya tad vitathaṃ kuryāt kanyādātur durātmanaḥ || 9.73 ||
yas tv iti | yaḥ punar doṣavatīṃ kanyāṃ doṣān anabhidhāya dadāti tasya kanyādātur durātmano dānaṃ tatpratyarpaṇena vyarthaṃ kuryāt | etad api tyāge doṣābhāvakathanārtham
|| 9.73 ||
vidhāya vṛttiṃ bhāryāyāḥ pravaset kāryavān naraḥ |
avṛttikarśitā hi strī praduṣyet sthitimaty api || 9.74 ||
vidhāyeti | kārye sati manuṣyaḥ patnyā grāsācchādanādi prakalpya deśāntaraṃ gacchet | yasmād grāsādyabhāvapīḍitā strī śīlavaty api puruṣāntarasaṃparkaṃ bhajet || 9.74 ||
vidhāya proṣite vṛttiṃ jiven niyamam āsthitā |
proṣite tv avidhāyaiva jīvec chilpair agarhitaiḥ || 9.75 ||
vidhāyeti | bhaktācchādanādi datvā patyau deśāntaraṃ gate dehaprasādhanaparagṛhagamana-rahitā jīvet | adatvā punar gate sūtranirmāṇādibhir aninditaśilpair jīvet || 9.75 ||
proṣite dharmakāryārthaṃ pratīkṣyo ‘ṣṭau naraḥ samāḥ |
vidyārthaṃ ṣaḍ yaśo’rthaṃ vā kāmārthaṃ trīṃs tu vatsarān || 9.76 ||
proṣite iti | gurvājñāsaṃpādanādidharmakāryanimittaṃ proṣitaḥ patir aṣṭau varṣāṇi patnyā pratīkṣaṇīyaḥ, ūrdhvaṃ patisaṃnidhiṃ gacchet | tad āha vasiṣṭhaḥ: “proṣitapatnī pañca varṣāṇy upāsīta, ūrdhvaṃ patisakāśaṃ gacchet” (17.15) iti | vidyārthaṃ proṣitaḥ ṣaḍ varṣāṇi pratīkṣyaḥ | nijavidyāvibhājanena yaśo’rtham api proṣitaḥ patiḥ ṣaḍ eva | bhāryāntaropabhogārthaṃ gatas trīṇi varṣāṇi || 9.76 ||
saṃvatsaraṃ pratīkṣeta dviṣantīṃ yoṣitaṃ patiḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarāt tv enāṃ dāyaṃ hṛtvā na saṃvaset || 9.77 ||
saṃvatsaram iti | patir viṣayasaṃjātadveṣāṃ striyaṃ varṣaṃ yāvat pratīkṣeta | tata ūrdhvam api dviṣantīṃ svadattam alaṃkārādi dhanaṃ hṛtvā nopagacchet | grāsācchādanamātraṃ tu deyam eva || 9.77 ||
atikrāmet pramattaṃ yā mattaṃ rogārtham eva vā |
sā trīn māsān parityājyāvibhūṣaṇaparicchadā || 9.78 ||
atīti | yā strī dyūtādipramādavantaṃ madajanakapānādinā mattaṃ vyādhitaṃ vā śuśrūṣādyakaraṇenāvajānāti sā vigatālaṃkāraśayyādiparicchadā trīn māsān nopagantavyā
|| 9.78 ||
unmattaṃ patitaṃ klībam abījaṃ pāparogiṇam |
na tyāgo ‘sti dviṣantyāś ca na ca dāyāpavartanam || 9.79 ||
unmattam iti | vātādikṣobhād aprakṛtisthaṃ patitam ekādaśādhyāye vakṣyamāṇaṃ, napuṃsakam abījaṃ bādhyaretastvādinā bījarahitaṃ, kuṣṭhādyupetaṃ, ca patim aparicarantyās tyāgo na karaṇīyaḥ, na ca dhanagrahaṇaṃ karaṇīyam || 9.79 ||
madyapāsādhuvṛttā ca pratikūlā ca yā bhavet |
vyādhitā vādhivettavyā hiṃsrārthagnī ca sarvadā || 9.80 ||
madyapeti | niṣiddhamadyapānaratā, asādhvācārā, bhartuḥ pratikūlācaraṇaśīlā, kuṣṭhādivyādhiyuktā, bhṛtyāditāḍanaśīlā, satatam ativyayakāriṇī yā bhāryā bhavet sādhivettavyā tasyāṃ satyām anyo vivāhaḥ kāryaḥ || 9.80 ||
vandhyāṣṭame ‘dhivedābde daśame tu mṛtaprajā |
ekādaśe strījananī sadyas tv apriyavādinī || 9.81 ||
vandhyeti | prathamartum ārabhyāvidyamānaprasūtā aṣṭame varṣe ‘dhivedanīyā, mṛtāpatyā daśame varṣe, strījanany ekādaśe, apriyavādinī sadya eva yady aputrā bhavati | putravatyāṃ tu tasyāṃ “dharmaprajāsaṃpanne dāre nānyāṃ kurvīta, anyatarāpāye tu kurvīta” (ĀpDh 2.11.12–13) ity āpastambaniṣedhād adhivedanaṃ na kāryam || 9.81 ||
yā rogiṇī syāt tu hitā saṃpannā caiva śīlataḥ |
sānujñāpyādhivettavyā nāvamanyā ca karhicit || 9.82 ||
yeti | yā punar vyādhitā satī patyur anukūlā bhavati śīlavatī ca syāt tām anujñāpyānyo vivāhaḥ kāryaḥ | kadācic cāsau nāvamānanīyā || 9.82 ||
adhivinnā tu yā nārī nirgacched ruṣitā gṛhāt |
sā sadyaḥ saṃniroddhavyā tyājyā vā kulasaṃnidhau || 9.83 ||
adhivinneti | yā punaḥ kṛtādhivedanā strī kupitā nirgacchati sā tadahar eva rajjvādinā baddhvā sthāpanīyā, ā kopanivṛtteḥ | pitrādikulasaṃnidhau vā tyājyā || 9.83 ||
pratiṣiddhāpi ced yā tu madyam abhyudayeṣv api |
prekṣāsamājaṃ gacched vā sā daṇḍyā kṛṣṇalāni ṣaṭ || 9.84 ||
pratiṣiddhāpīti | yā punaḥ kṣatriyādikā strī bhartrādinivāritā vivāhādyutsaveṣv api niṣiddhamadyaṃ pibet, nṛtyādisthānajanasamūhau vā gacchet, sā suvarṇakṛṣṇalāni ṣaṭ vyavahāraprakaraṇād rājñā daṇḍanīyā || 9.84 ||
yadi svāś cāparāś caiva vinderan yoṣito dvijāḥ |
tāsāṃ varṇakrameṇa syāj jyaiṣṭhyaṃ pūjā ca veśma ca || 9.85 ||
yadīti | yadi dvijātayaḥ svajātīyā vijātīyāś codvaheyus tadā tāsāṃ dvijātikrameṇa vāksaṃmānadāyavibhāgotkarṣārthaṃ jyeṣṭhatvaṃ pūjā ca vastrālaṃkārādidānena gṛhaṃ ca pradhānaṃ syāt || 9.85 ||
bhartuḥ śarīraśuśrūṣāṃ dharmakāryaṃ ca naityakam |
svā caiva kuryāt sarveṣāṃ nāsvajātiḥ kathaṃcana || 9.86 ||
bhartur iti | bhartur dehaparicaryām annadānādirūpāṃ dharmakāryaṃ ca bhikṣādānātithipariveṣaṇahomīyadravyopakalpanādi prātyahikaṃ sarveṣāṃ dvijātīnāṃ sajātibhāryaiva kuryān na tu kadācid vijātīyeti || 9.86 ||
yas tu tat kārayen mohāt sajātyā sthitānyayā |
yathā brāhmaṇacāṇḍālaḥ pūrvadṛṣṭas tathaiva saḥ || 9.87 ||
yas tv iti | yaḥ punaḥ svajātīyayā saṃnihitayā dehaśuśrūṣādikaṃ kartavyaṃ vijātīyayā maurkhyāt kārayet sa yathā brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdrāj jāto brāhmaṇacāṇḍalas tathaiva pūrvair ṛṣibhir dṛṣṭa iti pūrvānuvādaḥ || 9.87 ||
utkṛṣṭāyābhirūpāya varāya sadṛśāya ca |
aprāptām api tāṃ tasmai kanyāṃ dadyād yathāvidhi || 9.88 ||
utkṛṣṭāyeti | kulācārādibhir utkṛṣṭāya surūpāya samānajātīyāya varāyāprāptakālām api “vivāhayed adṛṣṭavarṣām evaṃ dharmo no hīyate” iti dakṣasmaraṇāt | tasmād api kālāt prāg api kanyāṃ brāhmavivāhavidhinā dadyāt || 9.88 ||
kāmam ā maraṇāt tiṣṭhed gṛhe kanyartumaty api |
na caivaināṃ prayacchet tu guṇahīnāya karhicit || 9.89 ||
kāmam iti | saṃjātārtavāpi kanyā varaṃ maraṇaparyantaṃ pitṛgṛhe tiṣthen na punar enāṃ vidyāguṇarahitāya kadācit pitrādir dadyāt || 9.89 ||
trīṇi varṣāṇy udīkṣeta kumāry ṛtumatī satī |
ūrdhvaṃ tu kālād etasmād vindeta sadṛśaṃ patim || 9.90 ||
trīṇīti | pitrādibhir guṇavadvarāyādīyamānā kanyā saṃjātārtavā satī trīṇi varṣāṇi pratīkṣeta | varaṣatrayāt punar ūrdhvam adhikaguṇavarālābhe samānajātiguṇaṃ varaṃ svayaṃ vṛṇīta
|| 9.90 ||
adīyamānā bhartāram adhigacched yadi svayam |
nainaḥ kiṃcid avāpnoti na ca yaṃ sādhigacchati || 9.91 ||
adīyamāneti | pitrādibhir adīyamānā kumārī yathoktakāle yadi bhartāraṃ svayaṃ vṛṇute tadā sā na kiṃcid pāpaṃ prāpnoti | na ca tatpatiḥ pāpaṃ prāpnoti || 9.91 ||
alaṃkāraṃ nādadīta pitryaṃ kanyā svayaṃvarā |
mātṛkaṃ bhrātṛdattaṃ vā stenā syād yadi tam haret || 9.92 ||
alam iti | svayaṃvṛtapatikā kanyā varasvīkaraṇāt pūrvaṃ pitṛmātṛbhrātṛbhir dattam alaṃkāraṃ tebhyaḥ samarpayet | yadā nārpayet tadā caurī syāt || 9.92 ||
pitre na dadyāc chulkaṃ tu kanyām ṛtumatīṃ haran |
sa hi svāmyād atikrāmed ṛtūnāṃ pratirodhanāt || 9.93 ||
pitre neti | ṛtuyuktāṃ kanyāṃ varaḥ pariṇayan pitre śulkaṃ na dadyāt | yasmāt sa pitā ṛtukāryāpatyotpattinirodhāt kanyāyāḥ svāmitvād dhīyate || 9.93 ||
triṃśadvarṣo vahet kanyāṃ hṛdyāṃ dvāsaśavārṣikīm |
tryaṣṭavarṣo ‘ṣṭavarṣāṃ vā dharme sīdati satvaraḥ || 9.94 ||
triṃśadvarṣa iti | triṃśadvarṣaḥ pumān dvādaśavarṣavayaskāṃ manohāriṇīṃ kanyām udvahet | caturviṃśativarṣo vāṣṭavarṣām, gārhasthyadharme ‘vasādaṃ gacchati tvarāvān | etac ca yogyakālapradarśanaparaṃ na tu niyamārtham, prāyeṇaitāvatā kālena gṛhītavedo bhavati | tribhāgavayaskā ca kanyā voḍhur yūno yogyeti gṛhītavedaś copakurvāṇako gṛhasthāśramaṃ prati na vilambeteti ‘satvaraḥ’ ity asyārthaḥ || 9.94 ||
devadattāṃ patir bhāryāṃ vindate necchayātmanaḥ |
tāṃ sādhvīṃ bibhṛyān nityaṃ devānāṃ priyam ācaran || 9.95 ||
deveti | “bhago aryamā savitā puramdhir mahyaṃ tvādur gārhapatyāya devāḥ” ityādimantraliṅgāt, yā devair dattā bhāryā tāṃ patir labhate na tu svecchayā | tāṃ satīṃ devānāṃ priyaṃ kurvan grāsācchādanādinā sadā dveṣādyupetām api poṣayet || 9.95 ||
prajanārthaṃ striyaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ santānārthaṃ ca mānavāḥ |
tasmāt sādhāraṇo dharmaḥ śrutau patnyā sahoditaḥ || 9.96 ||
prajanārtham iti | yasmād garbhagrahaṇārthaṃ striyaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ garbhādhānārthaṃ ca manuṣyās tasmād garbhotpānam evānayoḥ, agnyādhānādir api dharmaḥ patnyā saha sādhāraṇaḥ, “kṣaume vāsanāv agnīn ādadhīyātām” ityādir vede ‘bhihitaḥ | tasmāt “bhāryām bibhṛyāt” (9.95) iti pūrvoktasya śeṣaḥ || 9.96 ||
kanyāyāṃ dattaśulkāyāṃ mriyeta yadi śulkadaḥ |
devarāya pradātavyā yadi kanyānumanyate || 9.97 ||
kanyāyām iti | kanyāyāṃ dattaśulkāyāṃ satyām asaṃjātavivāhāyāṃ yadi śulkado varo mriyeta tadā devarāya pitrādibhir vāsau kanyā dātavyā yadi sā svīkaroti | “yasyā mriyeta” (9.69) iti prāg uktaṃ niyogarūpaṃ, idaṃ tu śulkagrahaṇaviṣayam || 9.97 ||
ādadīta na śūdro ‘pi śulkaṃ duhitaraṃ dadan |
śulkaṃ hi gṛhṇan kurute channaṃ duhitṛvikrayam || 9.98 ||
ādadīteti | śāstrānabhijñaḥ śūdro ‘pi putrīṃ dadac chulkaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt kiṃ punaḥ śāstravid dvijātiḥ | yasmāc chulkaṃ gṛhṇan guptaṃ duhitṛvikrayaṃ kurute | “na kanyāyāḥ pitā” (3.51) ity anena niṣiddham api śulkagrahaṇaṃ kanyāyām api gṛhītaśulkāyāṃ śāstrīyaniyamadarśanāc chulkagrahaṇe śāstrīyatvaśaṅkāyāṃ punas tan niṣidhyate || 9.98 ||
etat tu na pare cakrur nāpare jātu sādhavaḥ |
yad anyasya pratijñāya punar anyasya dīyate || 9.99 ||
etad iti | etat punaḥ pūrve śiṣṭā na kadācit kṛtavanto nāpy apare vartamānakālāḥ kurvanti yad anyasya kanyām aṅgīkṛtya punar anyasmai dīyata iti | etac cāgṛhītaśulkakanyām adatvā kasyacit, “kanyāyām” (9.97) iti tu gṛhītaśulkaviṣayam || 9.99 ||
nānuśuśruma jātv etat pūrveṣv api hi janmasu |
śulkasaṃjñena mūlyena channaṃ duhitṛvikrayam || 9.100 ||
neti | pūrvakalpeṣv apy etad vṛttam iti kadācid vayaṃ na śrutavantaḥ, yac chulkābhidhānena mūlyena kaścit sādhur gūḍhaṃ duhitṛvikrayam akārṣīd iti śulkaniṣedhārthavādaḥ || 9.100 ||
anyonyasyāvyabhīcāro bhaved āmaraṇāntikaḥ |
eṣa dharmaḥ samāsena strīpuṃsayoḥ paraḥ || 9.101 ||
anyonyasyeti | bhāryāpatyor maraṇāntaṃ yāvad dharmārthakāmeṣu parasparāvyabhicāraḥ syād ity eva saṃkṣepataḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ prakṛṣṭo dharmo jñātavyaḥ || 9.101 ||
tathā ca sati –
tathā nityaṃ yateyātāṃ strīpuṃsau tu kṛtakriyau |
yathā nābhicaretāṃ tau viyuktāv itaretaram || 9.102 ||
tatheti | strīpuṃsau kṛtavivāhau tathā sadā yatnaṃ kuryātāṃ yathā dharmārthakāmaviṣaye viyuktau parasparaṃ na vyabhicaretām || 9.102 ||
eṣa strīpuṃsayor ukto dharmo vo ratisaṃhitaḥ |
āpady apatyaprāptiś ca dāyabhāgaṃ nibodhata || 9.103 ||
eṣa iti | eṣa bhāryāpatyor anyonyānurāgayukto dharmo yuṣmākam uktaḥ | santānābhāve cāptyaprāptir uktā | idānīṃ dīyata iti dāyaḥ pitrādidhanaṃ tasya vibhāgavyavasthāṃ śṛṇuta
|| 9.103 ||
bhrātaro militvā pitṛmaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ paitṛkaṃ mātṛmaraṇād ūrdhvaṃ mātṛkaṃ dhanaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā vibhajeran | jyeṣṭhagocaratayoddhārasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt samabhāgo ‘yaṃ jyeṣṭhabhrātary uddhāram anicchati boddhavyaḥ | pitror maraṇād ūrdhvaṃ vibhāgahetum āha –
ūrdhvaṃ pituś ca mātuś ca sametya bhrātaraḥ samam |
bhajeran paitṛkaṃ riktham anīśās te hi jīvatoḥ || 9.104 ||
ūrdhvam iti | yasmāt te putrā jīvatoḥ pitros tadīyadhane svāmino na bhavanti | mātur api prakṛtatvāt ‘paitṛkam’ ity anena mātṛkasyāpi grahaṇam | ayaṃ ca pitṛmaraṇānantaraṃ vibhāgo jīvataḥ pitur icchābhāve draṣṭavyaḥ | pitur icchayā jīvaty api tasmin vibhāgaḥ | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ:
vibhāgaṃ cet pitā kuryād icchayā vibhajet sutān | iti |
|| 9.104 ||
yadā punar jyeṣṭho dhārmiko bhavati tadā –
jyeṣṭha eva tu gṛhṇīyāt pitryaṃ dhanam aśeṣataḥ |
śeṣās tam upajīveyur yathaiva pitaraṃ tathā || 9.105 ||
jyeṣṭha iti | jyeṣṭha eva pitṛsaṃbandhi dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | kaniṣṭhāḥ punar jyeṣṭhaṃ bhaktācchādanādyarthaṃ pitaram ivopajīveyuḥ | evaṃ sarveṣāṃ sahaivāvasthānam || 9.105 ||
jyeṣṭhena jātamātreṇa putrī bhavati mānavaḥ |
pitṝṇām anṛṇaś caiva sa tasmāt sarvam arhati || 9.106 ||
jyeṣṭheneti | utpannamātreṇa jyeṣṭhena saṃskārarahitenāpi manuṣyaḥ putravān bhavati | tataś ca “nāputrasya loko ‘sti” iti śruteḥ puṇyalokābhāvaparihāro bhavati | tathā “prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ” iti śruteḥ “putreṇa jātamātreṇa pitṝṇām anṛṇaś ca saḥ” iti | ato jyeṣtha eva sarvadhanam arhati pūrvasyānujās tena nāmnā varteran || 9.106 ||
yasminn ṛṇaṃ saṃnayati yena cānantyam aśnute |
sa eva dharmajaḥ putraḥ kāmajān itarān viduḥ || 9.107 ||
yasminn iti | yasmin jāte ṛṇaṃ śodhayati | yena jātenāmṛtatvaṃ prāpnoti | tathā ca śrutiḥ –
ṛṇam asmin samunnayaty amṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati |
pitā putrasya jātasya paśyec cej jīvato mukham || iti |
sa eva pitur dharmeṇa hetunā jātaḥ putro bhavati, tenaikenaiva ṛṇāpanayanādyupakārasya kṛtatāt | itarāṃs tu kāmajān munayo jānanti | tataś ca sarvaṃ dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyād ity asyaivāyam api viśeṣaḥ || 9.107 ||
piteva pālayet putrāñ jyeṣtho bhrātṝn yavīyasaḥ |
putravac cāpi varterañ jyeṣṭhe bhrātari dharmataḥ || 9.108 ||
piteveti | jyeṣṭho bhrātā vibhāgābhāve ‘nujān bhrātṝn bhaktācchādanādibhiḥ piteva bibhṛyāt | anujāś ca bhrātaraḥ putrā iva jyeṣṭhe bhrātari dharmāya varteran || 9.108 ||
jyeṣṭhaḥ kulaṃ vardhayati vināśayati vā punaḥ |
jyeṣṭhaḥ pūjyatamo loke jyeṣṭhaḥ sadbhir agarhitaḥ || 9.109 ||
jyeṣṭha iti | akṛtavibhāgo jyeṣtho yadi dhārmiko bhavati tadānujānām api tadanuyāyitvena dhārmikatvāj jyeṣṭhaḥ kulaṃ vṛddhiṃ nayati | yady adhārmiko bhavati tadānujānām api tadanuyāyitvena dhārmikatvāj jyeṣṭhah kulaṃ nāśayati | tathā guṇavāñ jyeṣtho loke pūjyatamaḥ sādhubhiś cāgarhito bhavati || 9.109 ||
yo jyeṣṭho jyeṣṭhavṛttiḥ syān māteva sa piteva saḥ |
ajyeṣṭhavṛttir yas tu syāt sa saṃpūjyas tu bandhuvat || 9.110 ||
yo jyeṣṭha iti | yo jyeṣṭho ‘nujeṣu bhrātṛṣu pitṛvad varteta, sa piteva mātevāgarhaṇīyo bhavati | yaḥ punas tathā na varteta, sa mātulādibandhuvad arcanīyaḥ || 9.110 ||
evaṃ saha vaseyur vā pṛthag vā dharmakāmyayā |
pṛthag vivardhate dharmas tasmād dharmyā pṛthakkriyā || 9.111 ||
evam iti | evam avibhaktā bhrātaraḥ saha saṃvaseyuḥ | yadi vā dharmakāmanayā kṛtavibhāgāḥ pṛthag vaseyuḥ | yasmāt pṛthagavasthāne sati pṛthak pṛthak pañcamahāyajñādyanuṣthānadharmas teṣāṃ vardhate tasmād vibhāgakriyā dharmārthā | tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
ekapākena vasatāṃ pitṛdevadvijārcanam |
ekaṃ bhaved vibhaktānāṃ tad eva syād gṛhe gṛhe ||
|| 9.111 ||
jyeṣṭhasya viṃśa uddhāraḥ sarvadravyāc ca yad varam |
tato ‘rdhaṃ madhyamasya syāt turīyaṃ tu yavīyasaḥ || 9.112 ||
jyeṣṭhasyeti | uddhriyata ity uddhāraḥ jyeṣṭhasyāvibhaktasādhāraṇadhanād uddhṛtya viṃśatitamo bhāgaḥ sarvadravyebhyaś ca yac chreṣṭhaṃ tad dātavyam | madhyamasya catvāriṃśattamo bhāgo deyaḥ | kaniṣṭhasya punar aśītitamo bhāgo dātavyaḥ | avaśiṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā vibhajanīyam || 9.112 ||
jyeṣṭhaś caiva kaniṣṭhaś ca saṃharetāṃ yathoditam |
ye ‘nye jyeṣthakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ teṣāṃ syān madhyamaṃ dhanam || 9.113 ||
jyeṣṭhaś ceti | jyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhau pūrvaśloke yathoktam uddhāraṃ gṛhṇīyātām | jeṣṭhakaniṣṭhavyatiriktā ye madhyamās teṣām evāvāntarajyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhatām anapekṣya madhyamasyoktacatvāriṃśadbhāgaḥ pratyekaṃ dātavyaḥ | madhyamānām avāntarajyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhadeyabhāge vaiṣamyavāraṇārtham idam || 9.113 ||
sarveṣāṃ dhanajātānām ādadītāgryam agrajaḥ |
yac ca sātiśayaṃ kiṃcid daśataś cāpnuyād varam || 9.114 ||
sarveṣām iti | sarveṣāṃ dhanaprakārāṇāṃ madhymād yac chreṣṭhaṃ dhanam, jyeṣṭhaḥ tad dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | “sarvadravyāc ca yad varam” (9.112) ity uktam anūditasamuccayabodhanāya | yac caikam api prakṛṣṭaṃ dravyaṃ vidyate tad api jyeṣṭha eva gṛhṇīyāt | tathā “daśataḥ paśūnām” (GDh 29.3) iti gautamasmaraṇād daśabhyo gavādipaśubhya ekaikaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyeṣṭho labhate | idaṃ ca yadi jyeṣṭho guṇavān itare nirguṇās tadviṣayam || 9.114 ||
sarveṣāṃ samaguṇatve tu –
uddhāro na daśasv asti saṃpannānāṃ svakarmasu |
yat kiṃcid eva deyaṃ tu jyāyase mānavardhanam || 9.115 ||
uddhāra iti | “daśataś cāpnuyād varam” (9.114) iti yo ‘yam uddhāra uktaḥ so ‘yam adhyayanādikarmasamṛddhānāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ jyeṣṭhasya nāsti | tatrāpi yat kiṃcid asya deyam iti | dravyaṃ pūjāvṛddhikaraṃ jyeṣṭhāya deyam | evaṃ ca samaguṇeṣūddhārapratiṣedhadarśanāt pūrvatra guṇotkarṣāviśeṣāpekṣayoddhāravaiṣamyaṃ boddhavyam || 9.115 ||
evaṃ samuddhṛtoddhāre samān aṃśān prakalpayet |
uddhāre ‘nuddhṛte tv eṣām iyaṃ syād aṃśakalpanā || 9.116 ||
evam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇa samuddhṛtaviṃśadbhāgādhike dhane samān bhāgān bhrātṝṇāṃ kalpayet | viṃśatitamabhāgādau punar anuddhṛta iyaṃ vakṣyamāṇā bhāgakalpanā bhavet
|| 9.116 ||
ekādhikaṃ harej jyeṣṭhaḥ putro ‘dhyardhaṃ tato ‘nujaḥ |
aṃśam aṃśaṃ yavīyāṃsa iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || 9.117 ||
ekādhikam iti | ekādhikam aṃśaṃ dvāv aṃśāv iti yāvat | jyeṣṭhaputro gṛhṇīyāt | adhikam arthaṃ yatrāṃśe sārdham aṃśaṃ jyeṣṭhād anantarajāto gṛhṇīyāt | kaniṣṭhāḥ punar ekaikam aṃśaṃ gṛhṇīyur iti vyavasthito dharmaḥ | idaṃ tu jyeṣṭhatadanujayor vidyādiguṇavattvāpekṣayā, kaniṣṭhānāṃ ca nirguṇatve boddhavyam | jyeṣṭhatadanujayor adhikadānadarśanāt || 9.117 ||
svebhyo ‘ṃśebhyas tu kanyābhyaḥ pradadyur bhrātaraḥ pṛthak |
svāt svād aṃśāc caturbhāgaṃ patitāḥ syur aditsavaḥ || 9.118 ||
svebhya iti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrāś catvāro bhrātaraḥ svajātyapekṣayā svebhyaḥ “caturo ‘ṃśān hared vipraḥ” (9.153) ityādinā vakṣyamāṇebhyo bhāgebhya ātmīyād ātmīyād bhāgāc caturthabhāgaṃ pṛthak kanyābhyo ‘nūḍhābhyo bhaginībhyo yā yasya sodaryā bhaginī sa tasyā eva saṃskārārtham iti evaṃ dadyuḥ | sodaryābhāve vimātṛjair utkṛṣṭair apakṛṣṭair api saṃskāryaiva | tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ:
asaṃskṛtās tu saṃskāryā bhrātṛbhiḥ pūrvasaṃskṛtaiḥ |
bhaginyaś ca nijād aṃśād datvāṃśaṃ tu turīyakam ||
yadi bhaginīsaṃskārārthaṃ caturbhāgaṃ dātuṃ necchanti tadā patitā bhaveyuḥ | etenaikajātīyavaimātreyabahuputrabhaginīsadbhāve ‘pi sodaryabhaginībhyaś caturthabhāgadānam avagantavyam || 9.118 ||
ajāvikaṃ saikaśaphaṃ na jātu viṣamaṃ bhajet |
ajāvikaṃ tu viṣamaṃ jyeṣṭhasyaiva vidhīyate || 9.119 ||
ajeti | ekaśaphā aśvādayaḥ | chāgameṣādyekaśaphasahitaṃ vibhāgakāle samaṃ kṛtvā vibhaktum aśakyaṃ tan na vibhajet, kiṃ tu jyeṣṭhasyaiva tat syān na tu tattulyadravyāntaradānena samīkṛtya vikrīya vā tatmūlyaṃ vibhajet | ajāvikam iti paśudvandvād vibhāṣaikavadbhāvaḥ || 9.119 ||
yavīyāñ jyeṣṭhabhāryāyāṃ putram utpādayed yadi |
samas tatra vibhāgaḥ syād iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || 9.120 ||
yavīyān iti | kaniṣṭho yadi jyeṣṭhabhrātṛbhāryāyāṃ viyogena putraṃ janayet tadā tena pitṛvyeṇa saha tasya kṣetrajasya samo vibhāgaḥ syān na tu pitṛvat soddhāro bhavatīti vibhāgavyavasthā niyatā | aniyogotpannasyānaṃśitvaṃ vakṣyati | yady api “sametya bhrātaraḥ samam” (9.104) ity uktaṃ, tathāpy asmād eva liṅgāt pautrasyāpi mṛtapitṛkasya paitāmahe dhane pitṛvyavad vibhāgo ‘stīti gamyate || 9.120 ||
jyeṣṭhabhrātuḥ kṣetrajaḥ putro ‘pi piteva soddhāravibhāgī yukta itīmāṃ śaṅkāṃ nirākṛtya pūrvoktam eva draḍhayati –
upasarjanaṃ pradhānasya dharmato nopapadyate |
pitā pradhānaṃ prajane tasmād dharmeṇa taṃ bhajet || 9.121 ||
upasarjanam iti | apradhānaṃ kṣetrajaḥ putraḥ pradhānasya kṣetriṇaḥ pitṛdharmeṇa soddhāravibhāgagrahaṇarūpeṇa na saṃbadhyate | kṣetry api pitā taddvāreṇāpatyotpādane pradhānam | tasmāt pūrvoktenaiva dharmeṇa vibhāgavyavasthārūpeṇa pitṛvyena saha taṃ kṣetrajaṃ vibhajed iti pūrvasyaiva śeṣaḥ || 9.121 ||
putraḥ kaniṣṭho jyeṣṭhāyāṃ kaniṣṭhāyāṃ ca pūrvajaḥ |
kathaṃ tatra vibhagaḥ syād iti cet saṃśayo bhavet || 9.122 ||
putra iti | yadi prathamoḍhāyāṃ kanīyān putro jātaḥ paścādūḍhāyāṃ ca jyeṣṭhas tadā tatra kathaṃ vibhāgo bhaved iti saṃśayo yadi syāt kiṃ mātur udvāhakrameṇa putrasya jyeṣṭhatvam uta svajanmakrameṇeti tad āha || 9.122 ||
ekaṃ vṛṣabham uddhāraṃ saṃhareta sa pūrvajaḥ |
tato ‘pare jyeṣṭhavṛṣās tadūnānāṃ svamātṛtaḥ || 9.123 ||
ekam iti | pūrvasyāṃ jātaḥ pūrvajaḥ | “ṅyāpoḥ saṃjñādhandasor bahulam” (Pāṇ 6.3.63) iti hrasvatvam | sa kaniṣṭho ‘py ekaṃ vṛṣabham uddhāraṃ gṛhṇīyāt tataḥ śreṣṭhavṛṣabhād anye ye santy agryāḥ śreṣṭhavṛṣabhās te tasmāj jyaiṣṭhineyān mātṛta ūnānāṃ kaniṣṭheyānāṃ pratyekam ekaikaśo bhavantīti mātrudvāhakrameṇa jyaiṣṭhyam || 9.123 ||
jyeṣṭhas tu jāto jyeṣṭhāyāṃ hared vṛṣabhaṣoḍaśāḥ |
tataḥ svamātṛtaḥ śeṣā bhajerann iti dhāraṇā || 9.124 ||
jyeṣṭha iti | prathamoḍhāyāṃ punar yo jāto janmanā ca bhrātṛbhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ sa vṛṣabhaḥ ṣoḍaśo yāsāṃ gavāṃ tā gṛhṇīyāt | pañcadaśa gā ekaṃ vṛṣabham ity arthaḥ | tato ‘nantaraṃ ye ‘nye bahvībhyo jātās te svamātṛbhāgata ūḍhajyeṣṭhāpekṣayā śeṣā bhāgādi vibhajerann iti niścayaḥ
|| 9.124 ||
sadṛśastrīṣu jātānāṃ putrāṇām aviśeṣataḥ |
na mātṛto jyaiṣṭhyam asti janmato jyaiṣṭhyam ucyate || 9.125 ||
sadṛśeti | samānajātīyastrīṣu jātānāṃ putrāṇāṃ jātigataviśeṣābhāve sati na mātṛkrameṇa jyaiṣṭhyam ṛṣibhir ucyate | janmajyeṣṭhānāṃ tu pūrvokta eva viṃśatibhāgādir uddhāro boddhavyaḥ | evaṃ ca mātṛjyaiṣṭhyasya vihitapratiṣiddhatvāt ṣoḍaśīgrahaṇāgrahaṇavad vikalpaḥ | sa ca gunavannirguṇatayā bhrātṝṇāṃ gurulaghutvāvagamād vyavasthitaḥ | ata eva “janmavidyāguṇajyeṣṭhas tryaṃśaṃ dāyād avāpnuyāt” iti bṛhaspatyādibhir janmajyeṣṭhasya vidyādyutkarṣeṇoddhārotkarṣa uktaḥ | “nirguṇasyaikaṃ vṛṣabham” iti, mandaguṇasya “vṛṣabhaṣoḍaśāḥ” iti mātṛjyaiṣṭhyāśrayaṇenoddhāro boddhavyaḥ | mātṛjyaiṣṭhyavidhiṃ tv anuvādaṃ medhātithir avadat | govindarājas tv anyamataṃ jagau || 9.125 ||
na kevalaṃ vibhāge janmajyaiṣṭhyaṃ kiṃ tu –
janmajyeṣṭhena cāhvānaṃ subrahmaṇyāsv api smṛtam |
yamayoś caiva garbheṣu janmato jyeṣṭhatā smṛtā || 9.126 ||
janmeti | subrahmaṇyākhyo mantro jyotiṣṭoma indrasyāhvānārthaṃ prayujyate | tatra prathamaputreṇa pitaram uddiśyāhvānaṃ kriyate – “amukapitā yajate” ity evam ṛṣibhiḥ smṛtam | tathā yamayor garbha ekakālaṃ niṣiktayor api janmakrameṇaiva jyeṣṭhatā smṛtā | garbheṣv iti bahuvacanaṃ strībahutvāpekṣayā || 9.126 ||
aputro ‘nena vidhinā sutāṃ kurvīta putrikām |
yad apatyaṃ bhaved asyāṃ tan mama syāt svadhākaram || 9.127 ||
[abhrātṛkāṃ pradāsyāmi tubhyaṃ kanyām alaṃkṛtām |
asyāṃ yo jāyate putraḥ sa me putro bhaved iti || ]
aputra iti | avidyamānaputro yad asyām apatyaṃ jāyeta tan mama śrāddhādyaurdhvadehikakaraṃ syād iti kanyādānakāle jāmātrā saha saṃpratipattirūpeṇa vidhānena duhitaraṃ putrikāṃ kuryāt || 9.127 ||
atra parapratipattirūpam anuvādam āha –
anena tu vidhānena purā cakre ‘tha putrikāḥ |
vivṛddhyarthaṃ svavaṃśasya svayaṃ dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 9.128 ||
aneneti | dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ putrotpādanavidhijñaḥ svavaṃśavṛddhyartham anenoktavidhānena kṛsnā duhitaraḥ pūrvaṃ putrikāḥ svayaṃ kṛtavān | kārtsnye athaśabdaḥ
|| 9.128 ||
dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa |
somāya rājñe satkṛtya prītātmā saptaviṃśatim || 9.129 ||
dadāv iti | sa dakṣo bhāviputrikāputralābhena prītātmālaṃkārādinā satkṛtya daśa putrikā dharmāya, trayodaśa kaśyapāya, saptaviṃśatiṃ candrāya dvijānām oṣadhīnāṃ ca rājñe dattavān | satkāravacanam anyeṣām api putrikākaraṇe liṅgam | daśetyādi ca bahvīnām api putrikākaraṇajñāpakam || 9.129 ||
yathaivātmā tathā putraḥ putreṇa duhitā samā |
tasyām ātmani tiṣṭhantyāṃ katham anyo dhanaṃ haret || 9.130 ||
yathaiveti | ātmasthānīyaḥ putraḥ “ātmā vai putranāmāsi” (ĀśGṛ 1.15) iti mantraliṅgāt | tatsamā ca duhitā tasyā apy aṅgebhya utpādanāt | atas tasyāṃ putrikāyāṃ pitur ātmasvarūpāyāṃ vidyamānāyām aputrasya mṛtasya pitur dhanaṃ putrikāvyatiriktaḥ katham anyo haret || 9.130 ||
mātus tu yautakaṃ yat syāt kumārībhāga eva saḥ |
dauhitra eva ca hared aputrsyākhilaṃ dhanam || 9.131 ||
mātur iti | mātur yad dhanaṃ tat tasyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ kumārībhāga eva syān na putrāṇāṃ tatra bhāgaḥ | kumārī cānūḍhābhipretā | tathā gautamaḥ: “strīdhanaṃ duhitṝṇām adattānām apratiṣṭhitānāṃ ca | aputrasya ca mātāmahasya dauhitra eva prakṛtatvāt pautrikeyaḥ samagraṃ dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt” iti || 9.131 ||
dauhitro hy akhilaṃ riktham aputrasya pitur haret |
sa eva dadyād dvau piṇḍau pitre mātāmahāya ca || 9.132 ||
dauhitra iti | dauhitraḥ prakṛtatvāt pautrikeya eva, tasya mātāmahadhanagrahaṇam anantaroktam, janakadhanagrahaṇaṃ ca | piṇḍadānārtho ‘yam ārambhaḥ, pitṛśabdasya tatraiva prasiddhatvāt | anyasya pautrikeyaḥ putrāntararahitasya janakasya samagraṃ dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt sa eva pitṛmātāmahābhyāṃ dvau piṇḍau dadyāt | piṇḍadānaṃ śrāddhopalakṣaṇārtham | pautrikeyatvena janakadhanagrahaṇapiṇḍadānavyāmohanirāsārthaṃ vacanam || 9.132 ||
pautradauhitrayor loke na viśeṣo ‘sti dharmataḥ |
tayor hi mātāpitarau saṃbhūtau tasya dehataḥ || 9.133 ||
pautreti | pautrapautrikeyayor loke dharmakṛtye na kaścid viśeṣo ‘sti | yasmāt tayor mātāpitarau tasya dehād utpannāv iti pūrvasyaivānuvādaḥ || 9.133 ||
putrikāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tu yadi putro ‘nujāyate |
samas tatra vibhāgaḥ syāj jyeṣṭhatā nāsti hi striyāḥ || 9.134 ||
putrikāyām iti | kṛtāyāṃ putrikāyāṃ yadi tatkartuḥ putro ‘nantaraṃ jāyate tadā tayor vibhāgakāle samo vibhāgo bhavet | noddhāraḥ putrikāyai deyaḥ | yasmāj jyeṣṭhāyā api tasyā uddhāraviṣaye jyeṣṭhatā nādaraṇīyā || 9.134 ||
aputrāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ tu putrikāyāṃ kathaṃcana |
dhanaṃ tatputrikābhartā haretaivāvicārayan || 9.135 ||
aputrāyām iti | aputrāyāṃ putrikāyāṃ kathaṃca mṛtāyāṃ tadīyadhanaṃ tadbhartaivāvicārayan gṛhṇīyāt | putrikāyāḥ putrasamatvenānapatyasya patnīrahitasya mṛtaputrasya pitur dhanagrahaṇaprasaktau tannivāraṇārtham idaṃ vacanam || 9.135 ||
akṛtā vā kṛtā vāpi yaṃ vindet sadṛśāt sutam |
pautrī mātāmahas tena dadyāt piṇḍaṃ hared dhanam || 9.136 ||
akṛteti | akṛtā vā kṛtā veti putrikāyā eva dvaividhyaṃ, tatra “yad apatyaṃ bhaved asyāṃ tan mama syāt svadhākaram” (9.127) ity abhidhāya kanyādānakāle varānumatyā yā kriyate sā kṛtābhisaṃdhimātrakṛtā, vāgvyavahāreṇa na kṛtā | tathā gautamaḥ – “abhisaṃdhimātrāt putrikām ekeṣām” (GDh 29.5) iti | ata eva “putrikādharmaśaṅkayā” (3.11) iti prāg avivāhyatvam uktam | putrikeva kṛtākṛtā vā putraṃ samānajātīyād voḍhur utpādayet tena dauhitreṇa pautrakāryakaraṇāt pautrikeyavān mātāmahaḥ pautrī | tathā cāsau tasmai piṇḍaṃ dadyāt | govindarājas tu ‘akṛtā vā’ ity aputrikaiva duhitā tatputro ‘pi mātāmahadhane pautrikeya iva mātāmahyādisattve ‘py adhikārīty āha | tan na, putrikāyāḥ putratulyatvād aputrikātatputrayor atulyatvena tatputrayor tulyatvāyogyatvād iti || 9.136 ||
putreṇa lokāñ jayati pautreṇānantyam aśnute |
atha putrasya pautreṇa bradhnasyāpnoti viṣṭapam || 9.137 ||
putreṇeti | putreṇa jātena svargādilokān prāpnoti | pautreṇa teṣv eva cirakālam avatiṣthate | tadanantaraṃ putrasya pautreṇādityalokaṃ prāpnoti | asya ca dāyabhāgaprakaraṇe ‘bhidhānaṃ pitur dhane patnyādisadbhāve ‘pi putrasya tadabhāve pautrasyety evaṃ putrasantānādhikārabodhanārtham || 9.137 ||
punnāmno narakād yasmāt trāyate pitaraṃ sutaḥ |
tasmāt putra iti proktaḥ svayam eva svayaṃbhuvā || 9.138 ||
punnāmna iti | yasmāt punnāmadheyanarakāt sutaḥ pitaraṃ trāyate tasmāt trāṇād ātmanaiva brahmaṇā putra iti proktaḥ | tasmān mahopakārakatvāt putrasya yuktaṃ tadīyapuṃsantānasya dāyabhāgitvam iti pūrvadārḍhyārtham idam || 9.138 ||
pautradauhitrayor loke viśeṣo nopapadyate |
dauhitro ‘pi hy amutrainaṃ saṃtārayati pautravat || 9.139 ||
pautreti | dauhitraḥ putrikāputraḥ | putradauhitrayor loke kaścid viśeṣo na saṃbhāvyate, yasmād dauhitro ‘pi mātāmahaṃ paraloke pautravan nistārayati | etac ca pautrikeyasya pautreṇa sāmyapratipādanārthaṃ putrikākaraṇānantarajātaputreṇa saha dhane tulyabhāgabodhanārtham || 9.139 ||
mātuḥ prathamataḥ piṇḍaṃ nirvapet putrikāsutaḥ |
dvitīyaṃ tu pitus tasyās tṛtīyaṃ tatpituḥ pituḥ || 9.140 ||
mātur ityādi | pautrikeyaḥ prathamaṃ mātre piṇḍaṃ, dvitīyaṃ mātuḥ pitre, tṛtīyaṃ mātuḥ pitāmahāya dadyāt | pitrādīnāṃ tu “pitre mātāmahāya ca” (9.132) ity uktatvāt pitṛkrameṇaiva piṇḍadānam || 9.140 ||
upapanno guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ putro yasya tu dattrimaḥ |
sa haretaiva tadrikthaṃ saṃprāpto ‘py anyagotrataḥ || 9.141 ||
upapanna iti | “putrā rikthaharāḥ pituḥ” (9.185) iti dvādaśaputrāṇām eva rikthaharatvaṃ vakṣyati | “daśāpare tu kramaśaḥ” (9.165) ity aurasakṣetrajābhāve dattakasya pitū rikthaharatvaṃ prāptam eva | ataḥ saty apy aurasaputre dattakasya sarvaguṇopapannasya pitṛrikthabhāgaprāptyartham idaṃ vacanam | yasya dattakaḥ putro ‘dhyayanādisarvaguṇopapanno bhavati so ‘nyagotrād āgato ‘pi saty apy aurase pitṛrikthabhāgaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | atra “eka evaurasaḥ putraḥ pitryasya vasunaḥ prabhuḥ” (9.163) ity aurasasya sarvotkarṣābhidhānāt tena nāsya samabhāgitvaṃ kiṃ tu kṣetrajoktaṣaṣṭhabhāgitvam evāsya nyāyyam | govindarājas tv “aurasakṣetrajābhāve sarvaguṇopapannasyaiva dattakasya pitṛrikthabhāgitvārtham idaṃ vacanam” ity avocat | tan na, kṛtrimādīnāṃ nirguṇānāṃ pitṛrikthabhāgitvaṃ, dattakasya tu tatpūrvapaṭhitasyāpi sarvaguṇopapannasyaivety anyāyyatvāt
|| 9.141 ||
gotrarikthe janayitur na hared dattrimaḥ kvacit |
gotrarikthānugaḥ piṇḍo vyapaiti dadataḥ svadhā || 9.142 ||
gotreti | gotradhane janakasaṃbandhinī dattako na kadācit prāpnuyāt | piṇḍaś ca gotrarikthānugāmī yasya gotrarikthe bhajate tasyaiva sa piṇḍo dīyate, tasmāt putraṃ dadato janakasya svadhā piṇḍaśrāddhādi tatputrakartṛkaṃ nivartate || 9.142 ||
aniyuktāsutaś caiva putriṇyāptaś ca devarāt |
ubhau tau nārhato bhāgaṃ jārajātakakāmajau || 9.143 ||
aniyukteti | yo gurvādiniyogaṃ vinā jāto yaś ca saputrāyā niyogenāpi devarādeḥ kāmād utpāditas tāv ubhau krameṇa jārotpannakāmābhilāṣajau dhanabhāgaṃ nārhataḥ || 9.143 ||
niyuktāyām api pumān nāryāṃ jāto ‘vidhānataḥ |
naivārhaḥ paitṛkaṃ rikthaṃ patitotpādito hi saḥ || 9.144 ||
niyuktāyām iti | niyuktāyām api striyāṃ ghṛtābhyaktatvādiniyogetikartavyatāṃ vinā putro jātaḥ sa kṣetrikasya pitur dhanaṃ labdhuṃ nārhati | yasmād asau patitenotpāditaḥ, “niyuktau yau vidhiṃ hitvā” (9.63) ity anena patitasyoktatvāt || 9.144 ||
haret tatra niyuktāyāṃ jātaḥ putro yathaurasaḥ |
kṣetrikasya tu tad bījaṃ dharmataḥ prasavaś ca saḥ || 9.145 ||
hared iti | tatra niyuktāyāṃ yo jātaḥ kṣetrajaḥ putra aurasa iva dhanaṃ haret | yasmāt tat tasya kāraṇabhūtaṃ bījaṃ tat kṣetrasvāmina eva, tatkāryakaraṇatvāt | apatyam api ca dharmatas tadīyaṃ tat “yavīyāñ jyeṣṭhabhāryāyāṃ putram utpādayed yadi” (9.120) ity anena kṣetrajasya pitāmahadhane pitṛvyena saha samabhāgasya proktatvāt | guṇavataḥ kṣetrajasya aurasavat svoddhārabhāgaprāptyartham idam aurasatulyatvābhidhānam || 9.145 ||
dhanaṃ yo bibhṛyād bhrātur mṛtasya striyam eva ca |
so ‘patyaṃ bhrātur utpādya dadyāt tasyaiva tad dhanam || 9.146 ||
dhanam iti | yo mṛtasya bhrātuḥ sthāvarajaṅgamaṃ dhanaṃ patnyā rakṣaṇākṣamayā samarpitaṃ rakṣet tāṃ ca puṣṇīyāt sa niyogadharmeṇa tasyām utpāditasya bhrātur apatyasya dadyāt | etac ca “dhanaṃ yo bibhṛyād bhrātuḥ”ity abhidhānād vibhaktabhrātṛviṣayam, “yavīyāñ jyeṣṭhabhāryāyām” (9.120) iti samabhāgābhidhānāt || 9.146 ||
yā niyuktānyataḥ putraṃ devarād vāpy avāpnuyāt |
taṃ kāmajam arikthīyaṃ vṛthotpannaṃ pracakṣate || 9.147 ||
yeti | yā strī gurvādibhir anujñātā devarād vānyato vā sapiṇḍāt putram utpādayet sa yadi kāmajo bhavati tadā tam arikthabhājaṃ manvādayo vadanti | akāmaja eva rikthabhāgī | sa ca vyāhṛto nāradena:
mukhān mukhaṃ pariharan gātrair gātrāṇy asaṃspṛśan |
kule tadavaśeṣe ca santānārthaṃ na kāmataḥ || iti |
|| 9.147 ||
etad vidhānaṃ vijñeyaṃ vibhāgasyaikayoniṣu |
bahvīṣu caikajātānāṃ nānāstrīṣu nibodhata || 9.148 ||
etad iti | samānajātīyāsu bhāryāsu ekena bhartrā jātānām eṣa vibhāgavidhir boddhavyaḥ | idānīṃ nānājātīyāsu strīṣu bahvīṣūtpannānāṃ putrāṇāṃ vibhāgaṃ śṛṇuta || 9.148 ||
brāhmaṇasyānupūrvyeṇa catasras tu yadi striyaḥ |
tāsāṃ putreṣu jāteṣu vibhāge ‘yaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 9.149 ||
brāhmaṇasyeti | brāhmaṇasya yadi krameṇa brāhmaṇyādyāś catasro bhāryā bhaveyus tadā tāsāṃ putreṣūtpanneṣv ayaṃ vakṣyamāṇo vibhāgavidhir manvādibhir uktaḥ || 9.149 ||
kīnāśo govṛṣo yānam alaṃkāraś ca veśma ca |
viprasyauddhārikaṃ deyam ekāṃśaś ca pradhānataḥ || 9.150 ||
kīnāśa iti | kīnāśaḥ karṣakaḥ, gavāṃ sektā vṛṣaḥ, yānam aśvādi, alaṃkāro ‘ṅgulīyakādi, veśma gṛhaṃ ca pradhānaṃ, yāvantaś cāṃśās teṣv ekaḥ pradhānabhūto ‘ṃśa ity etad brāhmaṇīputrasyoddhārārthaṃ deyam | avaśiṣṭaṃ vakṣyamāṇarītyā vibhajanīyam || 9.150 ||
tryaṃśaṃ dāyād dhared vipro dvāv aṃśau kṣatriyāsutaḥ |
vaiśyājaḥ sārdham evāṃśam aṃśaṃ śūdrāsuto haret || 9.151 ||
tryaṃśam ityādi | trīn aṃśān brāḥmaṇo dhanād gṛhṇīyāt | dvau kṣatriyāputraḥ | sārdhaṃ vaiśyāputraḥ | aṃśaṃ śūdrāsutaḥ | evaṃ ca yatra brāhmaṇīkṣatriyāputrau dvāv eva vidyete tatra pañcadhā kṛte dhane trayo bhāgā brāhmaṇasya, dvau kṣatriyāputrasya | anayaiva diśā brāḥmaṇīvaiśyāputrādau dvibahuputrādau ca kalpanā kāryā || 9.151 ||
sarvaṃ vā rikthajātaṃ tad daśadhā parikalpya ca |
dharmyaṃ vibhāgaṃ kurvīta vidhinānena dharmavit || 9.152 ||
sarvam iti | yad vā sarvaṃ rikthaprakāram anuddhṛtoddhāraṃ daśadhā kṛtvā, vibhāgadharmajño dharmād anapetaṃ vibhāgam anena vakṣyamāṇavidhinā kurvīta || 9.152 ||
caturo ‘ṃśān hared vipras trīn aṃśān kṣatriyāsutaḥ |
vaiśyāputro hared dvyaṃśam aṃśaṃ śūdrāsuto haret || 9.153 ||
catura iti | caturo bhāgān brāhmaṇo gṛhṇīyāt | trīn kṣatriyāputraḥ | dvau vaiśyāputraḥ | ekaṃ śūdrājaḥ | atrāpi brāhmaṇīkṣatriyāputrasadbhāve saptadhā dhane kṛte catvāro bhāgā brāhmaṇasya | trayaḥ kṣatriyāputrasya | evaṃ brāhmaṇīvaiśyāputrādau dvibahuputreṣu ca kalpanā kāryā || 9.153 ||
yady api syāt tu satputro ‘py asatputro ‘pi vā bhavet |
nādhikaṃ daśamād dadyāc chūdrāputrāya dharmataḥ || 9.154 ||
yady apīti | yadi brāhmaṇo dvijātistrīṣu sarvāsu vidyamānaputraḥ syād avidyamānaputro vā tathāpi śūdrāputrāyānantarādhikārī yas teṣu daśamabhāgādhikaṃ dharmato na dadyāt | evaṃ ca śūdrāputraviṣaye niṣedhād avidyamānasajātiputrasya kṣatriyāvaiśyāputrau sarvarikthaharau syātām || 9.154 ||
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāputro na rikthabhāk |
yad evāsya pitā dadyāt tad evāsya dhanaṃ bhavet || 9.155 ||
brāhmaṇeti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ śūdrāputro dhanabhāṅ na bhavati, kiṃ tu yad eva dhanam asmai pitā dadyāt tad eva tasya bhavet | evaṃ ca pūrvoktavibhāganiṣedhād vikalpaḥ, sa ca guṇavadaguṇāpekṣaḥ | atha vā anūḍhaśūdrāputraviṣayo ‘yaṃ daśamabhāganiṣedhaḥ
|| 9.155 ||
samavarṇāsu ye jātāḥ sarve putrā dvijanmanām |
uddhāraṃ jyāyase datvā bhajerann itare samam || 9.156 ||
samavarṇāsv iti | dvijātīnāṃ samānajātibhāryāsu ye putrā jātās te sarve jyeṣṭhāyoddhāraṃ datvāvaśiṣṭaṃ samabhāgaṃ kṛtvā jyeṣṭhena sahānye vibhajeran || 9.156 ||
śūdrasya tu savarṇaiva nānyā bhāryā vidhīyate |
tasyāṃ jātāḥ samāṃśāḥ syur yadi putraśataṃ bhavet || 9.157 ||
śūdreti | śūdrasya punaḥ samānajātīyaiva bhāryopadiśyate notkṛṣṭāvakṛṣṭā vā | tasyāṃ ca ye jātās te yadi putraśatam api tadā samabhāgā eva bhaveyuḥ | tenoddhāraḥ kasyacin na deyaḥ
|| 9.157 ||
putrān dvādaś yān āha nṛṇāṃ svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ |
