teṣāṃ ṣaḍ bandhudāyādāḥ ṣaḍ adāyādabāndhavāḥ || 9.158 ||
putrān iti | yān dvādaś putrān hairaṇyagarbho manur āha teṣāṃ madhyād yāḥ ṣaḍ bāndhavāḥ gotradāyādāś ca, tasmād bāndhavatvena sapiṇḍasamānodakānāṃ piṇḍodakadānādi kurvany anantarābhāve ca gotradānaṃ gṛhṇanti | pitṛrikthabhāktvasya “putrā rikthaharāḥ pituḥ” (9.185) iti dvādaśavidhaputrāṇām eva vakṣyamāṇatvāt | uttare ṣaṭ na gotradhanaharā bhavanti | bāndhavās tu bhavanti, tataś ca bandhukāryam udakakriyādi kurvanti | medhātithis tu ‘ṣaḍ adāyādabāndhavāḥ’ ityādyuttaraṣaṭkasyādāyādatvam abāndhavatvaṃ cāha | tan na, baudhāyanena bandhutvasyābhihitatvāt | tad āha:
kānīnaṃ ca sahoḍhaṃ ca krītaṃ paunarbhavaṃ tathā |
svayaṃdattaṃ niṣādaṃ ca gotrabhājaḥ pracakṣate ||
|| 9.158 ||
aurasaḥ kṣetrajaś caiva kṛtrima eva ca |
gūḍhotpanno ‘paviddhaś ca dāyādā bāndhavāś ca ṣaṭ || 9.159 ||
aurasa iti | aurasādayo vakṣyamāṇāḥ ṣaḍ rikthabhājo bāndhavāś ca bhavanti || 9.159 ||
kānīnaś ca sahoḍhaś ca krītaḥ paunarbhavas tathā |
svayaṃdattaś ca śaudraś ca ṣaḍ adāyādabāndhavāḥ || 9.160 ||
kānīnaś ceti | kānīnādayo vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇāḥ ṣaḍ gotrariktaharā na bhavanti bhāndhavāś ca bhavantīti vyākhyātam || 9.160 ||
aurasena saha kṣetrajādīnāṃ pāṭhāt tulyatvāśaṅkāyāṃ tannirāsārtham āha –
yādṛśaṃ phalam āpnoti kuplavaiḥ saṃtarañ jalam |
tādṛśaṃ phalam āpnoti kuputraiḥ saṃtaraṃs tamaḥ || 9.161 ||
yādṛśam iti | tṛṇādinirmitakutsitoḍupādibhir udakaṃ taran yathāvidhaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti tathāvidham eva kuputraiḥ kṣetrajādibhiḥ pāralaukikaṃ duḥkhaṃ duruttaraṃ prāpnotīti | anena kṣetrajādīnāṃ mukhyaurasaputravat saṃpūrṇakāryakaraṇakṣamatvaṃ na bhavatīti darśitam || 9.161 ||
yady ekarikthinau syātām aurasakṣatrajau sutau |
yasya yat paitṛkaṃ rikthaṃ sa tad gṛhṇīta netaraḥ || 9.162 ||
yadīti |
aputreṇa parakṣetre niyogotpāditaḥ sutaḥ |
ubhayor apy asau rikthī piṇḍadātā ca dharmataḥ || (YDh 3.127)
iti yājñavalkyoktaviṣaye, yadā kṣetrikasya pituḥ kṣetrajānantaram aurasaḥ putro bhavati tadā tāv aurasakṣetrajāv ekarikthināv ekasya pitur yady apy rikthārhau bhavatas tathāpi yady asya janakasaṃbandhi tad eva sa gṛhṇīyān na kṣetrajaḥ kṣetrikapituḥ | yat tu vakṣyati (9.164),
ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu kṣetrajasyāṃśaṃ pradadyāt paitṛkād dhanāt |
auraso vibhajan dāyam
iti, tat putrabahulasya | yat tu yājñavalkyenobhayasaṃbandhirikthaharatvam uktaṃ tat kṣetrikapitur aurasaputrābhāve boddhavyam | medhātithi-govindarājau tu aurasam aniyuktāputraṃ ca viṣayīkṛtyemaṃ ślokaṃ vyācakṣate | tan na, aniyuktāputrasyākṣetrajatvāt, “aniyuktāsutaś ca” (9.143) ity anena tasya rikthagrahaṇaniṣedhāt, ‘yady ekarikthinau’ ity ananvayāc ca || 9.162 ||
eka evaurasaḥ putraḥ pitryasya vasunaḥ prabhuḥ |
śeṣāṇām ānṛśaṃsyārthaṃ pradadyāt tu prajīvanam || 9.163 ||
eka iti | vyādhyādina prathamaurasābhāve kṣetrajādiṣu kṛteṣu paścād auṣadhādinā vigatavyādher aurasa utpanne satīdam ucyate | aurasa evaikaḥ putraḥ pitṛdhanasvāmī | śeṣāṇāṃ kṣetrajavyatiriktānāṃ tasya ṣaṣṭhāṃśāder vakṣyamāṇatvāt pāpasaṃbandhaparihārārthaṃ grāsācchādanaṃ dadyāt || 9.163 ||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu kṣetrajasyāṃśaṃ pradadyāt paitṛkād dhanāt |
auraso vibhajan dāyaṃ pitryaṃ pañcamam eva vā || 9.164 ||
ṣaṣṭham iti | aurasaḥ putraḥ pitṛsaṃbandhi dāyaṃ vibhajan, kṣetrajasya ṣaṣṭham aṃśaṃ pañcamaṃ vā dadyāt | nirguṇasaguṇāpekṣaś cāyaṃ vikalpaḥ || 9.164 ||
aurasakṣetrajau putrau pitṛrikthasya bhāginau |
daśāpare tu kramaśo gotrarikthāṃśabhāginaḥ || 9.165 ||
auraseti | aurasakṣetrajau putrāv uktaprakāreṇa pitṛdhanaharau syātām | anye punar daśa dattakādayaḥ putrā gotrabhājo bhavanti, “pūrvābhāve paraḥ paraḥ” (YDh 3.132) ity evaṃ krameṇa dhanāṃśaharāś ca || 9.165 ||
svakṣetre saṃskṛtāyāṃ tu svayam utpādayed dhi yam |
tam aurasaṃ vijānīyāt putraṃ prathamakalpitam || 9.166 ||
svakṣetra iti | svabhāryāyāṃ kanyāvasthāyām eva kṛtavivāhasaṃskārāyāṃ yaṃ svayam utpādayet taṃ putram aurasaṃ mukhyaṃ vidyāt | “savarṇāyāṃ saṃskṛtāyām utpāditam aurasaputraṃ vidyāt” (BDh 2.2.14) iti baudhāyanadarśanāt sajātīyāyām eva svayam utpādita auraso jñeyaḥ || 9.166 ||
yas talpajaḥ pramītasya klībasya vyādhitasya vā |
svadharmeṇa niyuktāyāṃ sa putraḥ kṣetrajaḥ smṛtaḥ || 9.167 ||
ya iti | yo mṛtasya napuṃsakasya prasavavirodhivyādhyupetasya vā bhāryāyāṃ ghṛtāktavattvādiniyogadharmeṇa guruniyuktāyāṃ jātaḥ sa kṣetrajaḥ putro manvādibhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 9.167 ||
mātā pitā vā dadyātāṃ yam adbhiḥ putram āpadi |
sadṛśaṃ prītisaṃyuktaṃ sa jñeyo dattrimaḥ sutaḥ || 9.168 ||
māteti | “śukraśoṇitasaṃbhavaḥ puruṣo mātāpitṛnimittakas tasya pradānavikrayaparityāgeṣu mātāpitarau prabhavataḥ” (VaDh 15.1) iti vasiṣṭhasmaraṇāt mātā pitā vā parasparānujñayā yaṃ putraṃ parigrahītuḥ samānajātīyaṃ tasyaiva putrābhāvanimittāyām āpadi prītiyuktaṃ na tu bhayādinā udakapūrvaṃ dadyāt sa dattrimākhyaḥ putro vijñeyaḥ || 9.168 ||
sadṛśaṃ tu prakuryād yaṃ guṇadoṣavicakṣaṇam |
putraṃ putraguṇair yuktaṃ na vijñeyaś ca kṛtrimaḥ || 9.169 ||
sadṛśam iti | yaṃ punaḥ samānajātīyaṃ pitroḥ pāralaukikaśrāddhādikaraṇākaraṇābhyāṃ guṇadoṣau bhavata ity evamādijñaṃ, putraguṇaiś ca mātāpitror ārādhanādiyuktaṃ putraṃ kuryāt sa kṛtrimākhyaḥ putro vācyaḥ || 9.169 ||
utpadyate gṛhe yasya na ca jñāyeta kasya saḥ |
sa gṛhe gūḍha utpannas tasya syād yasya talpajaḥ || 9.170 ||
utpadyate iti | yasya gṛhe ‘vasthitāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ putra utpadyate, sajātīyo ‘yaṃ bhavatīti jñāne ‘pi kasmāt puruṣaviśeṣāj jāto ‘sāv iti na jñāyate sa gṛhe ‘prakāśam utpannas tasya putraḥ syād yadīyāyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ jātaḥ || 9.170 ||
mātāpitṛbhyām utsṛṣṭaṃ tayor anyatareṇa vā |
taṃ putraṃ parigṛhṇīyād apaviddhaḥ sa ucyate || 9.171 ||
māteti | mātāpitṛbhyāṃ tyaktaṃ, tayor anyataramaraṇenānyatareṇa vā tyaktaṃ putraṃ svīkuryāt so ‘paviddhākhyaḥ putra ucyate || 9.171 ||
pitṛveśmani kanyā tu yaṃ putraṃ janayed rahaḥ |
taṃ kānīnaṃ vaden nāmnā voḍhuḥ kanyāsamudbhavam || 9.172 ||
pitṛveśmanīti | pitṛgṛhe kanyā yaṃ putram aprakāśaṃ janayet taṃ kanyāpariṇetuḥ putraṃ nāmnā kānīnaṃ vadet || 9.172 ||
yā garbhiṇī saṃskriyate jñātājñātāpi vā satī |
voḍhuḥ sa garbho bhavati sahoḍha iti cocyate || 9.173 ||
yeti | yā garbhavatī ajñātagarbhā jñātagarbhā vā pariṇīyate, sa garbhas tasyāṃ jātaḥ pariṇetuḥ putro bhavati sahoḍha iti ca vyapadiśyate || 9.173 ||
krīṇīyād yas tv apatyārthaṃ mātāpitror yam antikāt |
sa krītakaḥ sutas tasya sadṛśo ‘sadṛśo ‘pi vā || 9.174 ||
krīṇīyād iti | yaḥ putrārthaṃ mātāpitroḥ sakāśād yaṃ krīṇīyāt sa krītakas tasya putro bhavati | kretur guṇais tulyo hīno vā bhaven na tatra jātitaḥ sādrśyavaisādṛśye | “sajātīyeṣv ayaṃ proktas tanayeṣu mayā vidhiḥ” (YDh 3.133) iti yājñavalkyena sarveṣām eva putrāṇāṃ sajātīyatvābhidhānatvena mānave ‘pi krītavyatiriktāḥ sarve putrāḥ sajātīyā boddhavyāḥ || 9.174 ||
yā patyā va parityaktā vidhavā vā svecchayā |
utpādeyet punar bhūtvā sa paunarbhava ucyate || 9.175 ||
yeti | yā bhartrā parityaktā mṛtabhartṛkā vā svecchayānyasya punar bhāryā bhūtvā yam utpādayet sa utpādakasya paunarbhavaḥ putra ucyate || 9.175 ||
sā ced akṣatayoniḥ syād gatapratyāgatāpi vā |
paunarbhavena bhartrā sā punaḥ saṃskāram arhati || 9.176 ||
sā ced iti | sā strī yady akṣatayoniḥ saty anyam āśrayet tadā tena paunarbhavena bhartrā punarvivāhākhyaṃ saṃskāram arhati | yad vā kaumāraṃ patim utsṛjyānyam āśritya punas tam eva pratyāgatā bhavati tadā tena kaumāreṇa bhartrā punarvivāhākhyaṃ saṃskāram arhati
|| 9.176 ||
mātāpitṛvihīno yas tyakto vā syād akāraṇāt |
ātmānaṃ sparśayed yasmai svayaṃdattas tu sa smṛtaḥ || 9.177 ||
māteti | yo mṛtamātāpitṛkas tyāgocitakāraṇaṃ vinā dveṣādinā tābhyāṃ tyakto vātmānaṃ yasmai dadāti sa svayaṃdattākhyas tasya putro manvādibhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 9.177 ||
yaṃ brāhmaṇas tu śūdrāyāṃ kāmād utpādayet sutam |
sa pārayann eva śavas tasmāt pāraśavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 9.178 ||
yam iti | “vinnāsv eṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ” (YDh 3.92) iti yājñavalkyadarśanāt pariṇītāyām eva śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kāmārthaṃ putraṃ janayet sa jīvann eva śavatulya iti pāraśavaḥ smṛtaḥ | yady apy ayaṃ pitrupakārārthaṃ śrāddhādi karoty eva tathāpy asaṃpūrṇopakārakatvāc chavavyapadeśaḥ || 9.178 ||
dāsyāṃ vā dāsadāsyāṃ vā yaḥ śūdrasya suto bhavet |
so ‘nujñāto hared aṃśam iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || 9.179 ||
dāsyām iti | dhvajāhṛtādyuktalakṣaṇāyāṃ dāsyāṃ, dāsasaṃbandhinyāṃ vā dāsyāṃ śūdrasya yaḥ putro jāyate sa ‘pitrānujñātapariṇītāputraiḥ samāṃśabhāgo bhavān bhavatu’ ity anujñātas tulyabhāgaṃ labhata iti śāstravyavasthā niyatā || 9.179 ||
kṣetrajādīn sutān etān ekādaśa yathoditān |
putrapratinidhīn āhuḥ kriyālopān manīṣiṇaḥ || 9.180 ||
kṣetrajātīn iti | etān kṣetrajādīn ekādaśa putrān, putrotpādanavidhilopaḥ putrakartavyaśrāddhādilopaś ca mā bhūd ity evamarthaṃ putrapraticchandakān munaya āhuḥ
|| 9.180 ||
ya ete ‘bhihitāḥ putrāḥ prasaṅgād anyabījajāḥ |
yasya te bījato jātas tasya te netarasya tu || 9.181 ||
ya iti | ya ete kṣetrajādayo ‘nyabījotpannāḥ putrā aurasaputraprasaṅgenoktās te yadbījotpannās tasyaiva putrā bhavanti na kṣetrikāder iti saty aurase putre putrikāyāṃ ca satyāṃ na te kartavyā ity evaṃparam, idam ‘anyabījajāḥ’ ity ekādaśaputropalakṣaṇārtham | svabījajātāv api paunarbhavaśaudrau na kartavyau | ata eva vṛddha-bṛhaspatiḥ –
ājyaṃ vinā yathā tailaṃ sadbhiḥ pratinidhiḥ smṛtaḥ |
tathaikādaśa putrās tu putrikāurasayor vinā ||
|| 9.181 ||
bhrātṝṇām ekajātānām ekaś cet putravān bhavet |
sarvāṃs tāṃs tena putreṇa putriṇo manur abravīt || 9.182 ||
bhrātṝṇām iti | bhrātṝṇām ekamātāpitṛkāṇāṃ madhye yady ekaḥ putravān syād anye ca putrarahitās tadā tenaikaputreṇa sarvān bhrātṝn saputrān manur āha | tataś ca tasmin saty anye putrapratinidhayo na kartavyāḥ | sa eva piṇḍado ‘ṃśaharaś ca bhavatīty anenoktam | etac ca “
patnī duhitaraś caiva pitarau bhrātaras tathā |
tatsutāḥ | (YDh 3.135)
iti yājñavalkyavacanād bhrātṛparyantābhāve boddhavyam || 9.182 ||
sarvāsām ekapatnīnām ekā cet putriṇī bhavet |
sarvās tās tena putreṇa prāha putravatīr manuḥ || 9.183 ||
sarvāsām iti | ekapatnīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ strīṇāṃ madhye yady ekā putravatī syāt tadā tena putreṇa sarvās tāḥ putrayuktā manur āha | tataś ca sapatnīputre sati striyā na dattakādiputrāḥ kartavyā ity etadartham idam || 9.183 ||
śreyasaḥ śreyaso ‘lābhe pāpīyān riktham arhati |
bahavaś cet tu sadṛśaḥ sarve riktasya bhāginaḥ || 9.184 ||
śreyasa iti | aurasādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ putrāṇāṃ prakṛtatvād aurasādīn upakramya teṣāṃ pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ śreyān sa eva dāyaharaḥ, “sa cānyān bibhṛyāt” iti viṣṇuvacanāt | aurasādīnāṃ putrāṇāṃ pūrvapūrvabhāve paraḥ paro riktham arhati | pūrvasadbhāve parasaṃvardhanaṃ sa eva kuryāt | evaṃ ca siddhe śūdrāputrasya dvādaśaputramadhye pāṭhaḥ kṣetrajādisadbhāve dhanānarhatvajñapanārthatvena sādhakaḥ | anyathā tu kṣatriyāvaiśyāputravad aurasatvāt kṣetrajādisadbhāve ‘pi dhanaṃ labhet, pūrvasya parasaṃvardhanamātraṃ cāpavādetaraviṣaye draṣṭavyam | kṣetrajaguṇavaddattakaputrayoḥ pañcamaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vā bhāgam auraso dadyād iti vihitatvāt | yadi tu samānarūpāḥ paunarbhavādayo bahavaḥ putrās tadā sarva eva vibhajya rikthaṃ gṛhṇīyuḥ || 9.184 ||
na bhrātaro na pitaraḥ putrā rikthaharāḥ pituḥ |
pitā hared aputrasya rikthaṃ bhrātara eva ca || 9.185 ||
neti | na sodarabhrātaraḥ, na pitaraḥ, kiṃ tu aurasābhāve kṣetrajādayo gauṇaputrāḥ pitṛrikthaharā bhavantīty anenocyate, aurasasya tu “eka evaurasaḥ putraḥ” (9.163) ity anenaiva siddhatvāt | avidyamānamukhyaputrasya patnīduhitṛrahitasya ca pitā dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt teṣāṃ mātuś cābhāve na bhrātaro dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyuḥ | etac cānantaraṃ prapañcayiṣyāmaḥ || 9.185 ||
idānīṃ kṣetrajānām apy aputrapitāmahādidhane ‘py adhikāraṃ darśayitum āha –
trayāṇām udakaṃ kāryaṃ triṣu piṇḍaḥ pravartate |
caturthaḥ saṃpradātaiṣāṃ pañcamo nopapadyate || 9.186 ||
[asutās tu pituḥ patnyaḥ samānāṃśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
pitāmahaś ca tāḥ sarvā mātṛkalpāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || ]
trayāṇām iti | trayāṇāṃ pitrādīnām udakadānaṃ kāryaṃ, tribhya eva ca tebhyaḥ piṇḍo deyaḥ | caturthaś ca piṇḍodakayor dāta | pañcamasyātra saṃbandho nāśti | tasmād yukto ‘putrapitāmahādidhane gauṇapautrāṇām adhikāraḥ | aurasaputrapautrayoś ca “putreṇa lokāñ jayati” (9.137) ity anenaivātra pitāmahādidhanabhāgitvam uktam || 9.186 ||
anantaraḥ sapinḍād yas tasya tasya dhanaṃ bhavet |
ata ūrdhvaṃ sakulyaḥ syād ācāryaḥ śiṣya eva vā || 9.187 ||
anantara iti | asya sāmānyavacanasyoktaurasādipiṇḍamātraviṣayatve vaiyarthyāt tataś cānuktapatnyādidāyaprāptyartham idam | sapiṇḍamadhyāt saṃnikṛṣṭataro yaḥ sapiṇḍaḥ pumān strī vā tasya mṛtadhanaṃ bhavati | tatra “eka evaurasaḥ putraḥ” (9.163) ity uktatvāt sa eva mṛtadhane svādhikārī | kṣetrajaguṇavaddattakayos tu yathoktaṃ pañcamaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vā bhāgaṃ dadyāt | kṛtrimādiputrāṇāṃ saṃvardhanamātraṃ kuryāt | aurasābhāve putrikā tatputraś ca “dauhitra eva ca hard aputrasyākhilaṃ dhanam” (9.137) ity uktatvād aurasaputrarahita eva tatrāputro vivakṣitaḥ | tadabhāve kṣetrajādaya ekādaśa putrāḥ krameṇa pitṛdhanādhikāriṇaḥ | pariṇītaśūdrāputras tu daśamabhāgamātrādhikārī “nādhikaṃ daśamād dadyāc chūdrāputrāya” (9.154) ityādyuktatvāt | daśamabhāgāvaśiṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ saṃnikṛṣṭasapiṇḍo gṛhṇīyāt | trayodaśavidhaputrābhāve patnī sarvabhartṛdhanabhāginī | yad āha yājñavalkyaḥ |
patnī duhitaraś caiva pitarau bhrātaras tathā |
tatsuto gotrajo bandhuḥ śiṣyaḥ sabrahmacāriṇaḥ ||
eṣām abhāve pūrvasya dhanabhāg uttarottaraḥ |
svaryātasya hy aputrasya sarvavarṇeṣv ayaṃ vidhiḥ || (YDh 2.135–136)
bṛhaspatir apy āha |
āmnāye smṛtitantre ca lokācāre ca sūribhiḥ |
śarīrārdhaṃ smṛtā jāyā puṇyāpuṇyaphale samā ||
yasya noparatā bhāryā dehārdhaṃ tasya jīvati |
jīvaty ardhaśarīre tu katham anyaḥ svam āpnuyāt ||
sakulyair vidyamānais tu pitṛmātṛsanābhibhiḥ |
aputrasya pramītasya patnī tadbhāgahāriṇī ||
pūrvapramītāgnihotraṃ mṛte bhartari taddhanam |
vindet pativratā nārī dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ||
jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ hema kupyaṃ dhānyam athāmbaram |
ādāya dāpayec chrāddhaṃ māsaṣāṇmāsikādikam ||
pitṛvyagurudauhitrān bhartṛsvasrīyamātulān |
pūjayet kavyapūrtābhyāṃ vṛddhān apy atithīn striyaḥ ||
tatsapiṇḍā bāndhavā vā ye tasyāḥ paripanthinaḥ |
hiṃsyur dhanāni tān rājā cauradaṇḍena śāsayet ||
vṛddha-manuḥ |
aputrā śayanaṃ bhartuḥ pālayantī vrate sthitā |
patny eva dadyāt tatpiṇḍaṃ kṛtsnam arthaṃ labhet ca ||
yad uktam “strīṇāṃ tu jīvanaṃ dadyāt” iti saṃvardhanamātravacanaṃ, tad duḥśīlādhārmikasavikārayauvanasthapatnīviṣayam | ato yan medhātithinā patnīnām aṃśabhāgitvaṃ niṣiddham uktaṃ tad asaṃbaddham |
patnīnām aṃśabhāgitvaṃ bṛhaspatyādisaṃmatam |
medhātithir nirākurvan na prīṇāti satāṃ manaḥ ||
patnyabhāve ‘py aputrikā duhitā, tadabhāve pitā mātā ca, tayor abhāve sodaryabhrātā, tadabhāve tatsutāḥ, “mātary api ca vṛttāyāṃ pitur mātā hard dhanam” (9.217) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | pitṛmātā tadabhāve ‘nyo saṃnikṛṣṭasapiṇḍo mṛtadhanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tad yathā – pitāmahasaṃtāne ‘vidyamāne prapitāmahasaṃtāna eva | tad apy ayuktam | ata ūrdhvaṃ sapiṇḍisaṃtānābhāve samānodaka ācāryaḥ śiṣyaś ca krameṇa dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt || 9.187 ||
sarveṣām apy abhāve tu brāhmaṇā rikthabhāginaḥ |
traividyāḥ śucayo dāntās tathā dharmo na hīyate || 9.188 ||
sarveṣām iti | eṣām abhāva iti vaktavye sarveṣām abhāva iti yad uktaṃ tat sabrahmacāryāder api dhanahāritvārtham | sarveṣām abhāve brāhmaṇā vedatrayādhyāyino bāhyāntaraśaucayuktā jitendriyā dhanahāriṇo bhavanti, ta eva ca piṇḍadāḥ, tathā sati dhanino mṛtasya śrāddhādidharmahānir na bhavati || 9.188 ||
ahāryaṃ brāhmaṇadravyaṃ rājñā nityam iti sthitiḥ |
itareṣāṃ tu varṇānāṃ sarvābhāve haren nṛpaḥ || 9.189 ||
ahāryam iti | brāḥmaṇasaṃbandhi dhanaṃ na rājñā kadācid grāhyam iti śāstramaryādā | kiṃ tūktalakṣaṇabrāhmaṇābhāve brāhmaṇamātrebhyo ‘pi deyam | kṣatriyādidhanaṃ punaḥ pūrvoktarikthaharābhāve rājā gṛhṇīyāt || 9.189 ||
saṃsthitasyānapatyasya sagotrāt putram āharet |
tatra yad riktajātaṃ syāt tat tasmin pratipādayet || 9.190 ||
saṃsthitasyeti | anapatyasya mṛtasya bhāryā samānagotrāt puṃso guruniyuktā satī niyogadharmeṇa putram utpādayet | tasmin mṛtaviṣaye yad dhanajātaṃ bhavet tat tasmin putre samarpayet, “devarād vā sapiṇḍād vā” (9.59) ity uktatvāt | sagotrān niyogaprāptyarthaṃ tajjasya ca rikthabhāgitvārtham idam || 9.190 ||
dvau tu yau vivadeyātāṃ dvābhyāṃ jātau striyā dhane |
tayor yad yasya pitryaṃ syāt tat sa gṛhṇīta netaraḥ || 9.191 ||
dvāv iti | “yady ekarikthinau syātām” (9.162) ity aurasakṣetrajayor uktam, idaṃ tv auradapaunarbhavaviṣayam | yadotpannaurasabhartur mṛtatvād bālāpatyatayā svāmidhanaṃ svīkṛtya paunarbhavabhartuḥ sakāśāt putrāntaraṃ janayet tasyāpi ca paunarbhavasya bhartur mṛtatvād rikthaharāntarābhāvād dhanaṃ gṛhītavatī, paścāt tau dvābhyāṃ jātau yadi vivadeyātāṃ strīhastagatadhane tadā tayor yasya yajjanakasya dhanaṃ sa tad eva gṛhṇīyān na tv anyapitṛjo ‘nyajanakasya || 9.191 ||
jananyāṃ saṃsthitāyāṃ tu samaṃ sarve sahodarāḥ |
bhajeran mātṛkaṃ rikthaṃ bhaginyaś ca sanābhayaḥ || 9.192 ||
jananyām iti | mātari mṛtāyāṃ sodaryabhrātaro bhaginyaś ca sodaryā anūḍhā mātṛdhanaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā gṛhṇīyuḥ | ūḍhās tu dhanānurūpaṃ saṃmānaṃ labhante | tad āha bṛhaspatiḥ |
strīdhanaṃ syād apatyānāṃ duhitā ca tadaṃśinī |
aputrā cet samūḍhā tu labhate mānamātrakam ||
tataś cānūḍhānāṃ pitṛdhana ivoḍhānāṃ mātṛdhanaṃ bhrātrā svād aṃśāc caturthabhāgo deyaḥ
|| 9.192 ||
yās tāsāṃ syur duhitaras tāsām api yathārhataḥ |
mātāmahyā dhanāt kiṃcit pradeyaṃ prītipūrvakam || 9.193 ||
yā iti | tāsāṃ duhitṝṇāṃ yā anūḍhā duhitaras tābhyo ‘pi mātāmahīdhanād yathā tāsāṃ pūjā bhavati tathā prītyā kiṃcid dātavyam || 9.193 ||
adhyagny adhyāvāhanikaṃ dattaṃ ca prītikarmaṇi |
bhrātṛmātṛpitṛprāptaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ strīdhanaṃ smṛtam || 9.194 ||
adhyagnīti | adhyagnīti “avyayaṃ vibhaktisamīpa-“ (Pāṇ 2.1.6) ityādisūtreṇa samīpārthe ‘avayībhāvaḥ | vivāhakāle ‘gnisaṃnidhau yat pitrādidattaṃ tad adhyagni strīdhanam | tad āha kātyāyanaḥ |
vivāhakāle yat strībhyo dīyate hy agnisaṃnidhau |
tad adhyagnikṛtaṃ sadbhiḥ strīdhanaṃ parikīrtitam ||
yat tu pitṛgṛhād bhartur gṛhaṃ nīyamānayā labdhaṃ tad adhyāvāhanikam | tathā ca kātyāyanaḥ |
yat punar labhate nārī nīyamānā tu paitṛkāt |
adhyāvāhanikaṃ nāma tat strīdhanam udāhṛtam ||
yat tu prītihetukarmaṇi bhartrādidattaṃ tathā pitrā ca samayāntare yad dattam evaṃ ṣaṭprakārakaṃ strīdhanaṃ smṛtam || 9.194 ||
anvādheyaṃ ca yad dattaṃ patyā prītena caiva yat |
patyau jīvati vṛttāyāḥ prajāyās tad dhanaṃ bhavet || 9.195 ||
anvādheyam iti | anvādheyaṃ vyākhyātaṃ kātyāyanena |
vivāhāt parato yat tu labdhaṃ bhartṛkule striyā |
anvādheyaṃ tad uktaṃ tu sarvabandhukule tathā ||
vivāhād ūrdhvaṃ bhartṛkule pitṛkule vā yat striyā labdhaṃ bhartrā ca prītena dattaṃ yad adhyagnyādi pūrvaśloke uktaṃ tad bhartari jīvati mṛtāyāḥ striyāḥ sarvadhanaṃ tad apatyānāṃ bhavati || 9.195 ||
brāhmadaivārṣagāndharvaprājāpatyeṣu yad vasu |
aprajāyām atītāyāṃ bhartur eva tad iṣyate || 9.196 ||
brāhmeti | brāhmādiṣu pañcasu vivāheṣūktalakṣaṇeṣu yat striyaḥ ṣavidhaṃ dhanaṃ tad anapatyāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ bhartur eva manvādibhir iṣyate || 9.196 ||
yat tv asyāḥ syād dhanaṃ dattaṃ vivāheṣv āsurādiṣu |
aprajāyām atītāyāṃ mātāpitros tad iṣyate || 9.197 ||
yad iti | yat punaḥ striyā āsurarākṣasapaiśāceṣūktalakṣaṇeṣu vivāheṣu yat striyāḥ ṣaḍvidhaṃ dhanam api tad anapatyāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ mātāpitror iṣyate || 9.197 ||
striyāṃ tu yad bhaved dattaṃ pitrā dattaṃ kathaṃcana |
brāhmaṇī tad dharet kanyā tadapatyasya vā bhavet || 9.198 ||
striyām iti | brāhmaṇasya nānājātīyāsu strīṣu kṣatriyādistriyām anapatyapatikāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ, tasyāḥ pitṛdattaṃ dhanaṃ sajātivijātisāpatnyakanyāputrasadbhāve ‘pi brāhmaṇī sāpatneyī kanyā gṛhṇīyāt | tadabhāve tadapatyasya taddhanaṃ bhavet || 9.198 ||
na nirhāraṃ striyaḥ kuryuḥ kuṭumbād bahumadhyagāt |
svakād api ca vittād dhi svasya bhartur anājñayā || 9.199 ||
neti | bhrātrādibahusādhāraṇāt kuṭumbadhanād bhāryādibhiḥ strībhī ratnālaṃkārādyarthaṃ dhanasaṃcayaṃ na kartavyam | nāpi ca bhartur ājñāṃ vinā bhartṛdhanād api kāryam | tataś ca nedaṃ strīdhanam || 9.199 ||
patyau jīvati yaḥ strībhir alaṃkāro dhṛto bhavet |
na taṃ bhajeran dāyādā bhajamānāḥ patanti te || 9.200 ||
patyāv ityādi | bhartari jīvati tatsaṃmatābhir yo ‘laṃkāraḥ strībhir dhṛtas tasmin mṛte vibhāgakāle taṃ putrādayo na bhajeran | bhajamānāḥ pāpino bhavanti || 9.200 ||
anaṃśau klībapatitau jātyandhabadhirau tathā |
unmattajaḍamūkāś ca ye ca kecin nirindriyāḥ || 9.201 ||
anaṃśāv iti | napuṃsakapatitajātyandhaśrotravikalonmattajaḍamūkāś ca ye ca kuṇipaṅgvādayo vikalendriyās te pitrādidhanaharā na bhavanti | kiṃ tu grāsācchādanabhāginaḥ
|| 9.201 ||
tad evāha –
sarveṣām api tu nyāyyaṃ dātuṃ śaktyā manīṣiṇā |
grāsācchādanam atyantaṃ patito hy adadad bhavet || 9.202 ||
sarveṣām iti | sarveṣām eṣāṃ klībādīnāṃ śāstrajñena rikthahāriṇā yāvajjīvaṃ svaśaktyā grāsācchādanaṃ deyam | adadat pāpī syāt || 9.202 ||
yady arthitā tu dāraiḥ syāt klībādīnāṃ kathaṃcana |
teṣām utpannatantūnām apatyaṃ dāyam arhati || 9.203 ||
yadīti | ‘kathaṃcana’ ity abhidhānāt klībādayo vivāhānarhā iti sūcitam | yadi kathaṃcid eṣāṃ vivāhecchā bhavet tadā klībasya kṣetraja utpanne ‘nyeṣām utpannāpatyānām apatyaṃ dhanabhāg bhavati || 9.203 ||
yat kiṃcit pitari prete dhanaṃ jyeṣṭho ‘dhigacchati |
bhāgo yavīyasāṃ tatra yadi vidyānupālinaḥ || 9.204 ||
yat kiṃcid iti | pitari mṛte sati bhrātṛbhiḥ sahāvibhakto jyeṣṭhaḥ kiṃcit svena pauruṣeṇa dhanaṃ labhate | tato dhanād vidyābhyāsavatāṃ kaniṣṭhabhrātṝṇāṃ bhāgo bhavati netareṣām
|| 9.204 ||
avidyānāṃ tu sarveṣām īhātaś ced dhanaṃ bhavet |
samas tatra vibhāgaḥ syād apitrya iti dhāraṇā || 9.205 ||
avidyānām iti | sarveṣāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ kṛṣivāṇijyādiceṣṭayā yadi dhanaṃ syāt tadā pitryavarjite tasmin dhane svārjite samo vibhāgaḥ syān na tūddhāro ‘pitrya iti niścayaḥ || 9.205 ||
vidyādhanaṃ tu yad yasya at tasyaiva dhanaṃ bhavet |
maitryam audvāhikaṃ caiva mādhuparkikam eva ca || 9.206 ||
vidyādhanam iti | vidyāmaitrīvivāhārjitaṃ mādhuparkikaṃ madhuparkadānakāle pūjyatayā yal labdhaṃ tasyaiva tat syāt | “yat kiṃcit pitari” (9.204) ity uktvāyam apavādaḥ | vidyādhanaṃ ca vyāhṛtaṃ kātyāyanena |
parabhaktapradānena prāptā vidyā yadānyataḥ |
tayā prāptaṃ ca vidhinā vidyāprāptaṃ tad ucyate ||
upanyaste ca yal labdhaṃ vidyayā paṇapūrvakam |
vidyādhanaṃ tu tad vidyād vibhāge na vibhajyate ||
śiṣyād ārtvijyataḥ praśnāt saṃdigdhapraśnanirṇayāt |
svajñānaśaṃsanāḍ vādāl labdhaṃ prādhyayanāc ca yat ||
vidyādhanaṃ tu tat prāhur vibhāge na vibhajyate ||
ato yan medhātithi-govindarājābhyāṃ mādhuparkikam ārtvijyadhanaṃ vyākhyātaṃ tad ayuktam, vidyādhanatvāt || 9.206 ||
bhrātṝṇāṃ yas tu neheta dhanaṃ śaktaḥ svakarmaṇā |
sa nirbhājyaḥ svakād aṃśāt kiṃcid datvopajīvanam || 9.207 ||
bhrātṝṇām iti | rājānugamanādikarmaṇā yo dhanam arjituṃ śakto bhrātṝṇāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ dhanaṃ necchati sa svīyāḍ aṃśāt kiṃcid upajīvanaṃ datvā bhrātṛbhiḥ pṛthakkāryaḥ | tena tatputrās tatra dhane kālāntare na vivadante || 9.207 ||
anupaghnan pitṛdravyaṃ śrameṇa yad upārjitam |
svayam īhitalabdhaṃ tan nākāmo dātum arhati || 9.208 ||
anupaghnann iti | pitṛdhanānupaghātena yat kṛṣyādikleśād arjayet tat svaceṣṭāprāptam anicchan bhrātṛbhyo dātuṃ nārhati || 9.208 ||
paitṛkaṃ tu pitā dravyam anavāptaṃ yad āpnuyāt |
na tat putrair bhajet sārdham akāmaḥ svayam arjitam || 9.209 ||
paitṛkam iti | yat punaḥ pitṛsaṃbandhi dhanaṃ tenāsāmarthyenopekṣitatvād anavāptaṃ putraḥ svaśaktyā prāpnuyāt tat svayam arjitam anicchan putraiḥ saha na vibhajet || 9.209 ||
vibhaktāḥ saha jīvanto vibhajeran punar yadi |
samas tatra vibhāgaḥ syāj jyaiṣṭhyaṃ tatra na vidyate || 9.210 ||
vibhaktā iti | pūrvaṃ soddhāraṃ niruddhāraṃ vā vibhaktā bhrātaraḥ paścād ekīkṛtya dhanaṃ saha jīvanto yadi punar vibhāgaṃ kurvanti tadā tatra samo vibhāgaḥ kāryaḥ | jyeṣṭhasyoddhāro na deyaḥ || 9.211 ||
yeṣāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ kaniṣṭho vā hīyetāṃśapradānataḥ |
mriyetānyataro vāpi tasya bhāgo na lupyate || 9.211 ||
yeṣām iti | yeṣāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ madhye kaścid vibhāgakāle pravrajyādinā svāṃśād dhīyeta mṛto vā bhavet tasya bhāgo na lupyet || 9.211 ||
kiṃ tu –
sodaryā vibhajeraṃs taṃ sametya sahitāḥ samam |
bhrātaro ye ca saṃsṛṣṭā bhaginyaś ca sanābhayaḥ || 9.212 ||
sodaryā ityādi | sodaryā bhrātaraḥ samāgamya sahitāḥ bhaginyaś ca sodaryās tam aṃśaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā vibhajeran sodaryāṇāṃ sāpatnyānām api madhyād ye miśrīkṛtadhanatvenaikayogakṣemās te vibhajeyuḥ samaṃ sarve sodaryā sapatnyā vā | etac ca putrapatnīpitṛmātrabhāve draṣṭavyam || 9.212 ||
yo jyeṣṭho vinikurvīta lobhād bhrātṝn yavīyasaḥ |
so ‘jyeṣṭho syād abhāgaś ca niyantavyaś ca rājabhiḥ || 9.213 ||
yo jyeṣṭha iti | yo jyeṣṭho bhrātā lobhāt kanīyaso bhrātṝn vañcayet sa jyeṣṭhabhrātṛpūjāśūnyaḥ soddhārabhāgarahitaś ca rājadaṇḍyaś ca syāt || 9.213 ||
sarva eva vikarmasthā nārhanti bhrātaro dhanam |
na cādatvā kaniṣṭhebhyo jyeṣṭhaḥ kurvīta yautakam || 9.214 ||
sarva eveti | apatitā api ye bhrātaro dyūtaveśyāsevādikarmāsaktās te rikthaṃ nārhanti | na ca kaniṣṭhebhyo ‘nanukalpya jyeṣṭhaḥ sādhāraṇadhanād ātmārtham asādhāraṇadhanaṃ kuryāt
|| 9.214 ||
bhrātṝṇām avibhaktānāṃ yady utthānaṃ bhavet saha |
na putrabhāgaṃ viṣamaṃ pitā dadyāt kathaṃcana || 9.215 ||
bhrātṝṇām iti | bhrātṝṇāṃ pitrā sahāvasthitānām avibhaktānāṃ yadi saha dhanārjanārtham utthānaṃ bhavet tadā vibhāgakāle na kasyacit putrasyādhikaṃ pitā kadācid dadyāt || 9.215 ||
ūrdhvaṃ vibhāgāj jātas tu pitryam eva hared dhanam |
saṃsṛṣṭās tena vā ye syur vibhajeta sa taiḥ saha || 9.216 ||
ūrdhvam iti | yadā jīvataiva pitrā putrāṇām icchayā vibhāgaḥ kṛtas tadā vibhāgād ūrdhvaṃ jātaḥ putraḥ pitari mṛte pitṛriktham eva gṛhṇīyāt | ye kṛtavibhāgāḥ pitrā saha punar miśrīkṛtadhanās taiḥ sahāsau pitari mṛte vibhajet || 9.216 ||
anapatyasya putrasya mātā dāyam avāpnuyāt |
mātary api ca vṛttāyāṃ pitur mātā hared dhanam || 9.217 ||
anapatyasyeti | anapatyasya putrasya dhanaṃ mātā gṛhṇīyāt, pūrvaṃ “pitā hared aputrasya riktham” (9.185) ity uktatvāt, iha mātā hared ityādi yājñavalkyena “pitarau” (YDh 3.135) ity ekaśeṣakaraṇāt, viṣṇunā ca “aputrasya dhanaṃ patnyabhigāmi tadabhāve duhitṛgāmi tadabhāve pitṛgāmi” ity ekaśeṣasyaiv kṛtatvāt, mātāpitarau vibhajya gṛhṇīyātām | mātari mṛtāyāṃ patnīpitṛbhrātṛbhātṛjābhāve pitur mātā dhanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt || 9.217 ||
ṛṇe dhane ca sarvasmin pravibhakte yathāvidhi |
paścād dṛśyeta yat kiṃcit tat sarvaṃ samatāṃ nayet || 9.218 ||
ṛṇa iti | ṛṇe pitrādidhāryamāṇe dhane ca tadīye sarvasmin yathāśāstraṃ vibhakte sati paścād yat kiṃcit paitṛkaṃ ṛṇaṃ dhanaṃ vā vibhāgakāle ‘jñātam upalabhyeta tat sarvaṃ samaṃ kṛtvā vibhajanīyaṃ na tu śodhyaṃ grāhyaṃ na vā jyeṣṭhasyoddhāro deyaḥ || 9.218 ||
vastraṃ patram alaṃkāraṃ kṛtānnam udakaṃ striyaḥ |
yogakṣemaṃ pracāraṃ ca na vibhājyaṃ pracakṣate || 9.219 ||
vastram iti | vastraṃ vāhanam ābharaṇam avibhāgakāle yad yenopabhuktaṃ tat tasyaiva na vibhājyam | etac ca nātinyūnādhikamūlyaviṣayam | yat tu bahumūlyam ābharaṇādikaṃ tad vibhājyam eva | tadviṣayam eva “vikrīya vastrābharaṇam” iti bṛhaspater vibhāgavacanam | kṛtānnam odanasaktvādi tan na vibhajanīyam | tatrātipracurataramūlyaṃ saktvādi tāvanmātramūlyadhanena “kṛtānnaṃ cākṛtānnena parivartya vibhajyate” iti bṛhaspativacanād vibhajanīyam eva | udakaṃ kūpādigataṃ sarvair upabhogyam avibhajanīyam | striyo dāsyādyā yās tulyabhāgā na bhavanti tā na vibhājyāḥ kiṃ tu tulyaṃ karma kārayitavyāḥ | yogakṣemaṃ mantripurohitādi yogakṣemahetutvāt | pracāro gavādīnāṃ pracāramārgaḥ etat sarvaṃ manvādayo ‘vibhājyam āhuḥ || 9.219 ||
ayam ukto vibhāgo vaḥ putrāṇāṃ ca kriyāvidhiḥ |
kramaśaḥ kṣetrajādīnāṃ dyūtadharmaṃ nibodhata || 9.220 ||
ayam iti | eṣa dāyabhāgaḥ putrāṇāṃ kṣetrajādīnāṃ krameṇa vibhāgakaraṇaprakāro yuṣmākam uktaḥ | idānīṃ dyūtavyavasthāṃ śṛṇuta || 9.220 ||
dyūtaṃ samāhvayaṃ caiva rājā rāṣṭrān nivārayet |
rājāntakaraṇāv etau dvau doṣau pṛthivīkṣitām || 9.221 ||
dyūtam iti | dyūtasamāhvayau vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇau rājā svarāṣṭrān nivartayet | yasmād etau dvau doṣau rājñāṃ rājyavināśakāriṇau || 9.221 ||
prakāśam etat tāskaryaṃ yad devanasamāhvayau |
tayor nityaṃ pratīghāte nṛpatir yatnavān bhavet || 9.222 ||
prakāśam iti | prakaṭam etac cauryaṃ yad dyūtasamāhvayau, tasmāt tannivāraṇe rājā nityaṃ yatnayuktaḥ syāt || 9.222 ||
aprāṇibhir yat kriyate tal loke dyūtam ucyate |
prāṇibhiḥ kriyate yas tu sa vijñeyaḥ samāhvayaḥ || 9.223 ||
aprāṇibhir iti | akṣaśalākādibhir aprāṇair yat kriyate tal loke dyūtaṃ kathyate | yaḥ punaḥ prāṇibhir meṣakukkuṭādibhiḥ paṇapūrvakaṃ kriyate sa samāhvayo jñeyaḥ | lokaprasiddhayor apy anayor lakṣaṇakathanaṃ parihārārtham || 9.223 ||
dyūtaṃ samāhvayaṃ caiva yaḥ kuryāt kārayeta vā |
tān sarvān ghātayed rājā śūdrāṃś ca dvijaliṅginaḥ || 9.224 ||
dyūtam iti | dyūtasamāhvayau yaḥ kuryād yo vā sabhikaḥ kārayet teṣām aparādhāpekṣayā rājā hastacchedādivadhaṃ kuryāt | yajñopavītādidvijacihnadhāriṇaḥ śūdrān hanyāt || 9.224 ||
kitavān kuśīlavān krūrān pāṣaṇḍasthāṃś ca mānavān |
vikarmasthāñ chauṇḍikāṃś ca kṣipraṃ nirvāsayet purāt || 9.225 ||
kitavān iti | dyūtādisevinaḥ, nartakagāyakān, vedavidviṣaḥ, śrutismṛtibhāhyavratadhāriṇaḥ, anāpadi parakarmajīvinaḥ, śauṇḍikān madyakarān manuṣyān kṣipraṃ rājā rāṣṭrān nirvāsayed iti | kitavaprasaṅgenānyeṣām apy abhidhānam || 9.225 ||
atra hetum āha –
ete rāṣṭre vartamānā rājñaḥ pracchannataskarāḥ |
vikarmakriyayā nityaṃ badhante bhadrikāḥ prajāḥ || 9.226 ||
eta iti | ete kitavādayo gūḍhacaurā rāṣṭre vasanto nityaṃ vañcanātmakakriyayā sajjanān pīḍayanti || 9.226 ||
dyūtam etat purā kalpe dṛṣṭaṃ vairakaraṃ mahat |
tasmād dyūtaṃ na seveta hāsyārtham api buddhimān || 9.227 ||
dyūtam iti | nedānīm eva paraṃ kiṃ tu pūrvasminn api kalpe dyūtam etad atiśayena vairakaraṃ dṛṣṭam | ataḥ prājñaḥ parihāsārtham api tan na seveta || 9.227 ||
pracchannaṃ vā prakāśaṃ vā tan niṣeveta yo naraḥ |
tasya daṇḍavikalpaḥ syād yatheṣṭaṃ nṛpates tathā || 9.228 ||
idānīṃ parājitānāṃ dhanābhāve satīdam āha –
kṣatraviṭśūdrayonis tu daṇḍaṃ dātum aśaknuvan |
ānṛṇyaṃ karmaṇā gacched vipro dadyāc chanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 9.229 ||
kṣatreti | kṣatravaiśyaśūdrajātīyo nirdhanatvena daṇḍaṃ dātum asamarthas taducitakarmakaraṇena daṇḍaśodhanaṃ kuryāt | brāḥmaṇaḥ punar yathālābhaṃ krameṇa dadyān na karma kārayitavyaḥ || 9.229 ||
strībālonmattavṛddhānāṃ daridrāṇāṃ ca rogiṇām |
śiphāvidalarajjvādyair vidadhyān nṛpatir damam || 9.230 ||
strīti | strībālādīnāṃ punaḥ śiphāveṇudalaprahārarajjubandhanādibhir damanaṃ rājā kuryāt
|| 9.230 ||
ye niyuktās tu kāryeṣu hanyuḥ kāryāṇi kāryiṇām |
dhanoṣmaṇā pacyamānās tān niḥsvān kārayen nṛpaḥ || 9.231 ||
ye niyuktās tv iti | ye vyavahārāvekṣaṇādiṣu kāryeṣu rājñā niyuktā utkocadhanatejasā vikāraṃ bhajantaḥ svāmyādīnāṃ kāryaṃ nāśayeyus tān gṛhītasarvasvān rājā kārayet || 9.231 ||
kūṭaśāsanakartṝṃś ca prakṛtīnāṃ ca dūṣakān |
strībālabrāhmaṇaghnāṃś ca hanyād dviṭsevinas tathā || 9.232 ||
kūṭeti | kūṭarājājñālekhakān, amātyānāṃ ca bhedakān, strībālabrāhmaṇaghātinaḥ, śatrusevinaś ca rājā hanyāt || 9.232 ||
tīritaṃ cānuśiṣṭaṃ ca yatra kvacana yad bhavet |
kṛtaṃ tad dharmato vidyān na tad bhūyo nivartayet || 9.233 ||
(tīritaṃ cānuśiṣṭaṃ ca yo manyeta vikarmaṇā |
dviguṇaṃ daṇḍam āsthāya tat kāryaṃ punar uddharet || )
tīritam iti | yatra kvacid ṛṇādānādivyavahāre yat kāryaṃ dharmatas tīritam | “pāra tīra karmasamāptau” iti curādau paṭhyate | śāstravyavasthānirṇītam | anuśiṣṭaṃ daṇḍaparyantatāṃ ca nītaṃ syāt tat kṛtaṃ aṅgīkuryān na punar nivartayet | etac cākāraṇāt | ataḥ kāraṇakṛtaṃ nivartayed eva || 9.233 ||
amātyāḥ prāḍvivāko vā yat kuryuḥ kāryam anyathā |
tat svayaṃ nṛpatiḥ kuryāt tān sahasraṃ ca daṇḍayet || 9.234 ||
amātyā iti | rājāmātyāḥ prāḍvivāko vā vyavahārekṣaṇe niyukto yad asamyag vyavahāranirṇayaṃ kuryus tat svayaṃ rājā kuryāt paṇasahasraṃ ca tān daṇḍayet | idaṃ cotkocadhanagrahaṇetaraviṣayam | utkocagrahaṇe “ye niyuktās tu” (9.231) ity uktatvāt || 9.234 ||
brahmahā ca surāpaś ca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ |
ete sarve pṛthag jñeyā mahāpātakino narāḥ || 9.235 ||
brahmaheti | yo manuṣyo brāhmaṇaṃ hatavān sa brahmahā, surāpo dvijātiḥ paiṣṭyāḥ pātā – brāhmaṇaś ca paiṣṭīmādhvīgauḍīnāṃ, taskaro brāhmaṇasuvarṇahārī manuṣyaḥ, yaś ca kaścid gurupatnīgāmīty ete sarve pratyekaṃ mahāpātakino boddhavyāḥ || 9.235 ||
caturṇām api caiteṣāṃ prāyaścittam akurvatām |
śārīraṃ dhanasaṃyuktaṃ daṇḍaṃ dharmyaṃ prakalpayet || 9.236 ||
caturṇām iti | caturṇām apy eteṣāṃ mahāpātakināṃ prāyaścittam akurvatāṃ śārīraṃ dhanagrahaṇena ca dhanasaṃbandham aparādhānusāreṇa dharmād anapetaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryāt || 9.236 ||
gurutalpe bhagaḥ kāryaḥ surāpāne surādhvajaḥ |
steye ca śvapadaṃ kāryaṃ brahmahaṇy aśirāḥ pumān || 9.237 ||
gurutalpa iti | “nāṅkyā rājñā lalāṭe syuḥ” (9.240) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāl lalāṭam evāṅkanam avagamyate | tatra gurupatnīgamane yāvajjīvasthāyi taptalohena lalāṭe bhagākṛtiṃ gurupatnīgamanacihnaṃ kāryam | evaṃ surāpāne kṛte pātur dīrghaṃ surādhvajākāraṃ, suvarṇāpahāre saty apahartuḥ kukkurapādarūpaṃ kāryam | brahmahaṇi kabandhaḥ pumān kartavyaḥ || 9.237 ||
asaṃbhojyā hy asaṃyājyā asaṃpāṭhyāvivāhinaḥ |
careyuḥ pṛthivīṃ dīnāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ || 9.238 ||
asaṃbhojyā iti | annādikaṃ naite bhojayitavyāḥ, na caite yājanīyāḥ, nāpy ete ‘dhyāpanīyāḥ, nāpy etaiḥ kanyādānasaṃbandhaḥ kartavyaḥ | ete ca nirdhanatvād yācanādidainyayuktāḥ sarvaśrautādikarmavarjitāḥ pṛthivīṃ paryaṭeyuḥ || 9.238 ||
jñātisaṃbandhibhis tv ete tyaktavyāḥ kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ |
nirdayā nirnamaskārās tan manor anuśāsanam || 9.239 ||
jñātīti | jñātibhiḥ saṃbandhibhir mātulādyair ete kṛtāṅkās tyajanīyāḥ, na caiṣāṃ dayā kāryā, nāpy ete namaskāryā itīyaṃ manor ājñā || 9.239 ||
prāyaścittaṃ tu kurvāṇāḥ pūrve varṇā yathoditam |
nāṅkyā rājñā lalāṭe syur dāpyās tūttamasāhasam || 9.240 ||
prāyaścittam iti | śāstravihitaṃ prāyaścittaṃ punaḥ kurvāṇā brāhmaṇādayas trayo varṇā rājñā lalāṭe ‘ṅkanīyā na bhaveyuḥ | uttamasāhasaṃ punar daṇḍanīyāḥ || 9.240 ||
āgaḥsu brāhmaṇasyaiva kāryo madhyamasāhasaḥ |
vivāsyo vā bhaved rāṣṭrāt sadravyaḥ saparicchadaḥ || 9.241 ||
āgaḥsv iti | “itare kṛtavantas tu” (9.242) ity uttaraśloke śrūyamāṇam ‘akāmataḥ’ iti cātrāpi yojanīyam | tena ‘akāmata’ ity eteṣv aparādheṣu guṇavato brāhmaṇasya madhyamasāhaso daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ | pūrvoktas tūttamasāhaso nirguṇasya draṣṭavyaḥ | kāmatas teṣv aparādheṣu dhanadhānyādiparicchadasahito brāhmaṇo deśān nirvāsyaḥ || 9.241 ||
itare kṛtavantas tu pāpāny etāny akāmataḥ |
sarvasvahāram arhanti kāmatas tu pravāsanam || 9.242 ||
itara iti | brāhmaṇād anye punaḥ kṣatriyādaya etāni pāpāny anicchantaḥ kṛtavantaḥ sarvasvaharaṇam arhanti | idaṃ ca sarvasvaharaṇaṃ pūrvoktenottamasāhasena vṛttāpekṣayā vyavasthāpanīyam | icchayā punar eṣām eteṣv aparādheṣu pravāsanaṃ vadho ‘rhati | “pravāsanaṃ parāsanaṃ niṣūdanaṃ vihiṃsanam” iti vadhaparyāyaṃ pravāsanaśabdaṃ paṭhanty ābhidhānikāḥ || 9.242 ||
nādadīta nṛpaḥ sādhur mahāpātakino dhanam |
ādadānas tu tal lobhāt tena doṣeṇa lipyate || 9.243 ||
nādadīteti | dhārmiko rājā mahāpātakasaṃbandhi dhanaṃ daṇḍarūpaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt | lobhāt punas tad gṛhṇan mahāpātakadoṣeṇa saṃyujyate || 9.243 ||
kā tarhi dattadhanasya pratipattir ity etadartham āha –
apsu praveśya taṃ daṇḍaṃ varuṇāyopapādayet |
śrutavṛttopapanne vā brāhmaṇe pratipādayet || 9.244 ||
apsv iti | tad daṇḍadhanaṃ nadyādijale prakṣiped varuṇāya dadyāc chrutavṛttasaṃpannabrāḥmaṇāya vā dadyāt || 9.244 ||
īśo daṇḍasya varuṇo rājñāṃ daṇḍadharo hi saḥ |
īśaḥ sarvasya jagato brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ || 9.245 ||
īśa iti | mahāpātakidaṇḍadhanasya varuṇaḥ svāmī yasmād rājñām api daṇḍadhāritvāt prabhuḥ | tathā brāhmaṇaḥ samastavedādhyāyī sarvasya jagataḥ prabhuḥ | ataḥ prabhutvāt tau daṇḍadhanam arhataḥ || 9.245 ||
yatra varjayate rājā pāpakṛdbhyo dhanāgamam |
tatra kālena jāyante mānavā dīrghajīvinaḥ || 9.246 ||
niṣpadyante ca sasyāni yathoptāni viśāṃ pṛthak |
bālāś ca na pramīyante vikṛtaṃ na ca jāyate || 9.247 ||
yatreti | niṣpadyanta iti | yatra deśe prakṛtaṃ mahāpātakidhanaṃ rājā na gṛhṇāti tatra paripūrṇena manuṣyā utpadyante, dīrghāyuṣaś ca bhavanti | vaiśyānāṃ ca yathaiva dhānyādisasyāny uptāni tathaiva pṛthak pṛthak jāyante | akāle na bālā mriyante | ‘dīrghajīvinaḥ’ ity uke ‘py ādarārthaṃ bālānāṃ punar vacanam | vyaṅgaṃ ca na kiṃcid bhūtam utpadyate || 9.246–247 ||
brāhmaṇān bādhamānaṃ tu kāmād avaravarṇajam |
hanyāc citrair vadhopāyair udvejanakarair nṛpaḥ || 9.248 ||
brāhmaṇān iti | śarīrapīḍādhanagrahaṇādinā śūdram icchāto brāhmaṇān bādhamānaṃ chedādibhir udvegakarair vadhopāyair nṛpo hanyāt || 9.248 ||
yāvān avadhyasya vadhe tāvān vadhyasya mokṣaṇe |
adharmo nṛpatir dṛṣṭo dharmas tu viniyacchataḥ || 9.249 ||
yāvān iti | avadhyasya vadhe yāvān adharmo nṛpateḥ śāstreṇa jñātas tāvān eva vadhyasya tyāge ‘pi | yathāśāstraṃ daṇḍaṃ tu kurvato dharmaḥ syāt tasmāt taṃ kuryāt || 9.249 ||
udito ‘yaṃ vistaraśo mitho vivadamānayoḥ |
aṣṭādaśasu mārgeṣu vyavahārasya nirṇayaḥ || 9.250 ||
udita iti | aṣṭādaśaṛṇādānādiṣu vyavahārapadeṣu parasparaṃ vivadamānayor arthipratyarthinoḥ kāryanirṇayo ‘yaṃ vistareṇoktaḥ || 9.250 ||
evaṃ dharmyāṇi kāryāṇi samyak kurvan mahīpatiḥ |
deśān alabdhāṃl lipseta labdhāṃś ca paripālayet || 9.251 ||
evam iti | anenoktaprakāreṇa dharmād anapetān vyavahārān nirṇayan rājā janānurāgād alabdhān deśāṃl labdhum icchel labdhāṃś ca samyak pālayet | evaṃ samyag vyavahāradarśanasyālabdhapredeśaprāptyarthatvam uktam || 9.251 ||
samyaṅniviṣṭadeśas tu kṛtadurgaś ca śāstrataḥ |
kaṇṭakoddharaṇe nityam ātiṣṭhed yatnam uttamam || 9.252 ||
samyag iti | “jāṅgalaṃ sasyasaṃpannam” (7.69) ity uktarītyā samyagāśritadeśas tatra saptamādhyāyoktaprakāreṇa kṛtadurgaś caurasāhasikādikaṇṭakanirākaraṇe prakṛṣṭaṃ yatnaṃ sadā kuryāt || 9.252 ||
rakṣaṇād āryavṛttānāṃ kaṇṭakānāṃ ca śodhanāt |
narendrās tridivaṃ yānti prajāpālanatatparāḥ || 9.253 ||
rakṣaṇād iti | yasmāt sādhvācārāṇāṃ rakṣaṇāc corādīnāṃ ca śāsanāt prajāpālanodyuktā rājānaḥ svargaṃ gacchanti tasmāt kaṇṭakoddharaṇe yatnaṃ kuryāt || 9.253 ||
aśāsaṃs taskarān yas tu baliṃ gṛhṇāti pārthivaḥ |
tasya prakṣubhyate rāṣṭraṃ svargāc ca parihīyate || 9.254 ||
aśāsann iti | yathā punar nṛpatiś caurādīn anirākurvan ṣaḍbhāgādyuktaṃ karaṃ gṛhṇāti tasmai rāṣṭravāsino janāḥ kupyanti | karmāntarārjitāpy asya svargaprāptir anena duṣkṛtena pratibadhyate
|| 9.254 ||
nirbhayaṃ tu bhaved yasya rāṣṭraṃ bāhubalāśritam |
tasya tad vardhate nityaṃ sicyamāna iva drumaḥ || 9.255 ||
nirbhayam iti | yasya rājño bāhuvīryāśrayeṇa rāṣṭraṃ caurādibhayarahitaṃ bhavati tasya nityaṃ tad vṛddhiṃ gacchati, udakasekeneva vṛkṣaḥ || 9.255 ||
dvividhāṃs taskarān vidyāt paradravyāpahārakān |
prakāśāṃś cāprakāśāṃś ca caracakṣur mahīpatiḥ || 9.256 ||
dvividhān iti | cāra eva caurajñānahetutvāc cakṣur iva yasyāsau rājā, cārair eva prakaṭatayā gūḍhatayā dviprakārān nyāyena paradhanagrāhiṇo jānīyāt || 9.256 ||
prakāśavañcakās teṣāṃ nānāpaṇyopajīvinaḥ |
pracchannavañcakās tv ete ye stenāṭavikādayaḥ || 9.257 ||
prakāśeti | teṣāṃ punaś caurādīnāṃ madhyād ye tulāpratimānopacayādinā hiraṇyādipaṇyavikrayiṇaḥ paradhanam anucitena gṛhṇanti te prakāśavañcakāḥ, stenāś caurāḥ sadvicchedādinā guptāṭavyāśrayāś ca paradhanaṃ gṛhṇanti te pracchannavañcakāḥ || 9.257 ||
kiṃ ca –
utkocakāś caupadhikā vañcakāḥ kitavās tathā |
maṅgalādeśavṛttāś ca bhadrāś cekṣaṇikaiḥ saha || 9.258 ||
asamyakkāriṇaś caiva mahāmātrāś cikitsakāḥ |
śilpopacārayuktāś ca nipuṇāḥ paṇyayoṣitaḥ || 9.259 ||
evamādīn vijānīyāt prakāśāṃl lokakaṇṭakān |
nigūḍhacāriṇaś cānyān anāryān āryaliṅginaḥ || 9.260 ||
utkocakā iti | asamyag iti | evam iti | utkocakā ye kāryibhyo dhanaṃ gṛhītvā karyam ayuktaṃ kurvanti | aupadhikā bhayadarśanād ye dhanam upajīvanti | vañcakā ye suvarṇādi dravyaṃ gṛhītvāpadravyaprakṣepeṇa vañcayanti | kitavā dyūtasamāhvayadevinaḥ | dhanaputralābhādimaṅgalam ādiśya ye vartante te maṅgalādeśavṛttāḥ | bhadrāḥ kalyāṇākārapracchannapāpā ye dhanagrāhiṇaḥ | īkṣaṇikā hastarekhādyavalokanena śubhāśubhaphalakathanajīvinaḥ | mahāmātrā hastiśikṣājīvinaḥ | cikitsakāś cikitsājīvinaḥ | asamyakkāriṇa iti mahāmātracikitsikaviśeṣaṇam | śilpopacārayuktāś citralekhādyupajīvinaḥ te ‘py anupajīvyamānaśilpopāyaprotsāhanena dhanaṃ gṛhṇanti | paṇyastriyaś ca paravaśīkaraṇakuśalā ity evamādīn prakāśaṃ lokavañcakāṃś cārair jānīyāt | anyān api pracchannacāriṇaḥ śūdrādīn brāhmaṇādiveṣadhāriṇo dhanagrāhiṇo jānīyāt || 9.258–260 ||
tān viditvā sucaritair gūḍhais tatkarmakāribhiḥ |
cāraiś cānekasaṃsthānaiḥ protsādya vaśam ānayet || 9.261 ||
tān iti | tān uktān vañcakān sabhyaiḥ pracchannais tatkarmakāribhir vaṇijāṃ steye vaṇigbhir ity evamādibhiḥ puruṣair etadvyatiriktaiḥ saptamādhyāyopadiṣṭakāpaṭikādibhiś cārair anekasthānasthair jñātvā protsādya svavaśān kuryāt || 9.261 ||
teṣāṃ doṣān abhikhyāpya sve sve karmaṇi tattvataḥ |
kurvīta śāsanaṃ rājā samyak sārāparādhataḥ || 9.262 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ prakāśāprakāśataskarāṇāṃ svakarmaṇi cauryādau ye pāramārthikā doṣāḥ saṃdhicchedādayas tāṃl loke prakhyāpya tadgatadhanaśarīrādi-sāmarthyāpekṣayāparādhāpekṣayā ca rājā daṇḍaṃ kuryāt || 9.262 ||
na hi daṇḍād ṛte śakyaḥ kartuṃ pāpavinigrahaḥ |
stenānāṃ pāpabuddhīnāṃ nibhṛtaṃ caratāṃ kṣitau || 9.263 ||
na hīti | yasmāc caurāṇāṃ pāpācaraṇabuddhīnāṃ vinītaveṣeṇa pṛthivyāṃ caratāṃ daṇḍavyatirekeṇa pāpakriyāyāṃ niyamaṃ kartum aśakyam ata eṣāṃ daṇḍaṃ kuryāt || 9.263 ||
sabhāprapāpūpaśālāveśamadyānnavikrayāḥ |
catuṣpathāś caityavṛkṣāḥ samājāḥ prekṣaṇāni ca || 9.264 ||
jīrṇodyānāny araṇyāni kārukāveśanāni ca |
śūnyāni cāpy agārāṇi vanāny upavanāni ca || 9.265 ||
evaṃvidhān nṛpo deśān gulmaiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamaiḥ |
taskarapratiṣedhārthaṃ cāraiś cāpy anucārayet || 9.266 ||
sameti | jīrṇeti | evam iti | sabhā grāmanagarādau niyataṃ janasamūhasthānaṃ, prapā jaladānagṛhaṃ, apūpavikrayaveśma, paṇyastrīgṛhaṃ, madyānnavikrayasthānāni, catuṣpathāḥ, prakhyātavṛkṣamūlāni, janasamūhasthānāni, jīrṇavāṭikāḥ, aṭavyaḥ, śilpagṛhāṇi, śūnyagṛhāṇi, āmrādivanāni, kṛtrimodyānāni | evaṃprakārān deśān sainyaiḥ padātisamūhaiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamair ekasthānasthitaiḥ pracāribhiś cānyaiś cārais taskaranivāraṇārthaṃ cārayet | prāyeṇaivaṃvidhe deśe ‘nnapānastrīsaṃbhogasvaprahartrādyanveṣaṇārtham taskarā avatiṣṭhante || 9.264–266 ||
tatsahāyair anugatair nānākarmapravedibhiḥ |
vidyād utsādayec caiva nipuṇaiḥ pūrvataskaraiḥ || 9.267 ||
tad iti | teṣāṃ sāhāyyaṃ pratipadyamānais taccaritānuvṛttibhiḥ saṃdhicchedādikarmānuṣṭhānavedibhiḥ pūrvacauraiś cārarūpaiś cāramāyānipuṇais taskarāñ jānīyāḍ utsādayec ca || 9.267 ||
bhakṣyabhojyāpadeśaiś ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca darśanaiḥ |
śauryakarmāpadeśaiś ca kuryus teṣāṃ samāgamam || 9.268 ||
bhakṣyeti | te pūrvacaurāś cārabhūtā ‘āgacchatāsmadgṛhaṃ gacchāmas tatra modakapāyasādīny aśnīmaḥ’ ity evaṃ bhakṣyabhojyavyājena, ‘asmākaṃ deśe brāhmaṇo ‘sti so ‘bhilaṣitārthasiddhiṃ jānāti taṃ paśyāmaḥ’ ity evaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ darśanaiḥ, ‘kaścid eka eva bahubhiḥ saha yotsyate taṃ paśyāmaḥ’ ity evaṃ śauryakarmavyājena teṣāṃ caurāṇāṃ rājño daṇḍadhārakapuruṣāḥ samāgamaṃ kuryur grāhayeyuś ca || 9.268 ||
ye tatra nopasarpeyur mūlapraṇihitāś ca ye |
tān prasahya nṛpo hanyāt samitrajñātibāndhavān || 9.269 ||
ya iti | ye caurās tatra bhakṣyabhojyādau nigrahaṇaśaṅkayā nopasarpanti, ye ca mūle rājaniyuktapurāṇacauravarge praṇihitāḥ sāvadhānabhūtāḥ taiḥ saha saṃgatiṃ bhajante tāṃś caurāṃs tebhya eva jñātvā tad ekatāpannamitrapitrādijñātisvajanasahitān balād ākramya rājā hanyāt || 9.269 ||
na hoḍhena vinā cauraṃ ghātayed dhārmiko nṛpaḥ |
sahoḍhaṃ sopakaraṇaṃ ghātayed avicārayan || 9.270 ||
na hoḍheneti | dhārmiko rājā hṛtadravyasaṃdhicchedopakaraṇavyatirekeṇāniścitacaurabhāvaṃ na ghātayet kiṃ tu hṛtadravyeṇa cauryopakaraṇena ca niścitacaurabhāvam avicārayan ghātayet || 9.270 ||
grāmeṣv api ca ye kecic caurāṇāṃ bhaktadāyakāḥ |
bhāṇḍāvakāśadāś caiva sarvāṃs tān api ghātayet || 9.271 ||
grāmeṣv iti | grāmādiṣv api ye kecic caurāṇāṃ cauratvaṃ jñātvā bhaktadāḥ cauryopayuktabhāṇḍādi gṛhāvasthānaṃ ye dadati tān api nairantaryādyaparādhagocarāpekṣayā ghātayet || 9.271 ||
rāṣṭreṣu rakṣādhikṛtān sāmantāṃś caiva coditān |
abhyāghāteṣu madhyasthāñ śiṣyāc caurān iva drutam || 9.272 ||
rāṣṭreṣv iti | ye rāṣṭreṣu rakṣāniyuktāḥ, ye ca sīmāntavāsinaḥ krūrāḥ santaś cauryopadeśe madhyasthā bhavanti tāṃś cauravat kṣipraṃ daṇḍayet || 9.272 ||
yaś cāpi dharmasamayāt pracyuto dharmajīvanaḥ |
daṇḍenaiva tam apy oṣet svakād dharmād dhi vicyutam || 9.273 ||
yaś cāpīti | yājanapratigrahādinā parasya yāgadānādidharmam utpādya yo jīvati sa dharmajīvano brāhmaṇaḥ, so ‘pi yo dharmamaryādāyāś cyuto bhavati tam api svadharmāt paribhraṣṭaṃ daṇḍenopatāpayet || 9.273 ||
grāmaghāte hitābhaṅge pathi moṣābhidarśane |
śaktito nābhidhāvanto nirvāsyāḥ saparicchadāḥ || 9.274 ||
grāmeti | grāmaluṇṭhane taskarādibhiḥ kriyamāṇe, hitābhaṅge jalasetubhaṅge jāte | “kṣetrotpannasasyanāśane vṛttibhaṅge ca” iti medhātithiḥ | pathi cauradarśane tannikaṭavartino yathāśaktito ye rakṣāṃ na kurvanti te śayyāgavāśvādiparicchadasahitā deśān nirvāsanīyāḥ
|| 9.274 ||
rājñaḥ kośāpahartṝṃś ca pratikūleṣu ca sthitān |
ghātayed vividhair daṇḍair arīṇāṃ copajāpakān || 9.275 ||
rājña iti | rājño dhanagṛhād dhanāpahāriṇas tathā tadājñāvyāghātakāriṇaḥ śatrūṇāṃ ca rājñā saha vairivṛddhikāriṇo ‘parādhāpekṣayā karacaraṇajihvācchedanādibhir nānāprakāradaṇḍair ghātayet || 9.275 ||
saṃdhiṃ chittvā tu ye cauryaṃ rātrau kurvanti taskarāḥ |
teṣāṃ chittvā nṛpo hastau tīkṣṇe śūle niveśayet || 9.276 ||
saṃdhim iti | ye rātrau saṃdhicchedaṃ kṛtvā paradhanaṃ taskarā muṣṇanti teṣāṃ rājā hastadvayaṃ chittvā tīkṣṇe śūle tān āropayet || 9.276 ||
aṅgulīr granthibhedasya chedayet prathame grahe |
dvitīye hastacaraṇau tṛtīye vadham arhati || 9.277 ||
aṅgulīr iti | paṭaprāntādisthitaṃ suvarṇādikaṃ granthimokṣaṇena yaś corayati sa granthibhedas tasya prathame dravyagrahaṇe ‘ṅgulīś chedayet | te cāṅguṣṭhatarjanyau “utkṣepakagranthibhedau karasaṃdaṃśahīnakau” (YDh 3.274) iti yājñavalkyavacanāt | dvitīye grahaṇe hastapādau chedayet | tṛtīye grahaṇe vadhārho bhavati || 9.277 ||
agnidān bhaktadāṃś caiva tathā śastrāvakāśadān |
saṃnidhātṝṃś ca moṣasya hanyāc cauram iveśvaraḥ || 9.278 ||
agnidān iti | granthibhedādikāriṇo vijñāyāgnibhaktaśastrāvasthānapradān muṣyata iti moṣaś cauradhanaṃ tasyāvasthāpakāṃś cauravad rājā nigṛhṇīyāt || 9.278 ||
taḍāgabhedakaṃ hanyād apsu śuddhavadhena vā |
yad vāpi pratisaṃskuryād dāpyas tūttamasāhasam || 9.279 ||
taḍāgeti | yaḥ snānadānādinā janopakārakaṃ taḍāgaṃ setubhedādinā vināsayati tam apsu majjanena prakārāntareṇa vā hanyāt | yad vā yadi taḍāgaṃ punaḥ saṃskuryāt tadottamasāhasaṃ daṇḍyaḥ || 9.279 ||
koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāradevatāgārabhedakān |
hastyaśvarathahartṝṃś ca hanyād evāvicārayan || 9.280 ||
koṣṭheti | rājasaṃbandhidhānyādiṣu dhanāgārāyudhagṛhayor devapratimāgṛhasya ca bahudhanavyayasādhyasya vināśakān hastyaśvarathasya cāpahartṝñ śīghram eva hanyāt | yat tu saṃkramadhvajayaṣṭidevatāpratimābhedinaḥ pañcaśatadaṇḍaṃ vakṣyati so ‘smād eva devatāgārabhedakasya vadhavidhānān mṛnmayapūjitojjhitadevatāpratimāviṣayo ‘tra draṣṭavyaḥ
|| 9.280 ||
yas tu pūrvaniviṣṭasya taḍāgasyodakaṃ haret |
āgamaṃ vāpy apāṃ bhidyāt sa dāpyaḥ pūrvasāhasam || 9.281 ||
yas tv iti | yaḥ punaḥ prajārthaṃ pūrvaṃ kenacit kṛtasya taḍāgasyodakam eva gṛhṇāti | kṛtsnataḍāgodakanāśane vadhadaṇḍaḥ prāg uktaḥ | tathodakagamanamārgaṃ setubandhādinā yo nāśayati sa prathamasāhasaṃ daṇḍyaḥ || 9.281 ||
samutsṛjed rājamārge yas tv amedhyam anāpati |
sa dvau kārṣāpaṇau dadyād amedhyaṃ cāśu śodhayet || 9.282 ||
samutsṛjed iti | anārtaḥ san yo rājapatheṣu purīṣaṃ kuryāt sa kārṣāpaṇadvayaṃ daṇḍaṃ dadyāt, sa cāmedhyaṃ śīghram evāpasārayet || 9.282 ||
āpadgato ‘tha vā vṛddhā garbhiṇī bāla eva vā |
paribhāṣaṇam arhanti tac ca śodhyam iti sthitiḥ || 9.283 ||
vyādhitavṛddhagarbhiṇībālā na daṇḍanīyāḥ kiṃ tu te punaḥ kiṃ kṛtam iti paribhāṣaṇīyāḥ | tac cāmedhyaṃ śodhanīyā iti śāstramaryādā || 9.283 ||
cikitsakānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mithyāpracaratāṃ damaḥ |
amānuṣeṣu prathamo mānuṣeṣu tu madhyamaḥ || 9.284 ||
cikitsikānām iti | sarveṣāṃ kāyaśalyādibhiṣajāṃ duścikitsāṃ kurvatāṃ daṇḍaḥ kartavyaḥ | tatra gavāśvādiviṣaye duścikitsāyāṃ prathamasāhasadaṇḍaḥ | mānuṣaviṣaye punar madhyamasāhasaḥ || 9.284 ||
saṃkramadhvajayaṣṭīnāṃ pratimānāṃ ca bhedakaḥ |
pratikuryāc ca tat sarvaṃ pañca dadyāc chatāni ca || 9.285 ||
saṃkrameti | saṃkramo jalopari gamanārthaṃ kāṣṭhaśilādirūpaḥ, dhvajaś cihnaṃ rājadvārādau, yaṣṭiḥ puṣkariṇyādau, pratimāś ca kṣudrā mṛnmayyādayas tāsāṃ vināśakaḥ pañcaśatapaṇān dadyāt, tac ca vināśitaṃ sarvaṃ punar navaṃ kuryāt || 9.285 ||
adūṣitānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dūṣaṇe bhedane tathā |
maṇīnām apavedhe ca daṇḍaḥ prathamasāhasaḥ || 9.286 ||
adūṣitānām iti | aduṣṭadravyāṇām apadravyaprakṣepeṇa dūṣaṇe, maṇīnāṃ ca māṇikyādīnām abhedyānāṃ vidāraṇe, vedhyānām api muktādīnām anavasthānavedhane prathamasāhaso daṇḍaḥ kāryaḥ | sarvatra parakīyadravyanāśe dravyāntaradānādinā svāmituṣṭiḥ kāryā || 9.286 ||
samair hi viṣamaṃ yas tu cared vai mūlyato ‘pi vā |
samāpnuyād damaṃ pūrvaṃ naro madhyamam eva vā || 9.287 ||
samair iti | samaiḥ samamūlyadātṛbhiḥ sahotkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭadravyadānena yo viṣamaṃ vyavaharati samamūlyaṃ dravyaṃ datvā yaḥ kasyacid bahumūlyaṃ kasyacid alpamūlyam iti viṣamaṃ mūlyaṃ gṛhṇāti so ‘nubandhaviśeṣāpekṣayā prathamasāhasaṃ madhyamasāhasaṃ vā daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyāt || 9.287 ||
bandhanāni ca sarvāṇi rājamārge niveśayet |
duḥkhitā yatra dṛśyeran vikṛtāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ || 9.288 ||
prākārasya ca bhettāraṃ parikhāṇāṃ ca pūrakam |
dvārāṇāṃ caiva bhaṅktāraṃ kṣipram eva pravāsayet || 9.289 ||
bandhaneti | prākāreti | bandhanagṛhāṇi sarvajanadṛśye rājamārge kuryāt, yatra nigaḍabandhanādyupetāḥ kṣuttṛṣṇābhibhūtā dīrghakeśanakhaśmaśravaḥ kṛśāḥ pāpakāriṇo ‘nyair akāryakāribhir akāryanivṛttyarthaṃ dṛśyeran rājā gṛhapurādisaṃbandhinaḥ prākārasya bhadakaṃ tadīyānām eva parikhāṇāṃ pūrayitāraṃ tadgatānāṃ dvārāṇāṃ bhañjakaṃ śīghram eva deśān nirvāsayet || 9.288–289 ||
abhicāreṣu sarveṣu kartavyo dviśato damaḥ |
mūlakarmaṇi cānāptaiḥ kṛtyāsu vividhāsu ca || 9.290 ||
abhicāreṣv iti | abhicārahomādiṣu śāstrīyeṣu māraṇopāyeṣu laukikeṣu ca mūlanikhananapadapāṃśugrahaṇādiṣu kṛteṣv anutpannamaraṇaphaleṣu dviśatapaṇagrahaṇarūpo daṇḍaḥ kartavyaḥ | maraṇe tu mānuṣamāraṇadaṇḍaḥ | evaṃ mātṛpitṛbhāryādivyatiriktair asatyair vyāmohya dhanagrahaṇādyarthaṃ vaśīkaraṇe tathā kṛtyāsūccāṭanāpāṭavādihetuṣu kriyamāṇāsu nānāprakārāsu dviśatapaṇadaṇḍa eva kartavyaḥ || 9.290 ||
abījavikrayī caiva bījotkraṣṭā tathaiva ca |
maryādābhedakaś caiva vikṛtaṃ prāpnuyād vadham || 9.291 ||
abījeti | abījaṃ bījaprarohāsamarthaṃ vrīhyādi prarohasamartham iti kṛtvā yo vikrīṇīte, tathāpakṛṣṭam eva katipayotkṛṣṭaprakṣepeṇa sarvam idaṃ sotkarṣam iti kṛtvā yo vikrīṇīte, yaś ca grāmanagarādisīmāṃ vināśayati sa vikṛtanāsākaracaraṇakarṇādirūpaṃ vadhaṃ prāpnuyāt
|| 9.291 ||
sarvakaṇṭakapāpiṣṭhaṃ hemakāraṃ tu pārthivaḥ |
pravartamānam anyāye chedayet khaṇḍaśaḥ kṣuraiḥ || 9.292 ||
sarveti | sarvakaṇṭakānāṃ madhye ‘tiśayena pāpatamaṃ suvarṇakāraṃ tulāchadmakaṣa-parivartāpadravyaprakṣepādinā hemādicaurye pravartamānam anubandhāpekṣayāṅgaviśeṣeṇa sarvadehaṃ vā khaṇḍaśaś chedayet || 2.292 ||
sītādravyāpaharaṇe śastrāṇām auṣadhasya ca |
kālam āsādya kāryaṃ ca rājā daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet || 9.293 ||
sīteti | kṛṣyamāṇabhūmidravyāṇāṃ halakuddālādīnām apaharaṇe, khaḍgādīnāṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ, auṣadhasya ca kalyāṇaghṛtādeś caurye saty upayogakāletarakālāpekṣayā prayojanāpekṣayā ca rājā daṇḍaṃ kuryāt || 9.293 ||
svāmyamātyau puraṃ rāṣṭraṃ kośadaṇḍau suhṛt tathā |
sapta prakṛtayo hy etāḥ saptāṅgaṃ rājyam ucyate || 9.294 ||
svāmīti | svāmī rājā, amātyo mantryādiḥ, puraṃ rājñaḥ kṛtadurganivāsanagaraṃ, rāṣṭraṃ deśaḥ, kośo vittanicayaḥ, daṇḍo hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ, mitraṃ trividhaṃ saptamādhyāyoktam ity etāḥ sapta prakṛtayo ‘ṅgāni | saptāṅgam idaṃ rājyam ity ucyate || 9.294 ||
tataḥ kim ity āha –
saptānāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ tu rājyasyāsāṃ yathākramam |
pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gurutaraṃ jānīyād vyasanaṃ mahat || 9.295 ||
saptānām iti | āsāṃ rājyaprakṛtīnāṃ saptānāṃ kramoktānām uttarasyāvināśam apekṣya pūrvasyāḥ pūrvasyā vināśaviṣaye garīyo vyasanaṃ jānīyāt | tathā hi – mitravyasanāt sabalavyasanaṃ garīyaḥ, saṃpannabalasyaiva mitrānugrahe sāmarthyāt, evaṃ balāt kośo garīyān, kośanāśe balasyāpi nāśāt | kośād rāṣṭraṃ garīyaḥ, rāṣṭranāśe kutaḥ kośotpattiḥ | evaṃ rāṣṭrād durganāśo ‘pi durgād eva yavasendhanādisaṃpannād rājyarakṣāsiddhiḥ | durgād amātyo garīyān, pradhānāmātyanāśe sarvāṅgavikalyāt | amātyād apy ātmā, sarvasyātmārthatvāt | tasmād uttarāpekṣayā pūrvaṃ yatnato rakṣet || 9.295 ||
saptāṅgasyeha rājyasya viṣṭabdhasya tridaṇḍavat |
anyonyaguṇavaiśeṣyān na kiṃcid atiricyate || 9.296 ||
saptāṅgasyeti | uktasaptāṅgavato loke rāṣṭrasya tridaṇḍavad anyonyasaṃbandhasya parasparavilakṣaṇopakāraṇān na kiṃcid aṅgam aghikaṃ bhavati | yady api pūrvaśloke pūrvapūrvāṅgasyādhikyam uktaṃ tathāpy eṣām aṅgānāṃ madhyād anyasyāṅgasaṃbandhinam apakāram anyad aṅgaṃ kartuṃ na śaknoti, tasmād uttarottarāṅgam apy apekṣaṇīyam ity evaṃparo ‘yam ādhikyaniṣedhaḥ | atra prasiddhaṃ yatitridaṇḍam eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ | tad dhi caturaṅgulagovālaveṣṭanād anyonyasaṃbandhaṃ, na ca tanmadhye tridaṇḍadhāraṇaśāstrārthe kaścid daṇḍo ‘dhiko bhavati || 9.296 ||
teṣu teṣu tu kṛtyeṣu tat tad aṅgaṃ viśiṣyate |
yena yat sādhyate kāryaṃ tat tasmiñ śreṣṭham ucyate || 9.297 ||
teṣv iti | yasmāt teṣu teṣu saṃpādyeṣu kāryeṣu tattadaṅgasyātiśayo bhavati, tat kāryam anyena kartum aśakteḥ | evaṃ ca yenāṅgena yat kāryaṃ saṃpādyate tasmin kārye tad eva pradhānam ucyate | tataś cānyonyaguṇaviśeṣādi yad uktaṃ tad evānena sphuṭīkṛtam || 9.297 ||
cāreṇotsāhayogena kriyayaiva ca karmaṇām |
svaśaktiṃ paraśaktiṃ ca nityaṃ vidyān mahīpatiḥ || 9.298 ||
cāreṇeti | saptamādhyāyoktakāpaṭikādinā balasyotsāhayogena karmaṇāṃ ca hastibandhavaṇikpathādīnām anuṣṭhānena jātāṃ śatror ātmanaś ca rājā sadā jānīyāt || 9.298 ||
pīḍanāni ca sarvāṇi vyasanāni tathaiva ca |
ārabheta tataḥ kāryaṃ saṃcintya gurulāghavam || 9.299 ||
pīḍanānīti | pīḍanāni mārakādīni kāmakrodhodbhavāni, duḥkhāni ca svaparacakragatāni teṣāṃ ca gurulaghubhāvaṃ paryālocya saṃdhivigrahādi kāryam ārabhet || 9.299 ||
ārabhetaiva karmāṇi śrāntaḥ śrāntaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
karmāṇy ārabhamāṇaṃ hi puruṣaṃ śrīr niṣevate || 9.300 ||
ārabheteti | rājā svarājyavṛddhiparāpacayanimittāni kāryāṇi kathaṃcid idaṃ saṃjātam iti chalāny apy ārabhyātmanā khinnaḥ punaḥ punas tāny ārabhetaiva | yasmāt karmāṇi sṛjyamānaṃ puruṣaṃ śrīr nitarāṃ sevate | tathā nābrāhmaṇe nānāśraye śrīr astīti prarohitāpi śoṣam eti, na ca yugānurūpeṇa karmāṇi phalantīti rājñodāsitavyam || 9.300 ||
yataḥ –
kṛtaṃ tretāyugaṃ caiva dvāparaṃ kalir eva ca |
rājño vṛttāni sarvāṇi rājā hi yugam ucyate || 9.301 ||
kṛtam iti | kṛtatretādvāparakalayo rājña eva ceṣṭitaviśeṣās tair eva satyādiviśeṣapravṛtteḥ | tasmād rājaiva kṛtādiyugam abhidhīyate || 9.301 ||
kīdṛkceṣṭitaḥ kṛtādiyugam ity ata āha –
kaliḥ prasupto bhavati sa jāgrad dvāparaṃ yugam |
karmasv abhyudyatas tretā vicaraṃs tu kṛtaṃ yugam || 9.302 ||
kalir iti | ajñānālasyādinā yadā nirudyamo rājā bhavati tadā kaliḥ syāt | yadā jānann api nānutiṣṭhati tadā dvāparam | yadā karmānuṣṭhāne ‘vasthitas tadā tretā | yathāśāstraṃ punaḥ karmāṇy anutiṣṭhan vicarati tadā kṛtayugam | tasmād rājñā karmānuṣṭhānapareṇa bhāvyam ity atra tātparyaṃ na tu vāstavakṛtayugādyapalāpe || 9.302 ||
indrasyārkasya vāyoś ca yamasya varuṇasya ca |
candrasyāgneḥ pṛthivyāś ca tejovṛttaṃ nṛpaś caret || 9.303 ||
indrasyeti | indrādisaṃbandhino vīryasyānurūpaṃ caritaṃ rājānutiṣṭhet | tathā ca rājā kaṇṭakoddhāreṇa pratāpānurāgābhyāṃ saṃyuktaḥ syāt || 9.303 ||
katham indrādicaritam anitiṣṭhed ity āha –
vārṣikāṃś caturo māsān yathendro ‘bhivarṣati |
tathābhivarṣet svaṃ rāṣṭraṃ kāmair indravrataṃ caran || 9.304 ||
vārṣikān iti | ṛtusaṃvatsarapakṣāśrayaṇenedam ucyate | yathā śrāvaṇādīṃś caturo māsān indraḥ sasyādisiddhaye varṣaty evam indracaritam anutiṣṭhan rājā svadeśāyātasādhūn abhilaṣitārthaiḥ pūrayet || 9.304 ||
aṣṭau māsān yathādityas toyaṃ harati raśmibhiḥ |
tathā haret karaṃ rāṣṭrān nityam arkavrataṃ hi tat || 9.305 ||
aṣṭāv iti | yathā sūryo mārgaśīrṣādyaṣṭamāsān raśmibhiḥ stokaṃ stokaṃ rasam īṣattāpenādatte, tathā rājā śāstrīyakarān apīḍayā sadā rāṣṭrād gṛhṇīyāt | yasmād etad asyārkavratam || 9.305 ||
praviśya sarvabhūtāni yathā carati mārutaḥ |
tathā cāraiḥ praveṣṭavyaṃ vratam etad dhi mārutam || 9.306 ||
praviśyeti | yathā prāṇākhyo vāyuḥ sarvajantuṣv antaḥ praviśya vicaraty evaṃ cāradvāreṇa svaparamaṇḍalajāleṣu cikīrṣitārthajñānārtham antaḥ praveṣṭavyaḥ | yasmād etan mārutaṃ caritam || 9.306 ||
yathā yamaḥ priyadveṣyau prāpte kāle niyacchati |
tathā rājñā niyantavyāḥ prajās tad dhi yamavratam || 9.307 ||
yatheti | yady api yamasya śatrumitre na sthas tathāpi tannindakārcakayoḥ śatrumitrayor yathā yamaḥ śatrumitramaraṇakāle tulyavan niyamayaty evaṃ rājñāparādhakāle rāgadveṣaparihāreṇa prajāḥ pramāpaṇīyāḥ | yasmād etad asya yāmyaṃ vratamn || 9.307 ||
varuṇena yathā pāśair baddha evābhidṛśyate |
tathā pāpān nigṛhṇīyād vratam etad dhi vāruṇam || 9.308 ||
varuṇeti | yo varuṇasya rajjubhir bandhayitum iṣṭaḥ sa yathā tenāviśaṅkitaḥ pāśair baddha eva lakṣyate tathā pāpakāriṇo ‘viśaṅkitān eva yāvan na pārayante tāvac chāsayet | yasmād etad asya vāruṇaṃ vratam || 9.308 ||
paripūrṇaṃ yathā candraṃ dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti mānavāḥ |
tathā prakṛtayo yasmin sa cāndravratiko nṛpaḥ || 9.309 ||
paripūrṇam iti | yathā pūrṇendudarśanena manuṣyā harṣam utpādayanty evam amātyādayo yasmin dṛṣṭe tuṣṭim upagacchanti sa candrācāracārī narendraḥ || 9.309 ||
pratāpayuktas tejasvī nityaṃ syāt pāpakarmasu |
duṣṭasāmantahiṃsraś ca tad āgneyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam || 9.310 ||
pratāpayukta ityādi | pāpakāriṣu sadā daṇḍapātena pracaṇḍo ‘sahanaḥ syāt tathā pratikūlāmātyahiṃsanaśīlo bhavet | tad asyāgnisaṃbandhi vrataṃ smṛtam || 9.310 ||
yathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni dharā dhārayate samam |
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni bibhrataḥ pārthivaṃ vratam || 9.311 ||
yatheti | yathā pṛthivī sarvāṇy uccāvacāni sthāvarajaṅgamāny utkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭāni samaṃ kṛtvā dhārayate tadvad vidvaddhanikaguṇavadbhūtāni taditarāṇi ca dīnānāthādisarvabhūtāni rakṣaṇadhanadānādinā sāmāṇyena dhārayataḥ pṛthivīsaṃbandhi vrataṃ bhavati || 9.311 ||
etair upāyair anyaiś ca yukto nityam atandritaḥ |
stenān rājā nigṛhṇīyāt svarāṣṭre para eva ca || 9.312 ||
etair iti | etair uktopāyair anyaiś cānuktair api svabuddhiprayukto rājānalasaḥ san svarāṣṭre ye caurā vasanti, ye ca pararāṣṭre vasantas taddeśam āgatya muṣṇanti, tān ubhayaprakārān nigṛhṇīyāt | “so ‘gnir bhavati vāyuś ca” (7.7) ityādinā pūrvaṃ siddhavad uktam agnyādirūpatvam, iha tu tadguṇatyāgena sphuṭīkṛtam ity apunaruktiḥ || 9.312 ||
parām apy āpadaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇān na prakopayet |
te hy enaṃ kupitā hanyuḥ sadyaḥ sabalavāhanam || 9.313 ||
parām iti | kośakṣayādinā prakṛṣṭām apy āpadaṃ prāpto rājā brāhmaṇān na prakopayet | yasmāt te ruṣṭāḥ sabalavāhanam enaṃ sadya eva śāpābhicārābhyāṃ hanyuḥ || 9.313 ||
tathā hi –
yaiḥ kṛtaḥ sarvabhakṣyo ‘gnir apeyaś ca mahodadhiḥ |
kṣayī cāpyāyitaḥ somaḥ ko na naśyet prakopya tān || 9.314 ||
yair iti | yair brāhmaṇair abhiśāpena sarvabhakṣyo ‘gniḥ kṛtaḥ, samudraś cāpeyajalaḥ, candraś ca kṣayayuktaḥ paścāt pūritas tān kopayitvā ko na naśyet || 9.314 ||
kiṃ ca –
lokān anyān sṛjeyur ye lokapālāṃś ca kopitāḥ |
devān kuryur adevāṃś ca kaḥ kṣiṇvaṃs tān samṛdhnuyāt || 9.315 ||
lokān iti | ye svargādilokān parān anyāṃś ca lokapālān sṛjantīti saṃbhāvyate | devāṃś ca śāpena mānuṣādīn kurvanti tān pīḍayan kaḥ samṛddhiṃ prāpnuyāt || 9.315 ||
api ca –
yān upāśritya tiṣṭhanti lokā devāś ca sarvadā |
brahma caiva dhanaṃ yeṣāṃ ko hiṃsyāt tāñ jijīviṣuḥ || 9.316 ||
yān ityādi | yān brāhmanān yajanayājanakartṛkān āśritya “agnau prāstāhutiḥ” (3.176) ity nyāyena pṛthivyādilokā devāś ca sthitiṃ labhante, veda eva ca yeṣām abhyudayasādhanatayā yājanādhyāpanādinā dhanopāyatvāc ca, tāñ jīvitum icchan ko hiṃsyāt || 9.316 ||
evaṃ tarhi vidvāṃsaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ sevetety ata āha –
avidvāṃś caiva vidvāṃś ca brāhmaṇo daivataṃ mahat |
praṇītaś cāpraṇītaś ca yathāgnir daivataṃ mahat || 9.317 ||
avidvān iti | yathāhito ‘nāhito vāgnir mahatī devatā, evaṃ mūrkho vidvāṃś ca brāhmaṇaḥ prakṛṣṭā devateti || 9.317 ||
śmaśāneṣv api tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati |
hūyamānaś ca yajñeṣu bhūya evābhivardhate || 9.318 ||
śmaśāneṣv ityādi | yathāgnir māhātejāḥ śmaśāne śavaṃ dahan kārye ‘pi naiva duṣṭo bhavati kiṃ tu punar api yajñeṣu hūyamāno ‘bhivardhate || 9.318 ||
evaṃ yady apy aniṣṭeṣu vartante sarvakarmasu |
sarvathā brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ paraṃ daivataṃ hi tat || 9.319 ||
evaṃ yady apīti | evaṃ kutsitakarmasv api sarveṣu yady api brāhmaṇāḥ pravartante tathāpi sarvaprakāreṇa pūjyāḥ | yasmāt prakṛṣṭaṃ tad daivatam | stutyarthatvāc cāsya na yathāśrutārthavirodhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ || 9.319 ||
kṣatrasyātipravṛddhasya brāhmaṇān prati sarvaśaḥ |
brahmaiva saṃniyantṛ syāt kṣatraṃ hi brahmasaṃbhavam || 9.320 ||
kṣatrasyeti | kṣatriyasya brāhmaṇān prati sarvathā pīḍānuvṛttasya brāhmaṇā eva śāpābhicārādinā samyaṅ niyantāraḥ | yasmāt kṣatriyo brāhmaṇāt saṃbhūtaḥ, brāhmaṇabāhuprasūtatvāt || 9.320 ||
tathā ca –
adbhyo ‘gnir brahmataḥ kṣatram aśmano loham utthitam |
teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati || 9.321 ||
adbhya iti | jalabrāhmaṇapāṣāṇebhyo ‘gnikṣatriyaśastrāṇi jātāni, teṣāṃ saṃbandhi tejaḥ sarvatra dahanābhibhavacchedanārthakaṃ kāryaṃ karoti | svakāraṇeṣu jalabrāhmaṇapāṣāṇākhyeṣu dahanābhibhavacchedanātmakaṃ kāryaṃ na karoti || 9.321 ||
nābrahma kaṣatram ṛdhnoti nākṣatraṃ brahma vardhate |
brahma kṣatraṃ ca saṃpṛktam iha cāmutra vardhate || 9.322 ||
neti | brāhmaṇarahitakṣatriyo vṛddhiṃ na yāti, śāntikapauṣṭikavyavahārekṣaṇādidharmavirahāt | evaṃ kṣatriyarahito ‘pi brāhmaṇo na vardhate, rakṣāṃ vinā yāgādikarmāniṣpatteḥ | kiṃ tu brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyaś ca parasparasaṃbaddha eveha loke paraloke ca dharmārthakāmamokṣāvāptyā vṛddhim eti | daṇḍaprakaraṇe ceyaṃ brāhmanastutir brāhmanānām aparādhinām api laghudaṇḍaprayoganiyamārthā || 9.322 ||
yadā tu viśiṣṭadarśanenācikitsyavyādhinā vāsannamṛtyur bhavati tadā–
datvā dhanaṃ tu viprebhyaḥ sarvadaṇḍasamutthitam |
putre rājyaṃ samāsṛjya kurvīta prāyaṇaṃ raṇe || 9.323 ||
datveti | mahāpātakivyatiriktaviniyuktāvaśiṣṭasarvadaṇḍadhanaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo datvā, putre rājyaṃ samarpyāsannamṛtyuḥ phalātiśayaprāptaye saṃgrāme prāṇatyāgaṃ kuryāt | saṃgrāmāsaṃbhave tv anaśanādināpi || 9.323 ||
evaṃ caran sadā yukto rājadharmeṣu pārthivaḥ |
hiteṣu caiva lokasya sarvān bhṛtyān niyojayet || 9.324 ||
evam iti | evam adhyāyatrayoktarājadharmeṣu vyavahāryamāṇo rājā sarvadā yatnavān prajāhiteṣu sarvān bhṛtyān viniyojayet || 9.324 ||
eṣo ‘khilaḥ karmavidhir ukto rājñaḥ sanātanaḥ |
imaṃ karmavidhiṃ vidyāt kramaśo vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ || 9.325 ||
eṣa iti | etad rājñaḥ karmānuṣṭhānaṃ pāraṃparyāgatatayā nityaṃ samagram uktam, idānīṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ krameṇa vakṣyamāṇam idaṃ karmānuṣṭhānaṃ jānīyāt || 9.325 ||
vaiśyas tu kṛtasaṃskāraḥ kṛtvā dāraparigraham |
vārtāyāṃ nityayuktaḥ syāt paśūnāṃ caiva rakṣaṇe || 9.326 ||
vaiśyas tv iti | vaiśyaḥ kṛtopanayanaparyantasaṃskāro vivāhādikaṃ kṛtvā jīvikāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇāyāṃ kṛṣyādikāryārthaṃ paśupālane ca sadā samāyuktaḥ syāt | paśurakṣaṇasya vārtātve ‘pi prādhānyakhyāpanārthaṃ pṛthagvidhānam | tathā cottaraślokābhyāṃ prādhānyaṃ darśayati || 9.326 ||
prajāpatir hi vaiśyāya sṛṣṭvā paridade paśūn |
brāhmaṇāya ca rājñe ca sarvāḥ paridade prajāḥ || 9.327 ||
prajāpatir iti | yasmād brahmā paśūn sṛṣṭvā rakṣaṇārthaṃ vaiśyāya dattavān, ato vaiśyena rakṣaṇīyāḥ paśava it pūrvānuvādaḥ | prajāś ca sarvāḥ sṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāya rājñe ca rakṣaṇārthaṃ dattavān iti prasaṅgād etad uktam || 9.327 ||
na ca vaiśyasya kamaḥ syān na rakṣeyaṃ paśūn iti |
vaiśye cecchati nānyena rakṣitavyāḥ kathaṃcana || 9.328 ||
na ceti | paśurakṣaṇaṃ na karomīti vaiśyenecchā na kāryā | ataḥ kṛṣyādivṛttisaṃbhave ‘pi vaiśyena paśurakṣaṇam avaśyaṃ karaṇīyam | vaiśye ca paśurakṣaṇaṃ kurvaty anyaḥ paśurakṣaṇaṃ kārayitavyaḥ || 9.328 ||
kiṃ ca –
maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ lohānāṃ tāntavasya ca |
gandhānāṃ ca rasānāṃ ca vidyād arghabalābalam || 9.329 ||
maṇīti | maṇimuktāvidrumalohavastrāṇāṃ, gandhānāṃ karpūrādīnāṃ, rasānāṃ lavaṇādīnām uttamamadhyamānāṃ deśakālāpekṣayā mūlyotkarṣāpakarṣaṃ vaiśyo jānīyāt || 9.329 ||
bījānām uptivic ca syāt kṣetradoṣaguṇasya ca |
mānayogaṃ ca jānīyāt tulāyogāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ || 9.330 ||
bījānām iti | bījānāṃ sarveṣāṃ vapanavidhijñaḥ syāt | idaṃ bījam asmin kāle tatra saṃhataṃ coptaṃ prarohaty asmin nety evaṃ tathedam ūṣaram idaṃ sasyapradam ityādikṣetradoṣaguṇajñaś ca syāt | mānopāyāṃś ca prasthadroṇādīn tulopāyāṃś ca sarvān tattvato jānīyāt, yathānyo na vañcati || 9.330 ||
sārāsāraṃ ca bhāṇḍānāṃ deśānāṃ ca guṇāguṇam |
lābhālābhaṃ ca paṇyānāṃ paśūnāṃ parivardhanam || 9.331 ||
sārāsāram iti | idam utkṛṣṭam etad apakṛṣṭam ity ekajātīnām api dravyāṇāṃ viśeṣaṃ jānīyāt, tathā deśānāṃ prākpaścimādīnāṃ kva kim alpamūlyaṃ kiṃ bahumūlyaṃ cetyādideśaguṇadoṣau budhyeta | vikreyadravyāṇāṃ ceyatā kālena iyān apacaya upacayo veti vidyāt | tathāsmin deśe kāle ‘nena ca tṛṇodakayavādinā paśavo vardhante ‘nena kṣīyanta ity etad api jānīyāt || 9.331 ||
bhṛtyānāṃ ca bhṛtiṃ vidyād bhāṣāś ca vividhā nṛṇām |
dravyāṇāṃ sthānayogāṃś ca krayavikrayam eva ca || 9.332 ||
bhṛtyānām iti | gopālamahiṣapālānām idam asya deyam iti deśakālakarmānurūpaṃ vetanaṃ jānīyāt | gauḍadākṣiṇātyādīnāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ nānāprakārā bhāṣā vikrayādyarthaṃ vidyāt, tathedaṃ dravyam evaṃ sthāpyate ‘nena ca saṃyuktaṃ ciraṃ tiṣṭhatīti budhyeta, tathedaṃ dravyam asmin deśe kāle ceyatā vikrīyata ity etad api jānīyāt || 9.332 ||
dharmeṇa ca dravyavṛddhāv ātiṣṭhed yatnam uttamam |
dadyāc ca sarvabhūtānām annam eva prayatnataḥ || 9.333 ||
dharmeṇeti | dharmeṇa vikrayādinoktaprakāreṇa dhanavṛddhau prakṛṣṭaṃ yatnaṃ kuryāt | hiraṇyādidānam apekṣyānnam eva prāṇibhyo viśeṣeṇa dadyāt || 9.333 ||
viprāṇāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ yaśasvinām |
śuśrūṣaiva tu śūdrasya dharmo naiśreyasaḥ paraḥ || 9.334 ||
viprāṇām iti | śūdrasya punar vedavidāṃ gṛhasthānāṃ svadharmānuṣṭhānena yaśoyuktānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yā paricaryā saiva prakṛṣṭasvargādiśreyohetur dharmaḥ || 9.334 ||
śucir utkṛṣṭaśuśrūṣur mṛduvāg anahaṃkṛtaḥ |
brāhmaṇādyāśrayo nityam utkṛṣṭāṃ jātim aśnute || 9.335 ||
śucir iti | bāhyābhyantaraśaucopetaḥ, svajātyapekṣayotkṛṣṭadvijātiparicaraṇaśīlaḥ, aparuṣabhāṣī, nirahaṃkāraḥ, prādhānyena brāhmaṇāśrayas tadabhāve kṣatriyavaiśyāśrayo ‘pi svajātita utkṛṣṭāṃ jātiṃ prāpnoti || 9.335 ||
eṣo ‘nāpadi varṇānām uktaḥ karmavidhiḥ śubhaḥ |
āpady api hi yas teṣāṃ kramaśas taṃ nibodhata || 9.336 ||
eṣa iti | eṣa varṇānām anāpadi caturṇām api karmavidhir dharma uktaḥ, āpady api yas teṣāṃ dharmas taṃ saṃkīrṇaśravaṇād ūrdhvaṃ krameṇa śṛṇuta || 9.336 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau
navamo ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
daśamo ‘dhyāyaḥ
adhīyīraṃs trayo varṇāḥ svakarmasthā dvijātayaḥ |
prabrūyād brāhmaṇas tv eṣāṃ netarāv iti niścayaḥ || 10.1 ||
adhīyīrann iti | vaiśyaśūdradharmānantaraṃ “saṃkīrṇānāṃ ca saṃbhavam” (1.116) iti pratijñātatvāt tasmin vācye varṇebhya eva saṃkīrṇānām utpatteḥ varṇānuvādārthaṃ traivarṇikasya pradhānadharmam adhyayanaṃ brāḥmaṇasya cādhyāpanam anuvadati | brāhmaṇādayas trayo varṇā adhyayanānubhūtasvakarmānuṣṭhātāro vedaṃ paṭheyuḥ | eṣāṃ punar madhye brāhmaṇa evādhyāpanaṃ kuryān na kṣatriyavaiśyāv ity ayaṃ niścayaḥ | ‘prabrūyād brāhmaṇas tv eṣām’ ity anenaiva kṣatriyavaiśyayor adhyāpananiṣedhasiddhau ‘netarau’ iti punar niṣedhavacanaṃ prāyaścittagauravārtham || 10.1 ||
kiṃ ca –
sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇo vidyād vṛttyupāyān yathāvidhi |
prabrūyād itarebhyaś ca svayaṃ caiva tathā bhavet || 10.2 ||
sarveṣām iti | sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ jīvanopāyaṃ yathāśāstraṃ brāhmaṇo jānīyāt, tebhyaś copadiśet, svayaṃ ca yathoktavan niyamam anutiṣṭhet || 10.2 ||
atrānuvādaḥ –
vaiśeṣyāt prakṛtiśraiṣṭhyān niyamasya ca dhāraṇāt |
saṃskārasya viśeṣāc ca varṇānāṃ brāḥmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 10.3 ||
vaiseṣyād iti | jātyutkarṣāt, prakṛtiḥ kāraṇaṃ hiraṇyagarbhottamāṅgarūpakāraṇotkārṣāt, niyamyate ‘neneti nimayo vedas tasyādhyayanādhyāpanākhyānādiyuktasātiśayavedadhāraṇāt | ata eva “brahmaṇaś caiva dhāraṇāt” (1.93) iti sātiśayavedadhāraṇenaiva brāhmaṇotkarṣa uktaḥ | govindarājas tu “snātakavratānāṃ dhāraṇād” iti vyākhyātavān | tan na, kṣatriyādisādhāraṇyāt | saṃskārasyopanayanākhyasya kṣatriyādyapekṣayā prādhānyavidhāne viśeṣād varṇānām adhyāpanavṛttyupadeśayor brāhmaṇaḥ eveśvaraḥ || 10.3 ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyas trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ |
caturtha ekajātis tu śūdro nāsti tu pañcamaḥ || 10.4 ||
brāhmaṇa iti | brāhmaṇādayas trayo varṇā dvijāḥ, teṣām upanayanavidhānāt | śūdraḥ punaś caturtho varṇa ekajātiḥ, upanayanābhāvāt | pañcamaḥ punar varṇo nāsti | saṃkīrṇajātīnāṃ tv aśvataravan mātāpitṛjātivyatiriktajātyantaratvān na varṇatvam | ayaṃ ca jātyantaropadeśaḥ śāstre saṃvyavaharaṇārthaḥ || 10.4 ||
sarvavarṇeṣu tulyāsu patnīṣv akṣatayoniṣu |
ānulomyena saṃbhūtā jātyā jñeyās ta eva te || 10.5 ||
sarvavarṇeṣv iti | brāhmaṇādiṣu varṇeṣu caturṣv api, samānajātīyāsu yathāśāstraṃ pariṇītāsv akṣatayoniṣv ānulomyena brāhmaṇena brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyeṇa kṣatriyāyām ity anenānukrameṇa ye jātās te mātāpitror jātyā yuktās tajjātīyā eva jñātavyāḥ | ānulomyagrahaṇaṃ cātra mandopayuktam uttaraśloka upayokṣyate | gavāśvādivad avayavasaṃniveśasya brāhmaṇajātyabhivyañjakābhāvād etad brāhmaṇādilakṣaṇam uktam | atra ca patnīgrahaṇād anyapatnījanitānāṃ na brāhmaṇādijātitvam | tathā ca devalaḥ |
dvitīyena tu yaḥ pitrā savarṇāyāṃ prajāyate |
avavāṭa iti khyātaḥ śūdradharmā sa jātitaḥ ||
vratahīnā na saṃskāryāḥ svatantrāsv api ye sutāḥ |
utpāditāḥ savarṇena vrātyā iva bahiṣkṛtāḥ ||
vyasaḥ |
ye tu jātāḥ samānāsu saṃskāryāḥ syur ato ‘nyathā |
yājñavalkya ‘pi (1.90) |
savarṇebhyaḥ savarṇāsu jāyante hi sajātayaḥ |
ity abhidhāya,
vinnāsv eṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | (1.92)
iti bruvāṇaḥ svapatnyutpāditasyaiva brāhmaṇādijātitvaṃ niścikāya || 10.5 ||
strīṣv anantarajātāsu dvijair utpāditān sutān |
sadṛśān eva tān āhur mātṛdoṣavigarhitān || 10.6 ||
strīṣv iti || ānulomyenāvyavahitavarṇajātīyāsu bhāryāsu dvijātibhir ye utpāditāḥ putrāḥ, yathā brāhmaṇena kṣatriyāyāṃ, kṣatriyeṇa vaiśyāyāṃ, vaiśyena śūdrāyāṃ tān mātur hīnajātīyatvadoṣād garhitān pitṛsadṛśān na tu pitṛsajātīyān manvādayaḥ āhuḥ |. pitṛsadṛśagrahaṇān mātṛjāter utkṛṣṭāḥ pitṛjātito nikṛṣṭā jñeyāḥ | eteṣāṃ ca nāmāni mūrdhāvasiktamāhiṣyakaraṇākhyāni yājñavalkyādibur uktāni, vṛttayaś caiṣām uśanasoktāḥ:
hastyaśvarathaśikṣā astradhāraṇaṃ ca mūrdhābhiṣiktānāṃ, nṛtyagītanakṣatrajīvanaṃ sasyarakṣā ca māhiṣyāṇāṃ, dvijātiśuśrūṣā dhanadhānyādhyakṣatā rājasevā durgāntaḥpurarakṣā ca pāraśavograkaraṇānām | iti |
anantarāsu jātānāṃ vidhir eṣa sanātanaḥ |
dvyekāntarāsu jātānāṃ dharmyaṃ vidyād imaṃ vidhim || 10.7 ||
anantarāsv iti | eṣa pāramparyāgatatayā nityo vidhir anantarajātibhāryotpannānām uktaḥ | ekena dvābhyāṃ ca varṇābhyāṃ vyavahitāsūtpannānāṃ yathā brāhmanena vaiśyāyāṃ, kṣatriyaṇa śūdrāyāṃ, brāhmaṇena śūdrāyām imaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ dharmād anapetaṃ vidhiṃ jānīyāt
|| 10.7 ||
brāhmaṇād vaiśyakanyāyām ambaṣṭho nāma jāyate |
niṣādaḥ śūdrakanyāyāṃ yaḥ pāraśava ucyate || 10.8 ||
brāhmaṇād iti | kanyāgrahaṇād atroḍhāyām ity adhyāhāryam, “vinnāsv eṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ” iti yājñavalkyena (1.92) sphuṭīkṛtatvāc ca | brāhmaṇād vaiśyakanyāyām ūḍhāyām ambaṣṭhākhyo jāyate | śūdrakanyāyām uḍhāyāṃ niṣāda utpadyate | yaḥ saṃjñāntareṇa pāraśavaś cocyate || 10.8 ||
kṣatriyāc chūdrakanyāyāṃ krūrācāravihāravān |
kṣatraśūdravapur jantur ugro nāma prajāyate || 10.9 ||
kṣatriyād iti | kṣatriyāc chūdrakanyāyām ūḍhāyāṃ krūraceṣṭaḥ krūrakarmaratiś ca kṣatraśūdrasvabhāva ugrākhyaḥ putro jāyate || 10.9 ||
viprasya triṣu varṇeṣu nṛpater varṇayor dvayoḥ |
vaiśyasya varṇe caikasmin ṣaḍ ete ‘pasadāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10.10 ||
viprasyeti | brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyāditrayastrīṣu, kṣatriyasya vaiśyādivarṇadvayoḥ striyoḥ, vaiśyasya ca śūdrāyāṃ, varṇatrayāṇām ete ṣaṭ putrāḥ savarṇaputrakāryāpekṣayāpasadā avasannā nikṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ || 10.10 ||
evam anulomān uktvā pratilomān āha –
kṣatriyād viprakanyāyāṃ sūto bhavati jātitaḥ |
vaiśyān māgadhavaidehau rājaviprāṅganāsutau || 10.11 ||
kṣatriyād iti | atra vivāhāsaṃbhavāt kanyāgrahaṇaṃ strīmātrapradarśanārtham, atraiva śloke ‘rājaviprāṅganāsutau’ iti | brāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatriyāj jātyā sūtanāmā saṃjāyate | vaiśyād yathākramaṃ kṣatriyābrāhmaṇyor māgadhavaidehākhyau putrau bhavataḥ | eṣāṃ ca vṛttayo manunaivābhidhāsyante || 10.11 ||
śūdrād āyogavaḥ kṣattā caṇḍālaś cādhamo nṛṇām |
vaiśyarājanyaviprāsu jāyante varṇasaṃkarāḥ || 10.12 ||
śūdrād iti | śūdrād vaiśyākṣatriyābrāhmaṇīṣu krameṇāyogavaḥ kṣattā nṛṇām adhamaś cāṇḍālaś ca varṇānāṃ saṃkaro yeṣu janayitavyeṣu te varṇasaṃkarā jāyante || 10.12 ||
ekāntare tv ānulomyād ambaṣṭhograu yathā smṛtau |
kṣattṝvaidehakau tadvat prātilomye ‘pi janmani || 10.13 ||
ekāntara iti | ekāntare ‘pi varṇe brāhmaṇād vaiśyakanyāyām ambaṣṭhaḥ, kṣatriyāc chūdrakanyāyām ugraḥ, etāv ānulomyena yathā sparśādyarhau tadvad ekāntare pratilomajanane ‘pi śūdrāt kṣatriyāyāṃ kṣattā, vaiśyād brāhmaṇyāṃ vaidehaḥ, etāv api sparśādiyogyau vijñeyau | ekāntarotpannayoḥ sparśādyanujñānād anantarotpannānāṃ sūtamāghadhāyogavānāṃ sparśādiyogyatvaṃ siddham bhavati | ataś caṇḍāla evaikaḥ pratilomataḥ sparśādau nirasyate || 10.13 ||
putrā ye ‘nantarastrījāḥ krameṇoktā dvijanmanām |
tān anantaranāmnas tu mātṛdoṣāt pracakṣate || 10.14 ||
putrā iti | mātṛdoṣād iti hetūpanyāsād antaragrahaṇam anantaravac caikāntaradvyantarapradarśanārtham | ye dvijātīnām anantaraikāntaradvyantarajātistrīṣv ānulomyenotpannāḥ pūrvam uktāḥ putrās tān hīnajātimātṛdoṣān mātṛjātivyapadeśyān ācakṣate | mātāpitṛvyatiriktasaṃkīrṇajātitve ‘py eṣāṃ mātṛjātivyapadeśakathanaṃ mātṛjātisaṃskārādidharmaprāptyartham || 10.14 ||
brāhmaṇād ugrakanyāyām āvṛto nāma jāyate |
ābhīro ‘mbaṣṭhakanyāyām āyogavyāṃ tu dhigvaṇaḥ || 10.15 ||
brāhmaṇād iti | kṣatriyeṇa śūdrāyām utpannogrā, ugrā cāsau kanyā cety ugrakanyā, tasyāṃ brāhmaṇād āvṛtanāmā jāyate | brāhmaṇena vaiśyāyām utpannāmbaṣṭhā, tasyāṃ brāhmaṇād ābhīrākhyo jāyate | śūdreṇa vaiśyāyām utpannā āyogavī, tasyāṃ brāhmaṇād dhigaṇo jāyate
|| 10.15 ||
āyogavaś ca kṣattā ca caṇḍālaś cādhamo nṛṇām |
prātilomyena jāyante śūdrād apasadās trayaḥ || 10.16 ||
āyogavaś ceti | āyogavaḥ kṣattā caṇḍālaś ca manuṣyāṇām adhama ity ete trayo vyutkrameṇa vaiśyākṣatriyābrāhmaṇīṣu putrakāryād apagatās trayaḥ śūdrā jāyante | putrakāryākṣamatvapratipādanārtham uktānām apy eṣāṃ punarvacanam | evam uttaraślokoktānām api || 10.16 ||
vaiśyān māgadhavaidehau kṣatriyāt sūta eva tu |
pratīpam ete jāyante pare ‘py apasadās trayaḥ || 10.17 ||
vaiśyād iti | kṣatriyābrāhmaṇyor māgadhavaidehau kṣatriyād brāhmaṇyāṃ sūta ity evaṃ prātilomyenāpare ‘pi trayaḥ putrakāryād apasadā jāyante || 10.17 ||
jāto niṣādāc chūdrāyāṃ jātyā bhavati pukkasaḥ |
śūdrāj jāto niṣādyāṃ tu sa vai kukkuṭakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 10.18 ||
jāta iti | niṣādāc chūdrāyāṃ jāto jātyā pukkaso bhavati | niṣādyāṃ punaḥ śūdrād yo jātaḥ sa kukkuṭakanāmā smṛtaḥ || 10.18 ||
kṣattur jātas tathogrāyāṃ śvapāka iti kīrtyate |
vaidehakena tv ambaṣṭhyām utpanno veṇa ucyate || 10.19 ||
kṣattur iti | śūdreṇa vaiśyāyāṃ jātaḥ kṣattā, kṣatriyeṇa śūdrāyāṃ jātā ugrā, tena tasyāṃ jātaḥ śvapāka ity ucyate | vaidehakenāmbaṣṭhyāṃ brāhmaṇena vaiśyājātāyāṃ veṇa iti kathyate
|| 10.19 ||
dvijātayaḥ savarṇāsu janayanty avratāṃs tu yān |
tān sāvitrīparibhraṣṭān vrātyān iti vinirdiśet || 10.20 ||
dvijātaya iti | dvijātayaḥ savarṇāsu strīṣu yān putrān utpādayante te ced upanayanākhyavratahīnā bhavanti tadā tān akṛtopanayanān vrātyety anayā saṃjñayā vyapadiśet | “ata ūrdhvaṃ trayo ‘py ete” (2.39) ity uktam api vrātyalakṣaṇaṃ pratilomajaputravad asyāpy upakārākṣamaputratvapradarśanārtham asmin saṃkīrṇaprakaraṇe ‘nūditam || 10.20 ||
vrātyāt tu jāyate viprāt pāpātmā bhūrjakaṇṭakaḥ |
āvantyavāṭadhānau ca puṣpadhaḥ śaikha eva ca || 10.21 ||
vrātyād iti | vrātyād brāhmaṇāt “savarṇāsu” (10.20) ityanuvṛtter brāhmaṇyāṃ pāpasvabhāvo bhūrjakaṇṭako jāyate | tathā āvantya-vāṭadhāna-puṣpadha-śaikhā jāyante | ekasya caitāni deśabhedaprasiddhāni nāmāni || 10.21 ||
jhallo mallaś ca rājanyād vrātyān nicchivir eva ca |
naṭaś ca karaṇaś caiva khaso draviḍa eva ca || 10.22 ||
jhallo mallaś ceti | kṣatriyād vrātyāt savarṇāyāṃ jhalla-malla-nicchivi-naṭa-karaṇa-khasa-draviḍākhyā jāyante | etāny apy ekasyaiva nāmāni || 10.22 ||
vaiśyāt tu jāyate vrātyāt sudhanyācārya eva ca |
kāruṣaś ca vijanmā ca maitraḥ sāttvata eva ca || 10.23 ||
vaiśyāt tv iti | vaiśyāt punar vrātyāt savarṇāyāṃ sudhavācārya-kāruṣa-vijanma-maitra-sāttvatākhyā jāyante | ekasya caitāny api nāmāni || 10.23 ||
vyabhicāreṇa varṇānām avedyāvedanena ca |
svakarmaṇāṃ ca tyāgena jāyante varṇasaṃkarāḥ || 10.24 ||
vyabhicāreṇeti | brāhmaṇādivarṇānām anyonyastrīgamanena, sagotrādivivāhena upanayanarūpasvakarmatyāgena, varṇasaṃkaro nāma jāyate | ato yuktam asmin prakaraṇe vrātyānām abhidhānam || 10.24 ||
saṃkīrṇayonayo ye tu pratilomānulomajāḥ |
anyonyavyatiṣaktāś ca tān pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ || 10.25 ||
saṃkīrṇeti | ye saṃkīrṇayonayaḥ pratilomair anulomaiś ca parasparasaṃbandhāj jāyante tān viśeṣeṇa vakṣyāmi || 10.25 ||
sūto vaidehakaś caiva caṇḍālaś ca narādhamaḥ |
māgadhaḥ kṣattṛjātiś ca tathāyogava eva ca || 10.26 ||
sūta iti | ete ṣaḍ uktalakṣaṇāḥ sūtādaya uttarārdham anūdyante || 10.26 ||
ete ṣaṭ sadṛśān varṇāñ janayanti svayoniṣu |
mātṛjātyāṃ prasūyante pravarāsu ca yoniṣu || 10.27 ||
eta iti | ete pūrvoktāḥ ṣaṭ pratilomajāḥ svayoniṣu sutotpattiṃ kurvanti | yathā śūdreṇa vaiśyāyāṃ jāta āyogavaḥ āyogavyām eva, mātṛjātau vaiśyāyāṃ, pravarāsu kṣatriyābrāhmaṇīyoniṣu, cakārād apakṛṣṭāyām api śūdrajātau, sarvatra sadṛśān varṇāñ janayanti | sadṛśatvaṃ ca na pitrapekṣayā kiṃ tu mātṛjātyādiṣu cāturvarṇyastrīṣv eva pitṛto ‘dhikagarhitaputrotpatter vakṣyamāṇatvāt, tatsadṛśān pitṛto ‘dhikagarhitān, svajātāv api janayantīty etāvad evāprāptatvād anena vidhīyate | kiṃ tu jaghanyavarṇenottamavarṇastrīṣu janitatvāt kriyāduṣṭā āyogavādyāḥ pratilomajāḥ kriyāduṣṭābhyāṃ ca mātāpitṛbhyāṃ tulyābhyām api janite āyogavādiputre brahmahantranantarajanito brahmahantṛmātāpitṛjanitavad adhikaduṣṭa eva nyāyyaḥ | śuddhabrāhmaṇādijātīyena śuddhabrāhmaṇyādijātīyāyāṃ janitaḥ pitṛtulya evocito na tu kriyāduṣṭobhayajanito ‘pi || 10.27 ||
yathā trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ dvayor ātmāsya jāyate |
ānantaryāt svayonyāṃ tu tathā bāhyeṣv api kramāt || 10.28 ||
yatheti | yathā trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ kṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrāṇāṃ madhyād dvayor varṇayoḥ kṣatriyavaiśyayor gamane brāhmaṇasyānulomyād dvija utpadyate, sajātīyāyāṃ ca dvijo jāyate | evaṃ bāhyeṣv api kṣatriyavaiśyābhyāṃ vaiśyakṣatriyābhyāṃ kṣatriyabrāhmaṇyor jāteṣūtkarṣāpakramo bhavati | śūdrajātapratilomāpekṣayā dvijādyutpannapratiloma-prāśastyārtham idam | medhātithis tu dvijatvapratipādakam etad eṣāṃ vacanam upanayanārtham ity āha | tan na, “pratilomajās tu dharmahīnāḥ” (GDh 4.3) iti gautamena saṃskāraniṣedhāt
|| 10.28 ||
te cāpi bāhyān subahūṃs tato ‘py adhikadūṣitān |
parasparasya dāreṣu janayanti vigarhitān || 10.29 ||
te cāpīti | te cāyogavādayaḥ ṣaṭ parasparajātīyāsu bhāryāsu subahūn ānulomye ‘py adhikaduṣṭān satkriyābahirbhūtāñ janayanti | tad yathā — āyogavaḥ kṣattṛjāyāyām ātmano hīnataraṃ janayati, tathā kṣattāpy āyogavyām ātmano hīnataram utpādayati | evam anyeṣv api pratilomeṣu draṣṭavyam || 10.29 ||
yathaiva śūdro brāhmaṇyāṃ bāhyaṃ jantuṃ prasūyate |
tathā bāhyataraṃ bāhyaś cāturvarṇye prasūyate || 10.30 ||
yathaiveti | yathā brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdro ‘pakṛṣṭaṃ cāṇḍālākhyaṃ prāṇinaṃ prasūyate janayaty evaṃ bāhyaś cāṇḍālādivarṇacatuṣṭaye cāṇḍālādibhyo ‘py apakṛṣṭaṃ putraṃ prasūyate || 10.30 ||
etad eva vistārayati –
pratikūlaṃ vartamānā bāhyā bāhyatarān punaḥ |
hīnā hīnān prasūyante varṇān pañcadaśaiva tu || 10.31 ||
pratikūlam iti | atra medhātithi-govindarājayor vyākhyānam — cāturvarṇyabāhyāś caṇḍālakṣattrāyogavāḥ śūdraprabhavās trayaś cāturvarṇye gacchanta ātmano hīnatarān parasparāpakṣayāpakṛṣṭotkṛṣṭavarṇaprabhavatvāt pañcadaśavarṇān saṃpādayanti | tad yathā – caṇḍālaḥ śūdrāyām ātmano hīnataraṃ vaiśyākṣatriyābrāhmaṇījātebhya utkṛṣṭaṃ janayati, evaṃ vaiśyāyāṃ tato ‘py apasadaṃ, kṣatriyāyāṃ brāhmaṇījātād utkṛṣṭaṃ janayati, tato ‘pasadaṃ, kṣatriyāyāṃ brāhmaṇījātād utkṛṣṭaṃ, tato ‘pi hīnaṃ brāhmaṇyāṃ janayati | evaṃ kṣattrāyogavāv api cāturvarṇye caturaś caturo janayataḥ, ity ete śūdraprabhavacaṇḍālakṣattrāyogavebhyaś cāturvarṇyadvādaśaprebhedā utpadyante | ātmanā ca caṇḍālakṣattrāyogavās traya ity evaṃ śūdraprabhavāḥ pañcadaśa utpadyante | evaṃ vaiśyakṣatriyabrāhmaṇaprabhavāḥ pratyekaṃ pañcadaśa saṃbhavanti | evaṃ ṣaṣṭiś cāturvarṇyena saha catuḥṣaṣṭiprabhedā bhavanti | te tu parasparagamanena nānāvarṇāñ janayantīti |
naitan manoharam, pūrvaśloke ṣaṇṇāṃ pratilomajānāṃ prakṛtatvāt tadvistārakathanatvāc cāsya | atrāpi śloke ‘pratikūlaṃ vartamānāḥ’ ity upādānāt pratilomajamātraviṣayo ‘yaṃ śloko nānulomajaviṣayaḥ | tathā ca vaiśyakṣatriyabrāhmaṇaprabhavāś ca pratyekaṃ pañcadaśa saṃbhavanty evaṃ ṣaṣṭir iti na saṃgacchate | na ca saṃbhavamātreṇaiveyaṃ ṣaṣṭir uktā na duṣṭatayā, śūdraprabhavāyogavakṣattṛcaṇḍālā eva cāturvarṇyasaṃtānopetāḥ pañcadaś garhitā iti vācyam | yato vaiśyakṣatriyābhyām api pratilomata utpāditānāṃ trayāṇāṃ hīnatvāt tair api cāturvarṇye janitānāṃ garhitatvasya saṃbhavāt “tathā bāhyataraṃ bāhyaś cāturvarṇye prasūyate” (10.30) iti manunaivānantaraṃ sphuṭam uktatvāt | yuvābhyām api tathaiva vyākhyātatvāc cāturvarṇyena saha catuḥṣaṣṭir iti sarvathaivāprakṛtam | na hi saṃkīrṇaprakaraṇe śuddhacāturvarṇyagaṇanocitā | kiṃ ca ‘’varṇān pañcadaśa prasūyante’ iti śrūyamāṇadvādaśajanān uktvā te cātmanā caṇḍālakṣatrāyogavās traya ity evaṃ śūdraprabhavāḥ pañcadaśeti na yuktam | api cātmanā saha pañcadaśa saṃpādayantīti na saṃgacchate | asaṃpādyatvād ātmanaḥ pañcadaśa saṃpadyanta iti ca vyākhyāne ‘dhyāhāra eva doṣaḥ, tasmād evaṃ vyākhyāyate — pratikūlaṃ vartamānāḥ pratilomajā bāhyāḥ, dvijapratilomajebhyo nikṛṣṭatvāt | śūdraprabhavāyogavakṣattṛcaṇḍālās trayaḥ | pūrvaślokād anuvartamāne cāturvarṇye svajātau “ete ṣaṭ sadṛśān” (10.27) ity atra sajātyutpannasya pitṛto garhitatvābhidhānāt ātmāpekṣayā bāhyāntarān pratyekaṃ pañcadaśa putrāñ janayanti | tad yathā – āyogavaś cāturvarṇyastrīṣu cāyogavyām ātmano nikṛṣṭān pañca putrāñ janayati | evaṃ kṣattṛcāṇḍālāv api
