pratyekaṃ pañca putrāñ janayataḥ | itthaṃ bāhyās trayaḥ pañcadaśa putrāñ janayanti | tathānulomajebhyo hīnā vaiśyakṣatriyaprabhavā māgadhavaidehasūtā ātmāpekṣayā hīnān pūrvvac cāturvarṇyastrīṣu sajātau pratyekaṃ pañca putrāñ janayanto hīnā api trayaḥ pañcadaśaiva putrāñ janayanti | evaṃ triṃśad ete bhavanti | atha vā bāhyaśabdo hīnaśabdaś ca ṣaḍ eva pratilomajān āha | atra bāhyāś cāṇḍālakṣattrāyogavavaidehamāgadhasūtāḥ ṣaḍ yathottaram utkarṣāt prātilomyena strīṣu vartamānā bāhyatarān pañcadaśaiva purāñ janayanti | tad yathā – cāṇḍālāḥ kṣatriyādiṣu pañcasu strīṣu, kṣattāyogavyādiṣu catasṛṣu, āyogavo vaidehyāditisṛṣu, vaideho māgadhīsūtyoḥ, māgadhaḥ sūtyāṃ, sūtas tu pratilomābhāvāt prātilomyena pañcadaśaiva putrāñ janayati | punar iti nirdeśād dhīnāḥ sūtādayaś cāṇḍālāntāḥ ṣaḍ yathottaram apakarṣād ānulomyenāpi pratilomoktarītyā svāpekṣayā hīnān pañcadaśaiva purāñ janayanti | evaṃ triṃśad ete bhavanti || 10.31 ||
prasādhanopacārajñam adāsaṃ dāsyajīvanam |
sairindhraṃ vāgurāvṛttiṃ sūte dasyur ayogave || 10.32 ||
prasādhaneti | keśaracanādiḥ prasādhanaṃ tasyopacārajñaṃ adāsam ucchiṣṭabhakṣaṇādidāsakarmarahitam aṅgasaṃvāhanādidāsakarmajīvanaṃ pāśabandhanena mṛgādivadhākhyavṛttyantarajīvanaṃ sairindhranāmānaṃ “mukhabāhūrupajjānām” (10.45) iti śloke vakṣyamāṇo dasyur āyogavastrījātau śūdreṇa vaiśyāyām utpannāyāṃ janayati, tac cāsya mṛgādimāraṇaṃ devapitrauṣadhārthaṃ veditavyam || 10.32 ||
maitreyakaṃ tu vaideho mādhūkaṃ saṃprasūyate |
nṝn praśaṃsaty ajasraṃ yo ghaṇṭātāḍo ‘ruṇodaye || 10.33 ||
maitreyakam iti | vaiśyād brāhmaṇyāṃ jāto vaidehaḥ prakṛtāyām āyogavyāṃ maitreyākhyaṃ madhurabhāṣiṇaṃ janayati | yaḥ prātar ghaṇṭām āhatya rājaprabhṛtīn satataṃ vṛttyarthaṃ stauti
|| 10.33 ||
niṣādo mārgavaṃ sūte dāsaṃ naukarmajīvinam |
kaivartam iti yaṃ prāhur āryāvartanivāsinaḥ || 10.34 ||
niṣāda iti | brāhmaṇena śūdrāyāṃ jāto niṣādaḥ prāguktāyām āyogavyāṃ mārgavaṃ dāsāparanāmānaṃ nauvyavahārajīvinaṃ janayati | āryāvartadeśavāsinaḥ kaivartaśabdena yaṃ kīrtayanti || 10.34 ||
mṛtavastrabhṛtsv anāryāsu garhitānnāśanāsu ca |
bhavanty āyogavīṣv ete jātihīnāḥ pṛthak trayaḥ || 10.35 ||
mṛteti | sairindhramaitreyamārgavā hīnajātīyās trayaḥ mṛtavastraparidhānāsu krūrāsūcchiṣṭādibhaktānnāśanāyogavīṣu pitṛbhedād bhinnā bhavanti || 10.35 ||
kārāvaro niṣādāt tu carmakāraḥ prasūyate |
vaidehakād andhramedau bahirgrāmapratiśrayau || 10.36 ||
kārāvara iti | “vaidehyām eva jāyate” (10.37) ity uttaratra śravaṇāt, atrāpy āśaṅkāyāṃ saiva saṃbadhyate | niṣādād vaidehyāṃ jātaḥ kārāvarākhyaś carmacchedanakārī jāyate | ata eva auśanase kārāvarāṇāṃ carcacchedanācaraṇam eva vṛttitvenoktam | vaidehakād andhramedākhyau grāmabahirvāsinau | antarānirdeśād vaidehakena ca vaidehyāṃ jātasya garhitavaidehakasyāpy ucitatvāt, kārāvaraniṣādajātyoś cātra śloke saṃnidhānāt, kārāvaraniṣādastriyor eva krameṇa jāyate || 10.36 ||
caṇḍālāt pāṇḍusopākas tvaksāravyavahāravān |
āhiṇḍiko niṣādena vaidehyām eva jāyate || 10.37 ||
caṇḍālād iti | vaidehyāṃ caṇḍālāt pāṇḍusopākākhyo veṇuvyavahārajīvī jāyate | niṣādena ca vaidehyām evāhiṇḍikākhyo jāyate | asya ca bandhanasthāneṣu bāhyasaṃrakṣaṇād āhiṇḍikānām ity auśanase vṛttir uktā | samānamātāpitṛkatve ‘pi kārāvarāhiṇḍikayor vṛttibhedasaṃśravaṇād vyapadeśabhedaḥ || 10.37 ||
caṇḍālena tu sopāko mūlavyasanavṛttimān |
pukkasyāṃ jāyate pāpaḥ sadā sajjanagarhitaḥ || 10.38 ||
caṇḍāleneti | śūdrāyāṃ niṣādena jātāyāṃ pukkasyāṃ caṇḍālena jātaḥ sopākākhyaḥ pāpātmā, sarvadā sādhubhir nindito, māraṇocitāparādhasya mūlaṃ vadhyas tasya vyasanaṃ rājādeśena māraṇaṃ tena vṛttir yasya sa jāyate || 10.38 ||
niṣādastrī tu caṇḍālāt putram antyāvasāyinam |
śmaśānagocaraṃ sūte bāhyānām api garhitam || 10.39 ||
niṣādastrīti | niṣādī caṇḍālād antyāvasāyisaṃjñaṃ caṇḍālādibhyo ‘pi duṣṭatamaṃ śmaśānavāsinaṃ tadvṛttiṃ ca janayati || 10.39 ||
saṃkare jātayas tv etāḥ pitṛmātṛpradarśitāḥ |
pracchannā vā prakāśā vā veditavyāḥ svakarmabhiḥ || 10.40 ||
saṃkara iti | varṇasaṃkaraviṣaye etā jātayo yasyeyaṃ janayitrī ayaṃ janakaḥ sa evaṃjātīya ity evaṃ pitṛmātṛkathanapūrvakaṃ darśitāḥ | tathā gūḍhāḥ prakaṭā vā tajjātyuditakarmānuṣṭhānena jñātavyāḥ || 10.40 ||
sajātīyānantarajāḥ ṣaṭ sutā dvijadharmiṇaḥ |
śūdrāṇāṃ tu sadharmāṇāḥ sarve ‘padhvaṃsajāḥ smṛtāḥ || 10.41 ||
sajātīti | dvijātisamānajātīyāsu jātāḥ, tathānulomyenotpannāḥ brāhmaṇena kṣatriyāvaiśyayoḥ kṣatriyeṇa vaiśyāyām evaṃ ṣaṭ putrā dvijadharmiṇa upaneyāḥ | “tān anantaranāmnas tu” (10.14) iti yad yuktaṃ tat tajjātivyapadeśārthaṃ na saṃskārārtham iti kasyacid bhramaḥ syād ata eṣāṃ dvijātisaṃskārārtham idaṃ vacanam | ye punar anye dvijātyutpannā api sūtādayaḥ pratilomajās te śūdradharmāṇo naiṣām upanayanam asti || 10.41 ||
tapobījaprabhāvais tu te gacchanti yuge yuge |
utkarṣaṃ cāpakarṣaṃ ca manuṣyeṣv iha janmataḥ || 10.42 ||
tapa iti | sajātijānantarajāḥ, tapaḥprabhāveṇa viśvāmitravat, bījaprabhāveṇa ṛṣyaśṛṅgādivat, kṛtatretādau manuṣyamadhye jātyutkarṣaṃ gacchanti | apakarṣaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇahetunā yānti || 10.42 ||
śanakais tu kriyālopād imāḥ kṣatriyajātayaḥ |
vṛṣalatvaṃ gatā loke brāhmaṇādarśanena ca || 10.43 ||
śanakair iti | imā vakṣyamāṇāḥ kṣatriyajātaya upanayanādikriyālopena brāhmaṇānāṃ ca yājanādhyāpanaprāyaścittādyarthadarśanābhāvena śanaiḥ śanair loke śūdratāṃ prāptāḥ
|| 10.43 ||
pauṇḍrakāś cauḍradraviḍāḥ kāmbojā yavanāḥ śakāḥ |
pāradāḥ pahlavāś cīnāḥ kirātā daradāḥ khaśāḥ || 10.44 ||
pauṇḍreti | pauṇḍrādideśodbhavāḥ santaḥ kriyālopādinā śūdratvam āpannāḥ || 10.44 ||
mukhabāhūrupajjānāṃ yā loke jātayo bahiḥ |
mlecchavācaś cāryavācaḥ sarve te dasyavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 10.45 ||
mukheti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrāṇāṃ kriyālopādinā yā jātayo bāhyā jātā mlecchabhāṣāyuktā āryabhāṣopetā vā te dasyavaḥ sarve smṛtāḥ || 10.45 ||
ye dvijānām apasadā ye cāpadhvaṃsajāḥ smṛtāḥ |
te ninditair vartayeyur dvijānām eva karmabhiḥ || 10.46 ||
ya iti | ye dvijānām ānulomyenotpannāḥ “ṣaḍ ete ‘pasadāḥ smṛtāḥ” (10.10) iti teṣām api pitṛto jaghanyatvena apasadaśabdena prāgabhidhānād apadhvaṃsajā te dvijātyupakārakair eva ninditair vakṣyamāṇaiḥ karmabhir jīveyuḥ || 10.46 ||
sūtānām aśvasārathyam ambaṣṭhānāṃ cikitsanam |
vaidehakānāṃ strīkāryaṃ māgadhānāṃ vaṇikpathaḥ || 10.47 ||
sūtānām iti | sūtānām aśvadamanayojanādirathasārathyaṃ jīvanārtham | ambaṣṭhānāṃ rogaśāntyādicikitsā, vaidehakānām antaḥpurarakṣaṇam, māgadhānāṃ sthalapathavaṇijyā
|| 10.47 ||
matsyaghāto niṣādānāṃ tvaṣṭis tv āyogavasya ca |
medāndhracuñcumadgūnām āraṇyapaśuhiṃsanam || 10.48 ||
matsyaghāta iti | niṣādānām uktānāṃ matsyavadhaḥ, āyogavasya kāṣṭhatakṣaṇaṃ, medāndhracuñcumadgūnām āraṇyapaśumāraṇam | cuñcur madguś ca vaidehakabandhistriyor brāhmaṇena jātau baudhāyanenoktau boddhavyau | bandhistrī ca kṣatriyeṇa śūdrāyāṃ jātā sograiva grāhyā || 10.48 ||
kṣatrugrapukkasānāṃ tu bilaukovadhabandhanam |
dhigvaṇānāṃ carmakāryaṃ veṇānāṃ bhāṇḍavādanam || 10.49 ||
kṣatrugreti | kṣatrādīnāṃ bilanivāsigodhādivadhabandhanaṃ, dhigvaṇānāṃ carmakaraṇaṃ,
carmakāryaṃ tadvikrayaś ca jīvanaṃ dhigvaṇānām |
ity auśanasadarśanāt | ata eva kārāvarebhya eṣāṃ vṛtticchedaḥ | veṇānāṃ kāṃsyamurajādivādyabhāṇḍavādanam || 10.49 ||
caityadrumaśmaśāneṣu śaileṣūpavaneṣu ca |
vaseyur ete vijñātā vartayantaḥ svakarmabhiḥ || 10.50 ||
caityeti | grāmādisamīpe khyātavṛkṣaś caityadrumaḥ tanmūle śmaśānaparvatavanasamīpeṣu cāmī prakāśakāḥ svakarmabhir jīvanto vaseyuḥ || 10.50 ||
caṇḍālaśvapacānāṃ tu bahirgrāmāt pratiśrayaḥ |
apapātrāś ca kartavyā dhanam eṣāṃ śvagardabham || 10.51 ||
vāsāṃsi mṛtacelāni bhinnabhāṇḍeṣu bhojanam |
kārṣṇāyasam alaṃkāraḥ parivrajyā ca nityaśaḥ || 10.52 ||
caṇḍāleti | vāsāṃsīti | pratiśrayo nivāsaḥ | caṇḍālaśvapākānāṃ tu grāmād bahir nivāsaḥ syāt | pātrarahitāḥ kartavyā yatra lohādipātre tair bhuktaṃ tat saṃskṛtyāpi na vyavahartavyaṃ, dhanaṃ caiṣāṃ kukkurakharaṃ na vṛṣabhādi, vāsāṃsi ca śavavastrāṇi, bhinnaśarāvādiṣu ca bhojanaṃ, lauhavalayādi cālaṃkaraṇaṃ, sarvadā ca bhramaṇaśīlatvam || 10.51–52 ||
na taiḥ samayam anvicchet puruṣo dharmam ācaran |
vyavahāro mithas teṣāṃ vivāhaḥ sadṛśaiḥ saha || 10.53 ||
na tair iti | dharmānuṣṭhānasamaye caṇḍālaśvapākaiḥ saha darśanādivyavahāraṃ na kuryāt | teṣāṃ ca ṛṇadānagrahaṇādivyavahāro vivāhaś ca samānajātīyaiḥ sahānyonyaṃ syāt || 10.53 ||
annam eṣāṃ parādhīnaṃ deyaṃ syād bhinnabhājane |
rātrau na vicareyus te grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca || 10.54 ||
annam eṣām iti | annam eṣāṃ parāyattaṃ kāryaṃ, sākṣād ebhyo na deyaṃ kiṃ tu preṣyair bhinnapātre dātavyam | te ca rātrau grāmanagarayor na paryaṭeyuḥ || 10.54 ||
divā careyuḥ kāryārthaṃ cihnitā rājaśāsanaiḥ |
abāndhavaṃ śavaṃ caiva nirhareyur iti sthitiḥ || 10.55 ||
diveti | divā grāmādau krayavikrayādikāryārthaṃ rājājñayā cihnāṅkitāḥ santaḥ paryaṭeyuḥ | anāthaṃ ca śavaṃ grāmān nirhareyur iti śāstramaryādā || 10.55 ||
vadhyāṃś ca hanyuḥ satataṃ yathāśāstraṃ nṛpājñayā |
vadhyavāsāṃsi gṛhṇīyuḥ śayyāś cābharaṇāni ca || 10.56 ||
vadhyāṃś ceti | vadhyāṃś ca śāstrānatikrameṇa śūlāropaṇādinā sarvadā rājājñayā hanyus tadvastraśayyālaṃkārāṃś ca gṛhṇīyuḥ || 10.56 ||
varṇāpetam avijñātaṃ naraṃ kaluṣayonijam |
āryarūpam ivānāryaṃ karmabhiḥ svair vibhāvayet || 10.57 ||
varṇāpetam iti | varṇatvād apetaṃ manuṣyaṃ saṃkarajātaṃ lokatas tathātvenāvijñātam ata evāryasadṛśaṃ vastutaḥ punar anāryaṃ, ninditayonyanurūpābhiś ceṣṭābhir vakṣyamāṇābhir niścinuyāt || 10.57 ||
anāryatā niṣṭhuratā krūratā niṣkriyātmatā |
puruṣaṃ vyañjayantīha loke kaluṣayonijam || 10.58 ||
anāryateti | niṣṭhuratvaparuṣabhāṣitvahiṃsratvavihitānanuṣṭhātṛtvāni saṃkarajātitvaṃ asmiṃl loke prakaṭīkurvanti || 10.58 ||
yasmāt –
pitryaṃ vā bhajate śīlaṃ mātur vobhayam eva vā |
na kathaṃcana duryoniḥ prakṛtiṃ svāṃ niyacchati || 10.59 ||
pitryaṃ veti | asau saṃkarajāto duṣṭayoniḥ pitṛsaṃbandhi duṣṭatvabhāvatvaṃ sevate mātṛsaṃbandhi vobhayasaṃbandhi vā | na kadācid asāv ātmakāraṇaṃ gopayituṃ śaknoti
|| 10.59 ||
kule mukhye ‘pi jātasya yasya syād yonisaṃkaraḥ |
sa śrayaty eva tacchīlaṃ naro ‘lpam api vā bahu || 10.60 ||
kula iti | mahākulaprasūtasyāpi yasya yonisaṃkaraḥ pracchanno bhavati sa manuṣyo janakasvabhāvaṃ stokaṃ pracuraṃ vā sevata eva || 10.60 ||
yatra tv ete paridhvaṃsāj jāyante varṇadūṣakāḥ |
rāṣṭriyaiḥ saha tad rāṣṭraṃ kṣipram eva vinaśyati || 10.61 ||
yatreti | yasmin rāṣṭre ete varṇasaṃkarā varṇānāṃ dūṣakā jāyante tad rāṣṭraṃ rāṣṭravāsijanaiḥ saha śīghram eva nāśam eti | tasmād rājñā varṇānāṃ saṃkaro nirasanīyaḥ
|| 10.61 ||
brāhaṃārthe gavārthe vā dehatyāgo ‘nupaskṛtaḥ |
strībālābhyupapattau ca bāhyānāṃ siddhikāraṇam || 10.62 ||
brāhmaṇārtha iti | gobrāhmaṇastrībālānām anyatarasyāpi paritrāṇārthaṃ duṣṭaprayojanānapekṣaḥ prāṇatyāgaḥ pratilomajānāṃ svargaprāptikāraṇam || 10.62 ||
ahiṃsā satyam asteyaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
etaṃ sāmāsikaṃ dharmaṃ cāturvarṇye ‘bravīn manuḥ || 10.63 ||
ahiṃsetyādi | hiṃsātyāgaḥ, yathārthābhidhānam, anyāyena paradhanasyāgrahaṇaṃ, mṛjjalādinā viśuddhiḥ, indriyasaṃyama ity evaṃ dharmaṃ saṃkṣepataś cāturvarṇyānuṣṭheyaṃ manur āha | prakaraṇasāmarthyāt saṃkīrṇānām apy ayaṃ dharmo veditavyaḥ || 10.63 ||
idānīṃ “sarvavarṇeṣu tulyāsu” (10.5) ity uktalakṣaṇavyatirekeṇāpi brāhmaṇyādi
darśayitum āha –
śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇāj jātaḥ śreyasā cet prajāyate |
aśreyān śreyasīṃ jātiṃ gacchaty ā saptamād yugāt || 10.64 ||
śūdrāyām iti | śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇāj jātaḥ pāraśavākhyo varṇaḥ prajāyata iti sāmarthyāt strīrūpaḥ syāt | sā yadi strī brāhmaṇenoḍhā satī prasūyate sā duhitaram eva janayati | sāpy anyena brāhmaṇenoḍhā satī duhitaram eva janayati | śāpy evam eva saptame yuge janmani sa pāraśavākhyo varṇo bījaprādhānyād brāhmaṇyaṃ prāpnoti | ‘ā saptamād yugāt’ ity abhidhānāt saptame janmani brāhmaṇaḥ saṃpadyata ity arthaḥ || 10.64 ||
śūdro brāhmaṇatām eti brāhmaṇaś caiti śūdratām |
kṣatriyāj jātam evaṃ tu vidyād vaiśyāt tathaiva ca || 10.65 ||
śūdra iti | evaṃ pūrvaślokoktarītyā śūdro brāhmaṇatāṃ yāti, brāhmaṇaś ca śūdratām eti | brāhmaṇo ‘tra brāhmaṇāc chūdrāyām utpannaḥ pāraśavo jñeyaḥ | sa yadi pumān kevalaśūdrodvāhena tasyāṃ pumāṃsam eva janayati, so ‘pi kevalaśūdrodvāhenāparaṃ pumāṃsam eva janayati, so ‘py evaṃ, tadā sa brāhmaṇaḥ, saptamaṃ janma prāptaḥ kevalaśūdratāṃ bījanikarṣāt krameṇa prāpnoti | evaṃ kṣatriyād vaiśyāc ca śūdrāyāṃ jātasyotkarṣāpakarṣau jānīyāt | kiṃ tu jāter apakarṣāt,
jātyutkarṣo yuge jñeyaḥ saptame pañcame ‘pi vā | (YDh 1.96)
iti yājñavalkyadarśanāc ca kṣatriyāj jātasya pañcame janmany utkarṣāpakarśau boddhavyau | vaiśyāj jātasya tato ‘py utkarṣāt | yājñavalkyena vāśabdena pakṣāntarasya saṃgṛhītatvād vṛddhavyākhyānurodhāc ca tṛtīyajanmany utkarṣāpakarṣau jñeyau | anenaiva nyāyena brāhmaṇena vaiśyāyāṃ jātasya pañcame janmany utkarṣāpakarṣau, kṣatriyāyāṃ jātasya tṛtīye, kṣatriyaṇa vaiśyāyāṃ jātasya tṛtīya eva boddhavyau || 10.65 ||
anāryāyāṃ samutpanno brāhmaṇāt tu yadṛcchayā |
brāhmaṇyām apy anaryāt tu śreyastvaṃ kveti ced bhavet || 10.66 ||
anāryāyām iti | ekaḥ śūdrāyāṃ yadṛcchayā anūḍhāyām api brāhmaṇād utpanno ‘nyaś ca brāhmaṇyāṃ śūdrāj jātaḥ dvayor madhye kva cotpannasya śreyastvam iti cet saṃśayaḥ syāt, saṃśayabījaṃ yathā bījotkarṣāt | brāhmaṇāc chūdrāyāṃ jātaḥ sādhuḥ śūdraḥ, evaṃ kṣetrotkarṣād brāhmaṇyām api śūdreṇa jātaḥ kim iti sādhuḥ śūdro na syāt || 10.66 ||
tatra nirṇayam āha –
jāto nāryām anāryāyām āryād āryo bhaved guṇaiḥ |
jāto ‘py anāryād āryāyām anārya iti niścayaḥ || 10.67 ||
jāta iti | śūdrāyāṃ striyāṃ brāhmaṇāj jātaḥ smṛtyuktaiḥ pākayajñādibhir guṇair anuṣṭhīyamānair yuktaḥ praśasyo bhavati | śūdreṇa punar brahmaṇyāṃ jātaḥ pratilomata utpannatayā śūdradharmeṣv apy anadhikārād apraśasya iti niścayaḥ | nyāyaprāpto ‘py artho vacanaprāmāṇyād atra bodhyate || 10.67 ||
tāv ubhāv apy asaṃskāryāv iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ |
vaiguṇyāj janmanaḥ pūrva uttaraḥ pratilomataḥ || 10.68 ||
tāv ubhāv iti | pāraśavacaṇḍālau dvāv apy anupaneyāv iti vyavasthitā śāstramaryādā | pūrvaḥ pāraśavaḥ śūdrājātatvena jātivaiguṇyād anupaneyaḥ | prātilomyena śūdreṇa brāhmaṇyāṃ jātatvād ity uttaratvenānupaneyaḥ || 10.68 ||
subījaṃ caiva sukṣetre jātaṃ saṃpadyate yathā |
tathāryāj jāta āryāyāṃ sarvaṃ saṃskāram arhati || 10.69 ||
subījam iti | yathā śobhanabījaṃ śobhanakṣetre jātaṃ samṛddhaṃ bhavati, evaṃ dvijāter dvijātistriyāṃ savarṇāyām ānulomyena ca kṣatriyāvaiśyayor jātaḥ savarṇasaṃskāraṃ kṣatriyavaiśyasaṃskāraṃ ca sarvaṃ śrautaṃ smārtaṃ cārhati | na ca pāraśavacaṇḍālāv iti pūrvoktadārḍhyārtham etat || 10.69 ||
darśanāntarāṇy uktasyaivārthasya sthairyārtham āha –
bījam eke praśaṃsanti kṣetram anye manīṣiṇaḥ |
bījakṣetre tathaivānye tatreyaṃ tu vyavasthitiḥ || 10.70 ||
bījam iti | kecit paṇḍitā bījaṃ suvanti, hariṇyādyutpannaṛṣyaśṛṅgāder brahmamunitvadarśanāt | apare punaḥ kṣetraṃ stuvanti, kṣetrasvāmiputratvadarśanāt | anye punar bījakṣetre ubhe api stuvanti, subījasya sukṣetre samṛddhidarśanāt | etasmin matabhede vakṣyamāṇeyaṃ vyavasthā jñeyā || 10.70 ||
akṣetre bījam utsṛṣṭam antaraiva vinaśyati |
abījakam api kṣetraṃ kevalaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ bhavet || 10.71 ||
akṣetra iti | ūṣarapradeśe bījam uptaṃ phalam adadad antarāla eva vinaśyati | śobhanam api kṣetraṃ bījarahitaṃ sthaṇḍilam eva kevalaṃ syān na tu tatra sasyam utpadyate | tasmāt pratyekanindayā “subījaṃ cai sukṣetre” (10.69) iti prāguktam ubhayaprādhānyam evābhihitam
|| 10.71 ||
idānīṃ bījaprādhānyapakṣe dṛṣṭāntam āha –
yasmād bījaprabhāveṇa tiryagjā ṛṣayo ‘bhavan |
pūjitāś ca praśastāś ca tasmād bījaṃ praśasyate || 10.72 ||
yasmād iti | yasmād bījamāhātmyena tiryagjātihariṇyādijā api ṛṣyaśṛṅgādayo munitvaṃ prāptāḥ, pūjitāś cābhivādyatvādinā, vedajñānādinā praśastā vācā saṃstutās tasmād bījaṃ prastūyate | etac ca bījaprādhānyanigamanaṃ bījayonyor madhye bījotkṛṣṭā jātiḥ pradhānam ity evaṃparatayā boddhavyam || 10.72 ||
anāryam āryakarmāṇam āryaṃ cānāryakarmiṇam |
saṃpradhāryābravīd dhātā na samau nāsamāv iti || 10.73 ||
anāryam iti | śūdraṃ dvijātikarmakāriṇaṃ dvijātiṃ ca śūdrakarmakāriṇaṃ brahmā vicārya ‘na samau nāsamau’ ity avocat | yataḥ śūdro dvijātikarmāpi na dvijātisamaḥ, tasyānadhikāriṇo dvijātikarmācaraṇe ‘pi tatsāmyābhāvāt | evaṃ śūdrakarmāpi dvijātir na śūdrasamaḥ, niṣiddhasevanena jātyutkarṣasyānapāyāt | nāpy asamau, niṣiddhācaraṇenobhayoḥ sāmyāt | tasmād yad yasya vigarhitaṃ tat tena na kartavyam iti saṃkaraparyantavarṇadharmopadeśaḥ
|| 10.73 ||
idānīṃ brāhmaṇānām āpaddharmaṃ pratipādayiṣyann idam āha –
brāhmaṇā brahmayonisthā ye svakarmany avasthitāḥ |
te samyag upajīveyuḥ ṣaṭ karmāṇi yathākramam || 10.74 ||
brāhmaṇā iti | ye brāhmaṇā brahmaprāptikāraṇabrahmadhyānaniṣṭhāḥ svakarmānuṣṭhānaniratāś ca te ṣaṭ karmāṇi vakṣyamāṇāny adhyāpanādīni krameṇa samyag anutiṣṭheyuḥ || 10.74 ||
tāni karmāṇy āha –
adhyāpanam adhyayanaṃ yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathā |
dānaṃ pratigrahaś caiva ṣaṭ karmāṇy agrajanmanaḥ || 10.75 ||
adhyāpanam iti | adhyāpanādhyayane sāṅgasya vedasya, tathā yajanayājane, dānapratigrahau cety etāni ṣaṭ karmāṇi brāhmaṇasya veditavyāni || 10.75 ||
ṣaṇṇāṃ tu karmaṇām asya trīṇi karmāṇi jīvikā |
yājanādhyāpane caiva viśuddhāc ca pratigrahaḥ || 10.76 ||
ṣaṇṇām iti | asya brāhmaṇasyaiṣām adhyāpanādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ madhyād yājanam adhyāpanaṃ viśuddhapratigrahaiḥ,
dvijātibhyo dhanaṃ lipset praśastebhyo dvijaḥ |
iti vacananirdeśād dvijātaiḥ pratigraha ity etāni trīṇi karmāṇi jīvanārthāni jñeyāni || 10.76 ||
trayo dharmā nivartante brāhmaṇāt kṣatriyaṃ prati |
adhyāpanaṃ yājanaṃ ca tṛtīyaś ca pratigrahaḥ || 10.77 ||
trayo dharmā iti | brāhmaṇāpekṣayā kṣatriyasyādhyāpanayājanapratigrahākhyāni vṛttyarthāni trīṇi karmāṇi nivartante | adhyayanayāgadānāni tu tasyāpi bhavanti || 10.77 ||
vaiśyaṃ prati tathaivaite nivarterann iti sthitiḥ |
na tau prati hi tān dharmān manur āha prajāpatiḥ || 10.78 ||
vaiśyaṃ pratīti | yathā kṣatriyasyādhyāpanayājanapratigrahā nivartante tathā vaiśyasyāpīti śāstravyavasthā | yasmān manuḥ prajāpatis tau kṣatriyavaiśyau prati tāni vṛttyarthāni karmāṇi kartavyatvena noktavān | evaṃ vaiśyasyāpy adhyayanayāgadānāni bhavanti || 10.78 ||
śastrāstrabhṛttvaṃ kṣatrasya vaṇikpaśukṛṣir viśaḥ |
ājīvanārthaṃ dharmas tu dānam adhyayanaṃ yajiḥ || 10.79 ||
śastrāstreti | śastraṃ khaḍgādi, astraṃ bāṇādi, etaddhāraṇaṃ prajārakṣaṇāya kṣatriyasya ca vṛttyartham | vāṇijyapaśurakṣaṇakṛṣikarmāṇi vaiśyasya jīvanārthāni | dharmārthāḥ punar anayor dānādhyayanayāgā bhavanti || 10.79 ||
vedābhyāso brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyasya ca rakṣaṇam |
vārtākarmaiva vaiśyasya viśiṣṭāni svakarmasu || 10.80 ||
vedābhyāsa iti | vedābhyāso vedādhyāpanaṃ rakṣāvārtābhyāṃ vṛttyarthābhyāṃ sahopadeśāt tad brāhmaṇasya, prajārakṣaṇaṃ kṣatriyasya, vāṇijyaṃ pāśupālyaṃ vaiśyasya, etāny eteṣāṃ vṛttyarthakarmasu śreṣṭhāni || 10.80 ||
adhunā āpaddharmam āha –
ajīvaṃs tu yathoktena brāhmaṇaḥ svena karmaṇā |
jīvet kṣatriyadharmeṇa sa hy asya pratyanantaraḥ || 10.81 ||
ajīvann iti | yathoktenādhyāpanādisvakarmaṇā brāhmaṇo nityakarmānuṣṭhānena kuṭumbasaṃvardhanapūrvakam ajīvan, kṣatriyakarmaṇā grāmanagararakṣaṇādinā jīvet | yasmāt kṣatriyadharmo ‘sya saṃnikṛṣṭā vṛttiḥ || 10.82 ||
ubhābhyām apy ajīvaṃs tu kathaṃ syād iti ced bhavet |
kṛṣigorakṣam āsthāya jīved vaiśyasya jīvikām || 10.82 ||
ubhābhyām iti | brāhmaṇa ubhābhyāṃ svavṛttikṣatriyavṛttibhyām ajīvan kena prakāreṇa varteteti yadi saṃśayaḥ syāt tadā kṛṣipaśurakṣaṇe āśritya vaiśyasya vṛttim anutiṣṭhet | kṛṣigorakṣagrahaṇaṃ vāṇijyadarśanārtham | tathā ca vikreyāṇi vakṣyati | svayaṃkṛtaṃ cedaṃ kṛṣyādi brāhmaṇāpadvṛttiḥ | asvayaṃkṛtasya “ṛtāmṛtābhyāṃ jīvet tu” (4.4) ity anāpady eva vihitatvāt || 10.82 ||
saṃprati kṛṣyāder balābalam āha –
vaiśyavṛttyāpi jīvaṃs tu brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo ‘pi vā |
hiṃsāprāyaṃ parādhīnāṃ kṛṣiṃ yatnena varjayet || 10.83 ||
vaiśyeti | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo ‘pi vā vaiśyavṛttyāpi jīvan bhūmiṣṭhajantuhiṃsābahulāṃ balīvardādiparādhīnāṃ kṛṣiṃ yatnatas tyajet | ataḥ paśupālanādyabhāve kṛṣiḥ kāryeti draṣṭavyam | ‘kṣatriyo ‘pi vā’ ity upādānāt kṣatriyasyāpy ātmīyavṛttyabhāve vaiśyavṛttir astīty abhigamyate || 10.83 ||
kṛṣiṃ sādhv iti manyante sā vṛttiḥ sadvigarhitā |
bhūmiṃ bhūmiśayāṃś caiva hanti kāṣṭham ayomukham || 10.84 ||
kṛṣim iti | sādhv idaṃ jīvanam iti kṛṣiṃ kecin manyante, sā punar jīvikā sādhubhir ninditā, yasmād dhalakuddālādilohaprāntaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ bhūmiṃ bhūmiṣṭhajantūṃś ca hanti || 10.84 ||
idaṃ tu vṛttivaikalyāt tyajato dharmanaipuṇam |
viṭpaṇyam uddhṛtoddhāraṃ vikreyaṃ vittavardhanam || 10.85 ||
idaṃ tv iti | brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyasya cātmīyavṛtter asaṃbhave, dhamaṃ prati yathoktaniṣṇātatvaṃ tyajato vaiśyena yad vikreyatvaṃ dravyajātaṃ tad vakṣyamāṇavarjanīyavarjitaṃ dhanavṛddhikaraṃ vikreyam || 10.85 ||
tāni varjanīyāny āha –
sarvān rasān apoheta kṛtānnaṃ ca tilaiḥ saha |
aśmano lavaṇaṃ caiva paśavo ye ca mānuṣāḥ || 10.86 ||
sarvān iti | sarvān acodyamānān adharmān yathā siddhārthatilapāṣāṇalavaṇapaśumanuṣyān na vikrīṇīta | rasatvenaiva lavaṇasya niṣedhasiddhau viśeṣeṇa niṣedho doṣagauravajñāpanārthaḥ | tac ca prāyaścittagauravārtham | evam anyasyāpi pṛthaṅniṣedho vyākhyeyaḥ || 10.86 ||
sarvaṃ ca tāntavaṃ raktaṃ śāṇakṣaumāvikāni ca |
api cet syur araktāni phalamūle tathauṣadhīḥ || 10.87 ||
sarvam iti | sarvaṃ tantunirmitaṃ vastraṃ kusumbhādiraktaṃ varjayet | śaṇakṣumātantumayāny āvikalomabhavāni ca yady alohitāny api bhaveyus tathāpi na vikrīṇīta | tathā phalamūlaguḍūcyādīni varjayet || 10.87 ||
apaḥ śastraṃ viṣaṃ māṃsaṃ somaṃ gandhāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ |
kṣīraṃ kṣaudraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ madhu guḍaṃ kuśān || 10.88 ||
apa iti | jalalohaviṣamāṃsasomakṣīradadhighṛtatailaguḍadarbhān, tathā gandhavanti sarvāṇi karpūrādīni, kṣaudraṃ mākṣikaṃ, madhu madhūcchiṣṭa “sabhrāmaramadhūcchiṣṭa-“ (YDh 1.33) iti yājñavalkyena paṭhitaṃ varjayet || 10.88 ||
āraṇyāṃś ca paśūn sarvān daṃṣṭriṇaś ca vayāṃsi ca |
madyaṃ nīlīṃ ca lākṣāṃ ca sarvāṃś caikaśapāṃs tathā || 10.89 ||
āraṇyān iti | āraṇyān sarvān paśūn hastyādīn, daṃṣṭriṇaḥ siṃhādīn, tathā pakṣijalajantūn, madyādīn, ekaśapāṃś cāśvādīn, na vikrīṇīta || 10.89 ||
kāmam utpādya kṛṣyāṃ tu svayam eva kṛṣīvalaḥ |
vikrīṇīta tilāñ śuddhān dharmārtham acirasthitān || 10.90 ||
kāmam iti | karṣakaḥ svayam eva karṣaṇena tilān utpādya, dravyāntareṇāmiśrān utpattyanantaram eva na tu lābhārthaṃ kālāntaraṃ pratīkṣya dharmanimittam icchato vikrīṇīta, niṣiddhasya tilavikrayasya dharmārtham ayaṃ pratisravaḥ || 10.90 ||
bhojanābhyañjanād dānād yad anyat kurute tilaiḥ |
kṛmibhūtaḥ śvaviṣṭhāyāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati || 10.91 ||
bhojaneti | bhojanābhyaṅgadānavyatiriktaṃ yad anyan niṣiddhaṃ vikrayādi tilānāṃ kurute, tena pitṛbhiḥ saha kṛmitvaṃ prāptaḥ kukkurapurīṣe majjati || 10.91 ||
sadyaḥ patati māṃsena lākṣayā lavaṇena ca |
tryaheṇa śūdro bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ kṣīravikrayāt || 10.92 ||
sadya iti | māṃsalākṣālavaṇavikrayair brāhmaṇas tatkṣaṇād eva patatīti doṣagauravakhyāpanārtham etat, pañcānām eva mahāpātakināṃ pātityahetūnāṃ vakṣyamāṇatvāt | kṣīravikrayāt tryaheṇa śūdratāṃ prāpnoti | etad api doṣagauravāt prāyaścittagauravakhyāpanārtham || 10.92 ||
itareṣāṃ tu paṇyānāṃ vikrayād iha kāmataḥ |
brāhmaṇaḥ saptarātreṇa vaiśyabhāvaṃ niyacchati || 10.93 ||
itareṣām iti | brāhmaṇa uktebhyo māṃsādibhyo ‘nyeṣāṃ pratiṣiddhānāṃ paṇyānām icchāto na tu pramādād dravyāntarasaṃśliṣṭānāṃ saptarātravikrayaṇena vaiśyatvaṃ gacchati || 10.93 ||
rasā rasair nimātavyā na tv eva lavaṇaṃ rasaiḥ |
kṛtānnaṃ cākṛtānnena tilā dhānyena tatsamāḥ || 10.94 ||
rasā iti | rasā guḍādayo rasair ghṛtādibhiḥ parivartanīyāḥ | lavaṇaṃ punā rasāntareṇa na parivartanīyaṃ, siddhānnaṃ cāmānnena parivartanīyaṃ, tilā dhānyena dhānyaprasthaprasthenety evaṃ tatsamāḥ parivartanīyāḥ || 10.94 ||
jīved etena rājanyaḥ sarveṇāpy anayaṃ gataḥ |
na tv eva jyāyasīṃ vṛttim abhimanyeta karhicit || 10.95 ||
jīved iti | kṣatriyaḥ āpadaṃ prāptaḥ ‘etena’ ity abhidhāya ‘sarveṇa’ ity abhidhānād brāhmaṇagocaratayā niṣiddhenāpi rasādivikrayaṇena vaiśyavaj jīvet, na punaḥ kadācid brāhmaṇajīvikāṃ āśrayet | na kevalaṃ kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyavad anyo ‘pi || 10.95 ||
yo lobhād adhamo jātyā jīved utkṛṣṭakarmabhiḥ |
taṃ rājā nirdhanaṃ kṛtvā kṣipram eva pravāsayet || 10.96 ||
yo lobhād iti | yo nikṛṣṭajātiḥ san, lobhād utkṛṣṭajātivihiitakarmabhir jīvet taṃ rājā gṛhītasarvasvaṃ kṛtvā tadānīm eva deśān niḥsārayet || 10.96 ||
varaṃ svadharmo viguṇo na pārakyaḥ svanuṣṭhitaḥ |
paradharmeṇa jīvan hi sadyaḥ patati jātitaḥ || 10.97 ||
varam iti | viguṇam api svakarma kartuṃ nyāyyaṃ, na parakīyaṃ saṃpūrṇam api, yasmāj jātyantaravihitakarmaṇā jīvan tatkṣaṇād eva svajātitaḥ patatīti doṣo varjanārthaḥ || 10.97 ||
vaiśyo ‘jīvan svadharmeṇa śūdravṛttyāpi vartayet |
anācarann akāryāṇi nivarteta ca śaktimān || 10.98 ||
viśya iti | vaiśyaḥ svavṛttyā jīvitum aśaknuvan śūdravṛttyāpi dvijātiśuśrūṣayocchiṣṭabhojanādīny akurvan varteta, nistīrṇāpat kramaśaḥ śūdravṛttito nivarteta || 10.98 ||
aśaknuvaṃs tu śuśrūṣāṃ śūdraḥ kartuṃ dvijanmanām |
putradārātyayaṃ prāpto jīvet kārukarmabhiḥ || 10.99 ||
aśaknuvann iti | śūdraḥ dvijātiśuśrūṣāṃ kartum akṣamaḥ kṣudavasannaputrakalatraḥ sūpakārādikarmabhir jīvet || 10.99 ||
yaiḥ karmabhiḥ pracaritaiḥ śuśrūṣyante dvijātayaḥ |
tāni kārukakarmāṇi śilpāni vividhāni ca || 10.100 ||
yair iti | pūrvoktakārukarmaviśeṣābhidhānārtham idam | yaiḥ karmabhiḥ kṛtair dvijātayaḥ paricaryante tāni ca karmāṇi takṣaṇādīni śilpāni ca citralikhitādīni nānāprakārāṇi kuryāt
|| 10.100 ||
vaiśyavṛttim anātiṣṭhan brāhmaṇaḥ sve pathi sthitaḥ |
avṛttikarṣitaḥ sīdann imaṃ dharmaṃ samācaret || 10.101 ||
vaiśyeti | brāhmaṇo vṛttyabhāvapīḍito ‘vasādaṃ gacchan kṣatriyavaiśyavṛttim anātiṣṭhan “varaṃ svadharmo viguṇaḥ” (10.97) ity uktatvāt svavṛttāv eva vartamāna imāṃ vakṣyamāṇāṃ vṛttim anutiṣṭhet | ataś ca viguṇapratigrahādisvavṛttyasaṃbhave paravṛttyāśrayaṇaṃ jñeyam
|| 10.101 ||
sarvataḥ pratigṛhṇīyād brāhmaṇas tv anayaṃ gataḥ |
pavitraṃ duṣyatīty etad dharmato nopapadyate || 10.102 ||
sarvata iti | brāhmaṇa āpadaṃ prāptaḥ sarvebhyo ‘pi ninditatamebhyaḥ krameṇa pratigrahaṃ kuryāt | atrārthāntaranyāso nāmālaṃkāraḥ | yasmāt pavitraṃ gaṅgādirathyodakādinā duṣyatīty etac chāstrasthityā nopapadyate || 10.102 ||
yasmāt –
nādhyāpanād yājanād vā garhitād vā pratigrahāt |
doṣo bhavati viprāṇāṃ jvalanāmbusamā hi te || 10.103 ||
nādhyāpanād iti | brāhmaṇānām āpadi garhitādhyāpanayājanapratigrahair adharmo na bhavati | yasmāt svabhāvataḥ pavitratvenāgnyudakatulyās te || 10.103 ||
jīvitātyayam āpanno yo ‘nnam atti yatas tataḥ |
ākāśam iva paṅkena na sa pāpena lipyate || 10.104 ||
jīviteti | yaḥ prāṇātyayaṃ prāptaḥ pratilomajād annam aśnāti so ‘ntarikṣam iva kardamena pāpena na saṃbadhyate || 10.104 ||
atra parakṛtirūpārthavādam āha –
ajīgartaḥ sutaṃ hantum upāsarpad bubhukṣitaḥ |
na cālipyata pāpena kṣutpratīkāram ācaran || 10.105 ||
ajīgarta iti | ṛṣir ajīgartākhyo bubhukṣitaḥ san, putraṃ śunaḥśepanāmānaṃ svayaṃ vikrītavān | yajñe gośatalābhāya yajñayūpe baddhvā viśasitā bhūtvā hantuṃ pracakrame | na ca kṣutpratīkārārthaṃ tathā kurvan pāpena liptaḥ | etac ca bahvṛcabrāhmaṇe śunaḥśephākhyāneṣu vyaktam uktam || 10.105 ||
śvamāṃsam icchann ārto ‘ttuṃ dharmādharmavicakṣaṇaḥ |
prāṇānāṃ parirakṣārthaṃ vāmadevo na liptavān || 10.106 ||
śvamāṃsam iti | vāmadevākhya ṛṣir dharmādharmajñaḥ kṣudhārtaḥ prāṇatrāṇārthaṃ śvamāṃsaṃ khāditum icchan doṣeṇa na liptavān || 10.106 ||
bharadvājaḥ kṣudhārtas tu saputro vijane vane |
bahvīr gāḥ pratijagrāha vṛdhos takṣṇo mahātapāḥ || 10.107 ||
baradvāja iti | bharadvājākhyo muniḥ mahātapasvī putrasahito nirjane vane ‘raṇya uṣitvā kṣutpīḍito vṛdhunāmnas takṣṇo bahvīr gāḥ pratigṛhītavān || 10.107 ||
kṣudhārtaś cāttum abhyāgād viśvāmitraḥ śvajāghanīm |
caṇḍālahastād ādāya dharmādharmavicakṣaṇaḥ || 10.108 ||
kṣudhārta iti | ṛṣir viśvāmitro dharmādharmajñaḥ kṣutpīḍitaś caṇḍālahastād gṛhītvā kukkurajaghanamāṃsaṃ bhakṣitum adhyavasitavān || 10.108 ||
pratigrahād yājanād vā tathaivādhyāpanād api |
pratigrahaḥ pratyavaraḥ pretya viprasya garhitaḥ || 10.109 ||
pratigrahād iti | garhitānām apy adhyāpanayājanapratigrahāṇāṃ madhyād brāhmaṇasyāsatpratigraho nikṛṣṭaḥ paraloke narakahetuḥ | tataś cāpadi prathamaṃ ninditādhyāpanayājanayoḥ pravartitavyam, tadasaṃbhave tv asatpratigraha ity evaṃparam etat
|| 10.109 ||
atra hetum āha –
yājanādhyāpane nityaṃ kriyete saṃskṛtātmanām |
pratigrahas tu kriyate śūdrād apy antyajanmanaḥ || 10.110 ||
yājaneti | yājanādhyāpane āpady anāpadi ca upanayanasaṃskṛtātmanāṃ dvijātīnām eva kriyete | pratigrahaḥ punar nikṛṣṭajāteḥ śūdrād api kriyate tasmād asau tābhyāṃ garhitaḥ
|| 10.110 ||
japahomair apaity eno yājanādhyāpanaiḥ kṛtam |
pratigrahanimittaṃ tu tyāgena tapasaiva ca || 10.111 ||
japeti | enograhaṇād asatpratigrahayājanādhyāpanair yad upapannaṃ tat prāyaścittaprakaraṇe vakṣyamāṇakrameṇa japahomair naśyati | asatpratigrahajanitaṃ punaḥ pratigṛhītadravyatyāgena “māsaṃ goṣṭhe payaḥ pītvā” (11.193) ity evamādivakṣyamāṇatapasāpagacchati || 10.111 ||
śiloñcham apy ādadīta vipro ‘jīvan yatas tataḥ |
pratigrahāc chilaḥ śreyāṃs tato ‘py uñchaḥ praśasyate || 10.112 ||
śiloñcham iti | brāhmaṇaḥ svavṛttyājīvan yatas tato ‘pi śiloñchaṃ gṛhṇīyān na tu tatsaṃbhave ‘satpratigrahaṃ kuryāt | yasmād asatpratigrahāc chilaḥ praśastaḥ | mañjaryātmakān ekadhānyonnayanaṃ śilaḥ, tato ‘py uñchaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ | ekaikadhānyādiguḍakoccayanam uñchaḥ
|| 10.112 ||
sīdadbhiḥ kupyam icchadbhir dhanaṃ vā pṛthivīpatiḥ |
yācyaḥ syāt snātakair viprair aditsaṃs tyāgam arhati || 10.113 ||
sīdadbhir iti | snātakair brāhmaṇair dhanābhāvād dharmārthaṃ kuṭumbāvasādaṃ gacchadbhiḥ suvarṇarajatavyatiriktaṃ dhānyavastrādi kupyaṃ dhanaṃ yāgādyupayuktaṃ hiraṇyādy apy āpatprakaraṇāt kṣatriyo ‘py ucchāstravartī yācitavyaḥ syāt | yaś ca dātuṃ necchati kṛpaṇatvenāvadhāritaḥ sa tyājyo na yācanīya ity arthaḥ | medhātithi-govindarājau tu “tyāgam arhatīti tasya deśe na vastavyam” iti vyācakṣāte || 10.113 ||
akṛtaṃ ca kṛtāt kṣetrād gaur ajāvikam eva ca |
hiraṇyaṃ dhānyam annaṃ ca pūrvaṃ pūrvam adoṣavat || 10.114 ||
akṛtaṃ ceti | akṛtam anuptasasyaṃ kṣetraṃ tatkṛtād uptasasyāt pratigrahe doṣarahitaṃ tathā gochāgameṣahiraṇyadhānyasiddhānnānāṃ madhyāt pūrvaṃ pūrvam aduṣṭam | tataś caiṣāṃ pūrvapūrvāsaṃbhave paraḥ paro jñeyaḥ || 10.114 ||
sapta vittāgamā dharmyā dāyo lābhaḥ krayo jayaḥ |
prayogaḥ karmayogaś ca satpratigraha eva ca || 10.115 ||
sapteti | dāyādyāḥ sapta dhanāgamāḥ yathādhanādhikāraṃ dharmād anapetāḥ | tatra dāyo ‘nvayāgatadhanam, lābho nidhyādeḥ maitryādilabdhasya ca, krayaḥ prasiddhaḥ, ete trayaś caturṇām api varṇānāṃ dharmyāḥ | jayadhanaṃ vijayatvena kṣatriyasya dharmyaḥ, prayogo vṛddhyādidhanasya, karmayogaś ca kṛṣivāṇijye, etau prayogau vaiśyasya dharmyau, satpratigraho brāhmaṇasya dharmyaḥ | evaṃ caiteṣāṃ dharmatvavacanād etadabhāve ‘nyeṣv anāpadvihiteṣu vṛttikarmasu pravartitavyam | tadabhāve cāpadvihiteṣu prakṛteṣv ity etadartham etad ihocyate || 10.115 ||
vidyā śilpaṃ bhṛtiḥ sevā gorakṣyaṃ vipaṇiḥ kṛṣiḥ |
dhṛtir bhaikṣyaṃ kusīdaṃ ca daśa jīvanahetavaḥ || 10.116 ||
vidyeti | āpatprakaraṇāj jīvanahetava iti nirdeśād eṣāṃ madhye yayā vṛttyā yasyānāpadi na jīvanaṃ tayā tasyāpady abhyanujñāyate | yathā brāhmaṇasya bhṛtisevādi | evaṃ śilpādāv api jñeyam | vidyā vedavidyāvyatiriktā vaidyatarkaviṣāpanayanādividyā sarveṣām āpadi jīvanārthaṃ na duṣyati | śilpaṃ gandhayuktyādikaraṇaṃ, bhṛtiḥ praiṣyabhāvena vetanagrahaṇaṃ, sevā parājñāsaṃpādanaṃ, gorakṣyaṃ paśupālyaṃ, vipaṇir vaṇijyā, kṛṣiḥ svayaṃ kṛtā, dhṛtiḥ saṃtoṣas tasmin saty alpakenāpi jīvyate, bhaikṣyaṃ bhikṣāsamūhaḥ, kusīdaṃ vṛddhyā dhanaprayogaḥ svayaṃ kṛto ‘pīty ebhir daśabhir āpadi jīvanīyam || 10.116 ||
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vṛddhiṃ naiva prayojayet |
kāmaṃ tu khalu dharmārthaṃ dadyāt pāpīyase ‘lpikām || 10.117 ||
brāhmaṇa iti | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vṛddhyādidhanam āpady api na prayuñjīta kiṃ tu nikṛṣṭakarmaṇā dharmārtham alpikayā vṛddhyā prayuñjīta || 10.117 ||
idānīṃ rājñām āpadharmam āha –
caturtham ādadāno ‘pi kṣatriyo bhāgam āpadi |
prajā rakṣan paraṃ śaktyā kilbiṣāt pratimucyate || 10.118 ||
caturtham iti | rājño dhānyādīnām aṣṭama ityādy uktaṃ sa āpadi dhānyādeś caturtham api bhāgaṃ karārthaṃ gṛhṇan parayā śaktyā prajā rakṣann adhikakaragrahaṇapāpena na saṃbadhyate || 10.118 ||
kasmāt punar āpady api rājño ‘pi rakṣaṇam ucyate, yasmāt –
svadharmo vijayas tasya nāhave syāt parāṅmukhaḥ |
śastreṇa vaiśyān rakṣitvā dharmyam āhārayed balim || 10.119 ||
svadharma iti | rājñaḥ śatruvijayaḥ svadharmo vijayaphalaṃ yuddham ity arthaḥ | prajārakṣaṇaprayuktasya yadi kutaścid bhayaṃ syād tadā sa yuddhaparāṅmukho bhavet | evaṃ ca śastreṇa vaiśyān dasyubhyo rakṣitvā tebhyo dharmād anapetam āptapuruṣair balim āhārayet || 10.119 ||
ko ‘sau balis tam āha –
dhānye ‘ṣṭamaṃ viśāṃ śulkaṃ viṃśaṃ kārṣāpaṇāvaram |
karmopakaraṇāḥ śūdrāḥ kāravaḥ śilpinas tathā || 10.120 ||
dhānya iti | dhānye viṃśa upacaye vaiśyānām aṣṭamaṃ bhāgaṃ śulkam āhārayet | dhānyānāṃ dvādaśo ‘pi bhāga uktaḥ | āpady ayam aṣṭama ucyate | atyantāpadi prāguktaś caturtho veditavyas tatrāpi viṃśaṃ grāhyam | tathā hiraṇyadīnāṃ kārṣāpaṇāntānāṃ viṃśatitamaṃ bhāgaṃ śulkaṃ gṛhṇīyāt tatrāpi “pañcāśad bhāg ādeyo rājñā paśuhiraṇyayoḥ” (7.130) ity anāpadi pañcāśadbhāga uktaḥ | āpady ayaṃ viṃśa ucyate tathā śūdrāḥ, kāravaḥ sūpakārādayaḥ, śilpinaḥ takṣādayaḥ, karmaṇaivopakurvanti na tu tebhya āpady api karo grāhyaḥ || 10.120 ||
śūdras tu vṛttim ākāṅkṣan kṣatram ārādhayed yadi |
dhaninaṃ vāpy upārādhya vaiśyaṃ śūdro jijīviṣet || 10.121 ||
śūdras tv iti | śūdro brāhmaṇaśuśrūṣayājivan yadi vṛttim ākāṅkṣet tadā kṣatriyaṃ paricarya tadabhāve dhaninaṃ viśyaṃ paricarya jīvitum icchet | dvijātiśuśrūṣāsāmarthye tu prāguktāni karmāṇi kuryāt || 10.121 ||
svargārtham ubhayārthaṃ vā viprān ārādhayet tu saḥ |
jātabrāhmaṇaśabdasya sā hy asya kṛtakṛtyatā || 10.122 ||
svargārtham iti | svargaprāptyarthaṃ svavṛttilipsārthaṃ vā brāhmaṇān eva śūdraḥ paricaret | tasmāj jāto brāhmaṇāśrito ‘yam iti śabdo yasya | śākapārthivāditvāt samāsaḥ | sāsya śūdrasya kṛtakṛtyatā, tadvyapadeśatayāsau kṛtakṛtyo bhavati || 10.122 ||
yata evam ataḥ –
viprasevaiva śūdrasya viśiṣṭaṃ karma kīrtyate |
yad ato ‘nyad dhi kurute tad bhavaty asya niṣphalam || 10.123 ||
vipreti | brāhmaṇaparicaryaiva śūdrasya karmāntarebhyaḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ karma śāstre ‘bhidhīyate | yasmād etadvyatiriktaṃ yad asau karma kurute tad asya niṣphalaṃ bhavatīti pūrvastutyarthaṃ na tv anyanivṛttaye, pākayajñādīnām api tasya vihitatvāt || 10.123 ||
prakalpyā tasya tair vṛttiḥ svakuṭumbād yathārhataḥ |
śaktiṃ cāvekṣya dākṣyaṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ ca parigraham || 10.124 ||
prakalpyeti | tasya paricārakaśūdrasya paricaryāsāmarthyaṃ karmotsāhaṃ putradārādibhartavyaparimāṇaṃ cāvekṣya tair brāhmaṇaiḥ svagṛhād anurūpā jīvikā kalpanīyā
|| 10.124 ||
ucchiṣṭam annaṃ dātavyaṃ jīrṇāni vasanāni ca |
pulākāś caiva dhānyānāṃ jīrṇāś caiva paricchadāḥ || 10.125 ||
ucchiṣṭam iti | tasmai prakṛtāśritaśūdrāya bhuktāvaśiṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇair deyam | evaṃ ca “na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyān nocchiṣṭam” (4.80) ity anāśritaśūdraviṣayam avatiṣṭhate | tathā jīrṇavastrāsāradhānyajīrṇaśayyāparicchadā asmai deyāḥ || 10.125 ||
na śūdre pātakaṃ kiṃcin na ca saṃskāram arhati |
nāsyādhikāro dharme ‘sti na dharmāt pratiṣedhanam || 10.126 ||
na śūdra iti | laśunādibhakṣaṇena śūdre na kiṃcit pātakaṃ bhavati | na tu brahmavadhādāv api, “ahiṃsā satyaṃ” (10.63) ityādeś cāturvarṇyasādhāraṇatvena vihitatvāt | na cāpy upanayanādisaṃskāram arhati, nāsyāgnihotrādidharme ‘dhikāro ‘sti, avihitatvāt | na ca śūdravihitāt pākayajñādidharmād asya niṣedhaḥ | evaṃ cāsya sarvasya siddhārthatvād ayaṃ śloka uttarārtho ‘nuvādaḥ || 10.126 ||
dharmepsavas tu dharmajñāḥ satāṃ vṛttam anuṣṭhitāḥ |
mantravarjaṃ na duṣyanti praśaṃsāṃ prāpnuvanti ca || 10.127 ||
dharmepsava iti | ye punaḥ śūdrāḥ svadharmavedino dharmaprāptikāmās traivarṇikānām ācāram aniṣiddham āśritās te “namaskāreṇa mantreṇa pañcayajñān na hāpayet” (YDh 1.121) iti yājñavalkyavacanān namaskāramantreṇa mantrāntararahitaṃ pañcayajñādidharmān kurvāṇā na pratyavayanti | khyātiṃ ca loke labhante || 10.127 ||
yathā yathā hi sadvṛttam ātiṣṭhaty anasūyakaḥ |
tathā tathemaṃ cāmuṃ ca lokaṃ prāpnoty aninditaḥ || 10.128 ||
yatheti | paraguṇānindakaḥ śūdro yathā yathā dvijātyācāram aniṣiddham anutiṣṭhati tathā tathā janair anindita iha loke utkṛṣṭaḥ smṛtaḥ svargādilokaṃ ca prāpnoti || 10.128 ||
śaktenāpi hi śūdreṇa na kāryo dhanasaṃcayaḥ |
śūdro hi dhanam āsādya brāhmaṇān eva bādhate || 10.129 ||
śaktenāpīti | dhanārjanasamarthenāpi śūdreṇa poṣyavargasaṃvardhanapañcayajñāsyucitād adhikabahudhanasaṃcayo na kartavyaḥ | yasmād śūdro dhanaṃ prāpya śāstrānabhijñatvena dhanamadāc chuśrūṣāyāś cākaraṇād brāhmaṇān eva pīḍayatīty uktasyānuvādaḥ || 10.129 ||
ete caturṇāṃ varṇānām āpadharmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
yān samyag anutiṣṭhanto vrajanti paramāṃ gatim || 10.130 ||
eta iti | amī caturṇāṃ varṇānām āpady anuṣṭheyā dharmā uktāḥ | yān samyag ācaranto vihitānuṣṭhānān niṣiddhānācaraṇāc ca niṣpāpatayā brahmajñānalābhena paramāṃ gatiṃ mokṣalakṣaṇāṃ labhante || 10.130 ||
eṣa dharmavidhiḥ kṛtsnaś cāturvarṇyasya kīrtitaḥ |
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubham || 10.131 ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ
daśamo ‘dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
eṣa iti | ayaṃ caturṇāṃ varṇānām ācāraḥ samagraḥ kathitaḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ prāyaścittānuṣṭhānaṃ śubham abhidhāsyāmi || 10.131 ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau
daśamo ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
ekādaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ
sāntānikaṃ yakṣyamāṇam adhvagaṃ sarvavedasam |
gurvarthaṃ pitṛmātrarthaṃ svādhyāyārthy upatāpinaḥ || 11.1 ||
navaitān snātakān vidyād brāhmaṇān dharmabhikṣukān |
niḥsvebhyo deyam etebhyo dānaṃ vidyāviśeṣataḥ || 11.2 ||
sāntānikam iti | navaitān iti | nanu “ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubhaṃ” (10.131) iti prāyaścittasya vaktavyatayā pratijñātatvāt sāntānikādibhyo deyam ityādeḥ kaḥ prastāvaḥ?
ucyate | “dānenākāryakāriṇaḥ” (5.107) iti prāguktatvāt “dānena vadhanirṇekaṃ sarpādīnām aśaknuvan” (11.139) ityādeś ca vakṣyamāṇatvāt prakṛṣṭaprāyaścittātmakadāna-pātropanyāsaḥ prakṛtopayukta eva | varṇāśramadharmādivyatiriktaprāyaścittādinaimittika-dharmakathanārthatvāc cādhyāyasyānyasyāpi naimittikadharmasyātropanyāso yuktaḥ | santānaprayojanatvād vivāhasya sāntāniko vivāhārthī yakṣyamāṇo ‘vaśyakartavyajyotiṣṭomādiyāgaṃ cikīrṣuḥ, adhvagaḥ pānthaḥ, sarvavedasaḥ kṛtasarvasvadakṣiṇaviśvajidyāgaḥ, vidyāguror grāsācchādanādyarthaḥ prayojanaṃ yasya sa gurvarthaḥ, evaṃ pitṛmātrarthāv api, svādhyāyārthī svādhyāyādhyayanakālīnācchādanādy-arthī brahmacārī, upatāpī rogī, etān nava brāḥmaṇān dharmabhikṣāśīlān snātakāñ jānīyāt | etebhyo nirdhanebhyo gohiraṇyādi dīyata iti dānaṃ vidyāviśeṣānurūpeṇa dadyāt || 11.2 ||
etebhyo hi dvijāgryebhyo deyam annaṃ sadakṣiṇam |
itarebhyo bahirvedi kṛtānnaṃ deyam ucyate || 11.3 ||
etebhya iti | etebhyo navabhyo brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhebhyo ‘ntarvedi sadakṣiṇam annaṃ dātavyam | etadvyatiriktebhyaḥ punaḥ siddhānnaṃ bahirvedi deyatvenopadiśyate | dhanadāne tv aniyamaḥ
|| 11.3 ||
sarvaratnāni rājā tu yathārhaṃ pratipādayet |
brāhmaṇān vedaviduṣo yajñārthaṃ caiva dakṣiṇām || 11.4 ||
sarveti | rājā punaḥ sarvaratnāni maṇimuktādīni yāgopayogyāni ca dakṣiṇārthaṃ dhanaṃ vidyānurūpeṇa vedavido brāḥmaṇān svīkārayet || 11.4 ||
kṛtadāro ‘parān dārān bhikṣitvā yo ‘dhigacchati |
ratimātraṃ phalaṃ tasya dravyadātus tu santatiḥ || 11.5 ||
kṛteti | yaḥ sabhāryaḥ santatyarthādinimittam antereṇāparān dārān bhikṣitvā karoti tasya ratimātraṃ phalaṃ, dhanadātuḥ punas tadutpannāny apatyāni bhavantīti nindātiśayaḥ | naivaṃvidhena dhanaṃ yācitvānyo vivāhaḥ kartavyo nāpy evaṃ vidhāya niyamato dhanaṃ deyam iti || 11.5 ||
dhanāni tu yathāśakti vipreṣu pratipādayet |
vedavitsu vivikteṣu pretya svargaṃ samaśnute || 11.6 ||
dhanānīti | dhanāni gobhūhiraṇyādīni śaktyanatikrameṇa brāhmaṇeṣu vedajñeṣu vivikteṣu putrakalatrādyavasakteṣu pratipādayet tadvaśāc ca svargaprāptir bhavatīti || 11.6 ||
yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyavṛttaye |
adhikaṃ vāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātum arhati || 11.7 ||
yasyeti | yasyāvaśyapoṣyabharaṇārthaṃ varṣatrayaparyāptaṃ tadadhikaṃ vā bhaktādi syāt sa kāmyasomayāgaṃ kartum arhati | nityasya punar yathākathaṃcid avaśyakartavyatvān nāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ | ata eva “samānte saumikair makhaiḥ” (4.26) iti nityaviṣayatvam uktavān || 11.7 ||
ataḥ svalpīyasi dravye yaḥ somaṃ pibati dvijaḥ |
sa pītasomapūrvo ‘pi na tasyāpnoti tatphalam || 11.8 ||
ata iti | traivārṣikadhānād alpadhane sati yaḥ somayāgaṃ karoti tasya prathamasomayāgo nityo ‘pi na saṃpanno bhavati | sutarāṃ dvitīyayāgaḥ kāmyaḥ || 11.8 ||
śaktaḥ parajane dātā svajane duḥkhajīvini |
madhvāpāto viṣāsvādaḥ sa dharmapratirūpakaḥ || 11.9 ||
śakta iti | yo bahudhanatvād dānaśaktaḥ sann avaśyabharaṇīye pitṛmātrādijñātijane daurgatyād duḥkhopete sati yaśo’rtham anyebhyo dadāti sa tasya dānaviśeṣo dharmapratirūpako na tu dharma eva | madhvāpāto madhuropakramaḥ, prathamaṃ yaśaskaratvāt | viṣāsvādaś cānte, narakaphalatvāt | tasmād etan na kāryam || 11.10 ||
bhṛtyānām uparodhena yat karoty aurdhvadehikam |
tad bhavaty asukhodarkaṃ jīvataś ca mṛtasya ca || 11.10 ||
[vṛddhau ca mātāpitarau sādhvī bhāryā śiśuḥ sutaḥ |
apy akāryaśataṃ kṛtvā bhartavyā manur abravīt || ]
bhṛtyānām iti | putradārādyavaśyabhartavyapīḍanena yat pāralaukikadharmabuddhyā dānādi karoti tasya dātur jīvato mṛtasya ca tad dānaṃ duḥkhaphalaṃ bhavatīti pūrvaṃ kīrtyādidṛṣṭārthadānapratiṣedhaḥ | ayaṃ tv adṛṣṭārthadānapratiṣedhaḥ || 11.10 ||
yajñaś cet pratiruddhaḥ syād ekenāṅgena yajvanaḥ |
brāhmaṇasya viśeṣeṇa dhārmike sati rājani || 11.11 ||
yo vaiśyaḥ syād bahupaśur hīnakratur asomapaḥ |
kuṭumbāt tasya tad dravyam āhared yajñasiddhaye || 11.12 ||
yajñaś ced iti | yo vaiśya iti | kṣatriyāder yajamānasya viśeṣato brāhmaṇasya yadi yajña itarāṅgasaṃpattau satyām ekenāṅgenāsaṃpūrṇaḥ syāt tadā yo vaiśyo bahupaśvādidhanaḥ pākayajñādirahito ‘somayājī tasya gṛhāt tadaṅgocitaṃ dravyaṃ balena cauryeṇa vāharet | etac ca dharmapradhāne sati rājani kāryam | sa hi śāstrārtham anutiṣṭhantaṃ na nigṛhṇāti
|| 11.11–12 ||
āharet trīṇi vā dve vā kāmaṃ śūdrasya veśmanaḥ |
na hi śūdrasya yajñeṣu kaścid asti parigrahaḥ || 11.13 ||
āhared iti | yajñasya dvitryaṅgavaikalye sati tāni trīṇi cāṅgāni dve vāṅge vaiśyād alābhe sati nirviśaṅkaṃ śūdrasya gṛhād balena cauryeṇa vāharet | yasmāc chūdrasya kvacid api yajñasaṃbandho nāsti | “na yajñārthaṃ dhanaṃ śūdrād vipro bhikṣeta” (11.24) iti vakṣyamāṇapratiṣedhaḥ śūdrād yācanasya na tu balagrahaṇādeḥ || 11.13 ||
yo ‘nāhitāgniḥ śatagur ayajvā ca sahasraguḥ |
tayor api kuṭumbābhyām āhared avicārayan || 11.14 ||
ya iti | yo ‘nāhitāgnir gośataparimāṇadhana āhitāgnir vāsomayājī gosahasraparimitadhanaḥ dvayor api gṛhābhyāṃ prakṛtam aṅgadvayaṃ trayaṃ vā śīghraṃ saṃpādayituṃ brāhmaṇena dvābhyām āharaṇīyam | brāhmaṇakṣatriyābhyām api brāhmaṇa āharet | kṣatriyasya tu adasyukriyāvad brāhmaṇasvaharaṇaṃ niṣedhayiṣyati || 11.14 ||
ādānanityāc cādātur āhared aprayacchataḥ |
tathā yaśo ‘sya prathate dharmaś caiva pravardhate || 11.15 ||
ādānanityād iti | pratigrahādinā ādānaṃ dhanagrahaṇaṃ nityaṃ yasyāsāv ādānanityo brāhmaṇas tasmād iṣṭāpūrtadānarahitād yajñāṅgadvayatrayārthāyāṃ yācanāyāṃ kṛtāyām adadato balena cauryeṇ vāharet | tathā kṛte ‘pahartuḥ khyātiḥ prakāśate dharmaś ca vṛddhim eti
|| 11.15 ||
tathaiva saptame bhakte bhaktāni ṣaḍ anaśnatā |
aśvastanavidhānena hartavyaṃ hīnakarmaṇaḥ || 11.16 ||
tathaiveti | sāyaṃprātar bhojanopadeśāt trirātropavāse vṛtte caturthe ‘hani prātaḥ saptame bhakte dānādidharmarahitād ekadinaparyāptam arthaṃ cauryādinā hartavyam || 11.16 ||
khalāt kṣetrād agārād vā yato vāpy upalabhyate |
ākhyātavyaṃ tu tat tasmai pṛcchate yadi pṛcchati || 11.17 ||
khalād iti | dhānyādimardanasthānāt kṣetrād vā gṛhād vā yato vānyasmāt pradeśād dhānyaṃ hīnakarmasaṃbandhi labhyate tato hartavyaṃ, yadi vāsau dhanasvāmī pṛcchati kiṃnimittaṃ kṛtam iti pṛcchate nimittaṃ cauryādi vaktavyam || 11.17 ||
brāhmaṇasvaṃ na hartavyaṃ kṣatriyeṇa kadācana |
dasyuniṣkrayayos tu svam ajīvan hartum arhati || 11.18 ||
brāhmaṇasvam iti | ukteṣv api nimitteṣu kṣatriyeṇa brāhmaṇasya dhanaṃ tato ‘pakṛṣtatvān na hartavyaṃ, samānanyāyatayā tu vaiśyaśūdrābhyām utkṛṣṭajātito na hartavyam | pratiṣiddhakṛdvihitānanuṣṭhāyinoḥ punar brāhmaṇakṣatriyayor atyantāpadi kṣatriyo hartum arhati || 11.18 ||
yo ‘sādhubhyo ‘rtham ādāya sādhubhyaḥ saṃprayacchati |
sa kṛtvā plavam ātmānaṃ saṃtārayati tāv ubhau || 11.19 ||
yo ‘sādhubhya iti | yo hīnakarmādibhya utkṛṣṭebhyo ‘bhihiteṣv api nimitteṣūktānurūpaṃ yajñāṅgādi sādhanaṃ kṛtvā sādhubhya utkṛṣṭebhya ṛtvigādibhyo dhanaṃ dadāti sa yasyāpaharati tad duritaṃ nāśayati yasmai tad dadāti taddaurgatyābhidhānād ity evaṃ dvāv apy ātmānam uḍupaṃ kṛtvā duḥkhān mocayati || 11.19 ||
yad dhanaṃ yajñaśīlānāṃ devasvaṃ tad vidur budhāḥ |
ayajvanāṃ tu yad vittam āsurasvaṃ tad ucyate || 11.20 ||
yad dhanam iti | yajñaśīlānāṃ yad dhanaṃ tad yāgādau viniyogād devasvaṃ vidvāṃso manyante | yāgādiśūnyānāṃ tu yad dravyaṃ tad dharmaviniyogābhāvād āsurasvam ucyate | atas tad apy apahṛtya yāgasaṃpādanāt tad devasvaṃ kartavyam || 11.20 ||
na tasmin dhārayed daṇḍaṃ dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ |
kṣatriyasya hi bāliśyād brāhmaṇaḥ sīdati kṣudhā || 11.21 ||
na tasminn iti | tasminn uktanimitte cauryabalātkāraṃ kurvāṇe dharmapradhāno rājā daṇḍaṃ na kuryāt | yasmād rājño mūḍhatvād brāhmaṇaḥ kṣudhāvasādaṃ prāpnoti || 11.21 ||
tataś ca –
tasya bhṛtyajanaṃ jñātvā svakuṭumbān mahīpatiḥ |
śrutaśīle ca vijñāya vṛttiṃ dharmyāṃ prakalpayet || 11.22 ||
tasyeti | tasya brāhmaṇasyāvaśyabharaṇīyaputrādivargaṃ jñātvā śrutācārocitatadanurūpāṃ vṛttiṃ svagṛhād rājā kalpayet || 11.22 ||
kalpayitvāsya vṛttiṃ ca rakṣed enaṃ samantataḥ |
rājā hi dharmaṣaḍbhāgaṃ tasmāt prāpnoti rakṣitāt || 11.23 ||
kalpayitveti | asya brāhmaṇasya jīvikāṃ vidhāya śatrucaurādeḥ sarvato rakṣet | yasmād brāhmaṇād rakṣitāt tasya dharmaṣaḍbhāgaṃ prāpnoti || 11.23 ||
na yajñārthaṃ dhanaṃ śūdrād vipro bhikṣeta karhicit |
yajamāno hi bhikṣitvā caṇḍālaḥ pretya jāyate || 11.24 ||
na yajñārtham iti | yajñasiddhaye dhanaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kadācin na śūdrād yācet | yasmāc chūdrād yācitvā yajñaṃ kurvāṇo mṛtaś caṇḍālo bhavati | ato yācananiṣedhāc chūdrād ayācitopasthitaṃ yajñārtham apy aviruddham || 11.24 ||
yajñārtham arthaṃ bhikṣitvā yo na sarvaṃ prayacchati |
sa yāti bhāsatāṃ vipraḥ kākatāṃ vā śataṃ samāḥ || 11.25 ||
yajñārtham iti | yajñasiddhyarthaṃ dhanaṃ yācitvā yo yajñe sarvaṃ na viniyuṅkte sa śataṃ varṣāṇi bhāsatvaṃ kākatvaṃ vā prāpnoti || 11.25 ||
devasvaṃ brāhmaṇasvaṃ vā lobhenopahinasti yaḥ |
sa pāpātma paraṃ loke gṛdhrocchiṣṭena jīvati || 11.26 ||
devasvam iti | pratimādidevatārtham utsṛṣṭaṃ dhanaṃ devasvaṃ, brāhmaṇasvaṃ ca yo lobhād apaharati sa pāpasvabhāvo janmāntare gṛdhrocchiṣṭena jīvati || 11.26 ||
iṣṭiṃ vaiśvānarīṃ nityaṃ nirvaped abdaparyaye |
kḷptānāṃ paśusomānāṃ niṣkṛtyartham asaṃbhave || 11.27 ||
iṣṭam iti | samāpte varṣe dvitīyavarṣasya pravṛttir abdaparyayaṃ caitraśuklādivarṣapravṛttis tatra varṣāntare vaiśvānarīm iṣṭiṃ vihitasomayāgāsaṃbhave tadakaraṇadoṣanirharaṇārthaṃ sarvadā śūdrādito dhanagrahaṇenoktarūpam iṣṭiṃ kuryāt || 11.27 ||
āpatkalpena yo dharmaṃ kurute ‘nāpadi dvijāḥ |
sa nāpnoti phalaṃ tasya paratreti vicāritam || 11.28 ||
āpad iti | āpadvihitena vidhinā yo ‘nāpadi dharmānuṣṭhānaṃ dvijaḥ kurute tasya tat paraloke niṣphalaṃ bhavatīti manvādibhir vicāritam || 11.28 ||
viśvaiś ca devaiḥ sādhyaiś ca brāhmaṇaiś ca maharṣibhiḥ |
āpatsu maraṇād bhītair vidheḥ pratinidhiḥ kṛtaḥ || 11.29 ||
viśvair iti | viśvedevākhair devaiḥ sādhyaiś ca tathā maharṣibhir brāhmaṇair maraṇād bhītair āpatsu mukhyasya vidheḥ somāder vaiśvānaryādiḥ pratinidhir anuṣṭhito ‘sau mukhyāsaṃbhave kāryo na tu mukhyasaṃbhave || 11.29 ||
prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo ‘nukalpena vartate |
na sāṃparāyikaṃ tasya durmater vidyate phalam || 11.30 ||
prabhur iti | yo mukhyānuṣṭhānasaṃpannaḥ sann āpadvihitena pratinidhinānuṣṭhānaṃ karoti tasya durbuddheḥ pāralaukikam abhyudayarūpaṃ pratyavāyaparihārārthaṃ phalaṃ ca na bhavati | “āpatkalpena you dharmam” (11.28) ity anenoktam apy etac chāstrādarārthaṃ punar ucyate || 11.30 ||
na brāhmaṇo vedayeta kiṃcid rājani dharmavit |
svavīryeṇaiva tāñ chiṣyān mānavān apakāriṇaḥ || 11.31 ||
neti | dharmajño brāhmaṇaḥ kiṃcid apy apakṛtaṃ na rājñaḥ kathayet | api tu svaśaktyaiva vakṣyamāṇābhicārādināpakāriṇo manuṣyān nigṛhṇīyāt | tataś ca svakīyadharmavirodhād apakṛṣṭāparādhakaraṇe saty abhicārādi na doṣāyety evaṃparam etat | na tv abhicāro vidhīyate rājanivedanaṃ vā niṣidhyate || 11.31 ||
svavīryād rājavīryāc ca svavīryaṃ balavattaram |
tasmāt svenaiva vīryeṇa nigṛhṇīyād arīn dvijaḥ || 11.32 ||
svavīryād iti | yasmāt svasāmarthyād rājasāmarthyāc ca parādhīnarājasāmarthyāpekṣayā svasāmarthyam eva svādhīnatvād balīyaḥ tasmāt svena vīryeṇaiva śatrūn brāhmaṇo nigṛhṇīyāt
|| 11.32 ||
tat kiṃ svavīryam ity āha –
śrutīr atharvāṅgirasīḥ kuryād ity avicārayan |
vākśastraṃ vai brāhmaṇasya tena hanyād arīn dvijaḥ || 11.33 ||
[tad astraṃ sarvavarṇānām anivāryaṃ ca śaktitaḥ |
tapovīryaprabhāveṇa avadhyān api bādhate || ]
śrutīr iti | atharvavedasya āṅgirasīr duṣṭābhicāraśrutīr avicārayan kuryāt | tadartham abhicāram anutiṣṭhed ity arthaḥ | yasmād abhicāramantroccāraṇātmikā brāhmaṇasya vāg eva śastrakāryakaraṇāc chastraṃ tena brāhmaṇaḥ śatrūn hanyān na tu śatruniyamāya rājā vācyaḥ
|| 11.33 ||
kṣatriyo bāhuvīryeṇa tared āpadam ātmanaḥ |
[tad dhi kurvan yathāśakti prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim | ]
dhanena vaiśyaśudrau tu japahomair dvijottamaḥ || 11.34 ||
kṣatriya iti | kṣatriyaḥ svapauruṣeṇa śatrutaḥ paribhavalakṣaṇām ātmana āpadaṃ nistaret | vaiśyaśūdrau punaḥ pratikartre dhanadānena | brāhmaṇas tv abhicārātmakair japahomaiḥ
|| 11.34 ||
vidhātā śāsitā vaktā maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate |
tasmai nākuśalaṃ brūyān na śuṣkāṃ giram īrayet || 11.35 ||
vidhāteti | vihitakarmaṇām anuṣṭhātā, putraśiṣyādīnāṃ śāstā, prāyaścittārthadharmāṇāṃ vaktā, sarvabhūtamaitrīpradhāno brāhmaṇa ucyate | tasmai nigṛhyatām ayam ity evam aniṣṭaṃ na brūyān nāpi sākrośaṃ vācaṃ vāgdaṇḍadhigdaṇḍarūpāṃ tasyoccārayet || 11.35 ||
na vai kanyā na yuvatir nālpavidyo na bāliśaḥ |
hotā syād agnihotrasya nārto nāsaṃskṛtas tathā || 11.36 ||
va vā iti | kanyānūḍhā, ūḍhāpi taruṇī, tathā alpādhyāyimūrkhavyādhyādipīḍitānupanītāḥ śrautān sāyaṃprātarhomān na kuryuḥ | ‘hāvayet’ iti prasaktāv ayaṃ kanyādīnāṃ pratiṣedhaḥ || 11.36 ||
narake hi patanty ete juhvantaḥ sa ca yasya tat |
tasmād vaitānakuśalo hotā syād vedapāragaḥ || 11.37 ||
naraka iti | ete kanyādayo homaṃ kurvāṇā narakaṃ gacchanti | yasya tad agnihotraṃ pratinidhirūpeṇa kurvanti so ‘pi narakaṃ gacchati | tasmāc chrautakarmapravīṇaḥ samastavedādhyāyī hotā kāryaḥ || 11.37 ||
prājāpatyam adatvāśvam agnyādheyasya dakṣiṇām |
anāhitāgnir bhavati brāhmaṇo vibhave sati || 11.38 ||
prājāpatyam iti | ādhāne prājāpatym aśvaṃ prajāpatidevatākaṃ dhanasaṃpattau satyāṃ brāhmaṇo dakṣiṇām adatvā kṛte ‘py ādhāne ‘nāhitāgnir bhavaty ādhānaphalaṃ na labhate | tasmād ādhāne ‘śvaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt || 11.38 ||
puṇyāny anyāni kurvīta śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ |
na tv alpadakṣiṇair yajñair yajeteha kathaṃcana || 11.39 ||
puṇyānīti | śraddhāvān vaśī jitendriyo yajñavyatiriktāni tīrthayātrādīni karmāṇi puṇyāni kurvīta na tu śāstroktadakṣiṇāto ‘lpadakṣiṇair yajeta | paropakārthatvād dakṣiṇāyāḥ svalpenāpy ṛtvigādidoṣaniṣedhārtham idaṃ vacanam || 11.39 ||
indriyāṇi yaśaḥ svargam āyuḥ kīrtiṃ prajāḥ paśūn |
hanty alpadakṣiṇo yajñas tasmān nālpadhano yajet || 11.40 ||
[ annahīno dahed rāṣṭraṃ mantrahīnas tu ṛtvijaḥ |
dīkṣitaṃ dakṣiṇāhīno nāsti yajñasamo ripuḥ || ]
indriyāṇīti | cakṣurādīnīndriyāṇi jīvataḥ khyātirūpaṃ yaśaḥ, svargāyuṣī, mṛtasya khyātirūpāṃ kīrtiṃ, apatyāni, paśūṃś cālpadakṣiṇo yajño nāśayati | tasmād alpadakṣiṇādānena yāgaṃ na kuryāt || 11.40 ||
agnihotry apavidhyāgnīn brāhmaṇaḥ kāmakārataḥ |
cāndrāyaṇaṃ caren māsaṃ vīrahatyāsamaṃ hi tat || 11.41 ||
agnihotrīti | agnihotrī brāhmaṇa icchāto ‘gniṣu sāyaṃprātar homān akṛtvā māsaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret | yasmād vīraḥ putras tasya hatyā hananṃ tattulyam etat | tathā ca śrutiḥ: “vīrahā vā eṣa devānāṃ bhavati yo ‘gnim udvāsayate” | anye tu māsam apavidhyeti samarthayanti || 11.41 ||
ye śūdrād adhigamyārtham agnihotram upāsate |
ṛtvijas te hi śūdrāṇāṃ brahmavādiṣu garhitāḥ || 11.42 ||
ye śūdrād iti | ye śūdrād adhigamyārthaṃ prāpya sāmānyābhidhānena yācanena vārthaṃ svīkṛtya “vṛṣalāgnyupasevanāt” (11.43) it vakṣyamāṇaliṅgād ādhānapūrvakam agnihotram anutiṣṭhanti te śūdrāṇām eva yājakā na tu teṣāṃ tatphalaṃ bhavaty atas te vedavādiṣu ninditāḥ
|| 11.42 ||
teṣāṃ satatam ajñānāṃ vṛṣalāgnyupasevinām |
padā mastakam ākramya dātā durgāṇi saṃtaret || 11.43 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ śūdradhanāhitāgniparicāriṇāṃ mūrkhāṇāṃ mūrdhni pādaṃ datvā śūdras tena dānena satataṃ paraloke duḥkhebhyo nistarati, na tu yajamānānāṃ phalaṃ bhavati || 11.43 ||
akurvan vihitaṃ karma ninditaṃ ca samācaran |
prasaktaś cendriyārtheṣu prāyaścittīyate naraḥ || 11.44 ||
akurvann iti | nityaṃ yad vihitaṃ saṃdhyopāsanādi, naimittikaṃ ca śavasparśādau snānādi, tad akurvan tathā pratiṣiddhaṃ hiṃsādy anutiṣṭhann avihitaniṣiddheṣv atyantāsaktiṃ kurvan naro manuṣyajātimātraṃ prāyaścittam arhati |
nanu “indriyārtheṣu sarveṣu na prasajyeta kāmataḥ” (4.16) iti niṣedān ninditapadenaiva ‘prasaktaś cendriyārtheṣu’ ity api saṃgṛhītam ataḥ pṛthaṅ na vaktavyam |
ucyate – asya snātakavrateṣu pāṭhāt tatra “vratānīmāni dhārayet” (4.13) ity upakramān nāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kiṃ tu vratavidhiḥ |
tarhi ‘akurvan vihitaṃ karma’ ity anenaiva prāptatvāt pṛthaṅ vaktavyam iti cen,
na, snātaketaraviṣayatvenāsya saviṣayatvāt || 11.44 ||
akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ vidur budhāḥ |
kāmakārakṛte ‘py āhur eke śrutinidarśanāt || 11.45 ||
akāmata iti | abuddhikṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ bhavatīty āhuḥ paṇḍitāḥ | eke punar ācāryāḥ kāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ bhavatīty āhuḥ | etac ca pṛthakkṛtyābhidhānaṃ prāyaścittagauravārthaṃ śrutidarśanād iti: “indro yatīnt sālāvṛkebhyaḥ prāyacchat tam aślīlā vāg abhyavadat sa prajāpatim upādāvat tasmā indrāyeitam upahavyaṃ prāyacchat” iti | asyārthaḥ – indro yatīn buddhipūrvakaṃ śvabhyo dattavān, sa prāyaścittārthaṃ prajāpatisamīpam agamat, tasmai prajāpatir upahavyākhyaṃ karma prāyaścittaṃ dattavān ataḥ kāmakārakṛte ‘py asti prāyaścittam || 11.45 ||
akāmataḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vedābhyāsena śudhyati |
kāmatas tu kṛtaṃ mohāt prāyaścittaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 11.46 ||
akāmata iti | anicchātaḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vedābhyāsena śudhyati naśyati | vedābhyāseneti kāmakṛtaviṣayaprāyaścittāpakṣayā laghuprāyaścittopalakṣaṇārtham | prāyaścittāntarāṇām api vidhānād rāgadveṣādivyāmūḍhatayā punar anicchātaḥ kṛtaṃ nānāprakāraiḥ prāyaścittair vidyādhanatapobhiḥ śudhyatīti guruprāyaścittaparam | ataḥ pūrvoktasyaivāyaṃ vyākāraḥ | yady apy adhikāranirūpaṇaṃ prakṛtaprāyaścittaṃ tv anantaraṃ vakṣyati tathāpy ajñānāl laghuprāyaścittādhikārī jñānād guruprāyaścitte ‘dhikriyata ity adhikārinirūpaṇam evedam
|| 11.46 ||
prāyaścittīyatāṃ prāpya daivāt pūrvakṛtena vā |
na saṃsargaṃ vrajet sadbhiḥ prāyaścitte ‘kṛte dvijaḥ || 11.47 ||
[ prāyo nāma tapaḥ proktaṃ cittaṃ niśyaca ucyate |
taponiścayasaṃyuktaṃ prāyaścittam iti smṛtam || ]
prāyaścittīyatām iti | daivāt pramādād anyaśarīrakṛtena pūrvajanmārgitaduṣkṛtena kṣayarogādibhiḥ sūcitena prāyaścittīyatāṃ prāpyākṛte prāyaścitte sādhubhiḥ saha yājanādinā saṃsargaṃ na gacchet || 11.47 ||
iha duścaritaiḥ kecit kecit pūrvakṛtais tathā |
prāpnuvanti durātmāno narā rūpaviparyayam || 11.48 ||
iheti | iha janmani niṣiddhācaraṇaiḥ kecit pūrvajanmakṛtair duṣṭasvabhāvā manuṣyāḥ kaunakhyādikaṃ rūpaviparyayaṃ prāpnuvanti || 11.48 ||
suvarṇacauraḥ kaunakhyaṃ surāpaḥ śyāvadantatām |
brahmahā kṣayarogitvaṃ dauścarmyaṃ gurutalpagaḥ || 11.49 ||
piśunaḥ pautināsikyaṃ sūcakaḥ pūtivaktratām |
dhānyacauro ‘ṅgahīnatvam ātiraikyaṃ tu miśrakaḥ || 11.50 ||
annahartāmayāvitvaṃ maukyaṃ vāgapahārakaḥ |
vastrāpahārakaḥ śvaitryaṃ paṅgutām aśvahārakaḥ || 11.51 ||
[dīpahartā bhaved andhaḥ kāṇo nirvāpako bhavet |
hiṃsayā vyādhibhūyastvam arogitvam ahiṃsayā || ]
evaṃ karmaviśeṣeṇa jāyante sadvigarhitāḥ |
jaḍamūkāndhabadhirā vikṛtākṛtayas tathā || 11.52 ||
suvarṇeti | piśuna iti | annaharteti | evam iti || brāhmaṇasuvarṇacauraḥ kutsitanakhatvaṃ prāpnoti | niṣiddhasurāpaḥ śyāvadantatāṃ, brahmahā kṣayarogitvaṃ, gurubhāryāgāmī vikośamehanatvaṃ, piśuno vidyamānadoṣābhidhāyī durgandhināsatvaṃ, avidyamānadoṣābhidhāyako durgandhimukhatvaṃ, dhānyacauro ‘ṅgahīnatvaṃ, dhānyāder apadravyeṇa miśraṇakartā atiriktāṅgatvaṃ, annacauro mandānalatvaṃ, ananujñātādhyāyī mūkatvaṃ, vastracauraḥ śvetakuṣṭhatvaṃ, aśvacauraḥ khañjatvam | evaṃ buddhivākcakṣuḥśrotravikalā vikṛtarūpāḥ sādhuvigarhitāś ca prāgjanmārjitopabhukta-duṣkṛtaśeṣeṇotpadyante |
dīpahartā bhaved andhaḥ kāṇo nirvāpakas tathā |
hiṃsāruciḥ sadā rogī vātāṅgaḥ pāradārikaḥ ||
|| 11.49–52 ||
caritavyam ato nityaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye |
nindyair hi lakṣaṇair yuktā jāyante ‘niṣkṛtainasaḥ || 11.53 ||
caritavyam iti | yasmād aniṣkṛtam anāśitam eno yais te ‘niṣkṛtainaso ‘kṛtaprāyaścittāḥ paralokopabhuktaduṣkṛtaśeṣeṇa nindyair lakṣaṇaiḥ kunakhitvādibhir yuktā jāyante | tasmād viśuddhaye pāpanirharaṇārthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ sadā kartavyam | evaṃ ‘bhinne juhoti’ ityvan na naimittikamātraṃ prāyaścittaṃ kiṃ tv aniṣkṛtainasa ity upādānāt tathā viśuddhaye caritavyam ity upadeśāt pāpakṣayārthina evādhikāraḥ | tathā hi prāyaścittaṃ hi caritavyam iti vidhāv adhikārāpekṣāyāṃ phalamātre nirdeśād iti rātrisatranyāyena śrūyamāṇam eva viśuddhaya iti phalam adhikāriviśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam | imam evārthaṃ sphuṭayati yājñavalkyaḥ (3.219) |
vihitasyānanuṣṭhānān ninditasya ca sevanāt |
anigrahāc cendriyāṇāṃ naraḥ patanam ṛcchati |
tasmāt teneha kartavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ viśuddhaye ||
patanam ṛcchati pāpaṃ prāpnotīty arthaḥ | viśuddhaye pāpavināśāya |
bahūn varṣagaṇān ghorān narakān prāpya tatkṣayāt |
saṃsārān pratipadyante mahāpātakinas tv imān || (12.54)
ityādinā mahāpātakyādīnāṃ narakādiprāptiṃ vakṣyati | na tannaimittikamātratvaṃ prāyaścittānāṃ saṃgacchate | tasmād brahmavadhādijanitapāpakṣayārthina eva prāyaścittavidhāv adhikāra iti jñeyam || 11.53 ||
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ |
mahānti pātakāny āhuḥ saṃsargaś cāpi taiḥ saha || 11.54 ||
brahmahatyeti | brāhmaṇaprāṇaviyogaphalako vyāpāro brahmahatyā, sa ca sākṣād anyaṃ vā niyujya tathā gohiraṇyagrahaṇādinimittakāryakasyāpi taduddeśena brāhmaṇamaraṇe brahmahatyā |
nanv evam iṣukārasyāpīṣūtpādanadvāreṇa tathā vadhyasyāpi hantṛgatamanyūtpādanadvārā brahmahatyā syāt |
ucyate – śāstrato yasya brāhmaṇahantṛtvaṃ pratīyate sa eva brahmahatyā | ata eva śātātapaḥ |
gobhūhiraṇyagrahaṇe strīsaṃbandhakṛte ‘pi vā |
yam uddiśya tyajet prāṇāṃs tam āhur brahmaghātakam ||
evaṃ cānyāny api śāstrīyāṇy eva brahmavadhanimittāni jñeyāni | tathā,
rāgād dveṣāt pramādād vā svataḥ parata eva vā |
brāhmaṇaṃ ghātayed yas tu tam āhur brahmaghātakam ||
iti prayojakasyāpi hantṛtvaṃ śāstrīyam | tathā niṣiddhasurāpānaṃ, brāhmaṇasuvarṇaharaṇam, gurubhāryāgamanam | gurur atra pitā, “niṣekādīni karmāṇi” (2.142) ityādinā tasya gurutvena vidhānāt | etaiś ca saha saṃsargaḥ “saṃvatsareṇa patatīty” etāni mahāpātakāny āhuḥ | mahāpātakasaṃjñā ceyaṃ vakṣyamāṇasyopapātakādisaṃjñālāghavārtham || 11.54 ||
anṛtaṃ ca samutkarṣe rājagāmi ca paiśunam |
guroś cālīkanirbandhaḥ samāni brahmahatyayā || 11.55 ||
anṛtam iti | jātyutkarṣanimittam utkarṣabhāṣaṇaṃ yathā brāhmaṇo ‘ham iti abrāhmaṇo bravīti, rājani vā stenādīnāṃ pareṣāṃ maraṇaphalakaṃ doṣābhidhānaṃ, guroś cānṛtābhiśaṃsanam | tathā ca gauamaḥ (GDh 22.3): “guror anṛtābhiśaṃsanam” iti | mahāpātakasamānīty etāni brahmahatyāsamānīti || 11.55 ||
brahmojjhatā vedanindā kauṭasākṣyaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ |
garhitānādyayor jagdhiḥ surāpānasamāni ṣaṭ || 11.56 ||
brahmaojjhateti | brahmaṇo ‘dhītavedasyānabhyāsena vismaraṇam, asacchāstrāśrayaṇena vedakutsanam, sākṣye mṛṣābhidhānam, mitrasyābrahmaṇasya vadhaḥ, niṣiddhasya laśunāder bhakṣaṇam, anādyasya purīṣāder adanam | medhātithis tu na bhokṣyata iti saṃkalpya yad bhujyate tad anādyam ity ācaṣṭe | etāni surāpānasamāni || 11.56 ||
nikṣepasyāpaharaṇaṃ narāśvarajatasya ca |
bhūmivastramaṇīnāṃ ca rukmasteyasamaṃ smṛtam || 11.57 ||
nikṣepasyeti | brāhmaṇasuvarṇavyatiriktanikṣepasya haraṇaṃ tathā manuṣyaturagarūpyabhūmihīrakamaṇīnāṃ haraṇaṃ suvarṇasteyatulyam || 11.57 ||
retaḥsekaḥ svayonīṣu kumārīṣv antyajāsu ca |
sakhyuḥ putrasya ca strīṣu gurutalpasamaṃ viduḥ || 11.58 ||
retaḥseka iti | sodaryabhaginīkumārīcaṇḍālīsakhiputrabhāryāsu yo retaḥsekas taṃ gurubhāryāgamanasamānam āhuḥ | eteṣāṃ bhedena samīkaraṇaṃ yad yena samīkṛtaṃ tasya tena prāyaścittārtham | yat kauṭasākṣyasuhṛdvadhayoḥ surāpānasmīkṛtayor brahmahatyāprāyaścitaṃ vakṣyati tad vikalpārtham, yat punar guror alīkanirbandhasya brahmahatyāsamīkṛtasya punar upariṣṭād brahmahatyāprāyaścittanirdeśaḥ tatsamīkṛtānāṃ nyūnaprāyaścittaṃ bhavatīti jñāpanārtham | tathā ca loke rājasamaḥ saciva ity ukte sacivasya nyūnataiva gamyate | atraupadeśikaprāyaścittebhya ātideśikaprāyaścittānāṃ tannyūnaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samīkṛtānāṃ ca
|| 11.58 ||
idānīm upapātakāny āha –
govadho ‘yājyasaṃyājyapāradāryātmavikrayaḥ |
gurumātṛpitṛtyāgaḥ svādhyāyāgnyoḥ sutasya ca || 11.59 ||
parivittitānuje ‘nūḍhe parivedanam eva ca |
tayor dānaṃ ca kanyāyās tayor eva ca yājanam || 11.60 ||
kanyāyā dūṣaṇaṃ caiva vārdhuṣyaṃ vratalopanam |
taḍāgārāmadārāṇām apatyasya ca vikrayaḥ || 11.61 ||
vrātyatā bāndhavatyāgo bhṛtyādhyāpanam eva ca |
bhṛtyā cādhyayanādānam apaṇyānāṃ ca vikrayaḥ || 11.62 ||
sarvākareṣv adhīkāro mahāyantrapravartanam |
hiṃsauṣadhīnāṃ stryājīvo ‘bhicāro mūlakarma ca || 11.63 ||
indhanārtham aśuṣkāṇāṃ drumāṇām avapātanam |
ātmārthaṃ ca kriyārambho ninditānnādanaṃ tathā || 11.64 ||
anāhitāgnitā steyam ṛṇānām anapakriyā |
asacchāstrādhigamanaṃ kauśīlavyasya ca kriyā || 11.65 ||
dhānyakupyapaśusteyaṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇam |
strīśūdraviṭkṣatravadho nāstikyaṃ copapātakam || 11.66 ||
govadhetyādi – dhānyakupyetyantena | gohananaṃ, jātikarmaduṣṭānāṃ yājanaṃ, parastrīgamanaṃ, ātmavikrayaḥ, mātṛpitṛgurūṇāṃ ca śuśrūṣādyakaraṇaṃ, sarvadā brahmayajñatyāgaḥ, na vedavismaraṇaṃ “brahmojjhatā” (11.56) ity anenoktatvāt | agneś ca smārtasya tyāgaḥ śrautānāṃ “agnihotry apavidhyāgnīn” (11.41) ity uktatvāt, sutasya ca saṃskārabharaṇādyakaraṇam | kanīyasā ādau vivāhe kṛte jyeṣṭhasya parivittitvaṃ bhavati | “dārāgnihotrasaṃyogaṃ” (3.171) ityādinā prāguktaṃ kaniṣṭasya parivettṛtvaṃ tayoś ca kanyāyā dānaṃ tayor eva vivāhahomādiyāgeṣv ārtvijyaṃ, kanyāyā maithunavarjam aṅgulīprakṣepādinā dūṣaṇaṃ, retaḥsekaparyantamaithuneṣu tu “retaḥsekaḥ svayoniṣu kumārīṣv antyajāsu ca” (11.58) ity uktatvāt pratiṣiddhaṃ, vṛddhijīvanaṃ, brahmacāriṇo maithunaṃ, taḍāgodyānabhāryāpatyānāṃ vikrayaḥ, yathākālam anupanayanaṃ vrātyatā | tathā coktam: “ata ūrdhvaṃ trayo ‘py ete yathākālam asaṃskṛtāḥ” (2.39) iti | bāndhavānāṃ pitṛvyādīnām ananuvṛttiḥ, pratiniyatavetanagrahaṇapūrvakam adhyāpanaṃ, pratiniyatavetanapradānapūrvakam adhyayanaṃ, ca, avikrayyādīnāṃ tilādīnāṃ vikrayaḥ, suvarṇādyutpattisthāneṣu rājājñayādhikāraḥ, mahatāṃ pravāhapratibandhahetūnāṃ setubandhādīnāṃ pravartanaṃ, auṣadhīnāṃ jātimātrādīnāṃ hiṃsanam | etac ca jñānapūrvakābhyāsakriyāyāṃ prāyaścittagauravāt | yat tu “kṛṣṭajānām auṣadhīnāṃ” (11.144) ityādinā vakṣyati tatsakṛddhiṃsāyāṃ, prāyaścittalāghavāt | bhāryādistrīṇāṃ veśyātvaṃ kṛtvā tadupajīvanaṃ, śyenādiyajñenānaparāddhasya māraṇaṃ, mantrauṣadhinā vaśīkaraṇaṃ, pākādidṛṣṭaprayojanārthamātram eva vṛkṣacchedanaṃ, anāturasya devapitrādyuddeśam antareṇa pākādyanuṣṭhānaṃ, ninditānnasya laśunādeḥ sakṛd anicchayā bhakṣaṇam, icchāpūrvakābhyāsabhakṣaṇe punaḥ “garhitānadyayor jagdhiḥ” (11.56) ity uktatvāt | saty adhikāre ‘gnyanādhānaṃ, suvarṇād anyasya sāradravyasyāpaharaṇaṃ, ṛṇānāṃ ca ṛṇais tribhir ṛṇavān naro jāyate tadanapakaraṇaṃ, śrutismṛtiviruddhaśāstraśikṣaṇaṃ, nṛtyagītavāditropasevanaṃ, dhānyatāmralohādeḥ paśūnāṃ ca cauryaṃ, dvijātīnāṃ pītamadyāyāḥ striyā gamanaṃ, strīśūdravaiśakṣatriyahananaṃ, adṛṣṭārthakarmābhāvabuddhiḥ, etat pratyekam upapātakam | “bāndhavatyāgaḥ” (11.62) ity anenaiva mātrādīnāṃ tyāgaprāptau pṛthagvacanaṃ nindārtham | pitṛvyādibāndhavatyāgenāvaśyam eva prāyaścittaṃ bhavati kiṃ tu mātrādityāgaprāyaścittān nyūnam ap bhavati || 11.59–66 ||
brāhmaṇasya rujaḥkṛtyā ghrātir aghreyamadyayoḥ |
jaihmyaṃ ca maithunaṃ puṃsi jātibhraṃśakaraṃ smṛtam || 11.67 ||
brāhmaṇasyeti | brāhmaṇasya daṇḍahastādinā pīḍākriyā, yad atiśayadurgandhitayāghreyaṃ laśunapurīṣādi tasya madyasya cāghrāṇaṃ, kuṭilatvaṃ vakratā, puṃsi ca mukhādau maithunam ity etat pratyekaṃ jātibhraṃśakaraṃ smṛtam || 11.67 ||
kharāśvoṣṭramṛgebhānām ajāvikavadhas tathā |
saṃkarīkaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ mīnāhimahiṣasya ca || 11.68 ||
khareti | gardabhaturagoṣṭramṛgahasticchāgameṣamatsyasarpamahiṣāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ vadhaḥ saṃkarīkaraṇ jñeyam || 11.68 ||
ninditebhyo dhanādānaṃ vāṇijyaṃ śūdrasevanam |
apātrīkaraṇaṃ jñeyam asatyasya ca bhāṣaṇam || 11.69 ||
ninditebhya iti | apratigrāhyadhanebhyaḥ pratigrahaḥ, vāṇijyaṃ, śūdrasya paricaryā, anṛtābhidhānam ity etat pratyekam apātrīkaraṇaṃ jñeyam || 11.69 ||
kṛmikīṭavayohatyā madyānugatabhojanam |
phalaidhaḥkusumasteyam adhairyaṃ ca malāvaham || 11.70 ||
kṛmīti | kṛmayaḥ kṣudrajantavas tebhya īṣatsthūlāḥ kīṭās teṣāṃ vadhaḥ, pakṣiṇāṃ ca | madyānugataṃ yad bhojyam api śākādy ekatra piṭakādau kṛtvā madyena sahānītaṃ tasya bhojanam | medhātithis tu madyānugataṃ madyasaṃspṛṣṭam āha | tan na, tatra prāyaścittagauravāt | phalakāṣṭhapuṣpāṇāṃ ca cauryam alpe ‘pacaye ‘py atyantavaiklavyam | etat sarvaṃ pratyekaṃ malinīkaraṇam || 11.70 ||
etāny enāṃsi sarvāṇi yathoktāni pṛthak pṛthak |
yair yair vratair apohyante tāni samyaṅ nibodhata || 11.71 ||
etānīti | etāni brahmahatyādīni sarvāṇi pāpāni bhedena yathoktāni yair yair vrataiḥ prāyaścittarūpair nāśyante tāni yathāvat śṛṇuta || 11.71 ||
brahmahā dvādaś samāḥ kuṭīṃ kṛtvā vane vaset |
bhaikṣāśy ātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ kṛtvā śavaśirodhvajam || 11.72 ||
brahmaheti | yo brāhmaṇaṃ hatavān sa vane kuṭīṃ kṛtvā hatasya śiraḥ kapālaṃ tadabhāve ‘nyasyāpi cihnaṃ kṛtvāraṇye bhaikṣabhug ātmanaḥ pāpanirharaṇāya dvādaś varṣāṇi vased vrataṃ kuryāt | atrāpi “kṛtavapano nivased” (11.78) iti vakṣyati | munyantaroktā api viśeṣā grāhyāḥ | tathā ca yamaḥ |
saptāgārāṇy apūrvāṇi yāny asaṃkalpitāni ca |
saṃviśet tāni śanakair vidhūme bhuktavajjane ||
bhrūṇaghe dehi me bhikṣām eno vikhyāpya saṃcaret |
ekakālaṃ cared bhaikṣyaṃ tad alabdhvodakaṃ pibet ||
ayaṃ ca dvādaśavārṣikavidhir brāhmaṇasyājñānkṛtabrāhmaṇavadhe, “iyaṃ viśuddhir uditā pramāpyākāmato dvijam” (11.89) iti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | kṣatriyavaiśyaśūdrāṇāṃ tu krameṇaitad dvādaśavārṣikaṃ dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ ca draṣṭavyam | yathoktaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
dviguṇāḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu vaiśyānāṃ triguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ |
caturguṇas tu śūdrāṇāṃ parṣaduktā mahātmanām ||
parṣaduktavrataṃ proktaṃ śuddhaye pāpakarmaṇām |
yāvadbhir brāhmaṇair brāhmaṇānāṃ sabhā, tato dviguṇaiḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ draṣṭavyavyavahāradarśanād vyarthā sabhā bhavet, triguṇair vaiśyair vaiśyānāṃ caturbhiḥ śūdrāṇām iti sabhāvac ca kṣatriyādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ vratam api dviguṇatriguṇacaturguṇam ity arthaḥ | etāni ca manūktabrahmavadhaprāyaścittavacanāni guṇavatkṛtanirguṇabrāhmaṇahananaviṣayatvena bhaviṣyapurāṇe vyākhyātāni |
hantā ced guṇavān vīra akāmān nirguṇo hataḥ |
kartavyāni manūktāni kṛtvā vai āśvamedhikam ||
brahmahā dvādaśābdāni kuṭīṃ kṛtvā vane vaset |
gacched avabhṛtaṃ vāpi akāmān nirguṇe hate ||
jātiśaktiguṇāpekṣaṃ sakṛdbuddhikṛtaṃ tathā |
anubandhādi vijñāya prāyaścittaṃ prakalpayet ||
iti viśvāmitravacanāt prāyaścittādhikyam ūhanīyam | kāmakṛte tu brāhmaṇavadhe dviguṇaṃ brahmavadhaprāyaścittaṃ caturviṃśativarṣam | tad āhāṅgirāḥ |
akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ na kāmataḥ |
syāt tv akāmakṛtaṃ yat tu dviguṇaṃ buddhipūrvake ||
|| 11.72 ||
lakṣyaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ vā syād viduṣām icchayātmanaḥ |
prāsyed ātmānam agnau vā samiddhe trir avākśirāḥ || 11.73 ||
lakṣyam iti | dhanuḥśarādyāyudhadhāriṇāṃ brahmavadhapāpakṣayārtham ayaṃ lakṣībhūta ity evaṃ jānatāṃ svecchayā bāṇalakṣyabhūto vāvatiṣṭheta | yāvan mṛto mṛtakalpo vā viśudhyet | tad āha yājñavalkyaḥ (YDh 3.248) |
saṃgrāme vā hato lakṣyabhūtaḥ śuddhim avāpnuyāt |
mṛtakalpaḥ prahārārto jīvann api viśudhyati ||
agnau pradīpte vādhomukas trīn vārān śarīraṃ prakṣipet | “tathā prāsyeta yathā mriyeta” ity āpastambavacanād evaṃ prakṣipet | etat prāyaścittadvayam anantaraṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca “yajeta vāśvamedhena” (11.74) ity evaṃ prāyaścittatrayam idaṃ kāmataḥ kṣatriyasya brāhmaṇavadhaviṣayam | manuślokam eva likhitvā yathā vyākhyātaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
lakṣyaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ vā syād viduṣām icchayātmanaḥ |
prāsyed ātmānam agnau vā samiddhe trir avākśirāḥ ||
yajeta vāśvamedhena kṣatriyo vipraghātakaḥ |
prāyaścittatrayaṃ hy etat kṣatriyasya prakīrtitam ||
kṣatriyo nirguṇo dhīraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vedapāragam |
nihatya kāmato vīra lakṣyaḥ śastrabhṛto bhavet ||
caturvedavidaṃ dhīraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāgnihotriṇam |
nihatya kāmād ātmānaṃ kṣiped agnāv avākśirāḥ ||
nirguṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā kāmato guṇavān guha |
yaṣṭvā vā aśvamedhena kṣatriyo yo mahīpatiḥ ||
|| 11.73 ||
yajeta vāśvamedhena svarjitā gosavena vā |
abhijidviśvajidbhyāṃ vā trivṛtāgniṣṭutāpi vā || 11.74 ||
yajeteti | ‘yajeta vāśvamedhena’ ity anantaraṃ vyākhyātam | svarjitā yāgaviśeṣeṇa, gosavena vā, abhijitā viśvajitā vā, trivṛtāgniṣṭutā vā yājayet | etāni cājñānato brahmavadhe prāyaścittāni traivarṇikasya vikalpitāni | tad uktaṃ baviṣyapurāṇe |
svarjitādeś ca yad vīra karmaṇāṃ pṛtanāpate |
anuṣṭhānaṃ dvijātīnāṃ vadhe hy amatipūrvake ||
|| 11.74 ||
japan vānyatamaṃ vedaṃ yojanānāṃ śataṃ vrajet |
brahmahatyāpanodāya mitabhuṅ niyatendriyaḥ || 11.75 ||
japann iti | vedānāṃ madhyād ekaṃ vedaṃ japan svalpāhāraḥ saṃyatendriyo brahmahatyāpāpanirharaṇāya yojanānāṃ śataṃ gacchet | etad apy ajñānakṛte jātimātrabrāhmaṇavadhe traivarṇikasya prāyaścittam | tathā ca bhaviṣyapurāṇe ayam eva ślokaḥ paṭhito vyākhyātaś ca |
jātimātraṃ yadā vipraṃ hanyād amatipūrvakam |
vedavic cāgnihotrī ca tadā tasya bhaved idam ||
|| 11.75 ||
sarvasvaṃ vedaviduṣe brāhmaṇāyopapādayet |
dhanaṃ vā jīvanāyālaṃ gṛhaṃ vā saparicchadam || 11.76 ||
sarvasvam iti | sarvasvaṃ vā vedavide brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | yāvad dhanaṃ jīvanāya samartham | gṛhaṃ vā gṛhopayogidhanadhānyādiyutam | ataḥ sarvasvaṃ vā gṛhaṃ vā saparicchadaṃ dadyāt | jīvanāyālam iti vacanāj jīvanaparyāptaṃ sarvasvaṃ gṛhaṃ vā dadyān na tato ‘lpam | etac cājñānato jātimātrabrāhmaṇavadhe brāhmaṇasya prāyaścittam | tathā ca bhaviṣyapurāṇam |
jātimātraṃ yadā hanyād brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇo guha |
vedābhyāsavihīno vai dhanavān agnivarjitaḥ ||
prāyaścittaṃ tadā kuryād idaṃ pāpaviśuddhaye |
dhanaṃ vā jīvanāyālaṃ gṛhaṃ vā saparicchadam ||
haviṣyabhug vānusaret pratisrotaḥ sarasvatīm |
japed vā niyatāhāras trir vai vedasya saṃhitām || 11.77 ||
haviṣyeti | nīvārādihaviṣyānnabhojī vikhyātaprasravaṇād ārabhyāpaścimodadheḥ strotaḥ prati sarasvatīṃ yāyāt | etac ca jātimātrabrāhmaṇavadhe jñānapūrvake | tathā bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
jātimātre hate vipre devendra matipūrvakam |
hantā yadā vedahīno dhanena ca bhaved bhṛtaḥ ||
tadaitat kalpayet tasya prāyaścittaṃ nibodha me |
haviṣyabhuk cared vāpi pratisrotaḥ sarasvatīm ||
atha vā parimitāhāras trīn vārān vedasaṃhitām ||
saṃhitāgrahaṇāt padakramavyudāsaḥ | atrāpi bhaviṣyapurāṇīyo viśeṣaḥ |
jātimātraṃ tu yo hanyād vipraṃ tv amatipūrvakam |
brāhmaṇo ‘tyantaguṇavāṃs tenedaṃ parikalpayet ||
japed vā niyatāhāras trir vai vedasya saṃhitām |
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni traividyākhyaṃ surottama ||
|| 11.77 ||
idānīṃ “samāpte dvādaśe varṣe” (11.81) ity upadeśād dvādaśavārṣikasya viśeṣam āha –
kṛtavāpano nivased grāmānte govraje ‘pi vā |
āśrame vṛkṣamūle vā gobrāhmaṇahite rataḥ || 11.78 ||
kṛteti | lūnakeśanakhaśmaśrur gobrāhmaṇahite rato gobrāhmaṇopakārān kurvan grāmasamīpe goṣthapuṇyadeśavṛkṣamūlānyatame nivaset | “vane kuṭīṃ kṛtvā” (11.72) ity asya vikalpārtham idam || 11.78 ||
brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā sadyaḥ prāṇān parityajan |
mucyate brahmahatyāyā goptā gor brāhmaṇasya ca || 11.79 ||
brāhmaṇārtha iti | prakrānte dvādaśavārṣike ‘ntarāgnyudakahiṃsakādyākrāntabrāhmaṇasya gor vā paritrāṇārthaṃ prāṇān parityajan brahmahatyāyā mucyate | gobrāhmaṇaṃ vā tataḥ paritrāyāmṛto ‘py asamāptadvādaśavarṣo ‘pi mucyate || 11.79 ||
trivāraṃ pratiroddhā vā sarvasvam avajitya vā |
viprasya tannimitte vā prāṇālābhe vimucyate || 11.80 ||
trivāram iti | stenādibhir brāhmaṇasarvasve ‘pahriyamāṇe tadānayanārthaṃ nirvyājaṃ yathāśakti prayatnaṃ kurvaṃs tatra trivārān yuddhe pravartamāno nānīte ‘pi sarvasve brahmahatyāpāpāt pramucyate | atha vā prathamavāra eva viprasarvasvam apahṛtaṃ jitvārpayati tathāpi mucyate | yad vā dhanāpahārakatvena svenaiva brāhmaṇo yuddhena maraṇe pravartate tadā yady apy apahṛtasamadhanadānena taṃ jīvayati tadāpi tannimitte tasya prāṇalābhe brahmahatāpāpān mucyate | etad itaraprakārāntareṇa tu rakṣaṇe “goptā gor brāhmaṇasya ca” (11.70) ity apunaruktiḥ || 11.80 ||
evaṃ dṛḍhavrato nityaṃ brahmacārī samāhitaḥ |
samāpte dvādaśe varṣe brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 11.81 ||
evam iti | evam uktaprakāreṇa sarvadā niyamopahitaḥ strīsaṃyogādiśūnyaḥ saṃyatamanāḥ samāpte dvādaśe varṣe brahmahatyāpāpaṃ nāśayati | evaṃ “brāhmaṇārthe” (11.79) ityādi sarvaṃ prakrāntadvādaśavārṣikasya boddhavyam || 11.81 ||
śiṣṭvā vā bhūmidevānāṃ naradevasamāgame |
svam eno ‘vabhṛthasnāto hayamedhe vimucyate || 11.82 ||
śiṣṭveti | aśvamedhe brāhmaṇānām ṛtvijāṃ kṣatriyasya yajamānasya samāgameṣu svaṃ brahmahatyāpāpaṃ śiṣṭvā nivedyāvabhṛtasnāto brahmahatyāpāpān mucyate, dvādaśavārṣikasyopasaṃhṛtatvāt svatantram evedaṃ prāyaścittam | tathā ca bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
yadā tu guṇavān vipro hanyād vipraṃ tu nirguṇam |
akāmatas tadā gacchet snānaṃ caivāśvamedhikam ||
govindarājas tu “aśvamedhavivarjitasakalaprāyaścittaśeṣato ‘sya prakrāntadvādaśavārṣikaprāyaścittasyāntarāvabhṛtasnāne tenaiva śuddhiḥ” ity āha | tad ayuktam, bhaviṣyapurāṇavacanavirodhāt || 11.82 ||
dharmasya brāhmaṇo mūlam agraṃ rājanya ucyate |
tasmāt samāgame teṣām eno vikhyāpya śudhyati || 11.83 ||
dharmasyeti | yasmād brāhmaṇo dharmasya kāraṇaṃ brāhmaṇena dharmopadeśe kṛte dharmānuṣṭhānād rājā tasyāgraṃ prāntaṃ manvādibhir ucyate, tābhyāṃ brāhmaṇakṣatriyābhyāṃ samūlāgradharmataruniṣpatteḥ | tasmāt teṣāṃ samāgame ‘śvamedhe pāpaṃ nivedyāvabhṛtasnātaḥ śudhyatīty asyaiva viśeṣaḥ || 11.83 ||
brāhmaṇaḥ saṃbhavenaiva devānām api daivatam |
pramāṇaṃ caiva lokasya brahmātraiva hi kāraṇam || 11.84 ||
brāhmaṇa iti | brāhmaṇa utpattimātreṇaiva kiṃ punaḥ śrutādibhir devānām api pūjyaḥ sutarāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ lokasya ca pratyakṣavat pramāṇam, tadupadeśasya prāmānyāt | yasmāt tatra veda eva kāraṇaṃ vedamūlatvād upadeśasya || 11.84 ||
yata evam ataḥ –
teṣāṃ vedavido brūyus trayo ‘py enaḥ suniṣkṛtam |
sā teṣāṃ pāvanāya syāt pavitrā viduṣāṃ hi vāk || 11.85 ||
teṣām iti | teṣāṃ viduṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ madhye vedajñās trayo ‘pi kim utādhikāḥ, yat pāpanirharaṇāya prāyaścittaṃ brūyus tat pāpināṃ viśuddhaye bhavati | yasmād viduṣāṃ vāk pāvayitrī, tataś ca prakāśaprāyaścittārthaṃ viduṣām api pariṣad avaśyaṃ kāryā | rahasyaprāyaścitte punar etan nāsti, rahasyatvavirodhāt || 11.85 ||
ato ‘nyatamam āsthāya vidhiṃ vipraḥ samāhitaḥ |
brahmahatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohaty ātmavattayā || 11.86 ||
ata iti | asmāt prāyaścittagaṇād anyatamaṃ prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇādiḥ saṃyatamanā āśritya praśastārthatayā brahmahatyākṛtaṃ pāpam apanudati | etac ca brahmavadhādiprāyaścittavidhānaṃ sakṛtpāpakaraṇaviṣayaṃ, pāpāvṛttau tv āvartanīyam | “enasi guruṇi gurūni laguni laghūni” iti gautamasmaraṇāt | “pūrṇe cānasy anasthnāṃ tu śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret” (11.140) iti bahumāraṇe prāyaścittabahutvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāc ca,
vidheḥ prāthamikād asmād dvitīye dviguṇaṃ smṛtam |
tṛtīye triguṇaṃ proktam ||
iti gautamasmaraṇāt | gṛhadāhādinā yugapad anekabrāhmaṇahanane tu bhaviṣyapurāṇīyo viśeṣaḥ |
brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaṃ vīra brāhmaṇau vā bahūn guha |
nihatya yugapad vīra ekaṃ prāṇāntikaṃ caret ||
kāmatas tu yadā hanyād brāhmaṇān surasattama |
tad ātmānaṃ dahed agnau vidhinā yena tac chṛṇu ||
etac cājñānaviṣayaṃ sarvam evaitat | tathā –
akāmato yadā hanyād brāhmaṇān brāhmaṇo guha |
cared vane tathā ghore yāvat prāṇaparikṣayam ||
etac cājñānavadhe prakṛtatvād yugapanmāraṇaviṣayam | kramamāraṇe tu ‘vidheḥ prāthamikād asmāt’ ity āvṛttividhāyakaṃ vedavacanam || 11.86 ||
hatvā garbham avijñātam etad eva vrataṃ caret |
rājanyavaiśyau cejānāv ātreyīm eva ca striyam || 11.87 ||
hatveti | prakṛtatvād brāhmaṇagarbhaviṣayaṃ strīpuṃnapuṃsakatvenāvijñātaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ ca yāgapravṛttaṃ hatvā ātreyīṃ ca striyaṃ brāhmaṇīṃ “tathātreyīṃ ca brāhmaṇīm” ity yamasmaraṇāt | hatvā brahmahatyāprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt | ātreyī ca rajasvalā ṛtusnātocyate, “rajasvalām ṛtusnātām ātreyīm” (VaDh 2035) iti vasiṣṭhasmaraṇāt | evaṃ cānātreyībrāhmaṇīvadhe traivārṣikam upapātakam | yathoktam “strīśūdraviṭkṣatravadhaḥ” (11.66) iti | yat tūttaraśloke “kṛtvā ca strīsuhṛdvadham” (11.88) iti tad āhitāgnibrāhmaṇasya brāhmaṇībhāryāviṣayam | tathā cāṅgirāḥ |
āhitāgner brāhmaṇasya hatvā patnīm aninditām |
brahmahatyāvrataṃ kuryād ātreyīghnas tathaiva ca ||
|| 11.87 ||
uktvā caivānṛtaṃ sākṣye pratirudhya guruṃ tathā |
apahṛtya ca nikṣepaṃ kṛtvā ca strīsuhṛdvadham || 11.88 ||
uktveti | hiraṇyabhūmyādiyuktasākṣye ‘nṛtam uktvā, guroś ca mithyābhiśāpam utpādya, nikṣepaṃ ca brāhmaṇasuvarṇād anyad rajatādi dravyaṃ, kṣatriyādeḥ suvarṇam api cāpahṛtya, strīvadhaṃ ca yathāvyākhyātaṃ kṛtvā mitraṃ cābrāhmaṇaṃ hatvā brahmahatyāprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt || 11.88 ||
iyaṃ viśuddhir uditā pramāpyākāmato dvijam |
kāmato brāhmaṇavadhe niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate || 11.89 ||
iyam iti | etat tu prāyaścittaṃ viśeṣopadeśam antareṇākāmato brāhmaṇavadhe ‘bhihitam | kāmatas tu brāhmaṇavadhe neyaṃ niṣkṛtir naitat prāyaścittaṃ kiṃ tv ato dviguṇādikaraṇātmakam iti prāyaścittagauravārthaṃ na tu prāyaścittābhāvārtham, “kāmatas tu kṛtaṃ mohāt prāyaścittaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ” (11.46) iti pūrvoktavirodhāt || 11.89 ||
surāṃ pītvā dvijo mohād agnivarṇāṃ surāṃ pibet |
tayā sa kāye nirdagdhe mucyate kilbiṣāt tataḥ || 11.90 ||
surām iti | surāśabdaḥ paiṣṭīmātre mukhyo na tu gauḍīmādhvīpaiṣṭīṣu tritayānugataikarūpābhāvāt pratyekaṃ ca śaktikalpane śaktitrayakalpanāgauravaprasaṅgāt | gauḍyādimadirāsu guṇavṛttyāpi surāśabdaprayogopapatteḥ | ata eva bhaviṣyapurāṇe |
surā ca paiṣṭī mukhyoktā na tasyās tv itare same |
paiṣṭyāh pānena caitāsāṃ prāyaścittaṃ nibodhata ||
manunoktaṃ mahābāho samāsavyāsayogataḥ ||
etāsām iti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | etāsāṃ gauḍīmādhvīpaiṣṭīnāṃ prakṛtānāṃ madhye paiṣṭīpāne manūktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ‘surāṃ pītvā dvijo mohāt’ iti nibodhatety arthaḥ | mukhyāṃ surāṃ paiṣṭīṃ rāgādivyāmūḍhatayā dvijo brāhmaṇādiś ca pītvāgnivarṇāṃ surāṃ pibet | tayā surayā śarīre nirdagdhe sati dvijas tasmāt pāpān mucyate | etac ca gurutvāt kāmakārakṛtasurāpānaviṣayam | tathā ca bṛhaspatiḥ |
surāpāne kāmakṛte jvalantīṃ tāṃ vinikṣipet |
mukhe tayā sa nirdagdho mṛtaḥ śuddhim avāpnuyāt ||
|| 11.90 ||
gomūtram agnivarṇaṃ vā pibed udakam eva vā |
payo ghṛtaṃ vāmaraṇād gośakṛdrasam eva vā || 11.91 ||
gomūtram iti | gomūtrajalagokṣīragavyaghṛtagomayarasānām anyatamam agnisparśaṃ kṛtvā yāvanmaraṇaṃ pibet || 11.91 ||
kaṇān vā bhakṣayed abdaṃ piṇyākaṃ vā sakṛn niśi |
surāpānāpanuttyarthaṃ vālavāsā jaṭī dhvajī || 11.92 ||
kaṇān veti | atha vā goromādikṛtavāsā jaṭāvān surābhājanacihnaḥ sūkṣmataṇḍulāvayavānākṛṣṭatailaṃ tilaṃ vā rātrāv ekavāraṃ saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ surāpānapāpanāśanārthaṃ bhakṣayet | idam abuddhipūrvakam amukhyasurāpānaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, na tu guṇānaravaikalpikaṃ laghutvāt || 11.92 ||
surā vai malam annānāṃ pāpmā ca malam ucyate |
tasmād brāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśyaś ca na surāṃ pibet || 11.93 ||
sureti | yasmāt taṇḍulapiṣṭasādhyatvāt surānnamalam | malaśabdena ca pāpam ucyate | tasmād brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyāḥ paiṣṭīṃ surāṃ na pibeyur ity anena pratiṣedhe sati etadatikrame “surāṃ pītvā” (11.90) iti prāyaścittam | annamalānuvādāc ca paiṣṭīniṣedha eva sphuṭas traivarṇikasya manunaivoktaḥ || 11.93 ||
gauḍī paiṣṭī ca mādhvī ca vijñeyā trividhā surā |
yathaivaikā tathā sarvā na pātavyā dvijottamaiḥ || 11.94 ||
gauḍīti | yā guḍena kṛtā sā gauḍī, evaṃ piṣṭena kṛtā paiṣṭī, madhukavṛkṣo madhus tatpuṣpaiḥ kṛtā sā mādhvī evaṃ triprakārā surā jāyate | mukhyasurāsāmyanibodhanam itarasurāpekṣayā brāhmaṇasya gauḍīmādhvīpāne prāyaścittagauravārtham | yathā vaikā paiṣṭī mukhyā surā pūrvavākyān niṣiddhatvāt traivarṇikasyāpekṣayā tathā pūrvā gauḍī mādhvī ca dvijottamair na pātavyā || 11.94 ||
yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānnaṃ madyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāsavam |
tad brāhmaṇena nāttavyaṃ devānām aśnatā haviḥ || 11.95 ||
yakṣeti | madyam atra niṣiddhapaiṣṭīgauḍīmādhvīvyatiriktaṃ navavidhaṃ boddhavyam | tāny āha pulastyaḥ |
pānasadrākṣamādhvīkaṃ khārjūraṃ tālam aikṣavam |
mādhvīkaṃ ṭāṅkamārdvīkamaireyaṃ nālikerajam ||
sāmānyāni dvijātīnāṃ madyāny ekādaśaiva ca |
dvādaśaṃ tu surāmadyaṃ sarveṣām adhamaṃ smṛtam ||
māṃsaṃ ca pratiṣiddham | surā ca triprakārā proktā | asūyata ity āsavo pulastyoktaprāyaścittam:
drākṣekṣuṭaṅkakharjūrapanasādeś yo rasaḥ |
sadyojātaṃ tu pītvā tu tryahāc chudhyed dvijottamaḥ ||
evaṃ madyādicatuṣṭayaṃ yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācasaṃbandhyannaṃ tatas tad brāhmaṇena devānāṃ havir bhakṣayatā nāśitavyam | niṣiddhāyāḥ surāyā ihopādānaṃ yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānnatayā nindārtham |
atra kecit – ‘devānām aśnatā haviḥ’ iti puṃliṅganirdeśād brāhmaṇasya puṃsa eva madyapratiṣedho na striyā ity āhuḥ |
tad asat,
patilokaṃ na sā yāti brāhmaṇī yā surāṃ pibet |
ihaiva sā śunī gṛdhrī sūkarī copajāyate || (YDh 3.256)
iti yājñavalkyādismṛtivirodhāt || 11.95 ||
amedhye vā paten matto vaidikaṃ vāpy udāharet |
akāryam anyat kuryād vā brāhmaṇo madamohitaḥ || 11.96 ||
amedhya iti | brāhmaṇo madyapānamadamūḍhabuddhiḥ sann aśucau vā patet, vedavākyaṃ voccārayet, brahmahatyādyakāryaṃ vā kuryāt, atas tena madyapānaṃ na kāryam iti pūrvasyaivānuvādaḥ || 11.96 ||
yasya kāyagataṃ brahma madyenāplāvyate sakṛt |
tasya vyapaiti brāhmaṇyaṃ śūdratvaṃ ca sa gacchati || 11.97 ||
