yasyeti | yasya brāhmaṇasya kāyagataṃ brahma vedaḥ saṃskārarūpeṇāvasthitaḥ ekadehatvāt jīvātmā ekavāram api madyenāplāvyate tathā caikavāram api yo brāhmaṇo madyaṃ pibati tasya brāhmaṇyaṃ vyapaiti sa śūdratāṃ samāpnoti | tasmān madyaṃ sarvathaiva na pātavyam || 11.97 ||
eṣā vicitrābhihitā surāpānasya niṣkṛtiḥ |
ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi suvarṇasteyaniṣkṛtim || 11.98 ||
eṣeti | idaṃ surāpānajanitapāpasya nānāprakāraṃ prāyaścittam abhihitam | tasmāt paraṃ brāhmaṇasuvarṇaharaṇapāpasya niṣkṛtiṃ vakṣyāmi || 11.98 ||
suvarṇasteyakṛd vipro rājānam abhigamya tu |
svakarma khyāpayan brūyān māṃ bhavān anuśāstv iti || 11.99 ||
suvarṇeti |
apahṛtya suvarṇaṃ tu brāhmaṇasya yataḥ svayam |
iti śātātapasmaraṇād, brāhmaṇasuvarṇacauro brāhmaṇo rājānaṃ gatvā brāhmaṇasuvarṇāpahāraṃ svīyaṃ karma kathayan mama nigrahaṃ karotv iti brūyāt | brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ manuṣyamātrapradarśanārtham, “prāyaścittīyate naraḥ” (11.44) iti prakṛtatvāt kṣatriyādīnāṃ ca prāyaścittāntarānabhidhānāt || 11.99 ||
gṛhītvā musalaṃ rājā sakṛd dhanyāt tu taṃ svayam |
vadhena śudhyati steno brāhmaṇas tapasaiva vā || 11.100 ||
gṛhītveti | “skandhenādāya musalam” (8.316) ityāder uktatvāt tenārpitaṃ musalādikaṃ gṛhītvā steyakāriṇaṃ manuṣyam ekavāraṃ rājā svayaṃ hanyāt | sa ca steno vadhena musalābhighātena “hato mukto ‘pi vā śuciḥ” (YDh 3.257) iti yājñavalkyasmaraṇān mṛto vā mṛtakalpo vā jīvaṃs tasmāt pāpān mucyate | brāhmaṇaḥ punaḥ ‘tapasaiva vā’ ity evakāradarśanāt | tathā ca “na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyāt sarvapāpeṣv api sthitam” (8.380) iti tapasaiva śudhyati | ata eva manvarthavyākhyānapare bhaviṣyapurāṇe,
yad etad vacanaṃ vīra brāhmaṇas tapasaiva vā |
tatraiva kāraṇād vidvan brāhmaṇasya surādhipa ||
tapasaivety aneneha pratiṣedho vadhasya tu ||
vāśabdaś ca kṣatriyādīnām api tapovikalpārthaḥ | brāhmaṇasya tu tapa eveti niyamo na tu brāhmaṇasyaiva tapaḥ | ata eva bhaviṣyapurāṇe:
itareṣām api vibho tapo na pratiṣidhyate | iti |
|| 11.100 ||
tad eva tapa āha –
tapasāpanunutsus tu suvarṇasteyajaṃ malam |
cīravāsā dvijo ‘raṇye cared brahmahaṇo vratam || 11.101 ||
tapaseti | tapasā svarṇasteyotpannaṃ pāpaṃ dvijo nirhartum icchan araṇyagrahaṇāt prāthamyāc ca brahmahaṇi yad vratam uktaṃ tat kuryāt | etac ca dvādaśavārṣikaṃ kleśagauravāt kṣatriyādīnāṃ maraṇena vikalpitatvāc ca brāhmaṇasaṃbandhinaḥ suvarṇāpaharaṇe “pañcakṛṣṇalako māṣas te suvarṇas tu ṣoḍaśa” (8.134) iti suvarṇaparimāṇaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ, na tato nyūnasya, parimāṇāpekṣayā manūktaparimāṇasya grahītuṃ nyāyyatvāt | yat tv adhikaparimāṇaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe śrūyate tat tathānubandhaviśiṣṭāpahāre tathāvidhaprāyaścittaviṣayam eva | tathā bhaviṣyapurāṇe:
kṣatriyādyās trayo varṇā nirguṇā hy aghatatparāḥ |
guṇāḍhyasya tu viprasya pañca niṣkān haranti cet ||
niṣkān ekādaśa tathā dagdhvātmānaṃ tu pāvake |
śudhyeyur maraṇād vīra cared brahmātmaśuddhaye ||
|| 11.101 ||
etair vratair apoheta pāpaṃ steyakṛtaṃ dvijaḥ |
gurustrīgamanīyaṃ tu vratair ebhir apānudet || 11.102 ||
etair iti | brāhmaṇasuvarṇasteyajanitapāpam ebhir vratair dvijo nirharet | vratatapasor dvayor uktatvād etair iti bahuvacanaṃ saṃbandhāpekṣayā manūktam api prāyaścittaṃ kalpanīyam iti jñāpanārtham | gurustrīgamananimittaṃ punaḥ pāpam ebhir vakṣyamāṇaiḥ prāyaścittair nirharet || 11.102 ||
gurutalpy abhibhāṣyainas tapte svapyād ayomaye |
sūmīṃ jvalantīṃ vāśliṣyen mṛtyunā sa viśudhyati || 11.103 ||
gurv iti | “niṣekādīni karmāṇi” (2.142) ity uktatvād guruḥ pitā, talpaṃ bhāryā, gurutalpaṃ gurubhāryā tadgāmī gurubhāryāgamanapāpaṃ vikhyāpya lohamaye taptaśayane svapyāt | lohamayīṃ strīpratikṛtiṃ kṛtvā jvalantīm ālaṅgya mṛtyunā sa viśuddho bhavati || 11.103 ||
svayaṃ vā śiśnavṛṣaṇāv utkṛtyādhāya cāñjalau |
nairṛtīṃ diśam ātiṣṭhed ā nipātād ajihmagaḥ || 11.104 ||
svayaṃ veti | ātmanaiva vā liṅgavṛṣaṇau chittvāñjalau kṛtvā yāvaccharīrapātam avakragatiḥ san dakṣiṇapaścimāṃ diśaṃ gacchet | evaṃ coktaprāyaścittadvayaṃ gurutvāt savarṇagurubhāryāvaiṣayaṃ jñānato retovisargaparyantamaithunaviṣayam || 11.104 ||
khaṭvāṅgī cīravāsā vā śmaśrulo vijane vane |
prājāpatyaṃ caret kṛcchram abdam ekaṃ samāhitaḥ || 11.105 ||
khatvāṅgīti | khaṭvāṅgabhṛd vastrakhaṇḍācchanno ‘chinnakeśanakhalomaśmaśrudhārī saṃyatamanā nirjane vane varṣam ekaṃ prājāpatyavrataṃ caret | evaṃ ca vakṣyamāṇaprāyaścittalaghutvāt svabhāryādibhrameṇājñānaviṣayaṃ boddhavyam || 11.105 ||
cāndrāyaṇaṃ vā trīn māsān abhyasen niyatendriyaḥ |
haviṣyeṇa yavāgvā vā gurutalpāpanuttaye || 11.106 ||
cāndrāyaṇam ityādi | yad vā gurubhāryāgamanapāpanirharaṇāya saṃyatendriyaḥ phalamūlādinā haviṣyeṇa nīvārādikṛtayavāgvā vā trīn māsāṃś cāndrāyaṇāny ācaret | etac ca pūrvoktād api laghutvād asādhvīm asavarṇāṃ vā gurubhāryāṃ gacchato draṣṭavyam || 11.106 ||
etair vratair apoheyur mahāpātakino malam |
upapātakinas tv evam ebhir nānāvidhair vrataiḥ || 11.107 ||
etair vratair ityādi | ebhir uktavratair brahmahatyādimahāpātakakāriṇaḥ pāpaṃ nirhareyuḥ | govadhādyupapātakakāriṇaḥ punar vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇānekarūpavrataiḥ pāpāni nirhareyuḥ
|| 11.107 ||
upapātakasaṃyukto goghno māsaṃ yavān pibet |
kṛtavāpo vased goṣṭhe carmaṇā tena saṃvṛtaḥ || 11.108 ||
caturthakālam aśnīyād akṣāralavaṇaṃ mitam |
gomūtreṇācaret snānaṃ dvau māsau niyatendriyaḥ || 11.109 ||
divānugacched gās tās tu tiṣṭhann ūrdhvaṃ rajaḥ pibet |
śuśrūṣitvā namaskṛtvā rātrau vīrāsano vaset || 11.110 ||
tiṣṭhantīṣv anutiṣṭhet tu vrajantīṣv apy anuvrajet |
āsīnāsu tathāsīno niyato vītamatsaraḥ || 11.111 ||
āturām abhiśastāṃ vā cauravyāghrādibhir bhayaiḥ |
patitāṃ paṅkalagnāṃ vā sarvopāyair vimocayet || 11.112 ||
uṣṇe varṣati śīte vā mārute vāti vā bhṛśam |
na kurvītātmanas trāṇaṃ gor akṛtvā tu śaktitaḥ || 11.113 ||
ātmano yadi vānyeṣāṃ gṛhe kṣetre ‘tha vā khale |
bhakṣayantīṃ na kathayet pibantaṃ caiva vatsakam || 11.114 ||
anena vidhinā yas tu goghno gām anugacchati |
sa gohatyākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tribhir māsair vyapohati || 11.115 ||
upapātaketi | ‘anena vidhinā yas tu’ (11.115) iti yāvatkulakam | upapātakayukto goghātī śithilayavāgūrūpeṇa prathamamāsaṃ yavān pibet | saśikhaṃ muṇḍitaśirā lūnaśmaśrus tena hatagocarmaṇācchāditadeho māsatrayam eva goṣṭhe vaset | gomūtreṇācaret snānaṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ kṛtrimalavaṇavarjitaṃ haviṣyam annam ekāhaṃ bhuktvā dvitīye ‘hani sāyaṃ dvitīyatṛtīyamāsāv aśnīyāt | māsatrayam eva divā prātas tā gā anugacchet | tāsāṃ ca gavāṃ khuraprahārād ūrdhvam utthitaṃ rajas tiṣthann āsvādayet | kaṇḍūyanādinā tāh paricarya praṇamya ca rātrau bhittyādikam ananuveṣṭyopaviṣṭa āsīta | tathā śucir vigatakrodha utthitāsu goṣu paścād uttiṣṭhet | vane ca paribhramantīṣu paścāt tataḥ paribhramet | upaviṣṭāsu goṣūpaviśet | vyādhitāṃ cauravyāghrādibhayahetubhir ākrāntāṃ patitāṃ kardamlagnāṃ vā yathāśakti mocayet | tathā uṣṇa āditye tapati meghe ca varṣati śīte copasthite mārute cātyarthaṃ vāti gor yathāśakti rakṣām akṛtvātmanas trāṇaṃ na kuryāt | tathātmano ‘nyeṣāṃ vā gehe kṣetre khaleṣu sasyādibhakṣaṇaṃ kurvantīṃ vatsaṃ ca kṣīraṃ pibantaṃ na kathayet | anenoktavidhānena yo goghno gāḥ paricarati sa govadhajanitapāpaṃ tribhir māsair apanudati || 11.108–115 ||
vṛṣabhaikādaśā gāś ca dadyāt sucaritavrataḥ |
avidyamāne sarvasvaṃ vedavidbhyo nivedayet || 11.116 ||
vṛṣabhaikādaśā iti | vṛṣabha ekādaśo yāsāṃ tāḥ samyag anuṣṭhitaprāyaścitto dadyāt | avidyamāne tāvati dhane sarvasvaṃ vedajñebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo dadyāt || 11.116 ||
etad eva vrataṃ kuryur upapātakino dvijāḥ |
avakīrṇivarjaṃ śuddhyarthaṃ cāndrāyaṇam athāpi vā || 11.117 ||
etad eveti | apare tūpapātakino vakṣyamāṇāvakīrṇivarjitāḥ pāpanirharaṇārtham etad eva govadhaprāyaścittaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ vā laghutvāt kuryuḥ | cāndrāyaṇaṃ tu laghuny upapātake jātiśaktiguṇādy apekṣya vā yojanīyam || 11.117 ||
avakīrṇī tu kāṇena gardabhena catuṣpathe |
pākayajñavidhānena yajeta nirṛtiṃ niśi || 11.118 ||
avakīrṇī tv iti | avakīrṇī vakṣyamāṇaḥ kāṇena gardabhena rātrau catuṣpathe pākayajñena tantreṇa nirṛtyākhyāṃ devatāṃ yajet || 11.118 ||
hutvāgnau vidhivad dhomān antataś ca sam ity ṛcā |
vātendraguruvahnīnāṃ juhuyāt sarpiṣāhutīḥ || 11.119 ||
hutveti | tato nirṛtyau gardabhavapādihomān yathāvac catuṣpathe kṛtvā tadante “saṃ mā siñcantu marutaḥ” (AV 7.33.1) ity etayā ṛcā mārutendrabṛhaspatyagnīnāṃ ghṛtenāhutīr juhuyāt || 11.119 ||
aprasiddhatvād avakīrṇavato lakṣaṇam āha –
kāmato retasaḥ sekaṃ vratasthasya dvijanmanaḥ |
atikramaṃ vratasyāhur dharmajñā brahmavādinaḥ || 11.120 ||
kāmata iti | icchāto dvijaḥ,
avakīrṇī bhaved gatvā brahmacārī ca yoṣitam | (YDh 3.281)
iti vacanāt strīyonau śukrotsargaṃ brahmacaryasyātikramam avakīrṇarūpaṃ sarvajñā vedavidaḥ prāhuḥ || 11.120 ||
mārutaṃ puruhūtaṃ ca guruṃ pāvakam eva ca |
caturo vratino ‘bhyeti brāhmaṃ tejo ‘vakīrṇinaḥ || 11.121 ||
mārutam iti | vratacāriṇo vedādhyayananiyamānuṣṭhānajaṃ tejaḥ tad avakīrṇinaḥ sato marudindrabṛhaspatipāvakāṃś caturaḥ saṃkrāmati | atas tebhya ājyāhutīr juhuyād ity ājyāhuter ayam anuvādaḥ || 11.121 ||
etasminn enasi prāpte vasitvā gardabhājinam |
saptāgārāṃś cared bhaikṣaṃ svakarma parikīrtayan || 11.122 ||
etasminn iti | etasminn avakīrṇākhye pāpa utpanne pūrvoktaṃ gardabhayāgādi kṛtvā “gardabhacarma paridhāya” iti hārītasmaraṇāt sa gardabhasaṃbandhicarmaprāvṛto ‘vakīrṇy aham iti svakarmakhyāpanaṃ kurvan sapta gṛhāṇi bhaikṣaṃ caret || 11.122 ||
tebhyo labdhena bhaikṣeṇa vartayann ekakālikam |
upaspṛśaṃs triṣavaṇaṃ tv abdena sa viśudhyati || 11.123 ||
tebhya iti | tebhyaḥ saptagṛhebhyo labdhena bhaikṣeṇaikakālam āhāraṃ kurvan sāyaṃprātarmadhyandineṣu ca snānam ācaran so ‘vakīrṇī saṃvatsareṇaiva viśudhyati || 11.123 ||
jātibhraṃśakaraṃ karma kṛtvānyatamam icchayā |
caret sāntapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ prājāpatyam icchayā || 11.124 ||
jātīti | “brāhmaṇasya rujaḥ kṛtvā” (11.67) ityādi jātibhraṃśakarmoktaṃ tan madhyād anyatamaṃ karmaviśeṣam icchātaḥ kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇaṃ sāntapanaṃ saptāhasādhyaṃ kuryāt | anicchātaḥ punaḥ kṛtvā prājāpatyaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ caret || 11.124 ||
saṃkarāpātrakṛtyāsu māsaṃ śodhanam aindavam |
malinīkaraṇīyeṣu taptaḥ syād yāvakais tryaham || 11.125 ||
saṃkareti | “kharāśvoṣṭra-“ (11.68) ityādinā saṃkarīkaraṇāny uktāni | “ninditebhyo dhanādānam” (11.69) ityādinā cāpātrīkaraṇāny uktāni | teṣāṃ madhyād anyatamam icchātaḥ kṛtvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ māsaṃ śuddhaye kuryāt | “kṛmikīṭavayohatyā” (11.70) ityādinā malinīkaraṇāny uktāni | tanmadhyād ekam icchātaḥ kṛtvā trirātraṃ yavāgūṃ kvathitām aśnīyāt
|| 11.125 ||
turīyo brahmahatyāyāḥ kṣatriyasya vadhe smṛtaḥ |
vaiśye ‘ṣṭamāṃśo vṛttasthe śūdre jñeyas tu ṣoḍaśaḥ || 11.126 ||
turīya iti | brahmahatyāturīyo bhāgaḥ traivārṣikarūpo dvādaśavārṣikasya caturo bhāgaḥ | etac ca prāyaścittaṃ “strīśūdraviṭkṣatravadhaḥ” (11.66) ity upapātakatvenopadiṣṭaṃ traivārṣikatvāpekṣayā gurutvād vṛttasthakṣatriyasya kāmato vadhe draṣṭavyam | vaiśye sādhvācāre kāmato hate ‘ṣṭamo bhāgaḥ sārdhavārṣikaṃ vratam | śūdre vṛttasthe kāmato hate navamāsikaṃ draṣṭavyam || 11.126 ||
akāmatas tu rājanyaṃ vinipātya dvijottamaḥ |
vṛṣabhaikasahasrā gā dadyāt sucaritavrataḥ || 11.127 ||
akāmata iti | abuddhipūrvakaṃ punaḥ kṣatriyaṃ nihatya vṛṣabheṇaikenādhikaṃ sahasraṃ yāsāṃ gavāṃ tā ātmaśuddhyarthaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadyāt || 11.127 ||
tryabdaṃ cared vā niyato jaṭī brahmahaṇo vratam |
vasan dūratare grāmād vṛkṣamūlaniketanaḥ || 11.128 ||
tryabdam iti | yad vā saṃyato jaṭāvān grāmād viprakṛṣṭavṛkṣamūle kṛtanivāso brahmahaṇi yad uktaṃ “brahmahā dvādaśa samāḥ” (11.72) ityādi tad varṣatrayaṃ kuryāt | na tu “turīyo brahmahatyāyāḥ” (11.126) ity anena punaruktir vācyā, “jaṭī dūratare grāmād vṛkṣamūlaniketanaḥ” iti vacanād vytiriktaśavaśirodhvajadhāraṇādisakaladharmanivṛtty-arthatvād asya granthasya | akāmādhikārāc cedam akāmataḥ | ata evāṅgalāghavādy ucitam
|| 11.128 ||
etad eva cared abdaṃ prāyaścittaṃ dvijottamaḥ |
pramāpya caiśyaṃ vṛttasthaṃ dadyād vaikaśataṃ gavām || 11.129 ||
etad iti | etad eva dvādaśavārṣikavratam akāmataḥ sādhvācāraṃ vaiśyaṃ nihatya varṣam ekaṃ brāhmaṇādiḥ kuryād ekādhikaṃ vā gośataṃ dadyāt || 11.129 ||
etad eva vrataṃ kṛtsnaṃ ṣaṇmāsān śūdrahā caret |
vṛṣabhaikādaśā vāpi dadyād viprāya gāḥ sitāḥ || 11.130 ||
etad iti | etad apy akāmata idam eva vrataṃ śūdrahā ṣaṇmāsaṃ caret | vṛṣabha ekādaśo yāsāṃ gavāṃ tāḥ śuklavarṇā brāhmaṇāya dadyāt || 11.130 ||
mārjāranakulau hatvā cāṣaṃ maṇḍūkam eva ca |
śvagodholūkakākāṃś ca śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret || 11.131 ||
mārjāreti | biḍālanakulacāṣabhekakukkuragodhāpecakakākānām ekaikaṃ hatvā śūdrahatyāvrataṃ “strūśūdravadha” (11.66) ity upapātakaprāyaścittaṃ govadhavrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret, na tu “śūdra jñeyas tu ṣoḍaśaḥ” (11.126) ityādi prāyaścittaṃ, pāpasya laghutvāt | cāndrāyaṇam apy etat kāmato ‘bhyāsādiviṣaye draṣṭavyam || 11.132 ||
payaḥ pibet trirātraṃ vā yojanaṃ vādhvano vrajet |
upaspṛśet sravantyāṃ vā sūktaṃ vābdaivataṃ japet || 11.132 ||
paya iti | abuddhipūrvakaṃ mārjārādīnāṃ vadhe trirātraṃ kṣīraṃ pibet | atha mandānalatvādinā na samarthas trirātraṃ pratiyojanam adhvano vrajet | atrāśaktas trirātraṃ nadyāṃ snāyāt | tatrāpy akṣamas trirātraṃ “āpo hi ṣṭhā” (RV 7.6.5) ityādisūktaṃ japet | yathottaraṃ laghutvāt pūrvapūrvāsaṃbhave uttarottaraparigraho na tu vaikalpikaḥ || 11.132 ||
abhriṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ dadyāt sarpaṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ |
palālabhārakaṃ ṣaṇḍhe saisakaṃ caikamāṣakam || 11.133 ||
abhrim iti | sarpaṃ hatvā brāhmaṇāya tīkṣṇāgraṃ lohadaṇḍaṃ dadyāt | napuṃsakaṃ hatvā palālabhāraṃ sīsakaṃ ca māṣakaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt || 11.133 ||
ghṛtakumbhaṃ varāhe tu tiladroṇaṃ tu tittirau |
śuke dvihāyanaṃ vatsaṃ krauñcaṃ hatvā trihāyanam || 11.134 ||
ghṛteti | sūkare hate ghṛtapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | tittirisañjñini pakṣiṇi hate caturāḍhakaparimāṇaṃ tilaṃ dadyāt | śuke hate dvivarṣaṃ vatsam | krauñcākhyaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ hatvā trivarṣaṃ vatsaṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt || 11.134 ||
hatvā haṃsaṃ balākāṃ ca bakaṃ barhiṇam eva ca |
vānaraṃ śyenabhāsau ca sparśayed brāhmaṇāya gām || 11.135 ||
hatveti | haṃsabalākāmayūravānaraśyenabhāsākhyapakṣiṇām anyatamaṃ hatvā brāhmaṇāya gāṃ dadyāt || 11.135 ||
vāso dadyād dhayaṃ hatvā pañca nīlān vṛṣān gajam |
ajameṣāv anaḍvāhaṃ kharaṃ hatvaikahāyanam || 11.136 ||
vāsa iti | aśvaṃ hatvā vastraṃ dadyāt | hastinaṃ hatvā pañca nīlān vṛṣabhān dadyāt | pratyekaṃ chāgameṣau hatvā vṛṣabhaṃ dadyāt | gardabhaṃ hatvaikavarṣaṃ vatsaṃ dadyāt
|| 11.136 ||
kravyādāṃs tu mṛgān hatvā dhenuṃ dadyāt payasvinīm |
akravyādān vatsatarīm uṣṭraṃ hatvā tu kṛṣṇalam || 11.137 ||
kravyādān iti | āmamāṃsabhakṣiṇo mṛgān vyāghrādīn hatvā bahukṣīrāṃ dhenuṃ dadyāt | āmamāṃsabhakṣakān hariṇādīn hatvā prauḍhavatsikāṃ dadyāt | uṣṭraṃ hatvā suvarṇakṛṣṇalaṃ raktikāṃ dadyāt || 11.137 ||
jīnakārmukabastāvīn pṛthag dadyād viśuddhaye |
caturṇām api varṇānāṃ nārīr hatvānavasthitāḥ || 11.138 ||
[varṇānām ānupūrvyeṇa trayāṇām aviśeṣataḥ |
amatyā ca pramāpya strīṃ śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret || ]
jīneti | brāhmaṇādivarṇastriyo lobhād utkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭapuruṣavyabhicāriṇīr hatvā brāhmaṇādikrameṇa carmapuṭadhanuśchāgameṣāñ śuddhyarthaṃ dadyāt || 11.138 ||
dānena vadhanirṇekaṃ sarpādīnām aśaknuvan |
ekaikaśaś caret kṛcchraṃ dvijaḥ pāpāpanuttaye || 11.139 ||
dāneneti | abhriprabhṛtīnām abhāvād dānena sarvapāpanirharaṇaṃ kartum asamartho brāhmaṇādiḥ pratyekaṃ vadhe kṛcchraṃ prāthamyāt prājāpatyaṃ dvijaḥ pāpanirharaṇārthaṃ caret | sarpād anyaś ca “abhriṃ kārṣṇāyasīṃ dadyāt” (11.133) ity evamārabhyaitatparyantā gṛhyante || 11.139 ||
asthimatāṃ tu sattvānāṃ sahasrasya pramāpaṇe |
pūrṇe cānasy anasthnāṃ tu śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret || 11.140 ||
asthimatām iti | anasthisāhacaryād asthimatāṃ prāṇināṃ kṛkalāsādīnāṃ sahasrasya vadhe śūdravadhaprāyaścittam aupadeśikaṃ kuryāt | asthirahitānāṃ ca matkuṇādīnāṃ śakaṭaparimitānāṃ vadhe tad eva prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt || 11.140 ||
kiṃcid eva tu viprāya dadyād asthimatāṃ vadhe |
anasthnāṃ caiva hiṃsāyāṃ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || 11.141 ||
akiṃcid iti | asthimatāṃ kṣudrajantūnāṃ kṛkalāsādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ vadhe kiṃcid eva dadyāt | asthimatāṃ vadhe “paṇo deyaḥ suvarṇasya” iti sumantusmaraṇāt kiṃcid eveti paṇi boddhavyaḥ | anasthimatāṃ tu yūkāmatkuṇādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ vadhe prāṇāyāmena śuddho bhavati | prāṇāyāmaś ca ,
savyāhṛtikāṃ sapraṇavāṃ sāvitrīṃ śirasā saha |
triḥ paṭhed āyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate ||
iti vasiṣṭhoktalakṣaṇo grāhyaḥ || 11.141 ||
phaladānāṃ tu vṛkāṇāṃ chedane japyam ṛkśatam |
gulmavallīlatānāṃ ca puṣpitānāṃ ca vīrudhām || 11.142 ||
phaladānām iti | phaladānām āmrādīnāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ, gulmānāṃ kubjakādīnāṃ, vallīnāṃ guḍūcyādīnāṃ, latānāṃ, vṛkṣaśākhāsaktānāṃ puṣiptānāṃ ca vīrudhāṃ kūṣmāṇḍādīnāṃ, pratyekaṃ chedane pāpapramocanārthaṃ sāvitryādiṛkśataṃ japanīyam, “indhanārtham aśuṣkāṇāṃ drumāṇām avapātanam” (11.64) ityāder upapātakamadhye paṭhitasya guruprāyaścittābhidhānāt | idaṃ phalavadvṛkṣādicchedane laghuprāyaścittaṃ sakṛd abuddhipūrvakaviṣayaṃ veditavyam || 11.142 ||
annādyajānāṃ sattvānāṃ rasajānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ |
phalapuṣpodbhavānāṃ ca ghṛtaprāśo viśodhanam || 11.143 ||
annādyajānām iti | annādiṣu jātānāṃ, guḍādirasajātānāṃ ca, udumbarādiphalasaṃbhavānāṃ, madhūkādipuṣpodbhavānāṃ ca sarvaprāṇināṃ vadhe ghṛtaprāśanaṃ pāpaśodhanam || 11.143 ||
kṛṣṭajānām oṣadhīnāṃ jātānāṃ ca svayaṃ vane |
vṛthālambhe ‘nugacched gāṃ dinam ekaṃ payovrataḥ || 11.144 ||
kṛṣṭajānām iti | karṣaṇapūrvakajātānām oṣadhīnāṃ ṣaṣṭikādīnāṃ, vane ca svayam utpannānāṃ nīvārādīnāṃ niḥprayojanacchedane kṣīrāhāraḥ | eṣv ekam aho gor anugamanaṃ kuryāt
|| 11.144 ||
etair vratair apohyaṃ syād eno hiṃsāsamudbhavam |
jñānājñānakṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śṛṇutānādyabhakṣaṇe || 11.145 ||
etair iti | ebhir uktaprāyaścitair hiṃsājanitapāpaṃ jñānājñānakṛtaṃ nirharaṇīyam | idānīm abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaprāyaścittaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ śṛṇuta || 11.145 ||
ajñānād vāruṇīṃ pītvā saṃskāreṇaiva śudhyati |
matipūrvam anirdeśyaṃ prāṇāntikam iti sthitiḥ || 11.146 ||
ajñānād iti | mahāpātakaprakaraṇavyavadhānenāsyāmnānān nedaṃ mukhyapaiṣṭīsurāviṣayaṃ vacanaṃ kiṃ tu taditaraviṣayam | tatra “yathā caikā tathā sarvā” (11.94) | gauḍīmādhvyor mukhyasurāsāmyabodhanam itaramadyāpekṣayā brāhmaṇasya prāyaścittagauravārtham ity uktam | tenābuddhipūrvakaṃ gauḍīṃ mādhvīṃ ca pītvā gautamoktaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ kṛtvā punaḥsaṃskāreṇaiva śudhyati | tathā ca gautamaḥ: “amatyā madyapāne payo ghṛtam udakaṃ vāyuṃ pratyahaṃ taptakṛcchas tato ‘sya saṃskāraḥ” (GDh 24.1) | ittham eva vyākhyātaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe:
akāmataḥ kṛte pāne gauḍīmādhvyor narādhipa |
taptakṛcchravidhānaṃ syād gautamena yathoditam ||
buddhipūrvakaṃ tu paiṣṭītaramadyapāne “prāṇāntikam anirdeśyam” iti śāstramaryādā | tathā gauḍīmādhvyor jñānāt pāne maraṇaniṣedhād itaramadyāpekṣayā gurutvāc ca mānavam eva “kaṇān vā bhakṣayed abdam” (11.92) iti prāyaścittam uktam | ata eva gauḍīmādhvyoḥ kāmataḥ pānānuvṛttau bhaviṣyapurāṇe:
yad vāsminn eva viṣaye mānavīyaṃ prakalpayet |
kaṇān vā bhakṣayed abdaṃ piṇyākaṃ vā sakṛn niśi ||
surāpānāpanuttyarthaṃ vālavāsā jaṭī dhvajī || iti |
vaiṣṭīgauḍīmādhvīvyatiriktapulastyoktapānasādinavavidhamadyasya pratyekaṃ pāne lalghutvāt saṃskāramātram eva kevalam anyad vā laghutvāt prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇasya yuktam | buddhipūrvaṃ pānasādimadyapāne tu,
matipūrvaṃ surāpāne kṛte vai jñānato guha |
kṛcchrātikṛcchrau bhavataḥ punaḥsaṃskāra eva hi ||
iti bhaviṣyapurāṇīyam anyad vividhaṃ munyantaroktam || 11.146 ||
apaḥ surābhājanasthā madyabhāṇḍasthitās tathā |
pañcarātraṃ pibet pītvā śaṅkhapuṣpīśritaṃ payaḥ || 11.147 ||
apa iti | paiṣṭīsurābhāṇḍe taditaramadyabhāṇḍe ‘vasthitā apaḥ surārasagandhavarjitāḥ pītvā śaṅkhapuṣpyākhyauṣadhiprakṣepeṇa pakvaṃ kṣīraṃ na tūdakam | “śaṅkhapuṣpīvipakvena tryahaṃ kṣīreṇa vartayet” (BDh 2.1.22) baudhāyanasmaraṇāt pañcarātraṃ pibet | surāmadyayoḥ sarvatraiva gurulaghuprāyaścittābhidhānād ihāpi jñānājñānādiprakārabhedena viṣayasamīkaraṇaṃ samādheyam | “vācanikam eva prāyaścittaṃ sādhyam” iti medhātithir āha
|| 11.147 ||
spṛṣṭvā datvā ca madirāṃ vidhivat pratigṛhya ca |
śūdrocchiṣṭāś ca pītvāpaḥ kuśavāri pibet tryaham || 11.148 ||
spṛṣṭveti | surāṃ spṛṣṭvā datvā ca svastivācanapūrvakaṃ ca pratigṛhya śūdrocchiṣṭāś ca apaḥ pītvā, ‘pratigṛhya’ ity upādānād brāhmaṇo darbhakvathitam udakaṃ tryahaṃ pibet || 11.148 ||
brāhmaṇas tu surāpasya gandham āghrāya somapaḥ |
prāṇān apsu trir āyamya ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati || 11.149 ||
brāhmaṇas tv ityādi | brāhmaṇaḥ punaḥ kṛtasomayāgaḥ surāpasya mukhasaṃbandhinaṃ gandhaṃ ghrātvā jalamadhe prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddho bhavati
|| 11.149 ||
ajñānāt prāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭam eva ca |
punaḥsaṃskāram arhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ || 11.150 ||
ajñānād iti | viḍvarāhādīnāṃ vakṣyamāṇātvād (11.154) abuddhipūrvakaṃ manuṣyasaṃbandhi mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā prāśya madyasurāsaṃspṛṣṭaṃ ca bhaktādirasaṃ vā prāśya dvijātayas trayo varṇāḥ punar upanayanam arhanti || 11.150 ||
vapanaṃ mekhalā daṇḍo bhaikṣacaryā vratāni ca |
nivartante dvijātīnāṃ punaḥsaṃskārakarmaṇi || 11.151 ||
vapanam iti | śiromuṇḍanaṃ mekhalādhāraṇaṃ daṇḍadhāraṇaṃ bhaikṣāṇi vratāni ca madhumāṃsastrīvarjanayutāni prāyaścittāni punarupanayane dvijātīnāṃ na bhavanti || 11.151 ||
abhojyānāṃ tu bhuktvānnaṃ strīśūdrocchiṣṭam eva ca |
jagdhvā māṃsam abhakṣyaṃ ca saptarātraṃ yavān pibet || 11.152 ||
abhojyānām iti | abhojyānāṃ “nāśrotriyatate yajñe” (4.205) ityādyuktānām annaṃ bhuktvā jalamiśritasakturūpeṇa yavāgūrūpeṇa vā yavān pānayogyān kṛtvā saptarātraṃ pibet | amuṣminn eva viṣaye “matyā bhuktvā caret kṛcchram” (4.222) iti caturthādhyāye prāyaścittam uktaṃ tena saha vaikalpikam | vikalpaś ca kartṛśaktyapekṣaḥ | tathā dvijātistrīṇām ucchiṣṭaṃ śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ vā bhuktvaitad eva kuryāt | tathā “kravyādasūkaroṣṭrāṇām” (11.153) ityādinā yad viśeṣaprāyaścittaṃ tan niṣiddhamāṃsaṃ bhuktvedam eva kuryāt || 11.152 ||
śuktāni ca kaṣāyāṃś ca pītvā medhyāny api dvijaḥ |
tāvad bhavaty aprayato yāvan na vrajaty adhaḥ || 11.153 ||
śuktānīti | yāni svabhāvato madhurādirasāni kālayogenodakapariṇāmādināmlabhāvaṃ vrajanti tāni śuktāni, kaṣāyān vibhītakādīn, kvathitāny apratiṣiddhāny api pītvā yāvan na jīrṇāni bhavanti tāvad aśucuḥ puruṣo bhavati || 11.153 ||
viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ |
prāśya mūtrapurīṣāṇi dvijaś cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || 11.154 ||
viḍvarāheti | grāmyasūkarakharoṣṭraśṛgālavānarakākānāṃ mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā dvijātir bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāc chodanam | yat tu “chatrākaṃ viḍvarāhaṃ ca” (5.19) ity anena viḍvarāhagrāmakukkuṭayor buddhipūrvakbhakṣaṇe taptakṛcchram ity avirodhaḥ || 11.154 ||
śuṣkāṇi bhuktvā māṃsāni bhaumāni kavakāni ca |
ajñātaṃ caiva sūnāstham etad eva vrataṃ caret || 11.155 ||
śukṣkāṇīti | vāyvādinā śoṣitāni māṃsāni bhuktvā bhūmyādiprabhavāṇi chatrākāṇi bhuktvā,
bhūmijaṃ vā vṛkṣajaṃ vā chatrākaṃ bhakṣayati ye |
brahmaghnāṃs tān vijānīyāt |
iti yamena vṛkṣajasyāpi niṣedhāt | hariṇamāṃsaṃ vā rāsabhamāṃsam iti bhakṣyābhakṣyatayā yan na jñātaṃ, tathā hiṃsāsthānaṃ sūnā tato yad ānītaṃ tad bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇam eva kuryāt
|| 11.155 ||
kravyādasūkaroṣṭrāṇāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ ca bhakṣaṇe |
narakākakharāṇāṃ ca taptakṛcchraṃ viśodhanam || 11.156 ||
kravyādeti | āmamāṃsabhakṣiṇāṃ grāmyasūkaroṣṭragrāmyakukkuṭānāṃ tathā mānuṣakākagardabhānāṃ pratyekaṃ buddhipūrvakaṃ māṃsabhakṣaṇe vakṣyamāṇaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ prāyaścittam | grāmyasūkarakukkuṭayor buddhipūrvakabhakṣaṇe pañcamādhyāye pātityam uktaṃ tad abhyāsaviṣaye vyākhyātaṃ, idaṃ tu nābhyāsaviṣaye taptakṛcchram ity avirodhaḥ || 11.156 ||
māsikānnaṃ tu yo ‘śnīyād asamāvartako dvijaḥ |
sa trīṇy ahāny upavased ekāhaṃ codake vaset || 11.157 ||
māsikānnam iti | yo brahmacārī brāhmaṇo māsikaśrāddhasaṃbandhyannam aśnāti etac ca sapiṇḍīkaraṇāt pūrvam ekoddiṣṭaśrāddhārthopalakṣaṇam | sa trirātram upavaset | trirātramadhe ekasminn ahani jalam āvaset || 11.157 ||
brahmacārī tu yo ‘śnīyān madhu māṃsaṃ kathaṃcana |
sa kṛtvā prākṛtaṃ kṛcchraṃ vrataśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 11.158 ||
brahmacārīti | yo brahmacārī mākṣikaṃ māṃsaṃ vā anicchātaḥ, āpadi vādyāt sa prājāpatyaṃ kṛtvā prārabdhabrahmacaryavrataśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 11.158 ||
biḍālakākākhūcchiṣṭaṃ jagdhvā śvanakulasya ca |
keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca pibed brahmasuvarcalām || 11.159 ||
biḍāleti | biḍālakākamūṣikakukkuranakulānām ucchiṣṭaṃ keśakīṭarūpasaṃsargaduṣṭaṃ vākṛtamṛtkṣepaviśuddhikaṃ jñātvā bhuktvā brahmasuvarcalāṃ kvathitam udakaṃ pibet
|| 11.159 ||
abhojyam annaṃ nāttavyam ātmanaḥ śuddhim icchatā |
ajñātabhuktaṃ tūttāryaṃ śodhyaṃ vāpy āśu śodhanaiḥ || 11.160 ||
abhojyam iti | ātmanaḥ śuddhikāmena pratiṣiddham annaṃ nādanīyam | pramādāt tu bhuktaṃ vamitavyam | tadasaṃbhave prāyaścittaiḥ kṣipraṃ śodhanīyam | vamanapakṣe tu laghu prāyaścittaṃ bhavaty eva | jñānataḥ punaḥ pūrvoktaṃ prāyaścittam || 11.161 ||
eṣo ‘nādyādanasyokto vratānāṃ vividho vidhiḥ |
steyadoṣāpahartṝṇāṃ vratānāṃ śrūyatāṃ vidhiḥ || 11.161 ||
eṣa iti | abhakṣyabhakṣaṇe yāni prāyaścittāni teṣām etan nānāprakāravidhānam uktam | steyapāpahāriṇāṃ vidhānam adhunā śrūyatām || 11.161 ||
dhānyānnadhanacauryāṇi kṛtvā kāmād dvijottamaḥ |
svajātīyagṛhād eva kṛcchrābdena viśudhyati || 11.162 ||
dhānyeti | brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇagṛhād dhānyabhaktādyannarūpāṇi dhanacauryāṇīcchātaḥ kṛtvā na tv ātmīyabhrāntyā nītvā saṃvatsaraṃ prāpāpatyavratācaraṇena śudhyati | etac ca deśakāladravyaparimāṇasvāmiguṇādyapekṣayā mahattvādi boddhavyam | evam uttaratrāpi
|| 11.162 ||
manuṣyāṇāṃ tu haraṇe strīṇāṃ kṣetragṛhasya ca |
kūpavāpījalānāṃ ca śuddhiś cāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || 11.163 ||
manuṣyāṇām iti | puruṣastrīkṣetragṛhāṇām anyatamaharaṇe kūpajalasya vāpījalasya vā samastasya vā haraṇe cāndrāyaṇaṃ prāyaścittaṃ manvādibhiḥ smṛtam || 11.163 ||
dravyāṇām alpasārāṇāṃ steyaṃ kṛtvānyaveśmataḥ |
caret sāntapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ tan niryāty ātmaśuddhaye || 11.164 ||
dravyāṇām iti | dravyāṇām alpārghāṇām alpaprayojanānāṃ cānuktaprāyaścittaviśeṣāṇāṃ trapusīsakādīnāṃ paragṛhāc cauryaṃ kṛtvā tad apahṛtaṃ dravyaṃ svāmine datvā sāntapanakṛcchraṃ prāyaścittaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ cātmaśuddhaye kuryāt | svāmine ‘pahṛtaṃ dravyaṃ niryātv iti sarvasteyaprāyaścittaśeṣaḥ || 11.164 ||
bhakṣyabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca |
puṣpamūlaphalānāṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam || 11.165 ||
bhakṣyeti | bhakṣyasya modakādeḥ, bhojyasya pāyasādeḥ, yānasya śakaṭādeḥ, śayyāyāḥ, āsanasya ca, puṣpamūlaphalānāṃ ca pratyekam apaharaṇe pañcagavyapānaṃ viśodhanam
|| 11.165 ||
tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāṃ ca śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca |
celacarmāmiṣāṇāṃ ca trirātraṃ syād abhojanam || 11.166 ||
tṛṇeti | tṛṇakāṣṭhavṛkṣāṇāṃ śuṣkānnasya ca taṇḍulāder vastracarmamāṃsānāṃ madhye ekasyāpy apaharaṇe trirātram upavāsaṃ caret || 11.166 ||
maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca |
ayaḥkāṃsyopalānāṃ ca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇānnatā || 11.167 ||
maṇīti | maṇimuktāvidrumatāmrarūpyalohakāṃsyopalānāṃ ca pratyekaṃ apaharaṇe dvādaśāhaṃ taṇḍulakaṇabhakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt | sarvatra cātra sakṛdabhyāsadeśakāladravyasvāmi-guṇādau śaktyapekṣayotkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭadravyāpahāriviṣayasamīkaraṇaṃ samādheyam || 11.167 ||
kārpāsakīṭajorṇānāṃ dviśaphaikaśaphasya ca |
pakṣigandhauṣadhīnāṃ ca rajjvāś caiva tryahaṃ payaḥ || 11.168 ||
kārpāseti | kārpāsakṛmikośajorṇānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ dviśaphaikaśaphasya goraśvādeḥ, pakṣiṇāṃ śukādīnāṃ gandhānāṃ ca candanaprabhṛtīnāṃ rajjvāś ca pratyekaṃ haraṇe tryahaṃ kṣīrāhāraḥ syāt | atrāpi pūrvavad viṣayasamīkaraṇaparihāraḥ svāminaś cotkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭadravyasamarpaṇād api vacanād ekarūpaprāyaścittāvirodhaḥ || 11.168 ||
etair vratair apoheta pāpaṃ steyakṛtaṃ dvijaḥ |
agamyāgamanīyaṃ tu vratair ebhir apānudet || 11.169 ||
etair iti | etair uktaiḥ prāyaścittaiḥ steyajanitapāpaṃ dvijātir apānudet | agamyāgamananimittaṃ punar ebhir vakṣyamāṇair vratair nirharet || 11.169 ||
gurutalpavrataṃ kuryād retaḥ siktvā svayoniṣu |
sakhyuḥ putrasya ca strīṣu kumārīṣv antyajāsu ca || 11.170 ||
gurutalpavratam iti | svayoniṣu sodaryabhaginīṣu tathā mitrabhāryāsu, putrapatnīṣu kumārīṣu, cāṇḍālīṣu, pratyekaṃ retaḥ siktvā gurudāragamanaprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt | atrāpi jñānābhyāsādyanubandhāpekṣayā maraṇāntikam | ata eva,
retaḥ siktvā kumārīṣu cāṇḍālīṣv anyajāsu ca |
sapiṇḍāpatyadāreṣu prāṇatyāgo vidhīyate ||
iti yamena maraṇāntikam upadiṣṭam ajñānāt tad vratam || 11.170 ||
paitṛṣvaseyīṃ bhaginīṃ svasrīyāṃ mātur eva ca |
matuś ca bhrātus tanayāṃ gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ carét || 11.171 ||
paitṛṣvaseyīm iti | pitṛśvasur mātṛṣvasuś ca duhitaraṃ bhaginīṃ, mātuś ca sodaryabhrātur duhitaraṃ sodaryabhaginīm iva niṣiddhagamanāṃ gatvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāt, sakṛdajñānavyabhicaritāviṣayam alpatvāt || 11.171 ||
etās tisras tu bhāryārthe nopayacchet tu buddhimān |
jñātitvenānupeyās tāḥ patati hy upayann adhaḥ || 11.172 ||
etā iti | tisra etāḥ paitṛṣvaseyyādyā bhāryārthe prājño nodvahet | jñātitvena bāndhavatvena tā nopetavyāḥ | yasmād etā upayann upagacchan narakaṃ yāti | “asapiṇḍā ca yā mātuḥ” (3.5) ity anena niṣedhasiddhau dākṣiṇātyācāradarśanena niṣedhadārḍhyārthaṃ punar vacanam || 11.172 ||
amānuṣīṣu puruṣa udakyāyām ayoniṣu |
retaḥ siktvā jale caiva kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret || 11.173 ||
amānuṣīṣv iti | amānuṣīṣu vaḍavādyāsu na gavi, “goṣv avakīrṇī saṃvatsaraṃ pāyāpatyaṃ caret” iti śaṅkhalikhitādibhir guruprāyaścittābhidhānāt | tathā rajasvalāyāṃ, yonitaś cānyatra striyāṃ, jale retaḥsekaṃ kṛtvā puruṣaḥ sāntapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ kuryāt || 11.173 ||
maithunaṃ tu samāsevya puṃsi yoṣiti vā dvijaḥ |
goyāne ‘psu divā caiva savāsāḥ snānam ācaret || 11.174 ||
maithuman iti | yatra deśe kvāpi puruṣe maithunaṃ sevitvā striyāṃ goyāne śakaṭādau jale divākāle ca maithunaṃ sevitvā savastraś ca snāyāt || 11.174 ||
caṇḍālāntyastriyo gatvā bhuktvā ca pratigṛhya ca |
pataty ajñānato vipro jñānāt sāmyaṃ tu gacchati || 11.175 ||
caṇḍāleti | caṇḍālasyāntyajānāṃ ca mlecchaśarīrādīnām ajñānato brāḥmaṇaḥ striyo gatvā teṣāṃ cānnaṃ bhuktvā tebhyaḥ pratigṛhya patati | patitasya prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt | etac ca gurutvāc cābhyāsato bhojanapratigrahaviṣayam | jñānāt tu teṣāṃ strīgamanaṃ kṛtvā samānatāṃ gacchati | etac ca prāyaścittagauravārtham || 11.175 ||
vipraduṣṭāṃ striyaṃ bhartā nirundhyād ekaveśmani |
yat puṃsaḥ paradāreṣu tac caināṃ cārayed vratam || 11.176 ||
vipraduṣṭām iti | viśeṣeṇa praduṣṭām | icchayā vyabhicāriṇīm ity arthaḥ | bhartā nirundhyāt patnīṃ karyebhyo nivartya nigaḍabaddhām ivaikagṛhe dhārayet | yac ca puruṣasya sajātīyaparadāragamane prāyaścittaṃ tad evaināṃ kārayet | tataś ca “strīṇām ardhaṃ pradātavyam” iti yad vasiṣṭhādibhir uktaṃ tad anicchayā vyabhicāre ca kartavyam || 11.176 ||
sā cet punaḥ praduṣyet tu sadṛśenopayantritā |
kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caiva tad asyāḥ pāvanaṃ smṛtam || 11.177 ||
sā ced iti | sā strī sajātīyagamane sakṛd duṣṭā kṛtaprāyaścittā yadi punaḥ sajātīyenābhyarthitā satī tadgamanaṃ kuryāt tad asyāḥ prāyaścittaṃ prājāpatyaṃ kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ ca manvādibhiḥ smṛtam || 11.177 ||
yat karoty ekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanād dvijaḥ |
tad bhaikṣabhug japan nityaṃ tribhir varṣair vyapohati || 11.178 ||
yad iti | vṛṣaly atra caṇḍālī, prāyaścittagauravāt | caṇḍālīgamane yad ekarātreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ pāpam arjayati tad bhaikṣāśī nityaṃ sāvitryādikaṃ japan tribhir varṣair apanudati | tathā cāpastambaḥ: [ĀpDh 1.27.11)
yad ekarātreṇa karoti pāpaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ varṇaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ sevamānaḥ |
caturthakāla udaka ātmajāpī bhaikṣacārī tribhir varṣair tad vyapohati pāpam ||
medhātithis tu ittham eva vyākhyātavān | govindarājas tv akramapariṇītaśūdrāgamana-prāyaścittam idam āha || 11.178 ||
eṣā pāpakṛtām uktā caturṇām api niṣkṛtiḥ |
patitaiḥ saṃprayuktānām imāḥ śṛṇuta niṣkṛtīḥ || 11.179 ||
eṣeti | iyaṃ hiṃsābhakṣyabhakṣaṇasteyāgamyāgamanakāriṇāṃ caturṇām api pāpakṛtāṃ viśuddhir uktā | idānīṃ sākṣāt pāpakṛdbhiḥ saha saṃsargiṇām imā vakṣyamāṇāḥ saṃśuddhīḥ śṛṇuta || 11.179 ||
saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahācaran |
yājanādhyāpanād yaunān na tu yānāsanāśanāt || 11.180 ||
saṃvatsareṇeti | patitena saha saṃsargam ācaran ekayānagamanaikāsanopaveśana-paṅktibhojanarūpān saṃsargān ācaran saṃvatsareṇa patati | na tu yājanādhyāpanāḍ yaunāt saṃvatsareṇa patati kiṃ tu sadya evety arthaḥ | adhyāpanam atropanayanapūrvakaṃ sāvitrīśrāvaṇam | yājanādīnāṃ ca sadyaḥpātityam āha devalaḥ (34):
yājanaṃ yonisaṃbandhaṃ svādhyāyaṃ sahabhojanam |
kṛtvā sadyaḥ patanty ete patitena na saṃśayaḥ ||
viṣṇuḥ:
ā saṃvatsarāt patati patitena sahācaran |
sahayānāsanābhyāsād yaunāt tu sadya eva hi ||
baudhāyanaḥ:
saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahācaran |
yājanādhyāpanād yaunāt sadyo na śayanāsanāt || iti |
govindarājas tu yājanādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ saṃvatsareṇa pātityahetutvaṃ sahāsanādīnāṃ laghutvān na saṃvatsareṇa kiṃ tu tasmād ūrdhvam apīti vyācaṣṭe |
asmadīyamanuvyākhyā munivyākhyānusāriṇī |
naināṃ govindarājasya kalpanām anurundhmahe ||
|| 11.180 ||
yo yena patitenaiṣāṃ saṃsargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ |
sa tasyaiva vrataṃ kuryāt tatsaṃsargaviśuddhaye || 11.181 ||
yo yeneti | patitaśabdo ‘yaṃ pāpakārivacanaḥ, sakalapāpinām aviśeṣapāṭhāt | eṣāṃ patitānāṃ madhye yo yena pāpakāriṇā saha pūrvoktaṃ saṃsargaṃ karoti sa tasyaiva vratarūpaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kuryān na tu maraṇāntikam ity abhihitaṃ tad api vrataṃ saṃsargiṇā kriyamāṇaṃ “brahmahā dvādaśa samāḥ” (11.172) ityādikaṃ pāpahīnaṃ kartavyam | tathā ca vyāsaḥ:
yo yena saṃsṛjed varṣaṃ so ‘pi tatsamatām iyāt |
pādanyūnaṃ caret so ‘pi tasya tasya vrataṃ dvijaḥ ||
|| 11.181 ||
patitasyodakaṃ kāryaṃ sapiṇḍair bāndhavair bahiḥ |
nindite ‘hani sāyāhne jñātyṛtviggurusaṃnidhau || 11.182 ||
patitasyeti | mahāpātakino jīvata eva pretasyodakakriyā vakṣyamāṇarītyā sapiṇḍaiḥ samānodakaiś ca grāmād bahir gatvā jñātyṛtviggurusaṃnidhāne riktāyāṃ navamyāṃ tithau dinānte kartavyā || 11.182 ||
dāsī ghaṭam apāṃ pūrṇaṃ paryasyet pretavat padā |
ahorātram upāsīrann aśaucaṃ bāndhavaiḥ saha || 11.183 ||
dāsīti | sapiṇḍasamānodakaprayuktā dāsī udakapūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ pretavad iti dakṣiṇābhimukhībhūya pādena kṣipet yathā sa nirudako bhavati | tad anu te sapiṇḍāḥ samānodakaiḥ sahāhorātram aśaucam ācareyuḥ || 11.183 ||
nivarteraṃś ca tasmāt tu saṃbhāṣaṇasahāsane |
dāyādyasya pradānaṃ ca yātrā caiva hi laukikī || 11.184 ||
nivarterann iti | tasmāt patitāt sapiṇḍādīnāṃ saṃbhāṣaṇam ekāsanopaveśanaṃ ca tasmai ṛkthapradānaṃ sāṃvatsarikādau nimantraṇādirūpo lokavyavahāra etāni nivarteran || 11.184 ||
jyeṣṭhatā ca nivarteta jyeṣṭhāvāpyaṃ ca yad dhanam |
jyeṣṭhāṃśaṃ prāpnuyāc cāsya yavīvān guṇato ‘dhikaḥ || 11.185 ||
jyeṣṭhateti | jyeṣṭhasya yat pratyutthānādikaṃ kāryaṃ tat tasya na kāryam | jyeṣṭhalabhyaṃ ca tasya viṃśatyuddhārādikaṃ dhanaṃ na deyam | yady api ṛkthapradānapratiṣedhād evāpy uddhārapratiṣedhaḥ siddhas tathāpi yavīyasas tatprāptyartham anūdyate | tasyaiva jyeṣṭhasya saṃbandhi dhanaṃ soddhārāṃśaṃ tad anujo guṇādhiko labhate || 11.185 ||
prāyaścitte tu carite pūrṇakumbham apāṃ navam |
tenaiva sārdhaṃ prāsyeyuḥ snātvā puṇye jalāśaye || 11.186 ||
prāyaścitta iti | kṛte punaḥ patitena prāyaścitte sapiṇḍasamānodakās tenaiva kṛtaprāyaścittena saha pavitre jalādhāre snātvā jalapūrṇaṃ navaṃ ghaṭaṃ prakṣipeyuḥ | iha navaghaṭagrahaṇāt “dāsī ghaṭam” (11.183) ity atra kṛtopayogighaṭaḥ pratīyate || 11.186 ||
sa tv apsu taṃ ghaṭaṃ prāsya praviśya bhavanaṃ svakam |
sarvāṇi jñātikāryāṇi yathāpūrvaṃ samācaret || 11.187 ||
sa tv iti | sa kṛtaprāyaścittaḥ taṃ pūrvoktaghaṭaṃ jalamadhye kṣiptvā tataḥ svakīyabhavanaṃ praviśya yathāpūrvaṃ sarvāṇi jñātikarmāṇi kuryāt || 11.187 ||
evam eva vidhiṃ kuryād yoṣitsu patitāsv api |
vastrānnapānaṃ deyaṃ tu vaseyuś ca gṛhāntike || 11.188 ||
evam iti | strīṣv api patitāsv evam eva “patitasyodakaṃ kāryam” (11.182) ityādividhiṃ bhartrādisapiṇḍasamānodavargaḥ kuryāt | grāsācchādanāni punar ābhyo deyāni | gṛhasamīpe cāsāṃ vāsārthaṃ kuṭīr dadyuḥ || 11.188 ||
enasvibhir anirṇiktair kiṃcit sahācaret |
kṛtanirṇejanāṃś caiva na jugupseta karhicit || 11.189 ||
enasvibhir iti | pāpakāribhir akṛtaprāyaścittaiḥ saha dānapratigrahādikam arthaṃ kiṃcin nānutiṣṭhet | kṛtaprāyaścittān naiva kadācid api pūrvakṛtapāpatvena nindet kiṃ tu pūrvavad vyavaharet || 11.189 ||
asyāpavādam āha –
bālaghnāṃś ca kṛtaghnāṃś ca viśuddhān api dharmataḥ |
śaraṇāgatahantṝṃś ca strīhantṝṃś ca na saṃvaset || 11.190 ||
bālaghnān iti | bālaṃ yo hatavān, kṛtopakāram apakārācaraṇena yo vināśitavān, prāṇarakṣārtham āgataṃ yo hatavān, striyaṃ ca yo vyāpāditavān, etān yathāvat kṛtaprāyaścittān api saṃsargitayā na parivaset || 11.190 ||
yeṣāṃ dvijānāṃ sāvitrī nānūcyeta yathāvidhi |
tāṃś cārayitvā trīn kṛcchrān yathāvidhy upanāyayet || 11.191 ||
yeṣām iti | yeṣāṃ brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ ānukalpikakāla upanayanaṃ yathāśāstraṃ na kṛtavān tān prājāpatyatrayaṃ kārayitvā yathāśāstram upanayet | yat tu yājñavalkyādibhir vrātyastomādiprāyaścittam uktaṃ tena sahāsya gurulāghavam anusaṃdhāya jātiśaktyādyapekṣo vikalpo mantavyaḥ || 11.191 ||
prāyaścittaṃ cikīrṣanti vikarmasthās tu ye dvijāḥ |
brahmaṇā ca parityaktās teṣām apy etad ādiśet || 11.192 ||
prāyaścittam iti | ye pratiṣiddhaśūdrasevino dvijās te copanītā apy anadhītavedāḥ prāyaścittaṃ kartum icchanti teṣām apy etat prājāpatyāditrayam upadiśet || 11.192 ||
yad garhitenārjayanti karmaṇā brāhmaṇā dhanam |
tasyotsargeṇa śudhyanti japyena tapasaiva ca || 11.193 ||
yad iti | garhitena karmaṇā niṣiddhaduṣpratigrahādinā brāhmaṇā yad dhanam arjayanti tasya dhanasya tyāgena japatapobhyāṃ vakṣyamāṇābhyāṃ śudhyanti | dhanatyāgena ca prāyaścittavidhānād bahumūlye ca karituragādāv alpamūlye ca lohādau parigṛhīte tulyaprāyaścittābhidhānam upapannam | evam avikrayyāvikryādāv api || 11.193 ||
japitvā trīṇi sāvitryāḥ sahasrāṇi samāhitaḥ |
māsaṃ goṣṭhe payaḥ pītvā mucyante ‘satpratigrahāt || 11.194 ||
japitveti | trīṇi sāvitrīsahasrāṇi japitvā goṣṭhe vā māsaṃ kṣīrāhāro ‘satpratigrahajanitāt pāpān mukto bhavati | śūdrapratigrahādāv apy etad eva prāyaścittam | dravyadoṣeṇa ca dātṛdoṣeṇāpi pratigrahasya garhitatvāviśeṣād iti || 11.194 ||
upavāsakṛśaṃ taṃ tu govrajāt punar āgatam |
praṇataṃ paripṛccheyuḥ sāmyaṃ saumyecchasīti kim || 11.195 ||
upavāseti | kevalakṣīrāhāreṇa itarabhojanavyāvṛttyā kṛśadehaṃ goṣṭhāt pratyāgataṃ praṇataṃ namrībhūtaṃ ‘kim asmābhiḥ saha sāmyam icchasi, punar asatpratigrahaṃ na kariṣyasi’ ity evaṃ dharmaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ paripṛccheyuḥ || 11.195 ||
satyam uktvā tu vipreṣu vikired yavasaṃ gavām |
gobhiḥ pravartite tīrthe kuryus tasya parigraham || 11.196 ||
satyam iti | ‘satyam etat punar asatpratigrahaṃ na kariṣyāmi’ ity evaṃ brāhmaṇeṣūktvā ghāsaṃ gavāṃ dadyāt | tasmin yavasaṃ bhakṣyamāne deśe gobhiḥ pavitrīkṛtatvāt tīrthībhūte brāhmaṇās tasya saṃvyavahāre svīkāraṃ kuryuḥ || 11.196 ||
vrātyānāṃ yājanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣām antyakarma ca |
abhicāram ahīnaṃ ca tribhiḥ kṛcchrair vyapohati || 11.197 ||
vrātyānām iti | vrātyānāṃ “ata ūrdhvaṃ trayo ‘py ete” (2.39) ity uktānāṃ vrātyastomādiyājanaṃ kṛtvā pitṛgurvādivyatiriktānāṃ ca niṣiddhaurdhvadehikadāhaśrādddhāni kṛtvābhicāraṃ ca śyenādikam | abhicāro ‘nabhicāraṇīyasya | ahīnaṃ yāgaviśeṣaḥ, “ahīnayajanam aśucikaram” iti śruteḥ | trirātrādi tasya yajanaṃ kṛtvā tribhiḥ kṛcchrair viśudhyati || 11.197 ||
śaraṇāgataṃ parityajya vedaṃ viplāvya ca dvijaḥ |
saṃvatsaraṃ yavāhāras tat pāpam apasedhati || 11.198 ||
śaraṇāgatam iti | śaraṇāgataṃ paritrāṇārthm upagataṃ śaktaḥ sann upekṣate dvijātir anadhyāpyaṃ ca vedam adhyāpya tajjanitaṃ pāpaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yavāhāro ‘panudati
|| 11.198 ||
śvasṛgālakharair daṣṭo grāmyaiḥ kravyādibhir eva ca |
narāśvoṣṭravarāhaiś ca prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || 11.199 ||
[śunāghrātopalīḍhasya dantair vidalitasya ca |
adbhiḥ prakṣālanaṃ proktam agninā copacūlanam || ]
śvasṛgāleti | kukkurasṛgālagardabhanarāśvavarāhādyair grāmyaiś cāmamāṃsādair mārjārādibhir daṣṭaḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || 11.199 ||
ṣaṣṭhānnakālatā māsaṃ saṃhitājapa eva vā |
homāś ca śākalā nityam apāṅktyānāṃ viśodhanam || 11.200 ||
ṣaṣṭhānneti | apāṅktyāḥ “ye stenapatitaklībāḥ” (3.150) ityādinokās teṣāṃ viśeṣato ‘nupadiṣṭaprāyaścittānāṃ māsaṃ tryaham abhuktvā tṛtīye ‘hni sāyaṃ bhojanaṃ vedasaṃhitājapo “devakṛtasyainaso ’vayajanam asi” (VS 8.13) ityādibhir mantrair homaḥ pratyekaṃ kāryaḥ | etat samuddiṣṭaṃ dānaśodhanam || 11.200 ||
uṣṭrayānaṃ samāruhya kharayānaṃ tu kāmataḥ |
snātvā tu vipro digvāsāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || 11.201 ||
uṣṭrayānam iti | uṣṭrair yuktaṃ yānaṃ śakaṭādi, evaṃ kharayānam api | tat kāmata āruhya avyavadhāna uṣṭrakharābhyāṃ yāne prāṇāyāmabahutvam, nagnaś ca kāmataḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmena śuddho bhavati || 11.201 ||
vinādbhir apsu vāpy ārtaḥ śārīraṃ saṃniveśya ca |
sacailo bahir aplutya gām ālabhya viśudhyati || 11.202 ||
vineti | asaṃnihitajalo jalamadhye vā vegārto mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā kṛtvā savāsā bahir grāmān nadyādau snātvā gāṃ ca spṛṣṭvā viśuddho bhavati || 11.202 ||
vedoditānāṃ niyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ samatikrame |
snātakavratalope ca prāyaścittam abhojanam || 11.203 ||
vedeti | vedavihitānāṃ karmaṇām agnihotrādīnām anupadiṣṭaprāyaścittaviśeṣāṇāṃ ca parilope snātakavratānāṃ caturthādhyāyoktānām atikrame saty ekāhopavāsaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt
|| 11.203 ||
huṃkāraṃ brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṃkāraṃ ca garīyasaḥ |
snātvānaśnann ahaḥśeṣam abhivādya prasādayet || 11.204 ||
huṃkāram iti | “huṃ tūṣṇīṃ sthīyatām” ity ākṣepaṃ brāhmaṇasya kṛtvā tvaṃkāraṃ ca vidyādyadhikasyoktvābhivādanakālād ārabhyāhaḥśeṣaṃ yāvat snātvā bhojananivṛttaḥ pādopagrahaṇenāpagatakopaṃ kuryāt || 11.204 ||
tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi kaṇṭhe vābadhya vāsasā |
vivāde vā vinirjitya praṇipatya prasādayet || 11.205 ||
tāḍayitveti | prākṛtaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tṛṇenāpi tāḍayitvā kaṇṭhe vābadhya vāsasā vā vākkalahena jitvā praṇipātena prasādayet || 11.205 ||
avagūrya tv abdaśataṃ sahasram abhihatya ca |
jighāṃsayā brāhmaṇasya narakaṃ pratipadyate || 11.206 ||
avaguryeti | brāhmaṇasya hananecchayā daṇḍam udyamya varśaśataṃ narakaṃ prāpnoti | daṇḍādinā punaḥ prahṛtya varṣasahasraṃ narakaṃ prāpnoti || 11.205 ||
śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃsūn saṃgṛhṇāti mahītale |
tāvanty abdasahasrāṇi tatkartā narake vaset || 11.207 ||
śoṇitam iti | prahatya brāhmaṇasya rudhiraṃ yāvatsaṃkhyākān rajaḥkaṇān bhūmau piṇḍīkaroti tāvatsaṃkhyāni varṣasahasrāṇi tacchoṇitotpādako narake vaset || 11.207 ||
avagūrya caret kṛcchram atikṛcchraṃ nipātane |
kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kurvīta viprasyotpādya śoṇitam || 11.208 ||
aveti | brāhmaṇasya hananecchayā daṇḍādyudyamane kṛcchraṃ kuryāt | daṇḍādiprahāre datte ‘tikṛcchraṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ caret | rudhiram utpādya kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kurvīta || 11.208 ||
anuktaniṣkṛtīnāṃ tu pāpānām apanuttaye |
śaktiṃ cāvekṣya pāpaṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ prakalpayet || 11.209 ||
anukteti | anuktaprāyaścittānāṃ yathā pratilomavadhādikṛtānāṃ nirharaṇārthaṃ kartuḥ śarīradhanāni sāmarthyam avekṣya pāpaṃ ca jñātvā jñānājñānasakṛdāvṛttyanubandhādirūpeṇa prāyaścittaṃ prakalpayet || 11.209 ||
yair abhyupāyair enāṃsi mānavo vyapakarṣati |
tān vo ‘bhyupāyān vakṣyāmi devarṣipitṛsevitān || 11.210 ||
yair iti | yair hetubhir manuṣyaḥ pāpāny apanudati tān pāpanāśahetūn devarṣipitṛbhir anutiṣṭhitān yuṣmākaṃ vakṣyāmi || 11.210 ||
tryahaṃ prātas tryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryaham adyād ayācitam |
tryahaṃ paraṃ ca nāśnīyāt prājāpatyaṃ caran dvijaḥ || 11.211 ||
tryaham iti | prājāpatyākhyaṃ kṛcchram ācaran dvijātir ādyaṃ dinatrayaṃ prātar bhuñjīta | prātaḥśabdo ‘yaṃ bhojanānām aucityaprāptadivākālaparaḥ | ata eva vasiṣṭhaḥ: “tryahaṃ divā bhuṅkte naktam atti ca tryahaṃ tryaham | ayacitavrataṃ tryahaṃ na bhuṅkte” iti ca kṛcchraḥ | āpastambo ‘py āha: “tryahaṃ naktāśī divāśī ca tatas tryaham | tryaham ayācitavras tryahaṃ nāśnāti kiṃcana” iti kṛcchradvādaśarātrasya vidhiḥ | aparaṃ ca dinatrayaṃ sāyaṃsaṃdhyāyām atītāyāṃ bhuñjīta | anyadinatrayam ayācitaṃ tāvad annaṃ bhuñjīta | śeṣaṃ ca dinatrayaṃ na kiṃcid aśnīyāt | atra grāsasaṃkhyāparimāṇāpekṣāyāṃ parāśaraḥ:
sāyaṃ dvātriṃśatir grāsāḥ prātaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatis tathā |
ayācite caturviṃśat paraṃ cānaśanaṃ smṛtam ||
kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇaṃ ca yāvāṃś ca praviśen mukham |
evaṃ grāsaṃ vijānīyāc chuddhyarthaṃ prāsaśodhanam ||
haviṣyaṃ cānnam aśnīyād yathā rātrau tathā divā |
trīṃs trīṇy ahāni śāstrīyān grāsān saṃkhyākṛtān yathā ||
ayācitaṃ tathaivādyād upavāsas tryahaṃ bhavet ||
|| 11.211 ||
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam |
ekarātropavāsaś ca kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ smṛtam || 11.212 ||
gomūtram iti | gomūtrādy ekīkṛtya ekaikasminn ahani bhakṣayen nānyat kiṃcid adyāt | aparadine copavāsa ity etat sāntapanaṃkṛcchraṃ smṛtam | yadā tu gomūtrādiṣaṭ pratyekaṃ ṣaṭ dināny upabhujya saptame dine copavāsas tadā mahāsāntapanaṃ bhavati | tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ:
kuśodakaṃ ca gokṣīraṃ dadhi mūtraṃ śakṛd ghṛtam |
jagdhvā pare ‘hny upavaset kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caran ||
pṛthak sāntapanadravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsikaḥ |
saptāhena tu kṛcchro ‘yaṃ mahāsāntapanaṃ smṛtam || iti | [YDh 3.314]
ekaikaṃ grāsam aśnīyāt tryahāṇi trīṇi pūrvavat |
tryahaṃ copavased antyam atikṛcchraṃ caran dvijaḥ || 11.213 ||
ekaikam iti | atikṛcchraṃ dvijātir anutiṣṭhan prātaḥ sāyam ayācitādirūpeṇaikaikaṃ grāsaṃ tryahāṇi trīṇi trīṇi pūrvavat | anyac ca tryahaṃ na kiṃcid bhuñjīta || 11.213 ||
taptakṛcchraṃ caran vipro jalakṣīraghṛtānilān |
pratitryahaṃ pibed uṣṇān sakṛt snāyī samāhitaḥ || 11.214 ||
tapteti | taptakṛcchraṃ caran dvijātiḥ tryaham uṣṇodakaṃ, tryaham uṣṇakṣīraṃ, tryaham uṣṇaghṛtaṃ, tryaham uṣṇavāyuṃ, ekavāraṃ snānaṃ kurvan saṃyamavān pibet | atra parāśarokto viśeṣaḥ:
ṣaṭpalaṃ tu pibed ambhas tripalaṃ tu payaḥ pibet |
palam ekaṃ pibet sarpis taptakṛcchraṃ vidhīyate ||
|| 11.214 ||
yatātmano ‘pramattasya dvādaśāham abhojanam |
parāko nāma kṛcchro ‘yaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ || 11.215 ||
yatātmana iti | vigatānavadhānasya saṃyatendriyasya dvādaśāham abhojanam eva parākākhyaḥ kṛcchraḥ sakṛd āvṛttitāratamyena gurulaghusamaphalapāpāpanodanaḥ
|| 11.215 ||
ekaikaṃ hrāsayet piṇḍaṃ kṛṣṇe śukle ca vardhayet |
upaspṛśaṃs triṣavaṇam etac cāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || 11.216 ||
ekaikam iti | sāyaṃprātarmadhyāhneṣu snānaṃ kurvāṇaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ pañcadaśa grāsān aśitvā tataḥ kṛṣṇapratipatkrameṇaikaikaṃ grāsaṃ hrāsayet tathā caturdaśyām eko grāsaḥ saṃpadyate | tato ‘māvāsyāyām upoṣya śuklapratipatprabhṛtibhir ekaikaṃ grāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ nayet | evaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ pañcadaśa grāsāḥ saṃpadyante | etat pipīlikāmadhyākhyaṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || 11.216 ||
etam eva vidhiṃ kṛtsnam ācared yavamadhyame |
śuklapakṣādiniyataś caraṃś cāndrāyaṇaṃ vratam || 11.217 ||
etam iti | etam eva piṇḍahrāsavṛddhitriṣavaṇasnānātmakaṃ vidhānaṃ yavamadhyākhye cāndrāyaṇe śuklapakṣam āditaḥ kṛtvā saṃyatendriyaś cāndrāyaṇam anutiṣṭhann ācaret | tataś ca śuklapratipadam ārabhya ekaikaṃ piṇḍaṃ vardhayet | tathā paurṇamāsyāṃ pañcadaśa grāsāḥ saṃpadyante | tataḥ kṛṣṇapratipadam ārabhya ekaikaṃ piṇḍaṃ hrāsayet | yathāmāvāsyāyām upavāso bhavati || 11.217 ||
aṣṭāv aṣṭau samaśnīyāt piṇḍān madhaṃdine sthite |
niyatātmā haviṣyāśī yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ caran || 11.218 ||
aṣṭāv iti | yaticāndrāyaṇam anutiṣṭhan śuklapakṣāt kṛṣṇapakṣād vārabhya masam ekaṃ saṃyatendriyaḥ pratyaham aṣṭāv aṣṭau grāsān madhyaṃdine bhuñjīta | ‘madhyaṃdine’ iti gṛhasthabrahmacāriṇoḥ sāyaṃbhojananivṛttyartham || 11.218 ||
caturaḥ prātar aśnīyāt piṇḍān vipraḥ samāhitaḥ |
caturo ‘stamite sūrye śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || 11.219 ||
catura iti | prātaś caturo grāsān aśnīyāt | astamite ca sūrye caturo grāsān bhuñjīta | etac chiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ munibhiḥ smṛtam || 11.219 ||
yathākathaṃcit piṇḍānāṃ tisro ‘śītīḥ samāhitaḥ |
māsenāśnan haviṣyasya candrayaiti salokatām || 11.220 ||
yatheti | nīvārādihaviṣyasaṃbandhināṃ grāsānāṃ dve śate catvāriṃśad adhike kadācid daśa kadācit pañca kacācit ṣoḍaśa kadācid upavāsa ity evamādy aniyamena yathākathaṃcit piṇḍān māsena saṃyatavān bhuñjānaś candrasalokatāṃ yāti | evaṃ pāpakṣayārtham abhyudayārthaṃ cedam uktam | ata eva yājñavalkyaḥ |
dharmārthaṃ yaś cared etac candrasyaiti salokatām |
kṛcchrakṛc charmakāmas [-kṛd dharma-] tu mahatīṃ śriyam āpnuyāt ||
[ YDh 3.326 ]
ataḥ prājāpatyādikṛcchram apy abhyudayaphalam iti yājñavalkyenoktam || 11.220 ||
etad rudrās tathādityā vasavaś cācaran vratam |
sarvākuśalamokṣāya marutaś ca maharṣibhiḥ || 11.221 ||
etad iti | etac cāndrāyaṇākhyaṃ vrataṃ rudrādityavasumarutaś ca maharṣibhiḥ saha sarvapāpanāśāya gurulaghupāpāpekṣayā sakṛdāvṛttiprakāreṇa kṛtavantaḥ || 11.221 ||
mahāvyāhṛtibhir homaḥ kartavyaḥ svayam anvaham |
ahiṃsā satyam akrodham ārjavaṃ ca samācaret || 11.222 ||
mahāvyāhṛtibhir iti | mahāvyāhṛtibhir bhūr bhuvaḥ svar etābhiḥ | “ājyaṃ havir anādeśe juhotiṣu vidhīyate” iti pariśiṣṭavacanād ājyena pratyahaṃ homaṃ kuryāt | ahiṃsāsatyākrodhākauṭilyāni cānutiṣṭhet | yady apy etāni puruṣārthatayā vihitāni tathāpi vratāṅgatayāyam upadeśaḥ || 11.222 ||
trir ahas trir niśāyāṃ ca savāsā jalam āviśet |
strīśūdrapatitāṃś caiva nābhibhāṣeta karhicit || 11.223 ||
trir iti | ahani rātrāv ādimadhyāvasāneṣu snānārthaṃ sacailo nadyādijalaṃ praviśet | etac ca pipīlikāmadhyayavamadhyacāndrāyaṇetaracāndrāyaṇaviṣayam | tayoḥ “upasparśas triṣavaṇam” (6.24) ity uktatvāt | strīśūdrapatitaiś ca saha yāvad vrataṃ kadācit saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ na kuryāt
|| 11.223 ||
sthānāsanābhyāṃ vihared aśakto ‘dhaḥ śayīta vā |
brahmacārī vratī ca syād gurudevadvijārcakaḥ || 11.224 ||
sthāneti | ahani rātrau ca utthita āsīnaḥ syān na tu śayīta | asāmarthye tu sthaṇḍile śayīta na khaṭvādau | brahmacārī strīsaṃyogarahitavrataḥ | vratī mauñjīdaṇḍādiyuktaḥ,
pālāśaṃ dhārayed daṇḍaṃ śucir mauñjī ca mekhalām |
iti yamasmaraṇāt | gurudevabrāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjako bhavet || 11.224 ||
sāvitrīṃ ca japen nityaṃ pavitrāṇi ca śaktitaḥ |
sarveṣv eva vrateṣv evaṃ prāyaścittārtham ādṛtaḥ || 11.225 ||
sāvitrīm iti | sāvitrīṃ ca sadā japet | pavitrāṇi cāghamarṣaṇādīni yathāśakti japet | etac ca yathā cāndrāyaṇe tathā prājāpatyādikṛcchreṣv api yatnavān prāyaścittārtham anutiṣṭhet
|| 11.225 ||
etair dvijātayaḥ śodhyā vratair āviṣkṛtainasaḥ |
anāviṣkṛtapāpāṃs tu mantrair homaiś ca śodhayet || 11.226 ||
etair iti | lokaviditapāpā dvijātayaḥ ebhir uktaprāyaścittair vakṣyamāṇapariṣadā śodhanīyāḥ | aprakāśitapāpāṃs tu mānavān mantrair homaiś ca pariṣad eva śodhayet | yady api pariṣadi nivedane rahasyatvasya nāśas tathāpy amukapāpe kṛte kenāpi lokāvidite kiṃ prāyaścittaṃ syād iti sāmānyapraśne na virodhaḥ || 11.226 ||
khyāpanenānutāpena tapasādhyayanena ca |
pāpakṛn mucyate pāpāt tathā dānena cāpadi || 11.227 ||
khyāpaneneti | pāpakārī naro lokeṣu nijapāpakathanena ‘dhiṅ mām atipāpakāriṇam’ iti paścāttāpena śudhyati | tapasā cograrūpeṇa sāvitrījapādinā ca pāpān mucyate | tapasy aśakto dānena ca pāpān mukto bhavati | khyāpanaṃ cedaṃ prakāśaprāyaścittāṅgabhūtaṃ na rahasyaprāyaścittāṅgaṃ rahasyatvahāniprasaṅgāt | anutāpaś ca prakāśarahasyāṅgam eva | dāneneti prājāpatyavrata ekadhenuvidhānāt | dhenuś ca pañcapurāṇīyā tripurāṇīyā veti | etena brahmahatyānimittake dvādaśavārṣikavrate māsi sārdhadvayaprājāpatyāt vatsare triṃśad dhenavo bhavanti | dvādaśabhir varṣaiḥ ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatrayaṃ dhenavo bhavantīti || 11.227 ||
yathā yathā naro ‘dharmaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvānubhāṣate |
tathā tathā tvacevāhis tenādharmeṇa mucyate || 11.228 ||
yatheti | yathā yathā svayaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtvā naro bhāṣate loke khyāpayati tathā tathā tena pāpena sarpa iva jīrṇatvacā mucyata iti khyāpanavidher anuvādaḥ || 11.228 ||
yathā yathā manas tasya duṣkṛtaṃ karma garhati |
tathā tathā śarīraṃ tat tenādharmeṇa mucyate || 11.229 ||
yatheti | tasya pāpakāriṇo mano yathā yathā duṣkṛtaṃ karma nindati tathā tathā śarīraṃ jīvātmā tenādharmeṇa mukto bhavati | ayam anutāpānuvāda iti || 11.229 ||
kṛtvā pāpaṃ hi saṃtapya tasmāt pāpāt pramucyate |
naivaṃ kuryāṃ punar iti nivṛttyā pūyate tu saḥ || 11.230 ||
kṛtveti | pāpaṃ kṛtvā paścāt saṃtapya tasmāt pāpān mucyata ity uktam api ‘naivaṃ kuryāṃ punaḥ’ ity evam anūditam | yadā tu paścāttāpo ‘naivaṃ punaḥ kariṣyāmi’ ity evaṃ nivṛttirūpasaṃkalpaphalakaḥ syāt tadā sutarāṃ tasmāt pāpāt pūto bhavatīti | etac ca nivṛttisamkalpasya prakāśāprakāśaprāyaścittāṅgavidhānārtham || 11.230 ||
evaṃ saṃcintya manasā pretya karmaphalodayam |
manovāṅmūrtibhir nityaṃ śubhaṃ karma samācaret || 11.231 ||
evam iti | evaṃ śubhāśubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ paraloka iṣṭāniṣṭaphalaṃ manasā vicārya manovākkāyaiḥ śubham eva sarvaṃ karma kuryāt, iṣṭaphalatvāt | nāśubhaṃ, narakādiduḥkhahetutvāt || 11.231 ||
ajñānād yadi vā jñānāt kṛtvā karma vigarhitam |
tasmād vimuktim anvicchan dvitīyaṃ na samācaret || 11.232 ||
ajñānād iti | pramādād icchāto vā niṣiddhaṃ karma kṛtvā tasmāt pāpān muktim icchan punas tan na kuryāt | etac ca punaḥ karaṇe prāyaścittagauravārtham | ata eva devalaḥ:
vidheḥ prāthamikād asmād dvitīye dviguṇaṃ bhavet | iti ||
|| 11.232 ||
yasmin karmaṇy asya kṛte manasaḥ syād alāghavam |
tasmiṃs tāvat tapaḥ kuryād yāvat tuṣṭikaraṃ bhavet || 11.233 ||
yasminn iti | asya pāpakāriṇo yasmin prāyaścittākhye karmaṇy anuṣṭhite na cittasya saṃtoṣaḥ syāt tasmiṃs tad eva prāyaścittaṃ tāvad āvartayed yāvan manasaḥ saṃtoṣaḥ prasādaḥ syāt
|| 11.233 ||
tapomūlam idaṃ sarvaṃ daivamānuṣakaṃ sukham |
tapomadhyaṃ budhaiḥ proktaṃ tapo’ntaṃ vedadarśibhiḥ || 11.234 ||
tapa iti | yad etat sarvaṃ devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ca sukhaṃ tasya tapaḥ kāraṇam | tapasaiva ca tasya sthitiḥ | tapo’ntaḥ pratiniyatavidhir eva devādisukhasya tapasā jananād ādiṣṭaṃ vedārthajñair uktam | uktaprājāpatyādiprāyaścittātmakaṃ tapaḥ | prasaṅgena cedaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ ca sarvatapomāhātmyakathanam || 11.234 ||
brāhmaṇasya tapo jñānaṃ tapaḥ kṣatrasya rakṣaṇam |
vaiśyasya tu tapo vārtā tapaḥ śūdrasya sevanam || 11.235 ||
brāhmaṇasyeti | brāhmaṇasya brahmacaryātmakavedāntāvabodhanaṃ tapaḥ, rājanyasya rakṣaṇaṃ tapaḥ, vaiśyasya kṛṣivāṇijyapāśupālyādikaṃ tapaḥ, śūdrasya brāhmaṇaparicaryā tapa iti varṇaviśeṣeṇotkarṣabodhanārtham || 11.235 ||
ṛṣayaḥ saṃyatātmānaḥ phalamūlānilāśanāḥ |
tapasaiva prapaśyanti trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 11.236 ||
ṛṣaya iti | ṛṣayo vāṅmanaḥkāyaniyamopetāḥ phalamūlavāyubhakṣās tapasaiva jaṅgamasthāvarasahitaṃ pṛthivyantarikṣasvargātmakaṃ lokatrayam ekadeśasthāḥ santo niṣpāpāntaḥkaraṇāḥ prakarṣeṇa paśyanti || 11.236 ||
auṣadhāny agado vidyā daivī ca vividhā sthitiḥ |
tapasaiva prasidhyanti tapas teṣāṃ hi sādhanam || 11.237 ||
auṣadhānīti | auṣadhāni vyādhyupaśamanahetukāni | agado gadābhāvaḥ, nairujyam iti yāvat | vidyā brahmadharmacaryātmakavedārthajñānaṃ vedasaṃbandhinī ca nānārūpā svargādāv avasthitir ity etāni tapasaiva prāpyante | yasmāt tapa eṣāṃ prāptinimittam || 11.237 ||
yad dustaraṃ yad durāpaṃ yad durgaṃ yac ca duṣkaram |
sarvaṃ tat tapasā sādhyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam || 11.238 ||
yad iti | yad duḥkhena tīryate grahadoṣasūcitāpadādi, yad duḥkhena prāpyate kṣatriyādinā yathā viśvāmitreṇa tenaiva śarīreṇa brāhmaṇyādi, yad duḥkhena gamyate merupṛṣṭhādi, yad duḥkhena kriyate goḥ pracuradānādi, tat sarvaṃ tapasā sādhituṃ śakyate | yasmād atiduṣkarakāryakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ tapasā sādhyate tapo durlaṅghanaśakti || 11.238 ||
mahāpātakinaś caiva śeṣāś cākāryakāriṇaḥ |
tapasaiva sutaptena mucyante kilbiṣāt tataḥ || 11.239 ||
maheti | brahmahatyādimahāpātakakāriṇo ‘nye upapātakādyakāryakāriṇas tapasaivoktarūpenānuṣṭhitena tasmāt pāpān mucyante | uktasyāpi punarvacanaṃ prāyaścittastutyartham || 11.239 ||
kīṭāś cāhipataṅgāś ca paśavaś ca vayāṃsi ca |
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni divaṃ yānti tapobalāt || 11.240 ||
kīṭā iti | kīṭasarpaśalabhapaśupakṣiṇaḥ sthāvarāṇi ca vṛkṣagulmādīni bhūtāni tapomāhātmyena svargaṃ yānti | itihāsādau kapotopākhyānādiṣu pakṣiṇo ‘py agnipraveśādikaṃ tapas tapantīti śrūyate | kīṭānāṃ yaj jātisahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ tatsamaṃ tapas tena ca kṣīṇakalmaṣā avikāriṇo janmāntarakṛtena sukṛtena divaṃ yānti || 11.240 ||
yat kiṃcid enaḥ kurvanti manovāṅmūrtibhir janāḥ |
tat sarvaṃ nirdahanty āśu tapasaiva tapodhanāḥ || 11.241 ||
yat kiṃcid iti | yat kiṃcit pāpaṃ manovāgdehair mānavāḥ kurvanti tat sarvaṃ pāpaṃ nirdahanti | tapasaiva tapodhanā iti tapa eva dhanam iva rakṣaṇīyaṃ yeṣāṃ te tapodhanāḥ
|| 11.241 ||
tapasaiva viśuddhasya brāhmaṇasya divaukasaḥ |
ijyāś ca pratigṛhṇanti kāmān saṃvardhayanti ca || 11.242 ||
tapasaiveti | prāyaścittatapasā kṣīṇapāpasya brāhmaṇasya yāge havīṃṣi devāḥ pratigṛhṇanti | abhilaṣitārthāṃś ca prayacchanti || 11.242 ||
prajāpatir idaṃ śāstraṃ tapasaivāsṛjat prabhuḥ |
tathaiva vedān ṛṣayas tapasaiva prapedire || 11.243 ||
prajāpatir iti | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sakalalokotpattisthitipralayaprabhuḥ tapaḥkaraṇapūrvakam evemaṃ grantham akarot | tathaiva ṛṣayo vasiṣṭhādayas tapasaiva mantrabrāhmaṇātmakān vedān prāptavantaḥ || 11.243 ||
ity etat tapaso devā mahābhāgyaṃ pracakṣate |
sarvasyāsya prapaśyantas tapasaḥ puṇyam uttamam || 11.244 ||
[ brahmacaryaṃ tapo homaḥ kāle śuddhālpabhojanam |
arāgadveṣalobhāś ca tapa uktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā || ]
ity etad iti | sarvasyāsa jantor yad durlabhaṃ janma tapasaḥ sakāśād ity evaṃ devāḥ prapaśyantaḥ “tapomūlam idaṃ sarvam” (11.234) ityādi tapomāhātmyaṃ pravadanti || 11.244 ||
vedābhyāso ‘nvahaṃ śaktyā mahāyajñakriyā kṣamā |
nāśayanty āśu pāpāni mahāpātakajāny api || 11.245 ||
vedābhyāsa iti | yathāśakti pratyahaṃ vedādhyayanaṃ pañcamahāyajñānuṣṭhānam aparādhasahiṣṇutvam ity etāni mahāpātakajanitāny api pāpāni śīghraṃ nāśayanti kim utānyāni
|| 11.245 ||
yathaidhas tejasā vahniḥ prāptaṃ nirdahati kṣaṇāt |
tathā jñānāgninā pāpaṃ sarvaṃ dahati vedavit || 11.246 ||
yatheti | yathāgniḥ kāṣṭhāny āsannāni kṣaṇenaiva tejasā niḥśeṣaṃ karoti tathā jñānāgninā pāpaṃ sarvaṃ vedārthajño brāhmaṇo nāśayati | ity etatparamātmajñānasyaitat pāpakṣayotkarṣajñāpanārtham etat || 11.246 ||
ity etad enasām uktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi |
ata ūrdhvaṃ rahasyānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ nibodhata || 11.247 ||
ity etad iti | ity etad brahmahatyādīnāṃ pāpānāṃ prakāśānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhy abhihitam | ata ūrdhvam aprakāśānāṃ pāpānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ śṛṇuta | ayaṃ śloko govindrānenālikhitaḥ, medhātithinā tu likhita eva || 11.247 ||
savyāhṛtipraṇavakāḥ prāṇāyāmās tu ṣoḍaśa |
api bhrūṇahaṇaṃ māsāt punanty ahar ahaḥ kṛtāḥ || 11.248 ||
savyāhṛtīti | savyāhṛtipraṇavāḥ sāvitrīśiroyuktāḥ pūrakakumbhakarecakādividhinā pratyahaṃ ṣoḍaśa prāṇāyāmāḥ kṛtāḥ māsād brahmaghnam api niṣpāpaṃ kurvanti | apiśabdād ātideśikabrahmahatyāprāyaścittādhikṛtam api | etac ca prāyaścittaṃ dvijātīnām eva, na strīśūdrāder mantrānadhikārāt || 11.248 ||
kautsaṃ japtvāpa ity etad vāsiṣṭhaṃ ca pratīty ṛcam |
māhitraṃ śuddhavatyaś ca surāpo ‘pi viśudhyati || 11.249 ||
kautsam iti | kautsena ṛṣiṇā dṛṣṭaṃ “apaḥ naḥ śośucad agham” (RV 1.7.5) ity etat sūktaṃ vasiṣṭhena ṛṣiṇā dṛṣṭaṃ ca “pratistomebhir uṣasaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ” (RV 5.5.27) ity eva ṛcaṃ, māhitraṃ “mahitrīṇām avostu” (RV 8.8.43) ity etat sūktaṃ, śuddhavatyaḥ “etonvindraṃ stavāma śuddham” (RV 6.6.31) ity etas tisraḥ ṛcaḥ, prakṛtaṃ māsam ahar ahaḥ ṣoḍaśakṛvo ‘pi japitvā surāpo ‘pi viśudhyati | apiśabdād ātideśikasurāpānaprāyaścittādhikṛto ‘pi || 11.249 ||
sakṛj japtvāsyavāmīyaṃ śivasaṃkalpam eva ca |
apahṛtya suvarṇaṃ tu kṣaṇād bhavati nirmalaḥ || 11.250 ||
sakṛd iti | brāhmaṇaḥ suvarṇam apahṛtya “asya vāmasya palitasya” (RV 2.3.14) ity etat sūktaṃ prakṛtatvān māsam ekaṃ pratyaham ekavāraṃ japitvā, śivasaṃkalpaṃ ca “yaj jāgrato dūram” (VS 34.1) ity etad vājasaneyake yat paṭhitaṃ taj japitvā suvarṇam apahṛtya kṣipram eva niṣpāpo bhavati || 11.250 ||
haviṣpāntīyam abhyasya na taṃ ha itīti ca |
japitvā pauruṣaṃ śūktaṃ mucyate gurutalpagaḥ || 11.251 ||
haviṣpāntīyam iti | “haviṣpāntam ajaraṃ svarvidi” (RV 8.4.10) ity ekonaviṃśatiṛcaḥ “na tam aṃho na duritam” (RV 2.6.29) ity aṣṭau, “iti vā iti me manaḥ” (RV 8.6.26) śivasaṃkalpa iti sūktaṃ “sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ” (RV 8.4.17) ity etac ca ṣoḍaśarcaṃ sūktaṃ māsam ekaṃ pratyaham abhyaseti śravaṇāt prakṛtatvāt ṣoḍaśābhyāsāj japitvā gurudāragas tasmāt pāpān mucyate || 11.251 ||
enasāṃ sthūlasūkṣmāṇāṃ cikīrṣann apanodanam |
avety ṛcaṃ japed abdaṃ yat kiṃcedam itīti vā || 11.252 ||
enasām iti | sthūlānāṃ pāpānāṃ mahāpātakānāṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ copapātakādīnāṃ nirharaṇaṃ kartum icchan “ava te heḷo varuṇa namobhiḥ” (RV 1.2.15) ityetām ṛcaṃ, “yat kiṃcedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane” (RV 5.6.11) ity etāṃ ca ṛcaṃ, “iti vā iti me manaḥ” (RV 8.6.26) ity etat sūktaṃ saṃvatsaram ekavāraṃ pratyahaṃ japet || 11.252 ||
pratigṛhyāpratigrāhyaṃ bhuktvā cānnaṃ vigarhitam |
japaṃs taratsamandīyaṃ pūyate mānavas tryahāt || 11.253 ||
pratigṛhyeti | svarūpato mahāpātakidhanatvādinā vāpratigrāhyaṃ pratigṛhya cānnaṃ svabhāvakālapratigrahasaṃsargaduṣṭaṃ bhuktvā “tarat sa mandī dhāvati” (RV 7.1.15) ity etā ṛcas catasro japitvā tryahaṃ tasmāt pāpān manuṣyaḥ pūto bhavati || 11.253 ||
somāraudraṃ tu bahvenā māsam abhyasya śudhyati |
sravantyām ācaran snānam aryamṇām iti ca ṛcam || 11.254 ||
someti | “somārudrā dharayethām asuryam” (RV 5.1.18) iti catasraḥ | “aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ mitraṃ ca” (RV 3.4.16) iti ṛktrayaṃ nadyāṃ ca snānaṃ kṛtvā māsam ekaṃ pratyekam abhyasya bahupāpo viśudhyati | bahuṣv api pāpeṣu tantreṇaikaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kāryam iti jñāpakam idam || 11.254 ||
abdārdham indram ity etad enasvī saptakaṃ japet |
apraśastaṃ tu kṛtvāpsu māsam āsīta bhaikṣabhuk || 11.255 ||
abdārdham iti | enasvīty viśeṣāt sarveṣv eva pāpeṣu “indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇam agnim” (RV 2.3.22) ity etāḥ sapt ṛcaḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ japet | apraśastaṃ mūtrapurīṣotsargādikaṃ jale kṛtvā māsaṃ bhakṣabhojī bhavet || 11.255 ||
mantraiḥ śākalahomīyair abdaṃ hutvā ghṛtaṃ dvijaḥ |
sugurv apy apahanty eno japtvā vā nama ity ṛcam || 11.256 ||
mantrair iti | “devakṛtasya” (VS 8.13) ityādibhiḥ śākalahomamantraiḥ saṃvatsaraṃ ghṛtahomaṃ kṛtvā “nama indraś ca” ity etāṃ vā ṛcaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ japitvā mahāpātakam api pāpaṃ dvijātir apahanti || 11.256 ||
mahāpātakasaṃyukto ‘nugacched gāḥ samāhitaḥ |
abhyasyābdaṃ pāvamānīr bhaikṣāhāro viśudhyati || 11.257 ||
mahāpātaketi | brahmahatyādimahāpātakayukto bhikṣālabdhāhāro varṣam ekaṃ saṃyatendriyo gavām anugamanaṃ kurvan “yaḥ pāvamānīr adhyeti” (RV 7.2.18) ityādiṛco ‘nvaham abhyāsena japitvā tasmāt pāpād viśuddho bhavati || 11.257 ||
araṇye vā trir abhyasya prayato vedasaṃhitām |
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ parākaiḥ śodhitas tribhiḥ || 11.258 ||
araṇye iti | tribhiḥ parākaiḥ pūto mantrabrāhmaṇātmakāṃ vedasaṃhitāṃ araṇye vāratrayam abhyasya vā prayato bāhyābhyantaraśaucayuktaḥ sarvair mahāpātakair mucyate || 11.258 ||
tryahaṃ tūpavased yuktas trir ahno ‘bhyupayann apaḥ |
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvais trir japitvāghamarṣaṇam || 11.259 ||
tryaham iti | trirātram upavasan saṃyataḥ pratyahaṃ prātarmadhyāhnasāyaṃkāleṣu snānaṃ kurvan triṣavaṇasnānakāla eva jale nimajjya “ṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ca” (RV 8.8.48) iti sūktam aghamarṣaṇaṃ trir āvṛttaṃ japitvā sarvaiḥ pāpair mucyate | tatra gurulaghupāpāpekṣayā puruṣaśaktyādyapekṣayā cāvartanīyam || 11.259 ||
yathāśvamedhaḥ kraturāṭ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ |
tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam || 11.260 ||
yatheti | yathāśvamedhayāgaḥ sarvayāgaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvapāpakṣayahetus tathāghamarṣaṇasūktam api sarvapāpakṣayahetur ity aghamarṣaṇasūktotkarṣaḥ || 11.260 ||
hatvā lokān apīmāṃs trīn aśnann api yatas tataḥ |
ṛgvedaṃ dhārayan vipro nainaḥ prāpnoti kiṃcana || 11.261 ||
hatveti | bhūrādilokatrayam api hatvā mahāpātakyādīnām apy annam aśnan ṛgvedaṃ dhārayan viprādir na kiṃcit pāpaṃ prāpnoti || 11.261 ||
ṛgvedaṃ rahasyaprāyaścittārtham uktaṃ tataś ca rahasyapāpe kṛte ṛksaṃhitāṃ mantrabrāhmaṇātmikām abhyaset tad āha –
ṛksaṃhitāṃ trir abhyasya yajuṣāṃ vā samāhitaḥ |
sāmnāṃ vā sarahasyānāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 11.262 ||
ṛg iti | ṛksaṃhitāṃ mantrabrāhmaṇātmikāṃ na tu mantramātrātmikāṃ anantaraṃ “vede trivṛti” (11.263) iti pratyavamarśāt | yajuṣāṃ vā mantrabrāhmaṇānāṃ saṃhitāṃ sāmnāṃ vā brāhmanopaniṣatsahitāṃ vāratrayam abhyasya sarvapāpaiḥ pramukto bhavati || 11.262 ||
yathā mahāhradaṃ prāpya kṣiptaṃ loṣṭaṃ vinaśyati |
tathā duścaritaṃ sarvaṃ vede trivṛti majjati || 11.263 ||
yatheti | ṛgādyātmanā trir āvartata iti trivṛt yathā mahāhradaṃ praviśya loṣṭaṃ viśīryate tathā sarvaṃ duścaritaṃ trivṛti vede vinaśyati || 11.263 ||
trivṛttvam evāha –
ṛco yajūṃṣi cānyāni sāmāni vividhāni ca |
eṣa jñeyas trivṛd vedo yo vedainaṃ sa vedavit || 11.264 ||
ṛca iti | ṛca ṛṅmantrāḥ, yajūṃṣi yajurmantrāḥ, sāmāni bṛhadrathantarādīni nānāprakārāṇy anyāni eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ pṛthak pṛthak mantrabrāhmaṇāni eṣa trivṛdvedo jñātavyaḥ ya enaṃ veda sa vedavid bhavati || 11.264 ||
ādyaṃ yat tryakṣaraṃ brahma trayī yasmin pratiṣṭhitā |
sa guhyo ‘nyas trivṛdvedo yas taṃ veda sa vedavit || 11.265 ||
[pṛthagbrāhmaṇakalpābhyāṃ sa hi vedas trivṛt smṛtaḥ ]
prāyaścitte bahuminimatālocanād yan mayoktaṃ
sadvyākhyānaṃ khalu munigirāṃ tad bhajadhvaṃ guṇajñāḥ |
naitan medhātithir abhidhadhe nāpi govindarājo
vyākhyātāro na jagur apare 'py anyato durlabhaṃ vaḥ ||
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyṃ saṃhitāyām
ekādaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ ||
dvādaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
cāturvarṇyasya kṛtsno ‘yam ukto dharmas tvayānagha |
karmaṇāṃ phalanirvṛttiṃ śaṃsa nas tattvataḥ parām || 12.1 ||
cāturvarṇyasyeti | he pāparahita, brāhmaṇādivarṇacatuṣṭayasya sāntaraprabhavasyāyaṃ dharmas tvayoktaḥ | idānīṃ karmaṇāṃ śubhāśubhaphalaprāptiṃ parāṃ janmāntaraprabhavāṃ parārtharūpām asmākaṃ brūhīti maharṣayo bhṛgum avocan || 12.1 ||
sa tān uvāca dharmātmā maharṣīn mānavo bhṛguḥ |
asya sarvasya śṛṇuta karmayogasya nirṇayam || 12.2 ||
sa tān iti | sa dharmapradhāno manor apatyātmā bhṛgur asya sarvasya karmasaṃbandhasya phalaniścayaṃ śṛṇuteti tān maharṣīn abravīt || 12.2 ||
śubhāśubhaphalaṃ karma manovāgdehasaṃbhavam |
karmajā gatayo nṝṇām uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ || 12.3 ||
śubheti | manovāgdehahetukaṃ karma vihitaniṣiddharūpaṃ sukhaduḥkhaphalakaṃ tajjanyā eva manuṣyatiryagādibhāvenotkṛṣṭamadhyamādhamāpekṣayā manuṣyāṇāṃ gatayo janmāntaraprāptayo bhavanti | karmaśabdaś cātra na kāyaceṣṭāyām eva kiṃ tu mamedaṃ svam iti saṃkalparūpayogādidhyānācaraṇādāv api kriyāmātre vartate || 12.3 ||
tasyeha trividhasyāpi tryadhiṣṭhānasya dehinaḥ |
daśalakṣaṇayuktasya mano vidyāt pravartakam || 12.4 ||
tasyeti | tasya dehisaṃbandhinaḥ karmaṇaḥ utkṛṣṭamadhyamādhamatayā triprakārasyāpi manovākkāyāśritasya vakṣyamāṇadaśalakṣaṇopetasya mana eva pravartakaṃ jānīyāt | manasā hi saṃkalpitam ucyate kriyate ca | tathā taittirīyopaniṣadi — “tasmād yat puruṣo manasābhigacchati tad vācā vadati tat karmaṇā karoti” iti || 12.4 ||
tāni daśalakṣaṇāni karmāṇi darśayitum āha –
paradravyeṣv abhidhyānaṃ manasāniṣṭacintanam |
vitathābhiniveśaś ca trividhaṃ karma mānasam || 12.5 ||
paradravyeṣv iti | kathaṃ paradhanam anyāyena gṛhṇāmīty evaṃ cintanam, manasā brahmavadhādiniṣiddhākāṅkṣā, nāsti paralokaḥ deha evātmety etadgrahaś cety evaṃ triprakāram aśubhaphalaṃ mānasaṃ karma | etattrayaviparītabuddhiś ca trividhaṃ śubhaphalaṃ mānasaṃ karma, “śubhāśubhaphalaṃ karma” (12.3) ity ubhayasyaiva prakrāntatvāt || 12.5 ||
pāruṣyam anṛtaṃ caiva pauśunyaṃ cāpi sarvaśaḥ |
asaṃbaddhapralāpaś ca vāṅmayaṃ syāc caturvidham || 12.6 ||
pāruṣyeti | apriyābhidhānaṃ, asatyabhāṣaṇaṃ, parokṣe paradūṣaṇakathanaṃ, satyasyāpi rājadeśapauravārtāder niṣprayojanaṃ varṇanam, ity evaṃ catuḥprakāram aśubhaphalaṃ vācikaṃ karma bhavet | etadviparītaṃ priyasatyaparaguṇābhidhānaṃ śrutipurāṇādau ca rājādicaritakathanaṃ śubhaphalam || 12.6 ||
adattānām upādānaṃ hiṃsā caivāvidhānataḥ |
paradāropasevā ca śārīraṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam || 12.7 ||
adattānām iti | anyāyena parasvagrahaṇam aśāstrīyahiṃsā paradāragamanam ity evaṃ triprakāram aśubhaphalaṃ śārīraṃ karma | etadviparītaṃ trayaṃ śubhaphalam || 12.7 ||
mānasaṃ manasaivāyam upabhuṅkte śubhāśubham |
vācā vācā kṛtaṃ karma kāyenaiva ca kāyikam || 12.8 ||
[ trividhaṃ ca śarīreṇa vācā caiva caturvidham |
manasā trividhaṃ karma daśa dharmapathāṃs tyajet || ]
mānasam iti | manasā yat sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ va karma kṛtaṃ tatphalaṃ sukhaduḥkharūpam iha janmani janmāntare vā manasaivāyam upabhuṅkte | evaṃ vācā kṛtaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ vāgdvāreṇa madhuragadgadabhāṣitvādinā, śārīraṃ śūbhāśubhaṃ śarīradvāreṇa srakcandanādipriyopabhoga-vyādhitatvādinānubhavati | tasmāt prayatnena śārīramānasavācikāni dharmarahitāni ca varjaen na kuryāc ca || 12.8 ||
śarīrajaiḥ karmadoṣair yāti sthāvaratāṃ naraḥ |
vācikaiḥ pakṣimṛgatāṃ mānasair antyajātitām || 12.9 ||
[ śubhaiḥ prayogair devatvaṃ vyāmiśrair mānuṣo bhavet |
aśubhaiḥ kevalaiś caiva tiryagyoniṣu jāyate ||
vāgdaṇḍo hanti vijñānaṃ manodaṇḍaḥ parāṃ gatim |
karmadaṇḍas tu lokāṃs trīn hanyād aparirakṣitaḥ ||
vāgaṇḍo ‘tha bhaven maunaṃ manodaṇḍas tv anāśanam |
śārīrasya his daṇḍasya prāṇāyāmo vidhīyate || ]
śarīreti | yady api pāpiṣṭhānāṃ śārīravācikamānasikāny eva trīṇi pāpāni saṃbhavanti tathāpi sa yadi prāyaśo ‘dharmam eva sevate, dharmam alpam iti bāhulyābhiprāyeṇeti vyākhyātam, bāhulyena śarīrakarmajapāpair yuktaḥ sthāvaratvaṃ mānuṣaḥ prāpnoti | bāhulyena vākkṛtaiḥ pakṣitvaṃ mṛgatvaṃ vā | bāhulyena manasā kṛtais cāṇḍālāditvaṃ prāpnoti || 12.9 ||
vāgdaṇḍo ‘the manodaṇḍaḥ kāyadaṇḍas tathaiva ca |
yasyaite nihitā buddhau tridaṇḍīti sa ucyate || 12.10 ||
vāgdaṇḍa iti | damanaṃ daṇḍaḥ, vāṅmanaḥkāyānāṃ daṇḍā niṣiddhābhidhānāt sasaṃkalpapratiṣiddhavyāpāratyāgena buddhāv avasthitāḥ sa tridaṇḍīty ucyate | na tu daṇḍatrayadhāraṇamātreṇety abhyantaradaṇḍatrayapraśaṃsā || 12.10 ||
tridaṇḍam etan nikṣipya sarvabhūteṣu mānavaḥ |
kāmakrodhau tu saṃyamya tataḥ siddhiṃ niyacchati || 12.11 ||
tridaṇḍam iti | evaṃ niṣiddhavāgādīnāṃ sarvabhūtagocaratayā damanaṃ kṛtvaitad damanārtham eva kāmakrodhau tu niyamya tato mokṣāvāptilakṣaṇāṃ siddhiṃ manuṣyo labhate || 12.11 ||
ko ‘sau siddhim āpnotīty ata āha –
yo ‘syātmanaḥ kārayitā taṃ kṣetrajñaṃ pracakṣate |
yaḥ karoti tu karmāṇi sa bhūtātmocyate budhaiḥ || 12.12 ||
ya iti | asya lokasiddhasyātmopakārakatvād ātmanaḥ śarīrākhyasya yaḥ karmasu pravartayitā taṃ kṣetrajñaṃ paṇḍitā vadanti | yaḥ punar eṣa vyāpārān karoti śarīrākhyaḥ sa pṛthivyādibhūtārabdhatvād bhūtātmaiveti paṇḍitair ucyate || 12.12 ||
jīvasaṃjño ‘ntarātmānyaḥ sahajaḥ sarvadehinām |
yena vedayate sarvaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca janmasu || 12.13 ||
jīvasaṃjña iti | jīvaśabdo ‘yaṃ mahatparaḥ, ‘yena’ iti karaṇavibhaktinirdeśāt, uttaraśloke ca “tāv ubhau bhūtasaṃpṛktau mahān kṣetrajña eva ca” (12.24) iti tacchabdena pratyavamarśāc charīrakṣetrajñātirikto ‘ntaḥśarīram ātmākhyātvād ātmā jīvākhyaḥ sarvakṣetrajñānāṃ sahaja ātmā | tatprāptes tais tasya viniyogāt | yenāhaṃkārendriyarūpatayā pariṇatena kāraṇabhūtena kṣetrajñaḥ pratijanma sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ cānubhavati || 12.13 ||
tāv ubhau bhūtasaṃpṛktau mahān kṣetrajña eva ca |
uccāvaceṣu bhūteṣu sthitaṃ taṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhataḥ || 12.14 ||
tāv iti | tau dvau mahatkṣetrajñau pṛthivyādipañcabhūtasaṃpṛktau vakṣyamāṇaṃ sarvalokavedasmṛtipurāṇādiprasiddhatayā tam iti nirdiṣṭaṃ paramātmānam utkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭasattveṣu vyavasthitam āśritya tiṣṭhataḥ || 12.14 ||
asaṃkhyā mūrtayas tasya niṣpatanti śarīrataḥ |
uccāvacāni bhūtāni satataṃ ceṣṭayanti yāḥ || 12.15 ||
asaṃkhyā iti | tasya paramātmanaḥ śarīrād asaṃkhyamūrtayo jīvāḥ kṣetrajñaśabdenānantaram uktā liṅgaśarīrāvacchinnā vedānta uktaprakāreṇāgner iva sphuliṅgā niḥsaranti | yā mūrtaya utkṛṣṭāpakṛṣṭabhūtāgnidevarūpatayā pariṇatāni sarvadā karmasu prerayanti || 12.15 ||
pañcabhya eva mātrābhyaḥ pretya duṣkṛtināṃ nṛṇām |
śarīraṃ yātanārthīyam anyad utpadyate dhruvam || 12.16 ||
pañcabhya iti | pañcabhya eva pṛthivyādibhūtebhyo duṣkṛtakāriṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pīḍānubhavaprayojakaṃ jarāyujādidehavyatiriktaṃ duḥkhasahiṣṇu śarīraṃ paraloke jāyate
|| 12.16 ||
tenānubhūya tā yāmīḥ śarīreṇeha yātanāḥ |
tāsv eva bhūtamātrāsu pralīyante vibhāgaśaḥ || 12.17 ||
teneti | tena nirgatena śarīreṇa tā yamkāritā yātanā duṣkṛtino jīvāḥ sūkṣmānubhūtasthūlaśarīranāśe teṣv evārambhakabhūtabhāgeṣu yathāsvaṃ pralīyante | tatsaṃyogino bhūtvāvatiṣthanta ity arthaḥ || 12.17 |||
so ‘nubhūyāsukhodarkān doṣān viṣayasaṅgajān |
vyapetakalmaṣo ‘bhyeti tāv evobhau mahaujasau || 12.18 ||
so ‘nubhūyeti | sa śarīro bhūtasūkṣmādiliṅgaśarīrāvacchinno niṣiddhaśabdasparśarūparasa-gandhākhyaviṣayopabhogajanitayamalokaduḥkhādyanubhūyānantaraṃ bhogād apahatapāpmā tāv eva mahatparamātmānau mahāvīryau dvāv āśrayati || 12.18 ||
tau dharmaṃ paśyatas tasya pāpaṃ cātandritau saha |
yāmyām prāpnoti saṃpṛktaḥ pretyeha ca sukhāsukham || 12.19 ||
tāv iti | tau mahatparamātmānau analasau tasya jīvasya dharmaṃ bhuktaśeṣaṃ ca pāpaṃ saha vicārayataḥ | yāmyāṃ dharmādharmābhyāṃ yukto jīvaḥ paralokehalokayoḥ sukhaduḥkhe prāpnoti || 12.19 ||
yady ācarati dharmaṃ sa prāyaśo ‘dharmam alpaśaḥ |
tair eva cāvṛto bhūtaiḥ svarge sukham upāśnute || 12.20 ||
yadīti | sa yadi jīvo mānuṣadaśāyāṃ bāhulyena dharmam anutiṣṭhati alpaṃ cādharmaṃ tadā tair eva pṛthivyādibhūtaiḥ sthūlaśarīrarūpatayā pariṇatair yuktaḥ svargasukham anubhavati
|| 12.20 ||
yadi tu prāyaśo ‘dharmaṃ sevate dharmam alpaśaḥ |
tair bhūtaiḥ sa parityakto yāmīḥ prāpnoti yātanāḥ || 12.21 ||
yadīti | yadi punaḥ sa jīvo mānuṣadaśāyāṃ bāhulyena pāpam anutiṣṭhati alpaṃ ca puṇyaṃ tadā tair eva bhūtair mānuṣadeharūpatayā pariṇatais tyakto mṛtaḥ sann anantaraṃ “pañcabhya eva mātrābhyaḥ” (12.16) ityuktarītyā yātanānubhavocitasaṃpātakaṭhinadeho yāmīḥ pīḍā anubhavati
|| 12.21 ||
yāmīs tā yātanāḥ prāpya sa jīvo vītakalmaṣaḥ |
tāny eva pañcabhūtāni punar apy eti bhāgaśaḥ || 12.22 ||
yāmīr iti | sa jīvo yamakāritās tāḥ pīḍās tena kaṭhinadehenānubhūya tato bhogenāpahatapāpmā tān pañca jarāyujādiśarīrārambhakān pṛthivyādibhūtabhāgān adhitiṣthati | mānuṣādiśarīraṃ gṛhṇātīty arthaḥ || 12.22 ||
etā dṛṣṭvāsya jīvasya gatīḥ svenaiva cetasā |
dharmato ‘dharmataś caiva dadhyāt sadā manaḥ || 12.23 ||
etā iti | asya jīvasya etā dharmādharmahetukāḥ svarganarakādyupabhogocitapriyāpriyadeha-prāptir antaḥkaraṇe jñātvā dharmānuṣṭhāne manaḥ sadā saṃgataṃ kuryāt || 12.23 ||
sattvaṃ rajas tamaś caiva trīn vidyād ātmano guṇān |
yair vyāpyemān sthito bhāvān mahān sarvān aśeṣataḥ || 12.24 ||
sattvam iti | sattvarajastamāṃsi trīṇi vakṣyamāṇaguṇalakṣaṇāni ātmopakārakatvād ātmano mahato guṇāñ jānīyāt, yair vyāpto mahān imān sthāvarajaṅgamarūpān padārthān niḥśeṣeṇa vyāpya sthitaḥ || 12.24 ||
yo yadaiṣāṃ guṇo dehe sākalyenātiricyate |
sa tadā tadguṇaprāyaṃ taṃ karoti śarīriṇam || 12.25 ||
ya iti | yady api sarvam evedaṃ triguṇaṃ tathāpi yatra dehe yeṣāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye yo guṇo yadā sākalyenādhiko bhavati tadā tadguṇalakṣaṇabahulaṃ taṃ dehinaṃ karoti || 12.25 ||
saṃprati sattvādīnāṃ lakṣaṇam āha –
sattvaṃ jñānaṃ tamo ‘jñānaṃ rāgadveṣau rajaḥ smṛtam |
etad vyāptimad eteṣāṃ sarvabhūtāśritaṃ vapuḥ || 12.26 ||
sattvam iti | yathārthāvabhāso jñānaṃ tat sattvasya lakṣaṇam | etadviparītam ajñānaṃ tat tamolakṣaṇam | viṣādābhilāṣaṃ mānasakāryaṃ rajolakṣaṇam | svarūpaṃ tu sattvarajastamasāṃ prītyaprītiviṣādātmakam | tathā ca paṭhanti “prītiviṣādātmakāḥ prakāśavṛttiniyamārthā anyonyābhibhavajananamithunavṛttayaś ca guṇāḥ” | etac caiṣāṃ svarūpam anantaraślokatrayeṇa vakṣyati | eteṣāṃ sattvādiguṇānām etajjñānādi sarvaprāṇivyāpakaṃ lakṣaṇam || 12.26 ||
tatra yat prītisaṃyuktaṃ kiṃcid ātmani lakṣayet |
praśāntam iva śuddhābhaṃ sattvaṃ tad upadhārayet || 12.27 ||
tatreti | tasminn ātmani yat saṃvedanaṃ prītiyuktaṃ pratyastamitakleśaṃ prakāśarūpam anubhavet tat sattvaṃ jānīyāt || 12.27 ||
yat tu duḥkhasamāyuktam aprītikaram ātmanaḥ |
tad rajaḥ pratīpaṃ vidyāt satataṃ hāri dehinām || 12.28 ||
yat tv iti | yat punaḥ saṃvedanaṃ duḥkhānuviddham ata eva sattvaśuddhātmaprīter ajanakaṃ sarvadā ca śarīriṇāṃ viṣayaspṛhotpādakaṃ tattvanivārakāt pratipakṣaṃ rajo jānīyāt || 12.28 ||
yat tu syān mohasaṃyuktam avyaktaṃ viṣayātmakam |
apratarkyam avijñeyaṃ tamas tad upadhārayet || 12.29 ||
yat tv iti | yat punaḥ sadasadvivekaśūnyam asphuṭaviṣayākārasvabhāvam atarkanīyasvarūpam antaḥkaraṇabahiḥkaraṇābhyāṃ durjñātaṃ tat tamo jānīyāt | eṣāṃ ca guṇānāṃ svarūpakathanaṃ sattvavṛttyavasthitau yatnavatā bhavitavyam ity etat prayojanakam || 12.29 ||
trayāṇām api caiteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ yaḥ phalodayaḥ |
agryo madhyo jaghanyaś ca taṃ pravakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ || 12.30 ||
trayāṇām iti | eteṣāṃ sattvādīnāṃ trayāṇām api guṇānāṃ yathākramam uttamamadhyamādhamarūpo yaḥ phalotpādakas taṃ viśeṣeṇa vakṣyāmi || 12.30 ||
vedābhyāsas tapo jñānaṃ śaucam indriyanigrahaḥ |
dharmakriyātmacintā ca sāttvikaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.31 ||
vedābhyāsa iti | vedābhyāsaḥ, prājāpatyādyanuṣṭhānaṃ, śāstrārthāvabodhaḥ, mṛdvāryādiśaucaṃ, indriyasaṃyamaḥ, dānādidharmānuṣṭhānaṃ, ātmadhyānaparatā, etat sattvākhyaguṇasya kāryam || 12.31 ||
ārambharucitādharyam asatkāryaparigrahaḥ |
viṣayopasevā cājasraṃ rājasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.32 ||
ārambheti | phalārthaṃ karmānuṣṭhānaśīlatā, alpe ‘py arthe vaiklavyaṃ, niṣiddhakarmācaraṇaṃ, ajasraṃ śabdādiviṣayopabhoga ity etad rajo’bhidhānaguṇasya kāryam || 12.32 ||
lobhaḥ svapno ‘dhṛtiḥ krauryaṃ nāstikyaṃ bhinnavṛttitā |
yāciṣṇutā pramādaś ca tāmasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.33 ||
lobha ityādi | adhikādhikadhanaspṛhā, nidrātmatā, kātaryaṃ, paiśunyaṃ, paralokābhāvabuddhiḥ, ācāraparilopaḥ, yācanaśīlatvaṃ, saṃbhave ‘pi dharmādiṣv anavadhānaṃ, ity etat tāmasābhidhānasya guṇasya lakṣaṇam || 12.33 ||
trayāṇām api caiteṣāṃ guṇānāṃ triṣu tiṣṭhatām |
idaṃ sāmāsikaṃ jñeyaṃ kramaśo guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.34 ||
trayāṇām iti | eṣāṃ sattvādīnāṃ trayāṇām api guṇānām triṣu kāleṣu bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamāneṣu vidyamānānām idaṃ vakṣyamāṇasāpekṣikaṃ krameṇa guṇalakṣaṇaṃ jñātavyam || 12.34 ||
yat karma kṛtvā kurvaṃś ca kariṣyaṃś caiva lajjati |
taj jñeyaṃ viduṣā sarvaṃ tāmasaṃ guṇalakṣaṇam || 12.35 ||
yad iti | yat karma kṛtvā, kurvan, kariṣyaṃś ca lajjāvān bhavati | kālatraye dvayor anyatra veti vivakṣitaṃ tamaḥkāryatvāt tamo’bhidhānaṃ guṇalakṣaṇaṃ śāstravidā boddhavyam
|| 12.35 ||
yenāsmin karmaṇā loke khyātim icchati puṣkalām |
na ca śocaty asaṃpattau tad vijñeyaṃ tu rājasam || 12.36 ||
yeneti | ‘ihaloke mahatīṃ khyātiṃ prāpnuyām’ ity etadartham eva yo yat karma karoti na paralokārthaṃ na ca tatkarmaphalāsaṃpattau duḥkhī bhavati tad rajaḥkaryatvād rajoguṇalakṣaṇam vijñeyam || 12.36 ||
yat sarveṇecchati jñātuṃ yan na lajjati cācaran |
yena tuṣyati cātmāsya tat sattvaguṇalakṣaṇam || 12.37 ||
yad iti | yat karma vedārthaṃ sarvātmanā jñātum icchati, yac ca karmācaran kālatraye ‘pi na lajjati, yena yena karmaṇāsyātmatuṣṭir jāyate, tat sattvākhyasya guṇasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam
|| 12.37 ||
tamaso lakṣaṇaṃ kāmo rajasas tv artha ucyate |
sattvasya lakṣaṇaṃ dharmaḥ śraiṣṭhyam eṣāṃ yathottaram || 12.38 ||
tamasa iti | kāmapradhānatā tamaso lakṣaṇam, arthaniṣṭhatā rajasaḥ, dharmapradhānatā sattvasya, eṣāṃ ca kāmādīnām uttarottarasya śreṣṭhatvam | kāmād arthaḥ śreyān, arthamūlatvāt kāmasya | tābhyāṃ ca dharmaḥ, tanmūlatvāt tayoḥ || 12.38 ||
yena yās tu guṇenaiṣāṃ saṃsārān pratipadyate |
tān samāsena vakṣyāmi sarvasyāsya yathākramam || 12.39 ||
yenetyādi | eṣāṃ sattvādīnāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye yena guṇena svakāryeṇa yā gatīr jīvaḥ prāpnoti tāḥ sarvasyāsya jagataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ krameṇa vakṣyāmi || 12.39 ||
devatvaṃ sāttvikā yānti manuṣyatvaṃ ca rājasāḥ |
tiryaktvaṃ tāmasā nityam ity eṣā trividhā gatiḥ || 12.40 ||
devatvam iti | ye sattvavṛttāv avasthitās te devatvaṃ yānti | ye tu rajovṛttyavasthitās te manuṣyatvam | ye tamovṛttisthās te tiryaktvaṃ cety eṣā trividhā janmaprāptiḥ || 12.40 ||
trividhā trividhaiṣā tu vijñeyā gauṇikī gatiḥ |
adhamā madhyamāgryā ca karmavidyāviśeṣataḥ || 12.41 ||
trividheti | yā sattvādiguṇatrayanimittā trividhā janmāntaraprāptir uktā sā deśakālādibhedena saṃsārahetubhūtakarmabhedāj jñānabhedāc cādhamamadhyamottamabhedena punas trividhā boddhavyā || 12.41 ||
sthāvarāḥ kṛmikīṭāś ca matsyāḥ sarpāḥ sakacchapāḥ |
paśavaś ca mṛgāś caiva jaghanyā tāmasī gatiḥ || 12.42 ||
sthāvarā iti | sthāvarā vṛkṣādayaḥ, kṛmayaḥ sūkṣmāḥ prāṇinaḥ, tebhya īṣatsthūlāḥ kīṭāḥ, tathā matsyasarpakūrmapaśumṛgāś cety eṣā tamonimittā jaghanyā gatiḥ || 12.42 ||
hastinaś ca turaṅgāś ca śūdrā mlecchāś ca garhitāḥ |
siṃhā vyāghrā varāhāś ca madhyamā tāmasī gatiḥ || 12.43 ||
hastinaś ceti | hastyaśvaśūdramlecchasiṃhavyāghrasūkarās tamoguṇanimittā madhyamā gatiḥ | garhitā iti mlecchānāṃ svarūpānuvādaḥ || 12.43 ||
cāraṇāś ca suparṇāś ca puruṣāś caiva dāmbhikāḥ |
rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāś ca tāmasīṣūttamā gatiḥ || 12.44 ||
cāraṇāś ceti | cāraṇā naṭādayaḥ, suparṇāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ, chadmanā karmakāriṇaḥ puruṣāḥ, rākṣasāḥ, piśācāś cety eṣā tāmasīṣūttamā gatiḥ || 12.44 ||
jhallā mallā naṭāś caiva puruṣāḥ śastravṛttayaḥ |
dyūtapānaprasaktāś ca jaghanyā rājasī gatiḥ || 12.45 ||
jhallā iti | jallā mallāḥ kṣatriyād vrātyāt savarṇāyām utpannā daśamādhyāyoktā jñeyāḥ | tatra jhallā yaṣṭipraharaṇāḥ, mallā bāhuyodhinaḥ, raṅgāvatārakā naṭāḥ, śastrajīvidyūtapānaprasaktāś ca puruṣā adhamā rājasī gatir jñeyā || 12.45 ||
rājānaḥ kṣatriyāś caiva rājñāṃ caiva purohitāḥ |
vādayuddhapradhānāś ca madhyamā rājasī gatiḥ || 12.46 ||
rājāna iti | rājāno ‘bhiṣiktā janapadeśvarāḥ | tathā kṣatriyā rājapurohitāś ca śāstrārthakalahapriyāś ca eṣā rājasī gatir madhyamā boddhavyā || 12.46 ||
gandharvā guhyakā yakṣā vibudhānucarāś ca ye |
tathaivāpsarasaḥ sarvā rājasīṣūttamā gatiḥ || 12.47 ||
gandharvā iti | gandharvāḥ, guhyakāḥ, yakṣā jātiviśeṣāḥ purāṇādiprasiddhāḥ, ye ca devānuyāyino vidyādharādayaḥ, apsarāś ca devagaṇikāḥ sarvā ity eṣā rājasīmadhya utkṛṣṭā gatiḥ || 12.47 ||
tāpasā yatayo viprā ye ca vaimānikā gaṇāḥ |
nakṣatrāṇi ca daityāś ca prathamā sāttvikī gatiḥ || 12.48 ||
tāpasā iti | vānaprasthāḥ, bhikṣayaḥ, brāhmaṇāś ca, apsarovyatiriktāḥ puṣpakādivimānacāriṇaḥ, nakṣatrāṇi, daityāś cety eṣā sattvanimittādhamā gatiḥ || 12.48 ||
yajvāna ṛṣayo devā vedā jyotīṃṣi vatsarāḥ |
pitaraś caiva sādhyāś ca dvitīyā sāttvikī gatiḥ || 12.49 ||
yajvāna iti | yāgaśīlāḥ, tatharṣayaḥ, devāḥ, vedābhimāninyaś ca devatā vigrahavatya itihāsaprasiddhāḥ, jyotīṃṣi dhruvādīni, vatsarā itihāsadṛṣṭyā vigrahavantaḥ, pitaraḥ somapādayaḥ, sādhyāś ca devayoniviśeṣā ity eṣā sattvanimittā madhymā gatiḥ || 12.49 ||
brahmā viśvasṛjo dharmo mahān avyaktam eva ca |
uttamāṃ sāttvikīm etāṃ gatim āhur manīṣiṇaḥ || 12.50 ||
brahmeti | caturvadanaḥ, viśvasṛjaś ca marīcyādayaḥ, dharmo vigrahavān, mahān, avyaktaṃ ca sāṃkhyaprasiddhaṃ ca tattvadvayaṃ, tadadhiṣṭātṛdevatādvayam iha vivakṣitam, acetanaguṇatrayamātrasyottamasāttvikagatitvānupapatteḥ | etāṃ caturvadanādyātmikāṃ sattvanimittām utkṛṣṭāṃ gatiṃ paṇḍitā vadanti || 12.50 ||
eṣa sarvaḥ samuddiṣṭas triḥprakārasya karmaṇaḥ |
trividhas trividhaḥ kṛtsnaḥ saṃsāraḥ sārvabhautikaḥ || 12.51 ||
eṣa iti | eṣa manovākkāyarūpatrayabhedena triḥprakārasya karmaṇaḥ sattvarajastamobhedena trividhaḥ punaḥ prathamamadhyamottamabhedena trividhaḥ sarvaprāṇigataḥ samagro gativiśeṣaḥ kārtsnyenoktaḥ | ‘sārvabhautikaḥ’ ity abhidhānād anuktā apy atra gatayo draṣṭavyāḥ | uktagatayas tu pradarśanārthāḥ || 12.51 ||
