indriyāṇāṃ prasaṅgena dharmasyāsevanena ca |
pāpān saṃyānti saṃsārān avidvāṃso narādhamāḥ || 12.52 ||
indriyāṇām iti | indriyāṇāṃ viṣayeṣu prasaṅgena niṣiddhācaraṇena ca prāyaścittādidharmānanuṣṭhānena mūḍhā manuṣyāpasadāḥ kutsitā gatīḥ prāpnuvanti || 12.52 ||
yāṃ yāṃ yoniṃ tu jīvo ‘yaṃ yena yeneha karmaṇā |
kramaśo yāti loke ‘smiṃs tat tat sarvaṃ nibodhata || 12.53 ||
yāṃ yām iti | ayaṃ jīvo yena yena pāpena karmaṇā iha loke kṛtena yad yaj janma prāpnoti tat sarvaṃ krameṇa śṛṇuta || 12.53 ||
bahūn varṣagaṇān ghorān narakān prāpya tatkṣayāt |
saṃsārān pratipadyante mahāpātakinas tv imān || 12.54 ||
bahūn iti | brahmahatyādimahāpātakakāriṇo bahūn varṣasamūhān bhayaṃkārān narakān prāpya tadupabhogakṣayād duṣkṛtaśeṣeṇa vakṣyamāṇān janmaviśeṣān prāpnuvanti || 12.54 ||
śvasūkarakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ go’jāvimṛgapakṣiṇām |
caṇḍālapukkasānāṃ ca brahmahā yonim ṛcchati || 12.55 ||
śveti | kukkurasūkaragardabhoṣṭragocchāgameṣamṛgapakṣicaṇḍālānāṃ pukkasānāṃ ca niṣādena śūdrāyāṃ jātānāṃ saṃbandhinīṃ jātiṃ brahmahā prāpnoti, tatra pāpaśeṣagaurava-lāghavāpekṣayā krameṇa sarvayoniprāptir boddhavyā | evam uttaratrāpi || 12.55 ||
kṛmikīṭapataṅgānāṃ viḍbhujāṃ caiva pakṣiṇām |
hiṃsrāṇāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ surāpo brāhmaṇo vrajet || 12.56 ||
kṛmīti | kṛmikīṭaśalabhānāṃ purīṣabhakṣiṇāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ hiṃsanaśīlānāṃ ca vyāghrādīnāṃ prāṇināṃ jātiṃ surāpo brāhmaṇo gacchati || 12.56 ||
lūtāhisaraṭānāṃ ca tiraścāṃ cāmbucāriṇām |
hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca piśācānāṃ steno vipraḥ sahasraśaḥ || 12.57 ||
lūtāhīti | ūrṇanābhasarpakṛkalāsānāṃ, jalacarāṇāṃ ca, tiraścāṃ kumbhīrādīnāṃ, hiṃsanaśīlānāṃ ca yoniṃ suvarṇahārī brāhmaṇaḥ sahasravārān prāpnoti || 12.57 ||
tṛṇagulmalatānāṃ ca kravyādāṃ daṃṣṭriṇām api |
krūrakarmakṛtāṃ caiva śataśo gurutalpagaḥ || 12.58 ||
tṛṇeti | tṛṇānāṃ dūrvādīnāṃ, gulmānām aprakāṇḍādīnāṃ, latānāṃ guḍūcyādīnāṃ, āmamāṃsabhakṣiṇāṃ gṛdhrādīnāṃ, daṃṣṭriṇāṃ siṃhādīnāṃ, krūrakarmaśālināṃ vadhaśīlānāṃ ca vyāghrādīnāṃ jātiṃ śatavārān prāpnoti gurudāragāmI || 12.58 ||
hiṃsrā bhavanti kravyādāḥ kṛmayo ‘bhakṣyabhakṣiṇaḥ |
parasparādinaḥ stenāḥ pretāntyastrīniṣeviṇaḥ || 12.59 ||
hiṃsrā iti | ye prāṇivadhaśilās ta āmamāṃsāśino mārjārādayo bhavanti | abhakṣyabhakṣiṇo ye te kṛmayo jāyante | mahāpātakavyatiriktāś caurās te parasparaṃ māṃsasyādino bhavanti | ye cāṇḍālādistrīgāminas te pretākhyāḥ prāṇiviśeṣā jāyante | ‘pretāntyastrīniṣeviṇaḥ’ iti chandaḥsamānatvāt smṛtīnāṃ, “sarve vidhayaś chandasi vikalpyanta” (Kau. Pa. Sū. 36) iti visargalope ce | yad vā yalope ca savarṇadīrghaḥ || 12.59 ||
saṃyogaṃ patitair gatvā parasyaiva ca yoṣitam |
apahṛtya ca viprasvaṃ bhavati brahmarākṣasaḥ || 12.60 ||
saṃyogam iti | yāvatkālīnapatitasaṃyogena patito bhavati tāvantaṃ kālaṃ brahmahādibhiś caturbhiḥ saha saṃsargaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāṃ ca striyaṃ gatvā brāhmaṇasuvarṇād anyad apahṛtya ekaikapāpakāreṇa brahmarākṣaso bhūtaviśeṣo bhavati || 12.60 ||
maṇimuktāpravālāni hṛtvā lobhena mānavaḥ |
vividhāni ca ratnāni jāyate hemakartṛṣu || 12.61 ||
maṇīti | maṇīn māṇikyādīni, muktāvidrumau ca, nānāvidhāni ca ratnāni vaidūryahīrakādīni lobhena hṛtvātmīyabhramād vinā suvarṇakārayonau jāyate | kecit tu hemakārapakṣiṇam ācakṣate || 12.61 ||
dhānyaṃ hṛtvā bhavaty ākhuḥ kāṃsyaṃ haṃso jalaṃ plavaḥ |
madhu daṃśaḥ payaḥ kāko rasaṃ śvā nakulo ghṛtam || 12.62 ||
dhānyam iti | dhānyam apahṛtya mūṣiko bhavati | kāṃsyaṃ hṛtvā haṃsaḥ, jalaṃ hṛtvā plavākhyaḥ pakṣī, mākṣikaṃ hṛtvā daṃśaḥ, kṣīraṃ hṛtvā kākaḥ, viśeṣopadiṣṭaguḍalavaṇādivyatiriktam ikṣvādirasaṃ hṛtvā śvā bhavati | ghṛtaṃ hṛtvā nakulo bhavati || 12.62 ||
māṃsaṃ gṛdhro vapāṃ madgus tailaṃ tailapakaḥ khagaḥ |
cīrīvākas tu lavaṇaṃ balākā śakunir dadhi || 12.63 ||
māṃsam iti | māṃsaṃ hṛtvā gṛdhro bhavati | vapāṃ hṛtvā madgunāmā jalacaro bhavati | tailaṃ hṛtvā tailapāyikākhyaḥ pakṣī, lavaṇaṃ hṛtvā cīrākhyaḥ uccaiḥsvaraḥ kīṭaḥ, dadhi hṛtvā balākākhyaḥ pakṣī jāyate || 12.63 ||
kauśeyaṃ tittirir hṛtvā kṣaumaṃ hṛtvā tu durduraḥ |
kārpāsatāntavaṃ krauñco godhā gāṃ vāggudo guḍam || 12.64 ||
kauśeyam iti | kīṭakośanirmitaṃ vastraṃ hṛtvā tittirirnāmā pakṣī bhavati | kṣaumakṛtaṃ vastraṃ hṛtvā maṇḍūkaḥ, kārpāsamayaṃ paṭaṃ hṛtvā krauñcākhyaḥ prāṇī, gāṃ hṛtvā godhā, guḍaṃ hṛtvā vāggudanāmā śakunir bhavati || 12.64 ||
chucchundariḥ śubhān gandhān patraśākaṃ tu barhiṇaḥ |
śvāvit kṛtānnaṃ vividham akṛtānnaṃ tu śalyakaḥ || 12.65 ||
chucchundarir iti | sugandhidravyāṇi hṛtvā chucchundarir bhavati | vāstūkādipatraśākaṃ hṛtvā mayūraḥ, siddhānnam odanasaktvādi nānāprakāraṃ hṛtvā śvāvidhākhyaḥ prāṇī, akṛtānnaṃ tu vrīhīyavādikaṃ hṛtvā śalyakasaṃjño jāyate || 12.65 ||
bako bhavati hṛtvāgniṃ gṛhakārī hy upaskaram |
raktāni hṛtvā vāsāṃsi jāyate jīvajīvakaḥ || 12.66 ||
baka iti | agniṃ hṛtvā bakākhyaḥ pakṣī jāyate | gṛhopayogi śūrpamusalādi hṛtvā bhittyādiṣu mṛttikādigṛhakārī sapakṣaḥ kīṭo bhavati | kusumbhādiraktāni vāsāṃsi hṛtvā cakorākhyaḥ pakṣī jāyate || 12.66 ||
vṛko mṛgebhaṃ vyāghro ‘śvaṃ phalamūlaṃ tu markaṭaḥ |
strīm ṛkṣaḥ stokako vāri yānāny uṣṭraḥ paśūn ajaḥ || 12.67 ||
vṛka iti | mṛgaṃ hastinaṃ vā hṛtvā vṛkākhyo hiṃsraḥ paśur bhavati | ghoṭakaṃ hṛtvā vyāghro bhavati | phalamūlaṃ hṛtvā markaṭo bhavati | striyaṃ hṛtvā bhallūko bhavati | pānārtham udakaṃ hṛtvā cātakākhyaḥ pakṣī | yānāni śakaṭādīni hṛtvā uṣṭro bhavati | paśūn uktetarān hṛtvā chāgo bhavati || 12.67 ||
yad vā tad vā paradravyam apahṛtya balān naraḥ |
avaśyaṃ yāti tiryaktvaṃ jagdhvā caivāhutaṃ haviḥ || 12.68 ||
yad veti | yat kiṃcid asāram api paradravyam icchāto mānuṣo ‘pahṛtya puroḍāśādikaṃ tu havir ahutaṃ bhuktvā niścitaṃ tiryaktvaṃ prāpnoti || 12.68 ||
striyo ‘py etena kalpena hṛtvā doṣam avāpnuyuḥ |
eteṣām eva jantūnāṃ bhāryātvam upayānti tāḥ || 12.69 ||
striyo ‘pīti | striyo ‘py etena prakāreṇecchātaḥ parasvam apahṛtya pāpaṃ prāpnuvanti | tena pāpenoktānāṃ jantūnāṃ bhāryātvaṃ pratipadyante || 12.69 ||
evaṃ niṣiddhācaraṇaphalāny abhidhāyādhunā vihitākaraṇaphalavipākam āha –
svebhyaḥ svebhyas tu karmabhyaś cyutā varṇā hy anāpadi |
pāpān saṃsṛtya saṃsārān preṣyaāṃ yānti śartruṣu || 12.70 ||
svebhya iti | brāhmaṇādayaś catvāro varṇā āpadaṃ vinā pañcayajñādikarmatyāgino vakṣyamāṇāḥ kutsitā yonīḥ prāpya tato janmāntare śatrudāsatvaṃ prāpnuvanti || 12.70 ||
vāntāśy ulkāmukhaḥ preto vipro dharmāt svakāc cyutaḥ |
amedhyakuṇapāśī ca kṣatriyaḥ kaṭapūtanaḥ || 12.71 ||
vāntāśīti | brāhmaṇaḥ svakarmabhraṣṭaś charditabhuk, jvālāmukhaḥ pretaviśeṣo jāyate | kṣatriyaḥ punar naṣṭakarmā purīṣaśavabhojī kaṭapūtanākhyaḥ pretaviśeṣo bhavati || 12.71 ||
maitrākṣajyotikaḥ preto vaiśyo bhavati pūyabhuk |
cailāśakaś ca bhavati śūdro dharmāt svakāc cyutaḥ || 12.72 ||
maitreti | vaiśyo bhraṣṭakarmā maitrākṣajyotikanāmā pūyabhakṣaḥ preto janmāntare bhavati | mitradevatākatvān maitraḥ pāyus tad evākṣaṃ karmendriyaṃ tatra jyotir yasya sa maitrākṣajyotikaḥ | pṛṣodarādivāj jyotiṣaḥ, ṣakāralopaḥ | śūdraḥ punar bhraṣṭakarmā cailāśakākhyaḥ preto bhavati | celaṃ vastraṃ tatsaṃbandhinīṃ yūkām aśnātīti celāśakaḥ | govindarājas tu celāśakākhyaḥ kīṭaś caila ucyate, tadbhakṣaś ca sa bhavatīty āha | tad ayuktaṃ, pretākhyaprāṇiviśeṣaprakaraṇāt || 12.72 ||
yathā yathā niṣevante viṣayān viṣayātmakāḥ |
tathā tathā kuśalā teṣāṃ teṣūpajāyate || 12.73 ||
yatheti | yathā yathā śabdādiviṣayān viṣayalolupā nitantaṃ sevante tathā tathā viṣayeṣv eva teṣāṃ prāvīṇyaṃ bhavatīti || 12.73 ||
tataḥ –
te ‘bhyāsāt karmaṇāṃ teṣāṃ pāpānām alpabuddhayaḥ |
saṃprāpnuvanti duḥkhāni tāsu tāsv iha yoniṣu || 12.74 ||
ta iti | te ‘lpadhiyas teṣāṃ nibaddhaviṣayopabhogānām abhyāsatāratamyāt tāsu tāsu garhitagarhitataragarhitatamāsu tiryagādiyoniṣu duḥkham anubhavanti || 12.74 ||
tāmisrādiṣu cogreṣu narakeṣu vivartanam |
asipatravanādīni bandhanacchedanāni ca || 12.75 ||
tāmisrādiṣv iti | “saṃprāpnuvanti” (12.74) iti pūrvaślokastham ihottaratra cānuvartate | tāmisrādiṣu caturthādhyāyokteṣu ghoreṣu narakeṣu duḥkhānubhavaṃ prāpnuvanti | tathāsipatravanādīni bandhanacchedanātmikān narakān prāpnuvanti || 12.75 ||
vividhāś caiva saṃpīḍāḥ kākolūkaiś ca bhakṣaṇam |
karambhavālukātāpān kumbhīpākāṃś ca dāruṇān || 12.76 ||
vividhā iti | vividhapīḍanaṃ kākādyair bhakṣaṇaṃ tathā taptavālukādīn kumbhīpādādīṃś ca narakān dāruṇān prāpnuvanti || 12.76 ||
saṃbhavāṃś ca viyoniṣu duḥkhaprāyāsu nityaśaḥ |
śītātapābhighātāṃś ca vividhāni bhayāni ca || 12.77 ||
saṃbhavāṃś ceti | saṃbhavān tiryagādijātiṣu nityaṃ duḥkhabahulāsūtpattiṃ prāpnuvanti | tatra śītātapādipīḍanādi nānāprakārāṇi ca prāpnuvanti || 12.77 ||
asakṛdgarbhavāseṣu vāsaṃ janma ca dāruṇam |
bandhanāni ca kaṣṭāni parapreṣyatvam eva ca || 12.78 ||
asakṛd iti | punaḥ punar garbhasthāneṣu vāsaḥ samutpattiṃ ca yoniyantrādibhir duḥkhāvahām utpannāś ca śṛṅkhalādibhir bandhanādipīḍām anubhavanti | paradāsatvaṃ ca prāpnuvanti
|| 12.78 ||
bandhupriyaviyogāṃś ca saṃvāsaṃ caiva durjanaiḥ |
dravyārjanaṃ ca nāśaṃ ca mitrāmitrasya cārjanam || 12.79 ||
bandhupriyeti | bāndhavaiḥ suhṛdbhiḥ saha viyogān, durjanaiś ca sahaikatrāvasthānaṃ, dhanārjanaprayāsaṃ, dhanavināśaṃ, kaṣṭena mitrārjanaṃ, śatruprādurbhāvaṃ prāpnuvanti
|| 12.79 ||
jarāṃ caivāpratīkārāṃ vyādhibhiś copapīḍanam |
kleśāṃś ca vividhāṃs tāṃs tān mṛtyum eva ca durjayam || 12.80 ||
jarām iti | jarāṃ cāvidyamānapratīkārām vyādhibhiś copapīḍanaṃ kṣutpipāsādinā ca nānāprakārān kleśān mṛtyuṃ ca durvāraṃ prāpnuvanti || 12.80 ||
yādṛśena tu bhāvena yad yat karma niṣevate |
tādṛśena śarīreṇa tat tat phalam upāśnute || 12.81 ||
yādṛśeneti | yathāvidhena sāttvikena rājasena tāmasena vā cetasā yad yat karma snānadānayogādy anutiṣṭhati tādṛśenaiva śarīreṇa sāttvikena rajo’shikena tamo’dhekena vā tat tat sthānādiphalam upabhuṅkte || 12.81 ||
eṣa sarvaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ karmaṇāṃ vaḥ phalodayaḥ |
naiḥśreyasakaraṃ karma viprasyedaṃ nibodhata || 12.82 ||
eṣa iti | eṣa yuṣmākaṃ vihitapratiṣiddhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ sarvaḥ phalodaya uktaḥ | idānīṃ brāhmaṇasya niḥśreyasāya mokṣāya hitaṃ karmānuṣṭhānaṃ idaṃ śṛṇuta || 12.82 ||
vedābhyāsas tapo jñānam indriyāṇāṃ ca saṃyamaḥ |
ahiṃsā gurusevā ca niḥśreyasakaraṃ param || 12.83 ||
vedābhyāsa iti | upaniṣadāder vedasya granthato ‘rthataś cāvartanaṃ, tapaḥ kṛcchrādi, jñānaṃ brahmaviṣayaṃ, indriyajayaḥ, avihitahiṃsāvarjanaṃ, guruśuśrūṣety etat prakṛṣṭaṃ mokṣasādhanam || 12.83 ||
sarveṣām api caiteṣāṃ śubhānām iha karmaṇām |
kiṃcic chreyaskarataraṃ karmoktaṃ puruṣaṃ prati || 12.84 ||
sarveṣām iti | sarveṣām apy eteṣāṃ vedābhyāsādīnāṃ śubhakarmaṇāṃ madhye kiṃcit karmātiśayena mokṣasādhanaṃ syād iti vitarke | ṛṣīṇāṃ jijñāsāviśeṣād uttaraślokena nirṇayam āha || 12.84 ||
sarveṣām api caiteṣām ātmajñānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam |
tad dhy agryaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ prāpyate hy amṛtaṃ tataḥ || 12.85 ||
sarveṣām iti | eṣāṃ vedābhyāsādīnāṃ sarveṣām api madhya upaniṣaduktaparamārthajñānaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ smṛtaṃ yasmāt sarvavidyānāṃ pradhānam | atraiva hetum āha – yato mokṣas tasmāt prāpyate || 12.85 ||
ṣaṇṇām eṣāṃ tu pūrveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ pretya ceha ca |
śreyaskarataraṃ jñeyaṃ sarvadā karma vaidikam || 12.86 ||
ṣaṇṇām iti | eṣāṃ punaḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ vedābhyāsādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ madhye vaidikaṃ karma paramārthajñānam aihikāmuṣmikaśreyaskarataraṃ jñātavyam | pūrvaśloke mokṣahetutvam ātmajñānasyoktam, iha tu aihikāmuṣmikaśreyontarahetutvam ucyata ity apaunaruktyam | tathā hi – pratīkopāsanānāṃ saṃśayodayaṃ “nāma brahmety upāste yāvan nāmno gataṃ tatrāsya kāmacāro bhavati” | govindarājas tu “eṣāṃ pūrvaślokoktānāṃ vedābhyāsādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ karmaṇāṃ madhyāt smārtakarmāpekṣayā vaidikaṃ karma sarvadehaparaloke sātiśayaṃ sātiśayena kīrtisvarganiḥśreyasaḥsādhanaṃ jñeyam” iti vyākhyātavān | tad ayuktam, vedābhyāsādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇām api pratyekaṃ śrutivihitatvāt | teṣu madhye smārtāpekṣayā kiṃcid evaṃ kiṃcic ca neti na saṃbhavati | tataś ca kathaṃ nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī? tasmād yathokaiva vyākhyā || 12.86 ||
idānīm aihikāmuṣmikaśreyaḥsādhanatvam evātmajñānasya spaṣṭayati –
vaidike karmayoge tu sarvāṇy etāny aśeṣataḥ |
antarbhavanti kramaśas tasmiṃs tasmin kriyāvidhau || 12.87 ||
vaidaka iti | vaidike punaḥ karmayoge paramātmopāsanārūpe sarvāṇy etāni pūrvaślokoktāny aihikāmuṣmikaśreyāṃsi tasminn upāsanāvidhau kramaśaḥ saṃbhavanti | atha vā ‘sarvāṇy etāni’ iti vedābhyāsādīny eva parāmṛśyante | paramātmajñāne vedābhyāsādīni “tam etaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasānāśakena” (BṛĀrUp 4.4.22) iti śrutivihitāṅgatvenāntarbhavanti || 12.87 ||
sukhābhyudayikaṃ caiva naiḥśreyasikam eva ca |
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca dvividhaṃ karma vaidikam || 12.88 ||
sukheti | vaidikaṃ karmātra jyotiṣṭomādi pratīkopāsanādi ca gṛhyate | svargādisukhaprāptikarasaṃsārapravṛtthetutvāt pravṛttākhyaṃ vaidikaṃ karma, tathā niḥśreyasaṃ mokṣas tadarthaṃ karma naiḥśreyasikaṃ saṃsāranivṛttihetutvān nivṛttākhyam ity evaṃ vaidikaṃ karma dviprakārakaṃ veditavyam || 12.88 ||
etad eva spaṣṭayati –
iha cāmutra vā kāmyaṃ pravṛttaṃ karma kīrtyate |
niṣkāmaṃ jñānapūrvaṃ tu nivṛttam upadiśyate || 12.89 ||
[ akāmopahataṃ nityaṃ nivṛttaṃ ca vidhīyate |
kāmatas tu kṛtaṃ karma pravṛttam upadiśyate || ]
iheti | iha kāmyasādhanaṃ vṛṣṭihetukāri yāgādi, paratra svargādiphalasādhanaṃ jyotiṣṭomādi yat kāmatayā kriyate tat saṃsārapravṛttihetutvāt pravṛttam ity ucyate | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalakāmanārahitaṃ punar brahmajñānābhyāsapūrvakaṃ saṃsāranivṛttihetutvān nivṛttam ity ucyate || 12.89 ||
pravṛttaṃ karma saṃsevya devānām eti sāmyatām |
nivṛttaṃ sevamānas tu bhūtāny atyeti pañca vai || 12.90 ||
pravṛttam iti | pravṛttakarmābhyāsena devasamānagatitvaṃ tat phalaṃ karmaṇā prāpnoti | etac ca pradarśanārtham anyaphalakena karmaṇā pravṛttena phalāntaram api prāpnoti | nivṛttakarmābhyāsena punaḥ śarīrārambhakāni pañca bhūtāny atikrāmati | mokṣaṃ prāpnotīty arthaḥ || 12.90 ||
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani |
samaṃ paśyann ātmayājī svārājyam adhigacchati || 12.91 ||
sarveti | sarvabhūteṣu sthāvarajaṅgamātmakeṣv aham evātmarūpeṇāsmi sarvāṇi bhūtāni paramātmapariṇāmasiddhāni mayy eva paramātmany āsata iti sāmānyena jānann ātmayājī brahmārpaṇanyāyena jyotiṣṭomādi kurvan svena rājate prakāśata iti svarāṭ brahma tasya bhāvaḥ svārājyaṃ brahmatvaṃ labhate | mokṣaṃ āpnotīty arthaḥ | tathā ca śrutiḥ (ChUp 3.14.1): “sarvaṃ khalv idaṃ brahma tajjalān iti śānta upāsīta” | tathā yajurvedamantraḥ:
yas tu sarvāṇi bhūtāny ātmany evānjupaśyati |
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ tato na vijugupsate ||
|| 12.91 ||
yathoktāni karmāṇi parihāya dvijottamaḥ |
ātmajñāne śame ca syād vedābhyāse ca yatnavān || 12.92 ||
yatheti | śāstracoditāny apy agnihotrādīni karmāṇi parityajya brahmadhyānendriyajaya-praṇavopaniṣadādivedābhyāseṣu brāhmaṇo yatnaṃ kuryāt | etac caiṣāṃ mokṣopāyāntaraṅgopāyatvapradarśanārthaṃ na tv agnihotrādiparityāgaparatvam uktam
|| 12.92 ||
etad dhi janmasāphalyaṃ brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ |
prāpyaitat kṛtakṛtyo hi dvijo bhavati nānyathā || 12.93 ||
etad iti | etad ātmajñānavedābhyāsādi dvijāter janmasāphalyāpādakatvāj janmanaḥ sāphalyaṃ viśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇasya | yasmād etat prāpya dvijātiḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavati na prakārāntareṇa
|| 12.93 ||
idānīṃ vedād eva brahma jñātavyam iti pradarśayituṃ vedapraśaṃsām āha –
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ vedaś cakṣuḥ sanātanam |
aśakyaṃ cāprameyaṃ ca vedaśāstram iti sthitiḥ || 12.94 ||
pitṛdeveti | pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ havyakavyānnadāneṣu veda eva cakṣur iva cakṣur anaśvaraṃ tatpamāṇatvād asaṃnikṛṣṭaphalakavyadānādau pramāṇāntarānavakāśāt | aśakyaṃ ca vedaśāstraṃ kartum | anenāpauruṣeyatoktā | aprameyaṃ ca mīmāṃsādinyāyanirapekṣatayānavagamyamānaprameyam evaṃ vyavasthā | tataś ca mīmāṃsayā vyākaraṇādyaṅgaiś sarvabrahmātmakaṃ vedārthaṃ jānīyād iti vyavasthitam || 12.94 ||
yā vedabāhyāḥ smṛtayo yāś ca kāś ca kudṛṣṭayaḥ |
sarvās tā niṣphalāḥ pretya tamoniṣṭhā hi tāḥ smṛtāḥ || 12.95 ||
yā vedabāhyā iti | yāḥ smṛtayo vedamūlā na bhavanti dṛṣṭārthavākyāni “caityavandanāt svargo bhavati” ityādīni | yāni cāsattarkamūlāni devatāpūrvādinirākaraṇātmakāni vedaviruddhāni cārvākadarśanāni sarvāṇi paraloke niṣphalāni, yasmān narakaphalāni tāni manvādibhiḥ smṛtāni
|| 12.95 ||
etad eva spaṣṭayati –
utpadyante vinaśyanti yāny ato ‘nyāni kānicit |
tāny arvākkālikatayā niṣphalāny anṛtāni ca || 12.96 ||
utpadyanta iti | yāny ato vedād anyamūlāni ca kānicic chāstrāṇi pauruṣeyatvād utpadyante evam āśu vinaśyanti | tāni ca idānīṃtanatvān niṣphalāni asatyarūpāṇi ca, smṛtyādīnāṃ tu vedamūlatvād eva prāmāṇyam || 12.96 ||
cāturvarṇyaṃ trayo lokāś catvāraś cāśramāḥ pṛthak |
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarvaṃ vedāt prasidhyati || 12.97 ||
cāturvarṇyam iti | “brāhmaṇo ‘sya mukha āsīt” (RV 8.4.19) ityādivedād eva cāturvarṇyaṃ prasidhyati | brāhmaṇībhūtamātāpitṛjanitatvam iti tadupajīvitayā svargādiloko ‘pi vedād eva prasiddhaḥ | evaṃ brahmacaryādyāśramā api catvāro vedamūlakatvād vedād eva prasidhyanti | kiṃ bahunā, yat kiṃcid atītaṃ vartamānaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca tat sarvaṃ “agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyak” (3.76) ityādinyāyena vedād eva prasidhyati || 12.97 ||
śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaś ca pañcamaḥ |
vedād eva prasūyante prasūtiguṇakarmataḥ || 12.98 ||
śabda iti | ya iha loke paraloke ca śabdādayo viṣayāḥ prasūyante prayujyante etair iti prasūtam, prasūtayaś ca guṇāś ceti sattvarajastamorūpāḥ tannibandhanavaidikakarmahetutvād vedād eva prasiddhyanti || 12.98 ||
bibharti sarvabhūtāni vedaśāstraṃ sanātanam |
tasmād etat paraṃ manye yaj jantor asya sādhanam || 12.99 ||
bibhartīti | vedaśāstraṃ nityaṃ sarvabhūtāni dhārayati | tathā ca,
havir agnau hūyate so ‘gnir ādityam upasarpati, tat sūryo raśmibhir varṣati, tenānnaṃ bhavati, atheha bhūtānām utpattiḥ sthitiś ceti havir jāyate |
iti brāhmaṇam | tasmād vedaśāstram asya jantor vaidikakarmādhikāripuruṣasya prakṛṣṭaṃ puruṣārthasādhanaṃ jānanti || 12.99 ||
senāpatyaṃ ca rājyaṃ ca daṇḍanetṛtvam eva ca |
sarvalokādhipatyaṃ ca vedaśāstravid arhati || 12.100 ||
senāpatyam iti | senāpatyaṃ, rājyaṃ, daṇḍapraṇetṛtvaṃ, sarvabhūmyādhipatyādīny etat sarvam uktaprayojanaṃ vedātmakaśāstrajña evārhati || 12.100 ||
yathā jātabalo vahnir dahaty ārdrān api drumān |
tathā dahati vedajñaḥ karmajaṃ doṣam ātmanaḥ || 12.100 ||
[ na vedabalam āśritya pāpakarmarucir bhavet |
ajñānāc ca pramādāc ca dahate karma netarat || ]
yatheti | yathā vṛddho ‘gnir ārdrān api drumān dahaty evaṃ granthato ‘rthataś ca vedajñaḥ pratiṣiddhādyācaraṇādikarmajanitaṃ pāpam ātmano nāśayati | evaṃ ca na kevalaṃ vedaḥ svargāpavargādihetuḥ kiṃ tv ahitanivṛttihetur iti darśitāḥ || 12.101 ||
vedaśāstrārthatattvajño yatra tatrāśrame vasan |
ihaiva loke tiṣṭhan sa brahmabhūyāya kalpate || 12.102 ||
vedaśāstrārtheti | yas tattvato vedaṃ tadarthaṃ ca karma brahmātmakaṃ jānāti sa nityanaimittikakarmānugṛhītabrahmajñānena brahmacaryādyāśramāvasthito ‘sminn eva loke tiṣṭhan brahmatvāya kalpate || 12.102 ||
ajñebhyo granthinaḥ śreṣṭhā granthibhyo dhāriṇo varāḥ |
dhāribhyo jñāninaḥ śreṣṭhā jñānibhyo vyavasāyinaḥ || 12.103 ||
ajñebhya iti | ubhayoḥ praśasyatve saty anyatarātiśayavivakṣāyāṃ śreṣṭha itīṣṭhano vidhānād īṣadadhyayanā ajñās tebhyaḥ samagragranthādhyetāraḥ śreṣṭhāḥ | tebhyo ‘dhītagranthadhāraṇasamarthāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ | tena granthinaḥ paṭhitavismṛtagranthā boddhavyāḥ | dhāribhyo ‘dhītagranthārthajñāḥ prakṛṣṭās tebhyo ‘nuṣṭhātāraḥ || 12.103 ||
tapo vidyā ca viprasya niḥśreyasakaraṃ param |
tapasā kilbiṣaṃ hanti vidyayāmṛtam aśnute || 12.104 ||
tapa iti | “tapaḥ svadharmavṛttitvam” iti bhāratadarśanāt āśramavihitaṃ karma ātmajñānaṃ ca brāhmaṇasya mokṣasādhanam | tatra tapaso ‘vāntaravyāpāram āha – tapasā pāpam apahanti , brahmajñānena mokṣam āpnoti | tathā ca śrutiḥ –
vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca yas tad vedobhayaṃ saha |
avidyayā mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā vidyayāmṛtam aśnute ||
vidyāto ‘nyad avidyā karma mṛtyuvad duḥkhasādhanatvān mṛtyuḥ pāpaṃ | śrutyarthaṃ evāyaṃ manunā vyākhyāyoktaḥ || 12.104 ||
pratyakṣaṃ cānumānaṃ ca śāstraṃ ca vividhāgamam |
trayaṃ suviditaṃ kāryaṃ dharmaśuddhim abhīpsatā || 12.105 ||
pratyakṣam iti | dharmasya tattvāvabodham icchatā pratyakṣam anumānaṃ ca dharmasādhanabhūtadravyaguṇajātitattvajñānāya śāstraṃ ca vedamūlaṃ smṛtyādirūpaṃ nānāprakāradharmasvarūpavijñānāya suviditaṃ kartavyam | tad eva ca pramāṇatrayaṃ manor abhimatam | upamānārthāpattyādeś cānumānāntarbhāvaḥ || 12.105 ||
ārṣaṃ dharmopadeśaṃ ca vedaśāstrāvirodhinā |
yas tarkeṇānusaṃdhatte sa dharmaṃ veda netaraḥ || 12.106 ||
ārṣam iti | ṛṣidṛṣṭatvād ārṣaṃ vedaṃ dharmopadeśaṃ ca tanmūlasmṛtyādikaṃ yas tadaviruddhena mīmāṃsādinyāyena vicārayati sa dharmaṃ jānāti na tu mīmāṃsānabhijñaḥ | dharme karaṇaṃ vedaḥ, mīmāṃsā cetikartavyatāsthānīyā | tad uktaṃ bhaṭṭavārtikakṛtā –
dharme pramīyamāṇe hi vedena karaṇātmanā |
itikartavyatābhāgaṃ mīmāṃsā pūrayiṣyati ||
|| 12.106 ||
naiḥśreyasam idaṃ karma yathoditam aśeṣataḥ |
mānavasyāsya śāstrasya rahasyam upadiśyate || 12.107 ||
naiḥśreyasam iti | etan niḥśreyasasādhanaṃ karma niḥśeṣeṇa yathāvad uditam | ata ūrdhvam asya mānavaśāstrasya rahasyaṃ gopanīyam idaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ śṛṇuta || 12.107 ||
asya śāstrasyāsamastadharmābhidhānam āśaṅkyānayā sāmānyoktyā samagradharmopadeśakatvaṃ bodhayati –
anāmnāteṣu dharmeṣu kathaṃ syād iti ced bhavet |
yaṃ śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā brūyuḥ sa dharmaḥ syād aśaṅkitaḥ || 12.108 ||
anāmnāteṣv iti | sāmānyavidhiprāpteṣu viśeṣeṇānupadiṣṭeṣu kathaṃ kartavyaṃ syād iti yadi saṃśayo bhavet tadā yaṃ dharmaṃ vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇāḥ śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā brūyuḥ sa tatra niścito dharmaḥ syāt || 12.108 ||
dharmeṇādhigato yais tu vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ |
te śiṣṭā brāhmaṇā jñeyāḥ śrutipratyakṣahetavaḥ || 12.109 ||
dharmeṇeti | brahmacaryādyuktadharmeṇa yair aṅgamīmāṃsādharmaśāstrapurāṇādy-upabṛṃhito vedo ‘dhigatas te brāhmaṇāḥ śruteḥ pratyakṣīkaraṇe hetavaḥ, ye śrutiṃ paṭhitvā tadartham upadiśanti te śiṣṭā vijñeyāḥ || 12.109 ||
daśāvarā vā pariṣad yaṃ dharmaṃ parikalpayet |
tryavarā vāpi vṛttasthā taṃ dharmaṃ na vicālayet || 12.110 ||
[purāṇaṃ mānavo dharmaḥ sāṅgopāṅgacikitsakaḥ |
ājñāsiddhāni catvāri na hantavyāni hetubhiḥ || ]
daśeti | yadi bahavaḥ santo ‘vahitā na bhavanti tadā daśāvarā tryavarāś ceti vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇā yasyāḥ sā pariṣat tadabhāve trayo ‘varā yasyāḥ sā vā sadācārā yaṃ dharmaṃ niścinuyāt taṃ dharmatvena svīkuryān na visaṃvadet || 12.110 ||
traividyo hetukas tarkī nairukto dharmapāṭhakaḥ |
trayaś cāśramiṇaḥ pūrve pariṣat syād daśāvarā || 12.111 ||
traividya iti | vedatrayasaṃbandhiśākhātrayādhyetā śrutismṛtyaviruddhanyāyaśāstrajñaḥ, mīmāṃsātmakatarkavit, niruktajñaḥ, mānavādidharmaśāstravedī, brahmacārī, gṛhasthavānaprasthau ity eṣā daśāvarā pariṣat syāt || 12.111 ||
ṛgvedavid yajurvic ca sāmavedavid eva ca |
tryavarā pariṣaj jñeyā dharmasaṃśayanirṇaye || 12.112 ||
ṛgvedavid iti | ṛgyajuḥsāmavedaśākhānāṃ ye ‘dyetāras tadarthajñāś ca trayaḥ sā dharmasaṃdehanirāsārthaṃ tryavarā pariṣad boddhavyā || 12.112 ||
tadabhāve –
eko ‘pi vedavid dharmaṃ yaṃ vyavasyed dvijottamaḥ |
sa vijñeyaḥ paro dharmo nājñānām udito ‘yutaiḥ || 12.113 ||
eko ‘pīti | eko ‘pi vedārthadharmajño yaṃ dharmaṃ niścinuyāt prakṛṣṭo dharmaḥ sa boddhavyo na vedānabhijñānāṃ daśabhiḥ sahasrair apy uktaḥ | ‘vedavit’śabdo ‘yaṃ vedārthadharmajñaparaḥ | etac ca śreṣṭhopalakṣaṇam | smṛtipurāṇamīmāṃsānyāyaśāstrajño ‘pi guruparaṃparopadeśavic ca jñeyaḥ | tathā –
kevalaṃ śāsram āśritya na kartavyo vinirṇayaḥ |
yuktihīnavicāre tu dharmahāniḥ prajāyate ||
tena bahusmṛtijño ‘pi yadi samyaṅ prāyaścittādharmaṃ jānāti tadā tenāpy ekena dharma uktaḥ prakṣṭo dharmo jñeyaḥ | ata eva yamaḥ –
eko dvau vā trayo vāpi yad brūyur dharmapāṭhakāḥ |
sa dharma iti vijñeyo netareṣāṃ sahasraśaḥ ||
|| 12.113 ||
avratānām amantrāṇāṃ jātimātropajīvinām |
sahasraśaḥ sametānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ na vidyate || 12.114 ||
avratānām iti | sāvitryādibrahmacārivratarahitānāṃ, mantravedādhyayanarahitānāṃ, brāhmaṇajātimātradhāriṇāṃ, bahūnām api militānāṃ pariṣattvaṃ nāsti, dharmanirṇayasāmarthyābhāvāt || 12.114 ||
yaṃ vadanti tamobhūtā mūrkhā dharmam atadvidaḥ |
tat pāpaṃ śatadhā bhūtvā tadvaktṝn anugacchati || 12.115 ||
yaṃ vadantīti | tamoguṇabahulā mūrkhāḥ dharmapramāṇavedārthānabhijñā ata eva praśnaviṣayadharmāvidaḥ prāyaścittādidharmaṃ yaṃ puruṣaṃ praty upadiśanti tadīyaṃ pāpaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhūtvā vācakān bahūn bhajeta || 12.115 ||
etad vo ‘bhihitaṃ sarvaṃ niḥśreyasakaraṃ param |
asmād apracyuto vipraḥ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 12.116 ||
etad va iti | etan niḥśreyasasādhakaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ dharmādikaṃ sarvaṃ yuṣmākam abhihitam | etad anutiṣṭhan brāhmaṇādiḥ paramāṃ gatiṃ svargāpavargarūpāṃ prāpnoti || 12.116 ||
evaṃ sa bhagavān devo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
dharmasya paramaṃ guhyaṃ mamedaṃ sarvam uktavān || 12.117 ||
evam iti | sa bhagavān aiśvaryādisaṃyukto dyotanād devo manur uktaprakāreṇedaṃ sarvaṃ dharmasya paramārthaṃ śuśrūṣuśiṣyebhyaḥ agopanīyaṃ lokahitecchayā mamedaṃ sarvam uktavān iti bhṛgur maharṣīn āha || 12.117 ||
evam upasaṃhṛtya maharṣīṇāṃ hitāyoktam apy ātmajñānaṃ prakṛṣṭamokṣopakārakatayā pṛthak kṛtyāha –
sarvam ātmani saṃpaśyet sac cāsac ca samāhitaḥ |
sarvaṃ hy ātmani saṃpaśyan nādharme kurute manaḥ || 12.118 ||
sarvam iti | sadbhāvam asadbhāvaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇo jānan, brahmasvarūpam ātmany upasthitaṃ tadātmakam ananyamanā dhyānaprakarṣeṇa sākṣāt kuryāt | yasmāt sarvam ātmatvena paśyan rāgadveṣābhāvād adharme mano na kurute || 12.118 ||
etad eva spaṣṭayati –
ātmaiva devatāḥ sarvāḥ sarvam ātmany avasthitam |
ātmā hi janayaty eṣāṃ karmayogaṃ śarīriṇām || 12.119 ||
ātmaiveti | indrādyāḥ sarvadevatāḥ paramātmaiva sarvātmatvāt paramātmanaḥ | savaṃ jagad ātmany evāvasthitaṃ paramātmapariṇāmatvāt | hir avadhāraṇārthe | paramātmaivaiṣāṃ kṣetrajñādīnāṃ karmasaṃbandhaṃ janayati | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Kau. Brā.): “eṣa hy eva sādhu karma kārayati yam ūrdhvaṃ ninīṣati | eṣa hy evāsādhu karma kārayati yam adho ninīṣati” iti
|| 12.119 ||
idānīṃ vakṣyamāṇabrahmadhyānaviśeṣopayogitayā daihikākāśādiṣu bāhyākāśādīnāṃ
layam āha –
khaṃ saṃniveśayet kheṣu ceṣṭanasparśane ‘nilam |
paktidṛṣṭyoḥ paraṃ tejaḥ snehe ‘po gāṃ ca mūrtiṣu || 12.120 ||
manasīnduṃ diśaḥ śrotre krānte viṣṇuṃ bale haram |
vācy agniṃ mitram utsarge prajane ca prajāpatim || 12.121 ||
kham iti | manasīti | bāhyākāśam udarādyavacchinnaśarīrākāśeṣu līnam ekatvena dhārayet | tathā ceṣṭāsparśakāraṇabhūtadaihikavāyau bāhyavāyuṃ, audaryacākṣutejasor agnisūryayoḥ prakṛṣṭaṃ tejaḥ, daihikāsv apsu bāhyāḥ apaḥ, bāhyāḥ pṛthivyādayaḥ śarīrapārthivabhāgeṣu, manasi candraṃ, śrotre diśaḥ, pādendriye viṣṇuṃ, bale haraṃ, vāgindriye ‘gniṃ, pāyvindriye mitraṃ, upasthendriye prajāpatiṃ līnam ekatvena bhāvayet || 12.120–121 ||
evam ādhyātmikabhūtādikaṃ līnam ekatvena bhāvayitvā –
praśāsitāraṃ sarveṣām aṇīyāṃsam aṇor api |
rukmābhaṃ svapnadhīgamyaṃ vidyāt taṃ puruṣaṃ param || 12.122 ||
praśāsitāram iti | praśāsitāraṃ niyantāraṃ brahmādistambaparyantasya cetanācetanasya jāter yo ‘yam agnyādīnām auṣṇyādiniyamo yaś cādityādīnāṃ bhramaṇādiniyamo yac ca karmaṇāṃ phalaṃ pratiniyatam etat sarvaṃ paramātmādhīnam | tathā ca “etasyaivākṣarasya praśāsane gārgi” (BṛĀrUp 3.8.9) ityādyupaniṣadaḥ | tathā
bhayād asyāgnis tapati bhayāt tapati sūryaḥ |
bhayād indraś ca vāyuś ca mṛtyur dhāvati pañcamaḥ || iti |
tathā “aṇor aṇīyāṃsaṃ” sarvātmatvāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ (Śve. Up.):
vālāgraśatabhāgasya śatadhākalpitasya ca |
bhāgo jīveti vijñeyaḥ sa cānantyāya kalpate ||
rukmābham | yady api “aśabdam asparśam arūpam avyayam” (Kāṭ. Up. 1.3.15) ityādyupaniṣadā rūpaṃ paramātmano niṣiddhaṃ tathāpy upāsanāviśeṣe śuddhasuvarṇābham | ata eva “ya eṣo ‘ntarādite hiraṇmaya” (Ch.Up 1.6.6) ityādichāndogyopaniṣat | svapnadhīgamyaṃ dṛṣṭānto ‘yam, svapnadhīsadṛśajñānagrāhyam | yathā svapnadhīś cakṣurādibāhyendriyoparame manomātreṇa janyata evam ātmadhīr api | ata eva vyāsaḥ:
naivāsau cakṣuṣā grāhyo na ca śiṣṭair apīndriyaiḥ |
manasā tu prasannena gṛhyate sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ ||
evaṃvidhaṃ parātmānam anucintayet || 12.122 ||
etam eke vadanty agniṃ manum anye prajāpatim |
indram eke pare prāṇam apare brahma śāśvatam || 12.123 ||
etam iti | etaṃ ca paramātmānam agnitvenaike yājñikā upāsate | tathā “tam ekam agnim” ity adhvaryava upāsate | anye punaḥ sraṣṭṛtvāt sraṣṭākhyaprajāpatirūpatayopāsate | eke punar aiśvaryayogād indrarūpatayopāsate | apare punaḥ prāṇatvenopāsate | “sarvāṇi bhūrādīnīmāni bhūtāni prāṇam evābhisaṃviśanti prāṇam abhyujjihataḥ” ityādiśrutidarśanāt | apare punar apagataprapañcātmakaṃ saccidānandasvarūpaṃ paramātmānam upāsate | mūrtāmūrtasvarūpe ca brahmaṇi sarvā evopāsanāḥ śrutiprasiddhā bhavanti || 12.123 ||
eṣa sarvāṇi bhūtāni pañcabhir vyāpya mūrtibhiḥ |
janmavṛddhikṣayair nityaṃ saṃsārayati cakravat || 12.124 ||
eṣa iti | eṣa ātmā sarvān prāṇinaḥ pañcabhiḥ pṛthivyādibhir mahābhūtaiḥ śarīrārambhakaiḥ parigṛhya pūrvajanmārjitakarmāpekṣayotpattisthitivināśai rathādicakravad asakṛdupāvartamānair ā mokṣāt saṃsāriṇaḥ karoti || 12.124 ||
idānīṃ mokṣatvenoktasarvadharmaśreṣṭhatayā sarvatra paramātmadarśanam anuṣtheyatvenopasaṃharati –
evaṃ yaḥ sarvabhūteṣu paśyaty ātmānam ātmanā |
sa sarvasamatām etya brahmābhyeti paraṃ padam || 12.125 ||
[caturvedasamaṃ puṇyam asya śāstrasya dhāraṇāt |
bhūyo vāpy atiricyeta pāpaniryātanaṃ mahat || ]
evaṃ yaḥ sarvabūteṣv iti | evaṃ “sarvabhūteṣu cātmānam” (12.9) ityādyuktaprakāreṇa yaḥ sarvabhūteṣv avasthitam ātmānam ātmanā paśyati sa brahmasākṣātkārāt paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ padaṃ sthānaṃ brahma prāpnoti | tatrātyantaṃ līyate, mukto bhavatīty arthaḥ || 12.125 ||
ity etan mānavaṃ śāstraṃ bhṛguproktaṃ paṭhan dvijaḥ |
bhavaty ācāravān nityaṃ yatheṣṭāṃ prāpnuyād gatim || 12.126 ||
[manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo devaḥ sarvaśāstrārthapāragaḥ |
tasyāsyanirgataṃ dharmaṃ vicārya bahuvistaram ||
ye paṭhanti dvijāḥ kecit sarvapāpopaśāntidam |
te gacchanti paraṃ sthānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sadma śāśvatam || ]
iti mānave dharmaśāstre bhṛguproktāyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ
dvādaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ |
ity etad iti | samāptyartham itiśabdaḥ | etat smṛtiśāstraṃ bhṛguṇā prakarṣeṇoktaṃ dvijātiḥ paṭhan vihitānuṣṭhānaniṣiddhavarjanāt sadācāravān bhavati | yathāpekṣitāṃ ca svargāpavargādirūpāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuyād iti || 12.126 ||
sārāsāravacaḥprapañcanavidhau medhātitheś cāturī
stokaṃ vastu nigūḍham alpavacanād govindarājo jagau |
granthe ‘smin dharaṇīdharasya bahuśaḥ svātantryam etāvatā
spaṣṭaṃ mānavam arthatattvam akhilaṃ vaktuṃ kṛto ‘yaṃ śramaḥ ||1||
prāyo munibhir vivṛtaṃ kathayaty eṣā manusmṛter artham |
daśabhir granthasahasraiḥ saptadaśayutā kṛtā vṛttiḥ || 2 ||
seyaṃ mayā mānavadharmaśāstre vyadhāyi vṛttir viduṣāṃ hitāya |
durbodhajāter duritakṣayāya bhūyāt tato me jagatām adhīśaḥ || 3 ||
iti vārendrinandanāvāsīyadivākarātmajaśrīmatkullūkabhaṭṭakṛtāyāṃ
manvarthamuktāvalyāṃ manuvṛttau
dvādaśo ‘dhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ ||
iti śrīkullūkabhaṭṭaviracitā manvarthamuktāvalī samāptā |
